Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Multi-Heart Black
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Multi-Heart Black is part of the creative partnership of Converse and Comme des Garcons, a Tokyo-based streetwear label sought after for its deconstructed aesthetic and monochromatic colorways. The sneaker takes the Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi silhouette and applies Comme des Garcons signature heart motifs to the black canvas upper. Each heart comes with eyes and features a bright red hue. Six hearts form a line above the rubber outsole on the later side, while the medial side panel only displays three hearts and the Converse All Star logo. The sneaker features seven pairs of metal eyelets that house off-white laces. Our StockX experts appreciate the contrasting stitching on the upper, which comes in white thread. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Multi-Heart Black was launched on October 26th, 2023, and sold for $150.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC RGD Ironclad Black
Description: The ASICS Gel NYC RGD Ironclad Black blends modern street ready design with classic running cues in a palette that feels rugged and composed. Ironclad tones layer over Black, creating depth across the mesh and synthetic overlays. The chunky midsole and visible cushioning give the silhouette that unmistakable tech runner stance that has defined the Gel NYC line. What makes this pair stand out is its balance between utility and lifestyle. The darker color story gives it a tougher edge, making it easy to integrate into everyday wear without losing performance credibility. Fans of the Gel NYC appreciate how it merges archival inspiration with contemporary proportions, and this Ironclad Black execution feels especially versatile and durable. The ASICS Gel NYC RGD Ironclad Black was released on September 19, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Black Toe Medium Olive
Description: Slicker than your average, the Jordan 1 Low Black Toe Medium Olive is an instant classic kick. The perfect lifestyle sneaker to fit the wardrobes of modern streetwear fans, clean lines and simplicity of design make this shoe a must-have for collectors. The bar has been risen with the Air Jordan 1 Lows. In sophisticated olive, black and white on the colorways, the Black Toe Mediu m Olive Jordan 1 Low is as elegant as it is functional. As a low-top, the shoe provides a mature silhouette, whilst still throwing a nod to the athletic stylings of the original Air Jordan shape. The Jumpman logo features on the tongue and the Wings logo is branded on the back heel, making these leather sneakers minimalist and a fantastic heritage addition to your footwear collection. We love the strong, yet understated design of these low Air Jordans. A great pair for your lifestyle sneaker collection, the colors make them suitable for dressier occasions, work, or dates. The Jordan 1 Low Black Toe Medium Olive was released on 20 September 2024, priced at $115.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Pure Silver (GS)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Black Pure Silver (GS) brings heritage running style to the everyday pace of growing feet. Inspired by late-2000s performance silhouettes, this grade-school design pairs breathable mesh with sturdy synthetic overlays in a sharp Black/Pure Silver colorway for a sleek, versatile look that moves from classroom to playground with ease. A cushioned midsole with signature GEL technology softens each step, while the supportive build helps keep strides stable during long days on the go. Reflective accents and a layered panel construction add visual depth, delivering a modern twist on a beloved classic. Underfoot, a durable rubber outsole with reliable traction grips sidewalks and gym floors alike, making this model a smart pick for active routines and weekend adventures. The padded tongue and collar enhance all-day comfort, and the streamlined profile slips easily into school and sport rotations. Finished with ASICS branding and the style code 1204A169-001, the Gel-1130 offers an elevated blend of comfort, support, and street-ready appeal that complements everything from uniforms to athletic wear. Whether its daily wear or after-school practice, this pair balances stability and cushioning so kids can focus on fun, not foot fatigue. Our team thinks this product is great for young wearers who need dependable comfort, standout style, and day-to-day durability in one easy choice.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Zion Williamson Voodoo Alternate (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Zion Williamson Voodoo Alternate GS expands the Voodoo universe with a darker and more mysterious twist that feels deeply connected to Zions storytelling approach. The mix of purple, green, and black creates a layered and almost ritualistic vibe, giving the shoe personality far beyond a standard colorway. In grade school sizing, the design still carries the same intrigue and depth as the adult versions. Collectors love this pair because it treats the Jordan 1 as a narrative canvas. The Voodoo theme rewards attention to detail, appealing to fans who appreciate symbolism and mood in sneaker design. It stands out as one of those releases that feels intentionally strange and expressive, offering younger collectors a chance to own a truly character driven Jordan that breaks from tradition while still respecting the silhouettes roots. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Zion Williamson Voodoo Alternate GS was released on October 29, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Red Oreo
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Red Oreo features a white tumbled leather and perforated Durabuck construction with a matching mesh and rubber tongue. Hits of red with white speckles on the heel tab and midsole nod to the spray-paint styling of the 2010 Air Jordan 6 Oreo. From there, an icy semi translucent outsole completes the design. The Air Jordan 6 Red Oreo released in June of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 40 Dusty Rose
Description: The Air Jordan 40 Dusty Rose introduces a refined and contemporary tone to the latest chapter in the Jordan performance lineage. Light arctic pink wraps the upper with a soft yet confident presence, balanced by anthracite and black accents that anchor the silhouette in modern contrast. The design feels sleek and forward thinking, blending streamlined proportions with layered detailing that highlights the evolution of Jordan Brands basketball identity. It carries a calm but commanding energy that feels intentional rather than flashy. Collectors appreciate the Jordan 40 for marking a milestone moment in the franchises progression. The dusty rose inspired palette gives this iteration personality without overwhelming its performance roots. Fans gravitate toward the balance of subtle color and bold structure, making it wearable both on and off the court. It stands as a statement of growth within the Jordan line, pairing innovation with expressive but controlled color storytelling. The Air Jordan 40 Dusty Rose was released on September 20, 2025 with a retail price of $205.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 White Black Red (Women's)
Description: The adidas adizero adios pro 4 White Black Red Womens delivers a classic and high contrast color combination on a performance focused silhouette built for speed. The cloud white base provides a clean and bright look, while core black and red accents add structure and energy across the design. The overall feel is sharp and balanced, emphasizing both form and function. Fans of the Adios Pro line appreciate how traditional color combinations like this keep the design timeless while still delivering top tier performance. The mix of white, black, and red creates a familiar and versatile look. It is a sneaker that reflects consistency and innovation within adidas running lineup. The adidas adizero adios pro 4 White Black Red Womens was released on November 8, 2024 with a retail price of $250.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Tokyo T23 (2025)
Description: The Jordan 5 Retro Tokyo T23 (2025) carries one of the most legendary stories in sneaker history. First seen in 2011 as a tribute to the opening of the Jordan Tokyo23 boutique in Japan, the silhouette instantly became a grail thanks to its striking design and extreme rarity. The 2025 reissue draws inspiration not only from that release but also from the unreleased "Yellow Toe" sample that surfaced during the original run, giving fans a long-awaited chance to lace up a piece of sneaker lore. With a vivid yellow suede upper, this Jordan 5 Retro commands attention from every angle. Contrasting wolf grey hits at the tongue, side netting, and eyelets create balance against the bold base, while black accents on the laces, heel, and iconic shark tooth midsole bring in sharp definition. A standout detail is the embroidered Kanji character on the heel, a nod to its Japanese roots and a detail that cements its place as one of the most culturally significant Air Jordan 5 colorways. This mix of bright tones, subtle neutrals, and symbolic branding makes the Tokyo T23 unlike anything else in the Jordan archive. The Jordan 5 Retro Tokyo T23 (2025) released on September 27, 2025, at a retail price of $215. Arriving in a yellow, multi-color palette with wolf grey and black accents, this drop bridged past and present with fresh storytelling and timeless design. For collectors and sneaker enthusiasts alike, this pair represents more than a colorway. its a continuation of one of the most celebrated chapters in Jordan Brand history.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Blueberry
Description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro Blueberry reimagines an iconic design with a fresh twist, fusing heritage and modernity in a bold new colorway. Inspired by the original Cherry Air Jordan 12, this version trades vibrant red for an eye-catching game royal blue, paired with a clean white upper and subtle black accents. The smooth white leather upper provides a crisp canvas, while textured overlays and silver metal eyelets bring the classic silhouette to life. Every detail of the Blueberry speaks to Jordan Brands unmatched craftsmanship. Black hits on the tongue, inner lining, and heel tab add contrast, while game royal blue pops on branding elements and textured mudguardsgiving the sneaker its "Blueberry" moniker. The result is a harmonious balance of style and functionality, perfect for fans looking to elevate their collection or turn heads on the streets. Set to release on December 18, 2024, the Air Jordan 12 Retro Blueberry carries a retail price of $210. This fresh take on the classic Air Jordan 12 combines nostalgia and innovation, making it an essential pick for sneakerheads and collectors alike.

Display Name: adidas Campus Light Bad Bunny Chalky Brown
Description: The adidas Campus Light Bad Bunny Chalky Brown is a notable collaboration between adidas and the Latin music superstar  Bad Bunny. The sneaker adopts a classic low-top silhouette with clean lines in a blend of and beige, brown, and Cream White hues. The Bad Bunny Chalky Brown adidas Campus Light incorporates a brown suede upper with a textured finish, complemented by matching 3-Stripe branding. It also features a unique double-tongue construction. The shoe boasts an updated cream-colored rubber mudguard that transitions seamlessly from a wavy pattern into a sturdy rubber cup sole. Underneath, the outsole showcases a herringbone traction pattern for reliable grip. The branding is minimalistic, with the iconic adidas 3-Stripes on the sides and Bad Bunny's recognizable logo on the tongue. What our experts find most impressive about the adidas Campus Light Bad Bunny Chalky Brown is the collaboration between the giant sportswear brand and the Latin music superstar Bad Bunny. This sneaker represents a fusion of Bad Bunny's distinctive style and the classic adidas Campus silhouette, making it ideal for fans of both fashion and music. The adidas sneaker debuted for $160 on July 29th, 2023.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Medium Olive (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Medium Olive GS delivers earthy contrast through a Medium Olive upper balanced by Summit White, Sail, and Black accents. The low profile OG cut preserves the original proportions that made the AJ1 a global staple, while the olive tone introduces a grounded and versatile edge. Clean color blocking highlights the silhouettes timeless panel layout. This GS release resonates because it blends subtle personality with heritage structure. The olive shade feels mature and adaptable, making it easy to style while still standing apart from more common palettes. Younger fans get access to an OG inspired build that honors the models roots. It is a confident and wearable take on a classic that continues to evolve across generations. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Medium Olive GS was released on January 31, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Converse SHAI 001 Lux Truffle
Description: The Converse SHAI 001 Lux Truffle introduces a refined and minimalist take on performance driven design. Dressed in layered brown tones, the Lux Truffle colorway enhances the streamlined silhouette with warmth and depth. The clean structure and understated finish give the sneaker a premium feel, balancing modern basketball influence with lifestyle versatility. What makes this pair compelling is its tonal execution. The brown on brown palette feels mature and cohesive, allowing the shape and detailing to stand out without distraction. It reflects a forward looking approach to athlete signature footwear, blending contemporary style with understated confidence. The Converse SHAI 001 Lux Truffle was released on February 26, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Flight Club (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Flight Club GS brings the same heritage driven design into a smaller size range, maintaining the full visual impact of the original release. The black and sail upper provides that timeless base, while gum medium brown underfoot adds a subtle vintage feel that complements the overall palette. University red accents deliver just enough contrast to keep the design dynamic while staying true to the classic Air Jordan identity. Fans appreciate that the GS version does not compromise on the details that make the Flight Club colorway appealing. It offers the same balance of tradition and freshness, allowing younger collectors or those needing smaller sizing to access a release that feels just as complete. The Air Jordan 1 remains a cornerstone of sneaker culture, and this version continues that legacy with a thoughtful and wearable execution. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Flight Club GS was released on April 11, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan Spizike Low Black Cat
Description: The Jordan Spizike Low Black Cat continues the legacy of Michael Jordan and director Spike Lees partnership by applying an all-black colorway to the Air Jordan Spizike Low. This shoe pays homage to Lees contributions to film history and the iconic triple-black "Black Cat" colorway, known for its sleek, stealthy look. Taking elements from previous Air Jordan sneakers, including the Air Jordan 3, 4, 5, and 6, this version of the Spizike boasts soft cushioning in the tongue and collar. Velvety nubuck deepens the blacks rich hue, while the mudguard is crafted from suede and the heel and toe overlays display the signature elephant print. Our experts like the way the all-black aesthetic reaches the shiny midsole and durable rubber outsole. In addition, visible air units in the heel complete the look and speak to the sneakers Jordan-brand heritage. The Jordan Spizike Low Black Cat was released on June 11, 2024, and sold for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Element Gore-Tex Medium Olive
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Element Gore Tex Medium Olive leans into earthy tones and outdoor readiness, giving the Jordan 1 Low a grounded and adventurous personality. The medium olive palette feels natural and utilitarian, perfectly matching the Element Gore Tex build that emphasizes protection and versatility. It feels calm, confident, and purpose driven. Collectors appreciate this pair because it blends lifestyle heritage with practical design. The Jordan 1 Low remains instantly recognizable, while the weather ready construction makes it more adaptable to real world use. Fans love it as a reminder that iconic silhouettes can evolve thoughtfully, staying relevant through function and subtle color storytelling rather than trend driven changes. The Air Jordan 1 Low Element Gore Tex Medium Olive was released on October 9, 2025 with a retail price of $205.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 At Dawn
Description: The Nike Ja 3 At Dawn brings a vibrant and energetic color story to Ja Morants signature line, reflecting his explosive style of play. The black base provides a strong foundation, while baltic blue, total orange, and hyper pink accents create a dynamic and layered look. The silhouette feels responsive and fast, designed to match the speed and creativity associated with Jas game. Fans of the Ja line appreciate how each release captures a sense of movement and personality through bold color combinations. This version stands out for its contrast and energy, making it visually striking both on and off the court. It is a sneaker that blends performance intent with expressive design, continuing the momentum of the signature series. The Nike Ja 3 At Dawn was released on March 19, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide .SWOOSH Touch Grass Kelly Green
Description: The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide .SWOOSH Touch Grass Kelly Green blends recovery focused comfort with playful cultural commentary through a bold and expressive design. The ReactX foam construction prioritizes softness and reset, while the Kelly green colorway and .SWOOSH Touch Grass theme add humor and personality. It feels lighthearted but intentional, turning a recovery slide into something visually engaging rather than purely functional. Fans love this slide because it reflects modern sneaker cultures balance between performance and self awareness. The bright green tone stands out, while the sculpted shape keeps it comfortable for everyday wear and post activity recovery. Collectors appreciate how Nike treats even its slides as storytelling pieces, making this one feel fun, relevant, and perfectly in tune with the moment. The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide .SWOOSH Touch Grass Kelly Green was released on December 19, 2025 with a retail price of $75.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Sequoia
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Sequoia is a performance shoe providing unmatched support with a dark colorway. This iteration of the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 has an upper made of breathable dark green mesh. Black suede overlays run from the toe to the laces for support, while black leather forms the toe cap. The sides of the shoe contain black TPU cages with reflective silver Nike swooshes on top for added safety. The heel is also supported by a TPU cage and thereÄôs a Nike swoosh above it. The tongue contains Nike Vomero 5 branding in yellow. The black midsole and outsole complete the look. The standout feature of this shoe is the dark green mesh base, which blends perfectly into the black of the rest of the shoe. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Sequoia was first released on October 5, 2024, for $160.

Display Name: Nike Mind 001 Slide Light Smoke Grey
Description: Nike Mind 001 Slide Light Smoke Grey reflects a quieter side of Nike design, focusing on recovery, comfort, and mental balance rather than performance intensity. The Light Smoke Grey finish keeps the look clean and minimal, aligning with the Mind 001 concept of slowing down and being intentional. It feels modern and thoughtful, designed for moments away from the spotlight rather than center stage. Collectors appreciate this slide because it represents a shift in how footwear is valued. The design feels purposeful without being loud, appealing to fans who care about wellness and lifestyle as part of sneaker culture. It fits naturally into daily routines, reinforcing the idea that good design does not need to shout to be meaningful or relevant. The Nike Mind 001 Slide Light Smoke Grey was released on 01/08/2026 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: adidas Samba Jane Scarlet White Gum (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba Jane in Scarlet White Gum (Womens) refreshes an icon with a fiery palette and a refined, feminine fit. Dressed in Better Scarlet and Team Victory Red with crisp white Three Stripes, this pair delivers bold color blocking that elevates everyday outfits and standout streetwear looks alike. A smooth leather upper is complemented by a suede T?toe overlay that nods to the Sambas sport heritage, while a low?profile shape and padded collar provide an easy, all?day wear. The classic gum rubber outsole offers confident grip and a timeless finish, pairing effortlessly with denim, dresses, or tailored basics. Beyond style, the Samba Jane is built for comfort and versatility. A cushioned insole and lightweight midsole help soften every step, making it a reliable choice from morning commute to evening plans. The durable gum sole resists scuffs and delivers traction on city sidewalks, and thoughtful stitching along the panels adds structure that keeps its shape over time. Finished with adidas branding, style code JQ6446, and launched on June 1, 2025, this womens sneaker stands out as a wardrobe staple that bridges classic design with modern polish. Our team loves this product because it blends timeless Samba DNA with everyday comfort and a striking red-and-gum palette that instantly sharpens any rotation.

Display Name: Nike Air Trainer SC High Atlanta Olympics 30th Anniversary
Description: The Nike Air Trainer SC High Atlanta Olympics 30th Anniversary in Pro Purple, White, Sail, and Metallic Gold commemorates the 1996 Atlanta Games through one of the most technically complete and culturally loaded cross-training silhouettes Nike has ever produced, the SC High's support structure and premium construction carrying the Olympic tribute with the institutional weight the occasion deserves. Pro purple and metallic gold reference the specific and deliberately regal color palette that the Atlanta Games deployed across its visual identity, while white and sail provide the clean contrast that keeps the Olympic color story legible and historically accurate rather than loosely interpreted. The Air Trainer SC High was a flagship Nike training shoe during the mid-1990s and its presence in an Atlanta Olympics tribute feels completely authentic to the era it is honoring. Thirty-year Olympic anniversary releases occupy a specific and emotionally resonant space in Nike's commemorative product history because they reconnect a new generation of collectors and athletes with Games that defined an era of American athletic culture while rewarding the collectors who lived through the original moment with a physical tribute to memories they carry personally. The SC High's leather and synthetic upper construction, prominent Air cushioning, and high-top support architecture all feel genuinely appropriate for an Olympic tribute that wants to honor both the Games and the athletic performance culture that surrounded them rather than simply applying a flag graphic to an unrelated silhouette. Metallic gold against pro purple creates a combination that carries championship associations as naturally as any color pairing in the Nike catalog. The Nike Air Trainer SC High Atlanta Olympics 30th Anniversary in Pro Purple, White, Sail, and Metallic Gold has a retail price of $140.

Display Name: adidas Mundial Team Black Cloud White
Description: The adidas Mundial Team Black Cloud White stands as a true classic in football culture, built on decades of performance and trust. The black upper paired with cloud white accents delivers a timeless look that has remained consistent across generations of players. It is a silhouette that prioritizes control and feel, staying true to the fundamentals of the game without chasing modern trends. What keeps the Mundial Team relevant is its focus on craftsmanship and reliability. The construction is built for touch and durability, making it a favorite for players who value precision over flash. It is more than just a boot, it is a piece of football history that continues to hold its place on pitches around the world. The adidas Mundial Team Black Cloud White was released on January 1, 1995 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére While You Were Sleeping (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére While You Were Sleeping (Women's) is the latest addition to the ongoing collaboration between Jordan Brand and A Ma Maniére, known for blending luxury materials with timeless designs. This release features a premium fossil stone upper constructed from high-quality suede and leather, creating a refined, yet edgy look. The contrasting black accents on the midsole adds depth to the design, while the iconic Jumpman flight tag appears on the tongue of one shoe, with the A Ma Maniére logo featured on the other. As part of the "While You Were Sleeping" capsule, this sneaker follows the popular Jordan 3 from August, continuing the collection's success. Inside, the quilted lining adds a luxurious touch, enhancing both comfort and style. The classic Nike Air logo on the heel, along with the special packaging, makes this release even more special for collectors. The Jordan 4 model has always been a cultural icon, and A Ma Maniére's touch only elevates its status further. Released on September 20, 2024, the Jordan 4 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére While You Were Sleeping (Women's) retailed at $225. This colorway encapsulates the luxurious feel of the collaboration, making it a standout addition to any sneaker collection. Whether you're drawn to the premium materials, the sleek design, or the significance of the Jordan 4 model, this release is set to leave a lasting impact in both fashion and sneaker culture.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Yellow Ochre
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Yellow Ochre is a low-top basketball sneaker whose design was inspired by the classic version that came out in 1985. This iteration of the Jordan 1 Low comes with an upper made completely of smooth leather. The midsole is black, while the heel and toebox appear in Yellow Ochre. The toebox is also perforated to allow for better air flow. The Nike Swoosh also appears in Yellow Ochre on the midsoles, and the Air Jordan logo is stamped onto the yellow heel in black. The black cushioned tongue also contains a Simple Yellow Jumpman logo. A white and yellow outsole patterned for traction completes the look. What we like most about this sneaker is its bold color scheme, reminiscent of the colors of Pittsburgh. The Jordan 1 Low Yellow Ochre was first introduced on December 18, 2023, for a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat (2025) (GS)
Description: Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat 2025 GS brings back one of the most respected Jordan silhouettes in a colorway that has always been about restraint and confidence. The Black Cat identity strips the Air Jordan 4 down to pure attitude, letting the shape, paneling, and proportions do all the work without relying on contrast or loud details. In grade school sizing, the shoe still carries the same aura as the original adult releases, making it feel serious and intentional rather than scaled down or playful. What makes the Black Cat special is how timeless it feels on foot and on shelf. The monochromatic approach highlights the Jordan 4s structure, from the mesh panels to the iconic wing eyelets, giving the shoe a clean and powerful presence. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it represents a moment where simplicity became the statement, proving that some colorways never lose relevance no matter how trends shift around them. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat 2025 GS was released on 11/28/2025with a retail price of $165

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Raging Bull Red (2021)
Description: 2021 marked 12 years since the Air Jordan 5 Defining Moments pack dropped, and in the same year, one-half of that pack resurfaced on the SNKRS app. The Air Jordan 5 Raging Bulls is a suede lovers dream, bringing back the same look and feel from the 2009 version. The upper is composed entirely out of red suede, celebrating MJs tenure with the Chicago Bulls. From there, a red and black embroidered "23" appears on the lateral side of each shoes heel, highlighting Jordans quintessential jersey number. In usual Jordan 5 fashion, the upper part of the tongue is made of reflective materials with a contrasting black Jumpman logo. Lastly, the models World War II fighter jet inspiration is made apparent from the white and red shark tooth details that lay atop a black midsole. The Air Jordan 5 Raging Bulls released in April of 2021 for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Oxidized Green (GS)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Oxidized Green (GS) is a child-sized basketball shoe crafted of premium materials with metallic details. Like the adult-sized version, the Oxidized Green (GS) Jordan 4 Retro features a smooth leather base in white with white mesh on the quarter panels and above the toebox. Metallic Green accents are on the free-floating eyestays and the panel running along the midsole. The sneaker offers additional padding around the ankle and a thick tongue, which contributes to the shoes bulky aesthetic. Visible Air units provide responsive cushioning, seen through windows in the heel. Finally, the rubber outsole increases traction and comes in Oxidized Green, white, and Neutral Grey. Our StockX experts like the sneakers minimal branding, including Jumpman logos on the oversized tongue and the heel. The grade school-sized Jordan 4 Retro Oxidized Green (GS) was released on June 15, 2024, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Black Pure Silver
Description: The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Black Pure Silver is a running shoe that pays homage to the style of the late 2000s with updated materials and construction. This version of the ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 is made with a black mesh upper for breathability. Synthetic leather overlays can be seen across the midsole in black and silver forming the classic ASICS design. There are also black overlays around the toebox and heel for extra support. The ASICS logo appears in silver on the cushioned tongue, and GEL branding appears in silver on the heel. The shoe is equipped with a TRUSSTIC support system and trademark Gel cushioning for comfort and shock absorption. What makes these shoes stand out is the black colorway. The black with a few accents of silver elevates these shoes from a simple running shoe to a stylish fashion choice. The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Black Pure Silver was released on January 1, 2024, for a price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Black University Blue
Description: The Air Jordan 13 Retro University Blue takes on the "Black Cat" silhouette that debuted in 1998. The upper of this Retro Air Jordan 13 sneaker features black mesh and leather with blue suede overlays. The black tongue and black insole each feature a blue Jumpman and the toe box sports Jordan branding at the bottom of the laces. The panther eye on the lateral-side collar has a holographic finish. The blue midsole has black curving up onto it from the outsole. The outsole, designed to look like a panther paw, features Jumpman and AIR units. The Air Jordan 13 Retro University Blue was released on December 23rd, 2022 at $200 retail.

Display Name: Brooks Ghost 17 runDisney Winnie the Pooh (Women's)
Description: The Brooks Ghost 17 runDisney Winnie the Pooh Womens brings performance running together with one of the most beloved character worlds, creating a shoe that feels both functional and expressive. The honey yellow base with red and orange accents draws directly from Winnie the Poohs color palette, giving the shoe a playful identity while still maintaining the structure of a serious running model. The Ghost line is known for comfort and consistency, and this version keeps that foundation intact. This release stands out because it connects performance footwear with storytelling in a way that feels approachable. Runners who enjoy themed designs can appreciate the character inspiration without losing the technical reliability Brooks is known for. It is a unique crossover that blends comfort, familiarity, and personality into one design. The Brooks Ghost 17 runDisney Winnie the Pooh Womens was released on April 23, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: adidas Adizero EVO SL EXO White Black Silver
Description: The adidas Adizero EVO SL EXO White Black Silver delivers a clean and high contrast performance silhouette through a bright and structured color palette. The white base creates a crisp and lightweight look, while black and silver accents define the lines of the shoe and add depth. The EXO construction emphasizes a more technical and layered feel, reinforcing its modern design direction. Fans of the Adizero line appreciate how this version balances simplicity with performance focused detailing. The contrast between white and black keeps it visually sharp, while silver adds a subtle edge. It is a sneaker that reflects adidas commitment to speed, clarity, and contemporary design. The adidas Adizero EVO SL EXO White Black Silver was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Concrete Pure Silver
Description: The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 in Concrete Pure Silver is a sportstyle lifestyle sneaker built on the GEL-KAYANO 14 silhouette that was originally developed as a high-performance stability running shoe in the late 2000s and became the first iteration in the GEL-KAYANO series to be designed by someone other than Toshikazu Kayano, resurfacing in 2026 with its late 2000s technical aesthetic preserved through a light concrete grey open mesh base, metallic Pure Silver overlays covering the toe, eyestays, and midfoot, translucent silver Tiger Stripes that blend seamlessly with the shoe's layered panel approach, a sculpted heel counter in cream and champagne tones framed by subtle gold accents around the GEL branding in the rear, and a segmented midsole structure underfoot that gives the shoe its distinctly industrial and technically layered visual identity. The GEL technology cushioning positioned at the heel provides the shock absorption that defined the GEL-KAYANO performance platform across its history, while the TRUSSTIC support system preserves the midfoot stability architecture that positioned the GEL-KAYANO as one of ASICS's most trusted stability running platforms for runners requiring pronation support across long-distance training. The Concrete Pure Silver colorway stays within the grey-silver metallic palette family that the GEL-Kayano 14 has consistently returned to across its sportstyle reissue history, with the industrial grey and metallic silver combination creating the most visually coherent and technically authentic expression of the shoe's late 2000s engineering aesthetic without introducing seasonal color contrasts that would date the shoe to a specific era outside its own design period. The GEL-KAYANO 14's transition from performance running to lifestyle sportstyle status followed the same trajectory as many of ASICS's late 2000s technical running shoes, with the shoe's layered panel complexity, GEL branding in the heel, and overall chunky-but-technical proportions making it a natural fit within the wave of early 2000s and late 2000s retro runner enthusiasm that swept the sneaker market from 2022 onward. The Concrete Pure Silver colorway specifically arrived at a moment when ASICS was expanding the GEL-Kayano 14's colorway range beyond the initial cream and white executions that launched the shoe's sportstyle era, adding the grey industrial tone to give the silhouette broader seasonal coverage and to appeal to buyers who wanted the GEL-Kayano 14 in the more neutral, understated palette that makes running silhouettes most versatile for everyday wear. Released April 1, 2026 at $160 retail through ASICS and select retailers with style code 1203A537-025, the Concrete Pure Silver arrived alongside the broader 2026 ASICS sportstyle expansion that includes Gel-Cumulus 16 and Gel-1130 reissues. The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Concrete Pure Silver was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL Silver Metallic Lucid Red
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL Silver Metallic Lucid Red delivers a bold and high contrast look through its reflective base and vibrant accents. Silver metallic dominates the upper, creating a sleek and futuristic appearance, while lucid red adds sharp pops of color that enhance the structure. Iron metallic tones provide additional depth, giving the design a layered feel. Fans of performance running silhouettes appreciate how this colorway emphasizes speed and movement through its bright and reflective elements. The combination of metallic and red tones makes it visually striking while maintaining functionality. It is a sneaker that reflects adidas focus on innovation and dynamic design. The adidas Adizero Evo SL Silver Metallic Lucid Red was released on September 19, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro SE Sail
Description: The Jordan 5 Retro SE Sail is a special edition of the iconic high-top mens basketball shoe that comes in a Sail and black colorway. This version of the Jordan 5 Retro SE is made with premium material, including leather and textile cushioning. The upper of the shoe comes in a Sail beige color, which adorns the base and the overlays. On each side of the shoe under the laces there is a small window showcasing the white mesh cushion. Black detailing adorns the white rubber outsole under the forefoot, and theres a visible Air unit in the heel. The Jumpman logo appears in black on the heel and on the tongue. The tongue is made of flat canvas for more flexibility of movement. What we like best about this shoe is the black shark tooth design under the forefoot. This adds a pop of visual appeal to the otherwise simple shoe. The Jordan 5 Retro SE Sail was released on April 13, 2024, for a retail price of $210.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Red Gum
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Red Gum is a retro-inspired sneaker with a rich colorway of Preloved Red and clean accents in Cream White and Crystal White. Originally released in the 1970s as an indoor handball shoe, this version of the Handball Spezial features various throwback details. For example, the sneaker retains its T-shaped toebox overlay, serrated 3-Stripes on the side panels, and gum rubber outsole. However, the upper is crafted from synthetic suede instead of genuine suede, which contributes to the sneakers lightweight design. In addition, the textile inner lining allows the foot to breathe and doesnt weigh down the shoe. While the base comes in Preloved Red, Cream White accents can be found on the heel tab, the 3-Stripes logo, and the collar lining. Our experts at StockX like the classic logo tag, which comes with crisp Crystal White and Preloved Red lettering. The adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Red Gum was released on February 15, 2024, and sold for $110.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Bird Cloud White
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Bird Cloud White brings a timeless terrace icon into sharp, modern focus. Dressed in a vivid Blue Bird suede upper with crisp Cloud White 3-Stripes and heel tab, this mens sneaker captures the clean lines and low-profile stance that made the Gazelle a staple from courts to city streets. A translucent gum outsole anchors the look with classic indoor DNA, offering dependable grip and a subtly retro sheen that complements the rich texture of the suede. Gold-foil Gazelle branding, a streamlined T-toe, and meticulous paneling round out the heritage details, while the cushioned insole keeps every step comfortable from day one. Style code JI2061 and the 2024-06-01 release date make this colorway an easy standout for collectors and daily wearers alike. Engineered for versatile wear, the Gazelle Indoor pairs effortlessly with denim, track pants, and tailored casual fits, making it a go-to for minimalist rotations and bold wardrobes alike. The breathable upper and soft lining help regulate comfort across seasons, and the grippy gum sole performs on slick pavements and polished floors with equal poise. Whether youre after a finishing touch that pops or a reliable everyday sneaker with storied roots, this Blue Bird/Cloud White/Gum palette hits the sweet spot between sport heritage and street-ready style. Search-friendly and collection-worthy, the adidas Gazelle Indoor delivers enduring appeal without sacrificing comfort or craft. Our team thinks this product is great for elevating everyday outfits with a hit of color and classic gum-sole charm, and our experts love it because the premium suede, sharp contrast details, and easy-wearing comfort make it a true wardrobe staple.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Pine Green
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Pine Green features a black Durabuck upper with signature elephant print overlays and green perforated collars. Hits of Pine Green on the midsole and Jumpman tongue embroidery stand out against their neutral backdrops. From there, a Jumpman heel tab and Air sole adds the finishing touches to this retro design. The Air Jordan 3 Pine Green released in October of 2021 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 7 Retro Citrus (2022)
Description: The Air Jordan 7 Retro Citrus 2022 features a Black Durabuck upper, with citrus and red highlights on the sole. It also features citrus threading all around the shoe and a citrus-colored Jumpman logo on the outer side of the upper ankle. The shoe has a small red strap behind the ankle, as well as a "23" set on a black and yellow background. The Air Jordan 7 Retro Citrus 2022 is set for release in August, 2022, at a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High White Black Volt University Gold
Description: Jordan Brand started 2021 on a high note with the Jordan 1 High Volt Gold. The Volt Gold offers a new take on the renowned Black Toe theme by implementing new materials and features that contribute to a reconstructed design aesthetic. In familiar Black Toe color blocking, the upper of the Jordan 1 Volt Gold is composed of white, black, and yellow leather. A Volt yellow-tinted panel donning the Jordan Wings logo wraps the ankle. Unlike OG Jordan 1 designs that feature double stitch reinforcement, the Volt Gold utilizes single stitch reinforcement on its overlays, creating dimensionality with exposed edges. A nylon tongue with exposed foam edges and reverse transparent tongue label emphasize Jordans reconstructed design approach. A yellowed midsole and black outsole offer an aged look. The Jordan 1 High Volt Gold released in January of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Graphite Grey
Description: Blending retro runner style with modern comfort, the ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Graphite Grey delivers a clean, versatile look that works from morning miles to weekend fits. The airy mesh base is layered with glossy synthetic overlays in Graphite Grey, framing the streamlined silhouette while enhancing structure and durability. Underfoot, signature GEL cushioning in the heel and forefoot pairs with a responsive midsole to soften impact and keep strides smooth, while the TRUSSTIC support system helps stabilize transitions. A padded tongue, plush collar, and breathable lining round out a supportive, easy-wearing feel youll reach for daily. Designed for everyday wear with performance pedigree, this mens ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 nods to the late-2000s original with its sculpted lines and technical detailing. The White/Graphite Grey colorway keeps styling effortless, pairing with athletic gear or tailored casual looks. Durable rubber on the outsole grips city streets, and the streamlined last offers a snug, secure fit without bulk. Style ID 1203A537-110 and a June 6, 2025 release underscore its timely appeal, while the approachable $150 retail price makes it a smart pick for rotation-ready comfort. Our team thinks this product is great for anyone who wants dependable cushioning, stable support, and a timeless look in one pair, our experts love how the GEL setup, TRUSSTIC stability, and breathable materials come together for all-day wearability.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Black White Olive
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid Black White Olive brings a fresh twist to the iconic silhouette. This men's sneaker features a sleek black leather base, complemented by crisp white accents on the Swoosh, heel, and midsole. The standout olive green overlays add a subtle yet distinctive touch, creating a versatile colorway that effortlessly blends with various styles. Built with the classic Air Jordan 1 Mid construction, this shoe offers both style and comfort. The perforated toe box ensures breathability, while the padded collar provides ankle support. The rubber outsole with its signature traction pattern delivers excellent grip on various surfaces. With its balanced color scheme and timeless design, the Jordan 1 Mid Black White Olive is a versatile addition to any sneaker collection. Our experts state this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that combines classic style with modern colorways, perfect for everyday wear or making a subtle statement.

Display Name: adidas BW Army Dark Green Carbon
Description: The adidas BW Army Dark Green Carbon delivers a military inspired silhouette through a muted and tonal color palette that emphasizes simplicity and heritage. The dark green upper creates a grounded and understated look, while carbon accents add depth and subtle contrast. The low profile shape remains true to the original design, keeping it clean and versatile. Fans of BW Army models appreciate how they maintain a strong connection to their roots while remaining relevant in modern styling. The tonal execution makes this version easy to wear across different outfits. It is a sneaker that reflects timeless design through minimal color and classic form. The adidas BW Army Dark Green Carbon was released with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Bleached Coral
Description: Following the classic Black Toe theme, the Air Jordan 1 High OG Bleached Coral features a smooth white leather upper with black overlays and light grey Durabuck heel wraps. Tradition Nike woven tongue labels and Jordan Wings Logos on the collars add a retro feel. From there, a white and light grey Air sole completes the design. The Air Jordan 1 High OG Bleached Coral releases in July of 2022 and retails for $180.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Xuanwu Year of the Snake
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Xuanwu Year of the Snake brings mythological storytelling into the Jordan line, drawing inspiration from the legendary Black Tortoise figure tied to protection and strength. The black and metallic gold color scheme gives the shoe a regal and almost ceremonial feel, elevating the low top silhouette into something more symbolic. It feels less like a standard release and more like a tribute piece with deeper meaning behind the design. What makes this pair stand out is the way it blends cultural influence with classic Jordan DNA. The gold detailing adds richness and contrast, while the black base keeps the look grounded and wearable. It is a release that resonates with collectors who appreciate narrative driven design and the continued expansion of Jordan storytelling across global themes. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Xuanwu Year of the Snake was released on December 27, 2025 with a retail price of $250.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined
Description: Rediscover a classic with the Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined, dropping on February 17, 2024. This sneaker is a fresh take on the iconic Jordan 4, bringing a contemporary edge to a timeless design. This new release ditches the traditional nubuck, and incorporates a fresh take on the upper with a supple black leather.The Reimagined series, known for breathing new life into classic Air Jordans with innovative materials, makes this release a true collector's item. The colorway in Black/Cement Grey/Varsity Red/Summit White perfectly balances boldness and tradition. This reinvention of the legendary "Bred" aesthetic combines the familiar with the unexpected, creating a sneaker that's both nostalgic and forward-looking. It's a must-have for both long-time Jordan fans and newcomers to the sneaker scene. Priced at $210, the Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined is set to be a versatile addition to any collection. Whether you're hitting the streets or just showcasing your style, this sneaker blends history, innovation, and style in a way only Jordan Brand can. Don't miss out on this blend of past and future  grab your pair and step into a new era of sneaker culture.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Varsity Royal Cement
Description: Following up on the Fire Red Cement 3 that dropped during All-Star Weekend 2020, Jordan Brand released a new Jordan 3 colorway thats the polar opposite with the Jordan 3 Royal Cement. The Jordan 3 Royal Cement features all-blue tumbled leather uppers with grey perforated leather inserts by the laces and ankle. Traditional Jumpman insignias cover the heel tabs. As its name alludes, the Royal Cement features Cement print overlays around the toe and heel that provide its signature appeal. The Jordan 3 Royal Cement released in October of 2020 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid TD Cleat Bred Toe
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid TD Cleat Bred Toe delivers a performance focused adaptation of one of the most iconic Jordan color blockings. The gym red, white, and black palette recreates the classic Bred Toe look, while the cleated outsole provides traction and functionality for on field use. The structure remains recognizable, blending heritage with sport performance. Fans of the Bred Toe design appreciate how it continues to translate across different formats while maintaining its strong identity. The transition into a cleat adds purpose without losing visual impact. It is a sneaker that reflects legacy design adapted for performance. The Air Jordan 1 Mid TD Cleat Bred Toe was released on April 20, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Sequoia
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Sequoia embraces maximal creativity by transforming the Dunk into a bold art piece. The oversized Swamp Sponge textures and all sequoia palette give the shoe a surreal and almost sculptural feel. It is intentionally exaggerated, leaning fully into Cactus Plant Flea Markets philosophy of play, distortion, and individuality rather than restraint. Collectors love this pair because it challenges expectations. This is not a subtle Dunk, it is a conversation starter designed for people who appreciate sneakers as wearable art. Fans of CPFM gravitate toward it for its fearlessness, while Dunk collectors value it as a standout moment in the silhouettes history. It represents freedom in design, where personality takes priority over convention. The Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Sequoia was released on September 17, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: New Balance 327 Sea Salt Black (Women's)
Description: The New Balance 327 Sea Salt Black (W) comes in a sea salt, white, and black color palette. The New Balance 327 Sea Salt Black (W) features an upper that is made of lightweight, breathable mesh material with suede overlays for sturdiness and comfort. The shoe's outsole is composed of a rubber compound for grip and stability, while the midsole is made with REVlite foam for padding and support. The shoe features "NB" branding on the tongue, and it also has New Balance's iconic "N" emblem on the side panels. The womens rendition of the New Balance 327 Sea Salt Black (W) was released on August 19, 2022, and retailed for $95.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Metallic
Description: Composed of a light grey nylon upper with metallic "700" branding and reflective detailing, the adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Metallic beams with the futuristic aesthetic that Yeezy has garnered a reputation for. A thick Boost sole at the base supplies the responsiveness and comfort needed for everyday wear. The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Metallic released in December of 2021 and retailed for $220.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Black White
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 presents itself in an effortlessly sleek Black/White combo, blending the iconic retro silhouette with today's streetwear sensibilities. Riding high on the trend wave, this sneaker is a testament to timeless design. It showcases leather artistry throughout its upper, while black dominates and is accented by crisp white contrasts. The streamlined aesthetic is not only visually pleasing but also perfectly aligns with the current sneaker zeitgeist. Beyond its visual appeal, it carries the legacy of Onitsuka Tiger. Rocking the Mexico 66 means you're not just wearing a shoe; you're wearing an icon. For the admirers of classics, the Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 in Black & White debuted with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 3 Ice Cold (Women's)
Description: Nike Sabrina 3 Ice Cold Womens captures Sabrina Ionescus calm and calculated dominance through a colorway that feels sharp and composed. Ice Cold reflects her ability to control the game under pressure, pairing a clean visual identity with a silhouette built for precision and confidence. It feels modern and focused, mirroring Sabrinas leadership and poise on the court. Collectors appreciate this release because the Sabrina line has quickly become known for authenticity and intent. The Ice Cold execution reinforces that reputation, showing how performance footwear can carry personality without excess. It appeals to fans who value clarity, control, and a connection between athlete and design rather than loud expression. The Nike Sabrina 3 Ice Cold Womens was released on 10/01/2025with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Converse SHAI 001 Winter Red
Description: The Converse SHAI 001 Winter Red brings a festive twist to Shai Gilgeous-Alexanders first signature silhouette with a vibrant holiday palette perfect for December styling. Draped in bold red with contrasting green accents on the zipper, tongue logo, outsole, and heel, this iteration celebrates winterberries that stay bright through cold months. The sleek neoprene-like upper and sculpted sidewalls continue the SHAI 001s modern design language while adding a seasonal twist that feels intentional and fresh. This Winter Red colorway stands apart from earlier all-monochrome releases by weaving in festive tones without resorting to clichés. The red body and green details evoke classic holiday colors, but the overall look remains clean and wearable beyond just the season. Shais logo gracing the tongue and Converse branding on the heel tie the shoe to his growing legacy as a player with both on-court impact and off-court style influence. When the Converse SHAI 001 Winter Red released, it retailed for $130 and dropped on December 11, 2025. With its bold color and thoughtful seasonal design, this edition is a standout way to celebrate style and spirit all winter long.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Earth
Description: Yeezy delivers a new rendition of its most popular design with the adidas Yeezy 350 Earth, now available on StockX. This 350 V2 strays from newer releases by bringing back a heel tab that is present in early 350 silhouettes. This model was released as a regional exclusive specific to the Americas. This Yeezy 350 V2 Earth is composed of a mud Primeknit upper with a translucent outer side stripe. A mud colored Boost cushioned sole and mud interior completes the design. These sneakers released in February of 2020 and retailed for $220.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Wolf Grey
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Golf Wolf Grey gears the classic Jordan 1 model for the fairways. It features a tonal grey leather upper with black Swooshes and white Jordan Wings branding on the heel tab. At the base, an icy translucent outsole with grooves provides traction and stability. The Jordan 1 Low GolfWolf Grey released in January of 2022 and retailed for $140.

Display Name: Nike Total 90 3 SP Black
Description: The Nike Total 90 3 SP Black is a striking revival of a classic soccer boot, reimagined for modern style and performance. This sleek sneaker features a predominantly black colorway with contrasting white accents and metallic silver details, creating a bold and eye-catching design. The upper is crafted with premium materials, ensuring durability and comfort for everyday wear, while paying homage to its soccer heritage. Drawing inspiration from the iconic Total 90 line, this shoe combines nostalgic elements with contemporary aesthetics. The streamlined silhouette offers a versatile look that transitions seamlessly from casual settings to athletic environments. With its blend of style and functionality, the Nike Total 90 3 SP Black is perfect for those who appreciate the fusion of sports legacy and modern fashion. Us at StockX believe this product is great for soccer enthusiasts and sneaker collectors alike, offering a unique piece of footwear history with a modern twist.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Gorge Green Gold Mini Swoosh (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Gorge Green Gold Mini Swoosh Womens brings understated elegance to a familiar silhouette through subtle detail and classic color. Summit white and sail create a soft and neutral base, while gorge green overlays add richness and contrast. A metallic gold mini Swoosh introduces a refined focal point, elevating the design without disrupting the Dunks clean proportions. This release appeals to fans who appreciate quiet upgrades rather than loud redesigns. The mini Swoosh detail feels intentional and tasteful, rewarding close attention instead of demanding it. Collectors value how the color balance keeps the shoe versatile while the gold accent adds personality. It is a Dunk that feels polished and confident, proving that small design choices can make a lasting impression when executed with restraint and care. The Nike Dunk Low Gorge Green Gold Mini Swoosh Womens was released on July 8, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 380 Alien Blue
Description: The adidas Yeezy 380 Alien Blue arrives in a light grey and white reflective Primeknit upper with a Glow Green side stripe. From there, a faint Alien Blue translucent BOOST sole provides a supportive base. The adidas Yeezy 380 Alien Blue released in May of 2021 and retailed for $230.
Colorway: Alien Blue RF/Alien Blue RF/Alien Blue RF

Display Name: New Balance 1906A Thunder Brown
Description: The New Balance 1906A Thunder Brown leans into a darker and more grounded palette, giving the performance inspired silhouette a moodier and more refined presence. The Thunder Brown and Slate Grey combination adds depth across the layered upper, highlighting the technical construction that defines the 1906 line. It carries that signature mix of mesh and synthetic overlays, keeping the look rooted in running heritage while shifting into lifestyle wear. Fans gravitate toward this pair because it balances performance DNA with a more elevated color execution. The muted tones make it easy to style, while the structure still delivers the detail collectors expect from the 1906 series. It stands as a strong example of how New Balance continues to evolve its retro runners into everyday staples. The New Balance 1906A Thunder Brown was released on February 27, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 4 RM Ironstone
Description: The Air Jordan 4 RM Ironstone delivers a grounded and earthy take on the updated silhouette through a rich and layered color palette. Ironstone forms the base, creating a muted and rugged look, while baroque brown and medium olive accents add depth and warmth. Light bone elements provide contrast that keeps the design balanced and cohesive. Fans of neutral Jordan colorways appreciate how combinations like this emphasize tone and material rather than bold contrast. The earthy palette makes it versatile while still distinct. It is a sneaker that reflects modern updates within a heritage inspired design. The Air Jordan 4 RM Ironstone was released with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Pink Foam Phantom Metallic Platinum Black
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Pink Foam Phantom Metallic Platinum Black brings vibrant energy to a technical runner frame. Pink Foam dominates the upper with bold brightness, balanced by Phantom and black accents that sharpen the structure. Metallic Platinum overlays add reflective edge, highlighting the intricate paneling. The cushioned sole reinforces comfort, maintaining the models performance driven identity. Fans who favor expressive colorways will appreciate how pink transforms the layered silhouette into a standout statement. The darker accents keep the look grounded, ensuring versatility beyond the initial pop. It blends playful energy with serious comfort seamlessly. Bright and confident, this pair commands attention with every step. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Pink Foam Phantom Metallic Platinum Black was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Cortez Baroque Brown (Women's)
Description: The Nike Cortez Baroque Brown (Women's) revamps the classic Cortez runner design with a contemporary colorway of Baroque Brown, Sail, and khaki. Maintaining its 1972 retro appeal, the Baroque Brown (Women's) Nike Cortez boasts a soft foam midsole in Sail with a khaki-colored wedge beneath the heel. The jagged design on the rubber outsole represents another heritage detail and increases traction. Reinventing the design for contemporary audiences, the sneaker offers a wider toebox than the original for lasting comfort. Baroque Brown covers the shiny textile upper and the suede details on the toebox overlay, the heel counter, and the eyelets. On the other hand, splashes of Sail on the Swoosh logos, the laces, the tongue, the heel tab, and the rubber outsole provide subtle color-blocking and a premium feel. Our experts like the way khaki balances the color combination and appears on the branding details. The womens size Nike Cortez Baroque Brown (Women's) was released on April 2, 2024, and sold for $90.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Bob Marley Football Is Freedom
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Bob Marley Football Is Freedom delivers a culturally inspired take on the classic silhouette through a color palette tied to reggae influence. The core black base creates a strong foundation, while pure ruby and bold gold accents add warmth and contrast that reflect the theme. The low profile shape remains true to the Spezials heritage design. Fans of music inspired releases appreciate how this pair blends storytelling with a timeless sneaker model. The color combination gives it a bold identity while maintaining versatility. It is a sneaker that reflects cultural influence and classic adidas style in a cohesive design. The adidas Handball Spezial Bob Marley Football Is Freedom was released with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro French Blue (2025)
Description: The Jordan 12 Retro French Blue (2025) revives a beloved color story with crisp, modern execution. Dressed in a clean White/French Blue-Metallic Silver-Varsity Red palette, this pair spotlights the AJ12s sculpted leather upper with signature radiating stitch lines inspired by rising-sun motifs. A rich French Blue textured mudguard wraps the lateral and medial sides for a bold two-tone contrast, while polished metallic silver eyelets and subtle varsity red accents on the tongue and heel branding add a refined pop. Underfoot, the responsive midsole works with a supportive carbon-fiber-style shank look for stability you can feel from first step to all-day wear, and durable herringbone traction helps keep your stride confident on city streets or hardwood. Style ID CT8013-114 makes this 2025 release easy to spot for collectors and fans of timeless Air Jordan heritage. Thoughtfully balanced between court-born performance and effortless lifestyle appeal, the Jordan 12 Retro French Blue pairs easily with denim, technical pants, or tailored athleisure. The padded collar and secure lacing create a locked-in feel, while the toe shape and paneling preserve the sleek, athletic lines that define the model. Varsity Red hits on the heel tabs "23" and tongue Jumpman branding offer just the right amount of color to energize the classic white-and-blue blocking. Whether youre curating a rotation of iconic retros or looking for a standout everyday shoe, this AJ12 delivers comfort, durability, and unmistakable Jordan DNA in one sharply executed package. Our team loves this product because it blends heritage styling with dependable cushioning and day-to-night versatility, perfect for collectors and daily wearers alike.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Black Silver Multi
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Black Silver Multi introduces a more expressive take on the silhouette through a mix of colors layered over a darker base. Black anchors the design, while multi color accents bring energy and variation across the upper. The contrast highlights the structure and gives the shoe a more dynamic presence compared to tonal versions. Fans are drawn to this release because it adds personality without losing the core identity of the model. The ProGrid Omni 9 continues to evolve within the retro runner space, and this version reflects that progression clearly. It is a strong choice for those who want a balance between heritage design and more vibrant color execution. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Black Silver Multi was released on July 12, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan Spizike Low Black Cement
Description: The Air Jordan Spizike Low Black Cement channels one of the most beloved Jordan themes into a low top silhouette packed with layered detail. Dressed in Black with Wolf Grey, White, and Gym Red accents, the design nods directly to the legendary Cement aesthetic. The mashup construction combines elements from multiple Jordan models, creating a bold and textured presence. This pair stands out because it celebrates Jordan heritage through recognizable cues and strong contrast. The black and grey foundation keeps the look grounded, while red accents inject classic Chicago energy. Fans of the Spizike appreciate how the silhouette honors Spike Lees influence and Jordan history in one cohesive build. It is a confident reinterpretation of an iconic colorway in a more streamlined format. The Air Jordan Spizike Low Black Cement was released on December 1, 2025 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 520 Pack White Pink (Women's)
Description: Available in a white and pink colorway, the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 520 Pack White Pink (Women's) is a womens exclusive running shoe from the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 lineup released as part of the "520" pack. This Zoom Vomero 5 sneaker features an upper made of a white open mesh base and Metallic Silver leather overlays. Plastic side panels and heel counter offer additional support. Pink accents on the laces, inner lining, and tongue provide a contrasting tone to the upper. Other details include "520" branding on the heel and pink insoles and "Nike Vomero 5" branding on the tongue tag. The upper rests on a primarily white Zoom cushioned midsole with hits of pink and a pink and gray rubber outsole. Something we love about this Zoom Vomero 5 is its vibrant colorway and unique design elements, which give it a distinctive and stylish look. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 520 Pack White Pink (Women's) was released on May 20th, 2023, retailing at $160.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Craft Paris Olympics (Women's)
Description: Crafted with premium materials, the Jordan 6 Retro Craft combines luxurious aesthetics with top-notch craftsmanship. The upper is made of suede, providing durability and a modern finish. The metallic gold accents add a touch of glamour, while the glacier blue details offer a subtle contrast, enhancing the overall look.

Display Name: Nike Book 2 WNBA 30th Anniversary
Description: The Nike Book 2 WNBA 30th Anniversary is a May 8, 2026 release from Nike Basketball's WNBA 30th Anniversary Collection, retailing at $145 with style code IR6333-100 in the White/Midnight Navy/Fireberry/Light Photo Blue/Sail colorway, available in unisex sizing, confirmed by Nike.com, Sole Retriever, and Nice Kicks. As confirmed by the official Nike product description via Titan22, the WNBA 30th Anniversary Book 2 honors the league's founding year of 1996 with a forefoot Air Zoom unit repositioned from the heel for low-profile responsiveness, a midfoot webbing system for snug secure support during quick cuts, a light and durable woven synthetic upper, and Cushlon 3.0 foam in the midsole for plush underfoot sensation. Just Fresh Kicks' detailed colorway breakdown confirmed the white panel base carries a Midnight Navy Swoosh outlined in Fireberry red, a small "est. 1996" hangtag at the heel, Light Photo Blue ladder lacing pulling the original WNBA palette through the throat, and printed insoles with a retro "Just Do It" graphic alongside a 30 Year basketball badge.
