The KD line has always balanced precision and creativity, and this colorway highlights that duality through a look that feels intense yet controlled. Collectors gravitate toward themed KD releases because they add personality to a performance driven shoe, turning it into a piece that feels just as meaningful on display as it does in rotation. The Nike KD 18 Halloween was released on 10/22/2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 SE Hangul Day (2023) (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 SE Hangul Day (2023) (Women's) is a womens running sneaker crafted from light brown suede overlays on a white mesh base. The midsole is done in an Aged Yellow hue, complemented by a black and white outsole. The Nike Swoosh appears in white leather on both sides, complemented by a white embroidered Swoosh on the outer toe. To celebrate Hangul Day, which honors the creation of the Korean alphabet, Nike created this womens exclusive version of the Air Max 1, an iconic Nike sneaker design that debuted in 1987. The Air Max 1 SE features additional branding, such as Hangul Day insoles, tongue tags, and heel insignias to honor Hangul Day. In our opinion, the best feature of the Hangul Day Air Max 1 is its elegant composition of muted colors, which makes the shoe versatile. The Nike Air Max 1 SE Hangul Day (2023) (Women's) released on November 15, 2023, and retailed at $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Premium Coconut Milk Vintage Green
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Coconut Milk Vintage Green is a stunning addition to the iconic Air Max line. This men's sneaker showcases a harmonious blend of classic design and contemporary style. The upper features a luxurious combination of materials, including smooth leather and durable textile, all in a soothing coconut milk colorway. Accents of vintage green and dark team red provide striking contrast, elevating the shoe's visual appeal. Designed for both style and comfort, this Air Max 90 Premium boasts Nike's renowned Air cushioning technology in the heel, ensuring responsive support with every step. The padded collar and tongue offer additional comfort, while the rubber waffle outsole provides excellent traction on various surfaces. With its premium construction and timeless silhouette, this sneaker effortlessly bridges the gap between athletic performance and street-ready fashion. Our experts state this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that combines retro charm with modern comfort, perfect for everyday wear or as a standout piece in any sneaker collection.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Triple Stack Khaki Sail (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple Stack Khaki Sail Womens reimagines a classic silhouette with a layered and slightly exaggerated approach that adds depth without losing its familiar identity. The khaki and sail color palette creates a soft and neutral look, complemented by coconut milk tones that bring warmth and cohesion across the upper. The triple stacked detailing introduces a unique visual element, giving the shoe a more dimensional feel compared to standard Jordan 1 Lows. Fans are drawn to this version because it offers something different while still staying rooted in one of the most recognizable designs in sneaker culture. The subtle color palette makes it easy to style, while the layered construction adds just enough distinction to stand out. It feels like a thoughtful update that respects the original while pushing it slightly forward for a new audience. The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple Stack Khaki Sail Womens was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Solo White Black
Description: The Nike Air Max Solo in White and Pure Platinum with Black accents is a clean and accessible expression of a newer Air Max platform that prioritizes everyday wearability and straightforward design over the visual complexity and layered architecture of the Air Max family's more established and collector-focused silhouettes. White across the upper with pure platinum and black creating the structural definition and contrast gives this Solo a versatile and universally wearable personality that suits the platform's accessible positioning within the broader Air Max lineup. The visible Air unit remains the focal design element regardless of the colorway's understated character, the cushioning technology providing both the comfort performance and the Air Max family visual identity marker that connects the Solo to the broader heritage of the platform family it belongs to. Air Max platforms at the hundred dollar price point occupy a specific and important role in Nike's sneaker ecosystem as the entry points that introduce new wearers to the Air Max visual language and cushioning experience without the investment that premium or OG specification releases demand from collectors already familiar with the family's most celebrated silhouettes. White and black on the Air Max Solo creates the most universally outfit-compatible version of this platform, the clean neutral base making it the right daily driver for wearers who want Air Max presence in their rotation without the styling consideration that bolder colorways require. The pure platinum mid-tone adds just enough visual layering to keep the white and black combination from reading as too stark or simplistic. The Nike Air Max Solo in White and Black was released on July 6, 2023 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Salomon XT-Whisper Walnut Bitter Chocolate Vanilla
Description: The Salomon XT Whisper in Walnut, Bitter Chocolate, and Vanilla is a colorway that brings the XT Whisper's understated and lifestyle-oriented trail platform to one of the warmest and most dessert-adjacent color stories in the current Salomon catalog, the three tones creating a layered earth tone relationship that references the specific and deeply satisfying visual palette of rich brown, dark chocolate, and warm cream in a combination that feels genuinely appetite-inducing in its warmth and material character. Walnut as the dominant tone creates a mid-brown foundation with a slightly woody and naturalistic quality that grounds the more saturated bitter chocolate accents in organic warmth, while vanilla provides the pale and slightly sweet counterpoint that prevents the two dark brown tones from becoming visually heavy or monotonous across the XT Whisper's clean and well-proportioned construction. The three-tone brown and cream story creates a shoe that belongs to the fall and transitional season aesthetic territory with a completeness and conviction that most seasonal earth-tone footwear releases gesture toward without fully achieving. Salomon XT Whisper releases in warm brown and cream palettes consistently generate strong response from the lifestyle footwear community that has developed around the brand's more understated and fashion-aware releases, the colorway's natural warmth and material suggestion creating a shoe that integrates into earth-tone wardrobes with immediate ease while carrying enough color complexity and naming specificity to reward the collector who appreciates when a brand treats colorway selection as a genuine design decision rather than a seasonal commercial calculation. Walnut, bitter chocolate, and vanilla work together across the XT Whisper's platform with the same satisfying completeness that the food references they evoke deliver in their original context, the three tones creating a visual harmony that feels both deliberate and completely natural. At one hundred and forty-five dollars the XT Whisper in this colorway is a warm and seasonally generous acquisition that rewards daily wear with consistent visual satisfaction. The Salomon XT Whisper in Walnut, Bitter Chocolate, and Vanilla was released on April 2, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax Plus White
Description: The Nike Air VaporMax Plus White features an off-white neoprene upper with a white TPU cage and gray Swooshes. From there, the shoe's signature translucent outsole and VM branding on the heel complete the design. The Nike Air VaporMax Plus White released in February of 2018 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax Plus University Red Black
Description: This version of Nike Air VaporMax Plus University Red Black is clad in its moniker's striking arrangement of red neoprene in the forefoot that joins with its black counterpart at the heel counter, revisiting its gradient scheme that's been made a prominent addition to a pattern-padded upper. While hints of blood red ooze through an ankle Swooshes and a second grade graces its mid-foot shank, with darkly tinted caged overlays that continue throughout a translucent full-length Air Max Bubble and midsole. The ankle, tongue, and toe are all branded with tiny Swooshes. The "Vm Air" insignia from Nike has been resurrected and placed on the shoe's heel as a vintage touch. What we think is the standout feature of the Nike Air VaporMax Plus University Red Black is the floating cage around the foot resembles the original Air Max Plus design from 1998. This Nike Air VaporMax Plus University Red Black was released on 10th November 2019 and retailed at $190.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Spring Is In The Air (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Spring Is In The Air GS delivers a soft and nature inspired take on the silhouette through a layered mix of pastel and neutral tones. Sail creates a clean base, while jade aura and aura accents add a fresh and calming contrast. Iced carmine and iris whisper details introduce subtle pops of color that enhance the design. Fans of themed Jordan releases appreciate how this version captures a seasonal mood through its color palette. The combination of soft tones and layered accents gives it a balanced and modern feel. It is a sneaker that reflects spring inspired design within a timeless silhouette. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Spring Is In The Air GS was released on March 28, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Rabbit Floral Swoosh
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Rabbit Floral Swoosh introduces a more playful and detailed approach to the silhouette, using floral accents on the swoosh to create a design that feels unique and expressive. The sail and coconut milk base keeps the shoe light and neutral, allowing the floral detailing to stand out without overwhelming the overall look. Collectors are drawn to this pair for its creative direction and the way it adds personality to a familiar model. The floral swoosh brings a softer and more artistic element into the Jordan 1 line, making it feel distinct from more traditional releases. It is a version of the silhouette that leans into storytelling through detail. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Rabbit Floral Swoosh was released on March 18, 2026 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Hyper Royal Malachite
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Hyper Royal Malachite is a low-top basketball shoe with a bold and modern design. This version of the Nike SB Dunk Low is made with a suede upper. The base of the upper is a royal blue color on the sides, the toebox, and around the heel. The toebox is perforated for breathability. White suede overlays line the toebox, laces, and around the heel. The Nike Swoosh appears on both sides in a rich Malachite Green color. The blue tongue also contains a white Nike patch with green text, and the Nike brand name is stitched on the heel in green. The tongue and insole are cushioned for extra comfort, and the sole is made of rubber for traction and grip. What we like most about this shoe is the bold green and blue color blocking. This design helps the shoe stand out. The Nike SB Dunk Low Hyper Royal Malachite was released on April 24, 2024, for a price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Little Posite One Anthracite (2023) (GS)
Description: The Nike Little Posite One Anthracite (2023) (GS) in grade-school sizing presents a sleek black and anthracite color palette as it brings bold '90s basketball style to a new generation. Inspired by the iconic Nike Air Foamposite, this grade schoolsized sneaker delivers a durable synthetic leather upper with a classic lace-up design and plush foam cushioning for all-day comfort. Soft padding around the ankle and a sturdy rubber outsole provide reliable support and traction, perfect for play or everyday wear. Signature details like the "1Cent" heel logo and pull tabs on the tongue and heel nod to Penny Hardaways original look, giving this sneaker a nostalgic edge with modern-day durability. What our experts love about the Nike Little Posite One Anthracite (2023) (GS) is that the dark-black and anthracite shades are great at covering up dirt, scuffs, and bumps from kids on the go. Released on December 12, 2023, this grade-school sneaker sold for $190 retail price.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Family Reunion Hong Kong
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Family Reunion Hong Kong celebrates heritage through bold color and amplified cushioning. Cinnamon tones sweep across the layered upper, contrasted by Metallic Silver and black detailing that define the signature wave design. Voltage Green, Light Crimson, and Safety Orange accents inject vibrant personality, while the enlarged visible Air units nod to early Air Max innovation. The silhouette feels expressive and deeply rooted in 95 history. Family Reunion editions carry special energy, and this Hong Kong release channels that spirit with unapologetic color. The layered palette highlights the anatomical inspiration behind the design while pushing it into celebratory territory. It captures the global influence of the Air Max 95 and the continued reverence for its groundbreaking cushioning. Bold and commemorative, this pair honors legacy with confidence. The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Family Reunion Hong Kong was released on February 19, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike ACG LDV Brilliant Blue Turf Orange
Description: The Nike ACG LDV Brilliant Blue Turf Orange brings outdoor inspired design into a retro runner silhouette, combining bold color with functional influence. The brilliant blue base is paired with turf orange accents, creating a high contrast look that feels energetic and rugged at the same time. The ACG identity comes through in both the color choice and the overall construction. This pair stands out because it blends trail aesthetics with everyday wearability. ACG releases often carry a distinct personality, and this version leans into that through its palette and structure. It is a strong option for those who want a sneaker that feels adventurous without losing comfort. The Nike ACG LDV Brilliant Blue Turf Orange was released on April 23, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Model: Nike Tennis Classic CS PRM WTCH BND
Display Name: Nike Tennis Classic CS PRM WTCH BND Pale Ivory
Description: The Nike Tennis Classic CS PRM WTCH BND in Pale Ivory is a tonal and monochromatic expression of one of Nike's most quietly beloved and heritage-rooted court silhouettes, the all-pale-ivory execution presenting the Tennis Classic's clean and understated design in the warmest and most vintage-adjacent neutral available in the shoe's color vocabulary. The PRM designation signals premium material upgrades beyond standard Tennis Classic production, with the WTCH BND component indicating a watch band or strap-inspired construction detail that adds a distinctive and slightly unexpected design element to an otherwise classically proportioned tennis heritage silhouette. Pale ivory across every surface of the shoe creates the kind of total-tonal execution that makes the construction quality and material premium of the PRM specification the most important and visible dimension of the shoe's design, the single color demanding that every material and construction detail justify its presence through quality rather than visual novelty. Tennis Classic releases in premium tonal colorways occupy a specific and appreciated space in the Nike heritage footwear market as the shoes that reward wearers who prioritize material quality and design restraint over colorway complexity or brand visibility, the pale ivory execution creating a shoe that communicates aesthetic intelligence through what it deliberately withholds rather than what it adds. The tennis court heritage of the Classic CS gives the pale ivory colorway an authentic athletic origin that pure lifestyle silhouettes cannot claim, connecting the tonal premium execution to a design biography of genuine sport utility that adds depth and credibility to the shoe's understated visual character. At one hundred and twenty-five dollars the Tennis Classic CS PRM WTCH BND in Pale Ivory delivers premium construction and tonal sophistication in one of Nike's most quietly significant heritage court silhouettes. The Nike Tennis Classic CS PRM WTCH BND in Pale Ivory was released on May 7, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Model: Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro QS
Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro QS Kobe Bryant Lakers Home
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro QS Kobe Bryant Lakers Home takes inspiration from a pivotal moment in basketball historythe 2002-2003 NBA season, when Kobe Bryant made waves during his sneaker free agency. Paying homage to the Black Mambas legendary career with the Lakers, this edition showcases a classic white leather upper accented with varsity maize and varsity purple details, reminiscent of the Lakers iconic home jersey. The addition of Bryant's jersey number and the Kobe logo stitched on the heel solidifies its place as a collectors piece. This sneaker balances nostalgia with premium design. Every element, from the debossed Kobe logo on the outer heel to the clean yet bold colorway, exudes sophistication and style. The versatility of this color palette makes it a statement both on and off the court. Whether you're a lifelong Lakers fan or just appreciate the legacy of Kobe Bryant, this pair delivers a meaningful blend of history and sneaker culture. Released on December 6, 2024, at a retail price of $130, the Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro QS Kobe Bryant Lakers Home is more than just a sneakerits a celebration of basketball heritage. Featuring white, varsity maize, and varsity purple hues, this limited edition is a must-have.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite One Psychic Blue
Description: The Nike Air Foamposite One Psychic Blue is a performance sneaker that was made in collaboration with American basketball star Penny Hardaway. The Psychic Blue Nike Air Foamposite One is made with a base of black fabric for flexibility and breathability. This material makes up the area around the shoelaces as well as the ankle and heel. The rest of the upper is covered in supportive polyurethane Foamposite in Psychic Blue. With its curved ridges and light blue color, its clear that the design of this shoe was inspired by liquid. Penny Hardaways 1 Cent logo is seen on the heel, while subtle black branding appears on the tongue under the pull tab. The shoe is equipped with a Zoom Air unit. What we like best about this sneaker is the muted branding, which allows the bold design of the Foamposite to stand out. The Nike Air Foamposite One Psychic Blue was released on May 27, 2025, for $230.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Syna Central Cee Black White Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Central Cee Black White Smoke Grey brings UK rap influence to one of the most enduring silhouettes in sneaker history. Black dominates the upper, setting a sharp base that is broken up by Light Smoke Grey overlays and crisp White accents. The color blocking feels clean and deliberate, letting subtle detailing speak rather than relying on loud contrast. Central Cee has become a defining voice in modern British music, and translating that presence onto an Air Force 1 feels culturally aligned. The AF1 has long been tied to street scenes worldwide, so this collaboration lands naturally within that lineage. It is understated but confident, reflecting both the artists aesthetic and the timeless versatility of the silhouette. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Central Cee Black White Smoke Grey was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax 2021 FK White Black Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Air VaporMax 2021 FK White Black Metallic Silver is a thoughtfully crafted shoe. Notably, 40% of this sneaker is constructed from recycled materials. Its stretchy FlyKnit upper, for example, is made from recycled yarn. Originally designed for running, this sneaker features a soft collar, webbing eyestays for a modern look, traditional lacing, and heel padding for comfort. It also features Nike Grind rubber details for increased traction and longevity and the VaporMaxs traditional TPU Clip. All these features are set atop its revolutionary VaporMax 2 Air unit. The Nike Air VaporMax 2021 FK White Black Metallic Silver was released in June 2021 at a retail price of $200.

Display Name: New Balance 1906L Black
Description: The New Balance 1906L Black updates the classic 1906 with a loafer-like, slip-on design. The 1906L design reimagines the retro 1906, seamlessly blending the laid-back charm of sneakers with a refined, formal aesthetic. The Black 1906L ditches the usual technical mesh in favor of a premium leather construction finished with a shiny TPU heel counter and subtle branding, reinforcing the premium vibe. The loafer features dynamic paneling and a stitched N at the forefoot for additional flair. Underfoot, the loafer sits on performance-ready tech, including Ortholite insoles and an ACTEVA LITE midsole for cushioning. ABZORB SBS pods and a Stability Web outsole round off the design. What our experts find outstanding about the Black New Balance 1906L is its hybrid design that feels both familiar and a little alien. The 1906L redefines the boundaries between sneakers and loafers. The loafer was released on March 19, 2025, and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro Mambacita
Description: The Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro Mambacita honors Kobe Bryants legacy through a design that carries both performance focus and emotional significance. The white base is accented with metallic gold and black, creating a clean but meaningful palette tied to tribute storytelling. The low cut Protro build updates the original silhouette for modern performance while keeping its identity intact. This pair stands out because of what it represents. The Mambacita theme connects the shoe to a deeper narrative, making it more than just a performance model. It is a release that resonates with collectors and fans who appreciate both the history and impact behind the design. The Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro Mambacita was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver Platinum Violet (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver Platinum Violet for women is a stunning blend of style and performance. This sleek sneaker features a captivating colorway of Vast Grey, Metallic Silver, Platinum Violet, and Taupe Grey, creating a sophisticated and versatile look. The upper is crafted with premium materials, offering both durability and breathability for all-day comfort. The iconic Nike Swoosh adorns the sides, adding a touch of classic branding to this modern design. Engineered for optimal performance, the Zoom Vomero 5 incorporates Nike's renowned Zoom Air technology in the midsole. This responsive cushioning system provides excellent energy return and impact protection, making these shoes ideal for running or casual wear. The outsole features a strategic traction pattern, ensuring grip and stability on various surfaces. With its eye-catching metallic accents and comfortable fit, this women's sneaker is perfect for those who demand both style and functionality in their footwear. Our team thinks this product is great for fashion-forward individuals who appreciate a blend of retro and contemporary design in their athletic footwear.

Display Name: Nike Blazer Low Off-White University Red
Description: The Nike Blazer Low Off-White White University Red boasts a multi-disciplinary, multi-sport aesthetic - a central motif in Virgil Abloh's body of work. Encompassing aspects of basketball, skateboarding, and trail running silhouettes, the Off-White Blazer Low fuses an Air Terra Humara TPU heel piece with a classic vulcanized sole for a unique base. On the white leather upper, punched-out holes are scattered, similar to the Air Jordan 5 Off-White. An accented over-lacing system, exposed foam tongue, zip tie tag, and Swoosh tab all add Off-White's signature detailing to this modified classic. The Nike Blazer Low Off-White White University Red released in April of 2022 and retailed for $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low SP Undefeated Multi-Patent Wild Berry
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low SP Undefeated Multi-Patent Wild Berry is a unique variation of Nikes Air Force 1 Low sneaker dressed in Celestine Blue, Sail, and Gum color schemes. The Nike Air Force 1 Low SP Undefeated Multi-Patent Wild Berry features a perforated toe box to allow for unrestricted air entry and exit during wear, a Nike Swoosh on the lateral sides in Sail, white shoe laces to ensure a comfortable and secure fit, and "NIKE AIR" brandings on the black heel cap. The sneakers lower design features a white rubber midsole that ensures comfort by providing an energy return and cushioning and a treaded outsole to ensure traction on various surfaces. What we love about this Nike Air Force 1 Low SP Undefeated Multi-Patent Wild Berry sneaker, which first appeared on the market on February 2, 2023 with a recommended retail price of $160, are the contrasting color schemes that make it unique and fashionable.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 QS Smoke Grey Crocodile
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 QS Smoke Grey Crocodile introduces texture driven luxury to a beloved classic. Sail and Light Smoke Grey set a neutral base, while Black and Anthracite accents add structure and depth. Crocodile inspired detailing across the upper gives the shoe a distinctive edge that separates it from standard releases. Quickstrike editions often experiment with material storytelling, and this pair leans into that philosophy through its textured overlays. The croc effect adds dimension without overpowering the clean Air Max 90 shape. For collectors who gravitate toward premium spins on heritage silhouettes, this release offers subtle statement value grounded in familiar design language. The Nike Air Max 90 QS Smoke Grey Crocodile was released on December 23, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Photon Dust Bright Violet
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Fresh Mint for Women brings the iconic 95 silhouette's most dramatic design feature, the exaggerated Air unit, to a colorway built around the cool and slightly unexpected freshness of mint against a black-dominant base. The Big Bubble execution amplifies the heel Air unit beyond standard 95 proportions, making the cushioning architecture even more central to the shoe's visual identity and reinforcing the silhouette's status as one of the boldest and most structurally interesting designs in Nike's running archive. Fresh mint against black, white, medium grey, and anthracite creates a color story with real depth and tonal range that feels considered rather than coincidentally assembled. The women's specific offering acknowledges the Air Max 95's enormous and devoted female collector following while delivering the Big Bubble upgrade in a colorway that suits the silhouette's dramatic proportions without relying on pastels or conventional feminine palette choices. Fresh mint is confident and slightly unexpected, which is exactly the right energy for a shoe this architecturally bold. The layered gradient paneling that defines the 95's upper carries the cool and slightly athletic color story beautifully across every surface transition from toe to heel. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Fresh Mint Women's was released on June 1, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Snakeskin Light Orewood Brown (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Snakeskin Light Orewood Brown (Women's) is a stunning addition to the iconic Air Max line. This women's sneaker showcases a sophisticated blend of textures and colors, featuring a light orewood brown base accented with malt, velvet brown, and multi-color details. The standout element is the luxurious snakeskin texture, which adds an exotic touch to the classic silhouette. Designed for both style and comfort, these sneakers boast the renowned Air Max cushioning technology in the sole, ensuring a smooth and responsive ride. The upper combines premium materials, including leather and textile, for a durable and breathable construction. With its versatile colorway and timeless design, this Air Max 1 effortlessly transitions from casual daywear to more elevated occasions. We at StockX believe this product is great for fashion-forward individuals who appreciate a balance of classic design and contemporary flair. The unique snakeskin texture and neutral color palette make it an excellent choice for those looking to add a subtle statement piece to their sneaker collection.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Collegiate Green Semi Green Spark (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Collegiate Green Semi Green Spark (Women's) is a retro sneaker that finds inspiration in the original sneaker from the 1970s. Although the original shoe was designed for playing handball on indoor courts, this version does not have a specific sports designation. However, the rubber outsole provides traction on a variety of surfaces and the front lacing system ensures a secure fit. The upper is made from soft suede in Collegiate Green with tonal overlays crafted from the same material. The serrated 3-Stripes on the side panel, the retro-inspired tongue logo tag, the collar, and the laces all come in Semi-Green. A feature our StockX experts like is the branding details. Although you cannot find adidas branding on the heel counter, SPEZIAL and a small trefoil are printed along the serrated 3-Stripes logo in metallic gold. The womens size adidas Handball Spezial Collegiate Green Semi Green Spark (Women's) was released on November 27th, 2023, and retailed at $110.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Black Gym Red
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High Black Gym Red borrows a design and color scheme from the original Air Jordan 1. However, this sneaker boasts a shorter silhouette and red accents instead of a black-and-red upper. Nike released the Jordan 1 Retro High Black Gym Red in 2019 after launching sixty Air Jordan 1 colorways in 2018, then several more colorways in the following year. Shiny black overlays wrap around the white leather upper. The winged Air Jordan logo stands out brightly against the black leather. A red Nike swoosh logo appears on the side, accentuated by the red leather at the ankle. Jordan 1 Retro High Black Gym Red released in June of 2019 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Laney (2023)
Description: The Air Jordan 14 Retro Laney (2023) is a special colorway of the classic Jordan 14 Retro silhouette that has been a street favorite since its debut in 1998. It pays tribute to Michael Jordan's former high school, Emsley A. Laney High School in Wilmington, North Carolina - drawing inspiration from their team colors. The Laney colorway features Varsity Royal predominantly with accents Varsity Maize, black and white. The shoes upper is dressed in Varsity Royal suede, while Varsity Maize accents can be seen on the Jumpman branding, tongue, and heel. Black details include the outsole, heel tab, and inner lining, while white covers the midsole. It also maintains some signature features of the Jordan 14 model, such as the molded heel counter, padded collar, and the dual Zoom Air units in the forefoot and heel. The Air Jordan 14 Retro Laney (2023) was released for retail at the price of $210 on May 27, 2023.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Night Indigo
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Night Indigo reimagines the Handball Spezial with a dark colorway of Night Indigo with Cream White accents. Cream White on the heel tab, the 3-Stripes logo, and the collar lining give the sneaker a worn-in feel, which speaks to the adidas Handball Spezial's retro athletic roots. The upper is crafted from soft suede, while the 3-Stripes logo and the heel tab come in smooth leather. The heel panel, toebox overlay, and serrated edges of the lace cage are also suede. Instead of natural or light gum, the rubber outsole features a dark gum hue that complements the Night Indigo suede. Another retro touch is the vintage-inspired tag on the tongue that displays "adidas handball spezial" in Night Indigo letters. Our experts at StockX like the metallic "SPEZIAL" lettering on the lateral side panel. The adidas Handball Spezial Night Indigo was released on May 1, 2024, and sold for $100.

Display Name: Converse Run Star Motion Black White Gum
Description: The Converse Run Star Motion Black White Gum is a sneaker from the Converse Run Star Motion pack in a Black/White/Gum colorway. This high-top sneaker features a black canvas upper with a reinforced toe cap. Other upper details include the circle All-Star logo patch on the medial ankle, a CX foam insole, White stitching, branded tongue, a heel pull tab, silver metallic eyelets, and white Laces. The highlight of this sneaker is a chunky and wavy sole unit made up of a lightweight Phylon midsole dressed in white and lugged outsole with gum on the forefoot and black rubber at the heel. The Converse Run Star Motion Black White Gum was released on June 16, 2021 - retailing at $120.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL Silver Metallic
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL Silver Metallic brings a sleek and modern look to everyday performance running with a design that feels fast even at a glance. The silver metallic finish gives the shoe a clean and reflective aesthetic, while subtle tonal layering keeps it from feeling overly flashy. It sits in that sweet spot between performance and lifestyle, making it a versatile option that still carries Adizero DNA. Collectors and runners alike appreciate how this model blends comfort with a lightweight feel that works across different types of movement. The streamlined upper and balanced construction make it easy to wear consistently, whether for training or casual rotation. It is a shoe that does not try to do too much but still delivers a strong visual presence through its metallic palette. The adidas Adizero Evo SL Silver Metallic was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Light Smoke Grey (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Light Smoke Grey (Women's) provides the classic court silhouette using environmentally thoughtful construction. The colorway is a refined two-tone mix of White and Light Smoke Grey. The design retains the original's paneling and low-cut profile. The material choices emphasize sustainable sourcing, evidenced by the speckling visible in the outsole. The combination of the clean White base and Light Smoke Grey overlays offers a timeless, versatile aesthetic. Slated for release on December 20, 2024, this environmentally conscious Dunk was priced at $100 retail. The subtle contrast between the crisp White and the muted Light Smoke Grey ensures a clean, easily paired look. This model proves that heritage style and responsible material composition can be seamlessly integrated. Our experts commend the incorporation of sustainable materials, indicated by the speckled outsole, applied to the timeless two-tone White and Light Smoke Grey Dunk Low structure.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Run
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Run presents a clean and balanced palette built around everyday performance. Platinum Tint and Sail create a light and airy foundation, while College Grey and black accents provide contrast and structure. The premium build enhances the streamlined silhouette, preserving the comfort and responsiveness that define the Pegasus series. It feels smooth, dependable, and visually refined. Collectors and runners alike appreciate when neutral tones highlight thoughtful construction. The subtle grey spectrum keeps the design versatile, allowing the shape and cushioning system to take center stage. It blends understated style with reliable performance, reinforcing the Pegasus reputation for consistency. Calm and composed, this edition stands strong through simplicity. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Run was released on July 3, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Obsidian
Description: Jordan Brand adds a new colorway to its hot streak of Jordan 1 releases with the Air Jordan 1 "Obsidian / University Blue", now available on StockX. Since its debut in 1985, the Air Jordan 1 has been a cultural monument, breaking barriers between the court and the streets. Jordan Brand has continued to shed new light on this timeless silhouette and does so with this release. This AJ 1 features a similar design to the "UNC Patent" 1s that released in February of 2019, only this time the colorway receives a full leather treatment. This sneaker released in August of 2019 and retails for $160.

Display Name: Nike Shox Ride 2 Black University Red
Description: The Nike Shox Ride 2 Black University Red brings back a performance driven silhouette with a bold and mechanical look defined by its iconic cushioning system. The black upper creates a sleek and structured base, while metallic medium ash tones add subtle layering across the design. University red accents provide a sharp contrast, highlighting key areas and giving the shoe a more aggressive and energetic feel. Fans of the Shox line appreciate how it stands apart from traditional running models through its distinct column based sole and futuristic aesthetic. This colorway leans into that identity with strong contrast and clean execution. It is a sneaker that blends nostalgia with innovation, making it a standout option within Nikes retro performance lineup. The Nike Shox Ride 2 Black University Red was released on July 21, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Model: Nike Mercurial Superfly 1 RGN FG SE
Display Name: Nike Mercurial Superfly 1 RGN FG SE CR7 Metallic Gold Star
Description: The Nike Mercurial Superfly 1 RGN FG SE CR7 Metallic Gold Star arrived as a celebratory tribute to one of football's most remarkable individual achievements, marking Cristiano Ronaldo becoming the first player in history to score at six separate FIFA World Cups. Overflowing with goal scoring nostalgia, the boot revives the original 2009 Superfly 1 silhouette, drenching the ultra thin microfibre synthetic upper entirely in a shimmering metallic gold finish accented by a clean white Swoosh and matching laces. A large GOAT graphic printed across the insole, alongside Ronaldo's signature and CR7 branding at the heel, leaves no ambiguity about the boot's celebratory purpose. Beneath the retro inspired upper sits genuinely modern technology, pairing a unique three quarter length Air Zoom unit with a chevron stud wave pattern for explosive traction whenever it matters most. A lightweight Pebax soleplate with tuned flex zones delivers spring and stability, while Flywire cables integrated throughout the upper provide a snug, locked in fit when the laces are pulled tight. As Ronaldo's first personal signature Nike boot since the 2022 World Cup, this Metallic Gold Star edition stands as a genuinely significant release within the Mercurial line's storied history. The Nike Mercurial Superfly 1 RGN FG SE CR7 Metallic Gold Star was released on June 24, 2026 with a retail price of $300.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves Noise Aqua (with Bracelet)
Description: In collaboration with Patta, the Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves Noise Aqua (with Bracelet) features a grey mesh upper with white overlays with Aqua Swooshes and a wave-shaped mudguard. From there, classic Nike branding on the heel pays homage to the original line of Air Max 1s. A white midsole, multicolor outsole, and custom Patta woven tongue tags completes the design. The Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves Noise Aqua (with Bracelet) released in October of 2021 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Nike Waffle Debut Midnight Navy
Description: The Nike Waffle Debut Midnight Navy is a heritage-rooted lifestyle sneaker that modernizes the foundational design language of Nike's 1979 Daybreak, one of the brand's earliest and most influential running silhouettes, into a contemporary everyday shoe that connects directly to the origins of the waffle outsole technology that Bill Bowerman famously developed by pressing rubber into his wife Barbara's waffle iron in 1971. The Waffle Debut takes the suede and nylon upper combination that defined the pre-Nike Blue Ribbon Sports and early Nike running shoe era and pairs it with an updated wedge midsole that provides a lifted, modernized stance while preserving the low-profile, clean silhouette character of the original Daybreak. The Midnight Navy, Obsidian, Thunder Blue, and White colorway builds a tonal blue-dominant upper that layers two deep, rich navy tones for visual depth, the Thunder Blue accent providing the contrast note that separates the overlays from the base and gives the colorway a more dimensional appearance than a straightforward single-navy execution would allow. Soft suede overlays echo the materials used on the earliest Nike shoes, while textile underlays add durability and a crisp finish. Swoosh logos wrap around the heel to form pull tabs, adding a functional detail with considered aesthetics that makes on-and-off easier. The molded tongue adds structure, and the low-cut padded collar keeps the profile clean and the fit comfortable throughout the day. The rubber Waffle outsole at the bottom anchors every detail of the shoe to its founding heritage, the distinctive grid-pattern tread that has appeared on Nike shoes for over fifty years providing durable traction with the visual signature that makes a Waffle shoe instantly recognizable. Style code FJ4195-400. The Nike Waffle Debut Midnight Navy is the everyday lifestyle shoe for the Nike heritage enthusiast who wants the foundational suede and nylon material story of the early Nike running era in a deep, tonal navy colorway built on one of the most historically significant outsole designs in sneaker history. The Nike Waffle Debut Midnight Navy was released on April 4, 2024 with a retail price of $80.

Display Name: adidas Sambae Cloud White Metallic Gold (Women's)
Description: The adidas Sambae Cloud White Metallic Gold Womens refreshes the terrace classic with a slightly elevated and modern stance. Built in Cloud White with Core Black accents and touches of Gold Metallic, the familiar Samba lines are preserved while the platform inspired sole adds subtle height. The smooth upper and clean color blocking keep it rooted in football heritage while introducing a more fashion forward edge. The Sambae silhouette has become a favorite for those who want classic proportions with a contemporary lift. The gold detailing adds a refined touch that contrasts beautifully against the white base, giving the shoe a polished feel without losing its everyday versatility. It feels timeless yet updated, bridging sport history with current street style energy. The adidas Sambae Cloud White Metallic Gold Womens was released on May 1, 2024 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Anta Kai 1 Jelly
Description: The Anta Kai 1 Jelly is a premium basketball shoe thats part of a collaboration between Chinese sportswear company Anta and NBA player Kyrie Irving. It dresses the Anta Kai 1s sporty silhouette in an all-over hot-pink colorway with a shiny finish and subtle gradient shifts. The "Jelly" moniker is a reference to Irvings acrobatic, jelly-like layups, while the sleek silhouette represents the athletes style of play. Released as an exclusive in China, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia, the Jelly Anta Kai 1 is made from high-quality synthetic material, contributing to its lightweight design. The heel boasts a TPU counter for stability, while the carbon-fiber plate in the midsole increases energy return and forward momentum. Our StockX experts appreciate the Irving-specific branding details, including the shield of protection logo on the tongue. The Anta Kai 1 Jelly was released on October 1, 2024, and sold for $125.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Airy Green
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Airy Green is a performance shoe with a slim build that takes inspiration from the style of the 1960s. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 in Airy Green is constructed with a grained leather upper in the pale Airy Green color. A slightly darker green colors the suede overlays that form the t-shaped toe cap, eyestays, and the crisscross at the heel. Verdigris Green racing stripes, which have become synonymous with the shoe, cross each side in leather. Tiger branding is seen on the heel collar, and there is a white and green logo patch on the tongue. The shoe has a thick off-white rubber toe cap and sits on a thin off-white midsole and outsole. What we think stands out here is the tonal green colorway, which is perfect for seasonal wear. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Airy Green was released on August 13, 2023, for $120.

Display Name: Nike Dunk SB Low Krampus
Description: Nike Dunk SB Low Krampus dives into dark folklore and seasonal storytelling, transforming the SB Dunk into something eerie and atmospheric. Inspired by the mythical Krampus figure, the design leans into shadowy tones and unsettling details that feel purpose built for late night sessions and winter drops. It embraces the darker side of skate culture, where personality and narrative matter just as much as function. This pair stands out to collectors because it feels bold and unapologetic. The SB Dunk Low already carries deep counterculture roots, and the Krampus theme amplifies that identity with a design that rewards fans who appreciate concept driven sneakers. It feels like a release meant to be remembered, capturing mood and attitude rather than chasing broad appeal. The Nike Dunk SB Low Krampus was released on12/02/2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike GT Cut 3 White Bleached Turquoise
Description: The Nike GT Cut 3 White Bleached Turquoise blends sharp contrast with court ready speed. A white base keeps the silhouette bright and balanced, while Green Strike and Bleached Turquoise accents inject vibrant energy. Black detailing defines the structure, highlighting the low cut shape built for quick cuts and explosive movement. The responsive cushioning platform reinforces its guard focused identity. Players appreciate how the GT Cut line pairs agility with expressive color. The turquoise and green tones stand out against the white foundation, giving the shoe personality without overwhelming its clean build. It feels fast, dynamic, and ready for high pace play. Balanced and bold, this pair delivers impact from tip off to final buzzer. The Nike GT Cut 3 White Bleached Turquoise was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Michigan (2021/2024) (GS)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Michigan for grade school sizes (GS) brings back one of the original colorways from the 1985 Be True to Your School series, reimagined as a low-top and offered in grade school sizing. The Nike Dunk Low Michigan (GS) low-profile silhouette carries an all-leather upper and is built on a Varsity Maize yellow base with Midnight Navy overlays. Perforations on the toe box provide breathability, while a lightly padded nylon tongue that bears the Nike woven brand tag supports the fit. Underfoot, a Midnight Navy rubber outsole atop a White midsole to complete the design. The Nike Dunk Low Michigan (GS) was released in April 2021 and retailed for $85.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 22 What the Monopoly Tie-Dye (Translucent Outsole)
Description: LBJ and Nike Basketball expand their monopoly collection with the Nike LeBron 22 What the Monopoly Tie-Dye (Translucent Outsole). This playful tie-dye colorway embraces bold creativity and honors the iconic board game of Monopoly. The What the Monopoly Tie-Dye Nike LeBron 22 (Translucent Outsole) boasts a striking tie-dye finish, showcasing vibrant flashes of red, pink, blue, and orange, reminiscent of the shades of Monopoly currency. Volt Green accents grace the sock liner, laces, and tongue, adding a fresh contrast, while a jewel-like red Monopoly tag sits atop the tongue. Special details from the collaboration include embroidered dice motifs, a collar tag featuring Monopoly branding, and an iridescent Swoosh, which adds some shine to the design. The sneakers cushioning setup includes Cushion 2.0 foam, a Zoom Turbo unit, and an Air Zoom unit, with a two-tone icy outsole completing the design. What our experts love about the Nike LeBron 22 What the Monopoly Tie-Dye (Translucent Outsole) is its vibrant design that nods to the legendary board game in a bold, playful way. The sneaker was released for $200 on January 23rd, 2025.
Colorway: Mint Foam/Cerise/Light Lemon Twist/Aquarius Blue/Persian Violet/Pink Foam

Display Name: adidas Campus 00s Core Black
Description: The adidas Campus 00s Core Black was launched as part of the sports collection sneakers in the adidas brand. The adidas Campus 00s Core Black is covered in core black and white colorways at the upper, footwear white midsole, and brown outsole. This sneaker is a product of suede, rubber, and leather materials that completes the texture. The adidas Campus 00s Core Black features the adidas logo on the tongue and the heel with campus branding at its quarter. The adidas Campus 00s Core Black got released at a suggested retail price of $100 on February 17, 2023.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black Toe Reimagined (GS)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black Toe Reimagined (GS) pays tribute to the shoe Michael Jordan wore during his first season with the Chicago Bulls. The Black Toe Reimagined (GS) Jordan 1 Retro High OG is part of Jordan BrandÄôs Reimagined series, which updates classic Jordan silhouettes and colorways with a contemporary twist. It boasts color-blocking on the sole unit and upper in Varsity Red, black, and white. Crafted from premium leather, the upper displays black on the eyelets, collar, mudguard, and Swoosh logos. In contrast, the base and midsole come in crisp white, while Varsity Red decorates the ankle collar, the heel, and the rudder outsole. In terms of branding, ÄòAIR JORDANÄô appears on the ankle collar, and the tongue tag bears ÄòNIKE AIRÄô lettering. Our experts at StockX like how the ÄòNIKE AIRÄô branding stands out on the tongue, commemorating the NBA legend. The grade school-sized Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black Toe Reimagined (GS) was released on February 15, 2025, and sold for $140.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low LX Metallic Silver Pink Foam (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low LX Metallic Silver Pink Foam (Women's), in womens sizes, is an athletic shoe featuring a Photon Dust upper, highlighted by the Nike Swoosh in Metallic Silver on the sides. The midsole and outsole are done in a two-tone combination of Pink Foam and Medium Soft Pink. Nike branding on the tongue and rear heel tab pops against the frosty Pink color palette. Having developed the Dunk to complement university sports team colors, the iconic lifestyle sneaker is one of Nikes most riffed upon styles. While typically identified with natty, bold colors with a coordinating sole treatment, the Dunk Low LX explores the possibilities of midsole coloration that varies from the upper, an exciting experimentation. Our experts feel that the best feature of the Dunk Low LX is its Metallic Silver Pink Foam colorway, which is cool and fresh. The Nike Dunk Low LX Metallic Silver Pink Foam (Women's) released on August 9, 2024, and retailed for $110.
Colorway: Photon Dust/Metallic Silver-Pink Foam-Medium Soft Pink

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low SE Gone Fishing Rainbow Trout
Description: The Nike Dunk Low SE Gone Fishing Rainbow Trout is an addition to the Dunk Low sneaker line and is inspired by the rainbow trout fish, which is known for its bright and colorful scales. The colors on the Gone Fishing Rainbow Trout Nike Dunk Low SE are arranged in a gradient pattern. The Nike logo is featured prominently on the sides with a scale-like graphic. The sneaker has a padded tongue and collar, as well as a cushioned footbed that provides support and cushioning for your feet. The shoe also has a rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern, which offers traction and grip on various surfaces. We think that the notable feature of the Nike Dunk Low SE Gone Fishing Rainbow Trout is its uncanny design. The shoe's leather and suede upper are displayed to resemble the fish's scales, with a pattern of bright colors including Safety Orange and Sequoia. The Nike Dunk Low SE Gone Fishing Rainbow Trout was released on June 16th, 2023, at a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Comfort Ride EasyOn Platinum Tint College Grey
Description: The Nike Comfort Ride EasyOn Platinum Tint College Grey focuses on ease and accessibility, combining a neutral palette with a design built for convenience. Platinum tint and college grey create a soft and wearable base, while sail, spruce aura, phantom, and summit white accents add subtle layers of depth. The silhouette feels supportive and easy to step into. This pair resonates because it prioritizes everyday function. The EasyOn system simplifies the process of putting the shoe on and taking it off, making it practical for a wide range of users. Fans appreciate when comfort driven models still maintain a clean and thoughtful design, and this delivers that balance effectively. The Nike Comfort Ride EasyOn Platinum Tint College Grey was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Driftwood Timberwolf
Description: The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Driftwood Timberwolf delivers a softer, earth toned take on the modernized 990v6 silhouette. Driftwood shades dominate the upper, complemented by Timberwolf accents that add subtle contrast and warmth. The refined panel layout keeps the design sleek, while the updated sole unit gives the shoe a contemporary stance that feels responsive and balanced. As part of the Made in USA line, the craftsmanship and material quality are central to its appeal. This colorway resonates with fans who appreciate neutral palettes with depth. The combination of light brown and muted grey tones creates a versatile look that transitions easily across seasons. It feels calm and intentional, letting the silhouettes proportions and construction shine. For longtime 990 enthusiasts, this pair represents the ongoing evolution of a classic without losing its identity. The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Driftwood Timberwolf was released on October 30, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Cool Grey
Description: Jordan is bringing back the Cool Grey colorway for the first time since the release of the Air Jordan 11 Retro Cool Grey in 2021, with the release of the Air Jordan 6 Retro Cool Grey. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Cool Grey appears with white leather uppers, and grey nubuck paneling, a similar pattern as used on the Air Jordan 6 UNC White. The retro sneakers sit on top of an icy blue outsole, similar to the Air Jordan 11 Retro Cool Grey, and come with gray lace locks with white Jordan branding. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Cool Grey released February 25, 2023, with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: adidas Ozweego Core Black
Description: The adidas Ozweego Core Black Carbon Mesh was part of a relaunch and expansion of the adidas Originals Ozweego line. The Core Black Carbon Mesh adidas Ozweego features a predominantly black upper made of a mix of leather, suede, and mesh. The midsole has a chunky and sculpted design that provides ample cushioning and the rugged outsole offers durability and grip. The adidas Ozweego Core Black Carbon Mesh has rounded laces and a padded collar around the neck. The laces are black and the padded collar is designed to provide additional support. The adidas Ozweego Core Black was released on August 8th, 2019 at a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Space Jam
Description: Introducing the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'Space Jam', an iconic silhouette that brings the nostalgia of 1996 straight to the streets. These sneakers are a modern twist on a classic, combining historical significance with contemporary style. The sneaker integrates the cherished Space Jam colorway, traditionally seen on higher-cut models, onto the Jordan 11 Low for the first time, making it a groundbreaking release for collectors and new fans alike. This rendition of the Jordan 11 Low features a sleek black upper composed of high-quality patent leather and ballistic mesh, perfectly complementing the Varsity Royal accents that can be found on the iconic Jumpman logo & portions of the outsole. Contrasted with a crisp white midsole and a translucent outsole, the design maintains the aesthetic integrity of the original high-top version. This shoe celebrates Michael Jordan's larger-than-life influence both on and off the court. Released on May 18, 2024, at a retail price of $190, the 'Space Jam' Jordan 11 Retro Low is a piece of basketball heritage. As it hits the shelves, it brings with it stories of victories, cultural moments, and a legacy of innovation. Whether stepping out on the court or walking the streets, these sneakers offer a timeless style combined with unmatched comfort. Dont miss out on owning a piece of history with the Jordan 11 Retro Low 'Space Jam', a must-have for sneaker enthusiasts around the globe.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Cow Print (Women's)
Description: Step into style with the adidas Samba OG Cow Print, a playful twist on the classic silhouette designed exclusively for women. This eye-catching sneaker features a unique cow print pattern on the upper, blending dark brown and off-white hues for a bold, fashion-forward look. The iconic gum 3 outsole provides excellent traction and durability, while staying true to the Samba's timeless aesthetic. The Samba OG Cow Print combines comfort and style effortlessly. Its soft leather upper offers a premium feel and excellent support, while the cushioned insole ensures all-day comfort. The signature T-toe overlay and serrated 3-Stripes maintain the shoe's classic appeal, making it a versatile option for both casual wear and statement-making outfits. Us at StockX believe this product is great for fashion-conscious individuals looking to add a unique, conversation-starting piece to their sneaker collection.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low White Midnight Navy
Description: The Nike Dunk Low White Midnight Navy is a two-toned Dunk Low dressed in a classic colorway of Midnight Navy and Clean White. The all-leather construction infuses the White Midnight Navy Nike Dunk Low with a premium feel while paying tribute to the Dunk Lows basketball roots. Although the base comes in Crisp White, a section of Midnight Navy color-blocking provides contrast on the eyelets, the forefoot and heel overlays, the heel counter, the padded collar, and the flat tongue. In addition, the signature leather Swoosh logo, the rubber outsole, and the laces come in Midnight Navy. In terms of branding, NIKE is embroidered on the heel counter, and the tongues woven tag showcases NIKE and a Swoosh logo in white. Our experts at StockX like that the stitching comes in a tonal hue, blending into the leather panels. The Nike Dunk Low White Midnight Navy was released on January 1, 2025, and sold for $115.

Display Name: New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Navy
Description: The New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Navy continues the legacy of one of the most respected running inspired silhouettes in sneaker history through a colorway rooted deeply in New Balance heritage. The 990 series became iconic because of its balance of premium construction, understated design, and everyday comfort, and the v4 remains especially beloved for its clean proportions and timeless shape. The Navy and Silver palette represents classic New Balance styling at its purest, creating a refined and versatile sneaker that feels equally connected to athletic history and contemporary streetwear culture. Fans gravitate toward Made in USA 990 models because they represent craftsmanship, quality materials, and consistency in a sneaker industry increasingly focused on fast moving trends. The navy suede overlays paired with breathable mesh create a rich layered appearance that feels premium without becoming flashy or overstated. Collectors especially appreciate the 990v4 because it balances retro performance aesthetics and modern wearability more naturally than many other heritage runners. The muted color palette reinforces the understated confidence that has made the 990 line a staple across fashion, running, and lifestyle communities for decades. The New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Navy was released on October 20, 2023 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Concord
Description: Three major color schemes; concord, white, and black, are used to tone the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low Concord. The ballistic mesh upper of this Low Air Jordan 11 sneaker is finished in white, and the mudguard is covered in a black patent leather material. The Phylon midsole has full-length Air unit sole for cushioning underfoot. The herringbone pattern pods on the outsole are where the titular Concord hue appears. This Retro shoe comes with a white lacing system as well. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low Concord was first made available on May 3rd, 2014. It was recommended to retail at $150.

Display Name: Nike Lunar Force 1 High Duckboot Ale Brown Black
Description: The Nike Lunar Force 1 High Duckboot Ale Brown Black is a mens shoe that was originally designed for high-performance basketball. The Nike Lunar Force 1 High Duckboot in Ale Brown Black features an Air unit, which brings about a lightweight cushioning. Cold and dampness are kept away by the tongue folding around the ankle. The sneakers are designed with a lace-up, a slip-on, and a width, which allows a snug fit. The upper is made of water-resistant leather on its heel and quarter panel. A studded synthetic material is used on the forefoot. We think that the top feature of the Nike Lunar Force 1 High Duckboot Ale Brown Black is the design and color combination, which makes it suitable for casual wear school activities and workwear. Its also flat-heeled making it perfect for an all-day wear. The shoe was released on September 24th, 2016, at a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Pink Purple
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Pink Purple revives early performance running aesthetics through bold color and layered structure. Pink and purple tones energize the ProGrid Omni 9s technical build, giving the shoe a vibrant and expressive feel that still respects its stability focused roots. Mesh and synthetic overlays create depth, allowing color to flow naturally across the silhouette. Fans gravitate toward this pair because it feels nostalgic and fresh at the same time. The ProGrid Omni 9 has become a favorite for those who appreciate classic running shapes with modern styling, and this colorway amplifies that appeal. Collectors appreciate Sauconys ability to reintroduce archive models with confidence, making this release feel intentional, wearable, and visually exciting without losing authenticity. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Pink Purple was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Liberty London Delft Blue (Women's)
Description: The Adidas Handball Spezial in Crystal Sky, Silver Metallic, and Chalk White for Women is a colorway of one of the most culturally significant and enduringly beloved silhouettes in the entire Adidas archive, bringing a soft and atmospheric tonal palette to a shoe whose design has remained essentially unchanged since it was first developed for indoor handball courts in the 1970s and whose cultural journey from sport specific performance footwear to global street and fashion staple is one of the most remarkable trajectories in sneaker history. Crystal sky as a colorway description evokes exactly the kind of pale and slightly luminous blue that the name suggests, a tone that sits between grey and blue in a soft and almost ethereal register that gives the Spezial silhouette a feminine and fashion forward expression without the high saturation or bold contrast that would feel incongruous on a shoe whose entire aesthetic identity is built around subtle sophistication and understated confidence. Silver metallic introduces a gentle shimmer that plays across the detailing and overlays of the shoe, catching light in a way that adds dimension and luxury feeling to the crystal sky base without overwhelming the quiet elegance of the overall colorway. The Handball Spezial has experienced a remarkable cultural renaissance over the past several years that has seen it become one of the most worn and discussed silhouettes in the contemporary sneaker market, beloved by fashion editors, streetwear enthusiasts, and everyday wearers alike for the way its low profile gum sole construction, suede upper, and perfectly proportioned side stripe create a shoe that looks right with virtually every outfit context from tailored trousers to wide leg denim to summer dresses. The Women's specific iteration in crystal sky and silver metallic is the kind of Spezial colorway that rewards wearers who appreciate restraint and tonal sophistication over graphic impact, appealing to those who understand that the most lasting and wearable sneakers are often the ones that whisper rather than shout. Chalk white on the sole and detailing keeps the overall color story clean and cohesive, grounding the crystal sky and silver in a bright neutral that ensures the shoe reads as fresh and deliberate rather than muted or timid across every seasonal context it encounters. The Adidas Handball Spezial in Crystal Sky, Silver Metallic, and Chalk White Women's was released on February 6, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High '85 Wings Phantom
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High 85 Wings Phantom elevates the iconic silhouette into a true luxury statement, dressing it in soft Phantom and Wolf Grey tones that feel refined and premium. Sanddrift accents add warmth, while Metallic Gold detailing introduces a subtle flash that signals this is part of the prestigious Wings line. The High 85 cut preserves the vintage shape, grounding the elevated materials in authentic heritage. Wings releases have always carried an air of exclusivity, often tied to limited distribution and elevated craftsmanship. This Phantom execution feels intentionally muted, allowing texture and detail to speak louder than bold color blocking. Collectors understand that Wings editions sit in a different tier, blending Jordan history with near art piece level presentation. It is the kind of pair that feels just as at home on display as it does on foot. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High 85 Wings Phantom was released on October 19, 2024 with a retail price of $975.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro AJKO Low SP Union Sail Leather
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro AJKO Low SP Union Sail Leather is a sneaker that came as a result of a collaboration between Jordan Brand and Union LA. The Air Jordan 1 Retro AJKO Low SP comes in a color scheme featuring a blend of Sail, black, and Muslin-Neutral Grey. The upper is made of Sail canvas and is complemented by tone-on-tone overlays, as well as a suede Nike Swoosh in black. Additionally, the shoe is adorned with a UN/LA tag, with the Union LA monogram located behind the comma, and finished off with yellow stitching on the forefoot. The Air Jordan 1 Retro AJKO Low SP Union Sail Leather was released on 2nd February 2023 with its retail price set at $150.

Display Name: Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Champagne
Description: The Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Champagne is part of Drakes NOCTA collaboration with Nike. Like other sneakers in the NOCTA lineup, the NOCTA x Nike Hot Step Air Terra "Champagne" features premium materials, a sleek design, and attention to detail. This sneaker boasts a leather construction with stitched lines and perforations across the upper. The mini-Swoosh in metallic gold, the gold panels by the heel, and the gold G G-TEK logo on the heel break up the light bone base. The sneaker comes with a bulky midsole with a visible Nike Air unit in the heel. An outsole with texturized tread in a translucent grey-blue complements the light bone color of the leather upper. Our experts at StockX love the lace-up front closure that secures the shoe without distracting from the overall design. The Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Champagne was released on November 18, 2022, and retailed at $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Black Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Black Smoke Grey Dark Smoke Grey leans into tonal depth, using layered shades of black and smoke grey to give the classic silhouette a more modern edge. The familiar Air Force 1 shape remains intact, with its sturdy build and timeless proportions, while the darker palette adds a sharper and more understated presence. This version stands out because it shows how subtle adjustments can refresh an icon. The Air Force 1 has always been about versatility, and this colorway enhances that by making it even easier to style across different looks. Fans appreciate releases that respect the original design while offering something new, and this pair delivers that balance without overcomplicating the formula. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Black Smoke Grey Dark Smoke Grey was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Travis Scott Cactus Jack Wheat Lemon Drop
Description: Joining the Gold and Brown version of Nike SNKRS is the Nike Air Max 1 Travis Scott Wheat Lemon Drop sneaker in baroque brown, wheat, and lemon drop colorways. The Nike Air Max 1 Travis Scott Wheat Lemon Drop silhouette is constructed with a lemon-colored upper mesh and a baroque brown mudguard and heel tab. To complete the design is a baroque brown corporate branding, red rope laces, wheat-colored tongues, and overlays, including a reverse Swoosh on the lateral in a neural lemon drop hue. The Nike Air Max 1 Travis Scott Wheat Lemon Drop sneaker was released on May 2022, retailing at $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 .SWOOSH Low Poly
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 .SWOOSH Low Poly is an exclusive low-profile sneaker dressed in a university red, white, and neutral grey color combo released with Nike.SWOOSH web portal. This colorway draws inspiration from the original 1987 Nike Air Max 1 model and showcases an iconic university red theme. Neutral grey overlays house a polygon mesh pattern, which is a nod to 8-bit retro video games. The signature Nike Swoosh is in red with sharper edges, and the same edgy style and pixelated pattern is seen on the mudguard, quarter, and heel. The toe cap, tongue, laces, and sock liner are crisp white. Notice the small white embroidered Swoosh on the mudguard. What our experts love about this shoe is how creatively it incorporates the low-poly graphic concept into the design, from the standout red polygon eyelet to the pixelated Nike logo on the tongue. The Nike Air Max 1 .SWOOSH Low Poly was released on October 8, 2024, with a $150 price tag.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 5 White Bright Mandarin
Description: Built for high-intensity training with a clean, modern look, the Nike Free Metcon 5 White Bright Mandarin blends the flexibility of Nike Free with the stability of Metcon. A chain-link mesh upper in Summit White and Light Silver wraps the foot with breathable support, while a soft inner sleeve makes it easy to slip on and go. The wide, flat heel and firm sidewalls create a solid base for squats and kettlebell work, and a molded heel clip helps keep your foot planted when youre moving laterally. Deep flex grooves in the forefoot deliver natural movement for sprints, jumps, and agility drills, and targeted rubber on the outsole provides durable grip where you need it most. Finishing hits of Bright Mandarin energize the design, giving this performance trainer a bold, gym-ready edge. Engineered for versatility, this mens training shoe balances cushioning and control across your toughest circuits. Responsive foam smooths landings without sacrificing ground feel, while midfoot lockdown integrates with the lacing system to keep you secure through cuts and climbs. The rope wrap and reinforced toe cap add abrasion resistance for dynamic workouts, and the split outsole design encourages efficient transitions from strength to cardio. Whether youre tackling a metcon, pushing sleds, or chasing a new PR, the Nike Free Metcon 5 (style DV3949-101) provides confidence-inspiring traction and support in a crisp Summit White/Light Silver/Iron Grey/Bright Mandarin colorway. Our team loves this product because it delivers a rare combo of forefoot freedom and heel stability, ideal for cross-training, HIIT, and everyday gym sessions where speed and strength meet.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary (PS)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary (PS) is a "Special Project (SP)" sneaker, which means its created in the Nike lab and incorporates premium materials. This sneaker is also a collaborative project between American rapper Travis Scott and the Jordan Brand. The white leather construction serves as a backdrop for Canary, Racer Blue, and red accents, which intentionally use the kid-friendly primary colors. The forefoot overlays, the toebox mudguard, the heel panel, the laces, the heel tab, the tongue, and the collar lining come in bright Canary, which contrasts with the Racer Blue Swoosh logo on the side panels. In terms of branding, the heel tab displays the Jordan Wings logo, the red "NIKE" lettering graces the tongue tab, and the "cactus jack" in red is printed on the inner side panel. Our StockX experts like the inclusion of one reverse Swoosh and one standard Swoosh. The preschool-sized Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary (PS) was launched on May 25, 2024, and sold for $65.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Year of the Horse (2026) (GS)
Description: The Nike Kobe 8 Year of the Horse 2026 GS brings Lunar New Year energy to one of the lightest and most fluid silhouettes in the Kobe line. Light Crimson sets a vibrant foundation, while Vivid Blue and Bright Citron accents inject sharp contrast across the engineered upper. The low profile shape keeps the design fast and streamlined, true to the Kobe 8 identity. Year of the Horse editions have always carried symbolic weight, often tying performance excellence to cultural celebration. On the Kobe 8, the bold color mix feels dynamic and youthful, especially in GS sizing where expressive palettes thrive. For young fans of the Black Mamba legacy, this pair blends storytelling and speed in a way that feels both festive and performance ready. The Nike Kobe 8 Year of the Horse 2026 GS was released on January 31, 2026 with a retail price of $122.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Caitlin Clark Coconut Milk Spruce
Description: The Nike Kobe 5 Protro Caitlin Clark Coconut Milk Spruce brings a layered, story-driven color palette to one of Kobe Bryants most celebrated low-top silhouettes. Featuring coconut milk with bright spruce, midnight spruce, university red, and white accents, the design blends soft neutrals with rich green tones for a look that feels both refined and expressive. The mix of colors adds depth without overwhelming the streamlined shape of the Kobe 5. The Kobe 5 remains one of the most influential performance silhouettes ever created, originally introduced in 2010 as part of Kobes shift toward lightweight, low-cut basketball shoes. Protro releases have continued to reintroduce classic and new colorways with updated construction, allowing the model to remain relevant across generations. When the Nike Kobe 5 Protro Caitlin Clark Coconut Milk Spruce released, it retailed for $190. With its coconut milk, bright spruce, midnight spruce, university red, and white colorway, this release adds a fresh, layered look to one of the most iconic silhouettes in the Kobe line.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 8 After Hours
Description: The adidas Harden Vol. 8 After Hours represents a departure from the bold color blocking displayed on other Harden Vol. 8 iterations. Instead, it features Core Black and Cloud White on the upper and midsole, and a splash of Cobalt Blue on the outsole. Created by NBA player James Harden and adidas, this basketball shoe boasts a sleek silhouette with a sock-like cuff and breathable textile upper. The oversized EVA cage provides lateral support, while the BOOST midsole comes equipped with Lightstrike cushioning. However, the standout feature is the patent leather toe box in Cloud White. Its shiny surface reflects the light and draws attention to the sneakers molded design. Our experts at StockX like that both the textile base and other EVA cage come in Core Black, minimizing the color-blocking effect and reducing the spotlight usually shone on the side panels. The adidas Harden Vol. 8 After Hours was released on July 1, 2024, and sold for $160.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Birch
Description: The ASICS Gel 1130 Cream Birch leans into early 2000s running heritage with a colorway that feels soft, neutral, and easy to wear across seasons. Cream and birch tones give the mesh and synthetic upper a layered look that highlights the technical design without overwhelming it. The silhouette carries that familiar retro runner shape, with visible structure and paneling that nods to performance roots while fitting naturally into todays lifestyle rotation. What keeps the Gel 1130 relevant is how effortlessly it bridges nostalgia and everyday wear. The cushioning setup and breathable build stay true to ASICS running DNA, but the understated palette makes it especially versatile for modern styling. Fans appreciate how pairs like this do not rely on loud colors or collaborations to stand out, instead focusing on balance and wearability. It is a go to option for collectors who value comfort driven silhouettes with a clean and timeless aesthetic. The ASICS Gel 1130 Cream Birch was released on May 30, 2024 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Black Castlerock
Description: New Balance 9060 Black Castlerock blends futuristic proportions with heritage running cues, creating a silhouette that feels bold yet grounded. The black and castlerock palette gives the shoe a clean and versatile identity, allowing the exaggerated midsole and layered upper to stand out without overwhelming the design. It feels modern and confident, reflecting New Balances evolution into contemporary lifestyle culture. Collectors gravitate toward the 9060 because it represents experimentation done right.
