The shoe pushes form and scale while still feeling wearable, making it a favorite among fans who appreciate innovation rooted in brand DNA. It fits naturally into rotations built around comfort and design, reinforcing why New Balance continues to resonate with a new generation of sneaker enthusiasts. The New Balance 9060 Black Castlerock was released on 09/02/2022 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Ascent
Description: The adidas AE 1 Ascent adds a sleek colorway of Charcoal and Core Black to NBA player Anthony Edwards first signature sneaker with adidas. The mid-top Ascent adidas AE 1 sits on a lightweight, TPU-encased Jet Boost and LightStrike midsole, which finds support in a full-length torsional plate. While the upper is crafted from tightly woven mesh, TPU side panels with a honeycomb-like construction bolster the shoe and allow the foot to breathe. The TPU side panels also feature a marbled pattern in Charcoal that makes the "Ascent" stand out from other adidas AE 1 models. Although the sneaker boasts minimal branding details, a rubberized 3-Stripes logo graces the molded back heel. Our experts at StockX like the oversized herringbone traction pattern on the rubber outsole because it provides grip while complementing the honeycomb pattern on the side panels. The adidas AE 1 Ascent was released on July 20, 2024, and retailed at $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 QS Big Bubble Baroque Brown Leather
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 QS Big Bubble Baroque Brown Leather shifts the silhouette into a more refined and material focused direction, using a full leather build to create a smoother and more elevated finish. Baroque brown dominates the upper, giving the shoe a rich and uniform tone, while coconut milk and black accents add just enough contrast to define the layers. The result feels heavier and more premium. This version appeals to fans who appreciate texture and material over bold color. The leather construction changes the overall feel of the Air Max 95, making it look more polished while still maintaining its signature shape. It is a different kind of expression, one that focuses on depth and quality rather than contrast. The Nike Air Max 95 QS Big Bubble Baroque Brown Leather was released on February 11, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Teddy Santis White Black Plum
Description: The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Teddy Santis White Black Plum is a shoe designed as a collaboration between the brand and designer and Internet personality Teddy Santis. This iteration of the New Balance 990v6 features a white textile upper as the base. Synthetic overlays cross the upper in black, while the companys logo, a letter "N," appears on each side in a Black Plum (dark purple) color. A dark tan suede overlay forms the large toe cap, another forms the heel counter, and a lighter tan forms the mudguard in the middle. 990 branding is seen on the lateral heel counter, while Made in the USA branding is on the heel's back. The tongue bears a New Balance 990 patch. The shoe sits on a chunky tan and white midsole and black outsole. What stands out about this shoe is the contrast between the black and dark purple and the tans of the bottom of the shoe. The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Teddy Santis White Black Plum was released on June 27, 2024, for $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Premium Skunk
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Skunk leans fully into earthy tones with a layered mix of Cargo Khaki, Old Moss, Dusty Olive, and Velvet Brown. The upper feels rich and textured, emphasizing the sculpted panel design that made the Air Max 90 iconic. Deep greens and browns blend seamlessly, creating a rugged aesthetic that feels grounded and confident. The visible Air unit anchors the silhouette, preserving the performance heritage beneath the bold palette. This release resonates with collectors who gravitate toward outdoor inspired color stories. The tonal green and brown combination feels cohesive and mature, offering depth without relying on bright contrast. It is a statement built on texture and shade rather than flash. Rooted in heritage yet distinct in execution, this pair brings a fresh mood to a timeless runner. The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Skunk was released on December 1, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Anthracite Oatmeal Black
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus Anthracite Oatmeal Black blends performance innovation with a refined and neutral palette. Anthracite and Oatmeal layer across the upper, while Volt accents add a subtle pop of energy against the darker base. Black detailing ties the design together, keeping the silhouette sharp and cohesive. The Vomero line has long been praised for comfort and cushioning, and the Plus edition pushes that legacy forward with modern refinement. The contrast between muted tones and Volt highlights gives the shoe dimension without overpowering its performance identity. For runners and sneaker enthusiasts who appreciate understated design with technical backing, this release feels balanced and versatile. The Nike Vomero Plus Anthracite Oatmeal Black was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White Roses (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 White Roses Women are crisp white sneakers with a clean, flirty femininity. These low-rise shoes are versatile, modern and perfect for dressing up or down, with a subtle touch of romance in the rose details. Pure white from the colorways to laces and soles, the Nike Air Force 1 in women's sizing has an embossed rose motif on selected panels of the shoe. The toe box is perforated, and the Swoosh sits on the side panels in white leather. The heel has an embossed Nike wording and the Swoosh logo. The laces are white, making the entire shoe and crisp, clean and sophisticated. We just love how pretty these Nike sneaks are. Crafted only in womens sizes, they form part of the limited edition Valentines Day 2025 repertoire. Sleek and understated in design, the Nike Air Force 1 is known for its midsole cushioning for all-day easy wear with a breathable comfort. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 White Roses Women was released on January 8, 2025, and priced at $135.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Masterpiece (2025)
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Masterpiece returns in all its bold, artistic glory, celebrating Kobe Bryants legacy with a design as dynamic as his game. This high-top silhouette features a black & multi color Flyknit upper, acting as the perfect backdrop for an explosion of bright crimson, volt, and multi-color woven details, symbolizing the creativity and precision Kobe brought to the court. A metallic silver 3M Swoosh adds a reflective edge, while the quilted leather tongue with a green Mamba logo & red Kobe signature sets this release apart from previous Kobe 9s with a distinct pop of color. Function meets style with carbon fiber reinforcements on the midsole for added stability and paint splatter accents that enhance the sneakers artistic appeal. Paying tribute to Kobes relentless drive, the red Achilles stitch detail on the heel honors his legendary return from injury. A solid grey rubber outsole rounds out the look, ensuring durability and traction whether youre playing or keeping them fresh in your collection. True to the Protro philosophy, this 2025 edition keeps its original aesthetic while incorporating modernized performance upgrades for todays game. Released on February 8, 2025, exactly 11 years after its original 2014 debut, the Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Masterpiece retailed at $240. Featuring a standout black, metallic silver, bright crimson, and volt colorway, this iconic sneaker made a long-awaited return, solidifying its place as one of the most unforgettable Kobe releases to date.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink TD introduces a soft and elegant expression of a silhouette rooted in strength and structure. Pearl pink and medium soft pink tones wrap the upper in a gentle palette that contrasts beautifully with the bold lines of the Jordan 12 design. The stitched panels and sculpted shape remain instantly recognizable, giving the shoe presence even at a smaller scale while letting the color story lead with calm confidence. Fans appreciate this release because it reframes a powerful Jordan model through a more delicate lens without losing its identity. The Jordan 12 has always symbolized resilience and performance, and this version shows how that legacy can translate into something expressive and playful. Parents and collectors alike value the balance of heritage and softness, making it a meaningful introduction to Jordan design that feels intentional rather than purely cute. The Air Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink TD was released on November 20, 2025 with a retail price of $75.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Valentine's Day (2026) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Valentines Day 2026 GS delivers a soft and celebratory take on one of Jordan Brands most iconic silhouettes, blending sentiment with structure. White leather forms a clean and classic base, while medium soft pink details introduce warmth and emotion. Half blue and vapor green accents add unexpected contrast, giving the shoe a playful yet balanced feel that still respects the strong architectural lines of the Jordan 4. Fans are drawn to this release because it captures a specific moment and feeling without sacrificing wearability. Valentines themed Jordans often walk a fine line, and this pair succeeds by keeping the palette gentle rather than loud. In grade school sizing, the design feels thoughtful and expressive, making it popular with collectors who appreciate storytelling as much as silhouette. It feels joyful, modern, and rooted in Jordan heritage all at once. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Valentines Day 2026 GS was released on February 21, 2026 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Gorge Green Varsity Red (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Gorge Green Varsity Red (Women's) is a shoe in womens sizes featuring a low top and an eye-catching colorway. This iteration of the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG is made with a fully leather upper. A dark shade of Gorge Green forms the perforated toe box, while a black leather overlay rounds it out and attaches to the eyestays. The side panels are also black, and a Gorge Green Nike swoosh crosses each side. The heel counter is also Gorge Green leather, and a Varsity Red Air Jordan logo is printed on the heel collar. The tongue also features a green and red logo patch. The shoe sits atop a white rubber midsole and a Varsity Red outsole. What we love most about this shoe is its green and red colorway, which makes it perfect for fall or even the Christmas season. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Gorge Green Varsity Red (Women's) was released on June 12, 2024, for $140.

Display Name: Converse Chuck 70 Hi Hello Kitty Swarovski Egret
Description: The Converse Chuck 70 Hi Hello Kitty Swarovski Egret transforms a classic silhouette into a more playful and elevated statement piece through its collaboration with Hello Kitty and Swarovski. The egret base keeps the design clean, while sparkling details add a layer of shine that gives the shoe a more expressive and collectible feel. It blends nostalgia with a premium twist. What makes this pair stand out is the mix of character and embellishment. The Hello Kitty influence adds charm, while the Swarovski elements bring a level of detail that elevates the entire look. It is a shoe that feels both fun and visually striking. The Converse Chuck 70 Hi Hello Kitty Swarovski Egret was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $300.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Metamorphosis
Description: Own the court in the adidas Harden Vol. 9 Metamorphosis, a bold evolution in James Hardens signature line engineered for dynamic play. Wrapped in Semi Court Green with Core Black accents and Screaming Green pops, this colorway turns heads before tip-off and keeps the spotlight through every possession. A lightweight upper balances structure and breathability, while strategic overlays along the forefoot and midfoot help lock you in through sudden stops, jab steps, and step-backs. The plush, responsive midsole cushions hard landings and quick transitions, giving you a smooth ride from baseline to baseline without sacrificing court feel. Designed for two-way players who demand stability, the Harden Vol. 9 features a padded collar for ankle comfort and a secure lacing system that dials in a personalized fit. Underfoot, a durable rubber outsole delivers reliable grip for rapid changes of direction, with a traction pattern built for multi-angle coverage. Subtle details, like sculpted sidewalls, a streamlined silhouette, and the style code JH6484, underscore its purpose-built design and on-court versatility. Whether youre attacking off the dribble or locking down on defense, this pair brings the balance of support, comfort, and agility that modern guards need. Our team loves this product because it blends confidence-inspiring stability, responsive cushioning, and striking color blocking, ideal for players who want performance you can feel and a look that stands out game after game.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Mocha (GS)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Mocha (GS) borrows the classic "Oreo" color-blocking and adds a chocolatey touch of Mocha on the heel. Sticking to its retro roots, the Mocha (GS) Jordan 1 Retro Low OG boasts an all-leather construction with a white base and black accents on the forefoot overlay, the eyelets, the Swoosh, the mudguard, the collar lining, the rubber outsole, and the durable laces. The smooth leather heel counter and heel tab display Mocha, breaking up the black and white color-blocking. In addition, the heritage Air Jordan Wings logo embroidered on the heel tab comes in black, while the tongue tag features a black base with "NIKE AIR" lettering in Mocha. Our experts at StockX like that this shoe is a high-top rendition of the AJ1 High Mocha from 2020. The grade school-sized Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Mocha (GS) was released on September 21, 2024, and was priced at $140.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Green Snakeskin
Description: The adidas Harden Vol 9 Green Snakeskin Solar Slime Core Black Solar Slime brings texture and intensity to the hardwood with a striking snakeskin inspired finish. Solar Slime dominates the upper, creating a vivid green presence, while Core Black elements sharpen the silhouette and add structure. The layered construction and sculpted tooling maintain the performance identity that defines the Harden line. This colorway feels unapologetic and fearless, much like Hardens style of play. The snakeskin effect adds depth and movement across the upper, transforming the shoe into a visual statement before it even hits the court. Fans gravitate toward releases like this because they blur performance innovation with bold design language. It is a pair built to stand out, balancing aggressive aesthetics with the control and responsiveness expected from a signature model. The adidas Harden Vol 9 Green Snakeskin Solar Slime Core Black Solar Slime was released on October 17, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Silver Metallic
Description: The adidas AE 1 Silver Metallic is a shoe that was made as a collaboration between the sportswear brand and American basketball star Anthony Edwards. This model of the adidas AE 1 has a base of black fabric for breathability and a sock-like fit at the top. Polyurethane supports run the length of each side in a metallic-silver color and are designed to look like a honeycomb. These supports allow for stability during quick movements. The back of the heel contains an adidas logo in blue, while the tongue contains Anthony Edwards logo in blue. The BOOST midsole also contains Lightstrike cushioning for comfort and energy return. The outsole is black. What stands out about this sneaker are the silver honeycombs on each side, which make the shoe bold and eye catching. The adidas AE 1 Silver Metallic was released on February 27, 2025, for a retail price of $120.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Core Black
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Core Black is a sleek and stylish update to the classic Gazelle silhouette. This men's sneaker features a premium black suede upper, complemented by the iconic adidas three-stripe branding in contrasting white. The gum rubber outsole adds a touch of retro flair while providing excellent traction for indoor surfaces. With its low-profile design and cushioned insole, this shoe offers both comfort and versatility for everyday wear. Drawing inspiration from its athletic heritage, the Gazelle Indoor maintains the timeless appeal of its predecessor while incorporating modern elements for enhanced performance. The reinforced toe cap and padded collar ensure durability and support, making it an ideal choice for both casual outings and light indoor sports activities. The Core Black colorway offers a sophisticated look that pairs effortlessly with various outfits, from jeans to chinos. Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that combines classic style with contemporary comfort, perfect for both athletic pursuits and everyday casual wear.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Wolf Grey Vast Grey White
Description: Refined neutrals meet timeless street style in the Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 in Wolf Grey/Vast Grey/White (style HV9405-001). This modern take on a classic pairs layered grey tones with crisp white accents for a clean, easy-to-wear palette that elevates everything from denim to tailored joggers. A premium-feel upper with strategic perforations keeps airflow steady, while the padded collar and plush liner deliver that signature, step-in comfort. Underfoot, the encapsulated Air cushioning and resilient foam midsole work together for a smooth ride, and the cupsole construction with pivot-point traction offers dependable grip on city sidewalks and studio floors alike. Thoughtful details give this pair a polished edge: tonal Swooshes, subtle paneling that highlights the shoes lines, and durable stitching thats built to last daily rotation. The iconic AF1 tooling remains intact, raised midsole, star detailing at the toe, and a rubber outsole thats made for traction and longevity, while the LV8 execution sharpens the silhouette for a more contemporary look. Whether youre dressing it up or keeping it off-duty, the Wolf Grey and Vast Grey blend provides effortless versatility, making this a smart pick for anyone who values style that performs from morning to night. Our team loves this product because it blends everyday comfort with elevated materials and a versatile colorway that anchors any wardrobe.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Ox
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Ox Black
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Ox Black M9166 Black is the purest expression of the Chuck Taylor legacy, stripped down to its most essential form. A fully black canvas upper delivers a clean and uniform look that highlights the timeless low top silhouette. With no added color or distraction, the design leans entirely on proportion, familiarity, and cultural history to make its statement. This pair remains beloved because it works everywhere without trying. From music scenes to everyday wear, the black Chuck Ox has long been a symbol of individuality through simplicity. Collectors respect it not for rarity but for relevance, as it has quietly remained constant through decades of shifting trends. It is a sneaker that feels personal to whoever wears it, shaped by use and time rather than hype or reinvention. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Ox Black M9166 Black was released on March 16, 2011 with a retail price of $55.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Low Metallic Grey
Description: The adidas AE 1 Low Metallic Grey distills Anthony Edwards explosive on court personality into a sleeker and more refined low top silhouette that still feels aggressive and confident. The metallic grey finish gives the shoe a futuristic edge, highlighting the sculpted lines that define the AE 1 design language while keeping the overall look grounded and wearable. It feels sharp and intentional, built for fans who appreciate modern basketball sneakers that balance innovation with restraint. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it reflects Edwards evolution as both a player and a signature athlete. The low cut profile adds versatility, making it feel quicker and more fluid, while the neutral palette lets the shape do the talking. It is a shoe people love because it feels honest to the athlete, confident without being loud, and designed to perform while still carrying strong visual identity. The adidas AE 1 Low Metallic Grey was released on May 11, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Oatmeal Carbon
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Grey White carries decades of heritage through a sleek and timeless profile. Presented in Oatmeal and Carbon tones, the upper highlights the iconic crossed stripes that have defined the model since the sixties. The slim shape and low profile sole give it a lightweight and classic feel that remains instantly recognizable. Collectors gravitate toward the Mexico 66 for its deep roots in sport and culture, from early track history to cinematic moments that kept the silhouette in the spotlight. The neutral grey and white inspired palette keeps it versatile and understated, making it easy to pair with everyday fits. It is a shoe that proves simple lines and strong heritage never lose relevance. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Grey White was released on January 23, 2022 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Industrial Blue Sashiko
Description: Nike is drawing inspiration from Japan, using traditional Sashiko stitching on the 2023 release of the Nike Dunk Low Industrial Blue Sashiko. Nikes Dunk Low Industrial Blue Sashiko is constructed using denim uppers that feature white contrast stitching across the blue denim paneling. Traditional Japanese Sashiko stitching designs are sewn into the toe box and heel tab. The Nike Dunk Low Sashiko features white Nike branding on the tongue and insoles. The Nike Dunk Low Industrial Blue Sashiko released March 9, 2023, with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro SE Oregon
Description: Long before the most prominent athletes in the world donned the Swoosh, Nikes focus was giving University of Oregon athletes a competitive advantage with revolutionary products. Jordan Brand paid homage to the Ducks with the release of the Jordan 5 Oregon, now available on StockX. The Jordan 5 Retro SE Oregon colorway draws inspiration from a Jordan 5 PE that was gifted to Oregon student-athletes in 2014. The sneakers upper is smothered in Apple Green Durabuck with hits of yellow and black. Unlike the PE version, Oregon branding is replaced with traditional Jumpman on the tongue and a Team Jordan tag heel, similar to last years Jordan 5 Michigan release. A black midsole and icy translucent outsole completes this collegiate masterpiece. The Jordan 5 SE Oregon released in September of 2020 and retailed for $225.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Cloud White Core Black
Description: Engineered for elite play, the adidas Harden Vol. 9 Cloud White Core Black brings a sharp, modern look to James Hardens signature line while dialing up on-court control. The crisp Cloud White upper is framed by bold Core Black blocking and punched up with Screaming Green accents for a fast, high-contrast aesthetic that pops from warm-up to game-winner. A breathable textile build teams with structured overlays to keep your foot centered through crossovers and quick stops, while a refined lacing system and padded collar work together for a secure, dialed-in fit. Underfoot, a responsive midsole balances impact protection with court feel, helping you load up for step-backs and explode out of hesitations without sacrificing stability. Purpose-built traction lines the outsole with a grippy pattern designed to bite on hardwood, assisting with hard cuts, closeouts, and sudden changes of direction. A supportive midfoot frame and sculpted heel counter add containment when youre playing downhill or sliding laterally on defense, and the smooth heel-to-toe transition keeps movements fluid in every phase of the game. Finished with signature Harden detailing and the style code JR2504, this colorway lands right in time for the season with a release date of February 22, 2025, perfect for players who demand both performance and presence. Our team loves this product because it blends lockdown support, reliable traction, and head-turning style, ideal for guards and wings who thrive on quick shifts and confident shot creation.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Kith Marvel vs. Capcom Ryu
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Kith Marvel vs Capcom Ryu brings fighting game nostalgia into the world of performance running heritage. Rendered in Coconut Milk and Black, the upper reflects Ryus iconic color palette while preserving the layered construction that defines the Kayano 14. The visible Gel cushioning anchors the silhouette in its technical roots. Kith collaborations often blend pop culture with premium execution, and tying the Kayano 14 to Marvel vs Capcom adds strong crossover appeal. The cream toned base contrasts with black detailing for a balanced yet character driven look. It feels collectible and expressive, merging arcade era energy with one of ASICS most celebrated retro runners. The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Kith Marvel vs Capcom Ryu was released on November 14, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike GT Future Metallic Red Bronze
Description: The Nike GT Future Metallic Red Bronze elevates the futuristic silhouette with a shimmering Metallic Red Bronze finish that catches light from every angle. Black detailing provides contrast, sharpening the layered construction beneath the glossy surface. The streamlined build keeps the focus on performance while the finish adds undeniable flair. Metallic executions often amplify a shoe presence, and this version of the GT Future feels especially bold. The bronze inspired tone gives it a slightly luxurious edge while still maintaining aggressive court ready energy. For collectors who appreciate standout finishes on modern basketball models, this release blends innovation with eye catching detail. The Nike GT Future Metallic Red Bronze was released on February 20, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Kyrie 8 Circle Of Life
Description: The Nike Kyrie 8 Circle of Life flaunts a galactic multicolor mesh upper fused with a performance-oriented midsole and outsole. Cosigned by Kyrie Irving, these sneakers pay homage to the basketball legend with a matching performance. The Circle of Life induces the best with its light bone, yellow strike, malachite, orange trance, vivid purple, and hyper pink colorway. The colors blend on the breathable mesh with the vivid purple cropped Swoosh. The eyestays and laces take on a white hue to balance things up, while the liner draped in malachite reverts to the multicolor motif. A white midsole bearing Kyrie Irving's signature on the heel sits between the upper and a vivid purple outsole, which ends in an orange trance around the toecaps. Contoured serrations on the rubber outsole complete the Circle of Life design. What is the standout feature of the Kyrie Circle of Life sneakers? As our experts expound, it is the enhanced responsiveness of the midsole fused to the court-ready outsole. The combination allows you to accelerate and decelerate on demand. The Nike Kyrie 8 Circle of Life was released on November 14, 2022, retailing for $140.
Colorway: Light Bone/Yellow Strike/Malachite/Orange Trance/Vivid Purple/Hyper Pink

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat (2025) (PS)
Description: Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat 2025 PS brings one of the most respected Jordan colorways back in a form that still carries undeniable attitude despite its smaller scale. The all black execution strips the Air Jordan 4 down to pure shape and structure, letting the silhouettes aggressive lines and proportions speak for themselves. Even in preschool sizing, the Black Cat energy feels intact and confident. Collectors appreciate this release because of its simplicity and legacy. The Black Cat colorway has always been about restraint and presence, and that philosophy translates seamlessly here. It feels timeless and serious, offering younger fans a connection to a Jordan classic that has never relied on trends to remain relevant. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat 2025 PS was released on 11/28/2025 with a retail price of $105.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Keep Rippin Stop Slippin 2.0
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Keep Rippin Stop Slippin 2.0, originally introduced in 2008, makes a return featuring a gray mesh foundation complemented by off-white suede overlays along the medial side and black hairy suede mudguards. The Air Max 1 Keep Rippin Stop Slippin 2.0 introduces a modern twist to the original by integrating safari print onto the mudguard and Swoosh, achieved through the use of long hairy suede. Vast Gray emerges as the primary color for the mesh base, while Pearl White embellishes the suede overlays on the midfoot, heel, and vamp. Black details stand out on the lace set and sections of hairy suede, with reddish cedar accents appearing on the mini Swoosh located on the mudguard, sock liner, and the embroidery of Keep Rip'n Stop Slip'n on the heel. The standout characteristic of the Nike Air Max 1 Keep Rippin Stop Slippin 2.0 are the embroidered phrases "Keep Ripn" and "Stop Slipn" in red on the heel. The sneaker debuted for $160 on November 28th, 2023.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Grinch (2020)
Description: Nike opened a new chapter at the end of 2020 and refreshed the Kobe 6 design with the Nike Kobe 6 Protro Grinch. The Kobe 6 Grinch originally debuted in 2010 when Kobe Bryants Los Angeles Lakers faced LeBron James Miami Heat in a legendary match up on Christmas Day. This is the first Kobe 6 to receive the Kobe Protro treatment, a design process that takes classic Kobe designs and updates them with modern tech for improved performance. At a first glance, the Nike Kobe 6 Grinch looks identically like the OG pair from 2010: it features a Green Apple and Volt textured, snake-inspired upper as a tribute to Kobes Black Mamba moniker. A black Swoosh, red Kobe branding on the tongue, and green translucent outsole accentuate the shoes reptile theme. But, because this is a Protro, there are some differences. The updated Kobe 6 Grinch arrives with a more responsive Zoom Air cushioning system and scaled-down traction for an improved court feel. The silhouette shape is even altered to provide a lower, sleeker fit. The Nike Kobe 6 Grinch released in December of 2020 and retailed for $180.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Action Bronson Medusa Azul
Description: Created as part of American rapper Action Bronsons second series with New Balance, the New Balance 1906R Action Bronson Medusa Azul adds cool blue tones and rich earthy hues to the recognizable 1906R silhouette. While the Action Bronson Medusa Azul New Balance 1906R boasts all the technical features associated with the 1906R, including segmented ABZORB SBS pods beneath the heel and flexible cushioning in the midsole, the "Medusa Azul" colorway makes it stand out from other models. The upper construction features light blue mesh as the base, golden brown mesh below the N logo, and synthetic overlays in light grayish purple. Co-branding details decorate the tongue, the insole, and the silicone hangtag, while durable boot laces secure the front closure system. Our experts at StockX like the colorblocking on the midsole and outsole, which highlights the ABZORB SBS pods and other technical features. The New Balance 1906R Action Bronson Medusa Azul was released on June 21, 2024, and retailed at $185.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 20 Cream Independence Blue
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 20 Cream Independence Blue blends soft neutral tones with sharper accents, creating a balanced and slightly more expressive look. The cream base keeps the design warm and versatile, while independence blue details add contrast that brings energy to the silhouette. It feels like a modern update to a performance rooted model. Fans appreciate this pair for its combination of comfort and visual contrast. The Kayano line continues to deliver reliable structure, while the colorway adds personality without becoming overwhelming. It is a strong option for those who want a sneaker that feels both functional and styled. The ASICS Gel Kayano 20 Cream Independence Blue was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Smoke Grey Black Photon Dust
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Smoke Grey Black Photon Dust builds on a similar foundation but introduces an extra layer of tonal variation that gives the shoe more depth. Smoke grey and black anchor the design, while dark smoke grey and photon dust create a gradient effect that feels slightly more dimensional. The added contrast remains subtle, keeping the overall look cohesive and refined. This version stands out for how it elevates a familiar palette through small adjustments. Fans of neutral Air Max releases appreciate when extra tones are introduced in a way that enhances rather than complicates the design. It feels like a natural evolution of a classic look, offering just enough difference to make it worth adding to a rotation. The Nike Air Max 90 Smoke Grey Black Photon Dust was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Dutch Green (Women's)
Description: The women's Air Jordan 1 Mid Dutch Green (W) features two shades of green throughout. The upper consists of a mix of Dutch Green and mint leather overlays. Hits of pink are highlighted on the tongue tag, laces, and embossed Wings logo on the collar. A Dutch Green outsole wraps up this womens exclusive Jordan mid. The women's Air Jordan 1 Mid Dutch Green (W) released in 2021 for $120.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Cozy Girl (Women's)
Description: Air Jordan 4 Retro Cozy Girl Womens softens one of Jordan Brands most aggressive silhouettes through texture and tone rather than changing its DNA. The Cozy Girl concept leans into comfort and warmth, giving the Air Jordan 4 a more lifestyle focused personality while keeping its iconic shape intact. It feels approachable and confident, designed for everyday wear rather than spectacle. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it reinterprets the Jordan 4 in a way that feels natural and wearable. The familiar structure anchors the design, while the cozy elements add freshness and depth. It appeals to fans who enjoy seeing heritage models evolve with subtle creativity rather than dramatic reinvention. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Cozy Girl Womens was released on 11/01/2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Medium Soft Pink Malachite
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Medium Soft Pink Malachite is a low-top basketball sneaker made with a unique colorway. This iteration of the Nike Dunk Low Retro SE comes with an upper made of a mix of leather and suede. The base of the upper is a medium soft pink leather, which appears on the sides, toebox, and around the heel. The toebox is also perforated. Green suede overlays contrast with the pink leather, outlining the toebox, the laces, and snaking down around the heel. The Nike Swoosh on both sides also appears in green suede. The pink cushioned tongue also contains a Nike patch, and the Nike brand name is stitched onto the green heel tab in light pink. The rubber sole is white on top and green on the bottom, and is patterned for grip on the court. What we like best about this shoe is the combination of leather and suede on the upper, which allows for extra cushioning and style. The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Medium Soft Pink Malachite was released on April 9, 2024, for a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 White Metallic Silver (Women's)
Description: The Nike Shox R4 White Metallic Silver (Women's) dresses the Shox R4 from the 2000s in a sleek colorway that complements its retro-futuristic aesthetic. Like its 2000s predecessor, this reboot of the Shox R4 applies four pistons under the heel instead of foam or Air Max units. The pistons offer an alternative form of springy cushioning and represent how 2000s designers interpreted "futuristic" looks. Drawing inspiration from spacesuits, the synthetic leather upper features sleek likes and laser-cut perforations for an airy feel. Although white and metallic silver hues dominate the shoe, Max Orange accents disrupt the light color scheme on the heel, tongue, and rubber outsole. Our StockX experts like the Swoosh logo embroidered on the side panel in metallic silver. It brings balance to the sneaker and allows the futuristic features to stand out. The womens size Nike Shox R4 White Metallic Silver (Women's) was released on May 7, 2019, and sold for $140.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Pink Overdye
Description: The New Balance 9060 Pink Overdye is an athletic shoe featuring an upper in Pink. A Pink mesh fabric base is overlaid with curved and geometric overlays in multiple textures of Pink suede. The New Balance N logo is smooth and shiny on the exterior, countered by striped N branding on the interior. The ABZORB branded midsole in Pink juts throughout a white base, finished by a Pink outsole. American athletic shoe brand New Balance was founded in 1906, and the company is known for their running-focused sneakers. The 9060 style debuted post-2020, and its design references the understated 990 and blends it with early 2000s styling. The New Balance 9060 Pink Overdye released on July 24, 2024, and retailed for $150.

Display Name: New Balance 740 Rich Oak Bisque Pecan
Description: The New Balance 740 Rich Oak Bisque Pecan brings a layered, earthy palette to a silhouette that leans into retro running inspiration. Rich oak, bisque, and pecan tones work together to create a warm and grounded look that feels especially suited for transitional seasons. The combination of mesh and suede adds depth without overwhelming the design, keeping it balanced and wearable. Fans appreciate how this pair taps into a more natural color story while still maintaining a sport driven structure. It feels nostalgic without being dated, offering a familiar shape with a refreshed perspective. The versatility of the colorway makes it easy to integrate into everyday outfits, while still giving collectors something that feels distinct within the broader New Balance lineup. The New Balance 740 Rich Oak Bisque Pecan was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Model: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low
Display Name: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low Red
Description: The Red Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low connects a red canvas upper with a sculpted foam rubber midsole for a distinct design. The Red Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low by Maison Mihara Yasuhiro features a red cotton canvas upper with white contrast stitching. It includes a rubber cap toe, lace-up closure, and a logo flag on the tongue. There are metal eyelets on the inner side, and the heel is embossed with the brand's logo. The shoe is lined with felt and canvas, and it sits atop a hand-molded sculptural foam rubber midsole with a treaded rubber sole. Maison Mihara Yasuhiro was established in 1997 by designer Mihara Yasuhiro. Some of the things we enjoy about the Red Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low are the hand-molded sculptural foam rubber midsole, which provides a unique visual element, and the felt and canvas lining for a specific texture combination. This model was released on September 17, 2024, with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Chicago (2025) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Chicago 2025 GS brings the most iconic color story in sneaker history into a low cut form that still feels unmistakably powerful. The varsity red, black, and summit white combination instantly ties back to Chicago heritage, channeling the energy of Jordans earliest days and the foundation of the entire Jordan Brand story. Even in grade school sizing, the OG cut and classic blocking preserve the attitude and authenticity that make the Chicago theme so beloved. Collectors love this pair because it feels timeless rather than seasonal. The low profile gives it everyday wearability, while the OG details keep it rooted in history. Its the kind of sneaker that connects younger fans to the origins of sneaker culture, offering a true piece of Jordan legacy that feels just as meaningful now as it did decades ago. This release stands out because it doesnt reinvent anything, it simply delivers perfection through familiarity and balance. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Chicago 2025 GS was released on November 15, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Free RN 5.0 Next Nature Black Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike Free RN 5.0 Next Nature Black Smoke Grey is the most grounded and functional expression of a silhouette that has always been about getting out of your own way and letting the foot do what it naturally wants to do. Built around the Free philosophy that Nike first introduced in 2004, the 5.0 Next Nature iteration adds a meaningful environmental layer to that mission, constructing the knit upper with at least 87 percent recycled material by weight and ensuring the overall shoe reaches a minimum of 20 percent recycled content, making sustainability feel seamlessly integrated rather than bolted on. The black on black colorway with dark smoke grey detailing keeps the shoe visually clean and versatile, working just as well with training shorts as it does with casual streetwear, and the sock-like bootie construction wraps the foot in a seamless, low-profile fit that disappears once it is on. What separates the Free RN 5.0 from standard trainers is the flex groove system cut into the outsole, a pattern of strategically placed channels that allow the sole to bend and flex in multiple directions, mimicking the natural movement of a barefoot stride and encouraging the smaller stabilizing muscles in the foot to stay active throughout the run. Laser cut grooves in the sole work alongside flywire loops integrated through the lace system to provide midfoot lockdown without restricting the forefoot, creating a split-personality shoe that feels free and secure at the same time. For runners who want something light, minimal, and built with purpose, the Next Nature Black Smoke Grey delivers all of that with a sustainability story to match. The Nike Free RN 5.0 Next Nature Black Smoke Grey was released on February 8, 2022 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Holiday Pack Cream Pure Silver
Description: The ASICS Gel 1130 Holiday Pack Cream Pure Silver brings festive polish to a beloved retro runner. Wrapped in Cream with Pure Silver accents, the layered mesh and synthetic overlays highlight the early two thousands performance aesthetic that defines the 1130. The visible Gel cushioning adds both comfort and visual depth to the profile. The 1130 has built strong momentum thanks to its balance of tech runner nostalgia and modern wearability. In this holiday inspired palette, the neutral cream base feels refined while silver details add subtle shine. It is a versatile execution that keeps the silhouette fresh without straying from its performance roots. The ASICS Gel 1130 Holiday Pack Cream Pure Silver was released on November 7, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low LX Leaf Camo
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low LX Leaf Camo leans into natural textures and camouflage inspired tones to give the AF1 a rugged yet refined personality. The layered greens and muted accents create depth that feels organic rather than tactical, softening the camo concept into something wearable and lifestyle driven. It feels grounded, designed for people who appreciate earth tones and subtle complexity. Fans gravitate toward this release because it feels seasonless and versatile. The Air Force 1 remains familiar and dependable, while the leaf camo execution adds character without overwhelming the silhouette. Collectors appreciate how Nike uses material and color to refresh classics, making this pair feel fresh while still easy to integrate into everyday rotation. The Nike Air Force 1 Low LX Leaf Camo was released on October 17, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Moonbeam Sea Salt
Description: The New Balance 9060 Moonbeam Sea Salt is designed to capture elements of the preceding 99X, a classic New Balance model, and draws inspiration from Y2K era aesthetics. Sea salt, rain cloud and moonbeam colors are used for the sneaker. The upper is made from an off-white mesh that is fitted with sea salt pigskin suede overlays. Rain cloud accents are found in the "N" logo on the quarter panels, and the heel tab with the New Balance logo in off-white. The outer sole is made from a grey rubber sole, with the midsole uses Abzorb and SBS cushioning. The heel has a translucent CR fitting, while the tongue logo uses jewels inspired by the 991 sneaker. The shoes look is complemented with grey insole and lining, rain cloud laces, and punched eyelets at the throat. What do our experts like about the New Balance 9060 Moonbeam Sea Salt? Our experts at StockX like the downplayed color gamut selected for the classic sneaker silhouette, and the choice of lightweight materials. New Balance released the sneaker on 26th July 2023 for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Family Affair
Description: Air Jordan 3 Retro Family Affair feels deeply rooted in connection and legacy, using one of the most beloved Jordan silhouettes to tell a more emotional story. The Air Jordan 3 has always been about balance and heritage, and this colorway leans into that through thoughtful tones and subtle detailing that suggest unity and shared history rather than loud statement making. Collectors are drawn to this pair because of its quiet confidence. The familiar shape anchors the design, while the Family Affair theme adds meaning beyond aesthetics. It appeals to fans who value Jordan releases that emphasize storytelling and emotional resonance, reminding everyone that the brands impact extends beyond performance and into culture and relationships. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Family Affair was released on10/25/2025with a retail price of $215.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Stone Sage
Description: The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Stone Sage features a sculptural EVA foam and algae blended construction that arrives in a Stone Sage monochromatic color scheme. From there, a grooved outsole provides traction and support. The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Stone Sage released in March of 2022 and retailed for $90.

Display Name: adidas Samba Jane Disney Alice in Wonderland Crystal Sky (TD)
Description: The adidas Samba Jane Disney Alice in Wonderland Crystal Sky TD reimagines the classic Samba through a softer and more playful lens, drawing inspiration from Disneys Alice in Wonderland. The crystal sky upper brings a light and airy feel, complemented by cloud white details and a gum sole that keeps the design grounded in its original form. The Mary Jane style strap adds a unique twist, shifting the silhouette into something more whimsical while still retaining recognizable Samba elements. This pair stands out for how it blends storytelling with a heritage model, creating something that feels both nostalgic and fresh. Fans of Disney and adidas alike appreciate how the collaboration captures the essence of Alice in Wonderland without overwhelming the shoe. It offers a different take on the Samba that leans into creativity and character, making it especially appealing for younger collectors and those drawn to more expressive designs. The adidas Samba Jane Disney Alice in Wonderland Crystal Sky TD was released on December 22, 2025 with a retail price of $60.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro A Ma Maniére Smokey Mauve
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro A Ma Maniere Smokey Mauve continues A Ma Manieres tradition of elevating Jordan silhouettes through emotion, texture, and restraint. The smokey mauve colorway gives the Jordan 6 a soft yet powerful presence, shifting the silhouette away from aggression and toward refinement. It feels thoughtful and expressive, designed to be appreciated through detail rather than instant impact. Collectors are drawn to this release because it reflects intention and care. The Jordan 6s structure remains strong, but the muted palette and premium feel create a more introspective mood. Fans love how A Ma Maniere consistently brings storytelling and elegance to Jordan collaborations, turning iconic models into meaningful expressions of culture, identity, and modern luxury. The Air Jordan 6 Retro A Ma Maniere Smokey Mauve was released on December 6, 2025 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Wolf Grey (2026) (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Wolf Grey 2026 PS delivers a more muted and tonal approach to the silhouette, using light graphite, white, and wolf grey to create a clean and understated look. The palette leans into simplicity, allowing the shape and details of the Jordan 5 to stand out without heavy contrast. It feels refined and easy to wear. Collectors appreciate this version for its versatility and subtle execution. The softer tones give it a calm presence, making it a strong option for everyday wear while still carrying the identity of the model. It is a reminder that not every release needs bold color to make an impact. The Air Jordan 5 Retro Wolf Grey 2026 PS was released on February 28, 2026 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro OG Nigel Sylvester Brick After Brick
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG Nigel Sylvester Brick After Brick builds on Nigel Sylvesters growing presence within Jordan Brand, translating his BMX-driven perspective into a storytelling-focused design. Dressed in sail with cinnabar, anthracite, and muslin accents, the sneaker carries a worn-in aesthetic that reflects Sylvesters real-world riding style. Nigel Sylvester has carved out a unique space within the Jordan ecosystem, blending street riding with sneaker culture in a way that feels authentic rather than manufactured. The "Brick After Brick" concept speaks to progression and repetition, themes that mirror both BMX culture and Jordan Brands legacy of iteration. Subtle distressing and tonal variation give the shoe a sense of lived-in character. When the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG Nigel Sylvester Brick After Brick released, it retailed for $230. With its sail, cinnabar, anthracite, and muslin colorway, this collaboration stands out as one of the more narrative-driven takes on the Jordan 4 in recent years.

Display Name: Nike KD 19 Field Purple
Description: The Nike KD 19 Field Purple, nicknamed Purple Stuff, is one of the launch colorways of Kevin Durant's nineteenth Nike signature shoe, applying an almost fully monochromatic Field Purple execution to the KD 19's Y2K-inspired upper with Stadium Green insoles and University Gold in the official color specification, covering the molded TPU shell, mesh underlay, laces, tongue, liner, midsole, and outsole in a single saturated purple tone that lets the shoe's silhouette speak for itself. The KD 19 draws direct design inspiration from the Nike Zoom Hyperflight, the early-2000s Nike Basketball silhouette, with a two-piece injected TPU upper wrapping an internal mesh construction in a way that references the patent leather-adjacent, tech-forward aesthetics of Nike Basketball's Y2K era, while the Field Purple colorway specifically echoes Jason Williams' Sacramento Kings-era Hyperflight PE as an additional archival reference layered into the release. Cushioning is handled by a full-length Air Zoom Strobel unit paired with a Cushlon 3.0 foam carrier for responsive, court-level performance, with a midfoot shank providing stability and the outsole traction incorporating Durant's jersey numbers 35 and 7 as a personal identifier embedded into the shoe's functional geometry. Released June 17, 2026 at $155 retail via Nike SNKRS, Foot Locker, and select Nike Basketball retailers with style code IH1117-500. The Nike KD 19 Field Purple was released on June 17, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: adidas Superstar CLOT by Edison Chen x Bape Off White
Description: The adidas Superstar CLOT by Edison Chen x Bape Off White unites three influential forces in street culture under one iconic shell toe. Rendered in Off White with Branch and Olive Cargo accents, the classic Superstar shape is reinterpreted through layered materials and collaborative detailing. The textured upper and subtle co branding create depth while maintaining the instantly recognizable rubber shell front. CLOT and Bape collaborations consistently carry cultural weight, and bringing that energy to the Superstar elevates the silhouette beyond standard retro releases. The earthy palette adds a contemporary twist to a heritage staple, making it feel both grounded and collectible. It stands as a statement piece that blends skate, hip hop, and global streetwear influence in one bold package. The adidas Superstar CLOT by Edison Chen x Bape Off White was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Patent Leather Topaz Gold Pine Green
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Patent Leather Topaz Gold Pine Green delivers one of the more vibrant takes within the patent leather lineup, combining warm and earthy tones with a glossy finish. The Topaz Gold base sets a bright and energetic foundation, while Pine Green accents add contrast that keeps the look balanced. The patent leather elevates the colorway, giving it a polished and eye catching appearance. This pair resonates with collectors who appreciate bold color blocking with a premium feel. The combination of gold and green creates a distinct identity that stands out without feeling random. It reflects Nikes ability to refresh a classic silhouette through thoughtful color pairing and material choice, making it a strong addition for those who want something expressive. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Patent Leather Topaz Gold Pine Green was released on April 9, 2026 with a retail price of $120.
Colorway: Topaz Gold/Pine Green/Light Laser Orange/Midas Gold

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Slide Dark Onyx
Description: Step into unparalleled comfort and minimalist style with the adidas Yeezy Slide Dark Onyx. This sleek, monochromatic slide is the epitome of understated luxury, featuring a uniform dark onyx colorway that pairs effortlessly with any casual outfit. The Yeezy Slide's design focuses on simplicity and functionality, offering a sophisticated take on casual footwear. Crafted for those who value both style and comfort, the adidas Yeezy Slide Dark Onyx is built with a plush material that molds to the shape of your foot, ensuring all-day comfort. Its minimalist aesthetic is complemented by the slide's practicality, making it the perfect choice for a relaxed day out or a cozy evening at home. The adidas Yeezy Slide has quickly become a staple in the wardrobe of the fashion-forward, thanks to its versatile design and unparalleled comfort. Since its release on March 7, 2024, with a retail price of $70, the adidas Yeezy Slide Dark Onyx has established itself as a must-have for sneaker enthusiasts and style mavens alike. Its release has been met with enthusiasm, solidifying its status as a timeless piece of casual footwear. If you're seeking a blend of simplicity, comfort, and style, the adidas Yeezy Slide Dark Onyx is a choice that delivers on all fronts.

Model: Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro Premium
Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro Premium NYC Knicks
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro Premium NYC Knicks pays tribute to New York basketball culture through a bold color palette inspired by one of the citys most iconic franchises. The Air Force 1 has always held especially deep significance in New York sneaker culture, making the connection to the Knicks feel authentic and historically rooted rather than purely thematic. The combination of Safety Orange, Rush Blue, and White immediately recalls classic Knicks uniforms and Madison Square Garden energy while preserving the clean and timeless shape that made the Air Force 1 one of the most influential sneakers ever created. Fans gravitate toward city and team inspired Air Force 1 releases because they connect local sports identity and sneaker heritage in a way few silhouettes can match. New York basketball culture carries enormous influence across music, fashion, and streetwear, and the Air Force 1 remains deeply embedded within that legacy. Collectors especially appreciate premium executions that combine strong color blocking and nostalgic storytelling while preserving the simplicity central to the models appeal. The bright orange and blue accents give the sneaker vibrant visual impact while reinforcing its unmistakable connection to NYC basketball history and culture. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro Premium NYC Knicks was released on May 10, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Basketweave Black Cream White (Women's)
Description: The Adidas Samba OG Basketweave in Core Black, Cream White, and Gold Metallic for Women is a material-forward execution of the most iconic Samba silhouette that applies a woven basketweave texture to the upper construction, creating a surface character that departs from the standard suede and leather Samba material vocabulary while maintaining the silhouette's essential proportions and design architecture. The basketweave texture adds a tactile complexity and visual depth to the black upper that smooth leather alternatives cannot provide, the woven surface catching light differently across each section of the shoe and creating a material interest that rewards close examination with genuine craft consideration. Cream white and gold metallic provide the accent tones that complete the colorway, the warm cream referencing Samba heritage while gold metallic introduces a precious character that elevates the basketweave construction into premium territory. Women's specific Samba OG construction ensures the basketweave material's visual and tactile character lands on a silhouette proportioned for the female foot with the same authenticity and design intention that the men's versions of material-forward Samba releases deliver to their respective audience. Black basketweave with gold metallic accents creates a women's Samba that reads simultaneously as a premium material exercise and a daily lifestyle shoe, the texture adding enough visual distinction to justify its own place in a Samba collection while the classic black and cream palette ensures outfit integration across every casual and considered wardrobe context. At one hundred dollars the Samba OG Basketweave Women's is an accessible and material-thoughtful acquisition. The Adidas Samba OG Basketweave in Core Black, Cream White, and Gold Metallic Women's has a retail price of $100.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Black Red
Description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Black Red is one of the first original colorways to drop after the silouhettes debut in 2016. Despite its original 2017 release, the 350 V2 Black Red restocked in 2020, giving fans a second chance at grabbing a pair at retail. The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 Black Red features familiar style cues that made the silhouette popular today. The upper consists of black Primeknit material for breathability. A black ribbed midsole encases an entire BOOST cushioning system for added comfort. Lastly, signature "SPLY-350" is knitted along the lateral side of each pair. The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 originally released in February of 2017 and retailed for $220.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Sulfur
Description: Constructed with a blend of EVA foam and recycled materials, adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Sulfur arrives in an identical build to prior Foam RNNRs. Oval cut openings throughout the neutral-toned design create a sculptural look while providing ventilation. At the base, a cushioned footbed offers comfort and support. The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Sulfur released in April of 2022 and retailed for $90.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite One Carbon Fiber
Description: Nike Air Foamposite One Carbon Fiber pushes the Foamposite legacy into a more aggressive and futuristic direction, emphasizing texture and material over traditional color blocking. The carbon fiber inspired look highlights the molded shells sculptural form, giving the shoe a powerful and almost armored presence. It feels bold and unapologetic, true to the Foamposite identity that has always challenged convention. Collectors value this release because it lets the shape do the talking. The Air Foamposite One remains one of Nikes most daring designs, and this version reinforces its status as a cultural icon rather than a trend driven retro. It appeals to fans who appreciate innovation, presence, and history wrapped into one unmistakable silhouette. The Nike Air Foamposite One Carbon Fiber was released on 10/24/2025 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Twelve Time
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Twelve Time celebrates achievement and momentum through a bold mix of turquoise, safety orange, and vivid purple that feels energetic and unapologetic. The colorway gives the Ja 3 a vibrant and almost celebratory look, highlighting the silhouettes speed and fluidity. It feels expressive and confident, designed to match Ja Morants ability to take over moments repeatedly. Fans love this release because it feels triumphant. The Twelve Time theme suggests repetition of greatness, and the color execution reinforces that idea with fearless contrast and motion. Collectors appreciate how this pair pushes color while keeping performance front and center, making it a standout Ja 3 that feels symbolic, dynamic, and perfectly aligned with Morants rising legacy in the league. The Nike Ja 3 Twelve Time was released on January 20, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott Dark Mocha
Description: The Air Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott Dark Mocha, also known as the Jordan CJ1 T-Rexx, is the third colorway of Travis Scott's signature sneaker model, the Jumpman Jack. This Dark Mocha colorway features and all black and brown design with a velcro tongue flap, reverse swoosh branding, and the Air Jordan logo on the tongue. The underside of the sneaker also showcases unique Cactus Jack branding. This colorway is by far the most neutral and muted colorway of the Jumpman Jack so far, making it a versatile sneaker for many different occasion. As Travis Scott continues to ascend to new heights, his sneakers and surely set to become as hot as ever. The Air Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott Dark Mocha released on November 26th, 2024, for a retail price of $200. We love this sneaker due to it's iconic Cactus Jack branding and recognizable style in the world of sneakers.

Display Name: Under Armour UA Sola White Metallic Silver
Description: The Under Armour UA Sola White Metallic Silver delivers a clean and modern take on everyday performance footwear, blending lightweight construction with a sharp visual finish. The white base keeps the shoe fresh and versatile, while metallic silver details add a futuristic edge that feels sporty rather than flashy. It is designed to move easily, prioritizing comfort and breathability over complexity. Fans gravitate toward this model because it feels simple and reliable. The UA Sola works well for casual wear, light activity, and all day comfort, making it an easy choice for people who value function without unnecessary design noise. Collectors appreciate Under Armours focus on accessible performance, offering a shoe that fits seamlessly into daily routines while still looking modern and intentional. The Under Armour UA Sola White Metallic Silver was released on July 29, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: adidas BW Army Kith Cardboard
Description: The adidas BW Army Kith Cardboard revives one of adidas cleanest military inspired silhouettes through the elevated lens that Kith has become known for. Originally rooted in German training footwear, the BW Army has always carried a stripped down shape that feels timeless rather than trend driven, and this Cardboard colorway pushes that identity even further. Soft brown suede overlays meet Off White leather underlays and a classic Gum 5 sole, creating a palette that feels vintage, understated, and easy to wear without losing the heritage character that makes the silhouette special. Fans gravitate toward collaborations like this because Kith rarely overwhelms a classic model with excessive branding or gimmicks. Instead, the focus stays on texture, proportion, and subtle color execution that rewards people who appreciate detail. The low profile construction and terrace influenced design language make the BW Army especially versatile, fitting naturally into modern rotation heavy sneaker culture while still feeling connected to archival adidas history. Collectors appreciate how pairs like this prove quiet colorways can still carry serious presence when the materials and shape are executed correctly. The adidas BW Army Kith Cardboard was released on April 20, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 White Black Teal
Description: Make a statement with the Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 White Black Teal 2015 sneakers. Standing out above the crowd, these groundbreaking basketball shoes first emerged in 1995 with revolutionary Air cushioning, providing full support needed on the court. Today, as a lifestyle shoe, these Uptempos keep delivering on looks and trends. The Nike Air Max Uptempo has a long-standing legacy as the shoe of choice for NBA stars such as Scottie Pippen and Kobe Bryant. They remain a popular sneaker that provides traction, comfort, and looks. The leather and nubuck colorways are white, black, and teal, with pops of silver on the visibly cushioned midsoles and outsoles. The Air Branding features on the back heel, while a giant swoosh sits on the sides. We love the padded uppers on these high-top Nike Air Maxs. Made for comfort without skimping on flexibility, they are slick shoes that seamlessly combine aesthetics with utility. The pull cord on the tongue adds a cool feature. The Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 White Black Teal 2015 was released on April 25, 2019, and retailed at $165.

Display Name: Jordan 2/3 White Cement
Description: The Jordan 2/3 White Cement blends heritage design with modern comfort, merging the refined lines of the Jordan 2 with the iconic tooling inspired by the Jordan 3. Dressed in a crisp White/Cement Grey palette, this hybrid silhouette highlights premium leather across the upper, subtle perforations for breathability, and layered paneling that adds depth and structure. Classic "White Cement" cues, like textured grey accents and nods to elephant-inspired detailing, deliver undeniable courtside DNA, while the padded collar and supportive heel counter keep every step stable. From the first lace-up, the shoe balances everyday wearability with head-turning style, making it as compelling on the street as it is in your rotation. Underfoot, responsive cushioning and a durable rubber outsole provide traction you can trust, whether youre navigating the city or stepping onto the hardwood. The sculpted midsole and Air-Sole cushioning deliver a smooth, resilient ride, while the grippy tread pattern helps anchor your stride. With its clean color blocking and versatile profile, the Jordan 2/3 White Cement pairs effortlessly with denim, joggers, or tailored athleisure, and the FD0383-101 style code marks it as a standout release for 2024. For collectors and newcomers alike, this model captures the essence of classic Jordan heritage in a contemporary package that feels timeless the moment you put it on. Our team loves this product because it fuses two legendary silhouettes into a sleek, comfortable everyday sneaker thats easy to style and built to last.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Stealth
Description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro Stealth is an update of the iconic design that brought Zoom Air padding to the Jordan line with a muted color scheme. The upper is made of crushed gray leather and has a solid white lizard-textured overlay in addition to the 12's distinguishing stitching lines. On the heel tab and tongue, you can see the Jumpman logo. The mid-top is supported by a full-length Zoom Air Air unit, a compact Phylon midsole and a herringbone-grip rubber outsole. Additionally, there are eyelets in metallic silver and white signature overlays on the mudguard. The Air Jordan 12 Retro Stealth was launched on the market on 27 August 2022 and retailed at $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Spiridon Cage 2 Triple Black
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Spiridon Cage 2 Triple Black is a performance sneaker with a design that makes it look as intense as its functionality feels. This version of the Nike Air Zoom Spiridon Cage 2 has an upper made of black mesh in different knit patterns for breathability. Shiny black synthetic leather overlays cross the shoe for support, outlining the toe box, curving up and down the sides, and forming the heel. Shiny black Nike Swooshes appear on each side, and circular Nike branding appears again on the heel and on the tongue. The black midsole contains an Air Zoom unit for cushioning and energy return, and the outsole is also black. What stands out most about this shoe is the open mesh build of the sides, which allows you to see into the shoe and provides maximum breathability. The Nike Air Zoom Spiridon Cage 2 Triple Black was released on July 20, 2024, for $170.

Display Name: Nike KD 4 Easter (2025)
Description: The Nike KD 4 Easter (2025) is a highly anticipated revival of a classic silhouette, reimagined for the modern sneaker enthusiast. This men's performance basketball shoe showcases a refreshing Mint Candy, White, and New Green colorway that perfectly captures the essence of spring. The sleek design combines style and functionality, featuring Nike's innovative technologies to enhance on-court performance while maintaining a striking aesthetic appeal. Crafted with premium materials, the KD 4 Easter boasts a breathable upper that provides optimal ventilation during intense gameplay. The shoe's responsive cushioning system offers excellent impact protection and energy return, ensuring comfort throughout your performance. With its eye-catching pastel hues and distinctive KD branding, this sneaker is sure to turn heads both on and off the court. Our experts state this product is great for basketball players seeking a blend of retro charm and modern performance, as well as sneaker collectors looking to add a unique piece to their collection.

Display Name: New Balance 1906L Black Suede
Description: The New Balance 1906L Black Suede reimagines a cult?favorite silhouette with refined, city?ready attitude. Dressed in a deep Black/Black colorway, this pair balances plush suede paneling with subtle branding for a sleek, tonal finish that pairs effortlessly with everything from tailored trousers to relaxed denim. A loafer?inspired profile nods to classic menswear, while the sculpted 1906 running tooling provides everyday comfort and a modern edge. Underfoot, responsive cushioning and a supportive heel structure work together to soften impact and keep your stride steady from commute to weekend plans. Engineered details elevate the minimalist look: a durable rubber outsole grips varied surfaces, breathable linings keep things comfortable on the move, and carefully placed overlays enhance shape and longevity. The U1906LNT style code and streamlined design language make this a standout for those who want sophisticated style without sacrificing performance heritage. Whether youre dressing up a casual rotation or grounding a monochrome fit, the New Balance 1906L Black Suede delivers versatile wear and understated polish. Our team loves this product because it blends loafer?level sophistication with the cushioned stability of a modern New Balance sneaker, making it a smart, all?day choice.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC White Smoke Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel-NYC White Smoke Grey blends retro running DNA with modern comfort for a clean, versatile look that pairs with anything from tapered trousers to relaxed denim. Dressed in a crisp White/Smoke Grey palette, this mens lifestyle sneaker highlights layered mesh and leather-style overlays that add depth without feeling heavy. A sculpted midsole and visible GEL cushioning underfoot deliver plush step-in comfort, while the padded tongue and collar help keep your foot locked in on long city days. Finished with reflective-style accents and the iconic tiger stripes, the silhouette balances sport heritage with everyday polish. Engineered for daily wear, the Gel-NYC features a breathable upper to keep air moving, supportive sidewalls for stability, and a durable rubber outsole with reliable grip for varied surfaces. The colorblocking stays understated, letting the refined lines and paneling do the talking, and the neutral tones make this an easy rotation staple for all seasons. Whether youre commuting, exploring the city, or heading out for a casual night, the cushioning and smooth transition feel make each step comfortable and confident. Style ID 1203A383-111 and a launch date of May 18, 2025, cement this pair as a standout option for anyone seeking a streamlined runner-inspired profile with go-anywhere comfort. Our team thinks this product is great for all-day urban wear thanks to its balanced cushioning, versatile White/Smoke Grey palette, and durable build that elevates both comfort and style.

Display Name: Nike Free Run 5.0 Black Off Noir
Description: The Nike Free Run 5.0 Black Off Noir is a sock-like boot of a sneaker that offers a lightweight design intended to create a comfortable barefoot feeling with each step. The Black Off Noir Nike Free Run 5.0 is a sneaker dressed in unrelieved black. The upper is lightweight breathable knit fabric with Flywire loops that run from the laces down the side panel to add stability and structure. A thick textile heel counter offers support and a heel pull tab makes on/off easy for this pair of kicks. A black tongue and black insole both feature swoosh-pinwheel branding. The midsole is constructed from soft, lightweight foam with laser-cut grooves that add flexibility. A rubber outsole at the forefoot and heel provides durability. The detail of these Nike shoes we enjoy the most are the reflective swooshes on the lateral side. The subtle sheen in daylight glows in the dark when the lights go out. The Nike Free Run 5.0 Black Off Noir was released on June 28, 2021, for a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Light Smoke Grey Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Light Smoke Grey Black reflects the foundation of the silhouette, staying close to the tones that defined its early identity. Light smoke grey and black create a layered and neutral palette that highlights the structure without relying on bold color. Anthracite and photon dust details add depth, reinforcing the technical look that has kept the model relevant for decades. This pair carries weight because of its connection to the original era. It feels timeless rather than nostalgic, offering a version of the Air Max 90 that aligns closely with its roots. Fans who value authenticity are drawn to releases like this, where the focus remains on form, balance, and the elements that made the silhouette iconic in the first place. The Nike Air Max 90 Light Smoke Grey Black was released on September 15, 1990 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 2 CB '94 Suns
Description: Debuted in 1994, the Nike Air Max 2 CB 94 Suns features a white tumbled leather upper with hits of black and purple Nike Swoosh detailing. At the lateral heel, an embroidered "34" depicts the number Barkley wore while he played for the Suns. Nike Air Max cushioning in the heel and a velcro strap enclosure at the collar complete this retro design. The Nike Air Max 2 CB 94 Suns released in February of 2022 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Cloud White Core Black
Description: The adidas Samba OG Cloud White Core Black (Women's) represents a contemporary take on a timeless style, emanating an aesthetic charm that goes beyond its original athletic purpose.? ?? ?Crafted from full-grain leather, the upper of the Cloud White Core Black adidas Samba OG (Women's) offers a sturdy and resilient construction. A gray suede, paired with a contrasting black heel tab, introduces an element of sophistication to the overall design. The iconic serrated 3-Stripes appear in black on both the lateral and medial sides, creating a visually striking contrast. Enhancing the shoe's unique identity, a Bluebird tongue label and a foil logotype mark its distinctive DNA. Underneath, a brown gum rubber outsole ensures both traction and durability, underscoring the shoe's practicality and style.? ?? ?The standout characteristic of the adidas Samba OG Cloud White Core Black (Women's) lies in its signature T-toe design. This element pays homage to football pitches of the past, while embracing a forward-looking approach with its entirely vegan composition. The shoe debuted for $100 on December 1st, 2023.

Display Name: Nike LD Waffle sacai CLOT Kiss of Death 2 Cool Grey
Description: The Nike LDWaffle sacai CLOT Cool Grey features a tonal grey mesh upper with dual tongues and 3M Swooshes. Each Swoosh is thin and reinforced with a heat-pressing technique, similar to Hyperfuse technology. A stacked midsole and gum outsole complete the design. The Nike LDWaffle sacai CLOT Cool Grey was released in October of 2021 and retailed for $180.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten White Blue Gum
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten White Blue Gum is a slim, low-profile silhouette suitable for indoor soccer and everyday occasions. This colorway presents in a cool white, soft blue, and timeless gum palette. The Tokuten silhouette from Japanese footwear brand Onitsuka Tiger features a low top and a narrow cut. The suede upper with a reinforced t-toe tip is a calming, white tone and the iconic Tiger stripes adorn both sides of the shoe in a creamy blue. Pops of contrast arrive via the red-branded tongue patch and underfoot on the insoles. Flat white laces keep things simple but stylish and a rubber gum outsole completes the look with a vintage flourish. The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten White Blue Gum features a combination of the slim silhouette and classic side stripes that gives it a timeless edge. Originally released on August 1, 2023, it retailed at the time for $70.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Realtree Rattan Rocky Tan Seal Brown Camo
