Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Realtree Rattan Rocky Tan Seal Brown Camo reimagines the timeless basketball classic through an outdoor inspired lens. Rattan and Rocky Tan tones blend with Seal Brown camo detailing, creating a layered upper that feels rugged yet familiar. The Air Force 1 shape remains unchanged, preserving the clean lines and durable build that made it iconic. Realtree camo adds a distinct twist to a silhouette that has seen countless interpretations over the years. The earthy palette makes the design feel rooted in nature while still maintaining strong streetwear presence. For fans who appreciate themed executions of classics, this pair brings together heritage basketball DNA and hunting inspired camouflage in a way that feels fresh. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Realtree Rattan Rocky Tan Seal Brown Camo was released on October 3, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Mexico
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Mexico in Phantom, Team Red, Fir, Alabaster, Peony, and White is one of the most multi-tone and color-research-intensive World Cup 2026 host nation tributes in Nike's seasonal running platform lineup, the six-color palette drawing from Mexico's national flag colors and the full spectrum of the Mexican cultural color vocabulary to create a gradient-layered Air Max 95 execution that honors El Tri's 2026 World Cup moment with genuine chromatic depth and national color awareness. Phantom and alabaster provide the clean and slightly warm white tones that establish the gradient's foundation, team red introduces the Mexican flag's red with complete national color accuracy, fir brings the deep green in the palette's most forest-adjacent and organic expression, and peony adds the warm and slightly pink-adjacent accent that gives the full gradient complexity and visual warmth beyond what a simple three-color flag representation could achieve on the 95's layered panel architecture. The Big Bubble Air unit amplifies the visual impact of the Mexico tribute with the enlarged heel cushioning that makes every detail of the upper's multi-color story more dramatically present and display-worthy. Nike Air Max 95 World Cup host nation tribute colorways with Big Bubble specification represent the most technically and visually ambitious platform-specific FIFA World Cup product in the 2026 Nike seasonal lineup, the 95's gradient layering tradition creating the most natural and design-complete canvas for multi-tone national color tributes that the Nike running archive offers at any scale or production tier. The Mexico-specific color research embedded in the phantom, team red, fir, and peony selection demonstrates genuine national color knowledge and design intent beyond generic flag color application, making this a tribute that honors El Tri's 2026 hosting significance with the full design seriousness the moment deserves. At two hundred dollars the Air Max 95 Big Bubble Mexico is a premium and culturally significant host nation tribute acquisition. The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Mexico was released on April 20, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 5 Protro X-Ray
Description: The Nike Kobe 5 Protro X-Ray is a vibrant homage to Kobe Bryant's legendary career, taking inspiration from the iconic X-ray T-shirt that featured his hand adorned with five championship rings. Reimagining this concept, the X-ray design is applied to the upper of the Kobe 5 with glow in the dark elements, depicting an X-ray of a foot. Done in deep royal blue, baltic blue, and glacier blue, this bold sneaker also features glow-in-the-dark outsoles, adding an extra layer of flair to an already striking silhouette. As part of the Protro series, this Kobe 5 combines modern performance technology with the original model's design, making it a favorite among basketball players and sneakerheads alike. Known for its sleek, low-profile build, the Kobe 5 has been a go-to for athletes seeking speed, agility, and responsiveness. This latest iteration takes the iconic silhouette and elevates it with a design that truly celebrates the Mamba Mentality and Kobes enduring influence on the game. Released on October 17, 2024, the Nike Kobe 5 Protro X-Ray retailed for $190. This special edition release, with its unique X-ray graphic, glow-in-the-dark elements, and tribute to Kobe's incredible career, is a must-have for fans of Kobe Bryant and those who appreciate bold, innovative designs.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Sand Grey
Description: The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Sand Grey borrows an adjacent camouflage styling as the MX Moon Grey, but implements a new color mix. Swirls of beige, dark brown, and grey smother the sculptural EVA foam design, offering as similar visual appeal as the process of mixing paint. The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Sand Grey released in December of 2021 and retailed for $80.
Colorway: MX Sand Grey/MX Sand Grey/MX Sand Grey

Display Name: Nike Air Max 270 Triple Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 270 Triple Black (W) is another sleek addition to the Air Max collection. It is a sneaker made with a rubber sole and aerated top that makes sure your feet are able to breathe. The Nike Air Max 270 release for women is displayed in black color. It features a web-like top material rubber outsole and lace-up closure. The shoe has a netted and fabricated top, a fluff midsole, and an elastic inner sole. The Nike Air Max 270 Triple Black (W) sneaker sold at a retail price of $150 and was out in the market on August 2, 2018.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Safety Orange Camo
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Safety Orange Camo pushes the Air Max 95 into rugged territory by combining military inspired camouflage with high visibility safety orange accents. The layered upper takes on a tougher personality, blending dark tones with flashes of orange that feel utilitarian rather than decorative. It amplifies the models aggressive design language, making the gradient panels feel sharper and more industrial. Fans love this release because it gives the Air Max 95 a different kind of edge. The camo treatment adds texture and depth, while the orange details keep the shoe visually loud and unmistakable. Collectors appreciate how the silhouette adapts so naturally to heavier themes, proving its versatility beyond classic OG colorways. It feels built for people who want their Air Max to feel bold, durable, and unapologetically strong. The Nike Air Max 95 Safety Orange Camo was released on September 12, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star XXHi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star XXHi Black White
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star XXHi Black White revives an exaggerated silhouette that feels rebellious and unapologetic. The extended high top design pushes the Chuck Taylor into statement territory, wrapping the leg in black canvas while white accents provide classic contrast. The familiar toe cap and sole ground the look in Converse tradition, even as the height transforms the overall energy. Fans gravitate toward this model because it challenges expectations while staying rooted in history. The XXHi speaks to alternative style and self expression, appealing to collectors who enjoy silhouettes that feel dramatic and expressive. It brings a sense of edge back to the Chuck lineage, reminding people that Converse has always thrived in spaces where fashion, music, and attitude intersect rather than play it safe. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star XXHi Black White was released on June 28, 2024 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Metallic Silver Gym Red
Description: The Nike P 6000 Metallic Silver Gym Red brings sharp contrast and classic Nike energy to a runner inspired silhouette that thrives on layered detail. Metallic silver panels give the shoe a technical and almost futuristic shine, while gym red accents inject urgency and motion that feel rooted in performance heritage. The P 6000s flowing lines and stacked construction feel purposeful, balancing nostalgia with a modern edge that makes the design feel alive rather than archival. Fans love this release because it feels fast and confident without being overwhelming. The silver base keeps it versatile, while the red details add personality that stands out in motion. Collectors appreciate how the P 6000 continues to evolve as a lifestyle runner, offering comfort and visual depth that work well beyond athletic contexts. It is the kind of sneaker that feels energetic and dependable at the same time, making it an easy favorite for rotation. The Nike P 6000 Metallic Silver Gym Red was released on February 20, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Cloud Island
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Cloud Island brings cinematic influence into Ja Morants signature line, using a metallic silver black white baltic blue palette that feels futuristic and bold. The reflective elements and layered design give the shoe a high energy presence, aligning with the intensity associated with Jurassic Park themes. Fans are drawn to this release because it merges basketball performance with pop culture storytelling. The metallic finish adds a unique edge, making it stand out both on and off the court. It reflects the growing trend of signature sneakers tapping into broader cultural references, creating something that feels dynamic and collectible. The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Cloud Island was released on April 21, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Barons
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Barons is a commemorative sneaker that celebrates the 30th anniversary of Michael Jordans time with the Birmingham Barons, a Double-A affiliate team of the Chicago White Sox. The low-top Barons Jordan 1 Retro Low OG boasts a leather upper in white, black, and Wolf Gray, a colorway that pays tribute to the baseball teams colors. While the base comes in white, Wolf Gray overlays provide subtle color blocking. Small perforations on the vamp and the mesh material of the tongue allow the foot to breathe, even though the upper is constructed entirely from smooth leather. The flat tongue displays a woven tag with NIKE AIR lettering in Wolf Gray, while the Air Jordan Wings can be found on the heel tab. Our experts at StockX like the way the black accents on the laces, the Swoosh logos, and the leather heel tab contrast the Wolf Gray and white across the upper. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Barons was released on July 20, 2024, and sold for $140.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Shadow Red Shadow Green
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Shadow Red Shadow Green brings a bold contrast to one of adidas most timeless silhouettes, blending rich shadow red with deep shadow green for a look that feels both vintage and fresh. The pairing creates a layered color story that stands out without overwhelming the clean lines of the Gazelle Indoor. Wonder white accents help balance the design, keeping it grounded in the classic indoor aesthetic. What makes this pair hit is how effortlessly it combines strong color with a familiar shape. The Gazelle Indoor has always been about simplicity and versatility, and this version builds on that by adding depth through contrast. It is a colorway that feels expressive but still easy to wear, making it a strong option for collectors who want something with personality. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Shadow Red Shadow Green was released on April 22, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Black
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70s Hi Black provides a classic design that continues the tradition of perhaps one of the oldest athletic shoes in the history of footwear. Although the history surrounding Converse began to take shape as early as 1917, the company designed the Chuck Taylor All Star 70s Hi Black and similar models decades later as part of a tribute to the original shoe. The newer silhouette maintains many of the aesthetic aspects of its predecessor, but some of the fittings and materials have been updated as a way to make a robust shoe that Converse fans and footwear enthusiasts might be able to wear for decades to come. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70s Hi Black includes a premium canvas upper that is double-ply for extra strength and durability while the stitching near the toe is reinforced but designed to keep the classic look of the original. Converse added some extra padding to the insole in an effort to provide collectors or wearers with additional arch support and more cushioning for comfort. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70s Hi Black released in January 2018 for $85.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Net Black (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Net Black (Women's) sneakers combines comfort with chic black-metallic silver details. The upper and back heels are overlayed with mesh, and the thick soles feature patterned details. The womens Jorden 4 Retro sneakers feature a mix of premium leather and breathable mesh netting on the all-black upper. The sole features a visible Air cushioning, and the iconic Jumpman logo is on the heel. As part of the Jordan Brand legacy, the Jordan 4 Retro Net Black continues to bridge athletic innovation with fashion-forward design. What we think sets these sneakers apart are the signature design elements that elevate its aesthetic, like the sophisticated plastic wing eyelets and the bold black colorway. The subtle textural contrasts of the mesh details and the sole elevate its streetwear appeal. The Jordan 4 Retro Net Black (Womens) sneakers released on February 26, 2025, retailed at $210.

Display Name: Burberry Check Suede Leather Sneakers Vintage Check-print Black
Description: The Burberry Check Suede Leather Sneakers Vintage Check print Black combine luxury craftsmanship with iconic house patterning. Dressed in Black with Vintage Check print detailing, the upper blends smooth leather and suede for a refined and textured finish. The streamlined silhouette keeps the focus on Burberrys signature check motif. Burberry sneakers often balance understated form with recognizable branding, and this pair follows that tradition. The black base adds versatility, while the vintage check print injects heritage appeal. It feels polished and elevated, designed for those who appreciate subtle luxury cues within a clean and wearable profile. The Burberry Check Suede Leather Sneakers Vintage Check print Black was released on November 3, 2022 with a retail price of $690.

Display Name: Timberland 6" Premium Boot Wheat (TD)
Description: The Timberland 6" Premium Boot Wheat (TD) takes Timberlands signature 6" Premium Boot silhouette and applies it to a toddler-sized model in a warm Wheat colorway. Like the adult-sized variation, this work boot boasts an upper made of soft nubuck leather treated with a water-repellent solution. In addition, the boots seam-sealed construction prevents water from seeping into the shoe and adds a smooth finish where the nubuck panels overlap. The durable rubber outsole features a texturized lug design that grips the ground and contributes to the shoes recognizable silhouette. To further Timberlands sustainability goals, 10 percent of the outsole is constructed from plant-based materials instead of ones that use petroleum. Our experts like the way the PrimaLoft insulation keeps the foot warm without adding bulky padding, perfect for winter play days. The toddler-sized Timberland 6" Premium Boot Wheat (TD) was released on January 4, 2019, and retailed at $90.

Display Name: Nike Air Trainer Huarache Cool Blue Black
Description: The Nike Air Trainer Huarache Cool Blue Black revives a beloved cross?training icon with a sharp, modern palette. Dressed in a Black/Cool Blue-White colorway (style IH4470-001), this pair fuses plush comfort with lockdown support. A soft neoprene-style inner sleeve hugs the foot for that signature Huarache fit, while the adjustable midfoot strap secures every cut, jump, and sprint. Layered synthetic and textile overlays add structure without bulk, and the cool blue hits energize the upper with a crisp, athletic edge. Perforations promote airflow, keeping sessions fresh whether youre in the gym, on the turf, or moving through the day. Underfoot, responsive cushioning delivers a smooth, stable ride, complemented by a durable rubber outsole engineered for multi-surface traction. The sculpted midsole nods to the early 90s design language, balancing retro appeal with everyday wearability. From training circuits to weekend wear, the Air Trainer Huarache offers versatile performance and standout style in one streamlined package. Thoughtful details, like the padded collar, torsional stability from the midfoot frame, and a grippy tread pattern, round out a sneaker built for movement and designed to turn heads. This release earns its place in the collection because it blends classic Huarache support with modern comfort, making it a go-to for training sessions and all-day wear.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Medium Soft Pink (GS)
Description: Air Jordan 5 Retro Medium Soft Pink GS brings a refined and unexpected tone to one of Jordan Brands most aggressive silhouettes. The soft pink upper contrasts with the sharp lines and fighter jet inspired details of the Air Jordan 5, creating a look that feels confident and expressive rather than delicate. It challenges expectations while staying true to the models bold identity. This pair resonates with collectors because it highlights how color alone can transform a familiar silhouette. The pink tones emphasize the sculpted midsole and layered construction, giving the shoe a fresh personality without losing its edge. Fans appreciate releases like this for their creativity, especially when the reinterpretation feels balanced and intentional rather than experimental for shock value. The Air Jordan 5 Retro Medium Soft Pink GS was released on10/11/2025 with a retail price of $165

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Low Golf US Open
Description: The Air Jordan 9 Retro Low Golf US Open brings performance innovation to the course through a White base accented by University Gold, Cool Grey, and Anthracite. The streamlined low cut silhouette keeps the AJ9s signature lines intact, while the golf specific outsole adapts the design for competitive play. The crisp white upper gives the shoe a polished and tournament ready presence. This release stands out because it blends Jordan heritage with championship energy tied to one of golfs biggest stages. The gold detailing adds a subtle nod to prestige, while the grey and anthracite elements provide balanced contrast. Fans of crossover performance appreciate when classic basketball silhouettes are reengineered for new arenas. It is a confident fusion of sport legacy and course ready function. The Air Jordan 9 Retro Low Golf US Open was released on June 14, 2024 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 2 CB '94 OG Black White Purple (2023)
Description: The Nike Air Max 2 CB '94 OG Black White Purple (2023) adopts a high-top basketball sneaker silhouette, designed with a focus on ankle support and a bold, chunky appearance. The 2023 Black White Purple Nike Air Max 2 CB '94 OG combines black and white as the primary colors, with purple accents adding a pop of color and contrast. The shoe is constructed with a combination of leather and synthetic (nubuck) materials for durability. The midsole features Nike's Air Max cushioning technology to offer responsive cushioning and support. The rubber outsole features a herringbone traction pattern, delivering superior grip and traction. For branding, the high-top prominently features a rubberized Air Max badge on the tongue, along with Nike Swoosh branding on various parts of the shoe, including the heel and midsole. Something our experts have loved about the Nike Air Max 2 CB '94 OG Black White Purple (2023) is its nostalgic design, calling back to the 1990s when Charles Barkley was a basketball icon. The bold color scheme and chunky silhouette capture the essence of that era's sneaker culture. The shoe debuted on August 25th, 2023, for $170.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 5 White Bright Crimson
Description: The Nike Free Metcon 5 White Bright Crimson is a workout shoe that is reinforced with elements to enhance comfort and flexibility for peak performance. This iteration of the Nike Free Metcon 5 is made with a breathable white mesh upper thats engineered for stretchiness where needed. White overlays make up the toecap and mudguard and run back around the heel. Decorative black stitching attaches the forefoot to the rear part of the shoe, while a small black Nike Swoosh is found under the inner ankle. Bright Crimson accents are found on the top eyelets, as well as on the heel support. The tongue features a pull tab with Nike Free branding, and another Nike Swoosh in Bright Crimson is found vertically on the lateral side of the midsole under the ankle. The shoes midsole is chunky and white for extra support, and the outsole is black and white. What stands out about this workout shoe are the Bright Crimson accents, which provide welcome pops of color to the otherwise black and white design. The Nike Free Metcon 5 White Bright Crimson was released on April 6, 2023, for $130.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Obsidian Summit White
Description: The Nike P-6000 Obsidian Summit White adds an upper dressed in a selection of white hues and accents in dark Obsidian to the P-6000 silhouette. Inspired by running sneakers from the early 2000s, the Obsidian Summit White Nike P-6000 is designed for comfort. The breathable mesh upper in Phantom allows the foot to breathe, while genuine and synthetic leather overlays in Summit White provide structure and contribute to the sneakers 2000s aesthetic. Another comfort-first feature is the foam midsole, which adds lightweight cushioning underfoot. Obsidian creates contrast on the Swoosh, the rubber outsole, and the laces. In addition, the "NIKE" lettering printed on the tongue, the Swoosh on the heel, and the "P-6000" on the overlays come in Obsidian. Our experts like the molded synthetic leather Swoosh logo on the side panel because it gives the sneaker dimension. The Nike P-6000 Obsidian Summit White was released on June 6, 2024, and sold for $110.

Display Name: Nike Romaleos 4 Black White
Description: The Nike Romaleos 4 Black White was made available as part of the brand's commitment to continue producing workout sneakers. Designed for stability and strength, the shoe arrives in a black/black-white colorway. The Nike Romaleos 4 Black White boasts a broad, flat outsole, which is supported by a midsole. Adjustable straps can be found over the laces stitched at the midfoot to provide added support. Furthermore, the ankle flexion is reduced by the heel-to-toe drop, which appears in kind­ and is required at the lifts bottom, teaming up with a predictably rigid midsole to enable substantial explosiveness off the ground. The sneaker also features rubber treads to deliver added traction. Designed for high-intensity workouts, the adjustable straps at the midsole ensure total lockdown by providing a firm fit. Also, it ensures comfort during training. The Nike Romaleos 4 Black White was released at a retail price of $200 on April 1st, 2020.

Display Name: Nike Air Trainer SC High Auburn
Description: The Nike Air Trainer SC High Auburn comes dressed in a color-blocking, paying homage to Bo Jacksons alma mater, the University of Auburn, where he won the Heisman Trophy in 1985. The Nike Air Trainer SC High Auburn starts with a pure white leather base, with the laterals outfitted with overlays in a mix of blue, orange, and grey fabrics and a silver Swoosh. Additional eyelet supports are seen in the same orange and blue hues with a fuzzy tongue peeping out featuring a debossed "NIKE." A strip of orange lays over a white midsole housing an Air unit by the heel, while the forefoot outsole adds contrast in blue. The Nike Air Trainer SC High Auburn was released in May 2022 and retailed for $150.

Display Name: Nike ReactX Infinity Run 4 Wolf Grey Lime
Description: The Nike ReactX Infinity Run 4 Wolf Grey Lime continues Nike Runnings push toward maximum comfort and stability through a silhouette built around smooth transitions and everyday mileage support. The Infinity Run line became popular because of its soft cushioning and stable ride, making it especially appealing for runners looking for comfort driven performance without sacrificing modern design. The Wolf Grey and Lime palette balances neutral tones and bright energy perfectly, with the grey base creating a clean technical foundation while the lime accents inject speed and movement throughout the silhouette. Fans appreciate the Infinity Run series because it combines responsive cushioning and sleek aesthetics in a way that feels approachable for both dedicated runners and casual wearers. The ReactX platform gives the shoe a more futuristic and performance focused identity while maintaining the smooth visual flow associated with modern Nike running footwear. Collectors especially gravitate toward grey based runners because they pair easily with everyday wardrobes while still allowing brighter accents to stand out naturally. The lime detailing adds a sharp athletic contrast that reinforces the energetic and forward moving personality central to the Infinity Run franchise. The Nike ReactX Infinity Run 4 Wolf Grey Lime was released on October 3, 2023 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Infrared (GS)
Description: Built in grade school sizing, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Infrared (GS) adds some color to an otherwise neutral colorway of the vintage silhouette. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Infrared (GS) is built on a dark grey nubuck upper with black accents on the quarter panel netting, structural wings, and Jumpman-branded heel piece. Sitting atop the dark grey base is a lighter shade of grey forefoot overlay, while touches of Infrared appear on the molded eyelets and woven Jumpman tongue tag. Lightweight cushioning arrives via an exposed Air-sole unit nestled in the heel of the two-tone midsole. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Infrared (GS) was released in June 2022 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax 2023 Flyknit Anthracite
Description: The Nike Air VaporMax 2023 Flyknit Anthracite adds a black-on-black colorway of Anthracite to the signature Air VaporMax 2023 Flyknit silhouette. This sneaker boasts a durable woven upper made from Flyknit, which conforms to the foots shape while allowing the foot to breathe. This material stretches around the contours of the foot and creates a seamless design. In addition, a perforated sockliner adds to the snug yet comfortable fit. A front-closure lace system secures the sneaker, while the heel tab allows for easy removal and application of the shoe. However, what makes this sneaker stand out is the one-piece Air unit, which provides responsive cushioning and spans the length of the foot. Our StockX experts like the subtle Swoosh logo printed across the Flyknit upper because it doesnt distract from the sneakers minimalist aesthetic. The Nike Air VaporMax 2023 Flyknit Anthracite was released on September 26, 2023, and sold for $210.

Display Name: New Balance 550 White Grey
Description: The New Balance 550 White Grey features a white leather upper with monochromatic perforated leather overlays and puffed New Balance logos. From there, a woven New Balance Basketball tongue label and matching sole completes the design. The New Balance 550 White Grey released in June of 2021 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Black Toe (2024) (GS)
Description: The Jordan 14 Retro Black Toe (2024) (GS) relaunches the iconic white, black, and Varsity Red colorway for the fourth time. And, in a grade-school size, the color scheme is accessible to a wider audience. Inspired by sports cars, the Black Toe (2024) (GS) Jordan 14 Retro boasts smooth lines and a streamlined feel. The upper is crafted from premium leather in white with black suede accents on the toe. Unlike the most recent relaunch, this version doesnt have perforations across the vamp. Additionally, the collar lining, tongue, laces, and back tab come in black, while white decorates the midsole. The chrome-plated shank plate in the midsole adds stability, while encapsulated Zoom Air units provide cushioning underfoot. Other notable features include the Jumpman and oversized "23" in Metallic Silver on the heel. Our experts at StockX like the small Jumpman logo on the outer side, which draws inspiration from Ferrari branding. The Jordan 14 Retro Black Toe (2024) (GS) was released on November 2, 2024, and sold for $150.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 9 Big Bang (2022)
Description: Debuted during the 2012 NBA All-Star Weekend, the Nike LeBron 9 Big Bang returned just in time for its 10th Anniversary. Paying tribute to the Kennedy Space Center in Orlando, which was the host city of the 2012 All-Star Weekend, the Nike LeBron 9 Big Bang embraces an interstellar theme. Its bright orange mesh upper nods to fiery explosions that take place during a space shuttle's lift off. Metallic silver detailing depicts astronaut suits. Similar to clusters of stars in the solar system, the semi-translucent outsole glows in the dark. The Nike LeBron 9 Big Bang released in February of 2022 and retailed for $240.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Naruto Fossilized Vintage White
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Naruto Fossilized Vintage White brings anime fandom and classic sneaker culture together in a bold, limited-edition design that honors one of the most complex characters from a popular Japanese manga. Released as part of a collection that pays homage to five characters from the Japanese manga series Naruto, this original Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi model was inspired by Sasuke Uchihas iconic look. The canvas upper is a neutral fossilized tone. It is adorned with subtle flame graphics and the cursed seal of heaven on the lateral side. A metallic shuriken detail punctuates the Chuck Taylor logo patch on the medial side. Inside, co-branded insoles display an all-over graphic print, and the red Sharingan symbol is on the inner tongue. We just love how this sneaker is accented by light purple rope-style laces that stay true to Sasukes signature outfit and echo his belt. Released on May 22, 2025, the Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Naruto Fossilized Vintage White retailed for $80.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Multi-Color Sail Light Bone
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Multi Color Sail Light Bone brings playful contrast to the classic low cut icon. Featuring a Multi Color upper balanced by Sail and Light Bone tones, the layered panels create a dynamic and expressive look. The signature Swoosh and cupsole construction remain intact, preserving the silhouettes unmistakable identity. This special edition execution leans into variety and texture, offering something different from standard two tone releases. The softer neutral shades ground the vibrant elements, making the design feel cohesive rather than chaotic. It captures the ongoing evolution of the AJ1 Low, proving the model continues to thrive through creative color experimentation. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Multi Color Sail Light Bone was released on September 19, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Electric Green
Description: Jordan Brand revisited a colorway from their Player Exclusive archive for the Air Jordan 6 Electric Green. The Electric Green is nearly identical to the Air Jordan 6 Oregon Ducks PE that surfaced in 2018. The Air Jordan 6 Electric Green features an all-black Durabuck upper with hits of Electric Green on the heel tab, tongue, and midsole. A milky, green translucent outsole finishes off this retro model. The Air Jordan 6 Electric Green released in June of 2021 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Duckboot Black Neutral Olive
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Duckboot Black Neutral Olive transforms a street icon into a cold weather essential built for durability and protection. The Duckboot construction adds structure and weather resistance, while the black and neutral olive tones keep the look grounded and utilitarian. It feels tough and purposeful, designed for function without abandoning the Air Force 1s recognizable shape. Collectors appreciate this pair because it expands the Air Force 1s role beyond lifestyle wear. The Duckboot version feels ready for real conditions, appealing to fans who want practicality wrapped in heritage. It is loved for its versatility, offering a sneaker that works in harsher environments while still carrying the confidence and familiarity of one of Nikes most enduring silhouettes. The Nike Air Force 1 Duckboot Black Neutral Olive was released on September 25, 2023 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Bright Crimson Lime Blast (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 Bright Crimson Lime Blast Womens delivers one of Nikes most advanced running silhouettes through a colorway that feels just as fast as its design. Bright crimson dominates the upper, while lime blast and mint foam accents create a high contrast look that emphasizes speed and energy. The sculpted sole and visible air units give the shoe a futuristic profile that stands out immediately. Runners and collectors alike appreciate how the Alphafly line continues to push performance innovation while maintaining a bold visual identity. This version leans fully into vibrant tones, making it feel dynamic both in motion and at rest. It is a sneaker that represents the cutting edge of Nike running, combining technology and design in a way that feels purpose driven. The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 Bright Crimson Lime Blast Womens was released on February 13, 2025 with a retail price of $285.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Metallic Platinum Pure Platinum Metallic Silver University Blue
Description: The Nike P 6000 Metallic Platinum Pure Platinum Metallic Silver University Blue brings sharper contrast and shine to the P 6000 through metallic tones and cool color accents. Platinum and silver dominate the upper, giving the shoe a technical and almost futuristic feel, while university blue adds clarity and movement. The layered construction feels dynamic, emphasizing the models running heritage through structure rather than nostalgia alone. Fans love this release because it feels energetic and modern. The metallic finishes catch light without becoming overwhelming, making the shoe stand out through detail instead of volume. Collectors appreciate how Nike continues to evolve runner inspired silhouettes into lifestyle staples, and this colorway represents that balance perfectly by blending comfort, history, and visual impact into one cohesive design. The Nike P 6000 Metallic Platinum Pure Platinum Metallic Silver University Blue was released on April 4, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Blazer Mid 77 Vintage Summit White Pink (Women's)
Description: The Nike Blazer Mid 77 Vintage Summit White Pink (W) sneaker made for women features a white leather upper with hits of rough white suede on the toe and quarter. The pink swooshes connect in a pink arc across the heel that matches the pink word "NIKE" on the heel of this Nike Blazer Mid 77 Vintage Summit White Pink. The tongue is soft pink pebbled material with yellow edging and a white tag that has a black "NIKE" and an orange swoosh. The insole is pink with a white swoosh, the midsole is white and tumbled, and the outsole is patterned in white chevrons. The Nike Blazer Mid 77 Vintage Summit White Pink (W) sneaker for women was released in August 2021 at a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Court Purple
Description: This skateboarding (SB) Nike SB Dunk Low Court Purple delivers a straightforward colorway of the classic silhouette. The Nike SB Dunk Low Court Purple uses a white leather upper with contrasting black overlays on the forefoot, eyestay, and collar. Court purple makes its appearance on the heel overlay, which is matched by the rubber outsole that features a grippy traction pattern originally designed for basketball courts. A Zoom Air unit in the heel and a padded tongue are included for maximum comfort. The Nike SB Dunk Low Court Purple was released in January 2021 and retailed for $100. The Nike SB Dunk Low Court Purple restocked in January 2024 and retailed for $115.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Cool Grey (2019)
Description: Jordan Brand brings back a mid-2000s classic with the Air Jordan 4 "Cool Grey", now available on StockX. After originally releasing in 2004, the Cool Grey 4 has not since been retroed until 2019. The "Cool Grey" color garnered attention when it was featured on a pair of Air Jordan 11 Retros in 2001. It seemed only fitting for Jordan to carry this tremendous colorway to a very notable design with the Air Jordan 4. These AJ 4s are very similar to the 2004 release, featuring a cool gey upper, chrome hardware, and a dark charcoal interior. In classic Jordan 4 fashion, a heel tab is present sporting a Jumpman logo. A white midsole, dark charcoal outsole, and yellow detail embroidery on the tongue complete the design. These sneakers released in August of 2019 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Scratch 3.0
Description: Nike Ja 3 Turbo Green injects high energy color into Ja Morants signature line, pairing bold green tones with the aggressive spirit that defines his game. The Turbo Green finish gives the shoe instant presence, reflecting speed, confidence, and momentum. It feels expressive and fearless, much like Jas playing style itself. What makes this colorway hit is how naturally it complements the Ja 3 silhouette. The modern shape and performance focused design feel amplified by the vibrant color, making the shoe look fast even when standing still. Fans of the Ja line appreciate releases like this because they carry personality and storytelling, turning performance footwear into an extension of the athlete behind it. The Nike Ja 3 Turbo Green was released on 11/05/2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2025) (GS)
Description: Air Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue 2025 GS brings one of the most storied Jordan 5 colorways into the 2025 slate with a confident and iconic presence. The Fire Red accents paired with the contrasting black tongue pay homage to the original 1990 design while updating the silhouette for a new generation. Even in grade school sizing, the shoe retains the aggressive angles and fighter jet inspired shape that made the Jordan 5 a staple in sneaker culture. What makes this release meaningful to collectors is how it bridges heritage and modern energy. The Fire Red and black combo feels as bold now as it did decades ago, reinforcing the silhouettes legacy with a crisp, purposeful aesthetic. Its a shoe that appeals to fans who value story and form in equal measure, standing out on display and on foot alike. The Air Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue 2025 GS was released on 09/13/2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Better Scarlet White
Description: The adidas Samba OG Better Scarlet White Better Scarlet Cloud White Gum injects bold color into the timeless Samba frame. Better Scarlet saturates the upper, creating a vibrant base that feels energetic and confident, while Cloud White stripes provide crisp contrast. The gum outsole reinforces the silhouettes deep ties to indoor football, grounding the design in heritage even as the color pushes it forward. This colorway stands out because it commits fully to saturation without sacrificing balance. The red base commands attention, yet the white detailing keeps the look sharp and wearable. Fans of the Samba OG appreciate when adidas experiments with expressive palettes while preserving the original shape and proportions. It feels lively and modern, offering a fresh spin on one of the most recognizable sneakers in sport and street culture. The adidas Samba OG Better Scarlet White Better Scarlet Cloud White Gum was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: adidas BW Army Black Patent Leather
Description: The adidas BW Army Black Patent Leather reimagines a military rooted classic with a glossy and more elevated finish. The all black color scheme keeps the shoe grounded and versatile, while the patent leather upper adds a reflective quality that shifts the tone from purely utilitarian to more fashion forward. The silhouette remains low profile and understated, staying true to the BW Armys origins while introducing a new texture to the design. Collectors and longtime adidas fans appreciate how the brand continues to revisit archival models with subtle updates rather than full redesigns. This version keeps the DNA intact while offering a different visual experience that feels more polished. It is a reminder of how small material changes can completely reshape the perception of a familiar silhouette, giving it new life without losing its identity. The adidas BW Army Black Patent Leather was released on February 19, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Vans Premium Old Skool Gemstone Mushroom
Description: The Vans Premium Old Skool Gemstone Mushroom reimagines a classic skate silhouette through a muted gemstone mushroom palette that feels earthy and refined. The Old Skool structure remains unchanged, with the signature side stripe anchoring the design while the color adds a new mood. Collectors appreciate how Vans continues to evolve core models through subtle color updates. This pair leans into versatility, making it easy to wear while still offering a slightly different feel. It stands as a timeless option that fits across both skate and lifestyle settings. The Vans Premium Old Skool Gemstone Mushroom was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (GS) (2025)
Description: The Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (GS) (2025) revives a legendary color story in a sleek, kid-friendly silhouette. Dressed in Black/White-Varsity Red, this pair pairs a glossy patent leather mudguard with breathable ballistic-style mesh for that unmistakable Air Jordan 11 look, reimagined for everyday wear. A crisp white midsole sits above a bold Varsity Red rubber outsole for confident traction, while classic rope laces and a Jumpman hit deliver the heritage details fans love. Designed with comfort in mind, the cushioned setup and supportive shape make this GS edition an easy go-to for school, weekends, and game day alike. Style code FV5121-006 and a 2025-04-26 release date make this a standout pick for collectors shopping youth sizing. Beyond its timeless appeal, the Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (GS) offers reliable performance features that keep up with active kids. The low-cut profile promotes natural movement, and the durable outsole helps grip courts and sidewalks with ease. Subtle branding and the iconic patent shine elevate outfits from sport to street, giving this pair a versatile edge that works with jeans, shorts, and team gear. Whether youre drawn to the storied Tinker Hatfield design language or the legendary "Bred" palette, this release captures everything that made the AJ11 a cultural icon, now tailored for younger sneaker fans who want style and substance in one package. Our team loves this product because it blends the iconic Bred look with all-day comfort in GS sizing, making it a polished, versatile staple for growing sneaker rotations.

Model: Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite IC SE
Display Name: Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite IC SE Travis Scott
Description: The Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite IC SE Travis Scott is the indoor court version of the first-ever collaboration between Houston rapper Travis Scott and Nike Football, applying Scott's signature Cactus Jack aesthetic to Nike's Phantom 6 Low Elite indoor court football shoe in a Multicolor and Metallic Gold palette that blends bright green panels with deep brown tones, a scale-like textured heel, bright yellow laces, mini Swoosh logos on the forefoot and side panels, Scott's jewelled reverse Swoosh near the heel as a subtle signature, and Cactus Jack branding with a custom crest on the tongue. The IC (indoor court) soleplate makes this the street-ready and hard-court appropriate version of the collaboration, with the flat rubber outsole replacing the firm-ground studs of the FG cleat version  making it accessible for everyday wear and indoor play in a way that traditional cleats cannot achieve  while maintaining the same upper construction, GripKnit knitted forefoot for precise ball touch, and Phantom 6's updated shoe frame that moulds to the wearer's foot shape. The collaboration was previewed on Travis Scott's feet at Nike Toma indoor events during the 2026 World Cup buildup before the full rollout of official images as the tournament progressed, with Nike and Travis Scott also producing a 50-piece Total 90 football apparel collection spanning ten nations simultaneously. Released June 26, 2026 at $210 retail through TravisScott.com and Nike Football globally with style code IV2037-900. The Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite IC SE Travis Scott was released on June 26, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Pure Money (2025)
Description: Clean, crisp, and timeless, the Jordan 3 Retro Pure Money (2025) refreshes a beloved silhouette with a pristine White/White/Metallic Silver palette. The tumbled leather upper delivers a refined texture, balanced by smooth leather overlays and subtle perforations that enhance breathability. Metallic Silver accents at the eyelets and heel branding add a polished flash, while the classic Jumpman on the tongue grounds the look in heritage. Underfoot, a visible Air unit and cushioned polyurethane midsole provide day?long comfort, and a durable rubber outsole with dependable traction patterns keeps each step confident. Style code CT8532-111 and the July 3, 2025 release date mark this pair as a standout entry in the Air Jordan 3 lineage. With its clean lines and understated details, the Jordan 3 Retro Pure Money (2025) is built to elevate everything from tailored streetwear to everyday essentials. The padded collar, supportive heel counter, and sculpted midsole deliver a stable ride, while the white-on-white execution earns instant versatility across seasons and settings. Discreet textural hits echo the models iconic DNA without overpowering the minimalist aesthetic, making this a go-to choice for collectors and first-time Jordan buyers alike. Whether youre curating a rotation of neutral sneakers or seeking a statement-making yet wearable pair, this colorway offers the perfect blend of heritage design and modern polish. Our team loves this product because its monochrome leather construction, Metallic Silver highlights, and classic Air cushioning create a sleek, easy-to-style sneaker that feels just as good as it looks.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Black White Gum (GS)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Black White Gum (GS) is a grade school-sized shoe that pays homage to the classic design of the original model. This model of the adidas Samba OG comes with a soft black leather upper. A T-shaped suede toe cap also appears in black. The traditional adidas three stripes logo is formed on each side of the shoe in white leather overlays, and the heel collar is also white leather. The Samba model name appears on the lateral side in gold foil letters next to the three stripes, and a blue adidas logo patch appears on the tongue  the only deviation from the otherwise black-and-white color scheme. A dark brown gum rubber outsole completes the design. What we like best about this shoe is its classic and timeless look. It allows the shoe, originally intended for wear during soccer games, to be a lifestyle staple. The adidas Samba OG Black White Gum (GS) was released on August 10, 2023, for a retail price of $80.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Hustle & Flow
Description: Nike Ja 3 Hustle and Flow feels like a direct reflection of Ja Morants mindset, blending relentless drive with creative rhythm. The colorway tells a story about balance, where effort and instinct meet on the court, and the design carries that narrative through layered tones and dynamic visual energy. It feels expressive and intentional, built to match the pace of players who never slow down. What makes this pair resonate with fans is how closely it aligns with Jas personality. The Ja 3 silhouette thrives on motion, and Hustle and Flow amplifies that with a look that feels alive even when standing still. It is a favorite among collectors who appreciate storytelling in sneakers, where performance and personal narrative are tightly connected. The Nike Ja 3 Hustle and Flow was released on 09/10/2025 with a retail price of $130.
Colorway: Soft Yellow/Purple Dynasty/Volt Tint/Light Thistle/Bright Crimson

Display Name: Nike Air Diamond Turf 2 Royals
Description: The Nike Air Diamond Turf 2 in Sail, Mystic Navy, Blue Grey, and Metallic Gold is a Deion Sanders tribute colorway on one of the most historically loaded and sport-culturally specific Nike silhouettes ever produced, the Diamond Turf 2's direct biographical connection to Prime Time's unique position as a two-sport professional athlete and the most flamboyant and fashion-forward competitor of the early 1990s giving this colorway an immediate and emotionally resonant frame of reference for any collector who understands the shoe's specific athletic biography. The sail and mystic navy color story with metallic gold accents creates a palette that carries the Royals' baseball franchise associations while honoring Deion's signature love of gold and the specific kind of precious metal self-expression that made him one of the most culturally significant and visually memorable athletes of any era in American professional sport. The Diamond Turf 2's combination of turf football and baseball dual-sport design credentials and the clean silhouette's premium multi-material construction make this one of the most athletically authentic and design-complete retro releases in Nike's current seasonal offering. Nike Air Diamond Turf 2 Royals colorway releases carry a specific and devoted collector following among communities who understand the Deion Sanders two-sport legacy and the specific cultural moment the shoe documents as one of the most biographical and personally connected Nike signature releases ever produced. The sail, navy, and metallic gold combination creates one of the most visually premium and precious-metal-accented Diamond Turf 2 expressions available in the current retro cycle, honoring both the athletic context and Deion's personal aesthetic sensibility with equal design intention. At one hundred and seventy dollars this colorway is a fair investment in one of Nike's most culturally specific and biographically loaded archive silhouettes. The Nike Air Diamond Turf 2 Royals was released on June 12, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Mono Ice
Description: The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 Mono Ice is one of three from the Mono pack. Each sneakers upper is constructed from a new monofilament mesh in Ice blue that exposes the models inner cage lining. The Mono pack brings back the heels pull tab design on each pair. To finish it out, a familiar Boost sole is added for comfort for the wearer. The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 Mono Ice released in June of 2021 for $220, exclusively in the US.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Grape (2025)
Description: The Jordan 5 Retro Grape 2025 edition revives a colorway that helped redefine sneaker culture far beyond the hardwood. Originally launched in 1990, the "grape ice" and "new emerald" palette broke the mold, a bold move at the time for a Jordan model. What set it apart wasnt what happened on the court, but what happened on screen and in the streets. Think Will Smith rocking them lace-free in The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air and MJ flashing them on a Wheaties box. That energy is back, this time with the OG Nike Air heel branding and shape to match. This version of the "Grapes" get it right. Clean white leather uppers, the classic tongue, and icy translucent soles return, now crafted with more attention to the original than weve seen in decades. Tinker Hatfields fighter jetinspired details are sharper than ever, and the silhouette has been fine-tuned to mirror the 1990 blueprint. Whether youre a longtime collector or just building your rotation, this pair hits the perfect balance of nostalgia and current heat. eReleased on June 21, 2025, the Jordan 5 Retro Grape (2025) dropped at a retail price of $210. Featuring a fresh blend of white, grape ice, and new emerald, this reissue pays homage to the cultural wave that made the 5s iconic.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Sail Tropical Pink (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Sail Tropical Pink PS is the Preschool sizing version of the Sail Tropical Pink colorway from the Travis Scott x Jordan Brand Pink Pack, released May 29, 2026 at $80, part of the two-colorway Pink Pack that Sneakers Worldwide described as one of the most anticipated sneaker drops of 2026 after nearly two years of uncertainty, delayed starts, celebrity sightings on three continents, and a canceled 2024 launch that only made the eventual release more charged. The Sail Tropical Pink is the bolder and more statement-forward of the two Pink Pack colorways, described by SoleRetriever as the summer-ready statement piece: a soft pink nubuck base covering the toebox and midfoot, layered with sail leather overlays on the mudguard, eyestays, and heel, with the reverse Swoosh shifting to a deeper and brighter red that creates the maximum contrast and the most seasonally energetic color execution in Travis Scott's Jordan 1 Low catalog to date. The Preschool version translates all the construction and colorway details of the adult pair into youth sizing: the reversed lateral Swoosh that has defined every Travis Scott Jordan 1 Low, the mismatched heel branding with a Wings logo on one heel and a Cactus Jack smiley on the other, Cactus Jack tongue patches, the heart emblem on the tongue, a faux-aged midsole in keeping with the vintage-worn aesthetic, multiple lace sets, the premium leather and nubuck upper, padded collar, and encapsulated Nike Air unit in the heel. Style code IQ7605-101, released May 29, 2026 at $80 in Preschool sizing. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Sail Tropical Pink PS is the May 2026 Preschool Pink Pack colorway for the young Jordan and Cactus Jack collector who wants all the reversed-Swoosh, Cactus Jack smiley, and mismatched-heel Travis Scott Jordan 1 Low details in the most boldly pink-forward and most summer-energy-specific Sail Tropical Pink execution from the two-year-anticipated Pink Pack at Preschool sizing retail. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Sail Tropical Pink PS was released on May 29, 2026 with a retail price of $80.

Display Name: Nike Mind 001 Slide Team Red University Red
Description: The Nike Mind 001 Slide Team Red University Red delivers a bold and elevated take on minimal slide design through its layered color palette and clean structure. Team red and university red dominate the upper, creating a rich and saturated look, while subtle hits of midnight navy and chrome add depth and contrast. The silhouette remains streamlined, allowing the color and finish to define the overall presence. Fans of the Mind series appreciate how it focuses on simplicity while still experimenting with tone and material. This version stands out for its use of multiple red hues, giving it a more dynamic feel without overcomplicating the design. It is a slide that blends comfort with a strong visual identity, making it a standout option for everyday wear. The Nike Mind 001 Slide Team Red University Red was released on April 2, 2026 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Fade
Description: Yeezy unlocked a new 350 V2 colorway as part of their Fall 2020 lineup with the Yeezy 350 V2 Fade. The earthy brown look is primed for the autumnal season, embracing the vibe of newly fallen leaves and their natural surroundings. The Yeezy 350 V2 Fade features a marbled brown Primeknit upper with a deep blue side stripe across the quarter. A tan translucent midsole around a gum Boost interior completes this standard Yeezy design. The Yeezy 350 V2 Fade released in November of 2020 and retailed for $220.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Mocha
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Mocha is a low-top shoe whose design was inspired by the 80s basketball look. The Mocha Jordan 1 Retro Low OG has an upper made of white leather. This material and color form the side panels and the toebox, which also has perforations for extra air flow. A black leather overlay serves as the toecap and mudguard and attaches the bottom eyelets to the midsole. Thin black Nike Swooshes also appear in black leather on each side. Suede in Dark Mocha forms the heel counter and heel collar, and the heel collar also features a black Air Jordan logo. The tongue also bears a Dark Mocha Nike Air patch. A white midsole and black outsole complete the look. The most interesting feature of this shoe are the way the black and Dark Mocha colors work together, adding a hint of subtle elegance. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Mocha was released on September 21, 2024, for $140.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Copper Fade
Description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Copper Fade is composed of a copper Primeknit upper with a signature translucent TPU lace cage unit. At the base, a black and copper adiPRENE sole provides cushioning and stability. The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Copper Fade released in December of 2021 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive continues the highly coveted collaboration between Jordan Brand and Travis Scott, offering sneakerheads a fresh take on a classic silhouette. Dressed in a striking colorway of medium olive, black, sail, and muslin, this low-top design is instantly recognizable with its iconic reverse swoosh, a signature element of the Travis Scott x Jordan partnership. The premium leather and suede construction provides a tactile contrast, while the standout red Jordan wings logo on the heel and the Cactus Jack branding on the medial side elevate the sneakers distinctive style. Travis Scotts collaboration with Jordan has had an undeniable influence on sneaker culture, making each new release a must-have for collectors. The reverse swoosh, initially introduced with the first collaboration, has become synonymous with the Travis Scott brand, and this Jordan 1 Low model amplifies that signature aesthetic. Alongside the bold swoosh, other details like the sail midsole, muslin accents, and custom Travis Scott logos give the sneaker a blend of vintage appeal and modern streetwear edge, making it a versatile option for any look. Released on September 28, 2024, the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive retailed at $150. This medium olive, black, sail, and muslin colorway continues to build on the legacy of the Jordan x Travis Scott collaboration, offering a sneaker that is a key piece of todays sneaker fashion. Whether you're a dedicated Jordan collector or a fan of streetwear culture, this release is sure to make a statement.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Light Smoke Grey Off Noir
Description: Air Jordan 1 Low Light Smoke Grey Off Noir brings a muted and confident color story to one of Jordan Brands most versatile silhouettes, leaning into balance rather than flash. The combination of light smoke grey and off noir feels calm and intentional, giving the Jordan 1 Low a refined presence that works effortlessly across everyday wear. It highlights the silhouettes timeless paneling and proportions, letting form and color placement do the work instead of relying on bold contrast. Collectors appreciate this pair because it feels endlessly wearable without sacrificing identity. The understated palette allows the Air Jordan 1 Lows heritage to shine through, making it a natural rotation staple rather than a one moment statement. It represents why the Jordan 1 continues to resonate, adapting to modern tastes while staying rooted in its original DNA and cultural importance. The Air Jordan 1 Low Light Smoke Grey Off Noir was released on 07/11/2025with a retail price of $125

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Black Green Leopard (Women's)
Description: The Black Green Leopard Samba OG by adidas uses a black leather base, with leopard print panels appearing on the side to create a visual drawing point.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2025)
Description: The Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2025) pays tribute to one of the most legendary colorways in the AJ5 lineup. Dressed in white, fire red, and black, the sneaker brings back its iconic look with a premium white leather upper and sharp contrasts of fire red on the midsole and lining. The standout feature, of course, is the bold black tongue, a detail that separates it from its reflective-tongued counterparts and instantly signals hoops heritage. Every detail of this release channels the spirit of the 1990 OG. The embroidered "23" on the lateral heel, the visible Nike Air cushioning, and the translucent outsole with Jumpman branding all nod back to Tinker Hatfields original design. The return of the "Nike Air" logo on the heel makes this pair especially meaningful, closing the loop on earlier retros that left out that piece of authenticity. For longtime fans, this drop feels like a long-awaited reunion, while new collectors get a taste of history with modern build quality. Celebrating the 35th anniversary of the Air Jordan 5, the Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2025) released at a retail price of $215 on September 13, 2025. With its timeless mix of white, fire red, and black, this faithful recreation of the original quickly cemented itself as one of the years most anticipated and celebrated Jordan drops.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (2025)
Description: The Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (2025) is a highly anticipated release that pays homage to a legendary colorway. This low-top version features a sleek black mesh upper complemented by glossy patent leather mudguards, creating a striking contrast. The bold varsity red accents add a pop of color, while the white midsole and translucent red outsole complete the classic design. Inspired by the PE pair Michael Jordan wore during the 1996 season, this sneaker captures a significant moment in basketball history. The combination of premium materials and iconic color scheme makes this release the truest remake of the Bred colorway on the Jordan 11 Low to date. Whether you're a seasoned sneaker collector or a casual enthusiast, these kicks are designed to turn heads on and off the court. Our team thinks this product is great for those who appreciate timeless style and basketball heritage, offering a perfect blend of performance and street-ready aesthetics.

Display Name: adidas Samba Mule Woven Basketweave Cream White (Women's)
Description: The Adidas Samba Mule Woven Basketweave Cream White is the summer rethink the Samba has genuinely earned after years of dominating every other season, and it arrives as one of the most structurally interesting iterations the silhouette has produced across its long run of 2020s relevance. Offered exclusively in women's sizing, this version of the Samba strips the heel counter entirely and reconstructs the upper in an open, breathable basketweave woven leather that feels as purposeful as it looks unique, turning one of football footwear's most enduring shapes into a warm weather slip-on that retains every visual cue that makes the Samba instantly recognizable. The monochromatic cream white treatment runs across the woven leather body, suede T-toe overlay, and eyestay panels in a single cohesive tone that emphasizes the texture story rather than competing with it, while gold Samba script lettering on the outer side reintroduces the branding in a script-style font that feels entirely right for a shoe this relaxed in its attitude. The classic gum cupsole and low-profile silhouette carry forward from the original, keeping the heritage footprint intact while everything above the sole speaks to a completely different seasonal register. Three Stripes appear in a slightly textured finish that blends into the woven construction rather than interrupting it, and the overall effect is a shoe that manages to feel brand new while still carrying thirty years of Samba DNA in every stitch. The Samba has done Mary Janes, brogues, snakeskin boots, and collaboration reworks by some of fashion's most respected names, but the Mule Woven is the version that makes the most sense for how people actually want to wear shoes in summer: easy on, heritage intact, and light enough to forget you're wearing them until someone stops to ask what they are. The Adidas Samba Mule Woven Basketweave Cream White Womens was released on June 1, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Blazer Mid 77 Vintage White Black
Description: The Nike Blazer is a monument in the history of Nike Basketball. The design was first popularized by NBA great George "The Iceman" Gervin in the 1970s and is now a classic lifestyle sneaker. The Nike Blazer Mid 77 Vintage White Black features a smooth white leather upper with grey suede mudguards and black Swooshes. A white sole and classic Nike branded woven tongue label complete the design. The Nike Blazer Mid 77 Vintage White Black released in March of 2019 and retailed for $100. DISCLAIMER: There are two different variations of tongue tags for the Nike Blazer Mid 77 Vintage White Black (BQ6806-100). The standard Bold Nike Spellout logo, as shown, as well as the Nike Heritage Script logo variations are both passable under this product page.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Slide Resin (2022/2024)
Description: The adidas Yeezy Slide Resin (2022/2024) is the result from a collaboration between American rapper Kanye West´s brand and German sport and lifestyle manufacturer adidas. The Resin Slide is crafted from injected-molded EVA foam. The one-piece build sandal features a pale green finish throughout the lightly textured exterior. Branding is displayed on a tonal adidas logo debossed on the soft footbed. Underfoot, deep horizontal ridges cut throughout the sandal outsole, resulting in an sawtooth pattern for grip. The adidas Yeezy Slide Resin (2022/2024) was first released on the 24th of September 2022, and originally had a retail price of $70.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon
Description: Kanye West and adidas keep the ball rolling with the Yeezy 350 V2 Carbon. This release marks the 12th colorway of the favorite 350 V2 model in 2020 and this colorways dark-hued upper makes it the perfect piece of footwear for fall. The Yeezy 350 V2 Carbon holds all of the familiar elements that make the silhouette so popular; breathable Primeknit solid black mesh with its signature side stripe, ribbed patterned off-white midsole, and classic BOOST cushioning make the 350 V2 Carbon easy to love and easy to wear. The Yeezy 350 V2 Carbon released in October of 2020.

Display Name: On Running Cloudtilt Black Eclipse
Description: The On Running Cloudtilt Black Eclipse is a cutting-edge performance sneaker designed for men who demand both style and functionality. Featuring On's innovative CloudTec¬Æ technology, these shoes offer exceptional cushioning and energy return with every step. The sleek black and eclipse colorway provides a versatile look that seamlessly transitions from workout sessions to casual wear. Engineered with a breathable upper and a responsive midsole, the Cloudtilt ensures optimal comfort and support during various activities. The shoe's unique design incorporates On's signature cloud elements, which compress upon impact and then spring back, propelling you forward with each stride. This innovative approach to running shoe technology results in a lightweight yet durable shoe that adapts to your individual gait and movement patterns. We at StockX believe this product is great for athletes and fitness enthusiasts looking for a high-performance shoe that doesn't compromise on style or comfort. The On Running Cloudtilt Black Eclipse is perfect for those who want to elevate their running experience while maintaining a sleek, modern aesthetic.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Triple Black
Description: The New Balance 9060 Triple Black exemplifies the essence of simplicity and versatility in a sports shoe. Constructed with a breathable mesh and soft suede upper, the Triple Black New Balance 9060 prioritizes both comfort and temperature regulation, preventing overheating. Predominantly black, the mesh upper introduces a slightly softer dark charcoal hue, creating a balanced contrast. The iconic midfoot "N" motifs seamlessly integrate with the understated sole units, contributing to a unified aesthetic. The tongue logo pays homage to the original 991 lace jewel. Underneath, the sculpted pod midsole incorporates ABZORB, ENCAP, and SBS cushioning for optimal comfort. The most noteworthy feature of the New Balance 9060 Triple Black is its sculpted pod midsole, which includes ABZORB, ENCAP, and SBS cushioning. This aspect ensures enduring comfort, establishing the shoe as an excellent choice for everyday wear. The sneaker was originally sold for $150 on September 22nd, 2023.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Black Cat (2025)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Black Cat (2025) is a revival of an iconic silhouette that exudes stealthy elegance. Wrapped in premium black nubuck, the sneaker showcases subtle accents of dark charcoal on its signature elephant print overlays. The monochromatic design is elevated by black patent leather, unique elephant print laces and minimal black and chrome branding, creating a clean yet powerful aesthetic that resonates with Jordans legendary "Black Cat" persona. This modern interpretation of the Black Cat features updated materials, making it as functional as it is stylish. The classic Jumpman logo on the tongue and heel maintains its timeless appeal, while visible Air units in the sole provide both comfort and an enduring retro vibe. This sleek design perfectly balances contemporary flair with Jordans rich heritage. Releasing on January 11, 2025, the Air Jordan 3 Retro Black Cat (2025) comes with a retail price of $200. This updated edition remains true to its roots, cementing its place as a staple for collectors and sneaker fans who value iconic design and unmatched craftsmanship.

Display Name: Nike Shox TL White Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Shox TL White Metallic Silver features an ivory and silver mesh upper with white synthetic overlays and metallic silver Swoosh silhouettes on both sides. From there, pearl white shock absorbers on the outsole and glossy silver heel strips complete the design. The Nike Shox TL White Metallic Silver released in July of 2019 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Bluetile Skateboards
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Bluetile Skateboards brings a layered and color rich approach to the SB Dunk line, combining black, marina, and court blue tones with hits of campfire orange and orange horizon that give the shoe a strong visual rhythm. The mix of colors feels intentional rather than chaotic, highlighting the paneling that defines the Dunk while adding energy tied to the Bluetile Skateboards collaboration. It keeps the classic low profile shape intact while letting the palette carry the story. This pair stands out because it reflects skate culture through color and detail rather than heavy branding. SB Dunks thrive on collaborations that feel connected to real scenes, and this release captures that through its bold but balanced execution. It is a strong option for collectors who appreciate both storytelling and standout design. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Bluetile Skateboards was released on May 12, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) (GS)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) (GS) is a relaunch of the original Jordan 4 White Cement, designed by Tinker Hatfield and released in 1989. It features a simplistic Summit White base with accents in Fire Red, Tech Gray, and black. When compared to previous Jordan 4 White Cement relaunches, this version most closely replicates the original shoes shape, albeit in a kid-friendly size. The basketball shoe showcases a chunky yet supportive all-leather build with visible Air cushioning in the heel. The iconic Tech Gray and black speckled pattern adds a heritage touch to the reinforcing TPU wings, part of the midsole, and the oversized heel tab. Our experts at StockX appreciate the bold Jordan branding on the tongue, including the Fire Red Jumpman logo and Michael Jordans signature in fine, black lettering. The grade school-sized Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) (GS) was released on May 24, 2025, and sold for $160.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Preloved Red Leopard (Women's)
Description: Take on a unique look with the adidas Samba OG Preloved Red Leopard (Women's). The sneaker gives you a second-life design with a striking pattern. Expect a distinct, worn-in appearance with contrasting colors and a cool design. The Preloved Red Leopard Samba OG by adidas combines a leather upper with a variation of orange accents. Reddish orange leopard print overlays take up most of the space, with white 3 Stripes, laces, and a heel to add contrast and make the print stand out more. The shoe retains the classic Samba design, including the reinforced T-toe. The outsole uses gum rubber for grip. The design's history originates from indoor football shoes of the mid-20th century. As the StockX experts, something we love about the adidas Samba OG Preloved Red Leopard (Women's) is the natural variation in the texture; each pair has a unique appearance. The slightly worn gum sole adds to the vintage appearance. The shoe retailed at $110 when it was released on the 29th of January, 2025.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Bright Mandarin (2025)
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Bright Mandarin (2025) revives a beloved silhouette with bold, modern energy. Dressed in a striking Black/Bright Mandarin palette, this pair layers breathable mesh with sculpted synthetic and suede panels to deliver the AM95s signature gradient look. Subtle Swoosh branding, speed-lacing eyelets, and reflective hits keep the heritage DNA intact, while the vibrant Mandarin accents light up the lines of the upper for head-turning contrast. Underfoot, the upgraded "Big Bubble" visible Air cushioning anchors heel-to-toe comfort, blending plush step-in feel with the responsive ride that made the 95 a street icon. Style code HM4740-005 ensures this standout colorway is as collectible as it is wearable. Engineered for all-day versatility, the Air Max 95 OG pairs a supportive, ergonomic fit with a durable rubber outsole that grips city streets and daily commutes alike. A soft foam midsole works in tandem with the enlarged Air units for cushioning you can see and feel, while the layered construction nods to the models anatomical inspiration for a secure, foot-hugging hold. Finished with crisp detailing and a sleek profile, the Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Bright Mandarin (2025) slots seamlessly into rotation as a statement lifestyle sneaker and a nod to classic runner heritage. Whether styled with athletic fits or elevated streetwear, it adds a punch of color and timeless attitude to every step. Our team loves this product because it delivers the iconic Air Max 95 look with amplified cushioning, standout Bright Mandarin highlights, and dependable everyday comfort that makes it a go-to in any sneaker lineup.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro OG Flight Club
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro OG Flight Club was one of the most anticipated kicks of early 2026, celebrating an early chapter of MJ fandom with a fresh take on a classic silhouette. Dressed in sail, black, and university red, this retro captures a crisp yet bold look that marries clean neutrals with eye-catching pops of color. The sail leather upper sets a natural base, while a black heel tab and wing eyelets give the sneaker structure and contrast that elevates even the simplest outfit. University red accents on the Jumpman logo bring that classic Jordan color energy to the mix. This release channels the spirit of the original Air Jordan Flight Club, the fan membership program from the late 1980s and early 1990s that connected Jordan enthusiasts through newsletters, posters, and exclusive gear. That sense of community and shared passion is woven into this release, with Flight Club logos on the tongue and sockliner tapping into a deeper fan culture that goes beyond just the aesthetic. Its a sneaker that nods to history while feeling right at home in todays sneaker scene. When the Air Jordan 4 Retro OG Flight Club released, it retailed for $220 and dropped on January 17, 2026. With its refined palette, deep collector roots, and throwback Nike Air branding, its a standout addition to any rotation that values authentic story and timeless style.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Flax
Description: The adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Flax was released as part of a collaboration between American musician Ye, formerly known as Kanye West, and the sneaker brand. This Stone Flat model dresses the futuristic silhouette in a neutral monochrome finish in stone flax. The dual-layer Primeknit upper features a stretchy sock-like cuff with traditional lace closure. Structural support is provided by tapered polyurethane "fingers" that extend up the sides in an abstract pattern throughout the sneaker. The lightweight PU midsole is reinforced underfoot by a wavy-traction rubber outsole. The adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Flax was originally released on October 22nd, 2022, at a retail price of $210.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Mono Cinder
Description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Mono Cinder arrives with a Cinder lightweight mesh upper with a tonal side stripe and perforations exposing an interior skeletal frame. A Cinder Boost sole and heel loop completes its monochromatic look. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Mono Cinder released in June of 2021 and retailed for $220.

Display Name: Nike Total 90 Mule Kids of Immigrants Khaki
Description: The Nike Total 90 Mule Kids of Immigrants Khaki is a May 28, 2026 release from the Kids of Immigrants x Nike collaboration, retailing at $120 with style code IH4422-200 in the Khaki/University Gold/Fusion Red/Orange Horizon/Light Mulberry/Classic Olive colorway, confirmed by Nice Kicks, Sneaker Bar Detroit, Sole Retriever, and Sneaker News. As confirmed by Sneaker Bar Detroit and Sole Retriever, the collaboration completely transforms the iconic Nike Total 90 low-top soccer boot into a lifestyle mule by removing the heel, converting the 2000s pitch silhouette into a premium slip-on designed for the streets ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
