Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Next Nature White Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Next Nature White Black (Women's) recreates a '90s running shoe aesthetic using sustainable materials and decades of sneaker technology. This sports shoe is specifically sized for women. The Women's Next Nature Nike Air Max 90 in a White Black colorway features an upper of breathable white textile overlaid with white synthetic leather. The color white dominates the upper, from the laces and the tongue to the sock liner and the insole. A black side-panel Nike swoosh matches the hits of branding throughout the upper. Black Nike Air branding appears on the TPU heel, Air Max branding on the TPU side-panel window, Nike branding on the tongue tag, and Next Nature pinwheel branding on the insole. The feature we appreciate most about this shoe is its high-performance sole unit. The foam and TPU midsole houses visible Air units under the heel for maximum cushioning and energy return. The white rubber outsole features a waffle pattern that provides impact absorption and traction. The Nike Air Max 90 Next Nature White Black (Women's) was released on January 14, 2022, for $120.

Model: Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG
Display Name: Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite Patta Chrome White Black
Description: The Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Patta Waves Black brings together elite level football performance and Pattas signature wave design language in a release that feels both technical and expressive. The Chrome, Black, and White palette gives the boot a sleek and reflective look, while the Patta Waves detailing adds movement across the upper, creating a visual rhythm that stands out on the pitch. The Mercurial line has always been built for speed, and this version continues that legacy with a streamlined silhouette and lightweight construction. Fans gravitate toward Patta collaborations because they consistently introduce subtle but impactful design elements that shift the identity of familiar Nike models. The wave pattern adds depth without compromising the performance focus of the boot, making it feel unique without being overly decorative. Elite level Mercurials remain a favorite among players who prioritize acceleration and control. For collectors, pairs like this represent the intersection of football culture and streetwear design, where performance gear becomes part of a broader creative conversation. The Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Patta Waves Black was released on May 5, 2026 with a retail price of $320.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Embossed Black Sail (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Embossed Black Sail Womens elevates the silhouette through texture, using embossed detailing to create depth across the upper. The black base contrasts with sail accents, while metallic gold elements add a subtle touch of shine. The overall look feels more refined without losing the Dunks everyday appeal. This version stands out because it focuses on material rather than color. The embossed finish adds a layer of complexity that rewards closer inspection, making it feel more premium while still remaining versatile. Fans who appreciate texture driven design will find this pair especially compelling. The Nike Dunk Low Embossed Black Sail Womens was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Pink Rise Sail (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Pink Rise Sail Womens softens the Dunk Low with a gentle and modern color story that feels light and approachable. Pink rise accents sit against a sail base, creating a clean and airy look that highlights the silhouettes classic lines. The Next Nature execution reinforces Nikes push toward more mindful design while keeping the familiar Dunk identity intact. Fans love this pair because it feels easy and optimistic. The color palette brings warmth without overpowering the shoe, making it a natural fit for everyday rotation. Collectors appreciate how the Dunk Low continues to evolve through subtle shifts in tone and purpose, offering a sneaker that feels current while still rooted in one of Nikes most enduring silhouettes. It is a calm and wearable take that resonates through simplicity rather than statement. The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Pink Rise Sail Womens was released on April 4, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1000.2 Black Hyper Crimson
Description: The Nike Air Max 1000.2 in Black Hyper Crimson is a fully 3D-printed sneaker produced in partnership with Zellerfeld, the Hamburg-based 3D printing specialist, as the second colorway in the Air Max 1000.2's May 2026 rollout, building on the all-black Air Max 1000.2 released earlier that month by adding a Hyper Crimson Air Max unit in the heel that introduces a bold pop of saturated red against the triple-black one-piece printed upper. The Air Max 1000.2 is an evolved iteration of the original 3D-printed Air Max 1000, with the .2 designation marking refined outsole shaping and a more efficient lug system that improves production speed, continuing Nike's software-update approach to iterating the printed silhouette across successive releases without a formal model redesign. The entire upper, midsole structure, and outsole are produced as a single piece through Zellerfeld's additive printing process, with brand marks either inset into or protruding from the printed pattern, and the design's structural geometry referencing the original 1987 Air Max 1 in profile while translating that silhouette into the vocabulary of 3D printing's organic, latticed, and continuously variable construction possibilities. Distribution followed Zellerfeld's raffle model with the EQL raffle opening May 25, 2026 and closing May 28. Released May 25, 2026 at $200 retail through Zellerfeld's raffle platform in unisex sizing. The Nike Air Max 10002 Black Hyper Crimson was released on May 25, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Book 2 Rising
Description: The Nike Book 2 Rising signals the next chapter in Devin Bookers signature line with a colorway that feels energetic and forward looking. Rising uses bold contrast and layered tones to reflect momentum, growth, and ambition, giving the Book 2 silhouette a more expressive edge. The darker base allows the brighter accents to pop, creating a look that feels competitive and confident without becoming chaotic. Collectors gravitate toward this release because it represents progression. The Book 2 builds on what fans liked about the first model while pushing design and attitude further. The Rising theme feels symbolic of Bookers continued evolution as a player, making the sneaker resonate beyond performance alone. Fans appreciate how it balances statement and control, offering a signature shoe that feels modern, assertive, and ready for what comes next. The Nike Book 2 Rising was released on January 2, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Malachite White
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Malachite White brings a crisp and minimal look to the silhouette, using a clean white base accented by malachite green details. Collectors appreciate how the model continues to evolve through small updates that keep it relevant. It is a versatile option that maintains the legacy of the Air Force 1 while introducing a touch of color that adds personality. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Malachite White was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $115.

Model: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP
Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP Black Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP Black Metallic Silver leans into sleek contrast with a sharp black and silver combination. Black dominates the upper, giving the silhouette a stealth driven foundation, while Metallic Silver accents add reflective edge and depth. The streamlined build highlights the premium detailing, and the responsive cushioning underfoot maintains the trusted Pegasus performance feel. It is clean, modern, and purposeful. Fans of darker palettes will appreciate how the silver detailing elevates the monochrome base. The contrast feels refined rather than loud, making it easy to integrate into both training and lifestyle rotation. It captures the balance between technical innovation and street ready style. Confident and polished, this pair keeps the Pegasus legacy moving forward. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP Black Metallic Silver was released on December 18, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Cream Caramel
Description: High-fashion kicks dont come cooler than the Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Cream Caramel. The Japanese fashion brand offers a comfortable lifestyle shoe ready to elevate your footwear wardrobe. Perfect for all seasons, the lace enclosure has cream-colored laces with branding on the tongue. Simple, classic, and elegant while still paying homage to the sports legacy that Onitsuka Tiger honors. We love how this heritage brand has created a low-profile shoe that is contemporary and functional, all in one. Wear them casually or to give an edge to a smart outfit. The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Cream Caramel was released on 26 January 2022, priced at $70.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 SE Light Orewood Brown
Description: The Nike P-6000 SE Light Orewood Brown dresses the P-6000s mixed material upper and foam midsole in an off-white colorway of Light Orewood Brown with a splash of black on the rubber outsole. Inspired by early 2000s running sneakers, this version of the P-6000 combines elements from various Pegasus models, including the Pegasus 25. The neutral colorway contrasts the shoes tech-forward design, such as the lifted midsole and the layered overlays across the breathable mesh upper. Crafted from synthetic leather, the overlays add a web-like support system to the upper without reducing flexibility. Texturized suede appears on the heel and toecap, adding another mixed-material layer, while the tongue's logo tag is made from smooth leather. Our experts appreciate that the sneaker is part of the Bowerman Series, a collection of running shoes honoring Nikes legendary co-founder Bill Bowerman. The Nike P-6000 SE Light Orewood Brown was released on December 20, 2024, and retailed for $120.
Material: Leather, Suede, Mesh, Synthetic, Rubber, Foam

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 SP Patta Waves Sapphire
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 SP Patta Waves Sapphire channels the energy of Amsterdams Patta with a striking undulating mudguard that turns the iconic Air Max 90 into a statement piece. Dressed in Particle Grey and Neutral Grey with bold Sapphire accents, this pair balances everyday versatility with head-turning color pops, finished by Black, Coconut Milk, and White hits for a layered, modern look. Plush padding around the collar, breathable mesh underlays, and textured leather and synthetic overlays deliver structure and comfort, while the signature visible Air unit cushions every step. Style code HF8814-002 and a June 24, 2025 release date cement this edition as a standout entry in the Air Max lineage. Details matter here: the classic Waffle outsole offers dependable traction, the sculpted midsole provides lasting support, and the Patta "Waves" motif adds motion and attitude from every angle. Our team loves this product because it delivers all-day Air comfort with standout design cues that elevate any rotation.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Phantom Safety Orange
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Phantom Safety Orange pairs soft neutrals with striking contrast for a dynamic finish. Safety Orange accents inject bold energy, lighting up the silhouette with unmistakable intensity. The Tuned Air cushioning underfoot maintains the models signature bounce and presence. The Nike Air Max Plus Phantom Safety Orange was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Reverse Panda
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Reverse Panda features the Nike Swoosh logo in black on the tongue and also on the heel padding behind the ankle. The Nike Dunk Low Reverse Panda has a clean white color throughout, including the sole, with contrasting touches of black. The shoe also features a lace-up closure style with black laces. The Nike Swoosh is found on both sides, also in black, and these meet behind the ankle and below the white heel padding. The Nike Dunk Low Reverse Panda first debuted in Asia in June, 2022, and then in the UK and Europe in July of 2022 at a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 SB Cacao Wow
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 SB Cacao Wow blends skate influence with one of Nikes most recognizable running silhouettes. Black and anthracite tones create a dark and grounded base, while cacao wow introduces warmth and contrast across the layered upper. Light graphite, light charcoal, and pearl grey details add depth, giving the shoe a rugged and textured feel that suits its crossover identity. Fans appreciate how the SB treatment adds toughness and edge while keeping the design authentic. Collectors see it as a natural evolution, blending performance heritage with skate culture sensibility. It feels purposeful and durable, designed for those who value versatility and attitude in equal measure. The Nike Air Max 95 SB Cacao Wow was released on January 20, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Safari Mix (Women's)
Description: The women's Nike Dunk Low Safari Mix (W) explores exotic patterns and textures with its one-of-a-kind construction. Atop a white leather base, the upper features vibrant overlays constructed of leopard-pattern Durabuck, safari print, faux-horsehair, suede, and smooth leather. Vintage-style Nike woven tongue labels add the finishing touch. The women's Nike Dunk Low Safari Mix (W) released in March of 2022 and retailed for $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Year of the Horse
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Year of the Horse in Pencil Point, Sail, Phantom, and Anthracite is a Lunar New Year tribute that finds a genuinely poetic and thematically perfect connection between the celebration being honored and the shoe carrying it, the Pegasus silhouette's namesake winged horse mythology creating an immediate and natural bridge to the Year of the Horse's cultural significance in a way that most Lunar New Year sneaker tributes cannot claim through their respective silhouettes. Pencil point and sail create a warm off-white and slightly sketched visual character that references the artistic and calligraphic traditions associated with Lunar New Year celebrations, while phantom and anthracite provide the structural depth and tonal grounding that keeps the palette from becoming too light or washed out across the Pegasus Premium's substantial upper construction. The Premium specification ensures this culturally significant release delivers the most complete Pegasus experience available, honoring the Year of the Horse with the highest quality version of the mythologically appropriate silhouette. Nike's Lunar New Year releases have developed a devoted and multigenerational collector following among Chinese communities and sneaker enthusiasts globally, and the Year of the Horse iteration of the Pegasus Premium carries an additional layer of meaning because the thematic alignment between the winged horse silhouette and the equine zodiac year being celebrated creates a collector piece that will hold its cultural and narrative significance across every subsequent Year of the Horse cycle for anyone who understands the connection. Pencil point as the dominant tone gives the shoe a slightly muted and artisanal quality that suits the celebration context with more subtlety and consideration than the bright red and gold palette that less nuanced Lunar New Year releases typically default to. At two hundred and twenty dollars this Year of the Horse Pegasus Premium represents a premium investment in a culturally specific and thematically resonant Nike release. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Year of the Horse in Pencil Point, Sail, Phantom, and Anthracite has a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Stash (2024)
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Stash (2024) is a striking collaboration that brings together the iconic silhouette of the Air Max 95 with the artistic vision of graffiti legend Stash. This men's sneaker features a captivating Obsidian, Black, and Harbor Blue colorway that pays homage to Stash's signature palette. The upper showcases a gradient effect, reminiscent of the original Air Max 95 design, while incorporating unique textures and materials that reflect Stash's urban-inspired aesthetic. Functionality meets style in this reimagined classic. The shoe retains the Air Max 95's renowned comfort with its visible Air units in the heel and forefoot, providing responsive cushioning for all-day wear. Premium materials adorn the upper, including durable synthetics and plush textiles, ensuring both longevity and a luxurious feel. The distinctive lacing system and subtle branding elements add to the shoe's appeal, making it a standout piece for sneaker enthusiasts and collectors alike. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a perfect blend of street-style edge and athletic performance, offering a unique twist on a beloved Nike silhouette.

Display Name: Nike Air Rift Fir Metallic Gold (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Rift Fir Metallic Gold Womens brings one of Nikes most unconventional silhouettes back into focus with a colorway that highlights its split toe design and minimalist structure. Display Name: Nike Shox TL Hyper Royal

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Ashen Slate
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Ashen Slate made waves by finally incorporating Nike's ZoomX technology into a basketball shoe. The colorway is a stylish combination of Slate gray with an aquamarine sole and a white Swoosh. Our reviewers love that there's now a basketball shoe with Nike Zoom foam. They raved about the improved comfort and impact absorption. Of course, being the first of its kind from such an iconic sports manufacturer makes it highly collectible, too. Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Ashen Slate was released on July 1, 2024, for $190.

Display Name: Nike Shox TL White Metallic Silver Max Orange (Women's)
Description: The Nike Shox TL White Metallic Silver Max Orange (Women's) is a revival of the iconic 2003 Nike Shox TL. Like the original, the Nike Shox TL White Metallic Silver for women features a white nylon-base upper, detailed with glossy taped overlays, TPU strips that provide lightweight support, a mesh-lined tongue with a Nike Shox logo in Max Orange, a notched collar, Nike Swooshes in metallic silver on the sides, and another Max Orange Nike Shox logo on the heel. All the logos are embroidered. Its upper sits atop a dozen Shox columns which offer the shoe a distinctive look and a carbon rubber outsole. We all agree that the most attractive feature of the Nike Shox TL White Metallic Silver Max Orange (Women's), released on the 1st of May, 2019, at a retail price of $170, is the Shox columns. These columns cushion every stride and add the bounce-back effect needed on walks and long runs. The Nike Shox TL White Metallic Silver Max Orange (Women's) also re-released in 2023 and 2024.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Black White Swoosh

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Black Grey

Black elements ground the palette, sharpening contrast and allowing the dynamic lines of the Dn8 silhouette to stand out with clarity and movement. Fans connect with this release because it feels bold and forward facing. The Dn8 represents Nike pushing Air Max design into a new visual language, and this colorway amplifies that mission. Collectors who enjoy expressive sneakers are drawn to its confidence and intensity, seeing it as a statement piece rather than a neutral staple. It captures momentum and attitude, making it a standout for those who want their footwear to feel futuristic and fearless. The Nike Air Max Dn8 Hyper Pink Black Womens was released on March 26, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe (GS)
Description: The grade school Air Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe GS mimics the color scheme of its predecessor, the Air Jordan 1 Bred Toe. It features amazing details like a puffy black nylon tongue, a large Air Jordan Wings logo embroidered on the heel, and a white Jumpman logo. Additionally, it features an enhanced red outsole and a cushioned white midsole. The grade school Air Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe GS was released on 8th December 2021. It retailed at $75.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Hyperflight Unseen Hours DMV
Description: The Nike x NOCTA Yasuke Tee Black is a Spring Summer 2026 release from Drake's NOCTA x Nike Cardinal Stock program, retailing at $50 in the Black colorway, confirmed by StockX as an SS26 release. As confirmed by the official Nike.com NOCTA tee product description and eBay seller product overviews, the NOCTA Yasuke Tee features heavyweight 100 percent cotton construction with a stiff drape and structured feel, a signature NOCTA loose fit that is roomy through the body, a 100 percent cotton ribbed neckband, and high-density print Nike Swoosh and NOCTA branding. The Yasuke Tee name references Yasuke, the historically significant 16th-century African man who came to Japan in 1579 as a servant of the Jesuit missionary Alessandro Valignano and went on to serve the powerful feudal lord Oda Nobunaga, becoming one of the most celebrated and culturally resonant historical figures connecting African and Japanese heritage. NOCTA, Drake's Nike sub-label named from his nocturnal creative process, has built a consistent heavyweight cotton tee program across its Cardinal Stock seasonal collections, with each release combining premium cotton construction with culturally layered NOCTA branding and historically referential graphic themes. The Black colorway applies the all-over black tone to the heavyweight cotton base for the most broadly wearable execution of the NOCTA Yasuke Tee. Retail price $50. The Nike x NOCTA Yasuke Tee Black is the SS26 heavyweight-100-percent-cotton loose-fit ribbed-neckband HD-print-branding Yasuke-historical-reference NOCTA Cardinal Stock tee for the Nike and NOCTA collector who wants the culturally resonant Yasuke-named black heavyweight cotton execution from the Nike x NOCTA Cardinal Stock SS26 tee program. The Nike x NOCTA Yasuke Tee Black has a retail price of $50.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Better Scarlet
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Better Scarlet reimagines the classic Gazelle silhouette with a bold colorway of Better Scarlet with accents in Cloud White that give the sneaker a vintage, varsity athletics look. The use of suede on the upper provides depth of color and richness to the Better Scarlet, while the white leather 3-Stripes logo and heel tab give the Better Scarlet adidas Gazelle Indoor a timeless feel. The cotton laces, the trefoil on the heel, and the texturized tongue come in Better Scarlet, while the adidas branding on the tongue boasts Cloud White. The semi-transparent gum rubber outsole bears adidas branding beneath the heel and provides traction on a variety of surfaces. Our experts at StockX like the way this sneaker blends heritage and modern elements to create a retro-inspired shoe with a contemporary twist. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Better Scarlet was released on May 30, 2024, and retailed at $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '86 Jacquemus White (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 '86 Jacquemus White (Women's) is a collaboration between the sports brand and French high fashion house, Jacquemus. These trainers are conspicuous for their clean lines and top-quality materials. This model is built on the famous Nike Air Max technology, which it shares with many other sought-after trainers like the Nike Air Max Plus Triple Black. This provides high levels of cushioned support, making these shoes ideal for every-day, all-day wear. The French designer touch comes through in plush leather materials. We really appreciate the blend of sporty style with designer fashion. Details like a suede mudguard placed just above the sole give these trainers a premium look and feel. The minimalist design is another hallmark, with a classic silhouette that has never gone out of style. Perforated uppers allow for free airflow, adding superior breathability. The Nike Air Max 1 '86 Jacquemus White (Women's) was released on 23 July 2024, at a price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Varsity Maize Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Varsity Maize Black injects bold color into a heritage runner. Featuring Varsity Maize with Black and Metallic Silver accents, the upper emphasizes the layered gradient that made the 95 iconic. The Big Bubble Air units add retro authenticity and visual impact underfoot. The bright maize tone commands attention, contrasting sharply against the black foundation. This execution feels energetic and expressive while staying faithful to the original silhouette. It captures the daring spirit of mid nineties Nike design, refreshed for a new generation of collectors. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Varsity Maize Black was released on October 27, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: New Balance 1000 Black Silver Metallic
Description: The New Balance 1000 Black Silver Metallic revives a bold archive runner with a futuristic edge that feels perfectly suited for modern lifestyle wear. The aggressive shape and layered construction reflect early performance experimentation, while the black and silver metallic palette sharpens the silhouette with a sleek and technical finish. It feels powerful and intentional, designed to stand out through structure rather than color overload. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because the New Balance 1000 represents fearless design from the brands past. The metallic accents highlight the shoes sculptural form, making it feel both retro and forward looking at the same time. Fans appreciate how it blends comfort, presence, and heritage, offering a sneaker that feels substantial and expressive while still rooted in New Balances reputation for quality and wearability. The New Balance 1000 Black Silver Metallic was released on May 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas AE 2 Blue Fusion
Description: The adidas AE 2 Blue Fusion builds on the foundation of Anthony Edwards signature line while pushing the design forward with sharper lines and bolder contrast. Blue fusion anchors the look, giving the shoe a cool and confident tone, while zero metallic and lime burst details add energy without overwhelming the silhouette. The overall shape feels streamlined and intentional, signaling progression rather than repetition. This model matters to fans because it represents growth, both for the athlete and the series itself. The AE 2 feels more refined while still carrying the fearless edge that made the first model resonate. Collectors appreciate how adidas continues to evolve the story through color and form rather than safe updates. It feels like a shoe tied to momentum, built for a player and a fanbase that expect constant forward motion. The adidas AE 2 Blue Fusion was released on October 25, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Killshot 2 LTR PRM Tiempo Pack Black
Description: The Nike Killshot 2 LTR PRM Tiempo Pack Black updates the Killshot 2 with premium materials and a soccer-inspired design. Although the original Killshot from 1979 was created for the tennis court, the Tiempo Pack Black Nike Killshot 2 LTR PRM includes a fold-over "tongue," mimicking 1980s soccer cleats. Although it looks like a tongue, this piece of black leather is actually a removable attachment. The upper is crafted from smooth, black leather with exposed stitching in clean white. The stitching highlights the mudguard, the Swoosh logos, the eyelets, the heel counter, and the collar. Branding details grace the fold-over "tongue," the functional tongue, and the smooth heel tab. Our experts at StockX like that the grippy rubber outsole comes in Baroque Brown. This hue complements the black upper and gives the sneaker an earthy finish. The Nike Killshot 2 LTR PRM Tiempo Pack Black was released on September 18, 2024, and sold for $90.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Cargo Khaki
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Cargo Khaki honors a basketball legend through a muted and thoughtful execution. Dressed entirely in Cargo Khaki, the monochromatic upper gives the classic Air Force 1 a grounded and reflective tone. The familiar shape remains intact, preserving the heritage basketball DNA that has defined the model for decades. Kobe Bryant tributes often carry emotional weight, and using a restrained Cargo Khaki palette gives this pair a respectful and timeless feel. The Air Force 1 silhouette adds another layer of legacy, bridging basketball history with streetwear influence. For fans of Kobe and Nike Basketball, this release feels less like a trend driven drop and more like a meaningful nod to an enduring icon. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Cargo Khaki was released on December 2, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 20 Miami Heat
Description: The Nike Lebron 20 Miami Heat, available in different hues - including black, university red, university gold, and light smoke gray - is one of the collaborative designs between this iconic American brand and the NBA champion from Akron. The upper section of the Lebron 20 model is made of black woven textile with a double Swoosh on its right side. The sneaker has an elongated tongue beneath the laces made from cotton. Its midsole and outsole, which are both made from rubber, appears in the black and red colors. The Nike Lebron 20 Miami Heat was first released on October 24th, 2022 with $200 as the retail price.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Mid TD Cleat Patent Black
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Mid TD Cleat Patent Black brings one of the most iconic basketball silhouettes onto the field with a performance ready cleated outsole. Dressed in Black patent leather with White and Anthracite accents, the upper preserves the glossy finish that defines the AJ11 legacy. The mid cut structure maintains the sleek lines that made the original a cultural phenomenon. This release stands out because it merges hardwood heritage with gridiron functionality. The patent leather shine delivers unmistakable presence, while the cleat configuration adapts the silhouette for competitive play. Fans appreciate when Jordan Brand translates classics into new arenas without sacrificing identity. It is a bold crossover piece that carries championship energy from court to turf. The Air Jordan 11 Mid TD Cleat Patent Black was released on January 11, 2026 with a retail price of $225.

Display Name: adidas Samba LX Freizeit Song For The Mute Black Off White
Description: The adidas Samba LX Freizeit Song For The Mute Black Off White transforms one of adidas most recognizable silhouettes through the experimental and deeply textured design language that has defined Song for the Mute collaborations. Rather than dramatically changing the Samba shape, the collaboration focuses on material choice, layering, and subtle reinterpretation to create something that feels artisanal and emotionally driven. The combination of Core Black and Off White gives the shoe a worn in and almost archival aesthetic, while the Freizeit concept adds a slower and more relaxed personality compared to traditional football rooted Samba releases. Fans of Song for the Mute appreciate how the label approaches adidas classics with restraint and atmosphere instead of loud branding or exaggerated redesigns. The Samba already carries decades of history through football culture, terrace fashion, and modern streetwear, and this collaboration adds a more introspective and fashion focused edge to that legacy. Collectors are especially drawn to the layered textures and understated palette because the shoe feels crafted rather than mass produced. The darker tones and muted contrast give the pair a quiet confidence that stands apart from brighter contemporary Samba releases dominating sneaker culture today. The adidas Samba LX Freizeit Song For The Mute Black Off White was released on May 15, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Shadow Grey Castlerock
Description: The New Balance 9060 Shadow Grey Castlerock adds a gray-on-gray colorway to the technical 9060 lineup. A mix of gray tones, including Castlerock and Shadow Grey, cover the upper and extend over the midsole. Featuring a chunky silhouette and visible tech, the Shadow Grey Castlerock New Balance 9060 combines retro Y2K and futuristic aesthetics. The upper is crafted from lightweight yet durable mesh with supportive suede overlays. These overlays overlap, creating a layered look and a feeling of movement. Drawing inspiration from early 2000s running sneakers, the sculpted midsole pods house Abzorb and SBS cushioning. The diamond outsole pattern provides superior traction and gives a nod to the 860 silhouette. Our StockX experts appreciate the inclusion of design elements from the 991, including the 9060 tongue logo. It pays homage to the 991s shiny lace jewel. The New Balance 9060 Shadow Grey Castlerock was released on October 11, 2024, and sold for $150.

Display Name: adidas Japan Mid Yellow Black (Women's)
Description: The adidas Japan Mid Yellow Black Womens injects bold contrast into the slim Japan silhouette with a striking Yellow upper balanced by Core Black accents. Gold Metallic branding adds a refined touch, elevating the vibrant palette with a subtle flash that feels intentional. The mid cut structure gives the model a slightly more commanding presence while preserving the streamlined lines that define the Japan series. This release stands out because it commits to color. The bright yellow base demands attention, yet the black detailing keeps the look grounded and structured. Fans who appreciate heritage silhouettes with expressive palettes gravitate toward pairs like this for their ability to blend vintage inspiration with modern energy. It feels playful yet composed, offering a confident twist on a traditionally minimal design. The adidas Japan Mid Yellow Black Womens was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Mono Cortado
Description: The New Balance 9060 Mono Cortado embraces tonal depth, wrapping the sculpted silhouette in a cohesive Mono Cortado shade that feels rich and grounded. The layered upper blends mesh and suede seamlessly, allowing subtle texture differences to shine through the single color execution. The bold midsole design keeps the shoe futuristic while the monochrome palette refines its presence. Mono treatments often highlight the architecture of a sneaker, and the 9060 benefits from that focus. Without heavy contrast, the flowing lines and chunky sole unit become the centerpiece. Fans who appreciate understated but distinctive footwear will find this pair especially appealing for its balance of modern design and versatile color. The New Balance 9060 Mono Cortado was released on January 7, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Action Bronson Rosewater
Description: The New Balance 1906R Action Bronson Rosewater is part of a collaboration between New Balance and American rapper Action Bronson that reworks the well-known 1906R silhouette. This Action Bronson Rosewater New Balance 1906R stands out because of its vibrant colorway, which features splashes of fuchsia and orange across a light green base. In addition, blue details can be found on the rubber outsole, the New Balance "N," and the "new balance 1906" lettering on the tongue. The upper is crafted from durable mesh with supportive TPU overlays and reflective detailing. The rubber outsole features a segmented design with blue, orange, light orange, and brown sections. Finally, thin, green laces wind through the eyelets, providing the last color-blocking detail. Our StockX experts like the sneakers dual branding, including "Baklava" and "New Balance 1906." The New Balance 1906R Action Bronson Rosewater was released on May 31, 2024, and retailed at $185.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 450 Sulfur
Description: The adidas Yeezy 450 Sulfur features a monotone Sulfur sock-like Primeknit upper with a cinched collar and thick rope laces that appear to be braided into the forefoot. At the base, a sculptural sole that grips the upper provides structure and support. The adidas Yeezy 450 Sulfur released in May of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Nike Free Run 5.0 Black White (2021)
Description: The Nike Free Run 5.0 Black White (2021) updates a beloved silhouette with foam that is lighter than previous versions. This sneaker is renowned for its sock-like comfort paired with underfoot durability. The Black and White Nike Free Run 5.0 from 2021 features a black upper constructed of breathable knit designed to stretch as you run. Fly wires extend from the laces down the side panel to lend structure and keep your foot securely over the footbed. A black heel tab facilitates on/off, and black insoles sport Nike Free branding along with the pinwheel Nike swoosh logo. A white Nike swoosh adorns the lateral side panel, while a reflective Nike swoosh graces the medial toebox. This lightweight upper rests on a white foam midsole with laser-cut grooves for flexibility. Gray rubber pods at the forefoot and heel give this shoe durable traction with every step. An aspect of this shoe that we particularly appreciate is the environmentally conscientious effort that went into its creation. This Nike Free is constructed of a minimum of 20% recycled material. The Nike Free Run 5.0 Black White (2021) was released on June 13, 2021, for $100 retail.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG White Silver Metallic Grey (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG White Silver Metallic Grey (Women's) puts a shimmering spin on the classic low-top silhouette, blending vintage football roots with modern streetwear energy in a clean white, gray, and metallic-silver palette. This womens sizing gives the iconic adidas Samba OG design a fresh, elevated feel. The upper features crisp white leather contrasted by a soft gray suede t-toe and matching padded heel counter. Metallic-silver 3-Stripes bring shine to the side panels, echoed by SAMBA branding on the lateral side and a silver adidas logo on the tongue. White, flat laces and a gum rubber outsole ground the design with a timeless finish. What we love most about the Samba OG White Silver Metallic Grey is how the metallic touches add just the right amount of flash, making this everyday womens sneaker pop without straying from the silhouettes heritage style. Released on December 17, 2024, this shoe had a $100 retail price.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Disney Pixar's Toy Story Woody
Description: The Adidas Samba OG Disney Pixar's Toy Story Woody in Blue, Tan, and Yellow is a collaborative release that brings the most iconic and beloved character in Pixar's history into the Samba's legendary archive silhouette through a colorway that translates Woody's instantly recognizable cowboy outfit into sneaker form with genuine design intelligence and character faithfulness that goes far beyond simple logo application. Blue draws from the denim of Woody's jeans that have become as iconic and recognizable as the character's face across the thirty years since Toy Story first transformed animated filmmaking and popular culture in 1995, tan references the warm and earthy tones of his cowboy vest and hat that give the character his western American identity, and yellow introduces the bright and optimistic color associated with Woody's star badge and the spirit of adventure and loyalty that defines his entire character arc across the franchise's four films and countless additional appearances. The Samba OG's T-toe overlay, side stripe, and gum sole construction provide the ideal architectural canvas for this three color character tribute, each element of the silhouette's design working naturally with one of the Woody color references to create a shoe that is both a great Samba and a great Woody tribute simultaneously. Woody occupies an entirely unique position in the Pixar and Disney character universe because he is not just a beloved animated figure but a cultural archetype who has shaped how an entire generation understands friendship, loyalty, purpose, and the passage of time, making him one of the most emotionally resonant and universally meaningful characters that any sneaker collaboration has ever attempted to honor. The Samba OG as the vehicle for a Woody tribute is a particularly inspired choice because both the shoe and the character carry a vintage and nostalgic quality rooted in the American mid-twentieth century that makes their meeting feel thematically coherent rather than simply commercially convenient, the Samba's European football and terrace heritage sharing with Woody's cowboy aesthetic a sense of beloved old world charm that modern culture keeps returning to because it offers something genuine and warm that more contemporary references cannot replicate. For Toy Story devotees and Samba collectors who want a collaborative release that genuinely honors its subject through considered color and design choices, the Woody Samba OG is an essential and joyful acquisition. The Adidas Samba OG Disney Pixar's Toy Story Woody was released on June 6, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Sail All-Star
Description: The Nike Kobe 6 Protro Sail All-Star brings a fresh twist to an iconic silhouette. This edition stands out with its sail-dominated upper, offset by a striking black Swoosh and subtle platinum violet accents. Unlike previous versions of the Kobe 6, this release introduces a bold new starry pattern on the upper, replacing the signature snakeskin texture on the medial sides of the upper. This design choice not only elevates the shoes visual appeal but also nods to Kobe Bryants star power and celebrates the 2025 NBA all star weekend, making it a must-have for collectors and hoopers alike. Further refining its look, the sneaker features light bone tones across the midsole and heel, creating a balanced contrast with the white outsole. The platinum violet lining adds a unique pop of color without overpowering the shoes clean aesthetic. Performance-wise, the Kobe 6 Protro maintains its low-cut profile and responsive cushioning, ensuring optimal comfort on and off the court. Whether styled casually or laced up for a game, this pair seamlessly merges function with fashion. Released on February 13, 2025, the Nike Kobe 6 Protro Sail All-Star hit shelves at a retail price of $190, quickly becoming a sought-after addition to the Kobe lineup. Its refined blend of sail, black, light bone, white, and platinum violet gives it a timeless appeal, while the innovative design elements make it a standout among past iterations.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Sand
Description: DISCLAIMER: US and UK sizing is the same and does not require any conversion. The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Sand arrives in a Sand monochromatic color scheme. Its one-piece sculpted upper with oval cut-outs provide a futuristic aesthetic to complete the design. The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Sand released in May of 2021 and retailed for $75.

Display Name: Salomon S/Lab XT-6 Adv Triple Black
Description: The Salomon XT-6 Triple Black arrives in a black, black, and phantom color palette. The Triple Black Salomon XT-6 has an upper that is made of a durable, breathable fabric that provides ventilation. The outsole is furnished with an aggressive lug pattern made of Contagrip rubber to provide traction. The midsole features Salomon's EnergyCell+ technology, which provides responsive cushioning and energy return for comfort. The sneaker features "S-LAB XT6" on one side of the heel and "Salomon" on the other. A "LAB" text is featured on the edge of the protective toe cap. The Salomon XT-6 Triple Black was released on April 27, 2020, and sold for a retail price of $190.

Display Name: adidas Ultra Boost 20 Triple Black
Description: The adidas Ultra Boost 20 Triple Black adds a monochromatic black look to the Ultra Boost collection. The adidas Ultra Boost 20 features a black Continental outsole and Boost midsole. The midsole for these sneakers also features 20% more Boost, which offers more comfort, flexibility, and durability and allows the wearer to absorb and return more energy when running. The adidas Primeknit upper provides a supportive fit, while the heel is made with soft elastane material for comfort. Tailored Fiber Placement technology offers stitched-in reinforcement as well as a superior fit and lightweight feel. The adidas Ultra Boost 20 Triple Black released in December of 2019 and retailed for $180.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Israfil
Description: Yeezy added to their already extensive catalog with the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Israfil, now available on StockX. The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Israfil features the same elements that fans of the sneaker love. The upper features multi-colored threads that add a variety of looks to the wearers feet from different angles. From there, the upper is matched with a translucent midsole that showcases the sneakers BOOST cushioned tech. The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Israfil released in August of 2020 for $220.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Slide Salt
Description: Enter the realm of sleek minimalism with the adidas Yeezy Slide Salt, a silhouette that redefines casual footwear. Embracing a monochromatic salt hue, this slide is a testament to the idea that true sophistication lies in simplicity. Designed with a smooth, seamless construction, the Yeezy Slide Salt offers an uncluttered, organic aesthetic that's as tranquil as its namesake. The Yeezy Slide in Salt is crafted from a unique foam compound that blends lightweight comfort with durability, these slides are tailored for the trendsetters who seek to merge their laid-back lifestyles with high-fashion sensibilities. The soft, cushioned footbed conforms to your foot, making every step feel like a clouda testament to adidas and Yeezy's pursuit of innovation in comfort and design. Having graced the market on March 15, 2024, and with a price tag of $70, the adidas Yeezy Slide Salt swiftly became the go-to choice for those who covet a fusion of luxe and leisure. Its release is celebrated as the moment when adidas and Yeezy once again elevated the everyday to the extraordinary. For the aficionados of minimalist chic, the adidas Yeezy Slide Salt has set a new benchmark in effortless style.

Display Name: adidas Samba Decon White Black Gum
Description: The adidas Samba Decon White Black Gum updates the original Samba released in the 1950s with a deconstructed aesthetic and a minimalist colorway of Cloud White, Core Black, and Grey One. Cloud White leather makes up the upper, while the signature T-shaped overlay crossing the upper is crafted from velvety suede in Grey One. Highlights of black can be found on the heel tab and the 3-Stripes logos on the sides. Metallic gold SAMBA lettering runs next to the 3-Stripes on the outer side panel and matches the gold branding on the tongue. It reads "adidas" and displays an oversized trefoil. Keeping to the sneakers roots, the outsole is made of gum rubber that provides traction on multiple surfaces. Our experts like the tonal stitching on the upper because it doesnt stand out, keeping with the minimalist design. The adidas Samba Decon White Black Gum was launched first on August 25, 2023, and sold for $150.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Knit RNR Fade Onyx
Description: Pushing the boundaries of innovation and style, the adidas Yeezy Knit RNR Fade Onyx dropped a shadowy masterpiece on August 10, 2023. This Yeezy model takes sneaker aesthetics to a whole new dimension, blending simplicity with avant-garde design. The Yeezy Knit RNR Fade Onyx became the talk of the town with its unique sock-like silhouette, making it the sneaker of choice for those who crave comfort and a stand out look. With a neutral grey gradient, it showcases an uninterrupted flow from its ankle collar to its toe box. But it doesn't just stop there. The sneaker's grey rubber outsole complements the design, while its EVA midsole ensures lightweight comfort with every step. Plus, with its PU toe reinforcement, this Yeezy promises not just style, but also durability. Making its grand entry on August 10, 2023, the adidas Yeezy Knit RNR Fade Onyx was priced at a cool $210 for those looking to elevate their sneaker game.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Zebra
Description: Debuted in 2017, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Zebra is known as one of the most renowned colorways in the Yeezy line. It features a white and black marbled Primeknit upper with a white side-stripe and red "SPLY-350" text. At the base, a cushioned Boost sole provides comfort and support. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Zebra released in February of 2017 and retailed for $220.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Semi Frozen Yellow
Description: The Semi Frozen Yellow adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 was rumored as early as May of 2017-some blogs even claimed they would be mostly glow-in-the-dark-but it was when photos of Kanye West wearing them first surfaced on the web later in the year that confirmed the release. This colorway steps outside of the comfort zone of previous 350 Yeezy sneaker releases, which have remained subtle and mostly neutral primary colors and bright accents. The official colorway of the 'Frozen Yellow Yeezys' is actually Semi Frozen Yellow, Raw Steel and Red and features both of adidas pinnacle technologies, Boost cushioning and Primeknit sock-like upper. The hype for the yellow colored Yeezys was pushed to the roof before launch as Kanye West appeared with Kid Cudi and Takashi Murakami as 'Ye and Cudi toured the iconic artist's studio on a trip to Tokyo. In addition, the rumors throughout the sneaker world suggested the Frozen Yellow Yeezy would be an extremely hard to get release. As expected, the Semi Frozen Yellow was announced officially on November 13th, 2017 and released in limited quantities on November 18th, 2017. Sizes of the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Semi Frozen Yellow are available now.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite Pro Black Voltage Yellow
Description: The Nike Air Foamposite Pro Voltage 2026 continues the legacy of one of Nikes most futuristic silhouettes, pairing the molded Foamposite upper with a high contrast voltage yellow accent. The black shell gives the shoe a sleek and almost armored look, while the bright yellow details cut through the darkness with energy. It feels bold and instantly recognizable. This pair stands out because the Foamposite design still feels ahead of its time. The structure and material create a unique visual that sets it apart from traditional sneakers, and the colorway amplifies that effect. It is a strong release for collectors who appreciate statement driven design. The Nike Air Foamposite Pro Voltage 2026 was released on May 8, 2026 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: Vans Old Skool 36 LX Souvenir Asphalt
Description: The Vans Old Skool 36 LX Souvenir in Asphalt is a June 2026 release of the Old Skool 36 LX  Vans' luxury-positioned premium tier of the Old Skool silhouette that applies upgraded materials, construction specifications, and design details above the standard Old Skool's core canvas and suede construction  in an Asphalt colorway that applies the dark, slightly warm grey of pavement to the LX format's premium material palette, creating the most urban and most street-contextually grounded expression of the Souvenir design concept. The Old Skool 36 LX designation combines the model's 36th anniversary lineage with the LX (Luxury) premium specification that Vans applies to its most elevated material expressions of heritage silhouettes, with the LX format typically featuring premium suede, leather, or textile combinations and refined construction details that distinguish it from the standard Old Skool's everyday construction. The Souvenir concept adds a travel and memory-referential dimension to the Asphalt LX, suggesting a shoe that commemorates a specific place, moment, or cultural reference with the kind of collector-specific meaning that makes souvenir objects among the most emotionally charged and most personally significant items in collections. Released June 25, 2026 at $125 retail through Vans and authorized lifestyle footwear retailers globally. The Vans Old Skool 36 LX Souvenir Asphalt was released on June 25, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: adidas XLG Runner Deluxe Gray
Description: The adidas XLG Runner Deluxe Gray blends vintage running DNA with a chunky, Y2K-inspired silhouette in a sleek monochrome finish. Inspired by vintage runners, the Gray adidas XLG Runner Deluxe starts with a mesh base to keep things breezy. Like most track shoes, rubber, suede, and leather overlays wrap around the mesh upper, providing structure and durability. The 3-Stripes logo, finished in rubber, graces the lateral and medial sidewalls, while the adidas Performance logo features on the forefoot, heel, tongue, and rubber outsole. The upper sits on a 2-inch chunky Cloudfoam midsole finished in Silver Metallic, seamlessly blending with the overall gray theme. A rubber outsole provides grip, while super-long laces ensure a secure fit. The adidas XLG Runner Deluxe Gray stands out for its exaggerated proportions, showcasing a chunky midsole for bold cushioning and extra-long laces for a dramatic, oversized look. The sneaker was released on February 6, 2025, and sold for $160.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog Mater
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog Mater steps into the scene with a playful spirit, mirroring the whimsy of Disney Pixars Cars. This funky edition is no ordinary pair; its a tribute to Mater, the beloved tow truck from Radiator Springs. From the front, a glossy TPU overlay showcases Maters grin, while the back flaunts a tow hook detail on the heel strap, making every step a statement of fun and comfort. Mater's unique charm doesn't end there; these clogs feature an exposed engine design on the toe, a quirky touch that is bound to turn heads. The Crocs Classic Clog Mater isnt just about looks; its about celebrating youthful exuberance with a comfy, snug fit thats ready for adventure. The blend of iconic Crocs comfort with Mater's playful persona makes this pair a must-have for those looking to add a touch of whimsy to their footwear collection. Dropped on October 17, 2023, at a retail price of $60, this pair is a ride into the playful world of Radiator Springs.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite Pro Red October (2026)
Description: The Nike Air Foamposite Pro Red October 2026 brings one of the most iconic all red color themes into the Foamposite Pro silhouette, creating a bold and unmistakable statement piece. The Gym Red and Black palette covers the sculpted upper, giving the shoe a powerful and uniform look that draws immediate attention. Foamposite models have always leaned into futuristic design, and this version amplifies that identity through a colorway that feels both aggressive and culturally significant within sneaker history. Fans gravitate toward all red sneakers because they carry strong visual impact and have become associated with some of the most memorable releases in modern sneaker culture. The Foamposite Pro adds its own identity through the large Swoosh and streamlined shape, making the colorway feel fresh within this silhouette. The glossy shell enhances the red tone, giving the shoe depth and shine under different lighting conditions. For collectors, pairs like this stand out because they merge a legendary color concept with one of Nikes most unique basketball designs. The Nike Air Foamposite Pro Red October 2026 was released on May 29, 2026 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred has the same legendary durability and functionality features of Michael Jordan's first signature sneaker but with a low-cut design. They come with a unique and robust construction that makes them perfect for the office or the court. The Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred features a white Air midsole, ideal for both the court and the street. It also arrives with Swoosh logos that run across the sides, while the wings and Jumpman logo are featured at the heel and tongue, respectively. The side panels and toe come with black micro-perforated leather, while red leather covers the overlays. Padding at the ankle enhances the shoe's functionality and comfort. The Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred was released in September of 2020 for $90.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG White Night Indigo
Description: The Adidas Samba OG in Footwear White, Night Indigo, and Cream for Women is a colorway that approaches the legendary archive silhouette from one of its most sophisticated and seasonally versatile tonal combinations, bringing together the crisp brightness of footwear white with the deep and slightly mysterious quality of night indigo and the warm softness of cream in a three color relationship that feels genuinely considered and fashion intelligent rather than simply assembled from available palette options. Night indigo as a color name carries a specific atmospheric quality that sits darker and more complex than standard navy or blue, evoking the particular shade of sky between dusk and full darkness when blue reaches its deepest and most saturated point before giving way to black, and on a Samba OG upper that depth creates a striking and visually commanding accent that makes the white base pop with maximum contrast and clarity. Cream introduces a softening element that keeps the footwear white and night indigo contrast from feeling too stark or corporate, adding warmth and vintage character to a color story that might otherwise feel more contemporary and clean than the Samba OG's heritage aesthetic typically demands. The women's specific Samba OG delivers the iconic silhouette's T-toe, side stripe, and gum sole architecture in a last and fit proportion developed for the female foot, ensuring that a colorway this carefully composed lands on a shoe that fits and feels as intentional as it looks from the outside. Footwear white, night indigo, and cream is the kind of Samba colorway that reveals more of its quality and consideration the more time you spend wearing and examining it, the three color relationship shifting and evolving across different lighting conditions and outfit contexts in a way that simpler two color combinations cannot sustain. For women who want a Samba OG that works across every season and every wardrobe context from casual daily wear to more intentionally styled outfit building, this white, night indigo, and cream iteration delivers that universal wearability through a color story sophisticated enough to reward the collector who notices those things and simple enough to work for the wearer who simply wants to look consistently excellent. The Adidas Samba OG in Footwear White, Night Indigo, and Cream Women's was released on March 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Granite
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Granite leans into a darker and more textured palette, using layered greys to create a rugged and dimensional look. Black, white, medium ash, and dark pewter blend into a gradient that feels dense and structured, while granite tones add a slightly raw edge. The silhouette remains unmistakable, with its signature paneling and visible Air units. Fans gravitate toward this version because it emphasizes the strength of the original design through tone rather than contrast. It feels heavy and intentional, offering a more understated alternative to brighter releases. The balance of textures and shades keeps it visually engaging without relying on bold color. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Granite was released on February 5, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Black University Blue (2026) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 14 Retro Black University Blue 2026 GS delivers the same sleek and aggressive design in a grade school size, maintaining the bold contrast between black and university blue. The silhouette keeps its performance inspired look, with clean lines and a shape that stands apart from other Jordan models. It carries the same identity and energy as the adult version. Fans appreciate this version for making the release accessible to a younger audience while preserving the original design. The colorway remains consistent, ensuring the same visual impact across sizes. It is a faithful adaptation that keeps the essence of the Jordan 14 intact. The Air Jordan 14 Retro Black University Blue 2026 GS was released on March 21, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro What The (2025)
Description: This Nike Kobe 8 Protro What The (2025) revives one of the most iconic and eclectic designs in the Kobe signature series. Staying true to the "What The" theme, this sneaker mashes up multiple iconic Kobe 8 colorways into one bold, eye-catching design. With mismatched color palettes on each shoe and a blend of graphics, materials, and prints, this release celebrates the rich legacy of Kobe Bryants eighth signature model. Built with a lightweight engineered mesh upper, superior cushioning, and a low-profile silhouette, the Kobe 8 Protro remains one of the most performance-driven basketball sneakers to date. The combination of bold hues, reflective details, and oversized branding makes this sneaker stand out both on and off the court. <br<Releasing on April 13, 2025, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro What The (2025) retailed for $180. A must-have for Kobe collectors and sneaker enthusiasts, this wild mashup pays tribute to the Mambas lasting influence on the game.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Patent Leather Mystic Navy Grape Ice
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Patent Leather Mystic Navy Grape Ice takes a cooler and more layered approach, blending deep tones with lighter accents for a dynamic look. The Mystic Navy base anchors the design, while Grape Ice and Light Violet Ore introduce softer contrast that adds depth without overwhelming the palette. The patent leather construction gives the colors a reflective quality that enhances the overall effect. Fans gravitate toward this pair because it balances bold material with a more controlled color story. The mix of tones creates visual interest while keeping the shoe wearable across different styles. It is a strong example of how the Air Force 1 continues to evolve through color experimentation while maintaining its core identity. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Patent Leather Mystic Navy Grape Ice was released on April 9, 2026 with a retail price of $120.
Colorway: Mystic Navy/Grape Ice/Light Violet Ore/Light Liquid Lime

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Dodgers
Description: The Nike Kobe 6 Protro Dodgers pays tribute to the city of Los Angeles and its storied sports culture, blending Kobe Bryants legendary basketball legacy with the iconic colors of the Dodgers. The baseball-inspired stitching on the tongue ties the theme together, making this pair a standout tribute to both Kobe and LAs baseball dynasty. Designed for performance and style, the Kobe 6 Protro Dodgers retains the responsive Zoom Air cushioning and lightweight build that made the original a go-to on the court. Whether youre playing ball or rocking them casually, the combination of storytelling and signature Protro upgrades ensures a perfect balance of comfort and durability. The shoes sleek silhouette and city-inspired details make it a must-have for both Lakers and Dodgers fans alike. With its nods to baseball and basketball history, this release is a true collectors item.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax 2023 Flyknit Pure Platinum
Description: The Nike Air VaporMax 2023 FlyKnit Pure Platinum sneakers are a part of Nike's VaporMax series. They are a neutral-colored model that are designed to provide support and comfort. Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Bred (2019)

Display Name: adidas SL 72 OG Rhinestone Grey Black (Women's)
Description: The adidas SL 72 OG Rhinestone Grey Black Womens reimagines a running archive staple with a touch of sparkle that feels both playful and elevated. Grey Two sets a soft neutral base, while Core Black overlays maintain the vintage athletic structure that defined the original SL 72. Rhinestone detailing catches the light subtly, adding texture and personality without overwhelming the slim retro profile. The SL 72 has always been about lightweight heritage and streamlined design, and this version keeps that spirit alive while leaning into modern styling. Fans of adidas archives appreciate when the brand experiments carefully, and the rhinestone accents feel like a fashion forward update rather than a gimmick. It transforms a classic runner into something that bridges sport history and statement streetwear in a way that still feels authentic. The adidas SL 72 OG Rhinestone Grey Black Womens was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Grey is a sleek and stylish addition to the ASICS lineup, offering a perfect blend of comfort and urban aesthetics. Featuring a cream-colored upper with subtle grey accents, this sneaker delivers a versatile look that effortlessly complements various outfits. The shoe's design incorporates ASICS' renowned GEL technology in the midsole, providing superior cushioning and shock absorption for all-day comfort. Crafted with premium materials, the Gel-NYC boasts a durable construction that stands up to daily wear. The breathable upper ensures proper ventilation, while the padded collar and tongue offer additional support and a snug fit. With its sleek silhouette and neutral colorway, this sneaker is an ideal choice for both casual outings and light athletic activities. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a comfortable and stylish sneaker that seamlessly transitions from day to night, offering both performance and fashion-forward design.

Display Name: adidas Climacool Off White
Description: The adidas Climamog Off White, also known as the adidas Climacool Off White, is a 3D-printed running shoe that offers the breathability of a sandal but features a one-piece design that conforms to the foots natural shape. Inspired by other boundary-pushing models in the adidas catalog and the labels commitment to sustainability, this slip-on shoe is crafted from polyurethane, a plastic polymer known for its durability and flexibility. The construction boasts a web of crisscrossing lattices, giving the lightweight shoe a futuristic, minimalist feel. In addition, the entire shoe comes in neutral Off White, with the molded 3-Stripes on the side panels making up the only branding details. In terms of comfort, the runner offers arch support and protective padding around the heel. Our experts at StockX appreciate the way the shoe minimizes waste by reducing the total amount of materials used. The adidas Climamog Off White was released on October 25, 2024, and sold for $140.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024)
Description: The Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024), also known as the Columbia 11s, is easily one of the most well known and beloved colorways of the Jordan 11 ever produced. Dating back to 1996, this sneaker has only retro'd twice since then, with the latest version being 10 years ago in 2014. The Legend Blue 11s feature an all white upper with white laces and an icy blue sole. The Jumpman logo pops in a Legend Blue accent as the finishing touch on this clean colorway. Jordan was famously spotted wearing these for the first time in the 1996 All-Star game, donning the now-iconic teal blue jerseys as the East defeated the West in San Antonio by a score of 129 to 118, in which Jordan was the game's MVP. The Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024) released on December 14th, 2024, for a retail price of $230. Our experts love this sneaker due to its storied history and infrequent retro releases, making this sneaker likely to be ever-more collectible as the years go on.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére Diffused Blue Diffused Blue
Description: The new Jordan 3 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére Diffused Blue brings a fresh and sophisticated take on a classic silhouette, continuing the legacy of A Ma Maniéres refined collaborations with Jordan Brand. This iteration swaps out the traditional elephant print for soft suede paneling, while the quilted satin interior lining adds a luxurious touch. The crisp white tumbled leather upper is complemented by diffused blue accents on the eyelets, heel tabs, and midsole, this colorway strikes a balance between vintage aesthetics and contemporary style. Adding to its exclusivity, the sneaker features A Ma Maniéres signature branding on the tongue, reinforcing the boutiques commitment to craftsmanship and storytelling. A muslin midsole lends a nostalgic appeal, while the heel tabs include inspirational messaging"All We Have is Each Other" and "You Need to Get Comfortable Walking Alone"further solidifying its deeper narrative. Released on March 29, 2025, the Jordan 3 Retro OG SP A Ma Maniére Diffused Blue retailed for $225. With its premium materials and a design ethos rooted in timeless elegance, this sneaker continues A Ma Maniéres streak of highly sought-after Jordan collaborations.

Display Name: Nike KD 6 Illusion (2026)
Description: The Nike KD 6 Illusion 2026 revisits a fan favorite with bold multi color detailing layered over a sleek performance silhouette. Green Glow accents cut through black panels, creating sharp contrast and dynamic movement across the upper. The streamlined structure keeps the design responsive and lightweight, reflecting Durants scoring versatility. Its layered color story adds depth without overwhelming the shape. Collectors who remember the original Illusion theme will appreciate this refreshed execution. The bright green highlights energize the silhouette, making it feel modern while honoring its roots. It captures a blend of nostalgia and contemporary court energy in one cohesive design. Expressive and performance ready, this pair carries legacy with renewed confidence. The Nike KD 6 Illusion 2026 was released on February 27, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme Black

Display Name: Vans Authentic Reissue 44 Gallery Dept. Art That Kills Black

Display Name: New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Grey

Display Name: adidas Samba Espadrille CLOT By Edison Chen White Black
Description: The adidas Samba Espadrille CLOT By Edison Chen in White and Black is the Samba component of Edison Chen's CLOT x adidas Mundial Collection, released as a pre-celebration for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, transforming the Samba Millennium silhouette by combining its leather upper with a woven raffia espadrille midsole that replaces the standard rubber midsole to create what Highsnobiety described as the ultimate summer Samba. The espadrille sole construction references the traditional Chinese slipper as a deliberate East-meets-West cultural statement connecting CLOT's Hong Kong identity to the global football community gathering in North America for the 2026 World Cup, with the collection's anime-inspired campaign directed by Annie Choi featuring football athletes Raphinha and Luis Díaz as the creative framework grounding the release in the tournament's cultural moment. Released May 2, 2026 at $140 retail via adidas.com, the adidas CONFIRMED app, and select retailers globally with style code KJ0274. The adidas Samba Espadrille CLOT By Edison Chen White Black was released on May 2, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: adidas Superstar II Core Black White Core Black

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Ash Pearl

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue (2026)

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Space Jam (2016)

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Flight Club
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Flight Club taps into the legacy of one of the most influential sneakers ever created while adding a layered color story that feels both nostalgic and refreshed. The black and sail upper sets a classic foundation, while gum medium brown on the outsole introduces a vintage touch that grounds the design. Hits of university red bring contrast and energy, tying the look back to the Jordan lineage without overpowering the overall balance. What makes this pair stand out is how it blends familiar elements into something that still feels distinct within the Air Jordan 1 catalog. Fans of the silhouette appreciate when new releases respect the original structure while experimenting with color placement, and this version delivers exactly that. It carries the same cultural weight and versatility that has defined the model for decades, making it a strong addition for both longtime collectors and newer enthusiasts. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Flight Club was released on April 11, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Liberty London Floral Embroidery Stripes (Women's)
Description: Liberty London commemorates its 150th anniversary with a collaboration with the 3-Stripes for the adidas Gazelle Indoor Liberty London Floral Embroidery Stripes (Women's). The trainer arrives in a neutral color palette accented with Margaret Annie prints for a luxe touch. The Liberty London X adidas Gazelle Indoor women's trainer takes on an off-white nubuck upper with floral patterns adorning the 3-Stripes and heel tabs. Co-branded logos elevate the insole, matching the gold foil 'Gazelle' on the lateral panel and the Trefoil emblem on the tongue. Continuing the silhouette's indoor sports heritage, the trainer sits on a semi-translucent rubber outsole for grip and cushioning. This special edition for women includes extra green laces and a special shoe box with floral wrapping papers. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Liberty London Floral Embroidery Stripes (Women's) features intricate flower embroidery inspired by Liberty London's iconic fabric patterns, which add a touch of elegance to the classic Gazelle. The trainer debuted on the 17th of March 2025 and sold for $120.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Dynamo
Description: The adidas Harden Vol. 9 Dynamo captures James Hardens explosive confidence through a colorway that feels loud, fearless, and unapologetic. The Dynamo execution leans into bold energy, using vivid tones to mirror Hardens scoring mentality and ability to take over games at will. The Harden Vol. 9 silhouette already feels sharp and aggressive, and this colorway amplifies that identity by embracing contrast and motion rather than subtlety. Fans of Hardens line love this pair because it feels emotionally aligned with his game. The design communicates rhythm, confidence, and swagger, qualities that have always defined Harden at his peak. Collectors appreciate how the Vol. 9 continues to evolve the line without losing its core DNA, making this colorway feel like a natural extension of Hardens legacy rather than a seasonal experiment. It is a shoe people gravitate toward when they want performance footwear that carries real personality and presence. The adidas Harden Vol. 9 Dynamo was released on July 26, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Salomon XT-Whisper Void Carpet Company Habibi Express
Description: The Salomon XT Whisper Void x Carpet Company Habibi Express in Fiery Red, Black, and Footwear Silver is a collaborative release that brings together Salomon's technical trail and lifestyle platform with one of skateboarding's most distinctive and culturally specific creative voices, the Carpet Company's handmade rug-inspired aesthetic and irreverent design intelligence meeting Salomon's outdoor engineering tradition in a colorway that carries the collaborative energy and creative specificity that only the most thoughtfully conceived brand partnerships can produce. Carpet Company has built an extraordinary reputation within the skateboarding and street culture community through a consistently unexpected and visually distinctive approach to collaborative work that rewards genuine cultural knowledge and brand awareness from the collector who encounters it, and the Habibi Express naming adds the warm and slightly playful cultural reference that is completely consistent with Carpet's established collaborative design vocabulary. Fiery red, black, and footwear silver create a colorway that carries the intensity and visual boldness that the Habibi Express name's energy suggests, the warm and vivid red against the dark base and silver accent creating a shoe that communicates collaborative creative conviction rather than safe commercial palette selection. Salomon collaborative releases with skateboarding-adjacent and street culture specific creative partners represent one of the most interesting and culturally generative directions in the brand's current collaborative program, the Carpet Company's specific and community-rooted design identity giving the XT Whisper Void platform a street credibility and cultural biography that extends far beyond standard outdoor lifestyle brand partnerships into the more specific and devoted communities that follow both Carpet Company and Salomon's most design-ambitious seasonal output with genuine attention and acquisition intention. The Void specification within the XT Whisper family signals specific construction or material details that distinguish this collaborative version from standard XT Whisper production, and combined with the Carpet Company design input creates a shoe that rewards the collector's investment with genuine differentiation from the platform's standard seasonal expressions. At one hundred and seventy dollars the Habibi Express delivers a culturally significant and design-specific collaborative XT Whisper at a fair premium over standard platform pricing. The Salomon XT Whisper Void x Carpet Company Habibi Express in Fiery Red and Black was released on May 16, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Clay
Description: If you're searching for a new sneaker with major drip, then cop the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Clay. This Yeezy Boost 350 comes with a clay upper with orange accents, translucent stripe with orange accents, clay midsole, and clay sole. These sneakers released in March 2019 and retailed for $220. Add another swaggy 350 V2 to the rotation and buy them on StockX today.

Display Name: NikeCraft Mars Yard Shoe 3.0 Tom Sachs Space Camp
Description: NikeCraft Mars Yard Shoe 3.0 Tom Sachs Space Camp continues the Mars Yard story by pushing utility, experimentation, and design philosophy to the forefront. Built around Tom Sachss Space Camp mindset, this shoe feels like a tool rather than a fashion object, emphasizing process, function, and intent over polish. The design reflects exploration and iteration, staying true to the Mars Yard ethos that has always challenged what a sneaker can be. This release resonates deeply with collectors because it represents ideas rather than trends.
