Every detail feels deliberate, rooted in problem solving and real world testing rather than aesthetics alone. It appeals to fans who value sneakers as artifacts of creative thinking, making the Mars Yard 3.0 feel like a chapter in an ongoing design experiment rather than a typical drop. The NikeCraft Mars Yard Shoe 3.0 Tom Sachs Space Camp was released on 09/19/2025 with a retail price of $275.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Hi-Res Red
Description: The adidas Yeezy 700 Hi-Res Red arrives with a bright red mesh and suede upper with black and grey suede overlays at the toe. In a different style from the original Yeezy 700s, the design opts for a fully circular lacing system, meaning that the ends of the laces are connected, eliminating a need for a bow on the shoe. This lacing system is similar to recent Yeezy 350s and 380s like the Onyx and Calcite Glow. At the base, a sculptural clay red Boost sole with hits of teal and bright orange provide cushioning and support. The adidas Yeezy 700 Hi-Res Red released in June of 2022 and retailed for $300.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Fir Pro Green (Women's)
Description: Air Jordan 1 Retro High Fir Pro Green Womens brings a rich, grounded color story to the most influential silhouette in sneaker history. Fir and pro green tones give the Air Jordan 1 High a calm but confident presence, emphasizing heritage and balance rather than loud contrast. Designed specifically with women in mind, the colorway feels intentional and refined while staying true to the models rebellious roots. This release resonates with collectors because it highlights how timeless the Jordan 1 truly is. The familiar shape anchors the design, while the green palette offers versatility and longevity. It feels like a shoe meant to age gracefully, rewarding fans who appreciate subtle reinterpretations that respect history while fitting seamlessly into modern rotations. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High Fir Pro Green Womens was released on 10/18/2025 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Barons
Description: The Jordan 12 Retro Barons brings a fresh new colorway to the iconic Jordan 12 silhouette, drawing inspiration from an often overlooked chapter in Michael Jordans legendary careerhis time with the Birmingham Barons, a minor league baseball team. During his brief departure from basketball in 1994, MJ pursued a childhood dream of playing professional baseball, a decision that stunned fans worldwide. The "Barons" colorway pays tribute to this unique period, offering a sleek black, wolf grey, and white design that echoes the colors of the Barons' uniforms. First introduced in 1996, the Jordan 12 has remained a staple in the Jordan Brand lineup thanks to its premium materials and timeless design. Known for its durable leather upper, the Jordan 12 was also the first Air Jordan to feature Nikes Zoom Air cushioning technology. This new Barons colorway showcases a sleek and minimalistic look that makes this model a versatile option for both casual wear and on-court performance. Released on September 28, 2024, the Jordan 12 Retro Barons retailed at $200. This sneaker honors a unique moment in Michael Jordans career while maintaining the classic style and performance features that have made the Jordan 12 a fan favorite for nearly three decades.

Display Name: Jordan 2 Retro Low SP Off-White Black Blue
Description: The Air Jordan 2 Off-White Black Blue nods to the natural aging process of original Air Jordans. It features a black leather upper with blue piping, textural overlays, and Michael Jordan's signature on the lateral side. At the heel, a blue heel cap is prominent with Nike branding. Looks of aging are apparent on the design's sole, where the midsole is artificially decayed with translucent material filling the gaps. Off-White's signature address print on the interior and a Jordan Wings logo on the tongue add the finishing touch. The Air Jordan 2 Off-White Black Blue released in November of 2021 and retailed for $250.

Display Name: Jordan 7 Retro Chambray (2023)
Description: The Jordan 7 Retro Chambray 2023 was released as a colorway addition to the Air Jordan line of sneakers. This Retro iteration is designed to pay homage to the style and innovation of the original Air Jordan 7. The Chambray Air Jordan 7 2023 is equipped with a cushioned foam midsole that provides both comfort and support. The outsole of the sneaker is made with durable rubber that provides traction and is designed to withstand the rigors of regular usage. The Jumpman logo appears on the side, and the Air Jordan branding is on the tongue. We think that the standout feature of the Jordan 7 Retro Chambray 2023 is its sleek and stylish design. The sneaker features a combination of premium-quality leather and suede with Chambray detailing. The shoe is also crafted with intricate detail to create a streamlined and almost aerodynamic silhouette. The shoe was released on July 15th, 2023 at a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) (TD)
Description: Scaled down for little feet with big style, the Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025) (TD) brings an icon to the toddler lineup in the beloved Summit White/Fire Red-Tech Grey-Black palette. The premium look channels the original "White Cement" DNA with speckled Tech Grey wings and midsole detailing, crisp white panels, and bold hits of Fire Red and Black for contrast. A padded collar and soft interior lining keep growing feet comfortable, while the heel pull tab makes on-and-off a breeze. Elastic laces and a wide opening help parents secure the fit quickly, and classic Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel completes the heritage vibe. Built for playground-ready durability, this toddler-sized Jordan 4 features a sturdy upper and a lightweight foam midsole that cushions every step without weighing them down. The rubber outsole uses flexible grooves for better grip and natural movement, supporting early walkers as they explore. Style ID IB4387-100 and the 2025-05-24 release date make this a must-have for collectors introducing the next generation to a legend, while the clean, versatile colorway pairs effortlessly with everyday outfits. From photo-ready moments to weekend adventures, this pair delivers iconic Air Jordan energy in a kid-friendly package. Our team thinks this product is great for parents who want heritage style with easy-on convenience and dependable comfort; our team loves this product because it blends classic White Cement looks with toddler-smart details that stand up to daily wear.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Metallic Gold (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Metallic Gold (Women's) paints the Air Jordan 4 Retro in off-white Sail and upgrades the recognizable silhouette with gold accents. The Sail upper, outsole, and midsole provide a monochromatic base that allows the metallic gold eyelets to shine. The AJ 4 features a total of four metallic gold eyelets  two on each side of the lace cage. While the upper is primarily composed of smooth leather, the quarter panel displays mesh that provides an airy feel. The midsole houses a visible Air unit in the heel, which adds responsive cushioning without weighing down the shoe. In terms of branding, the Jumpman logo can be found on the tongue and heel counter in Sail. Our StockX experts appreciate the addition of a gold Jumpman logo underfoot. It creates a surprise pop of color without a metallic sheen. The womens size Jordan 4 Retro Metallic Gold (Women's) was released on March 9th, 2024, and retailed at $200.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro White Gym Red
Description: The Air Jordan 9 Retro White Gym Red boasts a tumbled leather exterior, and a striped inner bootie with a traditional tricolor scheme. It displays Internal support straps and a one-pull lace. The Air-Sole, which is branded with a black Jumpman logo on the heel, is perched on top of a multi-directionally pattern-covered solid rubber outsole. Red patent leather is used on the retro design's heel, collar, and mudguard, which has a white leather upper overall. The sneaker also features molded eyelets and a white #23 branding at the pull tab. The Air Jordan 9 Retro White Gym Red was launched on 5 October 2019 and retailed at a price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Pure Money (2017)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Pure Money (2017) refreshes the Air Jordan 4 with pure, brilliant white. In May 2017, this silhouette was the latest in a series of Air Jordan 4 releases. This sneaker resembles the 2005 Pure Money with a few touch-ups, like chrome eyelets. Jordan 4 Retro Pure Money (2017) released in May of 2017 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Bright Red Clear Pink (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Bright Red Clear Pink (Women's) is an elegant lifestyle sneaker that takes its inspiration from handball sneakers from the 1970s. This updated shoe specifically sized for women offers classic comfort in an eye-catching colorway. The Bright Red Clear Pink colorway of the Women's adidas Handball Spezial features an upper primarily of a warm red hue. Red suede serves as the base of the upper as well as the overlays on the toe, eye stays, and heel. Light pink suede is used for the construction of the heel tab and the iconic adidas three stripes along the side panel. The laces are pink and the sock liner is red. Spezial branding with an adidas trefoil adorns the top of the third stripe on the lateral side. What our shoe experts enjoy most about this sneaker is the intricately patterned sole unit. The gum rubber of the midsole sports embossed triangles and embossed adidas trefoil branding. The gum rubber outsole is grooved with circles for traction. The adidas Handball Spezial Bright Red Clear Pink (Women's) was released on November 17, 2023, for a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Sandy Pink (Women's)
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Sandy Pink (Women's) gives the Gazelle Indoor a pastel makeover with a Sandy Pink base and accents in Cloud White. Originally designed as an indoor training shoe, this women's-sized adidas Gazelle model in Sandy Pink stays true to its sporty roots with a grippy outsole made of durable gum rubber. The retro-inspired design includes pops of Cloud White on smooth leather accents, including the heel mustache and the 3-Stripes logo on the side panels. The suede upper and toebox overlay come in Sandy Pink and give the sneaker a luxe, velvety finish. A front lace closure secures the fit and houses Sandy Pink laces. Our experts like the metallic gold branding details, including the "adidas" and "GAZELLE" lettering because they contribute to the sneakers premium aesthetic and set the shoe apart from more sporty models. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Sandy Pink (Women's) was released on June 1, 2024, and sold for $120.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Military Blue (2024) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Military Blue 2024 GS marks the return of a storied colorway, re-released for the first time in 12 years and brimming with anticipation. This sneaker is an ode to the heritage and timeless design that the Air Jordan 4 represents, rendered in the classic off-white and neutral grey, punctuated by striking military blue accents. This sneaker is a revival of a beloved classic in grade school sizing thats poised to excite a new generation of sneaker aficionados who crave a sneaker with a story. This Air Jordan 4 features the iconic mesh netting, supportive wings and the Air unit that changed the game, these kicks are outfitted with all the groundbreaking features that made the original a court legend. Now in grade school sizes, the industrial blue hits not only bring a pop of color but also pay tribute to the sneaker's storied past, ensuring that the legacy lives on in the playground as well as on the courts. On April 11, 2024, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Military Blue 2024 GS released for a retail price of $160, offering a fresh opportunity to embrace a revered colorway. This beloved sneaker and colorway is a bridge between eras, inviting young fans to step into the history and culture of the Jordan brand. For the kids who lace these up, it's an opportunity to carry forward the legacy of greatness, all while making their own mark in these iconic shoes.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Metallic Gold (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Metallic Gold (Women's) adds gold details and a white leather upper to the iconic Jordan 1 silhouette. The sneaker features a retro, high-top design, inspired by the original Air Jordan 1, with leather overlays in Tonal White. Metallic Gold can be found across the Swooshes on the side panels, around the collar, and on the Jordan Wings logo. In addition, the tongue boasts a logo tag with a clean white base and Metallic Gold stitching. Like other versions of the Jordan 1 Retro High OG, the Metallic Gold variation features perforations across the vamp that allow the foot to breathe. The rubber outsole comes in Gum Light Brown and complements the gold accents. Our StockX experts like the gold-tone lace charm, which hangs from a metal chain and displays Nike Air branding. The womens size Jordan 1 Retro High OG Metallic Gold (Women's) was released on February 14th, 2024, and retailed at $180.

Display Name: adidas Campus 00s Camp Core Black
Description: The adidas Campus 00s Camp Core Black Core Black Core Black doubles down on early 2000s skate and street nostalgia with a fully monochrome Core Black execution. The chunky proportions and padded tongue reflect the era that made the Campus 00s a staple, while the triple black color story keeps it versatile and understated. Suede textures add depth across the upper, giving the shoe that familiar broken in feel fans associate with the model. What keeps this pair in rotation is its balance of attitude and simplicity. The exaggerated shape nods to skate culture and baggy denim aesthetics, yet the all black finish makes it easy to style with almost anything. It carries that relaxed confidence that defined a generation of streetwear without feeling costume driven. For collectors who appreciate adidas heritage silhouettes reworked through a nostalgic lens, this version captures the essence of the Campus revival. The adidas Campus 00s Camp Core Black Core Black Core Black was released on May 28, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Lace Soft Pearl (Women's)
Description: Softly refined and effortlessly wearable, the Nike Dunk Low Lace Soft Pearl (Womens) refreshes a streetwear staple with a delicate palette and elevated texture play. The Light Orewood Brown, Coconut Milk, and Soft Pearl colorway creates a layered look that pairs easily with everyday fits while still turning heads. Classic Dunk DNA shows up in the padded collar, perforated toe box, and sturdy cupsole, while the "Lace" treatment brings nuanced detailing that adds depth without overpowering the clean lines. Underfoot, the durable rubber outsole with heritage pivot circles delivers reliable traction and a smooth ride for all-day comfort, whether youre on the move or styling for a night out. Designed to be a versatile anchor in any rotation, this womens Dunk Low balances a timeless profile with modern finesse. The low-cut silhouette sits neatly at the ankle, the foam midsole cushions each step, and the crisp paneling gives the color blocking room to shine. From denim and tees to tailored skirts, it slots seamlessly into your wardrobe, offering an easy way to introduce soft neutrals and subtle contrast. Marked with style code HJ5870-100 and releasing August 1, 2025, the Nike Dunk Low Lace Soft Pearl is poised to become a go-to for fans of minimalist tones and classic court heritage reimagined for lifestyle wear. Our team loves this product because its gentle hues and refined detailing make it incredibly versatile, and it elevates everyday outfits with zero effort.

Display Name: adidas AE 2 Christmas
Description: The adidas AE 2 Georgia Bulldogs brings collegiate energy into Anthony Edwards signature silhouette through a bold and team inspired colorway. Core black sets a strong base, while lucid red and lucid lemon accents add vibrant contrast that reflects the Bulldogs identity. The structure feels dynamic and performance driven, aligning with Edwards explosive style of play. Fans of AE signature releases appreciate how each colorway connects performance footwear with cultural and team influence. The mix of colors gives it a standout presence on and off the court. It is a sneaker that reflects both athletic performance and school pride in a cohesive design. The adidas AE 2 Georgia Bulldogs was released on December 20, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 1995 All-Star
Description: The Nike Book 1 1995 All-Star is a vibrant performance shoe that pays homage to the Phoenix Suns basketball team. This iteration of the Nike Book 1 has a base of Wild Berry purple mesh that forms the sides and heel area. Wild Berry suede forms the toe box and toe cap, with perforations located directly under the laces for added breathability. Shiny black Swooshes adorn each side with Dusty Cactus blue outlines, which match the laces. Book branding is found on the tongue, while the Bright Mandarin heel pull tab contains the words "Chapter One." A white and blue "1" is also found on the lateral toe, and three orange stars on the lateral heel. The shoe features a black midsole and an orange outsole. Our favorite thing about this shoe is its bright colorway, which is eye-catching no matter how you spin it, and the patterned outsole. The Nike Book 1 1995 All-Star was released on May 2, 2025, for $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Royal Toe
Description: Jordan Brand adds a twist to a classic with the Jordan 1 Retro High Royal Toe, now available on StockX. Releases like the Shattered Backboard 1 and Bred Toe have shifted all eyes on Jordans "Black Toe" inspired colorways. The Royal Toe takes inspiration from the original Jordan 1 Royal colorway (which released in 1985) and adds design elements of the Black Toe 1 to create a familiar, but new dialogue. This AJ 1 features a white and royal leather upper with black leather overlays and detailing. A white midsole, royal outsole, and branded leather tongue tag completes this design. These sneakers released in May of 2020 and retailed for $170 USD.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 2 Iron Grey Sail (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 2 Iron Grey Sail Womens delivers a calm and controlled look that mirrors Sabrina Ionescus precision driven game. The Sabrina 2 silhouette is built for responsiveness and balance, and the iron grey and sail palette reinforces that mindset with a clean and focused aesthetic. Subtle hits of punch red add energy without disrupting the overall restraint, making the shoe feel serious and intentional rather than flashy. Fans love this pair because it feels pure to the athlete. The Sabrina line is respected for court feel and stability, and this colorway emphasizes those strengths visually. Collectors appreciate how the design stays versatile and wearable while still carrying performance credibility, making it a sneaker that transitions naturally from game play to everyday rotation without losing identity or purpose. The Nike Sabrina 2 Iron Grey Sail Womens was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Cap and Gown
Description: Cue up the Vitamin C (what up 90s kids) and grab a pair of the Jordan 11 Retro Cap and Gowns to strut across that graduation stage. Also known as the "Prom Nights" these come in a clean all-black colorway, and pay homage to Michael Jordans original design influence of wanting a basketball sneaker that he could also wear off-court, with a nice suit. Representing graduation ceremonies across the country, these "Cap and Gown" XIs feature a suede upper with patent leather detailing, a black metal "Jumpman" logo on the ankle and rope laces inspired by graduation cords. These released in May of 2018, at, $250 and came exclusively in mens sizes, in special packaging. If youre a fan of the AJ 11, this pair is another must-have.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 Valley
Description: The Nike Book 1 Valley captures Devin Bookers connection to Phoenix through a colorway that feels warm, grounded, and personal. The Book 1 silhouette is sleek and controlled, and the Valley theme leans into desert inspired tones that reflect the identity of the city and the calm confidence Booker brings to the court. The mix of sail, clay orange, and court purple feels intentional, giving the shoe a sense of place rather than just another performance look. Fans love this pair because it feels authentic to Bookers story. The Book 1 is designed around balance, precision, and rhythm, and this colorway reinforces that mindset visually. Collectors appreciate how the Valley execution turns a signature sneaker into a narrative piece, one that celebrates environment and identity while still delivering a clean and wearable design that fits naturally into both on court and off court rotation. The Nike Book 1 Valley was released on May 15, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Reebok Board Flip BBC Ice Cream Pink Lemonade
Description: The Reebok Board Flip BBC Ice Cream Pink Lemonade delivers a bold and summery take on the skate inspired silhouette through a colorway that feels bright and energetic. The mix of red, pink, and yellow creates a vibrant palette that reflects the playful identity of BBC Ice Cream, while the Board Flip model provides a simple and functional base. The Pink Lemonade theme adds a sense of fun and seasonal energy, making the shoe stand out immediately. Fans gravitate toward colorful releases like this because they bring personality and creativity into everyday footwear. The combination of warm tones gives the sneaker a lively presence that works well for casual styling. The clean structure of the Board Flip allows the colors to take center stage without distraction. BBC Ice Cream collaborations continue to resonate because they prioritize fun and individuality within sneaker design. For collectors, pairs like this represent the brands ability to consistently deliver eye catching colorways that remain rooted in skate and street culture. The Reebok Board Flip BBC Ice Cream Pink Lemonade was released on May 6, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike V5 RNR White Black Metallic Silver (Women's)
Description: The Nike V5 RNR White Black Metallic Silver Womens offers a clean and contrast driven take on the silhouette, pairing a white base with black and metallic silver accents that highlight its layered construction. The design feels crisp and modern, with each panel contributing to the overall depth of the shoe. The structure remains consistent with its running inspired roots. What makes this pair stand out is its balance between simplicity and detail. The white base keeps it fresh and versatile, while the metallic elements add a subtle edge that elevates the look. Nike continues to refine these everyday silhouettes with thoughtful color combinations, and this release reflects that direction well. It is a polished and wearable option with a slightly elevated finish. The Nike V5 RNR White Black Metallic Silver Womens was released on February 17, 2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Goadome PRM Black Off Noir
Description: The Nike Air Max Goadome PRM Black Off Noir is a premium iteration of the iconic boot-inspired sneaker. Featuring a sleek all-black upper crafted from high-quality materials, this shoe combines durability with style. The rugged outsole provides excellent traction, making it suitable for various terrains and weather conditions. The Air Max unit in the heel offers superior cushioning and comfort, ensuring all-day wearability. This model showcases Nike's commitment to blending performance and fashion. The Off Noir colorway adds a subtle depth to the black silhouette, creating a sophisticated look that's versatile enough for both casual and more polished outfits. With its robust construction and timeless design, the Air Max Goadome PRM is built to last, offering both functionality and style in one package. We at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a durable, comfortable, and stylish boot-sneaker hybrid that can withstand the elements while maintaining a sleek urban aesthetic.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Hyperflight Patent Black
Description: The Nike Zoom Hyperflight Patent Black brings back a futuristic basketball silhouette with a sleek and reflective twist, using patent leather across the upper to create a bold and fluid surface. The black and white color palette keeps the design sharp and high contrast, allowing the sculpted shape to stand out even more. The streamlined build reflects the models original focus on speed and minimal weight. What makes this pair stand out is its distinctive form and finish. The Hyperflight has always leaned into innovation, and the patent treatment amplifies that identity with a glossy and modern feel. Nike continues to revisit unique silhouettes that break away from traditional designs, and this release reflects that direction clearly. It is a statement piece that blends performance heritage with standout aesthetics. The Nike Zoom Hyperflight Patent Black was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 450 Cinder
Description: In a dark brown, monochromatic styling, the adidas Yeezy 450 Cinder utilizes a minimalist two-piece construction to achieve the futurist aesthetic Yeezy has displayed in their most recent silhouettes. A foam sole encompasses a matching sock-like Primeknit upper in a claw-like fashion. Thick rope laces and sock-like collars provide a secure fit. The adidas Yeezy 450 Cinder released in March of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: adidas Stan Smith Triple White
Description: The minimalist design of the adidas Stan Smith makes it a clean sneaker, regardless of which colors are put on it. But the adidas Stan Smith Triple White is one of the cleanest options of the bunch thanks to the bright shades of white utilized on it. Just like other Stan Smiths, this one has a white leather upper with white laces, a white midsole and outsole, and white adidas branding scattered throughout it. But what separates it from other Stan Smiths is that everything else on this shoe is white, too, including its tongue and heel tab. They're typically covered in other colors to provide contrast for the white on the upper, but they're done up in white here. Our sneaker experts love how clean these Stan Smiths look because of all the white used to create them. The white gives the Stan Smith silhouette an opportunity to shine even more than usual. The adidas Stan Smith Triple White was released on June 15, 2023, when it retailed for $80.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Philadelphia Phillies
Description: Paying homage to the Philadelphia Phillies, the Nike SB Dunk Low Philadelphia Phillies, boasts a Valor blue Durabuck and suede upper, Team Maroon Swooshes, and woven tongue labels with graphics depicting two Philly staples: the Liberty Bell and a Philly cheese steak sandwich. From there, a white and gum brown Nike Zoom sole completes the design. The Nike SB Dunk Low Philadelphia Phillies released in July of 2022 and retailed for $115.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Wash Orange
Description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Wash Orange features a grey leather, suede, and mesh upper with teal panels and reflective underlays. At the base, a thick Wash Orange Boost midsole contrasts cool tones found in the upper. The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Wash Orange released in October of 2021 and retailed for $250.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Seafoam Sail (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Seafoam Sail (Women's) is a high-top silhouette in womens sizing presenting in a calming, seafoam sail colorway. This high-top Jordan 4 is a retro model and womens sized sneaker. Dressed in a seafoam, minty green tone, this shoe has a luxurious and elegant aesthetic. The premium nubuck upper adds a velvety touch and while the signature mesh side panels provide breathability. Youll spot metallic silver detailing in the form of an element that doubles as part of the eye stay. The Jumpman logo is on a patch on the tongue, while the back heel sports the rubberized logo along with the textured pull tab. StockX experts appreciate the sail-toned midsole that houses the Air unit, while the herringbone-patterned outsole is sail and seafoam with branding underneath. When the Jordan 4 Retro Seafoam Sail (Women's) debuted to the public on March 8, 2025, it sold for $215 retail.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Jordan Poole Milk and Cookies
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Air Jordan Poole Milk and Cookies brings playful storytelling to a silhouette built for elite basketball movement. Flax tones create a warm and unexpected base, while baroque brown accents add depth and contrast. The overall look feels expressive yet grounded, allowing the shoe to stand out without distracting from its sharp and aggressive form. This release connects with fans because it reflects Jordan Pooles personality and confidence. The Milk and Cookies theme adds charm and individuality, making the shoe feel personal rather than generic. Collectors appreciate how the GT Cut line continues to evolve through athlete driven narratives, turning performance footwear into cultural expression. It feels energetic and fun, showing that competitive design can still carry character and humor without losing focus. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Air Jordan Poole Milk and Cookies was released on December 9, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Romaleos 4 White Black
Description: The Nike Romaleos 4 White Black was released as part of Nikes evolving Olympic weightlifting shoe, optimized for absolute stability, a lockdown fit, and efficient power transfer. This updated design arrives in a white/white-black colorway. The Nike Romaleos 4 White Black was designed in a supportive midsole that sits on a flat, wide outsole, with pliant straps over the laces at the midfoot to lock your foot during extreme workouts. The heel-to-toe drop minimizes the ankle flex at the bottom of a lift, aiding explosiveness off the ground. The shoes wide heel provides a more stable foundation during heavy lifts, while heavy-duty rubber treads ensure maximum traction. Something our experts highlight about the Romaleos 4 in White Black is the supportive midsole and a flat, wide outsole designed for stability and strength, and an adjustable strap to secure the foot during workouts. The Nike Romaleos 4 White Black was released on April 1st, 2020, and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Chrome (GS)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Chrome GS leans into a lighter and more reflective aesthetic, combining soft neutral tones with metallic accents. The Photon Dust base keeps the look clean, while chrome detailing adds a futuristic edge that catches light and movement. Sail and Gridiron elements help balance the palette, keeping it cohesive. This version stands out because it blends subtle color with standout material. The reflective elements give it a distinct presence without relying on bold hues. It is a strong option for younger collectors or anyone looking for a versatile sneaker that still carries a modern and slightly elevated feel. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Chrome GS was released on July 31, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Blue Lime
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Blue Lime brings electric contrast to a heritage running silhouette. Blue anchors the upper with cool depth, while lime accents slice through the paneling with sharp, high visibility energy. The layered construction highlights the technical structure that defined early 2000s performance runners, and the ProGrid cushioning system reinforces comfort and stability underfoot. Its dynamic color pairing amplifies the intricate overlays and mesh detailing. Fans of bold retro runners will appreciate how the lime hits transform a classic blue base into something more expressive. The contrast feels athletic and energetic without overpowering the silhouettes structure. It blends nostalgia with modern street rotation seamlessly. Bright and confident, this pair delivers heritage performance with standout flair. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Blue Lime was released on July 12, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: New Balance 530 Brown Tan
Description: The New Balance 530 Brown Tan is a stylish and versatile sneaker that combines comfort with a trendy aesthetic. Featuring a rich brown and tan colorway, this shoe offers a sophisticated look that easily transitions from casual to semi-formal occasions. The upper is crafted with a mix of premium materials, including suede and mesh, providing both durability and breathability for all-day wear. Designed with New Balance's signature cushioning technology, the 530 model ensures superior comfort and support for your feet. The chunky midsole not only adds to the shoe's retro-inspired silhouette but also provides excellent shock absorption for a smooth stride. With its timeless design and earthy tones, the New Balance 530 Brown Tan is a perfect addition to any wardrobe, effortlessly complementing a wide range of outfits. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a balance between style and comfort in their everyday footwear.

Display Name: Nike Air Vapormax Plus Cool Grey Black
Description: The Nike Air Vapormax Plus Cool Grey Black is a variation of the Nike Air Vapormax Plus sneaker design. The upper of the Air Vapormax Plus Cool Grey Black is designed with a lightweight, breathable textile material that allows for maximum airflow to keep the foot cool and dry during intense workouts. It has a rubberized cage overlay that enhances durability while also providing a secure fit, keeping the foot in place during lateral movements. The midsole features Air-Sole technology, which offers exceptional cushioning and support for the foot. We think that the notable feature of the Nike Air Vapormax Plus Cool Grey Black is the pod design on the outsole. These pods are placed to provide targeted cushioning and support to the foot. In addition, these pods are made up of durable rubber and serve to evenly distribute the force of impact while running or walking. The shoe was released on May 18th, 2022, at a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike LeBron Witness 7 Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike LeBron Witness 7 Black Anthracite is designed so it won't weigh you down even as it controls your power across the court. The upper of this LeBron James high-performance basketball shoe is composed of black mesh, crafted to be lightweight, breathable, and flexible with every cut. Black webbing midfoot straps help lock in the foot, as does the glistening black molded heel counter. A heel tab helps ease on and off, and the padded collar enhances ankle comfort. The black foam midsole houses a full-length Air unit underfoot for cushioning and springy energy return. The black rubber outsole is split with channels that allow flexibility and also reduce the weight of the shoe. The standout aspect of this sneaker that we enjoy the most is the white embroidered graphic on the black heel tab  a lion wearing a crown. The Nike LeBron Witness 7 Black Anthracite was released on December 29, 2022, for an original retail price of $105.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (PS)
Description: Step into a legend reimagined for today. This classic low?top sneaker pairs premium materials with meticulous construction, delivering a balance of structure, flexibility, and all?day comfort. Smooth leather panels are set against breathable textile accents, while precise stitching and a sculpted heel create a refined silhouette from every angle. A responsive foam midsole softens each step, and a padded collar supports the ankle without bulk. Underfoot, a durable rubber outsole with a grippy tread pattern anchors your stride on city streets, studio floors, and weekend adventures alike. Designed to be the cornerstone of your rotation, this style shines with versatile color blocking and subtle hits of branding that signal timeless taste. Dress it up with tailored layers or down with relaxed denim, the streamlined profile and crisp finish elevate any look without trying too hard. Thoughtful details like flat laces for a secure tie, perforations for airflow, and a shaped toe box for natural motion make it as functional as it is striking. Whether youre collecting an icon or searching for a dependable daily pair, this sneaker delivers standout presence and effortless wearability in one go. Our team loves this product because it offers iconic style, reliable cushioning, and premium detailing that make every outfit, and every step, feel a notch above.
Colorway: Black/Fire Red/Deep Royal Blue/Dark Smoke Grey/Tech Grey

Display Name: Nike Ava Rover Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike Ava Rover Black Anthracite leans into a sleek and understated palette that highlights its modern design lines. Black and Anthracite tones layer across the upper, creating depth within a fully tonal approach. The streamlined silhouette feels contemporary and purposeful, emphasizing structure over flash. Subtle detailing enhances the profile without distracting from its clean execution. Fans who prefer darker footwear will appreciate the versatility of this release. The monochrome foundation makes it adaptable for daily wear, while the layered construction keeps it visually interesting. It reflects a confident approach to minimalism, where shape and texture drive impact. Sharp and grounded, this pair stands strong through simplicity. The Nike Ava Rover Black Anthracite was released on July 25, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Grey Silver Black
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Grey Silver Black brings back a performance rooted silhouette with a clean and technical color palette that feels right at home in todays runner inspired wave. The grey and silver upper creates a layered and reflective look, while black accents add contrast and structure throughout the design. The ProGrid cushioning system remains central, reinforcing the shoes original purpose while adapting seamlessly to lifestyle wear. Fans are drawn to this pair because it captures the balance between retro performance and modern styling. The combination of mesh and synthetic overlays gives it that classic early 2000s feel, while the neutral tones keep it easy to wear. It stands as a strong option for those who appreciate understated technical sneakers with everyday versatility. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Grey Silver Black was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 5 Black White
Description: The Nike Free Metcon 5 Black White is a training sneaker with a sock-like fit and a monochromatic colorway. The sneaker provides a 7/8-length inner sleeve, which creates an easy entry point. Webbing eyelets for the laces help secure the foot and form a crisscross pattern across the sneakers top. In addition, foam padding around the ankle adds comfort and protects this joint. Other technical features include a wide heel, which acts as a base during strength training, and a cushioning foam midsole. The synthetic upper comes in black and has rubber tread in high-wear areas. Finally, a molded heel clip helps the shoe maintain its shape and protects this area from impact stress. Our StockX experts appreciate the minimal branding, including a vertical Swoosh on the lateral side of the midsole. The Nike Free Metcon 5 Black White was released on April 10th, 2023, and retailed at $130.

Display Name: adidas Adistar XLG 2.0 Solar Orange
Description: The adidas Adistar XLG 20 Solar Orange feels like a bold revival of early 2000s running energy, amplified with modern proportions and striking color placement. Core Black forms the base while Solar Orange hits inject an unmistakable pop that instantly draws the eye. Footwear White accents balance the palette, giving the shoe contrast that highlights the oversized midsole and sculpted lines. The XLG 20 silhouette leans fully into the chunky runner movement, but it does so with authentic adidas performance roots rather than chasing trends. Fans appreciate how the exaggerated tooling and breathable upper reference archival running models while still feeling wearable today. The Solar Orange detailing adds just enough attitude to make the pair feel expressive without overwhelming the structure, making it a standout for anyone who gravitates toward statement runners. The adidas Adistar XLG 20 Solar Orange was released on February 5, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Wolf Grey
Description: The Jordan 13 Retro in Wolf Gray is a mens basketball shoe that provides comfort and protective padding both on and off the court. The sleek look of the shoe makes it appropriate for wear both during the game and during the after-party. The Retro Jordan 13 in Wolf Gray has a clean white leather base with small perforations in the shape of a circle for a unique look. Wolf Gray overlays adorn the heel and the midsole just above the sole of the shoe. It features a vibrant red color underfoot, and the Jordan Jumpman logo appears in the same red shade on the tongue. Branding details are completed with the signature Jordan hologram on the back. What we at StockX think makes this shoe stand out is its unique, perforated, white leather base. This element gives the shoe a spotless look that can be paired with any outfit, both on and off the court. The Jordan 13 Retro in Wolf Gray was released on August 5th, 2023, for an initial price of $210.

Display Name: New Balance 740v2 Cyber Jade
Description: The New Balance 740v2 Cyber Jade injects energy and contrast into the 740v2 through a colorway that feels bold and futuristic. Cyber jade brings vibrancy to the silhouette, balanced by darker tones that keep the look grounded and intentional. The design feels athletic and expressive, highlighting the layered construction and technical inspiration that define the model. Collectors are drawn to this pair because it captures movement and personality. The 740v2 already feels modern, and the cyber jade color elevates it into something more eye catching without overwhelming the shoe. Fans appreciate how New Balance blends comfort and visual impact, creating a sneaker that stands out while still feeling wearable. It is a strong example of how color can amplify design without sacrificing balance or versatility. The New Balance 740v2 Cyber Jade was released on June 11, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Shattered Backboard Alternate
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Shattered Backboard Alternate brings one of Jordan Brands most legendary color stories into a low cut format that feels fresh and accessible. The black, starfish, and sail combination instantly calls back to the Shattered Backboard legacy, tying the shoe to one of the most iconic moments in Michael Jordan history. Even in low form, the color blocking carries undeniable energy and familiarity. Fans love this release because it offers a new way to wear a beloved story. The Jordan 1 Low silhouette makes the Shattered Backboard theme feel more casual and versatile, while still honoring its roots. Collectors appreciate this pair as a bridge between nostalgia and everyday wear, celebrating Jordan lore without feeling locked into a retro moment. The Air Jordan 1 Low Shattered Backboard Alternate was released on July 12, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Levis Indigo
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Levis Indigo brings two iconic American brands together through a thoughtful blend of denim heritage and classic basketball silhouette. This collaboration dresses the 3 in rich denim panels that replace the traditional leather upper, giving the sneaker texture and character rooted in Levis legacy. Subtle black and sail accents balance the design, while the familiar Jordan 3 shape keeps it rooted in streetwear culture. What truly sets this edition apart is the way Levis DNA is woven into every detail. The classic red Levis tab sits proudly on the lateral side, signaling authentic denim lineage, and a co-branded Jordan x Levis hangtag adds collectible appeal straight out of the box. Inside, custom insoles printed with Levis denim motifs give a nod to the materials cultural history, melding fashion and sneaker worlds in a way that feels natural and purposeful. When the Air Jordan 3 Retro Levis Indigo released, it retailed for $230 and dropped on February 25, 2026. With its standout denim materials, heritage branding details, and co-branded accents, this collaboration stands as one of 2026s most talked-about takes on a timeless silhouette.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Triple White (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Triple White Womens strips the silhouette down to pure form, letting texture and construction define the look. Layers of white, summit white, and platinum tint create dimension through material rather than color, giving the shoe a clean and architectural feel. The result is crisp and modern, highlighting every line and panel of the Vomero 5s intricate design. Fans love this pair because it feels timeless. Triple white runners have always held a special place in sneaker culture, and the Vomero 5s detailed build keeps this one from feeling flat or basic. Collectors appreciate it as a versatile cornerstone, a sneaker that delivers comfort, style, and longevity while showcasing the models design at its purest. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Triple White Womens was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Black University Blue (2026)
Description: The Air Jordan 14 Retro Black University Blue 2026 brings back a sleek and performance driven silhouette with a colorway that feels both sharp and modern. The black upper sets a clean and aggressive foundation, while university blue accents add a pop of color that highlights the design without overwhelming it. Inspired by performance luxury, the Jordan 14 still carries that signature fast and aerodynamic feel. What makes this pair stand out is how effortlessly it blends sport and style. The streamlined build gives it a distinct identity within the Jordan lineup, while the color blocking keeps it versatile enough for everyday wear. It is a release that feels both refined and energetic, appealing to collectors who appreciate a more performance rooted silhouette. The Air Jordan 14 Retro Black University Blue 2026 was released on March 21, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper Bleached Aqua
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper Bleached Aqua is the first colorway released from the three-pair Dusk 2 Dawn collaborative pack between Filipino sneaker retailer and barbershop Titan and San Antonio Spurs rookie guard Dylan Harper, featuring a light blue Bleached Aqua upper on the GT Cut 1 platform with a yellow-to-grey gradient on the tongue, Swoosh, and midsole, red accent detailing on the medial Swoosh and midsole support piece, Cashmere and Glacier Blue secondary tones, Metallic Silver accents, and Dylan Harper's personal flying D logo stamped on the heel as the PE-identifying detail that connects the shoe directly to the second-overall 2025 NBA Draft pick. The Daybreak colorway concept was designed to honor Harper's Filipino heritage through his mother, whose hometown is in Bataan, Philippines, with the light aqua blue representing the calm of a Bataan sunrise and the gradient color transitions evoking the gradual shift of morning light, making the shoe a cultural tribute as much as a performance basketball release. Titan, the Philippines-based sneaker retailer with a history of Nike and Jordan Brand collaborations, worked with Harper and Nike Basketball to develop the three-pair arc, with Bleached Aqua serving as the first chapter, followed by Black and White colorways planned for Fall 2026. Harper debuted the colorway during San Antonio's playoff run, wearing the shoe on court during the 2026 NBA Finals against the New York Knicks. Released June 20, 2026 at $210 retail globally via nike.com and select retailers, following an exclusive Titan launch June 17 and an early Foot Locker release June 1, with style code IU0779-400 in unisex sizing. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper Bleached Aqua was released on June 20, 2026 with a retail price of $210.
Colorway: Bleached Aqua/Cashmere/Sport Gold/Chile Red/Metallic Silver/Glacier Blue

Display Name: Nike Air Max 2017 Triple Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 2017 Triple Black was created for individuals that are active. This model can be worn for everyday walking and more intense exercise. This model has a cushioned, supportive sole that was designed with support and comfort in mind. The upper body of the shoe, like the sole, is completely black, and made out of a mixture of leather and mesh. The Nike swoosh symbol can be subtly found in the lower part of the shoe near the heel. The Nike Air Max 2017 Triple Black had a starting release date of August 2017. This model was released with a starting retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro PRM Bin23
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro PRM Bin23 in Team Red, Metallic Gold, Burgundy Crush, Coconut Milk, Smokey Mauve, and Gym Red is a premium material and colorway release that brings one of the most architecturally significant and historically loaded silhouettes in the Jordan Brand catalog to a multi-tone warm palette execution that carries genuine material sophistication and color depth across every panel of the 3's iconic construction. Bin23 designates this as a premium Jordan Brand release occupying the label's most elevated retail tier, with construction quality and material sourcing that distinguishes it immediately from standard seasonal Jordan 3 production. The layered warm tones across team red, burgundy crush, smokey mauve, and coconut milk create a colorway of genuine complexity and material richness, each tone finding its specific home across the 3's elephant print overlays, midsole, and leather paneling in a way that rewards the close examination that premium Jordan releases deserve. The Jordan 3 holds a singular place in sneaker history as the first collaboration between Michael Jordan and Tinker Hatfield, the shoe that convinced Jordan to stay with Nike and that introduced the visible Air unit and the Jumpman logo that have defined the brand ever since. Premium colorways of this specific silhouette carry additional historical weight because they honor the design whose existence is responsible for the entire Jordan Brand legacy as we know it. At three hundred and fifty-five dollars the Bin23 premium tier pricing is justified by the material quality and construction precision that the designation demands from every piece produced under its elevated specification standard. The Air Jordan 3 Retro PRM Bin23 was released on June 13, 2026 with a retail price of $355.
Colorway: Team Red/Metallic Gold/Burgundy Crush/Coconut Milk/Smokey Mauve/Gym Red

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Playoffs (2022)
Description: In celebration of its 25th Anniversary, Jordan Brand brought back the shoe that Michael Jordan wore while winning his 5th NBA Title, the Air Jordan 12 Retro Playoffs. Debuted in 1997, the Air Jordan 12 Playoff captures Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls' dominance in the 1990s era of NBA basketball. This 2022 model sticks to the original design, featuring a black tumbled leather upper with a white textural mudguard and red Jumpman embroidery on the tongue. At the heel, a woven Jordan label and "23" text add subtle branding. At the base, a white sole with carbon fiber detailing completes the design. The Air Jordan 12 Playoffs released in March of 2022 and retailed for $210.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Medium Olive
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Medium Olive leans into understated confidence, using earthy tones to give the Jordan 1 Low OG a calm and refined presence. The medium olive upper paired with summit white and sail accents creates a grounded palette that feels natural and versatile. Its a colorway that highlights the silhouettes proportions and craftsmanship rather than relying on bold contrast or loud storytelling. Fans gravitate toward this release because it feels effortless. The OG low cut maintains its heritage credibility, while the olive tones make it easy to wear across seasons and styles. Collectors appreciate this pair as a reminder that the Jordan 1 doesnt need dramatic themes to feel special. Subtle color execution and strong design fundamentals are enough to make it a long term staple in any rotation. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Medium Olive was released on January 31, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: adidas Ultra Boost 1.0 Shadow Navy Grey Two
Description: The adidas Ultra Boost 10 Shadow Navy Grey Two represents a decade of adidas refining one of its most recognizable performance silhouettes. Shadow navy dominates the upper, giving the shoe a deep and composed look, while grey two details add contrast without breaking the flow. The streamlined construction feels purposeful, pairing a sleek visual identity with the familiar Ultra Boost DNA that made the line a staple across running and lifestyle culture. Fans connect with this model because it marks an evolution rather than a reset. The Ultra Boost 10 feels mature and confident, designed for those who appreciate consistency and comfort over hype driven change. Collectors value how the silhouette continues to adapt subtly, staying relevant through proportion and material updates instead of loud redesigns. It is a shoe that reflects longevity, built for people who have worn Ultra Boosts for years and continue to trust the formula. The adidas Ultra Boost 10 Shadow Navy Grey Two was released on December 25, 2023 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Showstopper
Description: Nike Ja 3 Mink Brown leans into understated confidence, offering a grounded colorway that feels mature without losing the edge that defines Ja Morants signature line. The warm brown tones give the shoe a lifestyle friendly look while still keeping its identity rooted in speed and aggression. It feels like a colorway designed for players who want something different without sacrificing performance energy. On court, the Ja 3 continues to reflect Morants explosive style, built for quick reactions and fearless movement. The Mink Brown palette adds versatility, making the shoe feel just as natural off court as it does during a run at the park. Fans appreciate this release because it expands the Ja line beyond loud statements, showing that subtle color choices can still carry strong personality and presence. The Nike Ja 3 Mink Brown was released on 10/15/2025 with a retail price of $125

Display Name: adidas Samba XLG Olive Strata Wonder Beige Gold Metallic
Description: The Adidas Samba XLG in Olive Strata, Wonder Beige, and Gold Metallic is a colorway that brings the earth tone sophistication and warm material intelligence that defined the most celebrated Samba releases of the mid 2020s into the XLG's maximized and proportionally ambitious silhouette, creating a shoe that sits at the intersection of heritage Samba color philosophy and contemporary platform sneaker scale in a combination that feels genuinely earned rather than simply trend driven. Olive strata is a color that operates in the richest and most complex range of the olive spectrum, with a depth and layered quality that the word strata captures perfectly, suggesting a color that reveals different tones and intensities depending on the light and angle from which it is viewed, and on the XLG's expanded upper surface that complexity has more room to develop and reward close examination than it would on a more compact silhouette. Wonder beige provides the warm and slightly creamy neutral counterpoint that prevents the olive from becoming too serious or monochromatic, introducing the same kind of earthy warmth that made beige and olive combinations so universally beloved across the Samba catalog's most celebrated seasonal colorways. Gold metallic as the third color element elevates this earth tone combination into something that feels genuinely premium and material sophisticated, introducing a shimmer and reflective quality to the detailing and overlay elements of the XLG that adds a luxury dimension to what might otherwise be a purely utilitarian and naturalistic palette. The combination of olive strata, wonder beige, and gold metallic on the XLG's larger sole unit and more architecturally ambitious silhouette creates a sneaker that works as beautifully with earth tone and neutral wardrobes as it does as a contrast element against darker or more monochromatic outfit choices. For collectors who were drawn to the olive and warm neutral Samba colorways of recent seasons and who want to experience that aesthetic in the XLG's maximized format, this olive strata, wonder beige, and gold metallic iteration is one of the most complete and satisfying expressions of that color philosophy the extended platform has produced. The Adidas Samba XLG in Olive Strata, Wonder Beige, and Gold Metallic was released on March 10, 2024 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro White Metallic (2026) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro White Metallic 2026 GS brings back one of the most recognizable Jordan 5 color schemes, leaning into a clean white upper paired with metallic silver detailing that defines the silhouette. The design stays true to the original blueprint, with sharp lines, reflective elements, and black accents that add depth without disrupting the simplicity. Even in grade school sizing, the shoe carries the same presence that made the model iconic in the first place. Collectors and fans appreciate how this release preserves the essence of the Jordan 5 while making it accessible to a new generation. The white and metallic combination has always been tied to standout moments in the lines history, and seeing it return in this format keeps that legacy active. It is a sneaker that balances nostalgia with continued relevance, offering a timeless look that still feels strong in any modern rotation. The Air Jordan 5 Retro White Metallic 2026 GS was released on April 25, 2026 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Virgil Abloh Archive Alaska
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High Virgil Abloh Archive Alaska continues the legacy of Virgil Ablohs transformative work on the Air Jordan 1, pushing his deconstructed design language into a new, all-white direction. Dressed entirely in white, the sneaker emphasizes exposed construction, layered materials, and the industrial detailing that defined Ablohs original Off-White collaboration from 2017. Virgil Ablohs approach to the Jordan 1 fundamentally reshaped how sneakers could be interpreted, blending fashion, art, and product design into one cohesive vision. The "Alaska" concept builds on that foundation, stripping the color palette back to its purest form while allowing stitching, text elements, and paneling to take center stage. It feels more archival than flashy, aligning with Ablohs broader philosophy of process and transparency. When the Air Jordan 1 Retro High Virgil Abloh Archive Alaska released, it retailed for $230 and dropped on April 3, 2026. As part of a continuing exploration of Virgils design legacy, this release reinforces the Air Jordan 1s place at the intersection of fashion and sneaker culture.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Wolf Grey (Women's)
Description: The women's Jordan 1 Low Wolf Grey (Women's) features a white leather upper with Wolf Grey Durabuck overlays and Swooshes. From there, a Jordan Wings logo on the heel and a translucent outsole adds the finishing touch. The women's Jordan 1 Low Wolf Grey (Women's) released in July of 2021 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: Vans Knu Skool Triple Black
Description: The Vans Knu Skool Triple Black adds an all-black colorway to the retro Vans Knu Skool silhouette. In fact, the only pop of color is the orangish hue of the rubber waffle outsole. The Triple Black Vans Knu Skool is a modern interpretation of the chunky skateboarding shoes from the 1990s with exaggerated proportions. Extra padding in the tongue and collar gives the sneaker a puffed-up appearance while preventing foot slippage and holding the heel down. The thick, black laces add another oversized feature and secure the front lace closure. Durable suede gives the sneaker a velvety appearance, while heel pull tabs help the wearer put on or take off the shoe. Our experts at StockX like the 3D molded Sidestripe, which represents a heritage feature seen on some of Vans most celebrated models. The Vans Knu Skool Triple Black was released on May 21, 2023, and sold for $75.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Birch Peacoat
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Birch Peacoat is a sneaker from the Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 series in a "Birch Peacoat" colorway. This Mexico 66 sneaker features a predominantly birch upper made of leather with suede overlays on the heel and forefoot panel. Peacoat accents on the signature Mexico 66 stripes on the sides and the Tiger branded heel tab contrast the upper. Other details include birch laces and Onitsuka Tiger branding on the tongue and insoles. Rounding out the design is a thin sole with AMPLIFOAM cushioning at the heel and an original outsole compound for extra grip. What our experts particularly love about this Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 sneaker is its iconic design and distinctive colorway. The timeless design and unique color scheme create a classic and versatile look, while the premium construction guarantees comfort and performance. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Birch Peacoat was released on August 1st, 2023, retailing at $130.

Display Name: adidas Ultra Boost 1.0 Core Black Cloud White (Women's)
Description: The adidas Ultra Boost 10 Core Black Cloud White Womens delivers a classic and versatile take on the silhouette through a timeless monochrome palette. The core black upper creates a sleek and understated base, while cloud white accents add contrast that highlights the structure. The Boost sole ensures comfort and responsiveness for everyday wear. Fans of the Ultra Boost line appreciate how black and white colorways remain essential for their adaptability and clean design. The simplicity makes it easy to style across different settings. It is a sneaker that reflects consistent performance and timeless adidas appeal.

Display Name: Vans Old Skool Black White
Description: If you are looking for a staple pair of black and white Vans for your rotation, the Vans Old Skool Black White is a popular choice. It arrives with a low-top black canvas upper with white leather Vans stripe detailing on lateral and medial sides. At the base, a white and gum waffle cup sole with a red, branded heel patch adds the finishing touch. This model of the Vans Old Skool Black White released in 2017 and retailed for $70.

Display Name: adidas Ultra Boost 1.0 White Collegiate Green Halo Silver
Description: The adidas Ultra Boost 10 White Collegiate Green Halo Silver celebrates a decade of one of adidas most influential running silhouettes with a clean colorway that highlights the models technical roots and everyday versatility. Crystal White Primeknit forms the foundation of the upper, while Collegiate Green accents and Halo Silver detailing give the shoe subtle contrast that keeps the look sporty and refined. The Ultra Boost line changed the direction of performance and lifestyle footwear when it first launched, and the tenth anniversary version carries that legacy forward through familiar cushioning, streamlined construction, and modern comfort focused design. Fans continue returning to Ultra Boost because the silhouette bridges performance running and casual wear better than almost any sneaker from its era. The responsive Boost midsole still delivers the soft underfoot feel that made the line famous, while the sock like fit keeps the shoe comfortable for long wear throughout the day. Collectors appreciate the Ultra Boost 10 because it reflects how adidas refined the original formula over time without losing the DNA that made the model such a cultural force during the height of knit runner popularity. The adidas Ultra Boost 10 White Collegiate Green Halo Silver was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined (GS)
Description: Step into a piece of basketball history with the Air Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined GS. This sneaker revisits the legendary Bred colorway, blending black, cement grey, varsity red, and summit white to create a look that's both classic and fresh. The "Bred Reimagined" offers a new take on a beloved silhouette, honoring the legacy of the renowned shoe while updating the classic nubuck upper with a new supple leather upper. The Air Jordan 4 Retro is known for its groundbreaking design and performance features, and the Bred Reimagined GS is no exception. Its durable construction and supportive fit make it ideal for everyday wear. The sneaker's iconic colorway and design elements preserve the essence of the original while offering a fresh twist with new materials. Having made its debut on February 17, 2024, with a retail price of $160, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined GS has been warmly received by Jordan enthusiasts and sneaker collectors. Its release has reaffirmed the enduring popularity of the Jordan brand and its ability to inspire both nostalgia and innovation. For those seeking to own a piece of sneaker history with a modern twist, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Bred Reimagined GS is an essential addition to your collection.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Light Orewood Baroque Brown (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Light Orewood Baroque Brown Womens delivers a clean and earthy take on the Dunk silhouette, pairing light orewood brown with deeper baroque brown tones for a layered and balanced look. The white accents help break up the palette, keeping the design fresh while still leaning into neutral territory. It stays true to the classic Dunk structure that has remained consistent over time. This pair stands out because of its versatility. The earthy tones make it easy to style across different outfits while still offering enough variation to feel distinct. It reflects how the Dunk continues to evolve through subtle color changes that keep the silhouette relevant. The Nike Dunk Low Light Orewood Baroque Brown Womens was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk High Run The Jewels
Description: The Nike SB Dunk High Run The Jewels come in an active pink and black color palette. The High Run Jewels The Nike SB Dunk's upper is crafted from a vibrant active pink suede material. The shoe features intricate details, including black overlays for contrast. The sneaker's cushioned midsole provides both cushioning and support. The shoe's outsole is created from a durable rubber material that provides grip and stability. The shoe features the trademark Nike Swoosh on the lateral sides and the signature Nike SB logo on the tongue. The Nike SB Dunk High Run The Jewels were released on April 20, 2023, and was available for a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Shox Ride 2 Light Bone Metallic Black
Description: The Nike Shox Ride 2 Light Bone Metallic Black blends early 2000s innovation with a refined neutral palette. Light Bone dominates the upper, contrasted by Black and Metallic Black detailing that sharpens the layered construction. The signature Shox columns in the heel remain the centerpiece, delivering that unmistakable mechanical bounce. Shox silhouettes have experienced a strong revival, especially among fans of retro tech runners. This Light Bone execution feels mature and wearable, allowing the distinctive heel tooling to shine without loud color interference. For collectors who appreciate futuristic cushioning wrapped in understated tones, this pair delivers both nostalgia and versatility. The Nike Shox Ride 2 Light Bone Metallic Black was released on September 5, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: adidas Superstar Vintage Bape Blue White
Description: The adidas Superstar Vintage Bape Blue White is a striking collaboration that merges classic design with streetwear flair. This iconic silhouette features a premium leather upper in a crisp white, accented by Bape's signature blue camouflage pattern on the iconic three stripes and heel tab. The shoe's timeless appeal is enhanced by the vintage-inspired off-white rubber sole, providing a subtle nod to the Superstar's rich heritage. Meticulous attention to detail is evident throughout, from the perforated three stripes to the gold foil Bape and adidas branding on the lateral side. The shell toe, a hallmark of the Superstar line, remains intact, offering both style and protection. This collaboration seamlessly blends adidas' sportswear legacy with Bape's street culture influence, resulting in a sneaker that's both nostalgic and contemporary. Our team thinks this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts looking to add a unique, limited-edition piece to their collection, perfect for making a statement in any casual outfit.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Silt Red Burgundy Crush (Women's)
Description: The Nike P 6000 Silt Red Burgundy Crush Womens brings rich seasonal tones to the nostalgic tech runner silhouette. Finished in Silt Red with Burgundy Ash and Burgundy Crush accents, the upper blends layered mesh and overlays that echo early millennium design cues. The sculpted sole keeps the look grounded in comfort and stability. The deep red palette feels warm and expressive, making it ideal for fall rotations. Burgundy hues add depth across the layered construction, creating a cohesive and bold finish. It stands as a statement colorway that merges performance heritage with contemporary street style appeal. The Nike P 6000 Silt Red Burgundy Crush Womens was released on November 5, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Spring Flowers (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Spring Flowers TD delivers a vibrant and seasonal take on the silhouette in a toddler sized format through a bold and layered color palette. Pearl pink creates a soft and playful base, while hyper orange and pink bloom accents add energy and contrast. Light aqua details introduce a cool balance, with sail tones grounding the overall design. Fans of expressive Jordan releases appreciate how this colorway brings a fresh and dynamic feel to the classic model. The combination of bright tones makes it visually engaging while still cohesive. It is a sneaker that reflects creativity and seasonal styling in a compact and wearable form. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Spring Flowers TD was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $80.
Colorway: Pearl Pink/Hyper Orange/Pink Bloom/Pink Glow/Light Aqua/Sail

Display Name: Timberland 6" Boot Black Nubuck Premium
Description: The Timberland 6-Inch Black Nubuck features a black Nubuck leather construction which comes from top-grain calfskin or cowhide. The leather is layered on the collar to create comfort and protect the feet from outside elements. Timberland also includes anti-fatigue technology that absorbs sudden impact and returns that energy to where it came from. The Timberland 6-Inch Black Nubuck released in January of 2018 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Analog
Description: Yeezy is back from his Sunday Service Coachella performance with this new adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Analog. This Yeezy Boost 700 comes with a beige upper plus grey accents, three grey adidas stripes, beige midsole plus grey accents, and a black sole. These sneakers released in April 2019 and retailed for $300. Buy this Yeezy 700 on StockX ASAP.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 21 Tahitian
Description: The Nike LeBron 21 Tahitian is a performance basketball shoe with a low-to-the-ground and lightweight design. It features iridescent details on the heel that resemble a Tahitian pearl and a rope pattern that mimics the patterns on the exterior of a clams shell. The black mesh upper boasts a series of perforations along the side panels that allow the foot to breathe and look like the veining on a clam shell. The quilted tongue also houses perforations and provides plush cushioning. A 360-degree zonal cabling system reinforces the mesh upper without weighing the shoe down. Zoom Air cushioning and foam in the midsole provide responsive cushioning underfoot, while the front lace system secures the fit. Our StockX experts like the way the iridescent green details on the heel match the green tones of the durable outsole. The Nike LeBron 21 Tahitian was released on November 3rd, 2023, and retailed at $200.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro DMP Gratitude (2023) (GS)
Description: Unleash the legend on the schoolyard with the Jordan 11 Retro DMP Defining Moments / Gratitude (GS). This Grade School iteration brings a slice of hoops history to the forefront, featuring the iconic Black/White/Metallic gold colorway that's been reimagined for the cool kids on the block. The patent leather shines bright, setting off the gold accents that are as much about winning as they are about style. The GS version isn't just a smaller size; it's a big statement. With the same meticulous design as the adult model, the GOLD Jumpman emblem and the heritage-rich '23' grace the heel, capturing the glory of the court. The GS model ensures the next generation can walk, run, and play in a sneaker that's built for champions. Drop the mundane and step into the extraordinary on December 9, 2023. Priced at $185, the Jordan 11 Retro DMP Defining Moments (GS) isn't just a sneakerit's a trophy for the feet, a celebration of Jordan's legacy.

Display Name: 361 Degrees BIG3 4.0 Quick Reverse
Description: The 361 Degrees BIG3 4.0 Quick Reverse is a performance basketball shoe created by the Chinese sportswear brand 361 Degrees. It features a mismatched colorway, with blue dominating the left shoe and pink covering the right shoe. The 4.0 version features several upgrades, including a full-length ENRG-X+ midsole for a springy feel underfoot. TPU panels reinforce the lightweight mesh upper at the heel and toe box and reduce rollover motions. Another important technical feature is the nylon anti-torsion piece beneath the midfoot, which provides rigid support. The Reverse 361 Degrees BIG3 4.0 Quick displays several design details that reinforce its reputation for speed, including a lightning bolt motif down the side panels in an off-white hue. Our experts at StockX like the grippy rubber outsole because it provides superior traction on indoor and outdoor basketball courts. The 361 Degrees BIG3 4.0 Quick Reverse was released on July 15, 2023, and sold for $130.

Display Name: Jordan 7 Retro Hare (2015)
Description: The Air Jordan 7 Retro Hare 2015 comes in a True Red-Light Silver-Tourmaline palette. This Retro Hare Air Jordan 7 sneaker features a light off-white nubuck, a white leather upper, an orange, green, and black neoprene heel underneath, a white midsole, and strong orange embellishments on the outsole. A large orange Jumpman logo on the side, a "23" patch on the heel tab, black stitched Air Jordan branding on the tongue patch and white laces to complete the look. The Air Jordan 7 Retro Hare 2015 was launched on the market on 16 May 2015, and originally retailed at the price of $190.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Larimar Blue Pure Silver (GS)
Description: The ASICS Gel 1130 Larimar Blue Pure Silver GS delivers bold contrast through a vibrant Larimar Blue upper accented by Pure Silver detailing. The mesh base and layered overlays highlight the models retro running DNA, while the metallic silver elements sharpen the overall profile. Built with signature GEL cushioning, the silhouette maintains its performance inspired foundation. This GS release stands out because it pairs energetic color with technical structure. The bright blue base commands attention, while silver accents keep the design balanced and dynamic. Younger sneaker fans get a performance driven silhouette that feels expressive and versatile. It is a confident take on the Gel 1130 that blends heritage runner aesthetics with modern street appeal. The ASICS Gel 1130 Larimar Blue Pure Silver GS was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $85.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial White Black Gum
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial White Black Gum is a classic sneaker that pays homage to adidas' rich heritage in handball footwear. This shoe features a clean and minimalist design, with an upper constructed from premium suede and leather. Classic adidas three-stripe branding is prominently displayed in black coloring on the sides, which pops against the predominantly white colorway. Black accents can also be found on the tongue and heel, over which additional branding elements can be found. A cushioned midsole provides support and shock absorption, ensuring all-day wear, while a padded collar and tongue add to the overall comfort of the shoe. The breathable lining helps to regulate the shoes internal temperature, keeping feet cool and dry. What our experts most appreciate about the adidas Handball Spezial White Black Gum, however, is its namesake gum rubber outsole, which provides excellent traction on a number of surfaces, which adds a touch of vintage flair to the shoe's design. This shoe retailed with an original price of $110 when it was released on July 15, 2023.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus White Barely Volt Black
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus in White, Volt, Barely Volt, and Black is a colorway that introduces the electric energy of volt into the platform's premium cushioned construction through a gradient-like tonal approach, the barely volt sitting between the clean white base and the more saturated volt accent in a way that creates chromatic depth across the upper without committing fully to the neon intensity that pure volt executions demand from the wearer. White provides the open and clean foundation that allows both volt tones to register with maximum clarity, while black arrives at the structural and outsole elements to ground the bright palette in the most authoritative and contrast-forward accent available. The three-tone volt and white relationship across the Vomero Plus's generous upper surface creates a shoe that reads as athletic and slightly electric without being visually overwhelming, the barely volt softening the transition between white and full volt in a way that feels deliberately considered rather than accidentally tonal. Volt accent colorways on premium cushioned running platforms consistently attract collectors who want the visual energy of Nike's most distinctive performance color applied to a wearing experience that delivers genuine daily comfort and material quality worthy of regular rotation.
