The Vomero Plus's substantial stack height and premium construction ensure this isn't a colorway-first acquisition where the shoe's design quality disappoints relative to its visual promise. Black and volt is one of the most historically successful and collector-beloved color combinations in Nike's entire performance catalog, and the barely volt addition creates a more nuanced and sophisticated version of that classic pairing. At one hundred and eighty dollars the Vomero Plus in White, Volt, and Barely Volt delivers premium cushioning alongside one of running lifestyle's most energetic and purposeful color stories. The Nike Vomero Plus in White, Volt, Barely Volt, and Black was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 40 White Black Photon Dust
Description: Put a spring in your step every day with the Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 40 White Black Photon Dust. A classic running shoe designed for ultimate comfort and support, break your personal best today. These slick Air Zoom Pegasus 40 sneakers are the perfect support shoe for sprints or marathons, with responsive cushioning and improved comfort on arches and toes. Adding stability to your run, these white, black, and photon dust grey have breathable mesh uppers, cushioned insoles, and rubber outsoles. The Swoosh sits on the inside of the shoe in black, while a grey outline of the Swoosh sits on the outside. The Pegasus 40 logo sits on the sides of the lace enclosure, while Air Zoom branding sits on the outer midsole. We love the understated, elegant design of these unisex Air Zooms. Slim-cut and lightweight, get ready for the most responsive run yet. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 40 White Black Photon Dust was released in April 2023, priced at $130.

Display Name: Nike Cryoshot Air Speed M Palace
Description: The Nike Cryoshot Air Speed M Palace is London-based skate label Palace's contribution to Nike's X2 World Cup collection, part of the seven-collaborator Cryoshot series representing their respective national football federations, with Palace representing England by transforming the archival Nike Air Speed M football boot into a lifestyle sneaker through the Cryoshot process. The Air Speed M, drawn from Nike's late 1980s football catalog, receives a premium leather upper in Black with White Swooshes and Crimson accent details referencing England's national team colors, semi-transparent TPU collar support, Palace branding on the tongue and heel, co-branded insoles, and the Cryoshot's defining translucent clear TPU injection-molded cage encasing the original boot's stud configuration underfoot so the studs remain visible and structurally present but the shoe can be worn on everyday surfaces without the pitch-specific performance limitations of genuine cleats. The Cryoshot format was developed by Nike Football and unveiled ahead of the 2025 UEFA Champions League Final as the technology that converts archival football boots into lifestyle sneakers by preserving the original outsole geometry within a transparent housing, creating wearable objects that function simultaneously as footwear and as physical archives of football boot history. Released June 12, 2026 via Palace, then June 16, 2026 via SNKRS and select retailers at $210 retail with style code IM0702-001. The Nike Cryoshot Air Speed M Palace was released on June 16, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Shox TL Pearl White (Women's)
Description: The Nike Shox TL Pearl White Womens takes the Shox concept further with a full length cushioning system that extends across the entire sole. The Pearl White and Soft Pearl tones give the sneaker a clean and almost futuristic look, while subtle Particle Pink accents add softness and contrast. The Shox TL stands out through its continuous column design, creating a silhouette that feels both technical and visually striking compared to other models in the lineup. Fans gravitate toward the Shox TL because it amplifies the defining elements of the Shox line into a more dramatic form. The full length cushioning system gives the shoe a unique bounce and structure, while the light color palette enhances its sleek appearance. The combination of white tones with soft accents makes it easy to style while still maintaining a distinct identity. For collectors, pairs like this represent the evolution of Nikes Shox technology into more expressive and fashion forward silhouettes that continue to stand out within sneaker culture. The Nike Shox TL Pearl White Womens was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Black
Description: Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Black feels like a bridge between skate history and Supremes early visual language, pulling inspiration from the mid nineties era that shaped both brands. The black upper gives the shoe a serious and raw tone, while the Supreme influence adds cultural weight that longtime fans instantly recognize. It feels rooted in authenticity rather than trend chasing, designed for people who understand where SB culture comes from. This release stands out because it honors restraint. Instead of loud graphics, the design relies on mood and legacy, letting subtle details do the storytelling. Collectors gravitate toward Supreme SB Dunks like this because they represent moments when skateboarding, fashion, and attitude aligned naturally, creating pieces that age with meaning rather than noise. The Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Black was released on 09/04/2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Kool-Aid (PS)
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Kool-Aid Preschool in Lemon Venom, Deep Royal Blue, Light Green Spark, and Light Photo Blue brings one of the most playful and visually joyful collaborative colorways in the Ja 3's release history to the smallest sizing tier, making Ja Morant's third signature shoe available to the youngest basketball enthusiasts in a color story that captures the bright and sugary energy of the Kool-Aid brand partnership with complete chromatic commitment and zero restraint. Lemon venom leads the palette with an acidic and attention-grabbing brightness while deep royal blue provides the grounding contrast, and light green spark and light photo blue arrive as the secondary accents that fill out the multi-color story in a way that feels genuinely aligned with the Kool-Aid visual identity's tradition of saturated and unapologetically vivid color combinations. The Preschool sizing brings all of that colorway enthusiasm to a scale that serves the youngest Ja Morant fans whose energy and enthusiasm for the sport typically matches or exceeds the adult collector community's most devoted members. Kool-Aid collaborations with performance athletic brands consistently work best when the color story commits fully to the sugary and bright palette that the beverage brand's visual identity is built around, and the Ja 3 execution in lemon venom and deep royal blue achieves exactly that level of chromatic commitment across a basketball shoe platform whose performance credentials make the playful colorway feel athletic rather than purely novelty driven. Preschool sizes of signature athlete basketball shoes carry a specific and warmly regarded place in the Jordan and Nike collector ecosystem as the most accessible and generationally inclusive expressions of signature shoe culture, bringing the full colorway story and brand identity to the smallest feet in the community. At ninety-seven dollars the Ja 3 Kool-Aid PS delivers the complete collaborative color story in preschool sizing at a price point appropriate for the youngest generation of basketball shoe enthusiasts. The Nike Ja 3 Kool-Aid PS was released on May 20, 2026 with a retail price of $97.
Colorway: Lemon Venom/Deep Royal Blue/Light Green Spark/Light Photo Blue

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG White Saffron Quartz Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG White Saffron Quartz Black delivers a brighter and more contrast driven look, pairing a white base with saffron quartz accents that stand out across the layered panels. Black detailing helps anchor the design, giving it a structured and balanced feel despite the lighter tones. The silhouette remains instantly recognizable from every angle. This pair stands out because it blends clean tones with vibrant highlights. The saffron accents bring energy without overwhelming the design, making it a versatile option that still carries personality. It is a fresh take on a classic model that continues to evolve through color. The Nike Air Max 95 OG White Saffron Quartz Black was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy QNTM Amber Tint
Description: The adidas Yeezy QNTM Amber Tint features a marbled Amber Tint Primeknit upper with grey heel wraps and black collars. Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro PRM Valentine's Day (2023)

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Obsidian Powder Blue White
Description: Jordan Brand added Charlotte Hornets flair to their Fall 2021 line-up with the Air Jordan 13 Obsidian. The Air Jordan 13 Obsidian arrives in similar color blocking as the renowned Jordan 13 He Got Game. It features a white tumbled leather upper with dark Obsidian underlays and a light blue Jumpman tongue embroidery. In traditional fashion, a holographic bubble on the ankle adds the finishing touch. Display Name: Nike SB Air Max 2 CB '94 Low Supreme White Gum
Description: The Nike SB Air Max 2 CB 94 Low Supreme White Gum delivers a more classic and wearable take on the collaboration, using a white upper paired with a gum outsole for a timeless look. Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Union Off Noir
Description: 2020 brings another Union LA collaboration with Jordan Brand with the Air Jordan 4 Union LA Off Noir. Display Name: New Balance 1890 Action Bronson Hornet Tusk
Description: The New Balance 1890 Action Bronson Brown Blue brings expressive color into a bold collaborative silhouette. The brown base provides earthy grounding, while vibrant blue accents inject dynamic contrast across the upper. Sculpted tooling and layered materials give the sneaker a futuristic feel, amplified by Action Bronsons creative direction. The mix of tones feels deliberate and confident rather than chaotic. Collectors of Action Bronson collaborations appreciate when color and personality drive the design, and this pair captures that energy. The brown and blue pairing stands out while remaining cohesive. It stands as a fearless interpretation of New Balance performance heritage. The New Balance 1890 Action Bronson Brown Blue was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: New Balance 997 MiUSA Concepts Montage
Description: The New Balance 997 MiUSA Concepts Montage feels like a celebration of color and collaboration layered onto a true heritage silhouette. Grey and Black ground the upper, while Yellow and Pink accents inject vibrant contrast that gives the shoe personality. The 997 shape remains sleek and refined, reinforcing its place as one of the most beloved Made in USA models. Concepts has built a reputation for storytelling driven collaborations, and the Montage theme feels expressive without compromising the 997 classic lines. The bold color pops bring energy to a traditionally understated silhouette, creating a balance between playful and polished. For fans of curated boutique partnerships, this pair stands out as a memorable fusion of craftsmanship and creativity. The New Balance 997 MiUSA Concepts Montage was released on December 18, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Chrome
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Chrome brings quick-reaction performance to the hardwood with a sleek, minimalist palette that pairs crisp white with polished chrome accents. Built for players who change pace and direction in a heartbeat, this low-top features responsive cushioning anchored by a full-length Zoom Air Strobel for instant energy return, layered over a plush drop-in midsole to keep you fresh deep into the fourth quarter. A contoured heel clip and lateral sidewall help lock in your foot on sharp cuts, while the lightweight textile upper promotes airflow and reduces weight without sacrificing support. The metallic Swoosh and subtle chrome details deliver a clean, modern finish that looks as sharp courtside as it does in motion. Underfoot, a precision-engineered traction pattern grips the floor for confident stops, starts, and step-backs on any surface. Strategic padding around the collar enhances comfort, and the low-profile design offers excellent court feel so you can read the defense and react faster. Thoughtful touches, like reinforced eyelets for durable lockdown and a smooth internal lining to minimize distractions, round out a shoe made for speed, stability, and all-game control. Whether youre running the pick-and-roll or spacing the floor, the Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Chrome blends high-caliber tech with streamlined style to elevate your game and your rotation. Our team loves this product because it combines explosive cushioning, secure containment, and a versatile white-and-chrome look that transitions seamlessly from intense runs to everyday wear.

Display Name: Nike Mac Attack QS SP Travis Scott Cactus Jack
Description: The Nike Mac Attack QS SP Travis Scott Cactus Jack is unveiled in an engaging Light Smoke Grey, Black, and White color combination, incorporating a mix of leather and mesh across its upper. The mesh is prominently featured on the vamp and side panels, while high-quality leather forms the majority of the shoes construction. This sneaker stands out with its gray and black color scheme, infused with the signature Travis Scott flair. The sneaker's standout feature is the iconic reverse Swoosh in black leather, adding a rebellious edge to its appearance. The Cactus Jack logo, embroidered on the spine, and a blue and black checkerboard pattern on the tongue tag add unique Travis Scott touches, completing the overall look. What sets this sneaker apart is its functional design and comfortable fit. It features a white rubber midsole and a grey outsole, ensuring durability and stability. The Travis Scott x Nike Mac Attack QS SP Cactus Jack is set to release on December 19, 2023, at a retail price of $120, offering a perfect blend of style and performance for sneaker enthusiasts.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Bred Velvet (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 11 Retro Bred Velvet (Women's) is an iteration of the classic "Bred" colorway on the iconic Jordan 11, this time with a velvet upper and in a women's exclusive size run. Last released in 2019, the Bred 11s are one of the most sought after retros, as they represent Michael Jordan's comeback to win his fourth NBA championship in 1996. This velvet version provides a lux alternative to the standard leather option that the 2019 version has. This sneaker has an all-black upper, white mid-sole, and red sole along with a red Jumpman logo on the outer heel. The Jordan 11 Retro Bred Velvet (Women's) released on November 11th, 2024, for a retail price of $230. We love this sneaker due to its luxury take on a classic sneaker, making it something you truly cannot go wrong with.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid TD Cleat Panda
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid-TD Cleat Panda is a high-top performance shoe engineered for speed, with the classic monochrome "Panda" color blocking.? ?? ?The Jordan 1 Mid-TD Cleat Panda elevates its design by incorporating key elements from the AJ1, including the synthetic leather details in the upper and Jet Black overlays that enhance durability against abrasion. The sneaker has football-inspired elements, including specific gridiron aesthetics underfoot, wide stud placement ensuring traction on the field, and an external midsole that provides long-lasting cushioning. These contrasting details serve as a finishing touch to the overall design and cater to the demands of football.? ?? ?A notable feature our shoe experts highlight about the Panda Air Jordan 1 mid-sneaker is the white tread on the outsole that distinguishes it from the low tops. Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 PRM Dirty Denim
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 PRM Mineral Slate is a sneaker with a Nike premium silhouette. The Nike Air Max 1 PRM has a combination of mineral slate, deep royal blue, and lemon wash colorways. The upper part is made of suede with a denim overlay with flat cotton laces. The sneaker has a padded collar and TPU eyelets with a Nike Air Max woven patch and two Swoosh details, one on the side panel and the other embroidered on the toe. The visible midsole has been yellowed and complements the gum outsole to display a clear faux-vintage vibe. The Nike Air Max 1 PRM Mineral Slate was released on the 26th of August retailing at $150.

Model: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson 23 OG Sole Canvas Low
Display Name: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson 23 OG Sole Canvas Low White
Description: The Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson 23 OG Sole Canvas Low features a distinctive sole design. The Japanese fashion brand Maison Mihara Yasuhiro is known for its experimental approach to footwear. Founder Mihara Yasuhiro's architectural background influences his unique approach to shoe design, and the brand has built a reputation for pushing boundaries since it was established in 2004. The Peterson 23 OG Sole Canvas Low reflects this ethos, featuring a combination of canvas and suede materials in a muted color scheme. This shoe has a unique rubber compound and tread pattern, paired with a canvas upper in a neutral color palette. Display Name: ASICS Gel-Cumulus 16 Earls
Description: The ASICS Gel-Cumulus 16 Earls is one of the most emotionally resonant sneaker collaborations of 2026, and understanding what is built into this shoe makes it one of those rare releases where the story behind the object is inseparable from the object itself. Earls Collection is an Australian menswear label and retail institution founded by former National Rugby League player Lewi Brown, who grew up in Belfast, Christchurch, New Zealand, before building a post-playing career as one of the most respected voices in Australian menswear. This collaboration with ASICS is a deeply personal trip home for Brown, a tribute to his childhood house, his father, and most specifically his mother, whose years of physical labor, butchering, and sheep shearing are encoded into every material decision on the shoe. The Coconut Milk woven mesh base reflects the knitting and fabric work his mother produced throughout his childhood, the pebbled SILKYWRAP ASICS Stripes in an aged, grainy texture represent the wear and experience accumulated through decades of demanding work, and the brown suede and leather overlays speak to family heritage and the warmth of belonging. Orange accents appear on the GEL cushioning pods, tongue tabs, and heel branding, while silver paneling cuts through the upper to tie the design back to the Gel-Cumulus lineage. The footbeds carry the most personal detail of all: a printed graphic reproduction of a rug from Brown's childhood home, a direct material translation of memory into the sole of the shoe. The pair arrives in a bespoke shoebox designed to reference Brown's Christchurch house, and the collaboration also extends to a matching LETHAL TESTIMONIAL 4 football boot honoring the Riccarton Knights, his local rugby club. This is Earls and ASICS' second collaboration, following their 2024 GT-2160 that explored M?ori cultural heritage and sold out immediately. Sneakers built on grief, love, and the specific textures of someone's mother's hands are not something the industry produces often enough. The Gel-Cumulus 16 Earls is proof that when the story is real and the materials answer to it honestly, the result is a shoe that carries weight no hype cycle can manufacture. The ASICS Gel-Cumulus 16 Earls was released on May 22, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Description: The New Balance 992 MiUSA Salehe Bembury Green brings expressive color and organic influence to a silhouette already steeped in heritage. Green tones sweep across the layered upper, contrasted by blue accents that add vibrancy and depth. The 992s chunky proportions and classic paneling provide the perfect canvas for Salehe Bemburys bold design perspective. Made in USA construction reinforces the premium feel and ties the collaboration back to New Balance legacy. Fans of both the 992 and Salehes work appreciate how this release feels energetic yet grounded in storytelling. The mix of green and blue delivers strong visual impact without losing the wearable appeal of the model. It stands as a continuation of the creative dialogue between designer and brand, merging archival running DNA with contemporary expression. The New Balance 992 MiUSA Salehe Bembury Green was released on February 12, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro SE Paris Olympics Wet Cement
Description: Celebrate classic style as sports enter the world stage with the Jordan 4 Retro SE Paris Olympics Wet Cement. This clean AJ4 delivers in the clutch, with a soft suede and smooth leather finish. The all-gray pair is fit for any occasion with its versatile monochromatic look. Originally debuting in 1989, the Jordan 4 has become a favorite among sneakerheads, with new and retro styles alike often selling out quickly at retailers. This particular AJ4 draws inspiration from the cobblestone streets of Paris, and is sure to remind seasoned sneakerheads of the grail-like AJ4 KAWS, which was released in 2017. The Jordan 4 Retro SE Paris Olympics Wet Cement released on July 27th, 2024, for a retail price of $225. Lock in one of the cleanest AJ4s ever today on StockX.

Display Name: NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Field Brown
Description: Tom Sachs is continuing his partnership with Nike into 2023 with a new release of the NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs in a Field Brown colorway. The Tom Sachs NikeCraft GPS silhouette was regarded as one of the best new models to release in 2022. The NikeCraft Tom Sachs General Purpose Shoe is made up of a rich suede and breathable mesh and comes in a Field Brown colorway. A white Nike branded tag sits on top of the brown tongue with a black pull loop located on the tongue and heel of the sneaker. The NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Field Brown released February 5, 2023, with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Fragment x Travis Scott Sail Military Blue (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Fragment x Travis Scott Sail Military Blue PS brings two powerhouse collaborators together on a scaled down version of one of the most talked about silhouettes in recent memory. Sail and Muslin create a soft neutral base, while Military Blue and Black accents add sharp contrast that mirrors the adult release. The reversed Swoosh detail remains the centerpiece, instantly recognizable even in preschool sizing. Travis Scott Jordan 1 Lows have built a reputation as modern grails, and the addition of Fragment influence only amplifies that energy. Even younger fans get to be part of the story with this PS edition, carrying the same design language that defined the original collaboration waves. For families who collect together, pairs like this hold extra meaning because they connect generations through shared hype and history. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Fragment x Travis Scott Sail Military Blue PS was released on November 15, 2025 with a retail price of $80.

Display Name: Nike ZoomX Vaporfly 3 Sail Guava Ice
Description: The Nike ZoomX Invincible Run 3 Sail Guava Ice blends soft color with modern performance design. Sail creates a calm and neutral base, while guava ice and crimson tint accents add warmth and personality. Black details sharpen the silhouette, allowing the sculpted form to feel controlled and intentional rather than playful. The overall look feels smooth and flowing, reflecting motion and stability through tone and proportion. This model connects with fans because it represents confidence in comfort and innovation. The Invincible line is known for pushing cushioning forward, and this colorway reinforces that future focused identity through a clean but expressive palette. Collectors appreciate how the design feels contemporary without chasing trends. It is a shoe that feels reassuring and energetic at once, built for long runs and everyday movement with equal confidence. The Nike ZoomX Invincible Run 3 Sail Guava Ice was released on October 15, 2024 with a retail price of $260.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 White Dusty Amethyst Photon Dust Light Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 White Dusty Amethyst Photon Dust Light Smoke Grey delivers a softer and more atmospheric take on the iconic runner. White panels keep the base crisp, while dusty amethyst introduces a muted pop of color that feels calm and expressive. Photon dust and light smoke grey tones blend seamlessly, creating a layered palette that emphasizes balance and refinement over contrast. Fans gravitate toward this pair because it highlights nuance in color rather than bold statements. The subdued tones make it easy to style, appealing to collectors who appreciate understated design that still feels thoughtful. It reinforces the Air Max 90s ability to adapt to modern aesthetics through subtle shifts, maintaining relevance by evolving gently rather than chasing trends. The Nike Air Max 90 White Dusty Amethyst Photon Dust Light Smoke Grey was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Vomero 18 Black Coconut Milk Light Iron Ore Summit White
Description: The Nike Vomero 18 Black Coconut Milk Light Iron Ore Summit White builds on the Vomero lines reputation for comfort, combining layered cushioning with a balanced and neutral color palette. The black base provides contrast, while Coconut Milk and Summit White soften the overall look. Light Iron Ore adds subtle depth across the upper, keeping the design cohesive. Fans gravitate toward the Vomero series because it consistently delivers on comfort without sacrificing style. This version reflects that balance, offering a colorway that works across different settings while maintaining performance roots. It is a dependable option for those who want a cushioned ride paired with a clean aesthetic. The Nike Vomero 18 Black Coconut Milk Light Iron Ore Summit White was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat (2025)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat (2025) brings back one of the most understated icons in the Jordan lineup. Covered entirely in black with subtle touches of light graphite, the sneaker lives up to its namesake, a nod to one of Michael Jordans own nicknames from his playing days. The soft nubuck upper and tonal detailing give it a refined, stealth-like presence that feels effortlessly cool no matter how its styled. Originally released in 2006, the "Black Cat" quickly earned a cult following for its minimalist design and unmatched versatility. The all-black finish strips the 4 down to its essentials, letting the shape and materials take center stage. For 2025, Jordan Brand brings back the clean construction fans have been waiting for, along with the "Nike Air" branding on the heel for an extra touch of authenticity that collectors love. When the Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat (2025) released, it retailed for $220 and dropped on November 28, 2025.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Premium Renegade
Description: The Nike Vomero Premium Renegade pushes the silhouette into a more expressive and layered direction, combining Cinnamon, Brown Basalt, and Bronze Eclipse tones for a rich and earthy foundation. Hits of Hyper Crimson and Team Orange add energy, creating contrast that brings the design to life. The premium execution gives the shoe a more elevated presence compared to standard releases. This pair stands out because it blends comfort focused construction with a bold and almost rugged color story. The mix of warm tones and brighter accents creates depth that feels intentional and dynamic. It appeals to collectors who want a performance inspired shoe that also carries strong visual personality. The Nike Vomero Premium Renegade was released on April 4, 2026 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Premium Light British Tan Velvet Brown
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Light British Tan Velvet Brown leans fully into earthy refinement, dressing the iconic runner in rich Light British Tan and deep Velvet Brown tones. Black accents cut through the warm palette, adding contrast that sharpens the layered upper. The classic Air Max 90 paneling remains untouched, allowing the color blocking and material choices to elevate the familiar silhouette. Earth tone executions always feel at home on the Air Max 90, a model known for balancing sport heritage with lifestyle versatility. The blend of tan and brown gives this pair a slightly rugged and almost workwear inspired feel without sacrificing its athletic roots. For fans who appreciate premium finishes on timeless shapes, this release delivers understated depth with everyday wearability. The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Light British Tan Velvet Brown was released on January 24, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low White Black
Description: The Jordan 1 Low White Black takes an iconic silhouette designed by Peter Moore and crafts it with unusual color blocking that makes this bold sneaker stand out. The White Black colorway of the Jordan 1 Low-Top features an upper constructed with white smooth leather and black tumbled leather. White smooth leather forms the base of the side panel, toecap, and overlays that adorn the toecap, midfoot, and eyestays. Black tumbled leather forms the padded collar to enhance ankle comfort and the overlays that form the heel counter and side-panel Nike Swoosh. Continuing this colorway, the laces are white, the sock liner is black, and the mesh tongue is white with a black lining. The white foam midsole encapsulates Air for springy cushion and support and the solid black rubber outsole features concentric circles, stars, and grooves that absorb shock and provide traction. Our favorite detail of this instantly classic sneaker is the Air Jordan Wings logo embroidered in white. The striking simplicity of this branding locks in the undeniable style of this shoe. The Jordan 1 Low White Black was released on December 12, 2023, for $115 retail.

Display Name: adidas Adiracer GT Bad Bunny x Mercedes AMG Branch Sand
Description: The adidas Adiracer GT Bad Bunny Branch Sand blends motorsport heritage with Bad Bunnys expressive design language in a colorway that feels earthy and intentional. Branch and sand tones give the upper a grounded and organic feel, while cinder accents add depth without breaking the flow. The streamlined Adiracer shape keeps the look sleek and low profile, creating a silhouette that feels fast even at rest. Fans appreciate this collaboration because it highlights Bad Bunnys ability to reinterpret adidas archives without losing authenticity. The muted palette feels mature and wearable, allowing the design details to shine quietly rather than loudly. Collectors see this pair as part of a larger creative arc between artist and brand, where heritage models are refreshed through thoughtful color and cultural relevance. It stands as a balanced crossover between racing roots and global music influence. The adidas Adiracer GT Bad Bunny Branch Sand was released on November 17, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Black University Gold
Description: Jordan Brand adds a fresh spin to a classic silhouette with the Jordan 12 Retro University Gold, now available on StockX. Although this colorway has never released to the public, it draws a close resemblance to the Jordan 12 Gary Payton PE that The Glove wore during his 2003-2004 season with the Los Angeles Lakers. The Jordan 12 University Gold features a black tumbled leather upper with University Gold overlays and accents. Jordan "Two Three" branding on the tongue and a yellow sole complete the design. These sneakers released in July of 2020 and retailed for $190 USD.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro SoleFly
Description: The Air Jordan 13 Retro SoleFly features a mix of three main colors: neutral grey, university blue, and white. This Retro Air Jordan 13 model features a suede and a ripstop nylon upper, as well as a soft, textured interior. The SoleFly logo strikes on the tongue, elephant-print insoles, as well as fabric loops at the forefoot are other features of this sneaker. A sole that is primarily colored in gum brown, and has AIR units, completes the appearance. The Air Jordan 13 Retro SoleFly was had a retail price of $200 during its debut on December 2nd, 2022.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Gatorade Like Mike White
Description: This Air Jordan 6 Retro is known as the "Like Mike" edition. A part of the "Gatorade" Collection, this pair comes in an all-new summit white, team orange and black colorway. Featuring similar color blocking to the original "Carmines," this pair sports a white leather and orange nubuck upper. Custom lace locks, black accents and small hits of green found on the branding throughout tie everything together. Their release date was October 28th, 2017 where they were available at select Jordan Brand retailers worldwide. They came in men's sizes, priced at $190 as well as gradeschool for $140. One of the most popular Jordan releases of 2017, the Gatorade-themed "Like Mike" Air Jordan 6 Retro is another must-have. If you're looking for a pair, their are plenty to choose from online. Those that have one to sell can hit up the marketplace to see what this Air Jordan 6 Retro is currently going for.

Display Name: adidas BW Army Hartcopy Muted Grey
Description: The adidas BW Army Hartcopy Muted Grey offers a softer and more tonal take on the classic BW Army silhouette, using a muted grey gum colorway that emphasizes subtlety and versatility. The premium upper keeps the design clean, allowing the shape and proportions of the shoe to stand out without distraction. It feels understated in a way that resonates with collectors who appreciate quiet design over loud statements. This version stands out because it captures the essence of the original while shifting the mood through color. The Hartcopy collaboration brings a sense of intention and curation, giving the sneaker a slightly elevated feel within the realm of classic trainers. It is the kind of pair that works effortlessly across different outfits and seasons, reinforcing its value as both a wearable staple and a collector piece. The adidas BW Army Hartcopy Muted Grey was released on April 10, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Aluminum Wonder Beige (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Aluminum Wonder Beige (Women's) is a shoe made for women that was originally for indoor sports but has now become a lifestyle staple. This version of the adidas Handball Spezial has an upper made of nubuck leather in a light beige color. Suede overlays form the heel counter and the t-shaped toe cap in the same earthy beige tone. The adidas three stripes that appear on each side come in a slightly darker Aluminum beige color, and the Spezial brand name along with the trefoil logo are found in shiny gold letters on the lateral side. The plain heel counter matches the coloring of the adidas stripes. The tongue contains a subtle branding patch, while the midsole and outsole are gum rubber. What stands out about this sneaker is the neutral, earthy tone of the colorway, which allows it to be worn with any outfit. The adidas Handball Spezial Aluminum Wonder Beige (Women's) was released on December 1, 2024, for $110.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Ox
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Ox Comme des Garcons PLAY Black
Description: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70s Ox Comme des Garcons PLAY Black is a model of the iconic collaboration between Comme des Garcons, a Japanese Brand, and Converse. Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70s Ox Comme des Garcons PLAY Black features a canvas upper. It also features contrasting lace colorways and white seams. On the side, it features the famous red heart and a silhouette that ends on the cream-colored sole. Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70s Ox Comme des Garcons PLAY Black was released in July 2017 and had a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Element Low A/T Phantom Sail
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Element Low A T Phantom Sail brings a more functional and weather ready twist to the classic Jordan 1 low silhouette. The phantom and sail tones create a muted and versatile palette, while subtle material updates give the shoe a slightly more technical feel compared to standard versions. It keeps the familiar shape intact while introducing a different kind of utility. What makes this pair stand out is how it blends everyday wearability with a more rugged edge. The low profile design remains easy to style, while the updated construction gives it added purpose beyond just aesthetics. It is a version of the Jordan 1 that feels adaptable, offering something new without losing its core identity. The Air Jordan 1 Element Low A T Phantom Sail was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $205.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Flint Grey French Blue (2026) (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 9 Retro French Blue 2026 PS brings crisp contrast to the iconic silhouette through a White leather upper accented by French Blue and Flint Grey. The AJ9s distinctive paneling and sculpted midsole remain intact, delivering the same structured presence that defined its original era. Even in preschool sizing, the layered color blocking highlights the models sleek and slightly understated design language. This release stands out because it pairs classic white and blue tones with the Jordan 9s unique global inspired identity. The French Blue accents add sharp depth against the clean base, while grey details ground the look. Younger fans get a heritage driven colorway that feels both nostalgic and versatile. It is a faithful adaptation of a timeless palette built for the next generation. The Air Jordan 9 Retro French Blue 2026 PS was released on January 24, 2026 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Low Preloved Lime
Description: The adidas AE 1 Low Preloved Lime captures Anthony Edwards fearless on court personality through bold color and confident form. Preloved lime dominates the upper, immediately drawing attention, while core black and pure teal accents add depth and balance. The low cut shape feels aggressive and agile, giving the shoe a fast and modern presence that mirrors Edwards playing style. It looks built for momentum. Fans connect with this colorway because it feels unapologetic and young, much like the athlete behind it. This shoe represents adidas leaning into the future of basketball rather than relying on retro storytelling. Collectors see the AE line as the start of something long term, and this colorway stands out as one of the most expressive yet. It feels like a snapshot of a rising star defining his own lane. The adidas AE 1 Low Preloved Lime was released on July 19, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro World's Best Dad (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro World's Best Dad in Preschool sizing features a Sail tumbled leather upper with black accents on the collar, lace unit, and midsole, with the shoe's most distinctive design detail being the elephant print panels on the toe and heel replaced by a warm Palomino brown jacquard textile that replicates the carpet pattern from the Chicago Bulls' locker room floor where Michael Jordan collapsed in tears clutching the game ball after winning the 1996 NBA Finals on Father's Day  his first championship following the 1993 murder of his father James Jordan Sr. University Red appears on the Jumpman branding on the tongue and the bottom eyelets, with a red outsole echoing the Bulls' palette, connecting the colorway to both the Bred 11s Jordan wore during that 1996 Finals and the broader Chicago Bulls color identity of Jordan's championship era. The shoe also includes "World's Best Dad" embroidered on the inner tongue and a commemorative Father's Day card included with the packaging, making it one of the more narratively complete and emotionally resonant Jordan Brand packaging experiences in recent memory. Released May 16, 2026 at $95 retail in Preschool sizing via Nike and select Jordan Brand retailers globally with style code IF4396-103. The Air Jordan 3 Retro World's Best Dad PS was released on May 16, 2026 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Sasquatch
Description: Since its release, Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Sasquatch remains of the highest-selling variants in the Crocs catalog. The construction of Pollex Clog mainly utilizes croslite material. These Crocs come in an attractive sasquatch black colorway and feature a heel attached to the optional sport mode for great fitting. The upper part is perforated to enhance its breathability and allow the shedding of water and other particles, such as debris, from inside the Crocs. The Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Sasquatch was released on September 22, 2022. At the time of the release, its retail price was $85.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Shattered Backboard
Description: After a history of appearing on popular Jordan 1s, the renowned Shattered Backboard colorway made its way to the Jordan 5 for the Air Jordan 5 Shattered Backboard. Like other Shattered Backboard releases, white, orange, and black are prominent in the design's color-blocking. Instead of utilizing signature Jordan 5 netted inserts on the quarter and tongue, the Shattered Backboard opts for a translucent mesh that also appears on the collar. Metallic shark-tooth details on the midsole and a semi-translucent outsole add the finishing touches. The Air Jordan 5 Shattered Backboard released in October of 2021 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Tie Dye (Women's)
Description: Jordan Brand adds a psychedelic twist to a classic silhouette with the women's Jordan 1 Retro High Tie Dye (W), now available on StockX. This release is a womens exclusive, similar to the Jordan 1 Satin Shattered Backboard (W) and Jordan 1 Satin Black Toe (W). The Jwomen's ordan 1 Retro High Tie Dye (W) consists of a white and black leather upper with blue and green tie-dye print leather overlays. A black Swoosh, white midsole, and black outsole complete the design. The Jordan 1 Tie Dye (W) released in June of 2020 and retailed for $170 USD.

Display Name: Birkenstock Arizona Birko-Flor Black
Description: The Birkenstock Arizona Birko-Flor Black is an iconic slip-on silhouette that is suitable for all occasions from the Birkenstock brands Arizona line in a black color palette. The Arizona silhouette from the German footwear brand Birkenstock sports a timeless, effortless design. Boasting two adjustable black straps made out of the companys proprietary material Birko-Flor, youll also spot branding on metal pin buckles. The footbed fits the foot anatomically and the insole is made out of quality natural leather. The insole sits atop a cork footbed, which in turns sits upon an EVA outsole. Durable yet lightweight, this slip-on is convenient for indoor and outdoor use. Additional Birkenstock branding is seen on the insole along with the phrase "Made in Germany." Our experts feel that this two-strap sandals casual and comfy aesthetic is synonymous with the Birkenstock brand and their cult-classic designs. When the Birkenstock Arizona Birko-Flor Black colorway hit the shelves on February 8, 2024, it retailed for $110.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL Pharrell Williams Humanrace Preloved Brown
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL Pharrell Williams Humanrace Preloved Brown delivers a grounded and culturally driven take on the performance silhouette through a rich and earthy palette. Preloved brown dominates the upper, creating a warm and cohesive look, while red accents add contrast that highlights key design elements. The Humanrace influence brings a more expressive and thoughtful perspective to the streamlined structure. Fans of Pharrell collaborations appreciate how this pair blends performance with cultural identity, using color and tone to create meaning without overwhelming the design. The balance between subtlety and contrast gives it a distinct presence. It is a sneaker that reflects creativity, purpose, and modern performance design. The adidas Adizero Evo SL Pharrell Williams Humanrace Preloved Brown was released on November 8, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High CO.JP Neutral Grey (2020)
Description: For the first time since 2001, Jordan Brand has brought back the Air Jordan 1 Retro High CO Japan Neutral Grey, now available on StockX. The Air Jordan 1 CO.JP originally released as a Japanese exclusive in very limited quantities. Only 2,001 pairs were released in the Neutral Grey colorway while other colorways were produced as an edition of 3,000. After 20 years, the CO.JP was reborn and finally released globally. The Air Jordan 1 CO Japan Neutral Grey features a grey suede and silver leather upper with a bubble "Wings" stamp just like the 2001 version. The main difference between the 2020 iteration and its predecessor is in the tongue, where the updated pair features "Nike Air" embroidered on the tongue instead of the 2001s Jumpman tag. The Air Jordan 1 CO Japan Neutral Grey released in August of 2020 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro White Stealth (2021)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Stealth pays homage to the original Stealth colorway from 2006. This Stealth drop marks the third appearance of the 1989 Jordan 5 model in 2021, introducing a spring-ready predecessor from Februarys Anthracite 5. The Air Jordan 5 Stealth features subtle changes that differentiate it from the 2006 version. The midsole features a grey base with black accents hit with blue splatter paint, contrasting the blue spikes on the OG pair. Other noticeable differences include a new black embroidered Jumpman on the heel and black lining behind the classic reflective tongue. Outside of those additions, the 2021 Stealth brings familiar elements to the 15-year-old release, with a white tumbled leather upper and translucent rubber mesh on the panels for breathability. The Air Jordan 5 Stealth released March of 2021 for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Travis Scott Neutral Olive
Description: Indulge in the golf course's lush greens with the Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Travis Scott Neutral Olive, a stellar collaboration between the iconic Jordan brand and the renowned rapper, Travis Scott. This is the first-ever golf shoe collaboration between Jordan and Travis Scott, making it a rare treasure in the sneaker community. Reflecting Cactus Jacks signature earth-toned color palette, this sneaker captivates the crowd with its olive green shade harmoniously blended with sail-tinted leather overlays, a contrasting black reverse Swoosh logo, and subtle touches of bright volt green on the tongue label and heel logo. Crafted for golf enthusiasts, yet with a design that resonates with every sneakerhead, this pair is tailored for the greens with altered traction and hardened rubber. However, the cool and casual vibe it carries makes it suitable for off-the-green casual struts, giving Travis Scott fans a chance to sport these beauties anytime, anywhere. Dropped on October 13, 2023, at a retail price of $170, the Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Travis Scott Neutral Olive is not just a pair of sneakers; it's a statement of style, comfort, and unrivaled collaboration between sportswear and music royalty.

Display Name: Li-Ning Way of Wade 10 Low Family Love
Description: The Li Ning Way of Wade 10 Low Family Love brings warmth and sentiment into a sleek performance silhouette. The pink upper creates a bold and expressive foundation, giving the shoe immediate personality while preserving its streamlined construction. The low cut design emphasizes speed and agility, allowing the color to shine without competing against bulky structure. Fans connect with this release because the Family Love theme adds emotional depth to the Way of Wade 10 line. The pink execution feels celebratory and meaningful, standing apart from more traditional basketball palettes. Collectors appreciate how the silhouette remains performance driven while carrying a clear narrative. It stands as a vibrant and heartfelt entry in the Wade catalog, blending personal storytelling with modern court ready design. The Li Ning Way of Wade 10 Low Family Love was released on July 19, 2025 with a retail price of $199.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Low Easter (2021)
Description: Jordan Brand dropped off the Air Jordan 12 Low Easter just in time for Easter Sunday in 2021. This low-cut version of one of Jumpmans most storied silhouettes offers a clean, all-white look that is geared for the streets and Sunday dinner. The Air Jordan 12 Low Easter features an all-white smooth leather paneled upper with tumbled leather mudguards and iridescent detailing. Jumpman logos and "TWO 3" are embroidered on each shoes tumbled leather tongue. Other details on this Jordan 12 Low include a black textile heel tab, pink insoles, white midsole, and an "icy" blue translucent outsole. The Air Jordan 12 Low Easter released in April of 2021 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Dark Powder Blue
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG UNC arrives with a white leather upper with contrasting black overlays and a University blue Swoosh. This sneaker comes in a combination of white, dark powder blue, and black hues. This Retro Low OG UNC model also features a black Wings Nike logo on its heel. Lastly, there is a black woven tongue and a blue outer sole that completes its design. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG UNC was first released on 29th July 2022. At the time, this sneaker had a suggested retail price set at $130.

Display Name: Gucci Pursuit Pool Slides White
Description: The Gucci Pursuit Pool Slides White are a sleek and stylish addition to any summer wardrobe. These slides feature a white rubber sole with a Gucci logo embossed on the side, and a white strap with the iconic Gucci green and red stripe. The strap is made of a durable and comfortable rubber material, perfect for wearing by the pool or at the beach. Released on July 22, 2015, these slides have become a popular choice for those looking for a high-end pool shoe. The retail price of $210 reflects the quality and craftsmanship that goes into each pair. Something we love about Gucci Pursuit Pool Slides White is their versatility. They can be dressed up or down, making them a great choice for any occasion. Our experts think the standout feature of the Gucci Pursuit Pool Slides White is the attention to detail in the design, from the embossed logo to the signature stripe. Overall, we love the combination of style and functionality that these slides offer.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Valentine's Day (2026) (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Valentines Day 2026 PS brings playful contrast to the iconic silhouette through a White base accented by Medium Soft Pink, Half Blue, and Vapor Green. The classic AJ4 structure remains intact, from the signature netting to the sculpted midsole, while the pastel palette introduces a festive and youthful feel. The layered colors add dimension without overwhelming the familiar design lines. This preschool release stands out because it balances seasonal charm with heritage authenticity. The mix of pink and soft blue tones feels bright yet wearable, keeping the silhouette versatile beyond the holiday theme. Younger fans get a fresh take on one of the most celebrated Jordan models, delivered in a colorway that feels expressive and fun. It is a thoughtful update that keeps the AJ4 legacy vibrant for the next generation. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Valentines Day 2026 PS was released on February 21, 2026 with a retail price of $105.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Scarlet Gum
Description: Inspired by indoor sports, the adidas Handball Spezial Scarlet Gum is a retro-inspired sneaker from the adidas Handball lineup in a "Spezial Scarlet Gum" colorway. This adidas Handball Spezial sneaker features a Scarlet Red soft suede upper with contrasting hits of white on the jagged edge three stripes branding, branded tongue tag, and heel collar panel. Metallic Gold accents on the "SPEZIAL" Trefoil branding on the lateral next to the three stripes and the adidas branding on the tongue tag add more contrasting hues to the upper. The iconic T-toe overlay appears on the toe and forefoot. A white branded insole, Scarlet Red round laces, and a Gum sole unit round out the design. What our experts particularly love about this adidas Handball Spezial offering is its upper construction and color scheme. The eye-catching color combination and premium materials contribute to its unique and stylish appearance. The adidas Handball Spezial Scarlet Gum was released on July 10th, 2023, retailing at $110.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Mineral Beige Pink
Description: The ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Mineral Beige Pink is a technical running shoe that finds inspiration in heritage and contemporary ASICS models, including the Gel-Nimbus 3 from the 2000s and the Gel-MC Plus V. The upper construction of the Cream Mineral Beige Pink ASICS Gel-NYC features breathable mesh with a medium-sized weave in cream and a grid of suede and leather overlays in Mineral Beige and metallic silver across the side panels. Although the upper takes elements from the Gel-Nimbus 3, the midsole combines advanced underfoot technology from the Gel-Cumulus 16. The use of gel inserts in the rear and forefoot as well as a combination of foams creates a responsive feel and protects against impact stress. Something our experts at StockX love is the pink suede panels that form the mudguard and adorn the toecap area. They complement the pink detailing on the midsole and add a contemporary touch to the sneakers retro construction. The ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Mineral Beige Pink was released on May 1, 2024, and retailed at $130.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE White Cave Stone
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid SE White Cave Stone is a mid-top silhouette featuring a clean, natural-toned aesthetic accented by contrasting dark details. The shoe features White, Cave Stone, Dark Sulfur, and Oil Grey. The leather upper utilizes a clean White base, allowing the contrasting overlays to define the silhouette. The mid-cut profile provides essential ankle support and maintains the Jordan 1's court DNA. Slated for release on August 20, 2025, this versatile model carries a retail price of $140. The subtle, earthy hue of Cave Stone is complemented by the deep accents of Oil Grey and a vibrant pop of Dark Sulfur on the tongue. This design successfully blends traditional leather construction with a sophisticated, contemporary color palette. Our experts value the supportive structure of the mid-top silhouette, beautifully detailed with the subtle Cave Stone overlays and the contrasting Dark Sulfur accent.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Iridescent Pack
Description: The Salomon XT 6 Iridescent Pack reimagines one of the brands most iconic trail silhouettes through a finish that shifts with light and movement. The black base is layered with iridescent detailing that adds a dynamic and almost futuristic effect, giving the shoe a distinct presence. The structure remains rooted in performance, with a design built for stability and durability. Collectors are drawn to this release because it combines technical credibility with a more experimental visual approach. The XT 6 continues to bridge outdoor function and streetwear appeal, and this version highlights that crossover clearly. It is a pair that stands out both on the trail and in everyday settings. The Salomon XT 6 Iridescent Pack was released on March 15, 2024 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Pollen (GS)
Description: This Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Pollen (GS) reimagines the 85 "Iowa" Dunk color scheme from the original Be True to Your School collection. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Pollen (GS) upper is crafted from black tumble leather, overlaid by a contrasting smooth Pollen leather, including the Swoosh and laces. The sneaker has the standard perforations for breathability, a black Air Jordan wing logo, and a white midsole for cushioning. The sneaker is finished off with a concentric Pollen rubber outsole providing traction. The grade school-sized Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Pollen (GS) was released in August 2021 and retailed for $130.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Animal Instinct (Women's)
Description: The women's exclusive Air Jordan 11 Animal Instinct (W) features a muted black Durabuck upper with animal print faux fur overlays. Metallic Jumpman logos and semi translucent outsoles add key elements true to the origins of the Jordan 11 design. The Air Jordan 11 Animal Instinct (W) released in November of 2021 and retailed for $225.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Wheat (2023)
Description: Relive the glory of an icon with the Jordan 13 Retro "Wheat". This 2023 rendition pays homage to the silhouette's storied past, bringing back the famed wheat colorway first introduced in 2004. Tumbled leather uppers, crisply dressed in white, are accented by nubuck overlays in a workwear-associated wheat tone, delivering a striking contrast and undeniable style. The Jordan 13 Retro "Wheat" stays true to its roots, featuring signature holograms at the heel and the Jumpman logo on the tongue. These authentic details are a nod to the original, celebrated specifications that have made the Jordan 13 a beloved staple in sneaker history. The upcoming release mirrors its nearly two-decade-old predecessor while ensuring a fresh look. Mark your calendar for November 21, 2023, as the iconic Jordan 13 Retro "Wheat" hits the shelves. Retailing at $200, this sneaker is a piece of Jordan Brand heritage reimagined for the modern connoisseur. Don't miss out on the chance to own a part of sneaker legend.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low USC
Description: Nike has done it again with the Nike Dunk Low USC, code style DD1391-602 sneaker design featuring the University of Southern California Trojans' official colors. Nike Dunk Low USC is constructed of leather material on the upper and rubber on the outsole. Nike Dunk Low USC features a colorway composed of white, gym red, and yellow covering 90% of the upper, with yellow Nike branding at the heel and tongue. A white perforated vamp and a red suede Swoosh complete the design of this sneaker. Nike Dunk Low USC was released at a retail price of $100 on November 9, 2022.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Taxi (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Yellow Toe GS was designed by Peter Moore and added to the "Bred Toe" series. ?? ?The Retro High OG Air Jordans for grade-schoolers have an upper built of leather material with a Taxi yellow toe box contrasting the black and Taxi heel and forefoot overlays. The shoe has rubber cup-soles for extra comfort along with a lightweight polyurethane Air-sole heel design. The retro Wings logo on the lateral ankle and Nike Air branding on the sneaker tongue complete the look of these shoes. ? ?The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Yellow Toe GS was released in September 2022 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max LTD 3 White Black Cool Grey
Description: The Nike Air Max LTD 3 White Black Cool Grey is the most classically versatile and most universally wearable colorway in the Air Max LTD 3 catalog, a White-based execution of the heritage running silhouette that pairs a clean smooth leather upper with Black and Cool Grey tonal accents to deliver the kind of clean, three-color combination that works effortlessly against the broadest possible range of outfits and occasions. The Air Max LTD 3, a silhouette that builds on the Air Max LTD lineage with smooth leather uppers and stitched overlays designed to age toward a soft, worn-in perfection, occupies a specific position in Nike's Air Max catalog as the model that most directly delivers everyday comfort through premium materials and the visible Max Air heel unit at a price point that keeps the silhouette accessible relative to the brand's more limited or collaborative offerings. The smooth leather construction on a White base brings a dressed-up quality to a running-heritage silhouette that makes the LTD 3 appropriate for casual contexts where other, more technical Air Max models might read as too athletic, while the Black and Cool Grey accents through the Swoosh, overlays, and outsole provide the grounding contrast that keeps the White-based colorway from reading as too sterile or clinical. The visible Max Air heel unit provides unbelievable cushioning originally developed for performance running and now appreciated primarily for the all-day comfort it brings to a lifestyle-worn shoe, complemented by a foam midsole, mesh lining, and flex-grooved rubber outsole that promotes full range of motion. Style code 687977-105. The Nike Air Max LTD 3 White Black Cool Grey is the heritage running lifestyle sneaker for the wearer who wants the LTD 3's smooth leather construction and Max Air comfort in the most broadly applicable and most styling-flexible colorway the silhouette offers. The Nike Air Max LTD 3 White Black Cool Grey was released on November 20, 2023 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Howard University
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Howard University is a special edition sneaker paying homage to the rich history and cultural significance of Howard University. Featuring a bold colorway of white, gym red, midnight navy, neutral grey, sail, and muslin, this release celebrates the iconic HBCUs legacy while delivering a fresh look to the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG silhouette. The mix of colors represents school pride, blending classic Air Jordan styling with Howards vibrant spirit. This pair showcases the familiar low-cut design, making it perfect for both casual wear and collectors alike. The premium leather construction and signature Nike Air branding give this sneaker a timeless appeal, while the Howard University-inspired color scheme & small embroidered red Nike swoosh on the mudguard adds a unique touch to the design. Released on October 12, 2024, the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Howard University retailed for $140. With its tribute to one of the most influential HBCUs and its stylish colorway, this release is a must-have for both Jordan fans and those looking to celebrate Howards legacy.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium White Volt Black
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium White Volt Black pushes the Pegasus line into a more elevated and performance focused space through premium materials and bold color contrast. The White and Off White base creates a clean foundation, while Volt and Black accents add energy that highlights the shoes structure. The Premium designation reflects Nikes effort to refine one of its most consistent silhouettes with enhanced detailing and a more polished overall look. Fans gravitate toward premium versions because they offer a more refined take on familiar performance models. The Volt accents bring a bright and modern feel that stands out against the neutral base, giving the shoe a dynamic visual presence. The Pegasus line continues to serve as a go to option for both runners and casual wearers due to its balance of comfort and style. For collectors, pairs like this demonstrate how Nike continues evolving core models by introducing higher end materials and more expressive color combinations. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium White Volt Black was released in 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Harbor Grey
Description: The New Balance 1906R Harbor Gray is a running shoe with a design inspired by the fashion era of the early 2000s. This iteration of the New Balance 1906R is made with a mesh upper in dark gray. Synthetic overlays in metallic silver cross the entire upper, rounding out the toebox, crossing the midsole, and running up under the top of the heel. The New Balance N adorns both sides under the laces in a 3D paneled design with N-Lock branding appearing in the middle. 1906R branding can be found on the overlay on the lateral side of the heel. The heel is also supported by a silver TPU cage, which sports the NB logo. Another logo can be found on the tongue, while a patterned gray outsole completes the look. What we like best about this shoe is the technological enhancements, like N-ergy and ABZORB cushioning, which improve the functionality of the shoe. The New Balance 1906R Harbor Gray was released on January 15, 2024, for a price of $155.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Low Year of the Snake
Description: The adidas AE 1 Low Year of the Snake is a performance shoe thatÄôs part of the Anthony Edwards line, whose design celebrates the Year of the Snake on the Chinese calendar. The Year of the Snake adidas AE 1 Low has a snake-inspired mesh upper, appearing in Core Black. The shoe has the TPU supports with the honeycomb texture that has become synonymous with this model. However, this version sports an iridescent hue inspired by the camouflaged nature of some snakesÄô skin. The adidas logo is seen on the heel in a bright fuchsia color, as well as on the tongue. The shoe has heel and tongue pull tabs for easy on and off, while an iridescent outsole completes the look. Our favorite thing about this shoe is the complete commitment to the snake-inspired design throughout the mesh and TPU support elements. The adidas AE 1 Low Year of the Snake was released on January 18, 2025, for $120.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Raging Bull Red (2021) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Raging Bulls Red 2021 GS features a Varsity Red suede upper with quarter panel netting on the side wall. A red-on-red embroidered number 23, black leather molded eyelets, red laces, and a silver tongue edged with black complete the look. The outer sole is gray, black, and white. The midsole is black with jagged splashes of white and red and visible air cushioning. Iconic Jumpman logos appear on the tongue, heel, and outer sole. This grade-school-sized Air Jordan 5 Retro Raging Bulls Red 2021 GS was released on April 10, 2021 at a retail price of $140.

Display Name: New Balance 204L Cortado
Description: The New Balance 204L Cortado brings a quieter and more refined approach to the brands lifestyle lineup, focusing on subtle tones and clean construction. The cortado colorway feels warm and understated, drawing inspiration from coffee inspired hues that translate easily into everyday wear. The silhouette itself leans minimal, allowing the color and material quality to define the overall experience. This pair resonates with those who appreciate simplicity done right. It does not rely on bold contrasts or aggressive design choices, instead offering a calm and cohesive look that fits naturally into a wide range of outfits. New Balance continues to show that not every release needs to push boundaries to feel relevant, sometimes consistency and execution are enough to carry a shoe. The New Balance 204L Cortado was released on January 2, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Black Silver Grey
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Black Silver Grey leans into a classic running aesthetic with a color palette that highlights the shoes layered construction. The black base creates depth, while silver and grey accents add contrast that emphasizes the technical details across the upper. The design feels rooted in performance heritage, with a structure that reflects early 2000s running silhouettes. This pair resonates with collectors who appreciate retro runners that stay true to their origins. The ProGrid Omni 9 continues to gain attention for its balance of comfort and design, and this colorway reinforces that appeal. It is a versatile option that fits easily into both athletic and lifestyle rotations. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Black Silver Grey has a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro Halo
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro Halo honors the late basketball legend Kobe Bryant with performance-driven features and an angelic, white colorway. Released on the athletes birthday and Mamba Day, the Halo Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro boasts an all-white color scheme that immortalizes Kobe. The Flyknit upper creates a locked-in feel without sacrificing breathability or flexibility, while React Foam provides responsive cushioning in the midsole. Another performance upgrade is the exterior grip on the rubber outsole, which supports the foots natural movements. Like other sneakers decked out in the Halo colorway, splashes of black add contrast on both sides of the extended midsole. Our experts at StockX like the iridescent detailing on the Swoosh logos. This inclusion brings cohesion to the low-top sneaker and the feeling of being touched by angels. The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro Halo was originally released on August 23, 2024, and retailed at $240.

Display Name: Nike KD 4 Christmas (2024)
Description: The Nike KD 4 Christmas (2024) returns in time for the winter holiday season with a gleaming Metallic Copper upper and black accents. First launched in 2011, this iteration stays true to the original Nike KD 4 "Christmas." The innovative basketball from NBA player Kevin Durant boasts a Hyperfuse uppera lightweight, three-layer composite that supports stability and breathability. A wraparound strap with perforations contains the midfoot, while the front lace closure secures the fit. Although the upper comes in Metallic Copper, black accents decorate the Swoosh logo on the strap, a mini Swoosh on the toe box, "35" on the tongue, and "KD" branding on the heel. In addition, the grippy rubber outsole provides traction and comes in black. Our experts at StockX like that the 2024 model is almost identical to the version from 2011, making it modern yet timeless. The Nike KD 4 Christmas (2024) was released on November 20, 2024, and sold for $130.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Off White
Description: The New Balance 2002R Off White is a running shoe that comes in a Beige Off White colorway. This sneaker features an upper constructed with mesh, leather and suede with grey tones around the collar. Other details include jersey lining, a padded tongue and collar, the "N" logo on the sides, and the "2002R" on the lateral just below the collar. Rounding out the design is a textured ACTEVA LITE rubber midsole that utilizes the ABZORB cushioning technology and a black treaded N-ergy rubber outsole. The New Balance 2002R Off White was released on September 2nd, 2022, retailing at $120.

Display Name: New Balance 1000 Pearl Grey Black
Description: The New Balance 1000 Pearl Grey Black revives a bold performance silhouette with a refined and contemporary color approach. Pearl grey tones soften the aggressive shape, while black accents add contrast and structure across the upper. The layered design and sculpted lines feel unapologetically technical, giving the shoe a strong presence that reflects early two thousands innovation through a modern lens. Fans appreciate this model because it embraces complexity while remaining wearable. The New Balance 1000 appeals to collectors who value archival performance design reintroduced with intention. The neutral palette allows the form to shine, making it a versatile option that still feels distinct. It captures the brands ability to balance heritage and experimentation, delivering a silhouette that feels confident, expressive, and rooted in authentic design language. The New Balance 1000 Pearl Grey Black was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Black Multi
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Black Multi revives retro running heritage through bold contrast and layered detail. Black anchors the upper, while multicolor accents inject dynamic energy across the structured paneling. The ProGrid cushioning platform reinforces comfort and stability, staying true to Sauconys performance roots. Its intricate design lines highlight early 2000s runner aesthetics. Fans of archival silhouettes appreciate how the black base enhances the vibrant color pops. The mix of tones keeps the look expressive without overwhelming its structure. It captures nostalgia and modern styling in one cohesive package. Bold and balanced, this pair delivers heritage performance with contemporary flair. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Black Multi was released on February 12, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Bright Mandarin 2.0 (2025)
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Bright Mandarin 2.0 2025 revives one of the most instantly recognizable Air Max color stories by pairing it with the restored Big Bubble tooling that purists love. Bright mandarin accents cut sharply through layers of white and grey, giving the silhouette its signature high energy look that feels rooted in nineties running culture. The gradient panels and visible Air units feel aggressive and anatomical, reinforcing why the Air Max 95 has always stood apart visually from every other runner in Nikes archive. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it balances nostalgia and authenticity perfectly. The Big Bubble detail brings the shoe closer to its original form, while the mandarin hits deliver that unmistakable punch fans expect. It feels bold without being chaotic, a reminder of when Air Max design was fearless and expressive. This is the kind of release that longtime Air Max fans wait for, celebrating innovation, visibility, and attitude all in one silhouette. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Bright Mandarin 2.0 2025 was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (TD)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (TD), in toddler sizes, is a low-top athletic shoe featuring a Medium Olive leather upper contrasted by Sail overlays and the Swoosh in black, placed in a reverse orientation. In red, the Nike, Travis Scott, and Jordan Wings logos accent the tongue and heel. The Muslin midsole and Medium Olive outsole complete the aesthetic. The Air Jordan 1 is one of the American athletic shoe brand Nikes crowning achievements for its unparalleled longevity and popularity. Travis Scott is a rapper, producer, and songwriter from Houston, Texas, whose records have topped charts since the 20-teens. Nike tapped Scott to apply his signature aesthetic to the Jordan 1 Retro, one of their iconic styles. The shoe comes with accessories, like pink and black laces. Our experts feel that the best features of the Jordan 1 Retro Medium Olive are the rounded toe cap, sole pattern, and ventilation holes of this limited-edition shoe. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (TD) was released on September 28, 2024, and retailed at $50.

Display Name: Nike Daybreak SP Anthracite Light Bone
Description: The Nike Daybreak SP Anthracite Light Bone is one of two pairs in Nike's November 2025 Daybreak Light Bone pack, a release that revisits the 1979-born Daybreak silhouette through an unexpected reinterpretation that trades the model's traditional mesh and suede construction for an all-leather, lightly stuffed build that brings a puffed, almost Moon Boot-adjacent quality to one of running history's earliest and most architecturally distinctive Nike designs. The Nike Daybreak was released in 1979 as one of the brand's first major running shoes, designed during the early days of the Oregon-born running boom that transformed recreational sport in America, and its heritage as a pre-Air Max Nike runner gives it a different kind of cultural weight than the silhouettes that followed: it belongs to the founding era of modern performance running footwear, the moment before the visible Air unit changed everything. The SP designation marks this as a special project iteration, the premium reinterpretation that applies upgraded materials and construction to a heritage silhouette rather than a standard retroing. In the Anthracite Light Bone colorway, the lightly stuffed premium leather upper arrives in a deep Anthracite grey, with the Swoosh appearing in the contrasting soft Light Bone tone that gives the pack its name, the two-tone combination producing a quietly sophisticated result that references the Daybreak's running heritage while the puffed leather construction moves the design firmly into the lifestyle and collector category. The stitched Swoosh and toe definition, rope laces, EVA midsole, padded collar, and vintage Waffle rubber outsole complete a shoe that earns its Nike SNKRS placement through the distinctiveness of its material approach rather than through any loud graphic or color statement. Style code IO4865-200, released November 18, 2025 via Nike SNKRS at $115. The Nike Daybreak SP Anthracite Light Bone is the premium leather heritage runner for the collector who wants the Daybreak's 1979 founding-era Nike credentials in the most material-elevated and most quietly premium construction the silhouette has received. The Nike Daybreak SP Anthracite Light Bone was released on November 18, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: adidas Samba Classic White
Description: The upper part of the adidas Samba Classic White is constructed entirely of synthetic leather, which increases both its durability and lightness. The Samba Classic by adidas in white color has a suede overlay that increases its protection for its upper part and resistance to abrasion. Additionally, this shoe has a die-cut EVA cushioning for lightweight comfort and a rubber outsole with non-marking tread for superior traction on all interior surfaces. The sneaker also features a thick outsole that comes in black color. The adidas Samba Classic White, at the time of its market debut on the 25th of June, 2022, had a suggested retail price of $90.

Model: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo
Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Dallas Mavericks
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Dallas Mavericks channels team identity through a performance driven silhouette built for quick movement and responsiveness. College navy and mystic navy tones create a deep base, while pure platinum and multi color accents add contrast and energy. The low cut design emphasizes speed and control on the court. This pair resonates with fans who value both team affiliation and performance innovation. The GT Cut line is known for its responsiveness, and this version adds another layer through its connection to the Dallas Mavericks. It feels purpose built, combining function with a clear visual identity tied to the game. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Dallas Mavericks was released on November 20, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike KD 17 NRG Aunt Pearl
Description: The Nike KD 17 NRG Aunt Pearl commemorates Kevin Durant's late aunt with its meaningful design and striking aesthetics.
