This edition continues the tradition of blending basketball performance with heartfelt storytelling, and combines unique materials and design elements in an unforgettable silhouette. Aunt Pearl's version of the KD 17 NRG by Nike features a predominantly pink foam textile upper, accented with iridescent "KD" branding on the tongue and heel. Embroidered details on the heel overlay add depth and symbolize the emotional connection behind the design. The midsole integrates responsive Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot, complemented by an Air Strobel unit in the heel. This shoe was introduced to honor Durant's aunt and raise awareness for cancer research. One thing we love about the Nike KD 17 NRG Aunt Pearl is its intricate embroidery that honors Kevin Durants family legacy. Additionally, the cushioning system blends advanced Zoom Air and Air Strobel technology, which offers impressive performance. Released on 15th November 2024, this heartfelt design retailed at $150.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Black Gum
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Black Gum dresses the classic silhouette with practical colors. This Nike SB Dunk Low Black Gum color scheme consists of the classic combination of black, white, and Gum light brown. Its upper is composed of black nubuck material, complemented by a white leather Nike Swoosh. The heel tab is also adorned with an embroidered Nike wordmark in the same white color. The sneaker features a traditional cupsole design with white sidewalls and a tacky gum rubber outsole for traction. Additionally, a Zoom Air unit is incorporated into the insole to provide cushioning. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Black Gum was released on 1st March 2023 with its retail price set at $110.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Off Noir Medium Olive
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Off Noir Medium Olive pairs Light Orewood Brown with Medium Olive and Off Noir accents for a grounded and layered look. The mix of earthy and dark tones adds dimension across the upper, while Sail elements keep the palette balanced. The mid cut silhouette stays true to the AJ1 blueprint, preserving the shape that defines the models legacy. This colorway stands out because it embraces subtle contrast rather than bold saturation. The olive and noir combination feels mature and versatile, offering a refined take on the Jordan 1 Mid. Fans appreciate when neutral palettes are executed thoughtfully, creating depth without heavy branding. It is a composed and wearable update that keeps heritage intact while exploring new tonal territory. The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Off Noir Medium Olive was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Birkenstock Arizona Birkibuc Mocca
Description: The Birkenstock Arizona Birkibuc Mocha offers a laid-back look and dependable comfort in a silhouette that has been defining style since its debut in 1973. The Mocha colorway of the Birkenstock Arizona Birkibuc features a dual-strap upper crafted from warm brown synthetic Birkibuc leather. Each strap that closes across the foot is adjustable with metal pin buckles for a secure and comfortable fit. The mocha suede foot bed with black Birkenstock branding adds a slice of additional comfort underfoot, while the lightweight dark brown EVA outsole is grooved to provide grip with every step. Birkenstock branding also appears debossed in black on the medial side of the upper near the heel, adding a note of distinction. The aspect of this comfortable and stylish sandal that we appreciate most is the contoured cork-latex footbed that has been designed to conform to your foot and offer custom support as you wear the sandal. The Birkenstock Arizona Birkibuc Mocha was released on September 6, 2022, for $110 retail.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Gym Red Toro
Description: Jordan Brand released a new Chicago Bulls themed colorway with the Jordan 14 Retro Gym Red Toro, now available on StockX. This release draws a close resemblance to the Jordan 14 Challenge Red, but instead of yellow detailing to mimic its Ferrari inspiration, the Gym Red 14 implements white panels to create the Bulls uniform vibe. The Jordan 14 Gym Red Toro features a red suede upper atop a black and white sole. A black woven tongue, tire-like rubber heel tab, and arch underlay complete the design. These Jordan 14s released in July of 2020 and retailed for $190 USD.

Display Name: Nike Shox TL Black Metallic Hematite
Description: The Nike Shox TL Black Metallic Hematite features a combination of black, max orange, and metallic hematite color schemes. The upper part of this Nike Shox TL sneaker has a black mesh base with a molded TPU cage overlay. The fit of this shoe is supported by a padded mesh collar throughout. There are Shox columns on the signature midsole, while the underfoot of this shoe has a rubber outsole. A black lacing system completes its design. The Nike Shox TL Black Metallic Hematite was recommended to retail for $170 when it entered the market on May 5, 2019.

Display Name: Jordan 17 Retro Low SP University Blue (2024)
Description: The Jordan 17 Retro Low SP University Blue (2024) dresses the AJ17 in a beloved colorway that pays tribute to Michael Jordans alma materthe University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. Originally launched in 2002, the University Blue (2024) Jordan 17 Retro Low SP heritage sneaker features University Blue, white, chrome, and black. Mimicking the light hue of Carolina Blue, University Blue covers the TPU cage on the midsole and the Dynamic Fit sleeve. This interior sleeve supports the foot and provides a locked-in fit. Adding stability, the design boasts a full-length shank plate. Finally, the Zoom Air unit in the forefoot and Air cushioning in the heel protect against impact and create a springy feel. Our experts at StockX like the inclusion of heritage details, such as the shiny chrome strip running along the heel. The Jordan 17 Retro Low SP University Blue (2024) was released on August 28, 2024, and sold for $300.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Rings Anthracite
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Rings Anthracite blends championship legacy with a stealth driven palette that feels bold and grounded. Black and anthracite dominate the upper, creating a layered and shadowed look that emphasizes the hybrid silhouettes sculpted lines. Fire red accents inject sharp contrast, highlighting key details and adding energy without overpowering the dark base. The design feels aggressive and confident, built around the celebratory identity of the 6 Rings concept. Fans appreciate this release because the 6 Rings model represents Michael Jordans championship dominance distilled into one silhouette. The anthracite execution gives it a modern edge while preserving the hybrids historical significance. Collectors value how the red hits keep the look tied to classic Jordan storytelling, making it versatile yet unmistakably rooted in heritage. It stands as a strong fusion of past victories and contemporary tone, carried by bold structure and focused color blocking. The Air Jordan 6 Rings Anthracite was released on January 23, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Steel Grey Carrier Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel NYC Steel Grey Carrier Grey channels layered running heritage into a contemporary lifestyle silhouette. Finished in Steel Grey and Carrier Grey, the upper blends mesh and structured overlays to create depth and texture. The cushioned sole unit draws inspiration from classic ASICS performance models, giving it both comfort and a strong stance. The Gel NYC has gained traction for fusing archival design cues with modern proportions. In this monochromatic grey palette, the focus shifts to shape and construction rather than bold color. It feels balanced and easy to style, making it a strong option for those who appreciate technical sneakers with subtle presence. The ASICS Gel NYC Steel Grey Carrier Grey was released on May 18, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Union Guava Ice
Description: Los Angeles-based sneaker/streetwear boutique, Union, joined forces for a second time with Jordan brand to drop the Air Jordan 4 Union Guava Ice. Similar to 2018s unique construction, the product of this second partnership isnt immune to creative design. The Air Jordan 4 Union Guava Ice features many new elements never before seen on the silhouette. The most notable addition comes in the form of a foldable nylon tongue, showing off the "Air Jordan" logo traditionally stitched on the tongues backside. From there, hits of Guava, Fusion Red, and Brigade Blue make this Air Jordan 4 one of the more colorful releases for the model. The Air Jordan 4 Union Guava Ice released in August of 2020 for $250.
Colorway: Guava Ice/Light Bone-Brigade Blue-Light Fusion Red

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Year of the Horse
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Year of the Horse taps into the tradition of Jordan Brand celebrating the lunar zodiac through themed releases that blend storytelling with design. The sail and light chocolate palette gives the shoe a natural and slightly vintage feel, while subtle detailing tied to the Year of the Horse adds depth without overwhelming the silhouette. The use of hemp tones reinforces the earthy direction, creating a colorway that feels calm but intentional. Collectors are drawn to zodiac themed Jordans because they carry both cultural meaning and limited feel, making them more than just another colorway. This pair leans into subtlety rather than bold graphics, allowing the story to come through in materials and tones. It is a release that resonates with those who appreciate narrative driven design, offering a quieter but more thoughtful take on the Jordan 1 Low. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Year of the Horse was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Denim Navy Worn Blue
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 in Denim Navy and Worn Blue is a 2024 general release of the Air Force 1 Low applying denim-inspired material and textile treatments to the classic basketball silhouette, featuring a navy denim or denim-textured upper with Worn Blue accent details and Summit White midsole that translate the indigo denim's familiar casual-wear material context into one of Nike's most culturally embedded footwear silhouettes. The LV8 designation indicates a premium material or construction upgrade applied to the standard Air Force 1 Low 07 baseline, with the LV8 suffix across Nike's product line typically identifying seasonal iterations that apply elevated fabrics, textures, or color treatments that differentiate the shoe from the standard colorway lineup. The denim upper treatment connects the Air Force 1's foundational status in American streetwear and hip-hop culture to one of America's most quintessentially democratic and most culturally broad-based materials, with denim's associations spanning workwear, youth culture, and high fashion in a way that mirrors the Air Force 1's own extraordinary cross-cultural reach across four decades of production and cultural adoption. Released January 1, 2024 at $125 retail through Nike and authorized retailers globally. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Denim Navy Worn Blue was released on January 1, 2024 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pearl (2025)
Description: Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pearl 2025 revives one of basketballs most futuristic silhouettes with a finish that feels smooth, clean, and timeless. The pearl treatment gives the Foamposite Pro a subtle glow, highlighting its molded shell and fluid shape that once felt years ahead of its time. Even decades later, the design still feels bold and unapologetic. Collectors are drawn to this release because it celebrates the Foamposite legacy without overcomplication. The minimalist colorway lets the shape speak, reinforcing why this model became a cultural icon both on court and off. It feels like a reminder of an era when Nike pushed boundaries through form and material rather than trends. The Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pearl 2025 was released on 11/27/2025 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 White Black
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 White Black keeps things timeless with a sharp contrast that highlights every line of the iconic silhouette. A crisp white leather upper sets a clean foundation, while black accents cut through with bold definition across the Swoosh and heel. The familiar low cut shape and solid sole unit stay true to the original DNA, allowing the classic color blocking to carry the entire look. It is straightforward, confident, and rooted in decades of street credibility. Fans gravitate toward this combination because it never misses. The white and black pairing works in any setting, from daily wear to dressed up fits, without feeling overdone. It captures the pure essence of the Air Force 1, where form and contrast speak louder than added detail. For collectors, this is the type of pair that stays in constant rotation year after year. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 White Black was released on March 28, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Model: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1
Display Name: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Black Gum
Description: The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Black Gum is one of the most historically significant colorways in the ongoing 2025-26 P-Rod 1 retro program, a premium black suede and gum sole pair that recalls the original 2005 colorway spirit of Paul Rodriguez's debut Nike SB signature shoe, the first and most foundational in a signature line that has since grown to over ten models and established Rodriguez as the athlete with the deepest signature footwear legacy in Nike SB's entire history. Rodriguez famously demanded a signature shoe be written into his Nike SB contract before he would sign, a negotiating position that reflected his leverage as professional skateboarding's most technically complete street skater of the 2000s era and that ultimately launched a series that includes some of the most celebrated skate shoes ever produced. The Black Gum colorway applies a flooded black upper in premium suede to the P-Rod 1's rounded toe box and cupsole construction, the two foundational design decisions that gave the original shoe its silhouette-defining character and which the retro preserves in near-exact form. The PR monogram print on the heel panel appears in the same monochrome black as the upper, the subtle luxury detail that identifies the shoe without announcing itself across the room, while the Gum Light Brown outsole provides the contrasting base note that makes the entire colorway work: the warmth of the gum against the depth of the black creating the specific visual relationship that makes black-and-gum the most reliably satisfying colorway application in skate shoe history. An added plate in the cupsole construction cushions heavy impacts, and Air Zoom technology delivers the snappy, quick-off-the-ground responsiveness that has made the P-Rod 1 feel appropriate for actual skating as well as lifestyle wear across both its original release cycle and its 2025-26 retro. Style code IQ6827-001. The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Black Gum is the definitive P-Rod 1 retro colorway for the skater and collector who wants the most foundational and most historically evocative execution of the shoe that launched professional skateboarding's most significant Nike SB signature legacy. The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Black Gum is available at a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Crocs Echo RO Clog Bape Flame Camo
Description: The Crocs Echo RO Clog BAPE Flame Camo is part of the second and most technically ambitious collaboration between A Bathing Ape and Crocs, a Spring Summer 2026 capsule that marks an evolution from the Classic Clog of the first partnership to the chunkier, more trail-ready Echo RO silhouette, and applies BAPE's Color Camo in its Flame red palette to a platform designed for maximum sensory impact. Where the original BAPE x Crocs collaboration in 2025 applied the brand's iconic ABC Camo to the Classic Clog and generated secondary market prices well above retail, this follow-up makes a deliberate silhouette statement by choosing the Echo RO, a Crocs model with a molded Croslite upper, rounded closed toe, side ventilation cutouts, and a full-length rubber outsole with raised jagged tread wrapping around the lower edge that reads as genuinely technical and outdoors-adjacent rather than purely casual. The Flame colorway applies BAPE's Color Camo in a layered red and scarlet palette across the entire upper, the most aggressive and visually assertive of the three colorways in the SS26 pack alongside Powder Blue and Grapeberry, using the Color Camo's tonal layering approach where the pattern stays within its own color family rather than mixing contrasting tones. BAPE branding appears across the forefoot with a PVC STA plate on the lateral heel strap, and three custom Jibbitz charms, a GO! APE speech bubble, an APE HEAD, and Baby Milo resting on a BAPE logo, complete the package with the brand's full character lineup at each wearer's feet. The entire collection is limited to 1,000 pairs globally, releasing via BAPE first on May 9, 2026 before the wider Crocs drop on May 14. The Flame colorway is the one that makes the loudest statement in the Echo RO pack, carrying the full visual energy of BAPE's Color Camo heritage in a red palette that announces itself from every direction. The Crocs Echo RO Clog BAPE Flame Camo was released on May 14, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Grey Fog Chrome
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Grey Fog Chrome brings a lighter and more metallic driven take on the silhouette, combining grey fog tones with chrome accents that reflect light across the upper. Coconut milk elements add warmth, creating a layered palette that feels balanced and detailed. The design highlights the technical structure of the shoe. This pair stands out because of its use of metallic contrast. The chrome elements give it a slightly more futuristic feel, while the neutral base keeps it grounded. It is a strong option for those who appreciate detail and variation within a familiar silhouette. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Grey Fog Chrome was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Dark Iris
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Dark Iris is a high-top sneaker and comes in a white/black/Cement Grey/purple colorway. The leather base is primarily white with purple highlights around the heel and on the ankle. The shoe also has a black interior, plus a black-and-gray elephant print overlay. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Dark Iris is completed with a white midsole and Cement Grey outsole. The shoe features the Jumpman logo on the tongue and heel, with the 'AIR' brand logo below the Jumpman. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Dark Iris is set for release in August, 2022, at the retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Harvest Moon (Women's)
Description: The women's Nike Dunk Low Harvest Moon (W) features a white leather upper with light brown overlays and Swooshes. From there, a matching woven tongue label and sole complete the design. The women's Nike Dunk Low Harvest Moon (W) releases in 2022 and retails for $100.

Display Name: Jordan 2/3 Black Metallic Silver
Description: The Jordan 2/3 Black Metallic Silver blends the refined upper of the Jordan 2 with the performance tooling of the Jordan 3, resulting in a sleek low top that combines heritage design with modern edge. This hybrid Black Metallic Silver Jordan 2/3 silhouette showcases a smooth black leather base with textured black reptile-print overlays for added depth. Intricate deco stitching and perforations around the eyestays add visual dimension and breathability. A metallic silver TPU heel counter matches the silver tongue branding and the outsole, bringing in subtle contrast. Underfoot, a black foam midsole with visible Air cushioning ensures a responsive ride, while the metallic silver rubber outsole and black laces round out the look. Our favorite detail of the Jordan 2/3 Black Metallic Silver is the metallic silver Wings logo on the tongue, which makes for a striking nod to Jordan brand legacy. When it hit the shelves on October 1st, 2024, this shoe sold for $160 retail.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Pink Velvet (GS)
Description: The kids Nike Dunk Low Pink Velvet (GS) features a white leather upper with pink leather overlays and metallic pink Swooshes. From there, a velvet Nike branded heel tab, woven tongue label, and pale pink semi translucent outsole completes the design. The kids Nike Dunk Low Pink Velvet (GS) released in November of 2021 and retailed for $95.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Legend Ink Preloved Ruby
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Legend Ink Preloved Ruby delivers a refined and slightly deeper take on the silhouette through a rich and layered color palette. Legend ink creates a dark and structured base, while preloved ruby accents add warmth and contrast. Wonder white elements balance the design, giving it a clean and cohesive feel. Fans of the Gazelle Indoor appreciate how darker tones like this bring a more understated and versatile approach to the model. The subtle contrast keeps it visually engaging without being overly bold. It is a sneaker that reflects timeless design with a modern color update. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Legend Ink Preloved Ruby was released on December 1, 2024 with a retail price of $100.

Model: Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite FG
Display Name: Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite FG Fear Nothing Pack
Description: The Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite FG Fear Nothing Pack pushes speed driven design into a bold visual space, using a university red base that immediately stands out on the pitch. Dark obsidian accents add contrast, sharpening the silhouette while reinforcing the aggressive identity of the Mercurial line. The high cut collar and streamlined shape reflect a focus on acceleration and control. Players and collectors gravitate toward Mercurial releases like this because they represent the peak of Nike football innovation. The Fear Nothing theme adds a psychological edge, connecting performance with mindset. It is a boot that blends technical precision with bold design, offering a standout option for those who value speed and presence on the field. The Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite FG Fear Nothing Pack was released on June 23, 2025 with a retail price of $305.

Display Name: Nike Shox Z Metallic Silver (Women's)
Description: The Nike Shox Z Metallic Silver Womens pushes the Shox line into a sleek and reflective direction, using a metallic silver upper that highlights the futuristic nature of the silhouette. Black accents add contrast, allowing the structure and cushioning columns to stand out more clearly. The design feels sharp and technical, with the Shox system remaining a defining visual element. What makes this pair stand out is its blend of bold finish and performance heritage. The metallic treatment gives it a high energy presence, while the underlying design stays rooted in early 2000s innovation. Nike continues to revisit Shox models with updated relevance, and this version reflects that evolution clearly. It is a strong option for those who want a standout look with a retro performance edge. The Nike Shox Z Metallic Silver Womens was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Silver Lime
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Silver Lime injects bold contrast into the retro runner formula with a metallic Silver upper accented by vibrant Lime detailing. The layered mesh and synthetic overlays amplify the silhouettes technical feel, while GEL cushioning underfoot maintains the supportive ride that defines the Kayano legacy. The lime hits create sharp energy against the silver base, giving the shoe a dynamic and eye catching presence. This pair stands out because it leans into expressive color without sacrificing its performance roots. The silver foundation keeps the design grounded in early 2000s running heritage, while the lime accents add personality and brightness. Fans of tech runners gravitate toward releases like this for their balance of nostalgia and boldness. It is a confident and energetic take on a stability icon that feels equally at home on the street and in rotation. The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Silver Lime was released on June 26, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Caldera Brown Dark Field Brown
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus Caldera Brown Dark Field Brown blends earthy tones with performance comfort. Featuring Off Noir, Phantom, Natural, and Pecan accents, the upper highlights a layered construction that complements the cushioned sole. The neutral brown palette gives the silhouette warmth while maintaining its technical identity. Brown based colorways bring seasonal versatility, making this edition ideal for fall and winter rotations. The Vomero Plus design remains focused on soft landings and supportive cushioning. It feels grounded and modern, balancing rich tones with a comfort driven build. The Nike Vomero Plus Caldera Brown Dark Field Brown was released on November 21, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 270 Black Neon
Description: The Nike Air Max 270 Black Neon is a standalone colorway of the Nike Air Max 270 line. The upper of the Air Max 270 Black Neon is primarily black, with accents of Volt, Reflect Silver, and white. It is made of a lightweight and breathable mesh material that provides ventilation and flexibility. The shoe also features a rubberized overlay on the toebox, and additional synthetic overlays on the sides for structural support and durability. The outsole is made of a durable rubber material that provides traction and durability. The Swoosh is visible on the forefoot and on the side, while the Air 270 branding is on the tongue, side, and heel. We think that the standout feature of the Nike Air Max 270 Black Neon is its striking neon heel. The heel is designed to be large and visible, and incorporates Air unit technology, which is a pressurized air pocket that provides cushioning and support to the heel. The shoe was released on September 10th, 2021, at a price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey Wild Grape
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey Wild Grape introduces a more playful contrast through a darker base paired with vibrant accents. Iron grey and black tones create a muted foundation, while wild grape adds a pop of color that feels energetic without overwhelming the design. White details help break up the palette, keeping everything balanced and clean. This version resonates with fans who enjoy subtle color shifts that still bring personality. The Air Max 90 is known for its ability to handle contrast well, and this pair leans into that strength. It feels familiar at first glance but reveals more character the longer you look at it, making it a strong addition for those who want variation within a classic silhouette. The Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey Wild Grape was released on July 25, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Puma H-Street Ballet Warm White Silver (Women's)
Description: The Puma H Street Ballet in Warm White and Puma Silver for Women is a March 2026 women's lifestyle shoe from Puma featuring a ballet-inspired design aesthetic applied to the H Street silhouette, with the delicate off-white Warm White base referencing the soft satin of ballet pointe shoes and Puma Silver accents adding a subtle shimmer that connects to the performance and stage character of dance footwear without over-embellishing the clean minimal construction. The H Street Ballet arrives at the peak of the broader ballet aesthetic trend that swept women's fashion across 2024 and 2025, influencing footwear, clothing, and accessories globally as labels from luxury fashion houses to sportswear brands introduced ballet-inspired silhouettes and satin-finish materials as the dominant feminine aesthetic of the mid-2020s. The Warm White and Puma Silver combination is the most ethereal and most genuinely ballet-referential expression of the H Street Ballet colorway, with the off-white ground providing the most authentic visual connection to pointe shoe satin while the silver accent catches light in the way that stage performance footwear is designed to do. Released March 31, 2026 at $80 retail through Puma and authorized women's lifestyle footwear retailers globally. The Puma H Street Ballet Warm White Silver Womens was released on March 31, 2026 with a retail price of $80.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Travis Scott Cactus Jack Baroque Brown
Description: In collaboration with Travis Scott's record label Cactus Jack, the Nike Air Max 1 Travis Scott Cactus Jack Brown draws inspiration from the Nike ACG Pocket Knife hiking shoe. It features a layered mesh upper with tonal-brown Durabuck overlays and reversed Swoosh logos. A drawstring Gillie lacing system nods to common features on trail runners. At the base, a yellowed sole with a cloudy Air unit completes the design. The Nike Air Max 1 Travis Scott Cactus Jack Brown released in May of 2022 and retailed for $150.

Model: Kerwin Frost x McDonald's Fry Guy Clog
Display Name: Kerwin Frost x McDonald's Fry Guy Clog Cobalt Blue
Description: The Kerwin Frost x McDonald's Fry Guy Clog Cobalt Blue is a clog designed by American entertainer and DJ Kerwin Frost, inspired by a character from a McDonalds commercial from 1984. This version of the Kerwin Frost x McDonald's Fry Guy Clog is made with a shiny cobalt blue upper textured to look like the shagginess of the character Fry Guy. The upper is constructed with injected EVA foam to make the shoe both lightweight and durable. TPU detailing can be found on the large white and blue eyes and black eyebrows on top of the clog. The classic McDonalds golden arches are found on the heel in TPU detailing as well. The footbed comes with 2 extra layers of EVA foam for extra comfort, and the shoe comes in a collectible box. What we like best about this shoe is the complete dedication to the Fry Guy design, as it is void of any large branding elements. The Kerwin Frost x McDonald's Fry Guy Clog Cobalt Blue was released on December 11, 2023, for a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike KD 18 TB Triple Black
Description: The Nike KD 18 TB Triple Black strips Kevin Durant latest silhouette down to pure stealth. Black covers the entire upper and sole unit, creating a monochrome look that emphasizes the layered construction and streamlined shape. The low profile build keeps the focus on performance, reinforcing its court ready intent. Triple Black editions always highlight the architecture of a sneaker, and the KD 18 benefits from that minimal approach. Without color distractions, the technical details and sculpted cushioning stand out more clearly. For players who prefer a clean and understated aesthetic, this version delivers versatility and quiet confidence in every step. The Nike KD 18 TB Triple Black was released on November 5, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 White Black Silver Purple
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 White Black Silver Purple brings balance and contrast to one of Sauconys most respected performance rooted silhouettes. Clean white and black panels form a crisp base, while silver and purple accents add depth that highlights the shoes layered construction. The ProGrid Omni 9 is known for its structured support and early running era DNA, and this colorway lets that technical foundation shine while still feeling modern and wearable. Fans love this release because it feels like a perfect middle ground between heritage and lifestyle. The neutral tones keep it versatile, while the purple hits add personality without overpowering the design. Collectors appreciate how Saucony continues to reintroduce the Omni 9 with thoughtful color stories, proving that classic performance shapes can feel fresh through restraint and balance rather than reinvention. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 White Black Silver Purple was released on May 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 23 Out for Redemption (Translucent Outsole)
Description: The Nike LeBron 23 Out for Redemption leans into a darker and more focused palette, using midnight navy as a strong foundation while university red and metallic gold accents introduce contrast and meaning. The design feels controlled and deliberate, reflecting a mindset centered on determination and response. This version resonates because it ties directly into narrative. LeBrons line often reflects moments in his career, and this release captures a sense of purpose through its color story. Fans connect with that energy, making it more than just a performance shoe but a representation of mindset and drive. The Nike LeBron 23 Out for Redemption was released on January 30, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: New Balance 204L Silver Metallic Black
Description: The New Balance 204L Silver Metallic Black adds a futuristic touch to a sleek, low cut silhouette. Silver metallic overlays catch light across the upper, contrasted by black accents that ground the design. The streamlined shape keeps the sneaker feeling modern and agile, while subtle branding reinforces its performance roots. The metallic finish adds visual edge without overwhelming the overall balance. Fans of statement sneakers appreciate when texture and finish elevate simple forms, and this pair captures that dynamic. The silver and black palette pairs effortlessly with monochrome outfits or tech inspired fits. It stands as a bold yet wearable interpretation of New Balances evolving lifestyle direction. The New Balance 204L Silver Metallic Black was released on October 24, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Pink Taffy
Description: The New Balance 1906R Pink Taffy reimagines the early 2000s tech runner through a playful yet sharp color story. Eclipse and Black Cement provide a darker framework, while Pink Taffy accents inject vibrant contrast that instantly draws the eye. The layered mesh and synthetic overlays preserve the 1906R signature complexity. The 1906R has become a favorite for those who appreciate retro performance silhouettes with lifestyle versatility. Pink Taffy adds character without overpowering the structure, striking a balance between bold and wearable. It feels dynamic on foot, especially for fans who enjoy subtle color pops within predominantly neutral outfits. The New Balance 1906R Pink Taffy was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: adidas SL 72 Pro White Black Chalk Pearl
Description: The adidas SL 72 Pro White Black Chalk Pearl taps into vintage running DNA, bringing back a silhouette that has always carried a lightweight and streamlined feel. The crystal white base keeps the look crisp, while core black detailing adds contrast that sharpens the profile. Chalk pearl accents soften the overall palette, giving the shoe a slightly aged aesthetic that nods to its origins without feeling outdated. The SL 72 has always been about simplicity and function, and this version keeps that identity intact. Collectors who appreciate archival adidas designs tend to gravitate toward models like this because they reflect a different era of performance and style. The low profile build and retro materials create a distinct feel compared to modern runners, making it a refreshing option in rotation. It is a sneaker that does not rely on hype, instead earning attention through history, proportion, and subtle color execution that feels authentic to its roots. The adidas SL 72 Pro White Black Chalk Pearl with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro Lettering
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro Lettering is a low-top silhouette featuring design elements reminiscent of the 1970s style. This iteration of the Nike Dunk Low has a base of calf leather in a Sail white color. This forms the entire upper section, which is paneled for added support. The toe box is also perforated for breathability. The Nike Swooshes appear in a gradient from yellow to orange on each side, while a Navy heel collar bearing Nike branding in a curvy retro font in orange is visible on the back. The tongue also contains a branding patch, and Navy outlines are seen around the Swooshes and the ankle area. The shoe sits on a thin Sail midsole and an orange outsole. What stands out about this shoe are the bright Swooshes, white laces, and patterned soles, which add even more of a retro vibe. The Nike Dunk Low Retro Lettering was released on February 16, 2025, for $115.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Flu Game (2025) (GS)
Description: The Jordan 12 Retro Flu Game (2025) (GS) brings one of the most legendary sneakers in basketball history to a new generation. First introduced in 1997 and last seen in 2016, this colorway is tied to Michael Jordan's unforgettable Game 5 performance in the 1997 NBA Finals, where he overcame flu-like symptoms to drop 38 points and secure a crucial win for the Bulls. Now, kids can lace up a piece of basketball history with this downsized edition made just for them. Staying true to the original design, this GS version features a premium black tumbled leather upper paired with a bold varsity red mudguard and midsole, offering the same sleek and powerful aesthetic. Classic Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel tab keeps the look authentic, while the lightweight cushioning and supportive fit make it perfect for all-day wear whether on the playground or the court. Released on March 1, 2025, for a retail price of $150, the Jordan 12 Retro Flu Game (2025) (GS) gives kids the chance to rock one of the most historic sneakers in the Air Jordan lineup. With its deep-rooted legacy and bold color-blocking, this pair remains an essential pickup for young sneaker fans.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Delta Air Lines 100th Anniversary
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Delta Air Lines 100th Anniversary celebrates a century of aviation heritage through a clean and commemorative colorway. Featuring White with Blue, Grey, and Red accents, the upper reflects Deltas signature branding while preserving the timeless AF1 structure. Subtle detailing ties the design back to the milestone theme. Anniversary editions like this merge corporate history with sneaker culture in a way that feels unique and collectible. The crisp white base provides a neutral canvas for the airline inspired accents. It stands as a crossover piece that honors travel history while maintaining everyday wearability. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Delta Air Lines 100th Anniversary was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Mummy
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Mummy draws inspiration from the Ancient Egyptian mummification process. It features a layered textile upper with cross-stitched detailing and a suede Swoosh overlay. At the heel, eye graphics peek out from underneath the layered textile. A glow-in-the-dark sole and Eye of Horus woven tongue tag completes this Halloween design. The Nike SB Dunk Low Mummy released in October of 2021 and retailed for $110.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Multi-Heart Milk
Description: The "Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Multi-Heart Milk" is part of a collaboration between Converse and Comme des Garçons, a Japanese streetwear label known for its monochromatic colorways and statement pieces. This high-top sneaker applies Comme des Garçons signature heart motifs to Converses recognizable upper. The upper is made of durable canvas in Milk with tonal, reinforced stitching and metal eyelets that create a front lace closure. The lateral side panel features six black hearts with eyes that sit above the rubber outsole. On the medial side panel, there are only three black hearts. The Converse All Star logo can be found on the medial heel, while a black heelstay stretches up the back of the shoe. Our StockX experts like the vulcanized rubber sole, which provides traction. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Multi-Heart Milk was released on October 26th, 2023, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Triple Pink (GS)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Triple Pink has a full leather build, which makes use of three distinct shades of pink to complete the look. The base has a light shade of pink, with a slightly contrasting pink overlay. The look is completed by the Nike Swoosh in a bold pink that provides a strong contrast and stands out noticeably on the shoe. In addition to the Swoosh on both sides, the Nike Dunk Low Triple Pink (Grade School) features Nike branding on the sole, heel, tongue, and inner sole. This shoe comes in Grade School (GS) sizing. The Nike Dunk Low Triple Pink (Grade School) was released in early June, 2022, at the retail price of $85.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Michigan State
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Michigan State is composed of white leather uppers with Varsity Green leather overlays and Swoosh logos. From there, woven retro Nike logo tongue labels and heel embroidery nod to original Dunks from 1985. The Nike Dunk Low Michigan State released in June of 2021 and retailed for $100. The Nike Dunk Low Michigan State released again in May of 2024 and retailed for $115.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentine's Day (2026) (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentines Day 2026 Womens celebrates romance through layered pastel and deep red tones. Finished in Sail with Silt Red, Light Armory Blue, Peony, and Burgundy Crush accents, the upper plays with contrast while maintaining the AF1s signature structure. Subtle detailing enhances the seasonal theme without overwhelming the silhouette. Valentine themed releases often lean into expressive color, and this edition balances softness with bold touches. The mix of reds and lighter hues creates a playful yet refined aesthetic. It feels festive and wearable, carrying the spirit of the holiday into one of Nikes most iconic designs. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentines Day 2026 Womens was released on January 30, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Jade Horizon
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Jade Horizon delivers a calm and balanced take on the silhouette through a soft and layered mix of tones. Jade horizon accents provide a subtle and refreshing pop of color, while sail and summit white create a clean foundation. Pure platinum and redstone details add depth, giving the design a cohesive feel. Fans of understated colorways appreciate how this version offers versatility without losing personality. The muted tones make it easy to style across different outfits. It is a sneaker that reflects classic Jordan design with a refined and modern color approach. The Air Jordan 1 Low Jade Horizon was released on June 24, 2022 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Photon Dust Blue Chill (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Photon Dust Blue Chill GS delivers a cool and layered color story across one of Jordan Brands most celebrated silhouettes. Photon dust forms a neutral base, complemented by blue chill and blue tint accents that add clarity and contrast. Flat pewter and white details round out the palette, giving the shoe depth while keeping the overall look clean and composed. This pair resonates with fans because it feels modern yet familiar. The Jordan 4 remains a cornerstone of sneaker culture, and this colorway shows how thoughtful color balance can keep it feeling current. Collectors appreciate how the cool tones highlight the models structure and proportions, making it easy to style while still feeling special. It is a release that reinforces the Jordan 4s ability to evolve gracefully across generations. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Photon Dust Blue Chill GS was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Cream White Sand Strata (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Cream White Sand Strata (Women's) updates the classic Samba silhouette with a straightforward colorway and premium materials. Although the base color is Cream White, Sand Strata and Core Black add to the sneakers retro appearance. Originally an indoor soccer shoe, the Samba OG Sand Strata Cream White features a rubber outsole that provides traction without reducing flexibility. The upper is made of premium leather in Cream White with suede overlays in Sand Strata. The laces, the serrated 3-Stripes, and the collar come in Core Black. In terms of branding, SAMBA is printed along the 3-Stripes in Metallic Gold lettering, while the trefoil in gold can be found on the tongues logo tag. Our experts at StockX appreciate the inclusion of metallic elements in a way that doesnt overwhelm the shoe. The womens size adidas Samba OG Cream White Sand Strata (Women's) was released on January 10th, 2024, and retailed at $100.

Display Name: adidas Superstar Vintage Bape White Black
Description: The adidas Superstar Vintage Bape White Black is a striking collaboration that merges classic design with streetwear flair. This iconic silhouette features a pristine white leather upper, accented by the unmistakable black BAPE camo pattern on the iconic three stripes. Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro Soft Pearl Cream
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro in Soft Pearl and Cream is a colorway execution that strips the Dunk Low back to its most elegant and tonally restrained expression, pairing two warm off-white shades that sit in close proximity on the color spectrum while creating just enough contrast and visual distinction to make the two-tone panel structure of the Dunk Low's classic construction legible and satisfying. At one hundred and twenty dollars the Dunk Low Retro in Soft Pearl and Cream delivers the most wearable and daily-rotation-appropriate expression of the Dunk Low platform in the most universally beloved tonal direction the silhouette currently offers. The Nike Dunk Low Retro in Soft Pearl and Cream was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: New Balance FuelCell Rebel v4 Cyber Jade

Description: The Nike Vomero Premium Black Sapphire Rose Womens delivers a darker and more layered palette, combining black with sapphire and hot lava accents to create contrast and depth. Anthracite and iron grey tones round out the design, giving it a structured and cohesive look that feels both modern and refined. This pair stands out because it balances bold accents with a grounded base. The premium construction enhances the overall feel, making it a more elevated version of the Vomero line. Fans appreciate how it blends performance and style in a way that feels intentional and well executed. The Nike Vomero Premium Black Sapphire Rose Womens was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro Light Silver Steam
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro Light Silver Steam is the quiet achiever of the 2026 Kobe calendar, arriving in a colorway that strips back everything but the performance and lets the silhouette's design pedigree carry the full weight of the release. A Light Silver engineered mesh upper covers the low-cut frame in a tone that reads clean and neutral under court lighting, while Steam accents do their precise and considered work across the heel counter, Flywire cables, and sockliner in a soft sage green that gives the shoe just enough life without ever competing for attention. A second shade of steely green lands on the lace loops and midsole accents, grey fills the rest of the midsole, and a Summit White outsole completes a build that feels exactly as intentional as the more visually aggressive Kobes but chooses to express it differently. The Kobe 9 Low EM carries one of the most meaningful origin stories in Nike Basketball history. Designed to support Kobe Bryant's return from a torn Achilles in 2014, it was built around the radical idea that a lightweight, low-cut construction could provide elite performance support during one of sport's most demanding physical comebacks. The Protro version honors that legacy with a React foam sockliner and modernized midsole system that make the shoe as capable in 2026 as the original was over a decade ago. The "Steam" colorway is specifically made for the hooper who would rather be noticed for what happens on the court than what is on their feet, and that restraint is itself a kind of statement. The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro Light Silver Steam was released on April 13, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike NOCTA Glide Drake White Black
Description: The Nike NOCTA Glide Drake White Black blends performance inspired structure with Drakes understated approach to design. The Glide silhouette feels streamlined and futuristic, while the white and black palette keeps the look clean and versatile. Subtle gold accents add depth without overwhelming the design, giving the shoe a composed and confident presence that fits naturally into modern lifestyle wear. The NOCTA Glide feels intentional and wearable, appealing to people who want sneakers that feel premium without relying on flash. Collectors appreciate how the collaboration balances performance cues with everyday style, making the shoe feel relevant across settings rather than locked into a single use or moment. The Nike NOCTA Glide Drake White Black was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Cozzzy Sandal Monsters Inc. Sulley
Description: Step into the world of Monsters Inc. with the Crocs Classic Cozzzy Sandal Monsters Inc. Sulley. This playful and comfortable footwear combines the beloved character Sulley with Crocs' signature comfort and style. The sandal features a vibrant blue color reminiscent of Sulley's fur, complete with spots and details that capture the essence of the lovable monster. The fuzzy lining adds an extra layer of coziness, making these sandals perfect for lounging at home or casual outings. Designed with Crocs' renowned CrosliteÑ¢ foam construction, these sandals offer lightweight comfort and support for all-day wear. The adjustable turbo heel strap ensures a secure fit, while the textured footbed provides added traction. Whether you're a fan of Monsters Inc. or simply looking for a fun and comfortable sandal, the Crocs Classic Cozzzy Sandal Monsters Inc. Sulley is an excellent choice. Our team thinks this product is great for Disney enthusiasts and those who appreciate quirky, comfortable footwear that stands out from the crowd.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Dark Team Red
Description: Slick, refined, and cushioned for comfort, the Nike Air Max 1 Dark Team Red is an effortlessly stylish shoe that will take your sporty apparel and urban adventuring to new heights. The Air Max 1 is a timeless shoe that brings ultimate comfort to the wearer without skimping on good looks. A strong color blend of white and platinum with black and burgundy accents, the suede and textile combo act as an elegant mix of materials. The white base has mudguards, insoles, inner linings, and heel tab brandings, all in deep red, as well as a black Swoosh logo, black eyelets, and full Nike tongue branding in black. The white midsole features visible Air Max heel units, showing cushioned comfort in action. We cant get enough of the design features of this bold shoe. Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Court Purple White
Description: Jordan Brand added a new colorway to the silhouette that started it all with the Jordan 1 Retro High Court Purple White, now available on StockX. This release follows similar design elements as the Chicago 1, only this time replacing red with Court Purple. This Jordan 1 consists of a white leather upper with Court Purple overlays and black detailing. A black Swoosh and Wings logo, white midsole, and Court Purple outsole completes the design. Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Photon Dust (GS)

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cobblestone Flat Pewter (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cobblestone Flat Pewter W features a greyscale color palette with hints of sage green. This shoe in women sizing showcases a durable sole with a tread pattern designed for traction and grip on various surfaces. The iconic Nike Swoosh logo is prominently featured on the sides of the shoe, adding a touch of sporty style. The tongue of the shoe is adorned with a Nike branding label, showcasing attention to detail and brand authenticity. Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Flint Grey French Blue (2026) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 9 Retro French Blue 2026 GS refreshes a beloved colorway through crisp contrast and youthful scale. White leather anchors the upper, while french blue accents bring clarity and brightness across the midsole and detailing. Flint grey elements add depth and balance, giving the silhouette a layered and cohesive finish that stays true to its heritage roots. Fans appreciate this release because French Blue remains one of the most recognizable palettes within the Jordan 9 lineup. Translating it into grade school sizing keeps the design accessible while preserving its authentic proportions and structure. Collectors value how the clean white base enhances the blue and grey contrast, making it stand out without feeling overstated. It stands as a modern continuation of a classic formula, blending nostalgia with refreshed execution for a new generation. The Air Jordan 9 Retro French Blue 2026 GS was released on January 24, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Trophy Room Rookie Card Away
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Trophy Room Away elegantly bridges the gap between sports heritage and contemporary sneaker culture. Set in a classic palette of sail, black, varsity red, and muslin, this sneaker pays homage to the legendary lineage of Air Jordan 1s while infusing it with the exclusive allure of Trophy Room, the renowned sneaker store founded by Michael Jordan's son. Designed for those who value both the history and the exclusivity of their footwear, this edition is a testament to the enduring legacy of the Jordan brand and the unique vision of Trophy Room. This sneaker distinguishes itself with meticulous design details, including an embroidered Nike Swoosh, luxurious red satin accents throughout, and exquisite gold wings logo on the heel. These elements not only highlight the craftsmanship involved but also elevate the sneaker to a piece of collectible art, resonating with the tastes of sneakerheads and Jordan enthusiasts alike. The collaboration represents a seamless blend of Michael Jordan's storied career and his son's contemporary influence on the sneaker world. Released on March 21, 2024, for $140, the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Trophy Room Away quickly captivated the hearts of collectors and fans, becoming a coveted piece in many collections. Its launch is celebrated as a moment that offered sneaker aficionados a unique piece that's steeped in basketball lore and exclusivity.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 2 Lily (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 2 Lily Womens delivers the same refined and energetic color story in a build tailored for adult athletes. White dominates the upper, while Pinksicle brings a vibrant spark that contrasts against Cement Grey and Black accents. The sleek profile and responsive cushioning platform reflect the performance driven identity of Sabrinas second signature silhouette. Display Name: Nike GT Cut Academy Glacier Blue White Photon Dust Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike GT Cut Academy Glacier Blue White Photon Dust Metallic Silver brings a clean and icy palette to a performance focused basketball silhouette, using glacier blue tones that give the shoe a cool and modern feel. Display Name: Nike ACG LDV Dark Sulfur Photo Blue
Description: The Nike ACG LDV Dark Sulfur Photo Blue brings trail inspired energy into a lifestyle silhouette, using a dark sulfur photo blue sail white palette that feels vibrant and outdoors driven. Description: Step out in contemporary refinement with the Jordan 1 Low Iron Grey. A large Nike swoosh in black leather sits boldly on the sides. We love the good-looking appeal of this slick Nike shoe. A take on the original Air Jordan, the Low 1s are perfect for everyday appeal with clean, modern design sensibilities. The Air Jordan 1 Low Iron Grey was released on August 17, 2024, and retailed at $115.

Display Name: New Balance 530 Raincloud
Description: The New Balance 530 Raincloud continues the legacy of the original 530 which debuted in 1992. The Raincloud, Grey, and White colorway is inspired by the hue of a raincloud just before it pours and is similar to the color scheme found on several New Balance 990s. Display Name: Nike Book 1 Halloween (2025)
Description: The Nike Book 1 Halloween channels seasonal energy through a sleek and minimal basketball silhouette. Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Maroon (2015)
Description: One of the most highly anticipated Jordan 6's to ever release, the Air Jordan 6 Retro Maroon released towards the end of 2015. Jordan Brand had been teasing the release of the Maroon VI for years and many decided not to believe it until they saw it. When pictures of the shoes leaked from China in July, the blogosphere went crazy. Finally, the very simple and elegant shoe would see its first retro release, in men's, GS, and PS sizing. Moreover, it would prominently feature 'Nike Air' on its heels. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Maroon was part of Nike's Retro Remaster initiative, which began in spring of 2015 series, and was said by The Swoosh to be as close to the original 1991 product from back in the day. What makes the Maroon 6 so special are its gorgeous off-white leather upper and sparse deep maroon red accents at the midsole and tongue. Additionally, Jordan Brand decided to give the Maroon 6 milky translucent hits on the outsole, rather than the icy blue traditioanlly found on a Jordan Retro 6. For the final touch, Jordan Brand made sure the box for the Jordan 6 Retro Maroon was designed just like the original from 1991.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low New Jersey
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low New Jersey channels regional pride through thoughtful color and material storytelling. Cacao wow and light British tan tones give the upper a warm and grounded feel, balanced by summit white and black for contrast. Gum medium brown details reinforce the classic Air Force 1 foundation, while metallic gold accents add a celebratory touch tied to place and identity. Display Name: Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gold Medal (2024)
Description: The Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gold Medal 2024 is a re-release of an iconic colorway that pays tribute to Kobe Bryant's legendary performance at the 2008 Olympics. This sneaker, featuring a striking white, dark obsidian, varsity red, and metallic gold colorway, celebrates Kobes pivotal role in the Redeem Team, where he led Team USA to victory and secured his place in Olympic history. The Protro line brings modern performance upgrades to this classic silhouette, combining heritage with innovation. Designed with advanced tech, the Kobe 4 Protro features enhanced cushioning for superior comfort and support, making it perfect for both on-court performance and off-court style. The shoes low-cut design allows for maximum agility, while the Flywire technology offers a secure fit. The heel features the number 10 to honor the number Kobe wore in the Olympics. The colorways gold accents symbolize the triumph and excellence of Kobes Olympic journey, making this sneaker a meaningful addition to any collection. Released on August 6, 2024, the Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gold Medal retailed at $190. This sneakers blend of white, dark obsidian, varsity red, and metallic gold captures the essence of a significant moment in basketball history. With its blend of historical significance and modern enhancements, the Kobe 4 Protro Gold Medal continues to resonate with fans and athletes alike.

Display Name: Nike Moon Shoe OG Soft Yellow Black Soft Pearl (Women's)
Description: The Nike Moon Shoe Soft Yellow is one of the most historically loaded pieces of footwear Nike has ever brought to a general retail audience, a women's exclusive colorway of a silhouette that co-founder Bill Bowerman originally developed in 1971 and that never saw a public release until now, over half a century after it first left crater-like imprints in the dirt at the University of Oregon and inspired the waffle sole revolution that changed running forever. Soft Yellow nylon covers the upper in a butter-warm tone that leans fully into the vintage running aesthetic of early track footwear, with tone-on-tone suede accents around the heel and eyestay adding depth and texture without disrupting the shoe's deliberately minimal character. Soft Pearl leather Swooshes run across both side panels with a smoothness that complements the yellow base, cream laces and a traditional woven Nike tongue tag push the retro direction further, and an exposed zig-zag trim gives the construction a raw handmade quality that feels authentic to the shoe's origin story. The black outsole grounds the entire look with an aggressive square-shaped traction pattern that is a direct reference to the waffle design Bowerman famously developed after studying the grid pattern on his wife Barbara's waffle iron, seeking a solution for the slick urethane track surface at Oregon. That outsole detail is not just design language but documentation, connecting every pair of Moon Shoes released today to the exact moment that changed how Nike thought about performance footwear. The Soft Yellow colorway in particular has been widely embraced as the most wearable and season-appropriate of the current Moon Shoe lineup, its warm tone translating effortlessly from the track to everyday wear in a way that the silhouette's heritage fully supports. The Nike Moon Shoe Soft Yellow Women's was released on May 7, 2026 with a retail price of $105.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 23 From This Point Forward
