Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Crocodile White Blue Tint
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Crocodile White Blue Tint adds texture to a familiar silhouette, using crocodile style detailing to elevate the classic all white base. The Blue Tint accents bring a subtle contrast that keeps the design fresh while maintaining the clean identity associated with the Air Force 1. The low cut shape and durable construction remain unchanged, preserving the models legacy. This pair resonates with collectors because it introduces variation without straying too far from what makes the Air Force 1 iconic. The textured finish adds depth, giving the shoe a slightly more premium feel while staying wearable. It is a refined take on a staple, appealing to those who want something classic with a small but noticeable twist. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Crocodile White Blue Tint was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite FG Glacier Blue
Description: The Nike Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite FG Glacier Blue is a cutting-edge soccer cleat designed for peak performance on firm ground surfaces. Featuring a striking Glacier Blue and Blue Orbit colorway, these cleats are sure to turn heads on the pitch. The Superfly 10 Elite model showcases Nike's latest innovations in soccer footwear, combining speed, touch, and control in one sleek package. Engineered with a high-top collar for enhanced ankle support and a seamless fit, these cleats offer superior lockdown and stability during quick movements. The upper is constructed with Nike's advanced materials, providing a barefoot feel for precise ball control. The firm ground (FG) soleplate is equipped with strategically placed studs to deliver optimal traction and acceleration on natural grass surfaces. We at StockX believe this product is great for players seeking top-tier performance and style in their soccer cleats, perfect for forwards and wingers who prioritize speed and agility on the field.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big Bubble Sport Red
Description: Nike is celebrating Air Max Day in 2023 by bringing back an original Air Max design, with the release of the Nike Air Max 1 86 Big Bubble Sport Red. The Big Bubble pays homage to the original design of the Nike Air Max 1, which featured a bigger air unit. The Air Max 1 86 Big Bubble released as Nikes premier Air Max Day release in 2023. The sneakers are constructed using grey synthetic nubuck, white mesh and red synthetic suede across the uppers and a large air unit on the midsole. Nike used Sport Red branding on the tongue and heel of the sneaker. The Nike Air Max 1 86 Big Bubble Sport Red released March 26, 2023, with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut EYBL Volt
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut EYBL Volt celebrates elite youth basketball culture by bringing EYBL energy to one of Nike Basketballs most respected silhouettes. Volt and crimson tones give the shoe immediate presence, reflecting the intensity and ambition that define the EYBL stage. The GT Cuts streamlined shape remains performance focused, but the colorway adds excitement that feels earned rather than decorative. Collectors and players love this release because it represents aspiration. The EYBL connection signals high level competition and future talent, making the shoe feel symbolic as well as functional. Fans appreciate how the bright palette amplifies the GT Cuts aggressive stance, turning a trusted performance model into a statement of confidence and drive. It feels like a sneaker made for players who believe they belong on the biggest stages. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut EYBL Volt was released on December 23, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Blazer Low Off-White Black Electro Green
Description: The Nike Blazer Low Off-White Black Electro Green boasts a multi-disciplinary, multi-sport aesthetic - a central motif in Virgil Abloh's body of work. Encompassing aspects of basketball, skateboarding, and trail running silhouettes, the Off-White Blazer Low fuses an Air Terra Humara TPU heel piece with a classic vulcanized sole for a unique base. On the black leather upper, punched-out holes are scattered, similar to the Air Jordan 5 Off-White. An accented Electro Green over-lacing system, exposed foam tongue, zip tie tag, and Swoosh tab all add Off-White's signature detailing to complete the design. The Nike Blazer Low Off-White Black Electro Green released in April of 2022 and retailed for $140.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Premium QS Fleur De-Lis Geyser Grey (Women's)
Description: The Nike Vomero Premium QS Fleur De Lis Geyser Grey is one of the most visually distinctive women's running releases of 2026, a shoe that takes Nike's most cushion-forward daily trainer and wraps it in an all-over fleur-de-lis print that brings decorative European heritage directly into performance footwear. Geyser Grey mesh covers the upper with darker shading worked through the toe, side panels, and heel, giving the surface a slightly weathered dimension that makes the monochromatic grey tonal laces, molded eyelets, and soft collar padding read as completely unified rather than simple. Metallic Silver carries through most of the midsole in a futuristic finish that lets the chunky cushioning stack look as intentional as it performs. The strongest contrast arrives at the visible Air Zoom windows along the sidewalls, where Peony fills the long exposed cushioning units in a saturated rosy red that provides the shoe's most arresting visual detail and returns again on the insoles, outsole pods, and a small embroidered heel Swoosh. The Vomero Premium's performance architecture centers on two energy-boosting Air Zoom units surrounded by a full-length ZoomX foam midsole, a combination that delivers Nike's softest and most responsive daily running experience currently in production. The QS designation places this version in limited territory, making it more exclusive than the standard Vomero Premium lineup and appealing to the audience that understands Nike has been using the Vomero platform as a canvas for some of its most fashion-forward and experimentally designed running releases of the year. The fleur-de-lis print, whether read as a nod to New Orleans, French heraldry, or simply decorative elegance, gives this shoe a singular identity that no other runner in Nike's current catalog can claim. The Nike Vomero Premium QS Fleur De Lis Geyser Grey Women's was released on May 22, 2026 with a retail price of $245.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Pegasus Pack Sail (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Pegasus Pack Sail Womens brings a softer and more refined tone to the silhouette, using a light sail base to create a clean and airy look. Phantom and Team Crimson accents add subtle contrast, giving the shoe depth while maintaining its overall minimal feel. The design leans into simplicity, allowing small color details to carry the identity. This pair stands out because of its balance between restraint and personality. The Pegasus Pack theme adds a conceptual layer, while the color execution keeps it wearable and versatile. It appeals to those who prefer a lighter and more understated take on the Air Force 1 while still appreciating thoughtful design elements. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Pegasus Pack Sail Womens was released on January 9, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 4 Protro FC Barcelona Team Gold
Description: Channeling Mamba mentality with a European twist, the Nike Kobe 4 Protro FC Barcelona Team Gold fuses court-ready engineering with a color story inspired by one of footballs most storied clubs. The low-profile silhouette arrives in a lustrous Team Gold upper with bold Black hits and Persian Violet accents that nod to Barcelonas regal palette, delivering a look thats equal parts heritage and highlight reel. A sculpted heel clip and supportive collar keep you locked in through hard cuts, while the streamlined shape pays homage to the original Kobe 4, now refined for modern play. Style code IM2532-701 ensures youre lacing into the exact edition that elevates the Protro formula. Built for quickness and feel, this Kobe 4 Protro pairs responsive Zoom Air cushioning with a stable, agile ride that thrives on first steps, step-backs, and full-court bursts. A durable, grippy outsole pattern bites on hardwood for confident traction, and the breathable build helps manage heat during intense minutes. Subtle FC Barcelona cues add collectible appeal without sacrificing performance, making this a standout for hoopers and fans alike. Whether youre chasing buckets or curating a versatile rotation, the Nike Kobe 4 Protro FC Barcelona Team Gold delivers speed, style, and the kind of precision that turns split seconds into separation. Our team loves this product because it blends top-tier responsiveness and lockdown with a striking FC Barcelona-inspired palette that looks elite on and off the court.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Dark Pony Soft Pearl
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Dark Pony Soft Pearl delivers warm contrast through rich brown tones and lighter accents. Dark Pony overlays dominate the upper, paired with Soft Pearl and Pearl White panels that brighten the composition. The layered construction emphasizes the Dunks signature lines, allowing the interplay of tones to define the look. It feels balanced, refined, and rooted in classic design. Fans appreciate how subtle shifts in color can refresh a heritage silhouette. The brown and pearl combination offers warmth without overwhelming the structure, making it easy to wear year round. It captures the Dunks ability to remain relevant through thoughtful palette choices. Clean and confident, this pair brings depth to a timeless frame. The Nike Dunk Low Dark Pony Soft Pearl was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Hare
Description: Jordan Brand paid homage to an old ad campaign classic by releasing the Jordan 6 Retro Hare, now available on StockX. The Hare colorway originally made its debut on an Air Jordan 7 in one of the first Jordan ads that featured Bugs Bunny. Jumpman keeps the tradition alive by transferring this iconic colorway to a new silhouette. This Jordan 6 consists of a white leather upper with grey underlays and a red detailing. A translucent tongue, patterned outsole, and a purple Jumpman on the heel complete the design. These sneakers released in April of 2020 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf White Gum
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf White Gum is a low-top golf shoe equipped with Air cushioning and a special traction pattern for the course. The white gum version of the Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf has an upper made of genuine leather. This material forms the perforated toe box and the side panels. Overlays in pure platinum, which have a subtle silver sheen, form the toe cap, eyestays, and heel counter. The Nike Swoosh adorns both sides in silver. The Air Jordan logo appears on the back of the heel, while the tongue bears a Jumpman patch. The shoe rests on a white Air-cushioned midsole and a gum rubber outsole. Our favorite things about this sneaker are the pure platinum overlays, which add more visual interest to an otherwise white shoe. The Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf White Gum was released on January 20, 2024, for $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Black (2024)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Black (2024) is part of a collaboration between Nike and Cactus Plant Flea Market, a streetwear label defined by its DIY aesthetic and playful designs. This sneaker represents one of the first times Cactus Plant Flea Market reimagined the classic Air Force 1. Although the shoe doesnt display bold Cactus Planet Flea Market design elements, it has several key details. The left shoe features AIR, while the right shoe displays FLEA in black bubble letters outlined in white. The all-black upper is made of leather and boasts tonal leather overlays, a Swoosh on the medial side panel, and perforations across the vamp for breathability. Our StockX experts like the black rubber outsole, which completes the black-on-black aesthetic. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Black (2024) was launched on May 7, 2024, and sold for $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Airscape
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Airscape is a fabric upper athletic shoe featuring multiple textures of mesh in Football Grey and Summit White, highlighted by curvilinear details. Nike, the American sneaker and athletic wear giant, is serious about performance in running shoes. The Air Zoom Pegasus Premium represents several new frontiers for the brand, including the first time that the full-length Air Zoom Unit has been used. At the Airscape Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium, the raised midsole follows the curved silhouette in Football Grey, accented by a full-length visible Air Zoom unit in Total Orange. The Nike Swoosh and Air Zoom branding accent the sides, tongue, heel tab, and Air Zoom unit. Our StockX experts feel that the best feature of the Air Zoom Pegasus Premium is its Total Orange accent, which draws attention to the styleÄôs evolution. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Airscape was released on January 30, 2025, and retailed for $210.

Model: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB
Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Hydrogen Blue
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Hydrogen Blue delivers a clean and focused take on one of Kobes most distinctive silhouettes, using hydrogen blue as its defining tone. White and light photo blue accents add contrast while maintaining a cohesive and performance oriented look. This pair stands out because of its simplicity and execution. The Kobe 9 EM already carries a unique identity, and this colorway allows the structure to shine without distraction. Fans appreciate how it balances performance and style, offering something that feels both modern and true to the original design. The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Hydrogen Blue was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Slide Glow Green (2022/2023 Restock)
Description: DISCLAIMER: US and UK sizing is the same and does not require any conversion. The Yeezy Slide Glow (2022 Restock) arrives as a more vibrant variation of the 2021 Yeezy Slide Glow. It is constructed with a Glow EVA foam for comfort and responsiveness. A grooved outsole adds proper traction for daily wear. The Yeezy Slide Glow (2022 Restock) released in May of 2022 and retailed for $60.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 White Vast Grey (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 White Vast Grey (Women's) is a shoe in womens sizes with a monochromatic colorway. The White Vast Grey (Women's) Nike Zoom Vomero 5 is made with a breathable and durable white mesh upper enhanced with TecTuff technology. Supportive artificial overlays form the toe cap and mudguard, while white TPU cages are seen on each side of the shoe with the Nike Swoosh on top. The heel counter also features a supportive cage with a crisscross pattern, along with subtle Nike branding at the back. A Nike Vomero 5 logo patch appears on the tongue, while Zoom Air cushioning in the midsole provides responsiveness and energy return. The midsole is a combination of white and Vast Grey, while the rubber outsole is black and white. What we appreciate most about this shoe is the Zoom Air cushioning subtly built into the model, which provides functionality and comfort. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 White Vast Grey (Women's) was released on March 25, 2024, for $160.

Display Name: adidas Samba Jane Disney Pixar's Toy Story Jessie (Women's)
Description: The Adidas Samba Jane Disney Pixar's Toy Story Jessie in White, Black, and Gum for Women is a collaborative release that brings one of the most beloved and spirited characters from the Toy Story universe into the Samba family through a silhouette specifically designed for the female foot, translating Jessie the Yodeling Cowgirl's iconic visual identity into a shoe that honors the character's personality and aesthetic without reducing her to a simple print or logo application. The Samba Jane is the women's specific variant of the Samba family that has been developed with female fit and proportions in mind, offering the same iconic silhouette elements that make the Samba one of the most universally beloved sneakers in the world in a construction that serves the female wearer with genuine last geometry and sizing consideration rather than simply scaling down the men's version. White and black on a Samba Jane creates the cleanest and most classic possible base for the Jessie character references, evoking the cowgirl's white shirt and black detailing from her iconic outfit while the gum sole adds the warm and vintage quality that connects the shoe back to the Samba's deep athletic archive heritage. Jessie occupies a specific and beloved place in the Toy Story character hierarchy as a figure whose story arc across the franchise touched on themes of abandonment, belonging, and the fierce loyalty of found family in ways that resonated with audiences of every age and made her one of the most emotionally complex and satisfying characters in Pixar's extraordinary catalog. The decision to use the Samba Jane as the vehicle for a Jessie collaborative release is particularly fitting because both the character and the silhouette carry a warmth, authenticity, and timeless quality that speaks across generations and demographic categories in ways that more trend dependent designs cannot sustain over time. For women who grew up loving Jessie and who now wear the Samba as one of their most consistent and culturally aware footwear choices, this collaborative release creates a direct and joyful connection between two beloved icons of their respective worlds in a shoe that is genuinely worth wearing every day. The Adidas Samba Jane Disney Pixar's Toy Story Jessie Women's was released on June 6, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Field General '82 SP Black White (Black Heel Tab)
Description: The Nike Field General 82 SP Black White Black Heel Tab brings an archival football inspired silhouette back into focus with a clean and minimal colorway. The black base is paired with white accents that highlight the shape, while the black heel tab keeps the design cohesive and understated. The low profile structure gives it a slightly retro feel that connects to its origins. What makes this pair stand out is its simplicity and heritage. Nike continues to revisit older silhouettes that carry historical relevance, and this release reflects that approach through a stripped back execution. The colorway makes it easy to wear, while the design offers something slightly different from more common models. It is a subtle and versatile option with a strong connection to Nikes past. The Nike Field General 82 SP Black White Black Heel Tab was released on February 3, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike GT Cut 3 Furious Blue
Description: The Nike GT Cut 3 Furious Blue brings explosive color to one of Nike Basketballs most responsive silhouettes. Furious blue dominates the upper, giving the GT Cut 3 a fast and aggressive presence that mirrors the way the shoe is meant to perform. Metallic and dark accents add contrast that sharpens the look, reinforcing speed and control as the core themes. Hoopers love this release because it feels built for modern play. The GT Cut line is respected for its court feel and responsiveness, and this colorway adds confidence without distraction. Collectors appreciate how Nike keeps the design focused on movement and precision, making Furious Blue feel like more than just a color swap. It is a sneaker that looks and feels locked in, appealing to players who rely on quick reactions and constant pressure. The Nike GT Cut 3 Furious Blue was released on February 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Big Money Savings
Description: Introducing the Nike SB Dunk Low Big Money Savings, a sneaker that pays homage to the thrifty spirit and celebrates the art of the find. Released on April 17, 2024, these kicks are a perfect match for the crowd with a penchant for vintage vibes and sustainable fashion. Decked in a mix of baroque brown, summit white, sanddrift, dark smoke grey, and paradise aqua, the design mirrors the eclectic array of goods one might discover in antique, vintage and thrift shops.? ?? ?Constructed with a medley of premium materials, the Nike SB Dunk Low tells its unique story through textures that evoke the thrill of thrifting. You'll notice the suede overlays reminiscent of well-worn leathers and rope-textured laces that speak to the craft and quality of past eras. The sneaker's inner tongue features a boldly stated 'BIG MONEY SAVINGS' tag, a playful nod to the unexpected deals and steals found in the hunt for hidden gems.? ?? ?At $125, the Nike SB Dunk Low Big Money Savings is a narrative woven into each thread, inspired by a sustainable choice that resonates with the values of its wearers. It's an invitation to explore the stories behind the style, to embrace the patina of the past, and to make a fashion statement that is as conscious as it is cool.
Colorway: Baroque Brown/Summit White-Sanddrift-Dark Smoke Grey-Paradise Aqua

Model: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low
Display Name: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low White
Description: The Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low White presents a distinctive fusion of classic and contemporary design elements. Constructed from a traditional white canvas, the White Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Lows upper exudes a timeless charm. A subtle fraying at the ankle introduces a touch of modernity to the overall design. The shoe incorporates a lace-up closure and a woven logo patch on the tongue, while the insole is branded, and the logo is engraved on the heel. Underneath, the shoe boasts a rubber sole personally crafted by designer Mihara, who shaped it by hand using clay. The chunky rubber soles feature a distinctive black high foxing tape, providing the sneaker with a subversive finish. The standout quality of the Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low White is its original sole. This not only contributes a unique aesthetic appeal to the sneaker but also highlights the designer's experimental and innovative approach to design. The shoe debuted for $200 on July 30th, 2022.

Display Name: Nike Vomero 18 Black Dark Smoke Grey Light Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike Vomero 18 Black Dark Smoke Grey Light Smoke Grey is a stealthy colorway presenting in black, light, and Dark Smoke Grey shades that delivers a soft, cushioned ride. The Nike Vomero 18 offers maximum cushioning and a plush feel, designed for runners who crave comfort with every stride. This particular silhouette features a dual-density midsole with ultra-responsive ZoomX foam layered over ReactX, resulting in enhanced energy return. Engineered mesh in the black upper allows the foot to breathe, while plush padding in the tongue and lining provides all-day snugness. Tonal black Swooshes adorn the sides, and reflective design details on the heel add a unique touch to this running shoe. Our experts believe that the strategic outsole pods underfoot and a redesigned traction pattern ensure smooth heel-to-toe transitions, making these standout features. Released on March 20, 2025, the Nike Vomero 18 Black Dark Smoke Grey Light Smoke Grey sneaker retailed for $145.

Display Name: Nike Maxfly 2 White Obsidian
Description: The Nike Maxfly 2 White Obsidian is built for speed, combining a lightweight structure with aggressive design elements that signal performance. The white upper keeps the look clean, while bright crimson, hyper turquoise, and obsidian accents introduce sharp contrast that highlights key areas of the silhouette. It feels engineered for motion. This pair resonates with athletes who prioritize efficiency and responsiveness. The Maxfly line is known for pushing track performance forward, and this version continues that with a design that feels both technical and visually striking. Fans of performance footwear appreciate how it blends innovation with a strong identity. The Nike Maxfly 2 White Obsidian was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Olive Grey Enigma Stone
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low in Olive Grey, Summit White, Pale Ivory, and Enigma Stone is a colorway that approaches the most iconic basketball shoe silhouette in sneaker history from a distinctly earthy and tonal direction, assembling a palette of warm neutrals and muted naturalistic shades that give the AJ1 Low a grounded and sophisticated character that feels completely at home in the current sneaker aesthetic landscape where earth tones and considered neutral palettes have emerged as the dominant and most enduring color direction across the market's most culturally influential releases. Olive grey occupies a specific and interesting space in the color spectrum that sits between the military associations of traditional olive and the urban neutrality of grey, creating a shade that feels simultaneously outdoorsy and city ready in a way that neither pure olive nor pure grey can achieve alone, and as the primary color on an AJ1 Low upper it creates an immediately distinctive and wearable foundation for the rest of the palette. Summit white, pale ivory, and enigma stone provide the supporting color story across the midsole, overlays, and detailing elements of the shoe, each one contributing a slightly different warmth and tone to the overall composition in a way that creates visual depth and interest within what might initially appear to be a simple neutral palette. Air Jordan 1 Lows in earthy and neutral colorways have consistently proven to be among the most commercially successful and culturally beloved entries in the model's vast seasonal colorway catalog because they offer the sneaker's iconic design heritage and cultural biography in the most universally wearable and outfit versatile format, avoiding the bold color statements that make some AJ1 colorways exciting for collection but challenging for consistent daily wear. The enigma stone color name is the most poetically evocative descriptor in this palette, suggesting a shade with mystery and depth that sits in the warm beige and tan range of the neutral spectrum and provides the final grounding note that pulls the olive grey, summit white, and pale ivory together into a fully cohesive and satisfying color story. For sneaker collectors and everyday wearers who want the Air Jordan 1 Low in the colorway most likely to work with every outfit in their wardrobe across every season and context without ever feeling like the wrong choice, olive grey and enigma stone is one of the most reliably excellent answers the current Jordan 1 Low catalog provides. The Air Jordan 1 Low in Olive Grey, Summit White, Pale Ivory, and Enigma Stone was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Union LA Bephies Beauty Supply Summer of 96
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High Union LA Bephies Beauty Supply The Summer of 96 hit the shelves on August 24, 2023. Bringing the heat with an iconic silhouette, this edition reinvents the Jordan 1 narrative. Drenched in a fresh sail, wolf grey, muslin, pale vanilla, kinetic green, and university gold colorway, this sneaker is a canvas of culture and style. What makes it stand out? The intricate woven pattern that seamlessly wraps around the entirety of the shoe, marking its distinct identity in the Jordan 1 lineup. The design is a flawless blend of the past meeting the present. Priced at a cool $200, the Jordan 1 Retro High Union LA Bephies was a must-cop from the jump on August 24, 2023.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Off-White Muslin
Description: Virgil Abloh added a second Jordan silhouette to his series of Nike collaborations with the Jordan 5 Retro High Off-White Muslin, now available on StockX. This release pays homage to the first Jordan that Virgil ever owned, the Air Jordan 5 Black Metallic. In signature fashion, Virgil has reimagined this classic silhouette in a way that embraces the importance of Nike Air technology. This Jordan 5 is comprised of a black textile mesh upper with translucent netted panels and circular window inserts throughout the shoe. 3M reflective tongues, fire red Jordan branding, and an aged translucent outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in February of 2020 and retailed for $225.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue (2026) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue 2026 GS delivers a seasonal take on one of the most iconic Jordan silhouettes, translating the signature design into a lighter and more wearable low top form. The white upper keeps the look clean and crisp, while university blue patent leather wraps the base with a bold and recognizable pop of color. Black accents add contrast, helping frame the design and maintain the balance that defines the Air Jordan 11. This pair stands out because it captures the essence of the original model while adapting it for everyday wear. Fans of the Air Jordan 11 appreciate how colorways like this highlight the patent leather and sleek shape without overwhelming the design. It feels fresh and energetic, making it a strong option for those who want a classic silhouette with a vibrant twist that still feels grounded in Jordan history. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue 2026 GS was released on April 18, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Particle Grey
Description: With color blocking similar to the 2014 Air Jordan 9 Barons, the Air Jordan 9 Particle Grey boasts a black nylon upper with quilted panels and light grey Durabuck mudguards. At the heel, a red Jumpman basketball emblem brings a sharp contrast to its neutral base. Nodding to the original Air Jordan 9, a white outsole with embossed graphics and phrases completes the design. The Air Jordan 9 Particle Grey released in June of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 Moss Point (Translucent Outsole)
Description: The Nike Book 1 Moss Point reflects Devin Bookers composed and methodical approach to the game through subtle color and clean structure. Barely grey sets a neutral foundation, while metallic silver and moon particle accents add quiet depth. Pale ivory details soften the look, giving the shoe a calm and polished presence that feels intentional and controlled rather than flashy. This colorway resonates with fans because it mirrors Bookers on court identity. The Book 1 line emphasizes precision and consistency, and this palette reinforces that philosophy through restraint. Collectors appreciate how the design prioritizes balance and clarity, making it easy to wear while still feeling distinct. It is a sneaker built around focus and confidence, offering personality through nuance rather than excess or noise. The Nike Book 1 Moss Point was released on April 18, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Archive Dark Sulfur
Description: The NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Yellow is the result of a collaboration between Nike and Tom Sachs. The Tom Sachs Yellow NikeCraft takes on a functional design with a yellow mesh upper with tonal suede overlays and a contrasting white Swoosh on the lateral and medial sides. Orange tabs on the heel and tongue allow an easy on and off. The shoe sits a top a cream midsole packed with EVA for cushioning, while a black waffle-traction rubber outsole is for grip. The NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Yellow was released on the 2nd of September 2022, and originally retailed for $110.

Display Name: Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 4 White Obsidian Mist
Description: The Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 4 White Obsidian Mist refines Nikes premier racing silhouette with a cooler and more controlled aesthetic. White and obsidian mist tones give the shoe a composed and technical look, allowing its aggressive geometry and sculpted midsole to speak clearly. It feels fast and precise even at rest, reflecting the Vaporflys reputation as a tool built entirely around efficiency and forward motion. Fans gravitate toward this colorway because it balances innovation and restraint. The Vaporfly Next% 4 pushes performance forward, but this palette keeps the presentation calm and focused. Collectors appreciate how it highlights the shoes engineering rather than overpowering it with color, making it a favorite among runners who value clarity, discipline, and marginal gains above all else. The Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 4 White Obsidian Mist was released on April 3, 2025 with a retail price of $260.

Display Name: Nike Blazer Mid 77 Black White (PS)
Description: The Nike Blazer Mid 77 Black White PS brings vintage basketball heritage to a kid friendly size with timeless contrast. Black leather wraps the upper, while a crisp white Swoosh and midsole create bold definition. Subtle Team Orange accents add a hint of playful color without distracting from the classic look. The mid cut profile and simple paneling preserve the retro feel that made the Blazer a staple. Parents and young sneaker fans appreciate how this silhouette balances history with everyday wearability. The black and white pairing remains endlessly versatile, while the mid top shape offers standout presence. It introduces the next generation to a true Nike classic in a clean and confident way. Simple, iconic, and built to last, this pair carries heritage forward. The Nike Blazer Mid 77 Black White PS was released on June 6, 2021 with a retail price of $70.

Display Name: Nike Killshot 2 Phantom Black
Description: The Nike Killshot 2 Phantom Black is a lifestyle shoe channeling a timeless design in a Phantom Black color scheme. Ah, tennis and badminton, those were the days. Even if life is too busy to enjoy a game now, you can still enjoy the old-school style of the Killshot 2. Presenting in a Phantom Black colorway, this shoe has a minimalist aesthetic that complements casual outings with those that are a level up. The upper is smooth leather and forms the background for the white stitching, which adds details. Retro Nike branding in white is seen on the heel. The black outsole is gum rubber and will hide scuffs and scrapes. Something we think gives this shoe its character are the various overlay stitching lines throughout, including the outline of Nike Swooshes. When it was released to the marketplace on June 1, 2024, the Nike Killshot 2 Phantom Black retailed for $85.

Display Name: New Balance 550 Clay Ash Melon Water
Description: The New Balance 550 in Clay Ash and Melon Water is a colorway that takes the basketball-heritage silhouette's clean and vintage athletic aesthetic into the warmest and most seasonally evocative palette expression available in the 550's current seasonal production, the clay ash and melon water pairing creating a color story that sits at the intersection of dried earth and ripe summer fruit in a combination that feels simultaneously nostalgic and genuinely current. Clay ash provides a warm and slightly muted base that suits the 550's leather and nylon upper construction with the natural and slightly aged quality that the silhouette's 1989 basketball heritage most authentically inhabits, while melon water introduces a pale and slightly translucent warm pink-orange that carries the specific color character of its fruit reference with genuine freshness and visual warmth. The combination creates a 550 that works most naturally in warm weather and transitional season contexts where both tones' inherent warmth and organic associations feel most seasonally coherent and genuinely rewarding. New Balance 550 colorways in warm and fruit-adjacent palettes consistently generate strong collector response from the community that has embraced the silhouette as one of the current era's most beloved and wearable basketball heritage platforms, the clean court shoe proportions and premium materials creating the perfect canvas for color stories as specific and tonally considered as clay ash and melon water. At one hundred and twenty dollars the 550 in this colorway delivers the platform's full heritage construction quality and current lifestyle credibility in a color combination that rewards the collector who appreciates when a seasonal New Balance release reaches for something genuinely palette-specific rather than defaulting to the more predictable tonal combinations that most seasonal basketball heritage colorways employ without the same palette intelligence and naming specificity. The New Balance 550 in Clay Ash and Melon Water was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 10 Retro OG Steel (2025)
Description: The Jordan 10 Retro OG Steel (2025) revives a timeless court classic with a clean, high-contrast palette that never misses. Dressed in White/Black-Light Steel Grey, this pair balances premium leather up top with a sleek black tongue and collar for a crisp, versatile look that moves from street to sideline with ease. The signature speed-lacing system offers quick lockdown, while a padded collar and plush lining keep every step comfortable. Underfoot, the Jordan 10s famed striped outsole returns, showcasing Michaels early-career highlights and delivering dependable traction, so you get heritage storytelling and on-foot performance in one. Style code HJ6779-104 anchors the release for collectors who prioritize the details and the legacy. True to the Jordan 10 blueprint, cushioning comes courtesy of a responsive Air unit housed in a lightweight midsole, striking a smooth balance between support and all-day wearability. Subtle Light Steel Grey hits add depth to the neutral base, giving this colorway its refined edge and making it easy to pair with denim, joggers, or tailored athleisure. Whether youre building a rotation around iconic retros or seeking a standout everyday option, the Jordan 10 Retro OG Steel (2025) delivers a polished finish with unmistakable lineage. With its release date set for August 2, 2025 and a retail price of $200, this modern take on a storied silhouette is poised to be a cornerstone pickup for fans of classic Jordan design. Our team loves this product because it blends heritage detailing, versatile styling, and dependable cushioning, making it a go-to for collectors and daily wear alike.

Display Name: Alexander McQueen Oversized Black
Description: The Alexander McQueen Oversized Black is a stylish and comfortable sneaker that is perfect for any casual occasion. Made from high-quality materials, this sneaker features a sleek black design that is both timeless and modern. The oversized sole provides excellent support and cushioning, making it ideal for all-day wear. Released on April 1, 2020, this sneaker has quickly become a favorite among fashion enthusiasts. With a retail price of $490, it is a premium product that is worth the investment. Whether you're looking for a stylish sneaker to wear on the streets or a comfortable shoe for everyday wear, the Alexander McQueen Oversized Black is an excellent choice.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Next Nature White Blue Tint (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature White Blue Tint Womens delivers a fresh and crisp interpretation of the Dunk Low through cool tones and clean contrast. The white base keeps the design classic, while blue tint accents add softness and clarity that feel calm and contemporary. It highlights the Dunks simple proportions, allowing color placement to carry the visual interest. Fans love this release because it feels effortless. The colorway works across seasons and outfits, making it an easy choice for daily wear. Collectors appreciate how the Next Nature line refreshes core silhouettes with subtle updates, keeping them relevant without losing identity. This pair stands out through balance and restraint, reinforcing why the Dunk Low continues to thrive as both a cultural icon and a dependable everyday sneaker. The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature White Blue Tint Womens was released on March 27, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Dune Red
Description: The Jordan 13 Retro Dune Red reintroduces the Air Jordan 13 Retro silhouette with an updated combination of colors and materials. Instead of tumbled or pebbled leather, the dimpled overlays are a texturized textile in Dune Red. In addition, the upper is synthetic leather and microfiber, which provide a softer finish than animal-derived materials can produce. Terra Blush accents are on the microfiber and a panel along the midsole. Like other Jordan 13 Retro models, this version displays the signature holographic eye on the medial heel. In terms of branding, the padded tongue boasts a Jumpman logo in Dune Red, and the area beneath the laces houses a Dune Red "JORDAN" logo tag with white lettering. Our StockX experts like the paw-like outsole, which pays tribute to Michael Jordans "Black Cat" alter ego. The Jordan 13 Retro Dune Red was released on June 25, 2024, and retailed at $210.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low White Black Metallic Gold Swoosh
Description: The Jordan 1 Low White Black Metallic Gold Swoosh is a low-top silhouette with a design that is a modified version of the original model, which came out in 1985. The White Black Metallic Gold Swoosh Jordan 1 Low has a calf leather upper in black and white. Black forms the side panels and the toebox, which is perforated for increased air flow, while white takes over the toecap and mudguard, eyestays, heel counter, and ankle area. As the name suggests, the Nike Swoosh is found in Metallic Gold across both side panels, and a gold Air Jordan logo is embroidered onto the heel counter. A gold Jumpman logo is also found on the black tongue. The rubber midsole is white, and the shoe sits atop a black outsole. The most interesting feature of this shoe is the alternation of black and white leather on the upper, which gives it even more visual interest. The Jordan 1 Low White Black Metallic Gold Swoosh was released on June 1, 2024, for $115.j

Display Name: Jordan 8 Retro White True Red (2025) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 8 Retro Bugs Bunny 2025 GS brings back a beloved classic tied to one of the most memorable eras of Jordan Brand storytelling. The white, black, and true red colorway instantly recalls the Bugs Bunny association that helped cement the Jordan 8 as a cultural icon beyond basketball. In grade school sizing, the silhouette still carries the same bold structure and unmistakable attitude that defined the original release. Fans gravitate toward this pair because it blends nostalgia and authenticity so naturally. The Jordan 8s design is already loud and expressive, and the Bugs Bunny color story amplifies that personality without feeling dated. Collectors appreciate it as a gateway into Jordan history, offering younger fans a connection to a legendary moment where sport, animation, and pop culture collided in a way that still resonates today. The Air Jordan 8 Retro Bugs Bunny 2025 GS was released on December 20, 2025 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: Under Armour Curry Flow 12 What The Bay
Description: The Under Armour Curry Flow 12 What The Bay is an asymmetrical athletic shoe pair featuring a Multi-Color palette in ombré golden orange on the right and ombré blue on the left. Midsole and heel tab details correspond to the alternate colorway on each shoe, and Curry Flow branding accents the midsole and tongue. American brand Under Armor has been partnering with NBA MVP Stephen Curry since 2013. In 2020, Under Armor and Curry created his eponymous offshoot, Curry Brand, known for sneakers and apparel. Curry Brand is also known for its limited edition shoe colorways, such as the What The Bay, which are eye catching and quickly become covetable. The Curry Flow 12 has an asymmetrical color story and soles, which immediately draws the eye to the foot. The Under Armour Curry 12 What The Bay released on February 14, 2025, and retailed for $140.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 White Black
Description: Channel timeless design and everyday comfort with the Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 White Black. This modern take on a classic runner pairs a crisp white leather upper with bold black Tiger Stripes for a clean, high-contrast look that complements jeans, joggers, or tailored casual fits. The low-profile silhouette nods to vintage track heritage, while the signature heel-cross reinforcement and branded heel flap add distinctive detailing that collectors and style purists will recognize instantly. A cushioned footbed and padded collar deliver all-day wearability, and the flexible rubber outsole provides confident traction from city streets to weekend errands. Thoughtfully crafted for versatility, the Mexico 66 balances sleek proportions with subtle texture, making it a go-to sneaker for minimalist wardrobes and statement outfits alike. Ventilated lining helps keep things comfortable in warmer months, and the streamlined toe box ensures a refined shape that never feels bulky. Finished in the iconic White/Black colorway and anchored by a durable cupsole, this pair stands out for its blend of heritage aesthetics and modern comfort, ideal for anyone seeking a reliable, stylish staple that transitions effortlessly from day to night. Our team loves this product because it delivers a heritage-driven look with upgraded comfort and a versatile White/Black palette that fits seamlessly into any rotation.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Bred
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Bred reinterprets a basketball icon through one of the most powerful color stories in Nike history. Black dominates the upper for a sleek and commanding presence, while university red accents add just enough contrast to signal heritage and attitude. The familiar Air Force 1 shape remains unchanged, allowing color and legacy to carry the impact. This pair connects with fans because the bred palette carries undeniable cultural weight. It feels bold, confident, and rooted in decades of street and sport influence. Collectors appreciate how the LV8 execution refreshes a classic without overdesigning it, keeping the focus on simplicity and symbolism. It is a shoe that thrives on familiarity, proving that some color combinations never lose their relevance or power. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Bred was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Ja 2 Kool-Aid Tropical Punch
Description: Turn heads on and off the court with the Nike Ja 2 "Kool-Aid Tropical Punch," a high-energy take on Ja Morants quick-strike signature line. Drenched in a vibrant Bright Crimson base with Hyper Pink, Photo Blue, and Black hits, this colorway channels summertime flavor with a bold, electric finish. A Flat Silver Swoosh adds a sleek pop, while the streamlined upper supports dynamic cuts and sudden stops. Designed for speed and control, the Ja 2 silhouette pairs a breathable build with plush, responsive cushioning underfoot, helping you stay light on your feet during full-court sprints and confident during clutch possessions. The durable rubber outsole features a traction pattern tuned for multi-directional grip, keeping you planted when your game changes direction in a heartbeat. Details matter when the pace is relentless, and the Nike Ja 2 delivers with a supportive fit that locks in without weighing you down. Padded collar comfort, a secure lacing system, and reinforced high-wear zones mean you can push the tempo without compromise. Whether youre lacing up for a league night or styling a standout look for the street, the "Kool-Aid Tropical Punch" palette, paired with style code IF0302-600 / IF0303-600, brings eye-catching color and confident energy to every step. If you value a sneaker that blends pop-forward design with performance-minded features, this pair is a slam dunk for your rotation. Our team loves this product because it delivers lively color with court-ready comfort and grip, making it a go-to pick for players who want standout style and dependable, responsive performance.

Display Name: Nike Air Diamond Turf Ravens (2025)
Description: The Nike Air Diamond Turf Ravens (2025) is a low-top athletic shoe and a signature shoe for former NFL player and coach of the Colorado Buffaloes, Deion Sanders. American athletic shoe brand Nike has long collaborated with professional athletes, utilizing their stellar design team to incorporate players inspiration with athletic functionality. The Ravens (2025) Nike Air Diamond Turf salutes the final team of Deion Sanders's playing career, the Baltimore Ravens. With a monochrome Black suede upper, accented by an arch strap that displays Metallic Gold mesh inserts on the sides and the Nike Swoosh logo over the lace panel in White. The curved midsole in Black displays Nike Air branding with visible pops of Club Purple on the outsole. Ravens' branding on the tongue and embroidered Nike Air branding on the rear heel in Metallic Gold complete the look. In our opinion, the best feature of the Diamond Turf is its Black suede upper, which makes the Metallic Gold and Club Purple accents pop. The Nike Air Diamond Turf Ravens (2025) was released on May 30, 2025, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Levi's Light Orewood Brown
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Levi's Light Orewood Brown pairs the silhouettes iconic, layered sidewalls with a refined neutral palette thats easy to style year-round. Light Orewood Brown ripples across the upper in graduated tones, contrasted by crisp White and punctuated with Gym Red accents for just the right pop. The sculpted lines and speed-lacing system honor Sergio Lozanos original design, while the mini Swoosh and heel details deliver that unmistakable Air Max attitude. A plush tongue and padded collar enhance step-in comfort, making this mens sneaker as inviting as it is striking, whether youre dressing it up with denim or down with athletic staples. Function meets heritage in every stride. The visible Air units in the heel and forefoot provide responsive cushioning, supported by a resilient foam midsole and a grippy rubber outsole built for daily wear. Breathable mesh through the vamp helps regulate airflow, while durable overlays add structure and shape retention over time. Anchored by the model code HM4743-100, this edition balances lifestyle appeal with sport-born performance, delivering stability and comfort from commute to weekend. With its versatile colorway and timeless Air Max DNA, the Levi's Light Orewood Brown stands out as an effortless go-to in any rotation. Our team loves this product because it blends the legendary feel of visible Air with a sophisticated neutral palette that elevates everyday outfits.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Goadome Low Black
Description: The Nike Air Max Goadome Low Black brings rugged attitude to the Air Max lineage through a sturdy and grounded design. Wrapped entirely in black and Anthracite, the upper feels durable and purpose driven. The low cut build keeps the profile streamlined, while the visible Air unit in the heel ties it back to performance roots. It carries the spirit of outdoor exploration within a silhouette built for everyday wear. Fans appreciate the Goadome for its toughness and versatility. The all black execution reinforces its bold presence, making it easy to style while maintaining a strong identity. It bridges the gap between boot inspired durability and Air Max comfort, offering something distinct within the broader lineup. This pair stands firm with confidence and functional edge. The Nike Air Max Goadome Low Black was released on February 20, 2026 with a retail price of $175.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Off-White Sail
Description: Virgil Abloh added a second colorway to his Jordan 5 collaboration with the Jordan 5 Retro High Off-White Sail, now available on StockX. This release pays homage to the first Jordan that Virgil ever owned, the Air Jordan 5. In signature fashion, Virgil has reimagined this classic silhouette in a way that embraces the importance of Nike Air technology. This Jordan 5 is comprised of a sail textile mesh upper with translucent netted panels and circular window inserts throughout the shoe. 3M reflective tongues, fire red Jordan branding, and an aged translucent outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in 2020 and retailed for $225.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Grape (2025) (GS)
Description: The Jordan 5 Retro Grape (2025) (GS) refreshes an icon with vibrant energy sized perfectly for young sneaker fans. Dressed in the White/Grape IceNew Emerald palette, this Air Jordan 5 channels the famed "Grape" lineage with crisp white leather, a reflective tongue, and the signature lace lock for a secure, customizable fit. Translucent side netting boosts airflow, while the padded collar and plush interior cradle growing feet. Classic shark-tooth accents bite along the midsole in New Emerald, echoing the models fighter-jet inspiration, and the icy, translucent outsole adds a cool finish that grips with confidence from school halls to weekend adventures. Designed by Tinker Hatfield and revered since 1990, the Jordan 5 Retro delivers heritage style paired with modern comfort in a GS-specific build. A visible Air unit cushions every step, and durable rubber traction stands up to daily wear. The sculpted foam midsole softens landings, and the sleek profile pairs easily with uniforms, athletic gear, and casual fits alike. Marked with style code HQ7980-100 and slated for a June 21, 2025 release, this pair balances standout color with timeless design, making it a smart pick for any young rotation. Our team loves this product because it blends classic Air Jordan 5 details with playful Grape Ice and New Emerald pops, delivering comfort, durability, and unmistakable style for everyday wear.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Royalty Taxi
Description: Drawing a strong resemblance to the original Air Jordan 12 Taxi, the Air Jordan 12 Royalty Taxi elevates the classic design with minor alterations in its detailing. The design features a white tumbled leather upper with a black toe wrap and gold hook eyelets. A new feature is on the toe wrap, where a gold plaquet is prominent on the lateral side. From there, a woven heel tag and matching sole completes the design. The Air Jordan 12 Royalty Taxi releases in November of 2021 and retails for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Mocha
Description: Building off the success of their previous collaborations, Travis Scott adds yet another new design to his collaborative relationship with Jumpman via the Air Jordan 1 Low Travis Scott, now available on StockX. Travis teased the release of this shoe while on his Astroworld tour, leaving fans of both his music and the Jordan Brand alike with one question: When are these shoes dropping? On the Friday night of July 19, 2019, Travis answered the masses by making them available on his website, with a release on the SNKRS app following the next day. This AJ 1 Low features a black upper with dark brown overlays and red accents on the branding. Much like the Air Jordan 1 High Travis Scott, La Flame added his signature backwards Swoosh logo on the lateral side. "Cactus Jack" insignias on the heel and inner upper atopa sail midsole and dark brown outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in July of 2019 and retailed for $130.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Desert Boot Salt
Description: The adidas Yeezy Desert Boot Salt, Influenced by military and utility design, was made available as part of Season 7 lineup collection. This version was made of breathable mesh, suede, and nubuck with a Salt color palette. Its disassembled design lines are reminiscent of the 500 sneakers. Rubber outsoles are .finished in complementary colors. A 3M fluorescent nylon pull tab runs the entire length of the tongue's spine. A thick foam midsole with EVA cushioning and a serrated rubber outsole, both of which take on tonal colors dependent on the upper, complete the overall design. The adidas Yeezy Desert Boot Salt first debuted on 14 September 2019 and retailed at $200.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Beige Grass Green
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 evolved from a sneaker called the Limber-Up training shoe that was first developed in 1966 and designed for Japanese athletes taking part in the 1968 Summer Olympics. Onitsuka Tiger changed the name of this sneaker to the Mexico 66 in the early 2000s and continues to release it in new colorways, including the Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Beige Grass Green. This version of the Mexico 66 sneaker keeps the same classic shape that the original version had back in the 1960s. It's a slim sneaker with a beige upper made of leather and brown accents on both the front and back of the shoe. It also has an OrthoLite inner sole to provide extra cushioning and overall comfort. What our experts love most about this sneaker, though, are the green Onitsuka Tiger stripes on it. The Mexico 66 was one of the first Onitsuka Tiger sneakers to feature them, and they're every bit as iconic today as they were 60 years ago. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Beige Grass Green sneakers were released on May 19, 2023, for a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Speed Red
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Speed Red brings raw energy to a silhouette known for balance and structure, using bold red tones to emphasize motion and intensity. Speed red dominates the upper, giving the shoe an aggressive and athletic feel that highlights the Air Max 90s sharp lines and layered panels. The contrast with white and darker accents keeps the look grounded, letting color deliver impact without losing control or wearability. Fans love this release because it feels fast and confident. The Air Max 90 has always thrived when strong color stories meet its structured design, and Speed Red does exactly that. Collectors appreciate it as a statement Air Max that still works in daily rotation, offering visual punch without gimmicks. It captures the essence of Nike running heritage translated into modern street style, where clarity and confidence matter more than complexity. The Nike Air Max 90 Speed Red was released on April 11, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro University Blue
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro University Blue highlights a timeless design with bold, inspired color blocking. This retro sneaker redefines the iconic Dunk silhouette with vibrant colors and a meticulous finish, showing off a lovely mixture of original designs with striking visuals. The University Blue Dunk Low Retro by Nike comes with smooth leather panels in white and bright blue, giving you a two-tone design. Blue overlays extend across the toe box, eyestays, and heel, while Nike branding appears in matching blue and white on the tongue tag and heel tab. The foam midsole provides lightweight comfort, with a rubber outsole for traction. Introduced in 1985, the Dunk revolutionized basketball footwear, later gaining a cult following in casual wear. Something we love about the Nike Dunk Low Retro University Blue is its low-profile silhouette that gives you added versatility, and its two-tone leather overlays for a dynamic visual contrast. This sneaker retailed at $115 when it was released on October 1, 2024.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro Fauna Brown Soft Pearl
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro Fauna Brown Soft Pearl leans into earthy tones with a balanced and seasonal palette. Dressed in Fauna Brown with Soft Pearl and Black accents, the upper highlights the classic two tone panel construction. The low cut shape and sturdy cupsole preserve the silhouettes basketball origin. The brown and pearl combination gives the shoe a warm and versatile feel, making it ideal for transitional seasons. Subtle black accents add depth without overpowering the design. It captures the Dunks ongoing ability to evolve through thoughtful color stories while maintaining its heritage appeal. The Nike Dunk Low Retro Fauna Brown Soft Pearl was released on August 6, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Triple Black
Description: Yeezy introduced a new variation of their 700 series with the adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Triple Black, now available on StockX. Although the silhouette is similar to previous models, this shoe differs by displaying "700" branding on the upper using compact materials. This Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN is comprised of a triple black nylon upper paired with reflective detailing. A solid black sole with Boost cushioning completes the design. These sneakers released in February of 2020 and retailed for $220.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Shorts (GS)
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Shorts (GS) is a pair of shoes for grade schoolers that pays homage to Michael Jordans good luck charm of wearing his UNC varsity shorts underneath his Bulls uniform. This version of the Jordan 3 Retro is made with a base of white leather. Photon Dust light gray forms the round toe cap, heel support, and ankle area. Hydrogen Blue accents are on the eyestays, paying homage to the colors of UNC, and a Hydrogen Blue Jumpman logo with Air branding is on the heel. The midsole under the heel is also Hydrogen Blue, and a visible Air unit is seen under the heel. The rest of the midsole is white, and the outsole is a light gray color. What we like best about this shoe is the clean paneled look of the upper, achieved by the white leather with light-gray accents. The Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Shorts (GS) was released on February 22, 2025, for a price of $150.
Colorway: Summit White/Hydrogen Blue/Legend Blue/Photon Dust/Pure Platinum/Sail

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Suede Panda
Description: As classic as you can get, the Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Suede Panda is a durable and always-on shoe ready to be taken out regardless of the occasion. These black and white low-rise basketball-inspired shoes have stood the test of time with Nike fans and once again deliver the goods in stylish suede and leather textiles. The upper colorways are a bold contrast of black and white, hence the Panda name. Foam midsoles offer lightweight and highly responsive cushioning for extended wear. The rubber outsole provides durable traction for quick responses when you need to stay light on your feet. The padded collar adds extra comfort, and the Nike Swoosh sits on the outside of the shoes while the tongue boasts the Nike name. Where will you take your favorite Dunk Low Retros? We love the bold contrast of this classic sneaker cut, making it one of the most contemporary pairs of Nike sneakers for everyday use. The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Suede Panda was released on 12 July 2024, priced at $125.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 What The
Description: Nike Book 1 What The feels like a celebration of Devin Bookers scoring creativity distilled into one expressive sneaker. The What The approach pulls together contrasting colors and ideas, turning the Book 1 into a visual collage that reflects Bookers versatility and confidence on the court. It feels bold and intentional, designed to stand out without losing performance focus. Collectors enjoy this release because it captures personality and chaos in a controlled way. The Book 1 silhouette remains sleek and functional, while the mixed design elements give it character and replay value. It appeals to fans who enjoy sneakers that tell multiple stories at once, rewarding attention and appreciation beyond a single glance. The Nike Book 1 What The was released on 12/19/2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Carmine (2021)
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Carmine returned in its original form in 2021. The nearly 20-year-old colorway first made its appearance in 1991 during Michael Jordans 91-92 season and brought in a new form of color blocking to the signature silhouette. The Air Jordan 6 Carmine combines red, white, and black colors to represent the Chicago Bulls signature colors. The upper features bold red and white colors that help the model pop while on foot. From there, the upper is met with a white and black midsole, with hits of an icy blue outsole appear as well. The final touch to this OGs return is the signature "Nike Air" on the heel, replacing 2008 and 2012 retros "Jumpman" logo. The Air Jordan 6 Carmine released in February of 2021 for $200.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Grey Yellow Navy
Description: The New Balance 9060 Grey Yellow Navy pushes the silhouettes futuristic design language through a layered mix of tones that balance neutrality with contrast. Grey dominates the upper, creating a grounded base, while yellow and navy accents add energy and depth across the exaggerated midsole and paneling. The sculpted shape and stacked proportions give the 9060 its signature look, blending retro inspiration with a more experimental edge. Fans are drawn to this model because it feels like a step forward while still referencing New Balances running heritage. The mix of colors keeps it versatile without feeling flat, and the bold structure makes it stand out in any rotation. It is a strong example of how the brand continues to evolve its design language into something more modern and expressive. The New Balance 9060 Grey Yellow Navy was released on May 31, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Black Gum (2022)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Black Gum (2022) is consistent with an all-black upper. The sole opts for a gum construction to give the AF1 a twist. The AF1 Low 07 Black Gum features a black leather base with tonal black overlays on the toecap and heel wrap. The ankle entry also dressed in black has extra padding for comfort. A black Swoosh hits the perimeters to accent the black-on-black build. The midsole and Nike branding on the heel patch and tongue all feature the black color. The only contrast is a full gum outsole that falls in line with the monochromatic theme. Nike air cushioning on the midsole and the padded collar are designed to give your foot comfort. What our experts love about the AF1 Black Gum sneakers is their monochromatic theme that makes it fit for any occasion. Pair the Black Gum with any Nike apparel for luxe looks. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Black Gum (2022) was released on August 1, 2022, retailing for $110.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Explorer
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Explorer expands on the Jurassic Park-inspired storytelling seen in the Ja 3 lineup, this time leaning into a brighter, more adventurous palette. Featuring green spark with black, university red, and dynamic yellow accents, the colorway channels the lush, unpredictable environment of the franchises island setting. Where the "Raptor" edition focused on intensity and aggression, the "Explorer" version shifts toward exploration and discovery, reflecting Ja Morants evolving presence as a player who continues to push boundaries. The Ja 3s modern, angular design works naturally with this theme, allowing the contrasting colors to create movement and energy across the upper. When the Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Explorer released, it retailed for $135 and dropped on April 10, 2026. With its green spark, black, university red, and dynamic yellow colorway, this release offers a more vibrant take on the crossover, expanding the narrative beyond a single theme.

Display Name: adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Liberty London Black Floral Gum (Women's)
Description: The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Liberty London Black Floral Gum Womens delivers a delicate and fashion forward take on the silhouette through its floral detailing and refined construction. The core black base is layered with Liberty London floral patterns, creating a textured and expressive look. Off white accents add contrast, while the gum sole keeps it grounded in heritage. Fans of Liberty collaborations appreciate how intricate patterns bring a more artistic and feminine feel to classic adidas models. The combination of floral design and low profile structure gives it a unique identity. It is a sneaker that blends heritage form with expressive and detailed styling.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Enflame Amber
Description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Enflame Amber features a pale yellow mesh, leather, and suede upper with brown and teal overlays located over the forefoot. 3M detailing on the heel and a bright orange Boost sole finishes off this colorful design. The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Enflame Amber released in June of 2021 and retailed for $240.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Protro ASG Hollywood 3D (2026)
Description: The Nike Kobe 6 Protro ASG Hollywood 3D (2026) marks the return of a standout All-Star colorway first introduced in 2011 during NBA All-Star Weekend in Los Angeles. Dressed in dark grey with chlorine blue and daring red accents, the sneaker channels the energy of that moment when Kobe Bryant represented LA on one of basketballs biggest stages. The textured upper sets the foundation, while bold color placement gives the design a striking visual identity that feels both nostalgic and refreshed. What truly defines the "Hollywood 3D" concept is its playful mismatch execution. One shoe features a red heel counter while the other swaps in blue, with Nike Swooshes alternating between red and blue across each pair. This intentional contrast draws inspiration from classic red-and-blue 3D glasses once worn in movie theaters, a nod to Hollywoods cinematic culture and the spectacle surrounding All-Star Weekend. The result is a sneaker that feels dynamic and expressive, designed to look different from every angle. When the Nike Kobe 6 Protro ASG Hollywood 3D (2026) released, it retailed for $200. By reviving a colorway rooted in the 2011 Los Angeles All-Star Game and leaning fully into its 3D-inspired storytelling, this release celebrates Kobes legacy with a design that remains just as bold and memorable today.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2025)

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro French Blue (2025) (GS)
Description: The Jordan 12 Retro French Blue (2025) (GS) revives a fan-favorite colorway with crisp, confident style for everyday wear and standout moments. Display Name: adidas Samba Jane Crew Navy White (Women's)

Display Name: adidas Samba Jane Cloud White Pink (Women's)

Display Name: adidas Ultra Boost 1.0 DNA Triple Black

Display Name: Nike Kobe 11 Elite Low Protro Fade to Black (2026)
Description: The Nike Kobe 11 Elite Low Protro Fade to Black revisits one of the most respected storytelling series in the Kobe archive, originally introduced in 2016 as part of a countdown to Bryants retirement. Dressed in black with metallic gold accents, the design reflects the final chapter of Kobes career, gradually transitioning from lighter tones to darker ones across the collection. Collectors appreciate it as a foundational piece, one that prioritizes wearability and longevity over momentary trends, making it a staple that stays relevant long after release. The Nike Dunk Low SE Triple Black was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: adidas Vario Flat Earther Pharrell White Black
Description: The Adidas Vario Flat Earther Pharrell in White Black is a minimalist lifestyle sneaker released as part of Pharrell Williams's adidas VIRGINIA creative universe, drawing directly from the adidas Yoga Vario originally released in the Fall Winter 2004 season as a functional shoe for yoga practice, reinterpreted here as a stripped-back low-profile lifestyle sneaker with a full-grain leather upper, a velcro strap and shroud system that sweeps across the toe box carrying the Three Stripes branding motif, leather lining, EVA sockliner, and a direct-injected outsole that gives the shoe its flat, close-to-the-ground stance that inspired the Flat Earther name Pharrell gave the model in reference to his design intention of creating a shoe that provides a sense of grounding and balance while simultaneously encouraging a shift in perspective. The Supplier Color Core Black Cloud White colorway constructs the shoe in its white full-grain leather base with black Three Stripes on the velcro strap system, creating the most broadly wearable and cleanly graphic of the two launch colorways alongside the white and green version, with the black accents carrying the Flat Earther's minimal design vocabulary in the high-contrast black and white combination that most directly communicates the shoe's avant-garde restraint without the seasonal color specificity of the green version. The velcro strap and shroud is the design's most architecturally distinctive element, serving simultaneously as the shoe's closure system and as the primary surface for the Three Stripes branding in a format that differs from both standard lacing and the typical lateral placement of the Three Stripes, connecting to soccer boot and yoga shoe design references rather than conventional lifestyle sneaker construction. Pharrell Williams launched his VIRGINIA creative platform with adidas as a multidisciplinary universe encompassing music, events, limited-edition products, and creative experimentation, with the footwear line beginning with an oversized Superstar in early 2025 and expanding through the Jellyfish chunky platform sneaker that won the Footwear News Achievement Award for Shoe of the Year in 2025 before pivoting with the Flat Earther to the opposite end of the profile spectrum, demonstrating the VIRGINIA line's ability to operate across the full range of footwear silhouette territory. The shoe's origins in the Yoga Vario FW04 connect Pharrell's archival research process to one of adidas's most overlooked and niche historical releases, consistent with the broader VIRGINIA approach of surfacing unexpected adidas heritage pieces as creative starting points rather than defaulting to the more celebrated archival models that other collaborators typically target. Released April 11, 2026 through adidas.com/pharrell and the CONFIRMED app at $140 retail, the white-black version was one of two launch colorways alongside the white-green pair. The Adidas Vario Flat Earther Pharrell White Black was released on April 11, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Off White Aurora Coffee (Women's)

Display Name: Nike Cryoshot Tiempo R10 Jacquemus
Description: The Nike Cryoshot Tiempo R10 Jacquemus is Simon Porte Jacquemus's contribution to Nike's X2 World Cup collection representing France, transforming the Nike Tiempo Legend R10, the early-2000s boot most associated with Ronaldinho during Barcelona's peak years, into a lifestyle sneaker through the Cryoshot process with the most minimal and most quietly luxurious approach of the seven-pair collection, featuring a premium white leather upper with Sport Royal and University Red accents whose stud arrangement on the Cryoshot outsole specifically mimics the colors of France's flag as the primary national team reference embedded in the design. Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Summit White Daybreak
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Summit White Daybreak is the most tonally restrained and most elegantly understated release in the growing Mamba Forever Air Force 1 lineup, a Summit White-based pair that applies the series' allover snakeskin embossing treatment to premium white leather and deploys Daybreak, a soft blue-purple tone that sits between periwinkle and lavender, as the sole accent color across the collar lining, outsole, and heel details. Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Black University Blue (2026) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro in Black, University Blue, and White for Grade School sizing brings the most anticipated Jordan 5 colorway of the current release calendar to youth sizing, making the black and university blue color story accessible to younger collectors and basketball enthusiasts at the scale and price appropriate for the GS market. The Jordan 5's shark tooth midsole, reflective tongue, and lace lock system all translate to GS sizing with complete design fidelity and visual authority. Grade school Jordan 5 releases in significant colorways serve the expanding community of young sneaker enthusiasts who want genuine Jordan archive releases at youth-appropriate sizing and pricing rather than compromising on cultural significance for the sake of accessibility. The 2026 black and university blue Jordan 5 carries enough historical weight and collector anticipation at every sizing tier to make the GS version a meaningful acquisition for younger collectors and families who want to participate in one of the year's most discussed Jordan retro moments. At one hundred and fifty-five dollars the GS Jordan 5 Black University Blue delivers the full design and cultural significance of this release in youth sizing at a fair and family-accessible price point. The Air Jordan 5 Retro in Black, University Blue, and White GS was released on June 20, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Chinese New Year (2026)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Chinese New Year 2026 celebrates tradition through a refined Football Grey and Sail foundation accented by Light Chocolate detailing. The muted palette gives the low top silhouette a sophisticated and seasonal feel, while classic AJ1 paneling keeps the design rooted in basketball heritage. Subtle color placement allows the theme to shine without overpowering the timeless structure. This release stands out because it honors cultural storytelling through tone rather than loud graphics. The blend of grey and warm brown hues feels balanced and versatile, offering a thoughtful take on a festive drop. Fans of the Jordan 1 Low OG appreciate when special editions stay true to the original cut while introducing meaningful color updates. It is a composed and celebratory iteration of an enduring icon. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Chinese New Year 2026 was released on February 17, 2026 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro TEX Denim Worn Blue (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro TEX Denim Worn Blue (Womens) refreshes a legendary silhouette with rich texture and easy-to-style tones. Crafted in a Worn Blue denim that pairs effortlessly with everything from crisp tailoring to off-duty staples, this Air Jordan 4 balances heritage design with modern materials. Sail accents along the midsole brighten the profile, while Metallic Gold hits add a refined gleam at key touchpoints. Classic details, the molded wings, breathable mesh panels, and the signature heel tab, deliver that unmistakable Jordan 4 identity. Underfoot, a Gum Light Brown outsole enhances traction and gives the shoe a timeless finish, complementing the layered upper with a premium, lived-in look. Engineered for all-day comfort, the Jordan 4 Retro TEX integrates visible Air cushioning in the heel for responsive support, making it as wearable as it is statement-making. The structured build stabilizes the foot without feeling heavy, and the denim upper softens over time for a custom feel.
