With its versatile Sail/Worn Blue palette and thoughtful Metallic Gold accents, this pair moves seamlessly from streetwear rotation to elevated casual fits. Identified by style code IB6716-100 and designed in womens sizing, its a standout choice for collectors and anyone who appreciates the blend of archival Jordan DNA with contemporary craft. Our team loves this product because it pairs premium denim texture with everyday comfort, creating a versatile Jordan 4 that elevates any look without trying too hard.

Display Name: Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Freshwater (2021/2025)
Description: Designed for former MLB player Ken Griffey Jr, the Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Freshwater (2021/2025) is a retro-inspired sneaker from the Air Griffey Max 1 pack in a Freshwater colorway. This sneaker features an upper made of a synthetic Freshwater base with black nubuck overlays, ankle straps, heel pull tabs, and tongue. White accents appear on the laces, Griffeys jersey number "24" on the ankle straps, forefoot Swooshes, and the Nike checks on the heel and tongue. The heel Swoosh features Bold Red stitching. Rounding out the design is a black chunky sole unit with white pods throughout the midsole. The Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Freshwater (2021/2025) was released on August 1, 2021 for a retail price of $170.

Display Name: adidas Stan Smith Core White New Navy
Description: The adidas Stan Smith Core White New Navy was released as a means to improve upon the first tennis footwear from 1996. The sneaker is designed with a Core White/Core White/New Navy colorway. The adidas Stan Smith Core White New Navy is made of all-white leather with white eyelets and flat white laces. The sneaker features visible stitching on the front outsole, heel, and shoe sides. The text, "adidas Stan Smith," is on the tongue. Also, perforation holes can be found on the heel foam padding and the tongue. The adidas Stan Smith Core White New Navy was made available at a retail price of $95 on December 14th, 2022.

Model: Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG SE
Display Name: Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG SE Travis Scott
Description: The Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG SE Travis Scott marks the first ever collaboration between the Houston rapper and Nike Football, applying Travis Scott's distinctive Cactus Jack aesthetic to a genuine performance soccer cleat rather than a lifestyle sneaker. A predominantly bright green upper dominates the design, paired with deep brown tones at the collar and a scale like textured heel that gives the boot a genuinely unique visual identity within Nike's football lineup. Bright yellow laces and mini Swoosh logos on the forefoot and side panels add further contrast, while Scott's signature jeweled reverse Swoosh appears near the heel as a subtle, personal touch. Custom Cactus Jack branding and crest detailing appear on the tongue, tying the boot directly back to Scott's broader creative identity, and the cleat was previewed on his own feet at Nike Toma street soccer events during the buildup to the 2026 World Cup before its full retail rollout. Firm ground studs on the outsole are built specifically for natural grass pitches, giving the boot genuine on field performance credentials alongside its collectible status. Releasing alongside a fifty piece Total 90 apparel collection spanning ten different national teams, this Phantom 6 Low collaboration represents one of the more unexpected and closely watched sneaker crossovers of the World Cup season. The Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG SE Travis Scott was released on June 28, 2026 with a retail price of $310.

Display Name: Puma LaMelo Ball LaFrancé Amour Moment
Description: The Puma LaMelo Ball LaFrancé Amour Moment is an all-over-beige addition to NBA player LaMelo Balls signature LaFrancé lifestyle fashion label and Puma. Incorporating elements from streetwear fashion and sportswear, this sneaker, the Moment Puma LaMelo Ball LaFrancé Amour, boasts an exaggerated silhouette with oversized cotton laces and chunky padding in the collar. The earth-toned Alpine Snow colorway complements the splashes of cream across the upper and lets the overlapping upper design take center stage. The internal EVA midsole stretches the entire length of the shoe, while the rubber cupsole adds stability. LaFrancé lettering in a light-brown hue can be found underfoot, on the tongue, and on the heels pull tab. Although the upper is crafted from leather and textile, the inner lining is made from a lightweight synthetic material. Our experts like the textured outsole, which displays Puma and LaFrancé branding in gothic, graffiti-inspired lettering. The Puma LaMelo Ball LaFrancé Amour Moment was released on July 19, 2024, and sold for $110.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SP University Red
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SP University Red is a vibrant sneaker that incorporates different fabrics and textures in order to create an eye-catching pair of kicks. The University Red Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Special Project features an upper with a base of red mesh. This mesh is overlaid with a loose white mesh on the collar, heel, and toebox. Overlays of red synthetic leather and red synthetic suede streak across this mesh-on-mesh upper. Red plastic forms a cage-like heel counter and a cage across the quarter panel. A white foam midsole provides cushioning, while thick red rubber lugs form the outsole with a waffle pattern under the forefoot. The aspect of this sneaker that we enjoy the most are the reflective details on the upper. The silver side-panel Nike Swoosh, along with detailing in the laces and hits on the toe cap, glow in the dark, lending this jazzy sneaker even more sparkle. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SP University Red was released on December 13th, 2023, for and original retail price of $160.
Material: Leather, Suede, Mesh, Synthetic, Rubber, Foam
Colorway: University Red/Metallic Silver/Washed Coral/Magic Ember/Summit White

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low SP Syracuse
Description: Nike celebrated the 35th Anniversary of the Nike Dunk by releasing the Nike Dunk Low SP Syracuse (2020), now available on StockX. The Nike Dunk debuted as part of the 1985 Nike College Colors program, a program that delivered footwear in the school colors of 12 popular basketball programs allowing fans to support their favorite teams from head to toe. This Syracuse colorway was among the first collegiate colorways Nike released, breaking the mold for colorways used on basketball shoes. This Nike Dunk Low SP is composed of a white leather upper with orange blaze leather overlays. A white midsole, orange outsole, and classic Nike branding on the tongue complete the design. These sneakers released in March of 2020 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 SB Cactus Flower
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 SB Cactus Flower reimagines the iconic wavy panels of the 95 through a skate?influenced lens, delivering bold color blocking and everyday versatility. A crisp Summit White and Photon Dust base lets rich Cactus Flower accents pop across the eyestays and Swoosh, while Cool Grey gradients nod to the original runners DNA. Visible Air units in the heel and forefoot keep the ride cushioned and responsive, and the layered mesh-and-suede upper enhances breathability with structured support. Finished with a Gum Yellow outsole that adds timeless style and dependable grip, this pair bridges sport heritage with street-ready attitude in a way that feels fresh yet familiar. Attention to detail elevates the HF7545-100 colorway from standout to must-have. The sculpted sidewalls emphasize the silhouettes muscular lines, reflective hits catch the light after dark, and the streamlined lacing system secures a locked-in feel without bulk. Whether youre navigating city blocks or dressing up a casual rotation, the Air Max 95 SB delivers comfort and presence in equal measure. Released on August 22, 2025, its a statement piece for fans of Nike SB and Air Max alike, pair it with dark denim or technical cargoes to highlight the purple and gum contrasts and let the classic cushioning do the rest. Our team loves this product because it blends head-turning color with dependable Air Max comfort and a gum finish that wears beautifully day after day.
Colorway: Summit White/Photon Dust/Cool Grey/Cactus Flower/Gum Yellow

Model: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo
Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Reed Sheppard
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Reed Sheppard channels explosive guard play through a vivid and layered color story. Platinum Violet forms the base, while Bright Crimson accents inject sharp contrast that energizes the silhouette. Black and white details provide structure, framing the performance focused design. The streamlined build and responsive cushioning system emphasize speed and control, aligning with the dynamic style associated with Reed Sheppard. This release resonates with fans who follow emerging basketball talent and appreciate bold court footwear. The vibrant crimson against violet creates strong visual impact, making it impossible to ignore during play. It feels aggressive yet balanced, pairing personality with serious performance intent. Built for quick bursts and confident movement, this pair stands out in any lineup. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Reed Sheppard was released on July 7, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Valentine's Day (2026) (GS)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Valentines Day 2026 GS captures seasonal charm through a playful mix of Pink Foam and Light Crimson. Summit White accents keep the design balanced, allowing the brighter tones to shine without overwhelming the silhouette. The classic Dunk Low shape ensures it stays grounded in basketball heritage. Valentines themed Dunks have built a following over the years, often becoming memorable additions to the calendar. This GS version delivers vibrant color in a youthful format while maintaining the clean paneling fans expect. For younger collectors who enjoy expressive seasonal releases, this pair brings energy and versatility together in one cohesive design. The Nike Dunk Low Valentines Day 2026 GS was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $102.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Pure Platinum
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Pure Platinum is a low-top counterpart to the classic Dunk High silhouette. The Nike Dunk Low Retro has an all-leather construction leaving the Swoosh logos, outsole, and branded heel tabs in a Platinum grey tone. The shoe has a low-cut padded collar and a perforated toe box with Nike branding in the woven tongue tag, sock liner, and heel tab. It has a rubber cupsole for traction with stitched sidewall construction and an interior foam wedge for comfort. The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Pure Platinum was released on 19th November 2022. Upon its launch, its retail price was $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Premium Aurora Green Camo
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Aurora Green Camo layers texture and pattern across the classic runner in a bold and detailed execution. Sanddrift and Khaki tones provide an earthy foundation, while Aurora Green accents inject vibrant contrast. Mink Brown and Parachute Beige elements enhance the depth of the camo inspired detailing, giving the upper a rugged and dynamic feel. The visible Air unit remains central, anchoring the design in heritage performance. Fans who appreciate premium finishes and intricate color stories will find this release especially compelling. The camo influence adds personality and movement without overwhelming the silhouettes structure. It is a confident interpretation that blends outdoor inspired tones with street ready appeal. This pair proves the Air Max 90 can handle bold experimentation while maintaining its timeless identity. The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Aurora Green Camo was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Cool Grey
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Cool Grey pays tribute through a refined and respectful color palette. Cool Grey and Wolf Grey tones layer across the upper, creating depth while maintaining a calm and focused aesthetic. The classic low cut build preserves the timeless shape that has defined the Air Force 1 for generations. Subtle detailing reinforces the commemorative spirit without overwhelming the design. Fans who value legacy driven releases will appreciate the understated approach. The grey tones feel fitting and dignified, allowing the silhouettes heritage to carry the emotion. It stands as a quiet nod to greatness while remaining wearable in everyday rotation. This pair blends tribute and tradition through one of Nikes most enduring models. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Cool Grey was released on January 20, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Zoom GT Cut 3 EP Hyper Pink
Description: The Nike Zoom GT Cut 3 EP Hyper Pink fuses eye-catching style and elite performance features with a bold color palette of hyper pink, metallic silver, pink foam, and black wrapped in a silhouette built for serious performance. This Nike Zoom GT Cut 3 EP (engineered performance) version is specially equipped with an outsole made of XDR, an extra-durable rubber compound designed to withstand the demands of outdoor play. The upper features lightweight, breathable materials in vibrant hyper pink, perforated for ventilation and comfort. Pink foam runs down the tongue and throat, flowing seamlessly into a reinforced toe tip and structured side panels for added stability. The upper fades into a black ZoomX foam midsole, and metallic silver outlines the black Swooshes for a sharp look, while embroidered Nike branding at the heel adds a premium touch. What we like about the Nike Zoom GT Cut 3 EP Hyper Pink is the standout multicourt traction pattern underfoot with its unique lightning groove design that ensures super-high grip. Originally retailing for $190, this sneaker was released on January 1, 2025.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Premium Carbon Fiber Infrared
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Carbon Fiber Infrared brings a sleek, modern twist to the classic Air Max 90 silhouette. This men's sneaker features a striking black, cool grey, bright crimson, and photon dust colorway that's sure to turn heads. The upper showcases premium materials, including a carbon fiber-inspired texture that adds a high-tech aesthetic to the iconic design. The bright crimson accents pay homage to the original 'Infrared' colorway, creating a perfect balance between heritage and innovation. Comfort and style unite in this premium iteration of the Air Max 90. The visible Air unit in the heel provides responsive cushioning, while the padded collar and tongue ensure a snug, comfortable fit. The durable rubber outsole offers excellent traction and longevity, making these sneakers ideal for everyday wear. Our team thinks this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts who appreciate a blend of classic design and modern materials, offering both style and performance for urban environments.

Display Name: Nike Waffle One Summit White
Description: With extra cushioning and support, the Nike Waffle One Summit White can be used for both walking around town or for a bit of more intense exercise. This pair of shoes has a black sole next to a bright white midsole. The body of the shoe features colors like white, beige, and gray, with different fabrics, including suede and mesh. The iconic Nike symbol known as the Swoosh appears in white. This is a low top model that ends right at the beginning of the ankle. The Nike Waffle One Summit White was first released in May of 2021. This model had a starting retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 High '07 SP Billie Eilish Sequoia
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 High '07 SP Billie Eilish Sequoia is a special project collaborative sneaker from the Nike x Billie Eilish Air Force 1 High '07 collection in a Sequoia colorway. This high-top sneaker is made of synthetic nubuck upper dressed in a monochromatic Dark Green tone. The upper is highlighted by four additional velcro-secured straps that cover the variable-width lacing system. Other details include a tonal Swoosh on the sides, Billie Eilish's logo on the metallic dubrae, and BILLIE EILISH branded insoles. The signature Air Force 1 sole unit in a matching Dark Green tone rounds out the design. What our experts love about this collaborative AF1 sneaker is its unique color, materials, and simple design. The monochromatic Dark Green color gives it a unique tone, while the additional straps make the design stand out. The Nike Air Force 1 High '07 SP Billie Eilish Sequoia was released on October 14th, 2022, retailing at $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential Batman 2.0
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Batman 20 taps into a familiar color story that immediately recalls the iconic comic book character through its use of contrast and tone. The anthracite and black base creates a dark foundation, while bright citron accents add a sharp pop that brings the design to life. It feels like a subtle tribute without relying on direct branding. Fans are drawn to this pair because it captures a recognizable theme through color alone. The Air Max 1 continues to serve as a canvas for storytelling, and this version reflects that clearly. It is a sneaker that blends nostalgia and wearability, offering a look that feels both playful and grounded in a classic silhouette. The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Batman 20 was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Air Trainer 1 SP Travis Scott Grey Haze
Description: Pulling inspiration from backpacking gear, the Nike Air Trainer 1 SP Travis Scott Grey Haze features a light grey canvas upper with darker grey mesh overlays and single stitch Swoosh logos. Canvas shrouds on the upper give wearers options for styling. At the heel and inside of the tongue, concealed zipper pockets provide extra storage. From there, "Cactus Corporation" insignias at the heel and forefoot velcro strap add a custom feel. The Nike Air Trainer 1 SP Travis Scott Grey released in May of 2022 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Del Sol
Description: Jordan Brand geared up for springtime with the warm-toned Air Jordan 13 Del Sol. At first glance, the Air Jordan 13 Del Sol looks like a flip of the 2018 Air Jordan 13 Carmelo Anthony Class of 2002. It features a white tumbled leather upper and golden yellow Durabuck underlays along the mudguard, accentuating its sculptural design. Hits of red on the Jumpman tongue embroideries pop against their white backdrop. At the collar, a signature Jumpman hologram completes the retro design. The Air Jordan 13 Del Sol released in March of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Snakeskin
Description: The Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Snakeskin results from the collaborative efforts of Nike and NOCTA, a label associated with the rapper, Drake. On this Nike Hot Step Air Terra, a Snakeskin construction with a textured feel covers most of the shoe. Giving an authentic snakeskin look is a multicolor mix comprising light bone shades and sprinkles of cobblestone and gum light brown colors. The tongue uses a snakeskin finish and features a NOCTA three shooting star logo in a circular boundary. The quarter panels have narrow perforations, while the back has a metallic tag with a Gore-Tex embossment referencing the waterproof properties of the synthetic material covering most of the show. Our experts like the sole on the Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Snakeskin, with a white midsole housing an Air Sole unit and a transparent air bubble touch on the heel. We also like the gum brown rubber outsole. The retail price of this sneaker was $180 on May 19th, 2023, when it was released.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 SP Undefeated Sail
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 SP Undefeated Sail reframes a legendary runner through a lighter and more refined lens while preserving its unmistakable attitude. Sail tones soften the layered upper, allowing the signature gradient lines to feel cleaner and more architectural. Metallic silver details add polish, while gorge green and sport red accents bring subtle energy that nods to heritage without overwhelming the design. The silhouette remains bold, but the palette gives it a calmer and more elevated presence. This collaboration resonates because it shows restraint where many expect aggression. Undefeated has a history of confident storytelling, and this version feels deliberate rather than loud. Collectors appreciate how the sail base highlights the structure of the Air Max 95, letting form and proportion take center stage. It feels wearable yet meaningful, reinforcing why Undefeated partnerships continue to carry weight through balance, intention, and cultural credibility rather than excess. The Nike Air Max 95 SP Undefeated Sail was released on December 10, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: adidas Adistar XLG 2.0 Black
Description: The adidas Adistar XLG 20 Black Core Black Core Black Core Black leans fully into monochrome confidence, wrapping the entire silhouette in layered Core Black tones. The exaggerated proportions and sculpted tooling give the shoe a futuristic presence, while the triple black execution keeps it grounded and versatile. adidas pushes the Adistar line forward here, emphasizing bold shape and cushioning under a streamlined, almost stealth aesthetic. This is the kind of sneaker that thrives on subtle dominance. Without relying on loud color blocking, it makes its statement through form and depth, letting the stacked sole and oversized detailing carry the look. Collectors who appreciate modern runner inspired design gravitate toward pairs like this because they feel progressive yet wearable. It works effortlessly with tech driven outfits or minimalist styling, offering a strong foundation without competing for attention. The adidas Adistar XLG 20 Black Core Black Core Black Core Black was released on February 5, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike V2K Run Summit White Metallic Silver (Women's)
Description: The Nike V2K Run Summit White Metallic Silver (Womens) is a high-performance running shoe with a design that combines both retro and futuristic elements. With a chunky heel, flashy metallic colors, and plastic accents, this unique shoe is the perfect addition to any collection. This sneaker features an upper made of a mix of material. White mesh provides the base of the forefoot, while Metallic Silver synthetic leather overlays cross over the top of it. These overlays also appear lining the toe box and under the laces. Clear and white plastic overlays adorn the midsole of this Nike V2K Run, and on top of that a Nike Swoosh appears in gray outlined by black. What we like most about this sneaker is its chunky heel, which adds a unique design element to the shoe, while also serving to improve performance and impact. The Nike V2K Run Summit White Metallic Silver (Womens) was first released on July 13th, 2023, for a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Glacier Blue Mint Foam
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 Glacier Blue Mint Foam represents peak performance innovation wrapped in eye catching color. Glacier Blue dominates the upper, accented by Mint Foam and Green Shock tones that highlight the aerodynamic design. Black details provide contrast, framing the sculpted midsole and performance focused construction. The visible cushioning system and responsive build signal its place at the forefront of racing technology. Serious runners and collectors alike recognize the Alphafly line for pushing boundaries in speed and efficiency. The vibrant palette enhances the forward thinking silhouette, making it feel as fast visually as it performs. It captures the energy of competition through both engineering and color. Bold, technical, and unmistakably modern, this pair stands at the cutting edge of Nike innovation. The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 Glacier Blue Mint Foam was released on June 20, 2025 with a retail price of $295.

Display Name: New Balance 992 MiUSA Action Bronson Tiger Eye
Description: The New Balance 992 MiUSA Action Bronson Tiger Eye delivers another emotionally charged take on the iconic 992, using warm tan and red tones to create a look that feels energetic and grounded. The color story evokes movement and passion, while the classic 992 shape keeps everything balanced and wearable. It feels bold without being chaotic, driven by intention rather than excess. Fans love this pair because it captures Action Bronsons ability to translate feeling into design. The shoe feels alive, combining expressive color with the comfort and stability the 992 is known for. Collectors appreciate it as a statement release that still fits into rotation, blending personality, heritage, and craftsmanship into a sneaker that feels meaningful and memorable. The New Balance 992 MiUSA Action Bronson Tiger Eye was released on September 26, 2025 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Storm Cloud Pure Silver
Description: The ASICS Gel NYC Storm Cloud Pure Silver brings a more dynamic contrast to the silhouette, pairing storm cloud tones with pure silver accents that highlight the structure of the shoe. The metallic elements add a subtle shine that enhances the layered design, giving it a slightly more performance driven feel while still functioning as a lifestyle sneaker. It feels sharper and more defined compared to more muted versions. This colorway stands out because it blends everyday wearability with a bit more visual energy. The balance between neutral grey and reflective silver keeps it versatile while still giving it personality. ASICS continues to refine the Gel NYC through releases like this, keeping the model relevant across both sneaker culture and casual rotation. The ASICS Gel NYC Storm Cloud Pure Silver was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Ivory Saddle Brown
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Ivory Saddle Brown leans into warm neutral tones that highlight the silhouettes classic proportions. An Ivory base keeps the upper light and clean, while Saddle Brown accents add richness and contrast. The layered leather panels preserve the structure that made the Air Force 1 a cultural mainstay, allowing the earthy palette to stand out without overwhelming the design. This colorway resonates with fans who prefer understated elegance over loud statements. The ivory and brown combination feels timeless and easy to wear across seasons. It brings a refined edge to a street staple, proving the model can evolve through subtle tonal shifts. For collectors, it is another example of how thoughtful color choices keep a classic feeling fresh. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Ivory Saddle Brown was released on September 10, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike KD 4 Galaxy (2024)
Description: The Nike KD 4 Galaxy recaptures the essence of its 2012 counterpart, which was a highlight of the NBA All-Star Weekend. Its Metallic Silver/Total Orange/Dark Grey colorway is a nod to the original's space-themed design, making it a standout piece in any sneaker collection. The KD 4 Galaxy is not just a shoe; it's a piece of basketball history, embodying the spirit of one of the most memorable All-Star events. The 2024 version of the KD 4 Galaxy preserves the iconic design while integrating modern technology for enhanced performance. It's a perfect amalgamation of nostalgia and innovation, appealing to both long-time fans of the silhouette and new enthusiasts alike. The distinct colorway and star-studded design elements pay tribute to Kevin Durant's stellar performance and the sneaker's astronomical theme. Set to launch on February 15, 2024, with a retail price of $130, the Nike KD 4 Galaxy is more than just a re-release; it's a celebration of basketball heritage and sneaker culture. Its arrival is eagerly anticipated by fans around the world, ready to experience a piece of sneaker history.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred for Grade Schoolers (GS) showcases a clean Chicago Bullsinspired design. The Air Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred GS features a black upper with red overlays, a red Swoosh logo running across both lateral and medial sides, and a black embroidered Jumpman and Wings on the tongue and heel, respectively. On the shoe's solel, you'll find a classic white rubber midsole to keep you comfortable and a red outsole to give you optimum traction. The Air Jordan 1 Low Reverse Bred GS is a Grade Schoolsized sneaker, released in July, 2020, at a retail price of $75.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Wolf Grey
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Wolf Grey delivers understated depth through tonal layering. Dressed in Wolf Grey with Anthracite accents, the upper maintains the anatomical design lines that define the model. The enlarged Air units emphasize the return of the original cushioning proportions. Grey based executions allow the shape and construction of the 95 to stand out without distraction. The subtle variation between wolf grey and anthracite adds dimension while preserving a versatile aesthetic. It feels grounded and timeless, a faithful revival of one of Nikes most influential running silhouettes. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Wolf Grey was released on April 21, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Glacier Blue Summit White
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Glacier Blue Summit White delivers a calm and expressive take on the Jordan 1 through layered pastel tones and thoughtful contrast. Glacier blue leads the upper with a cool and airy feel, balanced by summit white panels that keep the look clean and grounded. Guava ice and sea glass accents add subtle warmth and depth, creating a palette that feels intentional rather than playful. The low cut silhouette keeps everything wearable and modern. Fans gravitate toward this pair because it feels fresh without straying from the Jordan 1 identity. The soft color story works across seasons and styles, appealing to collectors who appreciate nuanced design over loud statements. It captures the ongoing evolution of the Jordan 1 Low as a lifestyle staple, proving that careful color layering can give new energy to a familiar shape while staying rooted in culture and history. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Glacier Blue Summit White was released on April 20, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 PRM Valentines Day White
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 PRM Valentines Day White introduces a love-inspired color scheme, perfect for February 14th, in this iteration that playfully celebrates Cupids Day. The Valentines Day White Nike Air Max 1 PRM features a crisp white base crafted from breathable mesh, complemented by patent leather paneling and glossy, mismatched Swooshes in scarlet and magenta. Additional branding is present on the pink and red tongue tag, insoles, and Nike Air heel logo. Mimicking the look of chrome helium balloons, the sneaker adds large lace dubraes that spell out "Nike." The laces themselves feature a repeated text that reads, "Its not you, its me." A polyurethane midsole sits underfoot, housing a visible pink Air unit for responsive cushioning, while a bright crimson rubber outsole completes the design. What we love about the Nike Air Max 1 PRM Valentines Day White is its playful Valentines Day details, making it a standout seasonal release. The sneaker retailed for $160 when it was released on February 1, 2025.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Melitta Baumeister Volt (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Melitta Baumeister Volt pushes the Pegasus line into a more experimental space through a collaboration that emphasizes bold color and layered design. The volt dominant upper immediately stands out, with cyber and black accents adding depth and contrast throughout the silhouette. Off white elements help balance the intensity, while the varied volt tones create a dynamic and almost electric visual effect. Fans are drawn to this pair because it reimagines a performance staple through a more fashion driven lens. The Melitta Baumeister influence brings a conceptual edge that sets it apart from standard Pegasus releases. It stands as a statement version of a familiar model, blending innovation in both design and color execution. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Melitta Baumeister Volt was released on April 8, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Puma Speedcat OG Black White
Description: The Puma Speedcat OG Black White dresses this classic low-top sneaker from the early 2000s in a straightforward colorway of black and white. Inspired by motorsports and Pumas apparel partnerships with several F1 teams, this lifestyle shoe boasts a sleek, slim-fitting silhouette. The upper is crafted from premium suede in black with the signature formstrip in white reaching across the side panels. In addition, the Black White Puma Speedcat OG showcases subtle Puma branding, including PUMA in metallic gold lettering on the lateral side panel and the tongue, and a white Jumping Cat logo on the toebox. The thin, rubber outsole comes in black and offers traction underfoot, while the black laces secure the closure. Our experts like the sneakers overall premium feel created by the metallic gold accents set against the velvety suede upper. The Puma Speedcat OG Black White was released on June 29, 2024, and sold for $120.

Model: adidas Predator Elite Foldover Tongue FG
Display Name: adidas Predator Elite Foldover Tongue FG Jude Bellingham Glory Blue
Description: The adidas Predator Elite Foldover Tongue FG Jude Bellingham Glory Blue celebrates one of footballs brightest midfield stars with a design rooted in Predator heritage. Dressed in core black with footwear white and glory blue accents, the boot revives the iconic foldover tongue detail that defined many classic Predator models. The bold blue highlights bring modern energy to a silhouette that has long represented control and authority on the pitch. Since its debut in 1994, the Predator franchise has been associated with players who dictate the tempo of the game through precision passing and powerful striking. Jude Bellingham embodies that philosophy with his composed playing style and leadership in midfield. The foldover tongue design references the boots historic roots while the updated construction reflects adidas continued evolution of the Predator line. When the adidas Predator Elite Foldover Tongue FG Jude Bellingham Glory Blue released, it retailed for $290 and dropped on October 16, 2025. With its core black, footwear white, and glory blue colorway, the release bridges classic Predator tradition with one of footballs most influential rising stars.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 4 Protro CHBL
Description: The Nike Kobe 4 Protro CHBL is a striking tribute to the late basketball legend Kobe Bryant. This performance sneaker features a bold Lightening/Black/Soft Yellow/Dusty Cactus colorway that commands attention on and off the court. The shoe's design incorporates advanced technology and materials, providing exceptional support, responsiveness, and durability for players of all levels. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Kobe 4 Protro CHBL boasts a low-profile silhouette that enhances agility and speed. The upper combines breathable materials with strategic reinforcements, ensuring optimal comfort and stability during intense gameplay. The responsive cushioning system and grippy outsole deliver superior court feel and traction, allowing wearers to make quick cuts and explosive movements with confidence. We at StockX believe this product is great for basketball enthusiasts and Kobe fans alike, offering a perfect blend of style and performance that honors the Black Mamba's legacy.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten White Burgundy
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten White Burgundy is a 2024 release of one of Onitsuka Tiger's most quietly distinctive silhouettes, a heritage indoor court shoe that draws its design inspiration from the brand's 1980s archive rather than the running-derived lineage that grounds most of the catalog and that consequently brings a different visual register to the Tiger Stripes format, one that reads as preppy and sport-court rather than athletic and trail. The Tokuten, whose name translates loosely to "score" or "point" in Japanese, was originally an indoor court shoe, and the low-profile cupsole construction and clean, court-ready lines of the silhouette reflect that heritage in the way the shoe sits closer to the ground and presents a less bulky profile than the Mexico 66's wedge midsole provides. The suede upper is overlaid with leather Tiger Stripes in the signature lateral-to-medial crossing pattern that serves as Onitsuka Tiger's most immediately recognizable brand identification, the stripes in this case executed in Burgundy Red against the White suede base to create the specific two-tone color contrast that is the Tokuten's most classic presentation format. The jagged, distinctive character of the Tiger Stripes in the Tokuten's court shoe context gives the shoe a quality that reviewers have described as simultaneously vintage and contemporary, the stripes functioning as both heritage branding and design detail in the way the best archival logo applications do. A rubber gum outsole and cupsole construction complete the build, the gum sole adding the subtle warmth that lifts a monochromatic two-tone shoe out of pure function into considered lifestyle territory. Style code 1183C086-200, released February 11, 2024 at $70. The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten White Burgundy is the heritage indoor court shoe for the wearer who wants Onitsuka Tiger's 1980s archive silhouette in the most classically executed two-tone colorway the Tokuten offers, a shoe that communicates the brand's identity through a different material vocabulary than the Mexico 66 without abandoning the Tiger Stripes that define it. The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten White Burgundy was released on February 11, 2024 with a retail price of $70.

Display Name: Nike Free RN Flyknit 2018 Black White Ombre
Description: The Nike Free RN Flyknit 2018 Black White Ombre is a standalone colorway of the Nike Free RN series. The Free RN Flyknit 2018 Black White Ombre includes a midsole that is designed to provide comfort and responsiveness. The outsole features deep grooves that form a Tri-Star pattern allowing the shoe to flex and move with the natural motion of the foot. The shoe has a black-and-white ombre colorway and features the Nike Swoosh on the side. There is additional Nike branding on the tongue and on the base of the heel. We think that one of the most notable features of the Nike Free RN Flyknit 2018 Black White Ombre is its Flyknit upper, which is engineered to provide a sock-like fit that adapts to the shape of the foot while ensuring breathability and maximum flexibility. The Nike Free RN Flyknit 2018 Black White Ombre was released on February 20th, 2018 at a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 2017 Light Bone
Description: Nike has put modern twists on its iconic Air Max model on numerous occasions ever since the company unveiled the first Air Max in the late 1980s. The Nike Air Max 2017 Light Bone is one of the many fresh takes on the classic sneaker. This particular Nike Air Max features a light bone and off-white upper made from Flymesh and synthetic materials to keep it lightweight. It also has a midfoot that is constructed out of foam to provide a snug fit. But in our expert opinion, the best part about this version of the Air Max sneaker is that it has a full-length Max Air unit that is designed to set people up with superior cushioning. It adds to the aesthetic appeal of the sneaker while also delivering additional comfort. The Nike Air Max 2017 Light Bone was released on November 6, 2016, and it initially retailed for $190. The Nike Air Max 2017 Light Bone was re-released on August 2, 2023, and retailed again for $190.

Display Name: Nike Waffle Racer Midnight Navy Safety Orange
Description: The Nike Waffle Racer Midnight Navy Safety Orange revisits one of Nikes earliest running silhouettes with a colorway that feels both classic and energetic. The Midnight Navy upper provides a deep and stable base, while Safety Orange accents add a sharp pop that highlights the shoes simple construction. The Waffle sole remains a defining feature, tying the design back to Nikes original innovation. Fans gravitate toward the Waffle Racer because of its historical significance and straightforward design. This version keeps that identity intact while introducing a color combination that feels fresh. It is a sneaker that blends heritage and simplicity, appealing to those who appreciate Nikes origins in running culture. The Nike Waffle Racer Midnight Navy Safety Orange was released on December 29, 2025 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: adidas Stan Smith White Green (OG)
Description: The adidas Stan Smith White Green OG, inspired by a 1997 design, has become a staple for the German brand´s catalog. ? With a mixed combination, this Stan Smith sneaker is anchored by a "Cloud White and Green" colorway. The upper section features a leather build. The flat nylon laces matches the upper's composition and all-leather sock liner. The heel of the shoe is branded in green. Perforations down the mid-foot panel create the iconic 3-Stipes design that is possibly the most recognised feature of the brand. ? The adidas Stan Smith White Green OG was released on the 12th of November 2022 at a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Mind 001 Slide Black Chrome
Description: Nike Mind 001 Slide Black Chrome leans into restraint and intention, offering a recovery focused design that values mental reset as much as physical comfort. The black chrome finish gives the slide a sleek and modern feel, balancing minimalism with subtle attitude. It reflects a growing space in sneaker culture where rest and routine matter just as much as performance and visibility. Collectors appreciate this slide because it represents a shift in mindset. Rather than chasing attention, the design feels grounded and purposeful, fitting naturally into everyday life. It works as a quiet staple that supports moments away from the spotlight, reinforcing the idea that thoughtful design can still carry cultural relevance without being loud or overdesigned. The Nike Mind 001 Slide Black Chrome was released on 02/05/2026 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Run
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus Run delivers everyday mileage comfort through a clean and balanced color story. Summit White forms a bright and breathable base, while Vast Grey and Sail overlays add subtle depth across the layered upper. Black accents provide structure, sharpening the silhouette without overpowering its neutral palette. The sculpted midsole and cushioned platform reflect the Vomero lineage, built for smooth transitions and consistent responsiveness on the road. Runners who appreciate understated performance footwear will gravitate toward this versatile execution. The blend of white and grey keeps it adaptable for both training sessions and casual rotation. It highlights the models comfort driven focus without relying on bold contrast. Light, refined, and reliable, this pair captures the essence of daily run stability with modern polish. The Nike Vomero Plus Run was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Gold White
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Gold White takes a silhouette inspired by running shoes from the 1960s and infuses it with a modern street style with undeniable pizzazz. The upper of this low-top is crafted from premium calf leather in metallic gold. The iconic tiger stripes course across the side panel in white leather. Gold leather forms a T-toe overlay, the eyestay overlay, and overlay strips that cross at the heel. The branding on the tongue path adds another hit of sparkle to this shoe. A two-tone foam midsole in white and beige offers cushioning support, while the cream-colored outsole is patterned for traction. Our favorite aspect of this bright sneaker is the heel tab. A flap of gold leather folds over the heel and sports white Tiger branding in a script, giving the sneaker a decided look of distinction. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Gold White was released on January 24th, 2022 for $120 retail.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Oatmeal Ginger Peach
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Oatmeal Ginger Peach is a shoe that takes its design inspiration from the style of the 1960s. This iteration of the Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 has an upper made of high-quality leather in a neutral Oatmeal cream color. A suede overlay with a pinkish hue forms the thin toe cap, which is shaped like a T. The Onitsuka Tiger racing stripes appear on each side as leather overlays in a Ginger Peach pink hue. The heel contains a pink leather flap with white Tiger branding on it, while a crisscross of leather strips is seen on the heel underneath. The tongue also contains a branding patch. The outsole is thin and patterned for traction. What we think stands out about this shoe is the neutral colorway, which allows it to be worn with a variety of outfits. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Oatmeal Ginger Peach was released on July 5, 2024, for $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Premium Cave Stone
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Premium Cave Stone refreshes a legendary silhouette with a refined, earthy palette built for everyday wear. Layered textures in Light Bone, Chamois, Desert Khaki, and Cave Stone create depth across the upper, highlighting the models signature paneling while keeping the look clean and versatile. A plush padded collar and breathable materials add step-in comfort, while the sculpted mudguard and Swoosh deliver that timeless Air Max attitude. Beneath it all, the visible Air unit pairs with resilient foam for smooth, responsive cushioning, and the grippy waffle-inspired outsole offers stable traction from sidewalk to weekend getaway. Designed for effortless styling, this Air Max 1 Premium balances heritage sport DNA with modern lifestyle appeal. The neutral colorway anchors everything from tailored joggers to raw denim, making it a reliable rotation staple. Subtle hits and tonal contrasts elevate the profile without shouting, and the premium build feels as good as it looks. Marked with style code IB6390-001 and launching on April 11, 2025, the Cave Stone edition underscores why the Air Max 1 remains a cultural icon, easy to dress up or down, endlessly wearable, and engineered to keep you moving comfortably all day. A must-have addition to the rotation, especially because it blends classic Air Max cushioning with sophisticated, go-with-anything colors that add instant polish to everyday fits.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Shattered Backboard (2025) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Shattered Backboard 2025 GS brings one of the most iconic Jordan color stories to a new generation through the classic high cut silhouette. The black, sail, and starfish palette instantly recalls the legendary moment that inspired the Shattered Backboard theme, giving the shoe undeniable energy and history. Even in grade school sizing, the design carries the same impact and attitude that made the original so beloved. Collectors appreciate this release because it keeps the story intact while making it more accessible. The high cut Jordan 1 remains a cornerstone of sneaker culture, and the Shattered Backboard colors give it personality rooted in real basketball lore. Fans love it as a way to connect younger wearers to one of Jordan Brands most celebrated narratives, blending nostalgia, heritage, and everyday wearability in a form that feels timeless. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Shattered Backboard 2025 GS was released on August 23, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott Bright Cactus
Description: The Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott Bright Cactus bursts onto the sneaker scene with an energetic combination of muslin, black, and vibrant bright cactus hues. Infused with Travis Scott's signature aesthetic. Its defining reverse swoosh, embroidered straps, and the iconic "Cactus Jack" detailing make this pair unmistakably unique, instantly elevating any outfit. Designed to turn heads and inspire confidence, this sneaker isn't just about looksit's built for versatility and street-ready durability. Its two-tone rubber sole and secure forefoot strap provide practical comfort, ensuring it excels from casual strolls to energetic outings. Whether you're a dedicated collector or simply appreciate bold, culture-defining footwear, this collaboration offers the best of both worlds. Priced at $200, the Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott Bright Cactus dropped on April 30, 2025, delivering an electrifying blend of muslin, black, and bright cactus that captured attention.

Model: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1
Display Name: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Habanero Red All-Star
Description: The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Habanero Red All Star revives a pivotal skate silhouette in a bold and celebratory palette. Habanero Red floods the upper, accented by Club Gold and Team Red details that enhance the heat of the design. The streamlined P Rod 1 shape remains clean and low to the ground, staying true to its performance roots. Paul Rodriguez first signature model holds a special place in SB history, marking a turning point for technical skate footwear. Bringing it back in an All Star themed execution adds a layer of spotlight energy to an already iconic shape. For longtime SB fans, this release feels like a tribute to both skate progression and the legacy of one of the brand defining riders. The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Habanero Red All Star was released on February 17, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: New Balance 530 Turtledove Mushroom
Description: The New Balance 530 Turtledove Mushroom blends soft earth tones with early two thousands running inspiration. Turtledove and angora create a light and neutral base, while mushroom accents add depth and warmth across the layered upper. The 530 silhouette remains sleek and breathable, emphasizing mesh construction and visible structure that feel rooted in performance heritage. Collectors appreciate this pair because it showcases New Balances strength in tonal execution. The gentle color combination makes it easy to style while still feeling distinctive. Fans value how the 530 continues to resonate through subtle palette updates rather than dramatic redesign. It stands as a calm and wearable runner that balances nostalgia with contemporary softness, offering comfort and versatility in equal measure. The New Balance 530 Turtledove Mushroom was released on November 3, 2023 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC White Feather Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel-NYC White Feather Grey is a stylish and comfortable sneaker that combines modern design with classic ASICS technology. Featuring a sleek white upper with subtle feather grey accents, this shoe offers a versatile look that can easily transition from casual to athletic wear. The Gel-NYC model incorporates ASICS' renowned GEL cushioning system in the midsole, providing superior shock absorption and comfort for all-day wear. Built with premium materials, the Gel-NYC boasts a durable construction that can withstand daily use while maintaining its appealing aesthetic. The breathable mesh upper ensures proper ventilation, keeping your feet cool and dry during various activities. With its ergonomic design and supportive fit, this sneaker is ideal for both urban exploration and light athletic pursuits. Our experts state this product is great for those seeking a balance of style and functionality in their everyday footwear.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Low Golf White University Blue
Description: The Air Jordan 9 Retro Low Golf White University Blue translates Jordan Brand heritage onto the course through a silhouette that feels clean, confident, and purpose driven. The white and university blue palette gives the shoe a crisp and athletic look, while the low cut Jordan 9 shape keeps it grounded in performance roots. It feels refined without losing the bold identity that defines the model. Collectors appreciate this release because it represents Jordan Brand expanding its legacy into new spaces without abandoning authenticity. The Jordan 9s global inspiration and streamlined design make it a natural fit for golf, appealing to fans who appreciate versatility and crossover culture. Its a shoe people love for its balance, honoring basketball heritage while embracing a different kind of competition and precision. The Air Jordan 9 Retro Low Golf White University Blue was released on August 12, 2024 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Jordan Spizike Low Black Classic Green White Varsity Red
Description: The Air Jordan Spizike Low Black Classic Green White Varsity Red fuses multiple chapters of Jordan Brand history into a single low profile silhouette that feels energetic and familiar. The black base with classic green, white, and varsity red accents pulls directly from some of the most iconic Jordan color stories, giving the Spizike Low a confident and layered identity. It feels bold and expressive without losing cohesion. Collectors enjoy this pair because it celebrates Jordan legacy through remix rather than reinvention. The Spizike concept has always been about honoring multiple silhouettes at once, and this colorway reinforces that philosophy with recognizable tones and strong contrast. Fans love it as a versatile everyday Jordan that still carries deep historical references, making it feel meaningful, wearable, and rooted in brand DNA. The Air Jordan Spizike Low Black Classic Green White Varsity Red was released on May 20, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mule Golf Wolf Grey
Description: As part of the Jordan golf line, the Air Jordan 1 Mule Golf Wolf Grey delivers a shoe that shows up for long stretches on the green, keeping you comfy and stylish from tee off to after-game drinks. Made from white and Wolf grey leather with a striking black Swoosh on the side, these Jordan golfing mules have a sleek simplicity. With midsoles that are more stable than regular cleats, the outsoles are stiffer with a spikeless traction. As a slider, the shoe has no laces and allows for easy wear. A perforated toe box keeps them breathable. Branding is clean with the clean Jumpman Golf logo on the top of the upper. We love the classic, mature color combo and design of these Jordan golfing mules. Easy to slip on and off, they arent just an ally on the golf course, but make for a great leisure shoe too. The Air Jordan 1 Mule Golf Wolf Grey was released on March 20, 2025, retailed at $110.

Display Name: New Balance 327 Lace Pack Rose Sugar (Women's)
Description: The New Balance 327 Lace Pack Rose Sugar Womens reimagines the brands retro running aesthetic through a softer and more fashion forward lens. The Rose Sugar and Sea Salt colorway gives the shoe a warm and delicate tone, while the oversized N logo and flared midsole maintain the bold identity of the 327 silhouette. The lace pack variation adds a subtle twist that enhances the overall look. This pair resonates with fans who appreciate when classic running inspiration is adapted into something more expressive. The 327 has become a staple for its unique shape, and this colorway reinforces its versatility. It is a sneaker that feels both nostalgic and modern, appealing to those who want a statement silhouette with a softer palette. The New Balance 327 Lace Pack Rose Sugar Womens was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Industrial Blue
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid SE Industrial Blue updates the legendary AJ1 silhouette with a neutral, white base and accents in Industrial Blue. This color combination gives the sneaker a vintage feel, augmented by the worn-in appearance of the Sail-colored midsole. Drawing elements from the original Air Force 1 and the Nike Dunk, this version of the Air Jordan 1 features a mid-top silhouette and a smooth leather upper. The iconic Wings logo in Industrial Blue decorates the outer side panel, while a tonal Swoosh breaks up the primarily white upper. In addition, the tongue displays the Jumpman logo, also in Industrial Blue, and the word "AIR." The foam midsole houses comfortable air cushioning, which offers a responsive feel, while a grippy rubber outsole tops off the design. Our experts like the way this sneaker stays true to its retro roots, from the colorway to the Jordan branding. The Jordan 1 Mid SE Industrial Blue was released on April 9, 2024, and sold for $150.

Display Name: Jordan 2 Retro SP Union Grey Fog
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Union LA Grey Fog features a grey canvas upper with matching perforated suede overlays and mudguards. Light blue eyelets, eyestay patches, and piping add a pop of color. Matching tongues with a yellowed woven tag and exposed foam edges offer a worn-in look to this futuristic design. From there, "UN|LA" and "HO2021" external tags provide a custom feel. The Air Jordan 1 Union LA Grey Fog released in April of 2022 and retailed for $225.

Display Name: New Balance 2010 Cream Grey
Description: The New Balance 2010 Cream Grey channels retro performance energy through a clean, balanced palette. Cream and grey tones work together across the layered upper, giving the silhouette a soft, vintage inspired feel. The combination of mesh and suede enhances depth while keeping the look lightweight and breathable. Subtle branding details sit naturally within the design, allowing the color blocking and shape to lead the visual impact. Fans of archival inspired runners gravitate toward colorways that feel timeless, and this pair captures that quiet confidence. The neutral tones make it adaptable across seasons, pairing easily with relaxed streetwear or athletic fits. It stands as a polished interpretation of New Balances heritage running DNA with modern comfort at its core. The New Balance 2010 Cream Grey was released on August 20, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Aluminum Core Black (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial in Aluminum Core Black W (womens) is an iteration of the original shoe that became popular with handball players in the late 1970s. As the latest colorway added to the collection, this shoe is rooted in history but features technological upgrades for comfort. This womens adidas Handball Spezial features a classic and simple design with the ultimate levels of comfort. The flexible rubber outsole provides bounce and energy return, while the soft suede upper and tongue provide soft comfort. Branding details include the classic 3-Stripes in black leather on the midsoles and the adidas name on the tongue. This simple design also features black leather on the heel. At Stock X, we think the standout feature of this shoe is the classic and simple colorway. The combination of black, Cloud White, and Aluminum color patterns ensures that this shoe goes with any outfit, whether it's sportswear or your daily street style. The adidas Handball Spezial in Aluminum Core Black for women was released on July 19th, 2023, for a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro What The
Description: To honor the 30th Anniversary of the Jordan 5, Jordan Brand added a "What The?" treatment to its catalog with the Jordan 5 What The. This design boasts a mix of materials and details from Jumpmans best Non-OG Jordan 5 colorways, including the Tokyo, Shanghai, Raging Bull, Bel-Air, Laser, Green Bean, Olive, and Quai 54 colorways. In true mismatched fashion, each foot of the Jordan 5 What The showcases a different look. On the right, yellow suede from the Tokyo 5 smothers the upper atop a purple and blue speckled Belair 5 midsole with a patterned interior pulled from the Jordan 5 Olive. On the left, red suede tributing the Raging Bull Jordan 5 covers the upper atop a black, grey, and lime green sole that references the Quai 54 iteration. Heel embroidery nodding to the Shanghai and Tokyo models, icy translucent outsoles, and 3M reflective tongues complete this scrambled iteration. The Jordan 5 What The released in November of 2020 and retailed for $220.

Display Name: adidas Adistar Control 5 Unheardof Pork Chop Piggy Runner 2.0 Cheeseburger
Description: The adidas Adistar Control 5 Unheardof Pork Chop Piggy Runner 20 Cheeseburger brings playful storytelling into performance running design, turning a technical silhouette into something far more expressive. The Almost Yellow Light Pink Light Yellow palette leans into its food inspired theme, with colors that feel intentionally bold and slightly offbeat in the best way. The Adistar Control 5 base grounds the shoe with a structured build, giving the design a sense of purpose beneath the humor. What makes this pair resonate is how confidently it commits to its concept. Unheardof collaborations have built a reputation for injecting personality into adidas models, and this release continues that approach with a narrative that feels memorable and distinct. The mix of performance DNA and character driven design creates a sneaker that stands out visually while still holding onto the integrity of the silhouette. It is the kind of release that collectors gravitate toward because it tells a story you do not see replicated elsewhere. The adidas Adistar Control 5 Unheardof Pork Chop Piggy Runner 20 Cheeseburger was released on March 28, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 Metallic Silver Black Psychic Blue
Description: The Nike Shox R4 Metallic Silver Black Psychic Blue introduces vibrant contrast to the classic tech runner frame. Metallic Silver forms the base, while black overlays define the structure and add depth. Psychic Blue accents inject bold energy, lighting up the silhouette with sharp color hits that emphasize the flowing lines. The iconic Shox columns remain visible and powerful beneath the streamlined upper. This release speaks to collectors who enjoy expressive updates on heritage tech silhouettes. The blue detailing transforms the silver base into something more dynamic and eye catching. It maintains the futuristic edge that defines the Shox R4 while adding fresh personality. Bold and balanced, this pair stands out with confident intensity. The Nike Shox R4 Metallic Silver Black Psychic Blue was released on April 11, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-DS Trainer 14 Hidden NY Dawn
Description: The ASICS Gel DS Trainer 14 Hidden NY Dawn captures lightweight running heritage through a crisp White and Green palette that feels fresh and energetic. The streamlined build emphasizes speed, with clean paneling that highlights the silhouette racing inspired roots. Subtle detailing nods to the Hidden NY collaboration, adding a layer of insider appeal to an already respected model. The DS Trainer line has long been associated with nimble performance and stripped down efficiency, and this version keeps that identity alive while adding cultural depth. Hidden NY brings a curated perspective that resonates with collectors who value community driven projects. The Dawn execution feels balanced and wearable, proving that understated color blocking can still make a strong statement when paired with the right silhouette. The ASICS Gel DS Trainer 14 Hidden NY Dawn was released on October 25, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Mind 001 Slide Solar Red
Description: Nike Mind 001 Slide Solar Red brings bold color into Nikes recovery focused design language, balancing calm intention with expressive energy. The solar red finish gives the slide a confident visual punch, standing out while still aligning with the Mind 001 concept of rest and mental reset. It feels modern and thoughtful, designed for moments away from competition and noise. What makes this slide appealing to collectors is its contrast of purpose and presence. The design remains minimal and functional, but the color choice adds personality and attitude. It reflects how lifestyle footwear can still feel meaningful, reinforcing that recovery and self care have earned their place in sneaker culture. The Nike Mind 001 Slide Solar Red was released on 01/08/2026 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low The Powerpuff Girls Buttercup
Description: Embrace the bold and daring with the Nike SB Dunk Low The Powerpuff Girls Buttercup. This edition captures Buttercup's fearless and tough personality, reflected in the Mean Green/Black/Lotus Pink colorway. The design elements of the sneaker are as dynamic and powerful as Buttercup herself, making a strong statement. The sneaker's striking color palette is complemented by its high-quality construction and attention to detail, embodying the spirit of the fierce Powerpuff Girl. This Dunk Low is not just a shoe; it's an expression of Buttercup's unyielding energy and charisma. Released on December 14 at skate shops and on SNKRS, and priced at $135, the Nike SB Dunk Low The Powerpuff Girls Buttercup is a perfect mix of style and attitude. Sneaker enthusiasts and fans of the show will not want to miss this unique and spirited sneaker.?

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Seafoam (Women's)
Description: The women's Air Jordan 1 High Seafoam (W) arrives in a smooth white leather construction with Seafoam Durabuck overlays and Swooshes. On the laces, crisp bronze trimming stands out against the design's subtle coloration. The women's Air Jordan 1 High Seafoam (W) released in August of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Red
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi M9621 in Red is a general release of the foundational high-top canvas basketball shoe in the most culturally significant and most historically loaded single color in the Chuck Taylor All Star's vast colorway catalog, featuring the standard canvas upper in Converse's varsity red across the full high-top construction including the ankle collar, sidewalls, and foxing, with the white rubber midsole, toe cap, and vulcanized outsole providing the clean neutral contrast that defines the Chuck Taylor's classic two-tone color expression at its most direct. The M9621 style code identifies this as the standard men's sizing configuration of the Red Hi in the Chuck Taylor's traditional production run, with the Hi silhouette's ankle collar providing additional coverage and the most distinctive visual proportions of the Chuck Taylor range's two main cuts. Varsity red Chucks hold a specific position in American popular culture, having been worn by athletes, musicians, and rebels across generations as the color that most directly connects to the competitive, energetic, and emotionally charged character that red communicates across cultural contexts globally, from high school gym floors to rock concert stages. Released May 25, 2018 at $60 retail via Converse and authorized retailers globally, representing the standard Chuck Taylor Hi retail price tier for core single-color colorways. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi M9621 Red was released on May 25, 2018 with a retail price of $60.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Flight Club (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Flight Club TD introduces iconic Jordan 4 design language to the smallest sneakerheads through a Sail and Black base accented by University Red. The structured upper, signature netting, and sculpted midsole keep the silhouette instantly recognizable despite its scaled down format. The balanced color blocking gives the shoe a clean yet bold presence. This toddler edition stands out because it carries authentic AJ4 heritage in compact form. The sail and red combination feels classic, tapping into the models strong basketball identity. Parents and collectors appreciate how the details remain true to the original blueprint, ensuring the design feels genuine rather than simplified. It is a faithful adaptation that keeps the Flight Club legacy moving forward. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Flight Club TD was released on January 17, 2026 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: New Balance 1906L Black Angora
Description: The New Balance 1906L Black Angora brings a refined and neutral palette to one of the brands most popular retro running silhouettes. The combination of Black and Angora tones creates a layered look that feels both technical and understated, highlighting the mesh and synthetic construction that defines the model. The 1906 line has gained strong traction within lifestyle and fashion spaces due to its balance of performance heritage and modern styling appeal. Fans gravitate toward the 1906 because it captures the early two thousands running aesthetic without feeling bulky or outdated. The Black Angora colorway enhances versatility, making the sneaker easy to wear across different outfits while still maintaining depth through tonal contrast. The layered upper and visible structure give the shoe a distinct look that stands out within the current wave of retro runners. For collectors, pairs like this represent the continued rise of New Balance within fashion, where comfort driven designs meet clean and wearable color execution. The New Balance 1906L Black Angora was released on January 7, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Racing Pack Light Smoke Green Strike
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Racing Pack Light Smoke Green Strike pairs cool greys with high voltage detailing for a dynamic finish. Light Smoke Grey sets a sleek gradient foundation, complemented by black panels that define the layered structure. Green Strike accents burst through the upper, bringing neon intensity that highlights the eyelets and branding elements. White touches balance the palette, keeping the design crisp and focused around the visible Air units. This release captures the spirit of speed through sharp contrast and vibrant tone. The neon green adds urgency and attitude, transforming a neutral base into something far more energetic. It reflects the Air Max 95s ability to carry bold color without losing its anatomical identity. Confident and eye catching, this pair keeps the Racing Pack theme alive with unmistakable presence. The Nike Air Max 95 Racing Pack Light Smoke Green Strike was released on October 21, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Model: Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG
Display Name: Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Air Max 95 White
Description: The Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Air Max 95 White fuses football innovation with iconic running heritage. White dominates the streamlined upper, while black accents reference the layered design language of the Air Max 95. The low cut Vapor build emphasizes speed and touch, maintaining Mercurials signature explosive feel. Its crisp palette enhances the aerodynamic shape with classic contrast. Fans of crossover inspirations will appreciate how this pair nods to a legendary Air Max silhouette while staying performance driven. The white and black combination feels timeless, elevating the football boot into collectible territory. It merges pitch precision with sneaker history effortlessly. Clean and dynamic, this edition bridges two iconic Nike worlds. The Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Air Max 95 White was released on September 8, 2025 with a retail price of $320.

Display Name: Nike Air Liquid Max Black Green Apple
Description: The Nike Air Liquid Max Fragment Black Green Apple pushes a more futuristic direction, combining full length visible cushioning with a sharp and high contrast color palette. The black upper is accented by chrome and green apple tones, creating a layered and reflective look that shifts depending on light. Fragments influence is felt through the clean execution and restrained approach to branding. What makes this collaboration stand out is its balance between innovation and minimalism. The Liquid Max platform introduces a bold technical element, while Fragment keeps the design focused and controlled. Fans of both Nike and Fragment appreciate this approach, where new technology is paired with a refined aesthetic. It is a sneaker that feels modern, experimental, and highly intentional. The Nike Air Liquid Max Fragment Black Green Apple was released on March 26, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Cheetah Print (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Cheetah Print Womens transforms the timeless silhouette with bold texture and earthy contrast. Baroque brown and sesame tones create a warm base, while cheetah print overlays inject a fierce and fashion driven edge. Sail accents soften the composition, keeping the design balanced while allowing the animal pattern to command attention. The familiar low cut shape grounds the look, ensuring the statement detail feels intentional rather than excessive. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it blends classic structure with expressive surface design. Animal prints have long held cultural relevance in street style, and applying them to the Air Force 1 adds fresh personality without altering its proportions. Fans appreciate how the color palette keeps the print wearable, making it versatile despite its boldness. It stands as a confident reinterpretation of a staple, where texture becomes the centerpiece rather than color alone. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Cheetah Print Womens was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: adidas Jabbar Low Bruce Lee Game of Death
Description: The adidas Jabbar Low Bruce Lee Game of Death pays tribute to two cultural icons by blending Kareem Abdul Jabbars signature silhouette with Bruce Lees legendary film legacy. The low profile Jabbar design carries timeless basketball heritage, while the Game of Death inspiration adds cinematic energy and symbolism that fans immediately recognize. It feels powerful and focused, honoring discipline, movement, and philosophy through design rather than excess. Collectors are drawn to this release because it represents respect and storytelling. The color execution reflects Bruce Lees iconic imagery, while the silhouette remains clean and wearable. Fans appreciate how the shoe feels intentional, celebrating legacy across sport and cinema in a way that feels authentic and emotionally grounded rather than novelty driven. The adidas Jabbar Low Bruce Lee Game of Death was released on September 13, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Magnet
Description: The New Balance 9060 Magnet represents a fresh interpretation of the refined style and innovation-driven design found in the classic 99X series. With a magnet colorway accented by shades of gray, the New Balance 9060 showcases a modern and streamlined aesthetic. Its contemporary appeal is emphasized by suede overlays and a mesh upper, coupled with flat cotton laces and TPU eyelets. Drawing influence from the 990, the 9060 Magnet incorporates sway bars across the entire upper, creating a visually dynamic effect. Wavy lines and exaggerated proportions on a sculpted pod midsole enhance the familiar cushioning technologies of ABZORB and SBS. Inspired by the original 991 lace jewel, the tongue logo adds a distinctive touch, while the diamond outsole pattern, borrowed from the classic 860, completes the overall design. The standout characteristic of the New Balance 9060 Magnet lies in its advanced cushioning technology. Featuring ABZORB and SBS technologies in the sole, the shoe delivers dynamic and lightweight cushioning for optimal comfort and performance. The sneaker debuted for $150 on September 25th, 2023.

Display Name: MSCHF Gobstomper Sour Edition
Description: Every part of the MSCHF Gobstomper is constructed of 4 layers of colored material that expose as the shoe wears. Designed as a heavily-padded skate shoe, the Gobstomper reveals purple/green/lime underlayers as the shoe wears down against grip tape and asphalt. The shoe features a suede upper and rubberized outsole. The Gobstomper Sour colorway was released in December of 2022, and retailed for $195.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro SP SoleFly Cafecito
Description: The Jordan 12 Retro SP SoleFly Cafecito is a striking collaboration that pays homage to Miami's rich coffee culture. This limited edition sneaker features a pristine white leather upper, complemented by baroque brown accents that evoke the rich hues of freshly brewed coffee. The shoe's design incorporates SoleFly's signature aesthetic, blending it seamlessly with the classic Air Jordan 12 silhouette. Attention to detail is evident throughout, from the premium materials to the subtle nods to coffee culture. The sneaker comes with a green box shield and brown laces, further emphasizing its connection to the cafecito theme. With its release date set for December 13, 2024, this Jordan 12 Retro SP is poised to become a coveted item for sneaker enthusiasts and coffee lovers alike. Our experts state this product is great for those who appreciate unique collaborations and want to add a touch of Miami's vibrant culture to their footwear collection.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Flyknit 2.0 Light Bone
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Flyknit 2.0 Light Bone reimagines the classic silhouette through a lighter and more breathable lens. Light Bone tones flow across the woven upper, creating a sleek and seamless look that feels modern yet familiar. Khaki and Desert Khaki accents add warmth and subtle contrast, maintaining depth within the tonal palette. The Flyknit construction reduces weight while preserving the unmistakable Air Force 1 shape and stance. Fans appreciate how this version keeps the spirit of the original while updating its feel. The flexible upper gives the shoe a contemporary edge, making it comfortable and adaptable for everyday wear. The neutral colorway enhances its versatility, allowing the texture and craftsmanship to take center stage. It stands as a thoughtful evolution of an icon that continues to adapt with the times. The Nike Air Force 1 Flyknit 2.0 Light Bone was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Tiempo Legend Ronaldinho Touch of Gold
Description: The Nike Tiempo Legend Ronaldinho Touch of Gold offers a more classic interpretation of the same tribute, leaning fully into elegance and simplicity. The all white base paired with subtle metallic gold detailing gives the boot a timeless and refined look. It feels grounded in tradition, reflecting the smooth control and creativity that defined Ronaldinhos career. Fans appreciate this version because it feels pure. There is no excess, just a beautiful execution of one of Nikes most respected football silhouettes. Collectors love it as a wearable piece of football history, connecting modern players and fans to an era defined by flair and joy.
