It resonates with those who value touch, finesse, and legacy over speed driven hype. The Nike Tiempo Legend Ronaldinho Touch of Gold was released on December 10, 2025 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus 3 Black Wolf Grey
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus 3 Wolf Grey features a grey plastic TPU, mesh, and leather upper, with the fine mesh base Wolf Grey that transitions slowly into black for the rest of the silhouette.[1] From there, small Nike "Swooshes" in silver at the front of the Air Max Plus 3 combine with the patented cushioning technology in the midsole to complete the design. The Nike Air Max Plus 3 Wolf Grey released in November of 2019 and retailed for $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Dn8 Black Bright Crimson
Description: The Nike Air Max Dn8 Black Bright Crimson comes with a woven textile base with bright crimson panels and university-red stripes. There are eight pressurized Air units housed in a foam layer to give you dynamic responsiveness, and a rubber tread for durability, stability, and texture grip. The Black Bright Crimson Air Max Dn8 by Nike has a lightweight knit body with panels to reinforce the toe and heel. There are University-red Swoosh stripes on both sides. A TPU clip at the heel is there to stabilize each step, while the foam columns at the bottom hold the integrated Air cylinders beneath a foam layer. Here at StockX, a few things we love about the Nike Air Max Dn8 Black Bright Crimson are the reflective heel tab, which increases visibility, and the removable foam insole, which supports custom orthotic inserts for personalized fit. It retailed at $190 when it was released on the 6th of March, 2025.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo (2013)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo has four dominant colors that define its look; cement grey, fired red, white, and black. The upper of Toro Bravo Air Jordan 4 is made of Fire Red nubuck material. Black accents as well as Cement Grey on the outsole, tongue tag, and eyelets complement the design of these sneakers. The white midsole of the shoe also contains some Visible Air-units. This white midsole rests atop a grey sole, completing the design. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo was launched for the first time on July 13th, 2013, with $160 as the retail price.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mule Golf White Midnight Navy
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mule Golf White Midnight Navy delivers a relaxed and functional take on the iconic silhouette through a slip on mule design built for the course. The white upper creates a clean and structured base, while midnight navy accents add contrast that defines the design. The open heel construction adds ease of wear while maintaining performance intent. Fans of Jordan golf releases appreciate how models like this blend comfort and practicality with recognizable design elements. The mule format offers a more casual approach while still carrying strong identity. It is a sneaker that reflects versatility and modern adaptation of a classic silhouette. The Air Jordan 1 Mule Golf White Midnight Navy was released on June 20, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: New Balance 993 MiUSA Grey
Description: The New Balance 993 MIU Grey features a gray suede upper with mesh underlays and white-on-gray New Balance logos. From there, cushioning pockets at the base of the heel and high-performance woven mesh on the forefoot complete the design. The New Balance 993 MIU Grey released in November of 2019 and retailed for $175.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro QS Halloween Skull
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro QS Halloween Skull is here to celebrate Halloween in style, offering a spooky twist on the classic Dunk silhouette. This limited-edition sneaker features a cracked leather upper, with vibrant green hues emerging from beneath the black exterior, creating a dramatic contrast. An embossed black skull decorates the toe box, adding to the eerie theme, while the custom insole showcases a series of skull graphics for a chilling effect. Designed with the same iconic Dunk Low shape, the Halloween Skull edition stands out for its bold design and attention to detail. The textured cracked leather gives the shoe a unique look, and the bright cactus and green curry accents make it a real eye-catcher. Whether youre hitting the streets or attending a Halloween event, this sneaker is sure to turn heads with its striking visuals and Halloween-themed aesthetics. Released on October 24, 2024, the Nike Dunk Low Retro QS Halloween Skull retailed for $140. With its vibrant colorway and limited-edition design, this sneaker is a must-have for sneakerheads looking to celebrate Halloween in style.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 5 Pink Foam (Women's)
Description: The Nike Free Metcon 5 Pink Foam Womens blends flexibility and stability within a silhouette designed for training, using a pink foam base that adds a lighter and more energetic feel. The structure combines support and movement, giving the shoe a balanced look that reflects its performance focus. Accents of adobe, platinum tint, and dark team red add subtle contrast, keeping the design layered without overwhelming the palette. Fans of training footwear gravitate toward the Free Metcon line because it offers versatility across different workouts. This colorway adds personality while maintaining the functionality the model is known for. It is a sneaker that balances performance and style, making it suitable for both gym sessions and casual wear. The Nike Free Metcon 5 Pink Foam Womens was released on February 13, 2024 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Black (Women's) blends athletic technology with a smart duotone design. This running-inspired silhouette is ideal for casual and active use and features premium materials and Nike's trusted engineering for a reliable fit. The Photon Dust Black Zoom Vomero 5 (Women's) by Nike comes with a layered mesh and synthetic-leather upper for breathability and structure. Its dual-tone palette combines soft grays with striking black accents on the Swoosh and overlays. Lightweight cushioning is integrated into the midsole, with a rubber outsole designed for traction. Originally released in 2006, the Vomero line is renowned for its comfort-driven designs geared towards high-performance activities. One thing we love about the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Black (Women's) is its well-engineered midsole that gives you consistent support. We also appreciate the sole pattern, almost like bubbles, that curves like the shape of the feet. This women's-sized shoe retailed at $160 upon its release on September 1, 2024.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Silver Tongue (2020)
Description: Jordan remastered a 1990s masterpiece with the release of the Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Silver Tongue (2020), now available on StockX. This is the fourth iteration of the original Fire Red colorway. This Jordan 5 consists of a white leather upper with netted underlays and Fire Red detailing. A silver 3M reflective tongue with a red Jumpman logo, black and Fire Red midsole, and an icy translucent outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in March of 2020 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Dark Obsidian
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Dark Obsidian delivers a sleek and moody take on one of Nikes most aggressive silhouettes. The dark obsidian base gives the Air Max Plus a stealthy presence, while subtle blue chill accents add depth without breaking the flow. The iconic cage lines and Tuned Air sole still command attention, but the darker palette makes the shoe feel more refined and controlled. Collectors appreciate this pair because it shows restraint without sacrificing attitude. The Air Max Plus has always been about dominance and presence, and this colorway channels that energy through tone rather than contrast. Fans love it as a wearable option that still carries the rebellious spirit tied to the models legacy in street and rave culture, making it feel powerful, modern, and confident. The Nike Air Max Plus Dark Obsidian was released on July 3, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Spiridon Barely Volt Hot Punch
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Spiridon Barely Volt Hot Punch brings back a classic runner with a colorway that feels energetic and unmistakably bold. The Barely Volt base sets a bright foundation, while Hot Punch and Volt accents amplify the intensity across the upper. Metallic Silver elements tie back to the silhouettes original design language, keeping it rooted in its late 90s running heritage. This pair stands out because it embraces color in a way that feels true to the Spiridons identity. The mix of neon tones and reflective detailing creates a dynamic look that captures attention without losing authenticity. It appeals to collectors who appreciate retro runners with strong visual impact and historical relevance. The Nike Air Zoom Spiridon Barely Volt Hot Punch was released on May 8, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Evergreen Aura
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Evergreen Aura brings a refreshing pop of color to the legendary silhouette. Summit White forms a bright and balanced base, while Evergreen Aura accents add a cool green lift across the design. Vast Grey and Smoke Grey details provide structure, framing the layered upper and classic mudguard. The visible Air unit remains the defining feature, reinforcing the models performance heritage. This release appeals to collectors who enjoy lighter palettes with subtle personality. The green accents feel vibrant yet controlled, enhancing the shape without overwhelming it. It captures the spirit of the Air Max 90 as a canvas for color experimentation while honoring its iconic build. Fresh and versatile, this pair continues the evolution of a timeless runner. The Nike Air Max 90 Evergreen Aura was released on June 20, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Light Armory Blue Denim
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Light Armory Blue Denim is a low top sneaker featuring an upper crafted in multiple shades of Blue Denim. The Light Armory Blue base is overlaid by Diffused Blue, while the Swoosh pops in Midnight Navy. The Pale Ivory midsole meets a black outsole, and Nike branding on the tongue and rear heel tab finish the look. The Nike Dunk has experienced a circuitous path to its success as one of Nikes most riffed upon shoes. It was first designed in the 1980s to display collegiate athletics colors, and then skateboarders appreciated its construction in the late 1990s. With the Blue Denim fabrication, the sport company expands the Dunk Lows aesthetic possibilities even further. In our opinion, the best feature of the Dunk Denim is its denim fabrication, which is both uncommon for a sneaker and nuanced in its execution. The Nike Dunk Low Light Armory Blue Denim released on February 20, 2025, and retailed for $125.
Colorway: Light Armory Blue/Midnight Navy/Diffused Blue/Pale Ivory

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 White Black Dusky Orchid
Description: The Salomon XT 6 White Black Dusky Orchid brings a softer contrast to the trail ready silhouette, blending a clean white base with black structure and Dusky Orchid accents. The purple tones add a subtle layer of color that shifts the shoe away from purely technical aesthetics and into a more lifestyle friendly space. The familiar XT 6 construction remains intact, with its layered upper and performance driven foundation. Fans of Salomon appreciate how small color changes can reshape the identity of the model. This version feels lighter and more expressive without losing the rugged DNA that defines the XT 6. It is a strong option for those who want a balance between outdoor function and everyday wearability. The Salomon XT 6 White Black Dusky Orchid was released on February 11, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Shadow Toe
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Shadow Toe (2021) is a sleek and stylish take on the classic Jordan 1 silhouette.? ?? ?The highlight of this shoe is the Shadow Toe box, which gives the shoe a unique look. Featuring a black and grey upper with a white midsole and translucent, grey outsole, this shoe has a simple but refined look. It is distinct from other shoes thanks in part to the Air Jordan embroidery on the collar. The design features as well a basketball under the Air Jordan words. ?? ?The Air Jordan 1 Low Shadow Toe (2021) released in June of 2021. At the time of its release and beyond, the shoe has a retail cost of $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Mamba Mentality
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Mamba Mentality reimagines an icon through the lens of a driven competitor. Dressed in a refined Soft Yellow/Soft Yellow palette (style HV9408-700), this AF1 pairs clean lines with a sun?washed tone that nods to West Coast hoops culture. Premium-feel leather, precise paneling, and classic perforations on the toe box deliver the timeless AF1 look, while a plush padded collar and sturdy heel structure provide a secure, comfortable fit day in and day out. A crisp white midsole and grippy rubber outsole ground the sneaker with dependable traction and the familiar, responsive feel of Air cushioning, making it an easy go-to for both city wear and court-inspired style. Thoughtful details extend the story: the Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Mamba Mentality arrives with a Kobe booklet and two extra lace options, powerful purple and vibrant yellow, so you can personalize the vibe to match your rotation. Subtle branding, smooth Swoosh overlays, and neat stitchwork elevate the silhouette without overpowering its versatile color blocking. Whether youre pairing it with tapered denim or athletic staples, the streamlined profile and balanced proportions keep outfits sharp and modern. Released on June 24, 2025, this pair blends heritage design with contemporary flair, delivering a collectible take on the AF1 thats made for everyday wear. Our team loves this product because it combines the timeless comfort of the Air Force 1 with a striking Soft Yellow finish and thoughtful extras that celebrate Mamba Mentality in a way that feels wearable, elevated, and memorable.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Reverse Metallic
Description: If you're looking for a striking-looking trainer with top-class credentials, the Jordan 5 Retro Reverse Metallic is right up there. It's an almost surrealistic take on the traditional high-top basketball shoe, with ultra-modern contours and high-tech accents. This is a fascinating update on the Air Jordan 5. It has an ice white upper punctuated with black panels on the sole and collar. The leather upper has a synthetic mesh cut-out panel for breathability. The collar has a high front, crested by a long tongue, and an ultra-low back. The midsole has jagged white highlighting that creates a dramatic effect. Our experts are very taken by this design. It's aggressive but also very familiar at the same time. It screams aggressive hoop action and makes one want to get out and play. The transparent air capsule in the heel adds the perfect high-performance touch. The Jordan 5 Retro Reverse Metallic was released on 7 December 2024, priced at $200 retail.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 PRM Escape Treeline
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 PRM Escape Treeline is a premium edition of the iconic Air Max 1 sneaker that was released as a new addition to Nike's "Escape" collection, which pays homage to outdoor adventures. ?? ?The Air Max 1 PRM Escape Treeline features a premium leather upper with tree graphics on both lateral sides. The color scheme of the upper is predominantly white with Slate Blue, black, and soft gray overlays. The sneaker is equipped with Nike's iconic Air Max technology in the sole, which provides superior cushioning and shock absorption.? ? ?We think that the unique feature of the Nike Air Max 1 PRM Escape Treeline is its premium construction and materials including a mix of suede, leather, and ballistic nylon, which provide durability and a premium feel to the sneaker. The Nike Air Max 1 PRM Escape Treeline was released on May 25th, 2023, at a listing price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Regal Pink (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Regal Pink Womens leans fully into soft tonal storytelling with a confident edge. Regal Pink wraps the upper, complemented by Pink Foam and Soft Pearl accents that create a layered and harmonious look. The classic Dunk construction stays intact, from the smooth leather panels to the sturdy sole that has defined the silhouette since the nineteen eighties. Monochromatic executions like this resonate because they feel intentional and polished. The varying pink shades add dimension without overwhelming the design, making it easy to style while still standing out. For fans who love color driven statements without heavy graphics, this pair offers a clean and expressive take on a timeless favorite. The Nike Dunk Low Regal Pink Womens was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '87 Stranger Things Steve Harrington
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 87 Stranger Things Steve Harrington taps into nostalgia through a character driven reinterpretation of a legendary runner. White and neutral grey create a familiar base, while team maroon, speed red, and black accents add personality tied to Steve Harringtons on screen style. The Air Max 1 shape keeps the design grounded in Nike running heritage while letting the storytelling bring it to life. This release stands out because it connects sneaker culture with television fandom in an authentic way. Fans appreciate how the design references character and era without becoming costume like. Collectors value it as a crossover piece that feels wearable beyond the collaboration itself, proving that thoughtful storytelling can elevate a classic silhouette while maintaining its timeless appeal and cultural relevance. The Nike Air Max 1 87 Stranger Things Steve Harrington was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Diamond Shorts
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Diamond Shorts features a black Durabuck and white leather upper in a classic color blocked format, similar to legendary Jordan 1s like the Bred and Shadow colorways. At the heel, an Air Jordan Wings logo nods to the origins of the Air Jordan line. A white midsole and semi-translucent outsole add the finishing touch. The Jordan 1 Low Diamond Shorts released in February of 2022 and retailed for $120.

Display Name: Nike Shox MR4 Mule Martine Rose Metallic Platinum Varsity Red (Women's)
Description: The Nike Shox MR4 Mule Martine Rose Metallic Platinum Varsity Red Womens turns performance heritage into high fashion through Martine Roses bold and subversive design lens. The Shox columns give the mule a sculptural and futuristic feel, while metallic platinum and varsity red add drama and contrast. It feels intentionally unconventional, challenging traditional ideas of what footwear should look like or how it should be worn. Fans and collectors love this release because it blurs boundaries. The MR4 Mule is not about practicality alone, but about expression, identity, and confidence. Martine Roses influence transforms Nike Shox into a statement piece that feels at home in fashion spaces rather than the gym. It resonates with people who see sneakers as design objects and cultural commentary rather than purely functional tools. The Nike Shox MR4 Mule Martine Rose Metallic Platinum Varsity Red Womens was released on October 30, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Chicago (2023)
Description: The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Chicago (2023) is an updated version of the Jordan 1 basketball sneaker. The upper of the Air Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Chicago (2023) comes in a white and University Red colorway with black accents. The shoe features a low-cut design, which allows for a full range of motion for the ankle, allowing players to make quick and agile movements on the field. The toe box is reinforced with additional leather and has perforations, which provides extra protection and breathability. We think that the standout feature of the Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Chicago (2023) is its sole. The sole is made from a hard rubber material, which provides traction on the field and features a cleat pattern that allows for multidirectional movement and stability, ensuring that players can maintain control and grip on various surfaces. The shoe was released on June 1st, 2023, at a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High CO.JP Midnight Navy (2020)
Description: If there is anything that we learned from summer 2020 releases like the Nike Dunk Low Samba or the Jordan 1 CO.JP Neutral Grey, its that CO.JP came back and bigger than ever before. Jordan Brand revived another colorway from the 2001 Jordan 1 CO.JP Pack with the Jordan 1 CO.JP Midnight Navy. The original Jordan 1 CO.JP Midnight Navy first released as a Japanese exclusive in 2001. With only 3,000 pairs produced, the 2001 Navy CO.JP is one of the rarest Jordan 1 releases of all time. Now, for the first time in almost two decades, the Midnight Navy CO.JP made a return. Dressed in white tumbled leather, navy suede overlays, and a silver Swoosh, the Jordan 1 CO.JP Midnight Navy holds many of the same attributes as the OG. The only point of difference between this 2020 iteration and the OG is that the 2020 pair features classic Nike branding on the tongue instead of the traditional Jumpman embroidery. A sail midsole, navy outsole, and bubble Wings logo on the ankle complete the throwback design. The Jordan 1 CO.JP Midnight Navy released in November of 2020 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero Roam Triple Black
Description: Maintaining key details from its early 2010s silhouette, the trail-ready Nike Zoom Vomero Roam Triple Black arrives in a stealthy all-black color scheme crafted in heavy-duty ripstop nylon fabrics with suede across the eyestays. Almost everything on the Triple Black Nike Zoom Vomero Roam is black, from the reinforced mudguard to the ripstop base at the upper, with bits of reflectivity featured on the heel tab, lacing system, and laces. The all-black aesthetic is complemented by Racer Blue, which appears on the tongues pull tabs "VOMERO" text, and Swoosh on the heel tab. As for the midfoot Swooshes, both are finished in tonal black. The sneaker sits atop an enhanced Cushlon foam midsole housing Zoom Air pockets that deliver a bouncy ride. What our experts love about the Nike Zoom Vomero Roam Triple Black is its stealthy aesthetic, which combines sleek design with rugged functionality. The all-black monochrome palette enhances its versatility, making it a great option for urban exploration and everyday wear. The sneaker debuted on November 1, 2024, for $180.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro UNC Win Like 82
Description: These Jordan 11 Retro UNC Win Like 82s will have you feeling like you hit the biggest midrange jumper of your life. These Air Jordan 11 Retros pay homage to Jordans championship season at UNC, coming in a Tar Heels-inspired white, university blue, and midnight navy colorway. These collegiate feeling 11s dropped in November of 2017 in full-family sizing. Any true MJ fan or Tar Heel alum should be looking to place a Bid on these and add to their collection.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Black Blue Crystal
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus in Black Blue Crystal is a March 2026 general release applying the Blue Crystal icy outsole treatment to the Air Max Plus silhouette, featuring a black upper across the TN's characteristic gradient mesh and TPU overlay construction with black Swoosh and lace cage, finished with a translucent Blue Crystal outsole that adds the icy, semi-transparent blue tone beneath the shoe's dark palette as the colorway's defining visual accent. The Air Max Plus, designed by Sean McDowell and introduced in 1998, is built around a TPU cage structure that runs along the lateral and medial sides of the shoe giving the TN its distinctive exoskeleton appearance, a gradient mesh upper that fades from dark to light across its length, a large visible Air Max tube unit in the heel and forefoot for cushioning, and the aggressive forward-leaning silhouette that made it a street culture staple in Europe and Australia before becoming globally recognized. The Blue Crystal outsole on the black body creates the most dramatic contrast in the colorway, with the transparent blue reading as an almost-frozen quality underfoot that gives the TN a seasonal freshness while maintaining the aggressive, dark-toned character associated with the Air Max Plus's most popular black-based executions. Released March 20, 2026 at $190 retail via nike.com and select retailers. The Nike Air Max Plus Black Blue Crystal was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Anta Kai 3 Sneaker Politics Patchwork
Description: The Anta Kai 3 Sneaker Politics Patchwork channels Kyrie Irvings creative and unpredictable on court identity through a design packed with texture, storytelling, and visual contrast. Created alongside Sneaker Politics, the collaboration embraces a patchwork inspired aesthetic that combines shades of blue and white across layered materials and stitched detailing. The Kai line has become known for reflecting Kyries artistic personality and spiritual influences rather than following conventional basketball sneaker design trends, and this release pushes that direction even further through its handcrafted appearance and expressive color blocking. Basketball fans and sneaker collectors gravitate toward Kyrie footwear because every release feels personal and creatively driven. The patchwork theme gives this pair a one of one energy, almost like different pieces of basketball culture and streetwear were stitched together into a single silhouette. Sneaker Politics collaborations also carry extra weight among collectors because the boutique consistently approaches projects with storytelling and regional influence rather than surface level branding. For hoop fans, the Kai 3 Patchwork stands out as a basketball shoe willing to embrace individuality and artistic experimentation without losing its performance roots. The Anta Kai 3 Sneaker Politics Patchwork was released on March 21, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD Birch Metropolis
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD Birch Metropolis is a Super Deluxe iteration of the Onitsuka Tigers beloved silhouette. This high-end sneaker is dressed in a subtle colorway that exudes elegance. This low-riding lifestyle sneaker begins with an upper base of Birch tumbled leather. Birch suede forms a T-toe overlay, the eyestay overlay, the rim around the collar, a heel counter, and the signature serrated strips that cross at the heel. Warm gray suede in a Metropolis shade is used to craft the stripes that of course both vertically and horizontally over the side panel. Birch-colored rubber is used to help reinforce the toecap. A foam midsole in both Birch and rests atop a Birch rubber outsole. The detail of this sneaker we most enjoy is the fold-over heel flap in Birch suede. It sports Metropolis Tiger branding that locks in the elegant dual colorway of this shoe. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD Birch Metropolis was released on September 1, 2023, for retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Pink Foam
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Pink Foam is a basketball style athletic shoe with a low top. The leather upper in Pink Foam coordinates with a matching Pink Foam midsole, accented by Love You Forever branding. The rear heel tabs sport Nike Air and NOCTA branding on the right and left, respectively, and NOCTA branding appears on the insole. Additional details include a Metallic Silver dubrae, alternate laces, and included block letter beads for personalization. In collaboration with Canadian artist Drake, American athletic wear brand Nike produces NOCTA, an outlet for Drakes clothing and footwear expression. NOCTA is known for its symbolism, and for the first time ever, Nike modified the Air Force 1s midsole branding to say Love You Forever in script, referencing Drakes favorite book as a child. Our experts feel that the best feature of the AF1 Low Lover Boy is its monochrome Pink Foam colorway, which stands out from other Air Force 1s. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Pink Foam released on March 7, 2025, and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 3 Blueprint (Women's)
Description: Engineered for the speed, vision, and sharp cuts of Sabrina Ionescus game, the Nike Sabrina 3 Blueprint (Womens) blends precision design with standout style. The Glacier Blue, Neptune Blue, and Light Armory Blue palette is layered in cool gradations, while Metallic Gold hits deliver a refined finish that catches the light with every move. A streamlined low-top silhouette supports agile footwork, with structured sidewalls and a secure lacing system that help lock in your midfoot during quick changes of direction. Underfoot, responsive cushioning softens hard landings and helps you spring into your next step, while a sculpted heel and padded collar add comfort through the full run of a game or workout. Built for performance on hardwood or blacktop, the Sabrina 3 features a grippy, multidirectional traction pattern designed to keep you connected to the floor when you plant, pivot, and stop on a dime. Breathable materials keep airflow steady, and durable overlays reinforce high-wear zones so you can push the pace without worrying about breakdown. Style codes HF2881-400 and HF2882-400 mark this colorway as part of the Blueprint story, pairing modern performance with a clean, versatile look that pairs easily with team kits and streetwear alike. From high-intensity drills to everyday rotation, this pair delivers the balance of stability, responsiveness, and effortless polish that todays two-way players demand. Our team loves this product because it combines secure support, quick-rebounding cushioning, and confident traction in a striking blue-and-gold palette that performs on court and elevates your off-court fit.
Colorway: Glacier Blue/Neptune Blue/Light Armory Blue/Metallic Gold/Still Blue/White

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Kith x Lionel Messi White Collegiate Royal
Description: The Adidas Handball Spezial Kith x Lionel Messi in White, Collegiate Royal, and Gold is a three way collaborative release that brings together three of the most culturally significant names in their respective worlds, uniting Adidas's most beloved archive silhouette with Kith's position as one of the most respected and taste making retail and creative forces in contemporary streetwear and the greatest footballer in the history of the sport in a single shoe that carries extraordinary weight from every angle of cultural examination. Collegiate royal is a blue with deep American athletic and collegiate associations that simultaneously evokes the Inter Miami color story that has defined the most recent chapter of Messi's playing career, creating a colorway that feels personally connected to where Messi is in his footballing journey right now while also drawing from Kith's deep roots in American sport and college aesthetic traditions. Gold as the third color element brings the unmistakable association of championship, excellence, and the kind of achievement that only the most singular athletes in any sport's history ever accumulate, which makes it the most appropriate accent color possible for a Messi collaborative release. Kith has demonstrated across multiple seasons and collaborations that the brand understands how to honor athletic legends through product releases that feel genuinely reverential and design intelligent rather than simply commercially motivated, and their involvement in a Messi x Adidas Handball Spezial ensures the collaborative execution meets the standard that the subject deserves. White and collegiate royal on a Spezial creates a shoe that draws from the silhouette's European handball heritage while simultaneously speaking the color language of American sport culture that Kith inhabits most naturally, and gold accents throughout give the shoe a visual finish that signals its status as something more than a standard seasonal Spezial release. For sneaker collectors, Kith devotees, and Messi fans who want a wearable object that honors the greatest player in football history in the most considered and aesthetically serious format available, this collaborative Spezial is an essential and historically significant acquisition. The Adidas Handball Spezial Kith x Lionel Messi in White, Collegiate Royal, and Gold was released on May 29, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro SE Paris Olympics Wet Cement (GS)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro SE Paris Olympics Wet Cement GS edition captures the excitement of the 2024 Summer Olympics with its trendy monochromatic color palette . Featuring a striking colorway of smoke grey, iron grey, and cement grey, this sneaker is one of the most anticipated releases of the year. Its bold and modern aesthetic makes it a standout in the Jordan 4 lineup. The Jordan 4 Retro Wet Cement is constructed with a mix of premium materials, ensuring both comfort and durability. The upper combines smooth and textured leathers, creating a dynamic look and feel. The midsole features the signature Air cushioning for maximum comfort, making it perfect for everyday wear. The varying shades of grey give the sneaker a sophisticated yet edgy vibe, ideal for those who want to make a statement. Released on July 27, 2024, the Jordan 4 Retro SE Paris Olympics GS edition retailed at $170. Its smoke grey, iron grey, and cement grey colorway embodies a sleek and modern look that has quickly become a favorite among sneakerheads. Combining classic design with contemporary flair, the Jordan 4 Retro continues to capture the hearts of basketball fans and sneakerheads alike.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '01 Nigo Last Orgy 2
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 01 Nigo Last Orgy 2 brings together classic Air Force 1 construction with Nigos distinct design influence, resulting in a pair that feels both familiar and culturally significant. The sail and loyal blue color combination gives it a clean but expressive look, while the collaboration ties it to a deeper history within streetwear and music culture. The silhouette remains unchanged, allowing the details to carry the story. This release stands out because of its connection to legacy. Nigos influence adds meaning beyond the design itself, making it more than just another Air Force 1. For collectors, it represents a moment where heritage and collaboration intersect in a way that feels authentic. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 01 Nigo Last Orgy 2 was released on May 2, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike React Phantom Run Flyknit 2 White Black
Description: The Nike React Phantom Run Flyknit 2 White Black uses a neutral two-tone color scheme on the breathable knit upper. The Nike React Phantom Run Flyknit 2 White Black slip-on silhouette trades in standard lace closure for elastic Flywire cables integrated into the midfoot. At the same time, external molding on either side of the heel provides enhanced stability. The sock-like build is supported by a React foam midsole, good for responsive cushioning with each step, and increased rubber at the outsole helps deliver better traction and durability. The Nike React Phantom Run Flyknit 2 White Black was released in may 2020 and retailed for $140.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low White Black
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low White Black is a leather upper low-top sneaker featuring an optic White and Black color palette. The uppers overlays and underlays are both White, connecting to a white midsole. The Nike Swoosh in Black accents the sides and coordinates with the tongue label logo, heel tab, and outsole, all done in Black. While American sneaker brand Nike originally developed the Dunk Low as part of a university sports team outfitting initiative, it gained a new audience of skateboarders in the 1990s for its grippy sole and comfortable performance. Nikes skateboarding division, Nike SB, began releasing a skateboarding-engineered Dunk in the early 2000s, and the White Blacks aesthetic harks to its origins as a style designed to feature team colors. Our experts feel that the best feature of the SB Dunk Low is its perfectly balanced, high-contrast colorway. The Nike SB Dunk Low White Black was released on March 1, 2025, and retailed for $115.

Display Name: Nike Air Pegasus Wave Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike Air Pegasus Wave Black Anthracite is a running shoe that draws inspiration from heritage Y2K models in the Air Pegasus lineup and the rave scene of the early 2000s. It boasts an ultra-dark colorway of Anthracite and black with accents in neon yellow Cyber. Featuring a slightly chunky design, the mixed-material upper is crafted from layers of textile, mesh, and leather. TPU overlays support the midfoot, contributing to the sneakers tech-forward appearance. The supportive midsole houses full-length Nike Air cushioning for a responsive feel, while the rubber outsole provides superior traction. Look for pops of Cyber on the outsole and reflective details on the durable laces. The shoe features a stash pocket, which can be found behind the tongue, and this pays tribute to rave culture. The Nike Air Pegasus Wave Black Anthracite was released on September 1, 2024, and sold for $160 retail.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Oyster White Steeple Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 in Oyster White and Steeple Grey showcases a timeless colorway on a beloved classic as oyster white and steeple grey tones reimagine the original Gel-Kayano design. Retaining the retro runner aesthetic of its 2008 predecessor, this modern update features an oyster white mesh upper layered with sleek steeple grey synthetic overlays that flow from the toe through the eyestay and wrap around the heel. The signature stripes pop in black and give the shoe structure and depth. The breathable oyster white mesh base dominates the toe box and side panels, delivering a lightweight and airy feel. The midsole houses renowned GEL cushioning for all-day impact protection. Tying the look together, oyster white laces blend seamlessly with the upper. Released on December 1, 2024, for $150, we love that the ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Oyster White Steeple Grey has the addition of a TRUSSTIC support shank underfoot for enhanced stability between the heel and forefoot.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air (GS)
Description: Air Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air GS brings a fresh layer of storytelling to one of Jordan Brands most elegant silhouettes, using subtle variation to create something that feels special rather than loud. The Rare Air concept has always been about celebrating imperfection and uniqueness, and this grade school release carries that spirit through thoughtful detailing and refined contrast. The Air Jordan 11s sleek profile and flowing lines remain front and center, giving the shoe a premium feel that still connects to its performance roots. Collectors are drawn to this pair because it highlights the Jordan 11s versatility as both a court icon and a design canvas. The Rare Air approach adds depth without disrupting the silhouettes balance, making it feel intentional and story driven. It appeals to fans who appreciate Jordan releases that reward closer inspection, proving that even subtle shifts can give a legendary model new energy and relevance. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air GS was released on 11/05/2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 White Black Metallic Silver
Description: The New Balance 9060 White Black Metallic Silver sharpens the futuristic runner silhouette with a crisp and high contrast palette. White dominates the layered mesh and suede upper, while Black panels add structure and depth throughout. Hits of Metallic Silver bring out the tech inspired detailing, reflecting light against the exaggerated midsole that defines the 9060 design language. The 9060 has become one of New Balance most recognizable modern shapes, blending early 2000s inspiration with bold proportions. In White, Black, and Metallic Silver, the shoe feels balanced and versatile without losing its statement presence. Fans who appreciate a mix of retro performance cues and forward thinking construction will find this colorway especially wearable across seasons. The New Balance 9060 White Black Metallic Silver was released on July 24, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Shox R4 Black (Women's) dresses the Shox R4 in an all-black colorway, toning down the sneakers Y2K design elements. Originally released in 2000, the Shox R4 silhouette has maintained an understated presence in the retro sneaker scene. However, the women's black iteration replaces the usual bright colorways with a stark black upper and accents in Max Orange. Part of the modified waffle sole, the branding on the tongue, and the line of dots on the heel come in Max Orange. The textile-and-synthetic upper features laser-cut perforations and design lines highlighting the sneakers molded design. However, the stand-out feature is the Nike Shox column under the heel. It provides shock absorption while distributing weight across the foot. Our experts at StockX like that the upper is almost identical to the model from 2001, paying homage to the Shox legacy. The women-sized Nike Shox R4 Black (Women's) was released on April 3, 2024, and sold for $140.

Model: adidas Fear of God Athletics II Basketball Low
Display Name: adidas Fear of God Athletics II Basketball Low Derrick Rose
Description: The adidas Fear of God Athletics II Basketball Low Derrick Rose blends Jerry Lorenzo minimalist design language with the legacy of one of the most dynamic guards of his generation. Rendered in Black with Red and Cream accents, the color palette nods subtly to classic Chicago energy without being overly literal. The low cut build keeps the silhouette sleek, emphasizing shape and proportion over heavy branding. Fear of God Athletics has built its reputation on restraint and structure, and pairing that philosophy with Derrick Rose adds emotional weight. Rose story as a former MVP who played with relentless explosiveness makes this collaboration feel earned rather than decorative. Fans appreciate how the design stays understated, letting materials and form do the talking while still carrying the presence expected from a signature level basketball release. The adidas Fear of God Athletics II Basketball Low Derrick Rose was released on December 5, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Caldera Brown Pecan
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Caldera Brown Pecan elevates the trusted Pegasus formula through layered, tonal richness. Caldera Brown dominates the upper, complemented by Pecan accents that add depth and warmth. The streamlined design highlights the premium finish while preserving the responsive cushioning underfoot. It feels refined yet ready for daily miles, blending performance engineering with an elevated aesthetic. Fans of the Pegasus appreciate when familiar comfort meets thoughtful material upgrades. The cohesive brown palette gives this pair a sophisticated presence without sacrificing versatility. It bridges serious running credibility with lifestyle appeal, making it equally at home on pavement or in rotation. Grounded and polished, this edition reinforces the enduring strength of the Pegasus franchise. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Caldera Brown Pecan was released on December 18, 2025 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Valentine's Day Sierra Red (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Valentines Day Sierra Red PS delivers bold seasonal energy through a Pale Ivory base accented by striking Sierra Red detailing. The clean ivory foundation highlights the AJ4s signature mesh panels and sculpted midsole, while the red hits add warmth and intensity. The preschool sizing preserves the silhouettes iconic proportions and recognizable structure. This release stands out because it leans into contrast rather than complexity. The ivory and red pairing feels sharp and confident, giving the classic Jordan 4 a romantic yet powerful edge. Younger fans get access to a themed edition that still respects the heritage design language of the model. It is a vibrant take on a sneaker that continues to define basketball culture across generations. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Valentines Day Sierra Red PS was released on February 7, 2026 with a retail price of $105.

Display Name: New Balance 1906A Black Pink
Description: The New Balance 1906A Black Pink updates a performance rooted silhouette with a colorway that balances edge and energy. The black base keeps the look grounded and technical, while pink accents add contrast that feels sharp rather than playful. The 1906A design leans into visible structure, layered materials, and a slightly futuristic aesthetic that has helped it stand out within New Balances modern lineup. Fans love this pair because it reflects the brands ability to remix performance DNA into lifestyle relevance. The shoe feels supportive and substantial, while the color story adds personality without overpowering the design. Collectors appreciate how the 1906A continues to evolve through color and material experimentation, making this version a strong choice for those who enjoy runners that feel purposeful, modern, and visually confident. The New Balance 1906A Black Pink was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Chrome (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Chrome Womens continues the resurgence of early 2000s running aesthetics through a silhouette that balances technical complexity and everyday wearability. The Vomero 5 became one of Nikes most celebrated retro runners because of its layered mesh construction, visible support cage, and highly comfortable ride that naturally transitioned from performance running into modern streetwear culture. The Black, Cool Grey, White, and Metallic Silver palette gives this womens release a sleek and futuristic atmosphere while preserving the sporty DNA and detailed paneling that define the silhouette. Fans gravitate toward the Vomero 5 because it perfectly captures the current popularity of technical runners without sacrificing comfort or versatility. The black base creates a stronger and more aggressive foundation while metallic silver accents enhance the layered construction and reflective energy associated with turn of the millennium performance footwear. Collectors especially appreciate darker Vomero colorways because they maintain the silhouettes futuristic identity while remaining highly wearable across everyday outfits and modern streetwear styling. The overall presentation feels technical, polished, and deeply connected to the ongoing influence of retro running culture within contemporary sneaker fashion. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Chrome Womens was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro SE Fire Red Denim (2020)
Description: Although being most recognized in its OG colorway assortment, the Jordans third model takes on new hues with the Air Jordan 3 SE Denim Fire Red. After being teased as a Japan exclusive, featuring a Nike Air logo printed in Japanese, this 2020 retro of the famous silhouette finally landed stateside. The Air Jordan 3 SE Denim Fire Red features new elements never before seen on this model. For starters, what is usually composed out of suede-like nubuck, the Air Jordan 3s signature elephant print is printed onto actual denim. From there, hits of Fire Red on the Jumpman and ankle are seen throughout. The standout feature comes in the form of a translucent Jordan heel tab, revealing a Fire Red colored Nike Air logo underneath. The Air Jordan 3 SE Denim Fire Red released in August of 2020 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Moon Shoe SP Jacquemus Off Noir (Women's)
Description: Nike Moon Shoe SP Jacquemus Off Noir reimagines one of Nikes most mythical creations through a modern fashion lens, blending deep history with refined minimalism. The original Moon Shoe has always symbolized Nikes experimental origins and obsession with innovation, and this Jacquemus collaboration strips that legacy down to pure form and attitude. The off noir palette feels elegant and intentional, letting silhouette and texture take priority over overt branding or nostalgia driven cues, which gives the shoe a quietly confident presence. Collectors appreciate this release because it treats history with restraint rather than spectacle. The low profile shape and sculpted sole feel almost architectural, aligning naturally with Jacquemus design language while still honoring Nikes early running DNA. It feels less like a retro and more like a reinterpretation, designed for fans who value concept and storytelling over familiarity. This shoe lives at the intersection of archive and runway, making it especially meaningful to collectors who see footwear as design objects rather than just products. The Nike Moon Shoe SP Jacquemus Off Noir was released on 10/06/2025 with a retail price of $180.
Colorway: Off Noir/Cashmere/Gum Light Brown/Neptune Green/Storm Blue/Hydrogen Blue

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Sail Plum Eclipse (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Diffused Taupe (Women's) was released alongside several Dunk Low variations with subdued palettes, including Hemp Sail and Cacao Wow. It pays tribute to iconic Nike basketball shoe silhouettes from the 80s while utilizing premium materials. On this Nike Dunk Low for women the upper is crafted entirely from smooth leather with perforations across the vamp and the Swoosh checked across the side. The use of leather gives the shoe a slightly cushiony appearance that adds a minimal amount of bulk to the silhouette. The Diffused Taupe colorway includes Sail, Plum Eclipse, and Diffused taupe, which presents as an off-white base with taupe accents on the overlays, lace cage, heel tab, and rubber outsole. Our experts at StockX love the Swoosh detail in Plum Eclipse, which contrasts the light tones found on the rest of the shoe. The womens size Nike Dunk Low Diffused Taupe (Women's) was released on December 1, 2023, and retailed at $110.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Black Croc Scream Green (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Black Croc Scream Green in Black Black Black Scream Green is a women's exclusive Air Jordan 1 Low Special Edition featuring a predominantly triple black colorway with crocodile-embossed patent leather overlays across the heel, Swoosh, toe, and lace loops creating a textured luxury material that contrasts against the surrounding smooth black leather panels, with Scream Green appearing as an accent through the embroidered Jumpman logo at the tongue, the insole branding, and a green-tinted outsole that completes the palette with the only color break from the otherwise all-black construction. The crocodile-embossed patent leather is the defining construction distinction of this SE version, connecting the Air Jordan 1 Low to the elevated fashion and high-end material references that Jordan Brand has increasingly deployed across its women's-specific Special Edition releases as part of a broader strategy of treating the women's Jordan 1 Low as a canvas for luxury material experimentation rather than simply a smaller-sized version of men's colorways. The patent leather's glossy, reflective surface creates a visual interplay with the matte smooth leather across the remaining upper panels that gives the shoe its sense of formal elegance within a casual silhouette, referencing the way luxury goods brands treat embossed reptile-print materials as simultaneously a texture statement and a premium material signal. The Scream Green accent functions as the deliberate disruption within the all-black luxury aesthetic, appearing with precisely the right intensity and specificity to make the shoe feel designed rather than simply dark, connecting the Women's exclusive to the broader Jordan Brand vocabulary of neon and vibrant accent colors that punctuate dark or neutral base colorways with a pop of electric chromatic energy that references the brand's history of bold colorway energy from the original Air Jordan colorways forward. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE format specifically combines the classic AJ1 Low silhouette with premium construction and material upgrades that distinguish it from the standard Air Jordan 1 Low, carrying a leather upper offering durability and structure, an encapsulated Nike Air-Sole unit providing lightweight cushioning, rubber outsole for everyday traction, Wings logo on the heel, and Jumpman on the tongue in the same essential construction package as the standard model elevated through the crocodile patent leather treatment and the Scream Green accent placement. Released February 1, 2026 at $130 retail in women's sizing with style code IQ9701-010, the Black Croc Scream Green is among the most fashion-forward Jordan 1 Low SE releases in the 2026 women's calendar. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Black Croc Scream Green Womens was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Model: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro ISO
Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro ISO Orange Label Wolf Grey Gum
Description: Nike continued its Orange Label collection, releasing another Nike SB Dunk Low Pro model in a new Wolf Grey Gum colorway. The Nike Low Pro ISO Orange Label Wolf Grey Gum is constructed with a premium Wolf Grey upper, white leather Nike Swoosh, and gum outsole. Nike SBs Orange Label collection features premium materials and special packaging along with Nikes signature orange branding. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro ISO Orange Label Wolf Grey Gum released February 24, 2023, with a retail price of $110.
Colorway: Wolf Grey/White/Wolf Grey/Gum Light Brown/Pure Platinum/Safety Orange

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Jarritos
Description: Rumors of a collaboration project between Nike and Mexican beverage company Jarritos started initially in 2022 and now in 2023 we are seeing the collection come to fruition, with the release of the Nike SB Dunk Low Jarritos. The Nike SB Dunk Low Jarritos is constructed using white leather and tear-away canvas materials across the uppers, while green accents help cover the outsoles and Nike Swoosh. Jarritos branding is seen throughout the insoles, heel tabs, and tongue of the sneakers. The limited edition sneakers come with orange, green, and white laces. The Nike SB Dunk Low Jarritos released May 10, 2023, with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Palm Angels Pool Slides Black
Description: The Palm Angels Pool Slides Black are a stylish and comfortable addition to any summer wardrobe. Made from durable rubber, these slides feature a textured footbed for added grip and comfort. The sleek black colorway is accented with a bold Palm Angels logo on the strap, making them a statement piece for any outfit. These slides were released on July 1st, 2021, and retail for $145. Whether you're lounging by the pool or running errands around town, these slides are the perfect choice for a casual and cool look. Don't miss out on this must-have summer accessory.

Display Name: New Balance 204L Basketcase Beef & Broccoli
Description: The New Balance 204L Basketcase Beef & Broccoli feels like a playful but grounded take on New Balance experimentation, blending humor, color storytelling, and a surprisingly wearable silhouette. The 204L shape leans chunky and expressive, giving the shoe presence without feeling clumsy. The beef and broccoli palette instantly connects to streetwear history, but here it feels reinterpreted rather than copied, using rich brown and green tones to give the shoe personality and depth. Collectors are drawn to this pair because it embraces fun without losing intention. The design feels self aware, celebrating color and contrast while still delivering the comfort and structure New Balance fans expect. It works as a statement sneaker that still fits into rotation, appealing to people who enjoy shoes that spark conversation and show taste without trying to be serious. This is the kind of release that reflects modern New Balance energy, confident enough to play with references while still feeling authentic and wearable. The New Balance 204L Basketcase Beef & Broccoli was released on December 19, 2025 with a retail price of $148.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite One Metallic Red (2023)
Description: The Nike Air Foamposite One Metallic Red (2023) is an additional colorway in Nike's Foamposite line. The Red Air Foamposite One Metallic Red has a predominantly black upper with white and Varsity Red accents. The outsole is made with translucent rubber, providing grip and traction on any surface. The translucent outsole is designed to showcase the carbon fiber shank plate that helps provide additional support and stability to the wearer's foot. What we love about the Nike Air Foamposite One Metallic Red (2023) is the Foamposite overlay that runs all around the shoe. This overlay, also in Varsity Red, immediately catches the eye. The metallic sheen reflects light in a unique way, making the shoe appear as though it's shimmering. The Foamposite material itself is highly durable and meant to provide protection and comfort while conforming to the wearer's foot over time. The shoe was released on July 6th, 2023, at a retail price of $230.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Black Gunmetal
Description: The New Balance 2002R Black Gunmetal is a performance running shoe with interior technical features inspired by the MR2002. The sneaker boasts a breathable mesh upper with cut-out suede and leather overlays. Suede detailing can also be found on the heel and forming the mudguard. Although the shoe features ABZORB SBS pods in the heel for increased energy return and an ABZORB midsole for added cushioning, it appears light. Another element that makes the sneaker stand out is the black-on-grey colorway of Gunmetal, Phantom, and Black, which creates a stealthy look. In terms of branding, the New Balance "N" graces the lateral side panel, and "2002R" can be found on the mesh upper. Our experts like how the white midsole contrasts the dark tones of the upper. The New Balance 2002R Black Gunmetal was released on October 21st, 2022, and retailed for a price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Photon Dust
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 in Photon Dust is a summer 2025 general release built on the Air Force 1's standard leather upper with the Photon Dust grey tone applied to the toe and midfoot overlays, a slightly darker grey on the forefoot, tongue, and heel for tonal contrast, Sail on the base leather layer, a faux-aged midsole that adds a subtle vintage character, and a Light Armory Blue outsole that introduces a cool ice-toned accent underfoot. The Light Armory Blue outsole is the most visually distinct element of the colorway, adding an unexpected pop of color beneath the otherwise neutral grey and white palette that references the summer palette approach Nike regularly uses for Air Force 1 general releases during the warm-weather selling season. Display Name: Nike GT Future Hyper Pink
Description: The Nike GT Future in Hyper Pink is a basketball performance shoe that arrives in the most visually arresting colorway available in the GT family's current catalog, the hyper pink covering both the upper and the shoe's substantial cushioning platform in a total-color execution that transforms one of Nike's most technically ambitious basketball silhouettes into an unmissable court presence. Display Name: Puma Speedcat Ballet Venus Jasmine Flower (Women's)
Description: The Puma Speedcat Ballet Venus in Jasmine Flower and Warm White is a women's exclusive colorway that channels the pristine, sun-kissed delicacy of a traditional ballet slipper in the most literal possible interpretation of the silhouette's design concept. Jasmine Flower takes over the matte satin upper in a creamy floral tone that sits between white and pale yellow, delivering a soft neutral that functions as one of the most versatile colorways in the Ballet Venus lineup and immediately communicating the shoe's dual identity as both a performance-adjacent design and a genuine lifestyle piece. The Speedcat Ballet Venus represents Puma's most explicitly fashion-forward reinterpretation of the Speedcat lineage, a family of shoes rooted in 1990s motorsport heritage that has become one of the defining silhouettes of the current sneaker moment. The Ballet Venus strips that heritage of its overtly performance-coded construction and replaces it with the visual language of dance, creating a shoe that earns its place in both the sneaker collector rotation and the balletcore fashion conversation simultaneously. Jasmine Flower specifically is the colorway that works most naturally alongside flowy skirts, wide-leg denim, and the soft daytime palette that has defined women's fashion across recent seasons, making it the version that casual buyers and fashion-forward collectors alike are most naturally drawn to first. The Puma Speedcat Ballet Venus Jasmine Flower Warm White Women's was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 Brazil
Description: The Nike Shox R4 Brazil in Black, Canary, Metallic Pewter, Light Photo Blue, and White is a World Cup 2026 adjacent colorway that brings the Brazilian national team's color story into the Shox R4's iconic four-column platform in a multi-tone execution that honors the most celebrated football nation in the sport's history through the lens of one of the early 2000s most culturally significant performance shoe platforms. The R4 was peak Shox technology applied to its most visually ambitious silhouette, the four columns sitting beneath a substantial leather upper in proportions that felt genuinely futuristic when the shoe debuted and that have aged into something that reads as powerfully nostalgic to the collectors who wore them during their peak years in the early 2000s. The multi-tone execution across canary, light photo blue, metallic pewter, and white creates the kind of complex color story that the R4's layered upper construction and tall column midsole can carry with complete conviction, each color finding its specific panel and structural home across the shoe's architecture. At one hundred and fifty-five dollars the Shox R4 Brazil delivers the most architecturally commanding Shox silhouette in a colorway that honors one of football and sneaker culture's most important nations simultaneously. The Nike Shox R4 Brazil was released on March 23, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Unseen Hours Virginia
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Unseen Hours Virginia is the GT Cut 1's contribution to Nike Basketball's DMV-inspired Unseen Hours collection, a three-shoe pack released May 22, 2026 that honors the basketball legacy of Washington D.C., Maryland, and Virginia, the tri-state area known in basketball culture as the DMV and recognized as the birthplace of Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, Angel Reese, Azzi Fudd, and a generational roster of elite players stretching back through Allen Iverson, Moses Malone, and Alonzo Mourning. The Unseen Hours series began with a tri-state New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut pack and expanded south along the I-95 corridor for this DMV chapter, with cherry blossom pink driving the entire collection's color story as a reference to one of the region's most recognizable seasonal landmarks, the pink blooms that blanket the DMV each spring serving as the palette's primary cultural anchor. The GT Cut 1 in Pinksicle with White and Hyper Pink accents brings the same bold pink base to the collection's most performance-specific silhouette, the cut-first basketball shoe that Nike developed for guards and wings who need explosive lateral movement support, with the pink upper covering the smooth toe area, molded overlays, and open mesh side panels while white hits on the Swoosh, heel support piece, and midsole provide the contrast that keeps the colorway from reading as flat. The Unseen Hours branding is hidden behind the tongue in the series' signature concealed detail, while the hourglass logo stamps the right heel and the left heel carries a cherry blossom at the center of its Unseen Hours emblem. Virginia-specific details include the VA text and the 703 area code on the inner and outer tongue, referencing Arlington, Alexandria, Fairfax, and the surrounding communities that define Virginia's contribution to DMV basketball culture. Style code CZ0175-600, available in unisex sizing. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Unseen Hours Virginia is the DMV pack's performance silhouette, the cherry blossom-colored GT Cut 1 for the player or collector who wants their basketball shoe to carry the regional pride and hidden storytelling of the Unseen Hours series' most geographically specific Virginia chapter. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Unseen Hours Virginia was released on May 22, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant Draft Day
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant Draft Day in Fierce Purple, Blue Lagoon, and Sail is the first-ever Dunk Low Protro  applying the Protro concept Kobe coined to mean Performance Retro, historically used for his signature shoes, now extended to the Dunk Low as a lifestyle silhouette with ReactX foam insole upgrade  designed to honor the pivotal night in June 1996 when Kobe Bryant was selected 13th overall by the Charlotte Hornets and immediately traded to the Los Angeles Lakers, presented in the Hornets' teal and purple palette that defines this moment in basketball history. The Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant Draft Day was released on June 26, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1000.2 Black Pink Spell
Description: The Nike Air Max 1000.2 in Black Pink Spell is the third colorway of Nike and Zellerfeld's updated second-generation 3D-printed Air Max 1000 silhouette, featuring the same predominantly all-black 3D-printed upper as earlier Air Max 1000.2 releases  printed in one continuous piece rather than assembled from separate components  with a bright Pink Spell Air unit in the heel as the colorway's sole accent detail, creating a high-contrast pop of pink against the dark sculptural construction that is simultaneously the most minimal and most visually impactful approach possible for this entirely 3D-printed shoe format. The Pink Spell Air unit continues the strategy used across all Air Max 1000 colorways of keeping the upper monochromatic and allowing a single color in the visible cushioning unit to serve as the complete color story, a design restraint that emphasizes the shoe's 3D-printed construction as its primary visual statement. Released June 25, 2026 at $180 retail through SNKRS and Zellerfeld.com, with a Zellerfeld EQL raffle opening June 22, with style code JF3484-004. The Nike Air Max 10002 Black Pink Spell was released on June 25, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

A Samba collaboration in Villa's colors arrives at exactly the right moment in the club's trajectory, when the combination of historic identity and contemporary football relevance creates the ideal conditions for a sneaker release that resonates with longtime Villa supporters and newer fans who have discovered the club during its current exciting chapter in equal measure.
