The Air Jordan 4 Retro Pale Ivory Sierra Red Womens was released on February 7, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Clay Brown
Description: Yeezy returned to the Earth-toned palette with the Yeezy 700 V3 Clay Brown. The Clay Brown slightly resembles the Alvah with its primarily black look. But instead of a completely muted upper, it dons lighter earth tones, adding contrast throughout the silhouette. The Yeezy 700 V3 Clay Brown features a black engineered mesh upper with light brown streaks running along the side encompassed by a signature translucent cage unit. A thick EVA foam midsole, reinforced toe cap, and 3M detailing on the forefoot complete this futuristic look. The Yeezy 700 V3 Clay Brown released in December of 2020 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (GS)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (GS) brings an iconic hoops silhouette to growing sneaker rotations with a bold mix of Black, Fire Red, Deep Royal Blue, Dark Smoke Grey, and Tech Grey. Classic AJ4 cues, like the breathable grid mesh, molded lace wings, and a secure mid-cut profile, deliver support from school days to weekend adventures. Underfoot, the visible Air unit cushions every step, while a sturdy foam midsole and herringbone-pattern rubber outsole provide reliable traction on sidewalks and courts alike. The "Rare Air" detailing nods to heritage style, pairing premium textures with sharp color blocking for a look thats easy to dress up or down. Thoughtfully built for grade school sizing, this Jordan 4 balances durability and comfort with a padded collar, a snug lace system, and a structured heel tab for easy on-and-off. The IB4171-003 style code underscores its place in the Jordan lineage, and the eye-catching palette stands out without sacrificing versatility. Whether theyre lacing up for a big day or grabbing a statement pair for everyday wear, this release captures the timeless energy of the Air Jordan 4 with kid-ready comfort and stability. Scheduled for a July 26, 2025 release, its a head-turning essential for any young sneaker fan. Our team thinks this product is great for delivering everyday comfort and standout style in a durable, kid-friendly package that celebrates classic Jordan design.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone pairs rugged earth tones with iconic hoops heritage for a look thats effortlessly modern. Dressed in Cave Stone, Black, and Moon Particle, this AJ4 layers a premium upper with tactile overlays, breathable black mesh panels, and sculpted eyestays that sharpen the silhouette. Classic TPU wings and a supportive midfoot cage echo the original design language, while the visible Air unit and plush foam underfoot deliver the cushioned ride the Jordan 4 is known for. The palette feels tailor-made for fall fits, grounding streetwear and denim with a refined, versatile edge. Details matter, and this pair gets them right: the heel flaunts bold Nike Air branding, a heritage touch that resonates with longtime fans, paired with the FV5029-200 style code for easy reference. A padded collar, secure lacing system, and durable rubber outsole with grippy traction make it a dependable daily go-to as well as a collection-worthy standout. Whether youre rotating it for lifestyle wear or styling it with minimalist layers, the Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone brings depth, texture, and timeless appeal to any lineup. Our team loves this product because it blends season-ready tones, classic comfort, and heritage details into a versatile sneaker that elevates every outfit.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Huarache 2K4 OT Black (2026)
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Huarache 2K4 OT Black 2026 brings back a performance driven basketball silhouette with a clean and understated all black execution. The design focuses on lockdown and support, with a structure that reflects early 2000s basketball innovation. The monochrome palette gives it a more versatile and modern feel compared to original releases. This pair stands out because it connects past performance design with current styling preferences. The Huarache 2K4 line holds significance within Nike basketball history, and this version keeps that identity intact while updating the look. It is a strong option for collectors who appreciate heritage models with a refreshed finish. The Nike Air Zoom Huarache 2K4 OT Black 2026 was released on May 8, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: adidas Taekwondo Mei Song for the Mute Cream White (Women's)
Description: The adidas Taekwondo Mei Song for the Mute Cream White Womens channels the same martial arts inspired minimalism through a lighter Cream White and Cloud White palette. Core Black accents add crisp contrast, emphasizing the slim profile and streamlined construction that define the Taekwondo Mei silhouette. The design feels fluid and low to the ground, highlighting its performance roots while leaning into modern styling. This version resonates because of its clarity and balance. The cream based color story feels versatile and refined, allowing the shape and detailing to take center stage. Fans appreciate how Song for the Mute reinterprets classic sport influences without overpowering them, creating footwear that feels thoughtful and elevated. It is a subtle yet distinctive release that blends tradition and contemporary design with ease. The adidas Taekwondo Mei Song for the Mute Cream White Womens was released on October 10, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: adidas SL 72 OG Leopard Print (Women's)
Description: The adidas SL 72 OG Leopard Print for women is a striking fusion of classic design and bold style. This reimagined version of the iconic SL 72 silhouette features a eye-catching leopard print upper, crafted from a combination of suede and textile materials. The dark brown base is complemented by off-white accents and pops of semi impact orange, creating a visually captivating sneaker that's sure to turn heads. Built for both style and comfort, the SL 72 OG boasts adidas' signature cushioning technology in the midsole, ensuring all-day wearability. The rubber outsole provides excellent traction, while the low-profile design offers versatility for various casual occasions. With its unique colorway and timeless silhouette, this women's sneaker effortlessly bridges the gap between retro aesthetics and contemporary fashion. Our experts state this product is great for fashion-forward individuals looking to make a statement with their footwear while enjoying the comfort and quality associated with the adidas brand.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Patent Snakeskin Black Off White (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Patent Snakeskin Black Off White Womens gives the classic Samba a more fashion driven edge through texture and finish. The core black upper is elevated with a patent snakeskin treatment that catches light differently across each panel, while off white accents and a gum sole keep it grounded in the models heritage. It is a bold update that still respects the original structure and low profile shape. This version appeals to collectors who want something familiar but with more attitude. The added texture transforms the Samba from a simple everyday sneaker into something with a stronger presence, making it easy to style in more expressive ways. adidas continues to show how versatile the Samba can be, and this pair stands out as one of the more statement driven interpretations. The adidas Samba OG Patent Snakeskin Black Off White Womens was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro OG Rare Air
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro OG Rare Air brings a fresh twist to a classic silhouette. Its black leather upper is complemented by grey suede overlays, replacing the traditional elephant print, and features mismatched Nike Air heel tabs, one reversed for a unique aesthetic. Accents of chile red, military blue, and coconut milk add vibrant pops of color, while the red Jumpman logo on the tongue ties the design together. This release pays homage to early Jordan samples, embracing imperfections as marks of rarity. The combination of premium materials and unconventional details makes this sneaker a standout addition to any collection. Whether youre a longtime fan or new to the Jordan legacy, the Rare Air offers a distinctive style statement. The Jordan 3 Retro OG Rare Air was released on May 30, 2025, at a retail price of $210. Its colorway includes black, chile red, neutral grey, military blue, and coconut milk. This pair checks every box: iconic shape, bold updates, and that rare, sample-inspired flair. Add in the custom packaging and youve got a drop thats as memorable on the shelf as it is on foot. This release is a fresh chapter in the AJ3 story.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Collegiate Green
Description: The adidas Samba OG Collegiate Green adds a simple, retro-inspired colorway of Collegiate Green and Cloud White to the Samba OG silhouette. Originally envisioned as a soccer shoe, this version of the Samba OG features a sleek silhouette with minimal padding. Cloud White covers the full-grain leather upper, while splashes of Collegiate Green decorate the large serrated 3-Stripes logo and the leather heel tab. The Collegiate Greens rich green is reminiscent of varsity sports colors and gives the shoe a retro appeal. adidas branding decorates the tongue and insole, but, in our opinion, the SAMBA lettering in gold foil is the stand-out feature. Our experts like the light beige hue applied to the suede toebox overlay because it breaks up the purely Collegiate Green and Cloud White upper without distracting from the design. The adidas Samba OG Collegiate Green was released on March 1, 2024, and retailed at $120.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Patent Bred
Description: The Air Jordan 1 High Bred Patent features black and red patent leather upper with signature weaved Nike Air tongue labels. From there, a classic Wings logo on the collar and a white with red Air sole complete the retro design. The Air Jordan 1 High Bred Patent releases in December of 2021 and retails for $170. To shop all Air Jordan 1 shoes, click here.

Display Name: Vans Premium Old Skool 36 Paint Splatter Charcoal Grey
Description: The Vans Premium Old Skool 36 Paint Splatter Charcoal Grey rebuilds the brand's beloved Old Skool silhouette using the original 1977 Style 36 specifications, complete with a smaller toe cap and double stitched eyestay construction that longtime Vans collectors immediately recognize. A dark charcoal grey base pairs with a cream sidestripe, while scattered white paint splatter covers much of the forefoot and midsole for a genuinely lived in, studio floor aesthetic. Small hits of deep red paint add a touch of aggression to the design without overwhelming the shoe's overall restrained, tasteful presentation. Every panel receives a grease treatment that intentionally dulls and dirties the canvas and suede upper, embracing a worn in, vintage feel rather than a fresh out of the box finish. As the harder to find makeup within the two colorway Paint Splatter pack, this Charcoal Grey edition was released as an in house exclusive through Vans' own retail locations, making it a genuinely sought after pickup compared to its lighter Turtledove counterpart. This release continues Vans' recent stretch of distressed, artisan inspired takes on its most iconic silhouettes, following in the footsteps of releases like the Pearlized pack. The Vans Premium Old Skool 36 Paint Splatter Charcoal Grey was released on June 11, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Throwback Low
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Throwback Low Black Vintage White
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Throwback Low Black Vintage White revisits one of the most foundational sneakers in history with a subtle shift in tone that emphasizes its heritage. The black canvas upper stays true to the original formula, while vintage white accents soften the look and give it a slightly aged feel that nods to earlier eras of the silhouette. The low top shape remains unchanged, keeping the profile clean and instantly recognizable. This pair continues to resonate because it does not try to reinvent what already works. Instead, it refines the details in a way that feels thoughtful and grounded in history. For collectors and everyday wearers alike, the Chuck Taylor remains a constant, and this version highlights how small adjustments in color can keep a timeless design feeling fresh and relevant. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Throwback Low Black Vintage White was released on March 3, 2026 with a retail price of $80.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Light Show
Description: Light up every cut, burst, and fast break in the Nike Ja 3 Light Show, a high-energy take on Ja Morants third signature shoe. Wrapped in a crisp White base with electric hits of Dusty Cactus, Hyper Pink, and Star Blue, this colorway turns heads on court and off. A breathable, reinforced upper provides lightweight containment through hard plants and sudden changes of direction, while a padded collar and sculpted heel keep you centered over your foot. Underfoot, a lively midsole gives you a springy, close-to-the-court feel for quick first steps and confident landings, and the durable outsole pattern is engineered to bite on hardwood for stop-on-a-dime traction when the game speeds up. Designed for players who thrive in the open floor, the Nike Ja 3 Light Show balances support and agility to help you stay explosive for four quarters. Dynamic lacing helps lock you in without pressure points, and strategic overlays add structure where you need it most. The bold palette pairs seamlessly with team uniforms and streetwear fits alike, and the included Blue Laces let you dial in your look with a custom touch. Finished with signature details and style code HF2794-100/HF2793-100, its a performance-first basketball sneaker that delivers the confidence to attack every angle and finish through contact. Our team loves this product because it blends quick-response cushioning, trustworthy traction, and striking color pops to elevate both your game and your style.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Space Jam
Description: The Space Jam colorway is making its return, with the release of the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Space Jam. Jordan is releasing this special edition sneaker as homage to his 1996 movie Space Jam. Jordan uses key details from the Air Jordan 11 Retro Space Jam on this Jordan 1 Mid SE silhouette, including black patent leather uppers, and icy blue translucent outsole. The Jordan 1 Mid SE sits lower on the ankle compared to its Air Jordan 1 OG High counterpart. The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Space Jam released January 23, 2023, with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Bambi Brown Desert (Women's)
Description: The Adidas Samba OG Bambi in Brown Desert Warm Vanilla Wonder Mauve is a women's Samba OG colorway with style code KJ7447 that applies a warm, earth-toned and dusty mauve palette to the iconic indoor soccer shoe silhouette first introduced in 1949, combining a brown desert leather upper with warm vanilla and wonder mauve accents in a color story that references the gentle, sun-warmed tones associated with the Bambi name and Disney's 1942 animated deer character and the organic earth palette of a forest in warm, golden light. The Bambi name is applied to the colorway as a character coding that connects the warm brown, cream, and soft mauve color family to the visual world of the Disney fawn, a specific art direction approach that adidas has used across its broader Samba catalog to give colorways emotional and cultural reference points that communicate their identity beyond purely descriptive color names. The construction follows the standard Samba OG specification that has made the silhouette one of the most sustained and culturally significant footwear releases in adidas's catalog across its contemporary revival: full-grain leather upper, contrasting suede T-toe overlay, serrated Three-Stripes on the lateral side, reinforced toe detail, synthetic leather lining, cushioned insole, and a gum rubber cupsole that provides the low-profile outsole traction and visual grounding characteristic of the original indoor soccer heritage construction. The Samba OG's ongoing dominance in the adidas lineup since its mainstream cultural resurgence beginning in 2022 and 2023 has produced a catalog of hundreds of colorways across men's and women's releases, with women's-specific colorways like the Brown Desert Warm Vanilla Wonder Mauve occupying the softer, more fashion-forward end of the Samba color spectrum that has generated particular collector and fashion interest for its ability to coordinate naturally with contemporary wardrobe aesthetics centered on warm and dusty neutral tones. Adidas has positioned the Samba as their most important lifestyle silhouette for the ongoing period, and the Bambi colorway specifically participates in the brand's pattern of applying character-coded names and palettes from cultural references including Disney, wildlife, and seasonal imagery to give individual Samba colorways a narrative identity and desirability that pure color names cannot achieve alone. The women's sizing specification of this release makes it the targeted entry point for the Samba's most engaged contemporary demographic.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Toe
Description: The Jordan 1 High OG UNC Toe is taking the sneaker game by storm. Jordan Brand masterfully integrates a unique colorway combo of University Blue, Black, and White on this iconic silhouette. The Jordan 1 High OG UNC Toe showcases University Blue on the toe box and heel, which perfectly contrasts with the crisp White leather on the mid-panel and Black on the Swoosh and ankle collar. These kicks sit on a clean white midsole, offset by a vibrant University Blue outsole, creating an impressive visual balance. The Jordan 1 High OG UNC Toe debuted July 22, 2023, commanding a retail price of $180, truly delivering the essence of style and quality.

Display Name: Vans Era Supreme x Mike Kelley Grey
Description: The Vans Era Supreme x Mike Kelley Grey brings contemporary art into skate culture through a collaboration that blends Mike Kelleys expressive visual language with the classic Era silhouette. The grey base provides a neutral foundation that allows the multi color artwork to stand out across the canvas upper, creating a layered and slightly chaotic look. The low profile shape stays true to Vans heritage. This pair stands out because it transforms a simple skate shoe into a wearable art piece. Supremes collaboration approach often highlights influential creatives, and this release reflects that through bold visual storytelling. It is a strong option for collectors who appreciate both skate culture and contemporary art. The Vans Era Supreme x Mike Kelley Grey was released on April 16, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Crochet Pack Orbit Green (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Crochet Pack Orbit Green Womens introduces handcrafted texture to the terrace staple through an Orbit Green upper accented by Cream White stripes. The crochet detailing adds depth and a tactile quality that transforms the familiar silhouette into something softer and more intricate. A gum outsole grounds the look, maintaining the Sambas historic link to indoor football culture. This release resonates because it blends heritage sport design with artisanal influence. The woven texture gives the shoe a distinctive character that feels seasonal and expressive, while the green base keeps it rooted in classic color storytelling. Fans appreciate when adidas refreshes icons through material innovation rather than dramatic redesign. It is a thoughtful evolution of the Samba OG, offering a balance of craftsmanship and timeless shape. The adidas Samba OG Crochet Pack Orbit Green Womens was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Anthracite
Description: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Anthracite leans into intensity and structure, emphasizing the Air Max 95s anatomy inspired design through a dark and powerful color palette. Black and anthracite tones give the shoe a serious, industrial feel, allowing the layered panels and aggressive lines to dominate. The return of the Big Bubble detail brings the model closer to its original form, adding historical weight to the release. Collectors value this pair for its commitment to archival accuracy and mood. The Air Max 95 has always thrived on contrast and edge, and this colorway reinforces that identity without distraction. It feels purposeful and grounded, appealing to fans who appreciate Nikes willingness to revisit innovation with respect rather than reinvention. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Anthracite was released on 04/21/2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Bulls
Description: The Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Bulls dressed in Varsity Red, Black, and White is one of Nikes brands that pays homage to the Chicago Bulls' iconic colorway. The Bulls Air Max Uptempo 95 by Nike design showcases a combination of synthetic and genuine leather materials for durability and a classic look. The shoe features the signature Air Max technology, providing cushioning and impact absorption for optimal comfort during physical activities. The herringbone-patterned rubber outsole offers superior traction and stability. The upper design features a White-dressed Nike Swoosh on the sides and "AIR" embroideries in white. Additionally, the shoe's distinctive color scheme predominantly displays the Bulls' Red, Black, and White colors, creating a visually striking appearance that captures the essence of the legendary NBA team. Something we love about this Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Bulls that debuted on May 31st 2019, with a retail price of $150, is its midsoles full-length Air unit ensuring responsive and lightweight cushioning for enhanced performance on or off the court.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro True Blue (2026)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro True Blue 2026 is the sixth retro release of one of the four original 1988 Air Jordan 3 colorways, featuring a white tumbled leather upper, Cement Grey elephant print across the toe and heel in a thinner, more refined pattern that closely resembles the 1988 original's specification rather than the heavier print of some previous retros, True Blue accents on the sock liner, Nike Air-branded heel tab, and midsole, a red Jumpman logo on the tongue and tongue interior, and a mostly grey rubber outsole completing the OG-faithful construction. The True Blue Air Jordan 3 is the only one of the model's original 1988 colorways to break from Chicago Bulls colors, relying entirely on color and design to carry its iconic status without team affiliation, representing a pivotal moment in Tinker Hatfield's design demonstrating that the Jordan signature line could succeed outside of the Bulls palette. The 2026 retro also includes the throwback MJ face box packaging that distinguished the 2016 retro, with full family sizing spanning men's at $230, Grade School at $155, Preschool at $95, and Toddler at $80, available simultaneously across Nike SNKRS, Nike.com, Foot Locker, Finish Line, DSG, and Hibbett on release day. The 2026 release marks the tenth anniversary of the most recent 2016 retro and the first time the True Blue has been available since, making it one of the most anticipated Jordan retros of the summer 2026 calendar. Released July 18, 2026 at $230 retail via Nike SNKRS and select Jordan Brand retailers globally with style code IF4396-102. The Air Jordan 3 Retro True Blue 2026 was released on July 18, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Black
Description: The Nike P-6000 Black features a classic low-top silhouette presented in an all-black colorway. The Black Nike P-6000 has an upper made from a combination of leather and mesh materials, ensuring durability and breathability. The shoe features a lace-up closure system that allows for a secure and customizable fit. The cushioned midsole provides comfort and shock absorption. Furthermore, the rubber outsole offers traction and grip, ensuring stability and control. The shoe also includes Nike branding details, including the trademark Nike Swoosh logo on the sides and the "NIKE" wordmark on the tongue. What we love about this shoe is its sleek and modern design. The shoe features a mixture of leather and mesh materials, creating a dynamic and textured upper. The black colorway emphasizes the shoe's bold and statement-making appearance. In addition, the sneaker incorporates a chunky and supportive midsole, which enhances the shoe's overall aesthetic. The Nike P-6000 Black was released on June 28, 2019, at an initial price of $100.

Display Name: adidas Samba Jane Green White Gum (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba Jane Green White Gum (Womens) refreshes an icon with a lush Collegiate Green upper and crisp Cream White 3-Stripes, grounded by that timeless Gum 3 sole. The low-profile silhouette keeps the heritage Samba lines intact, sleek T-toe, clean stitching, and a refined shape that slides effortlessly from weekday errands to weekend plans. A soft lining and cushioned footbed provide easy, all-day comfort, while the textured gum rubber outsole delivers confident traction on city pavement. Subtle branding and a perfectly balanced color palette make this pair a standout for minimalist wardrobes and statement fits alike. Designed for versatility, the adidas Samba Jane JR7340 leans into the models indoor-soccer roots while embracing modern lifestyle wear. The green leather upper pairs naturally with denim, skirts, or tailored trousers, and the cream accents add just the right amount of contrast for a polished finish. Durable materials and dependable construction promise long-lasting wear, and the classic gum sole brings vintage character with a contemporary edge. Whether youre building a capsule rotation or hunting for a go-to daily sneaker, this Samba delivers a tasteful blend of retro sport style and current street appeal. Our team loves this product because it combines the heritage charm of the adidas Samba with a rich green-and-gum look thats incredibly easy to style and comfortable from the first step.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Legend Pink
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid SE Legend Pink is a special edition mid-top sneaker from the Jordan 1 Mid line featuring a white, Sail, and Legend Pink color palette. The Legend Pink Jordan 1 Mid SE puts a twist on the AJ 1 Mid silhouette by dressing it in a textured Legend Pink suede. The slightly shaggy material is seen in the usual positions for this model, namely the toecap, forefoot, eyestay, ankle strap, and heel counter. The rest of the upper is a white, smooth leather. Note the air perforations for ventilation in the toebox. A Sail, speckled midsole lies upon a speckled Pink Legend outsole. Matching flat pink laces complete this colorway. We love the white embroidered Wings logo, the pink Jumpman on the tongue patch, and the Pink Legend Swooshes for branding hits, they elevate the shoe and add to its aesthetic. The Jordan 1 Mid SE Legend Pink was released to the public on April 17, 2024.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Doernbecher Oli Fasone-Lancaster
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Doernbecher Oli Fasone Lancaster transforms a cultural staple into a deeply personal canvas. The multi color execution feels layered and expressive, reflecting storytelling rather than symmetry. Display Name: Nike LeBron 22 Blacklight
Description: The Nike LeBron 22 Blacklight delivers a bold and futuristic colorway that reflects the energy and evolution of LeBrons signature line. The mix of tones gives it a dynamic presence that translates well in motion. It is a sneaker that captures LeBrons impact through a combination of innovation and expressive design. The Nike LeBron 22 Blacklight was released on December 6, 2024 with a retail price of $180.
Colorway: Black/Laser Fuchsia/Dark Grey/Field Purple/Guava Ice/Vapor Green

Display Name: Jordan CMFT Era White Sail Black
Description: The Jordan CMFT Era White Sail Black is a casual athletic shoe featuring a low-top design. White mesh fabric features white suede overlays outlining the upper. The White overlays partially cover the Black Nike Swoosh on the sides, which coordinate with pops of Black Jordan and Nike branding at the tongue, rear heel, and mudguard. A Sail midsole and Black outsole finish the look. Michael Jordans success was parallel to Nikes advancements in basketball shoe comfort. Years later, Jordan is its brand, and comfort is still a significant factor in its lifestyle shoes, as referenced in the CMFT Era name. In our opinion, the best feature of the CMFT Era is its layered construction, which lends a neat and sophisticated look. The Jordan CMFT Era White Sail Black was released on April 20, 2025, and retailed at $120.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog One Piece Roronoa Zoro

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Thom Browne White

Display Name: Nike Air Max Muse Black Metallic Silver (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max Muse Black Metallic Silver (Women's) is a sleek and stylish addition to the iconic Air Max line. This women's sneaker combines classic Air Max design elements with modern aesthetics, resulting in a shoe that's both fashionable and functional. Featuring Nike's renowned Air cushioning technology, these sneakers offer exceptional comfort and support for all-day wear. With its blend of performance and style, this shoe is an excellent choice for women who appreciate both form and function in their footwear. Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Max Volume (GS)
Description: Nike Ja 3 Max Volume GS captures the high energy spirit of Ja Morants game in a colorway designed to stand out. Max Volume leans into brightness and contrast, giving the Ja 3 a lively and expressive personality that reflects Jas fearless approach to basketball. The Nike Ja 3 Max Volume GS was released on 08/21/2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 23 The Chosen One and The One Who Chose (Translucent Outsole)
Description: The Nike LeBron 23 The Chosen One and The One Who Chose delivers a powerful and reflective chapter in LeBron James signature legacy. Black dominates the upper with a commanding and focused presence, while metallic gold accents introduce a sense of achievement and destiny. The contrast feels symbolic rather than decorative, allowing the silhouette to communicate story through restraint and tone. The overall look feels deliberate, confident, and rooted in legacy. Fans connect with this release because it speaks directly to LeBrons journey. The title alone carries emotional weight, and the execution matches that gravity through clean color and strong structure. Collectors appreciate how the design avoids excess, letting symbolism and silhouette do the work. It feels ceremonial and meaningful, representing not just performance innovation but a career defined by choice, responsibility, and impact at the highest level of the game. The Nike LeBron 23 The Chosen One and The One Who Chose was released on October 23, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Levis All-Star
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Levis All Star merges basketball heritage with classic American denim culture in a way that feels authentic rather than forced. Denim covers the upper, giving the Jordan 3 a textured and casual edge, while Sail midsoles balance the look with clean contrast. Gym Red and Ocean Fog accents add subtle color hits that keep the palette dynamic without overwhelming the iconic elephant print framework. Levis collaborations always resonate because denim is such a foundational material in streetwear history. Pairing that with the Jordan 3, a silhouette deeply tied to All Star weekend energy and Tinker Hatfield legacy, creates a powerful crossover moment. Fans who appreciate material storytelling see this as more than a colorway, it is a celebration of two cultural staples coming together on one legendary model. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Levis All Star was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Jordan Spizike Low UNC
Description: The Jordan Spizike Low UNC is a low-top sneaker that pulls design inspiration from the OG Spizike that was designed in collaboration with film director Spike Lee. This Jordan Spizike debuts in a low variant, while sporting design elements from other classic Jordan silhouettes over the years. Presenting in a white, university blue, wolf grey, and anthracite color palette, some will be quick to notice that these are the colors of Michael Jordans alma mater, the University of North Carolina. As for cushioning, youll spot the visible Max Air unit in the heel and feel the Nike Air unit in the forefoot. Elephant print dons the toe cap and heel cap, while Jordan branding is on the tongue and Spike Lees production companys logo on the heel tab. We love that the Jordan brand continues to honor Michael Jordans legacy and history through colorways that honor his beginnings, and this Jordan Spizike Low UNC does exactly that. This sneaker retailed for $160 during its retail debut on November 13, 2024.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Oxidized Green
Description: The Jordan 1 Low SE Oxidized Green combines a distinctive color palette with Jordans iconic design heritage, offering a striking addition to sneaker collections. Its modern updates and premium materials create a fresh take on the classic low-profile silhouette, appealing to sneaker enthusiasts. The Oxidized Green 1 Low SE by Jordan has a unique mix of muted green overlays paired with crisp white leather underlays, with a green Swoosh along the sides and a green Jumpman logo on the tongue. The shoe features a perforated rounded toe box for ventilation and a rubber sole for traction. This model pays homage to Jordan's legacy with its signature style and stitched branding details. One thing we, the experts, love about the Jordan 1 Low SE Oxidized Green is its textured leather overlays that give you a refined feel, and the durable rubber outsole that'll give you excellent grip on multiple surfaces. Released on 20th July 2024, this edition retailed at $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Black Patent Swoosh
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 in Black with Patent Swoosh is a premium material variation on the most iconic and enduringly relevant basketball shoe silhouette in Nike's catalog, the patent leather Swoosh application creating a surface contrast between the matte black upper and the glossy and light-reflecting Swoosh that gives the AF1's most foundational design element a material distinction and visual drama that standard smooth leather execution cannot achieve with the same dimensional presence. Patent leather on the Swoosh specifically creates a visual hierarchy that foregrounds the branding mark above every other design element on the shoe, the reflective surface catching light and commanding attention in a way that makes the Swoosh feel almost three-dimensional against the darker and less reflective surrounding materials. University red hit details complete the colorway with the warm accent that connects this all-black and patent execution to the AF1's most historically loaded and community-beloved color vocabulary. Air Force 1 LV8 releases in premium material applications consistently attract collectors who follow the silhouette for its ongoing material and texture experimentation rather than simply its colorway variations, the LV8 designation signaling construction and material investment beyond the standard 07 production that rewards close inspection with the kind of quality differential that distinguishes a premium Nike release from seasonal baseline production. Black patent Swoosh on a matte black AF1 creates a tone-on-tone material story that communicates luxury and design consideration with more sophistication than contrasting color applications typically deliver, the surface variation doing the work that color difference handles in more conventional colorway-driven releases. At one hundred and twenty-five dollars the Black Patent Swoosh AF1 delivers premium material distinction at an accessible price point. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 in Black with Patent Swoosh has a retail price of $125.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Cream Raw Indigo
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Cream Raw Indigo continues the modern resurgence of early 2000s performance runners through a colorway that perfectly balances technical nostalgia and everyday wearability. Originally released during the peak era of mesh running footwear, the Gel Kayano 14 has become one of the most celebrated retro runners in contemporary sneaker culture because of its layered construction, visible performance details, and futuristic silver era design language. The Cream and Raw Indigo combination gives the silhouette a softer and more refined personality while still preserving the technical complexity that defines the model. Fans of the Gel Kayano 14 appreciate how the shoe feels equally rooted in archival running history and current fashion trends. The layered mesh and synthetic upper create depth and movement throughout the silhouette, while the indigo accents add cool contrast against the warmer cream tones. ASICS has earned major respect within sneaker culture for reviving technical runners without stripping away the authentic performance aesthetic that made them special originally. Collectors especially value colorways like this because they remain versatile and understated while still showcasing the detailed paneling and retro runner identity that turned the Gel Kayano 14 into a modern favorite. The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Cream Raw Indigo was released on January 31, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 All-Star (GS)
Description: The Nike Ja 3 All Star GS captures the energy of the All Star stage through a bold and vibrant execution that reflects Ja Morants style of play. Cobalt bliss drives the color story, creating a bright and expressive base, while black accents add contrast and structure. The silhouette feels quick and responsive, matching the pace associated with Jas game. This pair resonates with younger fans who connect with Jas presence on the court. The All Star theme adds another layer, turning the shoe into a moment rather than just a release. It feels fast, confident, and built to stand out, carrying the same energy that defines the player behind it. The Nike Ja 3 All Star GS was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro SP SoleFly Miami
Description: Air Jordan 3 Retro SP SoleFly Miami feels like a love letter to Miami culture wrapped in one of Jordan Brands most important silhouettes. SoleFlys influence comes through in a way that feels authentic and rooted, pulling inspiration from South Floridas warmth, movement, and layered identity. The Air Jordan 3s iconic shape anchors the design, while the color story adds regional personality that longtime collectors immediately recognize as more than surface level branding. What makes this release special is how naturally the story integrates into the silhouette. The Jordan 3 has always been about balance, and the SoleFly Miami execution respects that by letting materials, tones, and subtle details do the talking. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it represents a genuine collaboration, one that reflects place and culture without overpowering the shoes heritage or timeless appeal. The Air Jordan 3 Retro SP SoleFly Miami was released on 12/05/2025 with a retail price of $230.

Model: Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 11 Elite FG
Display Name: Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 11 Elite FG Breakout Pack
Description: The Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 11 Elite FG Breakout Pack marks a genuine reboot for the Superfly concept, introducing Air Zoom technology into the silhouette in a way never previously seen across the Mercurial line. Vibrant coral and multi color tones dominate the design, creating an unmistakable, highly visible look on the pitch built specifically for players who want to stand out from their very first touch of the ball. A FlyWeave Ultra upper delivers a locked in, tailored fit from heel to toe, while a low cut collar returns to the Superfly line for the first time since 2014, increasing freedom of movement without sacrificing the silhouette's signature secure containment. Underfoot, a three quarter length Air Zoom unit integrated directly into the soleplate pairs with ultra responsive ZoomX foam, marking the first time that particular cushioning technology has appeared in a football boot, delivering Nike's highest possible energy return for explosive acceleration. Chevron studs provide genuine grip for instant stops and sharp directional changes, while a classic adaptive lacing system rounds out the performance package. Endorsed by Kylian Mbappe among other elite players, this Breakout Pack colorway represents one of the most significant technological updates to the Mercurial line since its earliest breakthroughs. The Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 11 Elite FG Breakout Pack was released on June 1, 2026 with a retail price of $315.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 2 Pink Foam (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 2 Pink Foam (Women's) dresses WNBA player Sabrina IonescuÄôs second signature sneaker in a pink-forward colorway of Pink Foam and Elemental Pink with black accents. Released ahead of ValentineÄôs Day, the sneaker boasts a Pink Foam upper and subtly contrasting Elemental Pink on the sole unit. A dramatic black Swoosh checks across the side panels, while an additional Swoosh appears underfoot. Stitched cables and a fit band serve as the midfoot containment system, stabilizing the foot and supporting the arch. A fragment pattern appears around the side panel Swoosh logos, alluding to IonescuÄôs ability to shatter the proverbial glass ceiling in life and the world of sports. Our experts appreciate the slightly S-shaped herringbone traction pattern on the rubber outsole because it provides superior grip. The womenÄôs size Nike Sabrina 2 Pink Foam (Women's) was released on February 1, 2024, and retailed at $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Paisley Pack Pink (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Paisley Pack Pink (Women's) embraces a soft, delicate pink shade. Designed by Bruce Kilgore, the '07 Paisley Pack Pink is often referred to as "Pink Paisley." The shoe is adorned with a paisley print that extends across the iconic swoosh logo and the heel counter. It boasts a captivating colorway that is predominantly Pearl Pink, accentuated by touches of white and Coral Chalk. Crafted with a leather upper, this sneaker retains the enduring appeal of the classic Air Force 1 silhouette. Its fusion of style and technology includes Nike Air cushioning to deliver exceptional comfort for a lifestyle-focused design. What our experts love about the Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Paisley Pack Pink (Women's) is that it epitomizes a blend of timeless aesthetics and contemporary appeal. This makes it a standout choice for women who appreciate a combination of fashion and comfort in their footwear. The sneaker released 7th February 2023 for $100.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Easter (2026)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Easter 2026 brings a playful and seasonal approach to the silhouette, using a mix of soft pastel tones that feel light and expressive. Emerald rise, yellow pulse, hydrangeas, and pink foam create a layered color story that reflects the holiday theme, while the white base keeps everything cohesive and wearable. This pair resonates because it captures a sense of fun without losing structure. Seasonal releases can feel forced, but this one balances color and design in a way that feels natural. Fans appreciate how it stands out in a rotation while still maintaining the familiar Dunk identity. The Nike Dunk Low Easter 2026 was released on March 27, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Black University Blue (2026) (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Black University Blue 2026 PS in Black University Blue White is the preschool sizing of the 20th anniversary retro of the Air Jordan 5 Black Carolina colorway originally released in 2006 as part of Jordan Brand's mid-2000s Lifestyle series, returning June 20, 2026 in full family sizing for the first time in two decades, with the preschool version carrying the same premium black nubuck upper and University Blue accent construction that made the 2006 original one of the most sought-after mid-2000s Jordan colorways for its clean, collegiate-inspired palette rooted in Michael Jordan's formative years at the University of North Carolina. The Air Jordan 5's connection to the University of North Carolina runs through Jordan himself, who wore Carolina blue as a Tar Heel before being drafted in 1984 and who has maintained a celebrated and visible relationship with his alma mater throughout his career, making University Blue one of the most emotionally resonant and personally meaningful accent colors in the Jordan Brand lexicon, and making the Black Carolina Jordan 5 one of the few colorways that connects the shoe's identity directly to Jordan's pre-NBA biography rather than to his championship career with the Bulls. The construction follows the 2006 original precisely: premium black nubuck upper with University Blue hits across the lining, midsole shark-tooth detailing, and embroidered heel Jumpman branding, a 3M reflective silver tongue, translucent quarter-panel mesh netting, clear plastic lace locks, visible Air cushioning in the midsole, and a classic icy translucent outsole tinted with University Blue that provides both the visual signature and the performance underfoot cushioning characteristic of the Air Jordan 5 platform. The 2026 retro arrives as part of Jordan Brand's consistent 20-year anniversary retro strategy that has brought back mid-2000s colorways as they reach their two-decade milestone, joining the Burgundy and Green Bean Jordan 5 variants on the list of LS-era colorways getting full retro treatment with broader retail distribution than the original lifestyle series releases ever achieved in their initial run. The 2006 original arrived in the limited LS era format with corresponding apparel, accessible to only a fraction of the collectors who wanted it at the time, and the 20-year return with full family sizing and widespread Jordan Brand retailer distribution through Foot Locker, Finish Line, JD Sports, Hibbett, DTLR, and Nike SNKRS represents the first genuine mass-market opportunity for a colorway that has historically commanded significant premiums on the secondary market. At $95 retail the preschool sizing sits within the full family range of $220 men's, $155 grade school, $95 preschool, and $80 toddler, with the family sizing making the Black Carolina Jordan 5 one of the most complete multigenerational Jordan releases of the summer 2026 calendar. The Air Jordan 5 Retro Black University Blue 2026 PS was released on June 20, 2026 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Teyana Taylor Concrete Rose (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Teyana Taylor A Rose From Harlem Womens brings storytelling and personal identity into the Jordan line through a bold and layered design. The combination of fir, fire red, victory green, and metallic gold creates a rich and expressive palette that reflects Teyana Taylors roots and creative vision. It feels like more than just a colorway, carrying a deeper narrative tied to culture and community. What makes this pair stand out is its unapologetic presence and attention to detail. The design pushes beyond traditional Jordan 3 looks, introducing a more expressive and fashion forward approach while still keeping the silhouette recognizable. It is a collaboration that resonates with collectors who value both story and standout design. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Teyana Taylor A Rose From Harlem Womens was released on March 14, 2026 with a retail price of $280.
Colorway: Fir/Fire Red/Victory Green/Cement Grey/Metallic Gold/Gum Medium Brown

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro White Metallic (2026) (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro White Metallic 2026 PS revives one of the cleanest and most historically important Air Jordan 5 colorways in preschool sizing. Originally introduced during Michael Jordans early 1990s era, the White Metallic colorway became iconic for its crisp white leather upper, reflective silver tongue, and shark tooth detailing inspired by fighter aircraft aesthetics. Even in smaller sizing, the silhouette retains the bold proportions and unmistakable design features that made the Air Jordan 5 one of Tinker Hatfields most celebrated creations. The contrast between the bright white base and darker black accents keeps the shoe sharp and timeless decades after its original debut. Collectors and parents continue gravitating toward classic Jordan retros because they preserve the emotional connection tied to basketball history and sneaker culture across generations. The White Metallic colorway stands out because it feels both simple and dramatic at the same time, balancing clean construction with reflective details that immediately catch attention. Fans especially appreciate how the Air Jordan 5 introduced a more aggressive and futuristic personality compared to earlier Jordan models while still remaining highly wearable today. The preschool version keeps that legacy alive through proportions and details that mirror the adult release closely. The Air Jordan 5 Retro White Metallic 2026 PS was released on April 25, 2026 with a retail price of $105.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Kill Bill
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 surfaces in a striking Yellow/Black combo, channeling major vintage vibes while syncing perfectly with modern trends. Why's this sneaker catching everyone's eyes, you ask? Aside from its fresh color palette, this iconic model was sported by Uma Thurman's character in Quentin Tarantino's legendary film, ""Kill Bill"". Yep, that killer pair that powered those epic fight scenes? That's this gem. Leather dominates its upper, giving it a sleek, polished look. The design echoes a rich history, blending seamlessly with today's streetwear aesthetics. And for those chasing originality and a piece of pop culture, the Mexico 66 delivers in spades. Ready to wear a piece of cinematic history? We got you. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 in Black & Yellow released with a price tag of $120.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 All-Star
Description: The Nike Ja 3 All-Star brings a cool, polished look to Ja Morants third signature silhouette. Dressed in cobalt bliss with metallic silver and midnight navy accents, this colorway balances energy and refinement. The metallic elements add shine and dimension, while the deeper blue tones keep the design grounded and wearable. This release highlights the Ja 3s ability to shift between bold expression and clean styling. The cobalt base delivers vibrancy, while silver details elevate the overall look with a subtle futuristic edge. Its a colorway that feels confident without being overwhelming, making it easy to style while still standing out in a rotation. When the Nike Ja 3 All-Star released, it retailed for $125 and dropped on February 13, 2026. With its balanced palette and modern finish, this version adds a sleek chapter to the growing Ja Morant signature line.

Display Name: adidas Samba Jane Red Gum (GS)
Description: The adidas Samba Jane Red Gum GS is a Grade School sizing April 27, 2026 release of the Samba Jane, the Mary Jane-inspired hybrid design that GOAT described as pairing back the Samba OG upper for slip-on entry while preserving the core elements of the low-top classic including a leather construction, suede toe guard, Three Stripes branding, and rubber gum sole. The Samba Jane, which adidas officially described as the first true Mary Jane footwear to feature the iconic Three Stripes, combines the soccer heritage and cultural weight of the Samba with the cut and midfoot-strap closure of the classic Mary Jane shoe format, creating a silhouette that spans the boundary between sport-derived sneaker and fashion-forward slip-on in the specific way that has made it one of adidas Originals' most commercially successful new silhouette introductions in recent years. The Grade School version, as confirmed across Hibbett and Kids Foot Locker product listings, is based directly on the must-have Samba OG adult design, translated into youth sizing with the same hook-and-loop strap closure that makes the Samba Jane a cinch to slip on and off, a leather upper in playful colorways appropriate for pairing with favorite outfits, a synthetic lining, and a rubber outsole delivering superior traction and durability for active kids' wear. The Red and Gum colorway applies a red leather base with a gum rubber outsole, the warm red creating a visually energetic and seasonally versatile color that provides one of the most boldly colored executions in the Grade School Samba Jane range across the colorways available for the younger sizing category. Released April 27, 2026 at $80. The adidas Samba Jane Red Gum GS is the Grade School April 2026 Mary Jane-silhouette Samba for the young wearer who wants the hook-and-loop strap slip-on Samba Jane construction with leather upper and gum rubber outsole in the most boldly colored and most visually energetic red colorway from the Grade School Samba Jane range. The adidas Samba Jane Red Gum GS was released on April 27, 2026 with a retail price of $80.

Display Name: adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Black Gum (Women's)
Description: The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Black Gum Womens brings minimalist martial arts inspiration into modern lifestyle footwear with a silhouette that feels graceful, lightweight, and intentional. The Taekwondo Mei Ballet shape pulls from classic training shoes and ballet flats, giving it a sleek and almost delicate profile that stands out in a world of bulky sneakers. The black upper paired with a gum sole keeps the look grounded and timeless, letting form and proportion take center stage. Fans love this shoe because it feels different without trying too hard. It slips naturally into everyday wear, offering comfort and flexibility while still feeling stylish and refined. Collectors appreciate how adidas revisits niche archive influences and turns them into something relevant again, making this pair feel thoughtful and quietly confident rather than trend driven or loud. The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Black Gum Womens was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 380 Calcite Glow
Description: Yeezy added a new colorway to their expanding 380 line with the Yeezy 380 Calcite Glow, now available on StockX. While 380 releases following the Alien colorway are known for their brown, earth-toned look, the Calcite returned to the designs roots with a ghostly vibe just in time for Halloween. The Yeezy 380 Calcite Glow is reminiscent of the very first Yeezy 380 release, the Yeezy 380 Alien. Similar to the Alien, the Calcite Glow features a white and grey perforated Primeknit upper. The main difference between the two colorways is that the Calcite Glow primarily features white throughout, with grey detailing. Also, the Calcite comes with a translucent, glow-in-the-dark sole that is guaranteed to add some extra glow to your feet. The Yeezy 380 Calcite Glow released in October of 2020 and retailed for $250.

Model: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low
Display Name: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low Black
Description: The Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low Black is a sleek and stylish sneaker for any casual occasion. The shoe features a black canvas upper with white stitching and a white rubber sole. The shoe is made from high-quality materials, ensuring durability and comfort. The canvas upper is breathable, while the rubber sole provides excellent traction and support. The shoe is also lightweight, making it easy to wear for extended periods. The Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low Black was released on June 1st, 2022, and has a retail price of $220. It is available in a range of sizes, making it accessible to a wide range of customers. Something we love about the Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low Black is its minimalist design, which makes it versatile and easy to pair with any outfit. Our experts think the best features of the shoe are its high-quality materials, excellent traction, and lightweight construction. Overall, the standout feature of the Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low Black is its combination of style and functionality, making it a must-have for any sneaker enthusiast.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Neon
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Neon brings back one of the most recognizable color stories tied to the Air lineage, translating that iconic neon energy onto the 90 silhouette. The black and anthracite base sets the stage, allowing neon yellow accents to stand out with unmistakable clarity. Light charcoal and pearl grey tones round out the palette, keeping the design balanced while still letting the neon take focus. This pair resonates because it taps directly into Nikes heritage. Neon accents have long been associated with the Air Max line, and seeing that energy applied here creates a strong sense of continuity. Fans who appreciate legacy colorways are drawn to releases like this, where history is referenced in a way that still feels fresh and relevant. The Nike Air Max 90 Neon was released on March 6, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Triple Black Leather
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Triple Black Leather is a blacked-out rendition of the classic Nike Air Max Plus, first released in 1998. This low-top silhouette features an upper constructed with a mix of suede and leather. The suede makes up the base of the upper, while the leather makes up the overlays. It features wavy embroidered lines like the original Nike Air Max Plus and a glossy toe cap on its toe tip that adds shine and durability. Braced by a midfoot shank, this blacked-out sneaker sits atop a Nike Max Air unit and a rubber outsole. Branding-wise, it features Swooshes on its sides and TN branding on its heel. What do our experts love about this shoe? The most impressive feature of this shoe is the Max Air Unit. Originally designed for improved running performance, this unit enhances the shoes cushioning. The Nike Air Max Plus Triple Black Leather was released on April 19th, 2018. Originally, it retailed at $160.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Low Champagne Metallic
Description: Adidas continues to expand Anthony Edwards signature sneaker collection with the adidas AE 1 Low Champagne Metallic, boasting a sleek, futuristic design. Built for the court, the Champagne Metallic adidas AE 1 Low features a sleek black mesh base contrasted with rubberized Champagne Metallic sidewalls to deliver a bold yet refined look. The metallic color adds a touch of luxury to the design, enhanced by a light tan sole that ties everything together with a soft, neutral tone. Lucid Blue accents grace the sneakers branding elements, including Anthony Edwards tongue tag and adidas logo on the heel counter. The sneaker features a caged Lightstrike midsole that houses Light Boost cushioning at the heel and forefoot. What our experts love about the adidas AE 1 Low Champagne Metallic is the thoughtfully engineered sole, featuring perforated honeycomb-like detailing that enhances ventilation while providing support for quick movements on the court. The sneaker was released for $110 on February 15, 2025.

Display Name: New Balance 993 MiUSA Kith Asteroid
Description: The New Balance 993 MiUSA Kith Asteroid continues the celebrated partnership between Kith and New Balance through a refined reinterpretation of one of the brands most respected Made in USA silhouettes. The 993 has long been admired for its balance of premium comfort, durable construction, and understated design language, making it a favorite among collectors who appreciate timeless runners over trend driven experimentation. The Asteroid colorway introduces a darker and more atmospheric palette that gives the shoe a sleek and slightly cosmic personality while preserving the layered suede and mesh construction that defines the classic 993 aesthetic. Fans gravitate toward Kith and New Balance collaborations because they consistently deliver subtle luxury and carefully curated color palettes that elevate heritage models without compromising their original identity. The Asteroid tones create a moodier and more modern atmosphere compared to traditional grey based New Balance releases, giving the shoe stronger visual depth while remaining highly wearable. Collectors especially appreciate the 993 because it represents peak New Balance craftsmanship and comfort within the Made in USA line. The combination of premium materials and restrained styling gives this release a sophisticated and highly versatile presence within contemporary sneaker culture. The New Balance 993 MiUSA Kith Asteroid was released on May 11, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential Summit White Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Summit White Black updates the recognizable Air Max 1 Essential silhouette with a clean colorway of Summit White and Black with tan details. Supported by a foam midsole with an Air Max unit in the heel, the Summit White Black Nike Air Max 1 Essential delivers the same responsive cushioning as the original Air Max 1 model from 1987. However, the color-blocking scheme is decidedly modern. The Summit White mesh forms the base of the upper, while the suede overlays, heel panels, and eyelets are available in tan. Adding contrast, a synthetic leather mudguard wraps around the base of the shoe in black, complementing the tonal Swoosh and rubber outsole. Finally, Nike Air Max branding in black decorates the tongues woven tag and the heel. Our experts at StockX appreciate the grippy, waffle-patterned outsole, which adds a heritage element to the sneaker. The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Summit White Black was released on July 1, 2024, and sold for $140.
Material: Leather, Suede, Mesh, Synthetic, Rubber, Foam

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Red Thunder (GS)
Description: The grade school-sized (GS) Air Jordan 4 Retro Red Thunder GS uses a Black/Crimson/White colorway that features a white Jumpman on the black heel, tongue, insole, and outsole. The upper of black nubuck is accented with red mesh on the toe box, quarter, and inner tongue. Other features of the Air Jordan 4 Retro Red Thunder GS include red waffle eyestays and a black plastic heel tab. The red midsole features a visible Air compartment. On the black rubber outsole, the iconic star pattern arches over an area of red rubber chevrons. The grade school-sized Air Jordan 4 Retro Red Thunder GS was released on January 15, 2022, at a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Black Asphalt Castlerock
Description: The Salomon XT-6 Black Asphalt Castlerock is one of the most enduringly wearable and most broadly functional colorways in the XT-6's extensive palette history, a dark, tonal three-color combination of Black, Asphalt, and Castlerock that applies the deep grey-to-near-black range to the shoe's multi-material upper construction in a way that reads simultaneously as technical performance equipment and as the kind of considered, restrained aesthetic that has placed Salomon firmly in the fashion and streetwear conversation alongside its performance running identity. The Salomon XT-6, originally introduced as a competitive trail running shoe designed for elite endurance athletes navigating technical and rugged terrain, has since achieved a status in lifestyle and streetwear contexts that few performance running shoes have matched, its specific combination of aggressive Mud Contagrip outsole lugging, multi-layer synthetic and mesh upper construction, proprietary Quicklace system, and the visual complexity that comes from applying high-performance construction to a street-ready silhouette making it one of the defining shoes of the running-to-lifestyle crossover movement. The Black, Asphalt, and Castlerock upper deploys the XT-6's characteristic TPU overlay system, abrasion-resistant paneling, and single-layer breathable mesh in the most unified grey-family palette the colorway range offers, the three tones providing enough differentiation between the upper's material layers to read with visual depth without introducing any colors outside the dark achromatic spectrum. The Agile Chassis System delivers responsive stability and shock absorption, the EnergyCell midsole provides cushioning across all-day wear, EndoFit internal sleeve and SensiFit technology produce the secure sock-like fit, and the OrthoLite sockliner adds underfoot comfort. Style code L47989500, released January 2, 2026 at $180 in unisex sizing. The Salomon XT-6 Black Asphalt Castlerock is the XT-6 for the performance lifestyle wearer who wants the silhouette's full technical chassis and construction complexity in the most tonal, most dark-spectrum, and most effortlessly versatile colorway in the shoe's current lineup. The Salomon XT-6 Black Asphalt Castlerock was released on January 2, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Midnight Navy Gum
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Midnight Navy Gum is built on an iconic silhouette that has been delighting people around the world for over three decades. This iteration is heritage and its details and fresh in its colorway. The upper of this sneaker is crafted from tightly woven black mesh with a padded collar to enhance comfort. The tongue is navy-blue mesh, offering subtle contrast. Black leather forms the mud guard, while navy blue leather forms an overlay that stretches from the toe cap to the collar. Navy blue TPU overlays hit the side panel with Air Max branding, the eyestays, and the heel with Nike Air branding. The black tongue tag also sports white Nike Air branding. Besides the panel, Nike swoosh and flat laces are also white. This upper rides on a white foam midsole that houses a visible Air cassette surrounded by a navy blue TPU window. What we most appreciate is the gum rubber outsole with its vintage waffle traction pattern. This outsole locks in the old-school, time-honored, legendary aspect of this silhouette. The Nike Air Max 90 Midnight Navy Gum debuted on December 27, 2023, for $130 retail.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Lakers (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Lakers PS brings a bold team inspired colorway to one of the most recognizable silhouettes in the Jordan lineup. Imperial purple sets the tone across the upper, immediately referencing the Lakers identity, while multi color accents add layers of contrast that keep the design dynamic. The structure of the Jordan 4 remains unchanged, with its mesh panels and supportive wings maintaining the classic look that defines the model. This release stands out for how it channels team energy into a youth focused format, making it both vibrant and approachable. Fans of basketball culture appreciate the connection to one of the sports most iconic franchises, while the color execution keeps it playful and eye catching. It is a version of the Jordan 4 that feels expressive and rooted in the game, even in its smaller sizing. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Lakers PS was released on March 7, 2026 with a retail price of $105.

Display Name: Nike Maxfly 2 Citron Pulse Indigo Burst
Description: The Nike Maxfly 2 Citron Pulse Indigo Burst pushes track performance into a visually explosive space, using a citron pulse volt ice vivid purple indigo burst palette that feels fast even at a glance. The aggressive spike plate and sculpted upper reflect its elite sprinting purpose, while the color layering adds a bold identity that stands out on the track. It feels engineered for speed but styled with intention. Fans of Nike track innovation appreciate how the Maxfly line continues to evolve both technically and visually. This pair captures that balance, delivering a high performance tool that also carries strong design energy. It appeals to athletes and collectors who value cutting edge function paired with standout color execution. The Nike Maxfly 2 Citron Pulse Indigo Burst was released on September 21, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Slate Grey Arid Stone
Description: The New Balance 9060 Slate Grey Arid Stone offers a sophisticated blend of style and comfort. This men's sneaker showcases a sleek silhouette in a versatile colorway of slate grey, arid stone, and timberwolf. The upper features a mix of premium materials, including suede and mesh, providing both durability and breathability. The chunky midsole, a signature element of the 9060 model, not only adds to the shoe's distinctive look but also ensures superior cushioning for all-day wear. Designed with both fashion and function in mind, this New Balance 9060 iteration combines retro-inspired elements with modern technology. The shoe's layered design and exaggerated proportions create a bold, eye-catching aesthetic that's perfect for streetwear enthusiasts. The carefully chosen color palette allows for easy pairing with various outfits, making it a versatile addition to any sneaker collection. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a balance between trendy design and everyday comfort, offering a unique blend of style and practicality.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Game Royal
Description: A modern-day twist on the classic black/royals, the Jordan 1 Retro High Alternate Black Royal is an insta-classic for any fan of the AJ1s. Coming in game royal, black and summit white., these Jordan 1s sport royal blue and white upper with black accents. Their release date was in March of 2018 and retailed for the usual $160 in mens sizes, and gradeschool sizes for, $120. You can buy these Air Jordan 1 Retro High OGs online today on StockX.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Yellow
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Yellow is a timeless indoor sport shoe that applies a vintage-inspired, saturated colorway. The shoe features Preloved Yellow, Cream White, and Cloud White. The upper is constructed from soft suede, offering a premium texture and feel. The design maintains the classic T-toe overlay, streamlined profile, and the characteristic gum rubber outsole. This retro icon was released on May 1, 2024, with a retail price of $110. The deep, saturated Preloved Yellow hue dominates the upper, creating an immediate, sunny aesthetic. The creamy Cream White and crisp Cloud White accents provide a clean contrast on the Three Stripes and heel tab. This model successfully blends archival sport design with a desirable vintage color application. Our team appreciates the soft, premium feel of the Preloved Yellow suede and the durable traction provided by the classic Gum rubber outsole structure.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro Reverse Brazil
Description: Nike is setting sails towards South America, with the release of their Nike Dunk Low Retro Reverse Brazil. Nike originally debuted the Brazil Dunk Low in 2001, followed by a retro in 2020. This current retro delivers a new take to the iconic colorway. This Nike Dunk Low pays homage to the Brazilian national flag with yellow and green color blocking across the uppers. The leather sneakers sit on top of a white midsole and green outsole are tied together with yellow laces. The Nike Dunk Low Retro Reverse Brazil released February 15, 2023 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Rejuven8 Comme des Garçons Homme Plus White
Description: The Nike Air Rejuven8 Comme des Garcons Homme Plus White brings a conceptual edge to Nikes design language, shaped by the influence of Comme des Garcons Homme Plus. The all white execution keeps the look minimal, allowing the silhouette and construction to take center stage. The design feels experimental, with subtle details that reflect the collaborative approach rather than traditional performance cues. Fans of this partnership appreciate how it pushes beyond standard sneaker design, creating something that feels closer to wearable art. The simplicity of the color highlights the form, making every angle feel intentional. It is a piece that stands out through its concept and execution, appealing to those who value design driven collaborations. The Nike Air Rejuven8 Comme des Garcons Homme Plus White was released on September 18, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cool Grey Wolf Grey
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cool Grey Wolf Grey pairs plush performance tech with a sleek, everyday look. A layered mesh upper promotes airflow, while the tonal Cool Grey/Wolf Grey/White palette and sculpted lines deliver that refined, retro runner aesthetic the Vomero is known for. Signature overlays and the molded TPU midfoot cage add structure without bulk, and subtle reflective accents catch the light for low?key visibility. Style code HF1553-003 and clean branding details complete a versatile silhouette that transitions seamlessly from morning miles to weekend fits. Underfoot, dual Zoom Air units and responsive foam cushioning create a smooth, springy ride thats easy on the legs whether youre logging steps or standing all day. The padded collar, breathable tongue, and supportive heel counter lock in comfort, while a durable rubber outsole with targeted traction zones grips pavement and sidewalks with confidence. Balanced, stable, and effortlessly wearable, the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cool Grey Wolf Grey brings together modern comfort and timeless design for a go-to lifestyle sneaker that elevates any rotation. Our team loves this product because it blends soft, all-day cushioning with a versatile neutral colorway, making it ideal for daily wear, travel, and light training.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Reflection (GS)
Description: The New Balance 9060 Reflection (GS) is a grade school-sized shoe with a classic design and a shiny heel counter. This version of the New Balance 9060 comes with a white mesh and leather upper. Mesh dominates the toe box and the area under the ankle for breathability, while leather overlays form the toe cap and support the midsole. Leather overlays also run around the heel. The New Balance " N" appears across each side of the shoe in white, with a solid design on the lateral side and a dashed one on the other side. A small NB appears on the heel collar, while the tongue also bears New Balance branding. A shiny white TPU heel counter provides extra support, while a chunky and wavy white outsole completes the look. What we like most about this shoe is the all-white and shiny color scheme. The shiny heel counter adds a bit of visual interest to the white shoe. The New Balance 9060 Reflection (GS) was released on May 26, 2023, for a price of $110.

Display Name: Nike GT Future Wale Valor Blue
Description: The Nike GT Future Wale Valor Blue pushes Nike Basketball into conceptual territory with a silhouette that feels bold, sculptural, and unapologetically forward looking. The GT Future design is all about shape and motion, and the Valor Blue colorway amplifies that vision with layered blue tones that feel fluid and powerful. It looks less like a traditional performance shoe and more like a statement about where basketball design is headed next, prioritizing form and presence over convention. Fans love this release because it feels fearless. The GT Future does not rely on nostalgia or familiar cues, instead standing on its own as a modern design object. Collectors appreciate how Nike uses this model to explore new ideas, making it appealing to people who see basketball sneakers as cultural artifacts as much as athletic tools. It is a shoe that sparks conversation, valued for ambition, confidence, and willingness to challenge expectations. The Nike GT Future Wale Valor Blue was released on December 13, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Blazer Mid 77 White Black (GS)
Description: The Nike Blazer Mid 77 White Black (Gradeschool) is one of Nikes top releases in basketball shoes. The Nike Blazer Mid 77 White Black (Gradeschool) comes with a vintage touch to the sleek design of these basketball shoes. It features upper suede details, foam cushioning, and a herringbone rubber sole. The shoes have a black Nike logo on the sides and the Nike name on the back. The flatlaces are made from cotton. The shoes are comfortable for skipping, running, and jumping, thanks to the excellent design by Nike. Nike Blazer Mid 77 White Black (Gradeschool) was released on March 29, 2019, at a retail price of $80.

Display Name: New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Avocado Natural Mint
Description: The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Avocado Natural Mint introduces earthy color experimentation into the latest evolution of one of New Balances most celebrated silhouettes. The 990v6 modernized the legendary 990 series through sleeker lines, updated cushioning, and a more streamlined visual identity while still preserving the premium Made in USA craftsmanship central to the franchise. The Avocado and Natural Mint color combination gives the shoe a fresh and organic atmosphere that feels highly connected to contemporary lifestyle fashion trends while still remaining unmistakably New Balance in construction and overall aesthetic. Fans of the 990 line appreciate how the v6 continues evolving the silhouette without abandoning the understated comfort and quality that made earlier versions iconic. Earth toned runners have become increasingly popular because they pair naturally with modern relaxed wardrobes and muted streetwear styling, and this release leans fully into that aesthetic direction. Collectors especially gravitate toward unique green based palettes because they add individuality without sacrificing versatility or timelessness. The combination of soft mint accents and deeper avocado tones creates subtle contrast throughout the upper while preserving the refined and highly wearable identity associated with Made in USA New Balance releases. The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Avocado Natural Mint was released on April 10, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Triple Black Leather
Description: The New Balance 9060 Triple Black Leather applies a black-on-black colorway and premium materials to the 9060s technical silhouette. This New Balance 9060 combines elements from two high-performance predecessors  the 990 and the 860. While several technical features are borrowed from the 990, the sneakers style details come from the 860. The upper features black mesh with soft suede and synthetic leather overlays. The incorporation of mesh allows the foot to breathe and reduces the shoes overall weight. The overlays create a wavy pattern that complements the curves of the chunky midsole and rubber outsole. The signature New Balance N can be found on the side panels in tonal black leather.
