Our StockX experts like the addition of a stacked ABZORB midsole, which gives the shoe a semi-bulky appearance and reduces impact stress. The New Balance 9060 Triple Black Leather was released on September 24th, 2023, and retailed at $170.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Rainy Lake
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 White Rainy Lake pairs a crisp optic White mesh upper with curved cage overlays to create its running shoe silhouette. The overlays encircle the heel, lace panel, and tip in metallic silver. Rainy Lakes soft green hue is used on the ASICS Stripes, heel, and tongue branding. The aerodynamic White midsole repeats the color combination, displaying silver and Rainy Lake inserts that extend to the outsole. ASICS was founded in Japan in 1949, and its brand name references a Latin phrase meaning a sound mind promotes a sound body. As such, ASICS is constantly refining its running shoe assortment, seeking the ultimate in comfort. The GEL-1130 is a descendant of the GEL-1000 series, its ninth rendition that debuted in 2008. The GEL-1130 captures the retro runner vibe, while its updated fabrication gives it a modern feel. Our experts feel that the best feature of the ASICS Gel-1130 is its caging, which gives the shoe both shine and a pop of pigment. The ASICS Gel-1130 White Rainy Lake was released on March 1, 2025, and retailed for $95.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High J Balvin
Description: During the halftime performance at Super Bowl LIV, Latin sensation J Balvin unveiled a pair of signature tie-dye Jordan 1s that the world had never seen before. Then, in December of 2020, J Balvin and Jordan Brand got psychedelic and released the Air Jordan 1 High J Balvin. The Air Jordan 1 High J Balvin features a layered tie-dye canvas upper with designed jagged edges to expose solid black leather patches. Exposed foam tongues give off a vintage feel to the shoe, while velcro patches on the heel depicting Jordan and J Balvin insignias provide wearers with the freedom to customize their pair. A light pink sole and J Balvins smiley face logo on the tongue and insole add the finishing touches to this one-of-a-kind Jordan 1. The Jordan 1 High J Balvin released in December of 2020 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Elemental Pink Iced Carmine (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid Elemental Pink Iced Carmine Womens arrives as part of one of the most delicately executed Jordan Brand color stories of the spring season, offering two shades of pink on the classic Mid silhouette in a way that feels feminine without being saccharine and elevated without losing the street energy that makes the Jordan 1 worth wearing in the first place. The Elemental Pink base covers the smooth leather panels across the shoe's primary surfaces, creating a clean and light foundation that keeps the overall palette soft, while Iced Carmine lands on the suede overlays at the toe, eyestay, and heel as a deeper, more saturated pink tone that introduces contrast and dimension without breaking the tonal cohesion of the build. Coconut Milk appears on the midsole for a slightly aged, vintage cream finish rather than a stark white, and the Sail laces and tongue logo details keep the upper looking clean and restrained. The Wings logo badge sits on the ankle collar in matching tones, the perforated toe box adds texture to the front panels, and the rubber outsole in the accent pink ties the shoe together from sole to lace tip. The Air-Sole unit in the heel delivers the signature Jordan 1 cushioning that has made this silhouette a daily driver for decades, and the padded collar provides the supportive fit that keeps it comfortable across extended wear. Jordan Brand has been leaning into softer, more wearable seasonal colorways in recent seasons, and this Iced Carmine pack represents the clearest expression of that direction, giving the Jordan 1 an early spring wardrobe entry point that works with denim, linen, and anything in between. The Mid is the more color-blocked of the two Iced Carmine Jordan 1 options, with a brighter midsole contrast compared to the aged finish on the Low, making it the louder and more visually dynamic of the two styles in the pack. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Elemental Pink Iced Carmine Womens was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: New Balance 1906A Concrete Silver Metallic
Description: The New Balance 1906A Concrete Silver Metallic is a striking addition to the brand's lineup, combining style and performance in one sleek package. This men's sneaker features a sophisticated color palette of concrete, silver metallic, and Brighton grey, creating a versatile look that seamlessly transitions from casual to athletic wear. The upper is crafted with premium materials, ensuring durability and comfort for everyday use, while the iconic New Balance 'N' logo adorns the sides, adding a touch of brand recognition. Designed with the modern wearer in mind, the 1906A boasts advanced cushioning technology in the midsole, providing exceptional support and energy return with every step. The rubber outsole offers superior traction on various surfaces, making these sneakers ideal for both urban environments and light athletic activities. With its sleek silhouette and attention to detail, the New Balance 1906A Concrete Silver Metallic is a testament to the brand's commitment to quality and style. Our experts state this product is great for those seeking a balance between fashion-forward design and all-day comfort, making it an excellent choice for active individuals who don't want to compromise on style.

Display Name: Under Armour Curry 11 Mouthguard
Description: The Under Armour Curry 11 Mouthguard brings a playful and expressive twist to Stephen Currys signature line, using a bold blue and white colorway that references one of his most recognizable on court habits. The silhouette stays performance focused, built for quick movement and responsiveness while maintaining a lightweight feel. Under Armour continues to push the Curry line through both design and storytelling, and this version captures that through its unique theme. Fans of Curry gravitate toward releases like this because they reflect personality as much as performance. The color and concept make it stand out within the lineup, while the structure keeps it functional for basketball use. It is a sneaker that blends identity and innovation, offering a distinct addition for players and collectors alike. The Under Armour Curry 11 Mouthguard was released on April 1, 2024 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Coffee French Roast
Description: The Salomon XT-6 Coffee French Roast is a performance trail shoe that utilizes a deep, warm monochromatic colorway. The shoe is predominantly colored in Coffee and French Roast, with accents of Vanilla Ice. This iteration is built for technical terrain, featuring an abrasion-resistant mesh upper and the full-length Agile Chassis System (ACS) for stability. The Quicklace system ensures a precise, secure fit with one-pull tightening. Slated for release on October 1, 2025, this rugged model carries a retail price of $180. The rich, deep Coffee and French Roast tones provide a subtle, earthy contrast, giving the technical silhouette a refined, mature aesthetic. The pop of Vanilla Ice on the sole unit brightens the look. Our team emphasizes the reliable stability provided by the Agile Chassis System and the durable, abrasion-resistant mesh upper, wrapped in the sophisticated tones of Coffee and French Roast.

Display Name: New Balance Abzorb 2000 Silver Metallic-Faded Black
Description: The New Balance Abzorb 2000 Silver Metallic Faded Black brings a futuristic and performance driven aesthetic through its bold use of materials and structure. The silver metallic upper creates a reflective and technical look, while faded black accents add depth and contrast. The Abzorb cushioning system is visually integrated into the design, giving the shoe a sculptural and dynamic presence. Fans of New Balances more experimental models are drawn to releases like this for their forward thinking design language. The combination of metallic tones and layered construction gives it a strong visual identity that stands out immediately. It is a sneaker that pushes the brands innovation into a more expressive and modern space. The New Balance Abzorb 2000 Silver Metallic Faded Black was released on January 30, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Thom Browne Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Thom Browne Grey delivers a high fashion interpretation of a retro running silhouette, combining ASICS performance DNA with Thom Brownes signature minimalism. The grey on grey palette keeps the design restrained, allowing subtle detailing and structure to define the look. It feels elevated and precise, with a strong focus on form and proportion. Collectors are drawn to this pair for its clean execution and the weight of the collaboration. Thom Browne brings a tailored perspective that transforms the Kayano 14 into something more refined and conceptual. It is a sneaker that sits comfortably between performance heritage and luxury fashion. The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Thom Browne Grey was released on March 2, 2026 with a retail price of $330.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Red Cracked Leather (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Red Cracked Leather Womens brings bold texture to the iconic silhouette with a mix of Sail, Team Red, and Varsity Red. Cracked leather overlays add depth and a slightly vintage feel, creating visual movement across the upper. The mid cut structure stays true to the AJ1 blueprint, letting material and color elevate the familiar shape. This pair resonates because it combines rich red tones with tactile detail. The layered reds create warmth and intensity, while the cracked finish gives the shoe character that stands apart from smoother releases. Fans gravitate toward special editions like this for their ability to refresh the Jordan 1 through texture rather than drastic redesign. It is a confident and expressive take on a timeless model. The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Red Cracked Leather Womens was released on April 20, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 White Deep Royal Blue
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 White Deep Royal Blue delivers a crisp and confident take on a timeless icon. Clean white leather sets the foundation, allowing deep royal blue accents to bring clarity and energy to the design. The familiar proportions and simple blocking keep the shoe grounded in tradition, letting the color contrast do the work without distraction. This colorway resonates because it feels classic and immediately wearable. Fans gravitate toward releases like this for their versatility and unmistakable Nike DNA. The Air Force 1 continues to thrive through simple yet effective updates, and this pair reinforces that formula. Collectors appreciate how the royal blue adds just enough personality while preserving the clean aesthetic that has made the model a staple across generations and style movements. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 White Deep Royal Blue was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Game Royal Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Game Royal Metallic Silver merges bold aesthetics with cutting-edge innovation. Its dynamic color palette and distinct profile come together in a striking look that's designed to combine performance with fashion. The Game Royal and Metallic Silver Air VaporMax Plus by Nike has a gradient mesh upper with transitions of blue all around, complemented by metallic blue TPU overlays that resemble the original Air Max Plus design. A reflective Swoosh is on the side of the heel, and the VaporMax sole unit offers up a futuristic look along with responsive cushioning. First introduced in 2018, the VaporMax line highlights Nike's air technology and design evolution. Something we love about the Nike Air VaporMax Plus Game Royal Metallic Silver is its gradient upper, which gives you a bold visual impact, and the VaporMax sole, which offers a lightweight feel with superior responsiveness. This model retailed at $210 when it was released on the 24th of June 2024.

Display Name: Jordan 7 Retro White Infrared
Description: Bringing the heat in summer 2023, the Jordan 7 Retro Infrared made its debut. Jordan Brand, keeping the essence of the classic silhouette, injected an electrifying update with a striking Infrared and White colorway. A smooth White leather upper forms the base of the sneaker, making the fiery Infrared accents pop. The tongue and midsole are splashed with the bold hue, ensuring a statement with every step. The sneaker rests on a translucent outsole, giving a nod to its heritage roots while pushing boundaries. The Jumpman logo in Infrared further underlines the brand's signature aesthetic, while the retro-inspired design promises the perfect blend of comfort and style. The Jordan 7 Retro Infrared dropped on June 30, 2023, with a retail price of $210, making it a must-have addition for any sneakerhead's collection.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low 72-10
Description: Jordan Brand honored Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls' historic 72 win 1995-1996 season with the Air Jordan 11 Low 72-10. The Air Jordan 11 Low 72-10 boasts a black tumbled leather upper with a signature patent leather mudguard and woven lace loops. On the interior, an embroidered tongue tag that reads "Inspired by the most historic season led by the greatest player ever" tributes MJ's monumental accolade. From there, a semi-translucent sole with red and black carbon fiber detailing completes the design. The Air Jordan 11 Low 72-10 released in May of 2022 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Rainy Day Paloma
Description: The Salomon XT-6 in Rainy Day and Paloma is a Spring 2026 general release of the XT-6 in a cool, muted two-tone colorway, featuring Rainy Day as the primary grey-blue tone across the upper's mesh and overlay panels with Paloma providing a lighter, warmer secondary grey for contrast, finished with Footwear Silver on the midsole accents, creating a tonal palette that references overcast weather conditions and the soft natural tones that make the XT-6 most broadly versatile as a lifestyle shoe across a wide range of casual styling contexts. The Rainy Day and Paloma palette sits firmly within the cool-neutral color language that has become the XT-6's most consistent commercial sweet spot since the model began its crossover from technical trail running into lifestyle and gorpcore streetwear, with grey-adjacent tones consistently outselling louder colorways for the silhouette among the core buyer who wears the XT-6 primarily as an everyday lifestyle shoe. The XT-6's construction features EVA midsole cushioning, Sensifit wraparound lacing structure, Quicklace closure, and Contragrip rubber outsole with multi-directional lugs adapted for lifestyle use on urban surfaces while maintaining the trail-derived traction architecture that underpins all XT-6 variants. Released April 1, 2026 at $185 retail through Salomon and select retailers globally with style code L47988000. The Salomon XT-6 Rainy Day Paloma was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Mid Off-White Pine Green
Description: Off-White and Nike are partnering together again on another Air Force 1 sneaker collaboration, with the release of the Nike Air Force 1 Mid Off-White Pine Green. Nikes Air Force 1 Mid Off-White Pine Green is constructed using green premium leather throughout the body of the sneaker. Nike used white accents, the sneakers branding, zip tie, Swooshes, and midsole. The sneakers draw inspiration from Track and Field shoes with a spike like design on the outsoles. The Nike Air Force 1 Mid Off-White Pine Green released April 28, 2023, with a retail price of $205.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite One International Blue
Description: The Nike Air Foamposite One International Blue reapplies the International Blue colorway, also known as Royal, to the Foamposite One. As one of the most popular colorways in the Foamposite One line, the International Blue colorway features International Blue on the molded polyurethane panels. Giving the International Blue Nike Air Foamposite One sneaker its sleek silhouette, these panels have a wavy design and fit snugly around the foot. Black makes up the other half of the colorway and can be found on the nubuck upper, the lining, the mesh tongue, and the thin laces. Branding details include Penny Hardaway's "1 Cent" logo on the heel and a mini Swoosh near the toebox. Our experts like the black and International Blue spots on the midfoots carbon fiber shank because they pay homage to the OG Foamposite One from 1997. The Nike Air Foamposite One International Blue was released on September 13, 2024, and sold for $240.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Premium White Bright Crimson
Description: The Nike Vomero Premium White Bright Crimson elevates Nikes long distance running legacy into something expressive and modern, blending plush comfort with sharp visual contrast. The Vomero Premium silhouette is all about cushioning and smooth transitions, and the clean white base lets the bright crimson accents cut through with energy and intent. Subtle black and grey tones balance the look, giving the shoe a refined performance aesthetic that feels premium without drifting into excess. Fans love this release because it makes comfort feel exciting. The Vomero line has always been trusted for long wear and support, and this colorway adds personality that works just as well off the run as it does in motion. Collectors appreciate how Nike continues to push running silhouettes into lifestyle relevance, offering a shoe that feels technically advanced but visually confident. It stands as a reminder that performance footwear can still feel bold, expressive, and thoughtfully designed. The Nike Vomero Premium White Bright Crimson was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Travis Scott Mocha
Description: The first release as part of Travis Scott's monumental partnership with Nike, the Air Jordan 1 Travis Scott breaks the conventional rules of the Air Jordan 1 design. For starters, the side Swooshes are reversed, which each tailing facing the toe. Woven tongue tags are shifted and stitched to the side of the tongue instead of the top. Also, in the collar, there is a hidden stash pocket. A one-of-a-kind design fit for a one-of-a-kind artist. The Air Jordan 1 Travis Scott features a white leather upper with Mocha suede overlays and black leather reversed Swooshes. Hits of red on the tongue slightly contrast the design's earth tones. On the heel, a debossed Cactus Jack logo adds a custom feel. From there, a yellowed midsole and matching Mocha outsole complete the design. The Jordan 1 Travis Scott Mocha released in May 2019 and retailed for $175. To shop all Air Jordan 1 shoes, click here.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Explorer (GS)
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Green Spark GS delivers a vibrant and high energy take on Ja Morants signature model, using bold color to reflect the intensity of the Jurassic Park theme. The green spark upper dominates the design, creating a striking base that is complemented by black and university red accents. Dynamic yellow details add another layer of contrast, enhancing the overall visual impact. Fans appreciate this pair because it fully embraces the collaboration concept through color and design. The GS sizing makes it accessible to younger collectors while still delivering the same standout look. It feels like a statement piece that captures both performance and storytelling, making it a memorable addition to the lineup. The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Green Spark GS was released on April 10, 2026 with a retail price of $112.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Bright Crimson
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Bright Crimson revives a classic color story with amplified cushioning detail. Black and Anthracite create a dark gradient foundation, while Bright Crimson accents slice through with sharp intensity. Iron Grey and Smoke Grey tones enhance the layered wave design, emphasizing the anatomical inspiration behind the silhouette. The enlarged Air units bring added focus to the innovation that defined the models original impact. Fans of the Air Max 95 appreciate how bold red accents can completely transform its sculpted profile. The crimson highlights energize the design without overpowering the gradient base. It captures the spirit of early Air Max experimentation while delivering a modernized feel through the Big Bubble update. Striking and heritage driven, this pair stands as a powerful continuation of the OG legacy. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Bright Crimson was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $180.
Colorway: Black/Bright Crimson/Anthracite/Iron Grey/Smoke Grey/Light Smoke Grey

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Sandy Bodecker
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Sandy Bodecker was inspired by the original 2003 eBay Charity Auction Nike SB Dunk Low. It has a white base with overlays in the company's trademark red, green, blue, and yellow colors. The sneaker features clear stripes on its vamp, on the heel, and on the middle part. In addition, the shoe features a blue Nike Swoosh on both sides with an SB emblem on its heel panel. Its tongue panel is constructed with a padded cushion with a Nike Swoosh printed on it. The Nike SB Dunk Low Sandy Bodecker debuted on December 17th, 2022, and retailed at $130.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Golf Last Shot
Description: The Air Jordan 14 Retro Golf Last Shot delivers a performance ready adaptation of one of the most iconic Jordan 14 colorways through a golf specific build. The black upper creates a sleek and aggressive look, while varsity red accents add contrast that ties back to the original Last Shot design. The golf outsole ensures traction and stability on the course. Fans of the Last Shot colorway appreciate how it continues to appear across different formats while maintaining its legacy. The transition into a golf model adds functionality without losing its visual identity. It is a sneaker that reflects heritage design adapted for performance. The Air Jordan 14 Retro Golf Last Shot was released on October 24, 2025 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Golf Big Bubble Black White Gum
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 86 OG Golf Big Bubble Black White Gum brings a crossover approach to the Air Max legacy, adapting the original running silhouette for the golf course while preserving its identity. The black, white, and gum medium brown palette keeps it classic, while the big bubble unit references the early Air Max design language that fans recognize instantly. It feels nostalgic but functional. This version resonates because it bridges two worlds without compromising either. Golf adaptations often shift the identity of a shoe, but this one maintains the look and feel of the original while adding the traction and support needed for play. Fans appreciate when heritage models are reworked with purpose, especially when the result still feels true to its roots. The Nike Air Max 1 86 OG Golf Big Bubble Black White Gum was released on December 12, 2023 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Olive (2024)
Description: The Jordan 9 Retro Olive (2024) marks the return of a beloved, off-court colorway that has steadily grown in popularity since its debut in 1993. First introduced during Michael Jordans first retirement from the NBA, the Jordan 9 captured his global influence with its sleek design, despite Jordan not wearing it on the basketball court. The Olive colorway, featuring a mix of black, true red, and light olive, was an experimental shift from the usual Bulls-inspired colors, and while it initially underperformed, it has since gained a cult following. This 2024 release aims to stay true to the original design, with premium materials and a shape that captures the sneakers iconic status. The black upper is paired with olive overlays, creating a rugged yet stylish look that works both on and off the court. The true red accents on the branding add a pop of color to the otherwise understated palette, making this one of the most anticipated Jordan releases of the year. Released on November 16, 2024, the Jordan 9 Retro Olive (2024) retailed for $210. With its rich history and bold color scheme, this sneaker is perfect for Jordan fans and sneaker enthusiasts looking to add a timeless piece to their collection.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Sunset (2024)
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Sunset (2024) is a special-edition of the "Sunset" colorway, which has been released numerous times over the years throughout the history of the Nike Air Max Plus. The wave-like upper has TPU overlays that resembles waves in the sea as the sun sets. Aiming to mimic and capture all phases of a sunset, youll notice how the colors gradient from a bright Ceramic Yellow in the toe area all the way to a deep dark pimento in the heel area. Together with other colors such as black, resin, and white, the effect is nothing less than spectacular. On the quarter side panels, youll spot small red Nike Swooshes, while iconic Tuned Air (TN) logos sit on the heel, on the insole, and underfoot in the middle of the outsole. What our experts love about this shoe is how the Air Units complement the idea of a sunset, the orange color peeking through adds to the overall aesthetic. When it was released on July 3, 2024, the Nike Air Max Plus Sunset (2024) had a $180 price tag.

Display Name: Timberland 6" Premium Waterproof Patent Boots Black
Description: The Timberland 6 Premium Waterproof Patent Boots Black rework a workwear icon through a glossy, fashion forward lens. Retaining the classic six inch waterproof build, this version swaps traditional matte leather for a sleek patent finish that immediately shifts the mood. The blacked out construction keeps it cohesive and bold, blending rugged structure with high shine attitude. It feels like a reinterpretation that respects the original while pushing it into more expressive territory. Fans who appreciate statement footwear will gravitate toward the patent texture for its reflective depth and edge. The glossy upper catches light with every step, adding personality to an otherwise utilitarian silhouette. It pairs naturally with monochrome outfits or layered streetwear fits that lean into contrast and texture. This boot balances durability and fashion energy in a way that feels confident and unapologetic. The Timberland 6 Premium Waterproof Patent Boots Black were released on September 26, 2025 with a retail price of $198.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Patchwork Camo
Description: Taking inspiration from vintage surplus stores and fabrics, the Air Jordan 3 features a mixed camo patchwork upper consisting of waxed canvas, ripstop nylon, herringbone, wool, and twill materials. Adding more customization opportunities, heel tabs are backed with velcro material so that you can interchange Nike Air and Jumpman logo patches. The Air Jordan 3 Patchwork released in November of 2021 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Black Cat
Description: The Air Jordan 13 Retro Black Cat, designed by Tinker Hatfield, was inspired by Michael Jordan nickname of "black cat". This Retro Air Jordan 13 model has an upper that is built with suede material, finished in black, and overlaid by mesh, which sports a reflective finish. Rope laces secure the fit, while the Jumpman hologram logo marks the heel. Underfoot, there is a Zoom Air in the forefoot and heel of the Phylon midsole for cushioning, giving way to a herringbone panther's-paw outsole for traction. The Air Jordan 13 Retro Black Cat was released on January 2017, at a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Summit White Varsity Red Gum
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Summit White Varsity Red Gum brings a timeless balance of heritage and warmth through a color palette that feels rooted in classic sportswear. The summit white leather upper keeps the base clean and familiar, while varsity red accents introduce just enough contrast to give the shoe energy. The gum yellow outsole ties everything together, adding a vintage touch that connects back to early court styles and everyday wear. This pair resonates because it does not try to reinvent the formula. Instead, it refines it through thoughtful color placement and material consistency. Fans of the Air Force 1 appreciate when the silhouette leans into its roots, and this version delivers that with a slightly warmer, more nostalgic feel. It is the kind of release that feels instantly wearable while still carrying the legacy that made the model iconic. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Summit White Varsity Red Gum was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Invisible Woman 2.0
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Invisible Woman 2.0 brings subtle storytelling and modern elegance to one of Nikes most timeless silhouettes. Built around the idea of presence without noise, this version of the Air Force 1 leans into clean white tones with soft accents that feel almost hidden at first glance. The Invisible Woman concept celebrates quiet confidence, letting texture and finish do the talking rather than loud graphics or heavy contrast, which feels perfectly suited to the AF1s enduring shape. Fans love this pair because it rewards attention. The design feels minimal but intentional, offering a sneaker that fits seamlessly into rotation while still carrying a narrative edge. Collectors appreciate how Nike continues to find new emotional angles within such a familiar model, proving that the Air Force 1 can evolve through restraint just as effectively as it can through bold statements. It is a shoe people reach for because it feels polished, versatile, and quietly expressive. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Invisible Woman 2.0 was released on September 11, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 23 Miami Twice (Translucent Outsole)
Description: The Nike LeBron 23 Miami Twice taps into championship era energy by referencing one of the most defining chapters of LeBron James legacy. The mix of smokey blue and vibrant accent tones evokes Miami heat and celebration, while the translucent outsole adds a modern twist that feels playful and confident. It balances memory and progression, letting the LeBron 23 silhouette feel expressive without losing its performance focus. Fans gravitate toward this release because it blends storytelling and innovation so naturally. The Miami Twice theme resonates with people who remember that era vividly, while the execution keeps the shoe firmly in the present. Collectors appreciate how LeBrons signature line continues to honor career milestones through design rather than repetition, making this a sneaker that feels emotionally rich and visually dynamic at the same time. The Nike LeBron 23 Miami Twice was released on October 9, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: adidas F50 Elite Laceless FG Lamine Yamal Football's Heartbreaker Pack
Description: The adidas F50 Elite Laceless FG Lamine Yamal Football's Heartbreaker Pack represents the premium version of the young stars signature-inspired speed boot. Dressed in cloud white with core black and lucid red accents, the design builds on the same striking palette seen throughout the Heartbreaker Pack while introducing adidas elite-level construction. The F50 Elite Laceless silhouette emphasizes lightweight speed and fluid ball contact through its laceless design and streamlined upper. Lamine Yamals association with the pack highlights the creativity and fearless attacking style that define his rise in professional football. The vivid red accents symbolize attacking intent, while the clean white base keeps the look sharp and modern. When the adidas F50 Elite Laceless FG Lamine Yamal Football's Heartbreaker Pack released, it retailed for $260 and dropped on March 4, 2026. With its cloud white, core black, and lucid red colorway, this edition reflects the speed-driven identity that has defined the F50 franchise for years.

Display Name: adidas Superstar Coca-Cola White
Description: The Adidas Superstar Coca-Cola in Footwear White, Cream, and Red brings two of the most globally recognized brand identities in commercial design together on one of sneaker culture's most historically significant and enduringly beloved silhouettes. The Superstar's shell toe, perforated three-stripe side panel, and classic low-top construction provide the ideal canvas for the Coca-Cola collaboration, the shoe's clean architecture allowing the red accent and cream tones to function as genuine design elements rather than competing with any visual complexity in the silhouette itself. Footwear white and cream create a slightly warm and vintage-feeling base that suits the Coca-Cola partnership's American heritage associations, while red arrives through the branding and accent details as the most iconic and immediately recognizable single-color brand signal in the history of commercial design. Superstar collaborations with institutions of Coca-Cola's cultural standing consistently generate strong collector response because they bring together two brands whose individual legacies in popular culture are so well-established that their meeting feels genuinely meaningful rather than commercially convenient. The footwear white, cream, and red palette creates a colorway that ages beautifully, the warm tones developing a vintage character with wear that suits the Superstar's own mid-century athletic heritage with complete visual coherence. At one hundred and thirty dollars the Coca-Cola Superstar is a fair investment in a collaborative release that honors both brand histories with genuine design intelligence and palette consideration. The Adidas Superstar Coca-Cola in Footwear White, Cream, and Red was released on June 6, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Silver Black
Description: The New Balance 1906R Silver Black leans into Y2K trends with a striking colorway of metallic silver, black, and white. Featuring a low-top, lace-up design inspired by sneakers from the early 2000s, this version of the 1906R boasts a white mesh base with black accents on the heel, sock liner, rubber outsole, and ribbons threading through the signature New Balance N logo. However, the shiny silver overlays crisscrossing the upper stand out the most. The ABZORB SBS heel increases stability, while the ABZORB midsole protects against impact stress. Finally, the N-ergy technology in the outsole adds superior shock absorption as the Stability Web supports the midfoot arch. Our experts at StockX like the classic New Balance 1906R branding, including "1906R" on the overlays, "NB RUNNING" on the tongue, and "NB" on the heel. The New Balance 1906R Silver Black was released on June 1, 2024, and sold for $155.

Display Name: Nike Air Rift Triple Black Buckle Strap (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Rift Triple Black Buckle Strap (Womens) reimagines the cult-classic split-toe silhouette with a sleek, monochrome finish built for all-day movement. This all-black colorway (Black/Black/Black) wraps the foot in a breathable, foot-hugging upper that blends sneaker stability with airy comfort, while the signature split-toe design delivers a nimble, sock-like feel. An adjustable buckle strap secures the midfoot with quick, custom lockdown, complemented by a cushioned foam midsole and Nike Air underfoot for responsive comfort on city streets, daily commutes, and weekend escapes. Finished with grippy rubber traction and subtle branding, its a minimalist statement that pairs effortlessly with athleisure, techwear, or tailored casual looks. A modern evolution of the original Air Rift, this hybrid icon shines in a versatile Triple Black treatment that elevates everything from lightweight joggers to summer dresses. The streamlined profile flatters the ankle, while the supportive fit and flexible sole encourage natural motion and easy wear from morning to night. Style ID IB8881-001 and a Release Date of 2025-06-28 make this a timely pickup for fans of innovative design who want a distinctive, understated edge. Whether youre exploring a new city or dialing in a refined gym-to-street rotation, the Nike Air Rift Buckle Strap balances performance comfort with fashion-forward attitude. Our team loves this product because it delivers effortless, go-anywhere comfort in a refined all-black package that looks sharp with everything and feels even better on foot.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro SB Navy
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro SB Navy blends basketball heritage with skateboarding functionality, continuing the successful partnership between Nike SB and Jordan Brand. Following the hype of the "Pine Green" release, this edition swaps green for navy, adding a sleek and timeless twist to the SB-enhanced Air Jordan 4 silhouette. The upper features summit white leather with navy accents on the eyelets, heel tab, and midsole, delivering a clean yet bold aesthetic. A vibrant red Jumpman logo on the tongue and insoles provides a striking contrast, while the Nike SB branding on the heel cements this crossovers skate-ready DNA. Designed with performance in mind, the Jordan 4 Retro SB Navy incorporates subtle modifications tailored for skateboarding. The reworked sole offers enhanced grip and flexibility, while premium materials ensure durability whether youre on the board or the streets. The signature mesh side panels and classic lace cage maintain the AJ4s iconic look, seamlessly merging style and function. The gum yellow outsole adds a vintage-inspired touch while improving tractionessential for both skaters and sneakerheads alike. Landing on March 18, 2025, for a retail price of $225, the Jordan 4 Retro SB Navy marks the next evolution of this crossover collaboration. With its blend of skate and basketball culture, this release is set to make waves among collectors and casual wearers alike.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (Gold Lettering)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (Gold Lettering) pairs classic hoops heritage with refined detailing that stands out in any rotation. Anchored by a versatile Black/Fire Red/Deep Royal Blue/Dark Smoke Grey/Tech Grey palette, this take on the AJ4 leans into striking contrasts and layered textures for a bold, wearable look. Metallic gold script at the heel delivers the "Rare Air" callout, elevating the icon with a gallery-worthy accent, while the signature mesh panels, molded eyestays, and TPU wings keep the silhouette unmistakably Jordan. Underfoot, a visible Air unit teams with a supportive midsole for cushioning you can feel, and a grippy rubber outsole with defined herringbone traction inspires confidence from sidewalk to arena tunnel. Thoughtful touches set this colorway apart. The padded collar and tongue offer step-in comfort, and the sculpted heel tab provides easy on-and-off, ideal for everyday wear. Deep Royal Blue pops lend depth to the overlays and laces, with an additional set of blue laces included to customize your look on the fly. Style code (Gold) FV5029-003 and the July 26, 2025 release date stamp this pair as a must-track entry in the Jordan 4 lineage, blending modern craftsmanship with the models late-80s DNA. Whether youre dressing it up with tailored joggers or grounding a graphic tee and denim fit, the Rare Air (Gold Lettering) delivers head-turning presence and reliable performance. Our team loves this product because the cushioned ride, bold gold heel script, and included blue laces make it a standout mix of comfort, heritage, and easy personalization.
Colorway: Black/Fire Red/Deep Royal Blue/Dark Smoke Grey/Tech Grey

Display Name: ASICS Skyhand OG Oatmeal Black
Description: The ASICS Skyhand OG Oatmeal Black revives a classic indoor silhouette with a calm and understated palette. Oatmeal tones give the upper a warm and vintage feel, contrasted by black details that add clarity and structure. The low profile shape and simple construction stay true to the Skyhand legacy, letting proportion and texture define the look rather than excess detail. Fans appreciate this model because it feels honest and unforced. The Skyhand OG appeals to collectors who enjoy archival ASICS designs that translate naturally into modern styling. It carries a sense of nostalgia without feeling dated, making it easy to wear across different settings. This release reinforces the idea that timeless silhouettes do not need reinvention, only thoughtful color and respect for original design intent. The ASICS Skyhand OG Oatmeal Black was released on January 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Yeezreel (Non-Reflective)
Description: Preceding its reflective counterpart, Yeezy released the adidas Yeezy 350 Yeezreel Non-Reflective, now available on StockX. This 350 V2 is reminiscent of the Glow colorway that released in early 2019, but sets itself apart with the addition of new tones woven in the Primeknit upper. This model was released in both reflective and non-reflective variations. This Yeezy 350 V2 is composed of a Yeezreel upper and with black and grey accents ingrained in the upper. A translucent Yeezreel Boost cushioned sole and side stripe completes the design. These sneakers released in December of 2019 and retailed for $250.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 SB Eric Koston Obsidian Speed Yellow
Description: Nike Air Max 95 SB Eric Koston Obsidian Speed Yellow bridges skateboarding influence and running heritage through a bold and expressive reinterpretation of the Air Max 95. Obsidian tones ground the design, while speed yellow accents inject urgency and movement, creating a look that feels fast and functional. Eric Kostons influence brings credibility and intention, making the collaboration feel earned rather than decorative. Collectors appreciate this release because it challenges traditional boundaries. The Air Max 95s aggressive shape pairs naturally with skate culture, and this colorway highlights that crossover with confidence. It feels experimental but grounded, appealing to fans who enjoy seeing classic Nike silhouettes evolve through the lens of influential athletes and creative communities. The Nike Air Max 95 SB Eric Koston Obsidian Speed Yellow was released on11/07/2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary (Women's)
Description: Immerse yourself in the stylish and bold world of the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary (Women's), a sneaker that brings a fresh vibe to a classic silhouette. This edition is splashed in Canary, Racer Blue, and Light Silver hues, embodying the energy of Travis Scott's alma mater, Elkins High School. The sneakers design is highlighted by the iconic reversed Swoosh, a hallmark of Travis Scotts transformative touch to the Jordan 1 & sneaker culture. Adorned with the Cactus Jack logo, these sneakers are a true testament to the rapper's influence and aesthetic. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary is a piece of wearable art. Crafted with premium materials for comfort and durability, the design also features a gum medium brown outsole that complements the vibrant upper, ensuring these shoes stand out in any crowd. The combination of Travis Scott's unique style and Jordan Brand's legendary craftsmanship offers wearers a mix of street-worthy appeal and high-fashion sensibility. Released on May 17, 2024, the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary (Women's) was retailed for $150. Each pair reflects the spirit of innovation and youth, capturing the essence of Travis Scott's creative vision and the enduring legacy of the Jordan brand. With each step, wearers celebrate a legacy of musical prowess and sneaker history, making it a coveted addition to any collection.

Display Name: adidas Ultra Boost 20 Triple White
Description: The adidas Ultraboost 20 comes with tailored fiber placement technology that gives you more comfort. It comes with a Primeknit all-white upper that gives the shoe a sock-like feel and fit. The upper comes with a reinforced overlay that provides the shoe with additional stability and grip. A heel featuring a cushy foam and great lockdown lets your ankles and Achilles sink comfortably. It also features a durable continental black rubber covering the outsole, enhancing the shoe's grip and appearance. The adidas Ultraboost 20 was released in June of 2019 for $180.

Display Name: adidas Superstar II Triple White
Description: The adidas Superstar II Triple White delivers a fully tonal Cloud White execution that highlights the clean lines of the iconic shell toe silhouette. The smooth leather upper, white stripes, and matching rubber toe cap create a seamless look that feels crisp and timeless. By stripping the design down to a single color, adidas allows the shape and heritage details to take center stage. This pair resonates because it embodies simplicity at its strongest. The all white finish makes it endlessly versatile, pairing effortlessly with almost any outfit while still carrying decades of basketball and music culture behind it. Fans of the Superstar appreciate when the model is presented in its purest form, free from distraction. It is a minimalist expression of a global icon that continues to define everyday style. The adidas Superstar II Triple White was released on February 6, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SE SP Dark Grey Black White
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SE SP Dark Grey Black White grabs the viewer's attention with swooping lines, geometric patterns and radiating stripes that all come together to focus on the Nike logo in the center. This sneaker offers a combination of white leather and grey mesh that accentuates the chaotic design. "NIKE VOMERO 5" appears in bold text on the tongue. Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SE SP Dark Grey Black White released in April of 2019 and retailed for $160. This Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SE SP colorway re-released in 2024.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Granite
Description: All of the different slides and slip-ons that Kanye West has created as part of his partnership with adidas feature outside-the-box designs. The adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Granite is one of the most creative options that Kanye came up with during the adidas x Yeezy collaboration. This slip-on shoe features a single piece of EVA foam that has been carefully crafted to be both aesthetically pleasing and breathable for functionality. It includes a number of sculpted lines that give it an unorthodox appearance, while also delivering as much airflow as possible when the slip-on is worn. It's designed for maximum comfort, too, thanks to its textured footbed and contoured heel that help keep feet in place. But according to our experts, the best part about this slip-on might just be its grey "MX Granite" colorway that has a camo-like feel to it. It adds one more cool touch to a modern take on the classic slip-on design. The adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Granite was released on March 15, 2024, for a retail price of $90.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Glacier Grey
Description: Built on a silhouette originally launched in 2008, the ASICS Gel-1130 Black Glacier Gray is a stability running shoe that exudes retro vibes infused with more modern details. The Black Glacier Gray ASICS Gel-1130 begins with an upper of black mesh. Leather strips course across the upper, in shades of gray, black, and white. These overlays offer an early 2000s running shoe aesthetic, as well as support, enhanced at both the toe cap and heel. The black foam midsole features GEL technology in the heel for ultimate comfort cushioning. An incorporated TRUSSTIC support system improves stability with every step. Rounding it out, a black rubber outsole helps provide impact absorption and traction. Our favorite detail of this sneaker is the reflective detailing that enhances the side panel overlays in order to help make you more visible when you run in low-light conditions. The ASICS Gel-1130 Black Glacier Gray was released on April 15, 2024, for $100 retail.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Ja Morant Denim Light Armory Blue
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Ja Morant Denim Light Armory Blue reimagines a classic silhouette through a player inspired lens, blending basketball influence with a textured and lifestyle driven execution. The light armory blue denim upper adds a unique material twist, giving the shoe a more relaxed and expressive feel compared to standard leather versions. Metallic silver accents introduce contrast, while white elements keep the design balanced. Fans are drawn to this pair because it connects Ja Morants rising influence with one of Nikes most iconic models. The use of denim adds character, making it stand out while still maintaining the familiar Air Force 1 shape. It feels like a fresh take that bridges performance inspiration with everyday wearability, appealing to both sneaker collectors and fans of the player. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Ja Morant Denim Light Armory Blue was released on April 10, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Lower Merion Aces Away (2026)
Description: The Nike Kobe 5 Protro Lower Merion Aces Away 2026 delivers the same iconic story in its full performance form, combining heritage with updated construction. Metallic silver dominates the upper, while team red and white accents provide contrast that ties back to Kobes high school team. The silhouette remains fast and responsive. This pair stands out because it balances legacy and performance. The Protro updates ensure it meets modern standards, while the design keeps the story intact. Fans of Kobes line appreciate how these releases continue to honor his journey while still delivering on court functionality. The Nike Kobe 5 Protro Lower Merion Aces Away 2026 was released on March 23, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: adidas SL 72 RS Blue Scarlet
Description: The adidas SL 72 RS Blue Scarlet features a sports-inspired design that draws elements from the adidas catalog. This iteration of the SL 72 features a tightly woven mesh base in blue with tonal suede heel and toe overlays. The texturized leather tongue is blue and showcases retro "adidas" lettering and a trefoil in white. Enhancing the sporty look, additional white accents can be found on the laces, the leather heel mustache, and the serrated 3-Stripes logo. Layers of foam in blue and red form the EVA midsole, adding a heritage detail that complements the metallic "adidas SL-72" branding on the outer side panel. Our experts at StockX like the blue adidas trefoils and lettering that form a repeating pattern on the white insole. These details add a modern touch to the sneakers retro design. The adidas SL 72 RS Blue Scarlet was released on March 28, 2024, and sold for $100.

Display Name: Vans OTW Old Skool 36 Pearlized Pack Pink Black
Description: Vans OTW Old Skool 36 Pearlized Pack Pink Black takes the foundational Vans Old Skool silhouette and turns it into a celebration of texture and contrast, pairing a pearlized pink finish with classic black elements for a look that feels bold yet refined. The Old Skools iconic side stripe and low top profile provide a familiar canvas, while the pearlized detail gives it an elevated feel that appeals to both skate and lifestyle fans. This pack resonates with collectors because it blends the everyday wearability of Vans with a design that feels special enough to stand out in any rotation. The pink and black combination offers playful contrast without complexity, creating a piece that looks intentional and cohesive whether worn or displayed. The Vans OTW Old Skool 36 Pearlized Pack Pink Black was released on 11/18/2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Cloud White Collegiate Green
Description: The adidas Samba OG Cloud White Collegiate Green Clear Granite delivers a crisp update to the terrace icon with a Cloud White base accented by Collegiate Green stripes and subtle Clear Granite touches. The smooth leather upper keeps the look sharp and classic, while the green detailing channels vintage football energy that feels instantly familiar. Its slim profile and T toe remain untouched, preserving the silhouette that has defined indoor style for decades. This colorway resonates because it leans into tradition without feeling dated. The white and green pairing has long been tied to sport heritage, giving the shoe an authentic presence that works across generations. Fans of the Samba OG appreciate when adidas refreshes the model through refined color placement rather than structural change. It is a versatile, everyday pair that quietly reinforces why the Samba remains a cornerstone of casual culture. The adidas Samba OG Cloud White Collegiate Green Clear Granite was released on November 24, 2024 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Wave Runner
Description: The Yeezy 700 Boost Wave Runner is the shoe that led Yeezy's pivot from a sleek, minimal aesthetic to a chunky, 90s inspired one. This was the gateway sneaker between knit runners like the 350 and the grungy skate look of the 550. The Yeezy 700 Wave Runner features a grey mesh and leather upper with black suede overlays and teal mesh underlays. At the base, a thick Boost sole and contrasting hits of orange complete the design. The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Wave Runner originally released in November of 2017, and most recently re-released in March of 2022 for a retail price of $300.

Display Name: Converse SHAI 001 Ares Gray
Description: The Converse SHAI 001 Ares Gray reflects Shai Gilgeous Alexanders calm dominance and modern sensibility through a muted and confident colorway. The Ares Gray execution strips the silhouette down to essentials, letting shape, texture, and proportion take priority over loud branding. It feels composed and intentional, mirroring Shais controlled approach to the game and his growing influence in basketball culture. Fans love this pair because it feels thoughtful and authentic. The SHAI 001 silhouette blends performance inspiration with lifestyle versatility, making it easy to wear on and off the court. Collectors appreciate how this colorway reinforces the idea of a signature line built on identity rather than spectacle. It feels like a foundation piece, designed to age well and represent Shais voice with clarity and confidence. The Converse SHAI 001 Ares Gray was released on January 22, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: adidas Stan Smith Freizeit SpongeBob SquarePants
Description: The adidas Stan Smith Freizeit SpongeBob SquarePants transforms a tennis icon into a playful piece of pop culture by celebrating one of animations most beloved characters. The Stan Smith silhouette provides a clean and familiar canvas, while the SpongeBob theme adds personality and humor that feels lighthearted rather than overdone. It balances nostalgia and simplicity in a way that feels genuine and approachable. Collectors love this release because it leans into joy and storytelling. The Stan Smiths minimal design allows the character inspiration to shine without overwhelming the shoe, making it wearable as well as collectible. Fans of SpongeBob appreciate how the collaboration feels respectful and fun, turning a classic adidas staple into something that sparks smiles and conversation while still fitting naturally into everyday rotation. The adidas Stan Smith Freizeit SpongeBob SquarePants was released on December 10, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: adidas Achille SPZL Liam Gallagher Stone Khaki
Description: The adidas Achille SPZL Liam Gallagher Stone Khaki feels like a natural extension of terrace culture, rooted in adidas history and shaped by Liam Gallaghers unmistakable sense of style. The Achille SPZL silhouette leans into classic football training aesthetics, with a low profile shape and understated construction that rewards restraint over flash. The stone khaki palette reinforces that attitude, giving the shoe a worn in, everyday feel that longtime SPZL fans recognize as authentic rather than styled for effect. What makes this pair special is how effortlessly it fits into the broader SPZL story. Every detail feels intentional, from the clean lines to the muted tones that make the shoe endlessly wearable. Fans of Liam Gallagher appreciate how this release reflects his long standing relationship with adidas, built on loyalty, cultural consistency, and timeless sportswear rather than trends. It is a sneaker people love because it feels honest, grounded, and deeply connected to British music and football culture. The adidas Achille SPZL Liam Gallagher Stone Khaki was released on September 9, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Dn White Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Air Max Dn White Metallic Silver is a sleek shoe with a futuristic design, featuring the newest version of Air Max technology. The White Metallic Silver Nike Air Max Dn has an upper made of white mesh for breathability. A raised haptic pattern appears in curves across the upper, giving it a textured look. A small Nike Swoosh sits at the bottom of the laces on top of the toebox. White film forms the mudguard, which rounds out the shoe, and the arches are supported and bear small white Nike Swooshes. The gray heel area has Air Max Dn branding, as does the tongue. The shoe sits on a white midsole, and under the heel you can find four transparent Air Max Dn tubes for support and cushioning. The outsole is gray. What stands out most about this sneaker are the subtle branding elements, which let the futuristic design speak for itself. The Nike Air Max Dn White Metallic Silver was released on May 3, 2024, for $160.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Kool-Aid (GS)
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Kool-Aid in Grade School sizing is a youth colorway of Ja Morant's third signature Nike Basketball shoe, applying the Lemon Venom, Deep Royal Blue, Light Green Spark, and Light Photo Blue palette to the Ja 3's performance basketball platform in a vivid, summer-coded color combination that references the bright saturated colors of the Kool-Aid drink brand as the colorway's naming inspiration. The Ja 3 features Zoom Air cushioning, a lightweight knit and synthetic upper designed for the quick, dynamic movement style that defines Morant's attacking guard play, a low-profile construction for ground feel and court responsiveness, and the traction pattern optimized for the directional changes that perimeter players execute during both offensive creation and defensive recovery. The Grade School sizing makes the Kool-Aid colorway the youth-specific version of this release, positioned for young players who wear Ja Morant's shoes for both the on-court performance benefits and the cultural affiliation with one of the NBA's most exciting and most visually expressive athletes. The Lemon Venom and Light Green Spark combination against Deep Royal Blue creates the most energetic and most seasonally appropriate colorway in the Ja 3's GS range, with the neon-warm yellow and green tones reading as ideal summer performance color choices. Released May 20, 2026 at $112 retail via nike.com and select Nike Basketball retailers in grade school sizing. The Nike Ja 3 Kool-Aid GS was released on May 20, 2026 with a retail price of $112.
Colorway: Lemon Venom/Deep Royal Blue/Light Green Spark/Light Photo Blue

Display Name: New Balance 530 Silver Cream
Description: The New Balance 530 Silver Cream was released in celebration of the brands 30th anniversary. This model has a cream-toned mesh base with silver and grey synthetic overlays. The "N" logos on the shoe quarters also comes in a silver hue with a black outline. Further branding includes the "NB" text on its padded tongue, also in a silver tone, and a 530 text on the shoe collar. The base is equipped with an ABZORB midsole that provides light cushioning, and completes its design. The New Balance 530 Silver Cream was released on the market on January 7th, 2023. It retailed at a price of $100.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro H-Town
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Canvas Football Blue reimagines a legendary silhouette through material experimentation and bold seasonal color. Canvas replaces traditional finishes across the upper, giving the shoe a textured and contemporary feel, while football blue accents bring energy and contrast. Metallic silver details add polish, balancing the softness of the canvas with a sense of structure and presence. This version stands out because it pushes the Jordan 11 into new territory without losing its identity. Fans appreciate the willingness to reinterpret such a sacred model through subtle innovation rather than dramatic change. The result feels fresh yet respectful, appealing to collectors who value evolution rooted in understanding. It captures the Jordan 11s ability to feel luxurious, expressive, and culturally relevant decades after its debut. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Canvas Football Blue was released on November 22, 2025 with a retail price of $250.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 12.1 Silver Burgundy
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 121 Silver Burgundy introduces bold contrast to a technical classic. Dressed in Pure Silver with Burgundy and Cream accents, the layered upper reflects the Kayano lines long standing commitment to stability and support. The sculpted midsole and visible Gel elements maintain the performance DNA that has defined the series for decades. Kayano releases often balance technical function with lifestyle appeal, and this colorway leans into that crossover. The silver base adds a modern edge, while burgundy detailing injects warmth and character. It feels expressive yet grounded, a strong entry in the ongoing evolution of ASICS flagship stability runner. The ASICS Gel Kayano 121 Silver Burgundy was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Bright Crimson Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Bright Crimson Metallic Silver delivers a bold and energetic take on a silhouette known for comfort and layering. Bright crimson dominates the upper, while metallic silver accents add contrast and highlight the detailed construction. Black elements ground the design and keep it structured. This pair stands out because it blends performance comfort with a strong visual presence. The Vomero 5 has become a favorite for its layered design, and this colorway amplifies that through vibrant tones. Fans appreciate how it offers both cushioning and standout style. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Bright Crimson Metallic Silver was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Rings Black Infrared
Description: The Jordan 6 Rings Black Infrared is a hybrid silhouette, borrowing styles from Jordan 6 through 12. The Jordan 6 Rings arrive in a black and infrared colorway encompassing the various elements in its build. The Jordan 6 Rings are predominantly black, covering the leather, shiny patent leather, and mesh. With the need to stand out from the AJ6, accents of infrared appear throughout the 6 Rings from the rubber outsole to the detailing. However, the embellishments, such as the Jumpman logo on the toe box and the tongue, take on a brighter red hue. While the Jordan 6 Rings Black Infrared is predominantly a lace-up sneaker, an ankle strip bearing Air Jordan inspiration is attached to the black eyestays. To wrap up the design, the Air Jordans have a Zoom Air unit that delivers a responsive feel underfoot. What is the standout feature of the Jordan 6 Rings Black Infrared? Of course, as our experts acknowledge, it is the infrared accents that punctuate the black leather upper. The resulting colorway creates an attention-grabbing style, especially when paired with any Essentials merchandise. The shoe was released on September 1, 2022, retailing for $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Mid Triple White (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Mid Triple White W was released as a women's sneaker as part of Nike's Air Force 1 line of sneakers. The Mid Triple White Nike Air Force 1 W features a white leather upper that is complemented by white accents throughout. It has a mid-cut design that provides ankle support, and the midsole features a foam sole with an encapsulated Air-Sole unit in the heel - providing cushioning and support with every step. The Nike Swoosh is embroidered on the strap and is also on the side. What we think is the standout feature of the Nike Air Force 1 Mid Triple White W is the versatility brought about by the color scheme. The all-white colorway ensures that it can be worn with a wide range of outfits, while the classic design ensures that it will never go out of style. The Nike Air Force 1 Mid Triple White W was released on January 1, 2021 at a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Birkenstock Arizona Birko-Flor Dark Brown
Description: Timeless comfort meets understated style in the Birkenstock Arizona Birko-Flor Dark Brown. This iconic double-strap sandal features a smooth, easy-care Birko-Flor upper with a soft backing thats gentle on the skin, rendered in a versatile dark brown that pairs effortlessly with denim, dresses, and relaxed tailoring. Two adjustable metal pin buckles allow a customized fit, while the classic silhouette nods to Birkenstocks heritage design. Underfoot, the brands renowned anatomically shaped cork-latex footbed delivers all-day support with a deep heel cup, pronounced arch support, and a roomy toe box that encourages natural movement. A suede footbed lining adds breathable comfort, and a lightweight EVA outsole provides flexible cushioning and reliable traction for city strolls, weekend errands, and warm-weather travel. Engineered for long-wear ease, the Arizona Birko-Flor balances durability and refinement in every detail. The resilient synthetic upper maintains its shape and color with minimal upkeep, and the contoured midsole gradually molds to your foot for a personalized feel. Subtle texture and the rich dark brown hue elevate casual looks, while the streamlined profile slips on and off with ease. Whether youre styling them with linen separates or a cozy knit and cropped trousers, these sandals bring a polished, laid-back finish that seamlessly transitions from day to night. With the perfect blend of form and function, the Arizona Birko-Flor stands out as a wardrobe essential for dependable comfort and everyday versatility. Our team thinks this product is great for effortless, supportive wear that looks refined from brunch to the boardwalk, thanks to adjustable straps, a contoured footbed, and a neutral colorway that complements nearly any outfit.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Dn Roam Black Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Air Max Dawn Forrest Gump in White, Photo Blue, Black, and Red brings one of cinema's most beloved running scenes into sneaker form, the colorway directly referencing the Nike Cortez that Tom Hanks wore during Forrest Gump's cross-country run and translating that color story onto a completely different but equally casual and approachable Air Max silhouette. White dominates the upper with photo blue, black, and red arriving through the branding, overlays, and detailing in proportions that feel immediately familiar to anyone who knows the original Cortez colorway the film made iconic. The Air Max Dawn's lower profile and relaxed construction suits the Forrest Gump narrative perfectly, the shoe feeling as uncomplicated and genuine as the character himself. Nike movie reference colorways work best when the connection between the source material and the shoe's personality feels earned rather than forced, and the Forrest Gump execution on the Air Max Dawn achieves exactly that. The color story reads as a vintage Americana palette that would work completely independently of the film reference, which is the hallmark of a well-executed pop culture colorway that functions as great design first and clever reference second. Photo blue's lightness against the white base creates the kind of clean and slightly nostalgic visual character that makes this shoe feel personal and approachable rather than loud or attention-seeking. The Nike Air Max Dawn Forrest Gump was released on April 8, 2022 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Easter (2022)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Easter (2022) features a Regal Pink Durabuck upper with light purple semi translucent TPU inserts and a puffed, metallic tongue. Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel nod to Jordan Brand's retro styling of Air Jordan 5s from the mid-2000s. From there, a light purple and white speckled midsole with a bright blue semi translucent outsole completes the design. The Air Jordan 5 Easter (2022) released in May of 2022 and retailed for $210.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Gore-Tex Protection Pack Slate Grey
Description: The New Balance 2002R Gore Tex Protection Pack Slate Grey Castlerock builds on the rugged identity of the Protection Pack with a weather ready upgrade that feels purpose driven from the ground up. The slate grey and castlerock palette leans into tonal layering, giving the jagged suede overlays a more understated but still textured presence. Combined with Gore Tex construction, the shoe feels equipped for unpredictable conditions while maintaining the signature deconstructed aesthetic that defines the series. Fans of the Protection Pack gravitate toward pairs like this because they balance visual edge with real functionality. The distressed look is not just for style, it reinforces the idea of durability and wear over time. With its muted colorway and technical backing, this version fits seamlessly into daily rotation while still offering something distinct for collectors who appreciate evolution within familiar silhouettes. The New Balance 2002R Gore Tex Protection Pack Slate Grey Castlerock was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Sail Soft Pearl (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Sail Soft Pearl Womens delivers a gentle and refined take on the Jordan 1 Low, using soft neutral tones to create a look that feels elegant and approachable. The sail upper provides a clean foundation, while soft pearl accents introduce warmth and subtle contrast that feels thoughtfully placed. Its a colorway that leans into calm confidence, designed to feel light and wearable without losing its Jordan identity. Fans love this pair because it shows how small color shifts can completely change the mood of a classic silhouette. The Jordan 1 Low remains instantly recognizable, but the soft palette gives it a more lifestyle driven personality that fits effortlessly into daily wear. Collectors appreciate it as a balanced release that blends sport heritage with modern femininity in a way that feels natural and enduring. The Air Jordan 1 Low Sail Soft Pearl Womens was released on July 14, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Deep Royal Blue Gum
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Deep Royal Blue Gum combines classic color blocking with a timeless outsole choice, creating a look that feels both familiar and refreshed. Deep royal blue overlays sit against a wolf grey and sail base, while the gum outsole adds warmth and a vintage touch that ties the design together. This pair stands out because it leans into proven elements without feeling repetitive. The Dunk Low thrives on combinations like this, where color and material work together to create something dependable and stylish. Fans appreciate how it balances heritage with everyday wearability. The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Deep Royal Blue Gum was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Scorpion FK Triple Black
Description: Dressed in an all-Black color scheme, the Nike Air Max Scorpion FK Triple Black is one of the market's Air Max Scorpion FK editions. The Triple Black Nike Air Max Scorpion FK sneaker showcases a sleek, all-black Flyknit upper that offers a sock-like fit, providing unparalleled comfort and flexibility. Its Triple Black colorway exudes a sophisticated and modern aesthetic, making it suitable for sports and casual wear and for versatile use. The sneakers upper also features a Nike Swoosh lacing system and the pull tab on the heel. Concluding the design is the durable rubber outsole with a patterned tread for traction and stability on various surfaces. What our experts think is the special feature of the Nike Air Max Scorpion FK Triple Black that debuted on the 8th of December 2022 with a recommended retail price of $250 is the iconic Air Max technology integrated into the midsole. It delivers superior cushioning and shock absorption, enhancing performance and reducing strain during wear.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 King of the Court (GS)
Description: The Nike Ja 3 King of the Court GS leans into dominance and confidence, using a darker and more aggressive color palette to emphasize Ja Morants on court presence. Black and white tones anchor the design, while bright crimson and cobalt bliss accents inject intensity that feels competitive and sharp. The Ja 3s low profile and quick look reinforce the idea of control and authority in motion. Fans love this release because it feels powerful. The King of the Court theme aligns perfectly with Jas fearless mentality, turning the shoe into a statement about leadership and confidence. Collectors appreciate how this colorway gives the Ja 3 a more serious tone, making it a favorite for players who want their footwear to reflect edge, focus, and competitive drive rather than flash alone. The Nike Ja 3 King of the Court GS was released on October 16, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Chicago Split
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Chicago Split boasts a fierce colorway combo of University Red, Black, Light Silver, and White. This sneaker dropped on July 14, 2023. Challenging conventional aesthetics, this Dunk Low model remixes a classic silhouette with a split color design, creating a bold contrast that demands attention. The upper features university red and white on the medial and lateral sides respectively, with light silver and black dressing the Swoosh logo lending the design its 'split' distinction. A clean white midsole offset the strong, contrasting colors, and a black and white outsole completes the design. The Nike Dunk Low Chicago Split hit the shelves on July 14, 2023, at a retail price of $110.

Model: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low
Display Name: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low Red
Description: The Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Hank OG Sole Canvas Low in Red is a striking example of contemporary luxury footwear. This low-top sneaker showcases the brand's signature aesthetic, blending classic canvas construction with innovative design elements. The vibrant red colorway makes a bold statement, while the distinctive OG sole adds a unique twist to the silhouette. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, these shoes exemplify the high-quality craftsmanship Maison Mihara Yasuhiro is known for. Featuring a durable canvas upper, these sneakers offer both style and practicality. The OG sole design not only provides excellent traction but also adds a visually intriguing element to the overall look. With their versatile low-top profile, these shoes can effortlessly complement a wide range of outfits, from casual to more refined ensembles. We at StockX believe this product is great for fashion-forward individuals seeking a standout sneaker that combines comfort, style, and artistic flair in one exceptional package.

Model: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B
Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B Pale Ivory
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B "Pale Ivory" brings effortless style and skate-focused function to a beloved silhouette. Dressed in a refined mix of Pale Ivory and Summit White with Copper Moon accents and black hits, this colorway balances clean neutrals with subtle contrast for versatile wear on and off the board. Premium suede and leather paneling provide a plush handfeel and long-lasting durability, while classic SB details, like the padded, mesh-backed tongue and supportive collar, lock in comfort for all-day sessions. Perforations at the toe help with breathability, and the Swoosh in Copper Moon adds a standout touch that catches light without overpowering the minimalist palette. Performance is at the core of the Dunk Low Pro B, Style HJ0367-100. A responsive insole with Nike cushioning absorbs impact on landings, and the flexible cupsole delivers excellent boardfeel without sacrificing protection. The grippy rubber outsole, complete with the SB-modified tread pattern, bites into decks and pavement for reliable traction in varied conditions. Reinforced stitching in high-wear zones and a sturdy overlay at the ollie area extend the life of the shoe, while the classic Dunk profile makes it a go-to for streetwear rotation. Whether youre stacking clips or keeping it casual, this May 31, 2025 release pairs modern comfort with timeless SB heritage. Our team loves this product because it blends supple materials, dialed-in cushioning, and skate-ready traction with a crisp, everyday colorway that elevates any fit.

Display Name: Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Triple Black
Description: The Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Black features a black perforated tumbled leather reminiscent of the Air Jordan 14. Metallic mini Swoosh emblems at the toe and heel shine against a matte background. In addition to Air Max cushioning, G-TEK is also present in the sole, a technology found in the 1999 ACG Air Terra Humara. From there, NOCTA branding moments on the tongue and insole nod to Drake's Nike sublabel. The Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Black released in March of 2022 and retailed for $180.

Model: New Balance BB Hesi Low v2
Display Name: New Balance BB Hesi Low v2 White Grey
Description: The New Balance BB Hesi Low v2 in White and Grey is a basketball heritage silhouette that brings the second iteration of the Hesi Low platform to its most clean and universally wearable colorway expression, delivering the v2's refined construction and updated performance and lifestyle details in a white and grey combination that sits at the precise intersection of classic basketball court aesthetic and contemporary sneaker culture's ongoing appreciation for simple, well-proportioned, and technically credible footwear. The Hesi Low name references the hesitation move in basketball, one of the most fundamental and effective ball-handling techniques that creates separation and opportunity through pause and deception, and the shoe's design carries that athletic specificity through a basketball-rooted construction that maintains genuine court DNA alongside its considerable lifestyle credibility.
