The v2 designation signals meaningful refinements from the original Hesi Low platform based on the feedback and performance data that serious iterative sneaker development produces when a brand is genuinely committed to improving each successive version of a silhouette rather than simply refreshing the colorway and updating the season label. White and grey as the BB Hesi Low v2's colorway is the most fundamentally versatile and historically resonant combination available on a basketball-rooted low top silhouette, the clean white upper with grey accents and detailing creating a shoe that works across every casual and lifestyle context the New Balance customer inhabits while maintaining the technical and court-adjacent identity that makes the Hesi Low platform meaningful within the broader New Balance basketball heritage catalog. New Balance's basketball footwear resurgence has been one of the most discussed and appreciated developments in the sneaker market over the past several years, with the brand's willingness to invest seriously in basketball performance and lifestyle simultaneously creating a product category that rewards collectors who follow New Balance's most design-thoughtful and sport-historically aware releases with the same devotion they bring to the brand's most celebrated running and training platforms. At one hundred and ten dollars the BB Hesi Low v2 in white and grey delivers New Balance's basketball design intelligence and construction quality at an accessible price point that makes this a natural and immediately compelling daily wear acquisition for anyone who wants court heritage presence in their sneaker rotation without the premium tier investment that some basketball heritage platforms require. The New Balance BB Hesi Low v2 in White and Grey was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Cryoshot Tiempo Legend Ronaldinho Touch of Gold
Description: The Nike Cryoshot Tiempo Legend Ronaldinho Touch of Gold in White and Metallic Gold is a June 2026 release from Nike's Cryoshot program, converting the iconic Tiempo Legend into a street-ready sneaker that celebrates Ronaldinho's legendary Touch of Gold boots  the distinctive gold Tiempo cleats that became as visually inseparable from the Brazilian maestro's aesthetic identity as his playing style itself during his peak years at Barcelona and with the national team. The White and Metallic Gold execution is the most directly Ronaldinho-referential and most historically accurate expression of the Touch of Gold boot's visual identity, with the gold immediately evoking Ronaldinho's personal boot colorway in the same way the Cryoshot Mercurial R9 OG's Royal and Maize evokes Ronaldo's 1998 World Cup identity, making this pair and the Mercurial R9 OG a de facto dual tribute to Brazilian football's two most iconic footballers of the 1990s and 2000s era released together on the same day. Both Cryoshot pairs were shock-dropped in highly limited quantities via direct links on SNKRS on June 24, 2026, selling out almost immediately, with the Ronaldinho Touch of Gold Tiempo completing a release moment that positioned the 2026 FIFA World Cup as the launch moment for Nike's most ambitious football heritage lifestyle project. Released June 24, 2026 at $210 retail through Nike SNKRS in limited quantities. The Nike Cryoshot Tiempo Legend Ronaldinho Touch of Gold was released on June 24, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Model: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low
Display Name: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low Black
Description: The Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low Black is a sleek and stylish sneaker that combines classic design with modern flair. Made with high-quality canvas material, this shoe features a black colorway that is both versatile and timeless. The OG sole provides excellent traction and durability, making it perfect for everyday wear. This shoe was released on June 1st, 2022, and is available for purchase at a retail price of $200. Whether you're a sneakerhead or just looking for a comfortable and stylish shoe, the Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson OG Sole Canvas Low Black is a must-have addition to your collection.

Display Name: adidas Samba Jane Black White Gum (Women's)
Description: Blending terrace heritage with modern refinement, the adidas Samba Jane Black White Gum (Womens) reimagines an icon for everyday style. The Core Black/Carbon/Footwear White palette spotlights crisp serrated 3-Stripes and a clean heel tab, while the signature T?toe detail nods to the Sambas indoor soccer roots. A smooth leather upper paired with supportive overlays creates a sleek, low?profile look that slips effortlessly into any wardrobe, think tailored trousers, vintage denim, or a minimalist dress. Underfoot, the gum rubber outsole delivers that classic Samba grip and a timeless contrast, elevating the silhouette from casual staple to statement piece. Style ID JQ6445 and a June 1, 2025 release mark this pair as a fresh take on a perennial favorite. Thoughtfully designed for comfort and versatility, the Samba Jane features a comfortably cushioned footbed and a foot?hugging fit that keeps you moving from morning commute to late?night plans. The lightweight build and streamlined shape make it an easy go?to, whether youre dressing up a streetwear look or grounding a refined ensemble. Subtle Carbon accents add depth to the black upper, while the bright white branding pops just enough to keep the profile sharp. With its retro?sport DNA and fashion?forward polish, this womens adidas sneaker offers year?round wearability and endless styling potential. Our team loves this product because it pairs classic Samba traction and sleek leather craftsmanship with a versatile black-and-white look that elevates every outfit without sacrificing all?day comfort.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 450 Slide Cream
Description: Unveiled on August 3, 2023, the adidas Yeezy 450 Slide is the next evolution of the iconic Yeezy line, taking strides into new design territories. Defying traditional aesthetics, the Yeezy 450 Slide presents an unorthodox, avant-garde silhouette that instantly captures attention. Its meticulously engineered, one-piece design showcases an extraordinary visual dynamic. Crafted for comfort, the slides provide a snug, tailored fit for those who live life on the move. The adidas Yeezy 450 Slide dares to defy norms and set new trends. This model was released to the world on August 3, 2023, with an attainable retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Liberty London Pink Floral Gum (Women's)
Description: The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Liberty London Pink Floral Gum Womens delivers a delicate and expressive take on the silhouette through its soft floral detailing and refined color palette. The sand pink base creates a gentle and warm foundation, while Liberty London floral patterns add texture and visual depth across the design. Off white accents provide contrast, and the gum sole keeps the look grounded in adidas heritage. Fans of Liberty collaborations appreciate how intricate patterns bring a more artistic and feminine perspective to classic silhouettes. The combination of soft tones and detailed print makes it stand out while remaining wearable. It is a sneaker that reflects craftsmanship and expressive design within a timeless framework.

Display Name: Nike Mind 002 Black Hyper Crimson
Description: The Nike Mind 002 Black Hyper Crimson evolves the Mind concept with a bolder and more expressive approach, using high contrast color to energize a silhouette built for recovery and everyday movement. The black base keeps the design grounded, while hyper crimson accents inject urgency and confidence that make the slide feel active rather than passive. It reflects Nikes belief that rest and expression can coexist. Fans appreciate this release because it challenges expectations of what recovery footwear should look like. The Mind 002 feels intentional and forward thinking, appealing to people who value comfort but still want visual impact. Collectors see it as part of Nikes broader design evolution, where even the most minimal pieces carry strong identity and modern relevance. The Nike Mind 002 Black Hyper Crimson was released on February 5, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Cloud White Core Black (GS)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Cloud White Core Black (GS) is a grade school-sized version of the classic adidas Samba OG and comes in a neutral colorway of Cloud White, Core Black, and Gum. The sneaker boasts a full-grain leather upper in Cloud White with grey suede overlays. Like other Samba OG models, the Cloud White Core Black (GS) iteration features a prominent T-shaped overlay across the toe and the 3-stripes on the side panel. Metallic gold letters spell out "SAMBA" along the 3-stripes and add a pop of shimmer to the lateral side panel. In contrast, the simple adidas Trefoil can be found on the tongue tag. Our experts like the gum rubber outsole, which comes in a dark hue instead of the yellow tone more commonly associated with gum materials. The adidas Samba OG Cloud White Core Black (GS)was released on August 10th, 2023, and retailed at $80.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Triple Black
Description: The Nike VaporMax Plus Triple Black is a combination of the Air Max Plus series, which was released in 1998, and the VaporMax series. The Nike VaporMax Plus Triple Black has an upper construction of neoprene, true to the iconic look of the Nike Air Max Plus. The length of the Air Max sole extends through the entire sneaker. The tongue displays the Air Vapor Max Plus branding, and the VM logo is seen on the heel. The VM logo provides contrast through its yellow, white, and red colors. The heel is reminiscent of the Tuned Air Logo from 1998. Short white stripes run through the upper part of the Nike VaporMax complete the design. The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Triple Black released in January of 2018 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pine Green (2025)
Description: Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pine Green 2025 brings rich color to one of Nikes most futuristic basketball silhouettes, leaning into the Foamposite Pros sculptural strength. The Pine Green finish adds depth and character to the molded upper, highlighting the smooth curves that once felt years ahead of their time. It feels bold and confident, rooted in an era when Nike pushed form and material beyond convention. Collectors gravitate toward this release because it lets the shape speak. The restrained color choice allows the Foamposite Pros design to remain the focal point, reinforcing why the model still holds cultural weight decades later. It stands as a reminder of innovation driven design, appealing to fans who appreciate presence and history over trend cycles. The Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pine Green 2025 was released on 12/19/2025 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Bringback Pack Colombia
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Off White Earth Strata Gum Womens delivers a clean and neutral take on the iconic silhouette, blending off white and earth strata tones for a soft and wearable look. The gum sole anchors the design in its indoor roots, while the upper keeps things minimal and balanced. It feels like a refined version of a model that has always prioritized simplicity. Fans appreciate this colorway for its versatility and timeless appeal. The Spezial remains a go to for those who value understated design, and this version leans fully into that with a palette that works across seasons and styles. It is a pair that does not need bold elements to stand out, relying instead on consistency and clean execution. The adidas Handball Spezial Off White Earth Strata Gum Womens was released on November 29, 2024 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas Samba Ruffle Stripes Pack Wonder Mauve (Women's)
Description: adidas Samba Ruffle Stripes Pack Wonder Mauve Womens softens one of the most iconic silhouettes in footwear history through playful texture and fashion forward detail. The Wonder Mauve colorway adds warmth and personality, while the ruffled stripe treatment introduces movement and expression without overpowering the Sambas classic proportions. It feels romantic and modern, reinterpreting a heritage football shoe for contemporary lifestyle wear. Collectors gravitate toward this release because it shows how subtle design changes can create entirely new emotion. The familiar gum sole and low profile shape keep the shoe grounded, while the ruffle detail adds charm and individuality. It appeals to fans who love seeing timeless silhouettes evolve through material and mood rather than dramatic structural changes, proving the Sambas adaptability remains unmatched decades after its debut. The adidas Samba Ruffle Stripes Pack Wonder Mauve Womens was released on 07/01/2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: adidas XLG Runner Deluxe Grey Metallic Silver
Description: The adidas XLG Runner Deluxe Grey Metallic Silver brings exaggerated proportions to a sleek Grey and Metallic Silver palette that feels futuristic and bold. The sculpted midsole and layered upper amplify the silhouettes presence, while reflective silver accents add depth and movement across the design. The XLG platform pushes beyond traditional runner shapes, emphasizing volume and stance. This pair stands out because it leans into scale and shine. The metallic detailing catches light against the grey base, creating a dynamic contrast that elevates the performance inspired structure. Fans of modern runner aesthetics gravitate toward versions like this for their ability to merge comfort with statement design. It feels progressive and confident, offering a fresh perspective on everyday athletic footwear. The adidas XLG Runner Deluxe Grey Metallic Silver was released on January 15, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Reverse Grinch
Description: Step into the future while honoring a legend with the Nike Kobe 6 Protro Reverse Grinch. This long-awaited sneaker, flips the script on the iconic Grinch colorway. Boasting a Bright Crimson upper that mirrors the intensity of Kobe's game, this shoe is a standout piece in any collection. The snakeskin-textured upper, a nod to the Black Mamba himself, is complemented by black Swooshes and electrifying Electric Green accents. The Reverse Grinch doesn't just turn heads with its colorway; it pays homage to Kobe Bryant's enduring legacy. Electric Green laces and Kobe branding on the tongues and heels add to its unique charm. The midsole and heel counter, wrapped in Bright Crimson, maintain the shoes bold and cohesive look, ensuring it stands out on the court and in the streets. Set to release on December 16, 2023, for $190, the Nike Kobe 6 Protro Reverse Grinch is more than a sneakerit's a tribute to a basketball icon. With its vivid colors and sleek design, it's a must-have for sneakerheads and basketball fans alike.

Description: The Nike Air Max Moto 2K Mink Brown/Light Bone is a women's release from Nike's Air Max Moto 2K program, released January 28, 2026 at a retail price of $140 with style code IQ0278-214 in the Mink Brown/Light Bone/Phantom/Linen colorway, confirmed by the official Nike product page, Kicks on Fire, and eBay seller documentation. As confirmed by the official Nike.com product description, the Air Max Moto 2K features metallic accents complementing performance-inspired details and Max Air cushioning, an upper that mixes synthetic leather and textiles for a layered look built to last, a foam midsole, a rubber outsole for durable traction, and plush Max Air cushioning with just the right amount of support. The Nike Canada listing confirmed the Air Max Moto 2K is part of the Bowerman Series and fits small, with Nike recommending ordering half a size up. The Mink Brown/Light Bone/Phantom/Linen colorway balances earthy mink brown hues against subtle light bone accents, with phantom and linen as the complementary neutral tones completing the four-color autumn-toned palette that makes the Moto 2K Mink Brown the most broadly wearable and most versatile earth-tone women's execution in the Moto 2K multi-colorway program. All sales final. Retail price $140. The Nike Air Max Moto 2K Mink Brown/Light Bone Womens is the January 28, 2026 IQ0278-214 synthetic-leather-and-textile Max-Air-cushion foam-midsole rubber-outsole Bowerman-Series retro-runner women's Air Max Moto 2K for the Nike collector who wants the earthy mink brown and light bone four-tone neutral palette from the Nike Air Max Moto 2K women's program. The Nike Air Max Moto 2K Mink Brown/Light Bone Womens was released on January 28, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Photon Dust Black Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium in Photon Dust, Black, and Metallic Silver brings the Pegasus franchise's most elevated production tier to a colorway that balances running performance aesthetic with the kind of refined material and finish quality that justifies the Premium designation for daily training wearers and serious running collectors alike. Photon dust across the upper creates a clean and slightly luminous near-white base that reads as more sophisticated and material-aware than standard white, while black provides the structural definition and metallic silver delivers the premium finish accent that distinguishes this tier from standard seasonal Pegasus production. The Pegasus Premium's enhanced foam formulation and upper construction represent genuine upgrades over the standard platform, making this more than a colorway distinction within the family. The Pegasus has been Nike Running's most consistently trusted and broadly worn training platform for over four decades, and the Premium tier honors that legacy by delivering the silhouette's core performance credentials in a production quality that matches the most serious daily trainers' expectations of what a long-term running relationship with a shoe should feel like across hundreds of miles of consistent use. Photon dust and metallic silver create a colorway that transitions as naturally from track and road training into casual lifestyle contexts as the Pegasus platform itself transitions between performance and everyday wear, the refined palette never demanding outfit consideration from the wearer regardless of the context they take it into. At two hundred and ten dollars the Pegasus Premium in this colorway delivers the franchise's most complete version at a price that serious runners will find entirely justified. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium in Photon Dust, Black, and Metallic Silver was released on January 30, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Thunder Blue
Description: The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Thunder Blue delivers a sleek and futuristic take on one of Nikes most aggressive Air Max hybrids. The Thunder Blue upper deepens the VaporMax Plus attitude, giving the shoe a powerful and streamlined presence. The signature cage structure and visible Air units feel sculptural and bold, reinforcing the silhouettes reputation for standing out through form rather than subtlety. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it captures the VaporMax Plus at its most confident. The darker palette adds maturity without dulling the energy that defines the model. Fans love how it blends comfort and presence, making it feel equally suited for statement wear and everyday rotation. It represents Nikes ability to push design forward while still creating a sneaker that feels wearable, expressive, and rooted in Air Max culture. The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Thunder Blue was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Gucci Web Slide Black Rubber (Women's)
Description: The Gucci Web Slide Black Rubber (Women's) is a luxury slip-on sandal with a strap featuring Guccis signature house colors  red and green. Two straps reach from the heel to the forefoot, crisscrossing over the top of the foot. Each strap is made of flexible plastic and features three lines. The middle line is large and comes in red, while a green line can be found on either side. The placement of the straps creates a secure fit and prevents the heel from popping all the way out of the sandal. The slide boasts a black outsole made of durable plastic with light tread underfoot. The footbed is also black and conforms to the foot's natural arches. Our StockX experts like that Gucci is embossed into the footbed, but there are no branding details on the straps. The womens size Gucci Web Slide Black Rubber (Women's) was released on August 31st, 2022, and retailed at $450.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 Black Bright Crimson
Description: The Nike Shox R4 Black Bright Crimson is an athletic shoe with molded synthetic linear side panels on the upper in Black, paired with perforated Black fabric panels at the tip and heel collar. The Nike Swoosh outline in Black accents the sides. The sole houses the open Shox support system and coordinates with the Black tread sole, while the tongue displays Nike Shox branding. American footwear brand Nike introduced the Shox series back in the early 2000s. Always pioneering footwear technology, the Shox R4 created a ripple of excitement when fans viewed its columnar sole structure, which distributes weight evenly and offers even more inner shoe visibility than predecessors like the Air Max series. In our opinion, the best feature of the Shox R4 is its all Black upper, which unifies its bold, attention-grabbing look. The Nike Shox R4 Black Bright Crimson released on January 21, 2025, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Jade Horizon Fir
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Jade Horizon/Fir is a January 15, 2026 release from Nike's Dunk Low SE program, retailing at $130 with style code IB6399-301 in the Jade Horizon/Fir/Summit White/Black colorway, confirmed by StockX, Sneaker News, and the official Nike.com product page. As confirmed by the official Nike product description and Blue and Cream's product overview, the Dunk Low Retro SE Jade Horizon/Fir features a suede and leather upper that softens and gains vintage character with wear, plush padding and a low-cut collar, a perforated toe box for breathability, a foam midsole offering lightweight responsive cushioning, and a rubber outsole with the classic pivot circle for durable traction and heritage style. Sneaker News confirmed the Dunk Low Jade Horizon retails for $130 and carries the SE designation noting its special edition status within the broader Dunk Low program. The Nike Dunk, originally introduced for college basketball courts during the 1985-86 season as part of the College Colors program, has evolved from on-court footwear into one of Nike's most culturally resonant lifestyle silhouettes over four decades. The Jade Horizon/Fir/Summit White/Black colorway applies the soft sage jade horizon as the base across the leather upper, with fir as the darker green overlay accent, summit white and black as the structural contrast tones, creating a cool forest-toned palette on the Dunk Low SE. Retail price $130. The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Jade Horizon/Fir is the January 15, 2026 IB6399-301 suede-and-leather perforated-toebox foam-midsole rubber-pivot-circle-outsole low-cut vintage-character Dunk Low SE for the Nike collector who wants the cool jade-horizon-and-fir forest-green two-tone colorway from the Nike Dunk Low Retro SE program. The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Jade Horizon/Fir was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Georgetown (2022)
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro Georgetown 2022 was made available in the signature colors of the Hoyas team. This Retro Air Jordan 6 legacy silhouette makes use of a gray suede upper with perforated detailing and a Huarache-like inner sleeve. Contrasting navy accents make their way to the heel tab, lace locks, and Jumpman branding hits embroidered on the tongue and back heel. The sneaker rests on a two-tone polyurethane midsole, featuring a visible Air-sole unit in the heel and a translucent rubber outsole underfoot. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Georgetown 2022 was released on the 3rd of September 2022 for an original price of $200.

Display Name: UGG Lowmel Sand (Women's)
Description: The UGG Lowmel Sand (Women's), in womens sizes, is a lace up casual shoe with a booty or sneaker style silhouette, crafted from ballistic canvas mesh and soft suede. American brand UGG's origin dates to Southern California in 1978. It was founded by Australian surfer Brian Smith and his partner Doug Jensen, who aimed to provide Americans with the comfortable sheepskin boots that had widely available in Australia. Since then, the brand has revolutionized comfort footwear styling, and has utilized renewable materials, such as rainwater-grown sugarcane instead of petroleum-based EVA. Sand and white plaid laces, made from recycled materials, add detail to the shoe's monochrome aesthetic. UGG branding appears on the tongue and outer heel. Our experts feel that the best feature of the Lowmel is its lace up silhouette, which offers the versatility to be worn for the elements or just for style. The UGG Lowmel Sand (Women's) released on August 1, 2023, and retailed for $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus SE Night Maroon Metallic Silver (Women's)
Description: Inspired by moody nights, the Nike Air Max Plus SE Night Maroon Metallic Silver (Women's) is a lifestyle sneaker born from the original 1998 running shoe of the same name. Once a performance shoe, but now altered for urban living, the new Air Max Plus sneakers are a retro-looking trainer designed for long use and incredible comfort. With cushioned Tuned Air units visible in the midsole, standing just got easier. The maroon colorways with reflective metallic silver accents brings a romantic, mysterious look to the shoe, while mesh uppers provide breathability. We love the wavey patterning of metallic silver stripes on the top of these women's Air Max Plus sneakers. The midsole and outsole designs are styled to be inspired by palm trees and the whales tail which was the signature of the original design. The Nike Air Max Plus SE Night Maroon Metallic Silver (Womens) was released on November 14, 2024, priced at $180 retail.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Premium White Lapis Total Orange
Description: The Nike Vomero Premium White Lapis Total Orange introduces a brighter contrast within the premium Vomero lineup, using a white lapis total orange palette that feels fresh and dynamic. The clean white base allows the lapis and orange accents to stand out, creating a design that feels both energetic and balanced. Fans appreciate how this version combines the comfort of the Vomero platform with a more expressive color story. The premium materials elevate the look, while the color placement keeps it visually engaging. It stands as a versatile option that still carries enough personality to separate it from more neutral releases. The Nike Vomero Premium White Lapis Total Orange was released with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Flat Pewter
Description: The Nike P-6000 Flat Pewter is a design inspired by the 2006 Nike Air Pegasus running shoe. This comfortable, supportive, breathable sneaker shoe aims for an early 2000's aesthetic. The Flat Pewter iteration of the Nike P-6000 sports of base of matte gray mesh overlaid with strips of white leather and metallic-looking synthetic material with hits of aqua-green TPU. Gray suede overlays cover the toe and heel. A Nike swoosh in white leather adorns the side panel while embroidered Nike swooshes grace the toe box and heel tab. The gray tongue features a silver tongue tag with Nike branding and the green insoles that match the TPU have Nike swooshes in black. What we enjoy most about this shoe is its dependable sole unit. The stacked foam midsole provides cushioning and impact absorption and rests atop a rubber outsole in black, green, and white that provides traction. The Nike P-6000 Flat Pewter was released on September 25, 2023, for a retail price of $120.
Material: Leather, Suede, Mesh, Synthetic, Rubber, Foam

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Silver Cloud Black
Description: The Salomon XT 6 Gore Tex Silver Cloud Black delivers sleek contrast through a weather ready silhouette. Silver Cloud brightens the upper with cool clarity, while black accents sharpen the structure. The Gore Tex construction ensures protection from the elements, maintaining Salomons reputation for technical performance. Its streamlined build balances rugged traction with urban edge. Fans appreciate how lighter tones modernize the XT 6 without losing its trail identity. The silver and black pairing feels crisp and adaptable across rotations. It merges functional innovation with street styling seamlessly. Clean and capable, this pair thrives in both city and outdoor environments. The Salomon XT 6 Gore Tex Silver Cloud Black was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: New Balance 530 Munsell White
Description: The New Balance 530 Munsell White arrives in a Munsell white and silver metallic colorway. The New Balance 530 Munsell White has an upper that is crafted from a blend of leather and synthetic materials, making it both durable and lightweight. The shoe features ABZORB cushioning in the midsole for reduced impact. The outsole is constructed from sturdy rubber, making it both grippy and stable. The shoe features "N" branding on the lateral sides and an "NB" logo on the tongue. The New Balance 530 Munsell White was made available on December 8th, 2020, and sold for a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low LE Triple White (GS)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low LE Triple White GS features triple white leather upper perforations on the toebox as well as two perforations under each Swoosh. The Swoosh and overlays are also white leather. The outsole is white with a concentric-circles pattern and stars in the rubber. The midsole is white with a hidden Air compartment. The midsole says "AIR" in white. A silver tab saying "AF1" is on the top of the white laces. This grade school-sized shoe, the Nike Air Force 1 Low LE Triple White GS, was released on April 13, 2021 at a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite One Copper (2024)
Description: The Nike Air Foamposite One Copper (2024) redefines boldness with its head-turning metallic copper upper contrasted by black accents. Originally launched in the late 90s, the Foamposite One was ahead of its time in both design and technology. This 2024 re-release is a nostalgic nod to the silhouette's history for todays sneaker lovers. The innovative molded Foamposite upper ensures durability and a futuristic aesthetic, while a carbon fiber midfoot shank offers unparalleled stability. Its sleek, glossy finish and performance-driven design make it an easy favorite for both collectors and athletes. Off-court, the sneaker's bold colorway guarantees it as a standout piece in any wardrobe. Retailing at $230 and released on December 4, 2024, the Nike Air Foamposite One Copper (2024) is an essential addition to any sneaker collection. Its metallic copper, black, and off noir tones symbolize a seamless blend of heritage and regal aesthetics.

Display Name: Timberland 6" Premium Waterproof Boot Dark Red Nubuck
Description: The Timberland 6 Premium Waterproof Boot Dark Red Nubuck delivers a bold reinterpretation of one of the most iconic boot silhouettes, using dark red nubuck to create a rich and standout look. The structure remains true to the original, built for durability and weather resistance while maintaining its recognizable shape. This pair stands out because it blends heritage with color expression. The deep red tone adds a new dimension to a classic design, making it feel fresh without losing its identity. Fans appreciate how it maintains Timberlands reputation for toughness while offering a more distinctive aesthetic. The Timberland 6 Premium Waterproof Boot Dark Red Nubuck was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '87 Safari Summit White Phantom (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 '87 Safari Summit White Phantom W is a sneaker design in women sizing that draws inspiration from the original Air Max 1, released in 1987. The upper of the Safari Summit White Phantom Nike Air Max 1 '87 W is made using a combination of leather, suede, and textile. The sneaker features a supportive heel cup, reinforced toe box, and the visible Air unit that provides cushioning and comfort with every step. We think that the standout feature of the Nike Air Max 1 '87 Safari Summit White Phantom W is the iconic speckled Safari print on the mudguard and heel, which is inspired by the original Air Max 1 released in 1987. The Summit White and Phantom colorway of the shoe, combined with the Safari print, creates a unique and eye-catching design. The Nike Air Max 1 '87 Safari Summit White Phantom W was released on March 3rd, 2023 at a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 SP HUF Pear Green (2024)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 SP HUF Pear Green (2024) is a "Special Project (SP)" sneaker, which means it was crafted in the Nike Lab using premium materials. This sneaker is also part of a collaboration between Nike and HUF, a streetwear label known for using marijuana leaf patterns and a signature green. As a nod to HUF, this running shoe features a greyscale colorway with pops of Pear on the Swoosh logos, the collar lining, part of the rubber outsole, the tongue's logo tag, and the "NIKE AIR" lettering on the heel. The upper is leather in Medium Grey with leather overlays in Anthracite and Flat Pewter. Visible Air Max units in the heel protect against impact, while the padded collar cushions the ankle. Our experts at StockX like the dual HUF and Air Max branding on the woven tongue tag. The Nike Air Max 1 SP HUF Pear Green (2024) was launched on June 15, 2024, and sold for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Legend Blue
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid Legend Blue is a mid height basketball sneaker, featuring an upper in patent Legend Blue leather, accented by White overlays on the tip, lace panel, and heel. The Nike Swoosh accents the overlay construction in White, while the Jordan wings logo in Legend Blue appears on the outer heel. Finishing it off are the Jumpman logo on the tongue and the outsole, also in coordinating Legend Blue. American athletic wear brand Nike put itself on the map when it developed the Air Jordan 1 for NBA player Michael Jordan in 1984, going on to release the shoe to the public in 1985. The shoe was so successful that Jordan became a brand in its own right. The Jordan 1 Mid pays homage to Michael Jordans legacy, with its Legend Blue color story, the colors of his alma mater, the UNC Tar Heels. Our experts feel that the best feature of the Jordan 1 Mid Legend Blue is its patent finish leather, which makes the style pop. The Jordan 1 Mid Legend Blue released on November 1, 2024, and retailed at $135.

Display Name: Nike KD 4 NERF (2024)
Description: The Nike KD 4 NERF 2024 reintroduces one of the most hyped and beloved colorways in the KD line. Originally released in 2011, the NERF colorway features a playful and vibrant mix of concord, bright crimson, black, cool grey, and green strike, drawing inspiration from the nostalgic NERF toys. This re-release brings back the excitement and energy that surrounded its initial launch, making it a must-have for fans of the KD series and sneaker enthusiasts. The KD 4 is known for its lightweight and responsive design, perfect for dynamic players like Kevin Durant. The Hyperfuse construction provides breathability and durability, while the Adaptive Fit system ensures a snug and secure fit. The bold and colorful design of the NERF colorway adds a fun twist to this performance-driven sneaker, making it stand out both on and off the court. Released on August 9, 2024, the Nike KD 4 NERF retailed at $150. This concord, bright crimson, black, cool grey, and green strike colorway reaffirms the KD 4s place in sneaker history. Loved for its unique design and advanced technology, the KD 4 NERF continues to capture the hearts of basketball fans and fashion-forward individuals.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Racing Pack Black University Red
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Racing Pack Black University Red channels motorsport energy through a sharp and high contrast palette. Black dominates the upper, creating a sleek backdrop for University Red accents that cut through with intensity. White and Smoke Grey details add definition, emphasizing the layered construction that defines the model. Racing inspired colorways naturally complement the Air Max 95 aggressive design language. The black and red pairing feels fast and focused, echoing performance themes that align with the visible Air cushioning and sculpted midsole. Fans of bold yet classic combinations will appreciate how this pack keeps the silhouette dramatic without straying from its heritage roots. The Nike Air Max 95 Racing Pack Black University Red was released on December 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus Black Anthracite delivers a more understated take on the silhouette, using a dark and tonal palette to emphasize structure and form. Black dominates the upper, while anthracite adds depth and subtle variation that keeps the design from feeling flat. This pair stands out because of its versatility. It maintains the comfort and cushioning expected from the Vomero line while offering a colorway that fits easily into everyday wear. Fans appreciate how it balances performance with a clean and minimal aesthetic. The Nike Vomero Plus Black Anthracite was released on February 25, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Washed Pink (Women's)
Description: Jordan Brand is giving this Jordan 1 release to the ladies, with the womens-exclusive Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Washed Pink. ?? ?The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Washed Pink is constructed using pink suede and white leather across the uppers, with muslin and sail accents around the collar and midsole to help give the sneaker a vintage themed look. White laces tie the sneaker together over the muslin colored tongue. ? ?The womens-exclusive Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Washed Pink released April 22, 2023, with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro UNC University Blue
Description: Michael Jordan is paying homage to his alma mater, The University of North Carolina, with the release of the Air Jordan 5 Retro UNC University Blue. The Jordan 5 UNC comes in the Tar Heels signature University Blue across the uppers and is dressed with University Blue laces, and lace locks. A black midsole with white and University Blue detailing separates the translucent blue outsole from the suede uppers. The sneakers are topped off with a silver reflective 3M tongue with a black jumpman logo. The Air Jordan 5 Retro UNC University Blue released March 5, 2023, with a retail price of $225.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Bred Twist
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid Bred Twist delivers a bold reinterpretation of one of the most iconic color stories in Jordan history through a mix of familiar tones and updated detailing. The black upper sets a strong foundation, while varsity red accents bring energy and heritage influence tied to the original Bred theme. Summit white elements add contrast that sharpens the overall design. Fans of Bred colorways appreciate how variations like this keep the legacy alive while introducing subtle changes in execution. The balance between classic inspiration and modern updates gives it a fresh but recognizable feel. It is a sneaker that reflects heritage, identity, and evolution within the Jordan lineup. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Bred Twist was released on December 20, 2024 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: On Running Cloud 6 Waterproof All Black
Description: The On Running Cloud 6 Waterproof All Black brings performance driven design into a sleek and weather ready format, using an all black colorway that keeps the look streamlined and versatile. The silhouette focuses on comfort and cushioning, while the waterproof construction adds practicality for changing conditions. On continues to build its reputation through lightweight and responsive designs, and this model reflects that approach. Fans of the brand appreciate how shoes like this balance function with everyday wearability. The all black palette makes it easy to integrate into different settings, while the performance features ensure it holds up in active use. It is a sneaker that blends reliability and simplicity, appealing to those who want comfort without sacrificing style. The On Running Cloud 6 Waterproof All Black was released on February 11, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Goadome Sail Cacao Wow Cow Print Pony Hair
Description: The Nike Air Max Goadome Sail Cacao Wow Cow Print Pony Hair turns the rugged boot inspired silhouette into a bold statement piece. Dressed in Sail and Cacao Wow with Black accents, the upper features cow print pony hair detailing that adds texture and contrast to the sturdy build. The thick sole and structured construction preserve the Goadomes durable identity. This edition pushes the model into expressive territory, blending outdoor toughness with fashion forward materials. The mix of neutral sail tones and rich brown hues keeps the look grounded despite the eye catching print. It feels unapologetic and distinctive, offering a cold weather staple with added personality. The Nike Air Max Goadome Sail Cacao Wow Cow Print Pony Hair was released on December 11, 2025 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Playoffs Bred (2019) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Playoffs 2019 for Grade School (GS) uses the classic Black/White/Varsity Red bred colorway introduced in 1996. The patent leather mudguard, nylon mesh upper, tongue, webbed eyestays, and rope-like laces are black. A white Nike Air logo and swoosh appear on the black insole. The black leather collar features a red-stitched Jumpman and a white 23. A black Jumpman is visible through the translucent red rubber outsole with spots of black chevrons. A carbon-fiber midfoot shank in black and gray checks enhances the white midsole. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Playoffs 2019 GS sneaker for kids was released on December 14, 2019, at a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver
Description: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver leans fully into early two thousands running aesthetics, turning technical design into everyday style. The metallic silver finish amplifies the Vomero 5s layered construction, giving it a sleek and almost industrial look that still feels light and wearable. It reflects a moment when performance runners became cultural staples far beyond the track. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it captures nostalgia without feeling dated. The complex upper and reflective tones create visual depth, while the silhouette remains comfortable and adaptable for daily wear. It stands as a reminder of Nikes ability to translate function into lasting lifestyle appeal through thoughtful design language. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver was released on 03/01/2023 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG PSG Paris Saint-Germain
Description: Celebrate one of Europe's iconic football clubs with the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG PSG Paris Saint-Germain model. It's a highly desirable model in this famous Jordan range. The construction is immaculate, offering both style and excellent durability. This special Air Jordan 1 version has an all-leather upper sail with a white basic shell color, creating a foundation for an off-noir black layer and Swoosh. Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Ghost Grey
Description: The Salomon XT-6 Ghost Grey is a performance sneaker that started as a trail shoe but has become a lifestyle staple for many wearers. This iteration of the Salomon XT-6 has an upper made mostly of Ghost Grey mesh for breathability and flexibility. Polyurethane overlays in different shades of grey cross the upper for support in key areas, zigzagging across the sides supporting the eyelets and forming the toe cap, mudguard, and heel area. Salomon branding is found on the lateral heel, while S-Lab XT-6 branding is found on the inner side. More lab branding is found on the lateral toe. A colorful Salomon branding strip runs down the middle of the tongue under the laces, and the laces themselves have a Quicklace fastener instead of being traditional tie laces. What we like best about this shoe is its monochrome look with different shades of grey, which allows the functionality and versatility of the shoe to stand out. The Salomon XT-6 Ghost Grey was released on March 21, 2024, at a price of $200.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low April Skateboards
Description: Strap in for a ride with the Nike SB Dunk Low April Skateboards, a sneaker thats as much about performance as it is about making a statement. The Turbo Green/Metallic Silver/Turbo Green colorway is a nod to the fearless energy of the skate parks. The design stays true to the SB Dunk Low's heritage, blending functionality with street-ready aesthetics. This sneaker brings a bold twist to the classic design, incorporating a color pop that stands out against the concrete playgrounds. It's built to withstand the scrapes and scratches of skate life, all while keeping your style on point. Priced at a cool $120, the April Skateboards edition is an affordable piece of skateboarding's rich culture. Set to drop on November 27, 2023. It's a colorway that represents more than just style. It's a testament to the skate scene's vibrant personality and a must-have for those who live to ride.

Display Name: adidas AE 2 Black White Red
Description: The adidas AE 2 Black White Red builds on Anthony Edwards growing signature legacy with a colorway that leans into classic basketball contrast and attitude. Black and white form a strong foundation, while red accents inject urgency and edge, giving the shoe a look that feels competitive and fearless. The AE 2 silhouette feels more mature and intentional, signaling growth while staying true to Edwards relentless style of play. Fans appreciate this release because it feels rooted in tradition while still looking forward. The color blocking recalls timeless basketball footwear, but the shape and execution keep it modern. Collectors love how the AE 2 continues to carve out its own identity, making this pair appealing to those who enjoy signature lines that evolve naturally rather than reinventing themselves every season. The adidas AE 2 Black White Red was released on October 4, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro White Court Purple
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro White Court Purple delivers a clean and focused take on one of Kobe Bryants most performance driven silhouettes. The white base gives the shoe a sharp and clinical feel, while court purple accents add just enough contrast to keep the look unmistakably Kobe. The EM construction keeps the profile light and responsive, reinforcing the models reputation for precision and speed. Fans love this pair because it feels pure. There is no extra narrative or seasonal theme, just a refined execution of a silhouette built for serious play. Collectors appreciate it as a modernized version of a respected classic, offering performance credibility and timeless color balance. It stands out as a Kobe release that prioritizes function, focus, and legacy all at once. The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro White Court Purple was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Black Gum
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Black Gum takes on an original 1979 silhouette.? ?? ?The upper of this Spezial sneaker is made of black suede with a white heel tab in smooth leather. A gum rubber outsole is for traction on hard courts.? ?? ?The adidas Handball Spezial Black Gum was first released on August 26th, 2020 for a retail price of $100.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Earth Strata Wonder White
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Earth Strata Wonder White continues the legacy of one of adidas most respected indoor silhouettes with a warm and grounded color palette. The earth strata tones bring a natural feel to the upper, while wonder white accents and a gum sole keep the design rooted in classic indoor style. It feels like a subtle evolution of a model that has remained consistent for decades. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it stays true to the DNA of the Spezial while introducing a slightly richer color story. The silhouette itself remains unchanged, which is part of its appeal, offering a reliable and recognizable look that works across different styles. It is a reminder that small updates can keep a classic feeling current. The adidas Handball Spezial Earth Strata Wonder White was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Roam Black Light Silver
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Roam Black Light Silver is a winterized version of the classic Vomero 5, designed for wet weather in urban environments. It boasts a monochrome colorway of white and black with greyscale accents. Black dominates the upper, while Light Silver and Jade Horizon cover the durable rubber outsole. Weatherized details include layers of suede and textile with a water-resistant finish and the rubber mudguard. Nike Zoom Air cushioning in the bulky midsole protects against impact stress on pavement and other city surfaces, while reflective detailing increases visibility in low lighting. The lace toggle allows for easy adjustments and provides for a secure fit. Finally, large pull tabs at the heel and tongue assist the wearer with putting on and removing the shoe. Our experts like that the Swoosh logo on the side panel is evenly divided between black and Light Silver. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Roam Black Light Silver was released on November 1, 2024, and retailed for $180.

Display Name: Nike Mind 002 Light Violet Ore (Women's)
Description: The Nike Mind 002 Light Violet Ore Womens explores futuristic design through a layered mix of Light Violet Ore and Purple Smoke. Hyper Crimson accents inject bursts of energy, while Metallic Cool Grey elements add a subtle technical sheen. The sculpted silhouette feels modern and expressive, standing apart from more traditional performance runners. Mind 002 leans into experimentation, balancing soft purple tones with sharp contrast details that give it depth. The color story feels confident and slightly unconventional, making it a strong statement piece for those who gravitate toward forward thinking footwear. For collectors who appreciate innovation in both palette and form, this release delivers personality without sacrificing wearability. The Nike Mind 002 Light Violet Ore Womens was released on January 8, 2026 with a retail price of $145.
Colorway: Light Violet Ore/Purple Smoke/Hyper Crimson/Metallic Cool Grey

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Black Toe (2025)
Description: The Jordan 1 Low SE Black Toe (2025) revives one of the most coveted color blockings in the Air Jordan lineage with a sleek, everyday-ready profile. Dressed in White/Black/Gym Red, this low-top balances crisp leather panels with the iconic Black Toe forefoot and a bold red heel for a look thats instantly recognizable from courtside to city streets. Perforations across the toe enhance airflow, while the padded collar and plush tongue deliver lasting comfort. Signature details, Jumpman branding on the tongue, classic Wings at the back, and contrast stitching, underscore its timeless appeal and make the IB8971-106 a standout in any rotation. Built for all-day wear, the Jordan 1 Low SE pairs a responsive Air-Sole unit with a durable rubber cupsole for support you can feel and traction you can trust. The low-cut silhouette offers easy versatility, sliding seamlessly from athletic-inspired outfits to elevated casual fits. Subtle texturing on the leather overlays adds depth, and the heritage pivot-circle outsole pattern grips with confidence whether youre on the move or taking it easy. With its April 12, 2025 release date, this Jordan 1 Low bridges retro basketball DNA and modern lifestyle comfort in a way that never goes out of style. Our team loves this product because it blends the iconic Black Toe look with everyday comfort, perfect for collectors seeking heritage flavor and for anyone who wants a versatile, high-impact sneaker that upgrades every outfit.

Display Name: New Balance 574 Triple Black
Description: The New Balance 574 Triple Black is an iteration of the New Balance 574 sneaker in a Core Black colorway. This sneaker features an all-Black upper made of a mesh base with suede overlays on the forefoot, mid-panel, and heel. The mesh material used on the vamp, tongue, and ankle collar is made of 100% recycled polyester. Smooth, reflective material in a contrasting dark tone highlights the N logo, upper eyestays, and heel tab. This shoe rests on a tonal ENCAP-cushioned midsole and a rubber outsole made of 5% recycled rubber. The New Balance 574 Triple Black (2022) was made available on January 13th, 2022. Initially, it retailed at $95.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Gum
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Gum offers a versatile, blacked-out look in a silhouette that seamlessly blends performance and lifestyle. Designed as a classic running shoe, it also functions as a dependable everyday sneaker, offering breathable comfort, durable construction, and all-day support. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 boasts retro design elements and combines them with modern sneaker tech. The upper is all black except the light bone signature Swooshes on the side panels and heel tab. Textures abound on this upper, which features mesh paneling for breathability and a 3D-printed heel counter with ventilation ports to keep things cool. A medium-brown gum rubber outsole adds a touch of flair, while reflective design details and black laces complete the look. Our experts think that the plastic caging on the side panels gives the Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Gum a unique vibe while adding support. Originally priced at $160 retail, this sneaker debuted on March 1, 2025.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Artisanal Team Red (GS)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Artisanal Team Red (GS) applies a retro-inspired colorway of crisp white and Team Red to the Jordan 1 Retro High silhouette. This high-top sneaker features a white leather base with color-blocking overlays and accents in Team Red. The front laces create a secure closure, while the padded, high-cut collar protects the ankle. Like other Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG models, the Artisanal Team Red version boasts perforations across the upper that allow the foot to breathe. In terms of branding, the tongue displays a white logo tag with NIKE AIR lettering in Team Red, and a white Air Jordan Wings logo is printed on the collar. The signature Swoosh logos come in Team Red and are crafted from premium leather. Our experts at StockX like the choice of Team Red on the rubber outsole because it completes the red-on-white aesthetic. The grade school-sized Jordan 1 Retro High OG Artisanal Team Red (GS) was released on April 27, 2024, and retailed at $140.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 White Vanilla Ice Plum
Description: The Salomon XT 6 White Vanilla Ice Plum blends elite trail running DNA with a fashion forward color palette that has made the XT 6 a modern icon far beyond the mountains. The crisp white base keeps the silhouette clean and technical, while vanilla ice and plum accents soften the look and add depth without disrupting its performance roots. Every panel feels purposeful, reflecting Salomons commitment to stability, protection, and endurance driven design. Fans love this pair because it moves effortlessly between worlds. The XT 6 is trusted for long distance performance, yet its layered construction and refined colors make it a staple in contemporary streetwear. Collectors appreciate how Salomon continues to evolve the model through color rather than compromise, keeping the shoe authentic while expanding its cultural reach. It feels confident, functional, and unmistakably Salomon in both look and intent. The Salomon XT 6 White Vanilla Ice Plum was released on June 28, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: New Balance 1000 Faded Black Electric Indigo
Description: The New Balance 1000 Faded Black/Electric Indigo is a February 27, 2026 release from New Balance's ongoing 1000 program, retailing at $150 with style code U10004WR, confirmed by StockX as a unisex sizing release with the Faded Black/Electric Indigo colorway. As confirmed by Limited EDT's detailed product description and GRAIL Store's colorway overview, the 1000 Faded Black Electric Indigo brings back the iconic 1999 model with the inverted mesh-and-overlay construction where mesh underlays emerge from beneath the more prominent synthetic overlay panels, creating the refined, tech-inspired look that defined the original 1000's futuristic aesthetic. The segmented sole features ABZORB cushioning at the heel and forefoot with a Stability Web midfoot shank for support, while GRAIL noted the Electric Indigo accent color adds reflective details and subtle branding that give the sneaker a modern edge fitting for the 2026 release. The Faded Black ground creates the washed, slightly weathered surface quality that makes the Electric Indigo accent pop with maximum contrast against the darkened base, producing the most visually distinctive and most collector-forward colorway execution of the U10004WR 1000 program. Retail price $150. The New Balance 1000 Faded Black/Electric Indigo is the February 27, 2026 unisex U10004WR inverted-mesh-overlay ABZORB-midsole Stability-Web-shank 1999-heritage 1000 silhouette for the New Balance collector who wants the washed faded black ground with electric indigo accent and reflective detail from the New Balance 1000 multi-colorway program. The New Balance 1000 Faded Black/Electric Indigo was released on February 27, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Racer Blue
Description: In a style similar to classic Jordan 5s of the past, the Air Jordan 5 Racer Blue features a black Durabuck upper with signature TPU netted inserts and a reflective padded tongue. At the base, Racer Blue accents pop against a black midsole and icy translucent sole. The Air Jordan 5 Racer Blue released in February of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Vintage Birch Cactus Green
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Vintage Birch Cactus Green combines classic design elements with updated features to create a trendy nod to its historical roots. This sneaker highlights a three-tone leather and suede upper to give a simple and fashionable kick that's as classical as it is modern. The Birch Cactus Green Mexico 66 Vintage by Onitsuka Tiger shows off a supple leather and suede upper in birch with contrasting cactus green Onitsuka Tiger stripes. Inspired by the 1960s LIMBER-UP training shoe, it features a low-profile shape and modern elements like an OrthoLite insole for added cushioning. The minimalist branding and textured outsole show off the brand's Japanese design ethos. As the experts, one thing we enjoy about the Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Vintage Birch Cactus Green is its OrthoLite cushioning for improved comfort. We also admire its rounded toe cap and low profile, reflecting 1960s style with a modern twist. This sneaker retailed at $130 when it debuted on the August 15, 2023.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low White Hyper Royal (2025)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low White Hyper Royal 2025 revisits a timeless varsity inspired color pairing. Featuring a crisp White base with Hyper Royal overlays, the upper emphasizes the straightforward color blocking that made the Dunk a collegiate staple. The low profile silhouette keeps the look clean and recognizable. Royal blue accents always bring strong contrast against white leather, creating a bold yet classic aesthetic. This 2025 iteration feels both nostalgic and fresh, reinforcing the Dunks place in modern rotations. It stands as a dependable and confident take on one of Nikes most enduring models. The Nike Dunk Low White Hyper Royal 2025 was released on October 24, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten White Black Gold
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten White Black Gold fuses innovation with heritage in its bold colorway and classic low-profile silhouette. It's a stylish shoe made from top-class materials. This continues the brand's reputation for creating elevated streetwear. These Onitsuka trainers have a pure leather upper with an off-white colorway. The hallmark Onitsuka stripe pattern flows across this in black. A metallic gold back heel tab adds just a touch of bling. A cushioned footbed assures comfort, and the rubber outsole is grippy and durable. Our reviewers love the simplicity of this shoe. It's pure distilled Onitsuka tech in a classy-looking casual trainer with the evergreen design of the famous court shoes of the 1980s. One appreciates the premium materials immediately on first wearing. This perfectly balances a sports-inspired sneaker and a stylish casual shoe. The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten White Black Gold was released on 1 August 2023, priced at $70.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Fresh Mint (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Wave Pack in Photon Dust, Photo Blue, and Cyber brings an aquatic and energy-forward color story to the Air Max 90's classic layered construction, pairing the cool neutrality of photon dust with the vivid contrast of cyber and the blue tones that give this pack its wave-inspired identity. The combination reads as both retro and futuristic simultaneously, which suits the Air Max 90's design biography as a silhouette that has always straddled the line between performance heritage and pop culture presence. Cyber's neon-adjacent brightness against the softer photon dust base creates a shoe that earns its place in the Wave Pack concept through genuine visual momentum. Air Max 90 colorways that commit to a bold color concept rather than hedging toward safe neutrals consistently generate the most lasting collector interest, and the Wave Pack execution is a strong example of that philosophy applied to a palette with real depth and seasonal specificity. Photo blue and cyber together create an energy that feels tied to summer water and light in a way that photon dust's neutral ground amplifies rather than dampens. The Air Max 90's classic overlapping leather and mesh panels show the Wave Pack colors at their best, the multi-material construction giving each shade a different surface texture to register across. The Nike Air Max 90 Wave Pack in Photon Dust, Photo Blue, and Cyber was released on August 15, 2024 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Drift Black Dusty Cactus
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Drift in Black and Dusty Cactus is a variation on the Air Max 90 platform that incorporates the Drift's specific construction modifications while delivering the silhouette's heritage design language in a colorway pairing that places the most serious and foundational base color against one of the most organically naturalistic and desert-adjacent accent tones in the current Nike seasonal palette. Dusty cactus sits in the warm and slightly muted green-adjacent range that references the specific color of desert vegetation, the dusty qualifier indicating a slightly faded and sun-bleached quality that gives the tone a worn and environmental character rather than the clean freshness of standard greens. Black and dusty cactus work together across the Drift's construction in a color relationship that feels simultaneously urban and outdoor, the dark authority of the black ground and the natural warmth of the cactus accent creating a shoe that transitions naturally between city and trail-adjacent contexts without any visual friction or styling recalculation required from the wearer. Air Max 90 Drift releases in dark and earth-tone color combinations consistently attract collectors who want the platform's construction evolution explored in colorways that suit the Drift's hybrid urban-outdoor positioning with genuine palette intelligence rather than defaulting to the brightest or most commercially obvious seasonal color choices. Black and dusty cactus is the combination that makes this Drift release most wearable and seasonally appropriate for the summer and transitional contexts where an outdoor-leaning air max platform earns its most consistent and satisfying daily rotation. At one hundred and fifty dollars the Air Max 90 Drift in Black and Dusty Cactus is a fairly priced and design-considered seasonal release that rewards the collector who appreciates specific and thoughtful color naming and palette research over generic seasonal color choices. The Nike Air Max 90 Drift in Black and Dusty Cactus was released on August 15, 2024 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas Karintha OG Wales Bonner Black White Lush Blue
Description: The adidas Karintha OG Wales Bonner Black White Lush Blue continues the refined partnership between adidas and Wales Bonner through a silhouette that feels deeply rooted in vintage sport and elevated craftsmanship. Wonder White and Core Black create a classic foundation, while Lush Blue accents introduce contrast that gives the shoe extra depth without overwhelming the design. Wales Bonner consistently approaches adidas collaborations through texture, proportion, and heritage storytelling, and the Karintha OG reflects that philosophy with a shape that feels archival yet fashion forward. Collectors care about Wales Bonner releases because they rarely feel disposable or trend dependent. Every collaboration carries intentional styling choices that pull from music, culture, and global sport history while maintaining a sense of quiet luxury. The Karintha OG stands out through its sleek profile and balanced palette, making it feel wearable while still distinct within the broader adidas catalog. Fans appreciate how the collaboration continues to reinterpret classic sportswear through a more tailored and thoughtful lens, creating sneakers that feel equally appropriate in fashion spaces, casual rotation, or carefully curated collections. The adidas Karintha OG Wales Bonner Black White Lush Blue was released on April 17, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Team Gold
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Team Gold arrives in a white, team gold-wolf grey-white color palette. The Low Team Gold Nike Dunk adopts a classic silhouette with an upper that is made of leather, which provides durability. The shoe's midsole is constructed from a supportive and cushioning foam material. The sneaker's outsole features a durable rubber material with a textured pattern that provides traction. The shoe features the Nike Swoosh on the lateral sides and "NIKE" branding on the heel. The Nike Dunk Low Team Gold was released on March 14, 2023, and was sold at a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Low CLOT Terra Blush
Description: Chinese brand CLOT continues its partnership with Nike and Jordan Brand with this Jordan 14 Low. This marks their fifth collab on a Jordan model, as CLOT uses Jordan Retro silhouettes as a canvas to share stories of Chinese culture and history. The Air Jordan 14 CLOT design is inspired by The Terracotta Army, clay warrior statues that protected Chinas Emperor at his burial in 213 B.C. The sneaker takes cues from the warriors color scheme, adding earthy tones to every part of the silhouette. The upper mimics the amour featured on each statue. Lastly, the heel features a red-stitched medallion, adding to its historic theme. The Air Jordan 14 CLOT released in February of 2021 for $200.

Display Name: Nike Roshe Run Black Anthracite Sail
Description: The Nike Roshe Run Black Anthracite Sail comes in a black/Anthracite-Sail colorway and features round laces, a lightweight rubber waffle outsole, and a pylon midsole. The Nike Roshe Run Black Anthracite Sail features an upper crafted from breathable woven material with woven side panels. A black padded waffle lining can be found around the heel and collar. Also, the sneaker displays a lightweight Solarsoft inner sole adorning a Volt footbed. Furthermore, breathable woven fabric is featured on the tongue with a Swoosh woven label and a nylon tape pull loop. The Nike Roshe Run Black Anthracite Sail was released on July 14th, 2012, at a retail price of $70.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low LE Black (GS)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low LE Black (2021) (GS) arrives in an all-black colorway. The Black Nike Air Force 1 Low LE (2021) (GS) has an upper that is crafted from leather - providing durability. The shoe is fitted with a lace-up closure system, ensuring a customizable and secure fit. The shoe also features perforations on the toe box, providing breathability and ventilation. The shoe's midsole is built with Nike's Air cushioning technology, providing impact reduction, responsive cushioning, and comfort. The shoe's outsole is made of durable rubber material, providing traction and stability. The sneaker has an "AIR" inscription on a metallic plate fitted on the laces and a Nike Swoosh on the lateral sides. What we like about the Nike Air Force 1 Low LE Black (2021) (GS) is its timeless and iconic design. The Air Force 1 is one of Nike's most iconic and enduring sneaker silhouettes, and the "Black 202" colorway adds a sleek and versatile option to the lineup. The grade schoolers sizing of the Nike Air Force 1 Low LE Black (2021) was released on March 18, 2021 and retailed for $90.

Display Name: Nike Shox TL Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Shox TL Metallic Silver elevates the iconic column cushioned silhouette with layered neutral contrast. Metallic Silver dominates the upper, accented by Wolf Grey and Anthracite panels that add depth and definition. Summit White details brighten key areas, creating balance across the bold structure. The full length Shox system remains the centerpiece, delivering both visual drama and responsive feel. Collectors drawn to tech inspired footwear will appreciate how silver tones amplify the models futuristic lines. The neutral palette keeps the dramatic cushioning wearable in everyday rotation. It reflects the Shox TLs enduring ability to stand out through design alone. Sleek and engineered, this pair embodies retro innovation with modern edge. The Nike Shox TL Metallic Silver was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Snakeskin Pink Quartz
Description: The Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Snakeskin Pink Quartz brings a bold and textured approach to the silhouette, reflecting Drakes influence through material and color. Pink quartz sets the tone with a soft but noticeable hue, while the snakeskin texture adds depth and a slightly exotic edge. White and gum elements help balance the design and keep it grounded. This pair stands out because it leans into statement design. The NOCTA line often explores different textures and finishes, and this version pushes that idea further with a distinct material choice. Fans appreciate how it feels both luxurious and unconventional, offering something that does not blend into the background. The Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Snakeskin Pink Quartz was released on May 15, 2023 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Racer Blue White
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Racer Blue White features a smooth Racer Blue leather upper with contrasting white leather overlays and Swooshes. A woven Nike tongue tag and heel embroidery nod to the original stylings of the 1985 Nike Dunk. At the base, a matching EVA foam sole completes the design. The Nike Dunk Low Racer Blue White released in 2022 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Cyber Metallic
Description: Fresh and futuristic, the adidas Harden Vol 9 Cyber Metallic sneaker is one slick-looking basketball shoe. Designed for the NBA star James Hardens line, this cutting-edge sneaker not only looks the part but is backed by high-performance features to optimize every second on the court. This champagne-colored metallic model of sneaker is one of adidas edgiest-looking designs to date. Modern and sleek, it has upper colorways combining metallic with black, ventilated cut-outs forming a snug boot fit that wraps around your foot. With minimal branding, the 3-Stripes sit subtly on the back heel, while a small embossed adidas logo sits on the front midsole. The side of the shoe has rising waves of midsoles that are cushioned with LIGHTBOOST. High-traction outsoles provide great courtside stability. These adidas basketball trainers are so futuristic in both look and technique, and if thats not enough, we also just love the cut-aways in the uppers, giving it a truly unique appearance. The adidas Harden Vol 9 Cyber Metallic is a responsive and explosive shoe that was released on 25 January 2025, priced at $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 180 Ultramarine (2024)
Description: The Nike Air Max 180 Ultramarine (2024) is a stunning reissue of the classic 1991 design by Tinker Hatfield. This sneaker features a white neoprene upper with suede overlays, highlighted by vibrant ultramarine blue and solar red accents. The signature exposed Air unit adds a futuristic touch, making this sneaker both a fashion statement and a functional piece of footwear. The bold color scheme and high-quality materials ensure that this sneaker stands out in any crowd. Since its introduction, the Air Max 180 has been celebrated for its revolutionary 180-degree Air unit, providing maximum comfort and cushioning. The Ultramarine colorway, one of the most iconic in the Air Max lineup, is known for its eye-catching design and vibrant colors. The 2024 re-release faithfully replicates the original, offering the same striking visuals and superior comfort. Priced at $150, the Nike Air Max 180 Ultramarine (2024) was released on May 24, 2024. This sneaker is not just a piece of athletic footwear but a piece of cultural history. The Ultramarine colorway brings a fresh yet nostalgic vibe, making it a must-have for sneaker collectors and fashion enthusiasts alike. Dont miss your chance to own this timeless classic and experience the perfect blend of style, comfort, and heritage.

Display Name: Nike KD 18 TB White
Description: The Nike KD 18 TB in Triple White delivers Kevin Durant's eighteenth signature shoe in the Team Bank configuration that brings Nike Basketball's most technically complete performance platform to on-court use contexts and accessible team acquisition at a price point that reflects the TB specification's practical and institutional purpose. White across the upper, midsole, and outsole creates the most clean and multipurpose court colorway available in the KD 18 family, the all-white execution making it as compatible with any team uniform color scheme as any basketball shoe can be while presenting the signature's design architecture in its most architectural and construction-focused expression. The KD 18's Zoom Air cushioning and forward-angled geometry reflect eighteen iterations of refinement built around Durant's unique combination of height, wingspan, and scoring versatility that demands specific performance characteristics from his footwear across every offensive and defensive situation the game creates. Kevin Durant signature shoes have maintained consistent collector and performance player enthusiasm across eighteen releases because each iteration reflects genuine design evolution driven by one of the most technically skilled and analytically focused players in NBA history, and the TB White colorway is the foundation-level expression of the KD 18 platform that allows the shoe's design and engineering to speak entirely through its construction rather than its color story. Triple white basketball shoes carry a specific and classic court aesthetic that connects the KD 18 TB to the long tradition of clean white performance footwear that has been as central to basketball's visual language as any other design element across the sport's history. At one hundred and fifty-five dollars the KD 18 TB White is one of the most accessible points of entry into the KD 18 platform family. The Nike KD 18 TB in White was released on July 29, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Cumulus 16 White
Description: The ASICS Gel Cumulus 16 White strips the silhouette down to its cleanest form, delivering an all white look that highlights the structure and layering of the design without distraction. The tonal build gives it a sharp and minimal presence, allowing the shape and paneling to stand out in a subtle way. It feels crisp and versatile, fitting easily into both performance and everyday settings. What makes this pair appealing is its simplicity and adaptability. The all white palette makes it easy to wear across different styles, while the Gel Cumulus foundation keeps it rooted in comfort and function. It is a straightforward release that focuses on clean execution rather than complexity. The ASICS Gel Cumulus 16 White was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike ZoomX Invincible Run 3 White Photon Dust
Description: The Nike ZoomX Invincible Run 3 White Photon Dust is a clean, minimalistic take on one of Nikes most cushioned and supportive running shoes. Dressed in a crisp colorway with various shades of white, this edition strips the silhouette down to its essentials. It transitions easily from run to rest day because of Nikes premium ZoomX foam midsole that provides an ultra-soft, responsive ride. The white Flyknit upper with a platinum tint offers lightweight breathability and a snug fit. Plenty of branding hits are seen with a photon dust Swoosh on the lateral side, and tonal white Swooshes on the heel and toe box. The thick, rocker-shaped midsole is also white and is decorated with a Zoom X rubberized patch on the medial back area. Our experts highlight the Nike ZoomX Invincible Run 3 White Photon Dusts standout feature as its incredibly lightweight responsiveness, made possible by the full-length ZoomX midsole that delivers plush cushioning with every stride. Originally released on December 10, 2023, this sneaker sold for $180 retail.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro El Vuelo Summit White
Description: Air Jordan 3 Retro El Grito Summit White celebrates culture and heritage through one of Jordan Brands most beloved silhouettes. El Grito themes bring meaning and pride into the design, using summit white as a clean base that allows details and symbolism to feel intentional rather than overstated. The Air Jordan 3s classic proportions give the story a strong foundation rooted in legacy. This pair resonates with collectors because it blends emotional storytelling with timeless design.
