The Jordan 3 has always been about balance and confidence, and this release reinforces that through thoughtful execution. It feels respectful and celebratory, appealing to fans who value Jordan releases that carry message and meaning alongside style. The Air Jordan 3 Retro El Grito Summit White was released on 09/20/2025 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Pure Silver (Women's)
Description: The ASICS Gel 1130 Cream Pure Silver W is a sleek and stylish running shoe that offers both comfort and performance. The shoe features a cream-colored upper with silver accents, giving it a clean and modern look. The Gel cushioning system provides excellent shock absorption, while the durable rubber outsole offers traction and stability on a variety of surfaces. The ASICS Gel 1130 Cream Pure Silver W is made with high-quality materials, including a breathable mesh upper and synthetic overlays for added support. The shoe also features a padded collar and tongue for added comfort, as well as a removable sockliner that can be replaced with custom orthotics. Released on September 1st, 2021, the ASICS Gel 1130 Cream Pure Silver W is priced at $70, making it an affordable option for runners of all levels. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just starting out, this shoe is sure to provide the support and comfort you need to reach your goals. Something we love about the ASICS Gel 1130 Cream Pure Silver W is its versatile design, which makes it a great choice for both running and everyday wear. Our experts think the best features of this shoe are its Gel cushioning system and durable rubber outsole, which provide excellent support and traction. Overall, we think the standout feature of the ASICS Gel 1130 Cream Pure Silver W is its combination of style and performance, making it a must-have for any runner's shoe collection.

Display Name: On Running Cloudtilt Pearl Ice
Description: The On Running Cloudtilt Pearl Ice delivers lightweight performance wrapped in a soft and modern palette. Pearl shapes the upper with clean brightness, while Ice accents add a cool tonal shift that enhances the streamlined silhouette. The sculpted sole unit emphasizes forward motion and cushioning, reflecting On Runnings focus on smooth transitions and everyday comfort. Its minimal design keeps the look refined without unnecessary distraction. Fans of versatile runners appreciate how light neutral tones elevate performance footwear beyond training sessions. The blend of pearl and icy blue feels fresh and adaptable, making it easy to integrate into daily rotation. It captures the balance between technical innovation and understated style seamlessly. Crisp and composed, this pair moves with quiet confidence. The On Running Cloudtilt Pearl Ice was released on January 9, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Model: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo
Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo JuJu Watkins
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo JuJu Watkins captures the fearless energy of one of the brightest rising stars in basketball. Coconut Milk lays a smooth base across the upper, while Amarillo accents inject bold contrast and Chrome detailing adds a sleek finish. The low cut silhouette stays quick and agile, built for sharp changes of direction and explosive play. The GT Cut line has become a favorite among hoopers who prioritize responsiveness and court feel, and tying it to JuJu Watkins feels like a natural fit. Her game is dynamic and confident, and this colorway reflects that same attitude without overcomplicating the design. For fans who follow the next generation of talent, this release blends performance innovation with star power in a way that feels authentic. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo JuJu Watkins was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus White Black Cool Grey
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus White Black Cool Grey delivers a clean and balanced look that highlights the silhouettes performance driven foundation. The white base keeps the design crisp, while black and Cool Grey accents add structure and contrast across the layered upper. Metallic Silver details introduce a subtle reflective element that enhances the overall finish without overpowering the palette. Fans of the Vomero line appreciate how it consistently blends comfort with everyday wearability. This version leans into that strength, offering a versatile colorway that fits easily into different rotations. It is a dependable option that maintains the models reputation for cushioning while presenting a refined and modern aesthetic. The Nike Vomero Plus White Black Cool Grey was released on March 16, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Palomino
Description: Redefining classic style with a fresh color twist, the Jordan 3 Retro Palomino dropped on July 29, 2023. The Retro Palomino shows off the enduring appeal of the Jordan line. It exhibits a superior blend of light Orewood Brown, metallic gold, light British Tan, and Palomino. This mix gives the sneaker an earthy touch, amped up with the luxury of metallic gold accents. The iconic silhouette stays true to the Jordan 3 model but carries a distinctive visual twist. The Jordan 3 Retro Palomino, a combination of retro charm and forward-looking design, was released on July 29, 2023, with a retail price of $200.
Colorway: Light Orewood Brown/Metallic Gold/Light British Tan/Palomino

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low LX Ja Morant Swarovski
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low LX Ja Morant Swarovski pushes the iconic silhouette into flashier territory with shimmering detail. A Black base anchors the design, while Metallic Silver and Cobalt Bliss accents amplify the visual impact. Swarovski embellishments elevate the upper, catching light and transforming the familiar AF1 shape into something far more expressive. Ja Morants fearless style on the court translates naturally into bold footwear choices, and pairing his name with Swarovski detailing feels unapologetic. The contrast between the classic basketball silhouette and high shine accents creates a striking balance. For collectors who appreciate statement versions of staple models, this pair stands out as one of the more daring interpretations of the Air Force 1. The Nike Air Force 1 Low LX Ja Morant Swarovski was released on February 12, 2026 with a retail price of $225.

Display Name: Nike Dunk High Australia
Description: The Nike Dunk High Australia arrives with a white and dark green smooth leather upper in a traditional two-tone color blocking style. Hits of yellow on the heel tab and woven tongue label add slight contrast. From there, a white and dark green Air Sole provides support and durability. The Nike Dunk High Australia released in 2022 and retailed for $110.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Restful Teal
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 White Restful Teal brings timeless 2000s running DNA into the present with a clean, modern palette. Crisp white mesh breathes easily, while sleek synthetic overlays in Restful Teal and neutral accents create layered depth that pairs effortlessly with joggers, denim, or tailored streetwear. Underfoot, signature GEL cushioning in the heel teams with a responsive EVA midsole to soften impact and deliver smooth transitions from commute to weekend miles. A supportive TRUSSTIC-inspired midfoot shank adds stability without extra weight, and the durable rubber outsole is mapped for confident traction on city sidewalks and gym floors alike. Designed to balance comfort and control, this model leans into the Gel-1130s heritage of dependable daily wear. The sculpted silhouette nods to retro performance runners, while a padded tongue and collar enhance step-in comfort for long days on your feet. Thoughtful details, subtle ASICS striping, a streamlined toe box, and the distinctive 1203A609-103 style code, underscore its refined build. Whether youre after a versatile lifestyle sneaker or a reliable training companion, the Gel-1130 White Restful Teal delivers a fresh, go-with-everything look backed by cushioning you can feel and support you can trust. Our team loves this product because it blends retro runner aesthetics with reliable GEL comfort, making it great for everyday wear, light workouts, and seamless rotation styling.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Smoke Grey Volt
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Smoke Grey Volt balances muted tones with electric highlights for a sharp and contemporary look. Smoke Grey and Dark Smoke Grey flow across the upper, creating depth through subtle gradient shifts. Volt detailing pops against the darker base, adding just enough brightness to keep the design dynamic. This combination showcases how the Air Max Plus can adapt to both understated and high energy aesthetics at once. The grey foundation makes it versatile, while the Volt accents preserve that signature Tuned Air boldness. Fans who appreciate wearable colorways with a hint of neon edge will find this release especially appealing. The Nike Air Max Plus Smoke Grey Volt was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Pure Platinum University Red Black White
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Pure Platinum University Red Black White delivers a crisp and high contrast take on the Air Max Plus by combining cool neutrals with classic Nike red accents. The pure platinum base sharpens the silhouette, while university red details add urgency and familiarity rooted in Nike heritage. It feels athletic and assertive, highlighting the Tuned Air structure and flowing cage lines with clarity. Fans love this pair because it feels timeless and powerful. The Air Max Plus thrives when bold color meets strong form, and this execution strikes that balance cleanly. Collectors appreciate it as a versatile statement sneaker, one that carries attitude without excess and fits naturally into rotation for those who want an Air Max that feels confident, structured, and unmistakably Nike. The Nike Air Max Plus Pure Platinum University Red Black White was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro Premium Philly
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro Premium Philly celebrates "the City of Brotherly Love" through details and colors that represent this storied city. Boasting a low-top silhouette with padding around the collar and in the tongue, this Nike Dunk Low Retro Premium features an upper crafted from tumbled leather in white with a combination of leather and suede overlays. The heel overlay comes in grey shaggy suede, while the leather forefoot overlay displays a grey, mottled pattern. In addition, the Swoosh logo is made from grey cracked leather with a multicolor mark on the medial side panel. The various greyscale tones remind the wearer of the color of concrete and other materials that make up Philadelphias urban landscape. Instead of "NIKE," the heel tab displays "PHILLY" in multicolor lettering, which matches the collar lining and the tongues logo tag. Our StockX experts like that the Kelly Green laces reveal Philadelphias geographical coordinates. The Nike Dunk Low Retro Premium Philly was released on May 30, 2024, and retailed at $135.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Murray State
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Murray State brings things back to Ja Morants roots, using a color palette that reflects his college journey. Pure platinum sets a clean base, while deep royal blue, lightening, and dusty cactus accents add depth and school inspired energy. The silhouette remains performance focused, built for speed and control. This version stands out because of its story. It connects directly to Jas path, giving the shoe a personal edge that goes beyond design. Fans appreciate releases like this because they represent milestones, turning the sneaker into a piece of that journey rather than just another colorway. The Nike Ja 3 Murray State was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Mind 002 Black Chrome (Women's)
Description: The Nike Mind 002 Black Chrome Womens introduces a sleek and futuristic look to the emerging lifestyle silhouette. Dressed in Black with Hyper Crimson and Chrome accents, the layered upper highlights sculpted lines and reflective detailing. The modern sole construction reinforces its forward thinking design language. This colorway leans into contrast, pairing dark tones with bright crimson hits for a dynamic finish. Chrome elements add a subtle metallic edge that elevates the overall aesthetic. It feels contemporary and expressive, signaling Nikes exploration of new lifestyle shapes. The Nike Mind 002 Black Chrome Womens was released on February 5, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Away
Description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Away is a bold new release that combines legendary performance with iconic Lakers flair. Featuring a sleek black engineered knit upper, this colorway brings the energy of a Lakers away game to the court. Gold embroidered Nike swooshes and Kobe Bryants signature in gold on the black heel clip add a touch of luxury, while the white outsole provides contrast against the black midsole. This Lakers-inspired colorway brings the competitive intensity of Kobe's road performances to life. As part of the Kobe Protro line, the Kobe 8 continues to offer cutting-edge technology while paying homage to one of the most beloved basketball sneakers ever made. The Protro updates include advanced cushioning and materials, making this sneaker a top choice for athletes and sneakerheads alike. The performance-driven design, combined with the sleek look of the Lakers Away colorway, makes this a standout addition to any Kobe collection. Released on September 6, 2024, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Away retailed at $190. The black, university gold, white, and court purple colorway pays tribute to the Lakers iconic uniforms. Whether on the court or in your rotation, this Kobe 8 Protro is a must-have for fans of the Black Mamba and basketball culture.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Cream Silver Clay Green
Description: The Nike P 6000 Cream Silver Clay Green introduces lighter tones into the layered runner silhouette for a fresh update. Cream II shapes the base, while Metallic Silver overlays reflect subtle shine across the upper. Clay Green accents add a soft earthy contrast, enhancing the dynamic panel layout. Anthracite touches ground the design with deeper definition. This release resonates with fans who enjoy neutral foundations elevated by texture and shine. The silver detailing brings modern edge, while the clay green keeps the look balanced and wearable. It captures the P 6000s retro roots through thoughtful color placement rather than bold graphics. Light, layered, and expressive, this pair stands out with quiet confidence. The Nike P 6000 Cream Silver Clay Green was released on September 26, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas BW Army White Night Indigo
Description: The adidas BW Army White Night Indigo delivers a clean and classic take on the silhouette through a high contrast combination of white and deep blue tones. The core white upper provides a bright and structured base, while night indigo accents add sharp contrast that highlights the design. The gum sole completes the look, reinforcing its heritage feel. Fans of classic adidas silhouettes appreciate how this colorway balances simplicity with strong visual clarity. The contrast between white and indigo makes it versatile while still distinct. It is a sneaker that reflects timeless styling and everyday wearability. The adidas BW Army White Night Indigo was released with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG Fear Nothing Pack
Description: The Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG Fear Nothing Pack brings a performance driven mindset to the pitch, combining a bold color palette with a silhouette built for precision and control. Racer blue dominates the upper, while dark obsidian accents add depth and contrast that emphasize the structure of the boot. This pair stands out because it reflects confidence and intent. The Fear Nothing theme ties directly into the mentality required at the highest level of play, making the design feel purposeful beyond its performance features. Fans appreciate how it delivers both function and identity in a way that feels cohesive. The Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG Fear Nothing Pack was released on June 23, 2025 with a retail price of $270.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Union Passport Pack Pistachio
Description: Drawing inspiration from passports and government documentation, the Nike Dunk Low Union Passport Pack Pistachio features a light green and navy leather upper that is shrouded in a semi-translucent ripstop nylon. A Walter Lee Young-inspired emblem at the heel and a yellow Union LA tab on the quarter panel adds a touch of customization. At the base, a semi-translucent sole completes the design. The Nike Dunk Low Union Passport Pack Pistachio released in February of 2022 and retailed for $150.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 3 Night Purple (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 3 Night Purple Womens wraps the performance silhouette in rich and moody tones. Night Purple dominates the upper, accented by Atomic Violet and Mint Foam details that add layered contrast. White elements keep the composition sharp, enhancing the sculpted lines of the design. The low stance reinforces agility and precision on hardwood. Fans who gravitate toward darker palettes will appreciate the depth created by the purple spectrum. The interplay of violet and mint keeps the look expressive without overpowering the structure. It captures a calm yet competitive presence that aligns with focused play. Refined and confident, this pair stands strong through tonal intensity. The Nike Sabrina 3 Night Purple Womens was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Silver Metallic Nightwatch Green
Description: Inspired by the running shoe aesthetic of the early 2000s, the New Balance 1906R Silver Metallic Nightwatch Green sneakers are a great lifestyle shoe designed for long-wear comfort, durability, and style. These New Balance sneakers are made with mesh for breathability and a lightweight step, making them perfect for long-wear jobs and light sports. With a white base, the silver overlays are durable and give the shoe a sheen, while the Nightwatch Green adds a sophisticated accent. The famous "N" logo sits on the outside of the shoe on both sides, while the 1906R branding sits on the back outside the heel of each sneaker. The midsole comprises N-ERGY cushioning ABZORB for a lighter, bouncy step, and the outsoles come standard with rubber for excellent traction. We love the busy colorways and overlays on this shoe, which give it a running shoe appearance despite being more for everyday use. The New Balance 1906R Silver Metallic Nightwatch Green was released on September 6, 2024, for $155.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL Chinese New Year Purple Burst
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL Chinese New Year Purple Burst delivers a festive and vibrant take on the silhouette through its bold and celebratory color palette. Clear grey sets a neutral base, while purple burst accents add energy and visual impact. Aurora onix tones provide balance, creating a layered and dynamic design that reflects the theme. Fans of themed releases appreciate how this pair captures cultural celebration through color and detail while maintaining performance focus. The combination of tones makes it visually striking without losing cohesion. It is a sneaker that blends storytelling with functionality in a modern and expressive way. The adidas Adizero Evo SL Chinese New Year Purple Burst was released on March 11, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas Campus 00s Core Black White
Description: The adidas Campus 00s Core Black White is an elegant, stealthy lifestyle shoe that originally debuted in the '80s but now rocks a Y2K retro vibe. The Core Black / Cloud White colorway of the adidas Campus 00s features an upper of black suede with a black suede overlay on the eye stays. The signature adidas three stripes are serrated black matte leather and feature white stitching that stands out. The heel tab is the same matte black leather with singular white stitching. adidas trefoil branding graces both the heel tab and the tongue tag. The lining is a black textile, and the laces and insole are also black. Campus branding appears along the top of the third side panel stripe. The aspect of this shoe our StockX experts enjoy the most is the unrelieved black of the sole unit. The foam midsole is black with tonal stitching, and it sits on top of a black rubber outsole with a herringbone traction pattern. The adidas Campus 00s Core Black White was released on December 22, 2023, for a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Silver Toe (Women's)
Description: Jordan Brand continued its "Black Toe" theme with the Air Jordan 1 Silver Toe (W). Arriving in womens sizing, the Silver Toe added a new look to Jordans ever-growing womens collection. The women's Jordan 1 Silver Toe (W) is a spinoff of the 2018 Jordan 1 High Gold Toe, replacing metallic gold patent leather construction with metallic silver crinkled leather. White and black leather comprise the mid-panel, toe guard, and Swoosh as a nod to other classic Black Toe designs. Nike Air branding on the tongue, an Air Jordan Wings logo on the ankle, and a white/black sole complete the design. The women's Air Jordan 1 Silver Toe (W) released in February of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: New Balance 471 Sézane
Description: The New Balance 471 Sezane blends vintage athletic cues with effortless Parisian styling through a warm Brown, Tan, and Blue palette. The streamlined upper leans into classic runner proportions, while the soft earth tones give it an elevated lifestyle feel. Blue accents add just enough contrast to keep the look dynamic without overpowering the understated base. Sezane collaborations are known for refined simplicity, and this 471 reflects that balance perfectly. It feels thoughtful and versatile, designed to complement relaxed tailoring as easily as denim. Fans of cross cultural partnerships will appreciate how this release merges New Balance performance roots with a distinctly European fashion sensibility. The New Balance 471 Sezane was released on October 16, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low There Skateboards
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low There Skateboards is a stylish collaboration between Nike SB and the California based skate brand, There Skateboards. Dressed in a sleek black, gorge green, and summit white colorway, this Dunk captures the essence of skate culture with its clean lines and minimalist approach. The collaboration reflects the shared values of craftsmanship and authenticity, making this release particularly special for fans of both brands. The Nike SB Dunk has always been a symbol of the intersection between skateboarding and street fashion, and this partnership with There Skateboards underscores that connection. The design includes premium materials like smooth leather and suede, giving the sneaker both durability and a refined edge. Subtle branding details like the There logo on the tongue and insole make this collaboration distinct while maintaining the timeless appeal of the SB Dunk. Released on August 6, 2024, the Nike SB Dunk Low There Skateboards retailed at $135. The black, gorge green, and summit white colorway offers a versatile yet stylish look thats perfect for skaters and collectors alike. Whether youre hitting the pavement or just looking to elevate your style, this Dunk offers the ideal mix of function and fashion.

Display Name: Nike Air More Uptempo Low Triple White
Description: The Nike Air More Uptempo Low Triple White reimagines one of Nikes most iconic basketball silhouettes in a clean, all-white colorway with a modern, low-cut twist. Staying true to the original design, the low-top Nike Air More Uptempo carries forward the bold attitude of the '90s Uptempo, now dressed in tonal white from upper to outsole. The upper is built with premium leather and mesh for durability and breathability. Oversized "AIR" branding dominates the side panels in classic puffy style, blending seamlessly into the midsole. Five visible Air units run the length of the white sole, delivering signature Nike cushioning with every step. Subtle Swoosh details appear on the tongue and heel, while pull tabs add utility. We think the standout feature of the Nike Air More Uptempo Low Triple White is how the exaggerated AIR lettering and full-length cushioning deliver bold nostalgia while keeping things fresh and functional. Released on January 13, 2025, this sneaker sold for $170 retail.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Preheat
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Preheat pushes the GT series forward with a more fluid and futuristic design language. Persian violet and glacier blue tones create a cool and dynamic palette, while chrome accents introduce a reflective edge that highlights the shoes structure. The silhouette feels fast even when standing still. This version stands out because it leans fully into modern performance design. The shape, materials, and color all work together to create something that feels engineered for movement. Fans of the GT line appreciate how each iteration evolves, and this pair continues that progression with a bold and expressive look. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Preheat was released on February 3, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Diamond Turf 49ers (2025)
Description: The Nike Air Diamond Turf 49ers (2025) brings back Deion Sanders' first signature sneaker, originally introduced in 1993, with a bold colorway that pays homage to his time with the San Francisco 49ers. This retro release stays true to the original design with its distinctive midfoot strap, crisp white leather upper, black nubuck overlays, and fire red accented on the Nike Swoosh, liner and parts of the oputsole creating a look thats both nostalgic and fresh. A bold and distinct colorway that nods to Sanders' legendary career and the 49ers' championship pedigree. Designed for versatility, the Air Diamond Turf was originally built to support Sanders' dual-sport dominance in both the NFL and MLB. The secure midfoot strap not only delivers standout style but also ensures a snug, comfortable fit. A cushioned midsole enhances support, while the durable rubber outsole offers dependable traction. The tongue and heel branding provide an extra layer of flair, making this sneaker a standout addition to any rotation. Released on January 24, 2025, the Nike Air Diamond Turf 49ers (2025) retailed for $150. Dressed in white, fire red, black, and metallic gold, this reissue celebrates both the sneaker's heritage and Deion Sanders impact on sports and fashion, making it an essential pick for collectors and fans alike.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 6 Black White
Description: The Nike Free Metcon 6 Black/White features an upper that combines breathable engineered mesh with durable overlays, creating a snug fit accentuated by Flywire cables for stability. The sneaker is a minimalistic black-and-white colorway, and has a black undersole contrasting with a sharp white midsole under an all-black upper. The white midsole of this Free Metcon 6 design by Nike is contrasted by crisp white Swooshes in a black boxing. Accents in the foam midsole provide texture, while the thick stitching detail of the panel on the upper adds to the sporty aesthetic. The sole includes a flexible forefoot and firm heel, reinforced with extra foam and a broad, flat heel. Our experts praise the Nike Free Metcon 6 Black/White sneaker for its support and lightweight feel, created by the foam sole area. The breathable mesh upper adds to the flexibility of the sneaker and adds comfort. Released on June 1st 2024, the sneaker retailed for $120.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 6 Black White (Women's)
Description: The Nike Free Metcon 6 Black White for women is a versatile training shoe that combines the flexibility of Nike Free technology with the stability of Metcon. This sleek black and white colorway offers a modern aesthetic suitable for both gym sessions and casual wear. The shoe features a breathable mesh upper with strategic reinforcements, providing durability and support during high-intensity workouts. Designed for multi-directional movements, the Free Metcon 6 incorporates a flexible forefoot and a stable heel. The Nike Free midsole allows for natural foot movement, while the Metcon-inspired heel delivers the stability needed for weightlifting and other strength training exercises. The rubber outsole offers excellent traction on various surfaces, making it ideal for both indoor and outdoor workouts. Our experts state this product is great for athletes and fitness enthusiasts who need a versatile shoe that can handle a wide range of training activities, from cardio to weightlifting.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Infrared (2020)
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Infrared returned in its original form to celebrate the models 30th Anniversary. While younger Air Max fans might refer to the silhouette as the Air Max 90 Infrared, (referencing its release in 1990), the original colorway was dubbed Hyvent Orange. How the name shifted over time cant be traced to one source directly, but its clear that the Infrared name stuck, and the rest is history. The Nike Air Max 90 Infrared arrives in a mix of white mesh, black leather, and grey suede with Infrared inserts on the midfoot, heel tab, and mudguard. A white Air bubble, classic Nike Air branding on the heel tab, and a black and Infrared sole complete the retro design. The Nike Air Max 90 Infrared released in November of 2020 and retailed for $140. Learn more about the history of the Air Max 90 Infrared here.

Display Name: Nike Pegasus Premium Playful Pink Hyper Pink (Women's)
Description: The Nike Pegasus Premium Playful Pink Hyper Pink Womens brings a vibrant and expressive color story to a performance driven silhouette through its bold use of pink tones. Playful pink and hyper pink dominate the upper, while metallic silver and bright crimson accents add contrast and energy. The design feels dynamic and modern, highlighting the structure of the shoe through color. Fans of the Pegasus line appreciate how it continues to evolve while maintaining its reputation for comfort and reliability. This version stands out for its confident color execution, making it a strong option for those who want a more expressive running shoe. It is a sneaker that blends performance with personality, offering both function and visual impact. The Nike Pegasus Premium Playful Pink Hyper Pink Womens was released on August 9, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Taxi (2025) (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro Taxi 2025 PS delivers a preschool sized version of one of the most beloved Jordan colorways ever. Featuring White and Black with bold Taxi yellow accents, the design keeps the iconic ribbed upper and distinctive mudguard that define the AJ12. Even in smaller sizing, the silhouette carries the same strong presence as the original. The Taxi colorway has long been tied to memorable moments in Jordan history, and bringing it back for younger fans keeps that legacy alive. The crisp white upper contrasts sharply with black and yellow detailing, creating a timeless look. It feels nostalgic yet fresh, a classic reborn for the next generation. The Air Jordan 12 Retro Taxi 2025 PS was released on November 8, 2025 with a retail price of $105.

Display Name: adidas Ultra Boost 5X Black
Description: The adidas Ultra Boost 5X Black pushes the Ultra Boost lineage into a more streamlined and performance focused direction while keeping the comfort driven identity that made the franchise globally popular. Dressed in Core Black with subtle Cloud White contrast, the shoe leans into a stealthier aesthetic that allows the sculpted tooling and knit upper construction to stand out naturally. adidas refined the silhouette with a lighter build and updated geometry, giving the 5X a faster and more responsive personality compared to earlier Ultra Boost generations that focused more heavily on lifestyle crossover appeal. Collectors and runners alike continue supporting the Ultra Boost line because it represents one of the defining shifts in modern footwear cushioning. The combination of Boost foam comfort and flexible knit construction helped shape an entire era of sneakers, and newer models like the 5X show how adidas keeps evolving that formula without abandoning what made the silhouette successful. The all black execution makes this pair especially wearable, fitting seamlessly into athletic rotation, travel wear, or everyday casual styling while still carrying recognizable adidas running DNA. The adidas Ultra Boost 5X Black was released on July 17, 2024 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Book 2 Sunburst
Description: The Nike Book 2 Sunburst is Devin Booker's second signature Nike Basketball shoe in a Phoenix Suns-inspired colorway, featuring a Court Purple mesh upper accented with Clay Orange on the gradient Swoosh, lace loops, tongue branding, and heel pull tabs, Platinum Violet inside the ankle collars, Sail on the midsole, and an icy translucent outsole with orange sunburst gradient stripes and streaking sun details underfoot, with the jersey number 1 printed on the tongue interior in the style of Phoenix Suns retro throwbacks from the franchise's classic era. Booker debuted the Sunburst PE during Phoenix's play-in run, giving the colorway visible on-court exposure before it transitioned to retail, and the Sunburst nickname references the Phoenix Suns' iconic sunburst logo and the purple-and-orange uniform identity from the franchise's 1990s era. The Book 2's performance platform features a Cushlon 3.0 midsole, forefoot Zoom Air unit that Nike relocated from the heel for improved court responsiveness, ZoomX cushioning, mesh upper construction, and a herringbone-inspired outsole, with the sleeker and lower-to-the-ground profile compared to Book 1 providing improved court feel and lateral stability for perimeter players. Released June 8, 2026 at $145 retail via nike.com, Foot Locker, Hibbett, and DSG with style code FZ7013-500. The Nike Book 2 Sunburst was released on June 8, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Wales Bonner Snakeskin
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Wales Bonner Snakeskin pushes the classic Gazelle silhouette further into luxury fashion territory through a textured reinterpretation that feels both vintage inspired and unapologetically bold. Grace Wales Bonner continues her celebrated partnership with adidas by layering exotic visual cues onto one of the brands most culturally important indoor football shoes. The Dusty Rust upper paired with Wonder White and Core Burgundy creates a warm and sophisticated palette, while the snakeskin treatment gives the shoe a dramatic presence that immediately separates it from traditional suede Gazelle releases. The result feels rooted in heritage while carrying the confidence of high fashion styling. Fans of Wales Bonner collaborations appreciate how each release introduces subtle but meaningful changes that completely shift the personality of familiar adidas classics. The Gazelle Indoor silhouette already holds deep connections to terrace culture, vintage sport style, and global streetwear history, and the snakeskin finish gives that legacy a more elevated and experimental edge. Collectors especially value the collaboration because it consistently merges craftsmanship, storytelling, and fashion credibility without sacrificing the wearable simplicity that makes adidas indoor models timeless. The textured finish and earthy tones make this pair feel especially distinctive within the broader Gazelle lineup. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Wales Bonner Snakeskin was released on April 17, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Jordan 7 Retro Cardinal (2022)
Description: The Air Jordan 7 Retro Cardinal 2022 has become part of the sports collection of the brand and is dressed in a white, cardinal red, black, and chutney color scheme. This high Air Jordan 7 sneaker features a white leather upper with hints of chutney on the heel pull tab and the Jumpman logo on the lateral ankle. Black and cardinal red are featured on the heel tab, midsole decoration, lining, and insole. The signature "23" branding on the heel counter, a black "Air Jordan" embroidery on the tongue, a black outsole, and a round toe box complete the design. The Air Jordan 7 Retro Cardinal 2022 was released on December 17th, 2022, retailing at $210.

Display Name: Puma Speedcat Ballet Whisp of Pink (Women's)
Description: The Puma Speedcat Ballet Whisp of Pink (Women's) is a womens sized silhouette that merges the sleek profile of a ballet flat with the iconic DNA of the Speedcat, thus redefining motorsport heritage with a feminine twist. Designed for everyday ease, this womens sizing Puma Speedcat Ballet is a fusion of performance influence and everyday elegance. This chic slip-on silhouette is crafted out of a soft suede upper in a Whisp Pink shade. White and Whisp Pink elastic cross-foot bands allow the foot to breathe. A white embroidered logo sits on the lateral toebox area, while a debossed puma is on the heel. Inspired by racing culture but made for the streets, the Speedcat Ballet sits on a grippy tire tread sole that nods to its fast-paced roots. We think that the standout feature of the low-profile Puma Speedcat Ballet Whisp of Pink (Women's) is how the white distinctive Formstrip is cut-out and embedded into the design for a modern, deconstructed look. When it was released on March 1, 2025, this shoe was originally priced at $80.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Black Gum Light Brown White
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Black Gum Light Brown White shows off a low?cut design in black leather panels, gum rubber outsole, with black suede overlays. The Black Gum Light Brown White Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 has perforations on the toe box to improve airflow. A gum rubber outsole wraps around a black foam midsole that's fitted with Nike Air cushioning. There are stitched white Swoosh logos on the lateral and medial panels. The raised cushioning and perforated toe box give you court?ready support, a subtle platform, and street?ready style. Here at StockX, a few things we love about the Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Black Gum Light Brown White are the plushy padded collar that cushions the step and the contrast between the black body and the white Swoosh logo. They retailed at $120 when it was released on the 27th of March, 2025.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Dark Cinder Mercurial Vapor 1
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Dark Cinder Mercurial Vapor 1 is a May 21, 2026 release from Nike's Air Max 90 Family Reunion collection, retailing at $150 with style code IR5903-010 in the Black/White/Gold Leaf/Pear/Black Tea/Blue Jay colorway. As confirmed by Sole Retriever's detailed colorway history, the Air Max 90 Korea Family Reunion draws direct inspiration from the Nike Mercurial Vapor 1 that Cristiano Ronaldo wore on August 14, 2002 when he made his professional debut for Sporting CP against Inter Milan, at 17 years old, in the Dark Cinder colorway, confirmed by Sneaker Bar Detroit as an extremely lightweight sneaker that used thin synthetic material instead of the industry standard kangaroo leather of its era. The Air Max 90 Family Reunion program, as described by Sole Retriever, applies the Air Max 90 canvas to colorways that honor the cities that made the shoe popular, and the Korea edition's six-tone Black/White/Gold Leaf/Pear/Black Tea/Blue Jay palette translates the Mercurial Vapor 1's Dark Cinder multi-tone construction into an Air Max 90 lifestyle context. The Air Max 90, designed by Tinker Hatfield and originally released in 1990, carries the signature Max Air heel unit, waffle outsole, and leather and mesh upper construction confirmed as the defining standard of the silhouette across its 35-year history. Retail price $150. The Nike Air Max 90 Dark Cinder Mercurial Vapor 1 is the May 21, 2026 IR5903-010 Family-Reunion Cristiano-Ronaldo-Sporting-CP-debut-inspired six-tone Black/Gold-Leaf/Pear/Black-Tea/Blue-Jay Max-Air-heel-unit lifestyle Air Max 90 for the Nike and football heritage collector who wants the Mercurial Vapor 1 Dark Cinder cultural reference translated onto the Air Max 90 silhouette. The Nike Air Max 90 Dark Cinder Mercurial Vapor 1 was released on May 21, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Gold
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 White Black Silver Gold revisits early two thousands running energy through bold contrast and metallic detail. White and black establish a familiar athletic base, while silver and gold accents introduce shine and depth across the layered upper. The ProGrid structure gives the silhouette presence, emphasizing performance heritage through visible form and proportion. Fans connect with this pair because it captures a specific era of technical design without softening its identity. The metallic details add personality while staying grounded in function, appealing to collectors who enjoy archival runners with character. It feels nostalgic yet wearable, offering a balance between sport history and modern styling. This release reinforces Sauconys strength in bringing authentic performance silhouettes into contemporary rotation without losing their original intent. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 White Black Silver Gold was released on April 13, 2023 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Silver Metallic Sea Salt
Description: The New Balance 1906R Silver Metallic Sea Salt adds a neutral colorway with metallic accents to the recognizable 1906R silhouette. Featuring a bulky construction and crisscrossing overlays, the New Balance 1906R Silver Metallic Sea Salt draws inspiration from early 2000s technical running shoes. However, the gentle colorway is a contemporary addition. The base features lightweight mesh in Sea Salt and synthetic leather overlays in Silver Metallic with reflective detailing. The ABZORB midsole and N-ergy cushioning provide stability and protect against impact. In addition, the Stability Web technology creates a supportive base for the runner. The laces come in Sea Salt and can be adjusted for a customizable fit. Our experts at StockX like the splash of black beneath the heel that breaks up the Sea Salt and tan tones on the midsole. The New Balance 1906R Silver Metallic Sea Salt was released on November 24, 2023, and retailed at $155.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Reverse Mocha
Description: Nodding to the Air Jordan 1 High Travis Scott Mocha, the Air Jordan 1 Low Travis Scott Reverse Mocha offers a similar Mocha and off-white palette but in a reverse-style color blocking. Its upper is constructed with a Mocha Durabuck base, white leather overlays, and signature reverse Swooshes. Hits of red on the Wings logo heel embroidery and woven tongue label gives a sharp contrast to the design's neutral look. From there, a yellowed Air sole adds a vintage feel. The Air Jordan 1 Low Travis Scott Reverse Mocha released in July of 2022 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Pro SB Black White Gum
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Pro SB Black White Gum is a sleek and stylish addition to the iconic SB Dunk line. Featuring a classic color combination, this shoe boasts a black leather upper with contrasting white accents on the Swoosh, heel tab, and midsole. The gum rubber outsole adds a touch of warmth and provides excellent traction, making it perfect for skateboarding or casual wear. Designed with both style and functionality in mind, the Nike Dunk Low Pro SB incorporates premium materials and advanced cushioning technology. The padded collar and tongue offer enhanced comfort and support, while the Zoom Air unit in the heel delivers responsive cushioning. The durable construction ensures long-lasting wear, whether you're hitting the skate park or navigating city streets. Us at StockX believe this product is great for skaters and sneaker enthusiasts alike, offering a versatile and timeless design that can elevate any outfit.

Display Name: On Running Cloud 6 All Black
Description: The On Running Cloud 6 All Black delivers a stripped back and versatile take on one of Ons most recognizable silhouettes. The all black execution emphasizes the Cloud 6s clean lines and distinctive cushioning pods, giving it a sleek and understated presence. It feels lightweight and purposeful, designed to move seamlessly between daily wear and active use without drawing unnecessary attention. Fans love this model because it prioritizes comfort and simplicity. The Cloud 6 is known for its easy ride and breathable construction, and the monochrome palette makes it adaptable across environments. Collectors of On footwear appreciate how designs like this focus on function first, offering a dependable shoe that fits naturally into modern routines where versatility matters. The On Running Cloud 6 All Black was released on February 6, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble White University Red
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble White University Red brings the silhouette closer to its original roots through a lighter palette and classic color placement. The white and wolf grey upper creates a clean gradient effect, while University Red accents add a bold and familiar contrast that feels true to early Air Max storytelling. The enlarged Air units reinforce the OG inspiration, giving the shoe a more authentic presence. This pair resonates with collectors because it feels like a direct nod to the models history. The color blocking and Big Bubble design combine to create a version that feels both nostalgic and relevant. It is a standout release for those who value heritage driven updates that stay faithful to the original vision. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble White University Red was released on April 21, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE LA to Chicago
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE LA to Chicago brings back one of the most recognizable storytelling color concepts tied to the Jordan 1 lineage. The mix of true red, court purple, black, and white reflects the dual identity between Los Angeles and Chicago, creating a colorway that carries deeper meaning beyond its surface. The mid top silhouette provides a slightly different feel from the original high while still preserving the overall structure and presence. Fans continue to gravitate toward LA to Chicago themes because of the narrative tied to transformation and hidden layers. Even without wear away elements, the color blocking alone signals that story to those familiar with the concept. It is a release that connects directly to Jordan Brand history, offering a version of the idea that feels accessible while still holding strong cultural relevance. The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE LA to Chicago was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Grey
Description: A collaboration between Converse and Comme Des Garcons, the PLAY line, birthed the Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Grey, a variation of the All-Star Chuck 70 High sneaker model. It is constructed with an upper gray canvas accentuated by an oversized heart and eyes logo in basic black and white on the lateral side. This high-top shoe sits on an egret-colored rubber midsole, brown finish outsole, and toe box that enhance durability. It retains the signature canvas lace-up closure. The Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Grey was released on June 3, 2021, and retailed for $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Valentine's Day (2026) (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Valentines Day 2026 Womens captures the romantic energy of the annual themed drop with rich red tones that feel bold and celebratory. Team Red dominates the upper, layered with Sierra Red for added depth that keeps the palette dynamic rather than flat. The low cut shape keeps things wearable, letting the color story take center stage. Valentines Day Jordan releases have built a quiet tradition over the years, often becoming sleeper favorites once the season passes. This version leans into classic red hues without overcomplicating the design, which makes it easy to style long after February. Collectors who follow holiday themed Jordans know that the best pairs are the ones that stand on their own, and this execution feels confident enough to do exactly that. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Valentines Day 2026 Womens was released on January 14, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan Tatum 3 Pink
Description: The Jordan Tatum 3 Pink turns heads with a vibrant palette and court-ready design built for confident play. Dressed in Pink Tint with accents of Lava Glow, Hot Punch, and Guava Ice, this signature model balances bold style with functional details from heel to toe. A breathable upper keeps air flowing during intense runs, while the padded collar and sculpted heel help lock you in without adding bulk. The midfoot support frame works with a dynamic lacing system to create a secure, adaptive fit that stays comfortable through quick cuts, hard stops, and full-speed transitions. Underfoot, responsive cushioning delivers a smooth, springy ride that keeps you light on your feet and close to the floor for precise footwork. A durable rubber outsole features a multi-directional traction pattern engineered for grip on polished hardwood and blacktop alike, providing confident control when you pull up from deep or drive the lane. Finished with Tatum branding and the style code FZ6598-600/FZ6601-600, this mens basketball shoe brings modern performance with standout flair, ideal for both game day and everyday wear. The Jordan Tatum 3 Pink released on May 12, 2025, adding a fresh, high-energy colorway to the Air Jordan Tatum lineup. Our team loves this product because it blends dependable court performance, eye-catching color blocking, and a dialed-in fit thats great for players who want speed, support, and style in one shoe.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Starfish
Description: After a monumental 2020, Jordan Brand continues to push the 1999 model with their new Starfish colorway. Unlike starfish that often camouflage in the ocean, these Air Jordan 13s cannot be missed. The sneaker is fashioned in similar color-blocking techniques that appear on past colorways. The upper consists of white tumbled leather and orange suede that continues down to the midsole. A familiar holographic badge appears on the heel, while a carbon fiber shank plate is installed on the outsole to provide stability on the court. An orange-embroidered Jumpman appears on the tongue to complete the Jordan sneaker. The Air Jordan 13 Starfish released in January of 2021 for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink (GS)
Description: Air Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink GS brings a soft and playful twist to one of Jordan Brands most celebrated silhouettes, wrapping the classic Air Jordan 12 in tones that feel both premium and youthful. The pearl pink palette floods the tumbled leather upper, giving it a warm, elegant presence that still carries the performance inspired shape created by Tinker Hatfield. Even in grade school sizing, this release feels luxurious and intentional, perfect for collectors who appreciate subtle color stories rooted in heritage design. Collectors gravitate toward the Pearl Pink because it marries iconic structure with refined personality. The Air Jordan 12s signature radiating stitch lines and supportive build remain front and center, while the gentle pink hues create a fresh narrative that feels timeless rather than trend driven. Its the kind of release that feels at home in curated rotations and everyday rotation alike. The Air Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink GS was released on 11/21/2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike KD 18 Chet Holmgren Thunder & Reign
Description: The Nike KD 18 Chet Holmgren Thunder and Reign channels a player inspired theme through a space purple multi color pure purple palette that feels energetic and layered. The design reflects Kevin Durants signature line while incorporating elements tied to Chet Holmgrens presence and team identity, creating a crossover within basketball culture. Fans of KD models appreciate how each release introduces new narratives while maintaining performance focus. This pair stands out for its color execution and concept, offering something that feels both player driven and visually distinct. It works as a performance shoe with added storytelling, appealing to collectors who follow the evolution of signature lines. The Nike KD 18 Chet Holmgren Thunder and Reign was released on March 13, 2026 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: Nike Air Flightposite Black (2025)
Description: The Nike Air Flightposite Black (2025) is a sleek and futuristic addition to Nike's basketball footwear lineup. This iconic silhouette features a seamless, molded upper crafted from synthetic materials, providing a snug and supportive fit. The all-black colorway exudes sophistication and versatility, making it a standout choice for both on-court performance and street-style fashion. Designed with cutting-edge technology, the Air Flightposite incorporates Nike's renowned Air cushioning system in the midsole, delivering exceptional comfort and responsiveness during play. With its durable rubber outsole featuring a multidirectional traction pattern, players can expect superior grip and stability on various surfaces. Us at StockX believe this product is great for athletes and sneaker enthusiasts alike, combining innovative design with premium performance features for an unparalleled basketball shoe experience.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Sea Salt Moonbeam
Description: The New Balance 9060 Sea Salt Moonbeam is a subtle-looking yet fashion-forward sports shoe that you can use for training and casual wear. It's extra comfy, thanks to New Balance's ABZORB cushioning. New Balance 9060 trainers have always had great-looking, bold, modern styling. It's one of the hallmarks of the range. While this one is lightly colored and somewhat understated, it still gives off a distinctly high-tech air. The colorway combines a silvery upper with slightly grey panels, the Moonbeam shade. These alternate between breathable textiles and plush suede. We like the fluid lines of this shoe, as well as its high-tech credentials. A sculpted midsole pod well protects the foot. Underneath are six cushioning platforms that combine to provide flexibility and high grip levels. We can't fault this shoe regarding foot support when running. The New Balance 9060 Sea Salt Moonbeam was released on 31 July 2024, priced at $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 270 Sail Coconut Milk Pale Ivory (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 270 Sail Coconut Milk Pale Ivory Womens leans into softness and comfort through a colorway that feels light, warm, and effortlessly wearable. The Air Max 270s defining heel Air unit gives the shoe a modern identity, while the sail and coconut milk tones soften its profile into something calm and lifestyle focused. It feels airy and relaxed, designed for everyday movement rather than performance intensity. Fans love this release because it prioritizes comfort without sacrificing style. The 270 silhouette has always been about ease, and this palette enhances that feeling by keeping everything cohesive and gentle. Collectors appreciate how it fits naturally into rotation, offering a sneaker that feels modern, versatile, and aligned with the growing appreciation for comfort driven design in contemporary footwear culture. The Nike Air Max 270 Sail Coconut Milk Pale Ivory Womens was released on December 20, 2024 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Rain Cloud (GS)
Description: The New Balance 9060 Rain Cloud (GS) for grade schoolers reinterprets the original 9060 model with futuristic elements to give grade schoolers a fresh iteration of a classic shoe. This sneaker features a sleek and modern design with clean lines and minimalist aesthetics. Its upper is crafted from durable and breathable materials including premium mesh, suede, and synthetic leather. These materials provide ventilation to keep the feet cool and comfortable throughout the day while offering support and protection against wear and tear. Cushioning technology in the midsole delivers energy return and shock absorption, while a padded collar and tongue add comfort around the ankle area. A patterned rubber outsole ensures grip on pavement, grass, and a number of indoor surfaces. What our experts most appreciate about the New Balance 9060 Rain Cloud (GS) for grade schoolers, however, is its combination of Rain Cloud and Castlerock grays that imbue it with a timeless aesthetic. This shoe originally retailed for $110 on November 26, 2023.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Dark Olivine
Description: The New Balance 9060 Dark Olivine showcases this retrofuturistic model in a green hue similar to vintage army-issue garments. The sneaker reimagines the iconic 99X series, blending retro design elements with a daring, futuristic edge influenced by the tech-inspired aesthetics of the early 2000s. The Dark Olivine New Balance 9060 upper features a mix of materials, starting with a mesh base with suede overlays in deep olive hues, providing a premium feel with breathable comfort. The signature jumbo "N" badge marks the lateral and medial sides, with more branding elements on the tongue, heel, and insole. The silhouette sits atop a chunky midsole featuring the trusted ABZORB and SRS cushioning systems, with a rubber outsole completing the sneakers design. The New Balance 9060 Dark Olivine has a military-esque color palette, which blends olive tones for a rugged yet refined look. The Dark Olivine hue blends shades of khaki, sage green, and olive for a dynamic look that is both classic and minimalist. The sneaker debuted on the 15th of January 2025 for $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Stadium Green Crimson
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Stadium Green Crimson brings bold contrast to a timeless silhouette, pairing deep stadium green overlays with bright crimson accents that immediately stand out. The classic Air Force 1 structure remains unchanged, allowing the color combination to drive the overall energy of the design. Subtle hits of laser orange add another layer of vibrancy, giving the shoe a dynamic and slightly unexpected edge. What makes this pair stand out is how it pushes a familiar model into a more expressive space through color alone. The Air Force 1 continues to thrive because of its adaptability, and this release shows how far a strong palette can go. Fans appreciate when new colorways feel fresh without altering the core design, and this version delivers that balance. It is a bold take on a proven classic. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Stadium Green Crimson was released on April 16, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Sketch Black
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Sketch Black takes one of the most recognizable sneakers in history and reimagines it through a raw, hand drawn lens that feels creative and rebellious. The Sketch treatment gives the Chuck 70 an illustrated look, as if the shoe itself was pulled straight from a notebook, while the black base keeps it grounded and timeless. The Chuck Taylor has always been a canvas for self expression, and the sketch style reinforces that idea in a playful but intentional way. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Sketch Black was released on July 7, 2024.

Display Name: Nike Dunk High Iowa (2020)
Description: Another one of the first Nike Dunk colorways from the 1985 "Be True To Your School" returned in 2020, this time in the form of the Nike Dunk High Iowa (2020). The Varsity Maize colorway pays homage to the University of Iowa, one of the first universities to partner with Nike. Also known as the "Golden Rod", the Nike Dunk High Iowa has inspired a few renowned Dunks, most notably the 2005 Nike SB Dunk High Golden Rod and the Wu-Tang Dunk High. The Nike Dunk High Iowa (2020) arrives in its original form, featuring a black and yellow leather upper with traditional Dunk color blocking. A woven black and yellow Nike Swoosh tongue tag, white midsole, and Varsity Maize outsole finalize this latest Dunk re-issue. The Nike Dunk High Iowa (2020) released in December of 2020 and retailed for $120.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Legend Light Brown
Description: As part of the Method of Make series, the Jordan 1 Low SE Legend Light Brown reimagines the AJ1 Low using premium materials and a contemporary color scheme. It boasts neutrals, including Sail, Legend Light Brown, Archaeo Brown, and Neutral Grey. Creating a sophisticated feel, the base is constructed from leather in Sail, while the suede overlays at the heel and forefoot come in Legend Light Brown. The eyelets, the signature Swoosh logo, the Jumpman logo, and the Air Jordan Wings logo embroidered on the heel showcase soft Archaeo Brown. The minimalist branding on the tongue contributes to the sneakers premium appearance, while the perforations on the toebox allow the foot to breathe. Our experts at StockX like the midsoles off-white hue. Here, encapsulated Air units provide responsive cushioning without adding a distracting design detail. The Jordan 1 Low SE Legend Light Brown was released on July 18, 2024, and sold for $125.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 21 Prime 93
Description: Command every possession in the Nike LeBron 21 Prime 93, a powerhouse mens basketball shoe engineered for explosive play and refined with eye-catching polish. The sleek Black upper sets the stage for crisp White contrasts, bold Fire Red hits, and elevated Metallic Gold details that nod to championship pedigree. A supportive, breathable build helps you lock in without feeling weighed down, while a padded collar and secure lacing system keep the foot centered during hard plants, fast cuts, and above-the-rim finishes. Underfoot, a durable outsole with targeted traction zones bites the hardwood for confident stops and quick changes of direction, helping you stay balanced from tip-off to clutch time. Designed to cushion impact and return energy, the Prime 93 blends responsive cushioning with a stable platform that feels smooth from heel strike to toe-off. A sturdy heel counter and midfoot support work together to keep your stride aligned, while the wide, sculpted base provides a steady foundation during lateral moves. Styled to turn heads off the court and built to perform on it, this Nike LeBron 21 colorway pairs effortlessly with game-day kits and streetwear alike. With its Black/White/Fire Red/Metallic Gold palette and signature LeBron detailing, the Prime 93 delivers the power, control, and style todays players demand. Style: HQ3480-001/HQ3479-001. Our team loves this product because it blends top-tier cushioning, lockdown support, and statement-making color blocking for players who want performance without compromising style.

Display Name: adidas BW Army Cloud White Chalk White

The BW Armys appeal lies in its honesty, reminding collectors why foundational designs continue to influence modern sneaker culture without needing reinvention or excessive storytelling. Display Name: New Balance 9060 Mono Shipyard

Fans appreciate monochromatic releases like this because they highlight the design of the sneaker itself rather than relying on bold color blocking. For collectors, tonal pairs like this often become everyday staples, offering versatility while still carrying the distinctive aesthetic that makes the 9060 one of the brands standout modern silhouettes. The New Balance 9060 Mono Shipyard has a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024) (GS)

The Jordan 11 Retro Legend Blue (2024) (GS) was released on December 14, 2024, and sold for $185.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 OG Green Silver

The Jordan 1 Low SE Craft Dark Smoke Gray Varsity Red was released on December 27th, 2023, and retailed at $125.

Display Name: Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott University Red
Description: The release of the Air Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott University Red marks a momentous occasion: the first wide public launch of a brand-new, original colorway from the collaborative genius of Jordan Brand and Travis Scott. This sneaker is a homage to the past and a forward leap in design, drawing inspiration from classic basketball sneakers of the '80s and the rugged aesthetic of '90s skate shoes. Its a perfect blend for enthusiasts who appreciate a retro vibe with a modern twist. Travis Scott's first entirely original silhouette comes to life with the iconic, signature reversed Nike Swoosh in a bold university red, contrasting strikingly against the timeless sail & black upper. The carefully pre-yellowed midsole adds a touch of vintage appeal, invoking a sense of nostalgia while remaining at the pinnacle of style. Complete with a special co-branded shoe box and dust bag, the Jordan Jumpman Jack TR is as much a collector's piece as it is a testament to sneaker innovation. Released on April 26, 2024, the Air Jordan Jumpman Jack TR Travis Scott University Red retailed for $200. This sneaker is the inception of Travis Scott's original design legacy, offering a unique take on sneaker culture. With its rich 80s and 90s influences and the unmatched Travis Scott brand power, this sneaker is ready to conquer the streets and capture the essence of both basketball and skateboarding heritage.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Mutant
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Mutant leans into futuristic energy with a metallic execution that highlights the silhouettes technical complexity. Silver tones dominate the upper, giving the shoe a sharp and almost mechanical look that emphasizes structure and movement. The layered design feels dynamic, showcasing Sauconys performance heritage through material and form. Fans love this release because it stands out through texture and shine rather than color saturation. The ProGrid Omni 9 feels confident and modern here, appealing to collectors who enjoy running silhouettes as lifestyle statements. It reflects Sauconys growing presence in fashion forward spaces, offering a sneaker that feels bold, experimental, and rooted in real performance history. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Mutant was released on July 12, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Black Silver (Women's)
Description: adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Black Silver Womens reimagines a global classic through a fashion forward lens, adding sparkle and attitude to one of adidass most enduring silhouettes. The black base keeps the look grounded and timeless, while rhinestone detailing introduces contrast that feels expressive and bold without overwhelming the shoes heritage. It transforms the Samba from a purely utilitarian icon into something playful and elevated. What makes this release resonate is how confidently it blends sport history with modern style. The Samba OG shape remains untouched, preserving its cultural credibility, while the rhinestones add personality that feels designed for self expression. Collectors appreciate this version because it shows how subtle embellishment can refresh a classic without stripping away what made it iconic in the first place. The adidas Samba OG Rhinestone Black Silver Womens was released on 12/04/2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 SE Worn Blue Denim
Description: The Nike P 6000 SE Worn Blue Denim channels vintage energy through layered shades of blue. Worn Blue anchors the upper, complemented by Ashen Slate and Diffused Blue overlays that enhance the intricate paneling. Soft Pearl accents brighten the composition, keeping the design balanced and fresh. The mesh heavy build stays true to the early 2000s running inspiration that gives the P 6000 its character. Collectors appreciate how denim inspired tones add texture and personality to familiar silhouettes. The layered blues create movement without overwhelming the structure, making it both expressive and wearable. It bridges sport heritage with lifestyle appeal through thoughtful color placement. Relaxed yet dynamic, this edition brings casual depth to a performance rooted design. The Nike P 6000 SE Worn Blue Denim was released on June 27, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Premium Pale Ivory Off Noir Baroque Brown
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Premium Pale Ivory Off Noir Baroque Brown blends timeless hoops heritage with modern, wardrobe-ready tones. Pale Ivory sets a clean base across the perforated toe box and quarters, while Off Noir overlays sharpen the profile and frame the Swoosh for a refined contrast. Baroque Brown accents ground the palette with rich depth along the collar and outsole, creating a sophisticated look that moves effortlessly from day to night. Classic details, the embroidered Wings logo on the heel, a woven Jumpman tongue tag, and fine stitching, underscore the silhouettes craftsmanship, while the low-cut build keeps it easy to wear year-round. Underfoot, a durable cupsole with encapsulated Air cushioning delivers the comfortable ride the Jordan 1 is known for, backed by a grippy rubber outsole that bites on city streets and smooth floors alike. The padded collar and secure lace closure offer a snug, supportive feel, and the versatile colorway makes styling simple, think laid-back denim, clean chinos, or technical layers. With its balanced mix of soft neutrals and deep accents, this pair elevates everyday rotation without shouting for attention. Identified by style code IB8058-110 and released on 2025-04-20, its a polished take on a beloved classic that rewards both collectors and daily wearers. Our team loves this product because it delivers all-day comfort, premium finishing, and a versatile neutral palette that instantly sharpens any fit.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Street Hawker (2021)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low continues its reign into the new year with the Street Hawker colorway. Originally thought to be a design to celebrate Chinese New Year, the story behind the upper is unique in itself, reflecting on the world-wide love for Chinese food. The Nike Dunk Low Street Hawker is a piece of artwork in itself, as the upper features mismatched watercolors on a majority canvas, leather, and suede construction. From there, Chinese characters replace traditional "Nike" heel embroidery. Additionally, a stitched copper coin pays homage to Eastern culinary culture. The Nike Dunk Low releases in January 2021 and retails for $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble Total 90 University Red
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble Total 90 Black draws from one of Nike's most beloved football equipment sub-brands and applies that heritage to the 95 platform through a black base accented with metallic gold and metallic silver that references the Total 90 boot line's premium aesthetic language without requiring any explanation from those who remember wearing or chasing Total 90 gear during its peak. The Big Bubble Air unit in black with metallic hardware detailing creates a shoe that feels simultaneously athletic and luxury-adjacent, the precious metal accents giving the 95's most dramatic cushioning feature an elevated material register that standard colorways in the same platform cannot match. Total 90's legacy across football culture gives this Air Max 95 SE a specific and devoted audience that goes beyond standard sneaker collectors into the football community where the brand still carries genuine emotional weight. Black Air Max 95 releases with metallic accents have historically proven to be among the most wearable and consistently rotated colorways in the silhouette's archive, and the Total 90 framing gives this specific iteration a biographical depth that pure colorway releases lack. The SE designation signals material and design enhancements beyond the standard 95 platform, and the Big Bubble upgrade ensures this shoe's most iconic structural feature commands the full visual attention it deserves. Gold and silver metallics together create a color relationship that avoids the single-metal restraint of most premium colorways and instead delivers something richer and more complex across the 95's layered upper construction. The Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble Total 90 Black was released on October 1, 2024 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Shadow
Description: Taking cues from the original 1985 Air Jordan 1 Shadow, the Jordan 1 Low Golf Shadow arrives with a black and Shadow grey smooth leather upper. A woven Jumpman tag on the tongue and a Wings logo debossed at the heel decorate its neutral palette. From there, a grooved outsole contributes the traction needed for a steady golf swing. The Jordan 1 Low Golf Shadow released in January of 2022 and retailed for $140.

Model: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo
Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Rob Dillingham
Description: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Rob Dillingham captures the pace and creativity of one of basketballs most electric young guards through a silhouette built for constant motion. The Turbo theme feels appropriate, pairing sharp contrast and confident color with a design language focused on speed and control. This version of the GT Cut 3 feels expressive without losing its competitive edge, reflecting Dillinghams fearless approach to the game and his ability to change tempo at will. Collectors appreciate this pair because it represents where modern basketball footwear is headed. The GT Cut line has become known for precision and responsiveness, and the Rob Dillingham connection adds personality and future facing energy. It feels like a snapshot of a new era, where performance shoes double as cultural markers tied to emerging stars and evolving play styles. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Rob Dillingham was released on 07/16/2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: On Running Cloud 6 All Black (Women's)
Description: The On Running Cloud 6 All Black Womens refines the brands comfort driven identity through a sleek monochrome execution. Finished entirely in Black, the lightweight upper sits atop the signature Cloud cushioning pods that deliver smooth and responsive steps. The streamlined silhouette keeps the look modern and versatile. All black runners remain staples for everyday wear, and the Cloud 6 continues On Runnings focus on understated performance. The sculpted sole maintains the recognizable Cloud aesthetic while offering all day comfort. It feels clean and dependable, built for movement without unnecessary distraction. The On Running Cloud 6 All Black Womens was released in 2024 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue (2025) (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue 2025 PS introduces one of the most iconic Jordan 5 colorways to younger wearers while keeping its unmistakable energy intact. The white upper paired with fire red accents and the signature black tongue delivers instant recognition, tying the shoe directly to Jordan Brand heritage. Even in preschool sizing, the bold contrasts and fighter inspired design feel confident and authentic. Fans love this release because it preserves everything that made the Fire Red Black Tongue legendary. The Jordan 5s aggressive lines and classic color blocking translate perfectly at a smaller scale, offering an early connection to sneaker history. Collectors appreciate it as a foundational Jordan, one that introduces kids to a timeless look rooted in performance, attitude, and cultural impact rather than trends. The Air Jordan 5 Retro Fire Red Black Tongue 2025 PS was released on September 13, 2025 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Nike React Phantom Run Flyknit 2 Black White Blend
Description: The Nike React Phantom Run Flyknit 2 Black White Blend is a running shoe from the Nike React Phantom Run Flyknit 2 collection in a Black/White colorway. This sneaker features a slip-on, laceless design made of a Black and White Flyknit upper with elastic Flywire cables at the midfoot for a secure fit. It is supported by external moldings on the lateral and medial heel sections. A White Nike React midsole and a Black rubber outsole complement the design. The Nike React Phantom Run Flyknit 2 Black White Blend was made available on July 17th, 2020 for a retail price of $140.

Display Name: adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Black White (Women's)
Description: The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Black White (Women's) is a ballet-inspired, flat silhouette that pulled design cues from the original Taekwondo Mei silhouette from adidas. Crafted from soft leather, this black and white women's Taekwondo Mei Ballet combines heritage design and modern aesthetics. The front toe area pulls design inspiration from the adidas Y-3 model, with a cloud white Y-type overlay that sits on top of the core black upper. Three white stripes are on the side panels, while black adidas branding sits on the white heel. A durable gum rubber outsole equates to comfortable traction. The shoes lace up directly on the forefoot without a tongue and can be tied around the ankle if desired to resemble ballet pointe shoes. What do we think is this shoes standout feature? Wed have to say its that this silhouette draws inspiration from adidas' archival flats and the dynamic strength of martial arts, resulting in a minimalist style with an edge. The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Black White (Women's) debuted on March 15, 2025, with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 11 Protro Mamba Day
Description: The Nike Kobe 11 Protro Mamba Day revisits one of the most meaningful moments in Kobe Bryants career, honoring his final NBA game on April 13, 2016, when he delivered a legendary 60-point performance. Dressed in a multi-color execution, the design reflects the emotional weight of that night, blending bold tones and graphic elements to capture both celebration and closure. The original Kobe 11 marked the peak of Nike Basketballs Flyknit innovation at the time, offering a lightweight, flexible build that aligned with Kobes late-career evolution toward efficiency and precision. The "Mamba Day" theme has since become a recurring tribute across the Kobe line, symbolizing discipline, legacy, and the mindset that defined Bryants approach to the game. This Protro version carries that narrative forward while refining the original silhouette. When the Nike Kobe 11 Protro Mamba Day released, it retailed for $220 and dropped on April 13, 2026. By commemorating one of the most iconic farewell performances in sports history, this release stands as both a tribute and a continuation of Kobes lasting influence.

Model: Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen AMPD
