Display Name: Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen AMPD Equity
Description: The Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen AMPD Equity is a cutting-edge performance sneaker designed for the modern basketball player. Featuring a sleek white, black, and gold colorway, these shoes combine style with functionality. The innovative Zoom Air technology in the midsole provides responsive cushioning, allowing for explosive movements on the court. The upper is crafted with breathable materials to keep your feet cool during intense gameplay. Engineered with LeBron James' playing style in mind, the NXXT Gen AMPD offers superior stability and support. The durable rubber outsole features a multidirectional traction pattern, ensuring excellent grip on various court surfaces. With its lightweight construction and adaptive fit, this shoe allows players to move with agility and confidence. Our team thinks this product is great for serious basketball players looking to elevate their game with a shoe that delivers both performance and style.

Display Name: Nike A'ja Wilson A'Two Pink Beam (Women's)
Description: The Nike Aja Wilson ATwo Pink Beam Womens introduces a signature basketball model tied to one of the games most dominant and influential players. The Pink Beam and Black colorway gives the shoe a bold and confident look, reflecting Aja Wilsons presence on the court and her growing impact within the sport. The silhouette combines performance focused design with personal branding, creating a sneaker that feels connected to both play and identity. Fans gravitate toward signature models because they represent the athletes style and influence beyond the game itself. The Pink Beam tone adds energy and individuality, making the shoe stand out within a category often dominated by darker palettes. The structure of the model supports performance while still maintaining a strong visual identity. Basketball sneakers continue playing a major role in both sport and streetwear culture. For collectors, releases like this mark important moments as new signature lines emerge and expand the representation of athletes within the sneaker world. The Nike Aja Wilson ATwo Pink Beam Womens was released on May 2, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential British Tan Light Bone
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential British Tan Light Bone is a sophisticated iteration of the iconic Air Max 1 silhouette. This men's sneaker showcases a harmonious blend of light bone, flax, british tan, and black hues, creating a versatile and stylish aesthetic. The upper features a combination of premium materials, including smooth leather and breathable mesh, ensuring both durability and comfort. The signature visible Air unit in the heel provides responsive cushioning, while the classic waffle outsole offers excellent traction and stability. Designed with both form and function in mind, this Air Max 1 Essential boasts subtle details that elevate its overall appeal. The British tan accents add a touch of warmth to the light bone base, creating a balanced and eye-catching look. The black Swoosh logo stands out prominently against the lighter tones, maintaining the classic Nike branding. With its timeless design and modern colorway, this sneaker seamlessly transitions from casual everyday wear to more refined occasions. Our team thinks this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts looking for a versatile and comfortable shoe that combines classic design with contemporary style.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Medium Olive
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Medium Olive updates a classic from 1989 and dresses it in subtle tones and complementary textures to create an earthy shoe with bounce and high performance capabilities. The medium olive colorway of the Jordan 4 SE Retro "Craft" features an upper with an olive green nubuck base, both overlaid and underlaid with soft green suede. The green suede on the side panel is imprinted with a grid pattern, inspired by mesh side panels on previous iterations of the silhouette. Black accents pepper the shoe on the molded eyestays, side panel wings, synthetic heel counter, synthetic mudguard overlay, the sock liner. A vanilla colored Jumpman logo graces both the woven tongue tag and the heel to round out the look of this upper. What we enjoy most about this sport shoe is the high-octane sole unit. A white lightweight polyurethane foam midsole houses a visible Air unit. The rubber outsole in gray, white, black, and vanilla sports traction as well as a Jumpman logo. The Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Medium Olive was released on November 18, 2023, for retail price of $210.

Display Name: Vans Premium Old Skool Charms Black Grey
Description: The Vans Premium Old Skool Charms Black Grey delivers a clean and elevated take on the iconic Old Skool silhouette, using black and grey tones paired with charm detailing that adds a subtle decorative element. The structure remains classic and durable. This pair stands out because it blends minimal color with added detail. The charms introduce a small but noticeable variation, making it feel more unique. Fans appreciate how it enhances a staple without overcomplicating the design. The Vans Premium Old Skool Charms Black Grey was released on February 26, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Moss
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Moss is one of Cactus Plant Flea Markets first reinventions of the Air Force 1. It features a playful Moss colorway that pays tribute to the label's quirky, DIY aesthetic. The upper is made of a combination of smooth and pebbled leather in Moss, while the sneaker sits on a tonal rubber outsole. The right shoe displays "AIR" on the lateral side in bubble letters, while the left shoe features "SUNSHINE" stretching from the inner to the outer side panel. Perforations across the vamp allow the foot to breathe and create texture. In terms of branding, "NIKE" is embroidered on the heel and on the woven tongue logo tag in Moss thread. Our StockX experts like the silver hardware on the laces, which is the only non-Moss hue on the upper. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Moss was released on May 1, 2024, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: Nike Cortez Basic Black White (2023)
Description: The Nike Cortez Basic Black White (2023) is an updated version of a classic shoe that debuted in the 1970s. This iteration of the Nike Cortez Basic comes with an upper made largely of black leather. Black leather overlays also form the toe cap and the heel counter. The only deviations from this black color scheme are the heel collar, which is white, and the white Nike Swooshes that dominate both sides of the shoe. The Nike logo also appears on the heel collar in black, and the tongue has a Nike logo patch. Underfoot, the vintage sole is serrated and comes in black and white stripes, adding a classic modern look. What we like most about this shoe is the all black leather construction, aside from a few white elements, as it makes the shoe sleek and elegant. The Nike Cortez Basic Black White (2023) was released on December 19, 2023, for a price of $90.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Flax
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Flax channels autumn warmth through rich texture and grounded color. Flax suede wraps the upper in a golden tan tone, complemented by muslin accents that soften the overall look. Varsity red details add a sharp pop of contrast, giving the silhouette energy without disrupting its seasonal feel. The low cut shape keeps the design relaxed and versatile. Fans value this pair because flax colorways have long held strong cultural appeal within sneaker rotation. The combination of suede texture and warm tones makes it especially fitting for cooler months while still feeling wearable year round. Collectors appreciate how the SE designation often brings thoughtful material choices to the forefront. It stands as a comfortable and character driven take on the Jordan 1 Low, balancing familiarity with seasonal personality. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Flax was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog Lightning McQueen (TD)
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog Lightning McQueen (TD) takes the signature Crocs silhouette and applies details inspired by Lightning McQueen, a race car from the animated film Cars. Stand-out features include LED lights in the upper which flash while you walk. Although the batteries are not replaceable, they are long-lasting. Like other Crocs, the Lightning McQueen model is made from a lightweight foam resin and can be customized with Jibbitz charms. This Croc mimics the animated cars body with eyes above the Jibbitz charm holes, a mouth and headlights above the toe, and race car decals along the side. A pivoting heel strap allows you to wear the Croc as a slide-like shoe or as a clog. What do our experts love about this shoe? The toddler-sized version is almost identical to the Crocs Classic Clog Lightning McQueen for adults. The toddler-sized Crocs Classic Clog Lightning McQueen (TD) was released on August 8, 2023, and retailed at $45.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Toggle Black Reflective
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Toggle Black Reflective is an alteration of the iconic Nike Air Max Plus sneakers in black and silver color schemes. The Toggle Black Reflective Nike Air Max Plus sneaker is constructed from a mix of mesh with suede to give it an elevated look. Its design features an all-black color scheme contrasting with a silver-dressed Swoosh on the lateral sides. Concluding the upper design is the "Tn" on the heel cap and its Toggle lacing system. The sneakers lower design features black mudguards to reinforce the upper constructions, the visible Air Units in the midsole for cushioning and support, and the treaded outsole for traction. What our experts found interesting about this Nike Air Max Plus Toggle Black Reflective is its laces that happen to adopt the toggle lacing system. The sneaker debuted on October 29, 2022 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Vast Grey Safety Orange
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Vast Grey Safety Orange balances neutral structure with bold accent energy. Vast Grey and Anthracite form a sleek foundation, while white elements brighten the layered upper. Safety Orange detailing injects sharp bursts of color that emphasize the eyelets and branding touches. The visible Air unit remains central, reinforcing the performance DNA that defines the silhouette. Collectors gravitate toward grey based Air Max releases because they provide versatility without sacrificing personality. The orange accents give this pair a dynamic edge, transforming a muted base into something eye catching. It blends classic form with modern vibrancy, keeping the Air Max 90 relevant across eras. Clean, energetic, and confidently balanced, this edition stands out with precision. The Nike Air Max 90 Vast Grey Safety Orange was released on June 20, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Fusion Gum (Women's)
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Fusion Gum W upper is adorned with premium suede while showcasing the titular Blue Fusion. This womens-sizing silhouette arrives in a Blue Fusion/Footwear White/Gold Metallic colorway. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Fusion Gum W features a textured tongue with white branding. The signature minimizes its branding features. Other significant features of this low-top sneaker include white lace, Cloud White sock liners, and unbranded heel tabs. Meanwhile, the lateral and medial panels reveal sawtooth-edged Cloud White 3-Stripes. The lateral sides of the shoe, above the 3-Stripes, display the "Gazelle" branding. The gum sole unit is designed in caramel color to round out the sneaker's design. What we think stands out in the adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Fusion Gum W is its archival design that brings out a brilliant and vibrant colorway. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Blue Fusion Gum W was released at a retail price of $90 on December 15th, 2022.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 3 Silencer (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 3 Silencer Womens delivers a layered and expressive color story built around control and clarity. Summit white anchors the upper with a clean foundation, while iron grey and photon dust add structure and depth. Washed coral, artisan teal, and lemonade accents introduce subtle energy, creating a palette that feels complex yet composed rather than loud or chaotic. This pair resonates with fans because it highlights nuance over flash. The Silencer concept feels fitting for a player known for shutting down opponents through precision and awareness. Collectors appreciate how the Sabrina 3 continues to evolve through thoughtful color balance, offering personality without sacrificing wearability. It is a sneaker that rewards attention, revealing detail and intention through layered tones that reflect focus, intelligence, and quiet confidence on the court. The Nike Sabrina 3 Silencer Womens was released on September 6, 2025 with a retail price of $135.
Colorway: Summit White/Iron Grey/Photon Dust/Washed Coral/Artisan Teal/Lemonade

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low New York Yankees
Description: The Nike Dunk Low New York Yankees merges sports legacy with streetwear culture through one of the most recognizable palettes in American history. White leather keeps the base crisp and timeless, while midnight navy and photon dust accents reference the Yankees identity with clarity. Coconut milk tones soften the contrast, giving the shoe a slightly aged and lived in feel that adds character. This pair connects with fans because the Yankees logo and colors carry cultural weight far beyond baseball. The Dunk Low serves as a natural canvas for that identity, translating it into something wearable and everyday. Collectors appreciate how the design avoids heavy branding, letting color and association do the work. It feels iconic without being loud, offering a sneaker that represents heritage, confidence, and enduring relevance across style communities. The Nike Dunk Low New York Yankees was released on August 21, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High '85 Black White (2023)
Description: Nike is bringing back the original 1985 Air Jordan 1 silhouette with the release of the Air Jordan 1 Retro High 85 Black White (2023). This is the first time the black and white Air Jordan 1 has returned since their 2014 retro. The sneakers feature a familiar black and white color blocking commonly seen on other traditional Jordan 1 colorways. Leather uppers are constructed throughout, while a black Nike Air logo sits on top of its white tongue. The Jordan 1 Retro High 85 Black White (2023) released February 15, 2023, with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Select 3.0 Black Iron Metallic
Description: The adidas Adizero Select 30 Black Iron Metallic delivers a sleek and performance focused silhouette through a dark and structured color palette. Core black dominates the upper, creating a strong and grounded look, while iron metallic accents add subtle contrast and depth. Carbon tones enhance the overall design, giving it a cohesive and technical feel. Fans of the Adizero line appreciate how models like this emphasize simplicity and functionality, making them suitable for both athletic use and everyday wear. The monochrome palette enhances versatility, allowing the design to fit into different settings. It is a sneaker that reflects adidas focus on clean and efficient performance design. The adidas Adizero Select 30 Black Iron Metallic was released on July 13, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas BW Army Lux White Gum
Description: The adidas BW Army Lux White Gum is a casual lifestyle sneaker. The upper is constructed with Footwear White leather for the underlays and quarter, heel, and lace panel overlays. The tip continues the monochrome aesthetic while differentiating the texture in Footwear White suede. The Gum rubber mid- and outsole unit displays adidas Trefoil branding, which balances the monochrome Footwear White laces and tongue branding. Founded in 1924, Germany-based adidas is one of the worlds most prolific sneaker brands. With the ability to mine their century-plus worth of archives, adidas excels at reintroducing historic styles, such as the BW Army. It was originally called the German Army Trainer, and the shoe's classic styling complements adidas' modern reinterpretation well. Our experts feel that the best feature of the BW Army Lux is its classic Footwear White color palette, which is timeless and subtle. The adidas BW Army Lux White Gum was released on April 1, 2025, and retailed at $120.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Steel Grey
Description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Steel Gray paints this classic Yeezy silhouette in a gray-on-gray colorway with a tonal rubber outsole. This sneaker was released after Ye, formally known as Kanye West, and adidas ended their partnership. The upper is made of breathable PrimeKnit, which creates a bootie-like fit and conforms to the foots shape. A semi-translucent strip of knit material runs across the side panel and allows the foot to breathe. The knit in this area is slightly looser than on other parts of the upper. A ribbed TPU cage wraps around the full-length Boost midsole. Although the TPU cage comes in Steel Gray, its texture adds contrast to the shoes design. Our experts at StockX like the heel pull tab, which helps the wearer put on and take off the shoe. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Steel Gray was released on February 29th, 2024, and retailed at $230.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Fox Brown Off White Gum
Description: The adidas Samba OG Fox Brown Off White Gum leans into earthy tones with a rich Fox Brown suede upper contrasted by Off White stripes. The warm brown shade gives the terrace classic a grounded, almost vintage feel, while the gum outsole reinforces its deep ties to indoor football heritage. The slim profile and T toe construction remain untouched, preserving the proportions that have made the Samba a global staple for decades. This colorway resonates because it feels both seasonal and timeless. The brown and white pairing offers a softer alternative to black based versions, making it easy to style with denim, relaxed tailoring, or layered fits. Fans appreciate when adidas refreshes the Samba through subtle tonal shifts rather than dramatic changes. It is a confident, everyday update that stays loyal to the models roots while offering a warmer expression of a true icon. The adidas Samba OG Fox Brown Off White Gum was released on August 21, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: adidas Vento XLG Deluxe Beige White
Description: The adidas Vento XLG Deluxe Beige White leans into exaggerated proportions and modern streetwear attitude, delivering a silhouette that feels bold yet balanced. The XLG shape gives the shoe visual weight, while the beige and white color combination softens the impact, creating a look that feels intentional rather than overwhelming. It reflects adidas willingness to experiment with scale while keeping the design wearable. Fans love this pair because it makes a statement without relying on loud colors or graphics. The oversized form feels fashion forward, but the neutral palette keeps it versatile. Collectors appreciate how the Vento XLG Deluxe fits into the current wave of expressive footwear, offering personality and presence while still feeling grounded enough for everyday rotation. The adidas Vento XLG Deluxe Beige White was released on February 10, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Concepts Orange Lobster
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Concepts Orange Lobster comes toned in a mixture of three main colors: electro orange, orange frost, and white. This Low Nike SB Dunk features a nubuck upper with varying orange tones, softly speckled overlays, and a tonal Swoosh accented in white. The interior lining is embellished with a bib-inspired pattern, and the white mesh tongue is embellished with a woven Nike SB tag. The shoe boasts an orange rubber outsole and a cupsole with black sidewalls. The Nike SB Dunk Low Concepts Orange Lobster was set to retail at $120 at its market launch on December 20th, 2022.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Sand Taupe
Description: The Yeezy 350 V2 continued its reign in 2020 with the release of the Sand Taupe colorway. The sneaker brings back adidas and Yeezys love for taupe colors that appear on many of their silhouettes. Drops such as the Yeezy 500 Blush, 350 V2 Flax, and 350 Oxford Tan all feature similar hues. This Yeezy adds to that lightly shaded collection. The Yeezy 350 V2 Sand Taupe features three colors on the sneakers upper. Its Primeknit construction is similar to the other 350 V2 colorways that have released. The midsole is filled with adidas signature BOOST cushioning to add comfort with every step, plus another set of laces are included with the sneaker to add versatility. The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 Sand Taupe released in December 2020 for $220.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Team Red
Description: Constructed of white and Team Red smooth leather, the Nike Dunk Low Team Red is an ode to the original look of the 1985 Nike Dunk Low. Nike embroideries on the heel tab and a woven tongue label arrive in a classic fashion. From there, a white and Team Red sole completes the design. The Nike Dunk Low Team Red released in May of 2022 and retailed for $100. It was also re-released in 2023.

Display Name: adidas Samba XLG Night Indigo Warm Vanilla
Description: The Adidas Samba XLG in Night Indigo, Gum, and Warm Vanilla is a colorway that brings the extended and maximized proportions of the XLG platform into a tonal combination that feels warm, considered, and genuinely distinctive within the broader Samba color catalog, pairing the atmospheric depth of night indigo with the comforting softness of warm vanilla in a relationship that creates exactly the kind of unexpected and rewarding color tension that the best Samba colorways always generate when they bring together shades that seem like they should not work together and then proceed to work beautifully. The Samba XLG platform takes the classic Samba architecture and scales up the sole unit and overall proportioning to create a chunkier and more maximalist silhouette that sits in conversation with the current appetite for exaggerated sole height and dimensional sneaker construction while remaining recognizably within the Samba family's design language and heritage. Night indigo on the XLG's enlarged upper surface creates a rich and deep color presence that the bigger silhouette can carry with authority, while warm vanilla provides the lighter and warmer counterpoint that prevents the night indigo from becoming visually heavy or overwhelming across the shoe's expanded proportions. Gum on the XLG's substantial sole unit is the detail that keeps the entire shoe grounded in the Samba's most essential and beloved design tradition, the warm translucent brown creating a foundation that connects the night indigo and warm vanilla color story back to the decades of athletic and terrace heritage that every Samba silhouette carries regardless of how much its proportions or colorways evolve across seasonal iterations. The night indigo and warm vanilla combination is particularly successful on the XLG because the platform's larger scale allows both colors to develop and breathe across a more generous canvas than the standard Samba provides, each shade occupying enough surface area to register fully and create a genuine color conversation rather than simply appearing as an accent or trim detail. For Samba collectors who follow the XLG specifically and appreciate when the platform's expanded proportions are paired with color stories this thoughtful and tonally sophisticated, night indigo and warm vanilla with gum is one of the most rewarding and wearable entries in the XLG catalog. The Adidas Samba XLG in Night Indigo, Gum, and Warm Vanilla has a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas XLG Runner Deluxe White Black
Description: The adidas XLG Runner Deluxe White Black is a performance shoe with a chunky and somewhat chaotic design. This version of the XLG Runner Deluxe by adidas has a base of breathable mesh, with black forming the top of the upper and white found around the toebox and heel. Support cages in both black and white cross the upper in an almost surgical pattern, and the 3-Stripes adorn the side panels in silver. Another logo is found on the lateral toe. This shoe has some serious laces: black laces appear where laces normally would, but white laces also run from the arch over the toebox and over the black laces for extra support. The chunky platform rubber heel adds a futuristic look. What stands out about this shoe are the extra laces, which provide an intense vibe that lends a functional look to the shoe to match its performance. The adidas XLG Runner Deluxe White Black was released on October 4, 2024, for $170.

Display Name: adidas Samba Indoor Core Black Cloud White Vivid Red
Description: The adidas Samba Indoor Core Black Cloud White Vivid Red stays close to the silhouettes indoor roots while introducing a sharper contrast through its color blocking. Core black dominates the upper, giving the shoe a sleek and grounded feel, while cloud white details and vivid red accents bring energy without disrupting the classic structure. The gum sole remains a constant, tying the design back to its heritage and reinforcing the timeless appeal that defines the Samba line. Fans continue to gravitate toward the Samba because of its versatility and deep cultural presence across football, skate, and streetwear spaces. This version keeps that identity intact while adding just enough color to stand out in rotation. It is the kind of pair that feels familiar at first glance but reveals more personality through its accents, making it a reliable option that still carries a bit of edge. The adidas Samba Indoor Core Black Cloud White Vivid Red was released on January 10, 2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Infrared Salesman
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro Infrared Salesman brings a long-rumored concept out of the archives and into full release as part of the AJ6s 35th anniversary celebration. Dressed in black with light crimson accents, this colorway flips one of Jordan Brands most iconic looks by reversing the placement of infrared-inspired details. The familiar silhouette feels instantly recognizable, yet refreshingly different, thanks to the bold contrast and unexpected color balance. This release traces its roots back to a late-1990s sample often referred to as the "Infrared Salesman," a never-released concept that circulated quietly among collectors for decades. That story is honored through details that lean into its sample history, including a special sample-style tag and a "Not For Resale" stamp hidden on the inner collar. Bright light crimson branding on the heel and reversed midsole accents further reinforce the idea of a classic design viewed through a new lens, giving the sneaker a deeper narrative beyond its surface. When the Air Jordan 6 Retro Infrared Salesman released, it retailed for $215 and dropped on February 14, 2026. With its archive-inspired story, anniversary timing, and flipped color execution, this release stands as one of the most meaningful and conversation-worthy Jordan 6 drops in recent years.

Display Name: adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Basketweave Cream White (Women's)
Description: The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Basketweave Cream White Womens blends martial arts influence with delicate lifestyle styling in a way that feels both unexpected and unmistakably adidas. Inspired by traditional taekwondo footwear, the silhouette keeps a slim and low profile shape while introducing woven basketweave texture across the Cream White upper for added depth and softness. The Gum 4 outsole grounds the design with subtle vintage energy, helping the pair feel connected to classic indoor training shoes while still embracing a more fashion driven direction. Fans have gravitated toward adidas martial arts inspired models because they offer an alternative to bulkier sneaker trends without losing personality. This version stands out through its elegant construction and ballet adjacent feel, creating a silhouette that feels lightweight, refined, and highly versatile. The monochromatic palette gives the woven upper room to shine, while the minimal shape makes the shoe easy to style with relaxed tailoring, athletic wear, or softer streetwear fits. Collectors appreciate pairs like this because they highlight adidas ability to reinterpret archival sport references into something modern and culturally current without abandoning the roots entirely. The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet Basketweave Cream White Womens was released on May 23, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Triple White
Description: The Nike P 6000 Triple White have a plain white color and are made from a mix of genuine leather, nylon, mesh, faux leather, and rubber. The Nike P 6000 Triple White has a lace-up closure style and a prominent tongue with Nike branding on it. The shoe also has a small Nike Swoosh at the front that merges with the rubber sole. They have a thick sole and a side profile featuring horizontal and vertical lines that create a mesh pattern with the Nike Swoosh on both sides of the shoe. The Nike P 6000 Triple White debuted at the retail price of $100 in June 2019.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Wolf Grey (2026)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Wolf Grey (2026) marks the return of a fan-favorite colorway that originally debuted in 2011 and quickly earned its place as a standout within the Jordan 5 lineup. Dressed in light graphite, white, and wolf grey, the sneaker delivers a clean, understated look that has aged effortlessly over time. The smooth grey upper and crisp white details highlight the silhouettes sharp lines, giving it a balanced presence that feels just as relevant today. When the Wolf Grey colorway first released, it offered a softer, more versatile alternative to the bolder Jordan 5 designs of the era. That simplicity became its strength, allowing the silhouette to shine without relying on loud contrasts. Over the years, its been remembered as one of the most wearable Jordan 5s ever made, appreciated for its subtle elegance and everyday appeal. The 2026 retro stays true to that original vision, preserving the look that made it so popular while also inlcuding the iconic Nike Air logo on the heel. When the Air Jordan 5 Retro Wolf Grey (2026) released, it retailed for $220 and dropped on February 28, 2026. By bringing back a colorway that helped define a generation of Jordan 5 releases, this return reaffirms why Wolf Grey remains a go-to classic in sneaker culture.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 500 High Slate
Description: Yeezy enlists a new variation of a popular design with the adidas Yeezy 500 Slate High, now available on StockX. This is the first high-top sneaker silhouette Yeezy has released since the 750. Similar to the 500 Stone release, Yeezy replaces mesh with neoprene to add a sleek look to this high-top model. This Yeezy 500 High is composed of a Slate neoprene and suede with reflective piping. A matching Adiprene midsole and gum rubber outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in December of 2019 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: adidas SL 72 RS Cloud White Core Black
Description: The adidas SL 72 RS Cloud White Core Black revisits a running inspired classic with a clean and understated palette that highlights the silhouettes retro DNA. Cloud white dominates the upper, giving it a light and wearable feel, while core black and grey one accents add contrast through the stripes and heel detailing. The low profile shape and textured midsole keep the design grounded in its original era, delivering a look that feels both nostalgic and easy to integrate into modern rotation. Fans of vintage adidas silhouettes appreciate how the SL 72 RS continues to honor its roots without unnecessary updates. The simplicity of the color scheme makes it especially versatile, allowing the design and shape to take center stage. It is a model that resonates with collectors who value subtlety and history, offering a timeless option that remains relevant through consistency rather than reinvention. The adidas SL 72 RS Cloud White Core Black was released with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Grey Silver
Description: The New Balance 990v4 Made in USA Grey Silver is a part of the 990 series, which is well-known for its quality, comfort, and timeless aesthetic. The New Balance 990v4 Grey Silver comes with an upper in different tones of Grey. With an upper crafted from a combination of premium pigskin suede and breathable mesh, it is durable, ventilated, and flexible, allowing for a wide range of movement. The mesh and suede parts come in a light grey colorway, and details of darker grey outline the mesh parts. The iconic " N" logo on the side of the shoe follows the same grey colorway. And ENCAP midsole technology provides a superior level of support and cushioning with its dual-density foam system. But what our experts love most about the New Balance 990v4 Made in USA Grey Silver is the ABZORB technology set in the midsole to absorb shocks and reduce the impact of your steps. These shoes have been keeping feet stylish and comfortable since their release on June 2, 2023, for a price of $185.

Display Name: Jordan 15-23RE Black Muslin
Description: The Air Jordan 15 23RE in Muslin and Black is a release from Jordan Brand's 23RE program that takes one of the most controversial, polarizing, and ultimately fascinating silhouettes in the entire Air Jordan archive and revisits it with the benefit of three decades of design perspective and collector reappraisal, delivering a shoe whose original 2000 debut divided opinion but whose alien and aerospace inspired design language has aged into something that feels genuinely ahead of its time rather than simply strange. The Jordan 15 was designed by Tinker Hatfield with explicit inspiration from the SR-71 Blackbird reconnaissance aircraft, the fastest air breathing jet aircraft ever built, and that aeronautical and military technology reference gives the shoe one of the most specific and intellectually interesting design biographies in the Jordan lineage, a silhouette that was literally trying to look like something that flies rather than something that plays basketball. Muslin as the primary colorway delivers the Jordan 15's angular and slightly alien design elements in a warm and earthy neutral that softens the shoe's inherently aggressive and technological character, making the aerospace design language feel more approachable and wearable than the original black and red colorways that launched the silhouette and created its initial polarizing reception. The 23RE program represents Jordan Brand's commitment to revisiting underappreciated and collector significant chapters of the Jordan archive with the quality and design attention that those silhouettes deserve, and the Jordan 15 in muslin and black is exactly the kind of release that rewards the collector who has followed Jordan Brand's design history carefully enough to understand why the 15 occupies such an interesting and contested place in the lineage. Muslin and black creates a color relationship on the Jordan 15 that feels simultaneously vintage and contemporary, the warm neutral primary evoking archival and construction references while the black detailing maintains the shoe's inherently technical and precision engineered character that the SR-71 inspiration demands. For Jordan collectors who want the most historically significant and design intellectually interesting silhouette in the current Jordan Brand calendar in a colorway that makes it genuinely wearable as a daily sneaker rather than purely a display piece, the Jordan 15 23RE in muslin and black is a deeply rewarding and culturally important acquisition. The Air Jordan 15 23RE in Muslin and Black was released on June 6, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Black Wonder White (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Black Wonder White (Women's) is an iconic adidas silhouette inspired by indoor football from the 1950s. This updated version of the classic sports shoe is specifically sized for women and delivers adidas comfort, dependability, and cool, elegant style. The Black Wonder White colorway of the Women's adidas Samba OG features a refined upper of nearly smooth black suede. Creamy white suede overlays the toe and forms the iconic adidas three stripes on the side panel. The heel is composed of matching creamy white leather with embossed horizontal stripes. The tongue is constructed of this same leather. Black adidas trefoil branding graces the tongue tag and Samba branding is printed along one of the three stripes. The feature we enjoy most about this sneaker is its gum rubber sole unit. Gum rubber extends from the midsole onto the upper and forms the traction pattern on the outsole. The adidas Samba OG Black Wonder White (Women's) was released on December 7, 2023, for $100 retail.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Cool Grey (2021)
Description: Since its debut in 2001, the Air Jordan 11 Cool Grey has become one of the most celebrated colorways in the Jordan 11 catalog. The Air Jordan 11 Cool Grey (2021) features a Cool Grey Durabuck upper with patent leather overlays and a signature Jumpman embroidery on the collar. From there, a white midsole and an icy blue translucent outsole complete the design. The Air Jordan 11 Cool Grey (2021) released in December of 2021 and retails for $225.

Display Name: Vans Old Skool 36 LX Souvenir Warm Brown
Description: The Vans Old Skool 36 LX Souvenir Warm Brown brings refined craftsmanship to a timeless silhouette, pairing the iconic side stripe with a rich, earth-toned palette that complements everything from raw denim to tailored joggers. The supple, warm brown upper highlights classic Old Skool lines, while subtle textural contrasts and precise stitching underscore the 36 LXs premium build. A cushioned collar and supportive footbed deliver day-long comfort, and the reinforced toe area adds durability for daily wear. Underfoot, the signature waffle outsole ensures confident traction and that unmistakable board-ready feel, rounding out a sneaker that balances heritage styling with modern comfort. Designed for versatility, this Vans staple transitions effortlessly from casual weekends to creative workspaces. The low-profile shape and clean proportions make it easy to dress up or down, while the Souvenir Warm Brown colorway taps into a vintage-inspired mood that feels fresh and elevated. Style ID VN000D9RENB and the July 2025 release align this pair with the latest Vans lineup, making it a smart pick for collectors and minimalists alike. Whether youre building a capsule wardrobe or refreshing your rotation, the Old Skool 36 LX offers a polished, go-anywhere look backed by dependable materials and a time-honored construction. Our team thinks this product is great for adding a sophisticated, wear-with-anything brown hue to your lineup while delivering the comfort, grip, and durability that make Vans a perennial favorite.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Sail
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG in Sail, Sail, and University Red is a release that strips the Jordan 1 Low down to its most essential and historically authentic tonal expression, building the entire upper in the warm and slightly aged sail colorway that evokes the original natural leather and canvas materials of the earliest Jordan 1 production runs while the university red heel tab and outsole detailing provides the single bold color accent that connects this shoe directly to the most iconic and foundational chapter in the Jordan 1's four decade design biography. Sail on sail construction creates a tonal depth and material interest that monochromatic color approaches on sneakers always deliver when executed with genuine material consideration, the different textures and finishes across overlays, toe box, and collar all reading as slightly different shades of the same warm near-white in ways that reward close examination with the kind of visual complexity that a two color upper cannot achieve. University red as the sole and heel accent is the most historically loaded color in the entire Jordan 1 palette, the shade directly associated with the original Chicago colorway that launched the silhouette into cultural history when Michael Jordan wore it during his rookie season against the NBA's explicit rules and accepted the resulting fine rather than changing his footwear. The Retro Low OG designation places this sail colorway in the most collector significant and construction authentic tier of the Jordan 1 Low catalog, with OG tooling and proportions that distinguish it from standard seasonal Jordan 1 Low releases and signal a commitment to historical accuracy that the most devoted Jordan Brand collectors specifically seek out when making acquisition decisions within the Jordan 1 ecosystem. Sail and university red is a color combination with its own specific biography within the Jordan 1 archive, appearing across multiple high and low profile releases over the years as one of the most beloved and endlessly rewatchable color stories the silhouette has ever carried, and the 2015 Retro Low OG release documented here represents one of the most significant moments when that story was told in the low top format with full OG construction authenticity. For Jordan 1 collectors who want the most historically resonant and materially authentic version of this beloved color combination in the low top silhouette, this sail and university red OG release is the definitive reference point. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG in Sail was released on August 1, 2015 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 450 Utility Black
Description: The adidas Yeezy 450 Utility Black is made of synthetic fibers, a product of a combination of petroleum-based ethylene-vinyl acetate and foam from algae. The design of adidas Yeez 450 Utility Black is renowned for its comfortable, tight, sock-like fit as well as its fashionable mesh style. The shoe has a semitranslucent rubber outsole and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) for performance and flexibility. The design of adidas Yeezy 450 comes in Utility Black. adidas Yeezy 450 Utility Black was released on February 8, 2022 at a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro SB Pine Green
Description: Nike SBs collaboration with Jordan helps create the ultimate sneaker for the skatepark to the basketball court, with the release of the Jordan 4 Retro SB Pine Green. The Jordan 4 Retro SB Pine Green used a white leather upper with a Neutral Grey suede mudguard. The limited edition sneakers sit on top of a white and Pine Green midsole which is highlighted by a red air unit. Nike used a gum outsole to help with increased grip while skateboarding. The Air Jordan 4 Retro SB Pine Green released March 20, 2023, with a retail price of $225.

Display Name: adidas Samba Nylon Wales Bonner Wonder Clay Royal
Description: The adidas Samba Nylon Wales Bonner Wonder Clay Royal updates the Samba with Wales Bonners signature bespoke house codes. This collaboration creates a sneaker with retro inspirations and premium materials. The upper is crafted from smooth leather in Wonder Clay, while the T-shaped overlay across the toe and the panels around the laces are on tonal shaggy suede. The textural contrast between these materials mirrors details found in other Wales Bonner products. Splashes of Team Royal Blue grace the 3-Stripes logo, the multicolor laces, and the dual branding on the tongues logo tag. Although the collar is lined with smooth blue leather, it comes in a slightly lighter shade. Finishing the vintage look, a gum rubber outsole wraps around the base of the sneaker. Our experts at StockX like the exaggerated stitching on the heel and tongue. The adidas Samba Nylon Wales Bonner Wonder Clay Royal was released on May 21, 2024, and retailed at $160.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Bloodline (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro Bloodline in Black and Varsity Red for Preschool sizing delivers one of the Jordan 12 archive's most visually commanding and culturally significant colorways to the youngest tier of the Jordan Brand sizing ecosystem. The all-black construction with varsity red accents creates the Bloodline's signature high-contrast and slightly aggressive color story at a scale appropriate for the earliest Jordan enthusiasts beginning their relationship with a silhouette that Tinker Hatfield designed in 1996 inspired by the Japanese Rising Sun flag. The Jordan 12's carbon fiber shank, quilted upper panels, and distinctive strap all translate to preschool sizing with complete visual authority, delivering the Bloodline's full design impact regardless of scale. Preschool Jordan releases in collector-significant colorways like the Bloodline serve the intergenerational sneaker culture moments that Jordan Brand has facilitated across families for decades, allowing the youngest community members to wear culturally meaningful colorways at sizes and price points appropriate for their age. The black and varsity red combination on the Jordan 12 remains one of the most timeless and repeatedly sought-after color stories in the sneaker archive, and the PS Bloodline continues that legacy at the most accessible and family-oriented tier of the Jordan 12 collector market. At ninety-five dollars this is a fair investment in genuine Jordan heritage at preschool scale. The Air Jordan 12 Retro Bloodline PS was released on May 23, 2026 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro Khaki Team Red Pearl White (Women's)
Description: Nike Dunk Low Retro Khaki Team Red Pearl White Womens brings a grounded, lifestyle focused palette to one of Nikes most versatile silhouettes, leaning into balance rather than flash. The mix of khaki, team red, and pearl white feels intentional and wearable, giving the Dunk Low a calm presence that still carries classic attitude. This colorway taps into the Dunks roots as an everyday shoe, built for rotation and personal style rather than hype driven moments. What makes this pair resonate with collectors is how effortlessly it fits into modern wardrobes. The muted tones highlight the Dunk Lows timeless paneling and proportions, letting the shape speak for itself. For fans who appreciate understated color stories, this release feels like a reminder of why the Dunk remains relevant decade after decade, adapting naturally to shifting tastes without losing its core identity. The Nike Dunk Low Retro Khaki Team Red Pearl White Womens was released on 10/01/2025 with a retail price of $130

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy
Description: Previously dubbed "Certified Lover Boy", the new premium Drake-inspired AF1 is now known as the "Love You Forever." This sentiment is inspired by Drakes favorite childhood book with subtle added details of the scripted "Love You Forever" on the midsole, in the same white color. Additional design elements include customized laces, NOCTA logo on left heel, and a new perforation pattern on toe box. ? The special-edition Drake Nike Air Force 1 Low released December of 2022 for $160.

Display Name: adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet White Black (Women's)
Description: The adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet White Black (Women's) is a flat silhouette that channels a ballet aesthetic while pulling design elements from adidas original Taekwondo Mei silhouette. Crafted from soft leather, this Taekwondo Mei Ballet combines heritage design and modern aesthetics. A core black Y-type overlay adorns the front toe area and is a reminiscent element of the adidas Y-3 model. The cloud white upper is made of leather and is adorned with three iconic core black stripes on the sides. White adidas adds contrast on the black heel overlay. Everything is balanced out with a gum toned rubber outsole. Resembling ballet pointe shoes, there isnt a tongue and the shoes lace crisscross atop the forefoot, and can be additionally tied around the ankle. We think that this shoes standout feature is that it combines the dynamic strength of martial arts and draws inspiration from adidas' archival flats, which results in an edgy, minimalist design. Originally priced at $90, the adidas Taekwondo Mei Ballet White Black (Women's) was released on March 15, 2025.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Masterpiece (2025) (GS)
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Masterpiece 2025 GS brings back one of the most visually striking Kobe silhouettes through a colorway that blends art and performance. The black upper is layered with metallic silver, bright crimson, and volt accents, creating a look that feels dynamic and expressive. The high cut Elite construction gives the shoe a sleek and supportive profile that stands out immediately. Fans of the Kobe line appreciate how the Masterpiece colorway pushes beyond traditional basketball design, turning the shoe into a statement on and off the court. The Protro update keeps the silhouette relevant while preserving its original identity. It is a sneaker that reflects Kobes creative influence and performance legacy in a bold and recognizable way. The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Masterpiece 2025 GS was released on February 8, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Walnut Huckleberry
Description: The Salomon XT 6 Walnut Huckleberry delivers a warmer and more earthy palette, combining walnut tones with huckleberry and urban chic accents to create a grounded and natural look. The design feels cohesive, with each tone blending into the next across the layered upper. This pair stands out because it shifts the mood of the XT 6 into something softer and more lifestyle focused. The earthy tones make it easy to style while still maintaining the technical identity of the silhouette. Fans appreciate how it offers a different perspective on a familiar model. The Salomon XT 6 Walnut Huckleberry was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Vintage Indigo
Description: The New Balance 9060 Vintage Indigo is a technical running shoe with a bulky, exaggerated midsole that gives it a futuristic aesthetic inspired by sneakers from the 2000s. The 9060 model takes elements from the iconic 990 series, including visible technology and wavy etchings on the midsole. The sneaker boasts a grey-tone colorway of Arctic Grey, Steel, and Vintage Indigo. The upper is made from mesh with soft suede overlays overlapping and fusing to the midsole. To create effective cushioning and energy return, the midsole houses both ABZORB and SBS technology. The sneaker has minimal branding, including the New Balance "N" on both side panels, "NB 9060" printed on the tongue tag, and a small "N" below the laces. Our experts love the semi-translucent plastic heel counter that separates the suede from the midsole. The New Balance 9060 Vintage Indigo was released on September 23rd, 2023, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Sail All-Star (GS)
Description: The Nike Kobe 6 Sail All-Star (GS) updates the Kobe 6 in a neutral colorway of Sail, Light Bone, and white with contrasting accents in black and soft Platinum Violet. Instead of the original textile pattern, the Sail All-Star (GS) Nike Kobe 6 covers the upper in a raised star pattern, adding dimension to the shoe. The upperÄôs predominant Sail hue draws inspiration from a snake shedding its skin and revealing something new. Additional hits of Sail can be found on the midsole and tongue, while Light Bone adds a complementary creamy tone to the heel and grippy outsole. The signature Swoosh logo checks across the side panel in black, while KobeÄôs signature sheath logo decorates the tongueÄî also in black. Our experts at StockX appreciate the subtle contrast provided by Platinum Violet on the lining. It almost blends into the Sail upper but catches the eye upon close inspection. The grade school-sized Nike Kobe 6 Sail All-Star (GS) was released on February 13, 2025, and sold for $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus White Lyon Blue Varsity Maize
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus White Lyon Blue Varsity Maize brings a brighter and more open feel to the Tuned Air silhouette, using a white polar varsity maize lyon blue palette that highlights the structure of the upper. The contrast between the clean base and colorful accents gives the shoe a fresh and energetic look. Collectors enjoy this version for its balance between brightness and detail. The white base makes it versatile, while the blue and yellow elements add personality without overwhelming the design. It stands as a more wearable take on the Plus while still maintaining the bold identity the model is known for. The Nike Air Max Plus White Lyon Blue Varsity Maize was released on April 29, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike GT Future Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike GT Future Metallic Silver introduces a futuristic silhouette through bold material and confident structure. Metallic silver defines the upper with a high impact finish, contrasted by black and white details that sharpen the design. The form feels sculptural and intentional, emphasizing motion and innovation through proportion rather than ornamentation. Fans are drawn to this model because it represents Nike looking ahead rather than back. The GT Future feels experimental and uncompromising, appealing to collectors who enjoy design that challenges convention. The reflective finish amplifies its presence, making it feel almost architectural. It stands as a statement of progress, offering a glimpse into where performance and lifestyle aesthetics may continue to intersect through fearless material choices and modern design language. The Nike GT Future Metallic Silver was released on December 20, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Dylan Harper Tri-State
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Dylan Harper Tri State brings a player inspired edge to a performance basketball silhouette through a bold and layered color palette. Orange pulse leads the design, while multi color elements and bright violet accents create a dynamic and energetic look. The overall construction feels responsive and agile, aligning with the GT Cuts focus on quick movement and control. Fans of the GT series appreciate how it continues to evolve with athlete driven storytelling, and this release adds a regional identity tied to the tri state concept. The color combination gives it strong visual impact, making it stand out both on and off the court. It is a sneaker that blends performance intent with personal narrative in a way that feels modern and expressive. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Dylan Harper Tri State was released on March 19, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Arctic Sky
Description: The ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Arctic Sky is a shoe that takes its design inspiration from several eras of running style. This version of the ASICS Gel-NYC is made with a combination of mesh for the base and suede overlays. Cream mesh makes up the base of the shoe, while smooth overlays in Arctic Sky light blue form the overlays that support the upper. Suede darker blue overlays appear on top of these light blue ones to form the toe cap and mudguard and support the eyestays. The ASICS logo appears in purple on the lateral heel and on the tongue, while GEL branding also appears in purple on the back of the heel. The shoe is equipped with Gel technology for energy return and cushioning. The midsole is gray and white. The mix of shades of blue and white in the laces give it a streamlined look. The ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Arctic Sky was released on March 1, 2025, for a price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 270 White Royal
Description: The Nike Air Max 270 White Royal is inspired by the running culture. Its midsole features a frothy Air Max 270 unit and is enameled by a rubber outsole for enhanced traction. On its upper, the Nike Air Max 270 features a fine knit design. A subtle mudguard arises from a white synthetic material adorned by a blue swoosh. This shoes quarter panels feature a similar combination of a textile knit and synthetic finish  the only difference between it and the upper being a slightly larger Nike swoosh. The heel has multiple features, starting with a true blue plastic heel stabilizer. A textile mesh follows, with the "Air" logo imprinted on it. Finally, a blue pull tab with swoosh and "Air" branding tops it off. Our experts are fond of the blue and white colorway blended in this sneaker. The blue shade elegantly paints the Air 270 tongue logo and quarter panels, and zigzag stitch on the collar. The Nike Air Max 270 White Royal Released on 16th November 2020 for $150.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Swarovski Warning Label
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Swarovski takes Ja Morants third signature sneaker into luxury territory with a bold, statement-driven finish. Wrapped in black with multi-color Swarovski crystal detailing, this edition transforms the Ja 3s aggressive silhouette into something eye-catching and fashion-forward. The crystal accents catch light from every angle, adding texture and shine without overpowering the shoes sharp lines and streamlined profile. This release represents a crossover between performance-inspired design and high-end embellishment, tapping into a growing trend of sneakers doubling as statement pieces. Swarovski collaborations have long been associated with exclusivity, and pairing that legacy with Ja Morants rising cultural influence gives this colorway a unique presence. The all-black base keeps the look grounded, while the crystal detailing elevates it beyond a standard colorway into collectible territory. When the Nike Ja 3 Swarovski released, it retailed for $235 and dropped on February 13, 2026. With its luxe materials and limited feel, this version stands apart as one of the most visually striking entries in the Ja Morant signature line.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver is a performance running sneaker that finds inspiration in the ninth version of the Gel-1000 and the GEL-KAYANO. Synthetic overlays in black and metallic Pure Silver replace traditional leather and give the sneaker a contemporary look. The sneaker boasts a mesh upper in white with a loose weave. This loose weave allows the foot to breathe and is lightweight. The bulky midsole features Gel technology in the heel, which delivers responsive cushioning. ASICS, in black lettering, runs diagonally down the tongue and is one of the few visible branding elements. Like other ASICS Gel-1130 models, the White Pure Silver iteration features an adjustable lace closure. Our experts at StockX like the way the black details on the overlays complement the black tread on the rubber outsole. The ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver was released on February 15, 2024, and retailed at $95.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Mid Flax Outdoor Green
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Mid Flax 2016 delivers seasonal warmth through one of the models most beloved executions. Flax tones cover the upper from top to bottom, creating a monochromatic look that feels rugged and intentional. Outdoor green accents add subtle contrast, while the mid cut profile gives the silhouette added structure and presence suited for cooler months. Fans continue to value this release because the Flax Air Force 1 has become a yearly staple rooted in familiarity and comfort. The colorway feels timeless, appealing to collectors who appreciate consistency over novelty. It represents Nike leaning into tradition, offering a dependable option that fits seamlessly into rotation year after year while maintaining strong cultural recognition. The Nike Air Force 1 Mid Flax 2016 was released on November 11, 2016 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Cortez Polka Dots Light Magenta Bright Crimson (Women's)
Description: The Nike Cortez Polka Dots Light Magenta Bright Crimson Womens reimagines one of Nikes earliest running silhouettes through a playful and vibrant design that adds personality to a classic shape. The Light Magenta base sets a soft and expressive tone, while Bright Crimson accents and polka dot detailing introduce contrast that makes the sneaker feel energetic and unique. The Cortez remains an important part of Nikes history, and this version shows how the model can evolve through pattern and color. Fans continue gravitating toward the Cortez because of its simple construction and strong cultural roots. The polka dot pattern adds a fresh twist, giving the shoe a more fashion forward feel without losing its identity. The slim profile makes it easy to wear across different styles, from casual to more styled outfits. Bright color combinations like this enhance the playful nature of the silhouette. For collectors, releases like this highlight how classic models can be updated through creative detailing that keeps them relevant across generations. The Nike Cortez Polka Dots Light Magenta Bright Crimson Womens was released on April 2, 2026 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Midnight (Women's)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 debuts in the chic Midnight/White colorway, balancing classic ASICS heritage with a splash of modern flair. While its aesthetics scream streetwear-ready, its roots are firmly planted in ASICS iconic legacy. Built with precision and a keen eye for detail, the shoe sports a mix of leather and mesh on its upper. The White hue envelops the silhouette, while Midnight accents make a statement, ensuring this pair doesn't go unnoticed.What truly sets the Gel-1130 apart is its unmatched comfort  a testament to ASICS' commitment to quality and innovation. Slide in, and let the soft Gel cushioning cradle your feet. The ASICS Gel-1130 (W) in Midnight/White was unveiled on March 15, 2023. With a sleek design that speaks comfort and style, it came out swinging at a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Setsubun (2022)
Description: Nike is ready for Spring and is drawing inspiration from Japan's annual Setsubun Festival, for a new colorway on the Nike Dunk Low. The Setsubun Festival is held a day prior to the beginning of Spring and is known as the Festival of bean-throwing, whichs brings good fortune. The Nike Dunk Low Setsubun is designed with shades of brown and tan, honoring the beans thrown at the Setsubun Festival. Nike added splashes of purple across the Swoosh, sockliner, and heel logo. The limited edition sneakers come with purple and white laces with gold aglets. The Nike Dunk Low Setsubun (2022) released June 1, 2022, with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Lil Yachty Concrete Boys Lucky Green
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Lil Yachty Concrete Boys Lucky Green is a vibrant collaboration that brings a fresh twist to the iconic silhouette. This eye-catching sneaker features a striking Lucky Green leather upper, complemented by Mystic Red and University Gold accents. The bold color combination pays homage to Lil Yachty's energetic style and the Concrete Boys' street-inspired aesthetic. Designed with both style and comfort in mind, this Air Force 1 Low retains its classic elements while incorporating unique details that set it apart. The shoe boasts a durable rubber outsole, providing excellent traction and longevity. The Air-Sole unit in the midsole offers responsive cushioning, ensuring all-day comfort for the wearer. We at StockX believe this product is great for those looking to make a statement with their footwear while enjoying the timeless appeal and comfort of the Air Force 1 silhouette.

Display Name: Puma Speedcat Ballet Black White (Women's)
Description: The Puma Speedcat Ballet Black White Womens reinterprets motorsport inspired design through a softer and more fashion forward lens. The Speedcat Ballet keeps the low profile and sleek lines that define the Speedcat family, while introducing a ballet flat inspired silhouette that feels elegant and lightweight. The black and white colorway reinforces its timeless appeal, balancing sport and style effortlessly. Fans love this release because it feels unexpected but natural. The fusion of racing heritage and ballet inspired form creates a shoe that feels unique without being forced. Collectors appreciate how Puma continues to evolve classic designs into new spaces, making this a standout option for those who value slim silhouettes, comfort, and understated style with a twist of heritage influence. The Puma Speedcat Ballet Black White Womens was released on April 9, 2025 with a retail price of $80.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Phenomena Black Metallic Gold (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max Phenomena Black Metallic Gold Womens brings a more fashion forward perspective to the Air Max line, combining bold contrast with a sleek silhouette. The black base creates a strong foundation, while metallic gold accents introduce a sense of luxury and shine. Smoke grey and pink foam details add subtle variation that keeps the design layered. This version stands out because it blends performance heritage with a more elevated aesthetic. The Air Max identity is still present through its cushioning and structure, but the execution leans toward statement wear. Fans who enjoy mixing sport and fashion elements will find this pair especially compelling. The Nike Air Max Phenomena Black Metallic Gold Womens was released on December 20, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Model: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B
Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B Parachute Beige
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B Parachute Beige is a low-top silhouette with a color-blocking design and extra cushioning for comfort. This iteration of the Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B is made with a suede upper that is designed to soften and look more vintage with wear. The upper appears completely in a Parachute Beige color, including the base, overlays, and branding elements. The toe box has been perforated for increased air flow. The only deviation from the suede material is around the ankle, where you will find textile material, and the heel collar is white leather with Nike branding. A Nike patch also adorns the tongue. A Parachute Beige midsole and gum rubber outsole complete the look. Our favorite feature of this shoe is the suede material that is designed to gain even more character with wear. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B Parachute Beige was released on January 24, 2025, for $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus 7 Dusk
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus 7 Dusk builds on the iconic Tuned Air silhouette with a color palette that feels intense and atmospheric. The total orange volt black cactus flower smoke grey combination creates a layered gradient effect that enhances the wavy upper structure, giving the shoe a sense of motion even when still. Fans of the Air Max Plus appreciate how color plays a major role in defining each release, and this version delivers a strong visual identity. The mix of tones feels bold but controlled, making it a standout option within the lineup. It continues the legacy of the Plus as a silhouette driven by both design and attitude. The Nike Air Max Plus 7 Dusk was released on November 5, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Cryoshot Tiempo 94 NOCTA
Description: The Nike Cryoshot Tiempo 94 NOCTA is Drake's NOCTA label's contribution to Nike's X2 World Cup collection representing Canada, converting the Nike Tiempo 94, the classic leather boot worn by Paolo Maldini and Romario at the 1994 FIFA World Cup, into a lifestyle sneaker through the Cryoshot process in the boldest and most vivid colorway of the seven-pair collection, featuring a University Gold leather upper referencing Canada's national team secondary colors with a quilted toe box pattern that echoes the original Tiempo 94's construction, a black Swoosh on both side panels, large NOCTA lettering debossed on the heel, a NOCTA logo on the Velcro forefoot strap, sword emblems on the extended tongue, and the Cryoshot translucent outsole encasing the Tiempo 94's original stud configuration. Drake's NOCTA imprint represents the co-hosting nation with a colorway and branding that places the Drake-Canadian cultural connection at the center of the shoe's identity, with the University Gold standing out among the seven Cryoshot releases as the most saturated and most unmissable palette of the collection. The Tiempo franchise's direct association with the 1994 World Cup gives the NOCTA collaboration a historically specific resonance, connecting the boot's tournament moment to Canada's first World Cup participation as a co-host nation in 2026 across a thirty-two-year gap. Released June 11, 2026 via NOCTA and the Canadian Men's National Team channels, June 13 via Dover Street Market, and June 16 via SNKRS and select retailers at $210 retail with style code IM0703-700. The Nike Cryoshot Tiempo 94 NOCTA was released on June 16, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Black
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Black delivers a sleek and performance focused look through a dark and layered color palette. The black base keeps the design clean, while subtle multi color accents add depth across the upper. Built for quick movements and responsiveness, the silhouette reflects Nikes focus on modern basketball performance. This pair stands out because it balances function with a sharp visual identity. The understated colorway makes it versatile, while the structure supports high level play. It appeals to athletes and collectors alike who appreciate a shoe that performs on court while still fitting into everyday rotation. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Black was released on February 26, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Jade Smoke (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Jade Smoke (Women's) is a low-top sneaker that features bold color blocking in Jade Smoke, Anthracite, and Sail. The upper is constructed primarily from smooth leather with Anthracite as the base and Sail on the forefoot overlays, the mudguard, the heel counter, and around the collar. The flat, black tongue is made from a synthetic textile, which makes the sneaker stand out from other Jordan 1 Low models. Jade Smoke can only be found on the Swoosh logos, which check across the side panels. Other branding details include the Air Jordan Wings logo on the heel and a white Jumpman on the tongue. Something our StockX experts like is the choice of Legend Sand for the midsole. The slightly off-white hue gives the sneaker a retro, worn-in appearance. The womens size Jordan 1 Low Jade Smoke (Women's) was released on April 1, 2024, and retailed at $115.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL Bob Marley Black
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL Bob Marley Black brings a cultural tribute into a performance silhouette through a bold and meaningful color combination. The core black base provides a strong foundation, while pure ruby and bold gold accents add vibrant contrast that references reggae influence. The design feels expressive while maintaining the streamlined structure of the Evo SL. Fans of music inspired releases appreciate how this pair blends cultural storytelling with functional design. The color palette adds depth and identity, making it stand out while still remaining wearable. It is a sneaker that reflects both performance innovation and artistic inspiration in a cohesive form. The adidas Adizero Evo SL Bob Marley Black was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Total 90 3 SP Metallic Silver Black
Description: The Nike Total 90 3 SP Metallic Silver Black marks a bold return of a soccer silhouette thats been reimagined for contemporary, everyday streetwear. This shoe is dressed in a sleek metallic silver, black and university red color palette. Originally launched in 2000, the Nike Total 90 series was renowned for its performance on the field. This 2025 iteration pays homage to its roots while embracing modern design elements suitable for everyday wear.? Notice the signature quilted-like toe box area and asymmetrical lacing system which are nods to the original design. The upper is a glossy metallic silver with iconic "90" branding on the medial side in a bold university red. Black Nike Swooshes don the lateral side, the mid-forefoot, and heel. Tonal silver laces and a black, flat outsole completes the look. Our experts point out that this sneaker blends nostalgic elements with contemporary flair which gives it personality and adds to its appeal. The Nike Total 90 3 SP Metallic Silver Black debuted on March 1, 2025, with a $110 retail price.

Display Name: Jordan Hydro XI Retro Gamma Blue
Description: The Air Jordan Hydro XI Retro Gamma Blue delivers a bold and high contrast take on the slide silhouette through a mix of dark and vibrant tones. The black base creates a strong and grounded look, while gamma blue accents add a bright and energetic pop. Varsity maize details introduce additional contrast, giving the design a layered feel. Fans of Gamma Blue colorways appreciate how they bring a more modern and expressive look to classic Jordan designs. The combination of tones gives it a standout presence while remaining wearable. It is a slide that reflects comfort and bold styling within the Jordan lineup. The Air Jordan Hydro XI Retro Gamma Blue was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $70.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro Heat Map Black Racer Blue
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro Heat Map Black Racer Blue takes the classic Air Force 1 foundation and adds a more experimental visual layer through its heat map inspired detailing. The black base keeps the silhouette grounded, while racer blue accents introduce contrast that highlights the graphic elements across the upper. The familiar shape remains intact, allowing the design to feel recognizable while still pushing into a more expressive direction. Fans appreciate this version because it blends innovation with one of Nikes most dependable models. The heat map concept adds a sense of movement and energy, giving the shoe a unique identity within the Air Force 1 lineup. It stands as a pair that offers something different while still maintaining the versatility and cultural relevance that define the silhouette. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro Heat Map Black Racer Blue has a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Flightposite Jason Kidd Mavericks (2025)
Description: The Nike Air Flightposite Jason Kidd Mavericks 2025 revives a futuristic classic tied to one of the games iconic floor generals. Dressed in Multi Color with Midnight Navy accents, the molded upper retains the sleek and sculpted look that defined the Flightposite line. The zip shroud and streamlined shape reinforce its bold and ahead of its time identity. Jason Kidds Mavericks era adds nostalgic weight to this reissue, connecting modern collectors to early two thousands innovation. The shimmering upper and deep navy tones create strong contrast while honoring the original spirit. It feels daring and technical, a reminder of when Nike pushed boundaries in basketball design. The Nike Air Flightposite Jason Kidd Mavericks 2025 was released on November 21, 2025 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Malt Gold Mini Swoosh (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Malt Gold Mini Swoosh Womens blends subtle contrast with refined detailing. Finished in Sail with Metallic Gold and Malt accents, the upper features a small mini Swoosh that adds a premium touch to the traditional layout. The layered leather panels maintain the clean and recognizable Dunk structure. Mini Swoosh variations often feel elevated and understated at the same time. The soft sail base keeps the palette light, while gold detailing introduces a hint of shine. It stands as a polished take on the Dunk, offering womens sizing in a colorway that balances warmth and sophistication. The Nike Dunk Low Malt Gold Mini Swoosh Womens was released on October 29, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Parra Abstract Art (2021)
Description: Nike and Dutch artist and sneaker collab veteran Parra teamed up for an Olympic inspired Nike SB Dunk Low with the Nike SB Dunk Low Parra Abstract Art. The Nike SB Dunk Low Parra Abstract Art highlights Parra's surreal take on pop art. Off-white leather on the upper creates a blank canvas so that overlays smothered in vibrant, retro Parra patterns rise to prominence. Additional details like the embroidered mini-Swoosh on the toe box and gum outsole offer nostalgic appeal. The Nike SB Dunk Low Parra Abstract Art released in July of 2021 and retailed for $110.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 SE Black Seaweed
Description: The Nike Shox R4 SE Black/Seaweed is an October 1, 2025 release from Nike's Shox program, retailing at $155 with style code IM6596-001 in the Black/Seaweed/Light Lemon Twist/Black colorway, confirmed by StockX, the official Nike.com product page, and Grailify. As confirmed by Sneaker News, Grailify, and the official Nike description, the Shox R4 SE Black/Seaweed is a recrafted version of the 2001 icon replicating the original with a synthetic and textile upper, design lines, and laser perforations throughout for ventilation. The defining SE distinction is the iridescent reflective overlays on the parallel quarter panel panels and wavy side stripes that shimmer in a kaleidoscope of blue, green, yellow, and purple when exposed to direct light, with Sneaker News confirming the visual inspiration is the Aurora Borealis. Grailify confirmed the Black/Seaweed/Light Lemon Twist colorway features the dark black base as the backdrop with the wave-shaped reflective lines taking center stage, black laces and piston-inspired Shox columns in the heel, and a modified circular Waffle outsole for traction. The Nike Shox R4 originally debuted in 2001 as an innovative running sneaker featuring the column-shaped Shox cushioning technology that distributes weight to maximize comfort and provide a performance-inspired look. Retail price $155. The Nike Shox R4 SE Black/Seaweed is the October 1, 2025 IM6596-001 Aurora-Borealis-inspired iridescent-multicolor-reflective-overlay laser-perforated synthetic-and-textile Shox-column-heel modified-Waffle-outsole 2001-icon-recrafted Shox R4 for the Nike and Shox collector who wants the most visually dynamic and most light-shifting black-base iridescent execution from the Nike Shox R4 SE program. The Nike Shox R4 SE Black/Seaweed was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: New Balance 327 Moonbeam Classic Burgundy (Women's)
Description: The New Balance 327 Moonbeam Classic Burgundy W arrives in a white, burgundy, and light gray color scheme. ? ?The New Balance 327 Moonbeam Classic Burgundy W has on the upper as a base white leather with light grey suede overlays on the front and back of the shoe for an elevated appearance.
