Description: The adidas Adizero Select 2.0 Low Lucid Pink Preloved Lime is a September 1, 2025 release in the Adizero Select basketball shoe line, an entry-level performance basketball silhouette built around the Lightstrike cushioning system that adidas has deployed across its basketball shoe range as the lightweight, responsive midsole option for players who prioritize court feel, speed, and low-to-ground responsiveness over maximum cushioning height. The Adizero Select's construction, as confirmed across multiple retailer product pages, uses a textile upper for lightweight breathability, textile lining, Lightstrike midsole cushioning for a fast, court-feel-oriented ride, and a rubber outsole providing the traction appropriate to court surfaces, with a regular fit designed for guards and quick players who want a lower-profile basketball shoe offering superior court connection relative to higher-stacked cushioning alternatives. Slickdeals' product description confirmed the shoe is optimized for speed with a responsive Lightstrike midsole and high-traction rubber outsole, the design philosophy of the Adizero line name, which references the brand's history of speed-focused and lightweight athletic footwear across running and basketball. The Lucid Pink, Powder Plum, and Preloved Lime colorway is the most visually complex and most boldly color-blocked execution in the Adizero Select's chromatic range, the combination of warm pink, dusty plum, and soft lime green creating a pastel-adjacent but distinctly energetic palette that makes this colorway the most visually distinctive option in the September 2025 Adizero Select color program. Released September 1, 2025 at $90. The adidas Adizero Select 2.0 Low Lucid Pink Preloved Lime is the September 2025 Lightstrike basketball shoe for the player and collector who wants the speed-optimized, court-feel-focused Adizero Select construction in the most visually distinctive and most boldly multi-colored Lucid Pink, Powder Plum, and Preloved Lime colorway in the Adizero Select lineup. The adidas Adizero Select 2.0 Low Lucid Pink Preloved Lime was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Glacier Blue Mint Foam Green Shock Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Glacier Blue/Mint Foam/Green Shock/Black is a women's release from Nike's elite marathon racing program, released July 1, 2025 at a retail price of $295, confirmed by StockX and Pro Direct Running with style code FD8315-400. As confirmed by Pro Direct Running, Sneaker News, and the official Nike Alphafly 3 product description, the women's Glacier Blue/Mint Foam/Green Shock/Black colorway features the Atomknit upper in Glacier Blue with a contrasting black Swoosh, Mint Foam across the front portion of the midsole, and Green Shock accents on the Air Zoom cushioning and outsole, creating the light and visually dynamic palette that captures the competitive energy of the Alphafly 3's race-day performance. Pro Direct Running's technical specification confirmed the women's Alphafly 3 weighs approximately 174g, has a stack height approved by World Athletics below 40mm, 8mm offset, ZoomX max stack cushioning, double Air Zoom units, and a full-length carbon fiber plate. Nike confirmed the Alphafly 3 is the lightest Alphafly ever made, with the wider carbon fiber plate providing a more stable platform, the fully connected ZoomX foam midsole enabling smoother transitions from heel to toe, and the integrated knit tongue with lofted padding alleviating lace pressure during race-day use. Retail price $295. The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Glacier Blue/Mint Foam/Green Shock/Black Womens is the July 1, 2025 FD8315-400 174g Atomknit-Glacier-Blue dual-Air-Zoom-forefoot wider-carbon-fiber-Flyplate fully-connected-ZoomX-foam World-Athletics-approved women's elite marathon racing shoe for the Nike running collector who wants the most visually vibrant and most performance-forward Glacier Blue colorway from the Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 women's program. Display Name: New Balance 9060 Bone Sparrow

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Uncle Phil

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Spiridon OG Sport Red (2024)

Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble in Black, Anthracite, Dark Smoke Grey, and Sapphire is a premium execution that brings the 95's most architecturally pure and historically faithful OG specification to a colorway that delivers one of the most visually dramatic and cool-toned color stories available in the Big Bubble platform family. At one hundred and ninety dollars the Black Sapphire OG Big Bubble delivers the most historically complete and materially premium Air Max 95 experience in the September 2024 Nike release calendar. Description: The Jordan 12 Retro Flu Game (2025) marks the return of one of the most legendary sneakers in basketball history. First introduced in 1997 and last seen in 2016, this colorway represents an unforgettable moment in Michael Jordans career. During Game 5 of the 1997 NBA Finals, MJ battled flu-like symptoms and still delivered a clutch 38-point performance, securing a vital win for the Chicago Bulls. This sneaker, draped in black and varsity red, became a symbol of perseverance, making it one of the most iconic Air Jordans ever released Staying true to its roots, the 2025 edition features premium black tumbled leather on the upper, exuding a sleek and timeless look. The textured varsity red mudguard and midsole bring bold contrast, while signature details like the Jumpman logo on the tongue and heel tab complete the classic aesthetic. Whether you're a longtime collector or new to the game, the Flu Game 12s remain an essential piece of sneaker history. The Jordan 12 Retro Flu Game (2025) released on March 1, 2025, for a retail price of $210. With its deep-rooted connection to one of basketballs most legendary performances, this release continues to captivate sneakerheads and MJ fans alike.

Model: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP
Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP A Ma Maniére Black Burgundy Crush
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP A Ma Maniére Black Burgundy Crush is the centerpiece of one of 2026's most thoughtfully constructed running collaborations, rooted in A Ma Maniére's ongoing dialogue between Black culture, community, and craft. The dark engineered knit and mesh upper wraps the Pegasus Premium silhouette in a rich, mature palette, with Burgundy Crush accents tracing seams and side panels while Taupe Grey and Alabaster tones give the midsole that signature aged, worn in quality A Ma Maniére has made a house standard. Metallic Silver lands on the Swoosh and co branded details near the lateral toe box, finishing the shoe with just enough gleam to honor the collaborative nature without overshadowing the understated character of the build. The campaign behind this drop, titled "Timing Is Everything," was shot at Texas Southern University and centers Black love expressed through friendship, mentorship, partnership, and self, giving the shoe a narrative weight that goes far beyond product. A Ma Maniére has spent years applying its refined aesthetic to retro hoops and Jordan silhouettes, and stepping into performance running with the Pegasus Premium marks a meaningful expansion of that creative vision. The triple stack of ZoomX, Air Zoom, and ReactX cushioning underneath means the shoe performs at the highest level, and the limited SNKRS distribution following the boutique release makes this one of the more coveted running collaborations of the year. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP A Ma Maniére Black Burgundy Crush was released on June 19, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Timberland 6" Premium Waterproof Boot Wheat
Description: The Timberland 6 Inch Premium Waterproof Wheat is one of the variants from the Timberland brand, a common footwear among men and trekking sports enthusiasts. The boot is made from leather material at the upper part and rubber at the sole. The design unleashes in style code TB010062-713. 90% of the upper part of Timberland Waterproof is wheat, while the collar is black. The design consists of a stylish suede with a Timberland logo branded on the side of the shoe. Timberland 6 Inch Premium Waterproof Wheat was first released on June 1, 2019, at a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro CHBL
Description: The Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro CHBL in Sail, Metallic Gold, and Igloo is a release that carries the specific and deeply emotional weight of the Kobe signature catalog in a colorway that honors the most specific and personally loaded chapter of Bryant's legacy, with CHBL referencing Cheeseburglar, the nickname tied to a beloved and intimate chapter of Kobe family lore that connects this shoe to Gianna Bryant and the father-daughter relationship that has become central to how the broader basketball community honors both of them since their passing in January 2020. Sail and metallic gold create a warm and slightly precious color foundation while igloo introduces a cool and slightly unexpected blue-green accent that gives the CHBL colorway its specific and memorable visual identity beyond the warm neutral base. The Kobe 3 Low Protro's updated construction delivers the original 2007 silhouette's dimensions and design intent with modern production quality, honoring one of Bryant's most technically interesting and performance-forward signature eras. Kobe Protro releases that carry specific personal and family significance to the Bryant legacy generate collector responses that extend well beyond the sneaker community into the broader basketball culture where Kobe and Gianna's memory continues to inspire and move people across generations and geographies. The CHBL colorway is precisely the kind of release that rewards collectors who follow the Kobe catalog with genuine depth of knowledge and personal connection to the Bryant family story, the colorway's meaning carrying as much weight as its execution for those who understand what they are wearing and why it matters. Sail and metallic gold with igloo creates a visually refined and emotionally considered palette that honors the subject without resorting to overt or obvious tribute symbolism, letting the colorway name carry the meaning while the execution delivers genuine beauty and wearability. The Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro CHBL in Sail, Metallic Gold, and Igloo has a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 White Metallic Silver Black
Description: The Nike P-6000 White Metallic Silver Black is a striking addition to Nike's lineup of lifestyle sneakers. This model showcases a sleek design that seamlessly blends retro aesthetics with modern comfort. The upper features a clean white base, accented by metallic silver overlays that add a touch of sophistication. Black detailing on the Swoosh, heel, and outsole provides a bold contrast, creating a visually appealing balance. Engineered for both style and performance, the P-6000 boasts Nike's renowned cushioning technology, ensuring all-day comfort for wearers. The shoe's construction incorporates a mix of materials, including breathable mesh and durable leather, offering a premium feel and enhanced durability. With its versatile colorway and timeless silhouette, this sneaker effortlessly transitions from casual outings to more active pursuits. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that combines classic Nike design elements with contemporary comfort features.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air (2025) returns with subtle swagger and bold heritage. Dressed in deep royal blue, fire red, sail, black and muslin, the standout feature is the high-shine patent leather mudguard in the royal blue hue, a signal that this isnt just another run of the AJ11. Classic white leather above gives it that clean contrast while fire red hits and a muslin-tinted translucent outsole add vintage flavor. Lore plays a major role here: part of the "Rare Air" series that nods to sample-model aesthetics and collector culture, this drop adds "JORDAN" spelled across the eyestays and revisits some prototype styling cues. It feels like a sneaker built not just to wear, but to appreciate, ideal for someone who respects design story, Jordan history and statement kicks. When the Air Jordan 11 Retro Rare Air (2025) released, it carried a retail price of $235 and hit on November 5, 2025. With its mix of bold colors and nods to the AJ11 legacy, this release becomes a fit-friendly icon, a buy for both wearers and collectors alike.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Liberty London Blue Floral (GS)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Liberty London Blue Floral GS blends sport heritage with expressive pattern work rooted in British design history. The blue floral upper brings a soft yet detailed look to the Samba, contrasted by off white accents that keep the silhouette balanced and recognizable. A gum sole grounds the design, ensuring the classic indoor football foundation remains intact beneath the artistic surface. This release stands out because it transforms the Samba into something decorative without losing its identity. Fans appreciate the Liberty London collaboration for its attention to detail and textile storytelling, making this pair feel collectible and personal. It appeals to those who enjoy sneakers as design objects as much as everyday footwear, offering a fresh perspective on a model that has long lived at the center of global style culture. The adidas Samba OG Liberty London Blue Floral GS was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Dashawn Jordan Copperhead
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Dashawn Air Jordan Copperhead brings a layered and expressive take to the Dunk, reflecting Dashawn Jordans creative influence through a mix of tones and textures. String and black create a grounded base, while bright spruce, fierce purple, and dark russet accents add unexpected bursts of color that shift across the upper. The result feels dynamic and slightly unconventional. This pair stands out because it blends skateboarding identity with broader design references. The Copperhead theme gives it a distinct personality, while the mix of colors keeps it visually engaging from every angle. Fans of SB releases appreciate how it pushes beyond simple color blocking into something more narrative driven. The Nike SB Dunk Low Dashawn Air Jordan Copperhead was released on March 17, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 TGRS Black Cream (Women's)
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 TGRS Black/Cream (Womens) blends retro sport heritage with refined, everyday wearability. Rooted in the iconic 1966 silhouette, this pair showcases the brands hallmark crossed stripes in a soft cream against a sleek black upper for an effortlessly polished look. The low-profile shape flatters the foot, while subtle textural contrasts and a neatly stitched toe cap elevate the minimalist design. A flexible rubber outsole delivers reliable traction, and the lightly cushioned footbed keeps each step comfortable, ideal for everything from coffee runs to weekend exploring. Style code 1182A678-001 and the timeless Black/Cream colorway make this an easy, wardrobe-building staple. Thoughtful details underscore its quality: a supportive heel flap with embossed branding, a padded collar for a secure feel, and a lace-up closure that lets you fine-tune the fit. The Mexico 66 TGRS moves seamlessly from denim and a trench to flowy skirts and a tee, adding a sleek finish without overpowering your look. Whether youre drawn to vintage runners or simply want a versatile lifestyle sneaker, this ASICS classic offers a clean, balanced profile that stands up to daily wear. Released in March 2025, its a fresh take on a legend, modern comfort with unmistakable Onitsuka Tiger DNA. Our team loves this product because it delivers classic styling, easy all-day comfort, and a goes-with-everything palette that instantly sharpens any outfit.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Pink
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Pink balances technical design with playful contrast by pairing metallic silver with soft pink accents. The result feels approachable yet expressive, letting the silhouettes layered construction shine while color adds personality. It highlights the ProGrid Omni 9 as a bridge between archival running function and contemporary lifestyle appeal. Collectors appreciate this pair because it feels versatile and thoughtfully styled. The silver base keeps the look clean, while pink details add warmth and individuality that elevate the shoe beyond pure performance. Fans love how Saucony continues to reframe classic runners for modern wear, making this release a strong example of comfort, nostalgia, and visual balance working together naturally. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Pink was released on December 1, 2024 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Cloudburst Icy Pink
Description: The Salomon XT 6 Cloudburst Icy Pink brings a technical trail silhouette into a softer and more expressive color palette, combining cloudburst tones with icy pink and tapioca accents. The XT 6 remains known for its layered construction and performance driven design, giving the shoe a structured and functional feel. The lighter tones shift the aesthetic, making it feel more approachable while still retaining its outdoor roots. Fans of Salomon appreciate how colorways like this expand the versatility of trail models beyond rugged environments. The combination of technical design and softer tones creates a unique balance that works in both outdoor and urban settings. It is a sneaker that reflects the growing crossover between performance gear and lifestyle wear, offering comfort and style in one package. The Salomon XT 6 Cloudburst Icy Pink was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: adidas Superstar II White Black White
Description: The adidas Superstar II White Black White keeps the formula simple with a crisp White upper accented by bold Black stripes. The tonal white shell toe blends seamlessly into the leather base, giving the silhouette a smooth and cohesive look. By focusing on clean contrast, adidas highlights the Superstars unmistakable proportions without overcomplicating the design. This release stands out because it leans fully into heritage. The black stripes against white leather instantly recall the era when the Superstar became a cultural staple beyond basketball. Fans appreciate how the structure and detailing stay consistent, allowing the shoes legacy to speak for itself. It is a straightforward, confident expression of a model that has defined sport and street style for generations. The adidas Superstar II White Black White was released on February 6, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Velvet Brown
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Velvet Brown is a fresh collaboration that effortlessly merges the boldness of Travis Scotts aesthetic with the timeless allure of the Jordan 1 silhouette. Featuring a dark mocha, black, and velvet brown colorway, this sneaker embraces an earthy palette that feels both rugged and luxurious. Signature Cactus Jack branding and reverse Swoosh designs elevate the sneakers uniqueness, making it a must-have for collectors and fans. Beyond aesthetics, this iteration stays true to the Air Jordan 1s roots. The premium materials and meticulous detailinghallmarks of Travis Scotts collaborationspromise an experience thats as stylish as it is functional. Whether you're pairing it with streetwear or using it to anchor a statement outfit, this design delivers unparalleled versatility. Released on December 21, 2024, for $150, the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Velvet Brown captures the perfect mix of classic and contemporary. With its earthy brown tones, this sneaker stands out as a testament to the ever-evolving art of sneaker design.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro OG Black Metallic Reimagined
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro OG Black Metallic Reimagined pays homage to one of Jordan Brands most iconic designs, first debuted in 1990. This updated version reimagines the timeless sneaker with subtle yet impactful modern tweaks, staying true to its legendary roots. Featuring a sleek black nubuck upper, reflective metallic silver tongues, and bold fire red accents on the Jumpman logo, this sneaker effortlessly blends heritage with innovation. Every detail has been carefully crafted to elevate its legacy. The 3M reflective tongue and metallic silver shark teeth on the midsole add depth and dimension, while translucent netting and a visible Air unit in the heel enhance both style and comfort. Beloved touches like the "Nike Air" branding on the heel and upside-down "Air Jordan" text inside the tongue provide nostalgic nods to the original design while keeping the sneaker relevant. Released on February 8, 2025,the Air Jordan 5 Black Metallic Reimagined retailed for $210. This version marks the 35th anniversary of the silhouette and is part of Jordan Brands highly anticipated Reimagined lineup, giving both longtime fans and newcomers a fresh reason to celebrate.

Display Name: Vans OTW Old Skool 36 PP Parra
Description: The Vans OTW Old Skool 36 Parra merges skate heritage with bold artistic flair. Dressed in Midnight and Carmine, the classic Old Skool 36 silhouette highlights Parras expressive design language across the familiar low top shape. The durable canvas and suede construction maintain its skate ready identity. Parra collaborations consistently inject vibrant personality into Vans staples. The midnight base contrasts sharply with carmine accents, creating dynamic visual energy. It stands as a playful reinterpretation of a skate icon, blending art and street culture seamlessly. The Vans OTW Old Skool 36 Parra was released on January 22, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Mind 001 Mineral Slate Light Pumice Hyper Crimson Metallic Platinum
Description: The Nike Mind 001 Slide Mineral Slate introduces a more sculptural and design driven approach to casual footwear, emphasizing form and material over traditional branding. The mineral slate color creates a muted and cohesive look, while metallic platinum and light pumice accents add subtle variation across the surface. The shape feels modern and slightly futuristic, setting it apart from standard slide silhouettes. Fans are drawn to this model because it reflects Nikes exploration into more experimental design language. The focus on structure and texture gives it a distinct identity, making it feel more like a design piece than a basic slide. It stands as a forward looking option that blends comfort with visual innovation. The Nike Mind 001 Slide Mineral Slate has a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Chicago Lost and Found
Description: The original Air Jordan 1 Chicago colorway was first introduced in 1985 and has only been retroed a few times since. But 2022 is the year that the colorway returns with an added vintage look. Pre-yellowed accents and cracked leather uppers showcase a fabricated look of age and wear. The Air Jordan 1 Lost and Found Chicago released in November of 2022 for $180.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Thunder Brown Stonewear
Description: The New Balance 9060 in Thunder Brown, Stonewear, and Black Coffee is a colorway that brings one of the most technically complex and visually layered silhouettes in the current New Balance lifestyle lineup to an earth-toned palette that references the specific and beloved visual vocabulary of natural stone, aged leather, and the organic warmth of coffee and dark earth in a combination that feels genuinely grounded and materially sophisticated. Thunder brown as the dominant tone occupies the deep and slightly dramatic end of the brown spectrum, the thunder designation suggesting a brown with more density and visual weight than standard tan or caramel alternatives, and against stonewear's slightly grey-adjacent and mineral-textured complementary tone the combination creates a shoe with genuine dimensional visual complexity that rewards inspection from multiple angles. Black coffee as the third colorway element adds the deepest and most grounding tone to a palette that builds through layers of warm organic references from the lightest stonewear through the mid thunder brown to the deep black coffee darkness at the sole and structural accent elements. New Balance 9060 releases in deeply considered earth tone palettes represent the platform at its most materially sophisticated and lifestyle-conscious, the silhouette's multi-layer construction and aggressive midsole profile carrying warm neutral color stories with more dimensional richness than simpler designs can achieve across the same palette territory. The thunder brown, stonewear, and black coffee combination creates a 9060 that will integrate into the broadest possible range of earth tone and warm neutral wardrobes while carrying enough specific color nomenclature depth and tonal complexity to reward the close inspection that the most design-attentive collectors bring to their New Balance acquisitions. At one hundred and sixty dollars the 9060 in this palette reflects the platform's premium lifestyle tier positioning. The New Balance 9060 in Thunder Brown, Stonewear, and Black Coffee has a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Cryoshot CTR360 Maestri II G-Dragon Peaceminusone Natural University Red
Description: The Nike Cryoshot CTR360 Maestri II PEACEMINUSONE is G-Dragon's contribution to Nike's X2 World Cup collection representing South Korea, transforming the CTR360 Maestri II, one of Nike Football's most celebrated early-2010s control-focused boots favored by midfield playmakers including Andrés Iniesta and Cesc Fàbregas, into a lifestyle sneaker through the Cryoshot conversion process. The original Kanga-Lite synthetic upper of the CTR360 is replaced with a shaggy cream-colored suede in Natural that gives the shoe the vintage, worn-in quality consistent with G-Dragon's past Nike collaborations including the Para-Noise Air Force 1 series, University Red lands on the Swoosh logos, toe box, heel structure, and PEACEMINUSONE branding on the heel and tongue alongside the label's signature daisy logo on the lateral heel, University Gold accent detailing adds a third color dimension, and an aged yellowed midsole gradually transitions into the icy Cryoshot translucent cage that encases the original boot studs underfoot. The PEACEMINUSONE x CTR360 Maestri II represents G-Dragon's first major Nike Football collaboration and his most culturally significant Nike project since the Para-Noise series, connecting Korea's global cultural export through the K-Pop artist's creative vision to the most globally watched sporting event of 2026. Released June 11, 2026 via PEACEMINUSONE and the Korean National Team store, June 13 via Dover Street Market, and June 16 via SNKRS and select retailers at $210 retail with style code HQ1460-100. The Nike Cryoshot CTR360 Maestri II G-Dragon Peaceminusone Natural University Red was released on June 16, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Grey
Description: The adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Grey is another sneaker released as part of the long-standing collaboration between adidas and singer/fashion designer Kanye Wests Yeezy brand. The Yeezy 450 is a modern lifestyle sneaker featuring a seamless one-piece knit textile upper. It has a monochromatic color palette featuring a light grey hue and an avant-garde design aesthetic with a sock-like fit, elastic collar, and traditional lacing system. The shoes also have a molded rubber sole that extends to the sides of the shoe, creating a cage-like structure that not only adds aesthetic value, but also has functional importance. What we love most about the adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Grey is the added support provided by the cage-like structure on the shoe. This makes them sturdier while also supporting your feet, allowing for better balance. The shoes were first released for retail on the 15th of August, 2023, priced at $210.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Low PSG (2022)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low PSG 2022 is a collaboration between the French soccer team, Paris Saint-German (PSG), and the Jordan brand by Nike, which has been PSGs kit manufacturer since 2018. This Retro Low PSG 2022 fifth model is grey and has suede uppers. These shoes have a bright red Jordan-branded lace toggled to match the laces and the "PANAME" tag toward the shoe heels. The sneakers have black-toned tongues, black midsoles in icy blue, and the PSG badge underneath the translucent rubber accents. The Air Jordan 5 Retro Low PSG 2022 had a retail price of $200 upon its released in September 2022.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro SE Black Canvas
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE Black Canvas arrives in a neutral color scheming with contrasting touches of crimson red. This Black Canvas Air Jordan is a mid-top sneaker with a black canvas upper complemented by a gray tonal suede which covers the eyelets and forefoot overlays. A gray Jumpman logo graces the heel and woven tongue tag, with the latter getting a crimson Flight logo. The sneaker also rides on a two-tone polyurethane midsole with visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel. The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE Black Canvas was released on the 5th of October 2022, and retailed at a price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 5 Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike Free Metcon 5 Smoke Grey is a high-performance training sneaker designed to improve stability without sacrificing flexibility. Boasting a lightweight yet durable mesh upper in Smoke Grey, this sneaker has a sleek silhouette without added bulk around the collar or underfoot. The upper includes a 7/8-length inner sleeve that creates a locked-in feeling. The wide heel stabilizes the foot, while a double layer of foam provides supportive cushioning and protects against impact stress. In the forefoot, Nike Free technology allows for flexibility, and the collars natural stretch lets the foot move without restriction. The Smoke Grey Nike Free Metcon 5 sneaker features minimal branding details, but the small, white Swoosh logos on the inner side panels add a touch of Nike heritage. Our experts like the inclusion of rubber tread in high-wear areas, which contributes to the sneakers overall longevity. The Nike Free Metcon 5 Smoke Grey was released on April 6, 2023, and sold for $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Torch 4 Black Silver
Description: The Nike Air Max Torch 4 Black Silver features a silhouette reminiscent of Sean McDowell's classic Air Max Plus. Designed for support and comfort, this sneaker is dressed in a subtle, stylish colorway. The Black and Silver Nike Air Max Torch 4 features an upper base of loosely woven black mesh with an underlay of silver. Black synthetic textile overlays adorn the toecap, mud guard, eyestays, and heel. A silver TPU cage undulates vertically up the midfoot, providing style as well as structure. A three-dimensional silver Nike Swoosh adorns the side panel, matching a miniature silver Swoosh on the toe. Nike Air branding in silver appears at the lateral heel and on the tongue tag, completing the look of this upper. The aspect of this sneaker we appreciate the most is the dependable sole unit. A black Phylon midsole with a visible Max Air unit in the heel offers optimal cushioning. The black rubber outsole with hits of silver features heritage waffle lugs for traction, as well as Max Air branding and a Nike Swoosh. The Nike Air Max Torch 4 Black Silver was released on April 26th, 2018, for $140 retail.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Black Cool Grey Celestine Blue
Description: Nike P 6000 Black Cool Grey Celestine Blue pulls directly from early two thousands running culture, reviving a layered look that feels technical and casual at the same time. The mix of black and cool grey creates a grounded base, while Celestine Blue accents add just enough energy to keep the shoe from feeling flat. It taps into that retro performance aesthetic that has quietly become a staple for people who appreciate archival Nike design without chasing loud trends. What makes the P 6000 resonate with collectors is its effortless versatility. The structured upper and flowing lines give it visual depth, while the color balance allows it to move easily between everyday wear and curated rotation status. It feels like a shoe designed for movement through the city rather than the track, celebrating Nikes ability to turn functional design language into lasting lifestyle appeal. The Nike P 6000 Black Cool Grey Celestine Blue was released on 07/02/2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro White Cement (2016)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro White Cement 2016 features the classic 1989 colorway White/Fire Red/Black/Tech Gray. Black waffle eyestays and white mesh enhance the white leather upper. "Cement" refers to the black-speckled gray accents on the midsole, wings, and heel. A black Nike Air logo and Swoosh appear just below a cement-pattern heel tab. The white tongue features a red Jumpman above "Flight" printed in black. The black insole has a red Nike Air logo and Swoosh. The white midsole has visible Air. The rubber outsole includes every color in the colorway. The Air Jordan 4 Retro White Cement 2016 was released on February 12, 2016, at a retail price of $220.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Bliss Pink Purple (Women's)
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bliss Pink Purple (Women's) brings a Y2K update to the adidas Campus '80s. Infused with the skate vibes of the early 2000s, this sneaker for women pops with color and contrast.? ?? ?The upper of the 00s iteration of adidas Campus in a Bliss Lilac/?Collegiate Purple/?Core Black colorway features an upper made of pinkish purple suede with and a hit of black leather with adidas branding on the heel tab. Lighter purple laces criss-cross over a tonal pink suede tongue with a black adidas trefoil plate. The sock liner and insole match the upper, and the branding on the insole matches the laces. Grounding this updated sneaker firmly in classic adidas roots are the black leather adidas signature 3-Stripes on the quarter panel and the gold Campus branding above the top stripe. The outsole is in transluscent tan color with herringbone traction for ultimate grip.? ?? ?What we appreciate most about this shoe is the midsole. It's tan color harkens back to the Campus '80s while its platform height brings a new twist. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bliss Pink Purple (Women's) was released on May 1, 2023 for $110 retail.? ??

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Iced Carmine (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Iced Carmine PS brings playful color and classic Jordan design together in a preschool sized version of one of the most beloved sneakers in the Jordan archive. Iced Carmine overlays pair with Coconut Milk and Muslin tones to create a softer vintage inspired balance, while Pinksicle accents give the shoe extra energy that stands out against the layered upper construction. The Air Jordan 4 remains one of the most recognizable silhouettes in sneaker culture thanks to its mesh paneling, visible Air unit, and unmistakable wing eyelets. Smaller sized Jordan releases have become increasingly collectible because they reinterpret iconic silhouettes through brighter palettes and more experimental color combinations. This pair keeps the familiar Jordan 4 structure intact while introducing tones that feel lighter and more playful without losing the sneakers heritage appeal. Fans appreciate how the muted cream shades help balance the stronger pink and carmine accents, creating a shoe that still feels cohesive and wearable. For Jordan collectors, even preschool releases like this continue extending the cultural reach of the Air Jordan 4 across generations. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Iced Carmine PS was released on April 23, 2026 with a retail price of $90.

Model: Hoka One One Bondi Mary Jane
Display Name: Hoka One One Bondi Mary Jane Black
Description: The Hoka One One Bondi Mary Jane Black reimagines one of Hoka most cushioned silhouettes through an unexpected strap driven design. Dressed entirely in Black, the shoe maintains the chunky Bondi sole that has become synonymous with maximum comfort. The Mary Jane inspired upper adds a fashion forward twist, blending performance cushioning with a lifestyle oriented shape. Hoka has built its reputation on plush support and bold proportions, and seeing that DNA translated into a Mary Jane format feels both playful and practical. The all Black execution keeps it versatile, allowing the unique silhouette to stand out without loud color blocking. For those who appreciate comfort focused innovation with a design edge, this pair feels refreshingly different. The Hoka One One Bondi Mary Jane Black was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Better Scarlet Patent Leather
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Better Scarlet Patent Leather brings a bold and expressive edge to one of adidas most enduring indoor silhouettes. The glossy better scarlet patent leather upper immediately sets this pair apart, catching light in a way that feels playful and unapologetic while still honoring the clean Gazelle shape. Cloud white branding offers crisp contrast, and the gum sole grounds the look in its classic training roots, balancing flash with familiarity. This version resonates with fans because it pushes the Gazelle into a more fashion forward lane without losing its cultural credibility. The patent finish gives it a statement quality that feels suited for styling rather than sport, yet the proportions remain timeless. Collectors appreciate how adidas continues to experiment within its archives, proving that small material shifts can completely change the energy of a beloved model while keeping its identity intact. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Better Scarlet Patent Leather was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low CSEF
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low CSEF showcases an innovative partnership with the College Skateboarding Educational Foundation, combining skate culture with educational advocacy in a striking sneaker. Crafted from a premium medley of patent leather, suede, smooth leather, and mesh, the sneaker's eye-catching palette of summit white, black, iron grey, clear emerald, and bucktan creates a visually captivating experience. Hidden beneath the skate-friendly design, playful features such as a scantron-inspired tongue and a flaming graduation cap graphic bring its educational theme vividly to life. This sneaker not only celebrates skateboarding's cultural impact but also directly supports student skaters aiming higher academically. With unique elements like the eraser pink layer revealed through wear and CSEF branding proudly on display, it's a conversation starter both on and off the board. Released on May 3, 2025, the Nike SB Dunk Low CSEF retailed at $125, blending bold style with impactful purpose, making it a must-have for skaters and fashion-forward sneakerheads alike.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Bone
Description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Bone features a triple white Primeknit upper with mesh side stripes and canvas heel tabs. At the base, a semi-translucent sole with Boost technology completes the design. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Bone released in March of 2022 and retailed for $230.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Sail University Red
Description: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Sail University Red brings a timeless balance of heritage and warmth to the most iconic silhouette in sneaker history. The sail base softens the Jordan 1s sharp lines, while university red accents inject classic Bulls era energy that longtime fans instantly recognize. It feels rooted in legacy without being loud, letting color placement and proportion do the storytelling rather than graphics or gimmicks. Collectors appreciate this pair because it highlights why the Jordan 1 remains endlessly adaptable. The high cut shape carries attitude and history, while the sail tone gives it a refined, worn in feel that works naturally across seasons. It feels like a shoe designed to be lived in, not just displayed, reinforcing the idea that the strongest Jordan colorways often come from restraint and balance rather than reinvention. Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro OG Chicago (2026)

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Onyx
Description: The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Onyx features a PrimeKnit canvas characterized by a combination of black and gray tones, all of which sit atop a black sole equipped with cushioning Boost technology. Display Name: adidas Samba Ruffle Stripes Pack Clear Sky (Women's)

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low SB Light Orewood Brown Pink

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Larimar Blue Silver
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Larimar Blue Silver refreshes a beloved mid-2000s runner with modern comfort and a cool-toned palette. Display Name: adidas Samba OG Wonder White Shadow Red
Description: The adidas Samba OG Wonder White Shadow Red delivers a sharp and confident color update rooted in terrace tradition. Display Name: adidas Ballerina Bad Bunny Flamboyan

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro White Cement Reimagined

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Core Black Gum

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Low 3SSB PE
Description: Built for quick cuts and all-game comfort, the adidas AE 1 Low 3SSB PE blends on-court performance with a clean, modern aesthetic. This low-top take on Anthony Edwards signature line keeps you closer to the floor for faster first steps, while a sculpted midsole provides responsive cushioning through long runs and hard landings. Display Name: adidas Stan Smith CLOT By Edison Chen Night Navy Beads

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Ivory

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Giraffe Print Crystal Linen (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Cow Print in Crystal Linen and Ivory is a March 2026 women's release applying an abstract cow print pattern to the Samba OG's suede upper panels in a Crystal Linen off-white and ivory palette, translating the irregular black and white blotched pattern associated with Holstein cattle into the Samba's standard suede paneling for a textured, fashion-trend-aware iteration of adidas' most commercially significant lifestyle silhouette. The cow print is one of fashion's most durable animal print references, appearing periodically across footwear and apparel in both literal dairy-cow black-on-white and more fashion-abstracted color interpretations, with the Crystal Linen palette keeping this Samba OG version in the lightest and most neutral possible cow print expression by removing the standard black color from the pattern and replacing it with ivory-on-linen for a tone-on-tone effect that reads as a pattern texture from a distance rather than the bold contrast of a traditional cow print. The Samba OG's standard construction featuring a suede upper, serrated Three Stripes, T-toe overlays, and the recognizable low-profile EVA and rubber cupsole anchors the cow print's fashion-forward surface treatment in the most trusted and most broadly loved adidas silhouette of the current decade, making the Crystal Linen Cow Print an accessible fashion-trend shoe for the Samba's core women's buyer who wants something visually distinct within the model's large seasonal colorway catalog. Released March 1, 2026 at $110 retail via adidas.com and select retailers globally in women's sizing. The adidas Samba OG Cow Print Crystal Linen Womens was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL White Black
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL White Black is a super-light (SL) running shoe boasting a sleek, racing-inspired look in a cloud white and core black color combo. Display Name: UGG Tasman II Slipper Black

Display Name: adidas Samba LT Preloved Yellow
Description: The adidas Samba LT Preloved Yellow continues the lineage of one of the brand's most iconic trainers. This updated model has a striking design, while retaining that classic low profile. Display Name: adidas Response CL Bad Bunny Paso Fino

Display Name: Vans LX Classic Slip-On 98 Pearlized Pack Camo Black

Display Name: UGG Tasman II Slipper Chestnut

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Alumina Light Brown
Description: The Adidas Samba OG Alumina Light Brown is the kind of colorway that reminds you why the Samba has spent so many years at the center of the conversation without showing any signs of slowing down. Collectors who have been building through the Samba's neutral chapter will recognize this one immediately as a pair that stays relevant long after the initial release energy fades. The Adidas Samba OG Alumina Light Brown was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Collegiate Green (Women's)

Display Name: adidas Ultra Boost 5X Cloud White Core Black

Display Name: Nike Air Max 2 CB '94 Triple Black

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Black

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Patent Camo Pink
