Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro Xuanwu blends Jordan Brand heritage with symbolism pulled from Chinese mythology, creating one of the more atmospheric and story driven Air Jordan 6 releases in recent memory. Inspired by Xuanwu, the Black Tortoise deity associated with protection and strength, the sneaker leans into earthy Light British Khaki suede with layered textures that give the silhouette a weathered and almost ancient feel. Black accents and Sail detailing balance the upper while preserving the rugged mood that separates this pair from more traditional Jordan colorways. Fans appreciate culturally inspired Jordan releases when the storytelling feels woven directly into the design rather than added afterward, and the Xuanwu delivers that through material choice, palette, and overall tone. The Air Jordan 6 already carries strong legacy status thanks to its connection to Michael Jordans first championship season, and this reinterpretation gives the silhouette a quieter but more mysterious personality. Collectors gravitate toward pairs like this because they feel less focused on nostalgia alone and more centered on narrative, atmosphere, and craftsmanship within the broader Jordan archive. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Xuanwu was released in 2021 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Triple Black
Description: The Nike Vomero 5 Triple Black is part of Nikes Vomero 5 lineup, which includes sneakers with a technical silhouette and a variety of function-first details. The "Triple Black" comes with an all-black, mesh base and leather overlays. Like other editions of the Vomero 5, the sneaker features motifs of Bill Bowerman, a famous University of Oregon coach, on the insole. 3M reflective detailing along the overlays provides extra visibility during low lighting, while Zoom Air cushioning adds comfort and support. The sneakers all-black colorway makes it stand out from other versions of the Vomero 5 and gives the shoe a sleek appearance. Something our experts love is the plastic heel counter. It features a grid-like design and complements the plastic paneling on the side of the sneaker. The Nike Vomero 5 Triple Black was released on July 20, 2023, and retailed at $160.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Carbon
Description: The adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Carbon features a pink, yellow, purple, and dark grey marbled EVA foam and recycled algae construction with ventilation holes throughout the design. At the base, a sculptural sole adds cushioning and support. The adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Carbon released in August of 2022 and retailed for $90.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Footwear White Green
Description: The adidas Samba OG Footwear White Green adorns the classic low-top OG silhouette in a color scheme of footwear white, green, and supplier color. The Footwear White Green adidas Samba OG features an upper constructed from leather material, which offers longevity. The sneaker features branding details including the signature adidas Three Stripes logo on the side panels, the "SAMBA" wordmark on one side panel, and the Trefoil logo on the tongue. The padded collar offers comfort and support. In addition, the shoe's midsole is cushioned to provide impact protection and responsive cushioning. The shoe's sturdy rubber outsole provides traction. What we love about this sneaker is its striking green accents on the signature three stripes and the heel tab, adding a vibrant pop of color and making it the most notable feature of the shoe. The adidas Samba OG Footwear White Green was released on May 18, 2023, and sold at an initial price of $120.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Slate
Description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Slate Core Black Slate takes on a sock like design that is complemented with a neutral two-tone color scheme. The Yeezy Boost 350 by adidas in black upper utilizes tan Primeknit construction, highlighted by distinctive center stitching down the vamp. A contrasting black streak adorns the lateral side with signature SPLY-350 branding. The shoe sits atop a Boost midsole, confined in a semi-translucent TPU cage for durability and support. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Slate Core Black Slate was originally released on the 3rd of September 2022, and initially retailed at $230.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Orange White Patent
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Orange White Patent dresses the Air Force 1 Low 07 silhouette in a bright orange and clean white colorway. As a 2007 reissue of the original AF 1 from 1982, the Orange White Patent Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 maintains its heritage low-top design and bold color-blocking. The underlays are crafted from smooth leather in orange, while the heel and forefoot overlays, the heel tab, and the eyelets are made from shiny orange patent leather. Adding contrast, the midsole, laces, inner lining, and Swoosh logos are displayed in white. Visible branding details include "NIKE" on the heel tab, "NIKE AIR AIR FORCE 1" on the woven tongue tag, and "AIR" on the midsole. Our experts at StockX like the way white rope replaces the traditional flat laces in the lace cage. The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Orange White Patent was released on December 26, 2024, and retailed at $120.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Chicago Lost and Found (GS)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Chicago Lost and Found (GS) arrives in the classic 1985 silhouette with a color scheme of varisity red, black, sail and muslin hues. ? ?This sneaker for grade-schooler´s upper is primarily white, with contrasting red and cracked black overlays. Besides the black Swooshes on the sides, the shoe also features "NIKE AIR" branding on the muslin tongues, Wings on the collars, and printed insoles. White midsoles and contrasting red rubber outsoles complete the design. ? ?The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Chicago Lost and Found (GS) was released on the 19th of November 2022 and originally retail for $140.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 Puerto Rico
Description: The Nike Shox R4 Puerto Rico is a June 5, 2026 release from Nike's culturally inspired Shox program, retailing at $155 with style code IQ1867-474 in the Glacier Blue/White/University Red/Metallic Silver colorway, debuting through Up NYC and Takout and confirmed by Sole Retriever, Sneaker Bar Detroit, and House of Heat. As confirmed by Sneaker Bar Detroit and House of Heat, the Nike Shox R4 Puerto Rico features a Glacier Blue leather upper giving the retro runner a clean icy look, University Red on the Swoosh outline, heel embroidery, outsole circles, and bright insole branding, Metallic Silver on the Shox columns for a reflective finish, and white on the larger side Swoosh and sections of the sole for balanced color blocking. House of Heat confirmed the release includes a vejigante careta charm, the folkloric horned mask combining Spanish, African, and Taíno traditions that is an iconic symbol of Puerto Rican cultural celebration, with "PR" and star graphics wrapping the Shox columns as a direct tribute to the Puerto Rican flag's red, white, and blue palette. Sole Retriever and Highsnobiety confirmed the release is timed to celebrate the annual Puerto Rican Day Parade in New York City, continuing Nike's rich history of honoring Puerto Rican cultural identity through special-edition footwear including Air Force 1s and Air Max releases from the 2000s forward. Retail price $155. The Nike Shox R4 Puerto Rico is the June 5, 2026 IQ1867-474 Glacier-Blue-leather University-Red-Swoosh-outline-and-heel Metallic-Silver-columns PR-star-Shox-column-graphics vejigante-careta-charm unisex Puerto-Rican-Day-Parade-tribute Shox R4 for the Nike and Puerto Rican culture collector who wants the most culturally resonant Glacier Blue and University Red flag-inspired colorway from the Nike Shox R4 Puerto Rico program. The Nike Shox R4 Puerto Rico was released on June 5, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: adidas Superstar II Cream White Earth Strata (Women's)
Description: The adidas Superstar II Molly Mae Latte Womens refines the classic Superstar formula with a softer and more lifestyle focused approach that aligns with contemporary styling trends. The cream white base creates a clean and neutral foundation, while earth strata accents introduce a subtle warmth that gives the shoe a more elevated and tonal feel. The updated Superstar II shape keeps the familiar DNA intact while smoothing out the overall look for a more modern presence. Fans are drawn to this version because it balances heritage with a more curated aesthetic that fits seamlessly into everyday wear. The Molly Mae influence is evident in the understated palette and minimal approach, making it especially appealing for those who prefer versatility over bold contrast. It is a pair that feels intentional and refined, offering a fresh perspective on a silhouette that has long been a staple in sneaker culture. The adidas Superstar II Molly Mae Latte Womens was released on April 9, 2026 with a retail price of $132.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Wonder White Black Pony (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Wonder White Black Pony Womens adds texture driven personality to a silhouette known for its simplicity. Wonder white tones dominate the upper, while black pony hair detailing introduces contrast and tactile depth that immediately sets this pair apart. Alumina accents soften the overall look, keeping the design balanced and grounded within the familiar Samba framework. Fans appreciate this version because it feels expressive without losing refinement. The pony hair detail gives the shoe a fashion aware edge, making it especially appealing to collectors who enjoy material experimentation on classic forms. Despite the added texture, the silhouette remains clean and wearable, offering a fresh interpretation that still honors the Sambas long standing cultural presence and everyday appeal across style communities. The adidas Samba OG Wonder White Black Pony Womens was released on March 1, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Atlanta Braves City Connect (2026)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Atlanta Braves City Connect 2026 celebrates Atlanta baseball culture through a colorway inspired by the Braves City Connect identity and the deep connection between sports and streetwear in the city. The Air Max 1 serves as a perfect canvas for team inspired storytelling because of its iconic shape and layered panel construction, while the combination of White, Hyper Royal, Dark Powder Blue, and Speed Red immediately reflects Atlantas recognizable baseball palette and energetic sports atmosphere. The cleaner white foundation keeps the shoe versatile while allowing the brighter accents to stand out naturally across the upper. Fans gravitate toward City Connect themed sneakers because they merge local pride, sports culture, and collectible footwear in a way that feels authentic and emotionally tied to specific cities and fan bases. Atlantas influence across music, fashion, and sports gives this release additional cultural weight beyond baseball alone. Collectors especially appreciate how Nike uses subtle color storytelling rather than overwhelming graphics to create team inspired Air Max releases that remain highly wearable. The combination of royal blue and red accents gives the sneaker vibrant contrast while preserving the timeless and versatile identity of the Air Max 1 silhouette. The Nike Air Max 1 Atlanta Braves City Connect 2026 was released on May 12, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse
Description: Nike and Jordan Brand are returning back to the Spider-Verse for their second Spider-Man themed Air Jordan 1, with the release of the Air Jordan 1 High OG Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse. Also known as the Next Chapter, the Jordan 1 High OG Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse is the next iteration of the original Air Jordan 1 Chicago colorway. The limited edition sneakers are constructed using various leathers, suedes, and other premium materials across the uppers. The patterns used across the sneakers are designed to mimic the Miles Morales/Spider-Man animation style. The Air Jordan 1 High OG Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse released May 20, 2023, with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Marine
Description: The adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Marine dresses the minimalist, sock-like Yeezy 450 in an all-over Stone Marine colorway. Featuring a one-piece knit build, the upper is crafted from Yeezy Primeknit. This material creates a supportive, locked-in feel while keeping the foot cool and dry. Instead of traditional laces, the Stone Marine adidas Yeezy 450 applies no-tie laces crafted from a stretchy material. They crisscross the upper and complement the ribbed ankle cuff. The polyurethane-injected foam midsole wraps around the upper, featuring indentations and curves that bring to mind stones worn away by water. The midsole supports the foot, while wavy lines on the rubber outsole provide traction. Something our experts at StockX like is the minimal branding on the exterior. For example, adidas lettering can be found on the outsole and the Ortholite sockliner. The adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Marine was released on August 5, 2024, and sold for $210.

Display Name: adidas Superstar Hellstar Hazy Orange
Description: The adidas Superstar Hellstar Hazy Orange brings a bold reinterpretation to one of the most recognizable silhouettes in sneaker history, pushing the Superstar into a louder and more expressive space. The hazy orange finish takes over the upper entirely, giving the shoe a monochromatic intensity that feels unapologetically statement driven. Signature details like the shell toe and three stripes remain intact, but the color execution shifts the energy from classic to experimental without losing its foundation. This pair stands out because it leans into contrast through saturation rather than multiple tones, letting the color carry the identity. Fans of both adidas heritage and Hellstars aesthetic appreciate how the collaboration injects new life into a staple without stripping away what makes it iconic. It feels equally rooted in streetwear and sneaker culture, offering something that grabs attention while still being grounded in a silhouette that collectors trust and recognize instantly. The adidas Superstar Hellstar Hazy Orange was released on April 10, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Pegasus Pack Phantom
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Pegasus Pack Phantom brings a soft and refined palette to the timeless silhouette. Finished in Phantom with Sail and White accents, the upper keeps the familiar leather construction while introducing subtle design cues tied to the Pegasus theme. The clean color blocking enhances the classic proportions of the AF1. Phantom tones give the sneaker a muted elegance, making it easy to integrate into everyday rotation. The Pegasus Pack influence adds a light storytelling element without overpowering the design. It feels modern yet rooted in heritage, a thoughtful update to one of Nikes most enduring models. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Pegasus Pack Phantom was released on January 9, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Cinder
Description: Yeezy adds another colorway of its most popular design with the adidas Yeezy 350 Cinder, now available on StockX. This 350 V2 stays true to Yeezys signature palette, sporting dark earth tones that provide a natural feeling. This Yeezy 350 V2 is composed of a cinder Primeknit upper with a tonal side stripe. A cinder Boost cushioned midsole sole and gold outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in March of 2020 and retailed for $220.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Snakeskin Black (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Snakeskin Black Womens reinterprets a terrace icon through texture and attitude while staying true to its classic proportions. Core black anchors the upper, while subtle snakeskin detailing adds dimension that feels refined rather than flashy. Grey six accents provide contrast across the familiar stripe placement, and the gum sole keeps the silhouette grounded in its indoor football roots. The result feels sleek and elevated without losing the simplicity that defines the Samba. Fans appreciate this version because it pushes material rather than color. The snakeskin finish gives the shoe personality while maintaining everyday wearability, making it appealing to collectors who value subtle distinction. The Samba OG continues to thrive through thoughtful updates like this, where texture adds depth without compromising heritage. It stands as a confident evolution of a timeless design, blending street credibility with understated sophistication in a way that feels natural and lasting. The adidas Samba OG Snakeskin Black Womens was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG White Solar Red Gum (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG White Solar Red Gum (Women's) reimagines a silhouette originally designed for indoor soccer and gives it a street style that makes it a fashion icon. This low-top in a crisp dual colorway features an upper of smooth white leather at the base and the eye stay overlays. Red leather forms the heel tab, as well as the iconic serrated three stripes that course up the side panel. The leather tongue features a red tag that sports adidas trefoil branding. Samba branding hits the lateral side panel just above the third stripe. The collar is padded to enhance ankle comfort, and the insole is white with red adidas trefoil branding. The gum rubber sole unit is reinforced for durability. The standout aspect of the women's sneaker that we most enjoy is the T-toe overlay. In darker white nubuck, it adds a note of contrast to this shoe. The adidas Samba OG White Solar Red Gum (Women's) was released on November 19, 2023, for a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Max Volume
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Max Volume turns heads on and off the court with a high-energy palette of Hyper Pink, Mint Foam, Black, and Viotech. Designed for quick guards and explosive slashes to the rim, this mens basketball shoe pairs a lightweight, breathable upper with supportive overlays that keep your foot locked in through hard cuts and step-backs. A plush, responsive midsole helps soften landings and spring you into your next move, while the padded collar and sculpted heel provide a secure, comfortable fit for full-court runs. Underfoot, its grippy outsole pattern is engineered to bite on fast stops and sudden changes of direction, giving you confident traction from tip-off to clutch time. Style codes HF2793-600 / HF2794-600 and the bold "Max Volume" treatment make this Nike Ja 3 a standout addition to your rotation. Thoughtful details, like durable toe reinforcement, strategic ventilation zones, and a streamlined profile, balance performance with everyday wearability. Whether youre chasing buckets at the park or pairing them with streetwear, the color-blocking amplifies every fit, while the performance build keeps pace with the games most dynamic playstyles. If youre searching for a modern basketball sneaker that blends stability, cushioning, and unmistakable flair, the Nike Ja 3 Max Volume delivers. Our team loves this product because it fuses fast-feel support, lively cushioning, and a statement colorway that energizes every step.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike P-6000 Metallic Silver takes its inspiration from the Air Pegasus of 2006 and reimagines it with space-age details to give this sneaker a futuristic look. The Metallic Silver Nike P-6000 features an upper base crafted from breathable metallic fabric. Both vertical and horizontal overlays are constructed of chrome synthetic leather course across the upper, making it glisten. A silver side-panel Nike swoosh is outlined in black embroidery that connects with the black foxing and black Nike branding on the tongue tag and heel tab. The white laces match the tongue, sock liner, and insole with P-6000 branding in black. A miniature black Nike swoosh adorns the toe box. One of our favorite aspects of this sneaker is the comfortable and dependable sole unit. Cushioning white foam in the midsole works with a durable black outsole that provides traction for everyday wear. The Nike P-6000 Metallic Silver was released on October 6, 2023, for $120 retail.

Display Name: adidas F50 Formotion Sp5der Silver Metallic
Description: The adidas F50 Formotion Sp5der Silver Metallic pulls Young Thug's Sp5der label deeper into adidas territory, moving the collaboration beyond streetwear staples like the Superstar and into an entirely new silhouette built from soccer DNA. The shoe borrows its layered upper from the classic F50 boot while running on a chunky Formotion sole more associated with early two thousands runners, creating something that reads as technical heritage rather than a straightforward crossover. Silver Metallic dominates the build from toe to heel, giving it a chromed out presence that stands apart from anything else in the F50 lineup. Sp5der branding shows up on the tongue and heel, alongside the label's signature spider hangtag that instantly signals this is more than a standard adidas release. The low cut profile and dense layering give the shoe real visual depth up close, rewarding the kind of attention collectors pay to collaboration pieces built around a specific creative vision rather than mass appeal. Following earlier Superstar drops in gold and patent red, this F50 Formotion marks Sp5der's boldest step yet into performance inspired silhouettes. The adidas F50 Formotion Sp5der Silver Metallic was released on July 1, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Cap and Gown
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro Cap and Gown delivers a formal inspired take on the Jordan 6, dressing the silhouette in an all black execution that leans into a sleek and understated look. The upper carries a uniform finish that removes contrast in favor of depth, allowing the shape and structure of the model to take center stage. Subtle detailing and tonal variation keep the design from feeling flat, giving it a refined edge that aligns with the theme. This version resonates with collectors who appreciate when Jordan Brand explores different moods within classic silhouettes. The Cap and Gown concept taps into a sense of occasion, transforming a performance rooted design into something that feels more elevated and versatile. It is a pair that stands apart from louder releases, offering a more controlled aesthetic that still carries the weight of the Jordan 6s legacy. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Cap and Gown was released on April 30, 2026 with a retail price of $215.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Silver Metallic Cracked Leather (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Silver Metallic Cracked Leather (Women's) is a womens sized low-profile silhouette that blends vintage football heritage with street-ready flair. This womens adidas Samba OG is all dressed up as it shimmers with a metallic cracked leather upper. The iconic t-toe on this model is accentuated by delicate stitching. The 3-Stripes in a jagged-edged crisp white adorn both sides of the shoe for a classic look. A padded white heel counter, white tongue, and white laces allow the silver patch on the tongue to shine. White Samba branding is next to the 3-Stripes on the lateral side. A gum-colored outsole finishes the elegant aesthetic. We think the standout feature of the adidas Samba OG Silver Metallic Cracked Leather (Women's) has to be the metallic cracked leather. It adds just the right amount of shimmer to elevate everyday outfits while staying true to the Sambas timeless appeal. Originally released on April 1, 2025, this shoe sold for $120 retail.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Natural
Description: Yeezy added a new colorway to their most popular line with the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Natural, now available on StockX. The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Natural is reminiscent of the 350 V2 Cream that released in 2017. Its upper is mostly white, but instead of a monotone look, hits of light grey on the Primeknit upper give this design an identity of its own. A yellowed translucent Boost sole, a see-through side stripe, and traditional rope laces add the finishing touches to this most recent addition to the 350 V2 collection. The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Natural released in October of 2020 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Black Summit White
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Black Summit White delivers everything fans love about the Jordan 1 in its most stripped back and wearable form. The black and summit white color blocking feels timeless, letting the low cut silhouette speak through clean contrast rather than loud accents. This is the kind of Jordan that fits naturally into daily rotation, grounded in heritage while staying effortlessly modern and versatile across styles. Collectors appreciate this pair because it highlights the Jordan 1s core design language without distraction. The low profile makes it feel relaxed and approachable, while the classic color pairing keeps it anchored in basketball and street culture history. Its a shoe people return to again and again because it works everywhere, reinforcing why simple Jordan 1 colorways often have the longest staying power and the deepest cultural reach. The Air Jordan 1 Low Black Summit White was released on December 20, 2024 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1000.2 Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 10002 Black pushes Nikes Air Max lineage into a more futuristic and experimental direction through a silhouette that emphasizes structure and cushioning. The all black colorway gives the shoe a sleek and modern presence, allowing the designs shape and midsole construction to take center stage. Built around visible Air technology, the model continues Nikes focus on combining performance innovation with bold aesthetic choices. Fans gravitate toward newer Air Max models because they represent the evolution of one of Nikes most iconic technologies. The all black execution makes the sneaker versatile while still maintaining a strong visual identity through its exaggerated proportions and layered construction. Air Max designs have always stood out for their comfort and distinct look, and this model continues that tradition in a more forward thinking form. For collectors, pairs like this highlight Nikes willingness to experiment with new shapes while preserving the cushioning legacy that defines the Air Max line. The Nike Air Max 10002 Black was released on May 7, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Total 90 3 SP White Metallic Gold
Description: The Nike Total 90 3 SP White Metallic Gold shifts from sport to lifestyle while maintaining its sporty aesthetic. This lifestyle update of the iconic 2004 model gets a luxurious refresh and boasts a low-profile structure similar to the astroturf variant. The White Metallic Gold Nike Total 90 3 SP features a crisp white leather base, boldly accented with Metallic Gold on the heel, medial panels, and burrito-style tongue. An asymmetrical lacing system and quilted toe box pay homage to the Total 90s soccer heritage. Black Swooshes are featured on the vamp, lateral side wall, and heel section, with the iconic "90" circle logo appearing on the medial side. The "total90III" motif graces the foxing, while a flat gum rubber sole replaces the cleat tooling underfoot. One thing we love about the Nike Total 90 3 SP White Metallic Gold is its heritage design, which nods to the 2004 football tournament cleat that, two decades later, jumps from the pitch to the street. The lifestyle sneaker retains most of its original branding for a nostalgic yet elevated design. It was released on May 1, 2025, for $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus World Indigo
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus World Indigo layers deep blues and purples across the iconic Tuned Air frame. World Indigo dominates the upper, creating a rich and moody base, while Cave Purple accents add depth and dimension. Black detailing anchors the design, highlighting the sculpted cage and midsole lines. The visible Air units reinforce the silhouettes performance identity beneath the bold color story. Fans who favor darker tones will connect with this expressive palette. The interplay between indigo and purple feels dynamic yet cohesive, offering personality without sacrificing versatility. It captures the attitude and confidence that define the Air Max Plus while introducing a fresh tonal twist. Distinct and layered, this pair commands attention through color and structure alike. The Nike Air Max Plus World Indigo was released on July 29, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: New Balance 990v6 MiUSA White Sea Salt
Description: The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA White Sea Salt leans into purity and balance, delivering a refined take on one of the brands most respected silhouettes. The white and sea salt palette keeps things clean and elevated, allowing the updated v6 shape to stand out through proportion and flow rather than contrast. Subtle layering across mesh and suede adds depth without disrupting the calm, cohesive look that defines this pair. What makes this version resonate is its restraint. The 990 line has always been about consistency and trust, and this colorway reinforces that identity with a lighter, more breathable feel. Made in USA craftsmanship brings a level of precision that longtime fans expect, while the modernized structure ensures it still feels current. It is a quiet statement piece that rewards attention to detail rather than demanding it. The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA White Sea Salt was released on April 10, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Oxidized Green
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Oxidized Green takes the recognizable Air Jordan 4 retro silhouette and updates it with a colorway of White and Neutral Gray with Oxidized Green accents. The use of crisp White and deep Oxidized Green on the upper gives the sneaker a retro, varsity-sports-inspired appearance. The base is constructed from smooth leather in White with tonal leather overlay panels and wavy rows of tonal stitching. Oxidized Green details can be found on the floating, web-like eyestays, the synthetic collar lining, the sockliner, the Jumpman logo on the tongues tag, the Jumpman on the heel, and a strip on the midsole. Like other Jordan 4 Retro models, this version features visible air units in the heel that cushion the foot. Our StockX experts like the synthetic mesh on the side panel and below the tongue. The Jordan 4 Retro Oxidized Green was released on June 15, 2024, and retailed at $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves White Hyper Crimson (With Bracelet)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves White Hyper Crimson continues one of the most recognizable collaborative design themes in recent sneaker culture through its signature wavy mudguard. The white base keeps the upper clean and breathable, while hyper crimson accents bring energy and contrast across the design. The wave pattern adds movement and texture, giving the silhouette a more dynamic feel. Fans of Patta collaborations are drawn to this series for its ability to reinterpret a classic without losing its identity. The Air Max 1 remains a cornerstone model, and the wave detail has become a defining feature of these releases. It is a sneaker that combines heritage and innovation in a way that continues to resonate strongly with collectors. The Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves White Hyper Crimson was released on March 26, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas Adizero EVO SL EXO Black White Silver
Description: The adidas Adizero EVO SL EXO Black White Silver delivers a clean and high contrast take on the silhouette through a sharp and modern palette. The black base creates a strong and structured look, while white and silver accents add clarity and highlight the designs lines. The EXO variation emphasizes a more technical and layered construction. Fans of performance running footwear appreciate how this version balances bold contrast with a refined aesthetic. The color combination keeps it versatile while still visually engaging. It is a sneaker that reflects adidas focus on combining performance innovation with a clean and contemporary design. The adidas Adizero EVO SL EXO Black White Silver was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: New Balance 1000 Lunar New Year Black
Description: The New Balance 1000 Lunar New Year Black is a stylish and sophisticated sneaker that celebrates the Chinese New Year in grand fashion. This limited edition release features a sleek black upper with metallic silver accents, creating a striking contrast that's sure to turn heads. The shoe's design incorporates traditional Lunar New Year elements, blending them seamlessly with New Balance's renowned comfort and quality. Crafted with premium materials, the New Balance 1000 offers exceptional durability and support for everyday wear. The shoe boasts New Balance's innovative cushioning technology, providing superior comfort for long hours on your feet. With its versatile colorway and unique design elements, this sneaker effortlessly transitions from casual daytime looks to more upscale evening ensembles. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a luxurious, culturally-inspired sneaker that doesn't compromise on performance or style.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Light Smoke Grey Pink Rise (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Light Smoke Grey Pink Rise Womens combines soft contrast with a sustainability minded build. Light Smoke Grey shapes the upper with a cool and versatile base, while Pink Rise accents add a playful lift. Pale Ivory elements brighten the design, enhancing the layered Dunk paneling. The familiar low cut form stays intact, preserving the silhouettes enduring appeal. Fans appreciate when subtle color pops bring new energy to classic shapes. The grey and pink pairing feels balanced and modern, offering everyday wearability with personality. It reflects the Dunks continued evolution through thoughtful updates and refined tones. Fresh yet timeless, this pair keeps the legacy moving forward. The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Light Smoke Grey Pink Rise Womens was released on July 13, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Anta Kai 2 Kyrie and Klay
Description: The Anta Kai 2 Kyrie and Klay brings together two elite shooters through a Blue, White, and Gold color palette that feels crisp and competitive. The streamlined silhouette emphasizes agility and control, while the layered tones highlight the shoes modern construction. Subtle gold accents add prestige, reinforcing the collaborative spirit behind the design. This pair stands out because it celebrates synergy on and off the court. The balanced blue and white foundation keeps the look versatile, while the gold detailing injects championship energy. Fans of both Kyrie Irving and Klay Thompson appreciate when performance footwear carries narrative weight. It is a confident and dynamic release that merges precision and style into one cohesive design. The Anta Kai 2 Kyrie and Klay was released on September 26, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Paris
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Paris features a white, Sky Grey, and Football Grey textile, leather, and suede upper, with smooth leather making a minimal appearance in white on the quarter panels of the shoe. From there, the collar and tongue of the silhouette are both outfitted in sporty textiles and a debossed "Air Jordan" logo with a grey Nike "Swoosh" complete the design. The Jordan 1 Low Paris released in February of 2020 and retailed for $130.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Legend Blue
Description: Michael Jordan debuted the Legend Blue 11 in the 1996 All-Star Game after returning from his first retirement, securing the sneakers immortality, but that heritage got an update in 2021 with the Air Jordan 11 Low Legend Blue. The Air Jordan 11 Low Legend Blue features an all-white upper constructed of smooth leather and patent leather. Jumpman and "23" insignias are displayed on the back of the ankle. A white midsole, and an "icy" translucent outsole completes the design. The Jordan 11 Low Legend Blue released in May of 2021 and retailed for $185.

Display Name: adidas BW Army Kith Aurora Coffee
Description: The adidas BW Army Kith Aurora Coffee reworks a military inspired classic through Kiths refined lens, bringing warmer tones and premium textures into a silhouette known for its simplicity. The Aurora Coffee colorway introduces a rich brown upper that feels grounded and versatile, balanced by off white accents and a gum sole that ties back to the shoes heritage roots. The BW Army has always thrived on its understated shape, and this version leans into that while adding a more lifestyle driven palette. Fans appreciate how Kith approaches collaborations with restraint, allowing subtle color shifts and material upgrades to do the talking. This pair fits seamlessly into everyday wear, pairing just as easily with relaxed streetwear as it does with more tailored looks. The combination of classic structure and updated tones gives the shoe a timeless feel, reinforcing why the BW Army continues to resonate with collectors who value quiet design and strong execution over flash. The adidas BW Army Kith Aurora Coffee was released on April 20, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Infrared Salesman (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro Reverse Infrared PS flips a legendary color theme through a Black upper energized by Light Crimson accents. The bold contrast highlights the AJ6s signature midsole sculpting and heel tab design, preserving the silhouettes unmistakable identity. Even in preschool sizing, the structure remains true to the original blueprint that defined early 90s performance style. This release resonates because it reinterprets one of the most iconic Jordan palettes with a subtle twist. The crimson detailing pops against the dark base, delivering strong visual impact while honoring heritage roots. Younger fans get access to a colorway deeply connected to Jordan history. It is a faithful yet refreshed take on a classic that continues to hold cultural weight. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Reverse Infrared PS was released on February 14, 2026 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Metallic Silver (2020) (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Metallic Silver 2020 (Women) made its debut as one of the womens sizing of the performance running sneaker in March 2020. The Nike Air Max 90 Metallic Silver 2020 (Women) is dressed in a metallic silver/metallic silver-white colorway. The shiny silver material dominates the entire upper withthe Swoosh appearing on either side. Subtle contrast is provided by the heels Nike Air detailing and the Nike Air branding window. The design is completed by a white midsole that features an Air unit in the heel. During its release in March 2020, Nike Air Max 90 Metallic Silver 2020 (Women) retailed at $160.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Triple Red
Description: Nike offers cushioning, comfort, and style with the Nike Air VaporMax Plus Triple Red. ? ?The Nike Air VaporMax Plus triple red features TPU overlays along the upper of the midfoot. The shoe also incorporates neoprene mesh all over the shoe. Its well-padded upper complements the VaporMax Air midsole. The model is entirely draped in Red and neoprene heels, branding, and midsole. The Nike Air VaporMax Plus triple red also features a full-length VaporMax Sole unit with the signature "VM" branding on the heels and the insoles. ? ?The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Triple Red was launched on the 14th of February, 2020 at a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Anta Kai 2 Dallas
Description: The Anta Kai 2 Dallas captures Kyrie Irvings creative approach to basketball through a design that feels sharp, personal, and expressive. A clean white base sets a balanced foundation, contrasted by black elements that add structure and focus. Blue accents reference the Dallas connection, giving the shoe regional identity while keeping the overall look versatile and performance driven. This model resonates with fans because it reflects Kyries mindset rather than chasing traditional basketball design norms. The Kai line feels intentional and expressive, appealing to players and collectors who value individuality. The Dallas colorway adds an extra layer of meaning, tying place and personality together through color. It feels like a shoe designed with purpose, blending storytelling and on court energy in a way that feels authentic rather than manufactured. The Anta Kai 2 Dallas was released on April 19, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Corteiz Honey Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Corteiz Honey Black taps into bold energy with a rugged, tactical spin. Built atop a black leather upper with diamond-knit mesh, this pair leans into a utilitarian vibe that doesnt sacrifice style. The layered netting, beefed-up tongue and collar, and toggle lacing system all serve up function and fashion in equal measureperfect for those constantly on the move. Corteiz brings its unmistakable signature to the collab, dropping in co-branded hits on the heel and tongue along with a slick Alcatraz logo. This isnt just another streetwear dropits a full-on campaign. The tour yellow Air Max units punch through the black midsole with energy, while the clean sockliner ditches camo for a glossy black finish, setting this iteration apart from previous releases. Designed for the streets but ready for anything, its a shoe that moves how you do. The Nike Air Max 95 Corteiz Honey Black released on April 30, 2025, for $190. Featuring a black and tour yellow colorway, this collab carried forward Corteizs renegade approach to hype. DISCLAIMER: Dust Bag is not required to pass verification.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Black Volt
Description: The Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Black Volt is a modernized version of the original Air Max Uptempo 95 released in the mid-90s. The Air Max Uptempo 95 Black Volt has an upper that is made from leather and synthetic upper. The black monochromatic base is complemented by Volt accents, including the Nike Swoosh on the lateral side and the AIR lettering. The outsole is designed using rubber material, which provides grip on the court  even on dusty surfaces. This allows players to make quick cuts and sudden movements confidently, without worrying about slipping or sliding. We think that the outstanding feature of the Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Black Volt is its full-length Volt-colored Max Air unit in the midsole. This unit offers cushioning and shock absorption during high-impact activities like basketball, making the shoe ideal for players who need support while jumping and landing. The shoe was released on September 10th, 2019, at a retail cost of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Metallic Black
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Metallic Black brings the iconic 1985 cut of the Air Jordan 1 to a low-top version, providing a fresh take on one of the most beloved models in sneaker history. Featuring a clean white, black, and neutral grey colorway, this low-top version offers the same timeless appeal and cultural significance as the original high-top. The metallic black accents on the swoosh and other detailing add a sleek, modern twist, perfect for those looking to blend classic style with contemporary streetwear. The Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 retains all the elements that made the original Jordan 1 a cultural phenomenon, from the premium leather construction to the classic Nike Air branding. This low-top version is perfect for sneaker enthusiasts who want a more versatile, easy-to-wear option without sacrificing the boldness of the original design. Its influence on both basketball and streetwear culture remains undeniable, making this release a must-have for any collection. Released on October 2, 2024, the Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Metallic Black retailed for $160. This model continues the legacy of the Air Jordan 1, offering both heritage and modern flair in one stylish package.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Lower Merion Away
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Lower Merion Away honors Kobe Bryants high school legacy through a colorway rooted in Lower Merions identity. The team red and white palette reflects the away uniform, giving the shoe a strong connection to the early stages of Kobes career. The Air Force 1 silhouette provides a familiar foundation, allowing the story behind the colors to take center stage. What makes this release meaningful is its focus on origin and legacy. Lower Merion represents where Kobes journey began, and translating that into a sneaker creates a deeper emotional connection for fans. The design remains clean and respectful, letting the colorway carry the tribute without unnecessary additions. It is a piece that resonates with collectors who value storytelling tied to basketball history. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Lower Merion Away was released on March 23, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike ACG Rufus Limestone Black
Description: The Nike ACG Rufus Limestone Black is a unique slipper that has now made a comeback after about a decade. This model of the Nike ACG Rufus is made with a seamless suede upper in a Limestone tan color. The only design seen on the upper is a small Nike Swoosh embossed into the lateral side. The midsole is black rubber that dons a wavy texture near the bottom, and speckled Limestone tan forms the thick outsole, fully enclosing the black midsole. A small black Nike swoosh appears on the front tip of the outsole. The midsole has foam cushioning for extra comfort. Our favorite thing about this shoe is the unique black midsole unit that contrasts nicely with the Limestone color of the rest of the shoe. The Nike ACG Rufus Limestone Black was first released on May 10, 2024, for an initial retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low G-Dragon Peaceminusone Para-Noise 3.0
Description: Disclaimer: Please be aware of paint fragility regarding the first layer of color on the upper. Due to the thin coating of paint, colors may rub off. Introducing the Nike Air Force 1 Low G-Dragon Peaceminusone Para-Noise 3.0, the third installment in the highly coveted collaboration between Nike and South Korean artist G-Dragon utilizing the Air Force 1 base. This special edition features a black leather upper that wears away over time to reveal hidden artwork by G-Dragon, adding a personal, creative touch to every pair. The sneaker showcases contrasting swooshes in yellow, pink, and blue, with a signature sunflower logo on the tongue and custom graphics on the insoles, giving this sneaker a vibrant and artistic vibe. In keeping with the Air Force 1s legendary status in both basketball and streetwear, the Para-Noise 3.0 incorporates G-Dragons unique artistic flair with features like brushstrokes along the midsole, custom pins, and a special-edition box. Since its debut in 1982, the Air Force 1 has evolved into one of the most iconic sneakers in Nikes lineup, and this collaboration adds yet another layer of creativity to its storied history. Released on September 14, 2024, the Nike Air Force 1 Low G-Dragon Peaceminusone Para-Noise 3.0 retailed at $200. The black, new emerald, pinkfire, tour yellow, and blue gale colorway, paired with G-Dragons signature artwork, makes this release a statement piece for both sneakerheads and art enthusiasts alike. This collaboration continues to redefine what a sneaker can bea canvas for both fashion and expression.

Display Name: Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 4 Obsidian Persian Violet White
Description: The Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 4 in Obsidian, Persian Violet, Green Abyss, and White is a performance racing shoe that brings the fourth generation of Nike's most elite and record-breaking marathon racing platform to a colorway that pairs the depth and authority of obsidian with the unexpected richness of persian violet in a combination that makes the Vaporfly's technically ambitious ZoomX foam and carbon fiber plate construction look as sophisticated as it genuinely is. The Vaporfly Next% franchise has been at the center of the most significant performance revolution in distance running history since its introduction, with marathon world records falling in connection with the platform's energy return and propulsive geometry in ways that changed the sport's assumptions about what human-plus-technology performance was capable of achieving. Obsidian and persian violet create a colorway that feels premium and slightly unexpected for a racing shoe that could default to bright performance colors, the rich dark tones giving the Vaporfly 4 a visual maturity and sophistication that suits the platform's position as the most technically serious and performance-proven racing option in the current road racing market. ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 4 releases attract both serious competitive distance runners who use the shoe for its genuine performance advantages and the growing community of running enthusiasts and sneaker collectors who follow the Vaporfly franchise as the most technically significant and culturally discussed racing platform in contemporary running. Persian violet as an accent color gives this specific colorway a distinctive identity within the Vaporfly 4 seasonal lineup, the unusual and chromatically rich tone making this the most visually memorable and collector-specific release in the current Vaporfly generation for those who want genuine racing performance alongside color story distinction. At two hundred and seventy dollars the Vaporfly Next% 4 in Obsidian and Persian Violet represents a serious performance investment in the most proven and record-connected marathon racing technology Nike produces. The Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 4 in Obsidian and Persian Violet was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $270.

Display Name: Jordan Spizike Low White Metallic Silver Barely Blue Neutral Grey
Description: The Air Jordan Spizike Low White Metallic Silver Barely Blue Neutral Grey delivers a clean and modern remix of Jordan Brand history by blending familiar design cues into a low cut silhouette that feels fresh and wearable. The white base keeps the look crisp, while metallic silver and barely blue accents add subtle shine and softness that elevate the Spizikes layered identity. It feels balanced and intentional, letting the hybrid nature of the model feel cohesive rather than busy. Collectors love this pair because the Spizike concept is all about celebrating Jordan legacy through thoughtful combination. This colorway leans into restraint, allowing the details pulled from multiple iconic Jordans to feel unified instead of competing. Fans appreciate it as an everyday friendly Spizike, one that carries deep brand storytelling while remaining light, versatile, and easy to style, proving that the Spizike Low can feel both historic and contemporary at the same time. The Air Jordan Spizike Low White Metallic Silver Barely Blue Neutral Grey was released on April 21, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Black (PS)
Description: The New Balance 9060 Black PS brings the bold 9060 silhouette into preschool sizing without losing its defining character. The black and phantom colorway keeps the look clean and confident, letting the exaggerated midsole and layered upper do the visual work. Even at a smaller scale, the shoe feels substantial and true to the original design intent. Collectors appreciate this pair because it treats kids sizing with the same care as adult releases. The 9060 remains comfortable, expressive, and visually strong, making it a great introduction to modern New Balance design for younger wearers. Fans love it as a practical and stylish option that maintains identity rather than simplifying it away. The New Balance 9060 Black PS was released on August 13, 2023 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Desert Elephant
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Desert Elephant is one of the most anticipated colorways of the Jordan 3 catalog. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Desert Elephant (2022) is a re-release of the iconic Air Jordan 3 that first dropped back in 1988. This time around, the shoe comes dressed in a Desert Elephant print upper with Black and Cement Grey accents. In addition to the Desert Elephant print Durabuck upper, the shoe has a leather overlay and the usual Jumpman embroidery on the collar. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Desert Elephant (2022) was released back in, 2022 and retailed for $225.

Display Name: adidas Adistar Jellyfish Pharrell Williams Triple Black
Description: The adidas Adistar Jellyfish Pharrell Williams Triple Black pushes the Adistar line into futuristic territory, with Pharrell Williams bringing his distinct creative lens to the silhouette. Dressed in Core Black from top to bottom, the layered upper and sculpted midsole create a fluid shape that truly lives up to the Jellyfish name. The aggressive tooling and exaggerated proportions give it a runway ready presence while still feeling rooted in performance heritage. Pharrell collaborations always carry weight, especially when they reinterpret adidas running DNA through a fashion forward perspective. The triple black execution makes this pair feel stealthy and elevated, letting texture and construction do the talking instead of loud color blocking. Fans of boundary pushing adidas design see this as another chapter in Pharrell ongoing influence on the brand, blending street, sport, and art into one cohesive statement piece. The adidas Adistar Jellyfish Pharrell Williams Triple Black was released on February 21, 2026 with a retail price of $300.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Black Grey
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Black Grey delivers sharp contrast through a classic two tone palette. Finished in Black and Grey, the layered leather panels highlight the timeless proportions that define the AF1. The sturdy sole and perforated toe box preserve the models basketball heritage while maintaining street ready appeal. LV8 editions often introduce subtle tweaks and elevated detailing, and this version keeps the focus on bold simplicity. The black base grounds the look, while grey accents add depth without overpowering the silhouette. It feels versatile and confident, reinforcing the Air Force 1s legacy as a foundational sneaker. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Black Grey was released on September 15, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid White Pure Platinum Pine Green
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid White Pure Platinum Pine Green blends classic Jordan structure with a fresh injection of color that feels sporty and energetic. The white and pure platinum base keeps the look clean, while pine green accents add contrast that nods to vintage basketball aesthetics. The mid cut Jordan 1 profile anchors the design, giving it a familiar feel that works naturally for daily wear. Collectors love this pair because it balances simplicity and personality so well. The pine green details give the shoe identity without overpowering the silhouette, making it a favorite for fans who want something versatile but not plain. It feels like a reliable staple with just enough color to stand out, reinforcing why the Jordan 1 Mid remains popular among people who value comfort, heritage, and easy styling all in one package. The Air Jordan 1 Mid White Pure Platinum Pine Green was released on January 20, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Self Expression
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Self Expression elevates a legendary silhouette with a striking Black/Black-Summit White palette thats easy to style and impossible to ignore. Built on the beloved Air Jordan 1 foundation, this high-top pairs a premium-feel upper with crisp color-blocking for a clean, modern edge. Classic details return in full force, think the padded high-cut collar for support, the perforated toe box for breathability, and the Nike Air tongue tag that signals timeless heritage. Underfoot, a durable rubber cupsole and encapsulated Air-Sole cushioning deliver everyday comfort, while the grippy traction pattern keeps you steady on city streets and courts alike. Finished with signature Wings branding, this edition invites you to wear your point of view, subtle, bold, or somewhere in between. Designed for versatility, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Self Expression (Style: DZ5485-002) slots seamlessly into any rotation, from laid-back denim fits to tailored streetwear looks. The Summit White accents frame the black base for a balanced contrast that photographs beautifully and wears even better over time. Whether youre collecting the latest Air Jordan 1 releases or hunting for a dependable daily pair, this model hits the sweet spot between heritage and fresh design. With a July 31, 2025 release date, its primed to become a go-to for fans of the OG cut who appreciate refined details and day-long comfort. Our team loves this product because it blends iconic Air Jordan 1 DNA with versatile, all-season styling that makes expressing your personal look effortless.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Military Black (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Military Black for Grade Schoolers (GS) first was sold on the market in May of 2022. ? ?This unique shoe model provides a modern spin on the original retro item that was created in 1989. It features a white sole and base with suede and leather overlays in neutral shades of beige and black. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Military Black (GS) for grade schoolers has mesh side panels that were designed not only for style, but also for their breathability. The model provides the feet with plenty of support for walking and exercise. ? ? The retail price for this item started at $210 for adult sizes.

Display Name: Jordan 10 Retro Hydrangeas (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 10 Retro Hydrangeas Womens introduces soft pastel tones to a silhouette rooted in early nineties performance. Dressed in Chalk with Wild Grape and Hydrangeas accents, the upper keeps the streamlined AJ10 shape intact while adding fresh color contrast. The signature outsole detailing remains a nod to Michael Jordans career milestones. Jordan 10 releases often lean into subtle storytelling, and this womens exclusive colorway feels light and expressive. The hydrangea inspired hues bring a seasonal touch without overwhelming the classic build. It stands as a modern reinterpretation of a heritage model, balancing elegance and legacy in one cohesive package. The Air Jordan 10 Retro Hydrangeas Womens was released on February 12, 2026 with a retail price of $205.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Black Metallic Gold (2020) (GS)
Description: The Kids Air Jordan 1 Retro High Black Metallic Gold first was first revealed to the public as part of Jordan Brands Holiday 2020 collection. Its colorway is inspired by the 2003 Air Jordan Mid Black Metallic Gold, delivering elegant and even regal appearance. The Kids Air Jordan 1 Retro High Black Metallic Gold features black and metallic gold patent leather throughout the design. The metallic gold color of the shoe can be found on the collar and tongue tag, Nike Swoosh logo, and Wings logo. An Air sole unit is featured in the heel of this sneaker to provide cushioning. The Kids Air Jordan 1 Retro High Black Metallic Gold was released in November of 2020 and retailed for $130.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Pure Money (2025) (GS)
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro Pure Money (2025) (GS) revives a beloved clean look with crisp White/White/Metallic Silver tones that shine in any setting. This grade school edition keeps the iconic Tinker Hatfield design cues intact, layered leather panels for structure, a supportive padded collar, and the signature Jumpman heel tab, while refreshing the palette for a modern, minimalist edge. Subtle metallic hits and tonal detailing elevate the silhouette, making it a natural match for everyday wear or dressed-up fits. Underfoot, the classic visible Air unit teams with a cushioned midsole to deliver comfort and impact protection, while a durable rubber outsole with dependable traction helps keep every step steady. True to the Jordan 3s legacy, this pair balances heritage style with go-anywhere practicality. Perforations enhance breathability, and the smooth, easy-to-clean upper is built to handle school days, weekend outings, and everything in between. The familiar midfoot shape and supportive heel counter offer a secure feel, and the refined all-white finish makes color pairing effortless, from bold socks to neutral layers. With its timeless profile, premium feel, and everyday versatility, the Pure Money colorway stands out as a wardrobe essential for young sneaker fans. Our team loves this product because it blends iconic Jordan heritage with a fresh, all-occasion look thats comfortable for all-day wear and simple to style.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Artisanal Team Red
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Artisanal Team Red is a high-top basketball sneaker with a classic vintage design. This iteration of the Jordan 1 Retro High OG is made with a leather upper. The base of the upper is white on the sides, toebox, and around the heel, and the toebox contains perforations for air flow. Smooth red leather overlays adorn the upper, outlining the toebox, snaking up under the laces, supporting the heel, and acting as the ankle strap. The Nike Swoosh that appears on both sides is also red. White Air Jordan branding can be found on the outer red ankle strap. The cushioned tongue contains a Nike Air patch, and the rubber sole is patterned for traction. Our favorite feature of this shoe is the two-tone color scheme, as the simple white and red complement each other well. The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Artisanal Team Red was released on April 27, 2024, for a price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro SP A Ma Maniére Black (Women's)
Description: Following the successful release of their Air Jordan 4 collaboration in 2022, A Ma Maniére is back partnering with Jordan in 2023, on a womens-exclusive Air Jordan 12 Retro SP. ? ?A Ma Maniére is using nothing but the best quality materials on their latest collaboration, using premium black nubuck on the uppers, and burgundy suede mudguards. The limited edition sneakers are tied together with black wax rope laces and come with an A Ma Maniére branded keychain. ? ?The women's-exclusive Air Jordan 12 Retro SP A Ma Maniére Black released February 24, 2023, with a retail price of $225.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Black Taxi
Description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro Black Taxi is a monochromatic black sneaker with taxi-yellow hits that create visual contrast. The upper of this Retro Air Jordan 12 is constructed of both smooth and textured black leather. A taxi overlay features the word "Jumpman," taxi containment straps have a Jumpman embossed on them, and the heel sports a taxi "23", Jordan branding, and a taxi Jumpman patch. The black tongue and insole each feature a taxi Jumpman. The black outsole features a taxi in patterning, a "23" and Jumpman that stretches onto the toe. The Air Jordan 12 Retro Black Taxi was released on December 3rd, 2022, for a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Anta Kai 3 KAI Mentality
Description: The Anta Kai 3 KAI Mentality reflects Kyrie Irvings continued push to blend performance design with personal philosophy. The Purple and Gold colorway carries a regal and expressive tone, aligning with Kyries tendency to infuse deeper meaning into his signature line. The silhouette itself feels dynamic and fluid, built to mirror his unpredictable and creative style of play while maintaining a strong visual identity. Fans of Kyries footwear gravitate toward releases that feel connected to his mindset as much as his game. The KAI Mentality theme reinforces that connection, turning the shoe into more than just performance gear. It becomes a reflection of approach and perspective, making it especially appealing to collectors who follow his journey both on and off the court. The Anta Kai 3 KAI Mentality was released on February 7, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Low CLOT Jade
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Low CLOT Jade celebrates China's appreciation for jade, as its heritage and tradition is infused with greatness. The design features a black satin-like upper with semi-translucent TPU netted inserts and light grey heel embroideries. Attached to the red woven laces, clear jade beads add further decoration. At the base, a midsole similar to the Jordan 5 Metallic and a jade semi-translucent outsole complete the design. The Air Jordan 5 Low CLOT Jade released in May of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Cap and Gown (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro Cap and Gown GS brings a formal and understated twist to one of the most recognizable silhouettes in the Jordan lineup. Dressed primarily in black, the design leans into a sleek and elevated look that feels inspired by milestone moments and celebration. The Jordan 6 already carries strong presence through its shape and structure, and this version enhances that with a more refined color approach that keeps everything focused and cohesive. What makes this pair stand out is how it shifts the tone of the model without changing its identity. It feels more mature and intentional, appealing to those who appreciate subtle storytelling tied to achievement and transition. For younger collectors, it offers a version of the Jordan 6 that feels both meaningful and easy to wear across different settings. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Cap and Gown GS was released on April 30, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Shadow (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Shadow (Women's) celebrates Michael Jordan's love of satin. It has serious athletic credentials in a hi-top basketball shoe while sporting a designer touch, thanks to the soft satiny upper. It carries all the heritage of the iconic Air Jordan line. This is a luxe version of the Nike Air Jordan 1. The colorway alternates slightly metallic panels with black ones, both with a distinctive satin finish that make this shoe instantly catch the eye. It's further elevated by an embroidered Wings logo on the ankle. The black rubber outsole provides excellent traction and high comfort levels with Nike's trademark Air technology. Our reviewers argued over who got to review this great shoe  that's how much we love the styling. The satin finish makes this one unique, even in a crowded market. It's an ideal blend of sporty lines and elegant sophistication. This shoe is worthy of being kept in pristine condition in a collection. The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Shadow (Women's) was released on 5 October 2024 for $180.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Champagne and Oysters (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Champagne and Oysters Womens delivers understated luxury to one of Jordan Brands most iconic silhouettes, using soft tones and metallic accents to create a refined and elegant mood. The champagne inspired palette paired with subtle gold details gives the Jordan 3 a sophisticated presence, highlighting its classic shape through warmth and texture rather than contrast. It feels celebratory without being flashy, designed to be appreciated slowly. Collectors love this release because it elevates the Jordan 3 through emotion and storytelling. The silhouettes familiar proportions anchor the design, while the colorway adds a sense of occasion that feels personal and expressive. Fans appreciate how this pair blends heritage and elegance, offering a Jordan that feels both timeless and special for women who value meaning and refinement in their collections. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Champagne and Oysters Womens was released on November 22, 2025 with a retail price of $205.

Display Name: adidas Adizero PR Song for the Mute White Silver Metallic
Description: The adidas Adizero PR Song for the Mute White Silver Metallic delivers a lighter and more refined variation of the same silhouette through its clean and layered color palette. The cloud white base creates a bright and open look, while silver metallic accents add a subtle reflective quality that enhances the design. Core black details provide contrast, keeping the overall look balanced. Fans of the collaboration appreciate how this version emphasizes clarity and texture through its tonal execution. The combination of light and metallic elements gives it a more elevated feel while maintaining performance intent. It is a sneaker that reflects a blend of minimalism and innovation within adidas running lineup. The adidas Adizero PR Song for the Mute White Silver Metallic was released on October 10, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Black Barely Volt (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Black Barely Volt GS injects modern energy into one of Jordan Brands most elegant silhouettes by pairing deep black with sharp barely volt accents. The contrast adds a futuristic edge to the Jordan 11s flowing lines, making the shoe feel bold and contemporary while preserving its premium identity. Even in grade school sizing, the patent inspired shine and sleek structure feel impactful and confident. Fans appreciate this release because it brings freshness to a silhouette known for refinement. The Jordan 11 has always balanced performance and style, and this colorway leans into that duality with a look that feels both aggressive and clean. Collectors love it as a modern interpretation of a classic, proving the Jordan 11 can evolve visually without losing the grace that defines it. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Black Barely Volt GS was released on October 4, 2025 with a retail price of $185.

Model: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 LX
Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 LX Victor Wembanyama All-Star Warning Label
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Victor Wembanyama All Star captures the spectacle of All Star Weekend through bold design and layered detail. A multi color upper blends Metallic Platinum, Glacier Blue, and Bleached Lilac accents against a black base, creating depth and movement across the silhouette. The updated GT Cut 4 construction emphasizes responsiveness and court feel, aligning with Wembanyamas fluid and versatile playing style. It stands as a tribute to one of the leagues most talked about talents, merging innovation with showtime flair. Bold and forward thinking, this release embodies the future of the game. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Victor Wembanyama All Star was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Caitlin Clark Light Armory Blue
Description: The Nike Kobe 6 Protro Caitlin Clark Light Armory Blue (2025) celebrates a new chapter in basketball influence, one written by a player redefining the game. The snakeskin texture of the upper nods to the Kobe 6s DNA, while the shimmering gradient finish brings a sense of motion even when standing still. This release feels symbolic: a meeting point between Kobe Bryants relentless mentality and Clarks ascendant legacy. The crisp blue tones carry a calm intensity, echoing the precision of her game and the growing presence of womens basketball in sneaker culture. Its a thoughtful fusion of tribute and transition, honoring the Mamba lineage while passing the torch to a new generation of stars. Elegant, poised, and undeniably powerful, this sneaker captures the spirit of a player thats changing the landscape of the sport forever.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog One Piece Monkey D. Luffy
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog One Piece Monkey D Luffy brings anime energy into one of the most recognizable comfort silhouettes, featuring design elements inspired by the Straw Hat captain himself. The multi color execution reflects Luffys adventurous personality, with details that tie back to his iconic look and presence throughout the series.
