Sneaker Bar Detroit described Hallow as a soft sandy beige colorway, and Nice Kicks confirmed the four-piece 99X Series also includes the 990v4 in Dusty Mauve, the 992 in Argon, and the 993 in Asteroid, each featuring pigskin suede overlays across all four pairs. Retail price $220. The New Balance 990v3 MiUSA Kith Hallow is the May 11, 2026 Made in USA pigskin-suede-overlay mesh-underlay ENCAP-midsole Kith-branded-footbed-and-heel 990v3 debut collaboration for the Kith and New Balance collector who wants the soft sandy Hallow beige colorway from the Kith and New Balance 99X Series West Hollywood four-piece Made in USA release. The New Balance 990v3 MiUSA Kith Hallow was released on May 11, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Cool Grey (2021)
Description: Jordan Brand brought back a beloved Cool Grey from their archives with the Air Jordan 3 Cool Grey. The Cool Grey colorway has been prominently featured on some of Jumpmans most prolific silhouettes, most notably the Air Jordan 11. The upper of the Jordan 3 Cool Grey is constructed of a Cool Grey Durabuck with classic Elephant Print mudguards on the toe and heel. Hits of Sport Red and Orange Peel are located on the tongue, eyelets, Air bag, and heel tab. Instead of traditional "Nike Air" branding on the heel, this model stays true to its 2007 rendition and features a Jumpman logo. A white and dark grey sole completes this retro design. The Air Jordan 3 Cool Grey released in February of 2021 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Tokyo Bio Hack
Description: Remember back in 2005 when Nike collaborated on a Dunk High with Undefeated? The LA sneaker boutique put their very unique spin on the basketball silhouette, adding bold colors and an unpadded throat of the shoe. Now, the same mismatched color pattern has returned, only this time it on the Air Jordan 1. The Air Jordan 1 Bio Hack pushes the model to a whole new territory when it comes to color palettes. The upper is made of various suedes and leathers, matched with a hodgepodge of black, Baroque Brown, and Racer Pink. A metallic leather Swoosh is contrasted by a light green midsole to add even further appeal to the traditional model. The Air Jordan 1 Bio Hack released in September of 2020 for $170.

Display Name: Jordan 10 Retro Steel (2025) (GS)
Description: The Jordan 10 Retro Steel (2025) (GS) brings a timeless court classic back into the spotlight with a fresh kids sizing update and a crisp White/Light Steel Grey/Dark Powder Blue/Black palette. Clean white leather sets the stage for sharp Steel Grey detailing, while hits of Dark Powder Blue add a subtle pop that elevates everyday outfits and game-day fits alike. Signature AJ10 elements shine through, from the sculpted mudguard and streamlined eyestays to the sleek collar shape that frames the ankle, creating a look thats equal parts heritage and modern street appeal. Style code IB7359-104 nods to the latest drop, making this pair a standout for collectors and young sneaker fans who appreciate the legacy of the Air Jordan line. Comfort and durability take center court with the Jordan 10s proven formula: a cushioned midsole for soft landings, a supportive upper that hugs the foot, and the iconic outsole bars that celebrate MJs career achievements while providing reliable traction on sidewalks and schoolyard courts. Lightweight construction in GS sizing makes these easy to wear all day, while the padded tongue and collar help keep growing feet secure and comfortable. Whether paired with athletic gear or casual denim, the Jordan 10 Retro Steel (2025) (GS) delivers versatile style that feels as good as it looks, ready for rotation the moment the 2025-08-02 release hits. Our team loves this product because it blends classic Jordan design cues with kid-friendly comfort and everyday versatility, making it a go-to pick for style, support, and long-lasting wear.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 White College Grey Vast Grey University Red
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 White College Grey Vast Grey University Red offers a balanced and classic approach to one of Nikes most enduring designs. White anchors the upper with a clean and timeless foundation, while college grey and vast grey add depth through soft contrast. University red accents bring energy and heritage, tying the look back to traditional Nike color storytelling without overpowering the silhouette. This colorway resonates with fans because it feels dependable and easy to wear. It appeals to collectors who value versatility and familiarity, making it a strong everyday option that still carries personality. The Air Max 90 thrives on releases like this, where subtle color shifts keep the model fresh while preserving the structure and identity that have made it a staple across decades of sneaker culture. The Nike Air Max 90 White College Grey Vast Grey University Red was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low What The Paul
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low What The P-Rod pays homage to past Nike SB collaborations and releases from the P-Rod signature line. Its mismatched upper comes in an array of mesh, leather, suede, patent leather, and woven materials. Paul Rodriguezs signature on the tongue and special edition metal deubrés complete the design. The Nike SB Dunk Low P-Rod released in May of 2021 and retailed for $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG University Blue
Description: Jordan Brand paid homage to MJs alma mater with the Air Jordan 1 High University Blue. The University Blue colorway is prominent in the Jordan 1s history. The first UNC-inspired Jordan 1 dates back to 1985 when the Jordan 1 debuted. Since then, there have been numerous iterations of the UNC 1, most recently the Jordan 1 Retro High Fearless UNC To Chicago. Jumpman is building off of its past and switching it up this week with a new iteration. The upper of the Air Jordan 1 High University Blue is composed of a white and black tumbled leather upper with University Blue Durabuck overlays. Following traditional Jordan 1 detailing, a Nike Air woven label is located on the tongue and an Air Jordan Wings Logo is printed on the ankle. A white midsole and University Blue outsole complete rejuvenated classic. The Air Jordan 1 High University Blue released in March of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Anthracite Iron Grey Violet Ore
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Anthracite Iron Grey Violet Ore refreshes the legendary Air Force 1 through a darker and more layered color palette that emphasizes texture and subtle contrast over loud visual storytelling. The Air Force 1 remains one of the most important sneakers in footwear history because of its timeless basketball roots, clean panel construction, and deep influence across music, fashion, and street culture for more than four decades. The combination of Anthracite, Iron Grey, and Light Violet Ore gives this release a colder and more atmospheric personality while preserving the familiar structure that made the silhouette iconic worldwide. Fans continue gravitating toward tonal Air Force 1 colorways because they enhance the versatility and everyday wearability that define the models appeal. The muted greys create a sleek and understated foundation while the Violet Ore accents introduce softer depth and visual balance throughout the upper. Collectors especially appreciate darker Air Force 1 executions because they maintain the timeless simplicity of the silhouette while offering a slightly more fashion forward and contemporary edge. The result feels refined, wearable, and deeply connected to the enduring influence of the Air Force 1 within modern sneaker culture. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Anthracite Iron Grey Violet Ore was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low SE Lottery Pack Malachite Green
Description: The Nike Dunk Low SE Lottery arrives in a white smooth leather base with black leather Swooshes on both sides of the shoe, with malachite green heel tabs and the "Nike" in contrasting white. Malachite green leather material overlays provide the structure for this SE Lottery sneaker´s iconic silhouette and stylized cartoon "Jackpot" Nike logos decorate the tongue tabs and white insoles throughout. Rounding out the footwear design are scratch-off Nike coin hangtags, white midsoles, and malachite green rubber outsoles. The Nike Dunk Low SE Lottery was first released on the last day of August 2022, and its original retail price was set at $120.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Ivory Clay Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel-NYC Ivory Clay Grey takes its inspiration from the ASICS GEL-NIMBUS 3 and the MC-PLUS V and fuses it with tooling from the GEL-CUMULUS 16. The Ivory Clay Grey iteration of the ASICS Gel-NYC has an upper with a base of breathable ivory mesh. This is overlaid with undulating strips of silver, grey, and black leather and synthetics that lend the shoe style and support. GEL branding is embroidered on the ivory mesh window in the center of the heel, while ASICS branding appears on a grey lateral overlay, the grey mesh tongue, and the black insoles. Our experts really enjoy the sole unit of this ASICS sneaker. The lightweight ivory foam midsole incorporates GEL technology with inserts in the rear and forefeet. The black rubber outsole is arranged in large pods, grooved for traction and impact absorption. The ASICS Gel-NYC Ivory Clay Grey was released on July 1, 2023, for a $130 retail price.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog One Piece Thousand Sunny
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog One Piece Thousand Sunny transforms the familiar clog silhouette into a tribute to one of the most iconic ships in anime history. The multi color design pulls directly from the Thousand Sunny, incorporating playful detailing that reflects the adventurous spirit of One Piece. The lightweight construction and ventilation stay true to Crocs core design, while the theme adds a layer of personality that stands out immediately. Fans of One Piece are drawn to this release because it brings a central part of the story into a wearable format. The Thousand Sunny represents exploration and crew identity, and translating that into footwear creates a strong emotional connection. Crocs continues to explore character driven collaborations, and this version shows how the brand can fully commit to a concept without losing functionality. It is a fun and expressive piece that resonates with both collectors and casual fans. The Crocs Classic Clog One Piece Thousand Sunny was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $70.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Neon Paisley Bandana
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Neon Paisley Bandana pushes the classic Neon formula into a more expressive and layered direction, introducing a mix of patterns and colors that feel bold but intentional. Sail tones set a lighter base, while volt, university red, sport green, and midnight navy accents bring a vibrant mix that shifts across the upper. The paisley bandana detailing adds texture and storytelling to the familiar gradient structure. This pair stands out because it reimagines an icon rather than replicating it. The Air Max 95 has always been a strong canvas, and this version leans into that by blending heritage with more experimental elements. Fans who appreciate variation within classic models are drawn to releases like this, where the identity is preserved but the execution feels fresh. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Neon Paisley Bandana was released on March 26, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Alternate Bel-Air
Description: Jumpman paid tribute to Will Smiths electrifying 90s outfits in The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air with the Jordan 5 Alternate Bel-Air, now available on StockX. Drawing inspiration from the 2013 Jordan 5 Bel-Air, the Alternate Bel-Air arrives with a brighter take on Smiths favorite Jordans. Also known as the Jordan 5 Poison Green, the Alternate Bel-Air consists of the same 90s style colors and patterns as its predecessor, only this time the grey upper is replaced with white leather. A multi-color midsole, icy translucent outsole, and mismatched green and pink Jumpman logos on the tongues complete this retro-style masterpiece. These sneakers released in August of 2020 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Venice Beach (2024)
Description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Venice Beach (2024) is a vivid canvas of Los Angeless iconic coastal neighborhood, embodying the spirit and vibrancy of Venice Beach. The sneakers colorway, featuring stadium grey, metallic silver, and tour yellow, is as dynamic and eclectic as the bustling boardwalks and vibrant street art that define the area. Its a design that pays homage to Kobe Bryant's connection to the city, capturing the essence of its sun-drenched days and the creativity of its residents. This re-release Protro of the Kobe 8 maintains the same look of the beloved original on the outside, but updates the tech found on the inside for the modern basketball player. This colorway taps into the heartbeat of Venice Beach, where athletes, artists, and dreamers converge. The sneaker's design showcases a blend of textures and hues that mirror the beach's energy, from the sunlit sands to the azure sky. The artistic strokes of red, yellow, and blue across the upper reflect the eclectic tapestry of the neighborhood, while the signature Nike Swoosh in a striking yellow captures the attention just like the gleaming California sun. Snag your pair of the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Venice Beach 2024 which released on April 13, 2024, for $190, and step into a blend of style, comfort, and performance. As a staple piece in any Kobe fan's collection, or as the perfect sneaker for those inspired by the rich culture of Los Angeles, the Venice Beach 2024 edition is a celebration of history, art, and the spirit of one of basketball's greatest players. Make sure to add this iconic sneaker to your collection and carry forward the legacy of Kobe Bryant with every step.

Display Name: Puma LaMelo Ball MB.04 Reflections
Description: The Puma LaMelo Ball MB04 Reflections pairs dark intensity with electric blue accents across a futuristic silhouette. Black anchors the upper, providing a strong base that highlights the sculpted design lines. Blue detailing adds sharp contrast and depth, emphasizing motion and aggression. The structured build reflects the performance focus central to the MB franchise. Fans who gravitate toward bold yet versatile colorways will appreciate the black and blue execution. The contrast keeps the look dynamic without overwhelming the silhouette. It merges signature flair with competitive precision seamlessly. Sleek and assertive, this pair captures LaMelos confident court presence with clarity. The Puma LaMelo Ball MB04 Reflections was released on May 2, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Diamond Shorts
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid Diamond Shorts arrives with a smooth white leather upper with black Durabuck overlays and Swooshes. At the ankle, a traditional Wings logo nods to the origins of the Air Jordan collection. A Jumpman woven tongue label and semi-translucent outsole add the finishing touch. The Jordan 1 Mid Diamond Shorts released in February of 2022 and retailed for $120.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Bisque Sea Salt
Description: The New Balance 9060 Bisque Sea Salt delivers one of the most wearable interpretations of the 9060 by combining soft neutral tones with the models signature bold form. Bisque and sea salt work together to create a relaxed and cohesive look that feels natural and versatile. It is a colorway that emphasizes balance, allowing the silhouettes futuristic elements to feel approachable rather than aggressive. Collectors love this release because it fits effortlessly into everyday life. The 9060 already offers standout comfort and cushioning, and this palette makes it easy to pair with almost anything. Fans appreciate how it captures New Balances ability to blend innovation with wearability, making it a reliable choice that still feels distinctly modern. The New Balance 9060 Bisque Sea Salt was released on September 17, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Model: adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball
Display Name: adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball Clay
Description: The adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball Clay is a shoe designed as a collaboration between the sportswear brand and the luxury fashion brand. This version of the adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball is made with a base of textile in a tan clay color. A neoprene layer can be found over the toe box and sides of the shoe, with a final layer of thermoplastic polyurethane on top of the sides, forming an oversized adidas 3-Stripes in the same color. The ankle has a sock-like fit and the heel features a pull tab and is supported by polyurethane as well. The midsole is thick and contains a Fear of God patch at the back of the heel. What we like most about this sneaker is the modern take on the adidas logo, which sees it enlarged and slanted to take up the sides of the shoe. The adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball Clay was released on March 3, 2024, for $250.

Display Name: Crocs Crocband Clog Red Bull Racing
Description: The Crocs Crocband Clog Red Bull Racing marks Crocs' first ever official collaboration with a Formula 1 team, transforming the brand's snugger closed sidewall Crocband silhouette into something that genuinely reads as a race car for the feet. A front and rear wing sit across the build, joined by a raised halo, a helmet detail perched atop the toe box, and faux tire elements near the heel and forefoot that mimic the actual engineering of Red Bull's turbocharged machine. Red Bull Racing branding lines the rubber sidewall, while the energy drink's logo appears on the insole and behind the helmet for genuine collector detail. A spoiler finishes the sport mode strap, completing the transformation from clog to clog shaped race car in a way that feels genuinely playful rather than gimmicky. Underneath all the racing theatrics, the shoe still delivers Crocs signature lightweight, flexible, 360 degree comfort, making it just as wearable at home during a race broadcast as it is trackside. Releasing alongside a more understated Classic Runner and a set of themed Jibbitz charms, this Crocband Clog stands as the clear headline piece of the entire collection. The Crocs Crocband Clog Red Bull Racing was released on May 21, 2026 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Ja Morant Let Me Be Ja
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Ja Morant Let Me Be Ja channels Ja Morants unapologetic individuality into a silhouette built on strength and cultural relevance. The sundial and cobalt bliss tones bring energy and personality, reflecting Jas fearless approach to both the game and self expression. The Air Force 1 acts as a solid foundation, allowing the message and color to feel confident rather than chaotic. Fans connect with this release because it feels personal. The Let Me Be Ja theme captures Morants refusal to be boxed in, turning the sneaker into a statement about authenticity and confidence. Collectors appreciate how Nike uses the AF1 as a platform for athlete storytelling beyond performance, making this pair feel meaningful and emotionally tied to the player rather than just branded collaboration. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Ja Morant Let Me Be Ja was released on November 4, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 White Beige
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 White Beige is a thin sneaker with a vintage look and classic design elements. This iteration of the Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 has an upper made of smooth leather in white. This color and material make up each side of the shoe, with the classic Onitsuka Tiger racing stripes visible on each side as white leather overlays. The main deviations from this white colorway are the t-shaped toe cap and the crisscross at the heel, which appear as beige suede overlays. The heel contains a Tiger-branded tab over it, and another branding patch is seen on the tongue. The thin midsole is white and gray. What we like most about this sneaker is the logo patch on the tongue, which adds a hint of a gold color to the shoe. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 White Beige was released in August 2023, and sold for $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Toe (GS)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Toe (GS) draws inspiration from the University of North Carolinas blue-and-white color scheme, which is a tribute to Michael Jordan's alma mater. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Toe was released in grade-school sizes, and it features a perforated toe, which helps improve ventilation. The sneaker has a cushioned sole unit that provides shock absorption, enhancing comfort for daily wear. Additionally, the sneaker has a durable rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern that ensures traction and grip on any surface. The Nike Swoosh and Air Jordan logo are black while the Nike Air on the tongue is in University Blue. Something we love about the Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Toe (GS) shoe is its high-top design. This provides ankle protection and stability, making it ideal for both casual and athletic use. The shoe debuted on July 22nd, 2023, and retailed for $140.

Display Name: Jordan 7 Retro Flint (2021)
Description: To celebrate its 15th Anniversary, Jordan Brand reissued the Air Jordan 7 Flint for the first time. The upper of the Air Jordan 7 Flint is made with white leather and Flint Grey Durabuck while hits of purple appear on the side Jumpman logo, tongue, and rubber heel patch. A polyester tongue with a grey, white, and black geometric pattern completes the Retro release. The Air Jordan 7 Flint released in May of 2021 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 N7 (2020/2025)
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 N7 (2020) was released in honor of the Native American Heritage Month of November 2020. The Air Max 90 N7 (2020) features a combination of gray and Volt colors with Crimson and black accents. The upper is made from leather, mesh, and suede which offer durability, breathability, and support. The outsole provides good traction even on slippery surfaces. The Nike Swoosh is visible on the side, while the Nike branding is on the heel and on the tongue. We especially love the Nike Air Max 90 N7 (2020) for its midsole. The midsole is made of lightweight foam and incorporates a visible Air unit located in the heel. This Air unit is designed to provide excellent cushioning and impact absorption, making it ideal for athletes and anyone who spends a lot of time on their feet. The shoe was released on June 21st, 2020, at a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble City Pack Paris Atelier
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Family Reunion France brings a storytelling driven approach to the 95, using layered greys and soft contrasts to create a look that feels both unified and expressive. Black, sail, and multiple shades of grey flow across the signature gradient upper, while subtle detailing ties into the Family Reunion theme. The big bubble unit reinforces the connection to early Air Max innovation. This pair stands out because it blends heritage with narrative. The Air Max 95 already carries a strong identity, and adding a story driven concept gives it additional depth without disrupting its core design. Fans appreciate how it honors the past while introducing something new, making it feel both familiar and meaningful. The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Family Reunion France was released on February 19, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential Light Bone/Psychic Blue
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Light Bone/Psychic Blue utilizes Light Bone leather and Sanddrift Khaki suede overlays above white mesh fabric to define its misty neutral aesthetic. American sportswear giant Nike unveiled the Air Max 1 in 1987, at the time aiming to create the look of speed. Decades later, the Air Max 1s simplicity paired with innovation represents Nikes uncanny ability to design for longevity, and the Air Max 1 is a favorite for colorway improvisation. At the Light Bone/Psychic Blue Nike Air Max 1 Essential, the Nike Swoosh in Psychic Blue accents the sides, playing off the visible midsole Air unit. The white midsole and black outsole finalize the look, while tonal Nike Air branding graces the rear heel and tongue. In our opinion, the best feature within the Air Max 1 Light Bone is its leather and suede combination, which adds definition to the shoes aesthetic. The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Light Bone/Psychic Blue released on January 7, 2025, and retailed at $140.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Burgundy Crush (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Burgundy Crush Womens brings a rich and layered palette to one of Nikes most popular retro running silhouettes. The black base anchors the design, while Burgundy Crush and Dark Team Red tones add depth and warmth across the upper. The combination highlights the shoes detailed construction without overwhelming it. Fans of the Vomero 5 appreciate how it balances comfort with a strong visual identity, and this colorway reflects that clearly. The darker tones make it versatile while still offering enough color to stand out. It is a pair that fits seamlessly into everyday rotation while maintaining the performance inspired roots of the model. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Burgundy Crush Womens was released on August 10, 2023 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Burnt Green White Black
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Burnt Green White Black leans into classic indoor sport aesthetics, using a burnt green base that adds depth and contrast against white and black accents. The low profile silhouette stays true to the brands heritage, with clean lines and minimal detailing that emphasize its roots. Onitsuka Tiger continues to draw from its archive, and this model reflects that through a straightforward but effective design. Fans of retro sneakers gravitate toward pairs like this because they offer timeless styling without unnecessary changes. The color combination feels balanced and easy to wear, while the structure keeps it grounded in sport history. It is a sneaker that captures the essence of classic design, appealing to those who value simplicity and heritage. The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Burnt Green White Black was released on August 1, 2023 with a retail price of $70.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Wings (2025) (Women's)
Description: Elevate your rotation with the Jordan 5 Retro Wings (2025) (Womens), a refined take on a hoops icon that blends aviation-inspired detail with modern comfort. Dressed in Medium Grey/Black/Metallic Silver (style code IO2038-001), this womens colorway balances subtle tonal panels with polished metallic hits for a sleek, street-ready finish. Signature AJ5 elements are all here: the sculpted midsole with jagged "shark tooth" accents, translucent outsole for crisp traction, and the reflective tongue that catches light with every step. A breathable mesh quarter panel pairs with a supportive padded collar, while the lace lock nods to the silhouettes late-80s heritage and keeps your fit dialed in. The result is a versatile sneaker that looks just as sharp with tailored layers as it does with laid-back athleisure. Engineered for day-to-night wear, the Jordan 5 Retro Wings (2025) (Womens) delivers plush cushioning underfoot and a stable ride for city commutes, casual outings, or courtside moments. The Metallic Silver highlights amplify the clean Medium Grey base, making this pair a go-to for minimalists who still want standout detail. Released on July 16, 2025, this edition showcases why the Jordan 5 remains a cornerstone of Air Jordan history: bold lines, purposeful features, and timeless attitude. Whether youre drawn to the reflective tongue, the translucent outsole glow, or the distinctive profile that started on the hardwood and lives in lifestyle today, this pair brings iconic style into the present. Our team loves this product because it combines heritage design, premium finish, and everyday comfort, making it a smart pick for style-focused wearers who want impact without effort.

Display Name: Nike Air More Uptempo 96 Olympic (2024)
Description: The Nike Air More Uptempo 96 Olympic (2024) updates the OG sneaker worn by basketball player Scottie Pippen at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics with a patriotic colorway. The velvety nubuck construction of the Olympic (2024) Nike Air More Uptempo 96 comes in Midnight Navy, while the exaggerated "AIR" lettering wraps around the shoe and comes in crisp white. These colors reach over the midsole, which houses a visible air sole unit. Pops of University Red appear on the dual Swoosh logos on the rubber outsole and the Swoosh embroidered on the leather tongue tag. The heel displays a jewel Swoosh in Midnight Navy, complementing the tonal heel pull tabs. Something our StockX experts like is the small details that pay tribute to Scottie Pippen. For example, the number 8 in gold on the heel represents the athlete's Olympic jersey number. The Nike Air More Uptempo 96 Olympic (2024) was released on July 26, 2024, and sold for $170.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 6 Black Anthracite (Women's)
Description: The Nike Free Metcon 6 Black Anthracite Womens delivers a training focused silhouette that emphasizes flexibility and stability through a clean and performance driven design. The black and anthracite palette keeps the look sleek and understated, allowing the structure and build to take center stage. The combination of Free flexibility and Metcon stability creates a balanced feel suited for varied workouts. Fans of training footwear appreciate how the Free Metcon line continues to evolve while maintaining its core purpose. The tonal colorway enhances its versatility, making it easy to transition between gym sessions and everyday wear. It is a sneaker that reflects Nikes focus on functional design, offering both support and movement in a streamlined package. The Nike Free Metcon 6 Black Anthracite Womens was released on June 26, 2024 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Aqua
Description: The Aqua colorway is taking a new Air Jordan retro silhouette with the release of the Jordan 5 Retro Aqua. The Jordan 5 Aqua is the colorway of the Jordan 5 to release in 2023. ? ?The Retro Air Jordan 5 Aqua have a black nubuck upper with a black midsole, and white air unit. The sneakers have a black and aqua fabric sock lining, and a translucent aqua outsole. ? ?The Air Jordan 5 Aqua released February 4, 2023, with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver Black
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver Black is a striking addition to Nike's renowned running shoe lineup. This sleek sneaker combines style and performance, featuring a metallic silver upper that's accented with black details, creating a modern and eye-catching aesthetic. The shoe's design is complemented by pure platinum and white elements, adding depth and dimension to its overall appearance. Built for comfort and speed, the Zoom Vomero 5 incorporates Nike's innovative Zoom Air technology in the midsole, providing responsive cushioning and energy return with every step. The shoe's upper is crafted from a combination of materials that offer both durability and breathability, ensuring your feet stay cool and comfortable during intense workouts or casual wear. With its sleek silhouette and performance-driven features, this sneaker is versatile enough for both athletic pursuits and everyday style. Us at StockX believe this product is great for runners and sneaker enthusiasts alike, offering a perfect blend of retro-inspired design and modern performance technology.

Model: Nike SB Air Max 2 CB '94 Low
Display Name: Nike SB Air Max 2 CB '94 Low Supreme Black
Description: The Nike SB Air Max 2 CB 94 Low Supreme Black brings together skate culture and basketball heritage through a clean and bold execution. The black upper creates a strong and unified look, while metallic silver accents highlight the structure and add contrast. The silhouette retains the aggressive design language of the original CB 94. Fans appreciate how it respects the original while introducing a new context through skate culture. The Nike SB Air Max 2 CB 94 Low Supreme Black was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $168.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite One Light Orewood Brown
Description: The Nike Air Foamposite One Light Orewood Brown is part basketball sneaker and part streetwear shoe. It features a molded Foamposite upper that gives the sneaker a futuristic appearance. Like other basketball shoes in Nikes catalog, the Light Orewood Brown Nike Air Foamposite One displays the signature one-cent logo on the rubber outsole, a feature first introduced by NBA legend Penny Hardaway. The sneaker also boasts responsive cushioning designed for the basketball court. The Foamposite upper comes in Light Orewood Brown with a matte finish, while the inner bootie creates a secure fit around the ankle. Unlike traditional basketball shoes, this sneaker features a lace cage that extends across the vamp and into the toebox. The laces come in black and match the bootie and collar. Our experts at StockX like the one-cent logo embroidered on the heel. The Nike Air Foamposite One Light Orewood Brown was released on May 31, 2024, and sold for $240.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Lakers Away (Numbered Edition of 8000)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Lakers Away (Numbered Edition of 8000) is a low-top shoe whose design was inspired by the late basketball player. This iteration of the Nike Air Force 1 Low has a patterned black leather upper. The pattern is a debossed version of Kobe BryantÄôs logo that appears consistently throughout, including on the perforated toe box. What we like most about the shoe is the commitment to the Lakers colors of yellow and purple, which truly stand out against the black. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Lakers Away (Numbered Edition of 8000) was released on December 6, 2024, for $150.

Display Name: adidas Campus 00s Grey White
Description: The adidas Campus 00s Grey White comes in a grey three, footwear white, and off-white color scheme. ? ?The Grey White adidas Campus 00s has a grey and white upper with a subtle pattern. The shoe's upper is constructed with suede for durability and style. The sneaker has a durable rubber outsole for stability and traction. The sneaker's EVA wedge midsole provides comforting cushioning. The side perforations of the shoe provide ventilation and comfort. The shoe features the classic adidas 3-Stripes branding on the lateral sides. The sneaker has a "CAMPUS" inscription on one side. The shoe's design is completed with the adidas Trefoil logo on the tongue and heel. ? ?The adidas Campus 00s Grey White was released at a retail price of $100 on March 1, 2023.

Display Name: Nike Air Peg 2K5 Pale Ivory Black
Description: The Nike Air Peg 2K5 Pale Ivory Black brings back a classic early 2000s running silhouette with a softer and more lifestyle driven palette. The pale ivory and coconut milk tones give the shoe a vintage feel, while metallic silver overlays add that signature performance inspired contrast. Black accents ground the design, keeping the overall look balanced and easy to wear. This pair stands out because it blends nostalgia with versatility. The Air Peg line has always been rooted in performance, but colorways like this shift it into everyday rotation. It is a strong option for those who appreciate retro runners that feel both comfortable and visually layered. The Nike Air Peg 2K5 Pale Ivory Black was released on February 8, 2024 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Black Metallic Gold
Description: As cool as a sneaker can get, the Air Jordan 1 Mid Black Metallic Gold basketball shoes have style, utility, and street cred all rolled into one high-performance shoe. With black and gold being the primary color base, the Air Jordan 1s are stylish and slick while still providing all the tech needed for an athletic shoe. Made from leather with synthetic leather and textile upper, the mid-top hugs your foot for extra support. They have a foam midsole and traditional Nike Air Cushioning to deliver a lightweight step. The gold Air Jordan wings logo sits on the back sides of the heel, while the Swoosh sits on both sides of the shoe in gold. We love how these Air Jordan sneakers are inspired by the OG AJ1s, keeping the mid-top legacy that has become iconic. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Black Metallic Gold were released on 1 June 2024, priced at $125.

Display Name: Nike LD-1000 Flyknit White Sail
Description: The Nike LD-1000 Flyknit in White and Sail is a modern material reinterpretation of one of Nike's most historically significant and beloved long-distance running silhouettes, applying Flyknit's precision-engineered knit construction to the LD-1000's classic low-profile running architecture in a colorway that honors the original's clean and slightly aged visual character through the warm off-white relationship between white and sail. The LD-1000 carries a specific and respected place in Nike's running archive as a serious long-distance training and racing shoe from an era when form followed pure performance function, and the Flyknit update brings that heritage design into contact with one of Nike's most technically advanced upper construction technologies in a combination that feels genuinely earned rather than simply nostalgic. White and sail across the Flyknit upper creates the same clean and slightly vintage visual character that the original LD-1000's materials developed naturally over time, the colorway paying tribute to the source material's aesthetic biography through deliberate color selection rather than artificial aging treatment. Nike running archive silhouettes brought to life through modern material technologies represent some of the most interesting and rewarding releases in the current running collector and lifestyle sneaker market, because they allow wearers to experience the design intelligence and heritage of shoes that shaped running culture in genuinely new material forms that serve contemporary performance and lifestyle needs better than accurate replicas of the original construction could manage. The Flyknit construction gives the LD-1000's classic proportions a textile softness and breathability that leather and nylon originals could not provide, making this a shoe that wears differently and more comfortably than a strict retro would while maintaining complete visual fidelity to the silhouette's design heritage. At one hundred and fifteen dollars the LD-1000 Flyknit in white and sail is an accessible and genuinely rewarding running heritage acquisition. The Nike LD-1000 Flyknit in White and Sail was released on October 1, 2024 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Bringback Pack Mexico
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bringbacks Pack Mexico is a January 13, 2026 release from the adidas Gazelle Indoor Bringbacks Pack, a three-shoe World Cup-themed capsule released ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup that SoleRetriever described as a tribute to three World Cup kits of the past and present on pairs of Gazelles, with Mexico joined by Argentina and Colombia in the pack. The Mexico colorway of the Gazelle Indoor applies kit-referencing design elements to the Gazelle Indoor's classic suede and upper construction, with a green suede T-toe and lace panel, red Three Stripes on the side, and a green all-over print covering the rest of the shoe with decorative Mexican design referencing the jersey motif that has become one of the most recognizable visual signatures in Mexican football kit history across the sport's most celebrated decades. SoleRetriever confirmed a small three-striped national flag hanging off the back heel tab as a detail shared across all three colorways in the Bringbacks Pack, and SneakerNews noted the Mexico pair carries creative interpretations of overall Mexican kit hallmarks rather than one-to-one jersey comparisons, most clearly referencing the expressive geometry of the 1992 and 1996 Mexico editions. The Gazelle Indoor itself is the specific low-profile variant of the Gazelle family that has generated some of the most anticipated collaborations and colorways in adidas' recent Originals releases, the Indoor designation referring to the original position of the silhouette within adidas' performance sport range before its transition into lifestyle territory. A gum rubber outsole completes the construction in the classic finish associated with the Gazelle Indoor's most collector-forward colorways. Released January 13, 2026 in unisex sizing at $130. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bringbacks Pack Mexico is the World Cup-themed January 2026 Gazelle Indoor for the adidas collector and Mexico football supporter who wants the green suede, red Three Stripes, and all-over Mexican kit-referencing print in the most host-nation-specific execution of the three-shoe Bringbacks Pack ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bringbacks Pack Mexico was released on January 13, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Light Show (GS)
Description: Nike Ja 3 Light Show GS brings energy and movement into Ja Morants signature line through a colorway that feels vibrant and expressive. Light Show leans into contrast and brightness, giving the Ja 3 a playful personality that mirrors Jas fearless and creative style on the court. Even in grade school sizing, the design feels bold and intentional rather than scaled back. Collectors enjoy this release because it captures the fun side of performance footwear. The Ja 3 silhouette thrives on speed and motion, and the Light Show theme amplifies that feeling through color and attitude. It appeals to fans who appreciate sneakers that feel alive, blending athletic purpose with visual storytelling that reflects the athlete behind the shoe. The Nike Ja 3 Light Show GS was released on 08/05/2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Bricolage (Women's)
Description: The NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Summit White reflects a stripped back and utilitarian approach to sneaker design, focusing on function and simplicity over excess. The summit white base keeps the look clean and versatile, while pine green and university gold accents add subtle contrast that enhances the overall structure. The silhouette feels practical and purpose driven, aligning with Tom Sachs design philosophy. Fans are drawn to this model because it challenges traditional sneaker expectations by prioritizing everyday usability. The minimal design makes it easy to wear across different settings, while the collaboration adds a conceptual layer that resonates with collectors. It stands as a reminder that thoughtful design can exist without unnecessary complexity. The NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Summit White was released on April 14, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Model: Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG
Display Name: Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Fear Nothing Pack
Description: The Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Fear Nothing Pack brings a sharp and focused look to a performance football boot built for speed. University red dominates the upper, creating a bold and aggressive tone, while dark obsidian accents add depth and structure that emphasize the streamlined silhouette. This pair stands out because it reflects confidence and intent. The Fear Nothing theme aligns with the mindset required at the highest level of play, making the design feel purposeful beyond its performance features. Fans appreciate how it combines speed driven construction with a strong visual identity. The Nike Zoom Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Fear Nothing Pack was released on June 23, 2025 with a retail price of $270.

Display Name: New Balance 740v2 White Shadow Grey Navy
Description: The New Balance 740v2 White Shadow Grey Navy leans into timeless color blocking that highlights the silhouettes technical foundation. A white base keeps the upper bright and breathable, while Shadow Grey overlays add subtle depth and dimension. Navy accents provide a clean contrast that reinforces the runner heritage of the model. The updated v2 construction refines the proportions, giving the shoe a streamlined look without losing its layered identity. Collectors appreciate colorways like this because they feel dependable yet intentional. The mix of white, grey, and navy has a classic appeal that works year round, making it easy to integrate into any rotation. Rather than relying on bold graphics or loud tones, this pair lets craftsmanship and structure take center stage. It embodies the steady, confident design language that continues to define New Balance performance inspired releases. The New Balance 740v2 White Shadow Grey Navy was released on November 15, 2024 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Premium Iron Grey University Red
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Iron Grey University Red refreshes one of Nikes most iconic running silhouettes through a darker and more aggressive color palette rooted in classic sport styling. The Air Max 90 remains a permanent staple within sneaker culture because of its layered panel construction, visible Air cushioning, and deep connection to 1990s streetwear and performance history. The Iron Grey base creates a sleek and understated foundation while the University Red accents inject sharp contrast and energy that immediately recall vintage Nike running aesthetics and classic athletic color blocking. Fans continue gravitating toward the Air Max 90 because it balances bold design and everyday versatility better than almost any other retro runner. Premium material treatments elevate the familiar silhouette while preserving the unmistakable proportions and visual flow that made the model legendary decades ago. Collectors especially appreciate darker Air Max colorways because they highlight the layered construction and textured paneling without overwhelming the design through excessive brightness. The combination of grey, black, and red gives the sneaker a timeless and sport driven personality that feels equally connected to archival Nike heritage and contemporary streetwear styling. The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Iron Grey University Red was released with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 Mowabb
Description: The Nike Book 1 Mowabb is a mid-height athletic shoe featuring an upper in Sesame fabric and leather, accented by the Nike Swoosh in Black outlined in Bright Mandarin. Nike, operating out of Beaverton, Oregon, USA, excels at outfitting professional athletes and translating their creative vision to signature shoes. The Mowabb Nike Book 1 was designed for Devin Booker of the NBA's Phoenix Suns. The Mowabb colorway nods to Books southwest surroundings and pulls its colorway inspiration from his favorite pair of Nike ACG footwear. The Smoke Grey midsole meets a Black and Dusty Cactus outsole, coordinating with the mesh fabric of the heel collar and tongue. Additional branding elements include the small Bright Mandarin Swoosh at the mudguard, Book 1 branding on the tongue, and Air Book branding on the rear heel tab. In our opinion, the best feature of Book 1 is its fabrication, which shows off its southwest-inspired color story. The Nike Book 1 Mowabb was released on March 1, 2024, and retailed for $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Premium Spring Flowers
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Premium Spring Flowers introduces a softer and more expressive direction for the silhouette, leaning into seasonal tones that feel light and layered. Malt, light soft pink, particle rose, and mauve grey come together to create a palette that feels almost watercolor inspired, bringing a sense of calm and subtle movement across the upper. The premium build supports the concept with smooth transitions and refined finishes. What makes this pair stand out is its mood. It shifts the Air Force 1 away from its usual grounded tones and into something more delicate without losing its structure. Fans who appreciate variation within a familiar model are drawn to releases like this, where color becomes the main storytelling element. It feels fresh, wearable, and slightly unexpected in the best way. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Premium Spring Flowers was released on February 25, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Fauna Brown (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Fauna Brown Womens introduces a warmer and more earthy tone to the silhouette, using fauna brown to shift the overall mood. The gradient upper blends black, white, and medium grey with the brown accents, creating a layered look that feels grounded and natural. The structure remains bold, allowing the color to reshape the identity. This pair resonates with those who appreciate a softer and more wearable take on the Air Max 95. The addition of fauna brown gives it a distinct character without overpowering the design, making it feel unique while still rooted in the original concept. It is a subtle evolution that adds depth to the lineup. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Fauna Brown Womens was released on January 12, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Perforated Leather White Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Perforated Leather in White Black is an April 2026 premium iteration of Nike's iconic 1990 running and lifestyle silhouette featuring a perforated leather upper construction that transforms the standard Air Max 90's leather panels by adding a systematic pattern of small circular holes across the surface, creating both a textural visual detail and an enhanced breathability function that differentiates this edition from the standard smooth leather Air Max 90. The perforated leather treatment connects to a long tradition of premium Italian leather goods and luxury shoe production where perforation is used as both a decorative and functional technique, applying those craft-heritage associations to Nike's most enduring performance-to-lifestyle silhouette in a way that positions the Perforated Leather AM90 as the most refined and most premium expression of the model in the Spring 2026 release calendar. The White and University Red and Black colorway applies the most historically significant and most widely recognized Air Max 90 color combination to the perforated leather construction, connecting the premium material treatment to the shoe's most iconic OG colorway references while making the perforation pattern maximally visible against the clean white leather surface. Released April 20, 2026 at $135 retail through Nike and authorized retailers globally. The Nike Air Max 90 Perforated Leather White Black was released on April 20, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Levis Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Levis Black fuses heritage denim-inspired craftsmanship with the iconic lines of Sergio Lozanos 95 silhouette. A moody Black/Anthracite upper is layered with rugged textile and suede-like textures that echo Levis workwear roots, punctuated by Gym Red accents along the eyelets, Swoosh, and branding hits for a sharp, urban finish. The signature wavy side panels create depth and movement, while reflective touches enhance low-light visibility. Underfoot, visible Max Air units in the heel and forefoot keep every step cushioned and responsive, supported by a sculpted foam midsole and a durable rubber outsole engineered for dependable traction on city streets. Balancing utility and style, this mens Air Max 95 delivers all-day comfort without compromising its street-ready presence. The padded collar and breathable mesh tongue help regulate airflow, while rope laces and reinforced eye stays provide a secure, adaptable fit. Subtle Levis nods pair effortlessly with everyday staples, think black denim, utility jackets, and technical outerwear, making this colorway a versatile anchor for any rotation. Noted by style code HM4743-001, the Nike Air Max 95 OG Levis Black stands out as a refined blend of culture, comfort, and craftsmanship that elevates the legendary Air Max lineage. Our team loves this product because it pairs iconic Air cushioning with rugged, denim-inspired detailing, making it perfect for daily wear, long days on your feet, and polished street style.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentine's Day Black (2026)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentines Day Black 2026 takes a darker approach to the seasonal celebration, wrapping the silhouette in a sleek black finish. University Red accents provide sharp contrast, injecting subtle romance into the otherwise monochrome build. The familiar leather panels and low profile construction keep the design rooted in heritage, allowing the color interplay to drive the mood. It feels bold yet intentional, offering a twist on traditional Valentine themes. Fans who prefer understated statements will appreciate this take on a holiday release. The black base makes it highly wearable beyond the occasion, while the red touches add character and meaning. It captures the balance between seasonal storytelling and everyday versatility. This pair stands out through contrast rather than excess, keeping the icon sharp and relevant. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentines Day Black 2026 was released on January 14, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 Metallic Silver Black
Description: The Nike Shox R4 Metallic Silver Black revives early 2000s tech energy with a sharp metallic finish that defines the silhouette. Metallic Silver wraps the upper with futuristic shine, contrasted by black accents that sharpen the contours and highlight the sculpted design. The signature Shox columns underfoot remain the focal point, delivering both visual impact and unmistakable cushioning identity. Its streamlined build feels bold and performance driven without losing its retro roots. Fans of the Shox line appreciate how silver executions amplify the mechanical aesthetic that made the model iconic. The black detailing keeps the look grounded, preventing the metallic finish from feeling overwhelming. It blends nostalgia with modern street presence in a confident way. Sleek and unapologetic, this pair captures peak Shox attitude. The Nike Shox R4 Metallic Silver Black was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Michigan State (GS)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Spartan Green GS has as two dominant hues, the varsity green and white. The leather upper of this Low Nike Dunk sneaker for grade-schoolers is white-hued. The white leather upper is contrasted by a green hue on the Swoosh logos as well as on the overlays. This same color combination is used on the rest of the shoe, with varsity green appearing on the middle section, laces, and the outsole, whereas a white hue is displayed on the midsole. The Nike Dunk Low Spartan Green GS was recommended to retail at $100 when it was first released on May 3, 2021.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Phantom Mink Brown (Women's)
Description: Blending retro runner DNA with modern street style, the Nike P-6000 Phantom Mink Brown (Womens) delivers a versatile neutral palette that pairs with everything. Layered mesh and leather overlays in Phantom, College Grey, Metallic Summit White, and Mink Brown create dimensional texture and breathability, while the sculpted lines nod to the Pegasus heritage that inspired the silhouette. A plush, foam-cushioned midsole and padded collar keep every step supported, whether youre clocking city miles or elevating an everyday fit. The tonal Swoosh and reflective-style accents add subtle shine, and the rugged rubber outsole grips with confidence for all-day wear. Designed for comfort as much as aesthetics, this lifestyle sneaker offers a snug, true-to-feel fit in womens sizing with a secure lace system that hugs the midfoot. The horizontal and vertical overlay grid provides structure without sacrificing airflow, and the durable toe cap resists scuffs on the go. Style code HV6353-001 and a March 2025 release make this colorway a standout in the P-6000 lineup, delivering the kind of easy-on, easy-off styling that transitions seamlessly from errands to evenings out. Pair the warm Mink Brown notes with soft knits or tailored staples to highlight its refined, understated vibe. Our team loves this product because it blends cushioned, all-day comfort with a refined neutral color story thats effortless to style and built to last.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 SC Sail
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 SC Sail is a "Sports Classic" sneaker, which means its designated as a heritage model due to its influence on sports culture. In this case, this original Nike Air Max started as a running shoe, and this sneaker continues its legacy. It boasts a woven textile upper in white with synthetic leather overlays in Sail and a mudguard in warm Coconut Milk. In addition, a white Swoosh checks across the side panel. The low-cut collar features padding, which works with the thick midsole to provide a slightly bulky silhouette. As is expected of Air Max 1 models, the "SC Sail" version displays visible Air Max units in the heel. These units protect against impact and provide responsive cushioning Our StockX experts like the combination of warm, off-white colors across the upper, which gives the sneaker a neutral aesthetic. The Nike Air Max 1 SC Sail was released on April 5, 2024, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite One Anthracite (2023)
Description: Enter the realm of futuristic style with the Nike Air Foamposite One Anthracite. This 2023 edition, dressed in an enigmatic Black/Anthracite/Black colorway, represents the pinnacle of sneaker innovation. With its foamposite material, this sneaker offers a seamless blend of durability, comfort, and a distinctly modern aesthetic. The Anthracite colorway is a muted statement that provides versatility for any outfit. The sneaker's advanced features ensure a snug, comfortable fit, making it a reliable choice for daily wear or special occasions. Launched on December 12, 2023, at $240, the Nike Air Foamposite One Anthracite is a testament to Nike's commitment to pushing the boundaries of design and functionality. This sneaker is a must-have for those who live at the intersection of technology and trendsetting.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus College Grey Light Iron Ore Gum
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus College Grey/Light Iron Ore/Gum is an October 1, 2025 release from Nike's Vomero Plus running program, retailing at $180 with style code HV8150-005 in the College Grey/Light Iron Ore/Gum Medium Brown/Medium Ash colorway, confirmed by StockX and GOAT. As confirmed by GOAT's detailed silhouette description, the Nike Vomero Plus College Grey/Light Iron Ore/Gum showcases maximum cushioning highlighted by an ultra-responsive ZoomX foam midsole featuring increased rocker geometry and a 45-millimeter heel stack height, a high-abrasion rubber outsole with classic waffle traction pattern for reliable grip, and an engineered mesh upper in a pale grey finish with laces feeding through corded eyelets for a lockdown fit. The Vomero Plus is Nike's premium cushioning platform positioned as the performance-focused evolution of the Vomero running series, with the ZoomX foam and elevated 45mm heel stack placing it among the most cushioned lifestyle running shoes in Nike's 2025 catalog. The College Grey/Light Iron Ore/Gum colorway applies the pale college grey mesh as the primary base, light iron ore as the complementary neutral grey tone, gum medium brown on the outsole for the warm vintage-era contrast that defines the colorway's visual identity, and medium ash as the fourth accent completing the most understated and most broadly collectible tonal grey execution in the Vomero Plus multi-colorway program. Retail price $180. The Nike Vomero Plus College Grey/Light Iron Ore/Gum is the October 1, 2025 HV8150-005 ZoomX-foam 45mm-heel-stack increased-rocker-geometry corded-eyelet-lockdown waffle-traction-outsole gum-medium-brown-sole engineered-mesh-upper premium performance running shoe for the Nike collector who wants the most understated college grey and gum outsole neutral colorway from the Nike Vomero Plus program. The Nike Vomero Plus College Grey/Light Iron Ore/Gum was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $180.
Colorway: College Grey/Light Iron Ore/Gum Medium Brown/Medium Ash

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low UCLA
Description: The Nike Dunk Low UCLA closely resembles the school colors used by the University of California Los Angeles. The upper of the Nike Dunk Low UCLA is made of University Gold-colored leather. The sneakers upper part also features 'Blue Jay' leather overlays. The tongue of this shoe is golden colored and features blue detailing. The white midsole of this sneaker create an airy break from the combination of a gold-blue color that widely constitutes this shoe. A matching blue outsole rounds off this sneaker. Nike Dunk Low UCLA will debut on August 9th, 2022 at a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Realtree Camo Off Noir
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Realtree Camo Off Noir takes a performance runner and infuses it with a rugged camo aesthetic, using the Realtree pattern to give the shoe a distinct outdoor feel. The off noir base and metallic dark grey accents create depth, while black and iron grey tones keep the design cohesive. The Pegasus silhouette remains focused on performance, but the camo adds a lifestyle driven edge. Collectors and runners appreciate how this version blends function with a more expressive visual identity. The camo pattern gives it character, while the underlying design maintains the reliability the Pegasus line is known for. It is a sneaker that bridges outdoor inspiration and everyday wear, offering a unique take on a trusted performance model. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Realtree Camo Off Noir was released on February 5, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Mystic Red Rosewood
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Mystic Red Rosewood is crafted predominantly from plush suede, exuding a strong retro vibe while merging Mystic Red, Emerald Rise, Rugged Orange, and Rosewood into a distinctive and harmonious color scheme that combines the finest attributes of each shade. The Mystic Red Rosewood Nike SB Dunk Low departs from the conventional leather construction, opting for a shaggy suede upper in a vibrant crimson color, while additional touches of Emerald Rise grace the iconic Swoosh and Nike branding found on the cushioned tongue and heel tab. Within the shoe, a foam insole includes a Zoom Air unit to enhance impact absorption. Completing the low-top design is a sturdy rubber cup sole, finished in a solid Rosewood tone, providing durability and style. What our experts love about the Nike SB Dunk Low Mystic Red Rosewood its suede construction. This luxurious and shaggy suede material not only offers a premium and tactile feel, but also adds a distinctive retro aesthetic to the sneakers. The sneaker was released on August 23, 2023, for $110.

Display Name: Dynafish Dyna Super White
Description: The Dynafish Xiaonian in White is a lifestyle sneaker that brings a Chinese cultural celebration into footwear form, the Xiaonian festival, traditionally observed as the beginning of New Year preparations in the Chinese lunar calendar, providing the biographical and cultural context for a release that honors one of the most warmly anticipated and domestically significant moments in the Chinese cultural calendar through the medium of a clean and seasonally appropriate white sneaker design. White as the release colorway suits the Xiaonian concept with natural cultural coherence, the color's associations with cleanliness, fresh beginnings, and the preparation and renewal themes that the Xiaonian festival represents in its traditional context of house cleaning, cooking, and family gathering that precede the Lunar New Year's main celebrations. The Dynafish platform's design and construction create a sneaker that carries the cultural tribute with genuine respect and design consideration rather than simply applying holiday imagery to a generic silhouette for commercial purposes. Chinese cultural calendar-specific sneaker releases occupy an increasingly significant and collector-relevant space in the global sneaker market as brands develop more specific and culturally honest engagement with Chinese cultural occasions beyond the standard Lunar New Year red and gold formula that most Western brands default to without genuine cultural research. The Xiaonian-specific timing and the white colorway's cultural appropriateness demonstrate the kind of calendar-specific and culturally informed design decision-making that makes these releases feel genuinely personal and respectful to the communities whose celebrations they honor rather than commercially extractive. At one hundred and twenty-nine dollars the Dynafish Xiaonian in white is a fairly priced and culturally considered sneaker acquisition from a release that rewards both cultural awareness and genuine appreciation for the specific and beloved Chinese festival moment it was designed to honor. The Dynafish Xiaonian in White was released on March 1, 2023 with a retail price of $129.

Display Name: Salomon XT-Pathway 2 Feid FXXOMOR
Description: Salomon XT Pathway 2 Feid FXXOMOR blends technical trail heritage with modern music culture through a collaboration that feels raw and expressive. The XT Pathway 2 silhouette is built around movement and terrain awareness, and pairing it with Feids FXXOMOR identity gives the shoe a gritty and energetic personality. It feels rooted in real world motion rather than fashion fantasy. This release resonates with collectors because it reflects how performance footwear has crossed into cultural storytelling. The layered construction and trail ready aesthetic remain intact, while the collaboration adds mood and identity without overpowering function. It appeals to fans who appreciate gear that feels lived in and purposeful, designed for movement first but rich with cultural context. The Salomon XT Pathway 2 Feid FXXOMOR was released on 10/25/2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Violet Haze
Description: The Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Violet Haze draws its inspiration from streetwear and performance aesthetics. Born from a collaboration between Nike and NOCTA, the sub-label co-founded by Canadian artist Drake, the shoe features an upper crafted from premium leather and synthetic materials. The midsole employs Nikes Air technology for responsive cushioning, while a durable rubber outsole with a treaded pattern offers strong traction on a variety of surface types. NOCTA branding can be found on the tongue and heel, while Nikes iconic Swoosh logo makes a subtle appearance on the shoes lateral side. Perforations along the sides allow for air flow for added comfort. What our experts find to be a standout feature of the Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Violet Haze is its solid Violet Haze colorway. This shoe originally retailed with a price tag of $180 when it was first released on November 18th, 2022.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential Vamps
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Vamps is a striking addition to the iconic Air Max lineup. This men's sneaker showcases a sleek black base accented with bold University Red and subtle Iron Grey details, creating a visually captivating design. The shoe's upper combines premium materials and expert craftsmanship, ensuring both style and durability. The classic Air Max 1 silhouette is enhanced with modern updates, making it a perfect blend of retro charm and contemporary appeal. Featuring Nike's renowned Air cushioning technology in the heel, these sneakers offer exceptional comfort and support for all-day wear. The carefully constructed mesh and synthetic overlays provide breathability and structure, while the padded collar and tongue add to the overall comfort. The rubber outsole with its distinctive waffle pattern ensures excellent traction on various surfaces, making it suitable for both casual outings and light athletic activities. Our experts state this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts who appreciate a balance of classic design and modern performance, perfect for those seeking a versatile shoe that can effortlessly transition from street style to everyday wear.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Clay Beige
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Clay Beige delivers a refined and neutral take on the silhouette through a soft and earthy color palette. The clay and beige tones create a warm and understated look, while the gum sole reinforces its vintage indoor heritage. The design feels simple and balanced, emphasizing the shape and materials. Fans of the Spezial line appreciate how neutral colorways like this enhance the timeless nature of the silhouette. The combination of earthy tones makes it easy to style across different outfits. It is a sneaker that reflects understated elegance and classic adidas design. The adidas Handball Spezial Clay Beige was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant City of Champions
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Work Blue honors legacy through a performance inspired reinterpretation. Dressed in Work Blue with Metallic Gold and Summit White accents, the upper maintains the classic AF1 structure while incorporating Protro level refinements. The bold blue base pairs with gold detailing to reflect championship energy. Kobe themed releases always carry emotional weight, and applying that storytelling to the Air Force 1 gives the silhouette renewed depth. The work blue tone feels strong and confident, while gold hits elevate the look. It stands as a tribute piece that bridges basketball history with a timeless street icon. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Work Blue was released on February 4, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Lightning Denim Turquoise
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Lightning Denim Turquoise leans into contrast and texture, pairing a lightning yellow base with wolf grey and denim turquoise accents that create a layered and slightly rugged feel. The denim elements add depth to the upper, giving the shoe a different visual texture compared to standard leather builds. It feels both vibrant and grounded at the same time. This pair stands out because of its material mix. SB Dunk releases often experiment with fabrics, and this version uses denim to shift the overall look while keeping the silhouette familiar. It is a bold but wearable option for those who want something more expressive without losing structure. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Lightning Denim Turquoise was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Black
Description: Japanese designer Rei Kawakubo is one of the most prolific fashion designers of all time. Aside from her Comme des Garçons collections, she has had numerous sneaker collaborations over the years. One of the most outstanding of these collaborations involves her different iterations of work modifying and styling up the Converse Chuck Taylor with her sub-label Comme des Garçons PLAY. Kawakubos first iteration of his Converse Chuck Taylors came about in 2009 when she modified the original by stripping back its contrast stitching. Six years later, in 2015, she took the All Star Chuck 70s as her template and created a shoe so beloved that it has been re-released every year since. The most immediately recognizable thing in shoes from the Comme des Garçons PLAY line is their heart and eyes logo, originally conceived and created by Filip Pagowski. Unlike the original 2009 version, however, the 2015 version and every version thereafter has moved away from the original minimalist philosophy that inspired Kawakubo to start this line of collaborations. The Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70s Hi Comme des Garçons PLAY harks back to the classic 70s Chuck Taylor style but with a high-top collar that snugly hugs the ankles and a black upper, white laces and a white sole and toe cap. The Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70s Hi Comme des Garçons PLAY Black was released in March of 2019 and retailed for $125.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Military Black
Description: Jordan Brand flipped one of its original Air Jordan 4 colorways for the Air Jordan 4 Military Black. Pulling its color-blocked style from the Air Jordan 4 Military Blue, the Air Jordan 4 Military Black features a smooth white leather upper with a light grey Durabuck toe wrap and netted TPU inserts. Military Black eyelets, heel tabs, and underlays add a stark contrast to the upper. At the base, a white, black, and light grey sole with a visible Air unit completes the design. The Air Jordan 4 Military Black released in May of 2022 and retailed for $210.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Triple Black
Description: The New Balance 1906R Triple Black strips the silhouette down to its most stealth driven form, wrapping every panel in Black for a cohesive and aggressive look. The mesh upper and layered overlays blend seamlessly, emphasizing shape and structure over contrast. The tonal sole unit reinforces the monochrome identity while maintaining the model signature cushioning. Triple Black executions often highlight the architecture of a sneaker, and the 1906R benefits from that focus. Without color distractions, the flowing lines and technical details become more pronounced. For fans who value versatility and understated confidence, this version offers a reliable and durable addition to any rotation. The New Balance 1906R Triple Black was released with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Indigo
Description: Ever since Michael Jordans memorable 1997 Flu Game, the Air Jordan 12s have been a pinnacle addition to the Jordan Brand lineage. In 2020, the Air Jordan 12 Indigo brings back everything that Jordan heads love about the sneaker. The Air Jordan 12 Indigo shares a striking resemblance to 2012s Obsidian retro. Most Jordan 12 retros feature tumbled leather, but the Air Jordan 12 Stone Blue takes on smooth grain leather. Hits of white on the toebox and midsole add contrast to a majority Stone Blue sneaker. From there, the iconic Jumpman logo is seen on both stamped on the outsole and embroidered on the tongue. These sneakers released in August of 2020 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Chile Red
Description: The Air Jordan 9 Chile Red arrives with a Chile Red Durabuck construction with matching patent leather mudguards and quilted paneling. At the heel, an embroidered "23" and rubber Jumpman insignia stay true to the model's original detailing. From there, a muted black sole and matching lace hooks complete the design. The Air Jordan 9 Chile Red released in May of 2022 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Ekiden Pack Volt
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus Ekiden Pack Volt channels marathon season energy through a bold and race inspired palette. Volt accents flash across the Multi Color upper, contrasted by Black, White, Metallic Silver, and University Red details. The dynamic build reinforces the performance focus that defines the Vomero lineage. Ekiden themed releases celebrate team based distance racing culture, and the high visibility Volt highlights reflect that competitive spirit. The layered color mix gives the shoe a fast and vibrant presence that feels built for race day moments. For runners who appreciate bold design paired with trusted cushioning, this edition captures both speed and statement in one package. The Nike Vomero Plus Ekiden Pack Volt was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Marblehead Light Aluminum
Description: The New Balance 2002R Marblehead Light Aluminum was originally released in 2005. Its minimalist features shades of grey colorway. The stylish and versatile New Balance 2002R Marblehead Light Aluminum top features several colors of grey. Its design is of the platinum fabric base and supple leather details. It consists of a netting top with a plain, perforated ashy faux leather surface. It also displays a matching outsole that complements the finishing. The New Balance 2002R Marblehead Light Aluminum has ABZORB innovation and N-ergy padding underfoot. The New Balance 2002R Marblehead Light Aluminum was released in September of 2020 for a price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Baroque Brown
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Baroque Brown is a low-top shoe that features all the design elements of the classic Dunk Low, but is made with more recycled materials. This colorway of the Nike Dunk Low Next Nature is made with a synthetic tumbled leather upper in white. Synthetic suede overlays appear in Baroque Brown rounding out the perforated toebox, underneath the laces, and running from the top of the laces down around the heel. The Nike Swoosh appears in black on the midsoles. The black heel tab features the Nike brand name stitched onto it, while there is also a Nike patch on the tongue. A white and black rubber outsole completes the look. What we like best about this shoe is the synthetic and recycled materials, which add to this shoes sustainability. The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Baroque Brown was first released on January 24, 2024, for a price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Shadow (2024)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Shadow (2024) is a low-top sneaker with a colorway that is reminiscent of the original 1985 version of the shoe. This iteration of the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG is completely made of leather. The upper is gray and black, with gray coloring the perforated toebox and the heel, while reflective black adorns the midsole, the lining of the toebox, and the overlays. The Nike Swoosh also appears in gray across the midsole. The Air Jordan logo appears in black on the gray heel tab, and a Nike Air patch can be found on the tongue. The mesh tongue and lining allow for breathability and extra comfort, while the sole is patterned for traction. Our favorite thing about this shoe is the simple colorway with shiny black leather. It gives the shoe a sleek and stylish look. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Shadow (2024) was released on May 11, 2024, for a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Muslin
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Muslin features a heavy-duty canvas upper with grey suede overlays and cream TPU eyestays. At the heel, a matching cream heel tab with a red Jumpman logo adds contrast to the neutral tones prominent throughout the design. From there, a white and grey Air Max sole completes the design.
