The Air Jordan 3 Muslin released in March of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Model: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1
Display Name: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Dodgers
Description: The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Flint Grey is a 20th anniversary tribute to the silhouette that started everything for Paul Rodriguez and Nike SB, arriving in a colorway that the skate community has quickly nicknamed "Dodgers" for its obvious nod to P-Rod's Los Angeles roots. Two distinct shades of Flint Grey layer across the premium suede and textured leather upper, dark overlays sitting over a medium grey base with the kind of tonal interplay that makes a simple grey colorway look considered rather than safe. Deep Royal Blue cuts through on the Swoosh, inner lining, and tongue branding in a pop that references both the Dodgers franchise and the broader Los Angeles identity that has always been central to P-Rod's visual vocabulary. A signature diamond pattern on the heel panel, rounded toebox, and cupsole construction are all present and faithful to the 2005 original, and a semi-translucent outsole with an integrated impact plate keeps the build honest for real skating. Paul Rodriguez became Nike SB's first ever signature athlete in 2005, and the P-Rod 1 established a template for what a technical street skating shoe could look like when designed by someone who understood both performance demands and aesthetic intention at the highest level. Over twenty years and more than ten signature models later, the anniversary reissue of the P-Rod 1 has been one of the most thoughtfully managed retro campaigns in Nike SB history, rolling out original and new colorways that honor the shoe's lineage without overexposing it. Air Zoom cushioning delivers the snappy, quick-off-the-ground feel that made the original a player favorite on ledges and rails, and the Flint Grey colorway with its subtle LA reference gives this particular release a personal quality that collectors and longtime skaters will feel immediately. The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Flint Grey was released on June 12, 2026 with a retail price of $125.
Colorway: Flint Grey/Deep Royal Blue/Flint Grey/Medium Grey/White

Display Name: adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Tokyo Marathon Cherry Blossom (Women's)
Description: The adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Tokyo Marathon Cherry Blossom Womens captures the energy of race day through a design inspired by one of the worlds most iconic marathons. The core white base creates a clean foundation, while clear pink accents reference cherry blossoms and add a soft and expressive contrast. Silver metallic details enhance the overall structure, giving it a polished and dynamic look. Fans of marathon themed releases appreciate how they tie performance footwear to specific cultural moments and locations. This version blends that storytelling with high level running design, making it both meaningful and functional. It is a sneaker that reflects speed, tradition, and visual identity in a cohesive way. The adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Tokyo Marathon Cherry Blossom Womens was released with a retail price of $250.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Seafoam (Women's)
Description: Jordan Brand is bringing back the Jordan 4 for the first time in adult sizing, in 2023 with the release of the Jordan 4 Retro Seafoam. The Retro Jordan 4 Seafoams released exclusively in womens sizing. The Air Jordan 4 Seafoam (W) received the same color-blocking treatment as the Jordan 4 Fire Red, and Jordan 4 Military Blue. The Seafoam Air Jordan 4 features a smooth white leather upper, with a black midsole and heel tab. Seafoam green eyelets, mudguard, sock lining, and tongue and heel logos, add a layer of contrast to the sneaker. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Seafoam (W) released February 9, 2023, with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Wolf Grey Black
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Wolf Grey Black leans into a cooler palette that sharpens the legendary low top profile. Wolf Grey wraps the upper in a smooth and understated tone, while black detailing adds structure and depth. The layered leather panels remain clean and balanced, emphasizing the silhouettes unmistakable shape. It feels modern without drifting from the foundation that made the Air Force 1 a staple in sneaker culture. Collectors appreciate how grey tones give the model a refined edge. The addition of black creates contrast that keeps the look grounded and versatile. It is a colorway that slides effortlessly into everyday wear while still standing apart from standard white editions. This pair proves that subtle shifts in tone can refresh an icon without changing its core identity. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Wolf Grey Black was released on June 19, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Premium SP Black Mini Chrome Swoosh
Description: The Nike Vomero Premium SP Black Mini Chrome Swoosh strips the silhouette down to a sharp and minimalist execution. Black wraps the upper from heel to toe, creating a sleek base that highlights the sculpted lines. A subtle Mini Chrome Swoosh adds contrast and shine, giving the design a refined focal point against the monochrome build. Monochrome runners often emphasize form over flash, and this SP edition leans fully into that philosophy. The small chrome detail elevates the shoe without overpowering the clean aesthetic. For collectors who favor understated footwear with subtle premium touches, this release offers a confident and polished take on the Vomero platform. The Nike Vomero Premium SP Black Mini Chrome Swoosh was released on February 25, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Max TL 2.5 Metallic Silver
Description: Shimmering with a futuristic edge, the Nike Air Max TL 2.5 Metallic Silver revives a cult-favorite Air Max silhouette with gleaming Flat Silver/Metallic Silver-Black tones. Layered mesh and glossy synthetic overlays create depth and dimension, while the signature caged panels nod to early-2000s design language. A sculpted midsole frames the visible Air cushioning for a sleek profile that looks aerodynamic from every angle, making this a standout choice for city commutes, weekend fits, and after-dark outings alike. Style code HM8818-001 and a 2025-05-13 release date cement this pair as a modern highlight in the Air Max lineage. Underfoot, the TL 2.5 delivers plush, resilient comfort with a full-length Air setup engineered for smooth transitions and lasting support. A padded collar, breathable upper, and durable rubber outsole with multi-directional traction keep you locked in and ready for all-day wear. Polished metallic accents catch the light with every step, while black hits ground the shine for easy styling with denim, tech pants, or tailored streetwear. Whether youre collecting Air Max icons or seeking a versatile daily driver, this Metallic Silver colorway offers the perfect blend of statement-making flair and functional performance. Our team loves this product because it combines head-turning sheen with dependable Air cushioning, making it a go-to for comfort, style, and everyday rotation.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Birch Iron Navy Gum
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Birch Iron Navy Gum leans into retro court style with a clean and textured finish. Birch and Iron Navy combine across the upper, while a gum outsole anchors the design in classic indoor sport tradition. The streamlined profile and subtle paneling give the silhouette a refined and low key character. Tokuten models have gained attention for their minimalist approach, offering vintage energy without excessive detailing. The soft birch base contrasts nicely with the deeper navy accents, while the gum sole adds warmth and throwback appeal. It feels effortless and wearable, perfect for those who appreciate heritage inspired sneakers with a modern lifestyle edge. The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Birch Iron Navy Gum was released on November 4, 2024 with a retail price of $155.

Model: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro
Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro Game Royal
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Game Royal revives a modern classic through a clean and commanding color execution. Game royal covers the upper with intensity and clarity, balanced by crisp white details that keep the design sharp and focused. The low cut profile and engineered mesh construction emphasize speed and responsiveness, staying true to the silhouettes performance driven roots. Fans value this release because the Kobe 9 represents innovation at a pivotal moment in Nike Basketball history. The Protro treatment keeps the spirit intact while refreshing the experience for a new generation. Collectors appreciate the simplicity of the team inspired colorway, allowing the design itself to shine. It feels purposeful and refined, honoring Kobes legacy through precision, discipline, and unwavering attention to detail rather than unnecessary flair. The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Game Royal was released on October 17, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Shox TL White Work Blue (Women's)
Description: The Nike Shox TL White/Work Blue is a Spring 2026 women's release from Nike's Shox program, released April 1, 2026 at a retail price of $170 with style code AR3566-106, confirmed by StockX, Kicks on Fire, and Journeys. As confirmed by the official Nike product description and Hibbett's product overview, the Nike Shox TL is a recrafted version of the 2003 icon featuring breathable mesh in the upper and full-length Nike Shox technology for optimal impact absorption and a bold look on the streets, with Nike Shox technology combining resilient flexible columns with moderator plates for outstanding cushioning that compresses and regains its shape. The Nike.com product description confirmed the design is a near-exact replica of the original 2003 Nike Shox TL, featuring molded overlays throughout the midfoot for support and a snug fit, a TPU plate in the heel for lateral stability and support, and a modified circular Waffle outsole for traction. Sneaker News confirmed the White/Work Blue colorway features a crisp white base with the titular Work Blue popping across the TPU overlays, heel, and full-length Shox cushioning system underfoot, describing it as a clean and straightforward spring pick for those still invested in Y2K aesthetics. Retail price $170. The Nike Shox TL White/Work Blue Womens is the April 1, 2026 AR3566-106 breathable-mesh Work-Blue-TPU-overlay-and-heel full-length-Shox-columns molded-midfoot-overlay TPU-heel-plate circular-Waffle-outsole 2003-icon-recrafted women's Shox TL for the Nike collector who wants the most spring-clean and most broadly wearable white-base Work Blue accent execution from the Nike Shox TL women's program. The Nike Shox TL White/Work Blue Womens was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Legend Pink (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 11 Retro Low Legend Pink (Women's) adds a soft colorway of white and Legend Pink to the classic Air Jordan 11 Retro Low silhouette. The upper is crafted from durable ballistic mesh in white with tonal webbing eyelets that create a lace cage. A patent leather mudguard in Legend Pink wraps around the shoe and shines when hit by light. A full-length Air-sole unit provides lightweight cushioning, while a semi-translucent rubber outsole grips the ground and provides an additional splash of Legend Pink. In the midfoot, a carbon fiber shank provides additional stability without weighing down the sneaker. Our experts at StockX like the tonal stitches that attach the Legend Pink mudguard to the upper because they create a seamless transition between pink and white. The womens sized Jordan 11 Retro Low Legend Pink (Women's) was released on June 22, 2024, and retailed at $190.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Birch Kale Red Gold
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Birch Kale Red Gold is a Fall Winter 2023 colorway of the Mexico 66, the Onitsuka Tiger silhouette that draws its design heritage directly from the 1966 Limber training shoe that the Japanese brand produced for athletes preparing for the 1968 Mexico City Olympic Games, making the Mexico 66 one of the most historically situated and most culturally specific sneaker silhouettes in the global catalog of retro running shoes from the pre-Nike era. Onitsuka Tiger, the Kobe-founded brand that predates Nike's own origin story and that produced some of the earliest performance running shoes in the American market through a distribution arrangement with Phil Knight and Bill Bowerman before their partnership dissolved, has maintained the Mexico 66 as its most consistent and most globally recognized model for decades, the shoe functioning simultaneously as heritage document and contemporary lifestyle sneaker. The Birch, Kale, Red, and Gold colorway applies a warm natural birch base to the leather upper and overlays it with Kale, the deep earthy green, on the brand's signature Tiger Stripes that cross the midfoot in the lateral-to-medial direction that defines the Mexico 66's most immediately recognizable design feature. Red and Gold accents complete the palette, the warmth of the red and the richness of the gold tones building a colorway that has the earthy, natural-world character appropriate to the seasonal positioning of a Fall release. The leather construction delivers the premium material character that distinguishes the Mexico 66 from lower-tier lifestyle trainers, and the flat rubber outsole maintains the original shoe's low-profile, clean-contact ground feel. Style code 1183B511-200, released September 10, 2023 at $120 in men's sizing. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Birch Kale Red Gold is the heritage Japanese training shoe in the season's most grounded and most naturally referential colorway, the pair for the wearer who wants the Mexico 66's 1966 design lineage and premium leather construction in an earthy, warmly accented Fall palette. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Birch Kale Red Gold was released on September 10, 2023 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle CLOT Halo Ivory
Description: The adidas Gazelle CLOT Halo Ivory reimagines the Gazelle silhouette as an espadrille-like shoe. Its also part of a collaboration between adidas and CLOT, a Hong Kong-based streetwear label known for combining Eastern and Western aesthetics. The upper is crafted from a knit textile in Halo Ivory instead of leather or suede. This material makes the sneaker look handmade and almost like thick linen or woven hemp fabric. Paying tribute to the classic adidas Gazelle silhouette, the toebox boasts a suede overlay in tan. The heel tab and the panels around the laces also come in tan. However, this sneaker stands out because of the adidas 3-Stripes logo, embroidered with seed beads in Cloud White. Our StockX experts like the espadrille-inspired midsole with oversized stitching and a neutral tan color. The adidas Gazelle CLOT Halo Ivory was released on June 14, 2024, and retailed at $160.

Display Name: adidas Adistar Jellyfish Pharrell Williams Royal Blue
Description: The adidas Adistar Jellyfish Pharrell Williams Royal Blue pushes performance design into expressive territory through a bold collaboration. Dressed in Royal Blue with Core Black and Focus Olive accents, the sculpted upper and layered detailing create a futuristic profile. The exaggerated midsole structure gives the shoe a distinctive stance, blending running inspired tech with Pharrells creative lens. Pharrell collaborations consistently experiment with color and shape, and this pair feels unapologetically loud. The royal blue base dominates the look, while darker and earthy accents add contrast and depth. It stands as a statement sneaker that merges avant garde design with athletic roots, appealing to collectors who value individuality. The adidas Adistar Jellyfish Pharrell Williams Royal Blue was released on October 25, 2025 with a retail price of $300.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Cardinal Red
Description: Jordan Brand brought an OG Air Jordan 7 colorway to the Air Jordan 3 for the Air Jordan 3 Cardinal Red. Constructed with white tumbled leather and signature Elephant Print overlays, the Air Jordan 3 Cardinal Red takes a traditional approach in its color blocking and fabrication, similar to the iconic Black Cement 3s. Spicing up the design, sharp Cardinal Red midsoles and detailing pop against the neutral toned upper. Bright orange Jumpman logo embroidery on the tongue adds the finishing touch. The Air Jordan 3 Cardinal Red released in February of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Nike Blazer Low Platform White Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Blazer Low Platform White Black W is a basketball shoe designed by Bill Bowerman, co-founder of Nike. The Nike Blazer Low Platform for women has a white leather upper festooned by a conspicuous black Swoosh with tonal suede overlay accents at the shoe lateral forefoot and toe. The sneaker also has an exposed foam tongue. The shoe sits on double-tape detailing platform midsoles, while underfoot are herringbone-tread rubber outsoles for extra grip. The Nike Blazer Low Platform White Black W shoe was first released in July 2021 with a retail price set at $95.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Brotherhood
Description: Jordan Brand honored Michael Jordan's time as a member of one of the most historic African American college fraternities with the Air Jordan 1 High Brotherhood. Drawing inspiration from the Omega Psi Phi crest, the Air Jordan 1 High Brotherhood arrives with a vibrant University Gold, purple, and white leather construction. Its color blocking is simple and bold, similar to past Jordan 1 releases like the Shattered Backboards and Bred Toes. In retro fashion, a woven Nike tongue label and Wings logo at the collar complete the design. The Air Jordan 1 High Brotherhood released in February of 2022 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Sprint Sister Ridgerock Sail (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sprint Sister in Ridgerock, Ocean Cube, Dark Cinder, and Sail for Women is a lifestyle silhouette that brings an outdoor and trail-adjacent aesthetic sensibility to a women's-specific platform through a colorway that draws from the natural and slightly weathered palette of earth, water, and sky that the most considered outdoor lifestyle footwear consistently references when the design intent is genuine connection to natural environments rather than simply borrowing the visual language of outdoor gear for fashion credibility. Ridgerock as the dominant tone creates a warm and earthy foundation that suits the Sprint Sister's silhouette perfectly, the slightly dusty and geological quality of the color connecting the shoe to the trail running and outdoor exploration context that its design direction inhabits most authentically. Ocean cube and sail provide the cooler and brighter accent notes that keep the warm ridgerock base from feeling too heavy or single-dimensional, while dark cinder adds the structural depth and grounding contrast that keeps the full palette legible and purposeful across the shoe's construction. Women's Nike lifestyle silhouettes in earth tone and outdoor-referential colorways have found a devoted and growing audience among female wearers who want their everyday footwear to carry genuine connection to outdoor culture and natural color vocabularies rather than the more conventionally fashion-forward or sport-aesthetic color stories that dominate most lifestyle sneaker releases. The Sprint Sister's specific women's design and proportion makes it a natural fit for this kind of considered and outdoor-adjacent palette, the silhouette's purposeful design character aligning completely with the ridgerock and ocean cube color story's naturalistic intent. At one hundred and ten dollars the Sprint Sister in this colorway delivers genuine outdoor lifestyle character and women's specific construction at an accessible price point that makes it an easy and immediately rewarding daily wear acquisition. The Nike Sprint Sister in Ridgerock, Ocean Cube, Dark Cinder, and Sail Women's has a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Cortez White Black
Description: The Nike Cortez White Black is a classic sneaker that embodies simplicity and versatility. Founded in 1964, Nike has consistently pushed boundaries in athletic wear, and Cortez's enduring popularity is a testament to the company's design legacy. The white and black Nike Cortez features a clean, monochromatic color scheme that pays homage to its 1972 debut. This iconic design features a low-profile silhouette, herringbone outsole, and a contrasting color scheme that fits any scene. This low-profile sneaker has a leather upper and a herringbone outsole, classic design elements that have remained unchanged since its introduction. Our experts appreciate the Nike Cortez White Black color blocking and herringbone outsole. The contrasting black and white colors create a bold visual effect. At the same time, the herringbone pattern on the outsole provides lateral traction and stability, particularly on smooth or slippery surfaces, due to its unique tread design. When these were released on May 30, 2024, they retailed for $90.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Blue Crystal Turf Orange Midnight Navy Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Zero Gravity GS is a May 1, 2026 Grade School release from Nike Basketball's Ja Morant signature series, retailing at $112 with style code IO9418-400 in the Blue Crystal/Metallic Silver/Turf Orange/Midnight Navy/Sundial/Bright Violet colorway, confirmed by GOAT, Sole Retriever, and Tops and Bottoms USA. As confirmed by Sneaker News and House of Heat, the Ja 3 Zero Gravity GS is a mismatched kids-exclusive colorway splitting Blue Crystal and Turf Orange between the two shoes, with one shoe dominated by deep blue and purple tones with bright orange accents and the other flipping to a vibrant orange base with blue detailing, extending the asymmetry across the mesh uppers, molded overlays, laces, and liners. House of Heat confirmed the layered upper construction features breathable mesh with reinforced zones, Ja Morant's personal logo on the tongue and insole, the aggressive midsole design and textured outsole built for traction and responsiveness, and ZoomX foam cushioning providing the springy, lightweight energy return described by Ja as "jet fuel." The Ja 3, designed by Ben Nethongkome and announced in April 2025, was built for sharp, quick movement with ZoomX foam as its performance foundation. Sole Retriever confirmed Grade School pricing of $112 with a matching PS version at $97. Retail price $112. The Nike Ja 3 Zero Gravity GS is the May 1, 2026 IO9418-400 mismatched-Blue-Crystal-and-Turf-Orange breathable-mesh ZoomX-foam Ja-logo-tongue-and-insole kids-exclusive Grade School basketball shoe for the Nike and Ja Morant collector who wants the most colorfully asymmetric Blue Crystal and orange mismatched execution from the Nike Ja 3 Zero Gravity kids program. The Nike Ja 3 Zero Gravity GS was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $112.
Colorway: Blue Crystal/Metallic Silver/Turf Orange/Midnight Navy/Sundial/Bright Violet

Display Name: Nike Air Liquid Max Bright Crimson Fire Red
Description: The Nike Air Liquid Max in Bright Crimson and Fire Red is a June 2026 release of the Air Liquid Max, Nike's most significant new Air Max platform since the Air Max Scorpion, built around a full-length point-loaded Air unit that places cushioning only at the foot's pressure points surrounded by cored-out areas of negative space, eliminating excess weight while creating the Liquid Max's distinctive geometric outsole structure. The upper is constructed using three-layer textured printing developed with Zellerfeld-adjacent techniques, with a black woven-style base layered with crimson and fire-red accents in a digitally inspired pattern described as inspired by the poison dart frog, while metallic gold fills the Swoosh logos on both side panels and matches the tongue branding, with black laces, black lining, and a translucent rubber outsole completing the build. The Air Liquid Max debuted in early 2026 as Nike's push to take the Air Max franchise in a more aggressive and technically experimental direction, with the drop-in Cushlon midsole stacked on top of the point-loaded Air system delivering a fluid, smooth underfoot sensation that Ditte Kuijpers, Nike's design director of sportswear innovation footwear, described as requiring people to both feel and see how it was different from prior Air Max iterations. Released June 17, 2026 at $220 retail via SNKRS and select retailers with style code IQ7634-002. The Nike Air Liquid Max Bright Crimson Fire Red was released on June 17, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 X Black Cement
Description: The New Balance 9060 X Black Cement leans into darker tones while maintaining the bold structure of the silhouette. Finished in Black Cement and Black, the upper layers textured materials that highlight the models chunky and sculpted profile. The wavy midsole and dual density cushioning reinforce its performance inspired foundation. This colorway feels grounded and confident, using subtle cement detailing to add depth without overwhelming the design. The black base keeps it easy to style, while the distinctive shape ensures it stands out. It reflects New Balances ongoing ability to reinterpret retro influences through modern design language. The New Balance 9060 X Black Cement was released on August 19, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL Bob Marley Bold Gold
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL Bob Marley Bold Gold Bold Gold Core Black Pure Ruby channels rhythm and movement into a performance driven silhouette that feels alive with color. The Bold Gold upper sets a vibrant foundation, while Core Black and Pure Ruby accents bring depth and contrast that echo the spirit and legacy tied to Bob Marley. Built on the Adizero platform, the shoe keeps its streamlined, speed focused profile while embracing a palette that carries cultural weight far beyond the track. This pair resonates because it blends performance credibility with musical influence in a way that feels authentic. The lightweight construction stays true to adidas running heritage, but the color story gives it personality and presence. Fans who appreciate crossover storytelling see this as more than a themed release, it is a tribute expressed through motion and design. It stands out without feeling forced, capturing energy, rhythm, and individuality in every detail. The adidas Adizero Evo SL Bob Marley Bold Gold Bold Gold Core Black Pure Ruby was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Red Cement (GS)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Red Cement (GS) presents a fusion of colors, textures, shapes, and materials that will make any grade school kid wearing this sneaker the talk of the playground. The Grade School version of the Jordan 4 Retro Red Cement sports a white mesh upper overlaid with tumbled white leather along with hits of red synthetic with black speckles along the mud guard, eye stays, and heel tab. Black synthetic hits appear as the waffle eye stays and the toe cap, matching the black sock liner and insole. The Jumpman logo appears in red on the tongue and insole and black on the heel as a raised rubber decal. The white foam midsole encapsulates visible Air for ultimate cushioning. What are sneaker experts enjoy most about this shoe is the rubber outsole with herringbone traction in pods of black, white, and red, accented with a red Jumpman, thus providing traction and echoing the tri-color look of the upper. The Jordan 4 Retro Red Cement (GS) was released on September 9, 2023 for retail price of $150.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Lava Falls Silver
Description: The Salomon XT-6 Lava Falls/Silver is a February 1, 2026 release from Salomon's iconic XT-6 trail running silhouette program, retailing at $180 with style code L49301000 in the Lava Falls/White/Footwear Silver colorway, confirmed by WhenToCop and Salomon's official product page. As confirmed by Zalando and WhenToCop, the XT-6 Lava Falls/Silver features Salomon's Quicklace system with shoelace pocket and friction-free eyelets, Agile Chassis System providing motion control through AC Muscle 2 while balancing cushioning and stability, Contagrip outsole for sureness and durability on various surfaces, OrthoLite insole for optimal foot climate, Endofit System surrounding the forefoot and preventing slipping, and the SensiFit System surrounding the foot for a close-fitting and secure seat. The XT-6 is Salomon's defining lifestyle trail silhouette, originally developed for ultra-distance mountain racing and elevated to street-level cultural status across the mid-2020s gorpcore and technical fashion movement, making each new colorway a significant release in the Salomon lifestyle calendar. The Lava Falls/White/Footwear Silver colorway applies the volcanic deep red of Lava Falls as the dominant upper tone against clean white and footwear silver accents, delivering one of the most boldly colorful executions in the XT-6 seasonal program. Retail price $180. The Salomon XT-6 Lava Falls/Silver is the February 1, 2026 L49301000 Quicklace Agile-Chassis-System Contagrip OrthoLite Endofit SensiFit trail-running-to-lifestyle XT-6 for the Salomon collector who wants the bold lava-falls-red-and-white-and-footwear-silver colorway from the Salomon XT-6 seasonal program. The Salomon XT-6 Lava Falls/Silver was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Field Jaxx Travis Scott Light Chocolate
Description: The Nike Zoom Field Jaxx Travis Scott Light Chocolate is a performance shoe designed in collaboration with American rapper Travis Scott. The Travis Scott Light Chocolate Nike Zoom Field Jaxx features an off-white mesh base thickly woven for extra visual texture. This mesh makes up the toe box and sides. White leather overlays form the toe cap, mudguard, eyestays, ankle strap, and heel area, while the mudguard is separated from the rest by a thin cream strip. A forefoot strap also appears over the laces in white leather, while Shark branding is seen underneath it on the inner side. The Nike swoosh crosses the sides in a Light Chocolate brown color, while the tongue also bears Cactus Jack branding in Light Chocolate. The Nike swoosh appears as the mouth inside a drawn face on the heel, and the shoe sits on a branded brown midsole complete with Air technology. What we like best about this sneaker is the unique branding, including the face on the heel. The Nike Zoom Field Jaxx Travis Scott Light Chocolate will be released in January 2025 for $170.

Display Name: Golden Goose Super-Star White Black (Women's)
Description: The Golden Goose Super-Star in White, Ice, and Black for Women is a sneaker that has become one of the most recognizable and consistently coveted silhouettes in the contemporary luxury footwear market, its deliberately distressed and pre-worn aesthetic creating a visual language that simultaneously references vintage Italian sport shoes, skate culture, and the specific kind of effortless and slightly imperfect style that the Italian luxury sneaker brand has built its entire identity around since its founding in Venice in 2000. The Super-Star's star logo, deliberately scuffed leather upper, and aged sole construction create a shoe that arrives looking as if it has already accumulated years of character and personal history before the first wear, which is the central and most provocative design premise that Golden Goose has committed to across every iteration and colorway of the silhouette since its introduction. White and ice as the primary color relationship creates the most classic and heritage-rooted expression of the Super-Star aesthetic, the clean white leather base given a slightly cooler and more crystalline quality by the ice accent that creates a tonal sophistication within what appears to be a simple white sneaker at first glance, while black provides the contrast detailing that gives the shoe its most structured and legible design definition. Golden Goose Super-Stars in white and black have occupied a specific and enduring position in the luxury casual footwear conversation as the most wearable and outfit-versatile entry point into the Italian brand's deliberately imperfect universe, working as naturally with tailored trousers and blazers as with denim and casual knitwear in a way that only a genuinely simple and well-proportioned sneaker silhouette can achieve across such diverse dressing contexts. The women's specific fit and proportioning of this Super-Star ensures that the distressed aesthetic and clean colorway land on a last and construction that serves the female foot with the same Golden Goose craft quality that has made the brand one of the most consistently repurchased luxury sneaker labels in the women's footwear market across multiple seasons and fashion cycles. At five hundred and twenty-five dollars the white ice black Women's Super-Star delivers the full Golden Goose distressed luxury experience in the silhouette's most universally beloved and repeatedly worn colorway expression. The Golden Goose Super-Star in White, Ice, and Black Women's was released on January 1, 2020 with a retail price of $525.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Pale Ivory Jade Horizon
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Pale Ivory Jade Horizon takes the most technologically loaded Pegasus ever built and dresses it in a colorway that whispers retro tennis and terrace culture all at once. The creamy pale ivory circular knit mesh upper feels almost weightless, and jade horizon and spruce aura tones give the shoe an earthy, natural contrast that reads understated from across the room but lands with real intention up close. A green full length Air Zoom unit runs visibly through the midsole, and a gum outsole grounds the whole look in heritage sneaker tradition, making this one of the cleaner lifestyle crossover options in the Pegasus Premium lineup. Underneath that vintage inspired exterior lives some of the most advanced cushioning Nike has ever put in a running shoe. A triple stack of ZoomX foam, a sculpted full length Air Zoom unit, and ReactX foam in the heel creates a ride that is both energetic and smooth across every type of surface. The Pegasus Premium is notably the first Nike shoe ever to feature a full length Air Zoom unit in the midsole, and this colorway makes that technological milestone feel approachable rather than clinical. Runners who care about their miles and sneakerheads who care about their fit are after the same pair here. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Pale Ivory Jade Horizon was released on April 20, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Puma Speedcat Ballet Silver (Women's)
Description: The Puma Speedcat Ballet Silver (Women's) presents a low?profile metallic silver upper with signature Formstrip, elastic instep bands, and embroidered PUMA cat logo, white accents, seated on a lightweight rubber outsole for traction. The Silver Speedcat Ballet (Women's) by Puma combines a metallic upper with satin?finish elastic instep bands and embroidered cat logos near the heel and toe. It Shows off a white Formstrip along the lateral side and tonal stitching throughout. The interior lining uses breathable textiles, while the low?cut silhouette merges Formula 1?informed DNA with ballet?inspired updates and rests on a rubber outsole for traction. Puma was founded in 1949 by Rudolf Dassler. One of the things we, the experts, appreciate about The Puma Speedcat Ballet Silver (Women's) is its slip?on design with elastic instep bands for easy on?off transitions and lightweight feel, as well as the OrthoLite® sockliner for consistent underfoot cushioning during extended wear on indoor floors or studio sessions. It retailed at $80 when it was released on the 1st of March 2025.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '86 Big Bubble Obsidian
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 86 Big Bubble Obsidian is a reproduction of the original design from 1986. Designed by Tinker Hatfield, this was the first sneaker to have a visible Nike Air unit in the heel. Obsidian is also the original colorway that these sneakers were released with in 80s, making these sneakers timeless. ? ?This Air Max 1 ´86 sneakers upper is constructed from a mix of textile materials and suede, with a lining of textile material and a rubber sole for traction. The mesh inserts around the toe and the midsole appear in white, while beige suede overlays can be found on the side and the heel. The Swoosh appears on the side, and obsidian rounds out the design above the white rubber outsole. Red accents appear on the heel and on the tongue, giving this shoe a pop of color. ? ?What our StockX experts love about this shoe is the visible Air unit in the heel. The Nike Air Max 1 86 Big Bubble Obsidian was released on September 9th, 2023, at a price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Black Canvas (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Canvas GS has become a celebrated addition to the brand´s grade-schoolers catalog. This Retro Air Jordan 4 has a black, light steel grey, white, and fire red colourway with a black suede canvas base on the upper and grey detailing on the moulded eyelets, red contrasting accents and with white on the midsole. The sneaker has ventilated netting on the quarter panel and visible AIR cushioning. For branding, it has a woven Jumpman tag captioned with Flight in red script on the tongue and a grey Jumpman logo on the heel tab. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Canvas GS was released on October 1st, 2022, retailing at $210.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat (2025) (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat 2025 TD brings one of the most iconic and minimalist Jordan colorways to the smallest size range while keeping its unmistakable presence. The all black execution strips the Jordan 4 down to pure form, letting the silhouettes aggressive lines and structure do all the work. Even in toddler sizing, the Black Cat identity feels powerful and timeless rather than playful or toned down. Fans love this release because of its simplicity and attitude. The Black Cat colorway has always been about restraint and confidence, and that philosophy translates perfectly here. Collectors appreciate it as a foundational Jordan, one that introduces younger wearers to a legendary look that has never relied on trends to stay relevant within sneaker culture. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Black Cat 2025 TD was released on November 28, 2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Lucky Green
Description: Jordan Brand continued its pattern of Lucky Green colorways in early 2023, with the release of the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Lucky Green. The Air Jordan 1 is the third model to receive the Lucky Green treatment following the Jordan 2 and Jordan 3. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG is constructed using a leather upper, brought to life with shades of white, black and Lucky Green throughout. Lucky Green Nike branding sits on top of the black tongue and insoles of the sneaker. The sneakers are tied together with Lucky Green laces. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Lucky Green released April 15, 2023, with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Gucci Web Slide Sandal Black
Description: The Gucci Web Slide Sandal Black is one of the Guccis popular slides that appears in Black, Green and Red color schemes. The Gucci Web Slide Sandal Black features a slip-on style that makes it easy to wear and remove. The Sandals design also features a Gucci logo on the footbed displayed elegantly and discreetly and the equestrian heritage-inspired green and red Web stripe detail on the strap. To complete the design is the cushioned footbed to enhance comfort during wear and the treaded outsole for traction and gripping. The Gucci Web Slide Sandal Black joined the market on January 1st, 2019 at a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Jordan Why Not Zer0.4 Triple White
Description: The Air Jordan Why Not Zer0.4 in Triple White is a 2021 general release of Russell Westbrook's fourth Jordan Brand signature basketball shoe in an all-white colorway, featuring the Why Not Zer0.4's performance basketball construction across the full upper, midsole, and outsole in a clean white-on-white execution that makes the shoe's technical construction and distinctive silhouette the visual focus in the absence of color contrast. The Why Not Zer0.4 is built around Jordan Brand's React foam cushioning for responsive court feel, a reinforced upper construction designed to support Westbrook's physically aggressive and explosively athletic playing style, and the lateral support and lockdown features developed to accommodate the triple-double machine's demanding movement patterns that required particularly durable and responsive basketball footwear across his peak NBA seasons. The Triple White colorway is the most broadly versatile and most lifestyle-crossover-ready expression of the Why Not Zer0.4's design, with the clean all-white execution removing the shoe from its specifically performance-athletic context and making it more accessible as a casual lifestyle sneaker for non-basketball wearers who appreciate the silhouette's distinctive aesthetic outside of game day settings. At $130 retail the Why Not Zer0.4 Triple White is available through Nike and select Jordan Brand basketball retailers with style code CQ4433-100, released January 1, 2021. The Air Jordan Why Not Zer04 Triple White was released on January 1, 2021 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Royal
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Royal is a classic low-top shoe paying homage to the original model but coming in a new colorway. This version of the Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 comes with a black and Royal Blue leather build. The toe box is royal blue with perforations for breathability, while black leather forms the toe cap, side panels, and eyestays. The Nike Swoosh crosses each side of the shoe in Royal Blue, and Royal Blue also forms the heel collar and heel counter. The collar contains the Air Jordan logo in black, while a Nike Air logo patch adorns the tongue. A Summit White midsole gives way to a patterned Royal Blue outsole. What we think stands out about this shoe are the Royal Blue accents, which allow the dark build of the shoe to stand out. The Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Royal was released on February 22, 2025, for a retail price of $160.

Display Name: adidas BW Army Black Cracked Leather
Description: The adidas BW Army Black Cracked Leather taps into pure archival energy, reworking a classic German training silhouette with textured depth. The black cracked leather upper adds character, giving the minimalist shape a worn in feel straight out of the box. A Light Brown sole grounds the design, maintaining the vintage spirit that has made the BW Army a quiet favorite among sneaker purists. Longtime fans know the BW Army has deep roots in military training history, and that understated heritage is exactly why it endures. This cracked leather edition adds just enough edge without disrupting the clean lines that define the model. It pairs effortlessly with everything from tailored trousers to raw denim, appealing to collectors who appreciate subtle icons over loud hype driven releases. The adidas BW Army Black Cracked Leather was released on October 12, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Dusty Olive
Description: Dusty Olive, brown, and Pro Gold suede make up the majority of the Nike Dunk Low Dusty Olives upper. Brown canvas wraps around the heel leading to a white embroidered "NIKE" logo resting on a Pro Gold suede heel tab. A Pro Gold outsole and white midsole finish up this new Nike Dunk retro. The Nike Dunk Low Dusty Olive released in June of 2021 for $110, and again in November of 2023 for $120.

Display Name: New Balance 530 Sea Salt Moonbeam
Description: The New Balance 530 Sea Salt Moonbeam, inspired by retro aesthetics, embraces a laid-back style crafted with lightweight mesh uppers, durable synthetic overlays, and the iconic ABZORB midsole for both support and comfort. With a palette of pastel beige tones adorning the uppers, the Sea Salt Moonbeam New Balance 530 achieves a stylish Y2K aesthetic, featuring a synthetic overlay and breathable mesh. Enhanced with plush ABZORB cushioning underfoot, a technology engineered to absorb impact effectively, and robust traction rubber outsoles, these running shoes showcase the brand's unmistakable "N" logos along the sidewalls. Additional brand detailing includes the "NB" tongue patch, the "530" tag on the lateral side, and the "N" logo on the toe. The standout characteristic of the New Balance 530 Sea Salt Moonbeam lies in its remarkable ABZORB cushioning underfoot. This feature, designed to absorb impact, ensures unparalleled comfort for the wearer, making these shoes ideal for any daily pursuits. The sneaker debuted for $100 on October 10th, 2023.

Display Name: Crocs Echo RO Clog Bape Grapeberry Camo
Description: The Crocs Echo RO Clog Bape Grapeberry Camo transforms the futuristic Echo silhouette through one of streetwears most recognizable camouflage patterns in a collaboration that feels playful, loud, and instantly collectible. BAPEs influence on global streetwear remains enormous because of its bold graphics and iconic camo identity, and applying the Grapeberry camouflage palette to the sculpted Echo RO Clog creates a design that feels both experimental and unmistakably tied to hype culture. The exaggerated proportions and layered construction of the Echo model already push Crocs into more fashion forward territory, and the vibrant purple camo execution amplifies that personality even further. Fans of Crocs collaborations appreciate how the brand continues embracing unexpected partnerships and exaggerated design concepts without losing the comfort and wearability that made the silhouette popular. BAPE camouflage patterns naturally bring strong nostalgia and visual energy into any collaboration, especially when applied to unconventional footwear like the Echo RO Clog. Collectors are especially drawn to releases that combine recognizable streetwear branding with experimental shapes and materials, and this pair fits perfectly within that growing space. The Grapeberry tones give the clog a playful but aggressive visual identity that stands out immediately in both sneaker and streetwear culture. The Crocs Echo RO Clog Bape Grapeberry Camo was released on May 14, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 QS Volcano
Description: Step into the Nike Air Max 90 QS Volcano, a black, magma orange, and laser orange colorway that pulls design inspiration from the raw beauty of molten landscapes. The Volcano Nike Air Max 90 QS is a bold eruption on the sneaker scene, as itÄôs a limited-edition colorway. Its rugged black upper mimics volcanic rock with textured overlays, while striking magma orange and molten yellow accents add some heat. The iconic Swoosh is a sizzling orange with black lava details. The signature Air Max unit, tinted in fiery hues, adds depth and energy to the design, creating a layered and dynamic look. The volcano theme continues to the sock liners where flame graphics appear. We love the Nike Air Max 90 QS VolcanoÄôs scorching design which is a combination of rugged textures, vibrant details, and iconic cushioning. When it debuted on the market on February 23, 2025, this sneaker sold for $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid New Love (2025)
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid New Love (2025) revives a beloved color story with striking contrast and everyday wearability. Dressed in a Black/Varsity Maize-White palette (style HJ6654-071), this pair balances bold courtside heritage with clean street style. Smooth leather overlays frame a bright Varsity Maize toe box, collar, and heel, while a crisp white midsole lightens the look for a sharp, modern finish. Classic details, Wings logo at the collar, signature Swoosh sidewalls, and a padded, mid-cut silhouette, anchor the design in the DNA of the Air Jordan 1, making it a standout option for both collectors and daily rotation. The result is a timeless profile that turns heads without trying too hard. Performance meets comfort with responsive Air cushioning underfoot and a durable rubber cupsole for confident traction. Thoughtful touches like a breathable perforated toe, plush collar foam, and secure lace closure offer a locked-in feel that lasts from first wear to long after break-in. Whether youre pairing the Jordan 1 Mid with tapered denim or athletic staples, the New Love (2025) colorway adds energy to any outfit and nods to the silhouettes hoops lineage. Arriving May 20, 2025, this release blends retro inspiration with contemporary polish, ideal for anyone seeking a versatile, high-impact sneaker that elevates the everyday. Our team loves this product because the bold Varsity Maize accents, classic Air cushioning, and durable leather build make it great for all-day comfort, distinctive style, and collecting a modern take on an iconic Jordan 1 Mid colorway.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 NY vs. NY
Description: The Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 NY vs NY channels classic basketball energy through bold color and unmistakable volume. Black and white form a strong foundation, while orion blue, crimson pulse, and green glow accents inject rivalry inspired intensity. The oversized Air units and aggressive paneling give the shoe a commanding presence that feels true to its nineties roots. Fans connect with this release because it celebrates attitude and regional pride through a silhouette that never aimed to be subtle. The Uptempo 95 thrives on excess, and this colorway embraces that spirit fully. Collectors appreciate how the design captures a specific era of basketball culture, where confidence and visibility mattered. It feels loud, unapologetic, and nostalgic in the best way, standing as a reminder of when basketball sneakers were built to dominate visually as much as physically. The Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 NY vs NY was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low QS Terror Squad Blackout
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low QS in Terror Squad Blackout comes in a sleek black and white colorway. It also features references to the Terror Squad, the hip-hop group formed in the late 1990s with Fat Joe as a lead member. ? ?This sneaker features a white leather base with prominent black leather overlays on the heel, lining the perforated toebox, and around the laces  providing the Nike Air Force 1 Low QS with striking contrast. The cushioned midsole allows for prolonged wear. Terror Squad branding is evident in the white embroidered "TS" and "JC" initials at the heel, with "JC" being a reference to Fat Joes other nickname, Joey Clark. A Swoosh in black crosses the midsole. ? ?At StockX, we think this shoe stands out because of the bold contrast of the black and white leather throughout the shoe. The black overlays on the white leather give this shoe a classic, yet eye-catching look, making it appropriate for wear with any outfit. The Nike Air Force 1 Low QS Terror Squad Blackout was released on September 16th, 2023, for a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Trainer Huarache Wolf Grey Star Blue
Description: The Nike Air Trainer Huarache Wolf Grey Star Blue revives a legendary cross-training silhouette with a modern edge. Dressed in a cool Wolf Grey base with Star Blue pops and Metallic Silver hits, this edition pairs breathable mesh with supportive leather overlays for a sleek, layered look. The signature Huarache neoprene bootie wraps the foot for a snug, sock-like fit, while the sculpted midfoot cage and adjustable strap lock you in for confident lateral moves, whether youre in the gym or on the street. A padded collar and plush tongue round out the comfort-first design, complemented by a bold Swoosh and heritage branding that nod to the early 90s original. Underfoot, a responsive foam midsole teams with encapsulated Air cushioning to soften every step and training session. The durable rubber outsole features multi-surface traction patterns for secure grip during quick cuts, sprints, and daily wear, and the slightly raised heel helps promote a natural, efficient stride. Styled for versatility and built for performance, the Nike Air Trainer Huarache (style code IH4469-012) transitions seamlessly from workout to weekend, delivering stability, support, and standout color blocking that elevates any rotation. A must-have addition to the rotation, especially because it blends secure lockdown, day-long cushioning, and head-turning Wolf Grey/Star Blue styling in a timeless trainer youll reach for again and again.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Tokyo
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Tokyo brings a regional inspired take to one of the most celebrated silhouettes in the Jordan lineup, combining subtle tones with a polished overall finish. Light bone and phantom create a soft and cohesive base, while grey and sail accents add depth without disrupting the clean aesthetic. The patent leather mudguard remains a defining feature, giving the shoe its signature shine and structure. Fans of the Jordan 11 continue to value releases that balance simplicity with presence, and this pair delivers through its understated palette and strong shape. Regional themed colorways often carry a unique appeal, tying the design to a specific place while still maintaining broad wearability. It is a release that feels refined and intentional, reinforcing why the Jordan 11 remains such a cornerstone in sneaker culture. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Tokyo was released on February 26, 2026 with a retail price of $235.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Awake NY Arctic Pink
Description: The Jordan 5 Retro Awake NY Arctic Pink boldly reimagines a hoops icon through the lens of Angelo Baques New York label. Dressed in a plush Arctic Pink upper that sets off the silhouettes angular lines, this collaboration balances modern street style with heritage cues from the original 1990 design. A Metallic Silver reflective tongue catches the light with every step, while University Red pops at the liner and lace toggle energize the look. Signature AJ5 details return in full force: translucent side netting, sculpted ankle padding, and the shark-tooth midsole graphics set atop a clear icy outsole for a crisp finish. Subtle co-branding and the Awake Nike hangtag underscore the projects design story without overpowering the palette. Style code DV4982-600; colorway Arctic Pink/Metallic Silver-University Red-Black-White-Clear. Built for comfort as much as statement-making style, the Jordan 5 Retro offers visible Air cushioning underfoot for day-long wear, supported by a durable rubber outsole and dependable herringbone traction. Breathable mesh panels and a padded collar ensure a secure, comfortable fit, while included White and Red laces let you customize your look, from understated to high-contrast, in seconds. Whether paired with tapered denim or technical cargos, the Awake NY Arctic Pink finish elevates any rotation and photographs beautifully in natural or low light. A standout 2025 collaboration on the Air Jordan 5, this pair blends collectible appeal with everyday versatility for sneakerheads and newcomers alike. Our team loves this product because it fuses Awake NYs refined color sensibility with classic Air Jordan 5 comfort and performance, making it great for style-forward daily wear and curated collections.

Display Name: Puma Speedcat Ballet For All Time Red (Women's)
Description: The Puma Speedcat Ballet For All Time Red Womens reinterprets a motorsport inspired silhouette through a sleeker and more minimal lens, using a for all time red PUMA white PUMA black palette that feels bold and streamlined. The low profile shape keeps it close to the ground, emphasizing its racing roots while adapting it for lifestyle wear. Collectors appreciate how the Speedcat continues to evolve while maintaining its identity. This version leans into simplicity and color, making it a standout option without relying on heavy detailing. It works as both a fashion forward piece and a nod to Pumas motorsport heritage. The Puma Speedcat Ballet For All Time Red Womens was released on April 9, 2025 with a retail price of $80.
Colorway: For All Time Red/PUMA White/PUMA Black

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Game Royal
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Game Royal dresses this iconic Jordan 1 silhouette with the famous "Chicago" color-blocking pattern from 2018. Released as part of Jordan Brands Holiday 2024 lineup, the Game Royal version of the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG boasts an all-leather construction. The base comes in clean white, while Game Royal provides contrasting blue on the forefoot and heel overlays, the eyelets, the heel pull tab, and the durable rubber outsole. Splashes of black decorate the Swoosh logos and the collar lining. In addition, the branding details also come in blacktake a look at the "NIKE AIR" lettering on the tongue tag and the Jordan Wings logo printed on the heel tab. Our experts at StockX like that the leather tongue comes in white instead of blacka difference between this model and the original "Chicago" color-blocking scheme. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Game Royal was released on November 30, 2024, and sold for $140.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Home
Description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Home brings the energy of the Staples Center straight to your feet. This crisp white colorway is the perfect homage to the Lakers home uniforms, featuring a white engineered mesh upper, white midsole, and matching outsole. The purple embroidered Nike swoosh and Kobes signature in gold on the heel clip provide striking contrasts, while the gold Kobe logos on the tongue and heel tie the entire design together in true Lakers fashion. As part of the Protro line, the Kobe 8 Lakers Home brings modern performance technology to one of the most iconic basketball sneakers ever. With its lightweight construction, responsive cushioning, and durable materials, this sneaker is built for both the court and the streets. The Lakers Home colorway blends performance and style, making it a must-have for any fan of Kobe Bryant and the Lakers dynasty. Released on September 6, 2024, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Home retailed at $190. The white, court purple, and university gold colorway celebrates the Lakers rich history and Kobes incredible legacy. Whether youre rocking these on the court or adding them to your collection, the Lakers Home edition of the Kobe 8 Protro is a timeless tribute to basketball greatness.

Display Name: adidas BW Army Hartcopy Black
Description: The adidas BW Army Hartcopy Black reintroduces a classic training silhouette through a refined and understated lens that leans into minimalism. The black gum colorway keeps things grounded, with smooth leather and tonal detailing that highlight the shoes heritage roots without overcomplicating the design. Its low profile shape and clean construction give it a timeless presence that feels just as relevant now as it did decades ago. Collectors and fans appreciate this version because it stays true to the original DNA while incorporating subtle updates that enhance wearability. The Hartcopy influence adds a curated touch, making the shoe feel intentional and considered rather than purely archival. It fits seamlessly into a wide range of styles, from casual everyday looks to more refined outfits, reinforcing why the BW Army continues to hold a place in sneaker culture. The adidas BW Army Hartcopy Black was released on April 10, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Black Grey (GS)
Description: The New Balance 9060 Black Gray (GS) is a futuristic sneaker with visible technology that sources elements from heritage 99X models. It comes in a stealthy colorway of black, various shades of gray, and occasional pops of red. Like other Y2K-inspired sneakers from the New Balance catalog, the Black Gray (GS) New Balance 9060 features padding in the tongue and collar, creating a bulky silhouette. Oversized pods on the sculpted midsole contribute to the sneakers bulk while offering a pronounced technical element. The pods highlight the ABZORB and SBS cushioning underfoot. Adding structure without weighing down the shoe, the upper is crafted from breathable mesh in dark gray and white with suede overlays in gray and black. Our experts at StockX like the diamond-shaped pattern on the rubber outsole because its borrowed from the original 860. The grade school-sized New Balance 9060 Black Gray (GS) was released on September 2, 2022, and sold for $110.

Display Name: adidas Forum Buckle Low Bad Bunny Last Forum
Description: The adidas Forum Buckle Low White is a collaborative sneaker between the German lifestyle brand and artist Bad Bunny. The shoe has an off-white leather upper with matching suede overlays, and the signature 3-Stripes are made of grey suede. An adjustable ankle strap and toggle lacing that wraps around the collar is added to the laces for a secure fit. The "third eye" logo of Bad Bunny is displayed on two sets of overlapping tongues. The shoe has clear rubber sidewalls on a rubber cup sole. The adidas Forum Buckle Low White debuted on the market on December 10th, 2022, retailing at $160.

Display Name: New Balance 992 MiUSA Grey Silver Metallic
Description: The New Balance 992 MiUSA Grey Silver Metallic is a premium sneaker that combines classic style with modern comfort. Crafted in the USA, this shoe features a sleek grey upper with silver metallic accents, creating a sophisticated and versatile look. The iconic 992 silhouette is enhanced with New Balance's signature ABZORB midsole technology, providing superior cushioning and support for all-day wear. Designed for both style and performance, the 992 MiUSA boasts a durable pigskin suede and mesh upper, offering breathability and durability. The shoe's chunky sole unit not only adds to its distinctive aesthetic but also provides excellent traction and stability. With its timeless design and high-quality construction, this New Balance 992 is perfect for sneaker enthusiasts and casual wearers alike. We at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a blend of comfort, style, and American craftsmanship in their footwear. The 992 MiUSA Grey Silver Metallic offers exceptional versatility, making it an ideal choice for various occasions and outfits.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Vivid Sulfur (Women's)
Description: Introducing the Air Jordan 4 Retro Vivid Sulfur Women's, a fresh take on the timeless silhouette that has defined sneaker culture. This new colorway, with its crisp white and coconut milk base accented by vivid sulfur and anthracite, exudes a bold yet refined aesthetic. Tailored for the fashion-forward woman, this sneaker blends the storied heritage of the Jordan 4 with a palette that captures the contemporary vibe, making it a perfect fit for the style-savvy. The Jordan 4 is renowned for its striking design and the Vivid Sulfur iteration is no exception. From the distinctive mesh on the quarter panels to the unique wings and the innovative support lacing system, every element honors the Jordan 4's rich history. The sulfur color pops on the lace crowns and midsole, giving it a dynamic contrast that's sure to turn heads. The white upper, matched with the coconut milk and anthracite accents, offers a modern twist on the classic, making it a versatile addition to any collection. Released on April 6, 2024, with a retail price of $210, the Jordan 4 Retro Vivid Sulfur Women's is destined to become a coveted piece in sneaker collections across the globe. Its launch is not about offering a fresh, fashion-forward choice for women who demand both style and substance in their footwear. Grab these exclusive kicks and step into a world where heritage meets modern flair, all wrapped up in the iconic Jordan 4 design.

Display Name: New Balance 1890 Action Bronson Cyborg Tears
Description: The New Balance 1890 Action Bronson Blue Grey captures the Queens rapper bold personality through a refined but expressive runner silhouette. Blue and Grey tones layer across the upper, creating depth while maintaining a cohesive and wearable palette. The chunky midsole and technical detailing reinforce New Balance performance heritage, giving the shoe substance beyond aesthetics. Action Bronson collaborations with New Balance consistently bring personality and storytelling to archival inspired models. His color choices often feel unexpected yet balanced, and this Blue Grey pairing reflects that instinct perfectly. Fans of both Bronson and the brand appreciate how each release feels personal, blending music culture with authentic running DNA rather than simply applying surface level branding. The New Balance 1890 Action Bronson Blue Grey was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Under Armour Curry Flow 12 STRN
Description: The Under Armour Curry Flow 12 STRN delivers a performance driven basketball shoe built around speed and control, using a beige and white colorway that keeps the design clean and balanced. The silhouette reflects Stephen Currys playing style, emphasizing quick movement and responsiveness. This pair stands out because it focuses on precision. The Flow cushioning system supports traction and agility, making it suitable for fast paced play. Fans appreciate how it combines performance technology with a versatile look. The Under Armour Curry Flow 12 STRN was released on April 18, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1/97 Sean Wotherspoon (Extra Lace Set Only)
Description: The Air Max 97/1 Sean Wotherspoon is a perfect example of what Kevin Garnett was talking about when he yelled that "ANYTHING IS POSSIBLEEE!!" This ultra-special Nike Air Max 97/1 was originally part of a Nike design contest that Sean entered and ended up winning. Reportedly inspired by Seans love for vintage Nike hats from the 1980s, this shoe features both the upper of the Air Max 97 and the sole unit of the Air Max 1, a killer combo. The shoe also has a unique colorful corduroy upper with frayed edges, a truly one-of-a-kind look, with velour from toe to heel. These grails dropped on Air Max day 2018 (March 26th) and retailed at $160. If youre an Air Max fan, these are a pair that is a must have in your collection and one that will be sure to turn heads. This no accessories version comes with an extra lace set only.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 X Alpine Green Black
Description: The New Balance 9060 Alpine Green Black brings a rich color palette to one of the brands most modern silhouettes, combining deep green tones with black accents that enhance its layered design. The 9060 stands out for its exaggerated proportions and sculpted midsole, giving it a futuristic feel while still pulling from classic New Balance DNA. The alpine green adds depth, making the shoe feel both bold and grounded at the same time. Collectors gravitate toward this model because it represents a clear shift in how New Balance approaches design, blending heritage cues with forward thinking shapes. The colorway adds personality without overwhelming the structure, making it versatile while still distinctive. It is a sneaker that continues to define the 9060s place in the lineup, offering a strong mix of innovation and wearability. The New Balance 9060 Alpine Green Black was released on November 18, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Black Flame Scarlet
Description: The Salomon XT 6 Gore Tex Black Flame Scarlet pairs trail proven construction with a bold flash of color built for unpredictable conditions. Black dominates the upper, creating a stealth base that allows Flame Scarlet accents to ignite the design with sharp contrast. Subtle Vanilla Ice detailing softens the edges, while the Gore Tex membrane reinforces its all weather capability. The XT 6 has long been a favorite for those who value durability and technical precision, and adding Gore Tex only strengthens that reputation. The mix of dark tones and vibrant red gives the silhouette aggressive energy without losing versatility. For fans who want outdoor performance wrapped in statement color blocking, this release blends function and flair seamlessly. The Salomon XT 6 Gore Tex Black Flame Scarlet was released on July 24, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Shorts
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Shorts pays homage to one of Michael Jordans most well-known game-day ritualswearing his UNC practice shorts under his uniform for good luck. Fans appreciate how it stays true to the original concept while continuing to feel relevant, making it a strong addition to the Air Max 95 lineup. Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Bright Crimson Lime Blast Mint Foam Cave Purple
