Runners and collectors love this release because it symbolizes what modern racing footwear has become. The Alphafly Next 3 feels fearless and futuristic, designed for people who want the best tools available when it matters most. Fans appreciate how the vibrant palette highlights the shoes technical form, making it a statement of ambition and progress as much as a piece of elite running equipment. The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 Bright Crimson Lime Blast Mint Foam Cave Purple was released on February 13, 2025 with a retail price of $285.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 Black Metallic Silver (2025)
Description: The Nike Shox R4 Black Metallic Silver (2025) is a striking revival of the iconic Shox technology, blending futuristic design with classic Nike aesthetics. This men's sneaker features a sleek black upper complemented by eye-catching metallic silver accents, creating a bold and sophisticated look. The shoe's standout feature is the revolutionary Shox cushioning system in the heel, providing responsive energy return and superior comfort with every step. Engineered for both style and performance, the Nike Shox R4 boasts a durable construction with a mix of premium materials. The upper combines breathable mesh with supportive overlays, ensuring a secure fit and enhanced durability. The distinctive Shox columns in the heel not only offer exceptional shock absorption but also add a unique visual element to the shoe's design. Completed with a grippy rubber outsole for excellent traction, this sneaker is perfect for everyday wear or light athletic activities. Our team thinks this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts looking for a blend of retro charm and modern performance, offering a comfortable and stylish option for various casual occasions.

Display Name: Nike Vomero 18 Gore-Tex Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike Vomero 18 Gore Tex Black Anthracite brings weather ready protection into one of Nikes most comfort focused running silhouettes, combining a sleek black and anthracite palette with a build designed to handle tougher conditions. The upper keeps a clean and minimal look, while the Gore Tex construction adds a functional layer that helps shield against the elements. The Vomero line has always centered on cushioning and smooth transitions, and this version maintains that identity while expanding its versatility. Fans of the Vomero series appreciate how models like this adapt to different environments without losing their core feel. The all black colorway makes it easy to wear daily, whether on runs or as part of a casual rotation. It is a sneaker that blends performance and practicality, offering a reliable option for those who want comfort with added durability. The Nike Vomero 18 Gore Tex Black Anthracite was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Varsity Royal (2021/2026)
Description: The Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Varsity Royal arrives in a Varsity Royal, white, Volt, and black color scheme. Durabuck and leather make up the upper, while mesh make up the tongue. Griffeys uniform number, "24", is shown on the ankle strap, adding the finishing touches. The Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Varsity Royal released in May of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Platinum Tint
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Platinum Tint applies an off-white base of Platinum Tint with accents in Subtle Gray and beige hues to the Zoom Vomero 5 silhouette. This technical running shoe boasts a durable mesh upper with synthetic leather overlays that form an overlapping pattern. A plastic piece on the side panels provides support, while the synthetic grid-like design on the heel maintains the sneakers durability and allows the foot to breathe. The combination of Platinum Tint, Iron Gray, and cashmere across the upper gives the sneaker a slightly off-white appearance. The Zoom Air unit in the midsole gives responsive cushioning, while the rubber outsole grips the pavement or ground. Our StockX experts like the way the Cashmere Swoosh logos stand out against the plastic panels on the sneakers side panels. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Platinum Tint was released on January 2nd, 2024, and sold for $160.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Dark Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Dark Smoke Grey is a low-cut sneaker whose design follows the classic color blocking of previous Dunk Lows, with this iteration presenting in a dark smoke grey and black color palette. The SB Dunk by Nike is a low top sneaker that has a solid following thanks to its relaxed, casual aesthetic and comfortable fit. Fresh colorways are always appearing, and this iteration boasts a tonal dark smoke grey and black combination. The entire upper is all suede. The dark smoke grey envelopes the toe cap, forefoot, eyelet, and heel overlay. While black fills in the remaining areas. The white midsole adds balance, while the gum outsole is a classic choice that provides well-needed traction. According to our experts, the black leather Swoosh is a premium design element and gives this shoe a touch of elegance. The Nike SB Dunk Low Dark Smoke Grey was released on December 3, 2024, with a $115 recommended retail price.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Pure Gold Black
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Pure Gold Black is one of the most visually commanding executions in the Mexico 66 lineup, a colorway that takes the silhouette's iconic slim leather construction and floods it with metallic Pure Gold in a way that commands attention without sacrificing the heritage character that makes this shoe one of the most enduring designs in athletic footwear history. The Mexico 66's origin story runs directly to Japan's 1968 Olympic Games preparation, the model drawing inspiration from the Limber shoe of 1966, one of the first silhouettes to carry the Onitsuka Tiger Stripes, and the Limber-Up of 1961, with the resulting design delivering a slim toe box, low-cut profile, and serrated heel stripes that have remained unchanged because nothing about them needed to change. Here, that heritage silhouette is rendered in natural leather and artificial leather across the upper in Pure Gold, with Black arriving on the Tiger Stripes, the outsole, and the signature "MEXICO 66" lettering on the outer side panel, creating a contrast that makes each detail read with maximum clarity against the metallic base. The Mexico 66 has accumulated a following that spans generations of sneaker culture, earning credibility first in Japanese athletics before crossing over into global streetwear and fashion through decades of consistent design integrity and a growing number of high-profile collaborators who recognized the silhouette's timeless proportions. The Pure Gold colorway specifically appeals to collectors who understand that the Mexico 66's slim silhouette and heritage construction become most visible and most interesting when the color palette is doing something unexpected, and a full metallic gold execution with black contrast does exactly that with full commitment. The rubber outsole keeps the shoe grounded for genuine daily wear while the leather upper develops character with use, making this a pair that gets better the more it is actually worn. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Pure Gold Black was released on August 1, 2023 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 23 Grand Opening (Translucent Outsole)
Description: The Nike LeBron 23 Grand Opening arrives with celebratory energy, pairing White with Metallic Gold and University Red for a color story that feels premium and bold. Black accents frame the upper, sharpening the silhouette and highlighting the sculpted tooling that defines the latest chapter in LeBron signature line. The mix of tones gives the shoe a refined yet competitive presence. Grand Opening feels symbolic, marking another milestone in LeBron long running partnership with Nike Basketball. Gold detailing adds championship undertones, while the red hits keep it rooted in performance intensity. For fans who follow every evolution of the LeBron series, this edition blends legacy recognition with modern innovation in a way that feels earned rather than flashy. The Nike LeBron 23 Grand Opening was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Cacao Wow
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Cacao Wow is an eye-catching shoe that calls back to a legend. It delivers the same springy soft bounce that revolutionized sneaker history when this silhouette debuted in 1982 as the first basketball shoe with Nike Air in the midsole. The Cacao Wow iteration of the Nike Air Force 1 Low-Top '07 features a rich brown upper composed of subtly patterned synthetic leather that offers a slight sheen. Perforations in the toebox that facilitate breathability and the padded collar are both designed to enhance comfort. The tonal mesh tongue sports a Coconut Milk-colored liner that matches both the sock liner and the laces. A midsole constructed from Sail-colored foam rests atop a dark brown rubber outsole that provides multidirectional shock absorption and multi-surface grip. The standout detail of this sneaker that we most enjoy is the side-panel Nike Swoosh. The synthetic white leather offers a bright pop of contrast against the dark brown base of the upper. The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Cacao Wow was released on December 10, 2023, for an original retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey
Description: Originally designed as running shoes, the Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey sticks to its roots with the Waffle sole, a textile/leather upper, and classic TPU details. The Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey features a textile upper with leather and synthetic overlays. Most of the sneaker is in iron grey, with the Swooshes appearing in white on the lateral and medial sides. The low top also includes a padded tongue and collar for maximum comfort, and underfoot, Max Air cushioning provides cushioning, while the Waffle sole adds traction and durability. The Nike Air Max 90 Iron Grey was released in January 2020 and retailed for $120.

Display Name: Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG Kobe Bryant Phantom Black
Description: The Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG Kobe Bryant Phantom Black translates Kobe Bryants legacy into elite level football performance through a design that feels focused and uncompromising. The Phantom 6 Low silhouette is built for precision and control, and the all black execution reinforces a mentality of discipline and intent. It feels serious and purposeful, allowing performance innovation to take priority over flash or excess branding. Fans and collectors value this release because it honors Kobe through mindset rather than symbolism alone. The Phantom Black colorway reflects his approach to mastery and preparation, making the boot feel emotionally resonant while remaining technically elite. It stands as a crossover tribute that connects Kobes legacy to another sport defined by control, intelligence, and relentless pursuit of excellence. The Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite FG Kobe Bryant Phantom Black was released on December 15, 2025 with a retail price of $305.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big Bubble Lost Sketch
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big BubbleLost Sketch is a special iteration of the iconic Air Max 1 silhouette, featuring a unique colorway that combines Light Smoke Gray with Diffused Blue. The upper of this Air Max 1 86 OG is constructed using a mix of breathable mesh materials and leather. The majority of the upper is covered in gray, except the Nike Swoosh and Nike logo on the heel, which are in black. The mudguard that runs above the midsole is also gray, with a black bubble pattern that adds a bit of visual interest to the shoe. The midsole has a washed light brown color, while the outsole is black. A standout feature of the Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big BubbleLost Sketch is its midsole, which has a visible Air unit in the heel, strategically placed to deliver energy return and cushion the foot during normal activities. The shoe was first released for retail on June 16th, 2023, priced at $170.

Display Name: Puma Fade Pokémon Pikachu
Description: The Puma Fade Pokemon Pikachu brings one of the most recognizable characters in gaming into a performance inspired sneaker silhouette that feels playful and energetic. The energizing yellow upper reflects Pikachus signature color, while black accents add contrast and structure throughout the design. The fade effect introduces a sense of motion, giving the shoe a dynamic visual identity. Fans of both Puma and Pokemon are drawn to this release because it captures the characters personality without becoming overly literal. The balance between color and design keeps it wearable while still clearly referencing Pikachu. It stands as a crossover piece that blends gaming culture with everyday footwear in a way that feels fun and accessible. The Puma Fade Pokemon Pikachu was released on April 2, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Dunk High Fragment Beijing (2021)
Description: The Nike Dunk High fragment design Beijing arrives with a purple leather upper plus black overlays and Swooshes. A debossed white fragment design lightning bolt appears at the heel, a common detail that is prominent in most fragment Nikes. The Nike Dunk High fragment design Beijing released in June of 2021 and retailed for $150.

Display Name: Hoka One One Clifton 10 Black
Description: The Hoka One One Clifton 10 Black refines one of the brands most balanced silhouettes with a sleek, all black finish. Known for its lightweight cushioning and smooth transition, the Clifton line has become a staple for daily miles, and the tenth iteration continues that dependable formula. The Black Black colorway enhances the streamlined upper and sculpted midsole, giving the shoe a stealthy, versatile presence. It feels performance focused without unnecessary flash. Fans of the Clifton series appreciate how it delivers consistent comfort while staying responsive enough for varied training sessions. The tonal black design makes it easy to wear beyond running, fitting seamlessly into everyday rotations. With the Clifton 10, Hoka reinforces its commitment to lightweight support and balanced cushioning in a silhouette that feels both practical and polished. The Hoka One One Clifton 10 Black was released on April 15, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Rift Premium SE Light Soft Pink Ribbons (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Rift Premium SE Light Soft Pink Ribbons for women is a stunning addition to Nike's innovative footwear lineup. This unique sneaker combines style and comfort, featuring a split-toe design that offers a distinctive look and enhanced flexibility. The light soft pink colorway, accented with pale ivory details, creates a delicate and feminine aesthetic perfect for the fashion-forward woman. Colorway: Light Soft Pink/Pale Ivory-Light Soft Pink

Display Name: Nike Blazer Low 77 Black White
Description: The Nike Blazer Low 77 Black White offers a timeless color two-tone combination in a low-top silhouette, combining smooth and rough textures with a pop of color. The Black White Nike Blazer Low 77 upper features pristine black leather with a classic white Swoosh, complemented by durable black suede overlays at the toe and the sides. Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Shadow 2.0
Description: The upper of the Air Jordan 1 Shadow 2.0 is made of a black leather base with Light Smoke Grey overlays. Display Name: New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Rich Oak
Description: The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Rich Oak brings a deeper and more seasonal tone to one of the brands most respected silhouettes, using a rich oak cosmic grape palette that feels layered and grounded. The updated 990v6 shape keeps its performance roots intact while leaning further into lifestyle wear, with premium materials that elevate the overall look. It feels refined but still familiar. Display Name: Nike Air Max LTD 3 Triple Black
Description: The Nike Air Max LTD 3 Triple Black is a sleek athletic shoe with a black-on-black colorway and Air Max technology. This version of the Nike Air Max LTD 3 Triple Black features an upper made of a mix of genuine and synthetic leather. Shiny texture black leather forms the base under the laces and on the toebox, while matte black overlays round out the toebox and reach back to the heel. The heel contains a rubber patch with the Nike logo, while Air Max branding can be seen just above the sole under the ankle. The Nike logo is also present in black on the tongue. Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro Miami Hurricanes

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver Pink (Women's)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver Pink (Women's) gives the Gel-1130 a contemporary upgrade with a colorway of Pure Silver and light pink. Our experts like the combination of pink, Pure Silver, black, and white colors on the rubber outsole because they complement the hues on the upper. The womens size ASICS Gel-1130 White Pure Silver Pink (Women's) was originally released on June 1, 2024, and sold for $95.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Triple White (2022) (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Triple White (Women's) takes a classic silhouette and dresses it in a monochromatic colorway to present bold style ready for action in a sneaker specifically sized for women. The white / white / white colorway of the Jordan 1 Low-Top for women sports an upper of leather that's been tumbled. L eather overlays cover the toe cap, vamp, heel, and eye stays. The quarter panel classic Nike swoosh is also white leather. White laces with a white lace tab crossover a white tongue adorned with a white embroidered Jumpman logo. The insole is white with a tonal Jumpman logo that matches the sock liner. An OG Wings logo is stamped into the heel counter. What we really like about this shoe is the dependability of the signature foam midsole encapsulating an Air unit in its heel, all resting on top of a white rubber outsole. The Jordan 1 Low Triple White (Women's), sneaker was released on September 14, 2022 for an original retail price of $90.

Display Name: Anta Kai 3 432Hz
Description: The Anta Kai 3 432Hz is a February 28, 2026 release from the ANTA and Kyrie Irving Kai 3 signature program, a colorway that SoleRetriever described as channeling balance and control through a concept tied to sound frequency and mental alignment, drawing from the widely discussed but scientifically contested claim that 432 Hz is the natural frequency of the universe, a topic with significant presence in the wellness and spiritual communities that Irving regularly engages with in his public persona. The 432 Hz concept, which holds that sound tuned to this frequency provides calming, harmonizing, and healing effects in contrast to the standard 440 Hz tuning used in most modern music, provided the creative framework for the shoe's entire design language: as ANTA's official product page confirmed, the upper features a purple-to-pink gradient that echoes sound waves in motion, with violet representing the highest frequency on the visible color spectrum and symbolizing silence, stillness, and focus, while pink represents physical restoration and heightened mental acuity. Metallic gold accents on the ANTA logo at the midfoot and Kyrie's signature logo on the tongue and heel reference the tuning forks used in sound healing practices. House of Heat confirmed the backstory: Irving sat out the entire 2025-26 NBA season to recover from a torn ACL suffered in March 2025, making the 432 Hz colorway's themes of healing, balance, and recovery directly autobiographical. The outsole uses irregular flowing paths inspired by frequency diagrams, and the traction pattern features circular radiating zones that mirror the visual representation of frequency waves. Each pair includes a special shoe box and pendant exclusive to the 432Hz colorway. Released February 28, 2026 at $135 via ANTA.com and select retailers including Dick's Sporting Goods, Scheels, Shoe Palace, Sneaker Politics, Extra Butter, and Nice Kicks. Style code 8126B1102-1. The Anta Kai 3 432Hz is the February 2026 healing-frequency-concept Kyrie Irving signature shoe for the collector who wants the violet-to-pink sound-wave gradient upper, metallic gold tuning-fork-referencing ANTA and KAI logos, frequency-diagram outsole pattern, and exclusive 432Hz pendant and special packaging in the most conceptually personal colorway Kyrie Irving has produced during his ANTA partnership. The Anta Kai 3 432Hz was released on February 28, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 LX All-Star Warning Label
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Cobalt Bliss brings electric Memphis energy to Ja Morant evolving signature line. Cobalt Bliss floods the upper with vibrant intensity, layered with Glacier Blue accents that create movement across the sculpted design. Black detailing anchors the palette, sharpening the silhouette and emphasizing the aggressive midsole geometry built for explosive play. Ja signature models have quickly developed a reputation for bold color stories that mirror his fearless style on the court. Cobalt Bliss feels dynamic and expressive, capturing the speed and creativity that define his game. For fans who follow his rise closely, this pair represents another step in establishing a distinct identity within Nike Basketball modern lineup. The Nike Ja 3 Cobalt Bliss was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Eucalyptus Sage Cosmic Sky
Description: The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex in Eucalyptus, Silver Sage, and Cosmic Sky is a premium waterproof version of one of trail running's most celebrated and culturally significant silhouettes, the Gore-Tex membrane adding genuine all-weather performance to the XT-6's already impressive technical construction in a colorway that brings together three of the most naturalistic and atmospherically specific color names in the current Salomon catalog. Eucalyptus and silver sage create a layered relationship between two green-adjacent tones that references the specific color palette of Pacific coastal and forest environments with genuine precision and geographic awareness, while cosmic sky introduces a pale and slightly luminous blue that evokes the high altitude light conditions where serious trail runners and outdoor enthusiasts deploy technical footwear with the most genuine performance expectations. Gore-Tex waterproofing on the XT-6's proven trail platform creates a shoe that handles rain, stream crossings, and wet trail surfaces with the confidence that only genuine waterproof membrane construction can provide, making this the most weather-ready and condition-versatile version of the XT-6 available in the current Salomon lineup. Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex releases in nature-referential and atmospherically specific colorways consistently attract the segment of the trail and outdoor lifestyle market that wants their technical footwear to carry visual intelligence about the environments they are designed to perform in alongside the construction quality and weather protection that Gore-Tex certification guarantees. Eucalyptus, silver sage, and cosmic sky create a colorway that functions as a genuine design statement about place, environment, and the specific visual experience of moving through coastal and forested trail terrain in overcast and moody atmospheric conditions that Gore-Tex footwear was built to handle without hesitation. At two hundred dollars the XT-6 Gore-Tex in this colorway delivers Salomon's most weather-capable trail platform in one of the most design-intelligent and environmentally resonant color stories in the current outdoor lifestyle footwear market. The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex in Eucalyptus, Silver Sage, and Cosmic Sky was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Desert Boot Oil

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Black University Blue (2026)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro in Black, University Blue, and White for 2026 is a colorway that brings one of the most beloved and instantly recognizable color combinations in all of sneaker culture to the Jordan 5's iconic Tinker Hatfield designed silhouette, delivering the black and university blue pairing that carries enormous cultural weight in both Jordan Brand's own heritage and in the broader sneaker collector landscape where this specific color relationship has generated some of the most celebrated and sought after releases across multiple Jordan models and silhouette families. The Jordan 5 is widely celebrated as one of Tinker Hatfield's most complete and architecturally satisfying Jordan designs, inspired by WWII fighter aircraft with its shark tooth motif on the midsole, reflective tongue, and the lace lock system that has become one of the most recognizable design details in sneaker history, and in black and university blue those design elements read with maximum visual authority and historical resonance. University blue as the accent color against black creates a contrast that feels simultaneously athletic and street credible, the blue carrying associations with Jordan Brand's most celebrated University of North Carolina connected colorways while the black primary creates the dark and authoritative foundation that makes the blue pop with complete visual clarity. Jordan 5 Retro releases in black and university blue have historically generated enormous collector enthusiasm because the color combination hits the precise intersection of Jordan Brand heritage, cultural resonance, and visual impact that the most celebrated Jordan retro colorways achieve when everything comes together correctly, and the 2026 iteration arrives with the full weight of that anticipation behind it alongside the construction quality and historical authenticity that Jordan Brand brings to its most significant seasonal Retro releases. Black, university blue, and white on the Jordan 5's shark tooth midsole, visible Air unit, and reflective tongue creates a complete and visually satisfying shoe that works as powerfully on court in a basketball context as it does on the street in a fashion and culture context, which is the hallmark of the Jordan colorways that endure most significantly across collector generations. For Jordan Brand devotees who have followed the black and university blue color story across multiple silhouettes and releases, the Jordan 5 Retro 2026 version is the most architecturally satisfying home that combination has found in the current retro calendar. The Air Jordan 5 Retro in Black, University Blue, and White was released on June 20, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Palace

It stands as a collaboration that respects the original while adding a fresh perspective for a new audience. Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Pink Foam (GS)

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon Beluga
Description: Just in time for summer adidas and Kanye West delivered the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon Beluga, a revamped version of the classic Beluga colorway. It screams street-ready while maintaining that sleek Yeezy aesthetic we all know and love. This is a sneaker that not only speaks to your style but also pushes it to new levels. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon Beluga stomped onto the scene on May 31, 2023, with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Fire Red (2022)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Fire Red 2022 brings back an OG colorway from the year 1988. The top section of the Retro Fire Red is crafted from white leather with elephant print overlays done in dark gray at the heel and forefoot. The model also features contrasting fire red accents on the midsole, eyelets, and perforated leather collar. Display Name: Jordan 7 Retro Miro (2026)
Description: The Air Jordan 7 Retro Miro (2026) brings back one of the most visually unique collaborations in the Jordan archive, originally inspired by the work of Barcelona-based artist Joan Miró. Dressed in white with metallic gold, sport red, and varsity royal accents, the sneaker embraces bold color placement and abstract design language that stands apart from traditional Jordan releases. When the Miro concept first appeared in the mid-2000s, it represented a moment where Jordan Brand pushed beyond sports into art-driven storytelling. Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver Court Purple
