The black base keeps the look grounded, while the lighter tones provide visual relief that highlights the shoes structure. Collectors appreciate how each volume evolves without losing the lines daring spirit. This colorway feels controlled yet expressive, embodying Hardens flair through form and proportion rather than loud graphics alone. The adidas Harden Vol 9 Black Warm Vanilla was released on July 9, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Undefeated x Brooklyn Dodgers Ostrich
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Undefeated x Brooklyn Dodgers Ostrich brings together sport history and streetwear through a unique material driven execution. The black upper is elevated with ostrich textured detailing, giving the classic Chuck Taylor silhouette a more premium and unexpected feel. The Brooklyn Dodgers inspiration ties the shoe to a historic era in baseball, adding a layer of storytelling that goes beyond the design itself. This collaboration stands out because it blends heritage from multiple spaces into one product. Undefeated continues to reinterpret classic silhouettes, and this version shows how material changes alone can transform the entire look. It is a pair that feels rooted in history while still offering something new for collectors. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Undefeated x Brooklyn Dodgers Ostrich was released on April 20, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Neon Pack Pink (Women's)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Neon Pack Pink (Women's) dresses the Gel-1130 technical silhouette in a pink colorway with contrasting accents in black and metallic silver. Featuring a silhouette first released in 2008, this stability running shoe is part of ASICS "Neon Pack," a bold collection launched in Spring 2025. The sneaker infuses the Gel-1130 with metallic silver and black overlays, creating a dynamic, futuristic look. However, the design also includes heritage technologies, including an EVA foam midsole and a fuchsia pink Gel insert in the heel. In addition, pink covers the loose-weave mesh upper and part of the rubber outsole. Finally, ASICS signature trusstic support system allows the foot to bend without sacrificing midfoot stability. Our experts at StockX like that the overlays are crafted from synthetic leather, offering durability and resistance against weathering. The womens size ASICS Gel-1130 Neon Pack Pink (Women's) was released on April 4, 2025, and retailed for $95.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Tiempo Wolf Grey Black
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Tiempo Wolf Grey Black is an athletic shoe with a curved, stitched leather upper in Wolf Grey, featuring a large foldover tongue. The Nike Swoosh in Black appears on the tongue and sides, while Tiempo branding appears on the rear heel and outsole. The chunky Black outsole displays four visible Air units, and a Metallic Silver tip completes the look. Nike, the predominant force in American sneaker design, pioneered its Air Max technology beginning in 1987, with the series going on to add another triumph to the brand's innovations. The Air Max Plus Tiempos foldover tongue is inspired by traditional football sneaker design, while the Air Max technology in the sole offers solid comfort on the pitch. In our opinion, the best feature of the Air Max Plus Tiempo is its chunky sole, which balances the aesthetic of the foldover tongue. The Nike Air Max Plus Tiempo Wolf Grey Black released on July 12, 2024, and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Diffused Blue
Description: The Jordan 11 Retro Low Diffused Blue adds a diffused-blue hue to the wavy patent leather mudguard of Tinker Hatfields signature design. The combination of leather and mesh creates a lightweight yet durable upper, while thick padding around the collar protects the ankle. Twin Jumpman logos, one on the mesh tongue and one on the heel, come in Midnight Navy, while a large white Jumpman decorates the outsole. Like other AJ11 models, this version features a semi-translucent rubber outsole and patches of Diffused Blue on the herringbone traction pattern. Finally, an encapsulated Nike Air unit protects against impact without weighing down the shoe. Our experts appreciate the tonal stitching along the Diffused Blue mudguard because it contributes to the color contrast between the white mesh and the patent leather. The Jordan 11 Retro Low Diffused Blue was released on August 17, 2024, and retailed at $190.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Fear (2024) (GS)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Fear (2024) (GS) relaunches the recognizable silhouette from 2013, this time in a grade school size. It boasts a grayscale colorway with white, black, Anthracite, and Pure Platinum hues. The sneaker is part of Jordan Brands Fear Pack, which promotes fearlessness and overcoming obstacles. The upper is crafted from open-weave mesh in black with layered nubuck overlays in Anthracite and light gray. Signature Air Jordan 4 elements include the nubuck lace cage, TPU eyelets, and visible Air-Sole units in the heel. The 2024 grade-school Jordan 4 Retro Fear showcases a speckled pattern across the midsole that complements the gray tones. The branding details are oversized, including a white Jumpman logo on the heel and a premium tongue tag with Michael Jordans signature. Our experts at StockX like the subtle pop of color provided by the red hue on the Air-Sole units. The grade school-sized Jordan 4 Retro Fear (2024) (GS) was released on November 16, 2024, and sold for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Black Flint
Description: The Jordan 13 Retro Flint is making its return in 2023, with the release of the Air Jordan 13 Retro Black Flint. ? ? ?The Jordan 13 Retro Black Flint is dressed in black, white, red, and Flint Grey. The Jordan 13 is constructed using leather, suede, and reflective mesh across the uppers. The sneakers are tied together with white laces, while a red Jumpman logo sits on top of the tongue. A holographic eye sits on the outer heel. ?? ?The Jordan 13 Retro Black Flint released April 22, 2023, with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Anta Kai 2 Azurie
Description: The Anta Kai 2 Azurie captures Kyrie Irving creative energy through a bold Pink and Blue color story that feels expressive and fluid. The upper blends these contrasting hues in a way that feels almost artistic, reflecting Kyrie flair on the court. The silhouette itself remains performance focused, built for sharp cuts and quick directional changes that define his style of play. Kyrie signature line with Anta continues to grow in identity, and the Kai 2 shows how much personality the brand is willing to embrace. The Azurie colorway stands out immediately, making it the kind of pair that commands attention during game play or in a lifestyle rotation. Fans who follow Kyrie journey appreciate how each release feels personal, often tying color and design back to his creative mindset. The Anta Kai 2 Azurie was released on November 20, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Premium Blueprint
Description: To celebrate Air Max Day 2022, Nike delivered the Nike Air Max 1 Premium Blueprint. The North American-exclusive Nike Air Max 1 Blueprint highlights the silhouettes worldwide appeal and global impact. It features a white mesh upper with light blue Durabuck and tumbled leather overlays. Each Swoosh features a grid blue pattern, nodding to the composition of blueprints. At the heel, a globe embroidery and classic Nike Air logo completes the design. The Nike Air Max 1 Blueprint released in March of 2022 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Dn Black Metallic Grey
Description: The Black Metallic Grey Nike Air Max Dn redefines classic design with smart colors and dynamic detailing combined in a way that accentuates the brand's tone and creativity. This release merges Nikes signature Air cushioning with a trendy aesthetic tailored for casual and athletic settings. The Black Metallic Grey Air Max Dn by Nike features a synthetic and mesh upper for durability and breathability, paired with metallic grey accents highlighting its modern design. The signature Nike Air unit in the midsole ensures responsive cushioning, complemented by a durable rubber outsole for reliable grip. Since its inception in 1987, the Air Max line has revolutionized footwear, blending cutting-edge technology with street-ready designs. What our experts enjoy about the Nike Air Max Dn Black Metallic Grey is the secure lacing system that improves foot stability and its reflective accents in the heel to improve visibility in low-light conditions. This pair retailed at $160 when it debuted on 3 May 2024.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro J Balvin Rio
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro J Balvin Rio perfectly blends the classic Jordan 3 design with J Balvin's signature flair. Featuring a predominantly black upper, this sneaker is brought to life with solar flare and total crimson abyss accents that capture the vibrant energy of J Balvins music. The iconic elephant print on the heel and toe areas pays homage to the original Jordan 3 design, while the gradient midsole transitioning from bright orange to deep abyss adds a unique and colorful twist. As part of his ongoing collaboration with Jordan brand, J Balvin's "Rio" edition, named after his son, infuses a personal and artistic touch into the Jordan 3 model. The sneaker's construction maintains the high standards of comfort and durability that the Jordan 3 is known for. The bold colorway reflects J Balvins dynamic personality, making this model a standout piece. The thoughtful design elements, from the premium leather to the eye-catching gradient midsole, highlight the meticulous attention to detail in this collaboration. Retailing at $250, the Jordan 3 Retro J Balvin Rio was released on May 22, 2024. This sneaker is a tribute to J Balvin's influence and the enduring legacy of the Jordan brand. Dont miss out on this unique and stylish collaboration that perfectly captures the essence of both the music and sneaker worlds.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low White Aluminum (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low White Aluminum Womens delivers a crisp and refreshing take on the Jordan 1 Low, using a clean white base paired with aluminum blue accents for a light and airy feel. The colorway feels simple and confident, highlighting the silhouettes timeless proportions while adding a subtle pop that keeps it visually engaging. Its a design that feels easy and seasonless. Collectors appreciate this pair because of its versatility and clarity. The Jordan 1 Low remains true to its basketball heritage, while the white and aluminum combination gives it a fresh lifestyle edge that fits effortlessly into rotation. Fans love it as a dependable staple, a sneaker that feels polished without trying too hard and reinforces why the Jordan 1 Low continues to be a cornerstone of modern sneaker culture. The Air Jordan 1 Low White Aluminum Womens was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big Bubble Sport Red (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big Bubble Sport Red W is a women-sized colorway variation of the Air Max 1 model. The upper of the '86 Big Bubble Sport Red W is made from a combination of suede and mesh, creating a comfortable and breathable environment for the feet. The design features a mix of University Red, black, and Neutral Grey. The outsole has a tread pattern that is designed specifically for sport activities, giving the wearer increased stability and performance. We think that one of the key features of the Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big Bubble Sport Red W is the big bubble on the heel. This is a visual representation of the Nike Air cushioning technology, which provides maximum comfort and support for the feet. The bubble is visible from the side of the shoe, adding a unique and playful element to the design. The Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big Bubble Sport Red W was released on March 23rd, 2023, at a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Year of the Horse
Description: The Nike P 6000 Year of the Horse blends retro running aesthetics and Lunar New Year inspired storytelling through a silhouette that continues thriving within modern sneaker culture. The P 6000 draws heavily from early 2000s Nike running footwear with its layered mesh construction, metallic accents, and highly technical visual language, making it a natural fit for thematic color experimentation. The combination of Spruce Fog, Sail, Phantom, Twine, and Neutral Olive creates an earthy and organic palette that reflects the strength and endurance associated with the Year of the Horse while maintaining the sporty identity of the silhouette. Fans appreciate the P 6000 because it captures the current popularity of technical retro runners while remaining comfortable and highly wearable for everyday use. Lunar New Year themed releases add emotional depth and collectible value through thoughtful color choices and symbolic storytelling rather than excessive graphics or branding. Collectors especially gravitate toward muted earth toned runners because they pair naturally with modern streetwear and outdoor inspired styling trends. The layered greens and neutral accents give the sneaker a calm but dynamic personality that feels equally nostalgic and contemporary within todays running inspired sneaker landscape. The Nike P 6000 Year of the Horse was released on January 9, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Mind 002 Light Khaki
Description: The Nike Mind 002 Light Khaki introduces a forward thinking lifestyle silhouette with earthy and futuristic undertones. Light Khaki and Desert Khaki dominate the upper, accented by Hyper Crimson and Metallic Cool Grey for subtle flashes of contrast. The sculpted form and layered materials give it a modern identity that feels distinct from traditional Nike categories. This model feels experimental yet grounded, leaning into natural tones while incorporating technical detailing. The muted khaki palette keeps it versatile, while the crimson accents add controlled energy that draws the eye. Early adopters will appreciate how the Mind 002 carves its own space within the brands lineup, offering a fresh direction without losing the confident Nike attitude. The Nike Mind 002 Light Khaki was released on January 8, 2026 with a retail price of $145.
Colorway: Light Khaki/Desert Khaki/Hyper Crimson/Metallic Cool Grey

Display Name: Converse SHAI 001 Premium Steel
Description: The Converse SHAI 001 Premium Steel is the third colorway in the elevated Premium line for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's first signature shoe with Converse, featuring a metallic molded leather upper and leather-wrapped heel overlay with a reflective finish that plays with light from every angle, metallic silver applied to portions of the midsole tooling including the typically TPU heel unit, a metallic foil sockliner print continuing the Steel theme, and debossed tongue logos keeping the presentation elegant. All performance specifications of the SHAI 001 carry over in the Premium format  forefoot Zoom Air cushioning, radial traction pattern for quick directional changes, and an over-lasted midsole providing a low-to-the-ground feel for control and stability  while the metallic tumbled leather construction elevates the silhouette firmly into fashion-forward lifestyle territory alongside its on-court performance function. The Steel Premium follows the Truffle brown suede and Ink blue leather as the third colorway in the Premium sub-line, with the monochromatic metallic grey palette reflecting SGA's calm, controlled playing style in a luxury sneaker language that Sneaker Freaker described as embodying the nerves-of-steel composure Gilgeous-Alexander displayed during the 2026 NBA Playoffs, where the 2025 MVP and Finals MVP faced the Lakers in the Western Conference Semifinals while wearing the pair for Game 1. Released June 11, 2026 at $150 retail via Converse.com, SNKRS, and select retailers with style code A23977C, packaged in a cotton dustbag branded with a metallic logo. The Converse SHAI 001 Premium Steel was released on June 11, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Hall of Fame
Description: Once offered exclusively in a 2006 auction to support Hurricane Katrina relief efforts, the ultra rare Katrina Air Jordan 3s AKA "Hall of Fames" are making a comeback in 2018. The shoes feature a white leather upper, the iconic Jordan 3 cement detailing, red accents, and Jumpman branding on the tongue and the heel. These Jordan 3s dropped in May of 2018 and are now available to buy and sell on StockX.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Clear Jade
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Clear Jade takes a classic silhouette and dresses it in a two-tone colorway that pops.? ?? ?The Clear Jade Nike Dunk Low-Top features a white leather upper with a perforated toebox for breathability. Clear Jade leather is used for the side panel Nike Swoosh and the overlays surrounding the toebox, eyestays, heel, and collar. The tongue is white with Clear Jade trim, and a white branding patch with Clear Jade Nike branding. The padded sock liner is Clear Jade, and the insole is Clear Jade with white Nike branding. The foam cushion midsole is fully sewn-in and sits atop a rubber cup sole. The outsole is Clear Jade rubber with a traction pattern in concentric circles.? ? ?The detail that our sneaker experts appreciate most about this sports shoe is the white embroidery that makes up the Nike branding on the Clear Jade heel tab. The Nike Dunk Low Clear Jade was released on July 1st, 2023, for a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro UNC White
Description: Jordan Brand drew inspiration from Michael Jordan's alma mater, the University of North Carolina, for the Air Jordan 6 Retro UNC White. Constructed with University Blue Durabuck and white leather, the Air Jordan 6 Retro UNC White utilizes color blocking reminiscent of the renowned Jordan 6 Carmine. Hits of navy blue on the tongue and midsole integrate UNC's lesser known school color. At the heel, a Jordan Team patch nod to the jock tags that are stitched to the bottom of UNC's uniforms. From there, an icy semi-translucent Air sole completes the design. The Air Jordan 6 Retro UNC White released in March of 2022 and retailed for $210.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Shimmer (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Shimmer (W) arrives with a buttery beige Durabuck upper with semi-translucent "Wings" and a monotone Orange Bronze heel tab. In place of the classic Jordan Flight tongue patch, a metallic Jumpman logo adds contrast to the softer tones in the design. The womens-exclusive Air Jordan 4 Shimmer (W) released in September of 2021 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog Naruto Itachi
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog Naruto Itachi Blue Red pays homage to Itachi Uchiha, a ninja character in the Naruto manga and anime series created by Masashi Kishimoto. The clog features a dark blue base with cloud-like motifs in red across the upper. It also includes several Jibbitz charms, including a black ninja throwing star and a miniature of the iconic character. Like other Classic Crocs models, this version is made from croslite resin, which is lightweight and durable. Ventilation ports along the sides allow the foot to breathe, while the pivoting heel strap supports a secure fit. A metal tab across the top of the clog displays an emblem associated with Itachi Uchiha. Our StockX experts like the outsole's traction pattern because it provides grip on various surfaces. The Crocs Classic Clog Naruto Itachi Blue Red was released on June 10, 2024, and retailed for $70.

Display Name: UGG Tazz Slipper Chestnut (Women's)
Description: The UGG Tazz Slipper Chestnut W for women features a heat-embossed UGG logo on its side. This UGG model has the silhouette of UGG Slippers with a 1.5" platform sole for extra cushioning. It is made from the same suede upper as the original one in a chestnut color. It is also lined with the signature UGG plush wool blend for a slipper-like feel. Its textile binding is made from 100% recycled polyester fibers material. The UGG Tazz Slipper Chestnut W was originally released on the 1st November 2021, with a retail price set at $120.

Display Name: Jordan 17 Retro Low SP Infinite Archives
Description: The Air Jordan 17 Retro Low SP Infinite Archives revisits one of Jordan Brands most experimental silhouettes with a thoughtful and archival inspired approach. The Jordan 17 Low has always stood apart for its luxury cues and unconventional design, and the Infinite Archives theme leans into that uniqueness with muted tones and premium detailing. It feels reflective and deliberate, celebrating a chapter of Jordan history that was bold, ambitious, and ahead of its time. Collectors appreciate this release because it honors innovation rather than nostalgia. The low cut profile gives the shoe a sleeker and more wearable feel, while the archival concept reinforces its importance within the Jordan lineage. Fans love it as a reminder of when Jordan Brand pushed boundaries through form and presentation, making this release feel significant rather than routine. The Air Jordan 17 Retro Low SP Infinite Archives was released on October 17, 2025 with a retail price of $255.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Moto 2K Pink Spell (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max Moto 2K Pink Spell Womens leans into early 2000s running aesthetics, bringing a lightweight and streamlined silhouette that feels fast even at rest. Pink spell dominates the upper, creating a soft and expressive look, while white and silver accents keep it grounded in performance inspired design. The shape feels sleek and continuous. This pair resonates with fans who appreciate retro running styles making a return. The Moto 2K captures that eras focus on movement and simplicity, while the colorway adds a modern and wearable twist. It is a blend of nostalgia and current taste, making it appealing across different styles. The Nike Air Max Moto 2K Pink Spell Womens was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: New Balance 1906L Blacktop Phantom
Description: The New Balance 1906L Blacktop Phantom is a striking addition to the brand's lifestyle sneaker lineup. This sleek and modern design showcases a predominantly black colorway, accented with subtle phantom hues for a sophisticated look. The upper features a blend of premium materials, including breathable mesh and durable synthetic overlays, ensuring both style and functionality. The shoe's streamlined silhouette is complemented by New Balance's signature craftsmanship, offering a perfect balance of comfort and aesthetics. Engineered for all-day wear, the 1906L Blacktop Phantom incorporates New Balance's innovative cushioning technology in the midsole, providing exceptional support and responsiveness with every step. The outsole features a carefully designed tread pattern, offering reliable traction on various surfaces. With its versatile design, this sneaker effortlessly transitions from casual outings to more active pursuits, making it a valuable addition to any footwear collection. Our experts state this product is great for urban explorers and style enthusiasts who appreciate a blend of performance and contemporary fashion.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High '85 Georgetown
Description: Jordan Brand celebrated the 40th Anniversary of Michael Jordan's 1982 NCAA title win over the Georgetown Bulldogs by bringing back the original 1985 Air Jordan 1 silhouette in his former opponent-turned-partner's school colors. Drawing inspiration from the Nike Terminator Georgetown, the Air Jordan 1 High '85 Georgetown features a classic two-tone color blocked look, with a smooth grey leather upper and College Navy overlays. A yellowed nylon tongue with a woven Nike label nods to the appeal of vintage 1985 Jordan 1s. At the base, a white and navy air sole completes the design. The Air Jordan 1 High '85 Georgetown released in April of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Varsity Maize Pine Green
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Varsity Maize Pine Green combines high contrast color blocking with the signature wave like upper that defines the model. The varsity maize base brings brightness and energy, while pine green accents introduce a deeper contrast that cuts through the design. White and black details help balance the palette, keeping the overall look cohesive despite the bold tones. Fans are drawn to this pair because it highlights the dynamic structure of the Air Max Plus through color rather than material changes. The combination feels vibrant but controlled, making it stand out without becoming overwhelming. It continues the tradition of the silhouette being a canvas for expressive colorways that resonate strongly within sneaker culture. The Nike Air Max Plus Varsity Maize Pine Green was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Miami Dolphins
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Miami Dolphins translates team pride into one of Nikes most durable and recognizable silhouettes, blending sports culture with everyday wearability. The crisp white base lets the Dolphins inspired turbo green and pitch blue accents shine, giving the shoe a bright and energetic personality that instantly connects to Miamis identity. It feels athletic and expressive without overpowering the Air Max 90s classic structure and visible Air cushioning. Fans love this pair because it feels like a natural crossover between football culture and sneaker heritage. The Air Max 90 has always been about versatility, and this colorway adds emotional connection for Dolphins supporters while still working as a lifestyle sneaker. Collectors appreciate how Nike keeps these team inspired releases clean and wearable, making them easy to rotate beyond game day while still carrying strong regional pride. The Nike Air Max 90 Miami Dolphins was released on November 10, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk High Supreme Rammellzee
Description: Introducing the much-anticipated Nike SB Dunk High Supreme Rammellzee, released on August 31, 2023. This latest collab brings the legendary streetwear brand and art together, showcasing Rammellzee's iconic, vibrant artwork across the majority of the sneakers upper. This bold sneaker fuses an abstract color palette throughout most of the sneaker fused with subtle white suede overlays on the mudguard and swoosh. Every angle of this shoe shouts Supreme's audacious style meshing with Rammellzee's legendary artistry. The heel counter, toe box, and mid panel all integrate eye-catching designs that align seamlessly with the overall aesthetic. Launched on August 31, 2023, the Nike SB Dunk High x Supreme Rammellzee was an instant classic, retailing at $148.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Lucky Green
Description: Jordan brand continues its Lucky Green trend with the release of the Air Jordan 1 Low Lucky Green. The Air Jordan 1 Low gets the Lucky Green treatment after it was recently released on the Air Jordan 1 High, 2, and 3 models. The Air Jordan 1 Low Lucky Green is constructed using Lucky Green and black color blocking across the uppers. Jordan brand stitched a black Air Jordan Wings logo on the sneakers heel, and Jumpman logo on the tongue. The low cut sneakers are laced with flat black laces. The Air Jordan 1 Low Lucky Green released May 1, 2023, with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike GT Future EP CHBL Aurora Blue (CHBL Tongue Logo)
Description: The Nike GT Future EP CHBL Aurora Blue pushes Nike Basketball further into futuristic performance design through a silhouette built around speed, responsiveness, and modern athletic innovation. The GT series has become known for emphasizing explosive movement and next generation cushioning concepts, and the GT Future amplifies that identity through aggressive shaping, sculpted paneling, and metallic detailing that give the shoe a highly technical personality. The Aurora Blue colorway immediately creates a cool and electric visual atmosphere, while the black and metallic accents reinforce the sleek and performance driven energy associated with elite level basketball footwear. Fans gravitate toward futuristic basketball silhouettes because they represent the evolution of on court design language beyond traditional retro influences. The combination of metallic silver and darker tones creates strong contrast throughout the upper, giving the sneaker movement and depth that feel almost concept car inspired in execution. Collectors especially appreciate bold GT releases because they blend advanced performance identity and statement driven aesthetics in a way that feels distinctly modern within basketball sneaker culture. The overall presentation feels fast, sharp, and highly experimental while preserving the athletic functionality central to Nike Basketball innovation. The Nike GT Future EP CHBL Aurora Blue was released on April 30, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White Black Pebbled Leather
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White Black Pebbled Leather features a white pebbled leather upper with black Swooshes and heel panels. Woven Nike labels on the tongue offer a retro feel. At the base, a white Air sole adds the finishing touch. The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White Black Pebbled Leather released in January of 2021 and retailed for $90.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 270 React ENG Travis Scott Cactus Trails
Description: Nike and Travis Scott teamed up once again to deliver the Nike Air Max 270 React Travis Scott, now available on StockX. This is the first time La Flame has put his signature touch on an Air Max silhouette. This Air Max 270 consists of a mesh upper with tumblr leather and suede overlays. A gold midsole, green tongue with attached lace locks, and Cactus Jack branding on the heel tabs completes the design. These sneakers released in May of 2020 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Victor Wembanyama Gold Panther
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Victor Wembanyama Gold Panther in Black, Bright Crimson, and Metallic Gold is a signature colorway for basketball's most physically extraordinary and generationally rare talent, the GT Cut 4's lateral quickness-focused construction meeting a color story that carries the Gold Panther concept's predatory and regal visual character across one of Nike Basketball's most technically complete cutting and change-of-direction platforms. Black and bright crimson create the aggressive visual foundation while metallic gold arrives as the precious and championship-adjacent accent that elevates the Gold Panther concept beyond standard dual-tone colorway territory into something that feels specific to Wembanyama's unique and almost mythological presence in the game. The GT Cut 4's full-length Zoom Air and carbon fiber shankplate deliver the responsive and stable cutting performance that Wembanyama's multi-positional and technically demanding game requires from his footwear at every possession. Victor Wembanyama's Nike relationship has generated immediate and genuine collector enthusiasm because his combination of elite performance credentials and genuinely unprecedented physical dimensions make every signature colorway feel historically significant in a way that most rookie athlete collaborations cannot claim until years of proven success have accumulated behind them. The Gold Panther concept suits Wembanyama's playing style perfectly, the predatory grace and rare combination of power and elegance that defines his game finding a natural visual equivalent in the metallic gold and black palette. At two hundred and ten dollars the GT Cut 4 Gold Panther delivers premium performance engineering in a signature colorway that documents one of basketball's most significant generational talents at the very beginning of what promises to be an extraordinary career. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Victor Wembanyama Gold Panther was released on May 20, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Model: Nike Air More Uptempo Slide OG
Display Name: Nike Air More Uptempo Slide OG Black White
Description: The Nike Air More Uptempo Slide OG Black White is a slide that borrows design inspiration from the Nike Air More Uptempo sneaker. The Air More Uptempo Slide OG Black White features black synthetic leather upper with white accents. The slide boosts a full-length foam midsole that provides lightweight cushioning and support. In addition, the foam midsole is designed to absorb impact and improve energy return, ensuring that every step feels comfortable and effortless. The sole has a flexible design that allows for natural movement of the foot and the outsole is made of durable rubber that provides grip and traction on various surfaces. We think the biggest draw of this shoe is the iconic "AIR" branding on the sides, which pays homage to the classic Nike Air Max design. This bold branding gives this sneaker a unique and unmistakable look. The Nike Air More Uptempo Slide OG Black White was released on April 4th, 2023 at a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Nike Dunk High Championship White Red
Description: Similar to classic Dunks from the mid-1980's, the Nike Dunk High Championship White Red carries a more traditional look with a two-tone color blocked leather upper. At the base, a matching Air sole completes the design. The Nike Dunk High Championship White Red released in May of 2022 and retailed for $115.

Model: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 OG
Display Name: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 OG Bred
Description: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 OG Bred stands as a cornerstone of modern skate sneaker history, celebrating the shoe that helped define Paul Rodriguezs legacy. The OG Bred colorway gives the silhouette a serious and timeless feel, grounding its performance roots in a look that feels raw and authentic. It represents a moment when skate shoes began to command respect across culture. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it symbolizes longevity and influence. The P Rod 1 remains a benchmark for skate design, and seeing it return in OG form feels meaningful rather than routine. It captures a period where skill, style, and credibility aligned perfectly, making it essential for fans of skate history. The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 OG Bred was released on 09/16/2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Clear Pink Solar Orange (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Clear Pink Solar Orange Womens delivers a bright and energetic take on the silhouette through its bold use of color. The clear pink base creates a soft foundation, while solar orange accents add a vivid and high contrast pop. The gum outsole completes the design, reinforcing its retro indoor roots. Fans of expressive colorways appreciate how this version brings a playful and standout look to a classic model. The contrast between pink and orange gives it a strong and eye catching presence. It is a sneaker that blends vibrant styling with timeless adidas design.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus PSG
Description: In collaboration with the Paris Saint Germain football club, once again, Nike plays tribute to these great players with the Nike Air Max Plus PSG sneaker, representing the teams home kit. This PSG tribute to Nike Air Max delivers a dynamic shoe in the team's traditional colors, blending midnight blue, red, white, and black with gold accents. The show mimics the lines of the teams jersey on the upper textile. The outer shoe boasts a gold Swoosh, while the structural cage of the shoe provides integrity, which is synonymous with this comfortable, highly supportive shoe. The PSG logo sits on the heel and insole, while Air cushioned units pump up the midsole of this durable and bouncy shoe. What we think is the standout feature of the Nike Air Max Plus PSG is the dynamic pattern displayed all over the upper, in a design that resembles waves in the three colors. When released on 1 August 2024, it was priced at $200.

Display Name: Rigorer AR1 Valentine's Day
Description: The Rigorer AR1 Valentine's Day is the first signature shoe released by Rigorer and Austin Reaves, an NBA player originally from Arkansas. The sneakers design mimics a silkworm cocoon and symbolizes Reaves professional and personal growth. It also pays homage to Rigorers Chinese roots. The upper features a combination of textile and cord embroidery, which allows the foot to breathe and is lightweight. The cord embroidery also provides support and helps the sneaker maintain its shape. TPU in the forefoot and heel provides stability and reduces the risk of rollovers. In terms of details, two patches decorate the heel area. One features a pink A with wings and the other displays a blooming rose. Our experts at StockX like the sneakers pink and white colorway. It celebrates Valentines Day and complements the rose details. The Rigorer AR1 Valentine's Day was released on February 10th, 2024, and retailed at $100.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Summit White Sail
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Summit White Sail offers a softer, more layered take on the iconic Jordan 1 low silhouette, built around a palette that feels clean but not flat. Summit white and sail tones create a subtle contrast across the upper, while multi color detailing adds just enough variation to keep the design visually engaging. The low cut shape keeps things versatile, staying true to the models everyday wear appeal while still carrying the weight of Jordan Brand history. Collectors gravitate toward pairs like this because they strike a balance between simplicity and detail. The muted tones make it easy to style, but the layered color approach gives it more personality than a standard white sneaker. It feels like a thoughtful update to a classic, maintaining the structure and familiarity of the Jordan 1 while introducing small shifts that keep the silhouette feeling fresh within an ever evolving lineup. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Summit White Sail was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentine's Day Pink Foam (2026) (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentines Day Pink Foam 2026 Womens delivers a soft and romantic take on the Air Force 1, using pink foam tones to create a gentle and expressive mood. The monochromatic approach gives the shoe a cohesive and polished feel, while subtle black accents add just enough contrast to keep the design grounded. It feels playful and elegant at the same time, designed to celebrate emotion without becoming overly themed. Collectors appreciate this release because it shows how the AF1 can shift tone so easily. The familiar shape anchors the design, while the color story brings warmth and personality that feels seasonal but still wearable year round. Fans love it as a Valentines Day release that focuses on feeling and color rather than novelty, making it a meaningful addition to lifestyle rotation. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentines Day Pink Foam 2026 Womens was released on January 14, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus South Beach
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus South Beach injects vibrant energy into a silhouette already known for bold expression. Black anchors the base, allowing aurora green and orange pulse accents to pop with unmistakable intensity. The color placement feels dynamic and playful, echoing the heat and color of coastal nightlife while staying grounded in the sculpted Air Max Plus design language. This pair connects with fans because the South Beach palette carries cultural nostalgia and confidence. It feels expressive and unapologetic, appealing to collectors who gravitate toward statement driven colorways. The contrast between dark structure and bright accents keeps the shoe balanced, making it feel bold without chaos. It stands as a reminder of how color can transform a familiar silhouette into something instantly recognizable and emotionally charged. The Nike Air Max Plus South Beach was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 International Running Pack The Sting
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 International Running Pack The Sting embodies race day innovation through a vibrant and performance driven color story. Multi Colour tones blend with Starfish and Aloe Verde accents across the engineered upper, creating a look that feels fast even at rest. The sculpted midsole and visible Air pods highlight the advanced cushioning system that defines the Alphafly series. The Alphafly has become synonymous with elite marathon performance, often seen on podiums during major international races. The Sting edition captures that global competitive spirit through bold color blocking and unmistakable speed focused design. For runners and collectors who follow cutting edge footwear, this release represents the forefront of Nike distance innovation. The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 International Running Pack The Sting was released on September 5, 2025 with a retail price of $305.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential Soft Pearl Smokey Blue
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Soft Pearl Smokey Blue offers a calm and refined take on one of Nikes most influential running silhouettes. Soft pearl tones create a smooth and neutral base, while smokey blue accents introduce a cool and understated contrast. Light khaki and black details add depth, allowing the layered panels and iconic Air Max shape to feel balanced and intentional rather than busy. Fans gravitate toward this colorway because it highlights the Air Max 1s design without overpowering it. The muted palette feels timeless, making it easy to wear across seasons while still offering character. Collectors appreciate how Nike continues to let thoughtful color combinations do the work, reinforcing the Air Max 1 as a staple that evolves quietly through nuance rather than dramatic reinvention. It is a release built on subtle confidence and enduring appeal. The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Soft Pearl Smokey Blue was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Anta Kai 3 Chinese New Year
Description: The Anta Kai 3 Chinese New Year celebrates tradition through a rich Beige base layered with Gold and Red accents. The warm palette feels festive and symbolic, while the modern silhouette keeps the design performance ready. Gold detailing adds a celebratory shine, and red elements inject energy that aligns with Lunar New Year themes. This release resonates because it ties cultural storytelling directly into Kyries evolving signature line. The beige foundation offers a refined backdrop for the brighter accents, creating balance across the upper. Fans appreciate when themed editions feel intentional rather than surface level. It is a thoughtful and expressive sneaker that blends heritage inspiration with contemporary court design. The Anta Kai 3 Chinese New Year was released on January 17, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Metallic Gold Black White
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid got the golden treatment in addition to the Jordan 1 High in 2020. This Jordan Mid Metallic Gold model dons a shiny and reflective upper that is sure to make anyone take a second look at your feet. The Air Jordan 1 Mid features metallic gold overlays with a mix of smooth white leather. A quintessential Nike Swoosh in black provides a contrast to the upper. A black and white Jumpman logo appears on the tongue tag in typical Jordan Mid fashion. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Metallic Gold released in November of 2020 and retailed for $130.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 White Red
Description: The New Balance 9060 White Red injects classic athletic energy into the futuristic 9060 through a crisp and familiar color story. White forms a clean foundation, while red accents add urgency and contrast that recall vintage performance aesthetics. The sculpted sole and layered construction still feel forward looking, creating a blend of old school sport influence and modern design language. Fans gravitate toward this release because it feels energetic without being loud. The color blocking highlights the silhouettes movement and flow, making it feel dynamic and confident on foot. Collectors appreciate how it bridges heritage and innovation, offering a 9060 that feels sporty, expressive, and easy to integrate into everyday rotation while still carrying strong visual presence. The New Balance 9060 White Red was released on April 15, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: New Balance Abzorb 2000 Black
Description: The New Balance Abzorb 2000 Black pushes the brand further into futuristic design territory with a silhouette that emphasizes cushioning, structure, and bold proportions. The all black colorway gives the sneaker a sleek and modern look, allowing the sculpted midsole and layered upper to stand out without distraction. Built around Abzorb cushioning, the model focuses on impact absorption and comfort, reinforcing New Balances commitment to performance driven innovation. Fans gravitate toward newer silhouettes like this because they represent the next phase of New Balance design beyond traditional retro runners. The black execution adds versatility, making the shoe easy to wear while still maintaining a distinct presence due to its exaggerated shape. The midsole construction becomes a focal point, giving the sneaker a futuristic identity that contrasts with the brands heritage offerings. For collectors, models like the Abzorb 2000 highlight New Balances ability to evolve and experiment while staying rooted in comfort and technical performance. The New Balance Abzorb 2000 Black was released on February 23, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Salomon XT-4 OG White Lunar Rock
Description: The Salomon XT-4 OG White Lunar Rock takes a classic rugged sports shoe silhouette and enhances it with Salomon's greatest performance features. The White Lunar Rock Salomon XT-4 OG features a white-to-gray gradient mesh upper designed with SensiFit technology to cradle the foot for a snug, practically custom fit. Overlays of abrasion-resistant TPU add to the durability of this shoe. Black Salomon branding hits the side panel, toe cap, heel, and gray mudguard. A Quicklace closure with a lace pocket crosses over a blue, red, and yellow tongue that also sports XT branding. A white padded sock liner surrounds a die-cut OrthoLite insole that delivers supreme comfort. What we appreciate most about this rugged sneaker is the high-octane sole. Under the upper, a full-length Agile Chassis Skeleton helps deliver a stabilized ride. A white and gray dual-density EVA midsole offers soft cushioning, while a black and white Mud Contagrip Rubber outsole is designed for traction on any surface. The Salomon XT-4 OG White Lunar Rock was released on February 7, 2023, for $220 retail.

Display Name: Nike Shox TL Sunrise
Description: The Nike Shox TL Sunrise is a sleek and stylish sneaker that combines comfort and performance. The upper is made of a breathable mesh material that provides ventilation and support, while the iconic Shox technology in the sole offers responsive cushioning and shock absorption. The colorway features a gradient of orange and yellow hues, reminiscent of a sunrise, with black accents on the Swoosh and heel. Released on August 1st, 2019, the Nike Shox TL Sunrise retails for $170. Whether you're hitting the gym or running errands, these sneakers are sure to turn heads and keep your feet feeling great.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Volt Tint Lime Blast Sapphire
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus in Volt Tint, Lime Blast, Sapphire, and Black Spruce is the most chromatically energetic and visually bold colorway in the Vomero Plus April 2026 release window, pairing the near-neon brightness of volt tint and lime blast with the deep and saturated richness of sapphire to create a color combination that makes the platform's substantial cushioning architecture feel as visually dynamic and high-energy as its physical stack height suggests it should be. Volt tint leads the palette with the slightly softened neon quality that distinguishes it from full-intensity volt while maintaining the attention-commanding brightness that makes the shoe immediately distinctive in any environment, while lime blast adds a complementary yellow-green energy that keeps the palette vivid across multiple color registers simultaneously. Sapphire provides the cool and deep contrast that prevents the volt and lime combination from reading as flat or two-dimensional, the rich blue creating a visual weight and tonal counterpoint that completes the color story with genuine sophistication. Vomero Plus releases in multi-color bold palette directions appeal to the running lifestyle collector who wants their daily wear footwear to carry maximum visual energy and color confidence, understanding that the platform's premium cushioning and construction quality provides the functional foundation that allows even the most chromatically ambitious colorways to succeed as serious daily wear acquisitions rather than display-only collector pieces. Volt tint and sapphire is a particularly successful color pairing for a cushioned running lifestyle silhouette because the two tones occupy completely opposite ends of the color temperature spectrum, the warm neon and cool deep blue creating the kind of high-contrast chromatic tension that makes a shoe visually memorable from any distance and in any lighting condition. At one hundred and eighty dollars the Vomero Plus in Volt Tint, Lime Blast, and Sapphire delivers the platform's premium daily wear credentials in its most visually bold and chromatically committed seasonal expression. The Nike Vomero Plus in Volt Tint, Lime Blast, and Sapphire was released on April 20, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Premium Medium Olive Hemp
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Premium Medium Olive Hemp offers a deluxe version of the beloved silhouette designed by Peter Moore. Enjoy undeniable style and heritage mojo with every step you take and this iconic pair of kicks. The upper of this low-top features a base of smooth white leather sporting the iconic perforations on the toebox that enhance air flow and overall foot comfort. Olive-colored nubuck forms the overlays at the heel, collar, eyestays, vamp, and toecap. Peach-beige leather is used to construct the branded heel tab and the Nike Swoosh that courses across the side panel. Olive mesh forms the sock liner, while Peach-beige appears once again on the branded tongue tag. This refined sneaker rides on an outsole of olive rubber featuring concentric circles, dynamic grooves, and little stars to form its traction pattern. The aspect of this sneaker we enjoy the most is the vintage-looking midsole. The off-white side walls with tonal stitching offer comfort as well as retro vibes. The Nike Dunk Low Premium Medium Olive Hemp was released on July 4, 2024, for an original retail price of $125.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Wrought Iron Urban Chic
Description: The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex in Wrought Iron and Urban Chic applies GORE-TEX waterproof protection to the XT-6's trail running-derived silhouette, featuring a closed mesh upper with tighter chain-link TPU detailing in place of the standard XT-6's more open mesh construction, Sedona Sage accent tones completing the earthy, muted palette, a breathable textile liner inside the waterproof membrane, Salomon's Coated Quicklace system with lace pocket, a Mud Contragrip rubber outsole for maximum stability across wet and mixed terrain, and a molded OrthoLite sockliner for cushioning throughout the day. The GORE-TEX membrane addition to the XT-6 platform specifically uses a PFC-free ePE membrane construction, Salomon's environmentally updated approach to waterproofing that removes perfluorocarbon chemicals while maintaining the waterproof breathability that the GORE-TEX standard requires across variable weather conditions. The Wrought Iron and Urban Chic palette applies an industrial, muted green-grey color language to the XT-6 Gore-Tex that sits within the earthy, functional color aesthetic that has defined Salomon's most consistently popular general release colorways since the XT-6 moved from trail performance into lifestyle territory, making this colorway one of the most versatile and most broadly wearable in the Gore-Tex variant's palette range. Part of Salomon's Icon Capsule SS26 alongside the XT-Whisper. Released March 1, 2026 at $200 retail through Salomon and select retailers globally with style code L47991700. The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Wrought Iron Urban Chic was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Game Royal
Description: The Game Royal Jordan 1 Mid shows off vivid Game Royal overlays on a white leather base, with a black leather Swoosh, and is set on top of a white midsole with a matching Game Royal outsole. Game Royal 1 Mid by Jordan has a tumbled white leather base with smooth Game Royal overlays on the eyestays, heel, and ankle collar. A black leather Swoosh sits on the lateral side, and the toe box is perforated for ventilation. The midsole uses Air cushioning within a white foam unit, while the rubber outsole in Game Royal has traction patterns inherited from the original AJ 1 design. The model uses flat white laces and a woven Jumpman tongue label. One of the things we love about Game Royal Jordan 1 Mid is its Air-sole unit, which offers consistent underfoot cushioning during play or casual wear. We also like the Air Jordan logo stitched on the side for a little contrast. It retailed at $125 on October 1, 2024.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus White Fire Pink Hyper Crimson (Women's)
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus White Fire Pink Hyper Crimson Womens pushes the silhouette into a brighter and more energetic space, using a white base paired with fire pink and hyper crimson accents that immediately draw attention. The layered construction highlights the structure of the shoe, while the cushioning system keeps it focused on performance and comfort. The color combination gives it a lively and modern feel. What makes this pair appealing is its balance between clean foundation and bold detailing. The white base keeps it wearable, while the vibrant accents add personality that stands out during movement. Nike continues to refine its running lineup through both design and technology, and this release reflects that approach clearly. It is a dynamic option for those who want performance with a strong visual identity. The Nike Vomero Plus White Fire Pink Hyper Crimson Womens was released on September 30, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Triumph 4 Jae Tips Flowers Grow Uptown Sugar Maple
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Triumph 4 Jae Tips Flowers Grow Uptown Sugar Maple channels earthy warmth through a colorful lens. Dressed in Green with Pink and Multi Color accents, the upper balances natural tones with expressive contrast. The sculpted sole and ProGrid cushioning preserve the models performance DNA. Sugar Maple feels grounded yet lively, reflecting the broader theme of growth and community within the collaboration. The mix of green and pink creates depth and vibrancy across the layered construction. It stands as another bold chapter in the Flowers Grow Uptown series, blending heritage running aesthetics with creative storytelling. The Saucony ProGrid Triumph 4 Jae Tips Flowers Grow Uptown Sugar Maple was released on October 10, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Cool Grey
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Low Cool Grey is the perfect pair for completing any groutfit. Taking the classic retro colorway from 2001 and converting it into a low-top, this pair comes in a medium grey, white and gunsmoke colorway. These shoes sport a grey-based suede and patent leather upper, with white detailing and a full icy blue translucent outsole. Releasing in April of 2018, they came in a full family run of sizes. So when someone asks whats cooler than being cool? The Air Jordan 11 Low Cool Greys is your answer.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Off-White Pine Green
Description: Virgil Abloh pays homage to skate cultures adoption of 1980s Nike Basketball silhouettes with the Nike Dunk Low Off-White Pine Green, now available on StockX. This colorway was not a part of the original Be True To Your School collection in 1985; instead, it derives from the Gorge Green colorway that debuted in 2003 as part of a general release. This Dunk Low is comprised of a white leather upper with pine green overlays. A unique secondary lacing system, zip-ties, and signature Off-White text on the sides completes the design. These sneakers released in December of 2019 for $170.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Pink White (GS)
Description: The New Balance 9060 Pink White (GS) is a stylish and comfortable sneaker designed for kids. This eye-catching model features a vibrant pink upper complemented by crisp white accents, creating a fresh and playful look. The shoe's construction combines premium materials and innovative technology, ensuring durability and support for growing feet. Inspired by New Balance's heritage designs, the 9060 model offers a modern twist on classic running silhouettes. The chunky sole provides excellent cushioning and stability, while the breathable upper keeps young feet cool and comfortable throughout the day. With its blend of style and functionality, this sneaker is perfect for active kids who want to make a fashion statement. We at StockX believe this product is great for everyday wear, offering both comfort and trendy aesthetics that appeal to fashion-forward youth.

Model: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB
Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Purple Dynasty
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Purple Dynasty wraps the extended midsole silhouette in layered shades of Purple Dynasty, Fierce Purple, and Sanded Purple. The engineered mesh upper stays true to the EM construction, while the Protro update ensures modern responsiveness underfoot. The tonal purple execution gives the shoe depth without relying on heavy contrast. The Kobe 9 marked a turning point with its bold design language and focus on precision, and the Protro treatment keeps that innovation alive. Purple has long been tied to Kobe legacy, making this Team Bank edition feel especially fitting. For players who appreciate performance heritage wrapped in strong identity, this pair delivers both symbolism and function. The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Purple Dynasty was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary (TD)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary (TD) is a Special Project (SP) sneaker launched by American rapper Travis Scott and Jordan Brand. This means its crafted in the Nike lab using premium materials and design patterns. This low-top sneaker boasts an all-leather upper construction with a light silver base and overlays in bright Canary. Although the reinforced stitching is tonal, it appears oversized due to the sneakers small size. Large Swoosh logos in Racer Blue check across the side panels, while a woven tongue tag bears "NIKE" lettering in crimson. The upper sits on a durable rubber outsole, which features a standard traction pattern and a Gum Medium Brown hue. Our StockX experts like Travis Scotts CACTUS JACK branding, which can be found beneath the Swoosh, on the inner side panel, in crimson ink. The toddler-sized Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Canary (TD) was launched on May 25, 2024, and sold for $50.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro White Thunder (PS)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro White Thunder (PS) adds a monochromatic colorway of black and white to the beloved Jordan Brand silhouette from 1989. The black upper is crafted from mesh and nubuck, which gives the White Thunder (PS) Jordan 4 Retro sneaker a premium, velvety feel. Additional black details can be found on part of the midsole, the long tongue, and the plastic wings. Pops of white decorate the midsole, the TPU eyelets, and the Jumpman logo. The signature molded mesh on the side panels stands out because it has a looser weave than the mesh used on many Air Jordan 4 models. Another notable feature is the foam midsole that cushions against impact. Our experts at StockX like the oversized, white Jumpman logo on the heel, which is a nod to Michael Jordans gravity-defying athletic skills. The preschool-sized Jordan 4 Retro White Thunder (PS) was released on August 24, 2024, and sold for $100.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Off-White
Description: While the all-white canvas upper of the Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70s Hi Off-White draws similarities to classic non-collaborative colorways, there are many points of differentiation. To start, the black and white caution tape-themed midsole nods to one of Off-Whites key design motifs. Next, "Off-White for CONVERSE CHUCK TAYLOR ALL-STAR Malden, Massachusetts USA c. 1917" is screen printed on the inside medial panel of the upper. To round out this Off-White Chuck Taylor, a modified star patch appears on the ankle and a signature orange zip-tie is hooked to the laces. The Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70s Hi Off-White originally released in October of 2018, and restocked in April of 2021, at a retail of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Phantom (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 12 Retro Phantom (Women's) is a stunning addition to the iconic Air Jordan lineup. This sleek sneaker features a pristine white leather upper accented with metallic gold detailing, creating a luxurious and eye-catching look. The classic silhouette of the Jordan 12 is enhanced by the signature mudguard that wraps around the shoe, providing both style and durability. The Phantom colorway offers a fresh and modern take on the timeless design, making it a versatile choice for any outfit. Comfort and performance are at the forefront of this design, with Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot and full-length air sole unit providing responsive support. The premium materials and expert craftsmanship ensure long-lasting wear, while the rubber outsole with its distinctive herringbone pattern offers excellent traction on various surfaces. The Jordan 12 Retro Phantom (Women's) is not just a fashion statement, but a high-performance sneaker that lives up to the Jordan brand's legacy of quality and innovation. Our experts state this product is great for those seeking a blend of style and comfort in their everyday footwear.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Green Glow
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Green Glow is an electrifying addition to the Jordan lineage, incorporating a mesmerizing green glow color treatment that first captivated fans on the Jordan 4. This new colorway, set against a backdrop of black, green glow, wolf grey, and white, is a bold reinterpretation of the iconic Jordan 3 silhouette. Designed for the sneaker aficionado who appreciates the blend of classic design and innovative accents, this sneaker is a testament to Jordan Brand's commitment to evolution while honoring its heritage. Since its original release, the Jordan 3 has been celebrated for its revolutionary design, including the introduction of the visible Air unit and the elephant print detailing. The Green Glow version elevates the classic with its vibrant accents, offering a fresh take on the model's celebrated features. It's a sneaker that bridges the past and the present, appealing to both long-time Jordan enthusiasts and a new generation seeking to make a statement with their footwear. Launched on March 16, 2024, for $200, the Air Jordan 3 Retro Green Glow quickly lit up the sneaker community, becoming a must-have for collectors and style trendsetters. Its release is celebrated as a moment when the iconic Jordan 3 silhouette was reimagined with a bold, new colorway, inviting wearers to step into the glow of Jordan Brand's innovative legacy.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro 285
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Sail Off White delivers a refined and minimalist take on one of Jordan Brands most iconic designs. Sail and off white tones soften the silhouette, allowing the shape and materials to take center stage. Subtle newsprint details and sport royal accents add depth and contrast, creating a look that feels elevated without relying on bold color blocking. Fans gravitate toward this pair because it highlights the Jordan 11s elegance and versatility. The muted palette makes it adaptable across styles while still feeling special and intentional. Collectors value how the restrained color story brings out the craftsmanship and proportions of the silhouette, reinforcing why the Jordan 11 continues to hold such a powerful place in sneaker culture. It feels timeless, calm, and quietly confident. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Sail Off White was released on November 22, 2025 with a retail price of $250.

Display Name: Anta Kai 1 Yin Triple Black
Description: The Anta Kai 1 Triple Black is a collaboration between NBA player Kyrie Irving and Anta, a sportswear label based in China. The Triple Black Anta Kai 1 pays homage to Irvings graceful yet powerful style of play through its sleek design and graphics, including a silver shield motif on the tongue. The silver shield provides a pop of metallic against the all-black upper, midsole, and outsole. The minimalist upper is made from a lightweight synthetic material and doesnt include the intricate patterns found on other Anta Kai 1 models. However, a small, silver "11" can be found on the forefoot, representing Irvings preferred jersey number. Something that makes this sneaker stand out is the dual closure system. It features a traditional lace closure and a strap that crosses the forefoot. Our experts at StockX like the oversized pull tab on the heel because it assists with applying and removing the sneaker. The Anta Kai 1 Triple Black was released on June 3, 2024, and retailed for $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Black Phantom
Description: Travis Scott closed out 2022 with the return of his signature Jordan 1 Low, this time in a new Black Phantom colorway. The silhouette returned with his signature backwards Nike Swoosh but with a new contrast stitch design. The all black nubuck sneakers feature a Nike Air logo on the tongue and an Air Jordan Wings logo on the right heel tab. Red, Black, and White/Black laces are included and an embroidered Bee is located on the heel tab of the left sneaker inspired by Travis daughter, Stormi. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Black Phantom released December 15, 2022 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Bloodline
Description: Jordan Brand pays homage to where the legacy began with the Jordan 1 Retro High Bloodline, now available on StockX. Reminiscent of the Black Toe, this model sports black and red to pay tribute to the Chicago Bulls. This Jordan 1 features a white leather upper with black overlays and a red trimming that matches the laces and outsole. "Nike Air" tongues and "Who Said Man Was Not Meant To Fly" printed on the insoles completes the design. These sneakers released in November of 2019 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog South Park Kenny
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog South Park Kenny captures irreverent humor through one of animations most recognizable characters. Orange tones dominate the clog, referencing Kennys signature parka, while layered details bring the South Park connection to life in a way that feels playful and intentional. The familiar Crocs shape provides a simple base for the character driven design to shine. This pair connects with fans because it reflects South Parks unapologetic cultural impact. It feels bold, nostalgic, and slightly absurd in the best way, making it appealing to collectors who enjoy footwear as a form of expression. Crocs continues to succeed by leaning into collaborations like this, turning comfort driven design into conversation pieces that celebrate personality, humor, and fandom without restraint. The Crocs Classic Clog South Park Kenny was released on September 26, 2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Dark Pony
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Dark Pony brings depth and texture to the Jordan 1 Mid through a colorway that feels rich and expressive without losing balance. The dark pony tones add warmth and character, giving the shoe a slightly rugged personality that stands apart from cleaner white based releases. The mid cut shape keeps the look structured and confident, making it feel solid and intentional rather than experimental. Fans appreciate this release because it shows how material and color choices can elevate a familiar silhouette. The Jordan 1 Mid SE platform allows for subtle design exploration, and this version feels crafted for people who enjoy sneakers with mood and presence. Collectors gravitate toward it as a lifestyle driven Jordan that still carries basketball DNA, offering something distinctive that fits easily into rotation while feeling more expressive than standard colorways. The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Dark Pony was released on February 20, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Olive (2024)
Description: The Jordan 5 Retro Olive (2024) is an updated relaunch of the Jordan 5 Retro Olive that made its debut in 2006. The 2024 version features an upper made of Army Olive suede with mesh peeking through cutouts on the side panels. The plastic eyestays and laces also come in Army Olive. Splashes of Solar Orange provide contrast on the collar, the inside of the tongue, and the midsole. The Jumpman logos stitched across the heel and displayed on the tongue also come in Solar Orange. Other eye-catching features include the jagged design across the midsole, which resembles sharp teeth. Like other Jordan 5 Retro Models, the Olive (2024) version boasts visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel. Something our StockX experts like is the semi-transparent outsole, which matches the clear plastic toggle on the laces. The Jordan 5 Retro Olive (2024) was released on March 2nd, 2024, and retailed at $210.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Top 3
Description: Jordan Brand celebrated the 30th Anniversary of the Jordan 5 by releasing the Jordan 5 Top 3, now available on StockX. This colorway is a mash-up of some of the most memorable Jordan 5 colorways to ever release, featuring design elements from Fire Red, Metallic, and Grape colorways. This Jordan 5 is composed of a black nubuck suede upper with fire red detailing and translucent mesh underlays. A grape and aqua tongue, fire red and cement midsole, and classic translucent outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in May of 2020 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Brave Blue

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Travis Scott

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Family Affair (GS)

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Midnight Navy University Blue

Display Name: adidas Ballerina Bad Bunny Off White Black Gum

Display Name: Converse SHAI 001 Blush

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Black Sail Light British Tan
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Black Sail Light British Tan delivers a clean and understated take on one of Jordan Brands most versatile silhouettes. Display Name: Nike Sabrina 3 LX All-Star Warning Label (Women's)

Display Name: New Balance 1906L Red Croc
Description: The New Balance 1906L Red Croc reimagines the performance runner through bold texture and saturated color. Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Bred (2017)
Description: The Air Jordan 13 Retro Bred 2017 is a high-top variation added to the of the Air Jordan catalog.
