Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 College Grey
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 College Grey leans into a fully tonal approach, covering the silhouette in a consistent grey that highlights its shape rather than relying on contrast. The monochrome execution gives the shoe a clean and modern feel, while still maintaining the structure that defines the Air Force 1. It feels minimal but intentional. This version stands out because of its simplicity. The all grey palette makes it easy to style while still offering a different look compared to more traditional releases. It reflects how small changes in color can completely shift the feel of a classic sneaker. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 College Grey was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 5 Year of the Mamba Eggplant (GS)
Description: The Nike Kobe 5 Year of the Mamba Eggplant (GS) is a striking tribute to the legendary Kobe Bryant, designed specifically for young athletes. This Grade School edition showcases a bold eggplant purple upper, accented with sleek black details and luxurious metallic gold accents. The shoe's design seamlessly blends style and performance, featuring Nike's innovative technologies to provide superior comfort and support on the court. Engineered with the needs of growing athletes in mind, this Kobe 5 model offers exceptional responsiveness and lightweight construction. The shoe's low-profile silhouette allows for quick cuts and agile movements, while the durable outsole ensures excellent traction during intense gameplay. With its eye-catching colorway and premium materials, this sneaker is not only a high-performance basketball shoe but also a fashionable statement piece for young Kobe fans. Us at StockX believe this product is great for aspiring young basketball players who want to emulate Kobe's on-court excellence while showcasing their style off the court.

Model: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP
Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP A Ma Maniére White Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP A Ma Maniére White Metallic Silver is the lighter counterpart in A Ma Maniére's two piece "Timing Is Everything" collection, and it carries the same depth of intention wrapped in a cleaner, more luminous shell. Summit White takes over the engineered mesh and knit upper, creating a base that feels refined and elevated rather than stark, with Metallic Silver hitting the Swoosh and co branded details in a way that catches light with quiet confidence. Burgundy Crush and Taupe Grey bleed into the midsole paneling, maintaining the tonal connection to its darker sibling while giving this colorway its own distinct identity rooted in warmth and understated luxury. A Ma Maniére has always had a talent for making collaboration feel like a personal statement rather than a commercial one, and this Pegasus Premium continues that tradition. The Summit White base allows the materials and construction details to speak louder than the colorway itself, letting the premium knit texture, suede overlays, and aged midsole treatment do the storytelling. The same triple stack cushioning platform of ZoomX foam, full length Air Zoom, and ReactX foam lives underfoot, which means the shoe pulls double duty as a serious runner and a piece that belongs in a rotation of carefully chosen pairs. Both colorways in this pack feel like a natural next chapter for a boutique that has always moved with purpose. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SP A Ma Maniére White Metallic Silver was released on June 19, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Linen Canvas
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Linen Canvas is a low top basketball sneaker featuring an upper in linen canvas fabric with a natural linen shade of tan. The Nike Swoosh adorns the sides in Atmosphere Pink leather, coordinating with the outsole and Air branding on the midsole. A white midsole, tongue, and laces complete the aesthetic. The Air Force 1 is one of American shoe brand Nikes most storied styles, having been immortalized in songs and music videos. Remaining in production since 1982, the AF1 is prime for reinvention by Nikes creative team, and a fabric upper variation is among the rarest fabrications of the style. In our opinion, the best feature of the Air Force 1 Linen is its coordinated blend of materials, which gives it a clean, fresh look. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Linen Canvas released on March 20, 2025, and retailed for $130.

Display Name: Nike Roshe Run Wolf Grey
Description: The Nike Roshe Run Wolf Grey features a low-top silhouette in a wolf grey and white color scheme. The Wolf Grey Nike Roshe Run has an upper that is crafted from a mix of mesh and synthetic materials, which provides breathability and durability. The shoe features a lace-up closure system, allowing for a personalized and secure fit. In addition, the sneaker boasts a cushioned midsole, providing comfort and support. The shoe also has a padded collar and tongue, offering extra comfort and fit. The outsole of the shoe is made from a durable rubber material, offering traction and durability. There is a pull strap on the tongue and heel, providing an adjustable fit. The shoe's design also features the trademark Nike Swoosh on the sides. What we love about this sneaker is its captivating colorway. The distinct Wolf Grey, contrasted by white accents, exudes an understated sophistication that effortlessly creates a bold look. The Nike Roshe Run Wolf Grey was released on December 23, 2014, at a retail price of $75.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Lakers
Description: The Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Lakers is a basketball shoe that pays homage to the iconic NBA team  the Los Angeles Lakers. The Air Max Uptempo 95 Lakers comes in a predominantly white colorway, which is complemented by Amarillo and Court Purple Swooshes. The midsole incorporates Nike's Air Max technology, providing superior cushioning and impact resistance for players on the court. The Air Max unit is in the heel of the sneaker, helping to reduce the force of impact on the player's feet and joints, reducing injury risk. The outsole is made with solid rubber, providing a durable and long-lasting grip that helps players maintain traction on the court. Our experts say that one of the distinguishing features of the Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Lakers is the use of premium materials. The shoe is crafted from leather and synthetic nubuck materials that are both durable and stylish. The sneaker was released on August 28th, 2019, at a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Dn8 Black Green Strike
Description: The Nike Air Max Dn8 Black Green Strike is a sneaker featuring a bold aesthetic in Black, Green Strike, and Volt. American footwear brand Nike has adhered to their philosophy of radical innovation since the 1980s. Building on the Air Max legacy that the brand pioneered in 1987, the Air Max Dn8 incorporates Nikes Dynamic Air system, composed of transparent Air tubes within the sole, while compressing the shoes performance functionality aesthetically into a streamlined silhouette. The Black Green Strike Nike Air Max Dn8's upper gradients are Green Strike and Volt mesh fabric above gradient Black diagonal stripes. The rear heel, midsole, and lace panel balance the colorway in Black, accented by the coordinating Nike Swoosh and eight insole pressurized Air tubes in Volt. Our StockX experts feel that the best feature of the Air Max Dn8 is its color palette, which emphasizes the Dn8s aerodynamics. The Nike Air Max Dn8 Black Green Strike released on March 26, 2025, and retailed at $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Army Olive
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Army Olive brings a more rugged and understated tone to the classic silhouette, using an army olive upper that shifts the shoe away from its usual bright white look. The darker palette gives it a slightly utilitarian feel, while black accents help define the structure and keep the design balanced. It keeps the same shape that has made the Air Force 1 a staple for decades. This pair stands out because of how easily it fits into everyday wear while offering something different from the standard colorways. The muted tones make it versatile, especially for those who prefer more grounded palettes. It is a subtle update that still carries the full identity of the model. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Army Olive was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Coral
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Coral brings early two thousands running energy back into focus through a colorway that balances metallic tones with vibrant accents. The silver base gives the sneaker a technical and futuristic feel, while coral hits add contrast that brings warmth and personality to the design. Fans gravitate toward metallic runners because they reflect the era when performance footwear embraced bold materials and visible structure. The coral accents give this version a more expressive look while still maintaining balance with the neutral silver tones. The ProGrid cushioning system reinforces the shoes comfort and stability, making it practical for everyday wear. For collectors, pairs like this highlight the continued relevance of retro running silhouettes, where color and material play a key role in keeping classic designs fresh. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Silver Coral was released on December 1, 2024 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: New Balance 480 Triple White
Description: The New Balance 480 Triple White takes inspiration from the brand's 80s basketball heritage, offering a clean, retro court look that prioritizes simplicity. The upper is constructed from premium, durable leather in a monochromatic White/White finish, featuring a wide-bore mesh tongue for added breathability. The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Off White Moon Particle Dark Raisin was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low UNC (2021)
