Description: The Nike Air Max Plus 7 Varsity Maize pushes the TN lineage forward with a bold color execution that immediately commands attention. The varsity maize upper dominates the design, creating a bright and energetic base that is balanced by white and black accents throughout the structure. Metallic silver elements add a subtle edge, enhancing the futuristic feel that has always defined the Air Max Plus series. Fans of the silhouette appreciate how this version keeps the aggressive lines and tuned air identity intact while leaning heavily into color. The intensity of the yellow tone makes it a standout within the lineup, offering something that feels loud without losing structure. It remains rooted in the DNA of the original while continuing to evolve visually for a new generation of wearers. The Nike Air Max Plus 7 Varsity Maize was released on October 13, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Court Purple
Description: What screams both royalty and NBAs rookie of year in 1985? The Air Jordan 1 Retro High Court Purple. Showcasing a magical splash of color, these shoes have a leather upper in black, sail, and court purple. Showing similarities with the "Bred Toe", the Air Jordan 1 Retro has a black "Swoosh" with a white midsole and court purple sole. This silhouette released in September 2018 and retailed at $160. If youre looking to add to your sneaker collection, place an Ask or Bid at StockX.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Fragment x Travis Scott
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Fragment Design x Travis Scott nods to the original 2016 Air Jordan 1 Fragment with its simple color blocking. It features a smooth white leather upper with black and royal blue leather overlays. From there, a signature reversed Swoosh and yellowed soles add a Cactus Jack flair to the classic silhouette. The Air Jordan 1 Low Fragment Design x Travis Scott released in August of 2021 and retailed for $150.

Display Name: New Balance T500 Arid Stone Sea Salt Angora
Description: The New Balance T500 Arid Stone/Sea Salt/Angora is a men's lifestyle sneaker from New Balance's ongoing T500 program, retailing at $110 with style code CT500CJ, confirmed by StockX and multiple authorized retailers. As confirmed by ModeSens, Amazon, and multiple retail product descriptions, the New Balance T500 was originally released in 1982 to dominate the tennis court, featuring a pigskin suede and nubuck construction with a perforated toebox for improved ventilation, New Balance wordmark branding at the heel, a woven tongue label, a polyurethane midsole for a smooth ride, a countered polyurethane footbed for soft supportive fit, and a herringbone outsole pattern with a pivot circle for optimum traction and durability. The Odd Ball and ModeSens extended description confirmed the gum midsole offers an understated hint of 1980s tech that stands out from the vulcanized soles of older court models, connecting the reintroduced T500 to its on-court heritage while positioning it firmly in the lifestyle and off-court sneaker market. The Arid Stone/Sea Salt/Angora colorway applies the warm, desert-inspired arid stone as the primary tone across the pigskin suede and nubuck upper, with sea salt and angora as the complementary accent colors creating a three-tone neutral earth palette that is the most broadly wearable and most seasonally flexible execution of the T500 across its colorway range. Retail price $110. The New Balance T500 Arid Stone/Sea Salt/Angora is the CT500CJ pigskin-suede-and-nubuck perforated-toebox herringbone-outsole pivot-circle PU-midsole 1982-tennis-heritage lifestyle sneaker for the New Balance collector who wants the warm three-tone desert-neutral palette in the most broadly wearable arid stone ground from the New Balance T500 multi-colorway program. The New Balance T500 Arid Stone/Sea Salt/Angora has a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Fly 6 White Pure Platinum Obsidian Mist Gridiron
Description: The Nike Zoom Fly 6 White Pure Platinum Obsidian Mist Gridiron continues Nikes focus on performance running, combining lightweight construction with a clean and layered color palette. White and pure platinum form a crisp base, while obsidian mist and gridiron accents add depth that highlights the streamlined silhouette. This pair stands out because it is built for speed while maintaining a refined look. The Zoom Fly line has always balanced performance and style, and this version reinforces that with a colorway that feels both technical and wearable. Fans appreciate how it delivers efficiency without sacrificing visual appeal. The Nike Zoom Fly 6 White Pure Platinum Obsidian Mist Gridiron was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low Swooshless Triple White (2025)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low Swooshless Triple White 2025 strips the icon down to its purest form. Covered entirely in White, the low cut silhouette removes the traditional side Swoosh, creating a minimal and almost conceptual take on the classic design. The clean leather upper and simple cupsole keep the focus on shape and proportion. Going Swooshless shifts attention to the construction and legacy of the AJ1 itself. The triple white palette enhances that stripped back aesthetic, making it feel sleek and versatile. It is a subtle but bold reinterpretation, appealing to collectors who appreciate quiet design changes within a legendary silhouette. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low Swooshless Triple White 2025 was released on July 16, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Rookie of the Year
Description: What better way to celebrate MJs rookie of the year award than clinching the Jordan 1 Retro High Rookie of the Year. This unique shoe comes with a white and harvest leather upper, black Nike "Swoosh", white midsole, and a black sole. While taking a trip down memory lane, the sneaker released in October 2018 and retailed for $160. Be as unstoppable as Jordan was in 1985 and place a Bid on StockX now.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Vamps
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Vamps reimagines the iconic basketball silhouette with bold colors and premium detailing. This fresh iteration stays true to the classic Air Force 1 legacy while introducing striking design updates. The Vamps Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 by Nike features a black-suede upper paired with contrasting deep red on the sole, heel, and side Swoosh. The low-top design incorporates perforations on the toe box for breathability and a padded collar for comfort. On the side of the heel of the midsole, there's a raised "Air" logo in black. The durable rubber outsole and heritage-inspired design are a nod to Nikes rich basketball history. One thing we love about the Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Vamps is its unique color scheme that gives a fresh twist to a classic shoe. We also value the durable suede construction, which balances style and longevity. Released on October 5, 2024, this model retailed at $115.

Display Name: Nike NOCTA Glide Drake Black
Description: The Nike NOCTA Glide Drake Black is a special edition sneaker released as part of a collaborative effort between Nike and Canadian rapper and musician Drake that was included in the NOCTA collection. The Nike NOCTA Glide features a black and white color scheme with a significant part of the upper appearing in black while the midsole is white and the outsole is translucent grey with a touch of orange on the underfoot. It also has carbon-inspired mudguards running across both side panels and a white chunky midsole providing reinforcement on the shoe. Some of the branding details on the shoe include Nike branding on the eyestays and the NOCTA trident logo and glossy NOCTA badges on the tongue. What our experts love about the Nike NOCTA Glide Drake Black is the contemporary design. The carbon-inspired mudguards add a unique style to the shoes while the pods on the midsole offer structural support. The shoes were initially released at the retail price of $160 on the 29th of June, 2023.

Display Name: Nike V2K Run Mink Brown Ironstone Team Anthracite (Women's)
Description: The Nike V2K Run Mink Brown Ironstone Team Anthracite Womens draws from early 2000s running aesthetics, combining layered panels with a muted earthy palette that feels both retro and current. Mink brown and ironstone tones create depth across the upper, while anthracite accents add contrast that sharpens the overall design. The silhouette leans into that vintage running shape, giving it a familiar but updated feel. Fans of retro runners gravitate toward models like this because they balance nostalgia with modern wearability. The colorway keeps it versatile, while the layered construction adds enough detail to stand out. It is a sneaker that reflects the ongoing return of early running styles, offering a grounded option that still feels fresh within todays landscape. The Nike V2K Run Mink Brown Ironstone Team Anthracite Womens was released on January 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Premium White Snakeskin
Description: Bringing a high-fashion, exotic edge to the original 1987 runner, the Nike Air Max 1 Premium White Snakeskin features a premium material execution. The design features a sophisticated White/White/Pure Platinum/White palette, utilizing textured "snakeskin" embossed leather on the Swoosh and overlays. Released on May 1, 2025, for $150, it retains the signature visible Max Air unit in the heel for all-day urban comfort. Our team values the "Triple White" aesthetic; the lack of color highlights the intricate material depth and the architectural lines of the original Tinker Hatfield design. Its a sophisticated and historically rich choice for collectors, successfully honoring the birth of visible Air with an elevated material execution and a timeless color theory that feels both archival and contemporary for the modern street style scene.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Mid Supreme Black
Description: Another dynamic collaboration between streetwear giants Nike and Supreme comes in the form of the Nike Air Force 1 Mid Supreme Black. Slick, durable, and tough, this sneaker was designed for urban warriors. The Nike Air Force 1 Supreme collab is a hard-working high-top made from full-grain leather in sleek all-black coloring. The shoe is understated and classic, with only a simple embroidered red box with the Supreme logo on the back outer heel. Velcro straps give double support over the lace enclosure, which travels up the length of the high-top. Extra-cushioned, with back heel collars and thick midsoles, the shoes are chunky with a rubber outsole. Additional co-branding is on the lace lock and tongue label and a debossed Nike swoosh on the outer shoe. Be at your most comfortable, whether during a tough game on the courts or a night out, with these iconic high-tops. The mid-high of the shoe is what our team likes the most about the Nike Air Force 1 Mid Supreme Black. They were released on 29 August 2024, priced at $133.

Display Name: Nike KD 4 The Real MVP
Description: The Nike KD 4 The Real MVP is a high-top basketball shoe featuring a leather and mesh fabric upper in Summit White. Accented by a perforated midfoot strap that displays the Nike Swoosh in Hyper Royal, outlined with Metallic Gold, the tongue features KD branding with a Metallic Gold basketball, which reappears on the rear heel next to the Nike Swoosh. An airbrush-style midsole ombrés from Summit White to Hyper Royal. American sportswear brand Nike has forged many successful partnerships with professional athletes, and this aspect of the brand has had a major impact on Nikes untouched status and reputation. To honor NBA champion and MVP Kevin Durants acceptance speech at the 2014 NBA MVP awards, Nike created The Real MVP version of the KD 4, filled with subtle branding that references his moving speech. In our opinion, the best feature of the Nike KD 4 The Real MVP is its inspirational messages, which infuse the shoe with meaning. The shoe was released on February 18, 2025, and retailed for $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 White Pink Glow Wolf Grey (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 White Pink Glow Wolf Grey Womens brings a soft and balanced palette to one of Nikes most enduring silhouettes. The white base keeps the design clean, while pink glow accents add a subtle brightness that contrasts with the muted wolf grey elements. The layered construction of the Air Max 90 gives the colorway depth without overwhelming the overall look. This pair resonates with fans who appreciate lighter and more versatile color execution. The combination of soft tones makes it easy to style, while still offering enough contrast to stand out. It continues the legacy of the Air Max 90 as a staple in both performance history and everyday wear. The Nike Air Max 90 White Pink Glow Wolf Grey Womens was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Pollen
Description: In a simple two-tone format, the upper of the Air Jordan 1 High Pollen is constructed of black tumbled leather with Pollen Yellow overlays and Swooshes. Matching woven tongue tags and a Jordan Wings logo on the collar add authentic 1980s detailing. The Air Jordan 1 High Pollen released in August of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial FIFA World Cup 2026 Spain
Description: The Adidas Handball Spezial FIFA World Cup 2026 Spain is the terrace shoe of the summer for La Roja supporters, and it is exactly the kind of release that makes the Handball Spezial one of the most beloved silhouettes in the entire adidas catalog right now. Arriving as part of adidas' Federation Pack celebrating the nations competing at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, the Spain colorway channels the quiet confidence of a side that does not need to shout about its quality, pairing an off-white suede and leather base with deep burgundy Three Stripes that echo the rich tones of Spanish football culture without leaning on the brighter reds of match day kits. The Spain national team crest sits on the heel tab as the defining badge of allegiance, the detail that separates this from a standard Spezial colorway and makes it a genuine piece of football fan identity. The Handball Spezial silhouette itself was born on indoor courts in 1979 and has since become the preferred shoe of terrace regulars, music culture, and anyone who understands that the best football footwear works just as well off the pitch as on it. Gold toned Spezial lettering on the lateral side and the classic low profile cupsole complete the construction, grounding the Spain edition in the same heritage DNA that has made this silhouette one of the most consistent performers on the adidas roster for the last several years. The Spain edition sold out almost immediately on release day, which tells you exactly where demand sat for this particular colorway. The off-white and burgundy combination is understated in the way that only deeply considered color choices can be, and it works across every outfit that needs a shoe with genuine football soul without the noise of a loud colorway. The Adidas Handball Spezial FIFA World Cup 2026 Spain was released on March 24, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus White Black Bright Crimson
Description: Representing the high-spec frontier of the industry's most trusted distance trainer, the Nike Vomero Plus features a technical masterpiece of performance engineering. Rendered in a high-visibility White/Black/Bright Crimson/Metallic Silver palette, the shoe features an evolved engineered mesh upper and a dual-density midsole that combines Zoom Air and ReactX foams for elite energy return. Released on August 7, 2025, for $170, it sits on a specialized traction outsole designed for high-mileage road runs. Our experts commend the premium material execution; the "Bright Crimson" accents provide a sharp athletic contrast to the crisp white base. Its a historically rich icon that successfully honors the "workhorse" Vomero heritage while offering a significantly softer and more responsive ride than standard versions, prioritizing both maximum comfort and an unmistakable athletic aesthetic.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Gorge Green
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Gorge Green has become one of the most celebrated colorways in the Jordan catalog. The white tumbled leather upper of the Retro High OG sneaker has perforations in the toe box and hunter green tumbled leather overlays. The Swoosh is made in silver tumbled leather, the laces and sock liner are green, and the tongue and insole are white with green Nike Air branding. The collar sports a silver Wings logo. The midsole is white and the outsole is green rubber with AIR units. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Gorge Green was released on December 20th, 2022 for a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Brown Elephant
Description: The Jordan 1 Low SE Brown Elephant comes in a subtle light beige and white color combination. The sneakers are defined by a color-blocked leather upper adorned with Jordan's unmistakable Jumpman and Wings logos, as well as Nike's iconic Swoosh on the side panels. The Brown Elephant Jordan 1 Low SE upper begins with a classic white leather foundation and rugged brown suede overlays, extending from the mudguard to the heel section. The Swooshes feature a brown-on-brown elephant print, introducing the distinctive "Brown Elephant" element to the footwear. Additionally, black accents are found in the lining, rubber outsole, and Wings embroidery at the heel, finalizing the overall appearance of this fresh design. What our experts find most appealing about the Jordan 1 Low SE Brown Elephant is its elephant print texture overlay on the upper. This distinctive pattern not only adds a touch of urban style, but also pays homage to the iconic design elements seen on classic Air Jordan models. The sneaker debuted on July 21st, 2023, for $120.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG All-Star Cool Grey
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Cool Grey delivers a refined twist on one of the most important silhouettes in sneaker history. Cool grey overlays set a calm and versatile tone, layered over sail panels that soften the contrast and give the shoe a slightly vintage feel. Game royal accents add a sharp burst of color that keeps the design dynamic, while black details anchor the look in classic Jordan heritage. The high cut profile and traditional blocking preserve the unmistakable OG identity that collectors expect. Fans appreciate this pair because it balances subtlety and statement in a way that feels effortless. The cool grey palette makes it easy to wear, while the royal hits inject personality without overpowering the design. It feels like a modern staple that still respects its roots, appealing to collectors who value both versatility and legacy. This colorway reinforces why the Jordan 1 High OG remains a cornerstone of sneaker culture, adapting through tone rather than radical redesign. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Cool Grey was released on February 12, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Homage To Home (Non-numbered)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Homage to Home", might be the only thing more Chicago than the bean in Millenium Park. These combine two all-time AJ1 favorites in one shoe, the Banned and the Chicago Bulls, splitting the sneakers in half. The "Banned" portion is on the lateral side while the "Chicago" is on the medial. These released in May of 2018, and were not-numbered like the earlier, limited drop in Chicago. Retailing for $160, these are available exclusively in mens sizes. If youre a fan of the AJ 1 and love the classic colorways, this pair is a must-have.

Display Name: Birkenstock Arizona Soft Footbed Suede Taupe
Description: The Birkenstock Arizona Soft Footbed Suede Taupe boasts a timeless slip-on silhouette with a soft footbed from the Birkenstock brands Arizona series that is suitable for all occasions in a taupe color palette. This shoe oozes effortless and iconic style and is a footwear staple for any closet that pairs up well with casual and elegant outfits. Produced by German footwear brand Birkenstock, this iteration uses suede as the material for the two upper straps. There is also Birkenstock branding imprinted onto the metal pin buckles. This slip-on is part of the soft line, which means the traditional cork footbed has an integrated latex foam cushion. This is in addition to the suede lining, the deep heel cup, and the ample toebox. Our experts love that this shoe is lightweight yet durable, and is convenient for outdoor and indoor use. When it hit the marketplace on April 26, 2023, the Birkenstock Arizona Soft Footbed Suede Taupe retailed for $110.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Grey White
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Grey White keeps things minimal with a smooth Grey and White leather build that emphasizes clean contrast. The low profile shape remains true to the original AJ1 DNA, with classic paneling and streamlined proportions that have defined the model for decades. The muted grey overlays add subtle depth without overpowering the crisp white base. This colorway resonates because it prioritizes versatility. The neutral palette makes it easy to pair with almost any rotation, while still carrying the unmistakable Jordan 1 identity. Fans appreciate when the silhouette is presented in simple, balanced tones that let the design speak for itself. It is a reliable everyday option that honors the legacy without unnecessary flash. The Air Jordan 1 Low Grey White was released on August 20, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Model: adidas Fear of God Athletics '86 Lo
Display Name: adidas Fear of God Athletics '86 Lo Talc
Description: The adidas Fear of God Athletics '86 Lo Talc is a casual, low-top lifestyle shoe featuring a suede upper in Talc, a pale gray. adidas, the German sportswear brand, was founded in 1924, and the brandÄôs signature casual athletic shoes have influenced fashion for decades. Fear of God is a California-based American fashion brand, known for its muted, minimalist sportswear. The two brands teamed up for a collaboration, and the result is a roster of understated yet sporty styles. The iconic 3-Stripes appear on the sides of the Talc adidas Fear of God Athletics '86 Lo, creating a tonal, layered aesthetic. A platform, angled sole unit is accented by adidas trefoil branding at the heel tab and balanced by black Fear of God branding on the rear heel. In our opinion, the best feature of the '86 Lo Talc is its color story, which balances minimalism with detail. The adidas Fear of God Athletics '86 Lo Talc was released on December 3, 2023, and retailed at $200.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Melo (GS)
Description: The Jordan 12 Retro Melo (GS) is a stylish and comfortable sneaker designed for young athletes and fashion-forward kids. Featuring a crisp white leather upper with university blue accents, these shoes pay homage to NBA star Carmelo Anthony's signature colorway. The iconic Jordan 12 silhouette is enhanced with metallic silver detailing, creating a sleek and eye-catching look that's sure to turn heads on and off the court. These sneakers aren't just about looks - they're built for performance too. The full-length Zoom Air unit provides responsive cushioning, while the durable rubber outsole offers excellent traction for quick cuts and sudden stops. The padded collar and tongue ensure a snug, comfortable fit, making these shoes perfect for all-day wear. Our team thinks this product is great for young basketball enthusiasts looking to emulate their favorite players while enjoying superior comfort and style.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Shadow Green Warm Sandstone
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Shadow Green Warm Sandstone brings a softer and more lifestyle focused approach to one of adidas most enduring terrace silhouettes. Shadow Green suede covers the upper with a muted vintage feel, while Warm Sandstone accents and Wonder White details add warmth that complements the translucent indoor sole perfectly. The Gazelle Indoor has become especially popular because it keeps the familiar low profile Gazelle shape while adding slightly more depth and texture through the extended gum tooling and layered construction. Fans continue gravitating toward Gazelles because the silhouette sits comfortably between sport heritage and everyday wear. This colorway feels especially wearable thanks to the earthy tones and understated contrast, giving the shoe an almost archival feel despite its modern popularity. The mix of suede texture and indoor tooling creates a pair that works equally well with relaxed denim, trousers, or athletic inspired styling. Collectors appreciate how adidas keeps refreshing the Gazelle through thoughtful palettes that maintain the personality of the original rather than forcing dramatic redesigns onto a silhouette that already carries decades of cultural credibility. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Shadow Green Warm Sandstone has a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Jordan 2 Retro OG Chicago (2022)
Description: 2022 was unofficially dubbed the Year of the Jordan 2, as Jordan Brand brought back the classic Air Jordan 2 Chicago in its true OG form. The Air Jordan 2 Chicago reps the same historic colorway worn by Michael Jordan during his 1986-1987 season with the Bulls. The sneaker features white reptile-embossed leather uppers, Varsity Red reptile spine design on the heel, and Varsity Red signature Wings logo on the tongue. A black midsole and "NIKE" debossed branding on the heel tab ties up this signature silhouette. The Air Jordan 2 Chicago retro released in December of 2022 for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue (2026) (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue 2026 TD brings one of the most celebrated Jordan silhouettes to a toddler size, keeping the signature look intact in a smaller format. The white university blue black colorway highlights the glossy patent leather mudguard that defines the 11, paired with a clean upper that feels fresh and bright. Even at this size, the design carries the same visual impact that made the original a cultural icon. Fans love seeing the Jordan 11 translated into toddler sizing because it allows the next generation to be part of the legacy. The university blue accents add a soft pop of color that feels approachable while still rooted in classic Jordan design language. It is both a collectible and a wearable piece, appealing to families and collectors alike who appreciate the silhouettes enduring popularity and versatility. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low University Blue 2026 TD was released on April 18, 2026 with a retail price of $80.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Armory Navy
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid Armory Navy features a white leather upper with dark navy overlays and Swooshes. At the ankle, black leather collars add a subtle contrast to the overlays. A Jordan Wings logo at the ankle and Jumpman woven label on the tongue complete the design. The Jordan 1 Mid Armory Navy release in 2022 and retail for $115.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL Lucid Lemon
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL Lucid Lemon captures adidas running DNA at its most focused, built around speed, efficiency, and visual energy. The lucid lemon colorway gives the shoe an immediate sense of motion, making it feel fast before it ever hits the pavement. The Evo SL silhouette strips things back to essentials, highlighting the Adizero lines commitment to performance driven design without unnecessary distraction. Fans of running and design alike gravitate toward this pair because it represents clarity of purpose. Everything about the shoe feels intentional, from its lightweight construction to its sharp and confident appearance. Even outside performance circles, collectors appreciate its aesthetic honesty, seeing it as a modern expression of adidas innovation where function and form align naturally and convincingly. The adidas Adizero Evo SL Lucid Lemon was released on February 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Fear Pack (2023)
Description: Dive into the past and embrace the future with the Jordan 3 Retro Fear Pack (2023). A decade after its initial release, this iconic colorway returns, capturing the essence of Jordan's legacy. Crafted from dark grey nubuck with tonal elephant print overlays, the design pays homage to the original while forging its own path. Black suede on the collar and tongue is set off by the embroidered Jumpman logo in Total Orange, a vibrant nod to Jordan's boldness on and off the court. This sneaker is more than just a throwbackit's a statement. The eyelets echo the striking Total Orange, complemented by a second Jumpman icon on the back heel. The shoe is built for comfort and durability, with an orange-tinged Air-sole unit and a blend of 3 colors on the polyurethane midsole that blend performance with style. It's a perfect match for those who appreciate the history of the game and the evolution of sneaker culture. The Air Jordan 3 "Fear Pack" is set to release on November 25th, 2023, retailing at $200. Available in full family sizes, this release is a piece of history reborn. Capture the spirit of MJ's own words, "I'm scared of what I won't become", and step into greatness with the Fear Pack.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Pure Ruby
Description: adidas Harden Vol 9 Pure Ruby brings bold confidence to James Hardens signature line through a colorway that feels intense and expressive. Pure Ruby amplifies the Harden Vol 9s futuristic shape, giving it a striking identity that mirrors Hardens fearless scoring mentality. The color choice feels intentional, leaning into drama and presence rather than subtlety. This pair resonates with collectors because the Harden line has always been about individuality and control. The Vol 9 silhouette continues that tradition with a look that feels sharp and assertive, appealing to fans who appreciate signature shoes that carry personality. It stands as a reminder that Harden releases thrive when they embrace bold expression and on court authority together. The adidas Harden Vol 9 Pure Ruby was released on 07/09/2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Golf White Legend Blue
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf White Legend Blue brings classic Jordan heritage onto the fairway with a crisp White base accented by Legend Blue and Blue Tint detailing. The familiar low cut silhouette keeps the design rooted in basketball history, while subtle adjustments make it ready for the course. Clean color blocking highlights the iconic paneling, giving the shoe a fresh and polished presence. This pair stands out because it blends sport crossover appeal with timeless style. The white and blue combination feels sharp and versatile, echoing some of the most beloved Jordan palettes. Golfers who appreciate sneaker culture gravitate toward releases like this for their ability to carry legacy energy beyond the hardwood. It feels refined and confident, translating one of the most recognizable silhouettes into a performance ready format. The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf White Legend Blue was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL White Royal Blue
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL White Royal Blue delivers a cleaner and more classic take on the Evo SL line, pairing a bright white base with bold royal blue accents and touches of pure ruby. The color blocking feels sharp and intentional, giving the shoe a sporty look that stands out without being overwhelming. It carries that lightweight Adizero feel while leaning more into a timeless running aesthetic. Fans gravitate toward this colorway because it feels versatile while still having personality. The contrast between white and royal blue gives it a strong visual identity, making it easy to style while still feeling performance driven. It is a pair that works just as well on a run as it does in a daily rotation, blending function and style in a way that feels natural. The adidas Adizero Evo SL White Royal Blue was released on June 2, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Bordeaux
Description: The Air Jordan 1 High Bordeaux released in November of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Ivory Forest Night
Description: The ASICS Gel NYC Ivory Forest Night leans into contrast through a palette that feels both natural and refined. The Ivory base sets a clean foundation, while Forest Night accents bring a deeper tone that adds dimension across the layered upper. The silhouette continues to draw from ASICS running archives, combining familiar tooling with a structure that feels equally at home in lifestyle settings. This pair stands out because of how effortlessly it balances light and dark elements without feeling forced. The color combination gives it versatility while still offering enough character to stand apart from more neutral releases. For collectors, the Gel NYC continues to represent a strong direction for ASICS, merging performance DNA with everyday style in a way that feels intentional and easy to wear. The ASICS Gel NYC Ivory Forest Night was released on January 31, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro University Blue (GS)
Description: Released in 2021, the Air Jordan 4 Retro University Blue GS brings a silhouette with a suede upper and a popular shade of blue inspired by the University of North Carolina. It has a bright blue pallet often with a Jumpman icon on the back, tongue, and sole. The upper made from University Blue Suede and black plastic lace holders on its throat. The back of the grade school-sized Air Jordan 4 Retro University features classic cement detailing alongside a small visible air unit at the heels. It was retailed at $150.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Birch Dark Pewter
Description: The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Birch Dark Pewter is a reinterpretation of the Gel-Kayano 14, which finds inspiration in technical running shoes from the early 2000s. Unlike its predecessors, the "Birch Dark Pewter" version features a sustainably dyed sock liner. This dyeing process requires 35 percent less water and reduces carbon emissions by up to 45 percent. The breathable mesh upper comes in Birch, while the synthetic leather overlays feature Dark Pewter with a metallic sheen. Like the original Gel-Kayano, this version includes responsive gel cushioning in the bulky midsole. The sneaker also features ASICS signature TRUSSTIC support system and a front lace closure. ASICS branding can be found on the tongue, the heel, and the insole. Our StockX experts like the padding around the collar and on the tongue that contribute to the sneakers retro-inspired aesthetic. The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Birch Dark Pewter was released on January 1st, 2024, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Collegiate Green Cloud White Gum
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Collegiate Green Cloud White Gum is a casual sneaker featuring a suede upper in rich Collegiate Green, accented by adidas signature 3-Stripes in Cloud White. Gazelle text branding in metallic gold appears alongside the stripes. Germanys adidas has been producing footwear and sneakers since 1924, and the brands Gazelle indoor football shoe was first released in 1966. The Gazelle represents the first time that adidas produced a shoe using a suede fabrication, a tradition that continues to the modern era and remains current. At the Collegiate Green Cloud White adidas Gazelle Indoor, the Gazelle text branding in metallic gold appears alongside the stripes. A transparent gum sole displays the adidas Trefoil logo, which coordinates with the Trefoil-branded Cloud White rear heel tab. Our StockX experts feel that the best feature of the Gazelle Indoor is its gum sole, which amps up its sporty Collegiate Green color palette. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Collegiate Green Cloud White Gum was released on June 10, 2024, and retailed at $120.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Pink Black (Women's)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Pink Black (Womens) blends retro running DNA with modern comfort for a sleek, everyday sneaker that stands out. Dressed in a Pink/Black/Silver colorway (style 1202A536-700), this pair pairs breathable mesh with layered synthetic overlays for structure and style. The sculpted midsole houses signature GEL cushioning under the heel to soften every step, while the TRUSSTIC support system helps keep transitions stable whether youre on a morning coffee run or logging city miles. Reflective hits and contrasting panels add visual depth, highlighting the shoes 2000s-inspired lines with a contemporary finish. Underfoot, a durable rubber outsole with versatile traction keeps you moving confidently on varied surfaces, and the padded collar and tongue deliver a snug, secure feel without bulk. The streamlined profile makes it an easy match for leggings, wide-leg denim, or tailored athleisure, giving you a go-to sneaker that moves from workouts to weekends with ease. If youre seeking a lifestyle shoe with performance roots, the ASICS Gel-1130 brings comfort-forward engineering and timeless appeal to your rotation. Our team loves this product because its GEL cushioning, supportive TRUSSTIC framework, and breathable build make it a reliable, style-forward choice for all-day wear.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Neapolitan (Women's)
Description: Take a sweet stride in the all-new Women's Jordan 11 Retro "Neapolitan". A tasteful tribute to the classic Jordan heritage, this sneaker brings a deliciously fresh colorway to the iconic silhouette. The Sail/Velvet Brown hue swirls around the premium leather and ballistic mesh upper, reminiscent of the classic Neapolitan ice cream trio, while keeping the legendary Jordan aesthetics intact. The Jordan lineage is rich with innovative designs and the Jordan 11 Retro "Neapolitan" is no exception. It's a sneaker that speaks volumes about its legacy, the ingenuity in design echoes the relentless spirit of Michael Jordan that still resonates in the sneaker culture. This pair isnt just a sneaker, its a narrative of heritage meeting modernity head-on, ready to charm the sneakerheads and Jordan loyalists alike. The Jordan 11 Retro "Neapolitan" is a testament to the enduring allure of the Jordan brand, a blend of tradition and contemporary design, a statement of style that stands out in a crowd. Set to drop on November 11, 2023, at a retail price of $225, this pair is a scoop of Jordan heritage, a sprinkle of innovative design, and a whole lot of cool. Grab a pair and step into a legacy thats as tasteful and timeless as the Neapolitan colorway it sports.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Huarache 2K4 White Varsity Red
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Huarache 2K4 White Varsity Red is one of the original colorways from 2004, returning two decades later with every bit of its hardwood credibility intact. Designer Eric Avar drew from the Air Flight Huarache and Air Force 1 to build this shoe, fusing open ankle construction with a lightweight upper and Zoom Air cushioning for the modern era. The white leather base is sharp and clean, with Varsity Red outlining the Swoosh, coating the tongue branding, and sweeping through the midsole and outsole. Black textured detailing anchors the mudguard and heel, and carbon fiber on the outsole gives the underfoot setup a premium finish that feels true to the original spec. This silhouette carries weight beyond its design because of who wore it. Kobe Bryant laced up the 2K4 throughout the 2004 season, including the NBA All-Star Game, making it a prequel to his entire signature run with Nike. The sculpted heel counter and Zoom Air cushioning that made it a player favorite are all present here, and the fact that Nike is also issuing Penny Hardaway and Sue Bird player exclusives alongside this drop proves the brand is treating the revival with full archival care. For collectors who remember the original run and for younger fans discovering it now, this colorway represents classic Nike Basketball at its most essential. The Nike Air Zoom Huarache 2K4 White Varsity Red was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Converse SHAI 001 Butter
Description: The Converse SHAI 001 Butter brings warmth and personality to Shai Gilgeous Alexanders signature line through a colorway that feels soft, confident, and expressive. The butter tone gives the shoe an inviting and almost lifestyle driven presence, while the silhouette maintains its performance rooted structure. It feels approachable and modern, designed to stand out through tone rather than contrast. Collectors appreciate this release because it shows range within the SHAI 001 line. The design still feels grounded and intentional, but the color adds a sense of ease and individuality that resonates with fans. It reflects Shais ability to blend style and substance, making the shoe feel personal and wearable rather than overly technical or flashy. The Converse SHAI 001 Butter was released on September 4, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Black Cement (2018)
Description: One of the most anticipated releases of 2018, the Air Jordan 3 Retro OG marked the first time original "Nike Air" branding was featured on the "Black Cement" AJ 3 since it's 2001 retro. Jordan stuck to the mantra of "if it aint broke, dont fix it," on these, staying true to the OG with a black-based leather upper with cement grey, fire red, and white accents, finished off by the iconic elephant print detailing. Their release date was on Michael Jordan's 55th birthday, February 17th, 2018, and went for $200 in mens sizes. The "Black Cement" Air Jordan 3 Retro OG is a must-have, and you don't need us to tell you that. They should be in everyone's collection, multiples if possible. If you're on the hunt for a pair, you can buy them online today. Those with a pair to sell can hit up the StockX marketplace and see what they're currently going for.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Dark Charcoal University Gold
Description: The Air Jordan 9 returns with this upcoming Dark Charcoal University Gold iteration. Known colloquially as "Batman" for its black and yellow resemblance to the crime-fighting heros suit, this AJ9 is the perfect dark shade for the Winter season. The Air Jordan 9 Dark Charcoal University Gold is full of features every fan of the 1994 sneaker will gravitate towards. The upper is packed with a mix of Dark Charcoal and Black nubuck. From there, University Gold appears on the high-tops inner lining and makes an appearance on the heels "23" embroidery and the midsoles Jumpman logo. Lastly, like past retros, "Air Jordan" patches are stitched to the models tongue. The Air Jordan 9 Dark Charcoal University Gold released in January of 2021 for $190.

Display Name: New Balance 1000 Deep Ocean
Description: The New Balance 1000 Deep Ocean revives one of the brands boldest early 2000s running silhouettes through a colorway that leans heavily into technical nostalgia and futuristic design language. The New Balance 1000 stands apart because of its aggressive paneling, layered synthetic construction, and sculpted proportions that feel more experimental compared to classic retro runners from the brand. The Deep Ocean and Metallic Silver palette reinforces that identity through darker aquatic tones paired with reflective metallic accents that give the shoe a sleek and highly modern atmosphere while still preserving its archival performance roots. Fans gravitate toward the New Balance 1000 because it captures the growing appreciation for complex turn of the millennium running aesthetics within contemporary sneaker culture. The layered upper creates strong visual movement throughout the silhouette, while the silver detailing adds depth and contrast that enhance the technical appearance of the design. Collectors especially appreciate how the 1000 feels more aggressive and unconventional compared to softer lifestyle oriented New Balance retros. The Deep Ocean tones give the shoe a colder and more futuristic personality that works naturally within current trends surrounding tech runners and metallic footwear styling. The New Balance 1000 Deep Ocean was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan Son of Mars Low Grey Cement
Description: The Air Jordan Son of Mars Low Grey Cement is a 2013 release of the Jordan Son of Mars Low in the Grey Cement colorway, style code 580603-004, the specific Cement Grey, White, Black, and Fire Red execution that applies the iconic Jordan elephant print and cement texture, most closely associated with the Air Jordan 3 and Air Jordan 4, to the Son of Mars Low silhouette that itself fuses design elements from multiple Air Jordan models in a hybrid construction that represents one of the most architecturally layered Jordan Brand silhouettes ever produced. The Son of Mars, originally released in its high-top version in 2012, draws its design concept from several of Michael Jordan's most historic signatures: the outsole borrows from the Air Jordan 4, the upper panels incorporate elements from the Air Jordan 3's construction, the midsole references the Air Jordan 5, and the overall low-top profile is rooted in the Air Jordan 6, making the Son of Mars one of the rare Jordan silhouettes that explicitly borrows from four separate models rather than standing as an original design. Sneaker News, in covering the shoe's 2026 revival in the White Cement colorway, confirmed this context, noting that the grey cement print, white foundation, AJ4-referencing sole unit, and Fire Red hits align with the existing legacy. The Grey Cement colorway specifically applies the classic elephant print in cement grey across the toe box and heel overlays, with a white leather base providing the clean ground against which the cement texture reads with the specific visual character that has made the elephant print one of the most iconic material applications in the Jordan Brand catalog. The visible Air-Sole unit in the heel provides the cushioning technology consistent with the Jordan Brand retro program, and the rubber outsole delivers the court-appropriate traction. The Air Jordan Son of Mars Low Grey Cement is the 2013 hybrid multi-model Jordan silhouette for the Jordan Brand collector who wants the elephant print cement texture and Fire Red accent placement from the Air Jordan 3 heritage applied to the Son of Mars Low's four-model design fusion in the most classically Jordan Brand and most broadly wearable grey cement colorway. The Air Jordan Son of Mars Low Grey Cement was released on August 10, 2013 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Paisley Brown
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Paisley Brown features a brown, green, and red paisley-patterned textile upper with matching leather overlays and contrasting Swooshes. Nike SB woven tongue tags and white heel embroideries add further detailing. At the base, a white Zoom sole with a gum outsole completes the design. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Paisley Brown releases in May of 2022 and retails for $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Cannon
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Cannon is a men's road running shoe from Nike's Pegasus Premium program, released January 10, 2025 at a retail price of $220 with style code HQ2592-009 in the Cannon/Barely Volt/Volt/Seaweed colorway, confirmed by Sneaker Bar Detroit, Running Warehouse, and the official Nike product page. As confirmed by the official Nike and Hibbett product descriptions and Running Warehouse's detailed technical overview, the Pegasus Premium supercharges responsive cushioning with a triple stack of Nike's most powerful running technologies: full-length ZoomX foam on top for incredible energy return with each stride, a sculpted full-length Air Zoom unit in the middle offering the optimal level of springiness underfoot, and ReactX foam at the foundation that is 13 percent more responsive than previous React technology and engineered with a manufacturing process reducing its carbon footprint by at least 43 percent compared to prior React foam. The upper features breathable circular-knit and mono mesh construction with reflective taping for low-light visibility. Sneaker Bar Detroit confirmed the Cannon colorway applies the seafoam Cannon shade across the lightweight breathable mesh upper, with tonal overlays for stability, Volt on the full-length Air Zoom unit, Barely Volt highlights on the tongue and insole, and seaweed green toe and midfoot overlays that secure the foot and frame the vibrant palette. A modified Waffle outsole with high-abrasion rubber completes the construction. Retail price $220. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Cannon is the January 10, 2025 HQ2592-009 triple-stack ZoomX-foam-Air-Zoom-ReactX-midsole circular-knit-mesh reflective-taping modified-Waffle-outsole most-responsive-Pegasus-ever road running shoe for the Nike running collector who wants the seafoam Cannon upper with Volt Air-Zoom-unit and seaweed green overlay accents from the Nike Pegasus Premium program. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Cannon was released on January 10, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus 3 Triple White
Description: Combining style, comfort, and performance in a sleek package, the Nike Air Max Plus 3 Triple White is a variation of Nikes Air Max Plus 3 sneakers in a White and Vast Grey color scheme. The Triple White Nike Air Max Plus 3 features a predominantly White color scheme throughout its upper, sole, and midsole. The shoe boasts a durable synthetic and textile upper, providing a comfortable and breathable fit. Its iconic TPU overlays provide structural support and add a touch of sophistication to the design. Its rubber outsole provides traction on various surfaces, making it suitable for both casual wear and sports activities. What we think is the notable feature of this Nike Air Max Plus 3 Triple White, which was released on 17th March 2020 at $190 as the suggested retail price, is the Air Max cushioning technology in the midsole that offers impact absorption and responsiveness, ensuring a comfortable stride.

Display Name: New Balance 991v2 MiUK Kith Moonrock
Description: The New Balance 991v2 MiUK Kith Moonrock brings a refined and elevated take to a heritage silhouette, blending Kiths clean design approach with New Balances premium UK craftsmanship. The moonrock colorway leans into soft neutral tones, allowing the layered construction of the upper to stand out without relying on contrast. The 991v2 update subtly modernizes the shape while preserving the DNA that made the original so respected. What makes this collaboration stand out is its restraint and attention to detail. Kith continues to work within New Balances framework rather than reinventing it, resulting in a sneaker that feels timeless and carefully considered. The MiUK build reinforces quality and tradition, making it especially appealing to collectors who value both design and origin. It is a release that feels quiet but highly intentional. The New Balance 991v2 MiUK Kith Moonrock was released on March 16, 2026 with a retail price of $250.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Patta 20th Anniversary Chlorophyll
Description: Celebrate 20 years of Patta with the Nike Air Max 1 Patta 20th Anniversary Chlorophyll, which released in 2024 and pays homage to the 5th anniversary model which released in 2009. This sneaker features a grey, white, and green upper with a white midsole. This sneaker is highly coveted by sneakerheads due to it's similarly to the 5th anniversary model that released in 2009, that has similar color blocking. The Patta and Air Max branding can be seen on the tongue in white and green stitching. We love this sneaker due to its bold colors and OG references, making for a classic sneaker that you truly cannot go wrong with. The Nike Air Max 1 Patta 20th Anniversary Chlorophyll released on September 13th, 2024, for a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Black
Description: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Black gives the timeless Air Force 1 a meaningful narrative twist, using a colorway and theme that honor Kobe Bryants legacy without overwhelming the design. The all black execution feels understated yet serious, fitting a tribute thats thoughtful rather than loud. It reflects the idea of remembrance and continuity, allowing the silhouette itself to carry the emotional weight. Collectors connect with this release because it blends legacy with familiarity. The Air Force 1s everyday versatility and history pair naturally with the tribute concept, making it feel like a staple that also carries story. Its the kind of release that captures attention quietly, inviting appreciation over time rather than demanding it at first glance. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Black was released on 11/01/2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Light Orewood Brown Mink Brown
Description: The Nike P 6000 Light Orewood Brown Mink Brown leans fully into early running nostalgia with a colorway that feels warm and grounded. The layered upper and flowing lines reflect classic Nike performance design, while orewood and mink brown tones soften the silhouette into something calm and wearable. It feels familiar without feeling dated, letting texture and tone drive the appeal. Collectors appreciate this pair because it highlights the P 6000s strength as a lifestyle runner. The neutral palette makes it easy to integrate into rotation, while the structure keeps it visually interesting. Fans love how it captures the comfort and aesthetics of older performance shoes without leaning into gimmicks, making it a dependable choice that feels timeless and thoughtfully designed. The Nike P 6000 Light Orewood Brown Mink Brown was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Doernbecher Sergio Cano Marquez
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Doernbecher Sergio Cano Marquez transforms the Air Max Plus into a deeply personal expression through the Doernbecher program, blending storytelling, creativity, and courage into a single design. The multicolor execution feels emotional and expressive, reflecting Sergio Cano Marquezs perspective and imagination rather than a standard color formula. Every panel feels intentional, turning the silhouette into a canvas for individuality and resilience. Collectors cherish this release because Doernbecher pairs always represent more than aesthetics. The Air Max Plus already carries strong personality, and this version elevates it through narrative and meaning. Fans appreciate how the shoe celebrates creativity and strength, making it a reminder that sneakers can be vehicles for real stories and human connection, not just design experimentation. The Nike Air Max Plus Doernbecher Sergio Cano Marquez was released on January 17, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Model: Nike SB Air Max Ishod Wair
Display Name: Nike SB Air Max Ishod Wair Tennis Ball
Description: The Nike SB Air Max Ishod Wair Tennis Ball is a June 2026 release of the Air Max Ishod Wair  the signature skateboarding shoe for pro skater and Nike SB athlete Ishod Wair that adapts the Air Max platform for skateboarding use  in a Volt and Black Tennis Ball colorway that applies the unmistakable neon yellow-green of a tennis ball to the upper in a visually vivid and culturally playful colorway referencing the overlap between skate culture and tennis's own emergence as a streetwear-adjacent cultural reference point in the 2020s. The Air Max Ishod Wair represents Ishod Wair's signature approach to skateboarding footwear, which has consistently sought shoes with slim, low-profile construction and close-to-board feel rather than the bulkier protective-padding-forward approach of earlier skate shoes, adapted to the Air Max platform's visible cushioning and responsive underfoot feel. The Tennis Ball colorway is the most high-visibility and most sport-crossover-resonant expression of the Air Max Ishod across its SS26 color range, with the Volt yellow-green creating a shoe that reads simultaneously as a skate performance piece and as a lifestyle sneaker connected to tennis and court sport aesthetics. Released June 2, 2026 at $125 retail through Nike SB and authorized skate retail partners globally. The Nike SB Air Max Ishod Wair Tennis Ball was released on June 2, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Travis Scott Cactus Jack
Description: Travis Scott and Nike add a new design to their growing Air Force arsenal with the Air Force 1 Low Travis Scott Cactus Jack, now available on StockX. After a year of sneaker world dominance, Nike is adding a twist to their latest collaborative AF 1 with Cactus Jack. This new design features a never before seen detachable lace cover that encloses with a heavy brass zipper. This Travis AF-1 features a patchwork upper comprised of camouflage, corduroy, duck canvas, flannel, leather, suede and wool. Unmistakable Cactus Jack insignias are placed throughout the silhouette. A sail midsole and gum rubber outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in November of 2019 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R White Navy Silver Metallic
Description: The New Balance 1906R White Navy Silver Metallic delivers a cleaner and more classic interpretation of the technical runner silhouette that helped propel the 1906R into mainstream sneaker culture. Built around layered mesh panels, metallic overlays, and visible performance inspired detailing, the model captures the energy of early 2000s running footwear while remaining highly wearable for modern everyday styling. The combination of White, NB Navy, and Silver Metallic creates a balanced and timeless color palette that feels deeply connected to traditional New Balance design language and vintage athletic aesthetics. Fans gravitate toward the 1906R because it successfully merges archival running technology and contemporary streetwear appeal in a way that feels authentic rather than trend chasing. The white mesh base keeps the silhouette bright and versatile, while the navy and silver accents add depth without overwhelming the technical structure of the shoe. Collectors especially appreciate classic New Balance color combinations because they preserve the sporty and understated identity that made the brand iconic originally. The overall presentation feels refined, athletic, and highly adaptable across casual wardrobes while still showcasing the layered complexity that defines the 1906R silhouette. The New Balance 1906R White Navy Silver Metallic was released on December 6, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Velvet Brown (PS)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Velvet Brown (PS) is a highly anticipated release for young sneaker enthusiasts. This preschool-sized shoe features a rich color palette of dark mocha, black, and velvet brown, creating a sophisticated look for little feet. The premium materials and expert craftsmanship synonymous with the Jordan brand are evident in every detail, from the supple leather upper to the iconic reverse Swoosh on the lateral side. Designed in collaboration with hip-hop artist Travis Scott, this low-top sneaker combines classic Jordan styling with contemporary flair. The shoe boasts a comfortable low-cut silhouette, perfect for active kids, while maintaining the timeless appeal of the Air Jordan 1. With its unique colorway and special edition status, this sneaker is sure to turn heads on the playground and beyond. Our experts state this product is great for parents looking to elevate their child's style with a trendy, comfortable, and collectible sneaker that stands out from the crowd.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro SE White Blue Void
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE White Blue Void delivers a clean and modern take on the Dunk Low, using a balanced color palette that feels both classic and refreshed. The summit white base keeps the design crisp, while blue void overlays add depth and contrast without overwhelming the silhouette. Pure platinum accents help tie the look together, maintaining a cohesive and wearable finish. Fans are drawn to this pair because it stays true to the Dunks original appeal while introducing subtle updates through color. The combination feels versatile, making it easy to style across different looks. It stands as a reliable option within the Dunk lineup, offering a straightforward design that continues to resonate with sneaker culture. The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE White Blue Void was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Air More Uptempo SE Pink Blast Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air More Uptempo SE Pink Blast/Black is a women's exclusive release from Nike's Air More Uptempo program, released May 1, 2026 at a retail price of $160 with style code IV2376-600, confirmed by StockX, Sneaker Bar Detroit, and Extra Butter. As confirmed by the official product description via Extra Butter and Tops and Bottoms USA, the Air More Uptempo SE features real and synthetic leather for durability with oversized graffiti-inspired branding celebrating the streets, originally designed-for-performance-hoops Max Air units in the heel, forefoot, and midfoot for lightweight and durable cushioning, embroidered Swoosh logos, foam in the midsole, and a rubber outsole for durable traction. Sneaker Bar Detroit confirmed the bright pink leather upper wraps across the midsole and outsole, with the model's oversized AIR branding appearing in glossy black, creating the sharp contrast that emphasizes the sneaker's iconic design, with mini Swoosh branding at the toe and heel and black midfoot details breaking up the bold pink color scheme. The Air More Uptempo was first released in 1996 and made famous by Scottie Pippen during the Chicago Bulls' 72-win season, with the model's oversized AIR lettering drawn from 1990s graffiti culture establishing it as one of basketball's most recognizable silhouettes. All sales final. Retail price $160. The Nike Air More Uptempo SE Pink Blast/Black Womens is the May 1, 2026 IV2376-600 real-and-synthetic-leather oversized-black-AIR-logo Max-Air-heel-forefoot-midfoot embroidered-Swoosh women's exclusive Air More Uptempo for the Nike collector who wants the most bold and most saturated Pink Blast graffiti-inspired colorway from the Nike Air More Uptempo women's program. The Nike Air More Uptempo SE Pink Blast/Black Womens was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 Torched
Description: The Nike Book 1 Torched delivers a sharp and high contrast take on Devin Bookers signature silhouette. White dominates the upper, creating a clean and focused look, while black details add structure and definition. The simplicity of the palette allows the shape and proportions to stand out, reinforcing the performance driven nature of the design without unnecessary distraction. Fans appreciate this version because it feels direct and uncompromising. The Book 1 thrives on clarity and purpose, and this colorway highlights that identity perfectly. Collectors value it as a versatile option that reflects Bookers calm intensity and competitive mindset. It is a sneaker that feels composed and confident, designed for those who respect precision and appreciate when design speaks through form rather than complexity. The Nike Book 1 Torched was released on December 30, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Triple White
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Golf Triple White features a white tumbled leather upper with matching overlays and Swooshes. A debossed Wings logo at the heel nods to the first-ever Air Jordan logo that debuted in 1985. At the base, a grooved outsole provides support, no matter where you are on the golf course. The Jordan 1 Low Golf Triple White released in January of 2022 and retailed for $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Satin Snake Chicago (Women's)
Description: Jordan Brand added luxe materials to a classic silhouette with the release of the women's Jordan 1 Retro High Satin Snake Chicago (W). This release combines Jumpmans ongoing Satin 1 concept with the colorway that started it all. This women's Jordan 1 consists of a white and red leather upper with red satin tongue and liner. Black faux snakeskin leather detailing appears on the upper as well. A white midsole, red outsole, and a traditional Jordan Wings graphic on the ankle completes the design. These sneakers released in August of 2020 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro He Got Game (2018)
Description: Paying homage to the cult-classic movie of the same name, the Jordan 13 Retro "He Got Game" is based on the pair Denzel Washington wore in the 1998 film. Directed by Spike Lee, Washington originally wore this pair of classic kicks while playing ball against his basketball prodigy son, Jesus Shuttlesworth (Ray Allen). The shoes feature a buttery leather upper in white and black, a green hologram on the side panel, and a red and white outsole. These dropped in August 2018 for $190. Do the right thing and grab a pair today on StockX.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked Bred Black Patent
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Bred Black Patent takes one of the most iconic colorways in Jordan history and adapts it for the course with a sleek and polished finish. The black and varsity red combination remains instantly recognizable, while the patent leather adds a glossy edge that gives the shoe a more elevated look. It blends heritage with a more specialized purpose. What makes this pair compelling is how it maintains the identity of the Bred colorway while shifting its function. The low profile silhouette keeps it versatile, allowing it to move beyond the course into casual wear. It is a crossover design that appeals to both golfers and collectors who appreciate classic Jordan colorways. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Bred Black Patent was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $175.

Display Name: Puma Speedcat OG Team Royal White
Description: The Puma Speedcat OG in Puma Team Royal and Puma White is a February 2026 continuation of the Speedcat OG's ongoing revival campaign, applying the Team Royal blue to the suede low-profile motorsport heritage silhouette as one of the most broadly wearable and most seasonally versatile colorways in the Speedcat's expanding seasonal color range following the shoe's breakthrough 2024 commercial performance. The Team Royal colorway positions the Speedcat OG within the classic navy-adjacent sports blue tradition that connects to both the shoe's original motorsport racing contexts  where team colors in blue have historically dressed some of the most storied racing programs  and to the contemporary menswear casualwear context where royal blue has been one of the most dominant and most commercially successful accent colors across sneakers and apparel in the mid-2020s. The Speedcat OG's thin suede upper, minimal profile, and racing driver shoe last shape are maintained across the Team Royal and White execution with the same OG-specification construction that distinguishes the Speedcat OG from subsequent iterations that departed from the original proportions, ensuring this 2026 colorway carries the full heritage authenticity of the revival's initial positioning. Released February 6, 2026 at $120 retail through Puma and authorized lifestyle footwear retailers globally. The Puma Speedcat OG Team Royal White was released on February 6, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Hyper Royal
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Hyper Royal brings a crisp, court-bred look to everyday rotation, blending heritage hoops DNA with modern streetwear appeal. Dressed in a Hyper Royal/Black/White palette (style HF5441-401), this pair delivers bold contrast: rich royal overlays pop against clean white leather panels, while black Swooshes and accents frame the silhouette with sharp definition. A perforated toe box, padded collar, and classic nylon tongue nod to the iconic Dunk lineage, and the stitched cupsole construction pairs a cushioned midsole with a durable rubber outsole for confident comfort and traction. From denim and cargos to tailored joggers, the Hyper Royal color blocking adds an instant hit of energy to any fit. Released on March 1, 2025, this Dunk Low balances timeless details with everyday wearability. Signature branding on the tongue and heel tab anchors the retro vibe, while the grippy traction pattern underfoot keeps each step steady on city streets. The sleek profile makes it easy to style up or down, think layered hoodies, varsity jackets, or a clean tee, and the dependable build means its ready for repeat wear. Whether youre a longtime Dunk fan or stepping into the line for the first time, the Hyper Royal stands out as a versatile essential that turns heads without trying too hard. Our team loves this product because it delivers iconic Dunk style, confident comfort, and a striking Hyper Royal colorway that elevates daily outfits with minimal effort.

Display Name: Nike Cryoshot Mercurial Vapor R9 Patta
Description: The Nike Cryoshot Mercurial Vapor R9 Patta is Amsterdam-based label Patta's contribution to Nike's X2 World Cup collection representing the Netherlands, built on the Mercurial Vapor R9, the 1998 Nike boot designed as a signature cleat for Brazilian legend Ronaldo that was the first football boot to feature a full-synthetic upper and whose wavy structural lines were engineered for optimal ball control, transforming it via the Cryoshot process into a lifestyle sneaker in a Metallic Silver, Hyper Crimson, Black, and Anthracite colorway that Patta's Dutch perspective inflects through the collection's Netherlands national team identity. The Mercurial Vapor R9 holds one of the most storied places in football boot history, having been worn by Ronaldo during his legendary appearances for Brazil and his club teams in the late 1990s and early 2000s, with the boot's distinctive appearance and technological first-mover status as a synthetic-upper football boot giving the Patta collaboration an object of genuine archival football significance at its base. The Metallic Silver upper references the R9's original construction while the Hyper Crimson and Anthracite accents and the Cryoshot's translucent cage enclosing the original studded outsole complete the conversion into a lifestyle sneaker, with Patta branding integrated throughout the design alongside the Dutch-inspired color narrative of the broader X2 collection. Released June 11, 2026 via Patta's dedicated site and stores, June 13 via Dover Street Market, and June 16 via SNKRS and select retailers at $210 retail.
