Vapor green and malachite dominate the upper, while light lemon twist accents add brightness that cuts through the darker base. The result feels bold and kinetic, emphasizing the silhouettes wave like motion and aggressive stance. Collectors are drawn to this release because it captures the Air Max Plus at its most expressive. The color combination feels fearless, appealing to fans who love the model for its ability to stand out and command attention. It is a sneaker that thrives on personality, blending vibrant color with the technical edge that has made the Air Max Plus a symbol of confidence and rebellion for decades. The Nike Air Max Plus Vapor Green Malachite Black Light Lemon Twist was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 5 X-Ray (GS)
Description: In grade school sizes, the Nike Kobe 5 X-Ray (GS) is a sneaker featuring a Deep Royal Blue, Baltic Blue, and Glacier Blue upper. The upper displays printed artwork of foot bones, in the style of an X-ray image, across the quarter, accented by the Swoosh. Kobe branding appears on the tongue and heel, and the Deep Royal Blue midsole and Glacier Blue outsole finish the look. American athletic brand Nike is known for outfitting the top NBA players with signature shoes, and they worked with Kobe Bryant from the early 2000s. The Nike Kobe series is known for its bold and forward-leaning aesthetic, with the occasional out-there design, such as the 5 X-Ray, which surely stands alone. Our experts feel that the 5 X-Ray's best feature is its edgy and unique imagery. Cross laces help little ones put them on. The Nike Kobe 5 X-Ray (GS) was released on October 17, 2024, and retailed for $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 .SWOOSH Low Poly Big Head Mode
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 .SWOOSH Low Poly Big Head Mode brings a digital-first twist to an icon, fusing the classic runner silhouette with a geometric, low-poly aesthetic. Rendered in Dark Smoke Grey, White, and Metallic Gold, the layered upper showcases sharp lines and crisp paneling that nod to gaming culture while staying true to the Air Max DNA. Subtle gold accents highlight the Swoosh and trim, elevating the look with a refined pop that catches the light without overpowering the palette. Style code IB9898-001 and a release date of April 7, 2025, make this pair a standout entry for collectors and fans of forward-thinking design alike. Underfoot, the visible Max Air unit delivers that plush, springy comfort the Air Max 1 is celebrated for, paired with a supportive foam midsole for smooth strides all day. A durable rubber outsole with heritage traction elements offers reliable grip, while the padded collar and tongue add an easy-on, secure feel. Versatile and head-turning, this colorway moves effortlessly from streetwear staples to clean, minimalist fits, think tapered denim, technical cargos, or relaxed sweats. Its the perfect balance of retro lineage and modern edge, translating the Air Max story into a bold, contemporary statement youll reach for on repeat. Our team loves this product because it merges iconic Air cushioning with inventive low?poly detailing, delivering standout style and day-long comfort in one polished package.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Midnight Navy
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro Midnight Navy displays a classic color arrangement inspired by the original design, evoking memories of the iconic 'White Cement' colorway introduced in 1988. The Midnight Navy Jordan 3 Retro draws inspiration from a classic AJ3 colorway, incorporating Midnight Navy, white, and Cement Gray for a captivating visual contrast. The upper, crafted from white leather, is adorned with the distinctive elephant print detailing in Cement Gray at traditional points. Paying homage to the original design, the elephant-print mudguards, and overlays in various shades of Cement Gray evoke a sense of nostalgia. There are Midnight Navy accents on the eyelets and collars, while Jumpman branding on the tongues, heels, midsole, and underfoot infuse a contemporary twist. Riding on an Air-assisted polyurethane midsole, the mid-top silhouette is completed with a predominantly white finish, highlighted by a contrasting splash of navy at the heel. The standout feature of the Jordan 3 Retro Midnight Navy is its iconic elephant-print overlays at the forefoot and heel, coupled with the stylish midnight navy accents, creating a distinctive and visually appealing aesthetic. The sneaker debuted for $200 on December 16th, 2023.

Display Name: Timberland 6" Premium Waterproof Boot Medium Brown Nubuck
Description: The Timberland 6 Inch Premium Waterproof Boot Medium Brown Nubuck stands as one of the most iconic footwear silhouettes ever created, built on durability, function, and unmistakable style. The medium brown nubuck upper delivers a warm and rugged look, while the classic six inch construction reinforces Timberlands reputation for protection and reliability. It feels sturdy and timeless, designed to handle harsh conditions while remaining a staple in street and workwear culture. Fans love this boot because it has proven itself across decades. From construction sites to city streets, the six inch Timberland represents resilience and identity. Collectors appreciate how the design has remained largely unchanged, viewing it as a symbol of authenticity and longevity that transcends trends and seasons while staying relevant year after year. The Timberland 6 Inch Premium Waterproof Boot Medium Brown Nubuck was released on August 13, 2024 with a retail price of $198.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 2 CB '94 Black White Purple
Description: The Nike Air Max 2 CB 94 Black White Purple) is a Charles Barkley signature sneaker from the Nike Air Max 2 CB 94 collection in a Black/White-Varsity Purple color scheme. This offering features a White leather upper with Black nubuck overlays and Varsity Purple accents on the tongue. Additional details include spotty perforations on the nubuck overlays, a quick lacing style backed by a straightjacket-inspired fit strap, Nike branding on the heel and laterals, and Air Max branding on the tongue. A Black and White sole unit with a visible Max Air unit on the heel completes the design. The Nike Air Max 2 CB 94 Black White Purple (2020) was made available on August 1st, 2020. Initially, it retailed at $160. They re-released on May 1st, 2025 for $170.

Model: adidas Fear of God Athletics '86 Lo
Display Name: adidas Fear of God Athletics '86 Lo Clay
Description: As part of a partnership between adidas and Fear of God, the adidas Fear of God Athletics '86 Lo Clay combines the two labels house codes, creating a minimalist sneaker with a neutral colorway. Drawing inspiration from the adidas Rivalry Lows silhouette, designer Jerry Lorenzo kept some of the basketball shoe design elements. However, he also added a thick sole in Clay and crafted the upper using premium, tonal materials. For example, the upper boasts a premium-suede build, including the signature 3-Stripes logo, the eyelets, and the heel counter. Thin laces in Clay wind through the lace cage, while padding around the heel pays tribute to the Rivalry Low. Our experts like the stark differences between the branding of adidas and Fear of God. For instance, the adidas trefoil is embossed into the heel, while " FEAR OF GOD" lettering appears on a dark rectangle on the midsole. The adidas Fear of God Athletics '86 Lo Clay was released on December 3, 2023, and sold for $200.

Display Name: Converse SHAI 001 Hail Clay
Description: Converse SHAI 001 Hail Clay brings warmth and individuality to Shai Gilgeous Alexanders emerging signature line through a colorway that feels expressive yet controlled. The hail clay tone adds earthiness and depth, letting texture and form speak louder than branding. It mirrors Shais calm confidence and creative approach to the game, translating personality into design. Collectors are drawn to this pair because it feels intentional and human. The SHAI 001 silhouette is built to exist between basketball and lifestyle spaces, and the Hail Clay color enhances that versatility. It represents the early foundation of a signature line focused on authenticity, making it especially exciting for fans watching a new creative voice define itself in sneaker culture. The Converse SHAI 001 Hail Clay was released on 10/02/2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low TIGHTBOOTH
Description: The TIGHTBOOTH x Nike SB Dunk Low is where the heartbeat of the city meets the soul of skate culture. Releasing on November 14, 2023, this sneaker is a celebration of the skateboarding scene and the urban landscape it thrives in. The White/Black-Safety Orange colorway mirrors the street lights and city nights, serving as a beacon for skaters everywhere. This collaboration is about more than just looksit's about the feel of the board underfoot and the grip on the pavement. The reflective elements and textural contrasts are inspired by the very streets that skaters call home. Its a sneaker that doesn't just stand out visually; it's built to perform under the cover of darkness, embodying the essence of nocturnal sessions. At $135, the TIGHTBOOTH Nike SB Sunk Low collaboration is an investment into the legacy of street skating. It's a bold statement piece for those who make the city their playground after sundown.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC White Glacier Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel NYC White Glacier Grey blends archival running design with clean everyday styling through a crisp White base accented by Glacier Grey overlays. The layered upper nods to classic ASICS performance silhouettes, while modern cushioning keeps the ride comfortable for long city days. The cool grey detailing sharpens the lines of the shoe, giving it a balanced and refined look that feels both retro and current. This pair stands out because it captures the tech runner wave without leaning too loud. The white and glacier grey combination feels timeless and versatile, making it easy to pair with everything from relaxed denim to tailored fits. Fans of the Gel NYC appreciate when ASICS keeps the silhouette rooted in performance heritage while refreshing it with subtle color updates. It is a clean, wearable sneaker that merges sport DNA with street ready appeal. The ASICS Gel NYC White Glacier Grey was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 Neon 95
Description: The Nike Book 1 Neon 95 nods to Air Max heritage through bold accent detailing on a modern basketball frame. Light Smoke Grey forms the base, while Volt accents electrify the silhouette with unmistakable energy. Black elements define the structure and highlight the clean panel transitions. The low cut design keeps the shoe agile and responsive, reinforcing its performance purpose. Fans quickly recognize the neon inspiration, appreciating how the vibrant Volt hits elevate the otherwise neutral base. It bridges classic Nike color history with Devin Bookers contemporary signature line. The contrast feels sharp and intentional, giving the shoe standout presence on court. Bold yet controlled, this edition merges nostalgia with modern performance. The Nike Book 1 Neon 95 was released on September 9, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Golf Bred
Description: First appearing on PGA Tour pro Pat Perez back in July of 2021, the Jordan 4 Golf Bred offers tribute to one of the most renowned OG Air Jordan 4 colorways to ever release, the Air Jordan 4 Bred. Its upper practically mimics the original design, not including the classic Nike Air logo heel tab where a Jumpman logo is featured instead. Tailoring the design for the greens, spikes on the outsole offer stability and traction for that perfect swing. The Air Jordan 4 Golf Bred released in December of 2021 and retailed for $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Sage Low Triple White (Women's)
Description: The womens Nike Air Force 1 Sage Low Triple White (W) features an ivory leather upper with matching Swooshes and a perforated overlay on the forefoot. From there, a thick, grooved outsole and a pull tab on the bottom laces complete the design. The womens Nike Air Force 1 Sage Low Triple White (W) released in October of 2018 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: Crocs Echo RO Clog Bape Powder Blue Camo
Description: The Crocs Echo RO Clog Bape Powder Blue Camo reimagines the futuristic Echo silhouette through the unmistakable visual language of BAPE camouflage in a softer and more playful color execution. The Echo RO Clog already stands out because of its exaggerated sculpted shape and modern slip on construction, but the Powder Blue camouflage treatment transforms the silhouette into a true streetwear statement piece. BAPEs camouflage patterns remain some of the most recognizable graphics in fashion history, and applying them to Crocs boldest modern clog design creates a collaboration that feels energetic, experimental, and highly collectible within contemporary sneaker culture. Fans of Crocs collaborations appreciate how the brand continues pushing beyond traditional comfort footwear into fashion focused and hype driven territory. The Powder Blue tones give this release a calmer and more lifestyle oriented atmosphere compared to louder BAPE camouflage executions while still preserving the playful identity associated with both brands. Collectors especially gravitate toward collaborations that merge iconic streetwear graphics with unconventional silhouettes, and the Echo RO design naturally amplifies that appeal through its futuristic proportions and layered construction. The softer blue palette keeps the clog visually unique while maintaining the exaggerated personality that defines the Echo line. The Crocs Echo RO Clog Bape Powder Blue Camo was released on May 14, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Model: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro QS
Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro QS Neckface
Description: The Nike Dunk SB Low Pro QS Neckface is a multi-hued sneaker that tones black and white as the dominant colors. On the black nubuck uppers of this SB Low Pro Nike Dunk shoe, numerous patches bearing Neckface's distinctively expressive visual sense are the focal point. There is also a number of patches on this sneaker that illustrate several depictions of ghouls, tombstones, skulls, demons, as well as snakes. A white midsole that sits on a black sole completes the design. The Nike Dunk SB Low Pro QS Neckface made its debut in the market on 27th October 2022 with a suggested retail price of $120.

Display Name: New Balance 574 Grey White
Description: The New Balance 574 Grey White takes the iconic low-top design that first debuted in 1988 and revamps it with performance trailing running technology. The sneaker features an ENCAP midsole, which provides cushioning with a durable rim that supports the foot. Like other 574 variations, the Grey White (2022) edition comes with a rippled outsole that grips the ground and provides additional traction. This running shoe boasts a breathable mesh base with large, suede overlays that form a lace cage. The understated colorway displays White, Grey, and Silver, but grey is the dominant tone. The branding details are minimal, including the N on the side panel, NEW BALANCE written across the heel, and a New Balance label on the tongue. Our StockX experts love the way the white laces stand out against the grey-tone upper and the silver detailing on the heel and the N. The New Balance 574 Grey White (2022) was released on April 15, 2022, and retailed at $95.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Dodgers (GS)
Description: The Nike Kobe 6 Dodgers (GS) brings big-league energy to the hardwood with a Game Royal, White, and University Red palette that nods to Los Angeles pride while keeping the fast, low-profile DNA of Kobe Bryants signature line. The signature scale-textured upper delivers lightweight structure and a distinctive look that stands out courtside or on the street, while the low-cut collar supports sharp cuts and sudden changes of pace. Underfoot, responsive Zoom Air pairs with a cushioned midsole to soak up impact and return energy on every stride, and a secure heel clip helps lock in the fit for confident drives to the rim. A grippy, Mamba-inspired traction pattern bites the floor for quick stops and go moves, making this a smart pick for young players who want speed without sacrificing control. Details make the Dodgers (GS) edition a collector-friendly favorite for kids who love basketball and bold color stories. The crisp Swoosh pops against Game Royal, and thoughtful touches like the molded scales and streamlined proportions give this shoe a polished, modern feel. Whether its for daily wear or game day, the Kobe 6 blends comfort and performance thanks to its breathable build and durable outsole designed to handle repeated play. With style code FV9676-400 and a release date of May 30, 2025, this pair captures the ethos of Kobes relentless mentality in a design scaled for younger athletes who want to look fast and feel faster. Our team loves this product because it delivers pro-level traction and springy cushioning in a striking colorway that motivates young hoopers to play hard and stand out.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Abominable Snowman (GS)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Abominable Snowman GS brings playful storytelling to the Dunk Low through a winter themed concept that feels fun and imaginative. The icy greens and blues give the shoe a frosted look, evoking cold weather folklore without leaning into gimmick territory. Even in grade school sizing, the Dunk Lows familiar shape keeps the design grounded and wearable. Fans love this release because it taps into creativity and seasonal charm. The Abominable Snowman theme adds personality that feels lighthearted, making the shoe especially appealing to younger collectors and those who enjoy character driven designs. Collectors appreciate how Nike uses the Dunk as a canvas for storytelling, turning a simple silhouette into something memorable while keeping comfort and everyday wear at the forefront. The Nike Dunk Low Abominable Snowman GS was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $102.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Black White
Description: The New Balance 9060 Black White arrives in a black-and-white color palette. The New Balance 9060 Black White has a black upper made of synthetic material with black and white embellishments and a white midsole. The black upper is made up of mesh, suede, and synthetic leather. The shoe bears a white "N" logo on the lateral sides and an "NB" logo on the tongue. The midsole is entirely white and incorporates ABZORB's signature cushioning. The shoe's outsole is black and made of rubber for grip and stability. The New Balance 9060 Black White was made available on March 4, 2023, and retails for $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble Total 90 Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble in Photon Dust, Dark Grey, Grey Fog, and Bright Violet is a colorway that pairs the 95's gradient layering tradition with one of the most visually striking accent colors the silhouette has carried in recent seasons, the bright violet landing against the tonal grey base with a precision and confidence that makes the exaggerated Big Bubble Air unit feel even more dramatic than usual. The photon dust and grey fog tonal range across the upper panels creates the subtle gradient depth that the Air Max 95 was originally designed around, while bright violet arrives through the Air unit, branding, and detailing to make the shoe's most technically significant feature its most visually commanding one simultaneously. Big Bubble Air Max 95 releases consistently generate strong collector enthusiasm because they deliver the silhouette's most architecturally pure and visually impactful expression, the oversized heel unit demanding attention in a way that standard 95 tooling cannot replicate at the same visual scale. Photon dust and bright violet is a color pairing that feels both contemporary and connected to the 95's late 1990s palette sensibilities, the cool neutral and vibrant accent combination referencing the decade's design language through a modern material and colorway lens that keeps the execution feeling fresh rather than purely archival. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble in Photon Dust and Bright Violet has a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low White Cannon (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low White Cannon Womens delivers a clean and slightly vibrant take on the silhouette through a mix of neutral and accent tones. The white base creates a bright and structured foundation, while cannon green accents add a sharp pop of color. Sail and light orewood brown details provide warmth and balance across the design. Fans of Jordan 1 Lows appreciate how combinations like this maintain everyday wearability while introducing subtle personality. The contrast between white and green gives it a fresh and modern feel. It is a sneaker that reflects timeless design with a contemporary color update. The Air Jordan 1 Low White Cannon Womens was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Ja 2 Stargazer
Description: The Nike Ja 2 Stargazer is a glitzy trainer that will immediately catch everyone's eyes when you wear it. It has one of the most unusual colorways you'll likely encounter. Plus, you're also getting all the advanced Nike athletic tech. This is an updated version of the hugely popular Nike Ja 1. It benefits from additional padding around the ankle cuff and a new waterfall collar. The colorway features magenta ripple panels with a pastel blue swoosh. The lower heel and side soles have contoured gray segments that evoke stars in the Milky Way. A suede toe box completes the look. Our experts were very taken by the visual styling of this shoe. There's a fluidity that's designed to reflect Ja Morant's smooth playing style. The grippy undersole feels secure and solid during fast direction changes. This innovative trainer strikes a good balance between fashion, ability, and on-court ruggedness. The Nike Ja 2 Stargazer was released on 3 October 2024 and retailed at $120.
Colorway: Bold Berry/Baltic Blue-Light Lemon Twist-Dark Raisin

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Limosine Skateboards
Description: Nike SB Dunk Low Limosine Skateboards channels raw skate energy through a collaboration that feels grounded in real culture rather than surface level branding. Limosines identity brings grit and authenticity to the SB Dunk Low, giving the shoe a serious tone that reflects skateboarding as lived experience. The design feels stripped back and intentional, letting mood and attitude define the collaboration. This release resonates with collectors because it feels honest. The SB Dunk Low already carries deep roots in skate history, and the Limosine partnership builds on that foundation with confidence and restraint. It appeals to fans who value credibility and storytelling, rewarding those who understand skate culture beyond aesthetics and hype driven moments. The Nike SB Dunk Low Limosine Skateboards was released on 09/06/2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves Monarch (with Bracelet)
Description: In collaboration with Patta, the Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves Monarch (with Bracelet) features a grey mesh upper with white overlays with Monarch Swooshes and a wave-shaped mudguard. From there, retro Nike branding on the heel nods to the original line of Air Max 1s. A cream Air midsole, multicolor outsole, and signature Patta woven tongue tags add the finishing touch. The Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves Monarch released in October of 2021 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black Panda (TD)
Description: A toddlers shoe (TD), the Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black TD comes in a classic colorway. Crafted from soft leather, the Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black (TD) upper is made from a white base overlaid by contrasting black throughout. The black extends to the iconic Swoosh branding and the lightly padded nylon tongue. The tooling continues the two-toned design to include a white midsole and a black rubber outsole that draws directly from the Air Jordan 1. The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black (TD) was released in March 2021 at a retail price of $50.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Triple Black Suede
Description: The New Balance 2002R Triple Black Suede elevates everyday style with a stealthy, monochrome palette and rich materials. Wrapped in plush suede with tonal mesh underlays, this all-black take on the 2002R blends modern cushioning with classic running DNA for a look thats clean, versatile, and easy to wear. The Black/Magnet colorway keeps branding subtle and refined, while layered paneling and precise stitching add depth and texture. A sculpted midsole and streamlined silhouette deliver a contemporary edge that pairs just as well with technical gear as it does with pared-back streetwear. Underfoot, the 2002R is engineered for comfort and stability from first step to last lap. ABZORB cushioning in the midsole softens impact, N-ergy heel pods add responsive shock absorption, and a Stability Web shank helps keep transitions smooth and supported. Durable Ndurance rubber targets high-wear zones for long-lasting traction, making this pair a dependable daily driver. Finished with the style code U2002RBL and releasing on 2025-03-01, this Triple Black Suede edition is a go-to for anyone who wants refined design, premium feel, and all-day comfort in one effortless package. We're seeing major traction on this drop since it delivers stealth looks, plush materials, and dependable 2002R comfort that fits seamlessly into any rotation.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 USA (2025)
Description: The Nike Shox R4 USA 2025 channels patriotic inspiration through a performance driven classic. Finished in Midnight Navy with White, Metallic Silver, and Gym Red accents, the color palette nods to national pride while maintaining the sleek and aerodynamic lines of the R4. The sculpted upper flows seamlessly into the signature Shox cushioning columns, delivering both visual impact and responsive support. USA themed releases always resonate with fans who appreciate bold and symbolic color blocking. The deep navy base feels strong and composed, while red and white accents provide sharp contrast. It is a version of the Shox R4 that blends heritage inspiration with futuristic cushioning, standing out both for its color story and its unmistakable silhouette. The Nike Shox R4 USA 2025 was released on June 20, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 Black Metallic Silver Purple Dynasty
Description: The Nike Shox R4 Black Metallic Silver Purple Dynasty adds contrast and energy to the classic Shox silhouette, combining dark tones with reflective accents. Black forms the base, while metallic silver highlights the structure and purple dynasty adds a subtle but noticeable pop of color. The design feels both futuristic and grounded. This version stands out because it highlights the unique shape of the Shox R4 through color and material. Fans of the silhouette appreciate when it is updated in ways that enhance its identity rather than change it. It remains bold, structured, and instantly recognizable. The Nike Shox R4 Black Metallic Silver Purple Dynasty was released on December 10, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme Baroque Brown
Description: The Supreme Air Force 1 is back, this time in a classic brown colorway fit for your fall rotation. Supreme has a storied history of working with Nike on collaborative efforts, including various Air Force 1s that release seasonally through the brand's collections. This Baroque Brown colorway first released during the Supreme Fall/Winter 2023 season. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme Baroque Brown released on November 2nd, 2023, for a retail price of $124.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Spiridon Cage 2 Metallic Silver
Description: The appearance of the Nike Air Zoom Spiridon Cage 2 Metallic Silver is influenced by two major colors: metallic silver and light smoke gray. The Metallic Silver Nike Air Zoom Spiridon, commonly known as the Cage 2, features a mesh upper in silver and gray. Along with a black outlined Swoosh logo on the sides, it features patent and metallic silver leather overlays on the sides, toe, and heel areas. The heel sports a red Swoosh logo, while the front has white laces. A clear air cell with a glossy black cage surrounding it can be found at the heel of the white, foam-filled midsole. The Nike Air Zoom Spiridon Cage 2 Metallic Silver had $140 as the recommended market price during its launch on April 13th, 2020.

Display Name: New Balance 204L Timberwolf
Description: Meet the New Balance 204L Timberwolf, a clean, modern essential that blends everyday comfort with understated style. The Timberwolf colorway leans into earthy taupe and grey tones for an elevated neutral palette that pairs effortlessly with denim, cargos, or tailored athleisure. A soft, layered upper with mixed textures gives depth without shouting, while the signature N logos and streamlined overlays deliver that timeless New Balance look. The cushioned foam midsole absorbs impact for day-long wear, and a grippy rubber outsole offers reliable traction from city streets to weekend errands. Finished with a padded collar and breathable lining, the 204L keeps your stride light and your style refined. Designed as a versatile lifestyle sneaker, the New Balance 204L balances form and function in a silhouette that feels contemporary yet familiar. Thoughtful details, subtle contrast stitching, refined paneling, and a sleek toe shape, make the Timberwolf edition an easy go-to for minimalists and sneaker enthusiasts alike. Style code U204LMMC ties it directly to the Timberwolf release, and its balanced proportions ensure it sits just right with cropped trousers or relaxed fits. Whether youre dressing it up or keeping it casual, this pair delivers dependable comfort and a polished finish that works season after season. Our team loves this product because it combines a refined neutral palette with cushy, all-day comfort, making it a smart, wear-with-anything staple in any rotation.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Lyte III '07 Remastered Shigeyuki Mitsui Orange Cream
Description: The ASICS Gel-Lyte III 07 Remastered Shigeyuki Mitsui in Orange Cream Blue is a tribute release honoring both the GEL-Lyte III's 35th anniversary and the retirement of its original designer Shigeyuki Mitsui, who created the silhouette's defining split-tongue construction in 1990 as a practical solution to the problem of tongue slippage during running, accidentally producing the most distinctive and widely recognizable design detail in ASICS history, with Mitsui's signature embroidered directly onto the split tongue as the most personal design element on the shoe, placing the creator's name on the feature he invented and making the connection between designer and design the literal and visible subject of the tribute. The coral-themed colorway was chosen by Mitsui himself and derives its significance from Japanese wordplay, where the number 35 can be pronounced san-go, which also means coral, making the coral aesthetic simultaneously an anniversary marking and a linguistic tribute, with turquoise and teal hairy suede on the mudguard and heel overlays and cream suede across the toe box and lace panels providing the base construction, while orange Tiger Stripes in carved leather with textures that mimic coral reef formations run across the midsole, and coral reef artwork printed on the insoles completing the thematic coherence of the design across every visible surface. The Remastered construction format, previously reserved exclusively for collaborations including the landmark 2023 Kith x ASICS Gel-Lyte III Remastered partnership with Ronnie Fieg, makes its first general release appearance with this Shigeyuki Mitsui tribute, bringing upgraded materials, richer detailing, a chunkier toe shape, more padded collar, and slightly different panel dimensions compared to standard GEL-Lyte III releases. The 07 Remastered designation specifically references the 2007 era Gel-Lyte III construction that collectors identified as having distinct characteristics from the original 1990 version, including the fuller toe profile and collar padding that give the shoe a more substantial and premium feel that enthusiasts prefer over the standard modern release construction, and this Mitsui tribute is built entirely on that preferred 07-era architecture as a mark of respect for the original designer rather than producing a compromise construction. The Gel-Lyte III's broader cultural significance spans from its original 1990 running context through its transformation into the defining ASICS lifestyle and collector silhouette of the 2010s sneaker scene, propelled by Ronnie Fieg's legendary limited edition collaborations through his David Z. buyer role before his founding of Kith, with this Mitsui retirement tribute arriving at the moment when the shoe's 35th anniversary and its creator's career simultaneously reach their conclusions. Released June 5, 2026 at $160 retail through ASICS.com and select retailers with style code 1203B185-800, the Shigeyuki Mitsui release is available in unisex sizing. The ASICS Gel-Lyte III 07 Remastered Shigeyuki Mitsui Orange Cream was released on June 5, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Pink Foam
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Pink Foam pushes the Pegasus line into a more expressive space, using a pink foam black hyper pink off noir palette that feels bold without losing performance focus. The layered upper and responsive cushioning keep it grounded in running heritage, while the color execution adds a lifestyle edge that stands out immediately. It feels like a modern evolution of a trusted silhouette. Fans of the Pegasus series appreciate how each iteration builds on comfort and reliability, and this version adds a stronger visual identity to that foundation. The mix of tones creates depth, making it just as suitable for everyday wear as it is for performance. It stands out as a statement runner that still carries the consistency collectors expect from the line. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Pink Foam was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Undefeated 5 On It Dunk vs. AF1
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Undefeated 5 On It features a blue leather upper with snake print overlays, purple canvas quarter panels, and white suede Swooshes. From there, Undefeated logos on the heel and woven tongue label complete the design. The Nike Dunk Low Undefeated 5 On It released in August of 2021 and retailed for $120.

Display Name: New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Kith Dusty Mauve
Description: The New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Kith Dusty Mauve is the standout silhouette in Kith's 2026 Made in USA 99X Series, a four-sneaker collaboration released to celebrate the reopening and renovation of Kith West Hollywood alongside Ronnie Fieg's latest hospitality venture, Ronnie's Pronto, marking Kith's 15th anniversary as a brand with the kind of New Balance partnership that has become one of the most creatively consistent and most culturally significant collaborations in the premium sneaker space over more than a decade. The 990v4 in Dusty Mauve is the collection's warmest and most romantically toned pair, the muted rose and earthy mauve colorway occupying the specific palette position in Kith's seasonal color vocabulary that reads simultaneously as warm-weather appropriate and as genuinely wearable across all seasons, a tone that has characterized some of Fieg's most admired New Balance collaborations over the years. Built on the 990v4 silhouette, which features a firmer and denser ENCAP midsole relative to the 990v3's more cushioned setup, the Dusty Mauve pair is constructed with premium pigskin suede overlays over open mesh underlays engineered for breathability and durability, the material pairing that has defined the Made in USA collaboration line's commitment to craft across every silhouette in the 99X family. Co-branded details include Kith branding on the footbed and heel, a co-branded tongue, molded N logo on the side panels, and 990 branding on the lateral heel, with the entire package delivered in a custom co-branded box. The global release on May 11, 2026 followed an early-access in-store launch at Kith West Hollywood on May 8, with Kith App drawings open from May 8 through May 10 for pairs in unisex sizing. The New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Kith Dusty Mauve is the collaboration pair for the collector who wants the 2026 99X Series' most warmly toned and most thoroughly Fieg-coded colorway on the 990 family's sharpest riding silhouette. The New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Kith Dusty Mauve was released on May 11, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Olympic (2024)

This 2024 release marks the 3rd time this sneaker has released, which has come only once every 12 years (2000, 2012, and 2024). The white upper with midnight navy accepts and varsity red touches bring this classic style to life. The Jordan 6 Retro Olympic (2024) released on August 3rd, 2024, for a retail price of $200. Lock in this OG classic today on StockX.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Wales Bonner Pony Hair
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Wales Bonner Pony Hair transforms one of adidas most timeless terrace silhouettes into a luxury driven statement piece through Grace Wales Bonners signature blend of heritage sportswear and elevated craftsmanship. Display Name: Nike Sabrina 2 White Noise (Women's)

An example, the sneaker replaces the Sabrina 1s React cushioning with a responsive Air Zoom unit on the forefoot and two types of Cushlon foam underfoot. Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Bred

A foam midsole in anthracite provides cushioning and houses a visible Air cassette under the heel. The black rubber outsole sports modified waffle lugs in order to absorb shock and provide grip with every step. The detail that we enjoy most about this pair of kicks is the red tinting in the Air unit, which ties together the black and red or bred look of the shoe. The Nike Air Max 1 Bred was released on December 19, 2023, for a retail price of $150.

Model: Nike SB Air Max Ishod Wair
Display Name: Nike SB Air Max Ishod Wair Grand Purple
Description: The Nike SB Air Max Ishod Wair Grand Purple is a masterclass in tonal color storytelling, combining five distinct shades of purple across a vented suede upper in a way that creates genuine depth and movement rather than a flat monochromatic statement. Grand Purple anchors the toe and lower side panels with a rich, saturated base, while Noble Purple takes over the bulk of the toebox and lace panel in a slightly dustier interpretation of the same family. Gravity Purple hits the venting cutouts at the center of the side panels in the deepest, most concentrated shade of the palette, and near-white violet lands on the laces for quick contrast before a darker violet wraps the ankle collar and sockliner. An eggplant tone coats the midsole and a translucent light blue drop-in Air unit peeks through the heel, giving the underfoot construction its own quiet surprise. Black handles the outsole and mini Swoosh branding, with "WAIR" embroidered below the lateral lace loops and "ISHOD" stitched into the padded mesh tongue. Ishod Wair's connection to purple is well established across his Nike SB catalog, and the Grand Purple continues a lineage that includes "Court Purple" and "Black Grape" predecessors, each one building on Ishod's evident affinity for the color while finding new ways to execute it. What makes the Air Max Ishod historically significant within Nike SB is that it was the first signature skate shoe to incorporate visible Air cushioning, a concept Ishod drew from his deep appreciation of classic Nike Basketball silhouettes. That collision of skate and hoops DNA remains the defining tension of the shoe, and this colorway leans fully into the expressiveness that hoops-inspired design language allows while keeping the construction completely functional for actual skating. The Nike SB Air Max Ishod Wair Grand Purple was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $115.
Colorway: Grand Purple/Black/Noble Purple/Gravity Purple/Canyon Purple/Space Purple

For example, the white upper serves as a background for a collection of overlays that form sporty lines in Pure Platinum and Wolf Gray. Carved-out designs on the midsole mimic these lines and speak to the sneakers 2000s roots. While the upper is made of breathable mesh, the overlays come in leather and synthetic leather. The sneaker boasts a soft foam midsole, a supportive insole, and a durable rubber outsole. Our experts at StockX like the light padding around the tongue and heel that contributes to the sneakers Y2K aesthetic. The womens size Nike P-6000 Summit White Pure Platinum (Women's) was released on December 19th, 2023, and retailed at $120.

Display Name: Nike ZoomX Invincible Run 3 Black
Description: The Nike ZoomX Invincible Run 3 Black delivers a clean, stripped-down aesthetic to one of Nikes most cushioned and supportive running silhouettes in a sleek black colorway. Dressed in an all-black and anthracite color scheme, this edition takes a minimalist approach that seamlessly transitions from high-mileage runs to everyday wear. A breathable black Flyknit upper hugs the foot for a lightweight, sock-like fit, while tonal Swoosh branding on the lateral side, toe box, and heel adds subtle style. Underfoot, the plush ZoomX foam midsole offers a soft, bouncy ride designed to reduce fatigue across long distances. The rocker-shaped sole enhances smooth transitions, and a ZoomX-branded patch on the medial heel adds a finishing detail. What makes this version stand out is its reflective detailing, including a vertical strip along the heel tab and counter, plus reflective laces. They both provide visibility and a tech-inspired edge. Originally released on March 15, 2024, the Nike ZoomX Invincible Run 3 Black retailed for $180.

Display Name: Jordan Flight Court Who Decides War Coconut Milk (Women's)
Description: The Jordan Flight Court Who Decides War Coconut Milk (Women's) blends heritage hoops style with modern design cues, delivering a clean, minimalist palette that elevates any rotation. Dressed in the Coconut Milk/Black colorway (style HQ2958-100), this pair leans into soft neutrals accented by bold contrast hits for an effortlessly refined look. The streamlined upper showcases durable materials with subtle textural depth, while the padded collar and plush tongue create a supportive, locked-in feel. Underfoot, responsive cushioning helps soften every step, making these sneakers ideal for all-day wear, whether youre heading to a gallery opening or your favorite brunch spot. Designed for versatility, the Jordan Flight Court brings court-inspired traction and a dependable rubber outsole that grips reliably on city streets. The clean lines and balanced proportions flatter a range of outfits, from tailored trousers and a blazer to relaxed denim and a cropped tee, so you can move from day to night without missing a beat. Thoughtful details nod to the collaborative Who Decides War narrative, while the classic Jordan DNA keeps the silhouette timeless. With its July 11, 2025 release date and a refined neutral scheme, this womens sneaker is set to become a go-to staple for minimalists and trendsetters alike. Our team loves this product because it pairs elevated comfort with a versatile, fashion-forward color story that effortlessly upgrades everyday style.

Display Name: Nike Air Tech Challenge II Racer Pink
Description: The Nike Air Tech Challenge II Racer Pink brings a vibrant twist to the classic tennis-inspired silhouette. This men's sneaker features a crisp white leather upper, accented with eye-catching Racer Pink details that pay homage to its retro roots. The Light Smoke Grey and Coconut Milk accents provide a balanced contrast, creating a visually appealing design that stands out on and off the court. Combining style with functionality, this iteration of the Air Tech Challenge II maintains its iconic features, including the visible Air unit in the heel for responsive cushioning. The durable rubber outsole offers excellent traction, while the padded collar ensures comfort during wear. With its blend of retro aesthetics and modern performance elements, this sneaker is perfect for those who appreciate both style and substance in their footwear. Our experts state this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts looking to add a pop of color to their collection while enjoying the comfort and durability of a classic Nike design.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Black Aura Squadron Blue
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid Black Aura Squadron Blue delivers a bold and layered take on the silhouette through a mix of dark and vibrant tones. The black base creates a strong and structured look, while aura and squadron blue accents add contrast that highlights the design. White elements provide balance, keeping the overall composition cohesive. Fans of the Jordan 1 Mid appreciate how colorways like this bring energy and depth to the silhouette while maintaining its classic identity. The combination of dark and bright tones gives it a dynamic presence. It is a sneaker that reflects modern styling within a timeless Jordan framework.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Jackie Robinson
Description: In 1948, Jackie Robinson broke the color barrier in baseball when he stepped onto the field for the Brooklyn Dodgers in his MLB debut. Nike honored the legacy of the iconic civil rights activist and baseball hero with the Nike Dunk Low Jackie Robinson. The Nike Dunk Low Jackie Robinson boasts a Brooklyn Dodgers color palette with a light grey Durabuck upper, royal blue leather overlays, an embroidered mini-Swoosh at the toe, and a felted side Swoosh - reminiscent of baseball caps in the late-1940s. Throughout the design, Robinson's famous quote, "I'm not concerned with you liking or disliking meAll I ask is that you respect me as a human being", is printed in a pattern format. At the heel, Robinson's number 42 is embroidered, providing a custom feel. The Nike Dunk Low Jackie Robinson released in July of 2022 and retailed for $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 College Grey Racer Blue
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 College Grey Racer Blue delivers a crisp and athletic take on the Air Max 90, using cool tones to emphasize the silhouettes sharp lines. College grey forms a clean base, while racer blue adds energy and contrast that feels sporty without overpowering the design. It feels precise and balanced, rooted in Nike running heritage while fitting seamlessly into modern wear. Fans gravitate toward this release because it feels reliable and confident. The Air Max 90 remains one of Nikes most versatile models, and this colorway reinforces that strength through restraint and clarity. Collectors love it as a rotation staple, a sneaker that feels fresh but familiar, proving once again why the Air Max 90 continues to thrive across generations and style movements. The Nike Air Max 90 College Grey Racer Blue was released on January 21, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan Tatum 3 Tunnel Walk
Description: The Air Jordan Tatum 3 Tunnel Walk delivers a bold and fashion forward take on the silhouette through a clean base and premium accents. The white upper creates a bright and structured look, while black details add contrast that defines the design. Metallic gold elements introduce a refined touch, reflecting pre game style influence. Fans of tunnel walk aesthetics appreciate how this colorway blends performance with off court fashion. The combination of white, black, and gold gives it a sleek and elevated feel. It is a sneaker that reflects modern basketball culture and personal style. The Air Jordan Tatum 3 Tunnel Walk was released on April 15, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: New Balance 991v2 MiUK Kith Osaka Pack
Description: The New Balance 991v2 MiUK Kith Osaka Pack is a shoe designed as a collaboration between Kith and New Balance to commemorate the opening of the Kith store in Osaka. This iteration of the New Balance 991v2 has a blue-grey mesh upper that forms its base, allowing for increased airflow. Suede overlays form the toe box, mudguard, side supports, and heel counter in a dark grey color, while leather overlays in off-white support the toe box. The classic New Balance "N" appears on each side, while Kith branding is on the lateral heel. New Balance Made in England 991 V2 branding is seen on the tongue, while V2 lettering is also on the heel's back. The cushioned midsole appears in beige, white, and blue-grey shades. What stands out about this shoe is the ease with which the dual branding is accomplished, making it smooth and streamlined. The New Balance 991v2 MiUK Kith Osaka Pack was released on March 21, 2025, for $260.

Display Name: Burberry Slides Archive Beige (Women's)
Description: The Burberry Slides Archive Beige (Women's) feature the classic Vintage Check print on a pair of slides made from premium materials. These women's-sized slides boast a contoured insole that supports the arch and provides comfort during extended wear. The slip-on style allows the wearer to put on and remove the shoes easily. The placement of the strap prevents them from falling off the foot. The Black and Beige Colorway can be seen on the Vintage Check print, displaying black and red lines crossing the Beige background. Although the branding details are minimal, "BURBERRY" is embossed along the lateral side of the outsole. What our experts like about the women's slides is the simplistic design. Specifically, the choice of Black for the outsole allows the Vintage Check print to take center stage. The Burberry Slides Archive Beige (Women's) were released on March 1st, 2023, and retailed at $370.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax 2021 FK Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike Air VaporMax 2021 FK Black Anthracite was designed with both utility and sustainability in mind. The uppers are made out of stretchy and breathable Flyknit fabric, and they are adorned by the brands iconic Swoosh symbol. There is also a classic Nike symbol that is featured on the insoles. The Nike Air VaporMax 2021 FK Black Anthracite is made out of 40% recycled content by weight. The Nike Air VaporMax 2021 FK Black Anthracite has two cushioning units that are sizable yet sleek. These units sit across recycled rubber outsoles and are bolstered by recycled TPU clips. What our experts like the most in the Nike Air VaporMax 2021 FK Black Anthracite is its sleek design and total black colorway. The midsole and outsole complete the Nike sneaker making it one of the classics and recognizable designs of the Nike Air lines. The sneaker was first released in June of 2021 at a starting price of $200.

Display Name: New Balance 740v2 Concord Grape
Description: The New Balance 740v2 Concord Grape is a running shoe featuring a White mesh fabric upper overlaid with graphic caging. The metallic finish caging is done in Concord Grape purple and Phantom, with linear accents of silver and white. The molded 3D New Balance N logo anchors the sides in Concord Grape, and a textured white midsole and black tread outsole complete the look. American footwear and athletic wear brand New Balance was founded in 1906, and the brand became known over time for their performance shoes that could act as daily runners, incurring heavy mileage. New Balance delved into their 2000s archives to reproduce the 740 in the 2020s, and its ABZORB midsole features its signature compression resistance and cushioning. The 740v2 boasts caging in a bold Concord Grape hue, which is an uncommon running shoe color. The New Balance 740v2 Concord Grape released on January 15, 2025, and retailed for $110.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Armor Black
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Armor Black leans fully into the technical runner aesthetic with a darker and more aggressive interpretation of the silhouette. The all black palette enhances the layered construction, allowing the mesh and synthetic overlays to blend into a stealthy and cohesive design. The Omni 9 remains rooted in performance heritage, built around ProGrid cushioning that delivers stability and comfort while maintaining a structured look that fits naturally within modern sneaker trends. Fans gravitate toward monochrome runners like this because they highlight the shape and build of the shoe without relying on bold color contrast. The Armor Black execution gives the pair a tactical feel, making it versatile for everyday wear while still maintaining a strong visual identity. Retro performance silhouettes continue gaining traction due to their comfort and distinct design language. For collectors, pairs like this represent Sauconys ability to modernize its archive through clean and wearable updates that preserve the integrity of the original model. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Armor Black was released on February 12, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Black Metallic
Description: The New Balance 2002R Black Metallic pushes the silhouette into a more modern and slightly futuristic direction, using black tones paired with metallic accents to create depth and contrast. The layered upper highlights the technical structure of the 2002R, giving it a dynamic look that shifts depending on lighting. It stays rooted in performance design while leaning into lifestyle appeal. Fans appreciate how this colorway adds energy without sacrificing versatility. The metallic elements elevate the design just enough to make it stand out, while the black base keeps it wearable across different styles. The 2002R continues to thrive as a crossover model, and this version reinforces its place in both comfort and design focused rotations. It is a strong option for those who want a subtle but distinctive sneaker. The New Balance 2002R Black Metallic was released on January 30, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: New Balance 1890 Action Bronson Planet Frog
Description: The New Balance 1890 Action Bronson Planet Frog reflects the larger than life personality and fearless creativity that have made Action Bronson collaborations some of the most distinctive releases in modern sneaker culture. Bronson consistently approaches footwear through bold color combinations and storytelling driven concepts that reject minimalism entirely, and Planet Frog continues that direction through an energetic mix of yellow and grey tones layered across the futuristic New Balance 1890 silhouette. The result feels playful, loud, and deeply connected to Bronsons eclectic artistic identity spanning music, food, travel, and fashion. Fans gravitate toward Action Bronson collaborations because they feel personal and expressive rather than safe or trend focused. The Planet Frog concept immediately creates a surreal and imaginative atmosphere that fits naturally within the exaggerated proportions and technical construction of the 1890 model. Collectors especially appreciate how Bronson uses color unpredictably while still maintaining strong balance and wearability throughout the design. The combination of bright yellow accents and muted grey elements gives the shoe an adventurous and highly visual identity that stands apart sharply from more understated contemporary sneaker collaborations. The New Balance 1890 Action Bronson Planet Frog was released on May 8, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential Summit White University Gold
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Summit White University Gold delivers a clean and classic interpretation of the silhouette, focusing on simplicity and balance. The summit white base provides a neutral foundation, while university gold accents introduce a bright but controlled contrast. Vast grey and college grey details round out the palette, adding depth without overwhelming the design. This version resonates with fans who appreciate timeless color blocking. It does not rely on heavy storytelling or bold experimentation, instead offering a reliable and wearable option that highlights the strengths of the Air Max 1. It is the kind of pair that fits effortlessly into any rotation while still carrying the legacy of one of Nikes most important designs. The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Summit White University Gold was released on January 20, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Pulse Summit White
Description: The Nike Air Max Pulse Summit White is a men's release from Nike's Air Max Pulse program, retailing at $150 with style code DR0453-101 in the White/Summit White/White colorway, confirmed by Kicks on Fire, Flight Club, and multiple authorized retailers. As confirmed by Amazon's official product description and Sole Retriever's coverage of the Air Max Pulse Summit White Platinum Tint, the Air Max Pulse was introduced on Air Max Day 2023 and draws direct inspiration from the London music scene, featuring a fabric-covered midsole with vacuum-sealed construction details, a textile upper with leather and synthetic outer layers, a foam midsole, and a rubber outsole with waffle pattern. The point-loaded Air cushioning system, renewed from the Air Max 270, features a plastic clip that distributes weight in targeted points of the Air unit for a highly elastic experience, with the heel Air bubble providing exceptional comfort suited to both all-day casual wear and light athletic activity. The Summit White colorway applies the clean, all-white palette across every element of the Air Max Pulse upper, midsole, and lace system for a tonal, minimalist execution described by multiple retailers as the cleanest and most broadly wearable presentation of the Air Max Pulse across its colorway range. Retail price $150. The Nike Air Max Pulse Summit White is the DR0453-101 London-music-scene-inspired fabric-covered-midsole vacuum-sealed-construction point-loaded-Air-heel-cushion waffle-pattern-outsole Air Max Pulse for the Nike collector who wants the most tonal and most broadly wearable triple-white Summit White execution from the Nike Air Max Pulse multi-colorway program. The Nike Air Max Pulse Summit White has a retail price of $150.

Display Name: New Balance 740v2 Black Grey Silver
Description: The New Balance 740v2 Black Grey Silver is a sleek and stylish addition to the renowned New Balance lineup. This men's sneaker showcases a sophisticated color palette, combining black, grey, and silver hues for a versatile and modern aesthetic. The 740v2 model builds upon the success of its predecessor, offering enhanced comfort and performance features that cater to both casual wear and athletic pursuits. Crafted with New Balance's signature attention to detail, the 740v2 boasts a durable construction that ensures longevity. The upper is designed with a combination of premium materials, providing both support and breathability for all-day comfort. The shoe's cushioning system offers responsive support, making it ideal for various activities, from daily walks to light workouts. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a balance between style and functionality in their footwear, as it seamlessly transitions from casual outings to more active scenarios.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Pink Spell Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Pink Spell Black Womens pushes the retro tech runner into bold and playful territory. Featuring Pink Spell with Metallic Platinum, Pink Foam, and Black accents, the layered mesh and structured overlays highlight the models early two thousands aesthetic. The cushioned sole reinforces the comfort driven DNA of the Vomero line. Pink tones give this edition a vibrant edge, while black detailing keeps the look grounded and balanced. The Vomero 5 continues to thrive as a lifestyle favorite thanks to its intricate construction and nostalgic feel. It stands out as a confident and expressive take on a modern classic. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Pink Spell Black Womens was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 3 FK Ekiden Pack
Description: The Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 3 FK Ekiden Pack celebrates long distance racing culture through a colorway inspired by Japans iconic relay marathons. The Vaporfly Next% 3 FK silhouette is already synonymous with speed and efficiency, and the Ekiden palette adds energy and symbolism through bold red and gold accents layered over a clean white base. It feels ceremonial and performance driven at the same time, designed to honor teamwork, endurance, and precision. Runners and collectors love this release because it connects innovation with tradition. The Vaporfly platform represents the cutting edge of racing footwear, and the Ekiden theme grounds that technology in history and ritual. Fans appreciate how the design feels purposeful rather than decorative, making this a shoe that stands for both competitive ambition and respect for running culture. It resonates strongly with those who view racing as both science and craft. The Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 3 FK Ekiden Pack was released on December 4, 2024 with a retail price of $260.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 White Blue Crystal
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 in White Blue Crystal is a March 2026 general release featuring a White leather and mesh upper with Light Smoke Grey tonal overlays, black accent hits on the mudguard and laces, and Blue Crystal applied to the outsole creating the icy translucent blue sole color that gives this colorway its name and its most distinctive visual detail. The Blue Crystal outsole treatment applies a semi-transparent tinted rubber to the Air Max 90's signature exaggerated waffle tread and elephant print mudguard platform, producing a color that reads as a cool, light blue at a glance but reveals its crystalline translucency when examined closely or under specific lighting, connecting this colorway to the broader trend of icy and translucent outsoles that has appeared periodically across Nike's general release catalog as a premium visual treatment applied to standard Air Max silhouettes. The White body provides the cleanest possible base for both the Light Smoke Grey panel contrast and the Blue Crystal outsole, keeping the colorway neutral-forward with the blue accent providing the seasonal freshness appropriate for the spring 2026 release window without introducing the kind of bold color combination that would limit the shoe's outfit versatility. Released March 20, 2026 at $135 retail via nike.com and select retailers. The Nike Air Max 90 White Blue Crystal was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro 72-10
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro 72-10 introduced a minimalist design with transparent outsole, clean white midsole, and the patent mudguard that defines the Jordan 11 silhouette. ? This Retro 72 10 features a premium tumbled leather upper with microfiber suede and patent leather overlays. The design also includes a red and black carbon fiber shank plate. A gym red Jumpman logo appears at the heel and tongue, and the sneaker sits atop a white Phylon midsole, with full-length Air-sole cushioning, and on a translucent rubber outsole. ? The Air Jordan 11 Retro 72-10 was released on the 12th of December 2015, and originally retailed for $220.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Mambacita Sweet 16
Description: The Nike Kobe 6 Protro Mabacita Sweet 16 pays tribute to the late Gigi Bryant and the Mamba & Mambacita Sports Foundation. The Nike Kobe 6 debuted in 2011 and was the sixth signature sneaker between Nike and the late Laker legend, Kobe Bryant. In 2018, Nike would retro some of Kobes older and most memorable sneakers under their Protro program as a means to better equip each pair for the demands and needs of current athletes. The Nike Kobe 6 Protro Mabacita Sweet 16 features a black snakeskin-inspired upper as a tribute to Kobes Black Mamba on-court moniker. From there, Gigis AAU basketball jersey number, 2, is stamped on both lateral sides of the ankle. The Mamba & Mambacita Sports Foundation crest is printed on the heel of each shoe followed by both Kobe and Gigis names underneath. Lastly, a neoprene and mesh tongue and signature Zoom midsole provide comfort and stability on and off the court. The Nike Kobe 6 Protro Mabacita Sweet 16 released on May 1st, 2022.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Frozen Moments (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Frozen Moments made its debut on August 26, 2023. Cementing itself as a must-have, this iteration of the Jordan legacy showcased a balanced new design palette. Crafted with precision, the sneaker flashes a blend of light iron ore, sail-neutral grey, black, and metallic silver, bringing a balanced and understated aesthetic to the iconic Jordan 4 silhouette. The defining feature is its meticulous craftsmanship and the fusion of these nuanced colors with suede and leather overlays on the upper. The iconic wings on the side panel boast a flashy metallic silver hue that make the sneaker pop. With a lineage known for excellence and style, the Jordan 4 Retro Frozen Moments dropped at a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike KD 4 Weatherman (2024)
Description: The Nike KD 4 Weatherman (2024) brings back one of the most iconic colorways in the KD line, inspired by Kevin Durant's childhood dream of becoming a weatherman. This re-release features a lush green upper with volt, black, and team orange accents, creating a visually striking design. The sneaker's standout feature is the weather pattern graphics on the upper and outsole, which pay homage to Durant's passion for meteorology before he discovered his talent for basketball. This unique design element makes the KD 4 Weatherman a must-have for both sneaker enthusiasts and KD fans. The KD 4 Weatherman first made waves in 2011 and has remained a favorite among sneakerheads. This 2024 version retains the original's bold aesthetics. The vibrant colorway, highlighted by lush green and volt, captures attention, while the weather-inspired graphics add a layer of storytelling that connects to Durants personal history. The black and team orange details further enhance the dynamic look, making this sneaker a standout on and off the court. Priced at $130, the Nike KD 4 Weatherman (2024) was released on May 21, 2024. This re-release not only celebrates Kevin Durant's journey but also offers a piece of sneaker history with a fresh twist. Whether you're a long-time fan or new to the KD line, this sneaker combines heritage, design, and performance in one compelling package. Make sure to add this iconic model to your collection and step out in style with the KD 4 Weatherman.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Elemental Pink (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Elemental Pink (Women's) is a stylish and eco-conscious addition to the iconic Dunk lineup. Featuring a clean white base with soft Elemental Pink accents, this sneaker offers a fresh and feminine twist on the classic silhouette. The shoe's upper is crafted using sustainable materials as part of Nike's Next Nature initiative, demonstrating the brand's commitment to reducing environmental impact without compromising on style or performance. Designed with both fashion and function in mind, these Dunk Lows boast a low-cut profile that provides enhanced mobility and versatility. The combination of white and Elemental Pink creates a versatile colorway that can easily complement a wide range of outfits, making it a perfect choice for everyday wear. With its timeless design and modern eco-friendly approach, this sneaker represents the perfect fusion of heritage and innovation. Our team thinks this product is great for environmentally conscious sneaker enthusiasts who want to make a stylish statement while supporting sustainable practices in footwear manufacturing.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC 2.0 Graphite Grey Black
Description: The ASICS Gel NYC 20 Graphite Grey Black merges running heritage with modern street appeal, delivering a silhouette that feels both technical and wearable. The graphite grey black colorway keeps things sleek, allowing the layered panels and Gel cushioning elements to define the overall look. It reflects ASICS ability to translate performance design into lifestyle relevance. Collectors are drawn to the Gel NYC line because it captures the current shift toward performance inspired everyday sneakers. This pair stands out for its balance of structure and versatility, making it easy to incorporate into a wide range of styles. It feels grounded in function while still delivering on visual impact, reinforcing its place within the evolving sneaker landscape. The ASICS Gel NYC 20 Graphite Grey Black was released on February 5, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Metallic Blue
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low 85 Metallic Blue finds inspiration in the "Metallic Blue" colorway, which was launched in 1985 as part of Jordans High Metallic Series. This reimagined sneaker takes the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low silhouette and applies Metallic Blue accents to the sneaker's clean Summit White base. The upper is made of leather with tonal overlays and bright white laces winding through eyelets in the lace cage. The Swooshes and the heel tab both come in Metallic Blue, while the collar lining and the rubber outsole boast a similar blue without the metallic glisten. In terms of branding, the Air Jordan wings logo is printed across the heel tab and NIKE AIR can be found on the tongues woven logo tag. Something our StockX experts like is the sneakers simple design, which allows the metallic elements to shine without overwhelming the shoe. The Jordan 1 Retro Low 85 Metallic Blue was released on March 17th, 2024, and retailed at $160.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 5 White Aquarius Blue (Women's)
Description: The Nike Free Metcon 5 in White and Aquarius Blue is a women's training shoe applying the Free Metcon's dual-density platform to a soft, clean color palette, with a White mesh and synthetic upper complemented by Fierce Pink on the heel counter and inner lining, Deep Royal Blue on the Swoosh, and Aquarius Blue on the outsole accent pieces, creating a feminine and vibrant color combination within the Metcon's performance-forward training shoe framework. The same dual-density construction as the men's and unisex Free Metcon releases places flexible Free technology in the forefoot for dynamic movements and a stable flat Metcon heel for lifting, with the midfoot wrap and breathable upper maintaining support and ventilation across the full range of cross-training activities from HIIT and circuit work to barbell-based strength movements. The Aquarius Blue outsole provides the most distinctive and most color-specific element of the shoe's palette, with the light blue-green tone creating a soft contrast against the White body that keeps the shoe's overall look clean and wearable outside the gym context as well as within it. Released March 26, 2021 at $120 retail via nike.com and select retailers in women's sizing. The Nike Free Metcon 5 White Aquarius Blue Womens was released on March 26, 2021 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Halo
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Halo is an angelic tribute to the late NBA legend Kobe Bryant released on his August 24th birthday. White dominates the sneakers construction and symbolizes Kobes transition to the heavens. The Halo colorway was first seen on the Nike Kobe 8 Protro, which was released on the athletes birthday in 2023. The sneaker boasts an eye-catching high-top design with a lightweight Flyknit upper instead of traditional leather. The Flyknit provides a locked-in feel and is durable yet flexible. The addition of Nike React tech in the midsole allows for greater responsiveness, while the outsole is designed to mimic the natural movements of the foot. Our experts at StockX like the sneakers commitment to maintaining its white aestheticeven the Swoosh logo and the Kobe Bryant branding on the tongue come in clean white. The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Halo was released on August 23, 2024, and sold for $240.

Display Name: Puma LaMelo Ball MB.04 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Raphael & Donatello
Description: The Puma LaMelo Ball MB.04 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Raphael & Donatello is an asymmetrical athletic shoe pair featuring the left shoe in Fluro Green and Dark Amethyst and the right shoe in Fluro Green and PUMA Red. Fluro Greens illustrative placement encases the tip and midsole, dispersing into LOVE text and sword imagery. Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, M.E.L.O., and Puma branding appear on the rear heel. In collaboration with NBA player LaMelo Ball of the Charlotte Hornets, German brand Puma indulged Balls affinity for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, the film, comic, and TV series about evil-fighting turtle brothers in New York City. Each turtle brother gets his shoe within the collection, and the MB.04 features Raphael and Donatello. Our experts feel that the best feature of the Puma LaMelo Ball MB.04 is its intricate design, which is loaded with Ninja Turtles references. The Puma LaMelo Ball MB.04 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Raphael & Donatello was released on February 8, 2025, and retailed at $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Liquid Max Fragment Black
Description: The Nike Air Liquid Max Fragment Black brings together Nikes experimental cushioning design with Fragments signature minimalist approach. The all black palette keeps the look sleek and focused, allowing the liquid like sole unit to stand out as the defining feature. The upper remains clean and understated, reflecting Fragments preference for simplicity and precision. This collaboration resonates with fans who appreciate innovation paired with restraint. The Liquid Max concept pushes the visual identity of Air technology forward, while Fragment grounds it in a wearable format. It is a piece that feels both futuristic and controlled, appealing to collectors who value design evolution within a refined framework. The Nike Air Liquid Max Fragment Black was released on April 3, 2026 with a retail price of $225.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog Batmobile
Description: Step into the iconic world of Gotham City with the Crocs Classic Clog Batmobile. Featuring a playful yet sleek design, these Crocs celebrate one of the most iconic vehicles in cinematic historythe Batmobile. The predominatley black colorway with yellow accents mirrors the mysterious and bold spirit of Batman, and mimics the classic design of the iconic batmobile. While the lightweight, comfortable construction of the Crocs Classic Clog ensures youre ready for both everyday adventures and heroic missions. Inspired by the legendary Batmobile, these clogs stand out with their distinct black base complemented by the striking yellow details. Whether youre a fan of the Batman movies or just looking for a fun, unique addition to your wardrobe, this design allows you to showcase your love for one of the most beloved superheroes, and make a bold style statement. The Crocs Classic Clog Batmobile, released on September 16, 2024, retailed for $70, offering comfort and flair in one dynamic package. Whether youre hitting the street or lounging at home, these clogs let you embody the spirit of the Batmobile in style. Black and yellow have never looked so cool!

Display Name: adidas Samba Jane Black Off White (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba Jane in Core Black, Off White, and Gold Metallic is adidas' first-ever Mary Jane footwear to feature the iconic Three Stripes, blending the Samba's heritage soccer identity with the classic Mary Jane strap silhouette in a women's-specific design featuring a premium leather upper, serrated Three Stripes on the lateral side, the Samba name printed on the panel, a soft satin lining for interior comfort, and a grippy gum rubber outsole. The open slip-on construction with the Mary Jane strap across the vamp allows the wearer to style the Samba silhouette in a way that the traditional laced Samba cannot accommodate, with the strap creating the defining Mary Jane visual signature that connects adidas' football heritage to the fashion-forward women's footwear category where Mary Jane flats have maintained a strong presence across multiple decades of trend cycles. The Core Black leather body with Off White tonal detailing and Gold Metallic accent on the strap hardware and branding delivers the most classic and most broadly wearable color expression of the Samba Jane, with the black and off-white combination referencing the standard Samba OG's most iconic colorway while the gold metallic hardware elevates the design into a premium lifestyle context beyond the standard sports-adjacent Samba releases. Released April 1, 2026 at $110 retail via adidas.com and select retailers globally with style code IH9207. The adidas Samba Jane Black Off White Womens was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Black Red
Description: If anyone is discussing what's hotter than the earth's core, then the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Red must be a part of the discussion. Bringing hot lava vibes, these come with a core black upper and sole. There's also a core black "SPLY-350" branding across a scorching hot core red stripe on both sides. These dropped in November 2016 and retailed at $220. Add more sauce to your sneaker collection and buy now on StockX.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG White Better Scarlet
Description: The adidas Samba OG White Better Scarlet is a modern remake of the original adidas Samba that was first released in 1949. This model is primarily a bright white color and features pops of scarlet red. This Samba OG White Better Scarlet is a low-top shoe that falls just under the ankle. The upper part of the shoe is made of soft leather in bright white, with tan colored suede overlays on the toe area. The 3-Stripes that are associated with the adidas Samba line appear on the side of the shoe in scarlet red. A feature that our team particularly enjoys about the adidas Samba OG White Better Scarlet is dark brown gum sole that is made of rubber, as it is designed to provide both comfort and support. This model was originally made available for purchase in May 29th, 2023 and had a starting retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Zombie
Description: Nike Ja 3 Zombie leans all the way into playful chaos, giving Ja Morants signature line a colorway that feels pulled straight from late night arcade culture. The eerie green tones and slime inspired details instantly give the shoe personality, making it feel bold and animated before it ever touches the court. This design reflects Jas fearless energy and willingness to stand out, pushing the Ja line further into expressive storytelling. Beyond the visuals, the Ja 3 continues to focus on speed, control, and responsiveness. The shape feels aggressive and ready to move, designed for players who thrive on quick reactions and confident drives. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it blends performance with character, reinforcing why signature sneakers matter most when they truly mirror the athlete behind them.
