The Nike Ja 3 Zombie was released on10/22/2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike KD 18 Aunt Pearl
Description: Nike KD 18 Aunt Pearl continues one of the most meaningful traditions in signature sneaker history, blending performance design with purpose driven storytelling. The Aunt Pearl series has always symbolized strength, hope, and remembrance, and this edition carries that message through soft pink tones and thoughtful detailing that feel respectful rather than decorative. It is emotionally grounded and visually powerful. Beyond the message, the KD 18 silhouette reflects Kevin Durants precise and adaptable playing style. The shoe feels tuned for control and confidence, designed for players who rely on rhythm and finesse. Collectors value this release because it represents more than basketball, standing as a reminder that sneakers can carry real meaning while still delivering elite on court presence. The Nike KD 18 Aunt Pearl was released on 10/07/2025 with a retail price of $170.
Colorway: Pearl Pink/Laser Fuchsia/Tulip Pink/Playful Pink/Pink Foam/Glacier Blue

Display Name: Nike KD 6 Brazil (2026)
Description: The Nike KD 6 Brazil 2026 is a retro return of the Black, Multicolor, and Light Lucid Green colorway originally released in May 2014 to celebrate Brazil's hosting of the FIFA World Cup that year, now brought back in June 2026 for the 2026 World Cup hosted across North America  timed precisely to coincide with Brazil's group stage games at the tournament  reviving Kevin Durant's sixth signature shoe, widely considered Durant's favorite model in his own signature line, in the Brazil colorway's distinctive black base with multicolor graphic detailing and Light Lucid Green accents that encode the Brazilian flag's yellow-green national color palette into basketball shoe language. The KD 6, released in its original form in 2013 as a low-cut design inspired by soccer cleats  making its Brazil connection particularly apt  features a dual-density midsole combining Zoom Air and Max Air units for balanced speed and control, with the 2026 retro maintaining the 2014 Brazil colorway specifications in an updated construction appropriate to contemporary basketball shoe retro production standards. The timing of the 2026 retro release  on June 19, the same day Brazil faced Haiti in Group C play  makes this one of the most precisely event-synchronized retro releases in the KD line's ongoing retro cycle, with the Brazilian national team's Jordan Brand partnership for the 2026 World Cup adding additional Nike family resonance to the KD 6 Brazil's return. Released June 19, 2026 at $135 retail through Nike and select retailers including JD Sports, Foot Locker, and Champs globally with style code IH3582-001. The Nike KD 6 Brazil 2026 was released on June 19, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Teal
Description: Making a splash on May 31, 2023, the adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Teal are the epitome of innovation and style. These unique sneakers are drenched in the Stone Teal colorway, a hypnotic blend of earthy hues that make the shoe a standout in any setting. With a design that challenges conventional sneaker architecture, the 450's offer an avant-garde aesthetic highlighted by an intricately woven upper nestled in an eccentric, claw-like sole. The shoes embrace comfort, with the sock-like construction ensuring an effortlessly snug fit. The adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Teal isn't just a shoe; it's a statement piece, guaranteed to turn heads and garner compliments. Let these sneakers elevate your style game, providing a distinctive edge that's unmatched in the sneaker world. The adidas Yeezy 450 Stone Teal hit the streets on May 31, 2023, carrying a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Som Tum
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Som Tum draws inspiration from Thai street food culture, translating the vibrant and layered nature of som tum into a detailed and expressive sneaker. The mix of canvas, Vachetta Tan, and Parachute Beige creates a textured base, while Bright Crimson and Legend Dark Brown accents add contrast that feels both earthy and energetic. Subtle metallic silver hits bring a slight edge, tying the design together without overpowering the concept. Fans of SB Dunk releases appreciate how storytelling drives each colorway, and this pair stands out through its cultural reference and material mix. It feels thoughtful and intentional, offering more depth than a standard release. For collectors, it represents the continued creativity within Nike SB, where inspiration can come from unexpected places and still translate into strong design. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Som Tum was released on April 11, 2026 with a retail price of $130.
Colorway: Canvas/Vachetta Tan/Parachute Beige/Bright Crimson/Legend Dark Brown/Metallic Silver

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL Bape Bape Green Multi
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL BAPE in Blue and Green is the more visually aggressive of the two BAPE x adidas Adizero Evo SL colorways releasing simultaneously, featuring a mismatched design where the right shoe uses a blue base with BAPE's black Sta logo on the lateral and Three Stripes on the medial side, while the left shoe shifts into a green base with the branding placement inverted, both shoes unified by red laces, red lining, and a red outsole that creates a three-color cohesion across the asymmetric pair. The green shoe carries lighter sky blue tones referencing its counterpart, while the blue shoe incorporates mint green from the green shoe's base, with BAPE's Ape logo appearing in gold on the right heel and the BAPE name printed on the medial midsole, with ABC Camo appearing on the inner lining rather than covering the entire upper to let the mismatched colorway itself be the primary graphic statement. The Adizero Evo SL platform beneath the BAPE collaboration is one of adidas' fastest-growing silhouettes, having crossed 10 million pairs sold within approximately one year of its wide launch in 2024, built on the Adizero Adios Pro Evo racing shoe's DNA for a lightweight, modern trainer equally at home in performance and lifestyle contexts. Released June 27, 2026 at $200 retail via BAPE, adidas.com, and select retailers in unisex sizing with style code KJ5749. The adidas Adizero Evo SL BAPE Bape Green Multi was released on June 27, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Fjord Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Fjord Grey is a premium running shoe that combines style and performance. Featuring a sleek white upper with fjord grey accents, this sneaker offers a clean and versatile look suitable for both athletic pursuits and casual wear. The Gel-Kayano 14 incorporates ASICS' renowned GEL technology in the heel and forefoot, providing superior shock absorption and cushioning for a comfortable stride. Built with durability and support in mind, the Gel-Kayano 14 boasts a robust construction that caters to various foot types. The engineered mesh upper ensures breathability, while the reinforced heel counter promotes stability during movement. With its blend of cutting-edge technology and timeless design, this shoe is ideal for runners seeking a reliable and stylish option for their daily training or long-distance runs. Our experts state this product is great for athletes looking for a perfect balance of comfort, performance, and aesthetic appeal in their running footwear.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Kale
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Kale is part of GEL-1000s ninth iteration and is an updated version of the 2008 sneaker. Although this stability running sneaker resembles running shoes from the 2000s, it incorporates new technologies and design features. Unlike its predecessor, the Cream Kale variant features an all-mesh base and mesh detailing throughout the shoe. Even the inserts are made of mesh. This material allows the foot to breathe and keeps the shoe lightweight. GEL technology in the heel reduces shock from impact, while ASICS signature Trusstic support system provides stability and prevents the shoe from twisting. In terms of branding, ASICS can be found across the tongue. Our experts love the contrast between the silver and green overlays. Dark green can also be found along the padded color and splashed across the outsole. The ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Kale was released on September 23, 2023, and retailed at $95.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Total Orange (GS)
Description: Light up the court in the Nike Kobe 6 Total Orange (GS), a kids take on the iconic low-top built for speed, control, and all-day comfort. The striking Total Orange/Metallic Silver/Cosmic Clay palette pops from warm-up to buzzer, while the Mamba-inspired, scaled texture adds depth and dimension to the streamlined profile. A padded collar and secure lacing offer a locked-in feel, and the sculpted heel provides extra stability through quick cuts and step-backs. Underfoot, plush, responsive cushioning softens landings and keeps young athletes fresh through drills, games, and after-school play. Designed for agile movement, the Kobe 6s flexible forefoot and durable rubber outsole deliver confident traction on hardwood or blacktop. Breathable materials help manage heat during high-intensity runs, and the lightweight build makes it easy for developing players to find their rhythm without extra bulk. Finished with crisp Metallic Silver Swooshes and detailed with the FV9676-800 style code, this colorway captures the relentless energy that defines the Kobe lineage, perfect for kids who play hard and want standout style to match. We're seeing major traction on this drop since it pairs bold, high-visibility color with dependable cushioning and grip, making it a standout choice for young hoopers who demand performance and style.

Display Name: adidas SL 72 OG Silver Metallic Collegiate Navy (Women's)
Description: The adidas SL 72 OG Silver Metallic Collegiate Navy (Women´s) delivers a modern take on an iconic running silhouette. This shoe blends vintage aesthetics and premium materials by combining heritage design with modern upgrades, giving you a retro athletic style you can wear every day. The women´s Silver Metallic Collegiate Navy SL 72 OG by adidas has a metallic silver nylon upper complemented by collegiate navy suede overlays, giving you texture and contrast. The serrated 3-Stripes branding adds a classic touch. The EVA midsole offers lightweight cushioning. The SL 72 is an emblem of adidas' rich athletic history that was initially introduced for the 1972 Olympics and combines performance-driven design with a bold look and feel. We, the experts, appreciate the combination of the grippy rubber outsole for traction and the breathable nylon upper for extra comfort. The adidas SL 72 OG Silver Metallic Collegiate Navy (Women´s) debuted on 14th August 2024 and retailed at $100.

Display Name: Vans LX Old Skool 36 Pearlized Rust Bronze
Description: The Vans LX Old Skool 36 Pearlized Rust Bronze brings a refined finish to the classic Old Skool silhouette, using a brown upper with a subtle pearlized sheen that catches light and adds depth. The familiar low top structure stays intact, with clean paneling and the signature side stripe keeping it rooted in skate heritage. The elevated finish gives the shoe a slightly more polished feel while maintaining its everyday wearability. Fans of Vans appreciate how variations like this update a timeless model without changing its core identity. The brown tone keeps it versatile, while the pearlized effect adds just enough detail to stand out. It is a sneaker that blends classic design with a modern finish, offering a fresh take on a staple silhouette. The Vans LX Old Skool 36 Pearlized Rust Bronze was released on April 21, 2026 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Pink Foam
Description: Nike Ja 3 Valentines Day brings emotion and personality into Ja Morants signature line with a colorway built around connection and expression. The Valentines Day theme adds warmth and contrast to the Ja 3s aggressive shape, creating a look that feels playful without losing performance driven energy. It reflects Jas ability to balance intensity with individuality on and off the court. Fans appreciate how this release uses color and theme to tell a story. The Ja 3 silhouette thrives on motion, and this version feels expressive and alive, appealing to collectors who enjoy sneakers that carry narrative alongside function. It stands out as a reminder that performance shoes can still feel personal and culturally relevant. The Nike Ja 3 Valentines Day was released on12/20/2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Military Blue (2024)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Military Blue 2024 stands as a beacon of Jordan Brand's innovation and style. It features an off-white leather base contrasted with the striking military blue splashed on the eyelet wings, heel, and parts of the midsole, creating a look of disciplined yet daring design. The neutral grey touches on the forefoot and outsole balance the aesthetic, highlighting the sneaker's clean lines and geometric shapes. Every detail is meticulously crafted, with the Jumpman logo on the tongue, the 'Flight' script on the tongue's underside, and a visible Air-Sole unit encased in the soleall of which are hallmarks of the Jordan brand's dedication to quality and performance. The industrial blue mesh inserts not only offer breathability but also complement the sneaker's color scheme, adding both function and flair. The beloved Nike Air logo graces the heel and stays true to the original 1989 iteration. Released on May 4, 2024, at a retail price of $215, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Military Blue quickly ascended to iconic status. Collectors and sneaker enthusiasts eagerly celebrated the revival of the military blue colorway on a timeless model.

Display Name: adidas Superstar Sp5der Red Black
Description: The adidas Superstar Sp5der Black Silver Metallic builds on the same collaboration with a sharper and more reflective twist. The black base keeps the silhouette grounded, while silver metallic accents introduce contrast that catches light and adds energy to the design. It feels slightly more elevated, giving the collaboration a different visual tone while staying true to its core. Fans gravitate toward this version for its balance of subtlety and shine. The metallic detailing adds a layer of dimension that makes the shoe stand out without becoming overpowering. It is a strong option for collectors who want the Sp5der collaboration with a bit more visual impact. The adidas Superstar Sp5der Black Silver Metallic was released on March 3, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Mid SP Off-White Varsity Maize
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Mid SP Off White Varsity Maize represents a collaboration between Nike and Virgil Ablohs fashion house Off-White. This sneaker takes an iconic silhouette and a retro colorway and infuses it with hallmark Off-White creativity.? ?? ?The Off White X Nike Air Force 1 Mid-Top Varsity Maize SP sports an upper with a base of tumbled white leather and perforations in the toe box. The overlays and ankle strap are maize-colored tumbled leather, while the side-panel Nike swoosh is white tumbled leather. The laces are maize and an extra pair of white laces threads through fly cables on the upper. The white foam midsole houses visible Air and sits atop a maize rubber outsole where the classic AF1 traction pattern has been enhanced with track spikes.? ?? ?What we love most about this creative shoe is the Off-White branding. Characteristic Off-White text appears on the medial upper while a white grim reaper graphic is embroidered on the lateral heel. The Nike Air Force 1 Mid SP Off White Varsity Maze was released on November 9, 2023, for a retail price of $205.

Display Name: adidas Samba Mule White Black Gum (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba Mule White Black Gum Women's takes one of footwear's most enduring silhouettes and strips it down to something entirely new, cutting away the heel to transform the classic Samba into an easy slip on. The woven upper swaps the traditional suede for a breathable, textured build that feels lighter and more suited to warm weather styling, while the suede T toe remains fully intact as a nod to where the design started. It is proof that even an eighty year old shoe still has room to evolve. Underneath, the shoe keeps everything that made the original Samba a street style fixture, including the low slung profile and the signature gum rubber outsole with its familiar tread pattern. Gold script branding along the side panel gives this mule a slightly different visual signature compared to the standard lace up version, setting it apart for collectors who track every material and detail shift across the Samba family. For fans who love the silhouette but want something easier to wear, this mule delivers the DNA in a fresh, relaxed format.

Display Name: Vans LX Old Skool 36 Pearlized Pack Black Navy
Description: The Vans LX Old Skool 36 Pearlized Pack Black Navy delivers a refined take on a heritage silhouette, using pearlized finishes that add subtle shine and depth to the black and navy colorway. The Old Skool 36 structure remains classic and recognizable. This pair stands out because it elevates a staple through material treatment. The pearlized effect gives it a slightly more premium feel, while the design stays wearable. Fans appreciate how it offers a fresh perspective on a familiar model. The Vans LX Old Skool 36 Pearlized Pack Black Navy was released on March 19, 2026 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Black Cement (2024) (GS)
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro Black Cement (2024) (GS) is a relaunch of Tinker Hatfields iconic sneaker with gray elephant-print detailing and an eye-catching colorway of black, Fire Red, Cement Grey, and Sail. Originally released in 1988 and last seen in 2013, the Black Cement (2024) (GS) Jordan 3 Retro boasts a tumbled leather upper in black with tonal stitching. Elephant print decorates the leather overlays at the forefoot and heel, while perforations add texture to the gray leather around the collar. Pops of Fire Red stand out on the Jumpman logo, the first three eyelets, the bottom of the shoe, and the underside of the tongue. Padding in the tongue and collar completes the look and protects the ankle. Our experts like the tonal contrast provided by the raised, white Nike Air logo on the heel. The grade school-sized Jordan 3 Retro Black Cement (2024) (GS) was released on November 23, 2024, and sold for $150.

Display Name: Nike Blazer Low 77 Vintage White Black
Description: The Nike Blazer Low 77 Vintage White Black returns with its low-profile style, and heritage basketball looks. The nearly 1-to-1 remake of the Nike Blazer Low 77 Vintage White Black features crisp leather on the upper with soft suede and synthetic details for added durability and throwback styling. The ultra-clean colors, simple lines, and low-cut, padded collar continue the look, which is wrapped up by an outsole fused with the midsole. The solid rubber outsole with herringbone pattern adds traction, durability, and heritage styling. The Nike Blazer Low 77 Vintage White Black was released in December 2020 and originally retailed for $85.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black Toe Reimagined
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black Toe Reimagined is a fresh take on one of the most iconic Air Jordan 1 colorways. The black, varsity red, and white combination is a nod to the original 1985 release that helped define sneaker culture. However, this reimagined version includes several special updates, adding a modern twist to a classic look. One of the standout features is the "Air Jordan" text replacing the traditional wings logo on the collar, offering a subtle but significant change. Another striking detail is the black tongue, which contrasts against the red and white panels, along with a slightly aged-looking midsole, giving the sneaker a vintage vibe while maintaining its timeless appeal. Michael Jordans signature and a heartfelt message make this pair truly one of a kind. Add in a unique box featuring an image from the original Air Jordan 1 marketing campaigns, and this release is a true collectors item. Released in 2025, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black Toe Reimagined retailed for $180. With its blend of nostalgic elements and updates based on the original Air Jordan 1 High that was never released to the public, this highly anticipated release is a must-have for both longtime Jordan fans and new collectors alike.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Graphite Grey
Description: Celebrating the ninth installment of the GEL-1000 series, the ASICS Gel-1130 Black Graphite Gray sneaker reflects decades of design evolution. The upper section of the Black Graphite ASICS Gel-1130 is crafted from over 20% recycled material, showcasing ASICS' dedication to sustainability. Its color scheme harmoniously blends black and Graphite Gray, presenting a versatile and modern aesthetic. The shoe has undergone a transformation, incorporating synthetic leather paneling to update its traditional materials and achieve a more contemporary aesthetic. With GEL technology in the heel, the shoe offers cushioning and comfort. The inclusion of a TRUSSIC support arch enhances stability. The most prominent feature of the ASICS Gel-1130 Black Graphite Gray lies in its GEL technology embedded in the heel. This ensures enduring comfort, making the shoe an exceptional choice for both sports activities and everyday wear. The runner was originally sold for $80 on April 30th, 2022.

Display Name: adidas Samba Bape White Black Gum
Description: adidas Samba Bape White Black Gum brings streetwear energy to one of the most iconic silhouettes in adidas history. The classic Samba shape remains untouched, while Bapes influence adds bold personality through contrast and attitude. The white, black, and gum combination feels timeless yet charged, blending heritage football design with modern street culture confidence. Collectors value this release because it represents a true crossover moment. The Sambas global legacy pairs naturally with Bapes fearless identity, creating a shoe that feels instantly recognizable and culturally relevant. It works as both a statement piece and an everyday staple, rewarding fans who understand the significance behind both names. The adidas Samba Bape White Black Gum was released on 09/06/2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo (2026) (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo 2026 TD brings back one of the most beloved non original Air Jordan 4 colorways in toddler sizing with all the energy and boldness that made the Toro Bravo theme so memorable. The Fire Red upper immediately dominates the design, contrasted by black detailing, white accents, and touches of Cement Grey that preserve the aggressive personality associated with the original release. Even in toddler sizing, the Air Jordan 4 maintains the layered construction and iconic shape that helped turn the silhouette into a permanent staple within basketball and sneaker culture. Fans continue gravitating toward Toro Bravo releases because the vibrant red presentation captures attention instantly while remaining deeply connected to Jordan Brand history and Chicago era basketball aesthetics. The Air Jordan 4 itself holds enormous importance thanks to its connection to late 1980s basketball and its role in shaping modern sneaker culture through film, music, and streetwear. Parents and collectors alike appreciate smaller sized retro releases because they allow younger generations to participate in iconic sneaker moments. The bright red upper gives the pair unmistakable presence while the classic Jordan 4 structure keeps the design timeless and instantly recognizable. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo 2026 TD was released on May 30, 2026 with a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Green Strike
Description: The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Green Strike introduces a bold new take on comfort and functionality. Designed for all-day wear, this lightweight slip-on features a striking green strike colorway that commands attention. The wavy-textured upper enhances the overall aesthetic, while strategically placed ventilation holes ensure airflow and comfort throughout the day. Built with Nikes advanced ReactX cushioning, making it ideal for those who are constantly on the move and want a comfortable shoe. The slip-on construction, combined with a flexible, contoured fit, ensures effortless wearability. Releasing on March 5, 2025, the Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Green Strike retailed for $70. Whether for casual wear or post-workout recovery, this shoe delivers a blend of functionality and style that makes it a standout in Nikes lineup.

Display Name: adidas AE 2 Lucid Pink Black
Description: The adidas AE 2 Lucid Pink Black Lucid Red delivers a fearless mix of color that mirrors Anthony Edwards confident presence on the court. Lucid Pink sets the tone across the upper, while Core Black grounds the design and Lucid Red accents amplify the intensity. The sculpted midsole and layered construction keep the silhouette aggressive, giving the shoe a sense of motion even when it is standing still. This colorway stands out because it refuses to play it safe. The vibrant pink base commands attention, yet the darker elements provide balance that keeps the look sharp rather than overwhelming. Fans of the AE line appreciate how each release experiments with bold palettes while staying true to performance roots. It feels expressive and unapologetic, much like Edwards himself, making it a natural addition to a rotation built around energy and individuality. The adidas AE 2 Lucid Pink Black Lucid Red was released on January 17, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro White Metallic (2026)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro White Metallic (2026) brings back one of the most recognizable OG-inspired colorways tied to the models early 90s era. Dressed in white with metallic silver and black accents, the design highlights the Jordan 5s fighter jet-inspired lines while maintaining the clean, high-contrast look that made the original release a staple. The reflective tongue and icy outsole remain defining features, reinforcing the silhouettes distinct identity. First introduced in 1990 and designed by Tinker Hatfield, the Air Jordan 5 drew inspiration from WWII fighter planes, most notably through the shark-tooth detailing along the midsole. The White Metallic colorway became a fan favorite for its ability to balance that aggressive design language with a clean, wearable palette. Over multiple retros, it has remained one of the most consistent entries in the Jordan 5 rotation, often serving as a benchmark for how OG colorways should be executed. When the Air Jordan 5 Retro White Metallic (2026) released, it retailed for $215 and dropped on April 25, 2026. As a faithful return of a cornerstone colorway, this release reinforces the Air Jordan 5s place as one of the most visually distinctive models in the Jordan archive.

Display Name: adidas Samba OG Snakeskin Collegiate Green (Women's)
Description: The adidas Samba OG Black Cream White Collegiate Green refreshes the legendary silhouette with a color palette that feels both grounded and expressive. Black leather anchors the upper, contrasted by cream white accents that soften the look and collegiate green details that add character and depth. The familiar gum sole reinforces the Sambas heritage while keeping the overall presentation clean and balanced. Collectors appreciate this colorway because it feels versatile without being predictable. The green accent brings a subtle collegiate energy that nods to sport culture while remaining easy to style across different aesthetics. This version of the Samba feels intentional and wearable, proving that thoughtful color placement can keep a decades old design feeling relevant. It is the kind of pair that quietly earns its place in rotation through comfort, history, and effortless appeal. The adidas Samba OG Black Cream White Collegiate Green was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: adidas Yeezy 500 Stone Taupe
Description: The adidas Yeezy 500 Stone Taupe adds an all-beige colorway to the sleek Yeezy 500 silhouette. Despite the sneakers neutral design, reflective details break up the monotone colorway in low lighting. This lifestyle Stone Taupe adidas Yeezy 500 fortifies the open cell mesh upper with overlapping leather and suede overlays. These overlays form a mudguard that wraps around the shoe and circular panels that reinforce the eyelets cut into the mesh upper. In terms of branding, the Ortholite sockliner displays dual adidas and Yeezy branding, while the adidas trefoil is also printed into the midsole. Crafted with adiPRENE+, the sculpted midsole and outsole almost resemble a topographical map and draw inspiration from the adidas KB8 3 from 1999. Our experts at StockX like the oversized pull tab on the tongue, which helps put on and take off the close-fitting sneaker. The adidas Yeezy 500 Stone Taupe was released on March 18, 2024, and sold for $210.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Black University Blue (2026) (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 14 Retro Black University Blue 2026 TD carries the same high energy design language as the full size version, scaled down into a toddler friendly format that still captures the essence of the silhouette. The black upper provides a clean and structured base, while university blue accents add a pop of color that brings the design to life. Metallic silver detailing ties everything together, reinforcing the performance inspired aesthetic that defines the Jordan 14. This release makes the model accessible at an early stage, allowing younger fans to connect with a silhouette known for its sleek lines and automotive influence. The balance of bold color and strong shape keeps it visually engaging, even in a smaller format. It is a continuation of Jordan Brands approach to bringing iconic designs across all sizes, ensuring the legacy reaches every level of the culture. The Air Jordan 14 Retro Black University Blue 2026 TD was released on March 21, 2026 with a retail price of $75.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Ice Blue Melon Water
Description: The New Balance 1906R Ice Blue Melon Water is a retro-tech runner featuring a bright, cooling color scheme. The shoe blends Ice Blue, Melon Water, and Dusk Shower. The layered mesh and synthetic upper maintains the intricate, supportive structure of the 1906 model. The design incorporates ABZORB and N-ergy cushioning for proven comfort and shock absorption. Slated for release on April 30, 2025, this vibrant model carries a retail price of $155. The cool Ice Blue and Dusk Shower tones dominate the body, beautifully contrasted by the warm, vibrant pop of Melon Water accents. This shoe blends high-tech performance with a refreshing, summery aesthetic. Our experts note the technical support of the ABZORB and N-ergy cushioning, stylishly emphasized by the bright, contrasting palette of Ice Blue and Melon Water.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Black Silver
Description: The ASICS Gel 1130 White Black Silver delivers a clean and balanced take on one of ASICS most quietly influential retro runners. The white base paired with black and silver accents highlights the Gel 1130s layered early 2000s design language, giving it a technical look that feels timeless rather than trend driven. It sits comfortably in that space where performance heritage meets everyday wear, making it instantly familiar to longtime ASICS fans. Collectors appreciate this pair because it represents the Gel 1130 at its purest. The color blocking lets the structure and cushioning inspired design do the work, offering versatility without losing character. Its a shoe people love for its reliability and understated style, one that fits effortlessly into rotation while reflecting the growing appreciation for functional aesthetics and retro running silhouettes in modern sneaker culture. The ASICS Gel 1130 White Black Silver was released on June 9, 2023 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Puma All-Pro Nitro 2 Pokémon Pikachu
Description: The Puma All Pro Nitro 2 Pokemon Pikachu brings one of the most recognizable characters in gaming into a performance basketball silhouette, combining sport and nostalgia in a bold way. The yellow base immediately reflects Pikachus identity, while red and black accents add contrast that enhances the design. The Nitro cushioning platform supports performance while maintaining a strong visual theme. This pair stands out because it fully embraces the Pokemon influence without losing its functionality. Fans of both basketball and Pokemon appreciate how the design captures Pikachus energy and personality. It is a crossover that feels playful and performance driven at the same time, appealing to collectors who enjoy character inspired footwear. The Puma All Pro Nitro 2 Pokemon Pikachu was released on April 2, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever White
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever White celebrates timeless design with a serene, all-white finish and thoughtful tribute cues to one of basketballs most beloved icons. Dressed in a crisp White/White colorway, this AF1 pairs premium leather with signature perforations on the toe box for breathability and a polished look that works from courtside to city streets. Classic elements, like the padded collar, durable cupsole, and grippy pivot-circle outsole, deliver the dependable comfort the silhouette is known for, while the clean palette highlights the shoes streamlined lines and refined craftsmanship. Subtle commemorative details nod to Kobes legacy, creating a quietly powerful statement piece that honors greatness without sacrificing everyday wearability. Underfoot, an encapsulated Air unit cushions every step, making the Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever White (style code IB0018-100) as comfortable as it is collectible. The tonal Swooshes, stitched overlays, and crisp midsole keep the look cohesive, letting the tribute-inspired accents take center stage. Whether youre building a monochrome rotation or seeking a standout pair with meaningful backstory, this release delivers versatile styling that elevates denim, joggers, or tailored fits alike. With a release date of June 30, 2025, it captures the enduring appeal of the AF1 while paying homage to a player whose influence continues to shape sport and culture. Our team loves this product because it blends everyday comfort with a clean, commemorative design that feels special on foot and easy to style in any wardrobe.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog SpongeBob SquarePants Squidward
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog SpongeBob SquarePants Squidward brings a character driven twist to the iconic clog silhouette, centered around one of the most recognizable figures from the SpongeBob universe. The design leans into Squidwards personality through color and graphic elements, creating a playful and expressive look that stands out immediately. The classic clog shape remains unchanged, keeping the lightweight and comfortable feel that defines Crocs. This release appeals to fans of both the show and the brand, blending nostalgia with everyday functionality. Character collaborations like this continue to expand the reach of the clog, turning it into more than just casual footwear. It is a piece that balances humor and practicality, making it a standout option for those who enjoy bold and themed designs. The Crocs Classic Clog SpongeBob SquarePants Squidward was released on December 11, 2025 with a retail price of $80.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Green (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 is the next Jordan model to receive the Lucky Green treatment. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Green was released exclusively in womens sizing. Jordan Brand used white tumbled leather uppers on this rendition of the Air Jordan 3 Retro model. Lucky Green is seen throughout the midsole, lace eyelets, and heel tab of the sneaker, while a red Jumpman logo sits on top of the tongue, which is covered by white laces. The womens-exclusive Air Jordan 3 Retro Lucky Green released April 6, 2023, with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Tan Lines (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Tan Lines (Women's) features multi-color panels across the upper, giving the sneaker a patchwork appearance. Overlapping panels of suede stand out against the white mesh base. The suede overlays come in a variety of rich colors, including Plum Fog, Burnt Sunrise, Grain, violet, Deep Royal Blue, and Dust. Like the original Air Max 1 from 1987, this updated version boasts visible Air Max technology in the heel. However, the Nike branding is a change of pace from the usual fonts and logos. For example, the heel tab is embossed with stylized Nike lettering, while the suede tongue displays Nike in the same font. Our StockX experts like the inclusion of a black rubber outsole, which contrasts the upper's vibrant colors and provides traction. The womens size Nike Air Max 1 Tan Lines (Women's) was released on December 5th, 2023, and retailed at $180.
Colorway: Grain/Burnt Sunrise-Plum Fog-Violet Dust-Deep Royal Blue

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Light Smoke Grey (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High Light Smoke Grey (GS) is a unique take on the popular AJ1 model that has been a staple of Jordan Brand for years. Although grey and white colors cover much of the upper, the red and black hues here call to mind the Chicago Bulls franchise. The Retro High Light Smoke Grey (GS) starts with a base of pure white premium leather, but this quickly morphs into overlays made of suede to give a brushed appearance to the sneaker. The Jordan 1 Retro High Light Smoke Grey (GS) released in July 2020 and retailed for $130.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Grey Cream White
Description: Lean into timeless terrace style with the adidas Handball Spezial Grey Cream White (IF7086). Born on the indoor courts and perfected on the streets, this pair blends premium grey suede with cream white serrated 3-Stripes for a clean, heritage look. The iconic T-toe construction and gold-foil "Spezial" script nod to late-70s design, while a low-profile silhouette keeps outfits sharp and versatile. A crisp contrast heel tab and vintage-inspired details deliver easy wearability, whether youre pairing them with tapered denim, track pants, or tailored casuals. Underfoot, a classic gum rubber outsole anchors the shoe with flexible traction and everyday comfort. The cushioned footbed supports all-day movement, and the grippy tread pattern echoes the models sport roots with confident stability on city sidewalks. From its soft-touch suede to the balanced color blocking of Grey/Cream White, every element is thoughtfully tuned for effortless rotation, smart enough for a coffee run, relaxed enough for weekend plans, and refined enough to elevate your daily lineup. A standout for fans of retro silhouettes, the Handball Spezial remains a go-to sneaker that merges sport heritage with modern lifestyle appeal. Our team loves this product because it delivers rich suede, a classic gum sole, and versatile styling that seamlessly transitions from casual days to polished streetwear looks.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle CLOT Linen Khaki
Description: The adidas Gazelle CLOT Linen Khaki is a shoe designed as part of a collaboration with the fashion brand CLOT. This iteration of the adidas Gazelle has an upper made of nubuck leather and raffia, a palm tree native to tropical Africa. These woven raffia fronds make up the base of the upper in a Linen Khaki color, while nubuck leather overlays in the same color form the t-shaped toe cap, the eyestays, and the heel. The adidas three stripes appear on each side in beads in varying shades of blue, and blue stitching is seen at the heel, trimming the tongue, and attaching the upper to the braided midsole. The shoe sits on a classic rubber sole. The most intriguing thing about this shoe is its raffia construction, which is unique for sneakers. The adidas Gazelle CLOT Linen Khaki was released on August 23, 2024, for $160.

Display Name: Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Midnight Navy Comet Blue
Description: The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Midnight Navy Comet Blue pairs effortless comfort with modern design, delivering an easy-on, easy-off slip-on built for all-day wear. A sculpted upper with generous ventilation helps feet stay cool, while the contoured footbed cradles your arch for a soothing, locked-in feel. Underfoot, the responsive ReactX cushioning softens every step and rebounds smoothly, ideal for recovery after workouts, weekend errands, or airport sprints. The Midnight Navy base is accented by Comet Blue and Ghost tones for a sleek, versatile palette that complements athletic gear and casual fits alike. Durable traction pods add grip on wet or dry surfaces, and the lightweight build makes this mens clog a go-to for daily comfort without bulk. Thoughtful details distinguish the ReactX Rejuven8 from typical slip-ons. The streamlined profile wears well with joggers or shorts, and the molded sidewalls offer lateral stability when youre on the move. Easy pull zones at the collar speed up on-and-off transitions, while a smooth interior finish reduces friction for sockless comfort. Style ID IB6366-400 and the June 27, 2025 release date mark this colorway as a fresh addition to the lineup, bringing a clean, future-forward look to a recovery silhouette. With a retail price of $70, the Nike ReactX Rejuven8 balances value and performance, delivering cushion, breathability, and style in one dependable package. Our team loves this product because it combines plush ReactX comfort, breezy wearability, and a refined Midnight Navy/Comet Blue colorway that works from gym cooldowns to everyday city miles.

Display Name: Nike Ja 2 Ja-Breaker
Description: The Nike Ja 2 Ja Breaker brings bright energy and competitive attitude to Ja Morants second signature model. The mix of white, blue, and red gives the shoe a fast and confident look, reinforcing the Ja 2s identity as a weapon built for pressure and momentum. It feels sharp and assertive, designed to match Jas ability to break defenses and dictate pace. Fans gravitate toward this release because it feels bold and intentional. The Ja Breaker colorway highlights the silhouettes speed driven design while adding visual punch that stands out on court. Collectors appreciate how the Ja line continues to balance performance and personality, making each release feel connected to Morants style rather than just another seasonal update. The Nike Ja 2 Ja Breaker was released on May 1, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk High Hawaii
Description: Nike SB offers a tropical take on one of their most renowned silhouettes with the Nike SB Dunk High Hawaii. The Hawaiian theme of this colorway references the cannabis strain Maui Wowie, similarly to how other 4/20 releases have referenced cannabis strain names, like the 2018 Nike SB Dunk Mid White Widow. The upper of the Nike SB Dunk High Hawaii is covered in a blue, green, and pink floral fabric with a Sail textile Swoosh and tongue. With plenty of hard usage over time, the top layer of the upper wears away to reveal an orange floral fabric upper with shaggy green suede overlays. From there, a hidden stash pocket is located in the tongue. A bright orange Nike SB tongue tag, white midsole, and Sail outsole wrap up this island-themed design. The Nike SB Dunk High Hawaii released in April of 2021 and retailed for $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Luxe Summit White Light Bone
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Luxe Summit White Light Bone has a white leather upper with a cushioned mesh collar, wavy eye stays, and a perforated toe box. The rubber outsole, heel tab and "Air" branding on the midsole all have hints of Light Bone. The Nike Swoosh branding is printed on both sides of the sneakers and their heels. Additionally, it features a padded tongue, a round toe cap and rugged soles with Nike branding and a large Swoosh emblem on its laterals. Full-length AIR units are included on the soles. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Luxe Summit White Light Bone was released on February 16th, 2022, and retailed at $130.

Display Name: Anta Kai 1 Garden State
Description: The Anta Kai 1 Garden State dresses NBA player Kyrie Irvings inaugural basketball shoe with Anta in a soft Sage color scheme and a design that pays tribute to New York, the athletes home state, and New Jersey, "the Garden State." While "the Garden State" usually brings to mind New Jersey's agricultural heritage, this Anta Kai 1 sneaker applies a literal plant pattern to the majority of the upper. Crafted from ultra-lightweight mesh with TPU supports, the upper features a translucent material that covers the flora-inspired pattern. The Garden State Anta Kai 1 features two closures: traditional laces and a shoe strap. Displaying Kyrie Irvings branding, the shoe strap also comes in Sage and features lines that mimic a leaf's veins. Our experts at StockX like the Nitrogen Technology in the midsole because it provides cushioning without weighing the foot down. The Anta Kai 1 Garden State was released on July 20, 2024, and sold for $125.

Model: UGG Classic Ultra Mini Platform Boot
Display Name: UGG Classic Ultra Mini Platform Boot Chestnut (Women's)
Description: The UGG Classic Ultra Mini Platform Chestnut W is a womens sized slip-on ankle boot that is available in a chestnut colorway. This Ultra Mini Platform model by Australian shoe company UGG is a take on the 70s version, maintaining iconic staples such as the sheep skin interior and the suede upper, as well as the color. The upgraded version gets a 2-inch platform sole on the Treadlite outsole underfoot, and the design keeps branding minimal, with only a leather patch appearing at the back. The UGG Classic Ultra Mini Platform Chestnut W was first released on the 2nd of November 2022 and retailed for $150.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Neon Pack Green (Women's)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Neon Pack Green for women is a striking addition to the iconic Gel-1130 lineup. This eye-catching sneaker features a vibrant volt colorway with metallic silver accents, making it a standout choice for those who want to add a pop of color to their footwear collection. The shoe's upper is crafted with high-quality materials, ensuring both durability and comfort for everyday wear. Designed with ASICS' renowned GEL technology in the midsole, these sneakers offer superior cushioning and shock absorption, perfect for long walks or casual runs. The Gel-1130 model combines retro-inspired aesthetics with modern performance features, creating a versatile shoe that's suitable for both athletic activities and street-style fashion. We at StockX believe this product is great for fashion-forward individuals who prioritize both style and comfort in their footwear choices.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Premium Black Reflective
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Black Reflective takes a stealth driven approach and elevates it with subtle flashes of light catching detail. Black and Anthracite layer across the upper, creating depth within the dark palette, while reflective elements bring the design to life under direct light. Hints of Multi Color detailing add a quiet edge without disrupting the monochrome flow. The classic mudguard and visible Air unit remain intact, reinforcing the timeless structure that defines the Air Max 90. Fans who appreciate understated pairs with hidden personality will connect with this release. In daylight it feels clean and minimal, but reflective accents transform it after dark. It captures that balance between heritage runner and modern street statement, offering versatility with a technical twist. This pair proves that even an all black base can carry serious dimension. The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Black Reflective was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Mint Tint (Women's)
Description: Refresh your rotation with the ASICS Gel-1130 White Mint Tint (Womens), a heritage-inspired runner reimagined for modern life. Crisp white mesh sets a breathable foundation, while layered synthetic overlays add structure and a subtle, retro sheen. Soft Mint Tint accents brighten the profile and logo stripes, delivering a clean, versatile palette that pairs effortlessly with everything from leggings to wide-leg denim. A padded tongue and collar create a plush step-in feel, and the streamlined silhouette nods to classic late-2000s running style without sacrificing todays comfort standards. Underfoot, GEL cushioning helps absorb impact for smooth transitions, complemented by supportive midfoot tooling that promotes a steady ride whether youre on a quick coffee run or logging daily steps. A durable rubber outsole offers confident traction across city streets and gym floors, while the removable insole makes it easy to fine-tune your fit. Light, supportive, and easy to wear, this lifestyle sneaker balances sport-focused DNA with understated elegance, making it a reliable go-to for weekday commutes and weekend plans alike. Style ID 1202A164-120 and the White/Mint Tint colorway make this pair a standout choice for anyone seeking comfort-forward design with polished, everyday appeal. Our team loves this product because it blends cushioned, day-long comfort with a sleek retro aesthetic that elevates casual outfits without trying too hard.

Display Name: Nike V5 RNR SE Smokey Blue Denim
Description: The Nike V5 RNR SE Smokey Blue Denim leans fully into early 2000s energy, pairing the retro running silhouette's chunky, Y2K inspired proportions with a genuine denim upper that adds real textural character. A breathable mesh base combines with synthetic leather overlays and denim color blocking for a look that feels distinctly nostalgic without leaning entirely into costume territory. A bold 3D Swoosh logo finishes the design with a raised, sculptural detail that catches light differently depending on the angle. Underfoot, a chunky yet surprisingly lightweight foam midsole delivers genuine all day cushioning, while a rubber outsole finished with early 2000s inspired grooves provides dependable everyday traction. A plush collar lining adds comfort around the ankle, rounding out a shoe built as much for casual daily wear as for capturing a specific retro aesthetic moment. For collectors chasing Nike's ongoing wave of Y2K inspired lifestyle runners, this Smokey Blue Denim edition offers a genuinely distinctive material story within the V5 RNR's broader colorway lineup. The Nike V5 RNR SE Smokey Blue Denim was released on June 23, 2025 with a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Black Metallic (2016)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Black Metallic 2016 is dressed in a black, fire red, metallic silver, and white color scheme. The 2016 Retro Air Jordan 5 features a nubuck upper accompanied by the netting placed on the side panels. The metallic colored tongue comes in 3M, and branding comes by way of the Jumpman emblem on the tongue and outsole. The Nike Air logo is displayed on the heel. Additional features include lace locks, a clear icy outsole, and the black midsole paired up with the metallic shark teeth. The Air Jordan 5 Retro Black Metallic 2016 was released on the 23rd of July 2016, and originally retailed at a price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Kansas City Royals City Connect (2026)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Kansas City Royals City Connect 2026 is part of Nike's second annual MLB City Connect Air Max 1 series, translating the Royals' "Forever Fountains" City Connect jersey into the Air Force 1's OG 1987 silhouette with a white leather and mesh upper as a clean base, a vivid grape-to-blue gradient flowing across the outsole and insole referencing both Kansas City's identity as the City of Fountains and the fuchsia-to-blue sunset gradient of the alternate jersey, with a bright blue Swoosh outlined in navy on each panel and a stylized magenta crown logo appearing on both heel counters as the Royals' signature franchise mark. The gradient tongue tag features a crowned "R" logo fading from magenta into blue, an MLB batterman silhouette on the lace lock, and a second tongue tab, while the "HEY HEY HEY HEY" nod to the Beatles' Kansas City song connection also informs the jersey's detail work from which the shoe draws its narrative, connecting the shoe to both the city's fountain heritage and its musical history with the British Invasion. The Kansas City Royals City Connect AM1 continues Nike's 2026 approach of pairing each of eight selected club's alternate identity directly with the Air Max 1 platform without reshaping the silhouette itself, allowing color, gradient treatment, and team iconography to carry the full storytelling burden on one of Nike's most historically significant running shoes. Released June 9, 2026 at $150 retail through Nike.com, the Kansas City Royals Team Store, and select retailers including Dick's Sporting Goods with style code IQ2916-100. The Nike Air Max 1 Kansas City Royals City Connect 2026 was released on June 9, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Diamond Turf Must Be the Money
Description: The Nike Air Diamond Turf Must Be the Money brings luxury and swagger to a silhouette known for grit and strength. The mix of sail, off noir, and metallic gold gives the Diamond Turf a refined edge while still keeping its muscular identity intact. It feels confident and celebratory, designed to stand out as a statement rather than blend into rotation quietly. Fans love this release because it feels expressive and self aware. The Diamond Turf has always symbolized dominance, and this colorway leans into that narrative with humor and flair. Collectors appreciate how Nike reimagines a classic without stripping its attitude, making this pair feel bold, memorable, and rooted in the culture of confidence that defines the model. The Nike Air Diamond Turf Must Be the Money was released on September 15, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Premium Flax Sail
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Flax Sail revives a beloved 90s silhouette with a clean, monochromatic colorway dressed in warm flax and sail tones. This Nike low-top profile keeps true to the Air Max 90s roots with a layered construction featuring leather, textile, and rubber components that give it a rich, textural feel. Boasting an earthly flax tone all over, tonal flax Swooshes blend seamlessly into the side panels, while classic details like the ribbed rubber eyestays, textured heel counter, and iconic visible Air unit stay firmly in place. A padded collar and Max Air branding on the heel and above the Air bubble in the sail midsole round out the retro design. Underfoot, the signature Waffle outsole delivers durable traction and heritage appeal. What we love about the Nike Air Max 90 Premium Flax Sail is the elevated, tonal execution. The unified color palette lets the silhouettes textures and structure shine, offering a sophisticated take on a sports-inspired classic. This sneaker launched on June 28, 2024, with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Racer Blue (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Racer Blue (Women's) maintains the Zoom Vomero 5s classic design while adding a vibrant colorway of Racer Blue with metallic silver and black accents. Reimagining early 2000s running shoes, this iteration of the Zoom Vomero 5 features responsive Zoom Air cushioning in the Cushlon foam midsole. The upper is crafted from durable mesh with supportive synthetic overlays and distinctive plastic caging on the heel  all in Racer Blue. Adding an eye-catching detail, the Swoosh logos come in a mirror-like material that complements the 3M reflective detailing on the overlays. While the midsole and upper come in Racer Blue, the rubber outsole features contrasting black. Our experts at StockX like the sophistication provided by the suede eyestays to the sneakers performance-first design. The womens size Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Racer Blue (Women's) was released on July 1, 2024, and was orginally priced at $160.

Display Name: Nike LD Waffle sacai CLOT Kiss of Death Net Orange Blaze
Description: Taking cues from the Nike Air Max 1 CLOT Kiss of Death, the Nike LDWaffle sacai CLOT Orange Blaze boasts an off-white translucent and suede upper with Deep Red and Orange Blaze snake-textured Swooshes. From there, a two-toned stacked sole and doubled tongue amplify sacai's unique design aesthetic. The Nike LDWaffle sacai CLOT Orange Blaze released in September of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Ivory Peony
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Ivory Peony blends retro running design with a lighter and more refined color palette, using ivory tones paired with soft peony accents for a clean and balanced look. The layered upper reflects early 2000s performance aesthetics, while the ProGrid cushioning system anchors the design in comfort. Saucony continues to revisit its archive, bringing classic silhouettes back with updated colorways. Fans of retro runners gravitate toward models like this because they offer a mix of nostalgia and everyday wearability. The lighter tones make it easy to style, while the detailed construction keeps it visually engaging. It is a sneaker that captures the essence of vintage performance design while fitting seamlessly into modern rotation. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Ivory Peony with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Puma LaMelo Ball MB.01 Lo Black White
Description: The physical appearance of the Puma LaMelo Ball MB.01 Lo Black White is designed with only two main colors: Puma Black and Puma White. The MB.01 Lo Puma LaMelo Ball in Black White is crafted from high-quality leather. The upper showcases a timeless white and black color scheme, striking a perfect balance between classic and contemporary aesthetics. The lightweight foam midsole ensures comfortable cushioning and support during wear, while the sturdy rubber outsole guarantees excellent traction and grip. Emphasizing the brand identity, the Puma logo is prominently featured on the side of the shoe, adding a subtle branding element to the overall design. Something that we found interesting with the Puma LaMelo Ball MB.01 Lo Black White is that this sneaker can be worn on the court or on the streets, making it a versatile and fashionable option. At the time of its release on October 15, 2022, the Puma LaMelo Ball MB.01 Lo Black White retailed for about $120.

Display Name: Nike KD 18 Air Bakin
Description: Paying homage to Tim Hardaways legendary Air Bakin, Kevin Durants 18th signature shoe blends 90s basketball aggression with modern performance tech. The Fire Red/Black/Amarillo colorway features the signature "flame" overlays and rope laces of the original Bakin. Released on May 15, 2025, for $150, it is powered by a large Zoom Air unit for elite energy return on the court. We love the "Amarillo" yellow hits, which provide a sharp contrast to the bold red base, resulting in a performance-hoops shoe that is rich in Nike heritage.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 3 Twin (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 3 Twin Womens pairs warm and cool tones for a striking layered effect. Crimson Tint sets a soft yet vibrant foundation, while Arctic Punch and Light Current Blue accents add unexpected contrast. Black detailing anchors the design, highlighting the silhouettes clean and athletic structure. The streamlined build keeps the focus on speed and balance. This release feels playful yet performance driven, capturing the duality suggested by its name. The mix of pink and blue tones creates strong personality without sacrificing versatility. It blends expressive color with confident structure in a way that feels fresh. Bold and balanced, this pair stands out with creative energy. The Nike Sabrina 3 Twin Womens was released on December 6, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Lightning (2021) (GS)
Description: Similar to the original Air Jordan 4 Retro Lightning, the 2021 Grade School edition features a mid-top with a bright yellow nubuck upper. The yellow nubuck upper boasts black molded eyelets and matching black netting. In addition to its impressive mid-top, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Lightning 2021 GS also features a molded Jumpman logo as well as dark grey accents on its wings, a white foam midsole, and a grey rubber outsole. This magnificent colorway, which was released in August 2021, currently retails at $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Jade Horizon
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Jade Horizon introduces a more elevated take on a familiar running franchise, blending performance DNA with a refined and tonal color story. Jade horizon dominates the upper, creating a smooth and cohesive look, while light army accents add subtle variation without breaking the flow. The silhouette remains streamlined, but the execution feels more considered and layered. This pair stands out because it leans into simplicity while still feeling premium. The Pegasus line has always been reliable, and this version builds on that reputation with a more polished presentation. Fans appreciate when a performance model is elevated through tone and material, making it just as suitable for everyday wear as it is for movement. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Jade Horizon was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Navy Gum
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Navy Gum takes its inspiration from a 1980s handball shoe. Dressed in a Navy, Sky Blue, White, and Gum color scheme, this sneaker features a nubuck suede upper. Other details include adidas branding on the tongue, the trademark 3-Stripes on the sides, the "Spezial" Trefoil logo on the lateral in gold foil, and a branded OrthoLite insole. This shoe has a round toe and a lace-up closure system with Navy Blue laces that match the overall theme. A gum rubber outsole completes the vintage look. The adidas Handball Spezial Navy Gum was first released on 26th August 2020, retailing at $100.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey
Description: The New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey arrives in a monochrome suede with a leather and mesh construction. The New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey has got the "N" logo placed on both sides of the shoe and also on the front part of the shoe's outsole. The New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey mesh uppers have overlays of black leather and suede engulfing the silhouette. The design includes a grey and black sole unit, a bright white midfoot motif, and metallic silver rears. The New Balance 2002R Black Dark Grey was released in June 2022 and retailed for $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Essential Triple Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Essential Triple Black 2020/2023 was originally unveiled as one of Nikes Nike Air Max 95 model sneakers in January 2020. The Nike Air Max 95 Essential Triple Black 2020/2023 is dressed in a black-on-black colorway. The sneaker features a black mesh-constructed upper on top of a black leather base. The black tongues top features an "air max" labeling detail. Completing the design is the black rubber sole with Air Max units fitted within the heel and forefoot for extra comfort. The black rubber outsole is patterned for maximum traction. During its initial unveiling in January 2020, Nike Air Max 95 Triple Black 2020 retailed at $170.

Display Name: Nike ZoomX StreakFly 2 White Obsidian Mist Pure Platinum Gridiron
Description: The Nike ZoomX StreakFly 2 White Obsidian Mist Pure Platinum Gridiron is built for lightweight speed, delivering a stripped down racing silhouette that feels tuned for efficiency. The white upper keeps the design clean and aerodynamic, while obsidian mist, pure platinum, and gridiron accents add subtle contrast that highlights its streamlined structure. Everything about the shape suggests forward motion and precision. This pair stands out because it focuses on pure performance without unnecessary weight. The StreakFly line is designed for fast efforts and shorter distances, and this version reflects that through both construction and visual simplicity. Fans of Nike racing models appreciate how it feels responsive and direct, offering a shoe that is built to move quickly and confidently. The Nike ZoomX StreakFly 2 White Obsidian Mist Pure Platinum Gridiron was released on April 24, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Gym Red Flint Grey
Description: Jordan flipped one of the most popular Jordan 13 colorways of all time to create a new colorway with the Air Jordan 13 Red Flint. The Red Flint draws its inspiration from the often re-issued Air Jordan 13 Flint, remixing to the iconic colorway. The Air Jordan 13 Red Flint features an upper made of red reflective mesh, white leather, and Flint Durabuck. In line with Jordan 13s of the past, a holographic Jumpman emblem is displayed on the lateral ankle. An embroidered Jumpman insignia on the tongue, and a Flint and white sole complete this Jordan 13. The Jordan 13 Red Flint released in April of 2021 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Metallic Rose Gold (2020) (Women's)
Description: There are only two major tones that define the physical look of the Nike Air Max 90 Metallic Rose Gold 2020 W: Metallic Rose Gold and white. The Air Max 90 Rose Gold, designed in womens sizing, showcases a radiant monochromatic appearance, specially crafted to commemorate the retro runner's 30th anniversary. The sneaker's construction has been reimagined with a consistent design approach, featuring a white foam midsole and a durable rubber outsole, both adding to the shoe's overall aesthetic. The Max Air unit located under the heel provides lightweight cushioning. The upper of this Air Max 90 model combine leather and synthetic materials, while the outsole incorporates a waffle pattern. Additionally, the midsole of this shoe is composed of a lightweight foam material, further contributing to its comfortable and supportive design. At the time of market release on March 26th, 2020, the Nike Air Max 90 Metallic Rose Gold 2020 W had an associated market value of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Blue Spark
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Blue Spark brings a fresh jolt of energy to a legend. Inspired by the original Sergio Lozano design, this pair layers breathable mesh with smooth synthetic and leather overlays to create the signature gradient look, here shaded from Neutral Grey to Medium Grey and punctuated by vibrant Blue Spark hits. The sculpted lines mirror the contours of the human body, while the speed-lacing system locks in a personalized fit. Reflective accents catch the light at night, and the bold Swoosh and tongue branding sharpen the White/Blue Spark/Black/Neutral Grey/Medium Grey palette for a clean, modern finish that still feels unmistakably 95. Underfoot, the "Big Bubble" profile spotlights amplified visible Air windows in the heel and forefoot, delivering that plush, springy ride the Air Max 95 is known for. A cushioned foam midsole softens every step, and the durable rubber outsole with flex grooves provides reliable traction for daily wear. Whether youre pairing the IM7410-100 with denim or training gear, its retro-runner DNA and forward styling make it an easy standout. If youre building a rotation around versatile colorways with punchy accents, this release offers all-day comfort and eye-catching appeal in one essential silhouette. Our team loves this product because it blends timeless Air Max 95 heritage with a striking Blue Spark color pop and noticeably smooth cushioning that elevates both style and comfort.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1000 Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 1000 Black pushes the Air Max line into a more futuristic direction, using a fully blacked out design paired with volt accents that bring sharp contrast. The silhouette feels more modern and sculpted, with a focus on bold lines and visible cushioning that emphasizes performance and innovation. The dark base allows the smaller details to stand out more clearly. What makes this model interesting is how it builds on Air Max heritage while moving forward in design language. The black and volt combination gives it a strong and slightly aggressive presence, appealing to those who prefer more technical looking sneakers. Nike continues to evolve the Air Max platform, and this release reflects that progression clearly. It is a sneaker that feels both experimental and rooted in performance. The Nike Air Max 1000 Black was released on August 19, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Midnight Navy
Description: The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Midnight Navy merges futuristic cushioning with aggressive nineties inspired design. Midnight navy wraps the upper in a deep and commanding tone, complemented by metallic silver accents that emphasize the molded cage and flowing lines. White details add contrast, allowing the VaporMax sole and Plus structure to feel balanced and intentional rather than overwhelming. This model resonates with fans because it blends two distinct Nike innovations into one confident silhouette. The VaporMax cushioning brings modern comfort, while the Air Max Plus design language delivers attitude and edge. Collectors appreciate how this colorway keeps the look refined and wearable, proving that bold structure does not always require loud color. It stands as a strong example of Nike bridging eras through design rather than nostalgia alone. The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Midnight Navy was released on October 27, 2020 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Phychic Blue White Patent
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Phychic Blue White Patent showcases a stunning blend of style and sophistication. This men's sneaker features a captivating Psychic Blue and University Blue colorway, complemented by crisp white accents. The patent leather upper adds a luxurious touch, elevating the classic Air Force 1 silhouette to new heights of elegance. Designed for both comfort and durability, this iteration of the iconic Air Force 1 Low incorporates Nike's renowned Air cushioning technology in the midsole. The low-top design ensures versatility, making it suitable for various occasions. With its eye-catching color combination and sleek patent finish, this sneaker is sure to turn heads and make a statement. Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a perfect balance between street-ready style and premium craftsmanship. The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Phychic Blue White Patent offers a fresh take on a timeless classic, making it an excellent addition to any sneaker collection.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Black Aluminum
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Black Aluminum is a low-top shoe made for skateboarding with premium materials. The Black Aluminum Nike SB Dunk Low is mostly made of suede. The base of black suede makes up the toe box and side panels as well as the heel area, while Aluminum blue suede overlays form the eyestays, mudguard, and heel and ankle strap. The Nike swoosh appears in Football Grey on each side, while the Nike brand name is stitched in white thread into the heel collar. The cushioned black tongue also contains a Nike patch. A white midsole and grey outsole round out the shoe's look. What we like the most about this particular sneaker is that itÄôs made completely of suede material, giving it a different texture. The Nike SB Dunk Low Black Aluminum was originally released on February 19, 2025, for a retail price of $115.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Bisque Frosted Glass
Description: The New Balance 9060 Bisque Frosted Glass leans into subtle contrast and texture, offering a colorway that feels calm yet visually layered. The bisque base brings warmth, while frosted glass tones add a cool and almost translucent feeling to the overall design. The 9060s sculptural shape gives the palette room to breathe, creating a look that feels thoughtful and modern. Fans appreciate this pair because it rewards closer inspection. Nothing feels loud, but every element contributes to the shoes presence. Collectors love how this colorway highlights the 9060s design language, making it a strong option for those who value comfort and visual depth without relying on bold graphics or heavy color blocking. The New Balance 9060 Bisque Frosted Glass was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Huarache 2K4 All-Star (2026)
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Huarache 2K4 All Star 2026 revives an early two thousands basketball icon in celebratory form. Dressed in White with Varsity Royal, Varsity Red, and Metallic Silver accents, the upper highlights the bold paneling and strap system that defined the original silhouette. The supportive construction and responsive cushioning reinforce its performance heritage. All Star themed releases carry strong nostalgic appeal, especially when tied to a model associated with marquee moments. The patriotic red and blue accents pop against the white base, capturing the spectacle of All Star weekend. It feels like a tribute to a pivotal era in Nike Basketball innovation. The Nike Air Zoom Huarache 2K4 All Star 2026 was released on February 17, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Mineral Slate
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Mineral Slate brings a layered and slightly muted color palette into the skate focused Dunk silhouette, creating a design that feels both grounded and expressive. The mineral slate base sets a cool and neutral tone, while dark raisin and particle rose accents introduce depth and variation. Silt red details add a subtle pop, all anchored by a gum light brown sole that ties the look together. Fans of SB Dunks appreciate how this release uses color to create complexity without overwhelming the silhouette. The combination feels carefully balanced, making it stand out while still remaining wearable. It continues the tradition of SB releases being both skate ready and highly collectible within sneaker culture. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Mineral Slate has a retail price of $120.
Colorway: Mineral Slate/Dark Raisin/Particle Rose/Silt Red/Gum Light Brown

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Graphite Grey Graphite Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel NYC Graphite Grey Graphite Grey leans fully into a monochrome aesthetic that highlights the layered construction of the silhouette without distraction. The Gel NYC model blends retro running inspiration with modern comfort, and in this graphite grey execution, every panel and overlay feels more pronounced. The tonal approach gives the shoe a sleek and understated presence that works across different styles while still showcasing its technical roots. What makes this pair appealing is its versatility. The all grey palette keeps things neutral, making it easy to wear daily, while the mix of materials adds depth up close. ASICS has found a strong lane with the Gel NYC, and colorways like this reinforce why it continues to resonate with both casual wearers and collectors. The ASICS Gel NYC Graphite Grey Graphite Grey was released on March 14, 2024 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Carbon Fiber All-Star (2021)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid Carbon Fiber released alongside a pair of Nike Dunks, Air Force 1s, and Air Foamposite Ones to commemorate 2021s NBA All-Star Game. Just like each pair within the All-Star pack, the Air Jordan 1 Mid Carbon Fiber also features a black patent leather upper. Under the light, a pattern resembling carbon fiber plating, similar to those found on the outsoles of Jordan 11s, appears on the patent leather upper as well. White leather underlays and a white Wings logo on the ankle add contrast to the shiny material. Lastly, a Jumpman tongue tag is stitched onto a nylon tongue. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Carbon Fiber released in March of 2021 for $125.

Model: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 OG
Display Name: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 OG White Black (2025)
Description: Nike celebrates the 20th anniversary of the debut signature sneaker of pro skateboarder Paul Rodriguez with the Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 OG White Black (2025). Debuting in 2005 and first re-issued in 2015, the P-Tod 1 was one of the pioneers in the Nike SB catalog that helped Nike break into the skateboarding scene in the early 2000s. The 2025 Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 OG arrives with a crisp white leather base, a ventilated toe box, and quilted "PR" patterns at the heel. A black mesh Swoosh and tongue add contrast, and for added flair, metallic silver accents grace the "SHS" lace dubrae, topmost eyelet, and Nike branding on the tongue. The sneaker rides on Zoom Air tech, while a rubber cupsole provides grip. And unlike the original, the 2025 edition swaps the black outsole for an icy one. What our experts love about the Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 OG White Black (2025) is the "PR" debossed monogram at the heel, which pays homage to Paul Rodriguezs legacy. The sneaker debuted for $120 on May 20th, 2025.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Solar Red 2.0 (2025)
Description: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Solar Red 20 2025 revives one of the most aggressive and beloved Nike designs with a detail that longtime fans instantly recognize. The Big Bubble Air unit brings the shoe closer to its original form, enhancing the bold lines and human anatomy inspired structure that made the Air Max 95 iconic. Solar Red accents cut through the layered upper with urgency, giving the shoe a sense of motion and energy. This release resonates with collectors because it respects history while amplifying it. The Air Max 95 has always been about pushing boundaries, and restoring the Big Bubble detail feels like a celebration of Nike innovation at its peak. It appeals to fans who value archival accuracy and design integrity, making it feel like more than a retro and more like a statement of intent. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Solar Red 20 2025 was released on 10/10/2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Niagara
Description: The Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Niagara clog features a unique collaboration between Crocs and renowned footwear designer Salehe Bembury. The slide has a unique silhouette that is composed of three of Salehe Bemburys signature fingerprints combined, available in the Niagara colorway. The Niagara Salehe Bembury Crocs Pollex Clog showcases a "Niagara" color scheme, drawing inspiration from the Serene Gray tones observed at Niagara Falls. With its distinctive concave ridges, this model offers a breathable design, enhanced by intricate cut-out details, and is completed with the addition of a side strap for added functionality. The neutral color scheme is harmoniously paired with a lightweight foam construction, while the concave ridges serve as a practical water siphoning system.
