The adjustable heel strap proudly showcases dual branding from both Crocs and Salehe Bembury, featuring embossed logos for a distinctive touch. What our experts love about Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Niagara is its unique design. This collaboration with Salehe Bembury combines elements inspired by nature with innovative design details to create a unique clog thats not only visually striking, but also comfortable and practical. The clog debuted for $85 on July 20th, 2023.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Copper Moon
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Copper Moon explores warmer tones across the familiar Air Max 90 frame. Copper Moon overlays sweep across the upper, paired with Sail and Pearl White elements that keep the palette light and balanced. The layered construction highlights the mudguard and panel transitions that define the silhouette. Visible Air cushioning anchors the design, connecting it back to its performance roots. Fans appreciate when the Air Max 90 leans into earthy shades that feel distinct yet versatile. The copper tone adds richness without straying into overly bold territory, making it adaptable for everyday wear. It reflects how subtle shifts in color can refresh a heritage model without altering its core identity. This release feels warm, refined, and confidently rooted in tradition. The Nike Air Max 90 Copper Moon was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Golf White Black Gum
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Golf White Black Gum brings the iconic Air Max 1 silhouette to the golf course with style and performance. This golf-ready adaptation features a clean white leather upper accented with black Swoosh branding and heel details. The classic gum rubber outsole provides excellent traction on the greens, while maintaining the timeless aesthetic of the original Air Max 1 design. Engineered for comfort and stability during your round, this shoe incorporates Nike's renowned Air cushioning technology in the heel for responsive impact protection. The waterproof upper ensures your feet stay dry in various weather conditions, making it a versatile choice for golfers. With its blend of retro style and modern golf functionality, the Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Golf White Black Gum is perfect for fashion-conscious players who want to make a statement on the course. Us at StockX believe this product is great for golfers seeking a combination of classic sneaker style and on-course performance, offering both comfort and a touch of nostalgia in every swing.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro True Blue (2016)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 True Blues will have you feelin like your at Rooftop, bringin '88 back. One of the all-time great Jordan 3s, this particular retro brought the shoe back to its 1988 orgins, particularly with the "Nike Air" branding on the heel. Previous retro versions of the True Blue AJ3 have featured the Jordan Brand Jumpman on the heel, as well as on the insoles. Fun fact: True Blue 3s are one of the few colorways of the original Air Jordan signature models that Michael Jordan never wore in a traditional game, at least until he returned from retirement and began his chapter with the Washington Wizards. These shoes dropped in November of 2016 and are a must Bid if not already in your collection.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Bred (Women's)
Description: Unveiling the epitome of timeless design with the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Bred (Women's) in the ever-classic Black/University Red/White colorway. The sophisticated satin finish adorns the iconic silhouette, exuding a blend of vintage charm and modern-day chic. Every step in these sneakers resonates with the legacy of the Jordan brand, making a bold statement in today's fashion scene. The contrasting hues of black and university red, punctuated with white accents, embody a narrative of enduring style and basketball heritage. Released on October 4th, 2023, at a retail price of $180, this trending sneaker is not just a pair of shoes, but a passport to a legacy celebrated across generations. Seize the essence of cool encapsulated in every stitch of the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Satin Bred, and step into a story that continues to redefine sneaker culture.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Fire Red
Description: The Air Jordan 9 Retro Fire Red is Michael Jordans ninth signature collaborative shoe for the brand, and it comes in a white, fire red, and cool grey color scheme. This Air Jordan 9 model features an upper constructed with cool grey patent leather overlays, a white leather base, and hints of fire red on the lace loops, pull tab, and different branding emblems. This shoe also features a lace-up closing system with cool grey laces that match the overall theme. This high-profile version includes AIR units on its soles for cushioning. The Air Jordan 9 Retro Fire Red was made available on December 13th, 2022. Initially, it retailed at $200.

Model: Nike Air Force 1 Low Gore-Tex Vibram
Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Gore-Tex Vibram Summit White
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Gore Tex Vibram Summit White upgrades the classic silhouette with rugged performance elements built for tougher conditions. Summit White leads the upper, balanced by Smoke Grey and Light Bone accents that add depth and structure. Speed Yellow details inject a subtle burst of energy, while the Vibram outsole signals enhanced traction and durability. The familiar Air Force 1 shape remains intact, now reinforced with weather ready intention. This version speaks to collectors who value functionality alongside style. The Gore Tex build elevates the model beyond everyday wear, giving it a more technical edge without losing its iconic stance. The layered neutral palette keeps it versatile, while the upgraded sole sets it apart from standard releases. It feels like a practical evolution of a cultural mainstay. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Gore Tex Vibram Summit White was released on October 24, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Sea Salt Raincloud
Description: The New Balance 9060 Sea Salt Raincloud is a stylish and comfortable sneaker that combines modern design with classic New Balance aesthetics. Featuring a sleek silhouette, this shoe showcases a harmonious blend of sea salt and raincloud hues, creating a versatile and eye-catching look. The upper is crafted with premium materials, ensuring durability and breathability for all-day wear. The innovative ABZORB midsole technology provides superior cushioning and support, making these sneakers perfect for both casual outings and active lifestyles. Designed with attention to detail, the New Balance 9060 Sea Salt Raincloud boasts a chunky sole that adds a contemporary edge to its overall appearance. The shoe's construction incorporates a mix of suede and mesh panels, offering a luxurious feel and enhanced ventilation. The iconic 'N' logo is prominently displayed on the side, paying homage to the brand's heritage while embracing modern sneaker trends. With its balanced combination of style and functionality, this New Balance model is set to become a staple in any sneaker enthusiast's collection. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that effortlessly transitions from casual wear to light athletic activities, offering both comfort and style in one package.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 2 Trust Your Game (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 2 Trust Your Game (Women's), in womens sizes, is a sneaker featuring a bright look, with an upper and sole unit in Citron Tint. The Nike Swoosh accents the sides in Royal Pulse above muted Laser Fuchsia stripes, while the interior displays the Swoosh in bright Laser Fuchsia, coordinating with S tongue branding. Additional Sabrina branding appears on the rear heel and midsole. Nike, the American athletic shoe titan, has long outfitted professional sports players, working closely with them to bring their ideal signature shoe to fruition. The Sabrina 2 is Nikes second style designed for Sabrina Ionescu of the WNBAs New York Liberty, and it features two types of foam in its base, for cushioning and stability. Our experts feel that the best feature of the Sabrina 2 is its Citron Tint sole, which makes its branding elements pop. The Nike Sabrina 2 Trust Your Game (Women's) released on December 6, 2024, and retailed at $130.

Display Name: New Balance 992 MiUSA Sea Stone Green Apple
Description: The New Balance 992 MiUSA Sea Stone Green Apple is one of the most vibrantly colored and most spring-forward releases in Teddy Santis's Made in USA seasonal program for 2026, a pair that deliberately departs from the earth-tone palette that has defined much of the Santis-led creative direction in favor of a lively, warm-weather-ready color story built around a Sea Stone cerulean blue upper accented with Green Apple midsole cushioning elements and Maize gold detailing. The 992 was originally launched in 2006 as part of New Balance's celebration of its 100th anniversary as the direct successor to the 991, and remains one of the most beloved and most culturally significant lifestyle runners in the brand's archive, a silhouette with deep roots in the made-in-America craftsmanship tradition that Santis has consistently honored in his seasonal Made in USA output. The Sea Stone colorway builds its upper primarily from high-quality suede and mesh, the cerulean blue suede overlays dominating the upper surface while darker blue panels and matching mesh underlays add depth and dimension through the midfoot and toe. A purple suede heel tab introduces an unexpected additional accent color that pushes the palette beyond a straightforward seasonal blue and prevents the shoe from reading as predictably nautical. Underfoot, the ABZORB SBS cushioning delivers the signature shock absorption and bounce appropriate to the 992's performance-derived running heritage, with TS2 midfoot stability technology and an Ndurance rubber outsole providing the durability and ride quality that make the Made in USA 992 feel as compelling on foot as it looks on a shelf. Released April 30, 2026 via NewBalance.com and select retailers in unisex sizing at $200. The New Balance 992 MiUSA Sea Stone Green Apple is the Made in USA seasonal pair for the collector who wants the 992's premium American construction in the 2026 program's most color-forward and most spring-seasonally committed execution. The New Balance 992 MiUSA Sea Stone Green Apple was released on April 30, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Workwear Grey
Description: The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Workwear Grey updates the running shoe technology introduced in the 990 and designs a high-performance running shoe that is as stylish as it is dependable. The Made in USA New Balance 990 v6 in a Workwear/Grey colorway begins with an upper base of tannish-orange mesh that offers lightweight breathability. Perforated dark-gray leather forms overlays that course across the upper, tannish-orange suede forms the overlays at the eyestays and mud guard, and silvery leather hits the upper at the collar. The gray and white ENCAP midsole is made with propulsive FuelCell foam that offers cushioning and energy return and a polyurethane rim that provides durability. This sneaker rides on a black and gray rubber outsole. Our favorite feature of this sneaker is the design of the side panel N, which features horizontally corrugated silvery-gray synthetic that is also used in the upper eyestays. The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Workwear Grey was released on March 4, 2024, for $200 retail.
Material: Leather, Suede, Mesh, Synthetic, Rubber, Foam

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Reflection Black (GS)
Description: The New Balance 9060 Reflection Black GS brings futuristic running DNA into a youth sized silhouette with bold contrast. Dressed in Reflection and Black, the layered mesh and suede upper sits atop the exaggerated midsole that defines the 9060 line. The sculpted sole and split heel design give it a distinctive stance that feels modern and dynamic. The 9060 has become a standout within New Balances lifestyle lineup thanks to its blend of archival influence and forward thinking proportions. In this grey and black combination, the design feels versatile yet expressive. It captures the balance between tech runner nostalgia and contemporary street style energy. The New Balance 9060 Reflection Black GS was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Light Smoke Grey Anthracite
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Light Smoke Grey Anthracite brings a sophisticated monochromatic palette to the iconic silhouette. This sleek iteration features a light smoke grey leather upper, complemented by anthracite overlays that create a subtle contrast. The classic Nike Swoosh adorns the sides in a matching grey tone, maintaining the shoe's cohesive look. A crisp white midsole provides a clean foundation, while the anthracite rubber outsole ensures durability and traction. Designed for both style and comfort, this Dunk Low incorporates Nike's renowned cushioning technology in the midsole, offering support for all-day wear. The perforated toe box enhances breathability, while the padded collar provides ankle support and a snug fit. The shoe's minimalist color scheme makes it a versatile addition to any wardrobe, easily pairing with a wide range of casual outfits. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a refined, understated sneaker that doesn't compromise on comfort or quality.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 20 Pink Diamond
Description: The Nike LeBron 20 Pink Diamond brings elegance and confidence to one of LeBron James most refined signature silhouettes. The LeBron 20 is known for its low profile control and responsiveness, and the pink diamond colorway adds a sense of celebration and strength through shimmering pink tones and metallic silver accents. It feels polished and expressive without compromising performance intent. Fans love this release because it highlights LeBrons evolution. The colorway feels bold but composed, reflecting longevity, achievement, and continued dominance. Collectors appreciate how the LeBron 20 blends modern performance design with emotional storytelling, making this pair feel special without leaning into nostalgia. It stands as a reminder that even deep into his career, LeBrons signature line continues to push forward with confidence and clarity. The Nike LeBron 20 Pink Diamond was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: On Running Cloudtilt Black Ivory (Women's)
Description: The On Running Cloudtilt Black Ivory Womens blends lifestyle comfort with subtle performance cues in a silhouette designed for motion and balance. The Cloudtilt shape feels smooth and natural, prioritizing ergonomic flow and flexibility over aggressive structure. Black and ivory tones give the shoe a refined and understated presence, making it feel polished while still rooted in Ons performance driven design language. Fans gravitate toward this model because it feels effortless. The Cloudtilt is built for long days and constant movement, offering comfort that adapts rather than demands attention. Collectors appreciate how On continues to expand beyond traditional running silhouettes, creating footwear that supports everyday life while maintaining a clear identity built around precision, comfort, and thoughtful engineering. The On Running Cloudtilt Black Ivory Womens had a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Velvet Brown (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Velvet Brown Womens wraps the iconic silhouette in rich, layered earth tones. Velvet Brown and Baroque Brown sweep across the signature gradient panels, while Orewood Brown and Pearl Grey accents provide contrast and softness. The enlarged Air units reinforce the Big Bubble identity, spotlighting the cushioning that changed the game. The overall palette feels warm, grounded, and deeply textured. Collectors drawn to tonal executions will appreciate how this release emphasizes depth over flash. The brown spectrum highlights the sculpted wave design without relying on bright color. It feels mature yet expressive, offering a refined perspective on a heritage model. With its amplified cushioning and cohesive palette, this pair bridges innovation and understated style effortlessly. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Velvet Brown Womens was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Kay Yow
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Kay Yow carries forward one of Nikes most meaningful initiatives, blending performance design with a message tied to breast cancer awareness. The pink driven color palette takes center stage, with Pinksicle and Vivid Pink tones layered across the upper alongside metallic silver and black accents. The result is a shoe that feels vibrant and intentional, standing out both visually and symbolically. Fans of the Kay Yow series appreciate how each release connects sport with purpose. The GT Cut 4 platform delivers responsiveness and speed, while the color execution ensures the message remains front and center. It is a pair that resonates beyond performance, appealing to collectors who value both design and the story behind it. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Kay Yow was released on March 18, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Premium Alabaster
Description: The Nike Vomero Premium Alabaster elevates the trusted runner with a layered and vibrant mix of tones that feel both technical and expressive. Alabaster sets a soft foundation across the upper, while Blue Void, Indigo Burst, and Hyper Violet ripple through the paneling with depth. Citron Pulse and Volt accents inject sharp flashes of energy, amplifying the sculpted midsole and performance driven shape. The Vomero line has built its reputation on plush cushioning and reliable comfort, and the Premium treatment adds visual complexity without sacrificing that core identity. The interplay of muted neutrals and electric highlights gives this pair dimension from every angle. For fans who appreciate performance footwear with bold color storytelling, this release pushes the silhouette into standout territory while maintaining everyday versatility. The Nike Vomero Premium Alabaster was released on February 12, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Reebok Shaqnosis Low White Black
Description: The Reebok Shaqnosis Low White Black revisits one of the most visually striking basketball designs in a streamlined low cut format. White and Black swirl across the upper in the unmistakable hypnotic pattern that defined the original Shaqnosis era. Vector Red accents add a subtle pop that ties the look back to classic Reebok branding. The Shaqnosis silhouette remains a symbol of 1990s boldness, and bringing it back in low form adds fresh versatility while preserving its dramatic identity. The high contrast pattern still commands attention, making it impossible to ignore on or off the court. For fans of retro basketball nostalgia, this release keeps the attitude alive in a slightly more wearable profile. The Reebok Shaqnosis Low White Black was released on January 22, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Mexico World Cup
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Mexico World Cup celebrates football culture and national identity through one of Nikes most iconic sneaker silhouettes. The Air Force 1 has transcended its basketball origins to become a global lifestyle staple, and this World Cup inspired edition channels Mexican national colors and tournament energy through a refined combination of Phantom, Alabaster, Team Red, and Fir tones. Rather than relying on loud graphics, the shoe uses subtle color storytelling to create a celebratory and culturally connected atmosphere while preserving the clean structure and timeless proportions that made the Air Force 1 legendary. Fans gravitate toward World Cup themed sneakers because they capture the emotional excitement and national pride surrounding global football culture. Mexico inspired colorways naturally resonate strongly within both football and sneaker communities because of the countrys passionate fan culture and instantly recognizable green, red, and white palette. Collectors especially appreciate how Nike applies these references subtly, allowing the Air Force 1 to remain versatile and wearable while still carrying strong thematic identity. The softer Phantom and Alabaster base tones help the richer accent colors stand out naturally, giving the sneaker a balanced and celebratory personality. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Mexico World Cup was released on April 20, 2026 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Vintage Green
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Vintage Green is a leather low-top basketball shoe featuring an upper done in Vintage Green and White. The tip, lace panel, heel overlays, Nike Swoosh, and heel tab are done in Vintage Greens deep olive hue, accented by underlays in crisp White. The uniform bi-color palette extends to the Nike branding on the tongue and heel tab, while the Vintage Green midsole completes the aesthetic. American sportswear and sneaker brand Nike has always had a vision for the endless possibilities of athletic shoes, and the Dunk was conceptualized for university sports in the 1980s. Its fabrication was designed to lend itself to the bicolor palettes of college sports, and in the decades following the shoe has become a cult classic for its color variations and adaptability. In our opinion, the best feature of the Dunk Low is its Vintage Green overlays, which offer a neutral yet uncommon hue. Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Bart Simpson

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Photo Blue

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Arts-Rec
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Arts-Rec (style IH3211-200) blends skate-ready function with head-turning style, delivering a color story that stands out on and off the board. The Khaki, Amber Brown, Rough Green, Rust Pink, Black, and Sail palette is thoughtfully balanced across smooth panels and textured overlays, creating depth and contrast from every angle. Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Premium Olive Flak Picante Red

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Valentine's Day Black (2026)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Parra 2018 FF is one of the most celebrated and collector-significant collaborative sneaker releases of the past decade, bringing together the Dutch artist Piet Parra and the Air Max 1 silhouette in a collaboration that produced one of the most visually spectacular and artistically ambitious colorway executions in the history of Nike's most beloved and design-historically significant running shoe platform. Parra's visual language, built around his distinctive flat-color illustration style featuring abstract geometric forms, animals, and characters rendered in bold and unexpected color combinations that reference 1970s graphic design, psychedelia, and a specifically Dutch visual sensibility, translates into the Air Max 1's multi-panel upper construction with extraordinary success, each panel of the shoe carrying different graphic elements from Parra's artistic vocabulary that combine across the full shoe to create a wearable illustration that functions simultaneously as a sneaker and as a piece of graphic art. The FF designation contextualizes this specific version within the broader Parra collaboration release framework, and the white and multi-color execution gives the artist's graphic elements their most open and color-rich presentation context, the white base allowing each panel's specific illustration content to register with the full visual impact and color accuracy that Parra's flat-color aesthetic demands. The Nike Air Max 1 Parra 2018 collaboration stands as one of the most discussed and documented releases in the Air Max 1's retro era precisely because the quality of the artistic collaboration and the visual ambition of the execution exceeded what most Nike artist collaboration releases achieve, creating a shoe that has grown in collector significance and market value considerably since its initial release as the distance between 2018 and the present has allowed the cultural conversation around the collaboration to mature and deepen. Parra's presence in the art and streetwear world has only expanded since this release, with his collaborative footprint across multiple major brands and platforms giving new collectors who discover his work a reason to seek out the Air Max 1 collaboration as the most complete and historically significant expression of his Nike relationship available in the sneaker collector market. At one hundred and fifty dollars at retail the 2018 Parra Air Max 1 was one of the most accessible artistic sneaker collaborations produced at this level of visual ambition and cultural significance, and its current collector status reflects how completely justified that original pricing was in documenting a genuinely important moment in the ongoing conversation between fine art and sneaker culture. The Nike Air Max 1 Parra 2018 FF was released on July 21, 2018 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black White Metallic Silver

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Neon (2026) (GS)

Display Name: Nike Air Max Penny 1 Orlando (2022)

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Fast Pass

For SB loyalists who appreciate region specific narratives, this pair blends skate function with cultural nods seamlessly. Display Name: New Balance 1890 Joe Freshgoods Finger Waves
Description: The New Balance 1890 Joe Freshgoods Finger Waves continues the collaborations focus on storytelling through a palette that blends Orange and Black tones with a sharp and intentional visual contrast. The orange and black combination gives the shoe a bold presence while still maintaining wearability within modern styling. The 1890 silhouette provides a structured base that allows the colors and story to stand out clearly. For collectors, releases like this represent the continued evolution of New Balance collaborations, where storytelling and cultural relevance remain at the forefront of design, making each drop feel significant within the broader sneaker landscape. Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro PSG Paris Saint-Germain Silver
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro PSG Paris Saint Germain Silver brings a sleek and fashion forward approach to the silhouette through its partnership with the Paris based club. The metallic silver upper creates a bold and reflective look, while pure platinum and oil grey tones add depth and balance. The clean but eye catching finish gives it strong visual appeal, while the collaboration adds global relevance. The Air Jordan 6 Retro PSG Paris Saint Germain Silver was released on February 24, 2026 with a retail price of $215.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Evo SL Core Black Iron Metallic
Description: The adidas Adizero Evo SL Core Black Iron Metallic takes the lightweight performance identity of the Adizero line and refines it into a sleek everyday runner with an aggressive speed driven aesthetic. The combination of Core Black and Iron Metallic gives the silhouette a stealthy and technical appearance that feels modern without becoming overly loud. The streamlined upper and low profile build reflect adidas running innovation, while the subtle metallic detailing adds dimension that catches light naturally during movement. Even at a glance, the shoe carries the energy of elite race day footwear adapted for daily wear. Fans of the Adizero family appreciate how the Evo SL balances performance inspiration with versatility. The silhouette feels fast and responsive visually, but the understated color palette makes it easy to style casually beyond running environments. Collectors and runners alike gravitate toward adidas performance models that maintain authentic sport DNA instead of leaning entirely into lifestyle trends, and this pair stays true to that philosophy. The blacked out presentation gives the shoe a focused and disciplined personality while the metallic accents prevent it from feeling overly minimal or flat in hand. The adidas Adizero Evo SL Core Black Iron Metallic was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas Adistar HRMY BAPE Green Camo
Description: The adidas Adistar HRMY BAPE Green Camo Hemp Iron Metallic Off White merges performance running heritage with unmistakable streetwear attitude. The Hemp Iron Metallic Off White base gets overlaid with BAPEs signature Green Camo, creating a layered look that instantly separates it from traditional trainers. The Adistar platform has always carried a technical edge, and pairing it with BAPEs bold pattern gives it crossover appeal that bridges sport and hype culture. Fans of both brands see this as a natural evolution. adidas brings decades of running credibility, while BAPE injects graphic intensity that has defined street fashion for years. The camo detailing transforms a performance silhouette into a statement piece without stripping away its athletic DNA. It feels equally at home on pavement or styled into a fashion forward fit, capturing that rare balance where function and cultural weight meet. The adidas Adistar HRMY BAPE Green Camo Hemp Iron Metallic Off White was released on February 7, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Black Elephant Print
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Black Elephant Print adds textured heritage to a timeless low top silhouette. Dressed in Black and Anthracite with hints of Tour Yellow, the upper features elephant print detailing that nods to classic Jordan design language. The familiar low cut shape and stitched overlays keep it grounded in the original 1985 blueprint. Elephant print has long been associated with iconic moments in Jordan history, and bringing it to the AJ1 Low creates a fresh yet nostalgic feel. The black base keeps the look sleek and versatile, while subtle yellow accents inject energy. It feels like a thoughtful remix that blends two legendary visual cues into one everyday rotation staple. The Air Jordan 1 Low Black Elephant Print was released on October 20, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Crocs Brick Clog LEGO Red
Description: The Crocs Brick Clog LEGO Red transforms the classic clog silhouette into a playful tribute to building block culture. The bright red exterior mirrors iconic brick tones, giving the familiar Crocs shape a bold and instantly recognizable twist. Ventilation ports and lightweight construction preserve the comfort driven DNA of the clog, while LEGO inspired detailing injects nostalgic creativity into the design. What makes this pair compelling is its celebration of imagination. The red colorway amplifies the crossover appeal between footwear and toy heritage, creating something that feels fun yet collectible. It captures the spirit of collaboration in a way that resonates with both longtime Crocs fans and LEGO enthusiasts alike. The Crocs Brick Clog LEGO Red was released on February 16, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Flint (2020)
Description: Jordan Brand brought back one of the first Air Jordan 13 colorways with the release of the Jordan 13 Retro Flint (2020), now available on StockX. With previous retros in 2005 and 2010, this is the third time that the Jordan 13 Flint has been reintroduced. This Jordan 13 Retro consists of a navy mesh and white leather upper with flint grey suede underlays. A Jumpman holograph on the ankle, 3M detailing throughout the upper, and Carolina blue branding on the tongue completes the design. These sneakers released in May of 2020 and retailed for $190 USD.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Dried Leaf Green (Women's)
Description: The ASICS Gel 1130 White Dried Leaf Green Womens introduces soft earth tones to the retro runner formula. A White mesh base is accented by Dried Leaf Green overlays, creating a balanced and nature inspired contrast. The layered construction and signature Gel cushioning maintain the silhouettes early two thousands performance identity. This womens edition feels light and easy to style, with the muted green tone adding depth without overwhelming the design. The 1130 continues to thrive as a lifestyle favorite thanks to its comfortable build and nostalgic appeal. It captures that sweet spot between sporty and understated, making it a strong everyday option. The ASICS Gel 1130 White Dried Leaf Green Womens was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro University Blue
Description: Jordan Brand paid homage to MJs alma mater with the Air Jordan 4 University Blue. The University Blue colorway draws a close resemblance to the extremely rare Air Jordan 4 UNC PE that was given to Tarheel student-athletes in 2019. The Air Jordan 4 University Blue features a University Blue suede upper with mesh netting on the quarter panel and tongue. Similar to OG Jordan 4 colorways of the past, the eyelets, heel tab, and sections of the midsole are a speckled Cement Grey. Hits of black appear on the wing eyelets, sole, and Jumpman logo on the heel tab. Two woven labels are stitched to the tongue; one being the classic Jumpman woven label; the other being a Team Jordan jock tag. A black, white, and Tech Grey sole with a clear Air unit completes the design. The Air Jordan 4 University Blue released in April of 2021 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog SpongeBob SquarePants
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog SpongeBob SquarePants features a yellow upper and heel strap, accented by SpongeBob SquarePants signature yellow hands, white sleeves, and red necktie. Originating in 1999, SpongeBob SquarePants is Nickelodeons most popular animated series, which has garnered fans worldwide since its debut. Crocs is an American brand known for their signature molded shoe's comfort, practicality, and unique features. Crocs is also known for the numerous variations iterated of its Classic Clog, which the brand reimagines in a myriad of ways. SpongeBobs face accents the heel strap on one side, while Crocs branding adorns the other side. The midsole features a brown and black design in the style of SpongeBobs brown pants and black belt. A yellow outsole completes the SpongeBob aesthetic. In our opinion, the best feature of the Classic Clog SpongeBob is SpongeBobs hands, which are three-dimensional and adorn the shoe like Jibbitz. The Crocs Classic Clog SpongeBob SquarePants released on May 22, 2024, and retailed at $70.

Display Name: Jordan 4 RM Pine Green
Description: The Jordan 4 RM Pine Green is a performance sneaker with a modern design, equipped with visible Air units under the heel. The Pine Green Jordan 4 RM is made with a base of white leather. This material forms the toe box and the heel area, while a light grey suede mudguard rounds out the forefoot. The eyestays, wings, and heel of the shoe are joined together to make a supportive cage around the foot, while the Nike Air logo appears on the back of the heel in Pine Green. A red Jumpman logo adorns the tongue in red, and a Pine Green midsole supports the back half of the shoe. There is a visible transparent Air unit under the heel. What we like best about this shoe is the support cage, which appears where the Nike swoosh normally is, but provides improved functionality and a sleek look. The Jordan 4 RM Pine Green was released on February 1, 2025, for $150.
Colorway: White/Pine Green-Neutral Grey-Wolf Grey-Varsity Red-Gum Dark Brown

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Gym Red Chrome
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Gym Red Chrome pushes the silhouette into a more reflective and high impact direction, using gym red as a base while chrome accents add shine and dimension. Coconut milk tones provide balance, preventing the design from feeling too intense. This version resonates because it highlights the Vomero 5s layered structure through material and contrast. The chrome detailing gives it a slightly futuristic feel, while the red base keeps it bold and expressive. Fans appreciate how it stands out while still delivering the comfort the model is known for. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Gym Red Chrome was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Sea Salt Castlerock
Description: The New Balance 9060 Sea Salt Castlerock brings a refined, modern twist to a fan-favorite silhouette with a palette thats effortlessly wearable. A layered upper combines airy mesh with plush suede overlays in Sea Salt and Castlerock tones, creating depth and texture that elevate everyday style. Reflective details add subtle pop, while the sculpted lines and exaggerated proportions nod to Y2K design language through a contemporary lens. The signature 9060 platform features a chunky, diamond-patterned outsole and a sweeping midsole that delivers visual impact without sacrificing balance, making these mens lifestyle sneakers a standout choice from street to studio. Comfort takes center stage thanks to a stacked midsole that blends ABZORB cushioning with SBS heel support for a soft-yet-stable ride. The wide base enhances traction and confidence, while the padded collar and tongue secure a snug, supportive fit. Whether youre clocking city miles or dressing up a casual rotation, the U9060AGAs thoughtful materials and neutral colorway pair seamlessly with denim, tech pants, or tailored joggers. Our team loves this product because it delivers plush cushioning, on-trend proportions, and a versatile color scheme that anchors any wardrobe.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Pink Foam (PS)
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Pink Foam PS brings a softer and more playful approach to the silhouette, combining black and medium grey with pink foam accents that add a gentle pop of color. The layered design remains intact, giving the shoe structure while the color palette shifts it toward a more youthful feel. The darker base keeps it grounded, while the pink foam details add personality without overpowering the design. Nike continues to adapt its core silhouettes for younger audiences, and this release reflects that approach through thoughtful color placement. It is a clean and accessible take on a classic model. The Nike Air Max 95 Pink Foam PS was released on March 26, 2026 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro OG Chicago (2026) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 13 Retro OG Chicago 2026 GS delivers the same iconic look in a grade school sizing, keeping the legacy of the Chicago colorway accessible to a younger audience. The white leather upper combined with black and true red accents maintains the classic feel that defines the model. The colorway remains unchanged, preserving its connection to the Chicago era while fitting a different size range. Display Name: adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball Carbon

Display Name: Nike M2K Tekno Cool White (Women's)
Description: The Nike M2K Tekno is a white sneaker for women. It mixes classic Nike history with a modern Monarch franchise chunky look. Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 12.1 CARNIVAL Hidden Layers of Phra Nakhon

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 2 Activate (Women's)

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Starfish

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant x FC Barcelona Persian Violet
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant x FC Barcelona Persian Violet brings together hardwood legacy and European football flair in a striking, easy-to-style package. Our team loves this product because it fuses basketball heritage, FC Barcelona-inspired color blocking, and upgraded comfort into a standout Air Force 1 that feels as good as it looks.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Barely Green
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Barely Green brings softness and energy together in a colorway that feels light and optimistic. Barely green tones give the Pegasus Premium a fresh and airy presence, while subtle hits of brighter color add movement and depth. Display Name: New Balance 993 MiUSA Kith Madison Square Garden Ancient Scroll

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Rare Air Pale Ivory Thunder Blue

Display Name: Jordan Mule Black Metallic Silver (Women's)

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Slate Grey Calcium

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Dark Alpine Green

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Silver Metallic Blue Agate

Display Name: New Balance 530 White Black Details

Display Name: Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 White Photo Blue Black

Display Name: Nike Air Max TL 2.5 Black Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Air Max TL 2.5 Black Metallic Silver is a striking addition to the iconic Air Max line, combining classic design elements with modern aesthetics. With its versatile colorway and timeless appeal, this shoe effortlessly transitions from casual outings to more stylish occasions. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a perfect blend of retro charm and modern performance in their footwear.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Cloud Grey Cement Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel NYC Cloud Grey Cement Grey channels modern city energy through a layered runner silhouette that feels grounded and purposeful. Cloud grey and cement grey tones move across the upper in a calm and cohesive way, emphasizing texture and structure rather than contrast. The design blends heritage running cues with contemporary proportions, giving the shoe a technical look that feels refined and wearable at the same time. Every panel feels considered and intentional. Fans are drawn to the Gel NYC because it captures the balance ASICS does best, mixing performance DNA with lifestyle sensibility. This colorway in particular appeals to collectors who prefer subtle depth over bold statements, making it easy to style while still feeling distinct. It reflects a design mindset rooted in function, longevity, and quiet confidence, reinforcing why ASICS continues to resonate within modern sneaker culture beyond trend driven cycles. The ASICS Gel NYC Cloud Grey Cement Grey was released on May 18, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Green
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Green is a shoe that was originally designed for the handball court, but has now become a street-style staple. This version of the adidas Handball Spezial comes with a paneled suede upper in Preloved Green. Suede overlays in the same color appear on the toebox and around the heel. The adidas three stripes appear on the midsoles in a Cream White color, and "SPEZIAL" and the adidas trefoil logo appear in gold on the lateral side. The heel collar sports the same Cream White color. For a final note of branding, there is an adidas patch on the tongue, and an adidas logo is also stamped into the brown gum rubber outsole under the heel. Our favorite thing about this shoe is its streamlined color scheme, which allows for simplicity and easy styling. The adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Green was released on March 15, 2024, for a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike A'ja Wilson A'One Always Shining (Women's)
Description: The Nike Aja Wilson AOne Always Shining Womens celebrates one of basketballs brightest modern stars through a signature silhouette built around confidence, versatility, and elevated performance design. Aja Wilsons influence extends far beyond the court because of her leadership, dominance, and growing role within the evolution of womens basketball culture, and the AOne reflects that energy through a sleek and highly wearable silhouette. The combination of White, Football Grey, and Sapphire creates a clean and luminous appearance that reinforces the Always Shining concept while maintaining strong versatility and modern basketball styling throughout the design. Fans gravitate toward signature athlete models when the personality and presence of the player feel genuinely embedded into the overall aesthetic, and this release captures Aja Wilsons poised but powerful identity perfectly. The lighter tones give the sneaker a polished and uplifting atmosphere while the sapphire accents add sharp contrast and visual energy throughout the upper. Collectors especially appreciate how womens basketball signature footwear continues evolving into a stronger and more celebrated space within sneaker culture. The overall presentation feels elegant, performance driven, and deeply connected to Aja Wilsons growing legacy within the sport. The Nike Aja Wilson AOne Always Shining Womens was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low SP St. John's
Description: Nike celebrated the 35th Anniversary of the Nike Dunk by releasing the Nike Dunk Low SP St. John's (2020), now available on StockX. The Nike Dunk debuted as part of the 1985 Nike College Colors program, a program that delivered footwear in the school colors of 12 popular basketball programs allowing fans to support their favorite teams from head to toe. This St. John's colorway was among the first collegiate colorways Nike released, breaking the mold for colorways used on basketball shoes. The Nike Dunk Low SP St. John's is composed of a white leather upper with red leather overlays. A white midsole, red outsole, and classic Nike branding on the tongue completes the design. These sneakers released in June of 2020 and retailed for $100 and again in October of 2023 and retailed for $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Obsidian
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Obsidian brings back Sergio Lozano iconic gradient design with an updated Air unit that nods to the original tooling. Obsidian anchors the layered upper, while Diffused Blue and Celestine Blue ripple through the signature side panels. The return of the larger visible Air bubble gives the silhouette a more pronounced stance, reinforcing its performance heritage. The Air Max 95 has always stood out for its human anatomy inspired design, and the Big Bubble treatment adds a layer of nostalgia for longtime collectors. Deep blue tones feel especially natural on this model, emphasizing the flowing gradient that made it revolutionary in the first place. For purists who care about shape and detail, this release feels like a respectful evolution of a true classic. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Obsidian was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Neutral Grey Sail
Description: Premium, versatile, and with a timeless design, the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Neutral Grey Sail effortlessly elevates a sneakerheads game  and offers comfort and durability to boot. Pumped full of the legendary Nike Air cushioning for the bounciest, most comfortable step, these Air Jordan Mids bring a sophisticated touch of the legendary silhouette while popping with a crisp color combo. The uppers are a combination of greys, including neutral, sail, and smoke grey. White base coloring on the laces, toe box, and sides, the suede and textile help the Wings and Jumpman logos pop. A Nike Swoosh sits on both inners of the shoe. This show boasts great rubber soles for traction, and a breathable toe box delivers comfort. We love the sophisticated color palette of these Nike Air Jordans. A legendary shoe, street cred comes standard with the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Neutral Grey Sail, released on 1 July 2024, priced at $135.

Model: Nike SB Air Max 2 CB '94 Low
Display Name: Nike SB Air Max 2 CB '94 Low Supreme Metallic Gold
Description: The Nike SB Air Max 2 CB 94 Low Supreme Metallic Gold takes a more expressive approach, using a metallic gold upper to create a bold and attention grabbing look. Varsity red and black accents add contrast that keeps the design balanced, while the silhouette maintains its strong and structured presence. This version resonates with fans who appreciate statement pieces. The metallic finish gives the shoe a distinct identity, making it stand out immediately. Combined with Supremes influence, it feels like a collaboration that embraces visibility and confidence without compromise. The Nike SB Air Max 2 CB 94 Low Supreme Metallic Gold was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $168.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Off-White University Gold
Description: Virgil Abloh pays homage to skate cultures adoption of 1980s Nike Basketball silhouettes with the Nike Dunk Low Off-White Michigan, now available on StockX. When Nike unveiled the Dunk as the centerpiece of their Nike College Colors program in 1985, seven different colleges were represented in the first colorways offered, with Michigan was one of the first schools. This Dunk Low is comprised of a university gold leather upper with midnight navy overlays. A unique secondary lacing system, zip-ties, and signature Off-White text on the sides completes the design. These sneakers released in December of 2019 for $170.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Aqua
Description: Enter the realm of iconic basketball legacy with the Jordan 6 Retro Aqua, revamped in a vibrant Black, Bright Concord, and Aquatone colorway. Dripping with history, this Retro silhouette gets a refreshing twist. The upper's supple suede is highlighted by Bright Concord accents on the Jumpan logo and rubberized heel tab, ensuring that perfect mix of premium style and function. Dive into the unexpected brilliance of Aquatone, seamlessly blending with the stark Black upper and Bright Concord hues on the midsole a color fusion never witnessed before on this iconic model. Signature Jordan elements remain, from the pull-tab at the rear of the heel. But what steals the show? The uncharted Aqua color way elements that's ready to make waves. The Jordan 6 Retro Aqua is a throwback with a fresh splash. Dropped at $200, it's the bridge between vintage Jordan and contemporary cool.

Display Name: Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Tide
Description: The Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Tide is a product of the collaboration between the American footwear company Crocs and footwear designer Salehe Bembury.? ?? ?This product features two adjustable and removable heel straps constructed out of nylon, "Fingerprint" concave ridges for multi-directional traction, outsole pods designed to take abrasion, ridges on its upper side to enable water to channel off the shoe, and holes on its upper to improve its breathability.? ?? ?The Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Tide was released on 22nd September 2022. At the time of its release, this Salehe Bembury Tide colorway model had a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 White University Blue
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 White University Blue remains a timeless essential in any collection, boasting a classic silhouette presented in a color scheme of white, University Blue, black, and Photon Dust. The White University Blue Nike Air Max 1 upper predominantly features a white mesh base, with University Blue accents highlighting the suede mudguards and lateral Swooshes. This same blue extends to the mesh inner lining, branding, tongue, and the visible Air Max heel unit. Gray suede overlays are strategically placed on the midfoot, heels, and vamp. Sitting atop a white midsole and black rubber outsole, the shoe maintains a clean and classic look. The Air Max bubble's pillars introduce a touch of the University of North Carolina Blue underfoot, while the surrounding foam adopts a "colorless" finish. The waffle-patterned outsole echoes the color-blocking, reminiscent of debut styles from 1987. The distinctive feature of the Nike Air Max 1 White University Blue is the use of University Blue tints, adding a lively touch to the overall neutral palette, setting the shoe apart as a truly unique piece. The sneaker debuted for $140 on October 15th, 2023.

Display Name: Jordan Son of Mars Low White Cement
Description: The Air Jordan Son of Mars Low White Cement is the colorway that makes the most sense on this silhouette, and getting there required understanding exactly what the Son of Mars Low is and where it comes from in the Jordan Brand story. Created as a tribute to the partnership between Michael Jordan and filmmaker Spike Lee, whose Mars Blackmon character became the face of the most iconic Jordan ad campaigns of the 1980s, the Son of Mars Low is a deliberate fusion of five different Jordan silhouettes assembled into one shoe as an homage to the shoes Spike helped make famous. The Jordan 4 midsole with its characteristic cement grey speckled pattern anchors the entire build and immediately keys this shoe into one of the most beloved colorway families in the Jordan universe, while the Jordan 3's elephant print overlays on the mudguard and heel bring the other half of the classic cement story into the design. The Air Jordan 5 tongue, a reflective fabric panel, and the low profile silhouette drawn from the Jordan 6 round out the fusion, along with "Son" and "Mars" labeled lace deubres and a Mars Blackmon image on the lace lock that make the Spike Lee connection explicit. White leather provides the clean primary base that lets every other material and detail speak clearly, gym red hits on the Jumpman logo and tongue branding add the Bulls energy that ties the whole colorway back to its Chicago roots, and the cement midsole underneath finishes the look with one of the most recognized patterns in sneaker history. The Son of Mars Low has returned in 2026 in this exact colorway alongside Black Cement and Do The Right Thing, giving a new generation access to a hybrid that built a deeply loyal following when it first arrived. The White Cement version is the one that most clearly communicates the Jordan 3 and 4 DNA running through this silhouette, and for anyone who understands what those two models mean to the culture, this is the Son of Mars Low to own. The Air Jordan Son of Mars Low White Cement was released on June 22, 2013 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Midnight Navy (Women's)
Description: The "Air Jordan 11 Retro Midnight Navy W" features a monochromatic appearance in a navy color pattern. This "Air Jordan 11" for women has an upper made of nubuck, equipped with tonal webbing eyelets in the same navy color. A plush velvet overlay replaces the trademark patent leather mudguard of the Retro design. The lateral collar is embellished with a shiny silver Jumpman. A white Phylon midsole is for cushioning, while the outsole is made of translucent rubber. Finally, the lateral collar is also branded with the number "23". The Air Jordan 11 Retro Midnight Navy W debuted on 11 November 2022. The shoe retailed at $225.

Display Name: Nike KD 18 Rain City
Description: The Nike KD 18 Rain City pays tribute to Kevin Durants roots with a color story that feels moody and grounded. Dressed in Black with University Gold, Anthracite, Fir, and Dark Smoke Grey, the layered upper reflects the overcast skies often associated with the Pacific Northwest. The streamlined build and responsive cushioning platform give the silhouette a quick and aggressive stance, built for fluid scoring and sharp movement. Rain themed releases always carry deeper meaning for Durant fans, symbolizing the environment that shaped his early grind. The darker tones dominate the look, while subtle hits of gold and green add dimension without overpowering the design. It feels focused and intense, much like Durants game, blending personal narrative with modern basketball performance aesthetics. The Nike KD 18 Rain City was released on July 22, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike V5 RNR Black Anthracite (Women's)
Description: The Nike V5 RNR Black Anthracite Womens keeps the silhouette minimal and focused, using a black and anthracite palette to emphasize clean lines and structure. The lack of contrast shifts attention to the shape and build of the shoe, giving it a streamlined and modern feel. This pair stands out because it strips things back to essentials. It is designed to be versatile and consistent, offering a dependable option for everyday wear. Fans appreciate how it delivers a simple and effective look without overcomplicating the design. The Nike V5 RNR Black Anthracite Womens was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Concord Bred
Description: Jordan Brand combined elements of two of their greatest Jordan 11 colorways to create the Jordan 11 Retro Low Concord Bred, now available on StockX. This hybrid design takes the upper of a traditional Jordan 11 Low Concord and pairs it with the red outsole of the Jordan 11 Bred. The Jordan 11 Low Concord Bred consists of a white upper with black patent leather overlays and black detailing. A white midsole, red translucent outsole, and Jordan branding on the tongue complete the design. These Jordan 11 Lows released in June of 2020 and retailed for $185 USD.

Display Name: New Balance 992 MiUSA Navy
Description: The New Balance 992 MiUSA Navy returns one of the brands most respected silhouettes in a colorway that feels timeless and deeply rooted in its heritage. The navy upper delivers a rich and versatile tone, while the Made in USA construction reinforces the premium craftsmanship associated with the model. The layered suede and mesh build gives the shoe both texture and durability. Collectors consistently value the 992 for its balance of comfort, quality, and understated design. This navy version fits seamlessly into that legacy, offering a look that works across seasons and styles. It is a staple within the New Balance lineup, appealing to those who appreciate classic design executed at a high level. The New Balance 992 MiUSA Navy was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike SB Zoom Blazer Mid Black White
Description: The Nike SB Zoom Blazer Mid Black White is part of a series of sneakers that have been released under the Nike SB brand. The Mid Black White Nike SB Zoom Blazer features a black suede upper with a white Swoosh logo on the sides and a black rubber sole. The heel contains a Zoom Air unit to provide cushioning and impact absorption, and the mid-top is designed to offer ankle support. The sneaker has a traditional lacing system, and the outsole is made from durable rubber to provide grip. The Nike SB Zoom Blazer Mid Black White was released on February 1, 2021, at a retail price of $85. Retail price was increased to $90 in 2024.

Display Name: Puma Speedcat OG Black White (Women's)
Description: The Puma Speedcat OG Black White Womens brings motorsport heritage into a sleek and low profile silhouette, using a black and white colorway that emphasizes simplicity and precision. The slim shape reflects its racing inspired roots, creating a shoe that feels close to the ground and streamlined. The contrast between black and white keeps the design sharp and easy to style. What makes this pair stand out is its connection to racing culture and minimalist design. The Speedcat has long been associated with motorsport, and this version keeps that identity intact while fitting into modern fashion. The clean colorway enhances its versatility, making it a strong option for everyday wear. It is a classic silhouette that continues to hold relevance through simplicity. The Puma Speedcat OG Black White Womens was released on November 26, 2024 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Jordan Spizike Low Oreo
Description: The Air Jordan Spizike Low Oreo delivers a clean and familiar black and white look across the hybrid silhouette, leaning into one of the most recognizable color schemes in sneaker culture. The black base is contrasted by white and anthracite details, creating a sharp and balanced design that feels easy to wear. It keeps the complexity of the Spizike but simplifies the overall look through color. Collectors appreciate this pair for its versatility and classic appeal. The Oreo colorway has always been a favorite because it works across different styles, and applying it to the Spizike Low gives the model a more accessible feel. It is a straightforward but effective take on a silhouette known for its layered design. The Air Jordan Spizike Low Oreo was released on February 17, 2026 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: Nike Kobe Air Force 1 Low Steam Summit White
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Steam honors one of basketballs most iconic figures through a clean and reflective take on the classic silhouette. The steam and summit white palette keeps the design minimal, allowing the tribute aspect to carry the weight rather than bold color blocking. The familiar Air Force 1 structure remains unchanged, grounding the shoe in something timeless while the theme adds emotional depth. This pair stands out because it represents legacy more than design innovation. Kobes influence extends far beyond the court, and releases like this capture that impact in a subtle and wearable way. It is a meaningful addition for collectors who appreciate storytelling tied to one of the games most respected names. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Steam was released on April 23, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Varsity Red Black
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Varsity Red Black Womens brings high shine attitude to a timeless color combination. Glossy patent leather defines the upper, giving varsity red and black a bold and confident finish that immediately stands out. White details break up the contrast, keeping the look balanced while letting the material choice carry the visual impact. The low profile shape keeps it sleek and expressive. This version appeals to fans who enjoy classic Jordan colorways with a fashion forward edge. The patent treatment adds drama and texture, transforming a familiar palette into something more statement driven. Collectors appreciate how the shine shifts the energy of the shoe without altering its core identity, making it feel special while remaining unmistakably Jordan. It is a pair that feels made for nights out as much as everyday rotation. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Patent Varsity Red Black Womens was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Converse SHAI 001 Masi Blue
Description: Converse SHAI 001 Masi Blue reflects Shai Gilgeous Alexanders smooth, intentional approach to the game through a colorway that feels artistic and calm. The Masi Blue tone brings a sense of depth and personality without overwhelming the silhouette, letting shape and texture carry the visual weight. It feels understated yet expressive, aligning perfectly with Shais reputation for quiet confidence and individuality. Collectors appreciate this release because it feels personal rather than performative. The SHAI 001 is designed to live comfortably between basketball and lifestyle spaces, and the Masi Blue color enhances that versatility. It represents the early foundation of a signature line focused on authenticity, making it especially appealing to fans who enjoy watching a new creative voice take shape in sneaker culture. The Converse SHAI 001 Masi Blue was released on 10/02/2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Tokyo Marathon Cherry Blossom
Description: The adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Tokyo Marathon Cherry Blossom captures the energy of race day through a design that feels both fast and symbolic. Inspired by the Tokyo Marathon and the seasonal bloom of cherry blossoms, the color palette blends core white with soft pink tones and metallic accents that reflect movement and light. The silhouette stays true to the Adios Pro lineage with its streamlined build and aggressive stance, giving it a look that immediately signals speed and performance. What makes this pair stand out is how it connects performance running with cultural storytelling. Marathon specific editions carry a different weight for collectors and runners alike, and this one leans into that moment with a design that feels tied to place and timing. Fans of the Adizero line appreciate how adidas continues to evolve the model visually while keeping its identity intact, making this release feel both purposeful and collectible. The adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Tokyo Marathon Cherry Blossom was released on February 4, 2026 with a retail price of $250.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Satin Black Toe (Women's)
Description: Jordan Brand adds a twist to a classic with the women's Air Jordan 1 WMNS Satin "Black Toe", now available on StockX. Jordan is no stranger to adding satin to the Jordan 1. In May of 2018, they released a satin rendition of the "Shattered Backboard" 1 in a similar fashion, revealing that the release would be in womens sizing. This AJ 1 features classic "Black Toe" color scheme. This design is constructed in a mix of leather and satin construction providing a luxury feel. A metal Wings logo on the heel completes the design. These women's sneakers released in August of 2019 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Cozy Girl (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Cozy Girl Womens leans fully into texture and warmth, reimagining the iconic low in a palette that feels soft and elevated. Light Orewood Brown sets a neutral foundation, while Hemp overlays add an organic tone that pairs naturally with Sail accents. The overall effect feels understated yet refined, offering a fresh perspective on a silhouette rooted in basketball history. This pair stands out because it prioritizes feel as much as look. The Cozy Girl theme suggests comfort driven materials that make the shoe feel more lifestyle focused without losing its Jordan DNA. Fans who rotate Jordan 1 Lows daily will appreciate how easily this colorway fits into fall and winter wardrobes, especially when styled with earthy layers. It is subtle, but that restraint is exactly what gives it long term appeal. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Cozy Girl Womens was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Crocs Masterbrand Creativity Clog LEGO Black Multi
Description: The Crocs Masterbrand Creativity Clog LEGO Black Multi brings together two instantly recognizable brands, combining Crocs comfort with LEGOs playful building block identity. The multi color accents pop against the black base, creating a design that feels interactive and full of personality. It transforms the clog into something more imaginative while keeping the core silhouette intact. Collectors and fans are drawn to this collaboration because it taps into creativity and nostalgia at the same time. The design feels engaging, encouraging expression through color and detail in a way that aligns with LEGOs core philosophy. It stands out as a fun and wearable piece that appeals to both younger audiences and longtime fans of both brands. The Crocs Masterbrand Creativity Clog LEGO Black Multi was released on March 19, 2026 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 White Hinoki Beige
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Hinoki Beige refines the retro runner formula with a calm and balanced color story. White mesh sets a crisp base, while Hinoki Beige overlays add warmth and subtle contrast across the layered upper. The metallic accents and visible cushioning remain true to the Kayano 14 original design language, preserving its early 2000s performance identity. Kayano 14 has become a staple in modern rotations thanks to its mix of technical detail and lifestyle appeal. This White and Hinoki Beige pairing feels especially versatile, offering a soft neutral look that works year round. Fans of understated runners appreciate when ASICS keeps the color blocking clean, allowing the intricate panel work and shape to do the talking without relying on loud hues. The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 White Hinoki Beige was released on January 3, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Gucci Slides Bloom Supreme
Description: The Gucci Slides Bloom Supreme are a stylish and comfortable addition to any wardrobe. These slides feature the iconic Gucci Supreme canvas in beige and ebony, adorned with a vibrant floral print known as the Bloom motif. The upper is made of a durable canvas material, while the footbed is lined with soft leather for added comfort. Released on November 1st, 2020, these slides retail for $310. They are available in sizes ranging from 4 to 14, making them accessible to a wide range of customers. The Gucci Slides Bloom Supreme are perfect for casual wear, whether you're running errands or lounging at home. Something we love about Gucci Slides Bloom Supreme is their versatility. They can be dressed up or down, making them a great choice for any occasion. Our experts think the standout feature of the Gucci Slides Bloom Supreme is the bold and eye-catching Bloom motif, which adds a pop of color to any outfit. Whether you're a fan of Gucci or simply looking for a comfortable and stylish pair of slides, the Gucci Slides Bloom Supreme are a must-have.

Display Name: Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 Teyana Taylor A Rose From Harlem (Women's)
Description: The Teyana Taylor A Rose From Harlem (Women's) Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 made its stellar debut on June 1, 2023. A collaborative masterpiece between the multi-talented Teyana Taylor and Jordan brand, this sneaker is a vibrant representation of her Harlem roots. Equipped with a Zoom Air unit, these sneakers don't just boast of style, they provide unbeatable comfort too. These kicks are an emblem of Harlem's strength and resilience. The Teyana Taylor A Rose From Harlem (Women's) Jordan 1 High Zoom Air CMFT 2 retailed at a price of $150 on June 1,2023.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Fossil
Description: The ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Fossil is a contemporary runner blending design elements from multiple GEL models, offering a nuanced, muted aesthetic. The colorway features Cream and Fossil. The multi-layered upper combines mesh and structural overlays, predominantly in the soft, off-white Cream tone. The shoe utilizes signature GEL technology cushioning in the midsole, ensuring superior shock absorption and lasting comfort for everyday urban wear. Slated for release on June 1, 2025, this versatile sneaker carries a retail price of $145. The Fossil accents, a dark, earthy tone, provide subtle contrast and definition to the shoe's layered construction. This model successfully pays homage to ASICS running heritage while presenting itself as a modern, sophisticated lifestyle piece. Our team values the superior shock absorption of the signature GEL technology and the refined, versatile aesthetic achieved through the pairing of soft Cream and defining Fossil tones.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Bold Cream Night Indigo (Women's)
Description: The adidas Gazelle Bold Cream Night Indigo (Women's) is a modern platform interpretation of the classic indoor trainer silhouette. The colorway features a clean juxtaposition of Cream White and Night Indigo. The upper, typically suede, is rendered in a smooth Cream White tone. The defining feature is the dramatically stacked, triple-layer gum sole unit, which provides an exaggerated, fashion-forward lift while rooting the shoe in its heritage design via the Gum texture. Released on November 24, 2024, this bold sneaker was priced at $120 retail. The Night Indigo provides a deep, sophisticated contrast on the Three Stripes and heel tab. This design successfully transforms the low-profile Gazelle into a statement piece, blending the shoe's timeless simplicity with contemporary, exaggerated proportions. Our experts commend the dramatic height achieved by the triple-stacked platform sole, which boldly reinterprets the classic profile while showcasing the deep Night Indigo accents against the Cream White suede.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro SE 95 Neon
Description: Jordan Brand celebrated Air Max Month by releasing the Jordan 4 SE Neon, now available on StockX. This colorway draws heavy inspiration from the original Air Max 95 Neon. This Jordan 4 is composed of a tonal grey upper with white netting underlays and neon detailing. A split-color Jordan Flight patch on the tongue, black sole, and patterned laces complete the design. These sneakers released in March of 2020 and retailed for $225.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Edge Flight Club (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Edge Flight Club Womens brings a playful and layered approach to the classic mid top silhouette, blending soft tones with sharper contrast. The mix of pale ivory and muslin creates a warm and neutral base, while black and racer pink accents add a pop of energy that gives the shoe a more expressive feel. It feels like a design that leans into creativity while still staying grounded in Jordan heritage. What makes this pair stand out is the balance between subtle and bold elements. The lighter tones keep it wearable, while the pink hits give it personality without overpowering the design. It is a version of the Jordan 1 Mid that feels fresh and slightly more experimental, appealing to collectors who want something different but still recognizable. The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Edge Flight Club Womens was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Cumulus 16 Burgundy Pink
Description: The ASICS Gel Cumulus 16 Burgundy Pink brings warmth and softness to a performance rooted silhouette, giving the Gel Cumulus 16 a more expressive and lifestyle friendly personality. The burgundy and pink tones create a smooth and cohesive palette that complements the shoes flowing lines, making it feel calm and wearable while still grounded in ASICS running heritage. It strikes a thoughtful balance between comfort and visual appeal. Fans gravitate toward this release because it shows how performance models can evolve beyond the track. The Gel Cumulus 16 has always been about cushioning and consistency, and this colorway adds emotional depth without disrupting that identity. Collectors appreciate it as a sneaker that feels approachable and refined, offering comfort, nostalgia, and modern styling in one cohesive package. The ASICS Gel Cumulus 16 Burgundy Pink was released on September 25, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Cloud Grey (Women's)
Description: The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Cloud Grey (Women's) is a shoe for women that features Gel technology for comfort and was inspired by the 2000s running aesthetic. This iteration of the ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 is made with a Cloud Grey mesh upper for breathability and flexibility. Polyurethane overlays in silver round out the toe box and run under the laces. The overlays also form the signature ASICS design across the sides of the shoe, but these overlays are also infused with a darker gray color in the middle. The heel counter overlays are also silver, and the heel is branded with the words GEL and GEL-KAYANO 14. The tongue features a classic ASICS logo. A white and gray sole and outsole complete the look. The Gel technology present underfoot provides support and shock absorption. What stands out about this shoe is the Cloud Grey muted colorway, which provides versatility. ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Cloud Grey (Women's) was released on January 1, 2024, for $150.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Low Iron Sharpens Iron
Description: The adidas AE 1 Low Iron Sharpens Iron is a cutting-edge performance sneaker that combines style and functionality. Featuring a sleek low-top design, this shoe showcases a striking Iron Metallic, Core Black, and Solar Orange colorway that's sure to turn heads on and off the court. The upper is crafted with premium materials, offering durability and breathability for intense gameplay, while the innovative cushioning system provides responsive comfort with every step. Engineered for optimal performance, the AE 1 Low incorporates adidas' latest technology to enhance agility and support. The outsole features a specialized traction pattern, ensuring excellent grip on various surfaces, while the midfoot support system offers stability during quick lateral movements. With its eye-catching design and performance-driven features, the adidas AE 1 Low Iron Sharpens Iron is perfect for athletes and sneaker enthusiasts alike. Our experts state this product is great for basketball players seeking a lightweight, responsive shoe that doesn't compromise on style or performance.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Infrared Salesman (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro Reverse Infrared TD flips one of the most iconic Jordan colorways into a darker and more aggressive look, adapted here for toddler sizing. The black upper takes control of the design, while infrared accents provide that signature pop that fans immediately recognize. Even in a smaller format, the identity remains strong and unmistakable. What makes this pair appealing is its connection to one of the most important colorways in Jordan history. The reverse approach gives it a slightly different feel while still honoring the original. It is a version that keeps the legacy alive for a new generation of wearers. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Reverse Infrared TD was released on February 14, 2026 with a retail price of $75.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Yellow Ochre
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG in Yellow Ochre/Black/Sail is a vibrant celebration of the Air Jordan legacy. This edition's Yellow Ochre colorway brings an electrifying twist to the classic silhouette, making it a standout piece in any sneaker collection. Accented with Black and Sail, the sneaker's bold Yellow Ochre hue ensures that it's not just another pair of Jordans; it's a fashion statement. Crafted with excellence, this sneaker combines high-quality materials and comfort, embodying the spirit of Michael Jordan's legendary performance. Released on January 13, 2024, with a retail tag of $180, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Yellow Ochre is a piece of sneaker history, a canvas of artistry, and a symbol of enduring style. It's a must-have for those who value both legacy and contemporary fashion.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked White Fir Elemental Pink
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked White Fir Elemental Pink translates one of the most iconic silhouettes into a performance driven format without losing its cultural weight. The white base keeps the look clean and familiar, while fir and elemental pink accents introduce subtle contrast that gives the shoe a fresh personality on and off the course. The low cut shape stays true to the original design, maintaining the visual DNA that has defined the Air Jordan 1 for decades. Golf adaptations of classic Jordans continue to gain traction because they merge sport function with lifestyle credibility. This pair captures that balance, offering something that feels just as relevant in casual settings as it does in play. For collectors, it represents the ongoing expansion of Jordan Brand into new spaces while still honoring the legacy that made the silhouette iconic. The Air Jordan 1 Low Golf Spiked White Fir Elemental Pink was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $175.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Powder Blue (2024)
Description: The Air Jordan 9 Retro Powder Blue 2024 revives a fan favorite colorway with a fresh execution. It features a white leather upper that's both luxurious to the touch and robust for wear. Black components grace the tongue, eyelets, liner, pull tabs, and midsole, highlighted by the iconic Jumpman.
