These dark accents set the stage for the dark powder blue featured on the midsole, inner lining, tongue branding, and logo on the heel pull tabs, imbuing the sneaker with a cool, collected charm that makes this sneaker truly stand out. Every aspect of the sneaker is infused with intentionthe powder blue adorns the midsole creating a visual synergy that's both striking and sophisticated. The Air Jordan 9's unique globe emblem on the heel celebrates Jordan's global influence, while the intricate stitch patterns and layered panels add depth and texture to the design. The release of the Air Jordan 9 Retro Powder Blue on March 23, 2024, for $210, marked a triumphant return of a beloved colorway. The launch celebrated Jordan's global appeal, with the sneaker's white and black composition setting the stage for the serene powder blue, ensuring its place in the annals of sneaker culture as a testament to timeless design and universal appeal.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Fire Red (2022) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Fire Red 2022 GS is a unique Jordan shoe reprising one of the OG colorways of the Tinker Hatfields Jordan 1988 model. The Air Jordan 3 Retro for grade-schoolers, nicknamed Fire Red, comes in white, red, cement grey, and black colors. The shoe has a white leather upper with the signature dark-grey elephant-print heel and forefoot overlays. The perforated leather collar, the polyurethane midsole, molded eyelets, the tongue embroidered with the Jumpman logo, and the heel tab embossed with the Nike Air logo all sum up the iconic features. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Fire Red 2022 GS was released in August 2022 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Heritage
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Heritage flips the original Chicago colorway for a bold, unique look. It features a white and University Red smooth leather upper with black leather collars and red Swooshes. From there, a black and red woven Nike tongue label and an Air sole at the base completes the design. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Heritage released in 2022 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Shadow Black Pink Spell (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Shadow Black Pink Spell Womens reworks the classic AF1 through layered detailing and playful color contrast that gives the silhouette a more expressive identity. The black base anchors the design, while Pink Spell and Pink Blast accents bring energy through doubled Swooshes, stacked panels, and exaggerated branding elements. The Shadow line has become known for amplifying the original Air Force 1 structure, creating a look that feels familiar but intentionally reimagined. Fans gravitate toward the Shadow because it adds depth and personality without losing the everyday wearability of the original model. The layered construction gives the sneaker a more dimensional look, making it stand out while still remaining easy to style. Pink accents soften the overall palette and add a more playful feel, especially within womens releases. For collectors, pairs like this highlight how Nike continues evolving the Air Force 1 through subtle design shifts that refresh the silhouette while keeping its core identity intact. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Shadow Black Pink Spell Womens was released on December 1, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Hell Cat
Description: Rule the hardwood in the adidas Harden Vol. 9 Hell Cat, a precision-tuned basketball shoe built for sharp step-backs, sudden stops, and relentless drives. Draped in the Core Black/Lucid Red/Cloud White colorway, this edition balances stealth with striking detail, pairing a sleek upper with bold accents that mirror James Hardens fearless style. A springy foam midsole cushions landings and returns energy on takeoff, while sculpted sidewalls and a supportive heel counter help keep your foot centered during high-speed changes of direction. The engineered upper wraps the foot with a breathable, second-skin feel, and targeted overlays add structure where you cut, plant, and pivot the most. Below, a grippy rubber outsole with a multi-directional traction pattern bites into the court for confident stops and starts, giving you the space to create separation on every possession. A secure lacing system works with the plush collar to lock in comfort without sacrificing mobility, and a subtle midfoot shank helps stabilize your foot through powerful movements. Finished with signature Harden detailing and the style code JH6483, this performance model is made for players who demand control, comfort, and consistency from tip-off to buzzer. Whether youre logging hours in the gym or styling them off-court, the adidas Harden Vol. 9 Hell Cat delivers modern hoops tech in a refined, game-ready package released on 2025-04-05. Our team loves this product because it blends reliable traction, responsive cushioning, and confident lockdown, ideal for guards and wings who live on quick cuts, crafty footwork, and step-back jumpers.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Fly 6 Black Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike Zoom Fly 6 Black Smoke Grey is a cutting-edge running shoe designed for performance and style. Featuring a sleek black upper with smoke grey accents, this shoe combines aesthetics with functionality. The innovative Zoom Air technology in the midsole provides responsive cushioning, while the streamlined silhouette ensures a aerodynamic feel during your runs. Engineered with Nike's latest advancements in running shoe technology, the Zoom Fly 6 offers superior comfort and support for long-distance runs. The breathable mesh upper keeps your feet cool, while the durable rubber outsole provides excellent traction on various surfaces. With its stylish design and performance-driven features, this shoe is perfect for both serious runners and casual wearers alike. Our team thinks this product is great for runners seeking a balance of speed, comfort, and durability in their training and race day footwear.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Escargot
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Escargot was released ahead of the 2024 Paris Olympics and celebrates one of Frances most famous dishes. The base of the Escargot Nike SB Dunk Low features soft suede in Pear with smooth leather overlays in rich Sesame. This unusual color combination represents the garlic butter with parsley used in the escargot cooking process. Sticking to its skateboarding roots, this version of the SB Dunk Low boasts thick padding in the tongue and around the collar. Metallic-silver accents can be found on the Swoosh logos and the leather heel tab, while additional Pear hues decorate the "NIKE" embroidery on the heel and the Nike Skateboarding branding on the tongue tag. Our experts at StockX like that the metallic-silver accents represent the silver platter upon which escargot is served. In addition, the insole invokes white plate imagery celebrating Pariss culinary history. The Nike SB Dunk Low Escargot was released on October 1, 2024, and sold for $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Dn8 SE Black Dark Grey
Description: The Nike Air Max DN Roam in Black and Metallic Silver is a lifestyle and travel-focused expression of Nike's Dynamic Air cushioning platform, the DN's dual-tube Air system delivering a distinctive and immediately recognizable midsole profile that sets it apart from every other Air Max silhouette in the current lineup. Black across the upper with metallic silver hitting the DN's signature dual-tube structure creates a premium and slightly industrial visual character that suits the Roam designation's nomadic and urban exploration energy, the metallic accent transforming the cushioning architecture into the shoe's most visually compelling design feature. The DN platform's unique aesthetic is about making the technology visible and central, and the black and metallic silver colorway executes that design philosophy at its most refined and fashion-forward. Roam-specific Nike releases carry a travel and utility positioning that grounds even technically complex cushioning platforms in practical everyday use contexts, and the black and metallic silver colorway gives the DN Roam a versatility that wilder colorways in the same platform cannot always claim. The metallic silver's relationship with the dual-tube Air structure means the shoe looks different in different lighting conditions, which creates a dynamic visual character that rewards daily wear with a constantly evolving appearance across different environments and outfit contexts. At one hundred and ninety dollars the DN Roam in black and metallic silver represents a serious investment in one of Nike's most technically distinctive and architecturally interesting current Air Max platforms. The Nike Air Max DN Roam in Black and Metallic Silver was released on October 2, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Black Collective
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniere Burgundy Crush represents a refined and emotional reinterpretation of a performance icon through a luxury lens. A clean white upper sets a calm foundation, contrasted by deep burgundy crush tones that bring richness and gravity to the design. Subtle violet ore accents and black details add depth, allowing the Jordan 5 shape to feel elevated and intentional rather than aggressive. This collaboration resonates because A Ma Maniere approaches Jordan silhouettes with restraint and purpose. Every detail feels considered, prioritizing storytelling and material over flash. Collectors value how this release honors the Jordan 5 while transforming it into something more introspective and mature. It feels ceremonial and expressive, designed for those who see sneakers as cultural artifacts rather than just footwear, reinforcing the partnerships reputation for thoughtful execution. The Air Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniere Burgundy Crush was released on July 25, 2025 with a retail price of $225.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Barely Grape Photon Dust Summit White Metallic Silver (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Barely Grape Photon Dust Summit White Metallic Silver Womens layers soft lavender tones over a performance inspired silhouette. Barely Grape adds gentle color to the upper, balanced by Photon Dust and Summit White panels that brighten the design. Metallic Silver accents enhance the intricate overlay structure, giving the shoe a modern technical feel. Its cushioned platform reflects the comfort driven Vomero heritage. Fans drawn to pastel palettes will appreciate how the grape hue adds personality without overwhelming the silhouette. The blend of white and silver keeps the look fresh and versatile. It merges retro running influence with contemporary styling effortlessly. Light and expressive, this pair delivers comfort with subtle vibrance. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Barely Grape Photon Dust Summit White Metallic Silver Womens was released on March 20, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Year of the Mamba University Red
Description: The Nike Kobe 5 Protro Year of the Mamba University Red is a vibrant celebration of Kobe Bryants legacy and the 2025 Lunar New Year. Inspired by the Year of the Snake, this sneaker features a bold university red base with gold details and intricate snake motifs that pay homage to Kobes "Black Mamba" nickname. A golden snake wraps around the sides, while metallic gold accents highlight the toe box, heel, and tongue logo. The textured snakeskin pattern on the collar gives the sneaker a luxurious edge, complementing the bold design. Black swoosh logos and a durable black rubber outsole ground the shoe with striking contrast, ensuring its as functional as it is stylish. Packed with Protro performance updates, this iteration stays true to Kobes ethos of innovation and excellence. Released on January 18, 2025, the Nike Kobe 5 Protro Year of the Mamba University Red retailed for $190. This pair dropped exclusively in China to celebrate Kobe Bryants enduring impact and the joy and fortune associated with the Lunar New Year.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Shark Skin
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 White Shark Skin is a stability running shoe with design details that mimic the pattern of shark skin. Finding inspiration in the Gel-KAYANO 14 and other sneakers in the Gel-1000 catalog, the Gel-1130 White Shark Skin boasts a breathable mesh upper. Unlike previous iterations, this model incorporates synthetic leather instead of genuine leather in the overlays. When light hits the synthetic overlays, it produces a silvery sheen that is reminiscent of shark skin. Splashes of silver also add to the sneakers open ocean aesthetic. Other notable elements include gel technology in the heel, which provides responsive cushioning and protects against impact on hard materials such as pavement. The sneaker also houses ASICS signature Trusstic support system, which improves stability and can be found in many 2000s running shoes. Our StockX experts like the dope-dyeing of the inner lining. This dyeing technique provides lasting color and reduces carbon emissions. The ASICS Gel-1130 White Shark Skin was released on January 1st, 2024, and retailed at $95.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Orchid (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Orchid (Women's) introduces a vibrant new colorway to one of the most iconic Air Jordans of all time. The Jordan 4 has long been a fan favorite, both for its historic significance in Michael Jordans career and its timeless design. This womens exclusive release features a stunning orchid suede upper, accented by neutral grey, black, and white tones. The speckled midsole, wings, and back tab add even more flair to this already eye-catching sneaker. The Jordan 4 is known for its distinctive design elements, including the mesh paneling, visible Air cushioning, and plastic wing eyelets that provide both style and functionality. First introduced in 1989, the Jordan 4 quickly became a cultural icon, celebrated for its on-court performance and off-court appeal. The Orchid colorway brings a fresh, bold look to this beloved silhouette, perfect for those who want to stand out while paying tribute to a piece of sneaker history. Released on October 5, 2024, the Jordan 4 Retro Orchid (Women's) retailed for $215. With its vibrant color scheme and iconic design, this edition of the Jordan 4 is sure to be a hit among sneaker collectors and Jordan fans looking for something both stylish and timeless.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Skyline
Description: Jordan Brand is paying homage to the original Michael Jordan Skyline photograph, with the release of the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Skyline. ? ?The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Skyline is designed with gradient prints of oranges, pinks, and blues to represent the iconic Micheal Jordan photo of him dunking in front of the Chicago skyline. Jordan brand used canvas uppers and a sail midsole to help give the sneaker a vintage inspired look. The sneakers come with specially designed packaging to look like the Michael Jordan Skyline photograph.? ? ?The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Skyline released April 8, 2023, with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Light Mulberry (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid Berry Pink (Women's) was made for both comfort and utility, meaning that it can be worn to play a game of basketball or to walk around town. This high top shoe has a berry-colored sole next to a white midsole. For the body of the shoe, there are berry-colored leather overlays that sit on top of the white base. The Nike swoosh symbol appears in black, as well as parts of the shoe near the ankle, and the Air Jordan symbol. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Berry Pink (W) for women first hit the market in January of 2022. The retail price for this specific product was $120.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Clay Grey Pure Silver
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Clay Grey Pure Silver arrives in a sleek clay grey and pure silver colorway, drawing design inspiration from the Gel-Kayano 14, a standout in the ASICS lineup. The upper of this ASICS Gel-1130 is crafted from a mix of materials, including breathable mesh and synthetic overlays that mimic leather. A dynamic design sees the clay grey mesh base accented with pure silver details flowing across it, while metallic silver highlights add a polished touch. The iconic ASICS stripes feature prominently on both sides, tying the look together. True to its heritage, this low-profile running shoe incorporates ASICS signature Gel cushioning for reliable comfort. Matching clay grey laces complete the look. We think one of the shoes defining features is the silver-colored TRUSSTIC support system, a shank positioned between the forefoot and rearfoot that enhances stability. Released on September 1, 2024, the ASICS Gel-1130 Clay Grey Pure Silver hit shelves at a retail price of $95.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Somos Eternos
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Somos Eternos blends storytelling and color through a rich and layered design rooted in Latin culture. Denim turquoise and smokey blue tones dominate the upper, creating a calm foundation accented by red stardust highlights and light stone details. The mix of textures and hues feels intentional, giving the shoe emotional weight beyond simple color blocking. This release resonates with fans because it prioritizes meaning and identity. Somos Eternos translates to we are eternal, and the design reflects that sentiment through depth and nuance rather than flash. Collectors value how Jordan Brand uses the Jordan 1 as a canvas for cultural expression, making this pair feel personal and symbolic. It stands out as a release that invites connection, reflection, and pride while remaining wearable and refined. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Somos Eternos was released on October 18, 2025 with a retail price of $145.
Colorway: Denim Turquoise/Smokey Blue/Red Stardust/Light Stone/Denim Turquoise/Light Stone

Display Name: Bad Bunny The Last Campus
Description: The adidas Campus Bad Bunny The Last Campus is rapper and singer Bad Bunnys interpretation of the classic adidas Campus. This sneaker features a primarily Deep Brown colorway, which represents the brown full-face mask that Bad Bunny often wears while performing. While the upper is constructed from shaggy suede in Deep Brown, Chalk tones break up the dark colorway. The signature 3-Stripes logo on the side panels, the synthetic mudguard, the padded collar, the inner lining, the laces, and the tongue come in Chalk. In addition, the midsole and rubber outsole blend in with the Chalk mudguard. Something that makes this sneaker stand out is the tongue. It actually features two thin tongues layered one on top of the other. Our experts at StockX like the CAMPUS lettering in pink that runs along the 3-Stripes logo. The adidas Campus Bad Bunny The Last Campus was released on May 11, 2024, and retailed at $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Latte (Women's)
Description: Introducing the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Latte (Women's), a sneaker that blends classic style with a modern twist, perfect for today's fashion-forward crowd. This edition features a tasteful mix of Black, Legend Medium Brown, White, and Sail, reflecting a sophisticated palette thats as versatile as it is striking. The high-top silhouette maintains its legendary profile, updated with a fresh color scheme that resonates with the subtle yet bold tastes of a new generation. This Jordan 1 Retro High OG is designed not just for looks but also for lasting comfort. The high-quality leather upper and air-cushioned sole provide premium support and durability, making it ideal for daily wear. Whether you're stepping out for a night on the town or heading to a casual meetup, these sneakers are crafted to offer both standout style and practical functionality. Released on May 29, 2024, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Latte (Women's) retailed for $180. This sneaker has quickly become a staple in the collections of those who appreciate a refined approach to streetwear. With its neutral yet impactful colorway and classic design, it promises to remain a favorite for years to come, showcasing a timeless charm that transcends seasons and trends.

Display Name: Jordan 17 Retro Doernbecher Zach Rumbaugh
Description: Air Jordan 17 Retro Low Doernbecher Zach Rumbaugh stands as one of the most meaningful releases in Jordan Brand history, blending innovative design with a powerful personal story. Zach Rumbaughs vision brings color, texture, and emotion to the Air Jordan 17 Low, transforming the silhouette into a canvas for resilience and creativity. Every detail feels expressive, celebrating individuality and strength through design rather than subtlety. Collectors value this pair because it represents purpose beyond aesthetics. The Doernbecher program has always been about giving voice through design, and this release captures that spirit fully. The Air Jordan 17s futuristic shape amplifies the message, making the shoe feel bold, heartfelt, and unforgettable within Jordan lore and sneaker culture as a whole. The Air Jordan 17 Retro Low Doernbecher Zach Rumbaugh was released on 01/17/2026 with a retail price of $230.

Model: Jordan 1 Low Method of Make V3
Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Method of Make V3 Suit & Tie (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Method of Make V3 Suit and Tie in Black, Sail, Hydrogen Blue, and Black for Women is a release from Nike's Method of Make experimental construction series that applies unconventional material and assembly approaches to the most iconic basketball shoe silhouette in history, delivering a version of the AJ1 Low that challenges conventional assumptions about how premium footwear should be constructed while maintaining the essential design DNA that has made the Jordan 1 the most culturally significant sneaker of the past four decades. The Method of Make program is built around the idea that the process of making a shoe is as worthy of design consideration and communication as the final appearance of the shoe itself, and the Suit and Tie naming within the V3 framework suggests a material story drawn from tailoring and formal dressing traditions where fabric weight, construction technique, and textile quality are the primary vehicles for expressing excellence and care. Black, sail, and hydrogen blue create a colorway that feels simultaneously formal and sneaker credible, the black providing the authority of suiting while sail and hydrogen blue introduce the kind of unexpected color relationship that Method of Make releases consistently use to signal their departure from conventional Jordan 1 colorway logic. The women's specific Air Jordan 1 Low platform delivers the AJ1's iconic silhouette elements including the wings logo, ankle collar stitching, and outsole tooling in proportions and fit dimensions developed for the female foot, ensuring that a construction and material forward release like the Method of Make V3 delivers its intended wearing experience to the women's consumer it was designed for with the same precision and intention as the design and construction work invested in making the upper itself. Method of Make releases occupy a specific and valued tier in the Jordan Brand collector conversation because they represent the most experimental and design forward expression of Nike's thinking about what the Jordan 1 platform can become when freed from the conventional colorway and material expectations that govern most seasonal releases, and the Suit and Tie V3 in women's sizing brings that experimental ambition to a sizing range that deserves equal access to the Jordan Brand's most creative and forward thinking work. For women who follow Jordan Brand's most design ambitious releases and who want a pair that rewards close examination of construction and material as much as visual impact, the Method of Make V3 Suit and Tie is an essential and intellectually satisfying acquisition. The Air Jordan 1 Low Method of Make V3 Suit and Tie Women's was released on March 31, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Concord (2018) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Concord 2018 GS has a simple two-tone design, featuring a black and white mesh-leather upper, sitting atop a white midsole and translucent Concord rubber outsole. This 2018 Air Jordan 11 for grade-schoolers boasts the same design hallmarks as its full-sized counterpart, starting with the ballistic mesh upper in white. The upper transitions to a black patent leather mudguard, which then gives way to a translucent rubber outsole fitted with the Concord herringbone-tread inserts that give the shoe its name. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Concord 2018 GS was first released on the 8th of December 2018 for an initial retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Dodgers
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Dodgers brings West Coast baseball energy to the iconic low top silhouette through a crisp White and Old Royal foundation. University Red accents add a subtle pop that nods to classic team detailing, while the Gum Yellow outsole grounds the look with vintage warmth. The familiar AJ1 paneling keeps the design rooted in basketball heritage, even as the color story channels stadium nostalgia. This pair stands out because it blends sport crossover appeal with everyday wearability. The blue and white combination feels timeless, instantly recognizable without relying on heavy branding. Fans appreciate when the Jordan 1 taps into cultural moments beyond the hardwood, and this execution captures that balance perfectly. It is a clean, confident update that merges baseball pride with one of the most enduring sneaker silhouettes ever created. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Dodgers was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low New Beginnings
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low New Beginnings draws inspiration from the earliest chapters of Jordan Brand history through a clean and symbolic color story. Summit white covers nearly the entire upper, creating a crisp and uniform look, while varsity red accents add a subtle nod to the origins of the Jordan legacy. The low profile keeps the presentation modern and accessible. Fans appreciate this release for its meaning rather than flash. The New Beginnings theme speaks to heritage, growth, and legacy, making it appealing to collectors who value storytelling. It feels ceremonial yet wearable, offering a sense of history without relying on heavy contrast or complex detailing. This pair reflects the idea that sometimes the strongest statements come from restraint and intention rather than excess. The Air Jordan 1 Low New Beginnings was released on June 20, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Dark Pony
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Dark Pony is a mature take on the original Chicago color combo, swapping the bright red for a burgundy hue. Slick and sophisticated without lacking in street cred, these sneakers are a rich tribute with modern appeal. Made from premium textiles such as full-grain leather and suede, the Dark Pony Lows combine burgundy red with black and white panelling, following the same design as the original classic. With strong branding elements such as the Jumpman and Wings logos and Nike Swoosh, the contrast projects powerfully, whilst remaining iconic. Midsoles boast Nike Air cushioning while outsoles tap back to the burgundy color to wrap the shoe up nicely. We love how sleek these Low sneakers are. The tribute to the original is fitting and works for audiences who want to mix with smarter outfits. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Dark Pony was released on February 20, 2025, priced at $125 retail.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Off-White University Blue
Description: Time for some Tobacco Road vibes with these Jordan 1 Retro Off-Whites. Also known as the "UNC" editions, these Jordan 1s are the third colorway designed by Virgil Abloh and made in collaboration with his Off-White label. The sneakers come in a white, dark powder blue colorway, with a white and blue deconstructed leather upper and Off-White detailing throughout. If youre a fan of Virgil Ablohs work and want to rep Off-White, this pair is another must-have.

Display Name: Converse Run Star Hike Hi Black White Gum
Description: Inspired by hiking boots, the spiked rubber sole on the Converse Run Star Hike Hi Black White Gum turns this footwear into a piece of abstract art. The rest of the silhouette offers a thick white sole and a minimalist black-and-white design that's reminiscent of the original Chuck Taylor All Star. On the heel, this sneaker displays a chunky white star embedded into the black rubber sole. The Converse Run Star Hike Hi Black White Gum released in December of 2019 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink PS brings softness and charm to the Jordan 12 through a colorway designed to feel playful yet premium for younger wearers. The pearl pink upper highlights the Jordan 12s distinctive stitched panels and structured build, giving the silhouette a gentle and welcoming personality. Even in preschool sizing, the shoe feels thoughtfully designed, maintaining the strength and elegance that define the model. Fans love this release because it introduces classic Jordan design in a way that feels accessible and joyful. The Jordan 12s heritage remains intact, while the pink tones add warmth and personality that resonate with kids and collectors alike. It feels like a perfect balance of tradition and fun, making it a meaningful entry point into Jordan Brand for the next generation of sneaker fans. The Air Jordan 12 Retro Pearl Pink PS was released on November 20, 2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Leopard Magic Beige (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Leopard Magic Beige Womens adds a more expressive twist to the classic indoor silhouette, introducing leopard pattern elements that bring texture and personality to the design. The magic beige base keeps the look grounded, while subtle pattern details and ivory tones add depth without overwhelming the shoe. It is a bold direction that still respects the original shape. What makes this pair stand out is how it balances statement design with wearability. The leopard influence gives it a unique edge, while the overall color palette keeps it versatile enough for everyday use. It is a strong example of how the Spezial can evolve without losing its core identity. The adidas Handball Spezial Leopard Magic Beige Womens was released on December 6, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Low Ascent Pack MX Grey
Description: The adidas AE 1 Low MX Gray is a creation from NBA player Anthony Edwards that boasts a sleek silhouette and a marbled pattern on the TPU side panels. The basketball sneaker MX Gray adidas AE 1 Low features a mesh upper in Core Black that complements the Silver Pebble and Wonder Beige found on the TPU side panels and the rubber outsole. Featuring a honeycomb-like construction, the TPU side panels provide airflow and contribute to the sneakers eye-catching design. The ultra-lightweight midsole promotes energy return with LightStrike and Boost technologies, while the rubber outsole's herringbone pattern provides superior traction. Finally, the rubberized 3-Stripes logo in Silver Pebble adorns the molded heel. Our experts at StockX appreciate Anthony Edwards subtle branding elements, including the woven tongue tag that displays the athletes signature stylized anthill logo. The adidas AE 1 Low MX Gray was released on July 20, 2024, and sold for $110.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Cave Stone Medium Ash Flat Pewter Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike P-6000 Cave Stone Medium Ash Flat Pewter Metallic Silver is a striking addition to Nike's lineup of lifestyle sneakers. This model showcases a sophisticated color palette, combining earthy tones with metallic accents for a versatile and eye-catching design. The upper features a mix of materials, including breathable mesh and durable synthetic overlays, providing both style and functionality. The Cave Stone and Medium Ash hues create a neutral base, while the Flat Pewter and Metallic Silver details add a touch of understated elegance. Built for comfort and everyday wear, the P-6000 incorporates Nike's renowned cushioning technology in the midsole, ensuring responsive support with each step. The shoe's design pays homage to Nike's running heritage while offering a modern twist for contemporary street style. With its chunky silhouette and layered construction, this sneaker effortlessly blends retro aesthetics with current trends. We at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a comfortable, stylish sneaker that can easily transition from casual outings to light athletic activities.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 2 TB White Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 2 TB White Black Womens delivers clean contrast on a performance ready frame. A white base brightens the silhouette, while black accents define the structure and highlight the streamlined design. Subtle Photon Dust and Volt elements add dimension without overpowering the two tone foundation. The low cut build remains agile and responsive, built for sharp footwork and confident pace. This edition resonates with players who favor classic team color combinations. The white and black pairing feels timeless, offering versatility across uniforms and rotations. It keeps the focus on movement and precision rather than loud graphics. Balanced and composed, this pair reflects a steady competitive mindset. The Nike Sabrina 2 TB White Black Womens was released on September 1, 2024 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 White Black
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 White Black dresses the Zoom Vomero 5 in a white, black, and gray colorway that allows the sneakers technical features to take center stage. As a modern interpretation of early 2000s running shoes, the White Black Nike Zoom Vomero 5 features a slightly chunky midsole with plush Cushlon foam and Zoom Air cushioning. The combination of these technologies provides supportive comfort with each step without weighing down the foot. Airy mesh combines with plastic components and synthetic leather to create a layered upper with a visually complex design. In addition, plastic caging on the sides supports the sneaker, while ventilation ports at the heel allow the foot to breathe. Our experts at StockX like the way the white embroidered outline makes the signature Swoosh logos stand out even though all the sneaker's colors lie on the grayscale. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 White Black was released on March 27, 2024, and sold for $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Desert Khaki Black
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Desert Khaki Black brings a rugged, earthy aesthetic to the iconic silhouette. This men's sneaker features a desert khaki upper, creating a sleek and versatile look that's perfect for both casual and semi-formal occasions. The black accents, including the signature Swoosh and heel tab, provide a striking contrast against the khaki backdrop, enhancing the shoe's overall appeal. Crafted with Nike's renowned attention to detail, this Air Force 1 Low incorporates premium materials and expert construction. The LV8 (elevated) version offers subtle enhancements to the classic design, ensuring both style and comfort. The low-top profile allows for easy wear and versatility, while the Air-Sole unit in the midsole delivers the cushioning that has made the Air Force 1 a favorite among sneaker enthusiasts. Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a stylish, comfortable sneaker that effortlessly blends urban style with a touch of rugged charm.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Dn8 Black
Description: Step into the future of comfort with the Nike Air Max Dn8 Black, a sleek, all-conditions staple built for everyday wear and elevated style. Cloaked in a refined Black/Anthracite palette, this pair delivers a stealth look that pairs effortlessly with techwear, athleisure, or tailored street fits. A breathable mesh upper is reinforced with streamlined overlays for structure and durability, while the sculpted midsole showcases the signature Air Max cushioning that the line is celebrated for, soft underfoot feel, smooth transitions, and long-haul support. The padded collar and plush tongue hug the ankle for a secure, comfortable fit, and the classic lace setup allows precise lockdown whether youre on the move or off the clock. Underfoot, a grippy rubber outsole with targeted traction zones keeps each step confident on city pavement and beyond. The silhouettes flowing lines and low-profile stance create a modern, athletic frame that looks fast standing still, highlighting the shoes performance DNA. Subtle branding and tonal accents keep the aesthetic crisp and versatile, making it an easy go-to for travel, commuting, and weekend rotations alike. With its balanced blend of cushioning, stability, and understated style, the Nike Air Max Dn8 Black hits the sweet spot between sport-inspired engineering and everyday versatility. Our team loves this product because it delivers day-to-night comfort, sharp neutral styling, and reliable traction, perfect for anyone who wants a polished, modern Air Max they can wear nonstop.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Anthracite Flat Silver
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Anthracite Flat Silver is one of the most tonally cohesive and most considered colorways in the Vomero 5's ongoing 2025-26 reissue program, a grayscale palette that applies deep Anthracite, Chrome, Flat Silver, and Black across the silhouette's characteristically complex layered material construction to create what Sneaker News described as a "late-night aesthetic," the kind of monochromatic darkness-with-depth that makes the Vomero 5's structural complexity legible without the distraction of contrasting accent colors pulling the eye in multiple directions. The Zoom Vomero 5, originally a performance running shoe from the mid-2000s, re-emerged as one of the defining lifestyle sneakers of the early 2020s as the broader cultural appetite for Y2K-era technical running aesthetics brought the silhouette's signature plastic midfoot cage, multi-layer upper construction, and ventilated heel counter back into relevance as design features that read as futuristic rather than dated. The Anthracite Flat Silver upper layers breathable mesh, suede overlays, and the ribbed TPU cage in a grayscale progression, each material section shifting between deeper anthracite tones and lighter flat silver hits in a way that gives the shoe visual dimension through material contrast rather than color contrast. The black Swoosh with contrast edging provides the subtle depth that anchors the palette without introducing a new color direction, and Chrome accents on the midsole and outsole-adjacent details complete the circuit of silver-family tones that unifies the entire shoe. Cushlon midsole foam and Zoom Air cushioning deliver the comfort-first performance-derived ride that made the Vomero 5 a genuine daily-wear proposition rather than simply a display piece, while the rubber outsole provides durable traction with a waffle-influenced tread pattern that nods to the shoe's running heritage. Style code HF1553-006, $170. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Anthracite Flat Silver is the Vomero 5 colorway for the collector and daily wearer who wants the silhouette's full multi-material complexity expressed through the most restrained, most moody, and most effortlessly wearable grayscale palette in the 2025-26 reissue program. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Anthracite Flat Silver was released on January 5, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Mid Off-White Black
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Mid Off-White honors the 40th Anniversary of the Nike Air Force 1 by refreshing the classic design with Abloh's signature avante-garde style. It arrives with a black, wood grain-textured lightweight mesh upper with ripstop collar straps and clear TPU Swooshes. From there, a warped midsole with multi-colored sections of a track-inspired spiked outsole reference past Nike Off-White designs like the Nike Waffle Racer and Air Zoom Tempo Next%. The Nike Air Force 1 Mid Off-White Black released in June of 2022 and retailed for $185.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Rayssa Leal
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Rayssa Leal is a vibrant homage to the Brazilian skateboarding sensation, showcasing a color palette that reflects her youthful energy and spirited personality. Pure platinum, deep royal blue, vivid purple, and white converge with gum yellow accents to create a sneaker that's as dynamic and captivating as Rayssa Leal herself. This edition of the SB Dunk Low is designed for those who live their life on and off the skate ramps with passion and style. Rayssa Leal, famously known as the "fairy skateboarder" for her viral skating in a fairy costume, has become a symbol of joy and resilience in the skateboarding world. The sneaker mirrors her journey, featuring premium materials and intricate design details that embody the essence of skate culture while paying tribute to her achievements. The Nike SB Dunk Low Rayssa Leal combines functionality with flair, ensuring that it stands out in any crowd, much like Leal's awe-inspiring performances on the global stage. Released on March 20, 2024, for $125, the Nike SB Dunk Low Rayssa Leal quickly became a sought-after piece among both sneakerheads and skateboarding enthusiasts. Its release celebrates the legacy of the Nike SB Dunk's history in skate culture, intertwined with Rayssa Leal's inspiring story. This sneaker is a nod to the boundless potential and vibrant spirit of one of skateboarding's brightest stars.
Colorway: Pure Platinum/Deep Royal Blue/Vivid Purple/White/Gum Yellow

Display Name: On Running K-Tech 2 Kith White Real Teal
Description: The On Running K Tech 2 Kith White Real Teal delivers a brighter and more contrasted take on the silhouette, using a white base to create a clean foundation. Real teal accents introduce a fresh pop of color that highlights the structure and movement of the design without overwhelming it. This pair stands out because it offers a lighter and more expressive alternative within the collection. The contrast between white and teal keeps it visually engaging while still maintaining a refined feel. Fans appreciate how it brings energy to the collaboration while staying true to its performance roots. The On Running K Tech 2 Kith White Real Teal was released on March 6, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Model: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B
Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B Sequoia
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B Sequoia brings a refined, earth-toned palette to a skate icon. Dressed in Sequoia and Oil Green, this low-top pairs rugged overlays with a smooth base for layered depth and everyday versatility. Classic SB details shine through: a plush, padded tongue, supportive collar, and a responsive insole that helps soften hard landings while keeping board feel sharp. Underfoot, the grippy rubber outsole with pivot circles anchors every push, flick, and stop, while the cupsole construction offers dependable durability. Whether youre lining up a new line or elevating a casual fit, this colorways deep forest hues add a sophisticated edge that works from session to street. Thoughtful touches complete the design, from clean stitching around the Swoosh to tonal laces that keep the look cohesive. The balanced profile of the Nike SB Dunk Low Pro B delivers the comfort you want for long days, with secure lockdown and breathable materials that adapt to movement. Style code HJ0367-301 and the Sequoia/Sequoia/Oil Green colorway underscore its distinctive profile, while the 2025-07-29 release date marks it as a fresh chapter in the SB story. Versatile, skate-ready, and instantly wearable, its a staple for anyone who values form, function, and timeless style. Our team loves this product because it blends skate-focused cushioning and traction with a refined, wear-with-anything color scheme that looks as good on the board as it does off it.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black Panda (PS)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black PS features an entirely white leather upper with black overlays. The touches of black continue to the Swoosh branding, and the vintage basketball shoe is finished off with a padded collar and nylon mesh tongue, a white midsole, and a black outsole and treading. The Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black PS was released in March 2021 and originally retailed for $65.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 The Nightmare Before Christmas
Description: Step into a world where sneakers meet cinema with the Nike Book 1 The Nightmare Before Christmas. This unique collaboration brings Tim Burton's beloved holiday classic to life on your feet. The shoe features a pristine white base, accented with black and clay orange details that capture the essence of Jack Skellington's iconic suit. The intricate design elements pay homage to the film's characters and scenes, making these sneakers a must-have for both sneakerheads and movie enthusiasts alike. The Nike Book 1 silhouette provides the perfect canvas for this spooky yet stylish creation. With its performance-oriented design, these shoes offer both comfort and support for everyday wear. The attention to detail is evident in every aspect, from the carefully chosen color palette to the subtle nods to the film's imagery. Whether you're hitting the streets or showcasing your fandom, these sneakers are sure to turn heads and spark conversations. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those who want to make a bold statement while enjoying the comfort and quality synonymous with Nike footwear.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Palest Purple
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Palest Purple is an athletic sneaker designed in collaboration with Canadian rapper Drake. The Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Palest Purple Nike Air Force 1 Low is made with a leather upper in a light shade of Palest Purple. The upper is layered, with different panels forming different shoe parts. The toe box, as do the side panels, has perforations for increased airflow. A Nike Air logo is embroidered into the heel collar in silver, while a silver AF1 charm is seen on the bottom of the laces. The shoe is completely Palest Purple except for the midsole, a somewhat transparent white rubber with ÄúLove You ForeverÄù written in white cursive letters. What stands out about the sneaker is the cursive text on the midsole, which adds a nice, soft touch. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy Palest Purple was released on December 11, 2024, for $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Max LTD 3 Black Cool Grey White
Description: The Nike Air Max LTD 3 Black Cool Grey White sports a 3-tone colorway with a winterized fabric underlay for all-weather wearing. The mudguard of the Nike Air Max LTD 3 features leather overlays. Underneath it is a black fabric, which proceeds to a synthetic material on the eye stays. The signature deubred on the laces comes in black and has white swoosh. Different materials dress the quarter panels, starting with Cool Grey leather and embossed black "AIRMAX" branding. Above it is a crisp white patent leather swoosh laid atop a black surface. Topping the quarters are black and white plastic reinforcements in the eye stays. The shoe sits on a white midsole with a transparent Air Max unit on the heel and a black rubber outsole. What do our experts find outstanding in the Nike Air Max LTD 3 Black Cool Grey White? We like the branding on this shoe, especially the cool grey ridged rubber with a white swoosh on the tongue. The heel counter has a similar motif. Released on January 1st, 2019, for $120.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Independence Day
Description: The Nike P 6000 Independence Day blends retro running inspiration with patriotic color blocking. Dressed in Light Khaki and Pale Ivory with Thunder Blue, Cool Grey, and University Red accents, the upper showcases layered mesh and synthetic panels that echo early two thousands design. The cushioned midsole keeps it grounded in comfort. Independence Day themes often highlight red, white, and blue combinations, and this execution balances those elements with neutral khaki tones. The result feels festive without being overpowering. It stands as a summer ready take on a tech runner silhouette that continues to thrive in modern rotations. The Nike P 6000 Independence Day was released on July 17, 2025 with a retail price of $125.
Colorway: Light Khaki/Pale Ivory/Thunder Blue/Cool Grey/University Red

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Slip-On Birch Midnight
Description: In an elegant, understated colorway, the Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Slip-On Birch Midnight offers a lace-free version of Onitsuka Tigers most revered and renowned silhouette. This low-riding, easy-to-wear Slip-On Birch Midnight Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 builds upon a base of birch canvas that exudes vintage vibes. Tonal suede rings the toecap and forms the eyestays, the enhanced collar rim, the signature strips that cross over the heel, and the heel tab flap with black Tiger branding that matches branding on the birch canvas tongue. Black synthetic leather forms the recognizable stripes that run down and across the upper. Foam in black and birch forms the midsole that rests upon a birch rubber outsole patterned for both impact absorption and traction. What we find most delightful on this slip-on sneaker are the empty birch-colored eyelets, designed to highlight the lack of laces. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Slip-On Birch Midnight was released on May 14th, 2021, for a retail price of $130.
Material: Leather, Suede, Canvas, Synthetic, Rubber, Foam

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Swarovski Blue Force (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Swarovski Blue Force is a women's exclusive Holiday 2025 collaboration between Nike and Austrian crystal maker Swarovski, released December 4, 2026 at a retail price of $310 with style code IM7384-499 in the Blue Force/Blue Force/Blue Void/Metallic Silver colorway, confirmed by Nice Kicks, Sneaker Bar Detroit, and House of Heat. As confirmed by Sneaker Freaker and House of Heat, the Swarovski x Nike Pegasus Premium features a Blue Force-tinted breathable mesh and Blue Void mesh base reinforced with Blue Force taping across the entire upper, with the defining detail being the lateral Swoosh logo transformed from its standard semi-translucent finish into a surface encrusted with Swarovski crystals that refracts light with every stride. WWD confirmed the pair retails at $310, up from the standard Pegasus Premium pricing of $220, and includes a Swarovski-embossed dust bag as an accessory. Sneaker Bar Detroit confirmed glow-in-the-dark accents on the shoe add visibility alongside the crystallized Swoosh for a luxury-meets-performance aesthetic. The Pegasus Premium underneath the Swarovski treatment features the same triple stack of ZoomX foam, full-length sculpted Air Zoom unit, and ReactX cushioning as the standard model, maintaining the most responsive Pegasus ever built as the foundation. The Blue Force/Blue Void palette offers a deep ocean blue departure from the earth tones dominant in Fall 2025 releases. All sales final. Retail price $310. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Swarovski Blue Force is the December 4, 2025 IM7384-499 Swarovski-crystal-Swoosh glow-in-the-dark Blue-Force-taping Blue-Void-mesh ZoomX-Air-Zoom-ReactX-triple-stack luxury-dust-bag women's exclusive Pegasus Premium for the Nike and Swarovski collector who wants the most crystalized and most holiday-ready performance-running collaboration from the Swarovski x Nike Pegasus Premium program. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Swarovski Blue Force was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $310.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Light Carbon Monarch
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Light Carbon Monarch is a low-top sneaker featuring an all-suede fabrication. The upper features Light Carbon overlays on top of Monarchs deep orange base, accented by the Swoosh in Sesame. Nike branding adorns the tongue and heel tab, while the Summit White and Dark Stucco mid- and outsole combination complete the color palette. The Dunk Low is one of the American athletic wear brand Nikes most iconic and recognized styles, which was first introduced as a canvas for college sports team colors. The Dunk found fans in skateboarders, and it is now frequently released as part of Nike SB, Nikes skateboarding offshoot. The Light Carbon Monarch colorway is a limited edition release for the 2024 holiday season. Our experts feel that the best feature of this design is its all-suede upper, which coordinates well with its unique colorway. The Nike SB Dunk Low Light Carbon Monarch was released on October 3, 2024, and retailed for $115.

Display Name: Nike V2K Run Pink Foam Arctic Pink (Women's)
Description: The Nike V2K Run Pink Foam Arctic Pink (Womens) blends a retro runner vibe with modern comfort, delivering a look thats equal parts playful and polished. Dressed in layered Pink Foam/Arctic Pink tones, this pair nods to early-2000s style with breathable mesh, sculpted synthetic overlays, and a sleek, Y2K-inspired profile. A plush, responsive foam midsole softens every step, while the padded collar and tongue add a snug, supportive feel. Finished with a grippy rubber outsole for reliable traction, the silhouette transitions effortlessly from city strolls to weekend errands without missing a beat. Designed for daily rotation, the V2K Run shines as a versatile wardrobe anchor. The tonal pink palette elevates leggings, denim, and tailored athleisure alike, and the streamlined build keeps outfits feeling light and fresh. Practical touches, like durable materials and a stable, cushioned platform, provide lasting wear and comfort. Style ID HJ5269-600 and the 2025-04-24 release date make this colorway a standout for fans who appreciate modern performance cues wrapped in a nostalgic aesthetic. Our team loves this product because it pairs all-day cushioning with a vibrant, trend-right palette that instantly lifts any look.

Display Name: Nike Air Tech Challenge II Pixel Court (2025)
Description: The Nike Air Tech Challenge II Pixel Court 2025 revives one of Nikes most unapologetic tennis silhouettes with a colorway that feels energetic and rebellious in the best way. The Tech Challenge II has always carried attitude, and Pixel Court sharpens that edge through bright contrast and layered tones that highlight the shoes aggressive lines. It instantly calls back to an era when performance footwear was loud, expressive, and built around personality as much as function. Fans love this release because it represents Nike tennis at full confidence. The silhouette feels fearless, blending heritage design with a modern color story that still respects the shoes roots. Collectors appreciate how Pixel Court keeps the model bold rather than refined, staying true to the Tech Challenge identity. It is a sneaker that celebrates individuality, competition, and visual impact, making it feel just as relevant now as it did when tennis style broke free from tradition. The Nike Air Tech Challenge II Pixel Court 2025 was released on August 30, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Blazer Mid 77 Jumbo White Black
Description: The Nike Blazer Mid 77 Jumbo White Black is a remodeled edition of the classic Nike Blazer, which was styled in the 70s, a staple shoe in the 80s, and a classic in the 90s. Although it harnesses the old-school look of the original sneaker, this rethought sneaker features an elastic heel with large pull tabs. It also features oversized Nike swooshes on its sides, jumbo laces, raised herringbone pattern on the rubber outsole, a soft suede accent on the toe, and red stitching around its toe and heel. The Nike Blazer Mid 77 Jumbo White Black was released on 4th November 2021. During its release, this sneaker had a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Rift Leather Metallic Silver Sail (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Rift Leather Metallic Silver Sail Womens reimagines one of Nikes most unique silhouettes through a more elevated material choice. The split toe design remains the defining feature, while the Metallic Silver leather upper adds a sleek and slightly futuristic feel. Sail and black accents balance the shine, keeping the overall look wearable despite the bold material. This pair resonates with collectors who appreciate unconventional design. The Air Rift has always stood apart from traditional sneakers, and this version pushes it further into lifestyle territory. It is a piece that feels experimental yet intentional, appealing to those who want something different from standard footwear options. The Nike Air Rift Leather Metallic Silver Sail Womens was released on July 10, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Toro Bravo
Description: Stepping into 2023 with undeniable swagger, the Jordan 6 Retro made its fiery entrance with the Toro Bravo edition, released on May 24, 2023. This model features a bold blend of premium materials, proving once again why Jordan brand continues to lead the sneaker game. The upper is adorned with Varsity Red premium suede, giving it that stand-out Jordan style. The eye-catching red is contrasted perfectly with black accents throughout, from the midsole to the iconic Jumpman logo, ensuring a strong visual impact on and off the court. A translucent outsole anchors this design, complementing the vibrant upper and maintaining the timeless silhouette of the Jordan 6 Retro. Inside, you'll find a sockliner designed for comfort, making these sneakers as wearable as they are stylish. The Jordan 6 Retro Toro Bravo debuted on May 24, 2023, with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Flamingo Pink
Description: The adidas Harden Vol. 9 Flamingo Pink pushes expression to the forefront, delivering one of the most daring looks in James Hardens signature lineup. The flamingo pink palette feels confident and unconventional, reflecting Hardens comfort with standing out both on and off the court. The Vol. 9 silhouette provides a strong foundation, allowing the colorway to shine without overpowering the shoes performance driven shape. Collectors love this release because it embraces individuality without compromise. It feels playful yet serious, blending bold color with the technical presence Harden fans expect. The Flamingo Pink edition resonates with people who see sneakers as extensions of personality, appreciating how this pair turns confidence into design while staying true to Hardens fearless approach to the game. The adidas Harden Vol. 9 Flamingo Pink was released on September 13, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Obsidian Persian Violet
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 Obsidian Persian Violet represents the peak of Nikes running innovation, built with performance as the primary focus. The obsidian base keeps the look controlled, while Persian violet accents introduce a sharp and futuristic contrast. The sculpted sole and visible technology elements give it a distinctive and forward leaning profile. This model stands out because it is engineered for speed. Every element feels intentional, from the lightweight upper to the aggressive midsole design. Fans of performance footwear appreciate how it pushes boundaries while still maintaining a strong visual identity, making it as striking to look at as it is effective in motion. The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 Obsidian Persian Violet was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $295.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Drift Triple Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Drift Triple Black strips the silhouette down to pure attitude and form. Black covers the upper from heel to toe, allowing texture, paneling, and proportion to define the design rather than contrast. The Drift update adds a tougher and more utilitarian feel, giving the Air Max 90 a presence that feels grounded and purposeful while staying true to its roots. This pair resonates because triple black executions never fade from relevance. Fans value it as a dependable option that works across settings and styles, while collectors appreciate how the lack of color puts focus on the silhouette itself. It reinforces why the Air Max 90 remains a staple decades after its debut, proving that strong design holds up even when reduced to its most minimal expression. The Nike Air Max 90 Drift Triple Black was released on June 26, 2024 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mule Golf Chicago
Description: ?The Jordan 1 Mule Golf Chicago combines classic basketball design with golf-ready practicality. This slip-on model has a white leather upper, Varsity Red overlay, and a black Swoosh. It gives a unique blend of style and usefulness to the course.? The Chicago Mule Golf by Jordan gives us a laceless, low-cut design with a partially open heel that's easy to wear. Its upper combines perforated white leather, Varsity Red accents, and a black Swoosh. The outsole features a red rubber construction with a spike-less traction pattern that suits the game. This model with a perforated toe cap adapts the original 1985 Air Jordan 1 for modern golf use.? As experts, we enjoy the Jordan 1 Mule Golf Chicago's memory foam footbed for cushioning during extended wear and synthetic leather gusseted tongue for easy access and comfort around the ankle. This model retailed at $110 upon its release on January 17, 2025.?

Display Name: Converse Chuck 70 Low Isabel Marant Vanilla Ice Red
Description: The Converse Chuck 70 Low Isabel Marant Vanilla Ice Red blends classic sneaker heritage with a more fashion driven perspective through its collaboration with Isabel Marant. The vanilla ice upper keeps the look soft and neutral, while red and black accents introduce contrast that highlights the silhouettes structure. The Chuck 70 build adds a slightly more refined feel compared to standard versions, maintaining its vintage inspired construction. This release stands out for how it merges Converses timeless design with Marants understated approach to style. The result feels elevated without losing the casual appeal that defines the Chuck 70. Fans of both brands appreciate the balance between heritage and subtle updates, making it a versatile option that carries both fashion and cultural relevance. The Converse Chuck 70 Low Isabel Marant Vanilla Ice Red was released on June 5, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid White Rust Pink Black
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid White Rust Pink Black delivers balanced contrast through a White base accented by Rust Pink overlays and sharp Black detailing. The warm pink tone adds depth and personality, while the black elements define the silhouettes edges. The mid cut construction preserves the iconic AJ1 proportions that continue to shape sneaker culture. This colorway resonates because it blends softness and edge in equal measure. The rust pink adds warmth without overwhelming the clean white foundation, making the shoe expressive yet versatile. Fans appreciate when Jordan Brand experiments with nuanced shades that feel fresh while respecting heritage lines. It is a thoughtful update that keeps the model grounded in tradition with a modern twist. The Air Jordan 1 Mid White Rust Pink Black was released on April 20, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 NRG Bacon (2021)
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Bacon is still one of the most highly sought-after Air Max runners of all time. So much so that Nike brought back the 2004 design to celebrate Air Max Day in 2021. It is not often that Nike retros collaborations, while most rarely resurface. But with its continuously growing fan base and pleas from Air Max fans to revive the 16-year-old colorway, Nike brought back the sneaker in its OG form. The Nike Air Max 90 Bacon returns with all of the design qualities from the 2004 collaboration with Daves Quality Meats creator, David Ortiz. Mimicking the different shades of colors that appear from raw bacon, the sneaker is composed of various shades of brown, red, pink, and off-white. With a combination of suede, tumbled leather, and mesh, this Air Max 90 brings a luxe feel to the traditional 1990 model. The Nike Air Max 90 Bacon released in March of 2021 for $140.

Display Name: Saucony Endorphin Pro 5 Minted NY
Description: The Saucony Endorphin Pro 5 Minted NY is the third collaborative release between New York-based running and lifestyle brand Minted NY and Saucony, and the first time the partnership has worked on Saucony's elite race-day super shoe, bringing Minted's distinctly aesthetic-forward design approach to the most technically advanced running shoe in the Saucony lineup. Minted NY, founded in 2021 by brothers Marcus and Shawn Milione during the pandemic running boom that saw a new generation of runners build communities and brands around the sport, developed into one of the most credible and most design-conscious names in the running space through a build-in-public brand philosophy and a series of collaborations that understood both performance and cultural relevance simultaneously. The Endorphin Pro 5 itself is Saucony's premier marathon race-day shoe, featuring PWRRUN PB and PWRRUN HG dual-density cushioning, a full carbon fiber plate redesigned from version 4's spoon shape to a fork configuration for improved flex and propulsion, a PWRTRAC rubber outsole for grip, and a zig-zag mesh upper for enhanced ventilation and contained fit. Minted NY's contribution to the Pro 5 is conceptually specific and visually arresting: the shoe is covered from toe to heel in a chrome silver finish inspired by the mylar thermal blankets that marathon organizers give to finishers after long-distance races to prevent hypothermia, a material so associated with the post-race moment of physical and emotional exhaustion and relief that coating the shoe in chrome silver transforms the Pro 5 into a wearable tribute to the marathon finish line. The Minted blue accent beneath the lateral collar provides the only color break in the tonal silver execution, connecting the collab to Minted's signature blue identity established through the Endorphin Speed 4 collaboration. Metallic silver laces come with additional white and blue options. The shoe released in a custom drawer-style shoebox at $250 in unisex sizing from 3.5 to 14, dropping first at a Saucony Covent Garden London pop-up on May 16, online through Minted NY on May 19, and globally through Saucony on May 21, 2026. Style code S31064-2126. The Saucony Endorphin Pro 5 Minted NY is the Mylar-chrome super shoe collaboration for the runner and collector who wants Saucony's elite carbon-plated race-day platform in the most conceptually specific and most visually distinctive finish the Minted NY x Saucony program has produced. The Saucony Endorphin Pro 5 Minted NY was released on May 21, 2026 with a retail price of $250.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (PS) (2025)
Description: The Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (PS) (2025), in preschool sizes, is a basketball sneaker, with a low top, featuring a Black mesh fabric upper. The Air Jordan 11 debuted from American sneaker brand Nike in 1995, designed by Tinker Hatfield, two years before Jordan becoming its own brand, and the 11 is a favorite of designer Hatfield himself. The Bred colorway speaks to the styles heritage as a signature shoe designed for Michael Jordan during his time playing for the NBAs Chicago Bulls. At the Bred (PS) (2025) Jordan 11 Retro Low, the upper is encased in a Black patent overlay with a wavy silhouette that meets the sole treatment. The White midsole continues the wavy shape, meeting a Varsity Red tread outsole. The Jumpman logo on the tongue and rear heel in Varsity Red provides strategic branded accents. In our opinion, the best feature of the 11 Retro Low is its Varsity Red sole, which gives a bold pop of color. The Jordan 11 Retro Low Bred (PS) (2025) was released on April 26, 2025, and retailed at $80.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Rainy Day Black White
Description: The Salomon XT 6 Rainy Day Black White brings a weather inspired palette to one of Salomons most recognizable trail silhouettes, combining grey tones with black and white accents for a balanced and technical look. The layered construction highlights the shoes performance driven design while keeping it visually cohesive. This pair stands out because it blends outdoor functionality with everyday wearability. The XT 6 has become a staple beyond the trail, and this colorway reinforces that versatility. Fans appreciate how it delivers both durability and a clean aesthetic. The Salomon XT 6 Rainy Day Black White was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Model: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson 23 OG Sole Canvas Low
Display Name: Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson 23 OG Sole Canvas Low Black
Description: The Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson 23 OG Sole Canvas Low Black takes a traditional lifestyle sneaker and infuses it with a warped sense of iconic style that will turn heads everywhere you go. This classic Low-Top is constructed from black canvas and sports white deco stitching across the upper, at the collar, eye stays, heel, and midfoot. A sturdy white rubber toe cap surrounded by black foxing adds extra support and protection, and it matches the flat white laces that thread through the silver metal eyelids. MMY branding graces the tongue tag as well as the tonal license plate on the bumper. The black rubber outsole features a crosshatch diamond pattern of grooves that provides impact absorption, flexibility, and traction. The stand-out feature of this sneaker is its chunky, bumpy, undulating white platform foam midsole that designer Mihara created by first molding it out of clay. The Maison Mihara Yasuhiro Peterson 23 OG Sole Canvas Low Black was released on August 1, 2023, for a retail price of $315.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Year of the Horse (2026)
Description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Year of the Horse (2026) brings symbolic storytelling to one of Kobe Bryants most celebrated silhouettes. Featuring a vibrant mix of light crimson, vivid blue, and bright citron, this colorway draws inspiration from the Chinese zodiac, where the horse represents strength, speed, and perseverance. The bold palette gives the low-profile design a dynamic, energetic look that feels both expressive and intentional. Year of the Horse releases have long held a special place in sneaker culture, often arriving with thoughtful color choices and cultural significance. This edition continues that tradition, using contrast and movement to reflect the spirit of the theme rather than relying on overt graphics. The Kobe 8s sleek shape allows the colors to take center stage, resulting in a sneaker that feels fast, fluid, and visually striking. When the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Year of the Horse (2026) released, it retailed for $180 and dropped on January 31, 2026. With its meaningful inspiration and bold execution, this pair stands out as a memorable entry in the Kobe Protro lineup.

Display Name: UGG Tazz Love '26 Slipper Sea Salt Rosetta (Women's)
Description: The UGG Tazz Love 26 Slipper Sea Salt Rosetta Womens introduces soft contrast to the platform slipper lineup. Featuring Sea Salt and Rosetta tones, the upper blends gentle neutral shades with a playful twist. The raised sole keeps the silhouette modern while preserving UGGs signature plush feel. This edition feels light and expressive, with pastel inspired hues that add subtle personality. The Love 26 detailing enhances its uniqueness within the Tazz range. It stands as a cozy yet statement ready option, perfect for relaxed styling with a hint of charm. The UGG Tazz Love 26 Slipper Sea Salt Rosetta Womens was released on January 22, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Venice Beach (2024) (GS)
Description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Venice Beach (2024) (GS) is a sneaker for grade schoolers, with a design was inspired by the graffiti of Venice Beach. This iteration of the Nike Kobe 8 Protro features a flexible and breathable mesh upper with a gray base. The upper has a tie-dye effect, featuring bright colors like orange, red, yellow, green, and blue. The Nike Swoosh appears across the outside midsole in gray outlined in yellow, and you can find it once again in yellow under the ankle on the inner side. Blue supports line the heel and run under the forefoot. Kobes signature can be found in orange on the lateral heel. On the thin tongue, you will find Kobes yellow and gray logo outlined in black. Our favorite feature of this shoe is the bold color scheme. The combination of these bright colors makes the shoe perfect for summer. The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Venice Beach (2024) (GS) was released on April 13, 2024, for a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low EMB NBA 75th Anniversary Chicago (GS)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low EMB NBA 75th Anniversary Chicago GS shoe commemorates the 75th anniversary of the National Basketball Association with a Chicago Bulls inspired colorway. The Nike Dunk Low EMB NBA 75th Anniversary Chicago GS features a velvety and supple leather construction. The shoe offers a base of white with black and chile red overlays that make these shoes pop when you wear them. Another nice feature added to these shoes are the diamond-etched lace dubraes that are sure to make a statement. These great shoes had their release in October of 2021 and have a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro University Blue Gum
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro University Blue Gum is a low-top skateboarding shoe made with a mix of leather and suede materials. This iteration of the Nike SB Dunk Low Pro is built with a University Blue color dominating the upper. The base of the toe box, sides, and ankle is suede, while the overlays are leather. The Nike swoosh that crosses each side appears in white, while the blue heel collar also contains white embroidered Nike branding. The tongue features Nike SB branding with a bright orange swoosh Äì the only deviation from the blue and white colorway. A white midsole and gum rubber outsole round out the look. What we think is the standout feature of this shoe is the orange branding on the tongue, which adds a welcome pop of color. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro University Blue Gum was released for $115.
Colorway: University Blue/Sail/University Blue/Psychic Blue/Gum Light Brown/Safety Orange

Display Name: adidas Adistar Control 5 Disney Pixar's Toy Story Buzz Lightyear
Description: The Adidas Adistar Control 5 Disney Pixar's Toy Story Buzz Lightyear in Footwear White, Solar Slime, and Silver Metallic is a collaborative running and training shoe that brings one of the most beloved animated characters in cinema history into direct conversation with Adidas's performance footwear engineering, translating Buzz Lightyear's iconic space ranger aesthetic into a colorway and material language that feels genuinely connected to the character's visual identity rather than simply slapping a logo onto an existing silhouette. Footwear white provides the clean and authoritative base that mirrors Buzz's suit construction, solar slime introduces the bright and slightly alien green that appears across the character's chest display and wing detailing, and silver metallic brings the space age material associations of a toy designed to look like genuine intergalactic equipment into a real world footwear context that works both as a performance shoe and as a piece of pop culture wearable art. The Adistar Control 5 platform provides the actual athletic foundation for all of this collaborative storytelling, featuring Adidas's control and stability focused cushioning and construction that makes this a shoe that can be worn for genuine training activity rather than existing purely as a display piece. Adidas has a long and celebrated history of collaborating with Disney and Pixar properties in ways that honor the source material with genuine design research and color intelligence rather than simply licensing imagery for superficial graphic application, and the Buzz Lightyear Adistar Control 5 continues that tradition by finding the colorway and material story within Buzz's actual visual design rather than defaulting to a simple character print overlay. Toy Story occupies a specific and emotionally resonant place in the cultural biography of an entire generation of adults who grew up with the franchise and who now have the purchasing power and the nostalgia driven motivation to own collaborative products that connect their present adult lives to their childhood emotional landscape. The solar slime and silver metallic combination against footwear white creates a shoe that reads as a Buzz Lightyear tribute to anyone who has ever seen the film, which is effectively everyone, making this one of the most universally recognizable collaborative colorways in the Adistar Control 5 catalog. The Adidas Adistar Control 5 Disney Pixar's Toy Story Buzz Lightyear was released on June 6, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple White
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple White 2020 takes on a 1990 original design, and is covered in an all-white finish. ? ?The sneaker is constructed of white TPU eyelets, a mesh upper with stitched leather overlays, a waffle-tread rubber outsole for traction and an Air-infused midsole for cushioning. Further, it displays Air Max units on both medial sides with a padded tongue panel printed with a Nike Swoosh emblem. Additionally, this Air Max Triple version has printed Nike branding on its heel. ? ?The Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple White 2020 debuted on July 28th, 2020, and retailed at $130.

Display Name: Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Black Yellow
Description: The Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Black University Gold is a collaboration between Nike and Drakes NOCTA sublevel. The Nike Hot Step Air Terra has pebbled black leather uppers marked with reflective 3M hits on the side panels and down the tongues. The shoe has contrasting bright accents in the form of mini Swooshes at the lateral heel regions and NOCTA markings on the rears and the tongues. The sneaker has black rope laces, sculpted sole units with large Air units, specially printed insoles, and G-TEK traction rubber outsoles. The Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Black University Gold was released on September 16, 2022, with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Lil Yachty Concrete Boys It's Us
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Lil Yachty Concrete Boys It's Us updates the Air Force 1 Lows familiar silhouette with details inspired by American rapper Lil Yachtys Concrete Boys collective. The all-white base of the Lil Yachty Concrete Boys It's Us version of the Air Force 1 Low serves as an ideal backdrop for Concrete Boys branding. The collectives logoa stickman wielding a sledgehammeris embroidered on the outer side panel in Midnight Navy thread.
