The heel tab displays additional Concrete Boys branding, including construction equipment, "CONCRETE BOYS" lettering, and another stickman. The tongues logo tag showcases a Swoosh and the words "ITS US," a reference to the collectives 2024 compilation titled "It's Us, Vol. 1." Our experts at StockX like that the collar lining and the rubber outsole come in Midnight Navy because the dark hue sets off the all-white upper. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Lil Yachty Concrete Boys It's Us was released on December 2, 2024, and sold for $130.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Preloved Purple
Description: The adidas AE 1 Preloved Purple redefines street-inspired footwear with a bold purple aesthetic. This shoe's unique color-blocking and premium materials highlight how innovative adidas is as a fitness and lifestyle brand. These kicks give you an ideal blend of performance and fashion. The Preloved Purple AE 1 by adidas features a soft suede upper in black, with a rich purple-tone rubber outsole that almost covers the whole shoe, paired with contrasting white overlays for added depth. Adidas branding on the tongue and heel complements the color and style. These shoes were designed with versatility in mind and aim to bridge the gap between fashionable footwear and the athletic heritage of the German company´s shoes. One thing we, the experts, love about the adidas AE 1 Preloved Purple is its semi-translucent, purple outsole, which adds elegant visual detail. Another standout feature is the suede upper. It retailed at $120 when it was released on 5th October 2024.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Muscle 95 Yu-Gi-Oh! Joey (with Promo Card)
Description: Nike Air Max Muscle 95 Yu Gi Oh Psychic Blue fuses early two thousands running aesthetics with anime inspired energy, creating a sneaker that feels expressive and nostalgic all at once. The Air Max Muscle 95s aggressive lines and layered construction provide the perfect canvas for a Yu Gi Oh inspired color story that leans into Psychic Blue tones and dramatic contrast. It feels animated and powerful, mirroring the intensity of the series that influenced it. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it blends two worlds that share a love for bold visuals and storytelling. The design feels alive, celebrating maximalism and character through color and form. It stands as a reminder of how sneakers can act as cultural crossovers, pulling inspiration from unexpected places while still feeling cohesive and intentional. The Nike Air Max Muscle 95 Yu Gi Oh Psychic Blue was released on 09/12/2025 with a retail price of $210

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Bright Ceramic
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Bright Ceramic brings a sharper and more contrast driven approach to the silhouette, pairing a black base with bright ceramic accents that immediately draw attention. The gradient upper remains a defining feature, transitioning through darker tones while allowing the orange hits to stand out. The Big Bubble update reinforces the models identity while adding a modern twist. What makes this pair stand out is its balance between classic structure and bold color. The black foundation keeps it grounded, while the ceramic accents inject energy into the design. Nike continues to revisit the Air Max 95 with thoughtful updates, and this release reflects that approach clearly. It is a strong option for those who appreciate contrast driven colorways with a heritage feel. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Bright Ceramic was released on January 5, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Teddy Santis Vintage Rose
Description: The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Teddy Santis Vintage Rose continues the evolution of one of the brands most respected lines, blending heritage running design with Teddy Santis refined color direction. The vintage rose tone softens the silhouette, while sea salt accents add balance and contrast that keep the look grounded. The 990v6 introduces a more streamlined shape compared to earlier versions, giving it a modern feel without losing its legacy. Fans of the MiUSA line appreciate how this release maintains the craftsmanship and consistency the series is known for while introducing fresh color palettes. The vintage rose stands out without feeling overpowering, making it versatile across different styles. It is a sneaker that reflects New Balances ability to evolve a classic while staying true to its identity, offering something that feels both familiar and updated. The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Teddy Santis Vintage Rose was released on June 27, 2024 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Obsidian Lilac Bloom
Description: A bold and timeless lifestyle sneaker with the Nike Air Max 1 Obsidian Lilac Bloom. These fashionable sneakers are inspired by legacy running shoe styles and combine modern elegance with heritage design. These Nike Airs throwback to old-school running shapes whilst presenting as a trendy lifestyle shoe. Made with a mesh base, they are breathable and comfortable. The colorways are suede and pop against the white base in grey, black, and lilac. The midsoles are translucent, showing off the cushioned air units, and the rubber waffle outsoles creep onto the toe cap for extra traction. The Nike Swoosh is in lilac on both sides and the tongue as part of the full Nike logo. The laces are black and stand out in strong contrast against the grey. These stylish shoes are great for completing any casual look, and the color palette makes them the perfect unisex shoe, and we like that. The Nike Air Max 1 Obsidian Lilac Bloom sneakers were released on 5 February 2024, priced at $140.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro UNC (2020)
Description: Jordan Brand pays homage to MJs college career with the Jordan 3 Retro UNC (2020), now available on StockX. This colorway was originally created as a Player Exclusive for athletes at the University of North Carolina. After much anticipation, Jordan decided to make this release available to the public, only this time replacing the embroidered UNC logo on the tongue with their signature Jumpman logo. This Jordan 3 is comprised of a white tumbled leather upper with grey elephant print mudguards and valor blue detailing. A white rubber heel tab, visible Air unit, and grey outsole completes this design. These sneakers released in March of 2020 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Panda
Description: The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Panda reimagines an iconic basketball shoe into cleats meant for football players. The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat is a men's shoe where the TD stands not for toddler, but for "touchdown." The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat in a white and black "Panda" colorway features an upper of white tumbled leather with toebox perforations and black tumbled leather overlays. The side panel Nike Swoosh, collar, and eyestays are also tumbled black leather. The tongue is white with a black patch that features a white Jumpman logo. The laces, sock liner, and insole are also black. What our experts appreciate most about this shoe is the gridiron construction of the outsole, with the studs placed wide apart for flexibility and traction on the football field. The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Panda was released on June 7, 2023, for a retail price of $140.

Display Name: MSCHF Gobstomper Graylag Goose Edition
Description: Bold, playful, and built to evolve with every step, the MSCHF Gobstomper Graylag Goose Edition turns everyday wear into an art project. Inspired by the legendary multi-layer candy, this skate-influenced silhouette hides contrasting hues beneath its Grey/White upper, revealing fresh tones as the shoe naturally scuffs and breaks in over time. The chunky profile, padded tongue, and cushioned collar deliver that unmistakable MSCHF look, while the layered midsole and sturdy rubber cupsole provide grip and durability for daily rotations. Finished with thoughtful detailing and the model code MSCHF009-GG, this head-turning pair brings a dynamic twist to minimal shades, transforming the color story with each session on the pavement. Engineered for comfort and staying power, the Gobstomper blends premium materials with practical design cues. A plush footbed softens impact, breathable linings keep things comfortable, and reinforced overlays add structure where it matters most. The Grey/White colorway feels clean and versatile, pairing easily with denim, cargos, or tailored streetwear while still delivering the experimental flair MSCHF is known for. Launched on May 18, 2023, this edition captures the brands playful approach to design, made to be worn hard, revealed slowly, and styled your way. Our team loves this product because it mixes skate-ready comfort with a clever wear-away concept that keeps your sneakers getting better, not older, with time.

Model: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB
Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Wolf Grey
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Wolf Grey leans into clean minimalism with a cool Wolf Grey and White combination. The engineered mesh upper highlights the silhouette intricate paneling, while the Protro tooling delivers updated comfort and responsiveness. The low cut build maintains that close to court feel Kobe preferred. Wolf Grey gives the Kobe 9 a refined and versatile presence, allowing the design lines to stand out without distraction. Team Bank editions like this focus on performance first, but the understated palette makes it easy to integrate into everyday rotation as well. For purists who appreciate neutral tones with strong heritage backing, this pair delivers understated confidence. The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Wolf Grey was released on October 17, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Model: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro ISO
Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro ISO Orange Label Court Purple
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro ISO Orange Label Court Purple retains the iconic Dunk Low silhouette, characterized by its low-top design in a color scheme that pays homage to the Los Angeles Lakers, with the incorporation of Court Purple overlays and a subtly toned sole. The Orange Label Court Purple Nike SB Dunk Low Pro ISO comes in the Court Purple shade complemented by a white and gum light brown color palette. The shoe incorporates the customary white leather base, mesh tongues, linings, laces, and midsole. Suede overlays in Court Purple accentuate the design, while the orange label is prominently featured on the tongue, insole, and lace tips branding. The shoe is completed with a gum rubber outsole to add the finishing touch to the overall aesthetic. What our experts love about the Nike SB Dunk Low Pro ISO Orange Label Court Purple is its bold and distinctive colorway. The combination of Court Purple, white, and gum creates a visually captivating sneaker that serves as a fashion statement. The sneaker debuted for $110 on August 23rd, 2023.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Black White
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Black White (2023) gives the AF 1 Low a stealthy makeover with a black base and branding details in white. At the Black White (2023) Nike Air Force 1 Low '07, The leather upper, midsole, outsole, laces, and lining come in black, while the branding on the tongue and the heel tab features white. The leather heel tab showcases NIKE AIR and a Swoosh, while the tongue displays NIKE AIR FORCE 1 and the insole reveals NIKE. In addition, the classic leather Swoosh also comes in bright white. Perforations on the toebox and the side panels allow the foot to breathe, while the laces provide a secure front closure. Our experts at StockX like the encapsulated Air unit in the heel because its a heritage design element and provides responsive cushioning. The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Black White (2023) was released on September 18, 2023, and sold for $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Multi-Pixel
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Multi Pixel pushes the trusted Pegasus lineage into a more expressive digital inspired direction. Multi Color graphics ripple across the upper, accented by hits of Volt and flashes of Metallic Gold and Metallic Silver. The sculpted midsole keeps the performance focus intact while the upper steals the spotlight. Pegasus has long been known as a dependable daily trainer, and the Premium Multi Pixel edition adds personality without sacrificing function. The vibrant mix of tones gives it a high energy feel that stands out on the road. For runners who want reliable cushioning paired with bold design, this version delivers a striking balance between innovation and expression. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Multi Pixel was released on October 30, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big Bubble Air Max Day (2024)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big Bubble Air Max Day (2024) is a special-edition sneaker that was released to celebrate Air Max Day. The sneaker boasts a white mesh construction with suede overlays in Royal Blue and Sail. Unlike other Nike Air Max 1 models released as part of Air Max Day, the "Big Bubble Air Max Day" iteration features a Volt midsole that catches the eye. The tongues inner lining also showcases a panel of Volt synthetic material. The oversized window in the heel displays visible Air Max units and four circular cut outs. Something our StockX experts like is the 3.26 on the tongues logo tag. It represents the date of Air Max Day and comes in chunky Blue Volt letters. The Nike Air Max 1 '86 OG Big Bubble Air Max Day (2024) was launched on March 26th, 2024, and sold for $150.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Black Dark Concord
Description: Jordan Brand continued their hot streak of Jordan 12 releases in 2020 by enlisting a new colorway with the Jordan 12 Dark Concord, now available on StockX. As part of Jumpmans Holiday 2020 release line up, the Dark Concord 12 added the brands renowned Concord purple colorway to the luxe design of the Jordan 12. The Jordan 12 Dark Concord comes dressed in all black with Concord purple metallic detailing found on the forefoot, lace holders, and heel tab. Purple Jumpman embroidery on the tongue and a black outsole with carbon fiber inserts complete this upgraded iteration of the 1997 classic. The Jordan 12 Dark Concord released in October of 2020 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy White Cobalt Tint
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy White Cobalt Tint blends signature minimalism with subtle personality. A white leather upper keeps the base crisp and classic, while Cobalt Tint accents introduce a cool pop of color. Metallic Silver detailing adds a refined highlight, complementing the clean lines of the silhouette. The collaboration carries a focused and polished feel that aligns with NOCTAs understated design language. Fans of both Drake and the Air Force 1 appreciate how this release stays restrained while still distinct. The white foundation makes it highly wearable, while the blue and silver touches give it identity. It captures a modern take on a legendary model, rooted in cultural influence and contemporary style. This pair feels deliberate, clean, and built with lasting appeal. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy White Cobalt Tint was released on February 19, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 270 Black White (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 270 Black White (W) comes in a black and anthracite-white color scheme. The Nike Air Max 270 Black White for women features an upper comprised of mesh and synthetic materials, making it lightweight and breathable. The shoe's heel is cushioned and stabilized with a full-length Max Air unit. The foam in the midsole is responsive and makes for a nice, snug fit. The grip and sturdiness of the shoe are provided by the rubber outsole. The sneaker features a pull button on the back for easy on-and-off. The shoe's collar and tongue are cushioned for enhanced comfort. The shoe features a Nike Swoosh on either side. The Nike Air Max 270 Black White (W) was released on March 22, 2018, and retailed for $150.

Display Name: Nike NOCTA Glide Drake White Chrome
Description: The Nike NOCTA Glide Drake White Chrome is an all-white version of the Nike NOCTA Glide, a collaboration between Nike and Canadian rapper Drake. The sneaker finds inspiration in the Nike Zoom Flight 95 but incorporates mesh instead of premium leather on the upper. Like other iterations of the NOCTA Glide, the "White Chrome" model comes with bubble-like chrome detailing on the bulky, foam midsole and 3M reflective piping. A Zoom Air unit in the forefoot complements the Phylon midsole and adds extra cushioning. The midfoot overlay is made of a breathable woven textile and features a small Swoosh. In addition, NOCTA branding can be found on the padded tongue and debossed on the chrome details on the heel. Something our experts love is the triple-branded insole, which features logos from Nike, NOCTA, and G-Tek. The Nike NOCTA Glide Drake White Chrome was released on October 27, 2023, and retailed at $160.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Panda-Monium Green Curry Multi-Color
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Panda Monium Green Curry Multi Color flips the classic black and white formula into something far more chaotic and expressive. Green Curry, Luminous Green, Bright Mango, and Burnt Red collide across the upper, turning the traditionally simple Dunk layout into a canvas of bold contrast. The low profile and classic cupsole remain untouched, grounding the wild palette in familiar structure. This is the kind of Dunk that feels built for collectors who are tired of safe colorways. The vibrant mix of tones gives it a playful and almost rebellious personality, while the layered panels keep the look cohesive. It captures the current era of the Dunk where experimentation and loud storytelling have become just as important as heritage. The Nike Dunk Low Panda Monium Green Curry Multi Color was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 CLOT Kiss of Death (2021)
Description: Nike and long-time collaborator, CLOT, reissued their Nike Air Max 1 CLOT Kiss Of Death in 2021. The sneaker debuted in 2006 and now the original pair is reselling for over $1,000 on StockX. Bringing back the collab in its original design answers the prayers of many Air Max fans that were unable to get their hands on the pair 15 years ago and in the years since. For CLOT founder, Edison Chen, the sole mission of his work with Nike is to bridge Eastern and Western cultures through design and storytelling based on Chinese traditions. The Nike Air Max 1 CLOT Kiss Of Death fulfills this mission by mixing Nikes innovative designs with Chinese philosophies on medicine, specifically foot pressure points. The upper is composed of translucent materials, making feet the focal point. Following the translucent theme, the shoe also features an icy-blue outsole with a printed diagram showing the pressure points on the foot. The shoe also incorporates some luxe details, such as faux snakeskin on the Swoosh and ostrich texture on the collar. The Nike Air Max 1 CLOT Kiss Of Death released in March of 2021 for $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Tech Challenge II Stone Blue (2025)
Description: The Nike Air Tech Challenge II Stone Blue (2025) revives a legendary court silhouette with a refined palette and modern comfort. Dressed in Sail, Stone Blue, Football Grey, Pure Platinum, and Coconut Milk with a pop of Tart, this colorway brings depth and contrast to the shoes angular panels and sculpted midsole. The mid-top profile, padded collar, and supportive overlays nod to classic tennis DNA while offering everyday versatility for streetwear. Perforations at the toe box and quarter help with breathability, and the distinctive heel shape delivers that unmistakable Air Tech Challenge II stance that turned heads in the early 90s. Style code FZ9033-101 and a release date of June 27, 2025, make this pair a standout for collectors and fans of heritage Nike sneakers. Underfoot, responsive cushioning and a durable rubber outsole provide the stability and smooth ride the Air Tech Challenge II is known for, making it as wearable as it is collectible. The layered upper highlights the Stone Blue accents against creamy neutrals, creating an elevated look that pairs effortlessly with denim, athletic staples, and tailored casual fits. Subtle textural shifts between leather-like finishes and crisp synthetics give the shoe a premium feel, while the iconic paneling and Swoosh placement ensure instant recognition. Whether youre revisiting a favorite era or discovering this model for the first time, the Nike Air Tech Challenge II Stone Blue (2025) blends vintage energy with modern styling for a go-to sneaker in any rotation. Our team thinks this product is great for anyone who wants a heritage Nike icon with versatile colors, reliable cushioning, and standout design details that elevate everyday wear.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 White Black Neutral Grey (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 White Black Neutral Gray (Women's) features the Air Max 1s timeless design and signature visible Air Max units beneath the heel. Originally designed for performance running, the Nike Air Max 1 White Black Neutral Gray (Women's) boasts a simplistic colorway of white, Summit White, and black. The wavy, black leather mudguard and Swoosh logo stand out against the white mesh upper and the Summit White overlays. Branding details can be found across the sneaker, including NIKE AIR embroidered on the heel counter in black thread, NIKE AIR printed on the insole, and NIKE AIR MAX stitched on the woven logo tag. Finally, flex grooves in the outsole offer flexible traction in high-wear areas. Our experts appreciate the choice of white cotton laces instead of black because they allow the Swoosh and the mudguard to stand out. The womens size Nike Air Max 1 White Black Neutral Gray (Women's) was made available on October 5, 2023, and was priced at $140.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Safari
Description: The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Safari adds sand-colored hues to the rugged Salomon silhouette. Originally designed as a trail running shoe, this sneaker has evolved to meet the needs of urban environments. Released to celebrate the XT-6 GTXs 10th anniversary, the Safari Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex features a waterproof membrane and an anti-debris mesh construction. Although the colorway is subtle, the tongue tag has a bright, multicolor design with hits of yellow, red, and blue. The Quicklace system allows for fast adjustments of the no-slip laces by squeezing the "S" button on the buckle. Another technical feature is the Agile Chassis midsole, which provides dual-density foam cushioning and absorbs impact. Finally, the Contagrip rubber outsole houses lugs that provide traction on rough terrains. Our experts at StockX like the bold branding in black letters, including "SALOMON," "GORE-TEX," and "XT6." The Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Safari was released on January 27, 2024, and sold for $200.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Darth Maul
Description: More than a few Star Wars-inspired sneakers have been released over the years. Although the Nike Air VaporMax Plus Darth Maul wasn't officially endorsed by the iconic movie series, it did have clear ties to it. This Nike Air VaporMax Plus drew inspiration from the Darth Maul character that was first introduced in 1999's 'Star Wars: Episode I  The Phantom Menace.' It had a black and red upper that was designed to look just like Darth Maul due in large part to the sneaker's cage overlays. It also contained translucent Air Max bubbles on the bottom that gave the upper the room it needed to breathe. Our experts all agree that the gradient colors used to create this sneaker were what really made it extra special. These colors enabled Darth Maul's presence to be felt from the front to the back of the shoe. The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Darth Maul was released on November 2, 2022, and retailed for $210.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Midnight (GS)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 White Midnight (GS) is a stability running shoe that draws inspiration from the Gel-Kayano series, in particular the Gel-Kayano 14, and the ninth iteration of the GEL-1000 series. Originally introduced in 2008, the White Midnight (GS) ASICS Gel-1130 features white mesh underlays that provide breathability and create an airy feel. While previous models used genuine leather to create the supportive overlays, this version replaces genuine leather with faux leather. This materials upgrade gives the sneaker a modern look while paying tribute to archived design details. In addition, the sneaker boasts GEL technology in the heel for shock absorption and a TRUSSTIC support system for improved stability. Our experts at StockX like the Midnight details on the rubber outsole, collar lining, and overlays, which break up the sneakers primarily white and silver aesthetic. The grade school-sized ASICS Gel-1130 White Midnight (GS) was released on March 3, 2024, and retailed at $85.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Golf White Aegean Storm
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Golf White Aegean Storm is a low-top golf shoe that pulls inspiration from a legendary sneaker which makes it an instant hit on the golf course. This iteration presents in an armory navy, aegean storm and white color combination. Play the course all day with this Jordan 1 Low inspired golf shoe that boasts encapsulated Air in the heel. The leather upper features classic color blocking usually seen on Jordan 1 Lows. With a white base, a cool aegean storm color dresses the toe, eyelet and heel panels. The darker armory navy color provides the right amount of darkness on the Swoosh, lining, tongue and the outsole. The iconic Wings logo is on the heel while Jumpman logos are on the tongue and insole, both boasting the addition of the word GOLF below them. The fact that the outsole has been modified for golf is a unique element of design and, in our opinion, elevates this Jordan 1 Low Golf White Aegean Storm above the rest. This golf shoe debuted on July 1, 2024, with a recommended retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low EMB NBA 75th Anniversary Chicago
Description: In celebration of the 75th Anniversary of the NBA, Nike teamed up with the NBA to release a Chicago Bulls-themed Nike Dunk Low. The Nike Dunk Low EMB 75th Anniversary Chicago features a Sail leather upper with a red toe wrap and black overlays. From there, a commemorative NBA logo woven tongue tags and matching sole completes the design. The Nike Dunk Low EMB 75th Anniversary Chicago released in October of 2021 and retailed for $110.

Display Name: Nike Manoa Leather Triple Black
Description: The Nike Manoa Leather Triple Black delivers a rugged and durable take on everyday footwear, built around an all black leather upper that emphasizes strength and simplicity. The boot inspired silhouette gives it a sturdy presence, while the tonal design keeps the look clean and versatile. Nike leans into outdoor utility here, creating a shoe that feels ready for tougher conditions without losing its everyday appeal. Fans appreciate models like this because they offer reliability with a straightforward aesthetic. The triple black colorway makes it easy to pair with different outfits, while the structured build adds confidence in wear. It is a sneaker that bridges casual use and outdoor function, appealing to those who want something dependable with a strong and minimal look. The Nike Manoa Leather Triple Black was released on July 7, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Black Metallic Gold
Description: The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Black Metallic Gold is a standalone release of the Air VaporMax Plus line. The Black Metallic Gold Nike Air VaporMax has an upper that combines textile and synthetic materials, featuring a black base with a metallic gold cage overlay, along with a metallic gold Swoosh logo on the sidewalls. The laces are also black, with metallic gold aglets and the tongue tab has the signature 'Vm' branding. The shoe also showcases reflective detailing and boasts Nike's VaporMax technology for added cushioning. The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Black Metallic Gold was released on June 1st, 2020 at a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Sail Cement Grey (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro Sail Cement Grey (Women's) is a shoe for women with metallic design elements. This version of the Jordan 3 Retro has a paneled Sail white calf leather upper. A white mudguard rounds out the sides of the shoe, and a white support on the heel contains a Cement Grey Air logo with a Jumpman. The toe cap and the heel counter are both formed by Metallic Silver overlays that are somewhat cracked to look like cement. Another gray Jumpman appears on the heel, and the shoe sits atop a white and silver midsole equipped with an Air unit underneath the heel. What we like best about this shoe is the subtle integration of the transparent Air unit under the heel, which adds a futuristic vibe to the design. The Jordan 3 Retro Sail Cement Grey (Women's) was released on April 12, 2025, for $200.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Gore-Tex Light Bone
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Gore Tex Light Bone upgrades the timeless Dunk silhouette with weather ready construction and earthy refinement. Light Bone and Mink Brown layer across the upper, while Sail accents soften the contrast. The Gore Tex build adds durability, giving the classic low top a more practical edge for unpredictable conditions. Dunks have always been versatile, but adding Gore Tex functionality makes this version even more adaptable. The neutral palette keeps it easy to style while the technical upgrade ensures it performs beyond fair weather days. For fans who want heritage basketball design with real world durability, this pair delivers substance without sacrificing aesthetic appeal. The Nike Dunk Low Gore Tex Light Bone was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: New Balance 1906L Black Croc
Description: The New Balance 1906L Black Croc pushes the technical runner into elevated territory through material driven storytelling. Black dominates the upper, creating a sleek and commanding look, while the croc textured finish adds depth and luxury without disrupting the familiar silhouette. The design feels bold but controlled, allowing texture to transform the energy of the shoe rather than relying on color contrast. This version resonates with fans because it challenges expectations of what a performance inspired model can become. Collectors are drawn to the croc treatment as a subtle flex, offering something refined and unconventional within the New Balance catalog. It feels fashion forward while remaining grounded in the structure and proportions that make the 1906L recognizable. This release stands out as a confident blend of technical heritage and modern expression that rewards those who appreciate material innovation. The New Balance 1906L Black Croc was released on November 12, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Raptor (PS)
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Anthracite PS channels cinematic inspiration into a youth focused silhouette, blending Ja Morants signature line with one of the most iconic film franchises. The anthracite base creates a darker and more intense foundation, while bright crimson and yellow ochre accents bring energy and contrast that reflect the Jurassic Park theme. The design feels dynamic, capturing both movement and storytelling. Fans are drawn to this version because it brings a sense of imagination into performance footwear, especially for younger wearers. The collaboration adds a layer of excitement, making the shoe feel more like a collectible than a standard release. It stands out as a piece that merges basketball culture with pop culture in a bold and engaging way. The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Anthracite PS was released on April 10, 2026 with a retail price of $97.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 OG Royal Silver
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 OG Royal Silver is an updated relaunch of the original ProGrid Omni 9 from 2010. This lifestyle sneaker returns with a sleek colorway of Royal and silver with black accents. Featuring a technical silhouette, the upper is crafted from lightweight mesh, leather, and suede. The addition of metallic silver makes the leather overlays gleam like chrome, while the mesh allows the foot to breathe. The slightly chunky midsole houses Sauconys Grid technology, which provides stable, responsive cushioning and distributes pressure. The rubber outsole boasts a defined traction pattern that is designed with durability in mind. In terms of branding, Sauconys iconic creek logo graces the side panels, while SAUCONY appears on the tongue, and OMNI 9 is printed near the heel. Our experts at StockX appreciate the way the cage of supportive overlays contributes to the sneakers retro technical design. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 OG Royal Silver was released on February 15, 2024, and retailed for $140.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Ox
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Ox Black White
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70s Ox Black White is a retro throwback to the original Chuck Taylor that Converse released in the 1970s. With a black canvas upper, black-and-white striped sole and capped white toe, the Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70s Ox Black White is an instantly recognizable part of the Converse family. But unlike the original Chuck Taylor, this sneaker offers a low profile that hugs the ankle instead of covering it. The classic Converse All-Star tag appears on the heel. Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70s Ox Black White released in January of 2018 and retailed for $80.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 ESS+ Cave Stone
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 ESS Cave Stone embraces a monochromatic approach that highlights the silhouettes sculpted lines. Cave Stone wraps much of the upper, creating a unified and grounded aesthetic. Adobe accents introduce a subtle shift in tone, adding depth without disrupting the cohesive palette. The layered paneling and visible Air cushioning remain central to the design, preserving its heritage identity. Fans appreciate tonal executions like this because they let the form of the Air Max 90 take center stage. The muted color story feels mature and versatile, offering an alternative to brighter releases. It is a refined interpretation of a classic runner that continues to prove its relevance. Clean, cohesive, and rooted in history, this pair stands strong through simplicity. The Nike Air Max 90 ESS Cave Stone was released on July 25, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 5 Sail Sanddrift (Women's)
Description: The Nike Free Metcon 5 Sail Sanddrift (Womens) is a sneaker designed for top performance with a flexible forefoot and a heel that supports agility. This version of the Nike Free Metcon 5 is constructed with a white mesh upper. The upper also features solid white overlays around the toebox and under the laces in the forefoot area. An off-white overlay runs down from the top laces and around the heel. A small pink Nike Swoosh can be found on this overlay under the lace. The molded heel cup is thick and supportive, and features vertical Metcon and Nike Swoosh branding on either side. The sole under the forefoot is separated in columns for extra flexibility. What we like most about this shoe is the unique look of the sole, which also improves the shoes flexibility. The Nike Free Metcon 5 Sail Sanddrift (Womens) was released on April 6, 2023, for a price of $120.

Display Name: adidas Karintha OG Wales Bonner White Black Lush Blue
Description: The adidas Karintha OG Wales Bonner White Black Lush Blue represents a refined collaboration that blends adidas heritage with Wales Bonners elevated design perspective. The silhouette carries a more fashion forward edge, combining classic sport influence with premium detailing that feels deliberate and curated. The mix of core black, wonder white, and lush blue creates a clean but expressive palette that highlights the craftsmanship behind the shoe. Wales Bonner collaborations have built a reputation for thoughtful storytelling and subtle luxury, and this pair continues that approach. It appeals to collectors who appreciate understated design that reveals more the closer you look. The Karintha OG stands as a fusion of sport and culture, offering something that feels both rooted and progressive at the same time. The adidas Karintha OG Wales Bonner White Black Lush Blue was released on April 17, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 9 Glow Blue
Description: The adidas Harden Vol. 9 Glow Blue updates NBA player James Hardens 9th signature basketball shoe with an icy colorway of Glow Blue and Core White. This performance basketball shoe features a sleek construction, complete with a neoprene bootie supported by molded synthetic leather overlays and breathable mesh accents. Additionally, a carbon fiber heel cup stabilizes the foot and ankle, providing advanced energy return. While the bootie, laces, and heel cup come in Core White, the overlays, mesh detailing, and rubber outsole display a Glow Blue finish. In terms of cushioning, the sneaker houses Boost and Lightning Strike technology in the midsole, which creates a propulsive feel without weighing down the foot. Our experts at StockX appreciate the way the minimal branding complements the shoes futuristic aesthetic. For instance, a variation of adidas signature 3-Stripes logo can be found on the heel along with discrete Harding branding. The adidas Harden Vol. 9 Glow Blue was released on May 10, 2025, and sold for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High NRG Patent Gold Toe
Description: After the "Gold Top 3" AJ1s dropped at ComplexCon in 2017, Nike decided to strike while the gold was hot with the Jordan 1 Retro High NRG Patent Gold Toe. Known as the "Patent Gold Toe" edition, these AJ 1s came in the same black, metallic gold and summit white colorway as the "Gold Top 3s." However, they feature gold toes and tongue tags as well as black tongues on both sneakers. The medial of each shoe is also in black/gold while the lateral in white, black and gold. Their release date was February 16th, 2018, costing the usual $160 in mens sizes and $120 for grade school sizes. Another must-have for fans of the Air Jordan 1, you can use your "golden touch" to buy or sell this Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG online today on StockX.

Display Name: Jordan Spizike Low Anthracite Mango Cargo Khaki
Description: The Air Jordan Spizike Low Anthracite Mango Cargo Khaki blends multiple iconic Jordan elements into a single silhouette, delivering a layered and rugged colorway that feels grounded and versatile. The anthracite base provides a dark and structured foundation, while light wild mango accents add a pop of color that breaks through the muted tones. Cargo khaki and spruce fog details round out the look with an earthy finish. Fans are drawn to this pair for its combination of familiar design cues and unique color blocking. The Spizike has always been about merging different eras of Jordan history, and this version continues that tradition while leaning into a more outdoor inspired palette. It is a shoe that feels both complex and wearable at the same time. The Air Jordan Spizike Low Anthracite Mango Cargo Khaki was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Black White
Description: The Jordan 14 Retro Black White represents a recent inclusion in Michael Jordan's 14th signature footwear line, showcasing a timeless two-tone color palette. Inspired by Michael Jordan's passion for luxurious motor sports and high-performance vehicles, the Black White Jordan 14 Retro showcases an elegant design. Built on an all-black foundation, the shoe integrates suede underlays and nubuck overlays, creating a distinct texture. Jordan branding takes center stage on the prominently featured tongue, while white accents highlight the collar and toe. A subtle touch of red enriches the Jumpman logo within the crest, adding a burst of color amid the dominant black and white palette. The Jordan 14 midsole displays a striking black-and-white contrast, and the design is completed with a sturdy black rubber outsole. The noteworthy characteristic of the Jordan 14 Retro Black White is its elegant design lines coupled with high-performance technology. Taking inspiration from one of MJ's favorite cars, the Ferrari 550, the AJ14 incorporates a Jumpman logo reminiscent of the Ferrari crest and heel panels inspired by the car's high-performance tires. The sneaker debuted for $210 on December 20th, 2023.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Mega Crush Clog Black
Description: The Crocs Classic Mega Crush Clog Black is a clog with a large and exaggerated design, featuring the same sturdy build that the brand is known for. This version of the Crocs Classic Mega Crush Clog features an entirely black build made of their signature material, durable Croslite. The upper features large perforations on top of the toe for either breathability or personalization via Jibbitz charms, and the heel strap features subtle Crocs branding. The upper of this clog also features openings at the bottom of the upper, where you can see the foot of the wearer, adding more breathability and style. The clog sits on top of a 6-centimeter platform, formed by shiny black Croslite with branding at the heel. Textured elements around the mudguard and heel add visual interest. What we like best about this clog is the shiny platform, which adds an element of futuristic style to the classic clog. The Crocs Classic Mega Crush Clog Black was released on February 27, 2023, for $75.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Wonder White Black (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Wonder White Black (Women's) applies a two-tone colorway of Wonder White and black to the classic Handball Spezial silhouette. Originally designed as an indoor court shoe, the Handball Spezial is now a lifestyle sneaker with retro roots. The upper is crafted from premium leather in Wonder White with black details. For example, the 3-Stripes logo on the side panel, the heel tab, the collar, and the tongue come in black. Unlike other models, the "Wonder White Black" iteration features a T-shaped toebox made of soft suede in Magic Beige. Branding details include SPEZIAL in metallic gold lettering on the side panel and a Wonder White trefoil on the heel tab. Something our StockX experts like is the traditional gum rubber outsole. Due to its semi-transparent construction, it reveals the upper and the 3-Stripes beneath the gum. The womens size adidas Handball Spezial Wonder White Black (Women's) was released on December 29th, 2023, and sold for $110.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Solar Blue Silver Metallic Lucid Red
Description: The adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Solar Blue Silver Metallic Lucid Red delivers a vibrant and race ready aesthetic through its bold use of color and layered construction. Solar blue dominates the upper, creating a bright and energetic base, while silver metallic and lucid red accents add contrast and depth. The silhouette feels aggressive and fast, aligning with its performance intent. Fans of performance running shoes appreciate how colorways like this enhance the sense of speed and movement. The combination of bright tones makes it stand out both in competition and casual wear. It is a sneaker that reflects adidas focus on pushing both design and performance forward. The adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Solar Blue Silver Metallic Lucid Red was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $255.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Patent Bred Toe
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Patent Bred Toe brings glossy energy to one of the most recognizable color blockings in Jordan history. Dressed in Black, White, and Varsity Red, the patent leather finish amplifies the classic Bred Toe layout with a bold shine. The mid cut silhouette preserves the familiar panel structure and Wings logo, keeping it firmly rooted in the AJ1 lineage. Patent executions always elevate the presence of a Jordan 1, and pairing that finish with Bred Toe colors makes this release feel instantly iconic. The red toe box pops against the black overlays, while white panels keep the balance clean. It feels like a modern remix of a fan favorite, blending heritage color with a flashier edge. The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Patent Bred Toe was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Iced Carmine (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Iced Carmine TD introduces one of the most recognizable Jordan color inspirations to the Air Jordan 4 silhouette in toddler sizing through a softer and more playful execution. The mix of Iced Carmine, Coconut Milk, Muslin, and Pinksicle gives the shoe a pastel influenced look that feels lighter and more lifestyle oriented than traditional Carmine inspired Jordan releases. Even in smaller form, the Air Jordan 4 retains the bold design language that made it one of the most important sneakers of the late 1980s, including the signature mesh paneling, layered structure, and unmistakable wing eyelets that continue defining the silhouette decades later. Collectors and parents alike gravitate toward toddler Jordan releases because they preserve iconic sneaker history in miniature form while often introducing softer and more playful color palettes. The combination of creamy neutral tones and bright pink inspired accents gives this pair a cheerful personality that still feels connected to classic Jordan heritage. Fans especially appreciate how the Air Jordan 4 continues adapting to new generations and audiences without losing the aggressive shape and cultural importance that made it legendary. The lighter tones make this release feel especially suited for spring and warm weather styling within younger sneaker rotations. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Iced Carmine TD was released on April 23, 2026 with a retail price of $75.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe 2.0
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe 2.0 is a popular sneaker model from the Jordan Brand, a subsidiary of Nike. It is a low-top re-imagination of the Air Jordan 1 shoe, a model that was initially released for sale in the 1980s as the signature shoe for the legendary basketball player Michael Jordan. This Bred Toe 2.0 model maintains the same design elements and style as the high-top version but features a lower cut, making it a more casual and versatile option. The Jordan 1 Lows are crafted from a variety of materials, including leather, suede, and synthetic materials. The use of different materials allows for a range of color and texture variations. This model has a color range that is composed of black, white, and red. A feature that our team of experts particularly likes about the Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe 2.0 model is the dark red gum sole that allows for both traction and comfort. This model was first released on September 29th of 2023 for a starting price of $115.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog Black
Description: Since its debut, Crocs Classic Clog Black has become popular unisex footwear in the Crocs series. The Classic Clog is produced from croslite material covered in style code 10001BLK. This item is covered with a black colorway, with enough perforations at the Crocs' upper and sides of the toes that help in the breathability as well as the drainage of excess water or sand from the inside of the Croc. The design features an extended heel strap for comfortability while in movement. Crocs Classic Clog Black was initially released on July 15, 2022, at a retail price of $50.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Triple White (2023) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple White 2022 GS strips the iconic silhouette down to its purest form. An all white upper creates a clean and uniform look that highlights the Jordan 1 shape without distraction. From toe to heel, the simplicity feels intentional, allowing texture and proportion to define the design rather than color contrast. This pair remains popular because of its versatility and timelessness. Fans value it as a foundational sneaker that works with nearly anything, making it a go to option for everyday wear. Even in grade school sizing, the Triple White Jordan 1 Low carries the same appeal, offering a blank canvas that fits seamlessly into rotation. It represents the enduring power of simplicity within sneaker culture. The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple White 2022 GS was released on March 11, 2023 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Bliss Lilac Black (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Leopard Magic Beige Womens adds a more expressive twist to the classic indoor silhouette, introducing leopard pattern elements that bring texture and personality to the design. The magic beige base keeps the look grounded, while subtle pattern details and ivory tones add depth without overwhelming the shoe. It is a bold direction that still respects the original shape. What makes this pair stand out is how it balances statement design with wearability. The leopard influence gives it a unique edge, while the overall color palette keeps it versatile enough for everyday use. It is a strong example of how the Spezial can evolve without losing its core identity. The adidas Handball Spezial Leopard Magic Beige Womens was released on December 6, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan CMFT Era Sail Black Redstone
Description: The Air Jordan CMFT Era Sail Black Redstone modernizes familiar Jordan cues through a streamlined low profile silhouette dressed in Sail, Black, Light Cream, and Redstone. The clean upper balances neutral tones with bold red accents, creating a layered and contemporary look. Subtle branding keeps the design connected to Jordan heritage while leaning into a more lifestyle focused aesthetic. This pair stands out because it merges comfort driven construction with classic color blocking influence. The sail base softens the overall palette, while black and red elements inject energy and contrast. Fans appreciate when new silhouettes draw from archival inspiration without replicating it directly. It is a versatile and modern interpretation that carries Jordan identity into a fresh format. The Air Jordan CMFT Era Sail Black Redstone was released on September 20, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 21 Prime 96
Description: The Nike LeBron 21 Prime 96 is a stunning addition to the LeBron signature line, combining cutting-edge performance technology with a sleek, eye-catching design. Featuring a pristine white base accented with metallic gold and fire red details, this sneaker pays homage to LeBron James' rookie year in 1996 while incorporating modern innovations. The upper is crafted with lightweight, breathable materials that provide excellent support and flexibility, ensuring optimal comfort during intense gameplay. Engineered for elite performance, the LeBron 21 Prime 96 boasts Nike's advanced cushioning system, delivering responsive energy return and impact protection. The durable rubber outsole features a multidirectional traction pattern, offering superior grip on various court surfaces. With its striking colorway and premium construction, this shoe seamlessly blends style and functionality, making it a standout choice for both on-court dominance and off-court fashion. Our experts state this product is great for basketball enthusiasts and sneaker collectors alike, offering a perfect balance of performance, comfort, and iconic design.

Display Name: Under Armour Curry 13 Will Harris (GS)
Description: The Under Armour Curry 13 Will Harris GS reflects the evolution of Stephen Currys signature line through a colorway that emphasizes energy and creativity. The Pink Rave, Hyper Green, and White palette gives the shoe a vibrant and high contrast look that stands out on court. Designed for performance, the Curry 13 continues to focus on traction, responsiveness, and lightweight support, maintaining its position as a key model within basketball footwear. Fans gravitate toward Curry sneakers because they represent precision, movement, and skill driven play. The Will Harris theme adds a layer of personality, making the release feel more expressive and unique. The bold color combination enhances visibility while keeping the design dynamic. Grade school sizing ensures accessibility for younger players who want the same performance features. For collectors, pairs like this highlight the continued growth of the Curry line as it expands its identity through both design and storytelling. The Under Armour Curry 13 Will Harris GS was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Kyrie 8 All-Star
Description: The Nike Kyrie 8 All-Star is a shoe designed as a collaboration with American basketball star Kyrie Irving, which was released for All-Star Weekend. The All-Star Nike Kyrie 8 has a multicolored breathable and flexible fabric upper. The top of the upper gets the multicolor treatment, featuring shades of pink, black, and gray. The mudguard, wrapping around the entire bottom of the shoe, is a solid Pink Foam color. A large multicolored Nike Swoosh outlined in gold appears under the lateral ankle, while under the inner ankle a small white Swoosh can be found. Irvings branding can be found in orange stitching on the inner side of the heel, and the tongue also contains his logo. The shoe sits on a thick textured off-white midsole with Zoom Air cushioning and an off-white outsole. The most interesting feature of this shoe is the multicolored Swoosh on the lateral side, which is eye-catching against the colors of the rest of the design. The Nike Kyrie 8 All-Star was released on November 1, 2022, for $140.

Display Name: Nike Killshot 2 J Crew Sail Midnight Navy
Description: In 2017, the re-release of the Nike Killshot 2 J Crew Sail Midnight Navy marked the return of one of Nike's most popular exclusives. The history of the Killshot goes all the way back to the 1970s, but Nike launched the Midnight Navy colorway in 2012 as part of its collaboration with J.Crew. Originally, the Nike Killshot 2 J Crew Sail Midnight Navy was exclusively available at J.Crew. However, Nike re-released the Midnight Navy five year later globally. The Nike Killshot 2 J Crew Sail Midnight Navy features a retro design that's reminiscent of Nike's original shoes from the 1970s. The shoe starts with a thick tan sole with an aged, weathered appearance and then leads to a clean, off-white upper with gray accents and a navy Swoosh logo. Instead of rubber, the Nike Killshot 2 J Crew Sail Midnight Navy comes with a gum sole with a textured underside to complete the retro look. For a final touch, "NIKE" is printed on the heel in weathered navy letters to suggest that this sneaker has seen a lot of history. The Nike Killshot 2 J Crew Sail Midnight Navy released in February of 2017 and retailed for $90.

Model: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 TB
Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 TB Black White
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 TB Black White delivers a clean team based execution built for competitive play. Finished in Black with White and Green Strike accents, the upper keeps a streamlined and focused aesthetic. The responsive cushioning platform and low profile silhouette remain tuned for quick cuts and lateral control. Team bank colorways emphasize versatility, and this black and white foundation makes it easy to pair with uniform sets. Subtle green detailing adds a touch of energy without distracting from the performance intent. It stands as a dependable on court option that balances function and understated design. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 TB Black White was released on July 29, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike LD Waffle sacai Undercover Black Bright Citron
Description: The Nike LDWaffle sacai Undercover Black Bright Citron is constructed with a black nylon upper with white and Bright Citron leather, and tonal grey hairy suede overlays. In alignment with other LDWaffles, the tongues, overlays, and soles are doubled, carrying out sacai's reconstructive design aesthetic. The Nike LDWaffle sacai Undercover Black Bright Citron released in October of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Adios Pro Evo 3 White Black
Description: The adidas Adizero Adios Pro Evo 3 White Black is a pure race day statement, built for runners who obsess over speed, weight, and every detail that can separate a personal best from an almost. The Cloud White, Core Black, and Solar Turbo colorway keeps the shoe looking clinical and fast, with bright contrast that matches the aggressive geometry of the silhouette. adidas equipped the model with LightstrikePro cushioning, a lightweight textile and synthetic upper, and a rubber outsole tuned for traction when pace matters most. This pair matters because the Adizero line has become deeply connected to modern marathon culture and elite road racing. The Evo 3 takes that reputation even further with a stripped back feel that looks almost impossible in hand, like a prototype made for the starting line rather than the shelf. Display Name: Nike Air Rift Velvet Brown Gold (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Rift in Velvet Brown and Metallic Gold for Women is a colorway that gives one of Nike's most distinctive and unconventional silhouettes its most luxurious and materially sophisticated expression, pairing the Rift's split-toe construction and trail-running heritage with a warm and precious material palette that feels both vintage and genuinely elevated. Velvet brown and metallic gold is the colorway that makes the Air Rift feel most like a design object worth examining closely rather than simply a running shoe worth wearing casually, which is the highest compliment available to a colorway applied to a silhouette this architecturally interesting. The Nike Air Rift in Velvet Brown and Metallic Gold Women's was released on March 2, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Rift Polka Dots Triple Black (Women's)

The Nike Air Rift Polka Dots Triple Black Womens was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 PRM Valentines Day Playful Pink

A great shoe if youre looking to make an entrance, you can find athletic functionality wrapped up in the cutest aesthetic. The Nike Air Max 1 PRM Valentines Day Playful Pink sneakers were released on February 7, 2025, priced at $160 retail.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Core Black Iron Metallic Carbon
Description: The Adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 in Core Black Iron Metallic Carbon is a premier marathon and distance racing shoe featuring a completely redesigned architecture across every component from its predecessor the Adios Pro 3, applying a new generation of Lightstrike Pro foam formulated from TPEE with an updated compound that delivers the brand's softest and most resilient version of the material to date alongside the retained Energy Rods 2.0 system of five carbon-infused rods that mimic the foot's bone structure across the full length of the midsole, delivering torsional rigidity and propulsive energy return in a platform that weighs just 7.1 ounces in men's US size 9 at 39mm heel and 33mm forefoot stack heights with a 6mm drop. The Core Black Iron Metallic Carbon colorway applies the most classic and race-focused visual treatment in the Adios Pro 4 lineup, with the dark base and metallic accents creating a visual identity that connects directly to the performance and racing heritage associations of carbon-plated super shoe aesthetics while contrasting against the lighter and more visibility-forward colorways available elsewhere in the range. The new Lightstrike Pro foam's TPEE update marks a significant departure from the denser Adios Pro 3 formulation, appearing dramatically more airy and plush under microscopic examination at the cut foam level, and delivering a more compressed and cushioned feel that extends energy return throughout marathon distances in a way reviewers noted as maintaining spring well past the 20-mile mark where some racing shoes lose responsiveness, though the softer compound trades the exceptional durability of the previous formulation for greater immediate performance. The new Micro Fit upper is an ultra-lightweight and nearly transparent mesh that eliminates the stiffness and abrasiveness of the Adios Pro 3's upper, fitting slightly narrow compared to the previous version, and the improved eyelet design eliminates the fragile first two eyelet loops that were prone to tearing across the Adios Pro 3's lifecycle, adopting the eyelet design proven in the Pro Evo 1 release. Continental rubber at the most critical traction point under the medial forefoot and balls of the feet delivers the sticky, reliable grip that the Adidas Marathon Racing team prioritized after analyzing athlete landing patterns, while LIGHTTRAXION rubber covers the remainder of the outsole to reduce overall weight without sacrificing necessary grip across the full contact surface. The Adios Pro 4 is specifically optimized for neutral forefoot and midfoot strikers running at marathon pace or faster, with reviewers consistently noting that the shoe performs at its highest level between 10K and marathon pace while becoming too soft and compressed at mile race pace, making the black Core colorway a natural choice for the serious marathon and distance racing context the shoe is designed for. The Adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Core Black Iron Metallic Carbon was released on December 4, 2025 with a retail price of $255.

Display Name: Nike A'ja Wilson A'One Pearl (Women's)

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Desert Sunset
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Desert Sunset is one of the most narratively and visually complete gradient colorways in the Air Max Plus's long history of nature-referencing sunset-inspired executions, a Spring 2025 release that takes the fuchsia-to-orange gradient tradition Sean McDowell established with the silhouette's original coastal Florida sunset inspiration and applies it to the specific visual language of a desert twilight scene, building a complete landscape narrative across the shoe's construction from the warm colored upper to the grey midsole below. McDowell designed the original Air Max Plus in 1997 with Florida's beach sunsets, palm trees, and ocean waves as his reference points, and the Desert Sunset translates that same design philosophy to a different biome: the gradient mesh upper transitions from fuchsia at the toe into orange toward the heel, capturing the chromatic shift visible in the sky above a dry desert at the precise moment when the sun dips below the horizon. The black TPU overlays, the silhouette's most architecturally distinctive feature, serve in this colorway as the backlit silhouettes of desert flora against the vivid sky, the dark overlay shapes creating the illusion of plant shadows against a glowing background that makes the total design read as a complete visual scene rather than simply a color application. The grey midsole references the rocky terrain of a desert landscape, grounding the warm upper colors in the cooler, harder surface that desert floors present, while the Tuned Air cushioning system beneath provides the targeted support and shock absorption that defined the Air Max Plus as a performance running shoe before it became one of Nike's most globally beloved lifestyle silhouettes. Style code DM0032-014. The Nike Air Max Plus Desert Sunset is the TN for the collector who wants the silhouette's gradient narrative tradition in its most complete and most atmospherically specific desert-landscape execution, a pair that rewards careful attention to how the color story builds from toe to heel to sole. The Nike Air Max Plus Desert Sunset was released on February 20, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Mad Energy Pack
Description: Ignite every sprint with the Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Mad Energy Pack, a speed-focused firm-ground soccer cleat built for razor-sharp cuts and devastating acceleration. Display Name: New Balance 1906A Neon Green Mint Flash
Description: The New Balance 1906A in Neon Green and Mint Flash is a colorway that pushes the 1906 platform's technical and archival design language into its most visually energetic and chromatically bold territory, applying the bright and slightly electric combination of neon green and mint flash to a silhouette that has become one of the most culturally significant and collector-coveted New Balance releases of the current era through its sophisticated blend of late 1990s and early 2000s running technology heritage and the contemporary lifestyle and fashion context it has found itself occupying across multiple seasons of sustained and growing collector enthusiasm. The 1906 platform's design biography is rooted in New Balance's ABZORB and N-ergy cushioning technologies from the early 2000s, the multi-panel upper construction and substantial midsole profile creating a shoe that feels genuinely grounded in performance running heritage rather than simply borrowing athletic aesthetic signifiers for purely fashion purposes, and in neon green and mint flash that technical heritage is presented through a color combination that evokes the specific fluorescent and safety color palette of serious running gear from the era when these technologies were first deployed in competition and training contexts. Neon green's visual intensity against the cooler and slightly softer mint flash creates a color relationship that rewards the wearer who is confident enough in their aesthetic instincts to reach for a shoe this chromatically demanding, the two tones working together to create a gradient-like energy across the upper that feels dynamic and purposeful rather than arbitrarily bold. New Balance 1906A releases in statement colorways consistently attract the segment of the sneaker collector community that follows the platform specifically for its willingness to explore the full spectrum of color possibility across a silhouette whose technical credibility and construction quality provide the foundation for even the most visually adventurous colorway executions to succeed as wearable objects rather than simply display pieces. Neon green and mint flash on the 1906A creates a shoe that will be the most visually present and immediately attention-generating piece in any rotation it joins, demanding outfit partners that are confident enough to let the colorway lead the overall look without competition or visual conflict from other boldly colored pieces. At one hundred and seventy dollars the 1906A in neon green and mint flash delivers the platform's full technical and design heritage in the most chromatically exciting expression of the 1906 color story available in the July 2025 seasonal release window, rewarding the collector who reaches for it with a shoe that makes its presence known in every room and every environment it enters. The New Balance 1906A in Neon Green and Mint Flash was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Black Game Royal
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Black Game Royal revisits the iconic layered silhouette with an emphasis on bold contrast and enhanced Air presence. The black and dark grey gradient across the upper creates depth and structure, while Game Royal accents cut through with a sharp pop of color that energizes the design. The Big Bubble update amplifies the visible Air units, giving the shoe a more pronounced and nostalgic feel tied to its original innovation. Fans of the Air Max 95 appreciate when Nike leans back into its heritage details, and this version delivers exactly that. The balance between dark tones and vibrant accents keeps it versatile while still making a statement. It is a strong iteration that highlights the models legacy while refreshing its visual impact for modern collectors. The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Black Game Royal was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Space Jam (GS)
Description: The Jordan 11 Retro Low Space Jam (GS) finds inspiration in the adult-sized high-top iteration of the Jordan 11 Retro "Space Jam." This low-top sneaker features an upper made of durable ballistic mesh in black with a shiny, black patent leather mudguard that wraps around the shoe. The Phylon midsole comes in white and houses a full-length Air-sole unit plus a carbon fiber plate. The translucent rubber outsole wraps around the midsole and provides a glimpse of Varsity Blue rubber. In addition, Varsity Blue elements can be found on the Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel tab. Extra cushioning in the heel adds stability and supports the ankle, while the slightly oversized tongue pops out of the lace cage. Our StockX experts like how the wavy pattern on the mudguard matches the outsole. The grade-school-sized Jordan 11 Retro Low Space Jam (GS) was released on May 18, 2024, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro China
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro China celebrates Kobe Bryants deep connection to global basketball culture, particularly his lasting relationship with fans in China. The university red and metallic gold palette feels bold and ceremonial, aligning perfectly with the Kobe 9s sharp and aggressive silhouette. The Protro update modernizes the performance while preserving the visual identity that made the original so respected on court. Collectors gravitate toward this release because it represents Kobes international influence. The China colorway has always carried special significance, and pairing it with the Kobe 9 EM Low Protro makes it feel both nostalgic and forward looking. Fans appreciate how the shoe blends elite performance with cultural storytelling, making it a standout release that honors Kobes legacy beyond borders and statistics. The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro China was released on November 22, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Salomon XT-MM-6 MM6 Maison Margiela Black
Description: The Salomon XT-MM6 MM6 Maison Margiela Black is an April 29, 2026 release from the ongoing MM6 Maison Margiela x Salomon SS26 collaboration, retailing at $480 with style code L49200300 in the Black/Black colorway, confirmed by Sneaker Bar Detroit, Sole Retriever, and Modern Notoriety. As confirmed by Hypebeast and WWD, the XT-MM6 is a modified city-lifestyle counterpart to the technical XT-6 trail runner, featuring a new outsole tuned for everyday urban wear, updated MM6 Maison Margiela branding, and a wider toe box that distinguishes it from the standard inline XT-6, preserving Salomon's technical lacing system and layered construction beneath the Margiela high-fashion influence. Sole Retriever confirmed the SS26 collection features three XT-MM6 colorways alongside the newly introduced Cross Dust silhouette, with the Black/Black being the most stealthy and most wearable of the three XT-MM6 options alongside Asparagus Green and Sunny Lime, all released simultaneously via MM6 Maison Margiela, Salomon, and select global retailers. The Black/Black colorway applies tonal all-black across the upper, midsole, laces, and outsole for the most monochromatic and most urban-ready execution in the SS26 XT-MM6 drop. All sales final. Retail price $480. The Salomon XT-MM6 MM6 Maison Margiela Black is the April 29, 2026 L49200300 modified-city-lifestyle XT-6-base wider-toe-box MM6-branded-outsole all-black-tonal SS26 XT-MM6 for the Salomon and Maison Margiela collector who wants the most monochromatic black/black execution from the MM6 Maison Margiela x Salomon Spring Summer 2026 XT-MM6 three-colorway drop. The Salomon XT-MM6 MM6 Maison Margiela Black was released on April 29, 2026 with a retail price of $480.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 ASOS Exclusive Beige Brown Leopard Print
Description: The New Balance 9060 ASOS Exclusive Beige Brown Leopard Print pushes the 9060 into bolder fashion territory, blending New Balance comfort with statement driven styling. The leopard print adds texture and personality, while beige and brown tones keep the look grounded and cohesive. It feels expressive and confident, designed for people who enjoy sneakers as a core part of their personal style rather than a background detail. Collectors gravitate toward this release because it represents experimentation done right. The ASOS exclusive approach gives it a sense of uniqueness, while the 9060 silhouette ensures comfort and wearability remain central. Fans love how the pattern feels intentional rather than overpowering, turning the shoe into a standout piece that still fits naturally into a curated rotation. The New Balance 9060 ASOS Exclusive Beige Brown Leopard Print was released on May 7, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Cleats Black Grey
Description: The adidas Adizero Cleats Black Grey deliver performance driven design through a sharp and minimal color execution. Core black dominates the upper, reinforced by grey five accents that add subtle contrast while keeping the overall look focused. The streamlined Adizero construction emphasizes speed and precision, reflecting adidas long standing commitment to lightweight performance footwear. This pair resonates with athletes who value clarity and intent in their gear. The black and grey palette feels timeless and adaptable, letting the design communicate seriousness without distraction. Collectors who follow adidas performance lines appreciate how the Adizero series maintains its identity through structure and proportion rather than flashy updates. It is a cleat built around efficiency and confidence, offering a clean aesthetic that mirrors its on field purpose. The adidas Adizero Cleats Black Grey was released on May 11, 2022 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Pearl Grey Linen
Description: The New Balance 9060 Pearl Grey Linen offers a sophisticated blend of style and comfort. This men's sneaker showcases a refined color palette, combining pearl grey and linen hues for a versatile look that effortlessly transitions from casual to semi-formal settings. The upper features a mix of premium materials, including soft suede and breathable mesh, ensuring both durability and all-day comfort. Designed with New Balance's signature attention to detail, the 9060 model boasts an innovative sole unit that provides exceptional cushioning and support. The chunky midsole not only adds to the shoe's distinctive aesthetic but also incorporates advanced technology for superior shock absorption and energy return. With its sleek silhouette and carefully crafted details, this sneaker represents a perfect fusion of retro-inspired design and modern performance features. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a balance between fashion-forward styling and all-day comfort. The versatile colorway and premium construction make it an excellent choice for various occasions, from casual outings to more dressed-up events.

Display Name: Nike KD 4 Texas Longhorns (2025)
Description: The Nike KD 4 Texas Longhorns 2025 brings collegiate pride back to one of Kevin Durants most beloved signature models. The KD 4 silhouette is remembered for its low profile strap design and responsive feel, and the Texas Longhorns colorway ties directly to Durants roots. Desert orange and white give the shoe a bold but clean presence that feels instantly recognizable to fans of both KD and college basketball culture. Collectors love this release because it blends nostalgia with authenticity. The KD 4 represents an important era in Nike Basketball history, and revisiting it through a Texas themed lens adds emotional significance. Fans appreciate how the colorway feels purposeful rather than decorative, turning the shoe into a tribute to Durants journey and identity while keeping the silhouettes performance driven attitude intact. The Nike KD 4 Texas Longhorns 2025 was released on October 24, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Reebok Club C 85 Vintage Chalk Glen Green
Description: The Reebok Club C 85 Vintage (TV) Chalk Glen Green has the Reebok company logo on different shoe parts, including the front, side, and back, with the sole getting the Reebok logo as well. The Reebok Club C 85 Vintage (TV) Chalk Glen Green is available in different colorways, including chalk, paper white, and glen green. The upper material of the Club C 85 Vintage (TV) Reebok Chalk Glen Green is leather and a rubber sole sits underfoot. The Reebok Club C 85 Vintage (TV) Chalk Glen Green was released on the 12th of February, 2021 at a retail price of $90.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Cream White Beige (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Cream White Beige (Women's) paints the classic adidas Handball Spezial silhouette in Neutral Cream, Wonder Beige, and Magic Beige. Originally introduced in 1979 as an indoor handball shoe, this version of the Spezial maintains its roots through retro-inspired design elements. For example, the sneaker boasts a T-shaped toebox and an upper constructed with premium materials. Although the base is made of smooth leather in Cream, the toebox features shaggy suede in Magic Beige. Other standout features include the leather serrated 3-Stripes logo on the side panels and SPEZIAL printed on the lateral side in Metallic Gold. The sneaker boasts a gum rubber outsole that which provides traction without distracting from the neutral upper. Our StockX experts like the exposed stitching on the heel tab because it matches the Wonder Beige of the Trefoil logo. The womens size adidas Handball Spezial Cream White Beige (Women's) was released on December 29th, 2023, and retailed at $110.

Display Name: Alexander McQueen Oversized Black White
Description: The Alexander McQueen Oversized Black White is crafted of a calfskin leather upper featuring perforations on the quarter panels accenting its construction and adding to breathability. Its all-black finish is contrasted by a white calf leather heel accent, and the midsole is added to a black lace-up sneaker. The sneaker has a broad flat outsole made of white rubber and wide flat laces. The tongue and heel counter are finished with an Alexander McQueen signature. An extra pair of white shoelaces are supplied with the sneaker. The Alexander McQueen Oversized Black White was released on 8th October 2019 and retailed at the price of $490.

Display Name: adidas D.O.N. Issue #6 Purple Burst
Description: The adidas D.O.N. Issue #6 Purple Burst is an ultra-sleek basketball shoe, with an extremely forward-looking design. Its kaleidoscopic color scheme immediately stands out from the rest. Part of the Donovan Mitchell signature collection, it has all the hallmarks of top-class adidas basketball shoes. A key feature is the adidas Lightstrike technology, which creates an exceptionally lightweight midsole that's also extremely responsive to sudden changes of direction.
