Combined with a comfortable padded upper, this puts these shoes in the same realm as other adidas basketball icons. Our experts rate these shoes very highly for their performance on court. They provide superior lateral support without the need for a high side wall. This gives a low-profile basketball shoe that provides a high degree of flexibility while still imparting stability. An accentuated midsole gives excellent arch support too. The adidas D.O.N. Issue #6 Purple Burst retailed at $120 upon its release on 5 July 2024.

Display Name: Nike ReactX Infinity Run 4 Black White
Description: The Nike ReactX Infinity Run 4 Black White continues Nikes focus on comfort and consistency, delivering a running silhouette that feels stable and reliable. The black base keeps the design sleek and understated, while white and dark grey accents add contrast that highlights the structure. The ReactX platform provides a smooth and cushioned ride. This pair stands out because it prioritizes performance without unnecessary complexity. The Infinity Run line has built a reputation for support and durability, and this version reinforces that with a clean and versatile look. Fans appreciate how it fits into both running routines and everyday wear without losing its identity. The Nike ReactX Infinity Run 4 Black White was released on July 13, 2023 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Wet Putty 2.0
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Wet Putty 2.0 is an ideal street shoe. It's a real looker, and it's extremely comfortable. If you want an unusual colorway in one of the world's most sought-after trainers, this is one to go for. This model in the iconic Nike Air Force 1 range lives up to its unusual name. You instantly recognize the look of wet putty. The oily green upper is made from shiny patent leather, with a neon orange swoosh and a translucent carrot-colored sole. It has the classic low Air Force silhouette. We like the wet putty look and the striking contrast of the vivid orange shades. The patent leather look adds even more flair, making the trainer come alive. Of course, there's all the comfortable cushioning that comes with all shoes in the Air Force 1 range. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Wet Putty 2.0 was released on 1 September 2024, priced at $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Athletic Department Deep Royal Blue
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Athletic Department Deep Royal Blue presents a subtly elegant shoe with a classic design that delivers high-performance capabilities and style that fits in anywhere. ? The Athletic Department Deep Royal Blue iteration of the Nike Air Max 1 features an upper with a base constructed from white mesh that keeps the shoe lightweight and provides breathability. Suede in shades of gray overlay the forefoot, eye stays, side panel, and heel, providing an aesthetic element as well as structure. A dark blue suede mud guard surrounds the shoe and sports an iridescent mini swoosh. The same blue is echoed in a sock liner and the side-panel Nike swoosh that sneaks beneath the heel. ? What our experts enjoy most about this shoe is the sole unit that revolutionized sneakers. Visible Air is housed in the white foam midsole. The outsole is constructed from black rubber lugged for traction and white rubber vented for midsole expansion. The Nike Air Max 1 Athletic Department Deep Royal Blue was released on September 7, 2023, for a retail price of $150.

Model: Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen AMPD
Display Name: Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen AMPD White Silver
Description: The Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen AMPD White Silver blends performance precision with crisp contrast. White dominates the upper, creating a clean and focused base, while silver accents enhance the sculpted lines with subtle shine. The streamlined build emphasizes agility and court feel, reflecting the NXXT Gens responsive design. Its balanced palette keeps the look sharp without unnecessary distraction. Fans of LeBrons performance models appreciate how white based executions highlight structure and movement. The silver detailing adds depth and modern polish to the silhouette. It bridges innovation with versatility in a confident execution. Sleek and composed, this pair delivers championship energy through clarity and control. The Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen AMPD White Silver was released on March 15, 2024 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Veneer (2020/2024)
Description: Following February 2020s release of the Nike Dunk Low Plum, Nike made the next step to completely retro the 2001 CO.JP Ugly Duckling Pack with the re-release of the Nike Dunk Low Veneer. Similar to the Plum Dunk Low, the Veneer colorway had never seen a retro until this 2020. The Nike Dunk Low Veneer arrived in its OG form. Premium suede wraps the upper in shades of brown, green, and purple, providing nostalgic appeal for those who missed out on the 2001 issue. A mesh tongue, embroidered Nike lettering on the heel, and a white and purple sole add finishing touches to this cult classic. The Nike Dunk Low CO.JP Veneer released in November of 2020 and retailed for $100. The Nike Dunk Low CO.JP Veneer released again in April of 2024 and retailed for $115.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 3 Silencer (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 3 Silencer Womens delivers a layered and expressive color story built around control and clarity. Summit white anchors the upper with a clean foundation, while iron grey and photon dust add structure and depth. Washed coral, artisan teal, and lemonade accents introduce subtle energy, creating a palette that feels complex yet composed rather than loud or chaotic. This pair resonates with fans because it highlights nuance over flash. The Silencer concept feels fitting for a player known for shutting down opponents through precision and awareness. Collectors appreciate how the Sabrina 3 continues to evolve through thoughtful color balance, offering personality without sacrificing wearability. It is a sneaker that rewards attention, revealing detail and intention through layered tones that reflect focus, intelligence, and quiet confidence on the court. The Nike Sabrina 3 Silencer Womens was released on September 6, 2025 with a retail price of $135.
Colorway: Summit White/Iron Grey/Photon Dust/Washed Coral/Artisan Teal/Lemonade

Display Name: Nike KD 18 EYBL
Description: The Nike KD 18 EYBL is a cutting-edge basketball shoe that combines style and performance. Featuring a sleek Metallic Silver, Dark Smoke Grey, Green Strike, Dusty Sage, and Chrome colorway, this sneaker is designed to make a statement on and off the court. The KD 18 EYBL showcases Nike's commitment to innovation, incorporating advanced cushioning technology and responsive materials to enhance player performance. Engineered for elite athletes, the KD 18 EYBL offers superior support and agility. The shoe's construction includes a breathable upper for optimal ventilation during intense gameplay, while the responsive midsole provides excellent energy return with every step. The durable outsole features a multidirectional traction pattern, ensuring grip and stability on various court surfaces. Our experts state this product is great for serious basketball players looking to elevate their game with a shoe that delivers both style and high-level performance.
Colorway: Metallic Silver/Dark Smoke Grey/Green Strike/Dusty Sage/Chrome

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Brown Beige
Description: The New Balance 1906R Brown Beige channels earthy tones through a layered performance silhouette. The brown base pairs seamlessly with beige accents, creating warm contrast across the mesh and overlay construction. The sculpted midsole maintains the 1906Rs comfort driven heritage, while the neutral palette enhances everyday versatility. The overall composition feels grounded and cohesive. Fans gravitate toward muted colorways that transition easily between seasons, and this pair embodies that adaptability. The brown and beige combination adds depth without overpowering a fit. It stands as a refined, lifestyle ready take on a technical classic. The New Balance 1906R Brown Beige was released on May 28, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Model: Nike Tennis Classic CS PRM WTCH BND
Display Name: Nike Tennis Classic CS PRM WTCH BND Black
Description: The Nike Tennis Classic CS PRM WTCH BND Black is one of the most quietly sophisticated things Nike Sportswear has released in the retro court space, a triple-black execution of the Tennis Classic silhouette elevated into premium territory by a design concept borrowed from an entirely different world: the textured leather of vintage watch bands. The entire upper is wrapped in a crocodile-patterned leather that gives the shoe its defining character, the reptilian texture running across the Swoosh, heel tab, and mudguard in a way that feels more country club couture than traditional sneaker. All three color codes are black, creating a total monochromatic statement that lets the surface texture do the visual work rather than any contrast palette, and the result lands somewhere between hushed luxury and elevated athletic archival that few Nike sneakers manage to occupy at this price point. The Tennis Classic CS draws its bloodline from classic Nike tennis footwear of the 1970s, informed by iconic silhouettes like the Nike Wimbledon and the Nike All Court that defined the sport's golden era of both performance and style. The low-cut profile, clean toebox, and minimal construction that made those originals timeless are all intact here, brought forward into the PRM tier with upgraded materials and that watch-band inspired texture that reframes the shoe's identity from simple tennis heritage into something that wears as easily with tailoring as it does with casual fits. For collectors who understand that the Tennis Classic's entire appeal lives in its restraint, the Black version in crocodile-patterned leather is the purest expression of that philosophy. The Nike Tennis Classic CS PRM WTCH BND Black was released on May 7, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Timberland 6" Premium Waterproof Patent Boots Finch Wheat
Description: The Timberland 6 Premium Waterproof Patent Boots Finch Wheat reinterpret a rugged classic through unexpected finish and shine. Finch wheat tones remain true to Timberland heritage, while the patent treatment adds a bold and fashion forward edge that transforms the familiar silhouette. The contrast between workwear form and glossy texture gives the boot a striking presence that feels intentional and confident. Fans gravitate toward this version because it challenges expectations without losing identity. The six inch boot has always been about strength and reliability, and the patent finish reframes those qualities through style rather than function. Collectors appreciate how Timberland continues to experiment within its most iconic shape, offering something expressive that still feels grounded in history and recognizable from a distance. The Timberland 6 Premium Waterproof Patent Boots Finch Wheat was released on September 26, 2025 with a retail price of $198.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Red Stardust
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Red Stardust (style HJ4135-600) brings a refined, vintage-tinged palette to a skate icon. Dressed in Red Stardust with accents of Neutral Olive, Monarch, and Coconut Milk, this pair balances warm earth tones with a soft, sun-faded look that pairs effortlessly with denim, cargos, or tapered chinos. Textured suede overlays play against smooth underlays for a layered, premium feel, while the Coconut Milk midsole and classic gum-style traction deliver timeless court-to-curb appeal. From the padded mesh tongue to the supportive collar, every element is dialed for comfort whether youre lacing up for a session or stepping out off-duty. True to the SB lineage, the Dunk Low Red Stardust is built for performance without sacrificing style. A cushioned sockliner and responsive heel setup absorb impact on landings, the grippy circular-tread outsole locks in board control, and reinforced overlays stand up to daily wear. Thoughtful details, embroidered branding, clean stitch lines, and that perfectly balanced silhouette, make this colorway a standout in any rotation. Launched June 12, 2025, and aligned with the celebrated SB Dunk heritage, this pair nails the modern-meets-retro aesthetic that skaters and collectors reach for first. A must-have addition to the rotation, especially because it blends skate-ready comfort, durable materials, and a versatile Red Stardust colorway that elevates everyday fits.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Smoke
Description: Lightweight and durable, the Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Smoke sneakers deliver a responsive performance for basketballers that need quick turns and a spring in their step. With Zoom X cushioning along the length of the shoe, the Nike Air zoom GTs are a great fit for ballers who need extra bounce on the court. The outsole is sticky with rubber in a herringbone design to provide the ultimate traction, and the silhouette provides a stable support when needed most. A good-looking shoe in a dark Smoke color, with black, white and gray accents, the laces are black and the Nike text sits on the back heel. A giant white Swoosh brands the inner and outers, and the shoe has a tongue pull tag with the wording GT Cut 3. We love the slick, moody look the color combo delivers with the Air Zoom Smoke trainers. A hardy shoe for professionals as much as urban trend-setters, the Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Smoke was released on January 10, 2024, retailed at $190.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Mambacita (GS)
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Mambacita GS honors Gianna Bryant through a design that feels respectful, powerful, and emotionally grounded. The Kobe 9 EM Low silhouette is known for its speed driven construction and minimal profile, and the Mambacita theme brings added meaning through black, white, and metallic gold tones that symbolize legacy and remembrance. Even in grade school sizing, the shoe carries weight and intention, proving that storytelling does not need scale to be impactful. Fans love this release because it represents more than basketball performance. The Mambacita name connects directly to inspiration, resilience, and the future of the game, making this pair especially meaningful for younger players. Collectors appreciate how Nike uses the Kobe line to preserve legacy with care, turning the Kobe 9 EM into a tribute that feels wearable, respectful, and deeply personal rather than purely commemorative. The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Mambacita GS was released on May 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Free Metcon 6 Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike Free Metcon 6 Black Anthracite is a versatile training shoe that combines the flexibility of Nike Free technology with the stability of Metcon. This sleek, all-black design features a breathable mesh upper with supportive overlays, providing a secure fit during intense workouts. The innovative sole unit incorporates deep grooves for natural foot movement, while the wider heel offers enhanced stability for weightlifting and other strength-based exercises. Designed for the modern athlete, these shoes excel in various training environments. The cushioned midsole provides comfort for high-impact activities, while the durable rubber outsole ensures excellent traction on multiple surfaces. The Black Anthracite colorway offers a sophisticated, understated look that transitions seamlessly from the gym to casual wear, making it a versatile addition to any fitness enthusiast's wardrobe. Our experts state this product is great for athletes seeking a balance between flexibility and support in their training footwear, offering the best of both worlds for diverse workout routines.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD Kill Bill (Yellow Midsole) (2024)
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD Kill Bill (Yellow Midsole) (2024) features a yellow-and-black colorway inspired by the Mexico 66 model Uma Thurman wore in the 2003 film "Kill Bill: Volume 1." Although the Kill Bill (Yellow Midsole) (2024) Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD boasts the slim silhouette the Mexico 66 is known for, it also includes a contemporary colorway. The upper is constructed from yellow leather with black accents on the signature tiger stripes. One thing that sets this sneaker apart from other Kill Bill-inspired Mexico 66 models is the midsole. It includes dual stripes in black and yellow. The yellow on this shoe is also darker than the yellow hue on other models. Our experts at StockX like the iconic Onitsuka Tiger branding on the tongue because it maintains the sneakers retro roots. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD Kill Bill (Yellow Midsole) (2024) was released on March 1, 2024, and sold for $160.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Riot Skateshop
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Riot Skateshop is a striking collaboration that pays homage to the vibrant skateboarding culture. This men's sneaker features a rich mahogany base, complemented by dark beetroot, team red, sail, and night maroon accents, creating a visually captivating design. The premium materials and expert craftsmanship ensure both style and durability, making it an ideal choice for skaters and sneaker enthusiasts alike. Designed with skateboarding in mind, these shoes offer superior comfort and performance. The low-top silhouette provides flexibility and freedom of movement, while the padded collar and tongue offer enhanced support. The shoe comes with both red and black laces, allowing for customization to suit individual preferences. With its unique colorway and attention to detail, the Nike SB Dunk Low Riot Skateshop is set to become a coveted addition to any sneaker collection. Us at StockX believe this product is great for both skateboarding enthusiasts and fashion-forward individuals looking for a versatile, eye-catching sneaker that stands out from the crowd.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk High Sweet Tooth Candy Corn
Description: The Nike SB Dunk High Sweet Tooth Candy Corn boasts that recognizable Nike SB Dunk silhouette with a Halloween-inspired colorway and candy details. A gradient of Amarillo and Orange covers the smooth leather upper and overlays before fading to white across the vamp. It appears almost spraypainted across the sneaker. This high-top skateboarding shoe features overlapping Swoosh logos in Orange and Amarillo on the left and right sides that connect around the heel. In addition, the Orange swoosh complements the laces and the stitching along the midsole. The rubber outsole provides traction and a burst of black that contrasts the bright colors on the upper. Our experts at StockX love the Trick-or-Treat-inspired insole. It features graphics of candy corn with pennies, a nod to candy corn's status as the original "penny candy." The Nike SB Dunk High Sweet Tooth Candy Corn was released on October 18, 2023, and retailed at $125.

Display Name: UGG Tasman Slipper Chestnut (Women's)
Description: The UGG Tasman Slipper Chestnut W has become one of the classic colorways of the Australian brand's slippers. This Tasman Slipper for women construction features a combination of a foam footbed and Tread-lite outsole that is meant to provide a long-lasting fabrication. The UGG branding logo appears on the slippers upper. The Chestnut colored UGGs also feature the Tasman braid that is embroidered along its lining. To complete the design are the upcycled wool and the lyocell insole. The UGG Tasman Slipper Chestnut W made its debut on the market in November 2021, with an original retail price of $100.

Display Name: On Running Cloudtilt Remix Ivory Olive
Description: The On Running Cloudtilt Remix Ivory Olive brings soft neutral layering and technical cushioning together through a silhouette built around comfort, versatility, and understated modern design. The Cloudtilt line stands out because it softens the traditionally aggressive look of performance runners into something more streamlined and fashion conscious while still preserving the responsive cushioning and movement focused identity central to On Running footwear. The Ivory and Olive palette gives the sneaker a warm and natural atmosphere that feels clean and elevated without becoming overly minimal or sterile. Fans gravitate toward neutral Cloudtilt releases because they emphasize the sculpted sole geometry and flowing upper design while remaining easy to style across everyday outfits. The olive accents add subtle contrast and depth against the lighter ivory foundation, creating a balanced and highly wearable visual identity. Collectors especially appreciate how On Running continues evolving beyond performance athletics into broader lifestyle and fashion spaces without abandoning its technical roots. The overall presentation feels modern, comfortable, and highly adaptable while preserving the sleek and progressive identity associated with contemporary On Running silhouettes. The On Running Cloudtilt Remix Ivory Olive was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Anta Kai 2 Triple Black
Description: The Anta Kai 2 Triple Black brings a sleek and disciplined look to Kyrie Irvings Anta signature line, leaning fully into performance driven minimalism. The all black execution strips the Kai 2 down to pure form, emphasizing shape, structure, and intent without distraction. It feels focused and serious, reflecting Kyries precision oriented approach to the game and his preference for footwear that performs without excess noise. Collectors are drawn to this release because it highlights Antas growing confidence in design. The Kai 2 silhouette feels modern and controlled, and the triple black palette makes it adaptable both on court and off. Fans appreciate how the shoe feels purposeful and grounded, offering a signature model that communicates control, balance, and intensity rather than flash, making it a favorite for those who value subtle dominance in basketball footwear. The Anta Kai 2 Triple Black was released on May 31, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Phantom Light Crimson Smoke Grey Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Zip SP Phantom reimagines the classic silhouette through a functional twist that replaces traditional lacing with a zip up closure system. The Phantom base gives the shoe a clean and neutral look, while Black, Light Crimson, and Smoke Grey accents add contrast that enhances the layered upper. The zip construction introduces a more streamlined appearance, shifting the model into a more modern and technical direction without losing its core identity. Fans gravitate toward updated versions like this because they offer a new way to experience a familiar silhouette. The zip feature not only changes the look but also adds convenience, giving the shoe a more futuristic feel. The Phantom colorway keeps the design versatile, allowing it to work across a wide range of outfits while still carrying distinctive details. For collectors, releases like this represent how Nike continues experimenting with classic models, introducing new functionality while preserving the elements that made them iconic. The Nike Air Max 95 Zip SP Phantom has a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Reebok Pump Omni Zone II Dee Brown
Description: The Reebok Pump Omni Zone II Dee Brown takes its inspiration from the 1991 NBA Dunk Contest´s model worn by Dee Brown. This sneaker is made of a black leather upper dressed in a classic black, white, and orange color scheme. It features a mesh-cut collar, TPU overlays at the midfoot, and the famous orange "Pump" button on the tongue that activates a custom-fit air bladder built into the lining. Other details include embroidered "Reebok Basketball" branding below the tongue and an EVA midsole that sits on a retro multicolor outsole. The Reebok Pump Omni Zone II Dee Brown was released on the 5th of March 2021, retailing at $140.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Field Purple (GS)
Description: With a purple and black colorway, highlighted with metallic gold-colored eyelets along its laces, the Nike Air Jordan 12 Retro Field Purple (GS) is a bold sneaker for grade schoolers with a classic look. Its upper is made of both genuine and synthetic leather, its midsole is made of foam, and its outsole is made of rubber. Inspired by Gary Paytons Air Jordan 12 "Lakers" PE, with colors to match, the high-top Air Jordan 12 Retro Field Purple (GS) features a purple Jumpman logo on its black tongue. The Jumpman appears again displayed in yellow on its purple ankle tag, and the brands name appears along the side. Nike Air cushioning built into the heel provides comfort and support. What our experts like most about the Air Jordan 12 Retro Field Purple (GS) is its bold royal aesthetic with its high-contrasting regal color scheme. Its a stylish choice for any childs wardrobe. Originally released August 12, 2023, its retail price was $150.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 Sunrise
Description: The Nike Book 1 Sunrise introduces a bold design and imaginative materials in a dynamic color palette inspired by the shades of dawn with oranges, pinks, and purples. This modern silhouette reflects Nike's forward-thinking craftsmanship and offers a fresh approach to modern sneaker design. The Sunrise Book 1 by Nike features a knit upper in gradient tones transitioning from orange to light yellow, mimicking the colors of the sunrise. Structured overlays add durability, while the midsole uses lightweight foam for extra responsiveness. Subtle branding on the tongue and heel complements the futuristic look and feel. The Nike Book line reflects the brands evolution since it was founded in 1971 and combines visually appealing designs with the cutting-edge technological approach for which Nike is famous. What we love about the Nike Book 1 Sunrise is its seamless gradient knit upper, which highlights a new take on color blending in sports shoes, and its lightweight foam midsole. Released on 10th October 2024, it retailed at $140.

Display Name: Jordan Nu Retro 1 Low Golf Black White
Description: The Air Jordan Nu Retro 1 Low Golf Black White is Jordan Brand's most confident statement yet that the golf course deserves the same level of sneaker heritage attention as the hardwood, and it delivers that case through one of the cleanest and most wearable colorways in the entire Jordan Golf lineup. The Nu Retro 1 silhouette itself occupies an interesting position in Jordan Brand history, originally released in the early 2000s as an updated take on the Air Jordan 1 Low that traded some of the original's rawness for a refined, contemporary shape, and the 2025 golf conversion brings that same clean construction to the greens with performance modifications that keep the spirit of the shoe entirely intact. The all leather upper stays true to the Nu Retro 1's DNA with a nearly one to one recreation of the Jordan 1 Low toebox, while an extended mudguard panel embossed with the oversized Wings logo on the lateral side makes the golf orientation immediately clear without sacrificing the lifestyle appeal that makes this worth wearing beyond the course. The medial side carries a subtle Jumpman logo, the split rubber midsole and outsole deliver integrated golf spikes for reliable traction during swings, Jordan Golf branding on the insole grounds the performance intent, and a clean tongue with minimal branding keeps the overall look crisp and uncluttered. The Black White Cool Grey colorway is the definitive way to experience this shoe: the black toe box against the white mid-panel creates the sharp contrast that makes the Jordan 1 Low profile work so cleanly, and the grey midsole ties the build together without interrupting the primary palette. This is the rare golf shoe that you genuinely want to wear after your round ends, and for collectors who live at the intersection of Jordan heritage and the sport, the Nu Retro 1 Golf makes the case that the fairway has never looked this good underfoot. The Air Jordan Nu Retro 1 Low Golf Black White was released on January 7, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Correlate New Green Bright Mango (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max Correlate New Green Bright Mango (Womens) brings a retro-inspired style with a mix of textures and a Max Air unit for a classic vibe. The Nike Air Max Correlate New Green Bright Mango (Women's) design integrates white mesh across the tongues, toe boxes, and side panels, complemented by contrasting suede overlays on the forefoot, eye stays, and heels. Vibrant pops of New Green and Bright Mango adorn the tongues, heels, and eyelets. The distinct Max Air unit peeks out beneath the heel, paired with a rubber waffle outsole for reliable traction. Notable branding elements include black Swooshes on both the lateral and medial sides, a Nike wordmark and Swoosh on each tongue, and a rubber Nike tag on each heel. The standout attribute of the Nike Air Max Correlate New Green Bright Mango (Womens) is its multi-textured upper, providing a flexible and breathable fit. The women's-sized sneaker debuted for $95 on April 6, 2021.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Photo Blue
Description: Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Photo Blue feels like controlled chaos in sneaker form, leaning fully into CPFMs playful and unpredictable design language. The Swamp Sponge aesthetic gives the Dunk Low an exaggerated personality, using texture and bold contrast to make the shoe feel almost animated. Photo Blue accents cut through the organic chaos, grounding the look just enough to let the silhouette remain recognizable beneath the expressive layers. Collectors love this pair because it treats the Dunk as a canvas rather than a template. Every detail feels intentional and slightly offbeat, rewarding fans who appreciate CPFMs ability to blur art, fashion, and footwear into one object. It stands as a reminder that some of the most memorable sneakers are the ones willing to be strange, embracing individuality over mass appeal and turning wearability into conversation. The Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Photo Blue was released on 09/17/2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 PRM Duck Honey Dew
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 PRM Duck Anthracite was a special edition sneaker from the Ugly Duckling collection. Dressed in a mix of honeydew, anthracite, kumquat, and black color scheme, this shoe features an upper constructed with premium suede materials. Supple black highlights the base, with anthracite hits covering most of the center panel and heel. The mudguard and lining opt for a tonal kumquat, while honeydew accents the Swooshes, laces, and the embroidered duck motif on the heel. A white midsole with AIR units atop a honeydew-speckled outsole rounds out the design. The Nike Air Max 1 PRM Duck Anthracite made its debut on December 20th, 2022, retailing at $160.

Display Name: adidas D.O.N. Issue #7 Team Cloud White
Description: The adidas DON Issue 7 Team Cloud White delivers a clean and performance focused take on Donovan Mitchells signature silhouette through a fully tonal palette. The cloud white upper creates a bright and minimal look, while grey two accents add subtle depth that highlights the structure. The design feels streamlined and balanced, emphasizing clarity and versatility. Fans of the DON line appreciate how simpler colorways like this allow the silhouette to stand on its own without distraction. The monochrome approach makes it easy to wear across both on court and everyday settings. It is a sneaker that reflects modern performance design through simplicity and precision. The adidas DON Issue 7 Team Cloud White was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: UGG Lowmel Black (Women's)
Description: Crafted using recycled materials, the UGG Lowmel Black (Women's) is a comfortable sneaker designed to feel good, body and sole. This shoe is specifically designed for women. The upper of the Black (Women's) UGG Lowmel, built for comfort, is fashioned from black suede with recycled ballistic canvas mesh at the toe box and padded collar. A padded, oversized tongue and a black webbing pull tab at the heel to ease on/off are also black. Thick plaid laces made from recycled polyester fibers are meant to be worn loose and open. Tonal UGG branding is embossed on the tongue and lateral heel. The molded EVA footbed is supported under foot by a sugarcane EVA outsole with a starburst pattern for absorbing impact and providing grip. Our favorite aspect of this womens sneaker is the UGG plush upcycled wool sock liner and the Lyocell insole that envelope your foot in yet another layer of comfort. The UGG Lowmel Black (Women's) was released on August 1, 2023, for $150 retail.

Display Name: Dr. Martens Postal Supreme 4-Eye Shoe Supreme Black
Description: The Dr Martens Postal Supreme 4-Eye Shoe Supreme Black is the Spring 2026 chapter of one of the most consistently respected and culturally grounded collaborations in footwear, a partnership between Supreme and Dr. Martens that has been running since Fall 2015 and has reworked everything from six-eye boots to 3-eye shoes, Rousden Creepers, and Penton Tassel Loafers across nearly a decade of near-annual releases. The collaboration earns its longevity through a shared cultural logic that needs no explanation: Dr. Martens as the definitive footwear of British punk and grunge, Supreme as the founding institution of New York skateboarding and global streetwear, two labels that have spent their entire histories outfitting counter-culture movements with footwear that functions as much as it signals. The Postal Supreme is an entirely new silhouette developed exclusively for this collaboration rather than a rework of an existing Dr. Martens model, a 4-Eye Shoe that takes inspiration from the classic 4-Eye format and recalibrates it with proportions and details specific to the Supreme partnership. The Black colorway executes in smooth leather across the entire upper for a full stealth construction that is the most versatile and universally wearable option in the two-colorway release, the low-cut oxford profile working naturally across denim, work pants, and dressed-up contexts with equal ease. Dr. Martens' signature air-cushioned sole and padded collar are retained throughout, the functional foundations that make any Dr. Martens collaboration worth wearing rather than collecting, while co-branded insoles and a Supreme side tab provide the minimal branding that both brands' most thoughtful followers appreciate most. For collectors who follow the Supreme x Dr. Martens partnership because they understand what both brands have meant to underground culture since before either was mainstream, the Postal Supreme Black is the most considered and most wearable release the collaboration has produced in its current chapter. The Dr Martens Postal Supreme 4-Eye Shoe Supreme Black was released on April 30, 2026 with a retail price of $198.

Display Name: Nike Go FlyEase Triple Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Go FlyEase Triple Black (Women's) is a revolutionary lifestyle shoe recognized for its entirely hands-free entry and exit system. The shoe features a monochromatic colorway of Black/Black/Black. The design utilizes a unique bi-stable hinge mechanism that allows the foot to slide into the shoe without bending down, prioritizing convenience and accessibility. The lightweight upper and cushioned sole ensure comfort for all-day wear. This innovative design was released on October 5, 2024, with a retail price of $125. The uniform Triple Black application ensures a sleek, versatile, and understated aesthetic, allowing the groundbreaking hinge technology to be the focal point. This model is engineered for independence and speed of entry. Our experts commend the truly game-changing hands-free Go FlyEase hinge mechanism, perfectly concealed within the versatile Triple Black silhouette.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Kay Yow Think Pink (2026)
Description: The Nike Kobe 6 Protro Kay Yow Think Pink 2026 honors a powerful cause through bold and unmistakable color. Black forms the foundation, while Hyper Pink and Pink Foam accents ignite the textured upper with vivid contrast. The sculpted silhouette stays true to the Kobe 6 identity, combining performance precision with expressive design. Every detail carries symbolic weight while maintaining on court focus. Kay Yow editions consistently resonate with collectors for both their message and their presence. The vibrant pink against black creates strong visual impact that stands out in any rotation. It merges performance heritage with meaningful storytelling in a way that feels authentic. Powerful and purposeful, this pair continues a legacy of awareness and excellence. The Nike Kobe 6 Protro Kay Yow Think Pink 2026.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Reverse Laney (Women's)
Description: Jordan Brands popular Air Jordan 1 model is getting Michael Jordan's Emsley A. Laney High School treatment with the release of the Womens Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Reverse Laney. The Womens Air Jordan 1 High OG Reverse Laney is the second iteration of the Air Jordan 1 to receive the Laney treatment, after Nike previously released the sneakers in mens sizing in 2013. This version of the Laney features a leather upper, with blue and yellow color blocking, and a black and red Nike Air logo on the tongue. The Air Jordan 1 Retro high OG Reverse Laney (W) released February 17, 2023, with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Premium Black Volt
Description: Nike Vomero Premium Black Volt takes a comfort focused running silhouette and gives it a bold visual punch through contrast and tone. The black base grounds the design, while volt accents inject energy and modern attitude, creating a shoe that feels both technical and lifestyle ready. It reflects Nikes ability to evolve performance heritage into something that fits everyday movement and style. Collectors appreciate this version of the Vomero because it highlights balance. The premium approach elevates the silhouette beyond pure function, while the color story keeps it expressive without being overwhelming. It feels like a shoe designed for long wear and long term relevance, appealing to fans who value cushioning, presence, and understated confidence in equal measure. The Nike Vomero Premium Black Volt was released on 11/13/2025 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential PRM Neutral Olive Cacao Wow
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential PRM Neutral Olive Cacao Wow boasts premium materials and an earthy look with neutral olive, black, and cacao wow color blocking alongside an exposed Air unit in the heel. The Nike Air Max 1 debuted back in 1987, and it continues to be a popular silhouette. This iteration has a layered look with an upper that sports mixed materials and textures. A cacao wow-colored mudguard and lends way to a hemp-colored hemp cloth-like material that adorns the toe box, tongue and collar. Smooth neutral olive overlays adorn the eyestay, side panels, and heel counter. Youll spot black Nike branding on the sides, heel, and tongue. Our experts love the way the colors of the land all blend together for a rich, toasty feeling. The Nike Air Max 1 Essential PRM Neutral Olive Cacao Wow priced for $150 retail when it was released on September 1, 2024.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus OG Hyper Blue
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus OG Hyper Blue is a striking revival of a classic silhouette that continues to captivate sneaker enthusiasts. This iconic model showcases a bold color scheme, featuring a gradient upper that transitions from black to hyper blue, creating a visually stunning effect. The shoe's design is further enhanced by its signature wavy TPU overlays, which not only contribute to its distinctive aesthetic but also provide structural support. Built for both style and comfort, the Air Max Plus OG Hyper Blue incorporates Nike's renowned Air cushioning technology in both the heel and forefoot. This innovative system offers superior impact protection and responsive cushioning, making it ideal for all-day wear. The mesh upper ensures breathability, while the padded collar and tongue provide a snug, comfortable fit. Completed with a durable rubber outsole featuring a unique traction pattern, this sneaker delivers excellent grip on various surfaces. Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a perfect blend of retro style and modern performance. The Air Max Plus OG Hyper Blue offers unparalleled comfort and head-turning looks, making it an essential addition to any sneaker collection.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Burgundy Crush (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Burgundy Crush Womens delivers a monochromatic twist on a timeless classic. Wrapped entirely in Burgundy Crush, the smooth leather upper keeps the iconic Air Force 1 shape intact while offering a rich and saturated tone. The low cut silhouette and stitched overlays preserve the design that has defined decades of street style. Burgundy executions add depth and elegance to the AF1 without straying from its everyday versatility. The tonal approach keeps the look cohesive and bold at the same time. It feels refined yet approachable, continuing the legacy of one of Nikes most enduring silhouettes. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 Burgundy Crush Womens was released on October 20, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Moon Shoe SP Jacquemus Aluminum Pink (Women's)
Description: The Nike Moon Shoe SP Jacquemus Aluminum Pink Womens reinterprets one of Nikes earliest running concepts through a refined and fashion forward lens. The aluminum pink tone softens the silhouette, while sail and university red accents add subtle contrast that highlights its vintage inspired shape. The low profile build and minimal structure feel intentional, staying close to the spirit of the original Moon Shoe while elevating it through modern execution. This collaboration stands out because it bridges archival design with contemporary fashion. Jacquemus brings a lighter and more expressive touch, transforming a historically significant silhouette into something that feels current and wearable. Fans appreciate how it respects the past while offering a fresh perspective that fits seamlessly into todays style landscape. The Nike Moon Shoe SP Jacquemus Aluminum Pink Womens was released on March 9, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG All-Star Cool Grey (PS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG All Star Cool Grey PS delivers a youth sized version of a classic All Star inspired colorway through a soft and balanced palette. The cool grey upper creates a refined and understated base, while sail and game royal accents add contrast that enhances the design. Black details provide structure, keeping the look cohesive. Fans of All Star releases appreciate how colorways like this bring a mix of subtle and bold elements into a timeless silhouette. The GS format makes it accessible for younger wearers while maintaining the same identity. It is a sneaker that reflects heritage design with a modern and youthful touch.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black White
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black White stands as a timeless pillar in sneaker culture, marrying the heritage of Michael Jordan's rookie silhouette with a sleek, monochromatic design. This sneaker speaks directly to those who appreciate the origins of sneaker culture while staying firmly rooted in the present. Its black and white colorway delivers a stark, yet sophisticated contrast that transcends fleeting trends, making it an enduring staple in any collection. Crafted for the streets but born on the hardwood, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black White retains the classic elements that catapulted it to famepremium materials, an Air-Sole unit for comfort, and the iconic Wings logo. This sneaker is not just a piece of history; it's a canvas for self-expression, appealing to the stylistic sensibilities of a new generation who values both legacy and modernity. On February 24, 2024, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Black White was released for $180, instantly becoming a cherished addition to the rotations of sneaker enthusiasts. Its clean and versatile aesthetic, combined with its storied past, cements its status as a lifestyle essential that pays homage to the past while stepping boldly into the future.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Jubilee 25th Anniversary
Description: In 2020, Jordan Brand celebrated 25 years of one of their most popular models, the Jordan 11. To commemorate the famed silhouette, Michael Jordan and Nike released the Jordan 11 Jubilee. The sneakers distinct colorway was inspired by original sketches from the designer of the 1995 sneaker, Tinker Hatfield. The Jordan 11 Jubilee showcases everything Hatfield envisioned for the sneaker 25 years ago; a performance product that can be worn easily both on and off the court. Features such as the two types of leather on the upper with hits of metallic lettering and Jumpman emblem add luxe elements to the athletic sneaker. A white midsole and foggy translucent outsole deliver contrast to the black sneaker. Carbon fiber plating on the sole provides stability and power to the wearers feet on the court. The Jordan 11 Jubilee 25th Anniversary released in December of 2020 for $220.

Display Name: Nike ST Charge Iron Grey
Description: The Nike ST Charge Iron Grey blends modern basketball performance design with bold color contrast through a silhouette built around speed, responsiveness, and contemporary court aesthetics. The ST Charge line embraces a more futuristic and sculpted identity compared to traditional basketball sneakers, using layered paneling and aggressive shaping to create a dynamic visual flow throughout the shoe. The combination of Iron Grey and Photon Dust gives the silhouette a sleek and technical foundation, while Hyper Pink and Metallic Gold accents inject sharp bursts of energy that make the sneaker feel fast, expressive, and highly modern. Fans gravitate toward newer Nike basketball silhouettes because they represent the ongoing evolution of on court footwear beyond retro inspired design language. The darker grey tones create a strong base that allows the brighter accent colors to stand out dramatically without overwhelming the overall construction. Collectors especially appreciate basketball shoes that combine performance functionality with lifestyle level visual impact, and the ST Charge fits naturally into that space. The overall presentation feels futuristic, energetic, and deeply connected to the bold color experimentation that continues shaping modern Nike Basketball design culture. The Nike ST Charge Iron Grey was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Melo (2025)
Description: The Jordan 12 Retro Melo (2025) revives a cherished chapter in Jordan Brand history, paying tribute to Carmelo Anthonys legendary rookie season. Originally released in 2004 and inspired by Melos Denver Nuggets PE, the silhouette makes a full-fledged comeback this summer in a faithful recreation. The sneaker is draped in clean white leather with hits of university blue on the lining, outsole, and heel tab, plus touches of metallic silver on the eyelets that elevate its nostalgic edge. The 2025 version is all about authenticity, returning in true-to-original form rather than leaning into alternate takes or exclusive sizing. Jordan Brand has tapped into its early 2000s vault for this retro, offering longtime collectors and new fans a chance to experience one of Melos most iconic pairs. Its a release that nods to the past while fitting seamlessly into the current wave of retro basketball heat. The Jordan 12 Retro Melo (2025) released on May 17, 2025, for a retail price of $200. Featuring a white, university blue, and metallic silver colorway, this drop serves as a must-have moment for sneakerheads chasing that OG Melo magic.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro What The (2025) (GS)
Description: First released in 2013, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro What The (2025) (GS) returns triumphantly. This eclectic model embodies the spirit of the Kobe 8 series, combining several colors and designs into a single, vibrant sneaker. The What The (2025) Nike Kobe 8 Protro comes in grade school sizing. It takes an audacious approach to design, featuring a right shoe that showcases a mesh built-in red snakeskin print with a yellow Swoosh and lime green lining. The left shoe is mismatched, showcasing a contrasting blue snakeskin print with a crimson Swoosh that matches its textile lining. A reflective Nike wordmark graces the medial side of the left shoe, with its counterpart getting a yellow Swoosh. The colorful sneaker rides atop a Cushlon midsole, with the forefoot section getting a trusty Zoom Air unit. What our experts love about the Nike Kobe 8 Protro What The (2025) (GS) is its bold and colorful design that combines nearly 30 colorways from the silhouettes history to create a wild, mismatched masterpiece. The grade-school sneaker debuted for $120 on April 13, 2025.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Canyon Purple (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Canyon Purple W was inspired by Tinker Hatfields 1989 design. This shoe replaces the traditional leather or nubuck build. This Air Jordan 4 for women has an upper that is crafted from shaggy suede in a vibrant purple color finish. Lime green accents land on the speckled eyelets and midsole, while the signature Jumpman logo graces the woven tongue tag in Safety Orange. The bright hues are offset by contrasting hits of black on the molded wings, Jumpman-embossed heel tab, and herringbone-traction rubber outsole. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Canyon Purple W was released on the 15th of October 2022, and originally retailed for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe takes cues from the 2018 Air Jordan 1 High Bred Toe with its signature black and red color blocking. The upper is composed of white, black, and red leather, with black and red leather smothering the vamp, Swoosh, and heel while white leather is prominent on the quarter panel. From there, an embroidered Wing logo on the heel and a Jumpman tongue label complete the design. The Jordan 1 Low Bred Toe released in December of 2021 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: Alexander McQueen Oversized White Black
Description: DISCLAIMER: The included laces for this product vary by season. The Alexander McQueen Oversized White Black is an oversized sneaker that is primarily made out of calf leather. The Alexander McQueen Oversized White Black sneaker a rounded rubber toe as well as a rubber sole. The majority of the shoe is a bright white color. On the heel of the shoe, there are black details. The shoe also has perforated air holes in order to help make them be more breathable. The Alexander McQueen Oversized White Black also has white laces. The Alexander McQueen Oversized White Black first became available on the market in December of 2019. This model of shoes had a starting retail price of $590.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 270 Summit White Pink Spell (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 270 Summit White Pink Spell Womens brings a soft and clean color palette to one of Nikes most recognizable lifestyle runners, combining a summit white base with pink spell accents that add a subtle pop of color. The design emphasizes the large Air unit in the heel, giving the silhouette its signature look while keeping the upper minimal and streamlined. The light tones enhance the overall shape, making the shoe feel airy and modern. Fans of the Air Max line appreciate how colorways like this highlight the comfort driven design without adding unnecessary complexity. The white and pink combination keeps it versatile while still feeling fresh, making it easy to wear across different settings. It is a sneaker that balances performance inspired cushioning with everyday style, offering a clean and approachable option within the lineup. The Nike Air Max 270 Summit White Pink Spell Womens was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Diamond Shorts (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid Diamond Shorts for Grade School sizing (GS) is a Jordan brand colorway with a white and black scheme. Designed to honor the iconic Diamond Jordan basketball shorts, this mid-top sneaker features a white leather upper with black suede overlays on its eyelets, collar, and toe area. Additionally, it features nylon tongues, suede Nike Swooshes on its side panels, stamped wings logos on its collars, a rubber midsole, and a rubber outsole. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Diamond Shorts GS was released on 9th February 2022. During its release, it had a retail price of $100.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Aqua (GS)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 White Aqua (GS) presents the Gel-1130 in a kids size. This technical running shoe boasts performance-enhancing technologies and a colorway of crisp white and aqua. The upper construction features breathable mesh in white with a slightly loose weave. Aqua accents add splashes of color on the tongue branding, plastic pieces on the midsole, and along the upper. Like running sneakers in the ASICS catalog from the early 2000s, this shoe displays synthetic overlays with black and metallic silver stripes. In terms of technology, gel units in the midsole provide supportive cushioning and protect against impact stress. Padding around the collar and in the tongue contributes to the sneakers bulky, Y2K aesthetic. Our StockX experts like the metallic silver mudguard that protects the toe area and carries a hint of aqua. The grade schoolsized ASICS Gel-1130 White Aqua (GS) was originally released on March 3, 2024, and sold for $85.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Royal Toe (GS)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High Royal Toe (GS) features a white and royal blue leather upper with black overlays and black, textured Swooshes. From there, a tapered outsole and a white Air Jordan Wings logo near the heel complete the design. The Jordan 1 Retro High Royal Toe (GS) released in May of 2020 and retailed for $170 USD.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY White
Description: With a look inspired by the Converse Chuck Taylors of the 70s, the Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70s Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY White has a high-top that blends the collab branding and collaboration. Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70s Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY White has a white canvas upper with double stitching and shiny metal eyelets. It also features heart icons on the sidewall. The lower part of the shoe mostly features a vulcanized rubber midsole and outsole. Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70s Hi Commes des Garcons PLAY White was released in January 2019 and retailed at a price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Carmine (2021) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro Carmine 2020 for Grade School (GS) uses a White/Carmine/Black colorway in this grade schoolsized shoe. A black mudguard threads through the white midsole and edges the carmine nubuck upper and white leather overlays and collar. A carmine lace lock features black Jumpman icons. A carmine Jumpman and Air logo enhance the collar. The white Nike Air logo and Swoosh appear on the black insole. A denser white rubber and a carmine Jumpman amplify the translucent white outsole. White laces and a black tongue and sock lining complete the look. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Carmine 2020 GS was released on February 13, 2021, at a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Off Noir Toe
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid Off Noir Toe reworks the familiar black toe concept with darker nuance and modern tone. Black and off noir overlays anchor the upper, while summit white panels provide clarity and contrast. The color blocking echoes traditional Jordan patterns but introduces a slightly muted edge that feels more understated and contemporary than bright retro executions. Collectors gravitate toward black toe variations because they connect directly to foundational Jordan history. The off noir detail adds subtle depth, making the shoe feel refined rather than purely nostalgic. Fans appreciate how the Mid silhouette continues to reinterpret classic blocking with fresh color adjustments. It stands as a versatile and balanced entry in the Jordan 1 lineup, blending heritage reference with a darker and more mature finish. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Off Noir Toe was released on December 20, 2024 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 2 Retro A Ma Maniére Airness
Description: Jordan Brand and A Ma Maniére utilized a similar aesthetic from their 2021 Air Jordan 1 collaboration for the Air Jordan 2 A Ma Maniére. Constructed of a chalky, cream leather with a cracked finish and dark brown detailing, the Air Jordan 2 A Ma Maniére nods to the 2021 Air Jordan 1 A Ma Maniére and its luxe, vintage-inspired look. At the heel, TPU heel caps are featured in their original shape, but with a semi-translucent styling. From there, a snakeskin-patterned midsole references the Swooshes found on the two companies' collaborative AJ1. The Air Jordan 2 A Ma Maniére released in June of 2022 and retailed for $225.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Utility
Description: With black leather and Durabuck paneled construction, the upper of the Air Jordan 12 Utility sets the stage for its glittery sole to shine. The sole is composed of Nike Grind, a material made of a collection of recycled materials originating from leftover Nike manufacturing materials. The Air Jordan 12 Retro Utility released in August of 2021 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone (GS)
Description: Air Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone GS brings an earthy and grounded tone to one of Jordan Brands most iconic silhouettes. The Cave Stone colorway emphasizes texture and depth, giving the Air Jordan 4 a mature and composed look that feels timeless rather than trend driven. In grade school sizing, the shoe still carries the same strength and identity as the adult versions. Collectors gravitate toward this release because of its versatility and balance. The muted palette allows the classic Jordan 4 details to stand out naturally, from the mesh panels to the wing eyelets. It feels like a colorway designed to age gracefully, appealing to fans who appreciate subtle reinterpretations of heritage silhouettes. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Cave Stone GS was released on 09/06/2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Light Ginger (2022)
Description: The Air Jordan 14 Retro Ginger 2022 is the fourteenth signature release from the brand. These Retro Ginger 2022 by Nike, from the tag Retro, are a relaunch of the popular original "OG" colorway Air Jordan 14. The sneaker is a mid-top model and features a golden upper and black and white highlights with the Jumpman logo on the outer part of both sides of the pair, the in-soles, the outer sole, and the back and front parts of the shoes. The Air Jordan 14 Retro Ginger 2022 was released in August 2022 for a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Georgetown (2021)
Description: Jordan Brand embraced the spirit of the NCAA March Madness basketball tournament with the Air Jordan 3 Retro Midnight Navy. The colorway pays homage to the school colors of the Georgetown Hoyas, one of the most renowned college basketball programs in the NCAA. The upper of the Air Jordan 3 Retro Midnight Navy is composed mostly of a Midnight Navy tumbled leather while smooth perforated grey leather appears at the ankle and on the lacing system. In traditional Jordan 3 Cement styling, grey Elephant Print mudguards are located on the toe and heel. Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel tab, a grey Air Unit, and a white and grey sole completes this retro design. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Midnight Navy released in March of 2021 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Tiffany
Description: The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Tiffany is a running shoe featuring an upper that pairs Metallic Silver mesh fabric with Metallic Silver overlays. The ASICS stripes pop against the Silver upper in Aqua Blue, grounded by black accents at the heel, midsole, and heel collar. The midsole and outsole continue the Aqua Blue stripes motif, balanced by a white insertthe tongue and rear heel feature ASICS and Gel branding. ASICS, the Japanese footwear brand, was established in 1949, and the brand has developed a serious reputation for excellence in running footwear. The Gel-Kayano 14 is a descendant of the original Gel-Kayano, released in 2008, and it is known for its comfort and impact absorption. The Tiffany colorway name is a nod to the jewelry association of its Aqua Blue and Metallic Silver aesthetic. Our experts feel that the best feature of the Gel-Kayano Tiffany is its Metallic Silver mesh upper, which is an uncommon shade for mesh. The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Tiffany was released on February 1, 2025, and retailed for $150.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Brown Orange Tint Gum (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Brown Orange Tint Gum Womens delivers a warm and earthy take on the silhouette through a grounded and natural palette. The preloved brown upper creates a rich and muted base, while orange tint accents add a subtle pop of color that enhances the overall design. The gum sole reinforces its retro indoor roots, keeping the look balanced. Fans of neutral colorways appreciate how this version blends subtle contrast with everyday wearability. The combination of brown and orange gives it a distinct but understated identity. It is a sneaker that reflects a balance between heritage design and modern color execution. The adidas Handball Spezial Preloved Brown Orange Tint Gum Womens was released on February 10, 2024 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Chicago Toe
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid Chicago Toe features a black, white, and Gym Red leather and nylon upper. From there, a nylon tongue featuring a black "Jumpman" logo set and a white midsole complete the design. The Jordan 1 Mid Chicago Toe released in April of 2020 and retailed for $115.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Clay Grey (Women's)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Clay Grey (Women's) combines modern design with retro running influences, including a neutral tone blend. Its silhouette reimagines classic ASICS design, which has always been focused on sensible athletic wear. The Cream Clay Grey Gel-1130 by ASICS women's shoe features a breathable mesh upper with overlays in synthetic leather for durability. The color palette includes creamy off-white tones with grey accents for a clean, minimalist finish. ASICS branding appears on the side panels and tongue to add a subtle contrast. The Gel-1130 was first introduced in 2008 and draws inspiration from the Gel-1000 series and highlights ASICS' rich history with performance footwear. One thing we, the experts, love about the ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Clay Grey (Women's) is its GEL technology for exceptional shock absorption and the stabilizing Trusstic System for added support during movement. Released on August 12, 2024, it retailed at $95, giving you reliable innovation to thrive.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Rose Water
Description: The ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Rose Water is a running shoe featuring an upper with a Cream mesh fabric base. Softly geometric Pink suede overlays delineate the lace panel and upper structure, accented by ASICS stripes in Pink and Cream on the sides. The bubbled midsole in Cream and white displays GEL technology inserts, and ASICS GEL branding appears on the tongue, rear heel, and side heel. Japanese athletic wear brand ASICS heritage dates to 1949, and the brand creates its new designs by referencing and building upon elements of its vast archive of past styles. The Gel-NYC references the Gel-Nimbus 3 design, which debuted in at the start of the 2000s, while also incorporating elements from the Gel-MC Plus V design. The result is a modern-retro hybrid that is long on style and comfort. One great feature of the Gel-NYC is its outsole, with that wave pattern for traction and chunky aesthetic, which presents an alternate option for a wearable neutral tone combinations. The ASICS Gel-NYC Cream Rose Water released on February 20, 2025, and retailed for $130.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Light Fusion Red
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Light Fusion Red features a white leather upper with Light Fusion Red overlays and Laser Orange on the Swoosh and ankle wrap. A woven Nike label stitched atop the tongue completes the design. The Air Jordan 1 Light Fusion Red released in June of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 12.1 PACE Cream Black
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 121 PACE Cream Black introduces a forward thinking take on one of the brands most recognized performance lines, blending heritage running DNA with a more modern visual approach. The cream and black color combination creates a sharp contrast that highlights the layered construction and technical elements across the upper. The silhouette feels structured and supportive, staying true to the Kayano identity while evolving its overall presence. This version resonates with both performance focused runners and lifestyle collectors who appreciate ASICS for its consistency and innovation. The PACE designation adds a sense of progression, giving the model a refreshed identity within the broader Kayano lineage. It is a release that reflects the brands ability to push forward while maintaining the core elements that have made the Kayano line a staple for years. The ASICS Gel Kayano 121 PACE Cream Black was released on March 6, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Blue Fusion Gum
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten Blue Fusion Gum is a stylish and versatile sneaker that combines classic design with modern comfort. Featuring a sleek blue fusion upper, these shoes offer a fresh and eye-catching look that's perfect for casual wear. The gum sole provides excellent traction and durability, making these sneakers suitable for various surfaces and activities. Crafted with attention to detail, the Onitsuka Tiger Tokuten boasts quality materials and expert construction. The low-top silhouette offers flexibility and ease of movement, while the padded collar and tongue ensure a comfortable fit. With its timeless appeal and functional design, this shoe is an excellent choice for those seeking a blend of style and practicality in their footwear. We at StockX believe this product is great for everyday wear, offering both comfort and a touch of retro-inspired style that complements various outfits.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Sweetgrass Deep Ocean
Description: The New Balance 9060 Sweetgrass Deep Ocean is a maximalist lifestyle silhouette that adds an "organic" color twist to futuristic geometry. The upper, rendered in a refreshing Green/Sweetgrass/Deep Ocean/Silver Metallic palette, features a dual-density midsole with ABZORB and SBS cushioning. Released on April 1, 2025, for $150, the design is grounded by an exaggerated, segmented outsole. Our team praises the "Sweetgrass" green tones; they provide a mature, nature-inspired contrast to the industrial "Silver Metallic" hits, resulting in a sophisticated and highly stable trainer that captures the current trend for "eco-technical" aesthetics.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Ben & Jerry's Chunky Dunky
Description: Nike SB and Ben & Jerrys joined forces to add a new animated release to SB history with the Nike SB Dunk Low Ben & Jerrys Chunky Dunky, now available on StockX. Drawing inspiration from Ben & Jerrys colorful ice cream pint packaging, this release goes beyond a simple new colorway and features unique detailing that has never been used on the Dunk Low silhouette. This Nike SB Dunk Low is composed of a cloudy blue sky and green meadow leather upper with faux cowhide on the overlays and tongues. Yellow Swooshes on the side resemble melting ice cream with leather protruding the standard pattern in a drip-like fashion. Tie-dye interiors, Ben & Jerrys style Nike branding on the heel tab, and a white and green sole completes the design. These sneakers released in May of 2020 and retailed for $100 USD.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R No Sew Pack Black Cement
Description: The New Balance 1906R No Sew Pack Black Cement delivers a modern performance inspired silhouette with a clean and structured approach to materials. The black base sets a strong and versatile foundation, while cement grey accents add contrast that highlights the layered design. The no sew construction gives the upper a smoother and more streamlined appearance, reinforcing the technical feel of the model. Fans of the 1906R appreciate how it blends comfort and retro running influence with updated construction methods. This version leans into a more refined aesthetic, making it easy to style while still carrying a performance edge. It is a sneaker that reflects New Balances ability to evolve its running heritage into a modern lifestyle staple. The New Balance 1906R No Sew Pack Black Cement was released on August 21, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike A'ja Wilson A'One Leo Lights (Women's)
Description: The Nike A'ja Wilson A'One Leo Lights (Women's) is a cutting-edge basketball shoe designed for the modern female athlete. Featuring a sleek black base with vibrant accents of Hyper Pink, Laser Pink, and Pink Foam, this shoe is as stylish as it is functional. The A'One model, inspired by WNBA star A'ja Wilson, combines Nike's latest performance technologies with a fashion-forward aesthetic that stands out both on and off the court. Engineered for optimal performance, the A'One boasts responsive cushioning and enhanced stability to support quick cuts and explosive movements. The breathable upper provides excellent ventilation, while the durable outsole offers superior traction on various surfaces. With its eye-catching design and advanced features, the Nike A'ja Wilson A'One Leo Lights is perfect for athletes seeking a high-performance shoe that doesn't compromise on style. Our team of experts believes this product is ideal for serious basketball players and fitness enthusiasts who demand both style and substance from their footwear. The combination of cutting-edge technology and bold design makes it a versatile choice for competitive play and casual wear alike.

Display Name: Nike Ja 2 TB Triple White
Description: The Nike Ja 2 TB in Triple White delivers Ja Morant's signature basketball shoe in the cleanest and most universally versatile colorway available in the Team Bank lineup, the all-white execution stripping the Ja 2's design down to its most architectural and construction-focused presentation where the silhouette's performance features and proportions carry the entire visual conversation without any color assistance. TB specifications within Nike Basketball's catalog are designed for team purchase and on-court use, bringing the Ja 2's full performance package including its Zoom Air cushioning and lockdown upper construction to a price point and colorway context that makes the shoe accessible for team and training environments alongside individual collector acquisition. Triple white on a performance basketball shoe creates a visual character that is simultaneously pure and slightly uncompromising, the all-white palette demanding consistent care while rewarding that attention with a clean and timeless look that works across every basketball context from practice to game day. Ja Morant's signature line has generated genuine collector enthusiasm across both releases through the specific energy and visual identity that reflects his explosive and crowd-pleasing playing style, and the TB Triple White is the most clean-slate version of the Ja 2 platform available, presenting the shoe's design and engineering in their most unmediated and color-neutral form for collectors and players who want the performance without the colorway commitment. White basketball shoes carry a specific and beloved visual heritage in the sport stretching back across decades of classic court footwear, and the Ja 2 in triple white participates in that tradition while delivering contemporary Nike cushioning technology that makes it as relevant on today's courts as any of its more colorfully executed platform siblings. At one hundred and twenty-five dollars the TB Triple White is the most accessible entry point into the Ja 2 ecosystem. The Nike Ja 2 TB in Triple White was released on July 25, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry
Description: Nike added a luxe twist to the Dunk Low with the Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry. The Curry colorway first made its way onto the Nike Dunk Low in 1999 as part of the Nike CO.JP (Concept Japan) collection. Since then, there have been multiple Curry Dunk releases in Nikes catalog, including the 2003 Nike Dunk High Premium Curry, 2010 Nike Dunk Low VNTG Dark Curry, and now, the Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry. The upper of the Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry is composed of Sail hairy suede with Medium Curry overlays and a Bone-colored Swoosh. Nike branding is present on its traditional woven tongue tag and Medium Curry heel patch. A Sail nylon tongue, Sail midsole, and Medium Curry outsole complete this retro design. The Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry released in March of 2021 and retailed for $110. The Nike Dunk Low Medium Curry shock dropped again in May of 2024 and retailed for $125.

Display Name: Nike Tailwind 79 Black White
Description: The Nike Tailwind 79 Black White is part of a series of retro-style sneakers that was first released in the 1970s. The upper of the Tailwind 79 is made of a breathable black and white mesh with black suede overlays on the toe box and heel. It also features the Nike Swoosh on both sides in a contrasting white color, along with Nike branding on the tongue. The sneaker also offers additional accents in the form of black laces and a white midsole that features Nike's Air cushioning technology, providing a comfortable feel during wearing. The shoe has a low-cut design that is designed to allow easy movement. Our experts say that one of the defining features of the Nike Tailwind 79 Black White is its outsole. It is made of a durable rubber material and features a waffle pattern, providing traction on various surfaces. The shoe was originally released on June 29th, 2020 at a retail price of $100.

Model: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo
Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo White Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo White Metallic Silver delivers a sharp and modern take on a performance driven silhouette. White dominates the upper, creating a clean and focused look, while metallic silver details highlight the sculpted lines and layered construction. Football grey and royal pulse accents add subtle contrast, keeping the design dynamic without overpowering its streamlined shape. Fans appreciate this colorway because it emphasizes speed and clarity. The GT Cut 3 is built around quick movement and responsiveness, and this palette reinforces that intent visually. Collectors are drawn to its versatility, seeing it as a performance shoe that translates naturally into off court wear. It feels confident and precise, offering a refined option that balances technical energy with understated style. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo White Metallic Silver was released on June 9, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Terrascape White Croc Blue Tint
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Terrascape White Croc Blue Tint reworks a classic silhouette through a more rugged and material focused lens, blending white blue tint pure platinum chrome tones into a design that feels slightly more technical. The Terrascape approach introduces updated textures and layered elements that give the shoe a modern edge while still preserving the recognizable Air Max 90 structure. Collectors are drawn to Terrascape versions for their balance of familiarity and innovation. This pair keeps the iconic lines intact while adding depth through material variation and subtle color shifts. It feels refreshed without losing its identity, making it a strong option for those who want a classic with a slightly more experimental finish. The Nike Air Max 90 Terrascape White Croc Blue Tint was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Model: Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP
Display Name: Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Voltage Purple
Description: The Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Voltage Purple is a striking fusion of classic design and modern aesthetics. This eye-catching sneaker features a vibrant Voltage Purple upper, accented with Total Orange and Black details, creating a bold and energetic look. The shoe's design pays homage to Nike's rich heritage while incorporating contemporary elements for a fresh, updated feel. Built for both style and comfort, the Air Max Waffle Racer SP boasts Nike's renowned Air Max technology in the sole, providing superior cushioning and support for all-day wear. The waffle-inspired outsole offers excellent traction and durability, making these sneakers suitable for various urban environments. With its unique colorway and innovative features, this shoe is perfect for sneaker enthusiasts and fashion-forward individuals alike. Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a standout sneaker that combines retro charm with modern performance, offering both visual appeal and functional comfort.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Golden Gals Metallic Silver (Women's)
Description: The women's Nike Dunk Low Golden Gals Metallic Silver (W) features a white canvas upper with metallic silver cracked leather overlays and black Swooshes. From there, a woven tongue label and matching sole completes the design. The women's Nike Dunk Low Golden Gals Metallic Silver (W) released in December of 2021 and retailed for $110.

Display Name: New Balance 1906A Tech Explosion
Description: The New Balance 1906A Tech Explosion gives the 1906A an exaggerated technical makeover with overlapping, deconstructed overlays in a variety of metallic and matte hues. As New Balance digs into its retro catalog, the 1906A Tech Explosion joins the ranks of reimagined technical running shoes with early 2000s roots. It features a classic, white mesh base with exaggerated synthetic and genuine leather overlays in Silver Metallic, Gold Metallic, and Castlerock. Each overlay stands out against the base, highlighting the individual design details. Nylon ribbons in Castlerock thread through the New Balance "N" and hang over the midsole, giving the sneaker an unfinished look. Our StockX experts like the yellow-orange stains on the white midsole. They elevate the sneaker beyond models with an entirely off-white midsole, and pay homage to the shoes retro design elements. The New Balance 1906A Tech Explosion was released on July 24, 2024, and sold for $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Ducks of a Feather University of Oregon Egg or Duck
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Ducks of a Feather University of Oregon Egg or Duck channels collegiate pride through bold green energy.
