Dressed in White with Gorge Green and Green Spark accents, the upper highlights Oregon inspired detailing while keeping the classic AF1 silhouette intact. The low cut build and sturdy sole reinforce its heritage roots. University themed Air Force 1 releases consistently resonate with fans who appreciate school spirit and limited storytelling. The vibrant green palette reflects Oregons unmistakable identity, making the pair feel exclusive and spirited. It captures the balance between athletic tradition and streetwear influence in a single cohesive design. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Ducks of a Feather University of Oregon Egg or Duck was released on November 27, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike SB Zoom Nyjah 4 White Black
Description: The Nike SB Zoom Nyjah 4 White Black focuses on simplicity and performance, using a clean white upper to emphasize the silhouettes structure. Black accents add contrast that highlights key areas, keeping the design sharp and functional. The low profile build supports quick movement and control. This pair stands out because it reflects Nyjah Hustons precise and technical approach to skateboarding. The design avoids unnecessary elements, focusing instead on performance and durability. Fans appreciate how it delivers exactly what is needed without distraction, making it a reliable option for serious skating. The Nike SB Zoom Nyjah 4 White Black was released on July 8, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Incense Raincloud Arid Stone
Description: The New Balance 9060 Incense Raincloud Arid Stone is a shoe that combines design elements of the early 2000s with the 2010s to create a modern look. This iteration of the New Balance 9060 has a dark Raincloud gray mesh upper forming its base for breathability and flexibility. Suede overlays cross the upper for support in Arid Stone and different shades of beige and brown, supporting the toe box, sides, and heel. Thecompany´s logo, a letter N, appears on each side panel in silver, and NB also adorns the heel collar. The tongue also contains a subtle branding piece. The chunky and curvy midsole is beige and white and made of ABZORB foam cushioning for comfort and energy return. The chunky designs of the midsole pieces add a futuristic touch to the otherwise simple shoe. The New Balance 9060 Incense Raincloud Arid Stone was released on December 15, 2024, for $160.

Display Name: Nike Mind 002 Light Smoke Grey (Women's)
Description: The Nike Mind 002 Light Smoke Grey Womens softens the futuristic silhouette through a muted and versatile palette. Finished in Light Smoke Grey with Photon Dust, Hyper Crimson, and Chrome accents, the upper emphasizes layered texture and sculpted detail. The clean grey base allows the subtle pops of color to stand out naturally. Grey tones add refinement and everyday wearability to the Mind 002s bold structure. Hyper Crimson accents inject controlled energy without overwhelming the design. It feels balanced and modern, offering a wearable take on Nikes evolving lifestyle direction. The Nike Mind 002 Light Smoke Grey Womens was released on January 8, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Lakers
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Lakers delivers a bold and team inspired take on the silhouette through a vibrant and recognizable color palette. Court purple dominates the upper, while university gold accents add a bright contrast that reflects the Lakers identity. White and black elements provide balance, keeping the design cohesive. Fans of NBA inspired colorways appreciate how releases like this connect basketball culture with everyday footwear. The purple and gold combination gives it strong visual identity and team pride. It is a sneaker that reflects heritage design with a bold and energetic twist.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Luminous Green (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro Luminous Green Womens brings vibrant energy to the Jordan 5 through a colorway that feels expressive and modern without overpowering the silhouette. The luminous green accents contrast beautifully against softer neutral tones, giving the shoe a bold personality while keeping its structure balanced. It feels confident and playful, designed to stand out while still respecting the Jordan 5s iconic shape. Collectors gravitate toward this release because it shows how color can redefine a familiar design. The Jordan 5 has always thrived on contrast, and this version uses that strength to create a look that feels fresh and wearable. Fans appreciate it as a womens Jordan that blends power and personality, offering a sneaker that feels energetic, stylish, and deeply rooted in Jordan Brand history. The Air Jordan 5 Retro Luminous Green Womens was released on August 30, 2025 with a retail price of $205.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Palomino
Description: Introducing the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Palomino. Drenched in a stylish Black/Metallic Gold/Palomino/Sail colorway, this sneaker commands attention, blending tradition with a bold, modern edge. The meticulously crafted leather and nubuck upper, touched with shades of palomino and black, resonate opulence. Signature details like the iconic Jordan wings logo and the flowing Swoosh bring the perfect juxtaposition, harmonizing old-school vibes with new colors. The Metallic Gold Nike Air logo on the tongue adds the perfect pop of color. Launched on September 2, 2023, with a launch price of $180, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Palomino offers a fresh take on a timeless classic. Elevate your collection, and get your pair on StockX now.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Ferrari (2025) (GS)
Description: Inspired by high-performance motorsport design, the Jordan 14 Retro Ferrari (2025) (GS) pairs the sleek lines of the AJ14 with a bold Challenge Red/Black-Vibrant Yellow-Anthracite palette. Grade school sizing delivers the same striking presence as the adult model, highlighted by a rich red upper, sculpted side pods, and a yellow Jumpman shield that nods to classic supercar badges. Perforated panels and a breathable mesh tongue help keep feet cool, while the asymmetrical collar supports natural ankle movement on the court or on the go. The sculpted midsole and glossy accents echo carbon-fiber cues, giving this pair a dynamic, road-ready aesthetic that stands out in any rotation. Built for comfort and control, the Jordan 14 Retro features responsive cushioning with Zoom Air in the heel and forefoot for quick takeoffs and soft landings. A Phylon midsole, internal shank, and molded heel counter enhance stability, and the durable rubber outsole with herringbone traction grips hardwood and pavement with confidence. Signature details, like the bold heel tab, metallic aglets, and numbered "XIV" callouts, honor the legacy of Michael Jordans fourteenth signature shoe while pushing it into modern streetwear territory. Whether styled with everyday fits or laced up for practice, this GS edition brings performance tech and head-turning Ferrari-inspired flair to young sneaker fans. Our team loves this product because it blends iconic AJ14 heritage with vivid color blocking and dependable, all-day comfort for growing feet.

Display Name: adidas Campus 80s Jeremy Scott Bones Pink
Description: The adidas Campus 80s Jeremy Scott Bones Pink represents a wild collaboration between designer Jeremy Scott and the iconic sneaker company. By dressing an iconic silhouette with imagination and whimsy, adidas x Jeremy Scott create a singular pair of kicks. The Jeremy Scott Bones Pink adidas Campus 80s features an upper of leather covered in bright pink faux fur with black animalistic striping. Black leather is used to form the serrated 3-Stripes that run across the side panel. This same black leather is used for the heel tab, which sports white adidas trefoil branding. A faux fur tongue with long and wild fur at the top matches the laces and textile sock liner. A black rubber sole unit grounds this shoe, and the outsole features a herringbone traction pattern. The most distinguishable standout details of this shoe are the large white bone lace dubrae, which can be affixed to the laces, giving this shoe a prehistoric vibe. The adidas Campus 80s Jeremy Scott Bones Pink was released on February 15, 2023, for $140 retail.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Rare Air
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Rare Air pays homage to the original 1985 design with a contemporary twist, blending classic elements with modern updates. This iteration features a white leather base complemented by neutral grey collars and overlays, reminiscent of the OG "Storm Blue" colorway. Deep royal blue accents on the ankle flaps and outsole inject a vibrant touch, while the wear-away black Swooshes reveal a layer of red beneath, adding a dynamic and customizable aspect to the sneakers aesthetic. Notable design details include alternating "Air Jordan" and "Nike Air" lettering on the Wings logos, offering a unique nod to the brands heritage. The muslin midsole enhances the vintage-inspired look, making this pair a must-have for collectors and new enthusiasts alike. Released on April 5, 2025, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Rare Air was available at a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro SP A Ma Maniére (Women's)
Description: After a slew of collaborative releases with adidas and Nike, DC-based sneaker boutique A Ma Maniére teamed up with Jordan Brand to release a womens exclusive Jordan 3 with the Air Jordan 3 A Ma Maniére (W). The release aligns with their short film Raised By Women, an ode to the strides and accomplishments of everyday women in urban communities. The Air Jordan 3 A Ma Maniére arrives featuring a white tumbled leather upper with Medium Grey suede on the toe wrap, eyestay, heel wrap, and ankle. Each panel of leather on the upper has a raw trim, revealing a natural, tan edge. To provide a vintage aesthetic, the eyelets, heel tab, and lower portion of the midsole are yellowed. From there, the tongue on the left sneaker features an embroidered A Ma Maniére logo, while the right features a Jumpman logo. Quilted satin lining on the interior of the shoe adds an element of luxury. A white, Violet Ore, and Medium Grey sole with a classic Air unit in the heel completes this retro look. The women's Air Jordan 3 A Ma Maniére released in April of 2021 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Craft Ivory
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro Craft Ivory is a sophisticated blend of iconic heritage and contemporary design. This rendition of the legendary silhouette comes in an Ivory/Grey Mist/Cream colorway, offering a refined and elegant take on a classic. The sneaker's design pays homage to the heritage of the Jordan brand while infusing modern elements that resonate with today's fashion-forward crowd. Every aspect of the Jordan 3 Retro Craft Ivory, from its premium materials to its timeless design, exudes luxury and class. It represents a perfect balance between the Jordan brand's rich history and the evolving trends of sneaker culture. The subtle colorway enhances its versatility, making it suitable for various occasions, whether for casual outings or more formal events. Released on February 3, 2024, for $210, the Jordan 3 Retro Craft Ivory quickly became a sought-after item among sneaker enthusiasts. Its elegance, coupled with the Jordan brand's reputation for quality and style, makes it a valuable addition to any collection.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro White Thunder (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro White Thunder (GS) is a striking new release that pays homage to one of the most iconic colorways in Jordan Brand history. Inspired by the original Black and Yellow Thunder 4s, this grade school version brings a fresh take to the classic design. The upper features a predominantly black nubuck material, providing a sleek and bold look, while white accents create a sharp contrast. The Jumpman logo appears on both the tongues flight patch and the heel, ensuring that this sneaker remains true to its roots while introducing a new visual twist. The Air Jordan 4 holds a special place in the world of basketball sneakers, originally released in 1989 as the first Jordan model to be released globally. Its unique design elements, such as the plastic wings and mesh netting, set it apart from its predecessors and have made it a fan favorite over the years. The White Thunder colorway continues this legacy by offering a fresh take on the silhouette that captures the essence of the original while adding a modern touch. Released on August 24, 2024, the Air Jordan 4 Retro White Thunder (GS) retailed at $160. The black, white, and black colorway provides a striking contrast that makes this sneaker stand out in any collection. This grade school release ensures that even younger fans of the Jordan brand can step out in style with a piece of basketball history.

Display Name: adidas Adizero Cloud White
Description: Designed for pure speed and minimal weight, the adidas Adizero in Cloud White/Cloud White/Cloud White is a dedicated racing shoe for the road. The upper utilizes an ultra-thin mesh that provides maximum breathability during high-intensity runs, while the low-profile midsole is engineered for a snappy, responsive feel. Though its release date varies by region, it retailed for $120. Our experts highlight the inclusion of a high-traction rubber outsole, which provides the necessary grip for fast cornering and wet road conditions, making it a reliable tool for serious training.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Medium Soft Pink (TD)
Description: The Jordan 5 Retro Medium Soft Pink (TD) scales down the iconic basketball shoe for toddlers, featuring a delicate, pastel colorway. The shoe features White, Medium Soft Pink, and Black. The design retains the signature details of the Jordan 5, including the molded collar and tongue design. The combination of White leather and soft Medium Soft Pink accents provides a light, playful take on the aggressive silhouette. This edition is set for release on October 11, 2025, with a retail price of $90. The crisp White upper is accented gently by the Medium Soft Pink on the midsole details and inner lining, with small touches of Black providing minimal contrast. This shoe successfully translates the aggressive, high-performance look of the Jordan 5 into a fun, accessible size. Our team finds the aggressive profile of the Jordan 5 beautifully softened by the application of White and delicate Medium Soft Pink, offering high style in a durable toddler format.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG A Ma Maniére
Description: The Air Jordan 1 A Ma Maniére features a premium cracked leather upper with burgundy reptilian-textural leather collars and Swooshes. Silky quilted lining and custom woven tongue and insole labels add a sense of luxury. At the base, a yellowed sole provides a vintage feel to complete the design. The Air Jordan 1 A Ma Maniére released in November of 2021 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Olive Strata Cream White
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Olive Strata Cream White keeps terrace heritage alive with a rich and earthy update. Dressed in Olive Strata with Cream White accents and a gum sole, the low profile silhouette maintains its classic indoor sport roots. The soft upper and streamlined shape give it that timeless European feel that has defined the Spezial for decades. Originally built for handball courts, the Spezial has become a staple in street culture thanks to its clean lines and understated branding. The olive tone adds depth without overpowering the design, while the gum outsole reinforces its retro character. It feels effortless and authentic, a sneaker that thrives on subtle color shifts rather than dramatic redesigns. The adidas Handball Spezial Olive Strata Cream White was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: adidas BadBo 1.0 Bad Bunny Rise
Description: The adidas BadBo 10 Bad Bunny Rise delivers a bold and experimental take on the silhouette through a collaboration that leans into layered design and distinctive color blocking. The off white upper creates a soft and neutral base, while core black accents add structure and contrast. The gum sole grounds the design, giving it a classic finish that balances the more modern elements. Fans of Bad Bunny collaborations appreciate how each release pushes beyond traditional adidas design, blending music influence with fashion forward execution. The mix of tones and materials gives the shoe a strong identity that stands out immediately. It is a sneaker that reflects creativity, cultural influence, and modern streetwear energy. The adidas BadBo 10 Bad Bunny Rise was released on March 28, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (TD)
Description: Scaled down for the smallest sneaker fans, the Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (TD) brings iconic hoops heritage to toddler feet with a bold palette of Black, Fire Red, Deep Royal Blue, Dark Smoke Grey, and Tech Grey. Classic AJ4 design lines show up in the molded support wings, grid-style side panels, and a prominent heel tab that makes pull-on a breeze. A soft leather-like upper pairs with breathable mesh accents to balance durability and comfort, while the Rare Air styling delivers standout energy in a compact profile. The look is finished with crisp Jumpman hits and color-blocking that mirrors the larger sizes, making this toddler edition a perfect match for family lace-ups or photo-ready fits. Built with busy days in mind, the Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air (TD) focuses on comfort and convenience. Elastic laces create an easy-on, secure feel without complicated tie-ups, and a plush, padded collar cushions little ankles. Underfoot, a lightweight foam midsole softens every step, while a grippy rubber outsole with flex grooves helps provide traction as kids cruise, crawl, and explore. Style ID IB4387-003 marks this standout colorway, and the timeless AJ4 details ensure it pairs effortlessly with everything from joggers to mini jerseys. Whether youre introducing a future baller to a legend or completing a coordinated set, this toddler-ready take brings court-born style to everyday play. Our team thinks this product is great for pairing head-turning style with easy, comfy wear that keeps up with nonstop toddler movement.
Colorway: Black/Fire Red/Deep Royal Blue/Dark Smoke Grey/Tech Grey

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 12.1 Silver Green
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 121 Silver Green pairs Pure Silver overlays with vibrant Green and Cream accents for a look that feels both technical and expressive. The layered upper highlights the models structured design, while GEL cushioning underfoot reinforces its reputation for stability and comfort. The metallic silver base adds a futuristic edge that contrasts cleanly with the green detailing. This release stands out because it balances performance credibility with bold contrast. The silver and green combination feels dynamic without overpowering the silhouettes core lines. Fans of the Kayano series appreciate when ASICS refreshes the model through thoughtful color execution while maintaining its supportive identity. It is a versatile and modern take on a long standing stability staple. The ASICS Gel Kayano 121 Silver Green was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Two-Toned Grey (GS)
Description: Nike Sportswear added to their Dunk Low lineup with this Nike Dunk Low Two Toned Grey with grade school sizing (GS) colorway, arriving in a mix of gray tones. The Nike Dunk Low Two Toned Grey (GS) comes constructed in a full leather build featuring light and dark shades of gray. The clean two-toned Grey colorway sees the slightly darker shade of neutral overlaying the base layer, while the white Swoosh logo, laces, and midsole complete the two-tone look. A gray rubber outsole completes the design. The Nike Dunk Low Two Toned Grey (GS) was released in March of 2022 at a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Nike KD 17 B.A.D.
Description: The Nike KD 17 B.A.D. puts a personal spin on Kevin Durants seventeenth signature shoe, honoring his late grandmother, Barbara A. Davis. Like the Aunt Pearl line, which predominantly features pink details, the B.A.D. line leans into lavender hues, and the KD 17 B.A.D. is no exception. The sneaker showcases a gradient lavender hue on the breathable mesh upper with synthetic leather accents at the heel and a wavy TPU cage at the midfoot, providing structure. The tongue gets an iridescent KD patch, and Kevin Durants signature is etched at the heel. Underfoot, a large forefoot Zoom Air unit partners a springy Nike Air foam for shock absorption and cushioning, while a rubber outsole resembling a topographical map provides traction. Something we love about the Nike KD 17 B.A.D. is its balance of performance and tribute. The sneaker offers a breathable mesh upper, supportive overlays, and responsive cushioning, all wrapped in a design that honors Barbara A. Davis in elegant lavender hues. The sneaker debuted on the 1st of January 2025 for $150.

Display Name: Nike React Pegasus Trail 5 Gore-Tex Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike React Pegasus Trail 5 Gore Tex Black Anthracite brings weather ready performance into the Pegasus line, combining a trail focused build with a fully black and anthracite palette. The design emphasizes durability and protection, while the Gore Tex construction adds a layer of resistance that makes it suitable for tougher environments. The silhouette remains streamlined, balancing technical function with a clean look. Fans of trail running and outdoor gear appreciate how this model blends performance with versatility. The dark colorway keeps it adaptable for everyday wear, while the underlying technology ensures it holds up in different conditions. It is a sneaker that captures Nikes approach to functional design, offering a reliable option for those who move between city and trail. The Nike React Pegasus Trail 5 Gore Tex Black Anthracite was released on August 21, 2024 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Hyper Pink (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Hyper Pink Womens pushes a technical runner into bold territory with a layered pink palette. Hyper Pink, Pink Foam, and Playful Pink wrap the upper, softened by Summit White detailing that keeps the look balanced. The open mesh base and structured overlays maintain the early two thousands running aesthetic that made the Vomero 5 a cult favorite. This colorway feels unapologetically expressive, turning a performance rooted silhouette into a standout statement. The varying pink tones add depth and movement across the panels, while the supportive sole keeps the shoe grounded in comfort. It captures the current wave of appreciation for tech runners that blend nostalgia with fearless color. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Hyper Pink Womens was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low 72-10 (GS)
Description: With its supportive structure and comfortable sole, the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 72 10 (GS) for grade schoolers works well for more intense exercise, as well as everyday walking around. ? ?This unique and supportive model has an off-white, cushioned sole, with a bright white midsole. The shoes body is made up of black leather, both smooth and pebbled. It is a low rise model that ends at the bottom of the ankle. ? ?The model was designed to be comfortable for long periods. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 72 10 (GS) for grade schoolers had an initial release date of May 2022. The starting retail price for this model was $190.

Display Name: Salomon XT-Whisper Void Icy Pink Black Silver
Description: The Salomon XT-Whisper Void Icy Pink/Black/Footwear Silver is a May 4, 2026 release from Salomon's XT-Whisper Void program, retailing at $165 with style code L49099000 in the Icy Pink/Black/Footwear Silver colorway, confirmed by Fenom, Feature, and multiple authorized Salomon retailers. As confirmed by Feature and Good As Gold, the XT-Whisper Void builds on the XT-Whisper's foundation while reimagining an archival running silhouette, constructed with anti-debris and 3D open mesh, featuring the signature Agile Chassis System for stability, a Mud Contagrip outsole with Chevron lugs for superior traction, a protective mudguard for added durability, SensiFit technology with a unique wavy panelling application for secure fit, a molded OrthoLite sockliner, and QuickLace for a confident adjustable closure. Good As Gold confirmed the XT-Whisper Void was a retro trail racer remade in ethereal expression, originally made for female racers yet adopted by all, with an iridescent metallic finish that shifts with the light for a dynamic future-forward edge. Up There Store confirmed the XT-Whisper Void debuted in a collaboration with British singer and songwriter Ama Lou. The Icy Pink/Black/Footwear Silver colorway delivers soft icy pink tones against black and subtle silver accents for the most ethereally feminine and most visually striking execution in the XT-Whisper Void program. Retail price $165. The Salomon XT-Whisper Void Icy Pink/Black/Footwear Silver is the May 4, 2026 L49099000 SS26 anti-debris-3D-open-mesh Agile-Chassis Mud-Contagrip-Chevron-lugs SensiFit-wavy-panelling OrthoLite QuickLace iridescent-metallic-finish archival-running-reimagined for the Salomon collector who wants the ethereally feminine icy-pink-and-black colorway from the Salomon XT-Whisper Void program. The Salomon XT-Whisper Void Icy Pink/Black/Footwear Silver was released on May 4, 2026 with a retail price of $165.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Coyote Brown Sahara Sun
Description: The Salomon XT 6 Coyote Brown Sahara Sun channels desert inspired tones into a performance driven silhouette, creating a warm and cohesive color story. Coyote brown sets the base, while safari and sahara sun accents introduce lighter and brighter elements that reflect natural landscapes. The structure remains technical, built for stability and endurance across different environments. Fans are drawn to this pair because it feels rooted in outdoor exploration while still carrying strong lifestyle appeal. The earthy palette makes it versatile, while the subtle contrast keeps the design interesting. It stands as a colorway that highlights the connection between performance footwear and nature inspired aesthetics. The Salomon XT 6 Coyote Brown Sahara Sun was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: adidas F50 Elite Messi FG Ivory Blue Burst (El Ultimo Tango - Last Tango)
Description: The adidas F50 Elite Messi FG Ivory Blue Burst Icey Blue carries the weight of a genuine send off, part of the El Ultimo Tango collection built to honor Lionel Messi's final chapter on the world's biggest stage. The clean ivory and blue palette draws a direct line back to the F50.6 TUNIT boots Messi wore as an eighteen year old bursting onto the international scene in 2006, closing the loop on two decades at the very top of the sport with a design that nods to where it all began. Underneath the nostalgic color story sits a fully modern boot built for the way Messi actually plays. The HybridTouch+ upper delivers a soft, premium touch on the ball, while the Lace Cover+ closure expands the striking surface for cleaner contact on every pass and shot. Halocage+ technology reinforces the upper through explosive cuts and direction changes, and the lightweight Speedsystem+ soleplate keeps the whole boot feeling every bit as agile as the player it was built to honor. For collectors and players alike, this is as close as it gets to owning a piece of Messi's legacy. The adidas F50 Elite Messi FG Ivory Blue Burst Icey Blue was released on June 5, 2026 with a retail price of $280.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 College Grey Cave Stone
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 College Grey Cave Stone layers muted tones across its signature running silhouette. College Grey anchors the upper with cool neutrality, while Cave Stone overlays introduce earthy depth. Black accents add structure and definition, highlighting the complex paneling that defines the model. The cushioned midsole reinforces comfort, staying true to the Vomeros performance roots. Fans drawn to understated palettes will appreciate how grey and stone tones create dimension without overpowering the design. The balanced color blocking keeps the silhouette versatile across seasons. It merges retro running influence with refined everyday styling seamlessly. Calm and cohesive, this pair delivers comfort with subtle character. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 College Grey Cave Stone was released on July 21, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Astro Grabber SP Bode Chlorophyll
Description: The Nike Astro Grabber SP Bode Chlorophyll revives one of Nikes earliest football silhouettes through a handcrafted and narrative driven lens. Chlorophyll green defines the upper with an organic and vintage feel, complemented by black and treeline accents that add contrast and texture. Lawn toned details soften the palette, giving the shoe an earthy and archival presence that feels deeply intentional rather than recreated. This collaboration resonates because Bode approaches design with reverence and storytelling. Fans appreciate how the Astro Grabber is treated as a historical artifact, not just a retro sneaker. Collectors value the hand inspired aesthetic and material depth, seeing it as a bridge between sport, craft, and culture. It feels personal and nostalgic without relying on trends, standing out as a thoughtful reinterpretation of Nike history through modern perspective. The Nike Astro Grabber SP Bode Chlorophyll was released on March 14, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Dusk
Description: The Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Dusk takes center stage in a collaboration between A Ma Maniére and the Air Jordan Brand. It is part of a dynamic two-sneaker pack and is dressed in black and burgundy crush with additional black and pale ivory accents. This high-top silhouette features a black suede upper. Pale-ivory mesh netting made out of A Ma Maniéres distinctive A logo is found on the quarter and part of the tongue. The sleek design is complemented by black-on-black Nike Air embroidery on the heel and a silver reflective tongue that displays black Jumpman branding. The black polyurethane midsole, embellished with shark-tooth detailing in a deep burgundy hue, provides a striking contrast, while the pre-aged translucent rubber outsole gives it some added flair. Black laces can be held tightly in place with a translucent Nike-branded lace lock. A standout feature is the visible Air pack in the heel that sports A Ma Maniére branding on the lateral side of the shoe. The Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Dusk sneaker sold for $225 during its retail debut on November 24, 2023.

Display Name: New Balance 992 MiUSA Shadow Grey
Description: The New Balance 992 MiUSA Shadow Grey is a Made in USA Spring Summer 2026 seasonal release featuring pre-faded Shadow Grey leather at the quarter panel, Turtledove mesh for the base layer, and Team Away Grey nubuck wrapping the toe, mudguard, and heel, creating a fully neutral tonal palette where each material's slightly different grey tone adds depth without introducing color contrast. The Shadow Grey's leather quarter panels are finished with an aged, pre-faded quality that gives the shoe a vintage character from first wear, departing from the cleaner premium suede approach typical of most MiUSA 992 seasonal releases. The 992 was introduced in 2006 as New Balance's 100th anniversary model and third installment in the 99X series, featuring ABZORB cushioning at the heel and forefoot with compression resistance, ENCAP midsole technology combining lightweight foam with a polyurethane rim, and a pigskin suede and mesh upper construction assembled at New Balance's Massachusetts facilities under the brand's Made in USA program. The Shadow Grey arrives as part of the June 2026 batch of MiUSA releases that concludes New Balance's SS26 domestic production seasonal program with a grey theme across both the 992 and the simultaneously released 1300 Slate Grey. Released June 11, 2026 at $200 retail with style code U9927WX through newbalance.com and select retailers. The New Balance 992 MiUSA Shadow Grey was released on June 11, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Pale Ivory Psychic Blue (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Pale Ivory Psychic Blue Womens delivers a softer and more refined take on the classic high top silhouette, blending pale ivory and coconut milk tones with subtle hits of psychic blue. The color palette feels calm and balanced, giving the shoe a clean presence while still adding enough contrast to keep it visually engaging. It leans into a more elevated and wearable direction without losing the identity of the original design. What makes this pair stand out is how it uses color restraint to its advantage. The lighter tones create a smooth and cohesive look, while the blue accents add just enough personality to break up the neutral base. It is a version of the Jordan 1 that feels understated but intentional, appealing to collectors who prefer a more refined aesthetic. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Pale Ivory Psychic Blue Womens was released on March 7, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Nike Shox Ride 2 Cool Grey Celestine Blue
Description: The Nike Shox Ride 2 Cool Grey Celestine Blue blends tonal sophistication with signature cushioning presence. Cool Grey dominates the upper with sleek neutrality, while Celestine Blue accents add subtle brightness across the layered construction. Metallic Silver touches enhance the futuristic lines, emphasizing the mechanical feel of the silhouette. The Shox Ride platform delivers that unmistakable column driven cushioning beneath the streamlined design. Fans appreciate how grey based palettes elevate the Shox Rides bold structure without overwhelming it. The soft blue accents create contrast that feels fresh and modern. It captures the balance between technical heritage and wearable style. Refined yet striking, this pair delivers Shox energy with controlled detail. The Nike Shox Ride 2 Cool Grey Celestine Blue was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Black Metallic Reimagined
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid SE Black Metallic Reimagined is a mid-height basketball shoe featuring a leather upper. The Jordan 1 Mid traces its origins to Michael Jordans first signature shoe, which became a time-honored classic and legend among Nike lore for its NBA regulation-busting colorway, in 1984. Decades later, the AJ 1 is responsible for Jordan becoming its own brand since 1997, and the brands designers still manage to innovate its signature style in fresh variations. The Black Metallic Reimagined Jordan 1 Mid SE features a monochrome Black colorway that is used for the overlays, underlays, Nike Swoosh, and midsole, while the tongue and outsole coordinate in Silver Metallic. White laces pop and coordinate with the Jordan wings logo on the ankle, and the University Red tongue tab sports Air branding and the Jumpman logo. Our StockX experts feel that the best feature of the Jordan 1 SE Reimagined is its Black colorway, which recontextualizes the shoes construction and branding. The Jordan 1 Mid SE Black Metallic Reimagined released on January 23, 2025, and retailed at $135.

Display Name: New Balance 992 MiUSA White Royal Purple Fuchsia
Description: The New Balance 992 MiUSA White/Team Royal/Purple Fuchsia reintroduces the brand's celebrated heritage silhouette, originally released in 2006 for New Balance's hundredth anniversary, through a modern, more expressive color story rather than a direct retro reissue. A crisp white leather base anchors the design, layered with cream suede overlays at the mudguard and blue mesh underlays that bring energy and breathability without overwhelming the shoe's overall neutral foundation. Purple fills the oversized N logo with a clean white outline, while pops of fuchsia land at the heel and midsole for genuine contrast against the lighter upper. Bright yellow visibility foam peeking out from the tongue adds a distinctly retro nostalgic touch, tying the shoe back to New Balance's running archive even as the overall palette pushes into more vibrant territory. ABZORB cushioning at the heel and forefoot delivers the comfort and stability the 992 has long been known for, paired with an ENCAP midsole combining lightweight foam and a durable polyurethane rim. Arriving as the third drop in New Balance's Spring Summer 2026 Made in USA collection, this White/Team Royal/Purple Fuchsia pairing reflects the season's broader push toward bolder, more energetic colorways within the historically understated 992 lineup. The New Balance 992 MiUSA White/Team Royal/Purple Fuchsia was released on March 26, 2026 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low '85 Neutral Grey
Description: The Jordan 1 Low 85 Neutral Grey represents an effort by Nike to return to the brands vintage roots. The sneaker finds inspiration in Michael Jordans first lifestyle sneaker, the Air Jordan 1 released in 1985, but bears a similar resemblance to the Nike Dunk Low. Several details highlight the shoes vintage aesthetic, including the lightly pre-yellowed midsole that provides a worn-in appearance. The sneaker features a leather upper, perforations across the vamp, and a prominent Swoosh on the side. The Summit White, Light Smoke Grey, Neutral Grey, and Sail color blocking is similar to the OG version, but the grey tones are darker. Our experts love that the Jordan 1 85 Neutral Grey updates the Air Jordan 1 Low OG Neutral Grey released in 2020. Unlike the first reissue of the OG model, the Jordan 1 85 Neutral Grey version offers more details that pay homage to the sneakers of 1985. The Jordan 1 Low 85 Neutral Grey was released on October 25, 2023, and retailed at $170.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Pink Taffy Calcium
Description: The New Balance 9060 Pink Taffy Calcium balances softness and structure through a confident and expressive color palette. Pink taffy brings warmth and personality to the upper, while calcium tones keep the look grounded and cohesive. The sculpted sole and layered panels give the shoe its signature presence, allowing color and form to work together seamlessly. This pair connects with fans because it feels fun without sacrificing design integrity. The 9060 thrives on contrast and exaggeration, and this colorway leans into that energy with clarity. Collectors appreciate how the silhouette continues to evolve through thoughtful palettes, making each release feel distinct. It is a sneaker that celebrates individuality, offering a bold yet wearable option rooted in New Balance innovation. The New Balance 9060 Pink Taffy Calcium was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: New Balance 1890 Joe Freshgoods Naughty Things
Description: The New Balance 1890 Joe Freshgoods Naughty Things continues the storytelling driven approach that defines the collaboration, bringing a darker and more playful tone through its Purple and Black palette. The color combination gives the sneaker a moody and expressive identity, while the 1890 silhouette provides a structured and performance inspired base that supports the narrative. Joe Freshgoods consistently builds concepts that feel personal and layered, and this release reflects that through a design that balances bold color with intention. Fans gravitate toward this partnership because it consistently delivers sneakers that feel connected to culture and storytelling rather than just aesthetics. The Purple and Black execution adds depth and contrast, making the shoe stand out without becoming overwhelming. The silhouette itself carries a modern running influence, but the collaboration shifts it into a more lifestyle focused direction. For collectors, releases like this represent the continued evolution of New Balance collaborations where narrative, color, and cultural relevance come together to create something more meaningful within the sneaker space. The New Balance 1890 Joe Freshgoods Naughty Things was released on April 30, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Patent Bred (GS)
Description: A modified version of Michael Jordans first signature sneaker, the grade school Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Bred Patent GS is an outstanding colorway. Since its release, the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Bred Patent GS has earned a lot of market success primarily because it boasts accented details, including an upper constructed from patent leather, a woven tongue tag, a debossed Air Jordan Wings logo on the ankle, an encapsulated Air-sole cushioning, and an enhanced red rubber outsole. The gradeschool Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Bred Patent GS released in December 2021. It retailed at $130.

Display Name: adidas Adistar Control 5 Preloved Blue Dark Brown (Women's)
Description: The Adidas Adistar Control 5 in Preloved Blue, Dark Brown, and Grey Five for Women is a running and training shoe that approaches the performance footwear category from an aesthetic perspective that feels genuinely contemporary and fashion forward without compromising any of the functional architecture that makes the Adistar Control 5 platform a serious choice for athletes and active wearers who need real stability and cushioning support from their footwear. Preloved Blue is a colorway description that carries its own design philosophy embedded in the name, evoking the slightly faded and worn quality of well used and well loved blue that develops over time in denim and cotton, and bringing that warm and nostalgic tonal quality to a performance shoe gives the Adistar Control 5 a color personality that feels more lifestyle and wardrobe oriented than the typically brighter and higher contrast palettes that dominate the running shoe category. Dark brown grounds the preloved blue in an earthy and warm complementary tone that creates a sophisticated and considered color relationship across the shoe, while grey five provides a neutral balance point that keeps the combination from feeling overly fashion forward or impractical in active settings. Women's specific performance footwear at this level from Adidas delivers not only gender appropriate fit engineering and last geometry but also color and aesthetic considerations that reflect a genuine understanding of how women approach the intersection of performance capability and personal style in their athletic footwear choices, and the Preloved Blue Dark Brown colorway of the Adistar Control 5 speaks directly to a female athletic consumer who wants her training shoes to look as considered and intentional as the rest of her wardrobe without sacrificing any of the support and cushioning that serious activity demands. The Adistar Control 5's stability focused platform makes this shoe particularly well suited to wearers who need structured support during training, running, or high impact activity, and the preloved blue colorway ensures it transitions naturally from the gym or running path into everyday casual wear without requiring a shoe change. This is performance footwear designed for the woman who does not separate her athletic life from her aesthetic life. The Adidas Adistar Control 5 in Preloved Blue, Dark Brown, and Grey Five Women's was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Total Orange
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Total Oranges upper layers are vibrant neon orange mesh with contrasting white and light gray synthetic leather overlays. The eye-catching womens Total Orange Nike Zoom Vomero 5 sneaker uses the black details to accentuate the Bold Orange, such as the leather black Swoosh edged in orange on the midfoot, along with black strip panels overlaying the orange toecap mesh. The orange is balanced throughout the shoe with neon laces and matching neon orange cushioned midfoot pods. Underfoot, the sneaker sits on a midsole infused with full-length dual Zoom Air units in the heel and forefoot. A sleek black cage wraps the midfoot, and a gray cage wraps the heel for both structure and style. The sneaker is a bold revival of Nikes early?2000s tech-runner DNA, reimagined with a fiery colorway. What our StockX experts appreciate most is the high-quality cushioning provided by the midfoot pods and Zoom Air units, as well as the cushioning insole and foam lining. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Total Orange was released on September 20, 2024, and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Black White Metallic Silver
Description: Channeling early-2000s running heritage, the Nike P-6000 Black White Metallic Silver brings a fast, layered aesthetic to everyday wear. A breathable black mesh base is framed by sleek horizontal and vertical overlays in metallic silver, creating dynamic lines that highlight the Swoosh and amplify depth across the upper. Crisp white accents add contrast, while a padded tongue and collar enhance step-in comfort. Underfoot, a responsive foam midsole cushions every stride, and a durable rubber outsole with waffle-inspired traction grips city streets and gym floors alike. Finished with reflective-style sheen on key panels, this colorway catches light and attention from every angle, making it an easy upgrade for any rotation. Designed for versatility, the P-6000 pairs retro tech with modern comfort, delivering all-day support whether youre commuting, traveling, or styling a laid-back fit. The sculpted midsole and supportive overlay system stabilize the foot without feeling bulky, while the streamlined profile keeps the silhouette sharp with jeans, cargos, or performance gear. This mens model (style CD6404-026) lands in a timeless Black/White/Metallic Silver palette that slides seamlessly from weekday to weekend, and the 2000s-inspired details nod to Nikes storied Pegasus lineage. Its a bold yet wearable statement piece that elevates streetwear looks while standing up to daily mileage. Our team loves this product because it blends retro runner attitude with modern cushioning and durable traction for dependable, standout style all day.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Fauna Brown Velvet Brown (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Fauna Brown Velvet Brown Womens embraces rich earth tones through layered texture. Fauna Brown shapes the upper, complemented by Velvet Brown and Mink Brown accents that deepen the palette. The intricate mesh and overlay construction adds visual movement, while the cushioned sole reinforces the models comfort driven identity. Its warm tonal execution feels grounded and confident. Fans who gravitate toward brown based sneakers will appreciate the cohesive spectrum of shades. The layered browns create depth without heavy contrast, making it easy to integrate into everyday rotation. It blends retro running structure with lifestyle ready color effortlessly. Warm and refined, this pair stands out through tonal richness. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Fauna Brown Velvet Brown Womens was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike V5 RNR Jackie Robinson Day
Description: The Nike V5 RNR Jackie Robinson Day honors one of baseballs most important figures through a design that feels respectful and understated. The black pale ivory medium ash palette keeps the look grounded, allowing the significance of Jackie Robinson Day to carry the meaning behind the release. Collectors appreciate themed releases like this because they connect footwear to broader cultural history. The design remains wearable while still holding deeper significance, making it more than just a standard colorway. It stands as a tribute piece that resonates with both sports fans and sneaker collectors. The Nike V5 RNR Jackie Robinson Day was released on April 15, 2026 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Puma LaMelo Ball LaFrancé Amour 3x Black
Description: The Puma LaMelo Ball LaFrancé Amour 3x Black reflects LaMelos bold personality through a design that feels playful, expressive, and rooted in his personal brand. The LaFrancé Amour identity leans into attitude and confidence, and the all black execution gives the shoe a sleek and unified look that lets shape and detailing take center stage. It feels energetic without relying on loud color to make its point. Fans connect with this release because it feels true to LaMelos world. The design carries his flair and creativity, appealing to people who value individuality on and off the court. Collectors appreciate how Puma continues to build LaMelos line around self expression, making each release feel connected to his voice rather than just another performance update. The Puma LaMelo Ball LaFrancé Amour 3x Black was released on June 30, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike A'ja Wilson A'One #1 Draft Pick (Women's)
Description: Nike Aja Wilson AOne 1 Draft Pick Womens introduces a new era of signature storytelling by translating Aja Wilsons confidence and leadership into a debut silhouette that feels purposeful and celebratory. The Draft Pick theme centers achievement and momentum, pairing a clean visual identity with a presence that feels earned rather than flashy. It reflects Ajas rise as a generational talent, grounded in consistency, power, and calm dominance rather than noise. Display Name: Nike Moon Shoe OG Midnight Navy Gum Light Brown Soft Pearl (Women's)
Description: The Nike Moon Shoe Midnight Navy Gum Women's is part of the May 7, 2026 drop that marked the Nike Moon Shoe OG's formal introduction into the brand's mainline catalog following the silhouette's initial moment as a Jacquemus collaboration, the three-colorway release including Midnight Navy, Soft Yellow, and Summit White that established the Moon Shoe as a regular women's exclusive offering in Nike's Spring-to-Summer 2026 seasonal program. The Moon Shoe itself occupies a singular position in Nike's history: it is the shoe that Bill Bowerman created by pouring rubber into his wife Barbara's waffle iron, the result of his desire to develop a traction pattern that would work on the University of Oregon's slick urethane track surface, and the waffle outsole he developed from that experiment became the foundational technology that launched Nike's identity as an innovation-driven footwear company. The Midnight Navy colorway arrives with a dark blue nylon and leather upper built on the same vintage running architecture that defined the original, with decorative jagged trim detailing along both the toe box and the eyestay that prevents the silhouette from reading as too basic. Tri-tone suede overlays placed on the lateral side and heel add material dimension to the low-top construction, while crisp Soft Pearl white accents on the signature midfoot Swoosh and tongue label create the visual contrast that anchors the navy base. Underfoot, the classic waffle rubber outsole in Gum Light Brown provides the heritage traction detail that makes the Moon Shoe historically significant rather than merely aesthetically appealing, the same pattern from the waffle iron still doing the same job half a century later. Style code IW0955-400, available in women's sizing at $105. The Nike Moon Shoe Midnight Navy Gum Women's is the heritage runner for the woman who wants to wear the specific shoe that started everything for Nike, in the most classically nautical and most vintage-appropriate colorway in the May 2026 drop. The Nike Moon Shoe Midnight Navy Gum Women's was released on May 7, 2026 with a retail price of $105.

Display Name: Under Armour Curry 13 Lenny
Description: The Under Armour Curry 13 in the Lenny colorway of Purple Crest and Purple Pop is a signature basketball shoe release that brings the thirteenth iteration of Stephen Curry's celebrated performance platform to a purple-dominant color story that carries its own specific narrative within the Curry 13's seasonal colorway family, the two purple tones creating a dimensional and slightly gradient relationship across the upper that rewards close examination with the kind of chromatic sophistication that dual-tone executions within a single color family consistently deliver when the tones are chosen with genuine precision and visual intelligence. Purple in basketball shoe culture carries specific and beloved associations with several of the most storied franchises and individual legends in the sport's history, and the Lenny colorway's purple crest and purple pop combination participates in that broader basketball color tradition while maintaining its specific Curry universe identity. At one hundred and forty dollars the Curry 13 Lenny delivers Under Armour's most refined signature basketball performance engineering in a colorway with genuine visual sophistication and personal narrative depth. Display Name: Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Prism Pack
Description: The Nike Mercurial Vapor 16 Elite FG Prism Pack in Ocean Cube and Pink Blast is the speed boot of the summer, arriving in a colorway that feels as fast as the technology underneath it. Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Triumph 4 Lemon Chrome
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Triumph 4 Lemon Chrome is the original, most iconic colorway of a silhouette that first launched in 2007 and has become one of the defining early 2000s performance-to-lifestyle crossovers in the current sneaker revival cycle. Lemon saturates the open mesh base in a bold electric yellow that immediately signals both the shoe's era and its refusal to blend into any rotation quietly, while chrome-like leather overlays catch and reflect light across the sidewalls and toe in a futuristic metallic treatment that was visionary in 2007 and feels equally compelling viewed through the nostalgia lens of the present. The Lemon Chrome specifically is the colorway that anchors the silhouette's identity most completely, the shoe that makes the argument for the ProGrid Triumph 4's place in the conversation about early 2000s performance sneaker design most clearly and most immediately. For collectors tracking the ongoing rehabilitation of late 1990s and early 2000s technical runners as serious lifestyle pieces, this is the entry point that earns everything else the silhouette does across its expanding colorway range.
