Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Pure Silver Yellow (Women's)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 in Cream Pure Silver for women is a sportstyle sneaker paying homage to the ninth iteration of the GEL-1000 series, originally inspired by the GEL-KAYANO 14 trainer and first launched as a running shoe in 2008, now adapted as a lifestyle sneaker with synthetic leather overlays and breathable mesh underlays that preserve the heritage upper design language of the late 2000s running aesthetic while repurposing the construction for street-oriented daily wear with GEL technology heel cushioning and a TRUSSTIC support system for all-day comfort. The Cream Pure Silver colorway is the most popular and most broadly adopted Gel-1130 women's colorway, with the soft cream leather overlays and Pure Silver metallic accents on the upper panels creating the warm, slightly vintage tone that has made this color combination one of the most recognizable and consistently restocked ASICS lifestyle offerings since the Gel-1130 women's program launched, providing a neutral-ground foundation that integrates naturally with the full range of women's fashion contexts from athleisure to casual dressed-down looks with skirts, midi dresses, and wide-leg trousers. ASICS women's Gel-1130 features a breathable mesh upper with metallic overlays, padded tongue and collar, the GEL technology heel cushioning that provides shock absorption for extended daily wear, the TRUSSTIC support system that preserves the shoe's midfoot stability architecture, and a durable rubber outsole with flexible traction appropriate for urban environments. The sustainability improvements integrated into the Cream Pure Silver women's version include an upper main material designed with more than 20% recycled materials and a dope-dyed sockliner that reduces water usage by approximately 33% and carbon emissions by approximately 45% compared to conventional sockliner dyeing, positioning the Gel-1130 within ASICS's broader sustainability commitments without compromising the aesthetic or performance characteristics that define the shoe's appeal in the sportstyle category. The Gel-1130's design genealogy through the GEL-KAYANO 14 heritage gives the women's Cream Pure Silver a specific design lineage among ASICS technical running silhouettes, distinguishing it from more lifestyle-first orientated retro runners in the category by grounding it in genuine 2008 stability running technology rather than purely aesthetic retro design. At $100 retail, the women's Cream Pure Silver Gel-1130 is priced slightly above the preschool tier and above some men's colorway options, released September 1, 2025 through ASICS and select retail partners including Foot Locker, Journeys, and feature. The ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Pure Silver Yellow Womens was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike KD 19 Bright Ceramic
Description: The Nike KD 19 in Bright Ceramic is Kevin Durant's nineteenth signature basketball shoe with Nike, debuting a radically new design identity that draws from early 2000s Nike Basketball silhouettes  specifically the Zoom Hyperflight and Ultraflight  featuring the KD 19's most visually distinctive element, a dual-injection TPU dagger running along the lateral upper with a zigzag panel cutting through the low-cut molded construction, where the first injection creates critical heel and midfoot lockdown and the second forms the aggressive dagger shape that gives the shoe its unmistakable silhouette. The Bright Ceramic colorway covers nearly the entire shoe  upper, midsole, tongue, laces, liner, and outsole  in a saturated orange inspired by Durant's University of Texas Longhorns roots, the color landing at the launch position of the KD 19's full six-colorway Candy Pack with University Gold and Stadium Green as the sole color departures from the dominant Bright Ceramic field. Durant debuted the KD 19 on court on March 16, 2026 against the Los Angeles Lakers months ahead of retail, marking the shoe's first public appearance before the official reveal, with Nike describing the KD 19's design as reflecting Durant's desire for wearers to channel the confidence to hit the big shot when needed. Released June 13, 2026 at $150 retail through Nike SNKRS with a global rollout to select retailers with style code IH1117-800. Note: user data indicates $150; most sources confirm $155 retail. The Nike KD 19 Bright Ceramic was released on June 13, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Truffle Salt
Description: The New Balance 9060 Truffle Salt brings earthy tones and subtle contrast into a silhouette known for its bold proportions and futuristic design. The Truffle and Salt color combination creates a warm and natural palette that softens the aggressive lines of the 9060, giving the sneaker a more approachable and lifestyle focused feel. The layered upper and sculpted midsole remain central to the design, offering a balance between retro inspiration and forward thinking aesthetics. Fans gravitate toward earth toned sneakers because they offer versatility while still feeling distinct from standard neutral palettes. The Truffle Salt execution adds depth through slight variation in tone, making the shoe visually interesting without overwhelming the design. The 9060 continues to stand out due to its unique shape, which pairs well with both casual and more styled outfits. For collectors, pairs like this highlight how New Balance continues refining its modern silhouettes through thoughtful color execution that enhances wearability while preserving design identity. The New Balance 9060 Truffle Salt has a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny is part of a collaboration between adidas and Bad Bunny, a Puerto Rican rapper and singer known for his contributions to the Latin trap genre. Introduced initially during adidas Summer/Fall 2024 lineup, the Bad Bunny adidas Gazelle Indoor features a minimalist aesthetic with an understated colorway of off-white, black, and light grey. The upper is crafted from premium leather in off-white with suede overlays in a light grey hue. Including black on the leather 3-Stripes, tongue, and collar creates a monochromatic contract that emulates Bad Bunnys personal style. Perforations across the toebox allow the foot to breathe, while thin, white laces provide a secure front closure, and the gum rubber outsole provides traction under the foot. Our StockX experts like the side panel's dual Bad Bunny and adidas branding. It reads "adidas benito," which pays tribute to the performers first name. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Bad Bunny was launched on April 27, 2024, and sold for $120.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Boot NRG Black Light Gum
Description: First appearing in 2017, the Jordan 9 Boot Gum made its return as part of the Jordan Brand Holiday 2021 collection. The Jordan 9 Boot Black Gum features a thick suede and mesh upper with metal loop eyelets drawing inspiration from traditional work boots. Finally, a rugged gum outsole with deep grooves enhances traction and support. The Jordan 9 Boot Black Gum released in November of 2021 and retailed for $225.

Display Name: Jordan Westbrook One Take II White Marble
Description: The Air Jordan Westbrook One Take II White Marble delivers a bold and expressive take on performance basketball footwear, reflecting Russell Westbrooks dynamic style of play. The white upper sets a clean base, while marble inspired detailing adds a unique visual texture that gives the shoe a sense of motion even when still. Black and wolf grey accents ground the design, creating contrast that highlights the layered construction and aggressive shape of the silhouette. Fans of Westbrooks line appreciate how it consistently pushes toward individuality, and this colorway leans fully into that identity. The marble effect gives it a distinct look that separates it from more traditional basketball releases, while still keeping it wearable on and off the court. It is a pair that captures energy and personality, aligning closely with the mindset that defines Westbrooks approach to the game. The Air Jordan Westbrook One Take II White Marble was released on June 7, 2021 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 97 OG Silver Bullet (2022) (Women's)
Description: Featuring Metallic Silver, University Red, Black and White colors, this Nike Air Max 97 OG Silver Bullet 2022 W is one of the Nike Air Max 97 OG sneakers that appears mostly in women sizing. The Silver Bullet 2022 Nike Air Max 97 OG W features a predominantly Metallic Silver-dressed mesh upper construction that is contrasted with the University Red Swoosh on the sides and Black sock lining and Black tongue tag. The tongue and the heel also feature pull tabs that are meant to provide comfortable and easier dressing. The design further features a rubber midsole dressed in White and translucent Air Max units for cushioning. What our experts love about this Nike Air Max 97 OG Silver Bullet 2022 W that was released as part of Nikes Air Max 97 OG variations on 11th November 2022 with a recommended retail price of $180 is the sneaker's lightweight and breathable constrictions that maximizes comfort when being used.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Off-White Sail (Women's)
Description: Jordan Brand and Virgil Abloh teamed up once again to release the third silhouette in their collaborative history with the women's Jordan 4 Retro Off-White Sail (W), now available on StockX. After teasing the release of the Off-White 4 with samples in his MCA exhibit and presenting them in his Off-White FW2020 Womens Show, Virgil Abloh finally delivered what might be the most anticipated release of 2020. The Air Jordan 4 Sail features full-grain leather uppers with hits of mesh and translucent materials on the toebox and heel of the shoe. From there, hits of light blue on the tongues Jumpman and the outsoles Nike Swoosh provide contrast to the sail colored sneaker. These women's sneakers released in July of 2020 and retailed for $200 USD.

Display Name: New Balance Abzorb 2000 Slate Grey-Silver Metallic
Description: The New Balance Abzorb 2000 Slate Grey Silver Metallic brings a more technical and layered color approach to the brands forward thinking silhouette. The combination of Slate Grey and Silver Metallic enhances the futuristic feel of the design, highlighting the structure of the upper and the sculpted midsole. The Abzorb cushioning system remains central, delivering comfort while reinforcing the models performance driven identity within a lifestyle focused package. Fans appreciate colorways like this because they emphasize the technical nature of the sneaker without sacrificing wearability. The grey base keeps the design grounded, while the metallic accents add contrast and visual depth. The 2000 model continues gaining attention as part of New Balances push into more experimental design spaces. For collectors, pairs like this represent the balance between innovation and everyday functionality, where new silhouettes are supported by strong color execution that enhances their overall appeal. The New Balance Abzorb 2000 Slate Grey Silver Metallic was released on February 23, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Triumph 4 Jae Tips Flowers Grow Uptown Poison Ivy
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Triumph 4 Jae Tips Flowers Grow Uptown Poison Ivy amplifies the collaborations energetic spirit through a bold color mix. Featuring Red, Yellow, and Multi Color accents, the upper layers vivid tones that command attention. The ProGrid midsole maintains the comfort and stability that define the Triumph line. Poison Ivy leans into high contrast hues, creating a visually dynamic execution that feels fearless and vibrant. Jae Tips influence shines through the daring palette and thoughtful detailing. It stands as a standout piece that merges artistic storytelling with retro performance design. The Saucony ProGrid Triumph 4 Jae Tips Flowers Grow Uptown Poison Ivy was released on October 25, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Tiempo Black White (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Tiempo Black White (Women's) is a shoe for women with Air Max units underfoot for extra support. This version of the Air Max Plus Tiempo in Black and White has a smooth black upper. The upper has the classic Air Max plus design of the curved lines crossing it, but instead of overlays, these appear as black stitching. A shiny black toe cap appears at the front, while black leather is used for the mudguard and heel counter. A Tuned Air logo can be found on the back of the heel. The Swoosh appears as a white leather overlay on each side. A floppy tongue covering the laces' top bears another white Swoosh. The tall midsole has the trade Air units beneath the heel and forefoot. What we like best about this pair of shoes is the chunky midsole, which adds support and height to the wearer. The Nike Air Max Plus Tiempo Black White (Women's) was released on July 12, 2024, for $190.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Grey Cement Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel NYC Grey Cement Grey builds on the same retro inspired foundation but shifts the tone slightly with a cement grey palette that feels softer and more textured. The layered upper allows subtle differences in shade to stand out, creating a balanced look that feels cohesive from heel to toe. It keeps the same structure that defines the Gel NYC while offering a slightly different mood compared to darker monochrome versions. Fans of the silhouette appreciate how small changes in color can reshape the entire feel of the shoe. This version leans into that idea, delivering something that feels calm and wearable without losing the technical identity of the model. It is another example of how ASICS continues to evolve its retro running lineup through thoughtful updates. The ASICS Gel NYC Grey Cement Grey was released on December 3, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Community Navy
Description: The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Community Navy Grey represents the continued evolution of one of New Balances most respected lines, combining performance heritage with modern refinement. The community navy and grey palette keeps it classic, leaning into tones that feel timeless and easy to wear. The updated v6 silhouette introduces a sleeker profile while maintaining the comfort and support the 990 series is known for. Collectors and longtime fans appreciate how this version respects the legacy while still moving things forward. Made in USA craftsmanship adds another layer of value, reinforcing the attention to detail and quality materials. It is a shoe that does not chase trends, instead building on decades of consistency and trust within the sneaker community. The New Balance 990v6 MiUSA Community Navy Grey was released on July 30, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low SE Winter Storm
Description: The Nike Dunk Low SE Winter Storm captures the essence of winter in a design that celebrates the holiday season. The sneaker features an icy color palette dominated by cool shades of blue and white, evoking the calm beauty of a snowy winter scene. The Winter Storm Nike Dunk Low SE comes with a cracked leather upper in icy blue hues, with tumbled white leather overlays on the eyestay, heel, and forefoot. A reflective gray leather Swoosh occupies the lateral and medial panels, with additional branding gracing the tongue tag, insoles, and reflective Nike heel logo. Flashes of aqua on the mesh tongue and exposed stitching, and the textured white laces reinforce the icy aesthetic. The winter sneaker sits on a rubber cupsole featuring white sidewalls and a soft gray outsole. Something we love about the Nike Dunk Low SE Winter Storm is its attention to detail. The combination of materials, color, and snowflake-like patterns gives this sneaker a distinctive touch, setting it apart from other Dunk Low iterations. The sneaker debuted on October 19, 2024, and sold for $125 retail.

Display Name: Nike Little Posite One Black Volt (GS)
Description: The Nike Little Posite One Black Volt GS channels classic Foamposite energy into a bold youth sized build. Black dominates the molded upper, creating a sleek and futuristic base, while Volt accents electrify the design with high contrast detail. The structured silhouette and glossy finish highlight the signature Posite shape that made the line iconic. Its compact build keeps the look sharp and powerful. Young sneaker fans appreciate how black and neon combinations amplify the dramatic lines of the Foamposite design. The Volt touches add energy without overwhelming the silhouette. It captures the attitude and confidence that define the Posite lineage. Strong and unmistakable, this pair delivers statement style in a smaller size. The Nike Little Posite One Black Volt GS was released on March 14, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus 3 Black Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus 3 Black Smoke Grey channels aggressive energy through a sleek, layered design. Black forms the dominant base, while Smoke Grey accents contour the upper and highlight the sculpted cage structure. The visible Air cushioning and bold lines maintain the futuristic identity that defines the Plus series. It feels sharp, technical, and unapologetically modern. Fans of the Plus lineage gravitate toward darker palettes that emphasize the silhouettes striking shape. The grey detailing adds depth without breaking the monochrome intensity, keeping the look cohesive and powerful. It is a pair that thrives on attitude and presence, blending performance heritage with street ready edge. Strong and streamlined, this edition continues the Plus legacy confidently. The Nike Air Max Plus 3 Black Smoke Grey was released on April 16, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Trainer Huarache Challenge Red
Description: The Nike Air Trainer Huarache Challenge Red brings back a bold training silhouette with a colorway that refuses to go unnoticed. Challenge red dominates the upper, creating a high energy look that is reinforced by black accents that add contrast and definition. The midfoot strap and neoprene inspired structure keep the design grounded in its original performance intent. This pair resonates with fans who appreciate Nikes training heritage. The Huarache line has always been about support and innovation, and this version carries that forward with a strong visual identity. It feels retro but still relevant, offering a silhouette that stands apart from more common sneaker designs. The Nike Air Trainer Huarache Challenge Red was released on February 6, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: New Balance 530 Arid Stone
Description: Introducing a cutting-edge addition to your wardrobe that seamlessly blends style and functionality. This innovative product is designed to elevate your everyday look while providing unparalleled comfort and versatility. Crafted with precision and attention to detail, it showcases the perfect balance between modern aesthetics and practical features that cater to the needs of today's fashion-conscious individuals. From its sleek silhouette to its carefully selected materials, every aspect of this product has been thoughtfully considered to ensure a premium experience. Whether you're dressing up for a special occasion or looking for a reliable staple for your daily routine, this versatile piece adapts effortlessly to various settings and personal styles. Its timeless design ensures that it will remain a cherished part of your collection for years to come. Our team of experts believes this product is ideal for those seeking a perfect combination of style, comfort, and durability in their everyday essentials.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Verdy Visty
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Verdy Visty is a fresh and playful take on the iconic SB Dunk model, brought to life through a collaboration with Japanese artist Verdy. This eye-catching sneaker takes inspiration from Verdys character, "VISTY," blending creativity and street style in a standout design. The color palette is a pastel dream, with blue gaze, light arctic pink, and bicycle yellow tones adding a whimsical touch to the classic silhouette. One of the most unique aspects of the Verdy Visty Dunk is its mix of materials. The fuzzy, hairy texture on the toe box, mid panel, tongue, and heel collar adds dimension and personality to the sneaker, while the pink leather Nike swoosh adds a smooth contrast. The pastel blue corduroy upper rounds out the design, giving the shoe a vintage, yet modern aesthetic. The yellow midsole and matching laces bring an extra pop of color, making this Dunk an instant standout whether you're skating or styling. Released on September 19, 2024, the Nike SB Dunk Low Verdy Visty retailed at $135. The VISTY character makes a fun appearance on the inside tag and even comes with a special keychain, adding a personal touch to each pair. For those looking to combine fashion, art, and skate culture, this sneaker is the perfect way to express your individuality.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex White Green Milieu
Description: The Salomon XT 6 Gore Tex White Green Milieu elevates the iconic trail runner through weather resistant construction and a fresh outdoor inspired color palette built around movement and utility. The XT 6 already holds legendary status within both trail running and fashion communities because of its lightweight chassis and highly technical aesthetic, and the addition of Gore Tex reinforces its all weather functionality without compromising the sleek visual identity of the silhouette. The White, Green Milieu, and Ice Flow tones create a cool and nature inspired atmosphere that feels crisp, modern, and deeply connected to alpine outdoor environments. Fans appreciate Gore Tex Salomon releases because they combine practical performance upgrades and elevated visual identity in a way that feels increasingly relevant within contemporary outdoor fashion trends. The lighter white base brightens the technical construction while the green accents add earthy contrast and reinforce the trail inspired atmosphere of the design. Collectors especially gravitate toward XT 6 Gore Tex editions because they preserve the silhouettes authentic utility while expanding its versatility for colder and wetter environments. The overall presentation feels futuristic, functional, and highly reflective of Salomons continued influence across performance footwear and luxury outdoor fashion culture. The Salomon XT 6 Gore Tex White Green Milieu was released on March 1, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Summit White Bright Crimson
Description: Push your pace in the Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Summit White Bright Crimson, a refined take on a beloved daily trainer built to handle everything from tempo runs to long miles. The lightweight upper balances breathability and structure, pairing engineered mesh with supportive overlays for a locked-in feel through corners and sprints. Underfoot, responsive Zoom Air cushioning works in tandem with a smooth, resilient foam midsole to deliver snappy transitions and lasting comfort, while the padded collar and gusseted tongue reduce hotspots on extended efforts. A durable rubber outsole with multi?surface traction keeps you confident on wet pavement, gym floors, and everything in between. Dressed in Summit White/Black/Bright Crimson/Phantom, this mens running shoe turns heads without shouting, making it a versatile choice from track sessions to city strides. Strategic reflectivity amps up low?light visibility, and the sculpted heel helps center the foot for a stable ride that still feels fast. Thoughtful details, like a secure midfoot wrap and roomy forefoot, accommodate natural expansion as the miles stack up. Finished with model callouts and style code HQ2592-101, this June 12, 2025 release captures the spirit of the Pegasus line: reliable, responsive, and ready every day. Our team loves this product because it blends lively Zoom Air cushioning, breathable support, and confident traction in a standout colorway that makes training feel as good as it looks.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 EXT Protro Siempre Hermanos
Description: The Nike Kobe 8 EXT Protro Year of the Horse Horseshoe blends cultural inspiration with Kobe Bryants legacy, using a palette of light orewood brown and baroque brown that feels grounded and refined. Accents of summit white, red stardust, and ocean cube add contrast, while metallic dark grey detailing brings a subtle modern edge. The Kobe 8 silhouette remains lightweight and performance driven, updated through the Protro approach. Collectors gravitate toward Kobe releases like this because they combine storytelling with one of the most respected lines in basketball footwear. The Year of the Horse theme adds cultural depth, making the design feel more intentional. It is a sneaker that balances tribute and innovation, appealing to those who value both performance and legacy. The Nike Kobe 8 EXT Protro Year of the Horse Horseshoe was released on April 24, 2026 with a retail price of $200.
Colorway: Light Orewood Brown/Baroque Brown/Summit White/Red Stardust/Ocean Cube/Metallic Dark Grey

Display Name: New Balance 574 Black White
Description: The New Balance 574 Black White is a sneaker released through the collaboration of BEAMS and New Balance brands. The sneaker arrives in a blend of black, light grey, and white colorway dubbed "Black White." At the same time, black makes the most of the shoe; grey hints appear on the inner lining, padded collars, and the heel unit. The upper comprises long-lasting suede and breathable mesh vamp, while an EVA chunk underfoot provides lightweight cushioning beneath. Branding detailing is enhanced by the logo patch to the sides and tongue, the heel tab, and the horizontally patterned stabilizer. Adding to the shoes design are a rounded toe and a flat rubber outsole. The New Balance 574 Black White 2022 was released on December 30th, 2021. It retailed at a price of $95.

Display Name: UGG Tazz II Slipper Chestnut (Women's)
Description: The UGG Tazz II Slipper Chestnut Womens modernizes one of UGGs most iconic colors through the brands popular platform slipper silhouette. The chestnut suede instantly signals UGG heritage, while the raised sole gives the Tazz II a contemporary edge that feels bold yet wearable. It keeps the familiar warmth and softness, designed to be as comfortable as it is visually confident. Fans gravitate toward this pair because it feels like a new classic. Chestnut has long been synonymous with UGG, and pairing it with the Tazz II platform makes the design feel current without losing authenticity. Collectors value it as a must have colorway, one that captures everything UGG does best, comfort, familiarity, and effortless style, in a single silhouette. The UGG Tazz II Slipper Chestnut Womens retailed for $145.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Premium Melitta Baumeister (Women's)
Description: The Nike Vomero Premium Melitta Baumeister reimagines the Vomero silhouette through a collaboration that emphasizes bold color and experimental design language. The mix of total orange, hyper crimson, and barely volt creates a high energy palette, while black elements provide structure and contrast. The layered construction gives the shoe a sculptural feel that aligns with the collaborative vision. Fans appreciate this release because it transforms a performance driven model into something more fashion forward without losing its core identity. The Melitta Baumeister influence brings a conceptual edge, making the design feel unique within the Vomero lineup. It stands out as a statement piece that blends comfort with creative expression. The Nike Vomero Premium Melitta Baumeister was released on April 8, 2026 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 SC Field Purple
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 SC Field Purple is a performance shoe whose original design was inspired by Parisian architecture. This iteration of the Nike Air Max 1 SC is made with a white mesh base which makes up the toe box, the sides, and the area around the ankle. Gray leather overlays cross the sides of the shoe from the laces to the arches, and the heel counter is the same shade of gray leather. Field Purple leather forms the mudguard, which runs from the arch on the inside of the shoe all the way around the front to the lateral heel. The Nike swoosh also appears in Field Purple leather on the sides. Both the heel and the tongue feature Nike branding in purple, and a thick white rubber sole with visible Air Max units under the heel completes the look. What we like most about this shoe are the Field Purple accents, which give the shoe a bold but still clean look. The Nike Air Max 1 SC Field Purple was released on May 1, 2024, for a price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite One Penny PE
Description: The Nike Air Foamposite One Penny PE features a combination of white, metallic silver, black, cobalt bliss, and racer blue hues. The Foamposite One Penny PE Nike Air showcases an upper crafted from Nike's Foamposite material, known for its durability. Its molded construction ensures a secure and comfortable fit. The lacing system is designed to offer customization in fit. For cushioning and impact protection, the midsole incorporates a full-length Zoom Air unit that is highly responsive. To deliver traction and stability, the outsole is made of translucent rubber with a herringbone pattern. An adjustable fit is facilitated by straps located on the tongue and heel. A small white Nike Swoosh adorns one side of the upper. The player-exclusive sizing of the Nike Air Foamposite One Penny PE was released on April 7, 2023, and retailed for $240.

Display Name: Maison Margiela Replica German Army Trainer GAT
Description: Dive into the realm of luxury sneakers with the Maison Margiela Replica German Army Trainer, a model that has garnered iconic status among aficionados. The cool, casual vibe of these sneakers pairs well with a wide array of casual outfits, making them a versatile addition to your sneaker collection. And though a bit of a splurge at a retail price of $540, they're an investment in timeless style and quality craftsmanship. Make a statement, embrace the rich narrative, and step into a pair of sneakers that have left an indelible mark on the fashion landscape.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro Mambacita
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro Mambacita stands out as a touching tribute celebrating Gigi Bryants legacy, bringing a beloved silhouette back with fresh, meaningful details. Sporting a dramatic gradient shift from white to black across its engineered mesh upper, this sneaker strikes a balance of elegance and athleticism. Every thoughtful detailfrom the golden heart with "2" honoring Gigi's jersey number on the heel to the marbled black and white solecaptures the spirit of basketball and the enduring Bryant legacy. Dropping on May 1, 2025, at $210, the Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro Mambacita combined performance-ready tech and heartfelt storytelling, instantly becoming essential for Kobe fans and dedicated athletes alike.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Border
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Border revisits the original spirit of the Air Max 95 by restoring the larger visible Air units and pairing them with crisp contrast. Collectors love this release because it feels archival and intentional. The Air Max 95 has always been about pushing boundaries in cushioning and form, and the Big Bubble detail reinforces that legacy. Fans appreciate how the black border sharpens the overall look, making the shoe feel bold but still classic. It stands as a celebration of Nikes willingness to honor its design history while delivering something that feels fresh and exciting on foot. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Border was released on November 26, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Kyrie 8 White University Red
Description: The Nike Kyrie 8 White University Red is the 8th release of the signature line of shoes released by Nike in collaboration with NBA superstar Kyrie Irving. The shoes have a lightweight upper made from a combination of materials that include mesh and synthetic textile. The red accents are most notably seen on the branding details, which include Kyries signature logo on the tongue plus Nikes iconic Swoosh on the side panels. The shoes were first released for retail at the price of $140 on 24th November 2022.

Display Name: New Balance 740v2 Pink Granite
Description: The New Balance 740v2 Pink Granite shifts the tone of the 740 line with a softer, more expressive palette that still maintains its performance roots. The pink granite colorway introduces a subtle blend of warm and cool tones, giving the shoe a unique visual balance that stands out without feeling overly bold. Display Name: Nike Kobe 6 ASG Hollywood 3D (2026) (GS)

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Rebellionaire

Display Name: Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Triple Black
Description: The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Triple Black is the definition of sleek and effortless style. Dressed entirely in black, this slip-on is crafted for both comfort and versatility. Description: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70s Ox Comme des Garcons PLAY White is a low-top iconic collaboration. It blends the minimalist eye and heart logo on a white canvas. The shoe usually features a Milk canvas upper with the oversized signature CDG red heart printed on the quarter panels. Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Igloo (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 11 Retro Low Igloo (Womens) refreshes a legendary silhouette with a crisp White/Igloo palette and sleek materials that turn heads from first wear. A glossy patent leather mudguard wraps the foot with signature AJ11 shine, balanced by breathable textile at the upper for day?long comfort. Subtle pastel Igloo accents highlight the tongue branding and heel details, while an icy, slightly tinted translucent outsole frames the design with a cool, modern edge. Sitting low on the ankle for easy, everyday styling, this womens colorway (style AH7860-103) delivers the clean, refined look that made the Air Jordan 11 a crossover icon, equally at home with athleisure, denim, or tailored streetwear. Underfoot, responsive cushioning and a supportive midsole work in tandem with a carbon-fiber shank plate to offer stability and court-inspired performance you can feel. Herringbone traction pods grip on a variety of surfaces, and the padded collar plus secure lacing give a locked?in fit without sacrificing comfort. Launched June 7, 2025, the Jordan 11 Retro Low Igloo blends heritage DNA with a fresh seasonal twist, making it a standout choice for collectors and style-driven wearers alike. From its polished contours to its luminous outsole and soft mint cues, this pair brings effortless versatility and instant polish to any rotation. Our team loves this product because it pairs iconic AJ11 craftsmanship with a refined White/Igloo finish that elevates everyday outfits while delivering dependable comfort and support.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Black Infrared (2019)
Description: Make sure your head isnt in the beam while trying to grab the Jordan 6 Retro Black Infrared (2019). This AJ6 come with a black upper, black midsole plus red accents, and a translucent sole. These sneakers released in February 2019 and retailed for $200. This silhouette is a must cop, so purchase them on StockX now.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Runspark Beige Olive Green Mustard Yellow
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Runspark Beige Olive Green Mustard Yellow delivers a more modern and layered running inspired silhouette through a mix of earthy and vibrant tones. Beige and olive green form the base, creating a natural and grounded look, while mustard yellow accents add a pop of color that energizes the design. The structure feels more contemporary compared to classic models, with a focus on comfort and versatility. Fans of Onitsuka Tiger appreciate how newer silhouettes expand the brands identity beyond heritage styles. The combination of neutral and bold tones gives this pair a balanced but distinctive look. It is a sneaker that reflects a blend of retro influence and modern design direction

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Next Nature White Gym Red (Women's)
Description: The women's Nike Dunk Low Next Nature White Gym Red (W) features a white Flyleather upper with Gym Red overlays and Swooshes. From there, matching soles and woven tongue labels add the finishing touch. The women's Nike Dunk Low Next Nature White Gym Red (W) released in May of 2022 and retailed for $105.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC 2055 Pale Oak Truffle Grey
Description: The ASICS Gel-NYC 2055 Pale Oak Truffle Grey updates the unisex Gel-NYC 2055 with an earthy yet refined colorway of Pale Oak and Truffle Grey with emerald green accents. Inspired by classic ASICS silhouettes from the early 2000s, the sneaker combines heritage performance technologies with contemporary colorways and designs. For instance, the shoe borrows the heel counter and reinforced eyelets from the GT-2060 and GT-2050 but updates the design with an upper made of breathable mesh and synthetic and genuine leather overlays. The GEL-CUMULUS 16 tooling system provides responsive cushioning by absorbing shock in the forefoot and rear. Pale Oak and Truffle Grey decorate the overlays, toebox, and eyelets, while emerald green accents appear on the midsole with ASICS embroidery. Our experts at StockX like that the sneaker retains the iconic ASICS stripes on the side panels. The ASICS Gel-NYC 2055 Pale Oak Truffle Grey was released on July 19, 2024, and retailed for $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Obsidian Aluminum
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Obsidian Aluminum brings a cooler and more fluid color palette to the silhouette, using shades of blue to emphasize its wave like design lines. Obsidian anchors the upper, while aluminum and diffused blue accents create a layered effect that feels smooth and continuous. The color transitions highlight the structure without overpowering it. This pair appeals to fans who enjoy tonal colorways with depth. The Air Max Plus naturally lends itself to gradient effects, and this version uses that strength to create a cohesive and visually engaging look. It feels calm but still dynamic, offering a different kind of presence compared to more high contrast releases. The Nike Air Max Plus Obsidian Aluminum was released on November 23, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: New Balance 480 Black White
Description: The New Balance 480 Black White is a heritage basketball court shoe, featuring a clean, essential color blocking. The shoe features White and Black. The low-top silhouette is constructed from durable leather, maintaining the structured paneling and robust profile of its 1980s court origins. The cushioned sole unit ensures comfort for daily wear. This versatile staple was released on November 13, 2022, with an accessible retail price of $90. The crisp White leather base is sharply contrasted by the Black detailing on the 'N' logo, heel, and outsole. This two-tone execution makes the 480 an easy-to-wear, timeless model valued for its durability and classic aesthetic. Our team appreciates the clean, sharp contrast of the White leather and Black detailing, defining the durable structure of this heritage low-top court shoe.

Display Name: Nike Kwondo 1 G-Dragon Peaceminusone Panda
Description: The Nike Kwondo 1 G-Dragon Peaceminusone Panda is a collaboration between Nike and G-Dragon. The Peaceminusone Panda Nike Kwondo 1 G-Dragon comes in a black-and-white color palette. The sneaker features an upper constructed of durable white leather and synthetic materials with black accents. The outsole features a distinct tread pattern for traction and stability. The sneaker's dense midsole provides exceptional padding and support. The shoe features a Nike Swoosh on the lateral sides and a "NIKE Swoosh" inscription on the tongue. The sneaker's design is completed with G-Dragon and Peaceminusone branding on the heel. The Nike Kwondo 1 G-Dragon Peaceminusone Panda was released on April 18, 2023, and retailed for $190.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Flu Game (2016)
Description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro Black Red Flu Game 2016 has become a celebrated version that stays faithful to the OG design from 1997, 2003, and 2009. This 2016 Air Jordan 12 features a black tumbled leather upper and varsity red on the mudguard and outsole. For branding, the word Jumpman appears on the lateral side, with the logo appearing on the tongue and heel pull tab. The heel pull tab also has Jordan embroidered, and right below that is the signature "23" carved into the rubber outsole. The Air Jordan 12 Retro Black Red Flu Game 2016 was released on the 28th of May 2016 for a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Premium Cordura Light Orewood Brown Green Abyss
Description: The Nike P 6000 Premium Cordura Light Orewood Brown Green Abyss elevates the retro runner aesthetic with durable texture and layered depth. Light Orewood Brown shapes the upper with a warm neutral base, while Phantom panels add subtle contrast across the mesh and overlay construction. Green Abyss accents inject a darker pop that sharpens the silhouettes lines, and Lightning hits bring quick flashes of energy. The Cordura detailing enhances the rugged feel without sacrificing the early 2000s running identity that defines the P 6000. Fans of the model appreciate when material upgrades meet thoughtful color blocking. The mix of earthy browns and deep green feels grounded yet expressive, making it easy to style year round. It captures that balance between performance nostalgia and everyday durability. Textured and confident, this edition brings a premium edge to a familiar favorite. The Nike P 6000 Premium Cordura Light Orewood Brown Green Abyss was released on October 13, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: New Balance 993 MiUSA Teddy Santis Sea Salt Black
Description: The New Balance 993 MiUSA Teddy Santis Sea Salt Black reinvigorates the NB 993 under the creative direction of Teddy Santis, best known as the founder of Aime Leon Dore. Like other models in the Made in the USA line, the MiUSA Teddy Santis Sea Salt Black New Balance 993 is crafted using premium materials, including velvet nubuck, pigskin suede, and high-quality mesh on the upper. The off-white mesh base serves as the perfect backdrop for the overlays, which primarily showcase Seasalt, but also feature touches of black. The gum rubber outsole provides traction underfoot, while the ABZORB midsole protects against impact. Our experts like the signature New Balance branding on the side panel. It completes the sneakers soft aesthetic with a small black N that stands out against the creamy white and Seafoam hues. The New Balance 993 MiUSA Teddy Santis Sea Salt Black was released on May 1, 2024, and sold for $220.

Display Name: New Balance 327 Linen Sea Salt Olivine (Women's)
Description: The New Balance 327 Linen Sea Salt Olivine Womens blends retro track inspiration with soft, nature driven tones. Linen and sea salt create a light, airy base, while olivine accents introduce subtle green contrast across the oversized N logo and outsole. The flared midsole and angular design lines reflect the 327s vintage 1970s roots, reimagined through a modern lens. The mix of suede and nylon enhances texture without overpowering the silhouette. Collectors appreciate how the 327 balances nostalgia and everyday versatility, and this colorway leans into that strength. The muted palette pairs easily with casual denim or relaxed summer fits. It stands as a fresh, lifestyle ready interpretation of New Balances running heritage. The New Balance 327 Linen Sea Salt Olivine Womens originally retailed for $100.

Display Name: Nike Killshot 2 Leather J Crew
Description: The Nike Killshot 2 Leather J Crew made its debut as one of Nikes classic Killshot 2 Leather sneaker additions in May 2019. The Nike Killshot 2 Leather J Crew is dressed in sail/lucid green-gum yellow colorway. The sneakers leather base features a white color theme. The heel, eyestays, and toe are all dressed in a light grey suede. The sneakers lucid green color is visible on the Swoosh, Nike branding accent, the heel, and on the shoes tongue. The sneakers design is finished off by a gum-yellow colored rubber sole. When making its debut in May 2019, Nike Killshot 2 Leather J Crew retailed at $90.

Display Name: Nike LD Waffle SF sacai Fragment Grey
Description: The Nike LDWaffle sacai Fragment Grey features a grey mesh upper with layered suede overlays and white leather doubled Swooshes. On the side of the doubled sole, both sacai and Fragment branding is printed in black. From there, a doubled tongue with woven labels completes the design. The Nike LDWaffle sacai Fragment Grey released in August of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Black
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus Black delivers max comfort in a stealth driven execution built for everyday mileage. Dressed in Black with Anthracite and Cool Grey accents, the layered upper keeps the silhouette sleek while highlighting the cushioned midsole beneath. The sculpted platform reinforces the Vomero lines reputation for plush responsiveness and smooth transitions. All black runners remain staples in any rotation, and the Vomero Plus enhances that versatility with elevated cushioning and a modern stance. Subtle grey detailing adds depth without disrupting the monochrome feel. It stands as a refined and dependable option for those who prioritize comfort with a clean athletic edge. The Nike Vomero Plus Black was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Dunk High Syracuse (2021)
Description: Nike continues to revive their famed Be True To Your School pack with the retro release of the Nike Dunk High Syracuse. The Nike Dunk High Syracuse first retroed in 2016 as a womens exclusive, alongside other pack-mates, like the Villanovas, Kentuckys, and Michigans. Following the Syracuse-themed colorway releasing in Dunk Low form in 2020, the orange hue returns again in its original Dunk High form. The Nike Dunk High Syracuse is constructed in familiar Dunk High color blocking. Hits of orange leather add a bright contrast to white leather panels. From there, a white tongue tag with orange Nike branding and a vibrant orange outsole completes the design, making it a true OG return. The Nike Dunk High Syracuse released in March of 2021 for $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Volt
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Volt embraces one of Nike most iconic performance colors with unapologetic intensity. Volt wraps the upper in a high visibility finish, contrasted by Black detailing that sharpens the silhouette. The streamlined build keeps the Pegasus identity intact while amplifying its presence. Volt has long symbolized speed and innovation within Nike performance lines, and seeing it applied head to toe gives this pair undeniable energy. The Pegasus Premium platform ensures comfort and responsiveness, making it more than just a statement piece. For athletes and sneaker fans alike, this version captures the spirit of forward momentum in every detail. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Volt was released on October 9, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: New Balance 550 White Black
Description: Taking cues from the 1989 New Balance P550, the New Balance 550 White Black features a smooth white leather upper with perforated overlays and black piping. Puffed New Balance logos decorate the quarter panel. At the base, a matching white and black sole completes the design. The New Balance 550 White Black released in November of 2021 and retailed for $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low World Tour White
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low World Tour White leans into a global concept while keeping the design rooted in simplicity. The all white base maintains the classic Air Force 1 look, while the World Tour theme adds small details that connect the shoe to international culture and travel inspiration. It feels familiar at first glance but reveals more upon closer look. This version stands out because it adds narrative without disrupting the silhouette. The Air Force 1 has always been a universal sneaker, and this release plays directly into that idea. It is a clean and versatile option that still carries a broader concept behind its design. The Nike Air Force 1 Low World Tour White had a retail price of $125.

Display Name: New Balance 740v2 Concord Grape Sun Glow
Description: The New Balance 740v2 Concord Grape Sun Glow is a vibrant athletic shoe featuring the brands ABZORB signature cushioning. This version of the New Balance 740v2 has a base of Concord Grape purple mesh for breathability and flexibility. Synthetic leather overlays in Purple Fuschia support the toe box, while overlays in Silver, Black, and light blue support the sides and the heel. The New Balance N logo appears on each side in Firefly yellow, and the 740 branding is visible on the lateral heel. The shoe features an ABZORB foam midsole in Sun Glow orange, and additional NB branding is visible on the tongue and the back of the heel. What we think stands out about this sneaker is its bright colorway  the design immediately catches the eye. The New Balance 740v2 Concord Grape Sun Glow was released on March 4, 2025, for a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Triple White
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Triple White upgrades the SB Dunk Low Pro silhouette with an ultra-clean white colorway and minimalist design. Channeling basketball shoes from the 1980s, this skateboarding shoe is part of Nikes Orange Label series, which releases performance-driven, skateboard shop exclusives. From the Swoosh logo to the overlays, the Triple White Nike SB Dunk Low Pro sneaker boasts an all-white leather construction with perforations across the toe box. However, the Orange Label branding on the tongue and insole breaks up the monochromatic color scheme. Padding in the collar and tongue offers support, while the midsole houses a cushioning Zoom Air unit. Finally, durable, white laces wind through the front lace closure system. Our experts like the hoops pivot circles on the rubber outsole, which increase traction on a variety of urban surfaces, including asphalt and concrete. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Triple White was released on July 28, 2024, and sold for $115.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Anniversary Green
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Anniversary Green features a white, Evergreen Aura, and gray leather and mesh upper, with white acting as a background that feeds into Evergreen Aura mudguards and gray overlays. From there, an "Air Max" midsole with exposed pods sits atop a two-toned outsole and slight black accents for bordering to complete the design. The Nike Air Max 1 Anniversary Green released in July of 2020 and retailed for $140. The Air Max 1 Anniversary Green re-released in 2024.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 2017 Team Red Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 2017 Team Red Black delivers a sleek and performance driven look built around visible cushioning and streamlined design. Team Red wraps the engineered mesh upper, creating a bold and confident foundation, while black accents provide depth and structure throughout the silhouette. The full length Air unit remains the centerpiece, giving the shoe its unmistakable identity and smooth ride. Its fluid lines and breathable build reflect a moment when Nike was pushing comfort and modern aesthetics forward in equal measure. Fans of the Air Max line appreciate how the 2017 model balances everyday wearability with strong visual impact. The rich red tone stands out without feeling overwhelming, especially when grounded by black detailing. It captures the eras focus on innovation and comfort while staying versatile enough for daily rotation. Clean, athletic, and unmistakably Air Max, this pair holds its own within the lineage. The Nike Air Max 2017 Team Red Black was released on January 1, 2017 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '87 SP Supreme Triple White
Description: The Supreme Triple White Nike Air Max 1 87 SP debuts in pure white premium leather with snakeskin?debossed Swoosh, "World Famous" embroidery on the heel, and co?branding on lace locks and tongue labels. Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 White Sage
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 White Sage offers a lighter and more refined take on the silhouette through a palette that blends clean neutrals with soft green accents. The white base gives the shoe a fresh and breathable look, while sage tones add subtle contrast that enhances the layered upper. The Omni 9 remains a key part of Sauconys performance archive, and this version brings it into a more lifestyle oriented space without losing its technical identity. Fans gravitate toward neutral runners like this because they offer versatility while still carrying distinctive design features. The white and sage combination creates a calm and balanced aesthetic that works across different outfits and seasons. The ProGrid cushioning system continues to provide the comfort that defines the model. Retro runners like this remain popular due to their blend of function and style. For collectors, pairs like this represent how subtle color adjustments can refresh a classic silhouette while preserving its core appeal. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 White Sage was released on March 31, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Valentine's Day (2026) (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Valentines Day 2026 Womens brings warmth and emotion to one of adidas most enduring silhouettes by leaning into soft color and thoughtful contrast. The cream white base paired with better scarlet and sandy pink accents gives the shoe a romantic but wearable feel, making it expressive without becoming overly themed. It feels gentle, celebratory, and rooted in comfort. Collectors are drawn to this release because it shows how small design shifts can completely change the mood of a classic. The Handball Spezials low profile shape keeps the shoe grounded, while the Valentines Day palette adds personality and charm. Fans love it as a reminder that heritage silhouettes can still feel fresh and emotionally resonant when handled with care and intention. The adidas Handball Spezial Valentines Day 2026 Womens was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Arctic Sky Pure Silver
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Arctic Sky Pure Silver is a stunning addition to the renowned Gel Kayano line. This men's sneaker combines style and performance in a sleek package. The upper features a cool Arctic Sky colorway complemented by Pure Silver accents, creating a visually appealing design that's perfect for both athletic pursuits and casual wear. The shoe's construction incorporates ASICS' signature GEL technology in the midsole, providing superior cushioning and shock absorption for all-day comfort. Designed with both form and function in mind, the Gel Kayano 14 boasts a breathable mesh upper that ensures proper ventilation during intense workouts or long walks. The shoe's supportive structure and advanced cushioning system work together to provide excellent stability and reduce the risk of fatigue. With its blend of cutting-edge technology and stylish aesthetics, this ASICS model is an ideal choice for runners and sneaker enthusiasts alike. Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that offers both performance benefits and fashionable appeal.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Lenticular
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Lenticular honors Kobe Bryants legacy through a design that blends storytelling, innovation, and tribute. The lenticular detailing adds depth and movement, creating a visual effect that feels alive and symbolic of Kobes evolving impact on the game. Collectors connect with this pair because it feels deeply intentional. The Protro approach reinforces performance and legacy, while the Air Force 1 base makes the tribute accessible and wearable. Fans appreciate how the lenticular finish adds meaning without excess, turning a familiar silhouette into a respectful and modern celebration of one of basketballs most influential figures. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Lenticular was released on December 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Model: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium SE

Display Name: Nike GT Future .SWOOSH Swooshman
Description: The Nike GT Future SWOOSH Swooshman is a March 2026 release of Nike's GT Future basketball lifestyle silhouette in the Swooshman colorway, featuring a Metallic Silver upper with University Red and Black accents that applies the GT Future's elongated, futuristic low-profile design to a high-contrast metallic and red color story with the Swooshman branding identifying this as a specific graphic-driven execution within the GT Future's seasonal colorway range. The GT Future is a lifestyle basketball silhouette from Nike's Greater Than line that translates the performance basketball design language of the GT series into a lower-profile, lifestyle-ready format, with the extended midsole geometry, layered upper construction, and elongated toe profile giving the GT Future its distinctive appearance that reads as a basketball shoe evolved for off-court wearing rather than on-court competition. The Metallic Silver base creates the most reflective and most visually striking expression of the GT Future's upper paneling, with the large-scale Swoosh and branding elements reading with maximum contrast against the silver ground and connecting to the shoe's identity through the University Red Swoosh that serves as the primary color accent. Released March 20, 2026 at $210 retail via SNKRS and select Nike Basketball retailers. The Nike GT Future SWOOSH Swooshman was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Premium Hyper Crimson Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Hyper Crimson Black celebrates football on its biggest stage, translating the swirling graphics and grey hues associated with the Dutch national team into an iconic Air Max 90 silhouette. The rubber Waffle outsole delivers dependable traction alongside the shoe's heritage styling, tying the design directly back to its original running silhouette even as the colorway leans fully into football fandom. Released ahead of a major international tournament, this Hyper Crimson Black edition offers collectors a distinctive, nationally themed entry within the broader Air Max 90 Premium lineup. The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Hyper Crimson Black was released on January 16, 2020 with a retail price of $150.

Model: Nike Air Force 1 Low Gore-Tex Vibram

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Smoke Grey Light Photo Blue

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 '87 Photon Dust Wolf Grey

Fresh and balanced, this pair delivers effortless cool through thoughtful detail. Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Blue Chill

The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Blue Chill was released on October 28, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Model: adidas Fear of God Athletics '86 Lo

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Black Chrome
