The Black/Chrome palette delivers a polished edge, matte black panels set off mirror-like metallic accents and a bold Swoosh for a clean, modern finish that looks sharp from warmups to crunch time. Style codes CZ0175-006 / CZ0176-006 signal a dialed-in design thats all about speed, stability, and all-game comfort. Underfoot, a low-to-the-floor ride maximizes court feel without sacrificing impact protection. A Zoom Air Strobel underfoot teams with a responsive drop-in foam to return energy on every plant, jab, and burst, while additional cushioning in the heel smooths hard landings. The aggressive, data-informed traction pattern grips hardwood for fearless changes of direction, and a secure collar with padded interior locks in your ankle without bulk. Whether youre a shifty guard or a two-way wing, the GT Cut Black Chrome is engineered to help you separate, stop faster, and finish stronger. Our team loves this product because it blends razor-sharp traction, responsive Zoom cushioning, and a refined Black/Chrome finish that performs at the highest level and looks premium off the court.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Plum (2020/2024)
Description: Nike brought back another co.jp classic with the Nike Dunk Plum Low (2020/2024), now available on StockX. In the early 2000s, Nike released a series of Dunk and Air Force 1 colorways exclusive to their Japanese retailers. Among these releases was the Nike Dunk Low Plum, originally released in 2001 as part of the "Ugly Duckling" Dunk pack. The Dunk Low is composed of a purple-shaded premium suede upper with a red Swoosh and details. A white midsole, red outsole, and Nike branding on the heel completes the design. These sneakers released in February of 2020 and retailed for $100. The Nike Dunk Plum Low (2020/2024) restocked in March of 2024 and retailed for $115.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low SP Kentucky
Description: Nike celebrated the 35th Anniversary of the Nike Dunk by releasing the Nike Dunk Low SP Syracuse (2020), now available on StockX. The Nike Dunk debuted as part of the 1985 Nike College Colors program, a program that delivered footwear in the school colors of 12 popular basketball programs allowing fans to support their favorite teams from head to toe. This Kentucky colorway was among the first collegiate colorways Nike released, breaking the mold for colorways used on basketball shoes. This Nike Dunk Low SP is composed of a white leather upper with varsity royal leather overlays. A white midsole, royal outsole, and classic Nike branding on the tongue completes the design. These sneakers released in March of 2020 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat White Grey Fog
Description: The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat White Grey Fog seamlessly blends style and practicality, meticulously crafted to enhance speed and agility through its construction and stud placement. A fusion of white and Grey Fog hues adorns the Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat colorway, exuding a modern and sleek aesthetic. The shoe's upper is composed of synthetic leather, not only augmenting its visual appeal but also ensuring durability. Its low-cut design permits extensive ankle mobility, and the lace closure ensures a snug fit. Additionally, the reinforced toe box incorporates perforations, granting added protection and breathability. Underneath, the cleat showcases rubber studs strategically placed with a wide configuration and external pods, ensuring great traction. The most remarkable attribute of the Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat White Grey Fog is its strategically positioned wide studs. This innovative feature is expertly engineered to assist athletes in swift turns and maneuvers on the field, offering a heightened level of agility and responsiveness. The cleat debuted on June 1, 2023, for $140.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro French Blue
Description: The Air Jordan 13 French Blue features a white perforated leather upper with French Blue Durabuck mudguards and a grey leather toe wrap. Nodding to Michael Jordan's "Black Cat" nickname, a signature Jordan holographic emblem at the collar is reminiscent of panther eyes, while a sculptural sole takes the form of cat paws. The Air Jordan 13 French Blue released in August of 2022 and retailed for $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Peony Light Crimson
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Peony Light Crimson offers a softer and more balanced color approach, blending warm tones with a clean white base that keeps the design approachable. Peony and light crimson accents add a subtle pop of color, while team crimson details provide depth without overwhelming the silhouette. The classic Air Max 90 structure remains unchanged, allowing the color palette to define the overall feel. Fans appreciate this version because it delivers a refined and wearable take on a familiar model. The combination of lighter tones and classic design makes it easy to integrate into everyday outfits. It stands as a reminder that the Air Max 90 continues to evolve through thoughtful color updates rather than drastic changes. The Nike Air Max 90 Peony Light Crimson was released on January 10, 2024 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Presto Hello Kitty (2022)
Description: Originally produced as a gift for Nike's friends and family in 2004, the Nike Air Presto Hello Kitty returned in 2022 for its first-ever official release. The Nike Air Presto Hello Kitty nods to Sanrio's Hello Kitty, a fictional character created by Yuko Shimizu in 1974. The upper is constructed of a light blue neoprene upper with Hello Kitty graphics and a semi translucent TPU lace cage. At the heel, a Hello Kitty styled heel wrap adds further detailing. From there, a white and black Air sole with Swoosh detailing completes the design. The Nike Air Presto Hello Kitty released in May of 2022 and retailed for $140.

Display Name: Nike Book 2 Fragment
Description: The Nike Book 2 Fragment brings collaborative energy to the evolving Book line through a bold Multi Color execution. Layers of vibrant tones blend across the upper, creating a visually dynamic look that feels expressive and modern. The streamlined basketball silhouette maintains a performance first focus beneath the artistic palette. Fragment involvement always carries cultural weight, especially when paired with a rising signature series. The mix of colors gives this pair a curated and almost collage like feel, standing apart from standard team based releases. For collectors who track both performance footwear and influential collaborations, this edition represents a compelling intersection of sport and design. The Nike Book 2 Fragment was released on March 19, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Sprite
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Sprite injects playful energy into a silhouette known for stability and structure. White and silver form a familiar technical base, while green and blue accents introduce a fresh and lively contrast inspired by classic sport color palettes. The layered construction and visible lines remain true to the Kayanos running heritage, giving the shoe depth and character. Fans gravitate toward this version because it feels energetic without losing balance. The Sprite inspired colors bring personality while remaining grounded in performance driven design. Collectors appreciate how the Gel Kayano 14 continues to adapt through color storytelling, maintaining relevance without sacrificing identity. This release feels fun and confident, reinforcing the models ability to evolve while staying rooted in the design principles that made it iconic. The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Sprite was released on June 27, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Off-White Earth Strata Gum (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Off White Earth Strata Gum Womens delivers a clean and neutral take on the iconic silhouette, blending off white and earth strata tones for a soft and wearable look. The gum sole anchors the design in its indoor roots, while the upper keeps things minimal and balanced. It feels like a refined version of a model that has always prioritized simplicity. Fans appreciate this colorway for its versatility and timeless appeal. The Spezial remains a go to for those who value understated design, and this version leans fully into that with a palette that works across seasons and styles. It is a pair that does not need bold elements to stand out, relying instead on consistency and clean execution. The adidas Handball Spezial Off White Earth Strata Gum Womens was released on November 29, 2024 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Taupe Haze
Description: Hype for the new Air Jordan 4 Taupe Haze started brewing when the teasers of the sneakers surfaced, with sneakerheads noting their similarities to Travis Scotts unreleased Air Jordan 4 Olive. Despite being compared to such a hyped sneaker, the Air Jordan 4 Taupe Haze has characteristics that allow it to stand out on its own. The Air Jordan 4 Taupe Haze features a unique design that elevates the popular Jordan model. The upper holds cracked textures on the forefoot, midfoot, and tongue, with lighter shades of Taupe Haze under the top coat. From there, hits of black appear on the outsole, midsole, and eyelets. An Infrared Jumpman logo on the tongue brightens up the tonal sneaker and completes its overall design. The Air Jordan 4 Taupe Haze dropped in February of 2021 for $200.

Display Name: adidas BadBo 1.0 Bad Bunny Resilience
Description: Sneaker culture reached a new milestone with the adidas BadBo 1.0 Bad Bunny Resilience, a signature silhouette that marks Bad Bunnys first fully original design with adidas. Standing apart from his past collaborations on classic adidas icons, the BadBo 1.0 blends a bold, 90s-inspired athletic aesthetic with contemporary lifestyle sensibilities, giving this model an instantly recognizable presence on foot. Its layered construction mixes premium suede, mesh, and structured synthetics to create depth and texture, while a sculpted midsole gives the silhouette a chunky yet refined stance thats both wearable and statement-ready. The "Resilience" colorway interprets its title through a tonal palette of Chalk White, Talc, and Core White that emphasizes texture, letting the designs architecture take center stage. Subtle blue accents on the tongue and heel provide a quiet contrast, and signature "adidas para Bad Bunny" branding on the insoles highlights the collaborative nature of the release. The BadBos unique wing-like lace cage and geometric overlays nod to vintage court silhouettes while signaling forward thinking design, a perfect fit for a creative voice who continually pushes boundaries across music and fashion. Released on February 9, 2026, the adidas BadBo 1.0 Bad Bunny Resilience tapped into the momentum around Bad Bunnys Super Bowl Halftime Show appearance and broader cultural influence, quickly becoming one of the most talked-about drops of the year for sneaker enthusiasts. With a retail price of $160, this Chalk White/Talc/Core White edition stands as a landmark moment in adidas ongoing evolution of artist collaborations and signals that Bad Bunny is not just a muse, hes a creator shaping the future of footwear.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 Halloween
Description: The Nike Book 1 Halloween is a basketball shoe designed in collaboration with basketball player Devin Booker for the Halloween season. The Halloween Nike Book 1 is made of smooth leather on the upper in black, with a bit of a glittery sheen to it. The toe box features perforations for breathability, while overlays in the same color and material form the toe cap and heel counter. The Nike Swoosh, designed to look like poorly done monster stitching in white thread, appears on the sides. The tongue features Clay Orange Book branding and two matching metal eyelets at the top. The heel features a pull tab adorned with white text reading "Chapter One," and the shoe sits on a black and white midsole. What we think stands out about this shoe is the branding, which is truly in a Halloween spooky stitching style. The Nike Book 1 Halloween was released on October 30, 2024, for $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Mid '07 Black
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Mid '07 Triple Black (2021) features a smooth black-on-black upper made of genuine and synthetic leather with a black swoosh and overlays on the heel and toe cap. The Nike Air Force 1 Mid '07 Triple Black's black laces feature a silver AF1 tag. The black heel tab has black Nike Air branding and swoosh, and the strap at the top of the collar sports a mini swoosh. The black insole of the right shoe has a white patch with branding, the black midsole has a hidden Air Sole unit, and the black rubber outsole features an iconic concentric circles pattern. The Nike Air Force 1 Mid '07 Triple Black (2021) was released in 2021 at a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Rift Triple Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Rift Triple Black (Women's) offers a versatile, comfortable, and casual yet rugged shoe designed for all sorts of fun, whether it's in the city, at the beach, or on the trail. The sneaker has been specifically sized for women. This low-to-the-ground sneaker is comprised of black textile panels that overlap. The toebox panel sports a tonal embroidered Nike Swoosh, while the midfoot and heel panels feature black leather and webbing straps to help secure an overall foot fit. A lighter black foam midsole in an undulating pod design encapsulates Air for ultimate cushioning and features debossed Air branding. The outsole is lugged rubber that matches the midsole, providing rugged traction for any adventure. The feature of this women's shoe that we most appreciate is the tongue area, which has been left open, offering this shoe and easy sandal vibe. The Nike Air Rift Triple Black (Women's) was released on May 18, 2024, for retail price of $120.

Display Name: Puma Speedcat Premium Rosé Black
Description: Puma Speedcat Premium Rose Black revives motorsport inspired design through a sleek and low profile silhouette that feels elegant and intentional. The rose and black color combination adds sophistication to the Speedcats racing heritage, giving it a refined presence that feels equally at home on the street and in curated collections. It reflects Pumas ability to translate performance roots into lifestyle relevance. Collectors are drawn to the Speedcat because of its purity of form. The slim shape and grounded stance feel timeless, and this premium execution adds warmth and contrast without distracting from the design. It appeals to fans who appreciate footwear that feels precise, understated, and deeply rooted in movement culture. The Puma Speedcat Premium Rose Black was released on 08/29/2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: New Balance 993 MiUSA Red Black
Description: The New Balance 993 MiUSA Red Black brings a bold twist to one of the brands most respected Made in USA silhouettes. Known for its premium construction and comfort focused design, the 993 stands as a staple within New Balances heritage lineup. This version introduces a striking Team Red and Black color combination that gives the traditionally understated model a more aggressive and modern edge while still preserving its classic structure and layered suede and mesh upper. Fans gravitate toward the 993 because it represents the core of New Balance craftsmanship and everyday wearability. The Made in USA designation adds another layer of appeal, signaling quality materials and attention to detail that collectors value. The red and black palette brings new energy to the silhouette, making it stand out more than traditional grey based releases. For collectors, pairs like this highlight how New Balance continues evolving its heritage models through color while maintaining the comfort and authenticity that made the 993 iconic. The New Balance 993 MiUSA Red Black was released on April 2, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide Black
Description: Slip into effortless comfort with the Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide Black, a sleek, slip-on essential built to help you wind down and gear up with ease. Designed around Nikes ReactX cushioning, the footbed delivers a plush, responsive feel that softens every step, ideal for post-workout recovery, travel days, or everyday errands. A wide, supportive strap secures the foot without pressure points, while the contoured bed cradles your arch and heel for stable, all-day wear. The all-Black/Black palette pairs seamlessly with athleisure or streetwear, and the streamlined silhouette keeps your look clean from poolside to pavement. Style code HV4479-001 anchors the design, making it easy to match and collect. Practical details elevate the experience: a textured footbed helps reduce slippage when feet are damp, and a durable outsole with a subtle traction pattern holds its own on wet or dry surfaces. Lightweight materials make these slides easy to pack and even easier to live in, while the soft, flexible construction minimizes break-in time. Released on April 23, 2025, the Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide merges recovery-ready comfort with a minimalist aesthetic, creating a versatile staple that feels as good as it looks, whether youre cooling down after a training session or stepping out for a casual coffee run. Our team loves this product because the ReactX cushioning, contoured support, and understated Black finish deliver standout comfort and style youll reach for every single day.

Display Name: Nike ST Charge College Grey
Description: The Nike ST Charge College Grey is one of the more visually complex entries in Nike Basketball's Street Tough series, a model built around the idea that outdoor hoops demands ruggedness and visual aggression in equal measure, and this colorway delivers both. A College Grey TPU shell sits over a tough tan mesh base, the raised angular patterns running from toe through side panel and heel giving the upper an almost armored quality that sets the ST Charge apart from cleaner basketball silhouettes in Nike's catalog. A brown tongue and heel tab add a warm earthy contrast, while Bright Crimson lines the sockliner and medial Swoosh with a flash of intensity that only reveals itself once the shoe is on. Metallic Gold lands on the lateral panel Swoosh and upper lace eyelets, finishing the colorway with a premium accent that bridges streetball culture and trophy mentality. A semi-translucent icy outsole with visible blue and crimson traction zones completes the look underfoot, with Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot and a Cushlon 3.0 drop-in midsole delivering performance credibility to match the aggressive visual identity. The ST Charge, short for Street Tough, has quickly become one of Nike Basketball's most exciting non-signature models, built specifically for the physicality and unpredictability of outdoor courts where XDR rubber and a credit card-sized shank for lateral stability matter more than arena-level refinement. The model gained global attention through a Cade Cunningham PE that debuted during All-Star Weekend, and the College Grey College Grey colorway represents the kind of mainline expression that demonstrates the platform's range beyond player exclusives. The shoe is currently targeted at Asian markets, making US availability limited, which only adds to the appeal for collectors who follow Nike Basketball globally and understand that some of the brand's most interesting basketball releases never officially touch down stateside. The Nike ST Charge College Grey is available at a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Off Noir
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro Off Noir (Women's) takes a classic silhouette and dresses it in a fusion of different colors and textures and sizes it for women. This sneaker offers elite style and high-performance capabilities. The Women's Off Noir Jordan 3 Retro sports a base of black nubuck suede overlaid with black leather. The black leather of the tongue, eye stays, and collar is perforated, adding both style and breathability. Elephant print leather overlays the heel and toe. A tonal embossed Jumpman logo adorns the heel tab while a tonal debossed Jumpman graces the tongue. The eyelets provide the one hit of coconut milk on the upper. What we enjoy most about this singular shoe is its tried-and-true sole unit. Coconut milk-colored foam in the midsole houses visible Air for both cushioning and spring. The gray rubber outsole absorbs impact and provides multidirectional traction. The Jordan 3 Retro Off Noir (Women's) was released on November 15, 2023, for a retail price of $200.

Display Name: UGG Tasman Slipper Caspian Burnt Cedar (Women's)
Description: The UGG Tasman Slipper Caspian Burnt Cedar (Women's) decorates the Tasman silhouette in a bold leopard pattern. The women's Caspian Burnt Cedarcolored UGG Tasman Slipper retains its lightweight design while adding a calf-hair upper. The rough texture of the calf hair creates additional dimension beneath the leopard print, mimicking many traditional moccasin designs. The lightweight outsole is crafted from sugarcane EVA, which has a smaller carbon footprint than petroleum-based foams. Soft wool in Caspian Burnt Cedar lines the inside, while the iconic UGGbraid winds around the collar and the foam footbed adds a pillowy feel underfoot. Like other Tasman models, this version features a slip-on design and a rounded toe. Completing the look, a heat-embossed UGG logo decorates a leather tag sewn into the UGGbraid. Our experts at StockX appreciate that this shoe is part of Herproject, an initiative that supports women in the workforce. The womens-size UGG Tasman Slipper Caspian Burnt Cedar (Women's) was released on August 19, 2024, and originally sold for $110.

Display Name: New Balance 1906L Ice Wine Pink Taffy
Description: The New Balance 1906L Pink pushes the silhouette into a softer and more expressive direction through a colorway that feels light and playful. The Ice Wine and Pink Taffy tones bring a layered pastel look that contrasts with the models technical build, creating a balance between structure and color. It keeps the same performance inspired foundation while introducing a more lifestyle focused aesthetic. This pair stands out because it shows the versatility of the 1906 line. New Balance continues to experiment with color in ways that open the silhouette up to different audiences. For collectors, it represents a shift toward more expressive palettes while still maintaining the comfort and detail that define the model. The New Balance 1906L Pink was released on September 23, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: UGG Zora Ballet Flat Chestnut (Women's)
Description: UGG Zora Ballet Flat Chestnut Womens translates UGGs comfort driven DNA into a refined silhouette that feels effortless and grounded. The chestnut colorway brings warmth and familiarity, while the ballet flat shape offers a softer, more delicate expression of everyday wear. It feels cozy without being heavy, designed for ease and comfort rather than statement making. Collectors and lifestyle fans appreciate the Zora because it fits naturally into daily routines. The flat feels intentional and calm, offering the kind of reliability that makes it a quiet favorite over time. It reflects UGGs strength in creating footwear that feels emotionally comforting, turning simplicity into something genuinely desirable and lived in rather than seasonal or trend focused. The UGG Zora Ballet Flat Chestnut Womens was released on 10/20/2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Rigorer AR1 Silent Night
Description: The Rigorer AR1 Silent Night is NBA player Austin Reavess tribute to Kobe Bryants mamba mentality. It features the NBA legends iconic black mamba imagery and technical features inspired by stealthy snake movements. Boasting a black colorway with gray accents, the performance basketball Silent Night Rigorer AR1 has a lightweight upper crafted from textile and leather. A snake skeleton adorns the insole, while a hissing snake in gray graces the outer side panel. In addition, the shiny mudguard features a snakeskin pattern. In terms of technology, carbon fiber TPU creates an anti-rollover effect and supports swift movements. The sneaker boasts a thin insole, lowering the players center of gravity and providing a grounded feel. Although the sneaker celebrates "The Black Mamba," the mudguard houses Austin Reavess signature. Our experts at StockX like the imagery behind the sneakers name: a snake moving quietly through the night. The Rigorer AR1 Silent Night was released on October 30, 2024, and sold for $100.

Display Name: Under Armour Curry 13 Will Harris
Description: The Under Armour Curry 13 Will Harris continues Stephen Currys signature line with a design that reflects performance and creative storytelling, using a pink rave hyper green white palette that feels energetic and expressive. The silhouette is built for movement, with a structure that supports quick cuts and fluid play on the court. Fans of Currys line appreciate how each release connects to different influences while maintaining performance focus. This pair stands out through its bold color combination, offering something that feels unique within basketball footwear. It works as both a performance shoe and a collectible tied to Currys ongoing legacy. The Under Armour Curry 13 Will Harris was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Premium Light Violet Ore
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Light Violet Ore introduces a richer and more expressive palette, using light violet ore to reshape the mood of the silhouette. The deeper tone works against iron grey, anthracite, and black elements to create contrast that feels layered and slightly moody. It is a colorway that feels more atmospheric than traditional. This version resonates with fans who appreciate when the Air Max 90 leans into more experimental tones. The balance between dark and muted colors gives it a distinct presence without relying on brightness. It is a subtle shift in direction that still feels aligned with the models identity, offering something different without losing familiarity. The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Light Violet Ore was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $15

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Linen
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Linen revisits a beloved Air Force 1 color story through the lens of Kobe Bryants enduring influence. The linen tones give the shoe a calm and understated presence, highlighting texture and warmth rather than contrast. It feels effortless and timeless, blending lifestyle wearability with deeper cultural meaning tied to Kobes legacy and philosophy. Fans love this release because it balances nostalgia and tribute so naturally. The Air Force 1 silhouette remains clean and familiar, while the Protro treatment gives it renewed purpose. Collectors appreciate how the linen colorway feels mature and versatile, making it a sneaker that can be worn daily while still carrying emotional significance and respect for one of the games greatest icons. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Linen was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Gore-Tex Summit White Light Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Gore Tex Summit White Light Smoke Grey adds weather ready functionality to one of Nikes most recognizable silhouettes, using a summit white black off white light smoke grey palette that keeps the look clean and adaptable. The Gore Tex construction introduces durability and protection, making the shoe more versatile across different conditions. Collectors are drawn to this version because it enhances a classic without changing its core identity. The added material makes it more practical, while the neutral colorway ensures it remains easy to wear. It stands as a functional upgrade that still respects the Dunks place within sneaker culture. The Nike Dunk Low Gore Tex Summit White Light Smoke Grey was released with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Air DT Max '96 Black White (2024)
Description: The Nike Air DT Max '96 Black White (2024) is a shoe designed as a revival of the original design from the 1990s. This iteration of the Nike Air DT Max 96 is constructed with a white leather base for the upper. The upper is covered with a black leather overlay that looks like its dripping from the top in streaks down the white midsole and into the outsole. Black also forms the toe cap, and on the lateral side, the black streaks have perforations that reveal a Varsity Maize yellow color underneath. Small yellow Nike swooshes also appear on each side of the ankle, and a black strap over the laces contains a white Nike swoosh. The heel contains a yellow Swoosh and the word "AIR," while the tongue also features branding elements. The white wavy outsole contains a visible Air DT Max unit in the heel. What we like most about this particular sneaker is the way the black overlays look like theyre dripping down the shoes upper. The Nike Air DT Max '96 Black White (2024) was released on June 14, 2024, for $170.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Harris Tweed White Black Multi (Women's)
Description: Nike Dunk Low Harris Tweed White Black Multi Womens transforms the classic Dunk Low silhouette with a textured twist, layering traditional Harris Tweed fabric over the clean lines that made the shoe a staple. The white and black base keeps the look grounded, while the multi color tweed introduces subtle complexity that feels refined and elevated. It feels like a thoughtful blend of heritage material and streetwear energy rather than a rushed trend piece. Collectors appreciate this release because it highlights how sneakers can carry tactile narrative as well as visual style. The Dunk Low has always been a canvas for experimentation, and pairing it with Harris Tweed gives the shoe the feeling of purpose and context. Its the kind of design that invites closer inspection and rewards fans who value craft and texture in addition to silhouette history. The Nike Dunk Low Harris Tweed White Black Multi Womens was released on 09/03/2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 23 Honor Society
Description: The Nike LeBron 23 Honor Society brings a regal and elevated theme into LeBrons signature line, using wheat gold and gum medium brown tones to create a rich and grounded palette. Magic ember and wolf grey accents add depth, giving the design a layered and structured feel. The silhouette reflects modern performance needs, built for power, control, and responsiveness on the court. What makes this pair stand out is its concept driven execution. The Honor Society theme introduces a sense of prestige and recognition, aligning with LeBrons status within the game. The color palette reinforces that idea, creating a sneaker that feels both premium and performance ready. Nike continues to evolve the LeBron line, and this release reflects a strong balance between storytelling and functionality. The Nike LeBron 23 Honor Society was released on February 10, 2026 with a retail price of $210.
Colorway: Wheat Gold/Gum Medium Brown/Magic Ember/Wolf Grey

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Sashiko Pale Ivory
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Sashiko Pale Ivory brings a refined and textured approach to the retro runner through details inspired by traditional stitching techniques. The muslin and pale ivory base creates a soft and neutral look, while college grey accents add depth and structure across the upper. The layered construction reflects early 2000s running design, enhanced by subtle pattern work. Fans of the Vomero 5 appreciate how it continues to evolve through material and detail rather than drastic changes. The sashiko inspired elements add a unique touch that sets this version apart while keeping it wearable. It is a sneaker that blends heritage, comfort, and craftsmanship in a cohesive design. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Sashiko Pale Ivory was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Rick Owens DRKSHDW Vintage Low Black Milk
Description: The Rick Owens DRKSHDW Vintage Low Black Milk distills the labels avant-garde attitude into an everyday silhouette. Set in the striking Black/Milk/Milk colorway, this low-top sneaker pairs a deep black canvas upper with creamy "milk" tones on the cap toe, laces, and rugged rubber sole for bold contrast. Signature Rick proportions, an elongated tongue, oversized eyelets, and a sculptural foxing, create a distinctive profile that elevates denim, tailoring, and casual fits alike. A grippy tread and reinforced toe add durability, while the cushioned footbed keeps things comfortable from first wear. Minimal branding and precise stitching let the construction and shape do the talking, making this designer low-top an easy anchor for modern wardrobes. The thick rubber midsole delivers a confident stance without feeling heavy, and the clean lines ensure the shoe transitions seamlessly from day to night. Released on 2024-06-29, the DRKSHDW Vintage Low Black Milk stands out for its artful balance of edge and versatility, an essential for fans of contemporary luxury sneakers who want a piece that looks considered from every angle. Our team loves this product because it blends statement-making design with reliable comfort, making it great for daily rotation and standout styling.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Olympic
Description: Released ahead of the 2024 Paris Olympics, the Nike Air Max 1 Olympic decks out the Air Max 1 silhouette with details inspired by the Olympic Games. The Olympic Nike Air Max 1 embodies the spirit of Team USA, with a white base and patriotic accents in obsidian-blue and red. A metallic-gold Swoosh logo graces the side panel and represents the drive to achieve Olympic gold. Classic color blocking on the upper pays homage to the original Air Max 1, while the obsidian mudguard takes notes from the OG Obsidian colorway. The upper construction consists of a mesh base with Light Smoke Grey overlays near the rear and midfoot. Pops of red stand out on the eyelets, the tongues logo tag, and the NIKE AIR branding on the heel. Our experts like how this sneaker subtly celebrates the 2024 Olympics and Team USA through colors instead of motifs or bold lettering. The Nike Air Max 1 Olympic was released on June 17, 2024, and sold for $150.

Display Name: New Balance 530 Steel Grey
Description: The New Balance 530 was originally released in 1992, and the New Balance 530 in Steel Grey is a recreation of the companys classic running shoe designs. The New Balance 530 Steel Grey boasts of a synthetic mesh upper construction with steel grey leather overlays appearing on most of the upper. The signature N logo appears in white, and the white continues to the laces and the chunky ENCAP midsole and ABZORB heel cushioning. The adjustable lace closure provides a comfortable fit, and the ABZORB heel cushioning provides comfort. The New Balance 530 Steel Grey was released in January 2021 and originally retailed for $110.

Display Name: Nike KD 17 Christmas
Description: The Nike KD 17 Christmas dresses NBA player Kevin Durant's 17th signature basketball shoe in an icy colorway of Glacier Blue, Aquarius Blue, white, and Metallic Silver in time for Christmas 2024. Nike Air units in the heel and a Zoom Air unit in the forefoot deliver responsive cushioning that supports quick, decisive movements. Display Name: Nike LeBron 22 Bryce's World
Description: The Nike LeBron 22 Bryces World bursts with layered color that mirrors the creative energy behind the theme. Blustery and Armory Navy provide a cool foundation, while Fireberry, Ghost Green, Diffused Blue, and Playful Pink accents add vivid contrast throughout the silhouette. It feels playful yet commanding, blending family inspiration with elite level design. Dynamic and confident, this release stands out from every angle.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Gore-Tex Protection Pack Black Magnet
Description: The New Balance 2002R Gore Tex Protection Pack Black Magnet leans into durability and weather resistance while maintaining the layered aesthetic that defines the Protection Pack series. The black and magnet colorway gives it a stealthy and rugged appearance, while the jagged overlay design adds texture and dimension. It feels built for unpredictable conditions without losing its visual edge. What makes this pair resonate is its ability to merge function with style in a way that feels natural. The Gore Tex construction reinforces its readiness for wet environments, while the distressed detailing keeps it rooted in contemporary sneaker culture. It is a shoe that performs when needed but still looks intentional in everyday wear. Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Ocean Fog
Description: Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Ocean Fog channels skate heritage through a calm and understated palette that feels rooted in Supremes early identity. Ocean Fog gives the shoe a washed, coastal tone that softens the SB Dunks bold shape, letting mood and history take center stage. The design feels reflective, pulling from the mid nineties era that shaped both Supreme and modern skate culture. This release stands out because of its restraint. Instead of loud graphics, the shoe relies on color, proportion, and cultural context to tell its story. Collectors appreciate Supreme SB Dunks like this because they age with meaning, representing moments when authenticity mattered more than hype. It feels like a nod to the past delivered through a silhouette that still feels relevant today. The Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 Ocean Fog was released on 09/04/2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Jordan Son of Mars Low Do the Right Thing
Description: The Air Jordan Son of Mars Low Do The Right Thing in Game Royal Pimento Tour Yellow Cement Grey Pine Green is the definitive Spike Lee colorway applied to the Jordan Son of Mars Low, drawing directly from the vivid multi-color theatrical poster artwork of Spike Lee's 1989 film Do The Right Thing to create a Game Royal leather upper accented by Tour Yellow laces, tongue trim, and speckled midsole, Pimento red on the Jumpman logos and tongue shrouds, Pine Green on the lining and sockliner, and Cement Grey across the tongue, heelstay, and outsole, with elephant print overlays at the mudguard and heel maintaining the shoe's connection to the Air Jordan 3 heritage that forms one foundation of the Son of Mars hybrid construction. The Jordan Son of Mars is a hybrid model that Jordan Brand created in partnership with Spike Lee as a follow-up to the Jordan Spizike, combining design elements from the Air Jordan 3 through Air Jordan 6 across the silhouettes associated with Lee's Mars Blackmon character from his 1986 film She's Gotta Have It and from the iconic Air Jordan commercials Lee directed featuring his character from 1986 through the early 1990s, with the low-top version adding the Air Jordan 5's reflective tongue as a prominent design feature that carries red tongue shrouds embossed with Mars branding on the left shoe and Lee's 40 Acres and a Mule filmmaking company logo on the right shoe as the most explicit Spike Lee identifiers on the sneaker. The Do The Right Thing colorway was first applied to a Jordan shoe in 2007 on the Air Jordan 3, making the Son of Mars Low Do The Right Thing a continuation of a specific colorway narrative that Lee and Jordan Brand established before the Son of Mars silhouette existed. The Do The Right Thing Son of Mars Low was originally released June 29, 2013 at $140 retail through Jordan Brand accounts including House of Hoops by Foot Locker and Footlocker.com, debuting alongside the broader Son of Mars Low launch series and representing the highest-profile Spike Lee colorway available in the low-top Son of Mars format at the shoe's launch. The Son of Mars lace dubraes on the right and left sneakers reading Son Of and Mars respectively serve as the most characteristically dedicated Spike Lee branding element on the shoe beyond the 40 Acres logo, extending the storytelling approach that Lee and Jordan Brand applied across all Son of Mars colorways to give each pair a specific narrative identity beyond pure colorway description. The Do The Right Thing colorway's vivid Game Royal blue, Tour Yellow, Pimento red, and Pine Green combination is one of the most immediately recognizable and most reproduced color relationships in Jordan Brand history, connecting to the specific visual culture of late 1980s New York that both the film and Jordan Brand's partnership with Spike Lee during MJ's championship career permanently occupy. The Air Jordan Son of Mars Low Do The Right Thing was released on June 29, 2013 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Premium Barely Volt
Description: The Nike Vomero Premium Barely Volt elevates Nikes running heritage through a layered and experimental color palette that feels futuristic and bold. Barely volt and green tones flow across the upper, creating visual depth that highlights the shoes premium construction. It feels expressive and intentional, designed to showcase cushioning and structure as part of the aesthetic rather than hiding it. Fans love this release because it pushes comfort into statement territory. The Vomero Premium is built for plush ride and long wear, and this colorway reinforces that through energetic and modern styling. Collectors appreciate it as a forward looking runner that reflects Nikes willingness to experiment at the top end of its lineup, offering a shoe that feels luxurious, bold, and unmistakably contemporary. The Nike Vomero Premium Barely Volt was released on October 16, 2025 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential Psychic Blue
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Psychic Blue is an athletic shoe that subtly pays homage to the New York Knicks team via its colorway. This iteration of the Air Max 1 Essential is made with a light Psychic Blue mesh upper for breathability. The mesh stands out mostly on the toe box, peeks through the sides, and around the ankle collar. University Blue suede overlays cross the upper atop the toe box, on the sides, and as the heel counter for support, while a strip of Deep Royal blue leather forms the mudguard and the small Swooshes that adorn the sides. Bright orange Nike Air branding appears both on the heel and the tongue, and the top eyestays also get a bright orange hue. The thick white midsole contains Air Max units also accented with orange, while a blue and black outsole completes the look. This shoe has hits of bright orange, which are eye-catching against the blue backdrop. The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Psychic Blue was released on January 2, 2025, for $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Greedy (2026)
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Greedy 2026 brings back one of the most recognizable mixed color concepts, combining multiple bold tones across the layered upper to create a patchwork effect. Hyper turquoise, volt, and solar red all appear throughout the design, giving each section its own identity while still forming a cohesive whole. Description: The Nike Mind 002 Sail Womens introduces a forward thinking silhouette that blends lifestyle wear with experimental design language. The sail chrome chalk hyper crimson black palette feels layered yet soft, allowing the structure and material transitions to define the look. Display Name: New Balance 9060 Arid Stone Mushroom
Description: The New Balance 9060 Arid Stone Mushroom reimagines heritage design through a modern, sculptural lens. A breathable mesh base is wrapped in layered suede overlays, balancing durability with a refined, tactile feel. Our team loves this product because it blends cushioned ride, on-trend chunky proportions, and a versatile neutral colorway that makes effortless styling a daily habit.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High '85 OG Metallic Burgundy
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High '85 OG Metallic Burgundy is a relaunch of one of the rarest Air Jordan 1 models, a shoe originally released in 1985 as part of the Metallic Series. Display Name: Nike Air Max Torch 4 Dark Grey Metallic Silver Red
Description: The Nike Air Max Torch 4 Dark Grey Metallic Silver Red offers a practical and performance driven design with a color palette that emphasizes contrast and structure. Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Grisaille Blue Nights

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low City of Love Burgundy Crush

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Premium White Patent
