Description: The Air Jordan 3 Racer Blue features a white tumbled leather upper with grey perforated leather eyestays and Cement overlays. From there, hits of Racer Blue on the Jumpman logos and midsole add vibrance to the classic model. The Air Jordan 3 Racer Blue released in July of 2021 and retailed for $190.

Display Name: New Balance 530 Classic Black Grey
Description: The New Balance 530 Classic Black Gray is a technical running shoe that finds inspiration in classic sneaker designs from the New Balance catalog. One of the first things you notice is the overlapping overlays that come in Classic Black, gray, and Metallic Silver. Theyre constructed from leather and suede, and create a sense of movement across the upper due to the line designs. The upper is made of breathable mesh in Classic Black, while the tongue boasts a combination of mesh and synthetic materials. In terms of technology, an ABZORB midsole provides responsive cushioning and gives the sneaker a slightly bulky silhouette. This feature is similar to elements on early 2000s running shoes. Our StockX experts like the application of Classic Black on the rubber outsole because it contrasts the white midsole. The New Balance 530 Classic Black Gray was released on January 30th, 2023, and retailed at $100.

Display Name: New Balance 993 MiUSA Kith Madison Square Garden Navy
Description: The New Balance 993 MiUSA Kith Madison Square Garden Navy channels New York basketball culture through a heritage running silhouette. Dressed in Navy and Princess Blue, the upper showcases premium materials that reflect the Made in USA construction. The cushioned midsole and timeless shape keep it rooted in performance legacy. Kiths Madison Square Garden theme ties the release directly to the energy of New York sports history. The navy palette feels classic and versatile, while subtle detailing elevates the storytelling. It captures the fusion of sport, city pride, and refined craftsmanship in one cohesive design. The New Balance 993 MiUSA Kith Madison Square Garden Navy was released on November 3, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Running is Mental
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus Running is Mental leans into the mindset behind running as much as the performance itself, pairing a layered platinum tint and grey palette with a silhouette built for comfort and consistency. Reflect silver and metallic tones add subtle shine across the upper, giving the design a modern edge while keeping it grounded in neutral tones. The structure stays true to the Vomero line, emphasizing cushioning and a smooth ride. Fans of the Vomero series appreciate how releases like this connect design with the mental side of training. The message adds depth without overwhelming the look, allowing the shoe to remain versatile for both running and everyday wear. It is a sneaker that balances performance and perspective, offering a thoughtful take on a model known for reliability. The Nike Vomero Plus Running is Mental was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $190.
Colorway: Platinum Tint/Reflect Silver/Grey Fog/Iron Grey/Metallic Silver

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro SP 30th Anniversary Union Desert Moss
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Union LA Desert Moss features a Dark Iris mesh upper with Desert Moss suede overlays and translucent lace loops. From there, turquoise heel tabs and Union LA woven tabs on the lateral side complete the design. The Air Jordan 4 Union LA Desert Moss released in June of 2021 and retailed for $225.

Display Name: Crocs Pollex Juniper by Salehe Bembury Apricot
Description: The Crocs Pollex Juniper by Salehe Bembury Apricot is the fourth colorway of Salehe Bembury's first traditional sneaker silhouette created in partnership with Crocs, a model that debuted in May 2024 as a significant expansion of the Pollex Pod platform beyond the clog format that made the collaboration one of the most celebrated footwear partnerships of the early 2020s. Bembury, whose career trajectory from Versace to New Balance to independent creative partnerships has made him one of the most consistently interesting designers working at the intersection of performance footwear and fine art aesthetics, designed the Pollex Juniper from the ground up as a structured sneaker that carries the fingerprint motif, wavy sole design, and expressive material sensibility that characterize all of his Crocs work into a more conventional athletic upper format. The Apricot colorway pairs a bright orange upper across the synthetic material with a light purple molded sole unit carrying Bembury's signature wavy Pollex structure, with blue TPU plates at the midfoot, rouge red laces, a tan and brown tongue and collar, and yellow tongue tags completing one of the most deliberately polychromatic and joyfully complex color stories in the entire Pollex Juniper series. Ventilation holes on the heels and front upper ensure breathability and water flow, a nylon cushioning bootie provides ankle support and warmth, and the Pollex molding that wraps the sole delivers the multi-directional traction that makes Bembury's Crocs work genuinely functional. Releasing on May 22, 2025 exclusively through Bembury's BeASpunge website before wider retail availability on May 29, the Apricot continues the Pollex Juniper's consistent sell-out trajectory. Bembury's ability to build emotionally resonant and visually specific color narratives on a comfort-first foam platform is the design achievement that makes every Pollex release collectible, and the Apricot is the Pollex Juniper colorway that delivers maximum chromatic complexity in the most cohesive fruit-inspired palette the collaboration has yet produced. The Crocs Pollex Juniper by Salehe Bembury Apricot was released on May 29, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cool Grey
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cool Grey is a purpose-built running shoe designed for all distances. It has advanced cushioning technology that helps prolong stamina by returning energy through the foot on each stride. The Nike Zoom tech is combined with a forward-looking design, and the colorway of this model is a premium looking blend of greys and silvers. High visibility cross struts help runners stand out in low light conditions, while providing good lateral support for the wearer. Deeply grooved undersoles are made from sturdy modern synthetics. Our experts really appreciate the sophisticated layered look of the multiple upper materials in these trainers, and the breathability this creates. They also immediately noted how light they are. The model's athletic credentials are right up there, too. The Air Zoom cushioning literally puts a bounce in the step, while still robustly absorbing surface impact. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cool Grey was released on 20 July 2024, priced at $160.
Colorway: Wolf Grey/White/Metallic Silver/Cool Grey/Metallic Platinum/Wolf Grey

Display Name: Nike Kobe 1 Protro City of Champions
Description: The Nike Kobe 1 Protro City of Champions pays tribute to championship legacy through a refined blend of Work Blue and Summit White. Metallic Gold accents elevate the design, nodding to title winning moments while preserving the strong lines of the original Kobe 1 silhouette. The Protro build updates the performance components while maintaining its classic structure. City of Champions themes often carry deep emotional weight, and pairing that narrative with Kobe legacy makes this release especially meaningful. The balance of blue and gold gives it a regal presence without feeling overstated. For longtime Kobe collectors, this pair bridges past achievements with modern performance refinement. The Nike Kobe 1 Protro City of Champions was released on February 4, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Jordan Tatum 3 Welcome to the Garden Alternate
Description: The Jordan Tatum 3 Welcome to the Garden Alternate is a colorful kinetic green, white, and black colorway from the Jordan Tatum 3 line, which is NBA player Jayson Tatums signature shoe. The Welcome to the Garden Alternate colorway pays homage to Jayson Tatums mindset of putting energy where it matters most, such as his game and legacy. This high-top silhouette boasts a conforming fit that stretches when quick moves are needed. The upper is made of light textile and is dressed in black and white with wavy kinetic green accents and a floral pattern that is interspersed throughout. Black laces and a black tongue sporting a white JT logo round out this sneaker. In our opinion, we love this colorway was brought to life thanks to a growth mindset intertwined with a garden motif and floral pattern and that makes the Jordan Tatum 3 Welcome to the Garden Alternate standout from the rest. Released on October 10, 2024, this sneaker had a $125 retail price.

Display Name: New Balance 2010 Rich Paul Plum Brown
Description: The New Balance 2010 Rich Paul Plum Brown delivers refined storytelling through a rich and layered palette. Dressed in Plum Brown with NB Burgundy accents, the upper combines mesh and suede overlays for depth and texture. The sculpted sole unit maintains New Balances comfort focused design language while adding subtle performance cues. Rich Paul collaborations often emphasize understated luxury, and this colorway reflects that direction perfectly. The deep plum tones feel sophisticated and versatile, making the silhouette suitable for both casual and elevated styling. It captures New Balances ability to merge sports heritage with modern lifestyle influence. The New Balance 2010 Rich Paul Plum Brown was released on December 17, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Slate
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Slate revisits a classic silhouette with a focus on its most recognizable feature, the visible Air unit, now amplified through the Big Bubble design. The layered upper blends White, Emerald Green, Lake Blue, French Blue, Obsidian, and Black tones, creating a gradient inspired look that reflects the natural influences originally tied to the Air Max 95. The model remains one of the most iconic designs in Nike history, known for its human anatomy inspiration and distinctive paneling. Fans continue gravitating toward the Air Max 95 because of its unique structure and strong cultural presence. The Big Bubble update enhances the visual impact of the Air unit, making the shoe feel both nostalgic and refreshed. The mix of blues and greens adds depth while maintaining a cohesive color story that works well within the silhouettes layered design. For collectors, releases like this represent the continued evolution of a classic model, where small updates bring new life to a design that has remained influential for decades. The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Slate was released on May 7, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: New Balance 992 MiUSA Joe Freshgoods Aged Well
Description: The New Balance 992 MiUSA Joe Freshgoods Aged Well is a running shoe-style sneaker with an overlaid suede upper in Rose Smoke and Misty Rose, muted shades of orange and pink, over gray mesh. New Balance branding and Joe Freshgoods JFG logo accent the tongue and rear heel, highlighted by USA and N branding on the sides. The color-blocked midsole continues the Aged Well color palette, and a black outsole finishes the shoe. American sneaker brand New Balance has been based in Massachusetts since 1906, quietly and steadily producing performance-focused shoes. Hailing from Chicago, Joe Freshgoods is a lifestyle clothing brand known for bold, expressive graphics and creative outlets like films. Teaming up with New Balance, Joe Freshgoods applied their Aged Well motif to the 992 MiUSA. In our opinion, the best feature of the 992 MiUSA Aged Well is its color palette, which presents a new spin on neutrals. The New Balance 992 MiUSA Joe Freshgoods Aged Well was released on February 28, 2025, and retailed for $220.

Display Name: Nike LD Waffle SF sacai Fragment Blue Void
Description: The Nike LDWaffle sacai Fragment Blue Void combines the best of both sacai and Fragment's aesthetics. The mesh, leather, and suede construction of the LDWaffle represents sacai's experimental outlook, while the black and Blue Void palette is more reserved, similar to the utilitarian look that many of Fragment's collaborations have. The Nike LDWaffle sacai Fragment Blue Void released in August of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R JJJJound Storm Blue
Description: The New Balance 2002R JJJJound Storm Blue represents a collaboration between the world-renowned sneaker company and the Montreal-based design studio. This running and lifestyle shoe combines colors and textures in subtle, stormy hues. The JJJJound x New Balance 2002R Storm Blue sports an upper with a base of gray mesh. Overlays of gray suede, perforated blue leather, and silvery synthetic leather course across the upper giving the shoe style and support. A black leather N on the side panel ties into the black sock liner, insole, and black rubber outsole. Cream-colored laces match the cream-colored foam in the heel of the midsole. New Balance branding adorns the heel tab while JJJJound branding accents the tongue and insole. What our sneaker experts enjoy most about this shoe is the technology that provides cushioning and energy return in the midsole. ABZORB in the forefoot and ABZORB SBS in the heel provide cushioning and impact absorption while N-ergy specializes in springy energy return. Stability Web technology beneath the midfoot provides arch support. The New Balance 2002R JJJJound Storm Blue was released on October 26, 2023, for a retail price of $170.
Material: Leather, Suede, Mesh, Synthetic, Rubber, Foam

Display Name: Salomon XT-Whisper Almond Milk Lava Falls
Description: The Salomon XT Whisper Almond Milk Lava Falls introduces a softer and more fluid color palette to a performance driven silhouette known for its durability and structure. The Almond Milk base provides a light and neutral foundation, while Lava Falls accents add warmth and contrast that bring energy to the design. The XT Whisper continues Salomons focus on trail ready footwear, offering comfort and stability while adapting to modern lifestyle trends. Fans gravitate toward lighter colorways like this because they offer a different perspective on technical sneakers, making them easier to incorporate into everyday outfits. The combination of neutral and warm tones creates a balanced look that feels both natural and modern. Trail silhouettes continue gaining popularity due to their comfort and distinctive design language. For collectors, pairs like this represent how Salomon continues evolving its lineup through color experimentation while maintaining the performance features that define the brand. The Salomon XT Whisper Almond Milk Lava Falls was released on February 4, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Grey
Description: The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Grey comes in an all-grey color scheme. The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Grey has an upper constructed from a blend of synthetic and breathable mesh materials. The sneaker has a midsole featuring responsive foam for padding and stability. The outsole is made of rubber, making it durable and slip-resistant. The shoes include a sturdy toe cap and a sturdy heel counter for further protection. The shoe features an "N" logo and "2002R" lettering on either side. The sneaker also has "NB" branding on the heel. The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Grey was released on February 14, 2023, and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 SE Outer Space (GS)
Description: The Nike Ja 3 SE Outer Space GS leans into a more conceptual direction, using its color palette to reflect a cosmic theme. Photon dust and black create a darker base, while university red and game royal accents add bursts of color that feel almost like signals across space. The design feels dynamic and slightly futuristic. This pair resonates with fans who enjoy storytelling through design. The outer space theme adds personality without overwhelming the silhouette, allowing the performance features to remain at the forefront. It is a playful but still functional take on the Ja 3, making it appealing both on and off the court. The Nike Ja 3 SE Outer Space GS was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $112.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Denim (Women's)
Description: Since its first release, Air Jordan 1 High OG Denim (Women) remains variants of Nikes Air Jordan recording the highest number of sales. The shoe features a retro design comprising of rubber midsole and outsole and full leather uppers, which have a lace-up closure style. The uppers are a mix of won-blue metallic gold while its sole comes in white color. The shoe has a noticeable weight, which is a feature that increases its durability and strength. Air Jordan 1 High OG Denim (Women) was released on September 23, 2022. At the time of its debut, the price of the shoe was $170.

Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Grey Slime Blue
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 in Grey and Slime is a 2026 general release of the ProGrid Omni 9 in a two-tone colorway applying Slime green as the accent color against the Grey mesh base, with rubberized cage overlays providing the shoe's structural definition and durability alongside the ProGrid cushioning midsole system that delivers superior shock absorption by evenly distributing impact across each stride. The ProGrid Omni 9 originally launched in 2010 as the ninth iteration of Saucony's Omni stability running franchise, representing the brand's most advanced marriage of comfort technology and progressive styling at the time, and has returned in the contemporary lifestyle sneaker market as a significant entry in the Y2K mesh runner category that has driven the retro technical running revival of the 2020s. The Grey and Slime colorway participates in the neon green accent trend that has run consistently through the ProGrid Omni 9's general release catalog since its return, with the Slime tone occupying the same visual territory as the Vizigold and other bright accent colors Saucony uses to give the silver-dominated Omni 9 palette its most distinctive seasonal energy. The mesh upper with synthetic overlays, rubberized cage, ProGrid cushioning, foam midsole, and rubber outsole complete the construction that made the Omni 9 one of the most admired running shoes of its era and one of the most sought-after retro silhouettes of the current cycle. Released February 1, 2026 at $140 retail through Saucony and select lifestyle and sneaker retailers globally with style code S70739-59. The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 Grey Slime was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential White Pure Platinum Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential White Pure Platinum Black delivers the Air Max 1 in one of its cleanest and most dependable forms, emphasizing balance and timeless design. The white base keeps the look crisp, while pure platinum and black accents add contrast that highlights the silhouettes iconic lines. It feels calm and confident, letting shape and proportion carry the visual impact rather than relying on bold color stories. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it represents the Air Max 1 at its core. There is nothing trendy or fleeting here, just thoughtful color placement on a silhouette that has proven its relevance for decades. Fans love it as a daily staple, appreciating how it works across styles and seasons while still carrying the cultural importance that makes the Air Max 1 such a cornerstone of sneaker history. The Nike Air Max 1 Essential White Pure Platinum Black was released on July 1, 2024 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Cool Grey
Description: The Nike Air VaporMax Plus Cool Grey is a sleek and stylish sneaker that combines the classic Air Max Plus design with the innovative VaporMax technology. The upper is made of a cool grey synthetic material with a gradient effect, while the VaporMax sole unit provides unparalleled comfort and cushioning. The iconic Swoosh logo is featured prominently on the side, and the tongue and heel tab are both branded with the Nike logo. This sneaker was released on February 24th, 2018, and retails for $190. The combination of classic design and modern technology make the Nike Air VaporMax Plus Cool Grey a must-have for any sneakerhead.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Indoor Maroon Almost Yellow
Description: The adidas Gazelle Indoor Maroon Almost Yellow evokes the shades of leaves changing color in the fall. It retains the classic profile of the original. This joins a long line of imaginative athleisure trainers offering strong visual appeal and everyday wearability. Few shoes have enjoyed the enduring appeal of adidas Gazelle sneakers. This version has all its hallmark features. The low-profile suede upper is there, along with the almost translucent rubber sole containing foam cushioning. The colorway mixes the maroon of fall oak leaves with chocolate brown and, as promised, an "almost yellow" toe and lace panel. We really like the sophisticated look of this shoe. There's no need to convince trainer fans of the Gazelle's desirability, and this version will add a luxury touch to one's collection. The trusty slip-resistant sole is still there, and the familiar model name is embroidered in gold next to the adidas 3-Stripes. The adidas Gazelle Indoor Maroon Almost Yellow was released on 27 July 2024, priced at $120.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Designed by Japan (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Designed by Japan (Women's) is a layered multicolored sneaker that finds inspiration in the "Moon Shoe" designed by Nike co-founder Bill Bowerman. Although the sneaker boasts a variety of colors, most of the tones are neutral or earthy, which prevents the hues from clashing. The base comes in Pale Ivory with full-grain leather, soft suede, synthetic, plastic, and mesh details across the upper. The suede overlays in Pale Ivory are thin and create a web-like pattern. Black leather Swooshes reach across the side panels and complement the black on the rubber outsole. However, the outsole also features Light Bone, Aquarius Blue, and Orange-brown hues. The traction pattern pays homage to the waffle sole found on the "Moon Shoe." Our StockX experts like the addition of layered Aquarius Blue, Light Bone, and White on the bulky midsole. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Designed by Japan (Women's) was released on May 10, 2024, and retailed at $180.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Low Nick's Gift
Description: The adidas AE 1 Low "Nick's Gift" is a striking addition to the AE 1 lineup, showcasing a vibrant Blue Burst colorway that's sure to turn heads on and off the court. This low-top performance sneaker combines style and functionality, featuring a sleek silhouette designed for optimal agility and speed. The upper is crafted with a mix of premium materials, including breathable mesh and supportive overlays, ensuring both durability and comfort during intense gameplay. Engineered with adidas' cutting-edge technology, the AE 1 Low boasts responsive cushioning and enhanced stability to support quick cuts and explosive movements. The Blue Burst/Core Black color scheme creates a dynamic visual contrast, with eye-catching blue tones dominating the design and subtle black accents adding depth. A specially designed traction pattern on the outsole provides excellent grip on various surfaces, making these shoes versatile for both indoor and outdoor play. Our team thinks this product is great for basketball enthusiasts and sneaker collectors alike, offering a perfect blend of performance features and street-ready style.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Knicks
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Knicks pays homage to Manhattans NBA team, the New York Knicks, through a vibrant colorway of Bright Ceramic and Team Royal that represents the teams colors. The Knicks Nike Dunk Low is one of several Nike shoes inspired by the Knicks team colors that create a connection with basketball culture and the NBA. Boasting an all-leather build, Bright Ceramic acts as the base color, while Team Royal covers the overlays, Swoosh logos, eyestays, heel tab, tongue label, laces, and inner lining. In addition, the rubber outsole also displays Team Royal, while Bright Ceramic letters spell out NIKE on the tongue and heel tab. Our experts at StockX like the choice of crisp white instead of off-white on the midsole. It gives the sneaker a clean look and keeps the aesthetic contemporary without retro influences. The Nike Dunk Low Knicks was released on May 1, 2024, and sold for $115.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Blue Quartz
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70 Hi Comme Des Garcons PLAY Blue is a collaborative sneaker from the Comme des Garcons PLAY x Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70 Pack in a Bue Quartz colorway. This high-top sneaker features a canvas upper dressed in a Blue Quartz hue with white stitched detailing. The trademark heart and eyes logo appears on the lateral in black and white cut off by the white midsole, while the traditional Converse All-Star ankle patch appears on the medial. Other details include an OrthoLite-cushioned insole, Chrome eyelets, a reinforced toe cap, and a tonal Converse All-Star heel patch logo. The Converse Chuck Taylor All-Star 70 Hi Comme Des Garcons PLAY Blue was released on June 3, 2021 for a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG All-Star Cool Grey (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG All Star Cool Grey GS brings a refined and balanced color palette to the classic high top silhouette, combining cool grey with hits of game royal and black for a look that feels both modern and rooted in tradition. The color blocking keeps things clean while still offering enough contrast to stand out, making it a strong entry within the All Star lineup. What makes this pair appealing is its versatility and classic feel. The mix of neutral and bold tones allows it to work across different styles while still carrying that unmistakable Jordan 1 identity. It is a release that feels dependable and well executed, offering a clean take on a timeless silhouette. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG All Star Cool Grey GS was released on February 12, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Tokyo Bio Hack
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Tokyo Bio Hack channels bold experimentation through an energetic and unconventional color mix. Oil grey and white form the base, while cave stone, arctic punch, viotech, and dark sulfur accents layer in vibrant contrast. The result feels chaotic in the best way, echoing the fearless design approach that made the original Bio Hack concept so memorable. Fans appreciate this pair because it embraces creativity without restraint. It speaks to collectors who enjoy expressive sneakers that challenge traditional color rules while still feeling cohesive. The Tokyo influence adds to its cultural appeal, tying global inspiration to a classic Jordan silhouette. This is a shoe that thrives on confidence, rewarding those willing to lean into its bold personality and stand out through design rather than hype. The Air Jordan 1 Low Tokyo Bio Hack was released on August 20, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: adidas Hyper Boost Edge White Pure Ruby
Description: The adidas Hyper Boost Edge White Pure Ruby delivers a modern and performance focused silhouette through a clean base and bold accent color. The cloud white upper creates a crisp and lightweight appearance, while pure ruby details add a vibrant pop that enhances the structure. Zero metalic elements add subtle depth, giving the design a refined finish. Fans of performance running shoes appreciate how colorways like this balance versatility with visual impact. The contrast between white and red creates a strong identity without overwhelming the design. It is a sneaker that reflects adidas focus on innovation and modern styling. The adidas Hyper Boost Edge White Pure Ruby was released on March 17, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Mauve
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Mauve is part of Nikes Holiday 2023 Retro Footwear line-up. Like many shoes in this collection, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG in Mauve includes elements inspired by archival footwear with a modern twist. What sets this high-top sneaker apart from others is the straightforward White and Sky J Mauve colorway. While the base is all white, the leather overlays, synthetic inner liner, laces, Swoosh logos, and NIKE AIR branding on the tongue feature Sky J Mauve. Similarly, the rubber outsole features Sky J Mauve, contrasting the white midsole and stitching. What do our StockX experts love about this sneaker? The Wings detailing on the lateral ankle comes in White, while the same detailing on other Jordan 1 Retro High OG sneakers comes in Black. The Jordan 1 Retro High OG Mauve was released on October 14, 2023, and retailed at $180.

Display Name: Crocs Echo Clog Black
Description: The Crocs Echo Clog Black is a unisex clog that was designed to combine the comfort and functionality of the classic clog with the style of streetwear. The Black Crocs Echo Clog is made entirely of black Croslite, a lightweight and water-resistant resin material. The molded upper features perforations on the sides of the toe box, which can either enhance breathability or serve as areas to attach your personal Jibbitz charms, allowing you to customize your look. The midsole is boldly sculpted and features ventilation ports, allowing water to dry more quickly. The foot strap features a heel pad for added comfort, and the footbed is constructed from LiteRide foam for the same purpose. What we like best about this clog is the sculpted design of the midsole, which is bold and eye-catching. The Crocs Echo Clog Black was released on January 18, 2024, at a price of $70.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro OG Chicago (2026) (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 13 Retro OG Chicago 2026 TD brings the classic Chicago colorway to toddler sizing, completing the full family lineup for this iconic release. The same white, black, and true red combination is carried over, ensuring that the identity remains consistent across every version. Even at a smaller scale, the silhouette retains its recognizable panther inspired design. What makes this version special is how it extends the legacy of the Chicago 13 to the youngest collectors. It allows the full story of the release to be shared across generations, keeping the connection to Jordan history intact. It is a small but meaningful part of a much larger and iconic drop. The Air Jordan 13 Retro OG Chicago 2026 TD was released on March 14, 2026 with a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Shattered Backboard 3.0
Description: Jordan Brand adds to its Shattered Backboard lineage with the Jordan 1 Retro High Shattered Backboard 3.0, now available on StockX. This colorway was inspired by the orange and black jersey that Michael wore when he shattered a backboard in an Italian exhibition game in 1986. This newest installment in the SBB series differs from the previous three in material. The design is comprised of a black and orange crinkled patent leather upper to represent the shattered glass. A yellowed vanilla mid and outsole complete the design. These sneakers released in October of 2019 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Lucky Green (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 1 Lucky Green takes inspiration from Michael Jordans 63-point game against the Boston Celtics in 1986. Although its purpose is to draw attention towards MJs iconic scoring performance, the sneakers are known colloquially as the Heineken for its resemblance to the 2003 Nike SB Dunk Low. A mix of Lucky Green, white, and black tumbled leathers are featured on the upper. Hits of red come through on the wings logo, heel, and tongue tab. The women's Air Jordan 1 Lucky Green released October of 2020 and retailed for $170.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Undefeated x Los Angeles Dodgers Ostrich
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Undefeated x Los Angeles Dodgers Ostrich builds on the same concept but shifts the tone with a blue, cream, and red palette that reflects the Los Angeles era of the team. The ostrich textured upper adds depth and a more elevated feel, while the classic high top shape keeps it grounded in Converse heritage. The color combination brings more energy compared to the Brooklyn version. This pair stands out for how it connects sports history with modern streetwear design. The Dodgers theme adds cultural weight, while Undefeateds influence ensures it feels current. It is a strong example of how collaborations can bring new life to a silhouette that has been around for generations. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Undefeated x Los Angeles Dodgers Ostrich was released on April 28, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Yellow Ochre
Description: The Jordan 6 Retro Yellow Ochre changes up the color blocking introduced in the 2014 Air Jordan 6 Carmine release, all while delivering dependable support, comfort, and style. The Yellow Ochre colorway of the Air Jordan 6 Retro sports a base of yellow nubuck with perforations along the side panel for breathability. White tumbled leather overlays with perforations on the collar give this shoe its signature look. White laces criss-cross under a yellow neoprene lace cover adorned with a black Jumpman. A Jumpman also appears on the yellow lace lock. A yellow Jumpman graces the white heel just beneath a black and yellow synthetic pull tab for ease of on/off. The aspect of these sneakers that we enjoy the most is the high-performance sole unit. The midsole constructed of black, white, and light gray polyurethane encapsulates an Air unit in the forefoot and houses a visible Air unit in the heel. The outsole of both translucent and matte white rubber sports traction lugs and a yellow Jumpman. The Jordan 6 Retro Yellow Ochre was released on January 27, 2024, for $200 retail.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Triple Black
Description: The Jordan 1 Low Triple Black (2022) was released as an additional colorway in the Jordan 1 line. The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple Black 2022 has perforated detailing on the toe box for added breathability. The shoe includes a padded collar and matching black laces. The outsole consists of durable rubber, which provides traction and stability on a variety of surfaces. The sneaker has a low top silhouette which allows for easy movement and the Swoosh is visible on both sides. We think that the primary feature of the Jordan 1 Low Triple Black (2022) is its all-black colorway. The entire shoe, from the upper to the outsole, is a solid black color. This creates a minimalist and sleek aesthetic, with no contrasting colors or patterns to detract from the shoe's simple and clean design. The shoe was released on September 27th, 2022 at a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Awake NY Black
Description: Air Jordan 5 Retro Awake NY Black feels like a confident collision of New York street culture and Jordan Brand heritage, using the Air Jordan 5 as a canvas for Awake NYs sharp and expressive identity. Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Olive (2024) (GS)

Display Name: Hoka One One Clifton 10 Black White
Description: The Hoka One One Clifton 10 Black White continues the evolution of one of the most recognizable running silhouettes built around comfort, cushioning, and everyday versatility. The black and white colorway keeps the design clean and performance focused, while the updated Clifton model maintains the lightweight feel and smooth ride that made the series a favorite among runners and casual wearers alike. Display Name: UGG Lowmel Chestnut (Women's)
Description: The UGG Lowmel Chestnut (Women's) is a hybrid sneaker made for women that features some elements of the classic UGG boot. This iteration of the UGG Lowmel comes in a Chestnut brown color that is dominant throughout. True to its hybrid nature, the upper is made of suede, recycled canvas, and recycled polyester. Recycled canvas in a tan color outlines the heel counter. UGG branding is debossed into the lateral heel, and another UGG patch is seen on the tongue. The UGG Lowmel Chestnut (Women's) was initially released on June 24, 2024, for $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Light Bone Neutral Olive

Its foam midsole is another highlight. It retailed at $130 when it was released on December 23, 2024.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro World's Best Dad (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Worlds Best Dad TD is the Toddler sizing version of the Air Jordan 3 Retro World's Best Dad, released May 16, 2026 at $80 in full family sizing as one of the most narratively significant Jordan releases of 2026 and a direct tribute to one of the most emotionally resonant moments in Michael Jordan's career. The World's Best Dad colorway references June 16, 1996, Father's Day, when Michael Jordan's Chicago Bulls won Game 6 of the NBA Finals against the Seattle SuperSonics to claim the franchise's fourth championship and Jordan's fourth ring, the first since the 1993 murder of his father James Jordan Sr., whose absence on Father's Day made the moment overwhelming: Jordan collapsed to the locker room floor in tears, clutching the game ball, in photos that Sneaker News described as legendary and that humanized Jordan in a way that connected with everyone who has suffered a similar loss. The Air Jordan 3 Retro World's Best Dad translates that locker room moment into the shoe's design: SoleRetriever confirmed the elephant print on the toe and heel is reimagined in the brown carpet from that 1996 Finals night, with Sail white leather covering the rest of the upper, Palomino tones on the midsole, Bulls Varsity Red on the outsole and Jumpman tongue logo, and black hitting the lace panel, top of the tongue, sockliner, and ankle collar. As Athlon Sports confirmed, the release includes custom Father's Day packaging and a Father's Day card, the complete package making the World's Best Dad one of the most gift-oriented and most storytelling-forward Jordan releases in recent years. Style code DM0968-103 in Toddler sizing, released May 16, 2026 at $80. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Worlds Best Dad TD is the May 2026 Toddler sizing Father's Day tribute colorway for the family and Jordan legacy collector who wants the 1996 Bulls locker room carpet-referencing elephant print, Sail white leather upper, Varsity Red outsole and Jumpman, and Palomino midsole of the World's Best Dad Air Jordan 3 in the Toddler sizing retail configuration at $80. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Worlds Best Dad TD was released on May 16, 2026 with a retail price of $80.

Fans appreciate how the design stays true to its roots regardless of scale. The Nike Little Max 95 Neon 2026 TD was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $82.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD Birch Silver
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD Birch Silver takes inspiration from a vintage silhouette, and the result is an elegant shoe that elevates leisure footwear to a truly posh status. The upper of this low-riding Birch Silver Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD is fashioned from luxe cream-colored goat leather. This same leather forms a T-toe overlay, an eyestay overlay, and the signature serrated S strips that cross at the heel. Silver leather with a metallic sheen forms the strips that course vertically down the side panel and horizontally across the side panel from the heel to the toe cap. A cream-colored midsole with a black stripe features soft cushioning and rides atop a cream-colored outsole that has cross-hatch diamond patterning for traction. The aspect of these sneakers that we enjoy the most is the heel tab that folds over the back of the shoe. Also made from cream-colored leather, it's textured, providing a subtle difference. The tab also features Tiger branding. The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 SD Birch Silver was released on July 1, 2023, for $160 retail.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Off Noir Summit White
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Off Noir Summit White strips the Dunk Low down to pure contrast, letting tone and balance define the silhouette rather than graphics or gimmicks. The off noir overlays soften the usual black treatment, giving the shoe a more refined and wearable feel against the crisp summit white base. It feels intentional and calm, highlighting the Dunks classic paneling and proportions in a way that feels timeless rather than trendy. Fans love this release because it fits effortlessly into rotation. It carries the familiar panda energy people gravitate toward, but with a slightly elevated mood that feels more mature and versatile. Collectors appreciate how subtle color shifts can refresh a staple silhouette, making this pair feel dependable yet distinct. It is the kind of Dunk that proves simplicity, when done right, often has the longest staying power in sneaker culture. The Nike Dunk Low Off Noir Summit White was released on November 14, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Black Castlerock Grey
Description: The New Balance 2002R Black Castlerock Grey delivers a sleek, layered aesthetic through a refined neutral palette. The black upper anchors the design, while castlerock grey accents introduce subtle contrast across the mesh and suede overlays. The cushioned midsole preserves the 2002Rs comfort focused identity, balancing retro running roots with modern wearability. The tonal interplay feels understated yet purposeful. Collectors appreciate how the 2002R continues to bridge performance heritage with everyday style, and this colorway reinforces that versatility. The neutral combination pairs effortlessly with denim, sweats, or tailored streetwear. It stands as a dependable staple within the New Balance lineup. The New Balance 2002R Black Castlerock Grey was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike A'ja Wilson A'One Gold Dynasty (Women's)
Description: The Nike Aja Wilson AOne Gold Dynasty Womens blends understated elegance with championship confidence. Sail covers the upper in a smooth and balanced tone, while Metallic Gold accents add a refined shimmer that elevates the silhouette. The streamlined construction keeps the focus on performance, but the gold detailing nods to dominance and legacy. It feels both composed and celebratory in equal measure. Fans appreciate how this release channels power through subtle luxury rather than loud color. The sail and gold combination feels timeless, giving the shoe versatility while still carrying symbolic weight. It honors sustained excellence through thoughtful design choices. Clean, confident, and radiant, this pair reflects a winning mindset. The Nike Aja Wilson AOne Gold Dynasty Womens was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Black White
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus Black White is the most foundational and most broadly versatile colorway in the debut August 7, 2025 launch of the Vomero Plus, Nike's mid-tier entry in the three-level Vomero product family that sits between the Vomero 18 icon model and the Vomero Premium, applying a full-length ZoomX midsole for higher stack height and softer ride than the Vomero 18 while maintaining the daily trainer positioning appropriate to the Vomero franchise's identity as Nike's maximum-cushioning road running series. The Vomero Plus was designed by an all-female team over nine months with women's insights at the foundation of every construction decision, a development approach that shaped the shoe's softer, more rounded visual language as a deliberate departure from the sharp, aggressive lines of more performance-focused Nike running shoes, making the silhouette feel more accessible and more inviting without compromising the responsiveness and mileage-capability that serious daily trainers require. The Black and White colorway, with Anthracite, Light Smoke Grey, and Metallic Silver accent details completing the full palette, is the launch pair that most directly connects the Vomero Plus to the running tradition of clean, non-distracting colorways designed for wearers who want the shoe to disappear into their outfit rather than define it. The engineered mesh upper with no-sew overlays delivers the lightweight, breathable, and aerodynamic construction that the Vomero Plus's full-ZoomX midsole stack demands, keeping the upper from adding unnecessary weight or warmth above the shoe's substantial cushioning platform. A curved toe design supports the shoe's rocker geometry for smooth heel-to-toe transitions, reflective details provide low-light visibility for morning or evening runs, and high-abrasion rubber on the outsole ensures the platform holds up across the mileage for which maximum-cushioning trainers are typically used. Style code HV8150-002, $170. The Nike Vomero Plus Black White is the debut colorway for the runner who wants the most foundational and most styling-versatile execution of Nike's new mid-tier ZoomX maximum-cushioning daily trainer, the pair that earns its place in a running rotation through technology rather than color. The Nike Vomero Plus Black White was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: adidas AE 1 Low Metamorphosis
Description: The adidas AE 1 Low Metamorphosis is a low top athletic shoe featuring a Core Black upper with black laces. The upper meets molded, stretched open honeycomb pattern panels on the sides in Arctic Night, an iridescent blue-green-violet hue, which encase the tip. adidas branding in Scream Green pops from the rear heel and tongue. German athletic wear brand adidas, one of the worlds largest sneaker producers, has been at the forefront of sneaker innovation in their century-plus of existence. The AE 1 Low utilizes a BOOST cushion within the sole, and the shoes unmistakable aesthetic is created by its Generative Support Wings on the sides. The Wings provide full protection on the basketball court for their namesake player, Anthony "Ant-Man" Edwards, of the NBAs Minnesota Timberwolves. In our opinion, the best feature of the AE 1 Low is its color palette, which works as a dark neutral while still incorporating color. The adidas AE 1 Low Metamorphosis released on March 15, 2025, and retailed at $110.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro White Cement Reimagined (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro White Cement Reimagined GS was released to celebrate the 35th anniversary of the Air Jordan 3 designed by Tinker Hatfield. The Air Jordan 3 Retro White Cement Reimagined in grade-school sizing features a white leather upper adorned with elephant print overlays on the heel and toe, accents of Varsity Red on the lace loops, and a Jumpman logo on the tongue. Its vintage polyurethane midsole is accompanied by an exposed unit in the heel and an encapsulated Air-sole unit in the forefoot. Additionally, a crimson Jumpman logo is stitched onto the white leather tongue, while the back tab has a pre-yellowed appearance with an embossed Nike Air logo. The Air Jordan 3 Retro White Cement Reimagined GS was released on 11th March 2023 with its retail price set at $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Rare Air Sail Cinnabar (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High Rare Air Sail Cinnabar (Womens) is a standout addition to Jordan Brands "Rare Air" series, offering a fresh take on the classic silhouette. Crafted with premium leather, the upper showcases a harmonious blend of sail and light bone hues, providing a neutral canvas that highlights the bold cinnabar red accents. These striking red details adorn the iconic Wings logo, outline the Swoosh, and cover the rubber outsole, adding a vibrant contrast to the design. A unique gradient effect on the laces and a pop of blue on the tongue label further enhance the sneakers visual appeal. Designed with aesthetics in mind, this womens exclusive model features perforations on the toe box for breathability and a padded collar for added support. The sail midsole complements the overall color scheme, delivering a cohesive and stylish look that resonates with sneaker enthusiasts and fashion-forward individuals alike. Released on April 5, 2025, the Jordan 1 Retro High Rare Air Sail Cinnabar (Womens) retailed at $180. As a standout in the "Rare Air" lineup, this womens exclusive celebrates individual expression with subtle yet powerful updates to the iconic silhouette. Between the heritage-driven details and refined color palette, its a fresh take on classic Air Jordan designperfect for collectors and everyday wearers looking to make a statement.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE White Fire Red Black Matte Silver
Description: The Jordan 1 Low SE White Fire Red Black Matte Silver adds a sleek, modern twist to the classic silhouette, mixing colors and materials on the low-top. The White Fire Red Black Matte Silver Jordan 1 Low SE introduces a crisp white leather base overlaid by contrasting black accents on the Swoosh, eyestay, tongue, and forefoot overlay. The collar and heel panel get a Matte Silver finish, with a Fire Red Wings logo stitched on the heel and a Jumpman on the nylon tongue. The Jordan 1 Low SE rides on a classic rubber cupsole featuring classic white sidewalls and a black rubber outsole. What our experts love about the Jordan 1 Low SE White Fire Red Black Matte Silver is its bold use of color blocking. The sneaker combines crisp white, black, Fire Red, and Matte Silver to create a unique design synonymous with the Jordan aesthetic. The sneaker debuted on the January 21, 2025, for $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG White Cement
Description: The Air Jordan 1 is getting the cement print treatment, with the release of the Jordan 1 Retro High OG White Cement. Jordan is drawing inspiration from the popular Air Jordan 3 silhouette with its elephant inspired cement print. The Jordan 1 Retro High OG White Cement is constructed with high quality white leather uppers, with a contrasting black nike swoosh and leather accents. The sneakers are highlighted with gray cement print, and are tied together with black laces and sit on top of a muslin midsole, giving the sneaker a vintage look. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG White Cement released February 25, 2023, with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 12 Retro Field Purple
Description: Making a statement with vibrant color and unmistakable style, the Jordan 12 Retro Field Purple made its grand entrance on July 29, 2023. This colorway showcases a new aesthetic for the classic silhouette, pushing boundaries and setting trends. The Jordan 12 Retro stands out with its bold field purple and black leather upper, giving the classic silhouette an unexpected twist. The sneaker's iconic design elements are amplified, from the unique eyelets to the distinctive '23' at the heel. This unique color contrast is sure to grab attention and turn heads. The Jordan 12 Retro Field Purple was launched on July 29, 2023, with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Snowed In (GS)
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Christmas GS brings festive energy to Ja Morants signature line in grade school sizing. Featuring White with Bright Crimson, Volt, and Black accents, the upper blends bold holiday inspired contrast with a performance focused silhouette. The low cut profile and responsive cushioning maintain the explosive identity of the Ja series. Christmas editions often stand out for their vibrant palettes, and this release embraces that tradition with confidence. Volt hits add electric brightness, while crimson details nod to seasonal themes. It feels lively and expressive, designed for young athletes who want statement energy on the court. The Nike Ja 3 Christmas GS was released on December 26, 2025 with a retail price of $117.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low SE White Light Pumice
Description: The Nike Dunk Low SE White Light Pumice is a low-top shoe with a color-blocking design and a subtle colorway. The White Light Pumice Nike Dunk Low SE has a base of white leather. The white toebox features perforations for increased air flow, while the side panels and ankle collar also appear in white. Soft suede overlays in a Light Pumice gray color round out the toe and form the eyestays and the ankle strap. The Nike Swoosh can also be seen crossing each side as a Light Pumice overlay. The heel collar features the Nike brand name embroidered in white, and the tongue bears another Nike logo patch. The shoe sits on a white midsole and a Light Pumice outsole. What we like most about this sneaker is the simplistic design with a neutral colorway, which makes the shoe versatile. The Nike Dunk Low SE White Light Pumice was released on July 1, 2024, for $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro AJKO Low SP Union White Canvas
Description: Union LA and Jordan are starting off 2023 with the release of the Air Jordan Retro AJKO Low SP Union. This marks the seventh silhouette Union and Jordan Brand have partnered on. The collaboration between Union and Jordan brand comes with a white and neutral grey canvas upper, sail midsoles, and yellow stitching accents. The Jordan x Union AJKO Low SP features removable blue and grey swoosh patches with Union LA branding placed below. The Air Jordan 1 Retro AJKO Low SP Union released January 27, 2023, with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 White Black Stadium Green
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 White & Black Stadium Green blends crisp design with vibrant accents, giving us a reimagined look for the iconic Air Max line. This sneaker merges a classic design with daring, contrasting colors for a modern look and feel. The White & Black Stadium Green Air Max 1 by Nike features a white mesh base complemented by Pure Platinum overlays to create an elegant, layered sneaker. Stadium Green details highlight the Swoosh, mudguards, upper eyelets, and branding on the tongue and heel. Black accents appear on the outsole to improve the contrast. This updated take on the Air Max 1, originally designed by Tinker Hatfield in 1987, includes visible Air units in the white midsole. As experts, one thing we love about the Nike Air Max 1 White & Black Stadium Green is the premium mesh for better airflow and comfort and the toe cap. This sneaker retailed for $140 when it was released on April 1, 2024?.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro SP Nina Chanel Abney Bicoastal (Women's)
Description: The Jordan Air Jordan 3 Retro SP Nina Chanel Abney Bicoastal (Women's) is a stunning collaboration that merges fine art with sneaker culture. Featuring a unique colorway of bicoastal green, black, malachite, and fossil, this sneaker stands out with its striking design elements. The green canvas and suede upper, combined with rope laces, offers a fresh and stylish look. The modified Jumpman logo on the tongue, a first for a Jordan retro collaboration, adds a distinctive touch that highlights the innovative approach taken in this design. This sneaker celebrates the artistic brilliance of Nina Chanel Abney, a fine artist known for her bold and vibrant works. The Jordan 3, first introduced in 1988, is reinterpreted through Abney's creative lens, resulting in a sneaker that is both a piece of art and a fashion statement. The leather heel tab with a chenille Nike Air logo adds to the unique aesthetic, making this model a must-have for collectors. Released on June 20, 2024, and retailing at $225, the Jordan Air Jordan 3 Retro SP Nina Chanel Abney Bicoastal (Women's) is a standout piece in any collection. This sneaker seamlessly blends the heritage of the Jordan brand with contemporary artistic expression, offering a stylish and culturally significant addition to your wardrobe. Dont miss out on this exceptional model that embodies the spirit of innovation and creativity.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Cement
Description: Redefining the low-cut silhouette game, the Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Cement made a splash in the sneaker world on June 24, 2023. This classic model from Jordan Brand got a striking makeover with the brands renowned elephant print, showcasing an undeniable combo of quality and style. Sporting an impressive black upper, with iconic elephant print overlays on the heel and toe box these kicks are crafted from a mix of high-grade leather and suede, boasting durability and sophistication. Complementing the uppers is a clean white midsole, offering a stark contrast and enhancing the sneaker's visual appeal. A Nike Air logo resides on the tongue, adding a dash of bold color to the muted palette. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Cement promises a fitting tribute to the legacy of Jordan Brand. These Jordan 1 Retro Low OG Black Cements hit the streets on June 24, 2023, with a retail price tag of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Leopard Burgundy (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Leopard Burgundy Womens adds texture and attitude to the Air Max 90 through a design that feels bold but intentional. The leopard pattern paired with burgundy tones gives the shoe depth and personality, turning the classic silhouette into something more expressive. It feels confident and fashion forward, designed to stand out without losing the structure that defines the model. Collectors appreciate this pair because it shows how pattern can elevate a familiar design. The Air Max 90 remains instantly recognizable, while the leopard and burgundy combination adds a sense of luxury and edge. Fans love it as a statement sneaker that still fits comfortably into everyday wear, balancing bold styling with the comfort and heritage they expect from Nike. The Nike Air Max 90 Leopard Burgundy Womens was released on June 20, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen Wolf Grey Metallic Gold
Description: The Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen Wolf Grey Metallic Gold is a high-octane basketball sneaker sporting design elements from the life and history of LeBron James. The Wolf Grey Metallic Gold iteration of the Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen features an upper of lightweight, breathable grey mesh with a pattern based on the map of Akron, Ohio, the hometown of LeBron James. The lateral side of this shoe sports a white synthetic leather Nike Swoosh with a 3D gold Nike Swoosh overlapping it. A dark-grey leather overlay begins as a heel counter and wraps around to cover the medial side, where it is adorned with a white side-panel Swoosh. The silvery tongue matches the mesh of the upper, while the sock liner is a darker grey. NXXT branding appears on the lighter grey insole. What we enjoy most about this sneaker is the midsole, which houses ACZ Turbo Zoom Air under the forefoot and Zoom Air under the heel. The grey rubber outsole is also patterned after a map of Akron. The Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen Wolf Grey Metallic Gold was released on June 12, 2023, for $160 retail.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Rose Whisper (Women's)
Description: The women's Nike Dunk Low Rose Whisper arrives in a classic two-tone color blocked look similar to the original Nike Dunks of the 1980s. This Dunk offers a warm palette primed for the summer weather, with a white and Rose Whisper leather construction. Matching woven tongue labels contribute to the design's retro feel, while an EVA foam sole provides cushioning. The women's Nike Dunk Low Rose Whisper released in June of 2022 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Racing Pack Iron Grey Wild Grape
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Racing Pack Iron Grey Wild Grape brings motorsport energy to the iconic layered runner. Iron Grey and black sweep across the signature gradient panels, creating a dark and aggressive base that highlights the sculpted anatomy inspired design. Wild Grape accents inject vibrant contrast, cutting through the neutral tones with flashes of purple intensity. White detailing keeps the composition sharp, while visible Air cushioning in the forefoot and heel anchors the silhouette in performance heritage. This Racing Pack edition feels built for movement, channeling speed through color and contrast. The grape hits add personality without overwhelming the structure, making it bold yet wearable. Fans of the 95 appreciate how accent colors amplify the wave pattern, and this pair executes that formula with confidence. It is a striking evolution of a classic that continues to thrive on expressive updates. The Nike Air Max 95 Racing Pack Iron Grey Wild Grape was released on December 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Blue Tint (Women's)
Description: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Blue Tint Womens brings a softer yet confident tone to one of Nikes most aggressive and iconic runners. The blue tint palette lightens the Air Max 95s layered anatomy inspired design, while the Big Bubble Air unit restores a key detail that longtime fans appreciate. It feels archival and fresh at the same time, balancing history with modern wearability. Collectors are drawn to this release because it honors the Air Max 95s original innovation while offering a refined color story designed specifically for women. The silhouettes strong lines remain intact, and the blue tint accents add elegance without dulling its edge. It stands as a reminder of how powerful thoughtful updates can be when they respect the core of the design. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Blue Tint Womens was released on 10/22/2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike V5 RNR Black Anthracite Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike V5 RNR Black Anthracite Smoke Grey delivers a clean and grounded take on a performance inspired silhouette, using layered shades of black and grey to create depth. The combination of anthracite and smoke grey adds subtle variation while keeping the overall look cohesive and understated. This version resonates because of its simplicity and versatility. It is easy to wear across different settings, offering a reliable option that does not rely on bold color. Fans appreciate how it focuses on structure and tone rather than unnecessary detail. The Nike V5 RNR Black Anthracite Smoke Grey was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 White Blue Red Metallic Gold
Description: The ASICS Mexico 66 Blue Red Metallic Gold taps into one of the brands most historic silhouettes, originally tied to track and field heritage and global sport moments. The white base is accented with dark blue and red striping, while metallic gold details add a vintage inspired finish that elevates the overall look. The slim profile and classic construction give it a timeless feel that stands apart from more modern designs. What keeps the Mexico 66 relevant is its simplicity and history. It carries a different kind of appeal compared to technical running models, focusing more on heritage and everyday wear. This colorway adds just enough contrast and shine to make it stand out while still staying true to the silhouettes roots. The ASICS Mexico 66 Blue Red Metallic Gold was released on July 19, 2024 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Wave Pack Photon Dust Blue Cyber
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Valentine's Day Black 2026 takes the holiday theme in an unexpected direction, leaning into contrast and edge rather than the soft pinks and reds that Valentine's releases typically default to. Black dominates the upper while University Red accents inject the romantic color story through detailing that feels deliberate and restrained rather than overt. The Air Max 90's iconic visible Air unit and layered panel construction carry the two-tone execution naturally, the silhouette doing most of the heavy lifting while the colorway adds just enough seasonal character to make the connection clear without overcommitting to it. This approach rewards collectors who want holiday releases they can actually wear beyond the date they drop. Black Air Max 90s with red accents have a long and beloved history in the silhouette's archive, and the Valentine's Day framing gives this specific combination a narrative hook that distinguishes it from a standard two-tone colorway release. The restraint in the design is the whole point, letting the Air Max 90's architecture shine while the University Red does its work quietly across the overlays and branding details. The Nike Air Max 90 Valentine's Day Black 2026 was released on January 30, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Jordan 40-28 Black Metallic Gold
Description: The Air Jordan 40 28 Black Metallic Gold introduces a futuristic edge to the Jordan line, blending performance innovation with a colorway that leans into bold contrast. The black upper sets a strong foundation, while metallic gold accents cut through with a sharp, almost celebratory energy that feels worthy of a milestone model. Pearl white elements add balance, keeping the design from feeling too heavy while enhancing the layered look that defines this release. This pair stands out because it represents progression within the Jordan legacy rather than a simple throwback. Fans of the line appreciate when new models push design forward, and this one does that while still carrying familiar cues tied to the brands DNA. The mix of modern construction and classic color blocking gives it a presence that feels both current and connected, making it a compelling addition for collectors who follow the evolution of Jordan performance and style. The Air Jordan 40 28 Black Metallic Gold was released on April 24, 2026 with a retail price of $205.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 '07 Low WB Triple Wolf Grey
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 07 Low WB Triple Wolf Grey strips the iconic silhouette back to a fully tonal execution that feels both modern and rugged. Wolf Grey wraps the upper from panel to panel, creating a uniform look that highlights the classic Air Force 1 shape. Subtle black accents add depth without breaking the monochrome flow. The sturdy construction and textured materials give the shoe a durable edge while preserving the familiar low cut profile. Collectors appreciate tonal Air Force 1 releases because they let the silhouette speak through form rather than contrast. This all grey approach feels versatile and understated, making it easy to integrate into daily rotation. It carries the legacy of the model while presenting a refined and cohesive visual identity. Clean, confident, and built to last, this pair keeps the focus on timeless design. The Nike Air Force 1 07 Low WB Triple Wolf Grey was released on October 19, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Black
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Black is a classic sneaker that has been a staple in the fashion world for decades. This shoe features a black canvas upper with white stitching and a white rubber sole. The high-top design provides ankle support and a timeless look that never goes out of style. The materials used in the construction of this shoe are high-quality and durable, ensuring that they will last for years to come. The canvas upper is breathable and comfortable, while the rubber sole provides excellent traction and grip. Released on September 24, 2011, the Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Black has been a fan favorite ever since. With a retail price of $60, this shoe is an affordable option for anyone looking for a classic sneaker that will never go out of style. Something we love about the Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Black is its versatility. This shoe can be dressed up or down, making it the perfect addition to any wardrobe. Our experts think that the standout feature of this shoe is its timeless design, which has remained popular for decades. Overall, we love the Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Black for its durability, comfort, and classic style.

Display Name: adidas Adistar Control 5 Unheardof Pork Chop Piggy Runner 2.0 Cupcake
Description: The adidas Adistar Control 5 Unheardof Pork Chop Piggy Runner 20 brings a playful and conceptual twist to a performance silhouette through a bold and character driven design. The mix of green and light pink creates a vibrant and slightly unconventional palette, while the theme adds personality that sets it apart from standard releases. The structure remains focused on stability and comfort. Fans of unique collaborations appreciate how this release blends humor and performance into a single design. The color combination gives it strong visual identity, making it stand out immediately. It is a sneaker that reflects creativity and individuality within adidas running lineup. The adidas Adistar Control 5 Unheardof Pork Chop Piggy Runner 20 was released on March 28, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Green Glow
Description: Immerse yourself in the fusion of heritage and modern style with the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Green Glow. This bold reinterpretation of the classic Jordan 1 silhouette comes alive with striking Green Glow fused into the timeless black toe color blocking giving the classic sneaker a fresh, vivid twist. ? ?? ?The vibrant Green Glow set against the stark contrast of black and white, turns this shoe into a contemporary classic. Launched on April 20, 2024, with an accessible price point of $180, this sneaker instantly stands out as an icon reimagined. The sneakers high-quality leather uppers, married with the comfortable cushioning of an Air-Sole unit, uphold the Jordan 1's off-court style. ? ?? ?Honoring the past while propelling into the present, this iteration is a narrative, intertwining Michael Jordan's legacy with the vibrant beats of todays fashion trends. Its a testament to a design that has dominated both the basketball court and the streets, an embodiment of the culture that the Jordan brand has nurtured over decades. For those looking to make a statement, the Jordan 1 Retro High OG Green Glow is the perfect choice.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Sail Baroque Brown
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus Sail Baroque Brown refines the runner with a light and earthy contrast. Dressed in Sail with Caldera Brown, Black, and Pecan accents, the upper layers soft neutral tones that highlight the silhouettes depth. The thick midsole reinforces the Vomero Plus focus on plush and responsive cushioning. The sail base keeps the design fresh and versatile, while brown detailing adds warmth and dimension. This combination gives the runner a lifestyle ready feel without sacrificing performance DNA. It stands as a clean and balanced interpretation of Nikes comfort driven platform. The Nike Vomero Plus Sail Baroque Brown was released on November 21, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Rebellious Air Fireberry
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Rebellious Air Fireberry dresses the Air Max Plus with an electric colorway of Pure Purple and Fireberry with black and white accents. At the Rebellious Air Fireberry Nike Air Max Plus, The TPU overlays display a fade from Pure Purple to Fireberry, which matches the gradient of color across the mesh upper. The TPU overlays act as a cage and resemble palms swaying in the breeze or waves. Other nature-inspired accents include the TPU arch beneath the midfoot that looks like a whale tale and features Pure Purple and Fireberry. The sneaker offers visible Air Max cushioning underfoot, which provides support without weighing the foot down, while Air Max branding decorates the cushioned tongue's logo tag. The rubber outsole contains a surprising feature  pops of neon green. Our experts at StockX like the reflective detailing because it provides visibility in low lighting and gives the sneaker a sporty feel. The Nike Air Max Plus Rebellious Air Fireberry was released on July 12, 2024, and sold for $180.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Reflection White
Description: The New Balance 9060 Reflection White pushes the brands retro running DNA into more futuristic territory through exaggerated proportions and sculpted design language inspired by archival performance models. The 9060 quickly became one of New Balances most popular modern silhouettes because it combines familiar heritage elements with oversized midsoles and layered construction that feel experimental and fashion forward. The Reflection and White color palette enhances that identity through soft neutral tones that give the shoe a clean and highly versatile atmosphere while allowing the dramatic shape and flowing lines of the silhouette to remain the focus. Fans appreciate the 9060 because it represents a bold evolution of classic New Balance aesthetics without abandoning the comfort and wearability that define the brand. The lighter colorway creates a softer and more lifestyle oriented personality compared to darker technical runner releases, making the silhouette easier to integrate into modern casual wardrobes. Collectors especially gravitate toward neutral 9060 colorways because they highlight the sculptural midsole and layered upper construction without overwhelming the design through excessive contrast. The result feels futuristic, comfortable, and highly aligned with the growing popularity of chunky retro inspired runners within contemporary sneaker culture. The New Balance 9060 Reflection White was released with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: adidas Harden Vol. 10 Lucid Aquamarine
Description: The Adidas Harden Vol. 10 in Lucid Aquamarine, Footwear White, and Silver Metallic is the tenth iteration of James Harden's signature shoe line with Adidas, a milestone release that reflects a decade of collaborative design evolution between one of the NBA's most creative and statistically dominant offensive players and a sportswear brand that has built the Harden line into one of the most technically sophisticated and aesthetically distinctive signature basketball shoe series in the contemporary game. Lucid aquamarine is a colorway that suits the Harden aesthetic vocabulary perfectly, sitting in a vivid and slightly otherworldly blue-green that carries the same kind of confident and unexpected color intelligence that Harden has always brought to his personal style both on and off the court, refusing the conventional red, black, or team color default that most signature basketball shoes rely on and instead reaching for something that feels genuinely personal and visually distinctive in a crowded and competitive signature footwear market. Footwear white and silver metallic provide the structural color counterpoints that allow the lucid aquamarine to breathe and command attention without overwhelming the silhouette's technical design details and construction architecture. The Vol. 10 platform builds on the accumulated performance knowledge and athlete feedback from nine previous iterations of the Harden signature line, incorporating the cushioning, court feel, and lateral support refinements that a decade of collaboration between a specific athlete and a dedicated design team produces when both parties are genuinely committed to making the best possible basketball shoe rather than simply releasing a new colorway on an existing platform. Harden's game has always demanded specific performance characteristics from his footwear, particularly in the areas of pivot support, cushioned impact absorption for pull up jumpers, and the kind of multi directional traction that his step back heavy offensive repertoire requires, and the Vol. 10 addresses all of those requirements in a silhouette that also looks extraordinary in lucid aquamarine standing still. For Harden fans, signature shoe collectors, and basketball players who want performance and aesthetic ambition in equal measure, the Vol. 10 in lucid aquamarine delivers both without compromise. The Adidas Harden Vol. 10 in Lucid Aquamarine was released on April 18, 2026 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High '85 Neutral Grey
Description: To kick off the second month of 2021, Jordan Brand set the tone for the best release of the year the Air Jordan 1 85 Neutral Grey.
