The biggest difference is the Neutral Greys shape, as the slightly curved heel that has been standard since 2015s Chicago 1s, is subbed with a straighter cut. From there, the "Wings" logo on the collar gets revamped with a more textured feel, while the Swoosh and collar underlays of Neutral Grey suede add to the sneakers original status. The Air Jordan 1 85 Neutral Grey released in February of 2021 for $200.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Black White Swoosh
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Black White Swoosh delivers a clean and familiar take on one of Nikes most versatile silhouettes. The black upper provides a strong base, while the white swoosh cuts through with classic contrast that never feels outdated. The simplicity of the color blocking allows the Dunks shape and heritage to take center stage. This pair resonates because it stays true to the formula that made the Dunk a staple. There is no need for heavy storytelling when the execution is this reliable. Fans appreciate how easily it fits into any rotation, offering a go to option that works across styles without losing its identity. The Nike Dunk Low Black White Swoosh was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Zegamadome SP sacai Matte Silver Yellow
Description: The Nike Zegamadome SP sacai Matte Silver Yellow merges trail-bred utility with high-fashion design cues, delivering a striking silhouette that stands out on streets and switchbacks alike. Chitose Abes sacai signature comes through in layered components, think doubled-up tongues, overlapping eyestays, and a sculpted, stacked midsole, that create depth and dimension from every angle. The Matte Silver base acts as a sleek canvas for energizing Yellow accents, while mixed textiles add tactile contrast and durability. Co-branded touches and the distinctive profile underscore the collaborations refined yet adventurous spirit, making this colorway a head-turning addition to any rotation. Engineered for comfort and stability, the Zegamadome SP pairs plush cushioning with a rugged, trail-inspired outsole for confident traction. The exaggerated midsole geometry enhances underfoot support, while breathable panels help regulate heat during all-day wear. Strategic overlays provide structure without sacrificing flexibility, and pull tabs make on-and-off easy. With its blend of performance heritage and fashion-forward craftsmanship, this mens Nike sneaker (style HQ8618-002) offers versatile styling options, from technical outerwear to pared-back essentials, and lands as a standout release for 2025-05-09 in the sought-after Matte Silver/Yellow colorway. Our team loves this product because it fuses outdoor-ready comfort with sacais layered design language, creating a bold everyday sneaker that excels in style and wearability.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Pure Silver Black
Description: The Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Pure Silver Black is a low-profile on silhouette suitable for all occasions from the Onitsuka Tigers Mexico 66 line in a pure silver and black palette. This is a retooled shoe released in 2023 of the original Mexico 66 model that was originally worn by Japanese athletes at the 1968 Summer Olympics in Mexico. The design features a slim style and low top. The upper is a sleek pure silver color and adorned with the iconic Onitsuka Tiger stripes in black. A cream-colored outsole with a reinforced toe area matches the flat laces of the same color. Additional branding is seen on the tongue and heel tab. Our experts feel that this shoes slim styling is synonymous with the Onitsuka Tiger brand, its signature look is timeless and this is its standout feature. When the Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Pure Silver Black colorway hit the shelves on August 1, 2023, it retailed for $160.

Display Name: On Running Cloudtilt Black Eclipse (Women's)
Description: The On Running Cloudtilt Black Eclipse Womens brings a sleek and modern look to a performance silhouette through a clean and tonal color palette. The black and eclipse tones create a smooth and minimal appearance, while the layered sole design emphasizes comfort and movement. The structure feels lightweight and adaptable, aligning with Ons focus on everyday performance. Fans of On appreciate how models like this prioritize versatility, making them suitable for both active use and casual wear. The understated colorway enhances its wearability, allowing it to fit seamlessly into different styles. It is a sneaker that reflects a balance between function and refined design. The On Running Cloudtilt Black Eclipse Womens was released on January 31, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 JJJJound White Blue
Description: The ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 JJJJound White Navy blends refined minimalism with high-performance heritage, delivering a sleek, versatile sneaker that stands out in any rotation. Dressed in a crisp White/Navy palette (style 1203A961-100), this collaboration elevates the Gel-Kayano 14s retro 2000s design with premium materials, subtle co-branded touches, and clean lines that complement everything from technical outerwear to relaxed denim. Breathable mesh underlays pair with polished synthetic and leather overlays for structure and depth, while reflective accents add a sharp finish. The streamlined silhouette stays true to the original Kayano blueprint, timeless, functional, and effortlessly modern. Underfoot, signature GEL cushioning provides plush impact absorption for long days on the move, balanced by a supportive midsole that feels stable yet agile. A secure lace system and padded collar lock in comfort, and the durable rubber outsole supplies dependable traction on city streets and weekend miles alike. Thoughtful details, like the understated JJJJound mark and carefully tuned color blocking, underscore a design-first approach that prioritizes wearability and craftsmanship. With a release date of June 12, 2025, this pair captures the sweet spot between lifestyle appeal and running-inspired performance, making it a smart pick for daily wear and collection-worthy style. Our team loves this product because it fuses timeless JJJJound design with proven ASICS comfort, delivering a go-anywhere sneaker that looks sharp and feels great from the first step.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro NOTE Shop Manchester Brew and Biscuits
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro NOTE Shop Manchester Brew and Biscuits taps into local culture with a concept rooted in Manchesters identity, using a warm flax and honeycomb palette that reflects the idea of comfort and everyday ritual. The layered upper blends summit white and sail tones with subtle hits of green spark and university red, creating a design that feels both grounded and expressive. The SB Dunk silhouette remains unchanged, keeping its skate ready structure intact. What makes this pair stand out is its storytelling and sense of place. Nike SB continues to highlight skate shops and communities through thoughtful collaborations, and this release captures that spirit with a concept that feels specific and personal. The color palette adds depth without overwhelming the design, making it wearable while still distinct. It is a strong example of how narrative and design come together within the SB line. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro NOTE Shop Manchester Brew and Biscuits was released on March 31, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Plus Black Bright Crimson White
Description: The Nike Vomero Plus Black Bright Crimson White pushes the silhouette into a more contrast driven direction, pairing a dark base with sharp hits of Bright Crimson. The combination creates a dynamic look that highlights the structure of the shoe, while white elements add balance across the design. The build remains focused on cushioning and responsiveness. This pair stands out because it adds energy to a comfort focused model. The bold color accents make it more visually engaging, appealing to those who want performance footwear that still carries personality. It is a strong addition to the Vomero lineup, blending function with a more expressive edge. Display Name: Puma LaMelo Ball LaFrancé Amour Black
Description: The Puma LaMelo Ball LaFrancé Amour Black is a striking addition to the basketball star's signature line. This sleek sneaker showcases a predominantly black colorway, exuding a bold and sophisticated aesthetic. The design seamlessly blends style and performance, featuring Puma's innovative technology to enhance on-court agility and comfort. The LaFrancé Amour incorporates advanced cushioning and support systems, ensuring optimal performance during intense gameplay. Its versatile appearance makes it equally suitable for casual wear, allowing fans to showcase their appreciation for LaMelo's distinctive style in everyday settings. Set for release on March 12, 2025, this highly anticipated sneaker is poised to become a must-have for basketball enthusiasts and sneakerheads alike. Us at StockX believe this product is great for athletes seeking a high-performance basketball shoe that doubles as a stylish streetwear option.

Display Name: Nike ReactX Infinity Run 4 Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike ReactX Infinity Run 4 Black Anthracite updates the Infinity Run 4s road running silhouette with a sleek black-on-grey colorway. Designed for running on paved surfaces like sidewalks and roads, this version of the Infinity Run 4 features a rocker-shaped midsole that houses Nikes signature ReactX foam. This cushioning system delivers elevated energy return while protecting against impact stress. Additionally, the waffle-patterned outsole provides traction on various urban surfaces. Finally, the sneaker comes with a water-resistant membrane, though it isnt fully waterproof. Our StockX experts appreciate the way the sneaker commits to its ultra-dark colorwayeven the Swoosh logos and the tongues Nike branding come in Anthracite. The Nike ReactX Infinity Run 4 Black Anthracite was released on August 3, 2023, and sold for $160.

Display Name: Nike Air Liquid Max Triple Black
Description: The Nike Air Liquid Max Triple Black brings a futuristic edge through its fully visible cushioning system and all black execution. The liquid inspired sole unit gives the shoe a unique visual identity, while the triple black colorway keeps it sleek and cohesive. Metallic silver accents add just enough contrast to highlight the structure without breaking the flow. This pair stands out because of its technology driven design. The Air Liquid Max line pushes cushioning visibility further than traditional models, creating a look that feels almost experimental. It is a strong option for those who appreciate innovation combined with a clean and versatile palette. Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Midas Gold
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Midas Gold features a Midas Gold leather upper with Tough Red overlays and Swooshes. From there, matching woven tongue tags and soles complete the design. The Nike Dunk Low Midas Gold released in October of 2021 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: Nike Moon Shoe Soft Pearl Black (Women's)
Description: The Nike Moon Shoe Soft Pearl Black Womens draws inspiration from one of Nikes earliest innovations, reimagining the iconic waffle sole concept in a modern format. Display Name: On Running Cloudtilt Remix Sunstone Ivory (Women's)

Display Name: Nike Air Humara QS Black Metallic Silver

The Black Metallic Silver colorway of the Nike Air Humara QS features an upper with a base of black mesh overlaid with black and silver textile that courses down the side panel, providing support, durability, and style. Display Name: Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 OG White Brown
Description: The Saucony ProGrid Omni 9 OG White Brown leans into a more classic and grounded palette, combining white and brown tones that highlight the layered construction of the silhouette. Display Name: Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Smoke Grey
Description: The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Smoke Grey is a slip-on silhouette from Nike designed with ReactX foam to provide post-workout relief or everyday comfort. Display Name: New Balance 9060 Pink Granite Washed Burgundy (GS)
Description: The New Balance 9060 Pink Granite Washed Burgundy GS brings layered color into a youth exclusive take on the brand most forward leaning runner. Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Lunar New Year

Display Name: New Balance Abzorb 2000 Aminé Biblioteca
Description: The New Balance Abzorb 2000 Aminé Biblioteca is a highly personalized collaborative running shoe, featuring a vibrant, thematic colorway. The shoe features Green and White. All this sits atop a clean, white midsole, proving that simplicity can still make a statement. The Jordan 1 Retro Low Black Toe landed on the market on July 29, 2023, at a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (PS)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (PS), in pre-school sizes, is an athletic shoe with a low-top silhouette. The leather upper is done in Medium Olive overlaid with Sail at the tip, lace panel, and heel, accented by a reversed Swoosh in black. Travis Scott and Jordan wings branding accents the heel, while the Nike branding appears on the tongue. The midsole and outsole combo in Muslin and Medium Olive completes the look. Nike introduced the Air Jordan 1 to the public in 1985 after designing it for Michael Jordan in 1984, and from there, the shoe went on to have legendary status. Classic and iconic, the Jordan 1 retro has been reimagined in myriad variations. In 2024, Nike worked with Houston, Texas-based artist Travis Scott on his signature Jordan 1 Retro, which features his stitched mouth-face artwork. In our opinion, the Retro Low OG SP's best feature is its unusual branding and stitching, which distinguish it from other models. The Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP Travis Scott Medium Olive (PS) was released on September 28, 2024, and retailed for $60.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low Swooshless Black (2025)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low Swooshless Black 2025 strips back the iconic silhouette by removing the traditional side Swoosh for a cleaner, more minimalist look. The Black upper paired with Sail accents keeps the color story simple, allowing the altered design to take center stage. The low cut construction maintains the familiar AJ1 proportions despite the bold aesthetic shift. This version stands out because it challenges expectations while preserving heritage lines. By eliminating the Swoosh, the silhouette feels modern and experimental, yet the paneling and shape remain unmistakably Jordan. Fans appreciate when the brand reinterprets its classics through subtle but impactful design decisions. It is a sleek and statement driven update that feels both daring and rooted in legacy. The Air Jordan 1 Retro Low Swooshless Black 2025 was released on July 16, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R Silver Metallic Black (GS)
Description: The New Balance 1906R Silver Metallic Black (GS) scales down the retro-tech runner for grade school sizes, featuring a clean, high-contrast colorway. The shoe blends Silver Metallic and Black. The layered mesh and synthetic upper maintains the intricate, supportive structure of the 1906 model. The design incorporates ABZORB and N-ergy cushioning for proven comfort and shock absorption. This versatile model was released on June 24, 2024, with a retail price of $110. The sharp Silver Metallic overlays contrast boldly with the deep Black mesh base and sole unit. This color scheme emphasizes the shoe's technical layering and aggressive profile, making it a stylish and supportive option. Our experts note the technical support of the ABZORB and N-ergy cushioning, stylishly emphasized by the high-contrast Silver Metallic and Black paneling.

Display Name: Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Kuwata
Description: The Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Salmon Pink is a collaboration show that became one celebrated addition to the brand´s catalog. Dressed in salmon pink and red, this Pollex clog features an EVA foam upper with clear-cut concave ridges that resemble a fingerprint pattern. Vent holes appear on high-heat areas like the front, midfoot, and ankles. It also features adjustable velcro straps for fitting. Dark red accents the strap holders and the semi-translucent panels on the heel, forefoot, and medial toe. The Crocs Pollex Clog by Salehe Bembury Salmon Pink was released on 22nd October 2022, with a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Gore-Tex Tea Peat
Description: The Salomon XT 6 Gore Tex Tea Peat delivers a weather ready version of one of the brands most recognized trail silhouettes through a palette inspired by natural terrain. The Tea and Peat tones create a monochromatic look that feels grounded and earthy, while the Gore Tex construction adds waterproof protection that enhances the shoes functionality. The XT 6 remains a staple within both outdoor performance and lifestyle wear, known for its balance of cushioning and stability. Fans gravitate toward Gore Tex models because they extend the usability of trail shoes into more challenging conditions. The tonal colorway keeps the design cohesive, making it easy to style while still reflecting the outdoor inspiration behind the model. The XT 6 silhouette continues gaining traction within fashion due to its technical look and proven performance. For collectors, pairs like this represent the growing influence of outdoor gear within everyday style, where functionality and aesthetic come together seamlessly. The Salomon XT 6 Gore Tex Tea Peat was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Model: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB
Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB University Red
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB University Red brings striking energy to the iconic low cut silhouette. University Red dominates the engineered mesh upper, contrasted by clean White accents that sharpen the lines of the shoe. The Protro build refines the cushioning system, reinforcing its performance driven intent. Red executions on Kobe models often signal intensity and focus, aligning with his relentless mindset on the court. The streamlined Kobe 9 EM structure keeps the design aggressive and responsive, perfect for players who value quick movement. For fans of bold Team Bank colorways, this version stands out with confident simplicity. The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB University Red was released on November 22, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Nike Giannis Immortality 3 Oreo
Description: The Nike Giannis Immortality 3 Oreo is a sleek and stylish performance basketball shoe designed for players who demand both style and functionality on the court. Featuring a classic white and black colorway, this sneaker pays homage to the beloved 'Oreo' aesthetic while incorporating cutting-edge technology for optimal performance. The shoe's upper is crafted with breathable materials to keep your feet cool during intense gameplay, while the responsive cushioning system provides excellent energy return and comfort. Engineered with Giannis Antetokounmpo's explosive playing style in mind, the Immortality 3 boasts a durable rubber outsole with a multidirectional traction pattern for superior grip on various court surfaces. The shoe's midfoot support system and padded collar offer enhanced stability and ankle protection, allowing players to make quick cuts and dynamic moves with confidence. Our experts state this product is great for basketball enthusiasts and athletes looking for a high-performance shoe that doesn't compromise on style or comfort.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low OG EX Black Smoke Grey
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low OG EX Black Smoke Grey comes in a mixture of five different colors tones: sail, coconut milk, light smoke grey, dark smoke grey, as well as black. ? ?The leather upper of this Low OG Air Jordan 1 sneaker features complementary shades of grey and black hues. The upper is constructed entirely from breathable nylon and has an exposed foam backing. A white midsole sits on a black outsole that completes the look of this shoe. ? ?The Air Jordan 1 Low OG EX Black Smoke Grey was first made available on August 26th, 2022, with $140 as the suggested retail price.
Colorway: Black/Dark Smoke Grey-Light Smoke Grey-Sail-Coconut Milk

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Fragment x Union LA White Black
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Fragment x Union LA White Black offers a cleaner, more understated take on the same collaborative vision. Featuring a crisp white and black palette, this version leans into contrast and simplicity while still showcasing Union LAs signature construction details. Exposed stitching, layered panels, and vintage-inspired finishes give the sneaker depth without relying on bold color. This colorway highlights the balance between Fragments minimalist design language and Unions love for visible craftsmanship. Subtle co-branding appears throughout the upper inlcuding Fragment's iconic thunderbolts on the heel, keeping the look refined and intentional rather than overt. The white leather panels brighten the silhouette, while black overlays on the heel ground the design, making it one of the most versatile pairs in the collaboration. When the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG SP Fragment x Union LA White Black released, it retailed for $205. Clean, thoughtful, and rich in collaborative detail, this pair stands out as a wearable yet highly collectible take on the Jordan 1.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Zalando Exclusive Olive
Description: The New Balance 2002R Zalando Exclusive Olive is a European-market exclusive released through Zalando in a dark moss and olive palette that applies the 2002R's multilayer upper construction to a military-inspired colorway, featuring a dense olive-grey mesh base heavily layered with premium shaggy suede in Army Olive, a hairy suede tongue, warm tan leather underlays, an off-white N-ergy midsole with visible ABZORB SBS heel cushioning, a white N logo outlined in black, and silver reflective accents. The shaggy suede material treatment is the defining premium detail that distinguishes this Zalando exclusive from standard 2002R releases, providing a richer and more tactilely varied surface texture than the smooth suede or mesh combinations used on the general 2002R catalog. The 2002R silhouette draws from the tech running aesthetic of New Balance's late 1990s and early 2000s performance lineup, with its layered construction, substantial cushioned midsole, and multi-panel upper giving it its distinctive lifestyle runner identity that has made the model one of the most consistent performers in New Balance's contemporary sportstyle range. The Zalando exclusive distribution model mirrors the retailer-exclusive strategy New Balance uses globally to introduce unique colorways and material treatments that are unavailable through standard channels, giving Zalando's European customer base a specific regional release while reinforcing the 2002R's collector appeal across its full colorway catalog. Released May 25, 2023 at $150 retail with style code M2002RZD, exclusively through Zalando. The New Balance 2002R Zalando Exclusive Olive was released on May 25, 2023 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Black White Team Royal (Women's)
Description: The NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Black White Team Royal Womens delivers a practical and understated approach to everyday footwear, reflecting Tom Sachs focus on function and simplicity. The black and white base keeps the design grounded, while team royal and team orange accents add subtle variation that highlights the structure without overwhelming it. The gum outsole reinforces its utilitarian feel. This pair stands out because it is built to be worn consistently rather than occasionally. The General Purpose Shoe lives up to its name, offering something reliable and adaptable across different environments. Fans appreciate how it avoids excess and focuses on durability and intention, making it feel more like a tool than a statement piece. The NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Black White Team Royal Womens was released with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro J-Pack Chicago
Description: The latest Nike SB Dunk J-Pack Chicago keeps Jordan Brands relationship with skateboarding strong. For those that dont know, before the plethora of options for proper skateboarding footwear, skaters in the 80s and 90s preferred boarding in Air Jordan 1s. The sneakers high top construction provided the proper amount of ankle support needed to bare various skateboarding tricks. The recent addition to the Nike SB Dunk J-Pack pays homage to Air Jordan 1s involvement with early skate culture. This Nike SB Dunk Low J-Pack Chicago has something that both Jordan and SB heads will enjoy. The classic SB Dunk Low silhouette is dressed in a Chicago Jordan 1 red, white, and black leather colorway. From there, a fat tongue and oval laces introduce the skateboarding aspect of the sneaker. The Nike SB Dunk Low J-Pack Chicago release in September 2020 for $95. They were re-released in 2024.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Dark Mocha (GS)
Description: Jordan Brand continued one of its oldest Jordan 1 color blocking themes with the Kids Air Jordan 1 Retro High Dark Mocha. The Dark Mocha adds earth tones to the classic Jordan 1 Black Toe design. The Kids Air Jordan Retro High Dark Mocha features a white leather upper with brown Durabuck material utilized on the heel overlay and collar flap portion of the shoe. The Wings logo can be found on the ankle, and the Swoosh logo on the medial side. A white midsole and black outsole completes the design. The Kids Air Jordan 1 Retro High Dark Mocha was released in October of 2020 and retailed for $130.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Rare Air
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Rare Air celebrates individuality and imperfection through a colorway that feels expressive and slightly unconventional. The Rare Air concept has always been about standing apart, and this low cut execution brings that philosophy into an everyday friendly silhouette. The mix of tones creates visual interest without overwhelming the design, making it feel unique yet approachable. Fans love this release because it rewards closer attention. The Jordan 1 Low Rare Air feels personal, designed for collectors who appreciate storytelling through subtle color and detail rather than obvious themes. It stands out quietly, reinforcing the idea that some of the most meaningful Jordans are the ones that break pattern just enough to feel special without losing their roots. The Air Jordan 1 Low Rare Air was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Cumulus 16 Finesse Desert Rose
Description: The ASICS Gel Cumulus 16 Finesse Desert Rose brings an earthy and elegant tone to the Gel Cumulus 16, emphasizing softness and warmth through color rather than contrast. The desert rose execution feels calm and grounded, highlighting the shoes flowing construction and layered materials in a way that feels organic. It reflects ASICS ability to translate performance roots into lifestyle relevance naturally. Fans appreciate this release because it feels effortless and approachable. The Gel Cumulus 16 silhouette remains familiar and comfortable, while the finesse driven palette adds a sense of refinement that works well beyond running contexts. Collectors love it as a wearable and versatile sneaker, one that blends comfort, nostalgia, and subtle expression into a design that feels timeless rather than seasonal. The ASICS Gel Cumulus 16 Finesse Desert Rose was released on November 14, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: adidas Campus 80s South Park Towelie
Description: South Park and adidas joined forces to celebrate 4/20 in 2021 with the release of the adidas Campus 80s South Park Towelie. This release references Towelie, a laboratory-made, cannabis-consuming towel character who has made appearances in more than a dozen episodes and three South Park games. The adidas Campus 80s South Park Towelie features a purple terry cloth upper with white leather overlays and purple leather lining. Towelies eyes appear on the tongue and when exposed to sunlight, they transition from white to bright red. A hidden stash pocket in the tongue is big enough to fit the Towelie keychains that are included with the shoes. Quotes from Towelie that read "Dont Forget To Bring A Towel" and "I Have No Idea Whats Going On" also show up on the tongues interior. A white sole and adidas branding on the heel tab complete this South Park release. The adidas Campus 80s South Park Towelie released in April of 2021 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: adidas BW Army Kith Magenta Mauve
Description: The adidas BW Army Kith Magenta Mauve takes the same heritage driven silhouette and pushes it into a more expressive direction through a soft but distinct color palette. The magenta mauve upper stands out without feeling overwhelming, creating a balance between statement and wearability that fits Kiths design approach. Off white detailing keeps the look grounded, while the gum sole maintains that direct connection to the shoes original indoor training roots. This version resonates with collectors who want something slightly different without stepping too far away from a proven classic. The BW Army shape remains clean and low profile, letting the color do the work in defining the shoes identity. Kiths influence is clear in the way the tones are executed, giving the pair a refined edge that feels intentional. It is a sneaker that blends heritage with personality, making it a standout within a lineup built on subtle variations. The adidas BW Army Kith Magenta Mauve was released on April 20, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Steel Grey Pure Silver
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Steel Grey Pure Silver is a sleek and stylish sneaker that combines comfort and performance. Featuring a steel grey upper with pure silver accents, this shoe offers a modern and versatile look suitable for various occasions. The Gel-1130 model incorporates ASICS' renowned GEL technology in the heel, providing excellent shock absorption and cushioning for all-day comfort. Designed with both style and functionality in mind, the Gel-1130 boasts a breathable mesh upper that ensures proper ventilation during wear. The durable rubber outsole offers reliable traction on various surfaces, making it an ideal choice for everyday use. With its classic ASICS design elements and contemporary colorway, this sneaker effortlessly bridges the gap between athletic performance and casual style. Our experts state this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that can transition seamlessly from casual outings to light athletic activities while providing exceptional comfort and support.

Model: adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball
Display Name: adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball Carbon Sesame
Description: The adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball Carbon Sesame is part of an ongoing collaboration between adidas and the Los Angeles-based apparel label Fear of God. Created by Jerry Lorenzo, this hybrid basketball shoe features a minimalist aesthetic and the designers signature muted tones. For example, the knit upper and neoprene collar come in Carbon, while the toecap and exaggerated rubber outsole feature off-white Sesame. Paying tribute to adidas legacy, the side panels display the 3-Stripes logo made with plastic-like material. Instead of serving as a simple logo, the 3-Stripes form a lace cage that houses durable Carbon laces. Something our experts like about this sneaker is the lack of overt branding. For example, other than the 3-Stripes logo, the only branding is a small patch on the heel that reads fear of god. The adidas Fear of God Athletics I Basketball Carbon Sesame was released on December 3rd, 2023, and retailed at $250.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Panda (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid Panda (Women's) was released as part of the Jordan 1 Mid collection and was specifically made in women's sizes. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Panda for women is designed with a black-and-white color scheme that mimics the appearance of a panda. The Nike Swoosh is also black and can be seen on the side, while the Air Jordan Wings logo appears in white. The shoe also features a rubber outsole that provides traction and grip, even on slippery surfaces. In addition, the shoe is lined with a padded collar and tongue, which provide extra cushioning and support. Our experts believe that one of the most notable features of the Jordan 1 Mid Panda (Women's) is the mid-top silhouette. This design provides additional support and protection to the ankle, which makes the shoe ideal for sporty activities. The sneaker debuted on June 20th, 2023, and retailed for $125.

Display Name: Jordan 40 Blue Suede
Description: The Air Jordan 40 Blue Suede marks a milestone moment for Jordan Brand, bringing a sense of refinement and forward vision to a silhouette built to celebrate longevity and evolution. The Blue Suede execution gives the Air Jordan 40 a luxurious and confident feel, letting material choice elevate the design rather than loud graphics. The smooth blue tones highlight the modern lines of the shoe, making it feel ceremonial and significant rather than experimental. Collectors are drawn to this release because it represents a bridge between history and the future. The Air Jordan 40 is about honoring decades of innovation while still looking ahead, and the Blue Suede treatment reinforces that idea with restraint and elegance. Fans appreciate how it feels special without being excessive, a sneaker designed to mark an era and remind people why Jordan Brand continues to define basketball culture generation after generation. The Air Jordan 40 Blue Suede was released on August 20, 2025 with a retail price of $205.

Display Name: Jordan 6 Retro Infrared Salesman (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro Reverse Infrared GS flips a legendary formula, delivering the iconic Infrared energy in a youth exclusive format. Black dominates the upper, creating a stealth base that allows Light Crimson accents to pop with unmistakable intensity. The Jordan 6 design lines remain as bold as ever, from the angular overlays to the visible Air unit in the heel. Infrared will always be one of the most important color stories in Jordan history, and reversing the balance keeps it feeling fresh without losing its identity. For younger collectors, this GS version offers a chance to own a twist on a heritage classic that has defined multiple eras. The contrast between dark panels and vibrant crimson detailing gives it that familiar game ready presence fans instantly recognize. The Air Jordan 6 Retro Reverse Infrared GS was released on February 14, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Wolf Grey
Description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Wolf Grey updates Kobe Bryants eighth signature Nike basketball shoe with a sleek white and Wolf Grey color palette. Celebrating Bryants on-court performance legacy, the Wolf Grey Nike Kobe 8 Protro boasts enhancements designed to support agile movements. For instance, the upper is crafted from ultra-lightweight, engineered mesh that provides breathability and doesnt weigh down the foot. The responsive React midsole cushions against impact, while the thin laces thread through reinforced eyelets for a secure fit. Although the mesh, laces, collar, and part of the midsole come in Wolf Grey, the Swoosh logos, Bryants signature, the sheath and sword logos on the heel and tongue, and part of the midsole come in white. Our experts at StockX like the way the white and Wolf Grey complement each other, creating a timeless, neutral colorway. The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Wolf Grey was released on September 6, 2024, and sold for $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Football Grey Ghost Persian Violet Blue Void
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 Football Grey Ghost Persian Violet Blue Void offers a cooler and more composed interpretation of Nikes premier marathon racer. The muted greys and layered blue tones give the Alphafly a refined presence while keeping its futuristic shape intact. It feels controlled and precise, designed for runners who value clarity and focus as much as explosive speed. Fans appreciate this colorway because it lets the design speak through structure rather than brightness. The Alphafly Next 3 remains visually striking, but this palette gives it a more understated confidence. Collectors value it as a performance driven sneaker that balances innovation and restraint, proving that cutting edge running footwear can feel serious, elegant, and purpose built without losing its visual impact. The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 Football Grey Ghost Persian Violet Blue Void was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $285.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Hustle 2 Victor Wembanyama Alien
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Hustle 2 Victor Wembanyama Alien edition is a bold statement in performance basketball footwear, inspired by the rising star Victor Wembanyama. This special edition features a multi-color design dominated by striking black and green hues, creating a visually captivating aesthetic. The sneaker includes a glow-in-the-dark sole that reads "Be Unique Every Day," adding a unique touch that resonates with Wembanyama's out-of-this-world nickname, "alien." The metallic swoosh further enhances the sneaker's futuristic appeal, making it a standout both on and off the court. Designed for optimal performance, the Nike Air Zoom GT Hustle 2 incorporates advanced technology to meet the demands of modern basketball players. The alien logo on the heel serves as a tribute to Wembanyama's unique presence in the basketball world, symbolizing his extraordinary skills and potential. The combination of black and green, along with the glow-in-the-dark features, ensures that this sneaker is not just about performance but also about making a bold style statement. Priced at $170, the Nike Air Zoom GT Hustle 2 Victor Wembanyama Alien was released on May 15, 2024. This sneaker merges cutting-edge design with the name recognition of the NBA's newest star, offering a perfect blend of style and functionality. Celebrate Victor Wembanyama and embrace the "alien" spirit with this unique and stylish sneaker.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Phantom Medium Olive
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Phantom Medium Olive uses a soft and tonal palette to create a more refined and understated take on the silhouette. Phantom and medium olive tones blend together across the upper, giving the shoe a cohesive and slightly muted appearance. The layered construction remains a key feature, adding depth without relying on bold contrast. This pair resonates with fans who prefer subtle design over loud colorways. The tonal execution makes it versatile and easy to incorporate into everyday wear, while still maintaining the structure that defines the Air Max 90. Nike continues to explore these quieter palettes, offering options that feel modern without straying from the models roots. It is a clean and controlled take on a classic. The Nike Air Max 90 Phantom Medium Olive was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: adidas Campus 00s Wonder White Gum
Description: The adidas Campus 00s Wonder White Gum adds a neutral colorway of Wonder White and Cloud White to the bulky Campus 00s silhouette. Inspired by the original adidas Campus designs, the Wonder White Gum Campus 00s has a bulkier silhouette reminiscent of skateboarding shoes from the early 2000s. Extra padding around the collar and in the tongue creates exaggerated proportions that set this version of the Campus 00s apart from other legacy adidas sneakers. The upper boasts premium leather in Wonder White with hits of Cloud White on the heel mustache and the serrated 3-Stripes logo. Perforations between each stripe in the 3-Stripes logo provide ventilation, while thick cotton laces match the shoes oversized proportions and thread through the front closure system. Our experts like the 2000s-inspired adidas branding on the padded tongue, which features a stylized trefoil without adidas lettering. The adidas Campus 00s Wonder White Gum was released on May 1, 2024, and sold for $110.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Mid TD Cleat Legend Blue
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Mid TD Cleat Legend Blue brings one of the most beloved Jordan colorways onto the field through a performance driven update. White dominates the upper with a crisp and polished feel, while legend blue accents add freshness and clarity. Black details provide contrast that sharpens the overall look, and the cleated outsole transforms the familiar mid top shape into something built for traction and speed. Collectors and athletes alike appreciate how the Legend Blue palette carries emotional weight tied to the Jordan 11 legacy. Translating that look into a cleat format extends the story beyond lifestyle wear, merging heritage design with modern performance needs. It feels both nostalgic and practical, offering the unmistakable Jordan 11 presence in a competitive setting. This release highlights how iconic colorways can evolve without losing their original identity. The Air Jordan 11 Mid TD Cleat Legend Blue was released on February 6, 2025 with a retail price of $220.

Display Name: Salomon XT-6 Maritime Blue Black
Description: The Salomon XT-6 Maritime Blue Black is a colorway that translates the technical trail-running silhouette's utilitarian character into one of its most visually refined and daily-wear-appropriate executions, a deep maritime blue base that brings a sense of depth and restraint to a shoe whose entire design vocabulary was built around function-first engineering rather than fashion. Maritime Blue covers the anti-debris mesh upper in a rich, ocean-adjacent tone that feels both premium and purpose-driven, reinforced by sleek tonal TPU film overlays welded directly onto the mesh to provide structure and abrasion protection without adding bulk to the silhouette's streamlined profile. Black anchors the design through the midsole, key structural elements, and secondary detailing, creating a color relationship that reads authoritative and versatile across a wide range of styling contexts, while Fiery Red arrives as the accent that cuts through the darker tones on the branding and technical components with enough vivid energy to prevent the colorway from reading as too understated. The Quicklace system with its integrated lace pocket, multi-colored racing stripe tongue branding, and precision-welded lines on the quarters complete the design with all the engineering signatures that have made the XT-6 one of the most respected performance-to-lifestyle crossover silhouettes in contemporary sneaker culture. The XT-6 was introduced in 2013 as one of Salomon's most technically advanced trail shoes, engineered specifically for ultra-distance racing in harsh conditions with EnergyCell midsole cushioning, an agileCHASSIS stability system, and Contagrip outsole technology developed from decades of alpine footwear expertise. The model's transition into lifestyle and fashion relevance came organically through the convergence of outdoor aesthetics and streetwear culture, accelerated significantly by the Hidden New York collaboration that earned the XT-6 widespread critical recognition and established it as a collector-relevant silhouette beyond just the performance running community. The Maritime Blue colorway represents the shoe at its most wearable and seasonless, a version that works across outdoor technical contexts and urban everyday wear with equal conviction and the kind of color restraint that rewards long-term ownership rather than single-season trend relevance. The Salomon XT-6 Maritime Blue Black was released on January 15, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low The Powerpuff Girls Bubbles
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low The Powerpuff Girls Bubbles edition brings a playful and vibrant twist to the iconic Dunk Low silhouette. Inspired by the cartoon show, this Dunk Low is a perfect representation of sugar, spice, and everything nice, channeling the charm and energy of Bubbles. ? ?? ?Featuring the colorway Blue Chill/?Deep Royal Blue, this sneaker is a visual treat, capturing the essence of Bubbles' character. Each design element is thoughtfully crafted to reflect the cheerful and spirited nature of one of the beloved Powerpuff Girls. ? ?? ?Released on December 14 at skate shops and on December 15 on SNKRS, the Nike SB Dunk Low The Powerpuff Girls Bubbles was priced at $135. This sneaker is a must-have for fans of the series and sneaker collectors alike, offering a unique blend of nostalgia and style.

Display Name: On Running Cloudtilt Olive Desert
Description: The On Running Cloudtilt Olive Desert channels outdoor inspired minimalism through a silhouette designed around lightweight comfort and modern movement. The Cloudtilt represents On Runnings evolution toward more lifestyle friendly performance footwear, blending the brands signature cushioned sole geometry with a cleaner and more wearable upper construction. The Olive and Desert palette reinforces that direction through earthy neutral tones that create a calm and versatile atmosphere while preserving the futuristic identity associated with Ons performance technology and sculpted midsole design. Fans appreciate the Cloudtilt because it bridges the gap between running functionality and contemporary casual styling in a way that feels effortless and highly wearable. Earth toned runners continue growing in popularity because they integrate naturally into modern outdoor inspired wardrobes and minimalist fashion trends. Collectors especially gravitate toward muted olive based palettes because they add character without sacrificing versatility or everyday practicality. The overall presentation feels relaxed, technical, and highly reflective of the growing demand for performance sneakers that function equally well in active settings and modern streetwear culture. The On Running Cloudtilt Olive Desert was released on February 5, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Black Silver
Description: First released in 2017, the New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Black Silver dresses the fourth-generation performance runner in a sleek black and silver color scheme. The MiUSA Black Silver New Balance 990v4 boasts a mesh base with suede overlays, all dressed in black. Contrast is added to the sneaker by silver accents on the "N" side logos, upper eyelets, tongue branding, and reflective panels on the toe box and lateral heel (the 990 badge). In a deviation from the overall color scheme, touches of red can be seen on the heel and insole "NB" logos. The sneaker sits atop a gray ENCAP midsole, with a two-toned black and gray NDurance rubber outsole completing the look. Something we love about the New Balance 990v4 MiUSA Black Silver is how the sneakers reflective details subtly break up the monochromatic black look, adding depth and a hint of shine without overpowering the design. The fourth-generation runner debuted on October 3, 2023, and sold for $185.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Levis Lunar New Year
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Levis Lunar New Year blends heritage basketball design with denim craftsmanship in a way that feels celebratory yet rooted in history. The upper is wrapped in textured Denim, giving the Jordan 3 a casual edge that contrasts beautifully with the structured silhouette Tinker Hatfield introduced decades ago. Sail on the midsole keeps the look clean, while Gym Red accents inject a festive energy that nods to Lunar New Year traditions. Jordan 3 collaborations always carry weight, and adding Levis into the mix elevates the storytelling through material alone. Denim has long been a staple in street culture, and seeing it reworked on one of the most important Jordan models makes this pair feel instantly collectible. The Lunar New Year theme adds another layer of meaning, turning an already strong collaboration into a culturally resonant release. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Levis Lunar New Year was released on February 20, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Model: Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP
Display Name: Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Matte Olive Gum Dark Brown
Description: The Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Matte Olive Gum Dark Brown merges vintage running influence with bold Air Max attitude. Matte Olive dominates the upper, complemented by Legion Brown and black accents that add depth. A Gum Dark Brown outsole anchors the look, nodding to classic waffle traction while maintaining a street ready stance. The layered construction balances retro inspiration with contemporary presence. Fans appreciate how this silhouette bridges eras, blending heritage details with modern energy. The earthy palette feels rugged and versatile, offering warmth and texture without excessive contrast. It stands out through material and tone rather than flash. Rooted in history yet confidently updated, this pair delivers character with every step. The Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Matte Olive Gum Dark Brown was released on November 5, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: New Balance 740v2 Heron Blue Vintage Indigo
Description: The New Balance 740v2 Heron Blue Vintage Indigo brings layered depth to the updated 740v2 silhouette with a rich blend of blues and subtle metallic accents. Heron Blue and Vintage Indigo wrap the upper in a tonal story that feels bold yet cohesive, while Gold Metallic details introduce a refined contrast. Sea Salt underlays soften the palette, allowing the stronger hues to stand out without overwhelming the design. The streamlined build and breathable mesh construction keep the model rooted in performance tradition. Fans gravitate toward this colorway because it feels expressive without losing versatility. The interplay of blue shades gives it personality, making it stand apart from more neutral releases. At the same time, the balanced composition ensures it remains wearable in daily rotation. It reflects how New Balance continues to evolve its archival inspired runners through thoughtful color execution rather than drastic redesigns. The New Balance 740v2 Heron Blue Vintage Indigo was released on April 11, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro TEX Starfish (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro TEX Starfish (Womens) reimagines the 1988 icon with rugged, modern polish. A mixed-material upper pairs durable textiles with premium overlays, set in a refined Fossil and Sail base that lets the vivid Starfish accents energize every step. Classic AJ3 DNA is all here, the bold midsole, perforated details, and heritage heel tab, refreshed with the TEX treatment for a versatile, street-ready feel. Subtle contrast stitching and textured panels add depth, while the Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel keeps the look true to the lineage created by Tinker Hatfield. Underfoot, a cushioned midsole with visible Air in the heel delivers day-long comfort, supported by a sturdy rubber outsole that grips city pavement and court surfaces alike. The padded collar and secure lacing system lock in a stable ride, making the Jordan 3 Retro TEX as wearable as it is striking. Styled in the IH7694-200 colorway, this pair blends Fossil/Starfish/Sail into a palette thats effortlessly versatile, easy to dress up or down and perfect for rotation year-round. If youre seeking a standout womens Jordan that balances timeless design with functional edge, this release lands right on target. This release earns its place in the collection because it blends the AJ3s legendary shape with resilient materials and a lively Starfish pop, making it an everyday staple that still turns heads.

Display Name: Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide Summit White
Description: The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide Summit White is a one?piece ReactX foam slide in Summit White, with a broad molded strap and a contoured footbed. There's a sticky rubber outsole that adds grip, and minimal branding on the side. The upper comes with a molded ReactX foam strap and a footbed that's shaped to match the arch and heel. There's a tonal Swoosh on the side of the strap, with "ReactX" stamped across the bed and channels along the sole that add resistance by shedding water. The Summit White ReactX Rejuven8 Slide by Nike joins a line of recovery footwear designed around cushioned simplicity since 2022. Here at StockX, something we love about the Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Slide Summit White is the design that's specifically engineered to give you maximum comfort and support when your feet get tired after a workout. The strategic ventilation holes are another plus, integrated into the slide to improve airflow. It retailed at $60 when it was released on April 23, 2025.

Display Name: Nike V5 RNR Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike V5 RNR Black Anthracite delivers a stripped back running inspired silhouette designed for comfort, simplicity, and daily wear. The black and anthracite palette gives the shoe a sleek and understated look, allowing the shape and cushioning to take priority. It feels practical and approachable, built for people who value comfort and ease rather than visual noise. Fans like this model because it feels honest and functional. The V5 RNR focuses on everyday movement, making it a reliable option for walking, light running, or casual rotation. Collectors of Nike runners appreciate how silhouettes like this reflect the brands roots in accessible performance, offering a shoe that fits naturally into daily life without trying to make a statement. The Nike V5 RNR Black Anthracite was released on February 20, 2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf UNC
Description: Taking inspiration from the original Air Jordan 1 High UNC from 1985, the Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf UNC features a smooth white leather upper with University Blue overlays and Swooshes. At the base, a deeply grooved sole gears golfers for terrains ranging from the fairway, green, and if you are unlucky, the bunker. The Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf UNC released in February of 2022 and retailed for $130.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low QS CO.JP Reverse Ultraman (2024)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low QS CO.JP Reverse Ultraman (2024) is part of the CO.JP series and boasts a heritage colorway of Varsity Red and silver. Although the colorway was first seen in 1999, its not the only heritage element applied to the Dunk Low QS CO.JP Reverse Ultraman (2024). The sneaker boasts signature color blocking, including a Varsity Red base with forefoot and toe overlays in silver. In addition, the laces, Swoosh logos on the side panels, and rubber outsole also come in silver. Branding details include "NIKE" in red printed across the heel tab and silver "NIKE" lettering on the Varsity Red tongue tag. This sneaker has the "Quickstrike (QS)" designation, which means it was released by Nike in a limited quantity. Our experts like the layer of white on the midsole, which balances out the bold color blocking. The Nike Dunk Low QS CO.JP Reverse Ultraman (2024) was released on May 3, 2024, and retailed at $125.

Display Name: Nike KD 18 Soft Pearl
Description: The Nike KD 18 Soft Pearl delivers a refined and almost understated take on Durants latest signature model. Soft Pearl sets a smooth base, complemented by Pure Platinum, Wolf Grey, Metallic Silver, and Summit White for a clean and layered neutral palette. The sculpted upper and low cut profile emphasize speed and control, keeping the silhouette sleek and ready for high level play. This colorway stands out because of its restraint. Instead of bold contrast, it leans into subtle tonal shifts that highlight the shoes structure and detailing. Fans who appreciate minimalist performance footwear will gravitate toward this version, as it blends premium feeling hues with the responsive setup that defines the KD lines modern evolution. The Nike KD 18 Soft Pearl was released on May 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.
Colorway: Soft Pearl/Pure Platinum/Wolf Grey/Metallic Silver/Summit White

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Persian Violet
Description: Nike SB Dunk Low Persian Violet brings rich color to the skate driven silhouette, pairing a deep violet palette with the Dunk Lows timeless shape. The result feels grounded and expressive, capturing a mood that feels both regal and rooted in counterculture attitude. It is a straightforward yet striking colorway that highlights how color alone can transform a familiar silhouette. This release resonates with collectors because the SB Dunk Low continues to be a core canvas for mood and personality. Persian violet doesnt need graphics or flash to stand out; it carries presence through hue and simplicity, appealing to fans who appreciate subtle impact and everyday wearability. It fits naturally into skate and lifestyle rotations alike. The Nike SB Dunk Low Persian Violet was released on 10/07/2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Laser Orange Indigo Burst
Description: The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 in Laser Orange, Indigo Burst, Citron Pulse, Volt Ice, Vivid Purple, and Sapphire is a February 2026 release of Nike's most advanced marathon racing shoe platform, featuring the Alphafly's signature dual ZoomX foam Zoom Air pods in the forefoot alongside a carbon fiber plate for maximum propulsive energy return and record-setting marathon performance, presented in one of the most vibrant and most visually complex multicolor palettes in the Alphafly 3's release history. The Alphafly Next% series has been the choice racing platform for some of the world's fastest marathon runners across its multiple generations, with the ZoomX foam providing the highest energy return in Nike's running foam lineup and the Zoom Air pod system delivering explosive forefoot responsiveness that has been associated with marathon world record performances across Nike's elite athlete program. The Laser Orange and Indigo Burst multicolor palette is the most dramatically eye-catching and most high-visibility expression of the Alphafly 3's race day character, with the bright contrasting orange and indigo anchoring the chromatic range while the additional Citron, Volt, Vivid Purple, and Sapphire tones create a full-spectrum color experience that makes this the most visually festive and most celebratory version of the elite racing shoe. Released February 12, 2026 at $285 retail through Nike Running and authorized retailers globally with the standard Alphafly Next% 3 performance specification. The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next 3 Laser Orange Indigo Burst was released on February 12, 2026 with a retail price of $285.
Colorway: Laser Orange/Indigo Burst/Citron Pulse/Volt Ice/Vivid Purple/Sapphire

Display Name: Jordan 5 Retro Alternate Grape
Description: Jordan enlisted the fourth installment of its Grape theme with the Jordan 5 Retro Alternate Grape, now available on StockX. The Grape colorway was one of the first colorways to touch the Jordan 5 silhouette in 1990. Since then, the colorway has made a comeback in Retro form and in alternative colorways like the Black Grape and Fresh Prince. The Jordan 5 Alternate Grape is composed of a purple suede upper with charcoal underlays and green detailing. A Black and green midsole, visible Air unit in the heel, and traditional icy translucent outsole completes the design. These Jordan 5s released in July of 2020 and retailed for $190 USD.

Display Name: Salomon XT-4 OG White Lunar Rock Night Sky
Description: The Salomon XT 4 OG White Lunar Rock Night Sky brings a technical trail running silhouette into a versatile and layered color palette. The white base creates a clean foundation, while lunar rock and night sky accents add depth and contrast across the design. The structure remains rugged and performance focused, emphasizing stability and traction. Fans of Salomon appreciate how models like the XT 4 continue to bridge outdoor performance with everyday wear. The color combination enhances its adaptability, making it suitable for both trail use and urban styling. It is a sneaker that reflects durability and modern design in a cohesive way. The Salomon XT 4 OG White Lunar Rock Night Sky was released on January 28, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: New Balance 992 MiUSA Action Bronson Digitalis Purpurea
Description: The New Balance 992 MiUSA Action Bronson Digitalis Purpurea transforms a beloved heritage runner into a bold expression of personality and culture. Action Bronsons color choices push the 992 into vibrant territory, blending rich purples and pink tones with the models famously balanced shape. The result feels expressive yet controlled, letting color tell the story without overpowering the silhouettes premium build. Collectors are drawn to this release because Bronsons collaborations always feel personal. The 992 platform brings comfort and credibility, while the colorway reflects creativity and confidence. Fans appreciate how the shoe feels like a celebration of individuality, offering something visually daring that still honors New Balance craftsmanship and long standing design principles. The New Balance 992 MiUSA Action Bronson Digitalis Purpurea was released on October 22, 2025 with a retail price of $240.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low HUF San Francisco
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low HUF San Francisco is a collaborative sneaker made of a tumbled leather upper. ? ?The upper has a white base that goes along with black overlays. Printed on the toe vamp of the shoe is a "HUF" text with a metallic Swoosh passing across it. Additional branding details include the standard Nike SB tongue imprint, texts reading "FOREVER" and "KEITH" on the right and left of the heel, respectively, and a reflective skyline of the San Francisco city at the rear. A hidden tie-dye pattern is also found in white and orange. ? ?The Nike SB Dunk Low HUF San Francisco debuted on November 16th, 2022, and retailed at $130.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low UNC (GS)
Description: Dressed in all leather in a classic two-tone color block, this Nike Dunk Low UNC 2021 with Grade School sizing (GS) is available in Grade School size. The upper on the Nike Dunk Low UNC 2021 (GS) is crafted from smooth white leather, with perforations on the toe box to increase airflow around the foot. The shoe's white base is contrasted by University Blue overlays; University Blue is also the color used on the Swoosh, heel, and heel tag, where the Nike brand name is embroidered in white. "Nike" also appears in University Blue on the lightly padded tongue. The sneaker is completed by a white rubber midsole undergirded by a University Blue outsole. The Nike Dunk Low UNC 2021 (GS) was released in June, 2021, at a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Nike Air DT Max '96 Love Letter to Connie
Description: The Nike Air DT Max '96 'Love Letter to Connie' is a striking homage to the iconic silhouette, reimagined with a heartfelt twist. This men's sneaker showcases a bold University Red colorway, accented with White and Red Crush details, creating a visually captivating design. The shoe's upper features a combination of premium materials, including durable leather and breathable mesh, ensuring both style and comfort. The distinctive chunky midsole houses Nike's renowned Air Max technology, providing exceptional cushioning and support for all-day wear. Paying tribute to its '90s roots, this Air DT Max '96 maintains the classic silhouette while incorporating modern elements. The shoe's design includes subtle nods to the 'Love Letter' theme, making it a unique addition to any sneaker collection. With its eye-catching aesthetics and superior comfort, this release is perfect for both casual wear and making a bold fashion statement. Our team thinks this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts looking to add a touch of nostalgia and romance to their footwear rotation, combining retro charm with contemporary performance.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential Summit White Photon Dust Vapor Green
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Summit White Photon Dust Vapor Green keeps the original Air Max formula intact while introducing a fresh and balanced color palette. Summit white and photon dust create a clean and neutral base, while vapor green accents add a subtle pop that highlights key areas of the silhouette. The visible Air unit remains a defining feature, reinforcing the models place in Nikes design history. What makes this pair stand out is its ability to stay understated while still feeling updated. The color combination adds just enough energy without taking away from the timeless shape of the Air Max 1. Fans continue to gravitate toward releases like this because they offer versatility with a hint of personality. It is a dependable option that keeps the focus on heritage and wearability. The Nike Air Max 1 Essential Summit White Photon Dust Vapor Green was released on April 1, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 97 Undefeated Militia Green (2020)
Description: The UNDFTD X Nike Air collaboration brings back a coveted flight jacket-inspired colorway originally in this Nike Air Max 97 Undefeated Militia Green (2020). The Los Angeles retailers take on the Nike Air Max 97 Undefeated Militia Green (2020) features olive green coloring throughout the mesh and leather upper, accented with a repeating string of Undefeated logos printed on the lowermost of the sneakers wavy overlays. Touches of Orange Blaze are noticeable on the outsole, tongue patch and anterior pull tab, and underfoot, full-length Max Air provides cushioning. The Nike Air Max 97 Undefeated Militia Green (2020) was released in December 2020 and retailed for $180.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Green Apple
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Green Apple is a Spring 2026 JD Sports exclusive release from Nike's ongoing Air Max 95 Big Bubble program, retailing at $190 with style code IR1473-010 in the Black/Photo Blue/Action Green/Anthracite/White/Iron Grey colorway, confirmed by Sneaker News, Sneaker Bar Detroit, Just Fresh Kicks, and Sole Retriever. As confirmed by Sneaker News and Sneaker Bar Detroit, the 2026 retro anchors the design in grey leather side paneling, a black midsole, and white across the tongue, lining, and upper netting, with Green Apple and Photo Blue combining on the Swoosh and tongue logo, additional Green Apple hits on the lace loops and laces, and the Green Apple and Photo Blue pairing appearing in gradient fashion within the seamed Big Bubble heel unit. Sole Retriever and Sneaker Bar Detroit confirmed the Green Apple was originally a JD Sports exclusive released in 2010, making it one of the harder finds in the Air Max 95 lineup due to its limited original availability, and this 2026 retro represents the first rerelease of the colorway in over fifteen years. The Big Bubble program was introduced in 2025 for the Air Max 95's 30th anniversary, with Nike redesigning the silhouette to include plumper OG-spec visible Air units and a restructured less-tapered toe box to better align with the model's original 1995 appearance. Retail price $190. The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Green Apple is the Spring 2026 IR1473-010 JD-Sports-exclusive-retro grey-leather-side-panel black-midsole Green-Apple-and-Photo-Blue-gradient-heel-bubble OG-spec Big Bubble 30th-anniversary Air Max 95 for the Nike collector who wants the rarest and most sought-after JD exclusive colorway from the Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble anniversary program. The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Green Apple has a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 Rattlesnake
Description: The Nike Book 1 Rattlesnake is a premium sneaker thats part of a collaboration between NBA player Devin Booker and Nike. It features a primarily white upper with rattlesnake skin details. The upper is crafted from smooth leather and a canvas-like textile with white stitching. The combination of these two materials creates a gentle textural contrast that allows the rattlesnake elements to stand out. The Swoosh logos on the side panels display a rattlesnake pattern with brown, tan, and black tones. Embroidery around the Swoosh logos creates a white border and makes the print stand out. Hits of red can be found on the BOOK logo tag on the tongue and CHAPTER ONE running up the heel. Other noteworthy details include the number 96 on the heel pull tab, which represents the year Booker was born. Our StockX experts like the addition of a lightweight midsole with a Zoom Air unit in the heel. The Nike Book 1 Rattlesnake was released on May 11, 2024, and retailed at $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Flyknit 2 Black Pure Platinum
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Flyknit 2 Black Pure Platinum colorway combines the classic Air Force 1 silhouette with modern Flyknit technology. A flexible Flyknit upper that molds to the curve of the foot is incorporated into the shoe. Its heel features the recognizable Air-Sole unit, which provides dynamic cushioning and force absorption for a comfortable stride. The low-top model features overlay accents and a perforated toe box as are other distinctive design elements from the original Air Force 1. The outsole is made of tough rubber, which offers grip and traction on a variety of surfaces. Constructed of synthetic material to contrast with the Flyknit upper, the Nike Swoosh insignia is prominently visible on the sides of the shoe in black tones, while Nike writing and Swoosh are printed on its padded tongue. Our experts particularly love the sneaker's color combination of platinum accents with a black base, offering a sleek and versatile aesthetic. The Nike Air Force 1 Flyknit 2 Black Pure Platinum released on 1st May 2019 retailed at $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Sail Ironstone
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Sail Ironstone features a mix of four different hues: sail, ironstone, white, and rattan. This Nike Air Max 1 sneaker in Sail Ironstone features a white mesh base with off-white suede equivalents. Nike's Swoosh insignia appears in brown over the sides of this shoe. The small Swoosh emblem on the lateral toes is also presented in brown. It also boasts cream-colored Air midsole units and a white lacing system that complements its appearance. The Nike Air Max 1 Sail Ironstone was made available on November 24th, 2022, with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Maxfly 2 White Bright Spruce Barely Green Black
Description: The Nike Maxfly 2 in White Bright Spruce Barely Green Black is a cutting-edge running shoe designed for elite performance. This sleek and stylish sneaker features a pristine white base accented with vibrant pops of bright spruce, barely green, and black, creating a visually striking aesthetic. The Maxfly 2 incorporates Nike's latest innovations in running technology, offering a perfect balance of speed, comfort, and durability for athletes and casual wearers alike. Engineered with a lightweight and breathable upper, the Maxfly 2 ensures optimal airflow and support during intense workouts or competitions. The responsive midsole provides exceptional energy return with each stride, while the strategically placed outsole offers superior traction on various surfaces. Whether you're training for a marathon or simply looking for a high-performance everyday sneaker, the Nike Maxfly 2 delivers unparalleled comfort and style. Our team of experts believes this shoe is ideal for runners seeking a versatile, high-performance option that can handle both speed work and long-distance training.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Black Speed Yellow
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Black Speed Yellow brings a bold and striking update to the classic silhouette. This men's sneaker features a sleek black base, accentuated by vibrant speed yellow accents that create a dynamic contrast. The iconic Air Max cushioning system provides superior comfort and support, while the durable rubber outsole ensures excellent traction on various surfaces. The upper combines premium materials, including leather and mesh, for a perfect balance of style and breathability. Designed with both performance and aesthetics in mind, this Air Max 90 iteration showcases Nike's commitment to innovation and timeless design. The shoe's distinctive waffle outsole pattern pays homage to its heritage, while modern updates enhance its overall performance. The visible Air unit in the heel not only offers responsive cushioning but also adds a visual element that has become synonymous with the Air Max line. Us at StockX believe this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that seamlessly blends retro charm with contemporary flair, perfect for both casual wear and athletic pursuits.

Model: Rick Owens DRKSHDW Jumbolace Low Sneaks
Display Name: Rick Owens DRKSHDW Jumbolace Low Sneaks Black Milk
Description: The Rick Owens DRKSHDW Jumbolace Low Sneaks Black Milk elevate minimalist sneakers through exaggerated detail and bold contrast. Black shapes the upper with sleek intensity, while Milk accents define the oversized lacing and sole. The elongated lace design adds signature DRKSHDW drama, transforming a low top silhouette into a sculptural statement. Its clean color pairing keeps the look refined despite the amplified proportions. Fans of Rick Owens appreciate how unconventional details redefine everyday footwear. The black and milk combination enhances contrast while preserving versatility. It blends avant garde design with wearable structure seamlessly. Distinct and commanding, this pair stands as a modern luxury staple with unmistakable edge. The Rick Owens DRKSHDW Jumbolace Low Sneaks Black Milk was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $715.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Olive Sail
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Olive Sail leans into outdoor inspired tones to give the Jordan 1 Low a rugged yet refined personality. Medium olive dominates the upper with a grounded feel, while sail accents soften the look and keep it versatile. The SE treatment adds subtle texture and depth, making the shoe feel more tactile and purpose driven without straying from the silhouettes roots. Collectors are drawn to this release because it blends heritage and utility seamlessly. The Jordan 1 Lows classic shape anchors the design, while the olive and sail palette adds a sense of exploration and adaptability. Fans appreciate how this colorway feels ready for real world wear, reinforcing the idea that the Jordan 1 continues to evolve through thoughtful material and color choices rather than dramatic reinvention. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Medium Olive Sail was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Black White
Description: The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Black White applies the signature AJ 1 Low design to a football cleat. What makes this cleat stand out is the all-black base, outsole, and liner that contrast the striking white Swoosh. The Swoosh and the Jumpman logo on the tongue are the only elements that break from the black-on-black aesthetic. The outsole features studs that provide a gripping effect, while the lace-up front holds the foot in place. The sneaker features a leather upper with complementing leather overlays. The vamp comes with perforations that allow the foot to breathe, while the reinforced stitching adds durability. What do our StockX experts love? The sneaker boasts a swoosh on one of the studs beneath the forefoot. This subtle detail speaks to the cleats overall sleek, understated appearance. The Jordan 1 Low TD Cleat Black White was released on June 1, 2023, and retailed at $140.

Display Name: adidas Gazelle Core Black Cloud White Gold
Description: The adidas Gazelle Core Black Cloud White Gold is a soccer shoe turned streetwear staple. The Gazelle line was first released in 1991, and this newer version honors the first version with its classic, low-profile design. This iteration of the adidas Gazelle is constructed with a black nubuck upper. White synthetic overlays form the iconic 3-Stripes logo on the shoes midsole. Gazelle branding appears in gold lining one of the 3-Stripes. The Trefoil logo is also present in black on the white tongue and on the white heel tab. The OrthoLite sock liner provides extra comfort. A wide, white rubber outsole completes the classic design. What we appreciate most about this sneaker is the nubuck upper. This material makes the shoe soft and flexible for added comfort. The adidas Gazelle Core Black Cloud White Gold was first released on May 1st, 2018, for a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low SE Splash Volt
Description: The Nike Dunk Low SE Splash Volt is a special edition colorway of the Nike Dunk Low sneaker catalogue. The Splash Volt Nike Dunk Low SE features an upper that is made from leather and suede. The sneaker includes a padded collar and tongue to provide a comfortable fit for all-day wear, while the lace-up closure ensures that the shoe stays securely in place. We think that one of the key features of the Nike Dunk Low SE Splash Volt is its vibrant luminous upper. The unique upper is made of synthetic leather that has been treated with a special reflective material, making it glow in the dark. The shoe features a Volt colorway with a mix of Green Strike, black, and Total Orange hues. This gives the shoe a unique and eye-catching appearance that is perfect for those who love to make a statement with their footwear. The Nike Dunk Low SE Splash Volt was released on June 14th, 2023 at a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 SP Patta Waves Cyber
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 SP Patta Waves Cyber blends the legendary Air Max 90 DNA with Pattas signature flowing "Waves" motif for a striking take on a streetwear icon. A refined palette of Particle Grey and Neutral Grey sets the stage for vivid Cyber accents, while Coconut Milk touches bring a subtly vintage warmth. The sculpted, wavy mudguard reinterprets the shoes classic lines, contrasted by familiar TPU eyelets, a crisp Swoosh, and layered overlays that add depth from every angle. Underfoot, visible Air cushioning delivers the smooth, responsive ride the model is known for, paired with a grippy waffle outsole to handle daily mileage with ease. Built for style that lasts, the mixed-material upper balances breathability and structure, making it a versatile pick for city commutes, weekend fits, and on-foot rotation shots alike. The HF8814-001 style code marks this standout colorway, with Grey laces included so you can keep the aesthetic clean and cohesive. Thoughtful details, subtle branding hits, carefully placed paneling, and the modern-meets-retro color story, give the Patta Waves Cyber a distinctive look that elevates everything from minimalist streetwear to bold, layered fits. Whether youre a collector or simply want a statement Air Max 90, this collaborative design turns heads without sacrificing comfort. Our team loves this product because it merges timeless Air cushioning with Pattas wave-inspired design language, making it great for daily wear, photos, and standout rotation builds.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Shipyard
