Description: The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Shipyard continues the raw, layered design language that made the Protection Pack stand out, this time leaning into a cooler, industrial inspired palette. Shipyard and silver metallic tones give the shoe a slightly reflective, almost mechanical feel, while the uneven suede overlays maintain that worn in, deconstructed edge. The balance between structure and imperfection is what defines the look. Collectors appreciate this pair for how it expands the Protection Pack concept without losing its identity. The colorway introduces a different kind of energy, one that feels more urban and metallic compared to earth toned releases. It still carries the same comfort and versatility that made the 2002R a favorite, but with a finish that feels fresh and slightly more experimental. The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack Shipyard was released on November 3, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 Sapphire Light Liquid Lime
Description: The Nike Shox R4 Sapphire Light Liquid Lime is one of the most electrically charged color combinations in the current Shox revival, pairing a deep rich Sapphire blue across the synthetic and textile upper with Light Liquid Lime on the Shox columns underfoot in a contrast that feels like it was pulled from the early 2000s Y2K color theory that made this silhouette a cultural icon in the first place. Sapphire saturates the upper panels, laser perforations adding a breathable texture that breaks up the color and gives the surface visual depth, while Pencil Point and Black work through the detailing and outsole to ground the palette and prevent it from tipping into overwhelming territory. The Light Liquid Lime columns then activate the whole look from below, an electric green that reads especially sharp against the deep blue upper when seen from behind during movement. The Shox R4's mechanical design, built around flexible polyurethane columns and moderator plates in the heel that compress on impact and rebound with genuine energy return, was years ahead of its time as a performance concept and eventually became the template for an entire generation of cushioning philosophy. The modified circular Waffle outsole provides the traction foundation underneath the columns, keeping the shoe grounded on any surface while the Shox system does its work. The current recrafted version of the 2001 original stays faithful to the upper construction and design lines that made it a streetwear staple, and the Sapphire and Light Liquid Lime palette captures the same unapologetic color confidence that made early Shox colorways so memorable across the grime scene in the UK and basketball courts globally. The Nike Shox R4 Sapphire Light Liquid Lime was released on December 20, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Cave Stone
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Cave Stone takes a monochromatic approach, using cave stone tones across the entire upper to create a unified and minimal look. The lack of contrast shifts the focus to shape and material, allowing the silhouette to stand on its own without distraction. This version resonates with fans who appreciate simplicity and tone over bold color blocking. The Dunk Low has always been a strong base for experimentation, and this pair shows how restraint can be just as impactful as contrast. It feels clean, modern, and easy to integrate into any rotation. The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Cave Stone was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Sail College Grey Rattan
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Sail College Grey Rattan brings an earthy and balanced palette to one of Jordan Brands most versatile silhouettes, leaning into natural tones that feel calm and intentional. The sail base softens the Jordan 1 Lows familiar lines, while college grey and rattan inspired accents add depth and texture that feel understated rather than flashy. Its a colorway that feels designed for everyday wear, rooted in heritage but tuned for modern lifestyle rotation. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it highlights the Jordan 1 Low at its most wearable. The muted color story lets the silhouettes proportions and history shine without distraction, making it easy to pair with a wide range of looks. Fans appreciate how this release feels timeless and grounded, a sneaker that doesnt chase trends but instead reinforces why subtle, well executed Jordan colorways tend to age the best and stay relevant year after year. The Air Jordan 1 Low Sail College Grey Rattan was released on June 20, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog South Park The Boys
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog South Park The Boys brings together animated chaos and bold humor through a collaboration that feels loud and playful. The blue, green, and multi color design reflects the personalities of the characters, creating a clog that feels packed with references and visual energy. It stands out immediately as something different. What makes this pair hit is the cultural crossover. South Parks identity translates well into Crocs expressive format, creating a product that feels fun and slightly chaotic in the best way. It is a piece that appeals to fans who appreciate humor driven design. The Crocs Classic Clog South Park The Boys was released on September 26, 2025 with a retail price of $80.

Display Name: Nike Vaporposite Pro Pearl
Description: The Nike Vaporposite Pro Pearl delivers a refined and futuristic take on Nike Basketball innovation, blending Foamposite heritage with modern performance intent. The pearl inspired upper gives the shoe a smooth and almost liquid appearance, while contrasting red and black accents add sharpness and edge. It feels sculptural and powerful, designed to stand out through form and finish rather than loud branding or excess detail. Fans love this release because it represents evolution without abandoning identity. The Vaporposite Pro carries forward the bold attitude that made Foamposite models iconic, while updating the silhouette for a new era of play. Collectors appreciate how the pearl finish elevates the design, turning a performance driven shoe into something visually striking and culturally relevant. It feels like a statement sneaker that balances innovation, legacy, and on court authority in a way few Nike Basketball models can. The Nike Vaporposite Pro Pearl was released on November 27, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: New Balance 991 MiUK Kith Vetiver
Description: The New Balance 991 MiUK Kith Vetiver brings together heritage craftsmanship and modern collaboration through a colorway that feels refined and grounded. The vetiver tones create a muted and earthy palette, while the Made in UK construction highlights premium materials and attention to detail. The silhouette remains true to the 991s classic structure, offering a balance of performance roots and lifestyle appeal. Fans of Kith and New Balance appreciate how this collaboration leans into subtlety rather than loud contrast, allowing the quality and color to define the design. The 991 continues to hold a strong place within the brands lineup, and this version adds another layer of collectibility through its partnership. It is a sneaker that blends craftsmanship and culture in a clean and intentional way. The New Balance 991 MiUK Kith Vetiver was released on March 16, 2026 with a retail price of $260.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 97 Black White Anthracite
Description: Featuring Max Air cushioning and a durable design, the Nike Air Max 97 Black White Anthricite brings a 90s favorite to a new generation. The Nike Air Max 97 Black White Anthricite takes on a blend of materials, including reflective piping, water ripple lines, and full-length Max Air cushioning. The synthetic upper is lightweight yet durable, and its served up with welded overlays and a rubber outsole for traction. For the season, the Nike Air Max 97 Black White Anthricite takes on a black and white look, with the Swoosh done in white. The Nike Air Max 97 Black White Anthricite was released in October 2019 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid White Metallic Gold Obsidian
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid White Metallic Gold Obsidian is a recolored version of the OG Air Jordan 1. Like the OG Air Jordan 1, this shoe boasts a leather upper, a cushioned midsole, and a roughened rubber outsole. Its upper leather features a white base contrasted by obsidian overlays, a perforated toebox, a grayish nylon tongue, white laces, obsidian swooshes, a white Air Jordan Wings logo on its neck collar, and a metallic gold Jumpman logo on its tongue tag. The Air Jordan 1 Mid White Metallic Gold Obsidian was first released on 1st August 2019. At the time, its retail price was $110.

Display Name: Nike Free RN 2018 Wolf Grey
Description: The Nike Free RN 2018 Wolf Gray is a running shoe that comes in a Wolf Gray colorway with White accents. The upper of this Free RN 2018 sneaker features a lightweight, breathable material that allows air to circulate freely. The shoe includes Flywire cables integrated into the laces to provide a customizable fit that adapts to your foot's shape and movement for a secure and comfortable feel. The Nike Swoosh is visible on both sides while the Nike Free RN branding is seen on the tongue and heel. Our experts say that the standout feature of the Nike Free RN 2018 Wolf Gray is its updated Nike Free sole, which employs a tri-star outsole pattern to allow the foot to move more naturally. This unique pattern enhances flexibility and stability while reducing the overall weight of the shoe, making it easier and more comfortable to wear for extended periods of time. The shoe was released on February 17th, 2018, at a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike GT Cut Cross Barely Grape
Description: Built for stop-and-go playmakers, the Nike GT Cut Cross Barely Grape combines sleek court style with agile performance. The layered mesh upper keeps things light and breathable, while targeted overlays add structure through sharp cuts and quick changes of direction. A plush collar and padded tongue enhance comfort from warm?ups to the final buzzer, and the secure lacing system helps lock down the midfoot without pressure points. Finished in a clean White base with Barely Grape and Pink Foam accents, this colorway pops with subtle contrast, balanced by Light Smoke Grey details for a refined, modern look. Style codes HF0218-100 / HF0231-100 and the 2024-06-01 release mark it as a standout in the Nike Basketball lineup. Designed for responsiveness, the GT Cut Cross sits low to the ground to keep you connected to the hardwood. A resilient foam midsole cushions hard landings and fuels quick takeoffs, while a stabilizing heel frame adds confidence when you plant and explode. Underfoot, a grippy, multi-directional traction pattern helps you stay glued during crossovers, step-backs, and transition defense. Subtle Swoosh placements and crisp paneling highlight the shoes fast silhouette, making it just as strong for everyday wear as it is for competitive runs. If youre seeking a versatile mens basketball sneaker that blends speed, support, and standout color, the Nike GT Cut Cross Barely Grape delivers. Our team thinks this product is great for players who thrive on quick cuts and lockdown control, and our team loves this product because it offers a lightweight build, secure fit, and court-ready traction in a polished Barely Grape palette.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Dark Marina Blue
Description: The Air Jordan 1 High Dark Marina Blue arrives with a smooth black leather upper with Dark Marina Blue overlays and Swooshes. On the ankle wrap, a black Jordan Wings logo pays homage to the origins of the Air Jordan 1. From there, a contrasting white and blue Air sole completes the design. The Air Jordan 1 High Dark Marina Blue releases in February of 2022 and retails for $170.

Display Name: Nike Shox TL Black University Red
Description: The Nike Shox TL Black University Red brings a bold and dynamic look to the iconic Shox line. This men's sneaker features a sleek black upper complemented by striking University Red accents, creating a visually appealing contrast. The shoe's design is further enhanced by Metallic Silver details, adding a touch of sophistication to its athletic aesthetic. The Shox TL model is known for its distinctive cushioning system, which provides responsive support and energy return with every step. Built for both style and performance, this Nike Shox TL combines cutting-edge technology with street-ready design. The shoe's upper is crafted with durable materials, ensuring long-lasting wear and breathability. The signature Shox columns in the heel not only offer unique visual appeal but also deliver exceptional shock absorption and comfort. With its eye-catching colorway and innovative features, the Nike Shox TL Black University Red is perfect for those seeking a standout sneaker that doesn't compromise on performance. Our experts state this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts looking for a bold, comfortable shoe that seamlessly blends retro charm with modern technology.

Model: Nike Air Max Plus Golf NRG
Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Golf NRG Eastside Golf
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Golf NRG Eastside Golf merges performance heritage with cultural pride through bold color and refined detail. Deep royal blue and blue void dominate the upper, creating a rich and confident base, while comet blue and aluminum add dimension and movement. Metallic gold accents elevate the design, giving it a celebratory feel that aligns with Eastside Golfs mission and identity. This release matters because it expands what golf footwear can represent. Fans of Eastside Golf appreciate how the collaboration brings inclusivity and style into a traditionally conservative space. Collectors see it as a statement that blends sport, culture, and fashion without compromise. The Air Max Plus silhouette carries that message with confidence, making this pair feel purposeful, expressive, and rooted in something bigger than aesthetics alone. The Nike Air Max Plus Golf NRG Eastside Golf was released on October 2, 2025 with a retail price of $205.
Colorway: Deep Royal Blue/Blue Void/Comet Blue/Aluminum/Metallic Gold

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Birch Pure Silver Teal Gold
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Birch Pure Silver Teal Gold delivers refined balance through subtle color and trusted form. Birch tones soften the upper, creating a warm and neutral base that feels calm and wearable. Pure silver overlays emphasize the technical structure, while teal and gold accents add restrained flashes of color that elevate the design without overpowering it. This colorway connects with fans because it highlights the Gel Kayano 14s proportions and detail rather than relying on bold contrast. Collectors appreciate how the silhouette continues to thrive as a lifestyle staple rooted in performance credibility. The mix of neutral and accent tones makes it easy to integrate into rotation, reinforcing why the Kayano 14 remains one of ASICS most respected and enduring designs in modern sneaker culture. The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Birch Pure Silver Teal Gold was released on June 6, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Court Purple
Description: Step onto the court with confidence in the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Court Purple, a sneaker that combines elegance with performance. Inspired by Kobe Bryant's unparalleled legacy, this model features a White/Court Purple/White colorway that exudes sophistication. Paying homage to the basketball giant and his daughter, the numbers 8, 24, and 2 are thoughtfully incorporated throughout the upper, making each pair a symbol of excellence and remembrance. The Nike Kobe 8 Protro Court Purple is designed for those who demand the best in both function and fashion. Its advanced technology ensures peak performance during play, while the striking Court Purple highlights showcase a sense of style that is both bold and refined. This sneaker reflects the spirit of innovation and dedication that Kobe brought to every game, tailored for a generation that values legacy and looks. Released on February 8, 2024, and priced at $190, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Court Purple presents a new colorway that captures the heart of sneaker fans and basketball players alike. It's not just a shoe; it's a tribute to a legend and his impact on the game, making it an essential piece for those who celebrate greatness on and off the court.

Display Name: New Balance 1906L Metallic Silver
Description: The New Balance 1906L Metallic Silver reimagines the 1906 as a slip-on loafer. This hybrid sneaker showcases a futuristic color palette of metallic silver and grey. Seamlessly blending New Balances technical specs with the design requirements of a loafer, the Metallic Silver New Balance 1906L is lace-free. With N-ergy cushioning underfoot for shock absorption, the sneaker offers long-lasting comfort. The upper is crafted from a loose weave mesh that ensures durability, while the metallic silver accents draw attention to the supportive overlays. Although the sneaker doesnt need laces, a traditional loafer apron crosses the tongue. It features a silver metallic sheen that matches the collar. While many loafers include a tassel hanging over the vamp, this version doesnt include a tassel. Our experts appreciate this exclusion because it maintains the sneakers sporty aesthetic. The New Balance 1906L Metallic Silver was released on September 19, 2024, and sold for $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Light Madder Root (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Light Madder Root Womens brings warmth and sophistication to one of Jordan Brands most iconic silhouettes. The light madder root tones paired with sail accents give the high cut Jordan 1 a refined and earthy feel that feels both bold and elegant. Designed specifically with women in mind, the color story feels intentional and expressive while staying true to the classic shape that made the Jordan 1 legendary. Fans love this release because it shows how powerful color can be when applied thoughtfully. The high cut profile gives the shoe presence, while the softer palette adds balance and approachability. Collectors appreciate it as a statement Jordan that still feels wearable, celebrating individuality and modern style without abandoning basketball heritage. It is the kind of release that feels special the moment you see it and meaningful the longer you wear it. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Light Madder Root Womens was released on September 9, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-NYC Mineral Beige
Description: The ASICS Gel NYC Mineral Beige embraces a tonal approach that highlights the silhouettes layered construction without relying on contrast. The Mineral Beige upper carries a uniform look that feels clean and cohesive, allowing the different textures and panels to create subtle variation. It reflects a more minimal direction while still maintaining the technical feel that defines the Gel NYC line. Collectors appreciate tonal colorways like this because they emphasize form and material over bold design choices. The result is a pair that feels easy to style while still offering depth through its construction. ASICS continues to refine this balance between performance heritage and lifestyle appeal, and this release stands as a strong example of how restraint can still deliver impact. The ASICS Gel NYC Mineral Beige was released on January 10, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro Low Golf Chicago
Description: Similar to the Jordan 1 High Chicago Gold Cleat that was released in 2017, the Jordan 1 Low Golf Chicago gears the iconic colorway for the golf course. It features a smooth white leather upper with red overlays and black Swooshes. A black debossed Wings logo at the heel pays tribute to the first Air Jordan logo ever created. At the base, a red grooved outsole adds traction and support for long days on the green. The Jordan 1 Low Golf Chicago releases in 2022 and retails for $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite One Black Volt
Description: The Nike Air Foamposite One Black Volt presents in an electric volt and black colorway of the iconic Nike Air Foamposite silhouette associated with former pro basketball player Penny Hardaway. Sporting primarily a stealthy black design, the liquid-like Foamposite shell and breathable mesh elements have green volt accents in just the right spots to give this sneaker energy. Youll spot the iconic "1 Cent" logo embroidered on the heel, a small embroidered Swoosh on the eyestay, and a jewel logo on the tongue, all in the neon green. Heel and tongue tabs help with getting into these glove-like fitting sneakers. As for sneaker tech, theres full-length Air cushioning and a black carbon fiber shank plate for stability. What our experts love about this shoe that the seamless composite upper sits atop the semi-translucent volt toned outsole, complete with herringbone tread. The Nike Air Foamposite One Black Volt was released on March 14, 2025, with a $240 retail price.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Bruce Lee
Description: Known as one of the most coveted Kobe colorways of all time, the Kobe V Bruce Lee made a come back in 2020. The Kobe V Bruce Lee originally debuted in 2010, the year that Kobe won his final championship. This week, Nike is adding this iconic colorway to its Protro series, a Kobe line that meshes retro silhouettes with modified cushioning and construction. The Kobe V Protro Bruce Lee is inspired by two classic Bruce Lee films, Game of Death and Enter the Dragon. Black and Yellow paneling on the upper pays homage to the one-piece jumpsuit that Lee wore in Game of Death (famously duplicated in Kill Bill), while the red scratch marks on the lateral side pay tribute to the final fight sequence from Enter The Dragon. The Kobe V Bruce Lee Protro released in November of 2020 for $180.

Display Name: Nike Metcon 9 Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike Metcon 9 Black Anthracite is a training shoe in a stealth black colorway that is an upgraded version of the Nike Metcon 8. The Metcon 9 is Nikes mainline training silhouette designed for weight training, gym workouts, and cross-training. This iteration is dressed in a sleek black, smoke grey, anthracite, and white color combination. The upper is made out of breathable mesh and is expandable in the toe area. As for sneaker tech, there is a large Hyperlift plate which provides support during weight lifting exercises. A ribbed rubber wrap helps with rope climbing activities thanks to its position around the midfoot. Nike Swooshes appear on the side panels. StockX experts think that the lace lock on this Nike Metcon 9 Black Anthracite sneaker is a unique design element. Once youve laced up, the tab locks your laces in tight because Nike knows you need to focus on your workout. Released on August 3, 2023, this training shoe retailed for $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble England
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble England channels national identity through a colorway inspired by Englands signature tones. White forms the base, while speed red and obsidian accents add contrast that ties back to the theme. Metallic silver detailing enhances the layered construction, giving the design a slightly elevated feel while maintaining the Air Max 95s structure. What makes this pair stand out is its connection to place and identity. The color palette feels intentional, creating a sneaker that reflects national pride without relying on heavy graphics. The Big Bubble update adds a modern element that complements the classic design. It is a strong example of how Nike continues to use the Air Max platform for themed storytelling. The Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble England was released on March 23, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Under Armour Curry Flow 12 Pisces
Description: Celebrating Stephen Currys zodiac sign, the Under Armour Curry Flow 12 Pisces is a flagship performance basketball shoe built for the worlds greatest shooter. The design features a sleek Stream/White palette, utilizing an upgraded UA Flow cushioning system that eliminates the need for a rubber outsole, resulting in a significantly lighter and more responsive feel. Released on March 14, 2025, for $140, it features a multi-directional traction pattern that offers "stop-on-a-dime" grip. Our experts commend the breathable knit upper and the specialized heel counter, which provide the elite lockdown needed for shifty, off-ball movement. Its a technically superior performance tool that successfully combines Currys fluid playstyle with a clean, watery aesthetic that honors his personal history.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 270 White Black University Red
Description: Look no further because Nike has finally brought sugar, spice, and everything nice to a classic shoe with the Air Max 270 White Black University Red. This Air Max comes with an all-white upper, black Nike "Swoosh", white midsole, red Air Max bubble, and a black sole. These sneakers released in November 2018 and retailed for $150. Add some kick to your sneaker rotation and cop these on StockX.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Closing Ceremony
Description: The Air Jordan 11 is one of the most iconic sneakers of all time. The patent leather upper and translucent outsole, combined with the fact that Michael Jordan led the league in scoring with over 30 points per game, won the regular season Most Valuable Player Award, won the NBA Championship and the NBA Finals MVP while wearing the Air Jordan 11. Looking back, the Air Jordan 11 was destined for greatness both in Tinker Hatfield's design and in MJ's accolades. For 2016's Summer Olympics in Rio de Janeiro, Jordan Brand recreated the Jordan 11 in a low-top version for the closing ceremonies, celebrating the gold medal accomplishments of Team USA. The Jordan 11 Closing Ceremony releases August 27th, 2016.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 97 Triple Black
Description: Crafted from recycled materials, the Nike Air Max 97 Triple Black is covered in a black mesh and leather combination for a monochromatic look. The Nike Air Max 97 Triple Black is back, this time crafted from a combination of mesh and leather on a water rippleinspired silhouette. Everything on the shoe gets the black-on-black treatment, including the laces, tongue, and Swoosh. 3M Scotchlite strips supply reflective flair to the monochromatic upper. A multi-window Nike Air midsole and scuff-resistant outsole round off the design. The Nike Air Max 97 Triple Black was released in December of 2018 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High Black Metallic Gold (2020)
Description: Jordan Brand is no stranger to patent leather. Since the Air Jordan 11 debuted the material for the brand back in 1996, its found its way onto various models such as the Jordan 1, Jordan 4, and Jordan 7. 2020 marks the third issue of the patent-clad Air Jordan 1 Black Metallic Gold, with the first releasing back in 2001, and again in 2013. The Air Jordan 1 Black Metallic Golds 2020 retro delivers slight cosmetic changes from its 2013 predecessor. The upper black and metallic gold patent leather upper. From there, a full translucent black sole with gold speckles completes the Jordan 1 classic. The Air Jordan 1 Black Metallic Gold released in November of 2020 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Dn8 Black Volt
Description: The Nike Air Max DN8 Black Volt features an upper layer lightweight black mesh with gradient Light Smoke Gray accents, creating a dynamic aesthetic. The Neon Volt Swoosh and matching visible pods in the Air midsole adds a striking contrast. The full-length Dynamic Air system in the midsole is engineered with eight dual-chambered tubes that dynamically shift pressure from heel to toe for a springy step. The black low rubber outsole, heel guard, and toecap overlay add texture to the sneaker. Soft circular patterns decorate the upper in a matte black and shimmering gray gradient. The colorway of the womens Nike Air Max DN8 creates a minimalist look of predominately blacks with bursts of green. What we love most about the Nike Air Max DN8 Black Volt is the combination of the innovative Air technology combined with the sleek modern silhouette. Released on March 6th, 2025, the sneaker retailed for $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Light Smoke Grey Hyper Crimson Limelight
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Light Smoke Grey Hyper Crimson Limelight builds on a neutral base but injects bursts of color that shift the entire mood of the shoe. Light smoke grey keeps the upper grounded, while hyper crimson and limelight accents introduce sharp contrast that feels vibrant and modern. The combination creates a layered look that feels active and expressive. This version stands out because it balances restraint with energy. The base keeps it wearable, while the color hits give it a sense of movement and personality. Fans appreciate how the Air Max 90 continues to adapt through color alone, proving that even small changes can completely transform the feel of a classic model. The Nike Air Max 90 Light Smoke Grey Hyper Crimson Limelight was released on September 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Book 2 Must Be The Denim
Description: The Nike Book 2 Must Be The Denim introduces a more lifestyle driven concept into Devin Bookers signature line, using denim inspired textures and tones to shape the overall design. The multi color palette blends blues with sail and Game Royal accents, creating a layered look that feels casual but intentional. It shifts the silhouette away from pure performance and into a more expressive space. Fans are drawn to this release because it reflects Bookers off court style as much as his game. The denim theme adds personality without overcomplicating the structure, making it stand out within the signature lineup. It is a pair that blends storytelling with wearability, appealing to collectors who appreciate a more personal approach to basketball footwear. The Nike Book 2 Must Be The Denim was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Raptor
Description: The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Raptor merges Ja Morants explosive signature line with one of cinemas most recognizable franchises. Dressed in anthracite with bright crimson and yellow ochre accents, the sneaker channels the aggressive color palette associated with the Raptors from Jurassic Park. The darker base allows the vibrant red and yellow hits to stand out, creating a design that feels both dynamic and cinematic. This collaboration taps into the long-standing relationship between sneakers and pop culture storytelling. Jurassic Park has influenced design across multiple industries, and here its reinterpreted through the lens of basketball footwear. The Ja 3s sharp lines and modern silhouette provide the perfect canvas for this theme, with color blocking that mirrors the intensity and unpredictability of both the Raptors and Ja Morants style of play. When the Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Raptor released, it retailed for $135 and dropped on April 10, 2026. With its anthracite, bright crimson, and yellow ochre colorway and crossover appeal, this release stands out as a bold fusion of basketball culture and film-inspired design.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Premium Cordura Filbert Desert Khaki
Description: The Nike P 6000 Premium Cordura Filbert Desert Khaki brings durability and retro running design together through a layered upper built with Cordura materials. The filbert and desert khaki tones create a cohesive and earthy palette, while light khaki and cargo khaki accents add depth across the panels. The silhouette keeps that early 2000s running aesthetic intact. This pair stands out because it combines rugged material with a familiar design. Cordura adds a functional edge, making the shoe feel more durable while still maintaining comfort. It is a strong option for those who appreciate retro runners with added practicality. The Nike P 6000 Premium Cordura Filbert Desert Khaki was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Black Pure Silver (PS)
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Black Pure Silver PS in Black Pure Silver is the preschool sizing of the Gel-1130 retro running sneaker, paying homage to the ninth iteration of the GEL-1000 series with a design rooted in the late 2000s stability running shoe ASICS originally offered in 2008, adapted for children's sizing with a synthetic leather and breathable mesh upper construction that captures the technical aesthetic of the original while delivering the GEL technology cushioning, TRUSSTIC support system, and rubber outsole that keep the shoe comfortable and supportive for a young child's everyday active wear needs. The Black Pure Silver colorway applies the most classically versatile color combination for a kids' sneaker across the PS version, pairing the dark black base leather and synthetic panels with Pure Silver accents across the overlays and branding elements in a high-contrast execution that gives the small-sized shoe a sharp, adult-style aesthetic in children's sizing. The Gel-1130's design draws on the GEL-KAYANO 14 trainer's aesthetics as inspiration, with synthetic leather overlays and breathable mesh underlays reproducing the heritage upper design language of the 2008 original while incorporating modern sustainability improvements including an upper main material composed of more than 20% recycled materials and a dope-dyed sockliner that reduces water usage by approximately 33% and carbon emissions by approximately 45% compared to conventional dyeing processes. The GEL technology positioned in the heel provides the shock absorption that defines the Gel-1130's comfort system, softening each step and reducing impact forces during the kind of playground running, jumping, and activity that characterizes a preschool child's daily movement. The TRUSSTIC support system preserves the midfoot stability architecture from the original late 2000s shoe, maintaining the pronation control and structural support that made the GEL-1000 series a trusted stability running platform across generations of ASICS runners. At $70 retail the Black Pure Silver PS sits at the standard preschool tier for ASICS Gel-1130 kids' sizing, released June 1, 2025 through ASICS and select retailers as part of the broader Gel-1130 multi-format family launch that includes grade school, women's, and men's versions of the same shoe across coordinating colorways. The ASICS Gel-1130 Black Pure Silver PS was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $70.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Pizza (GS)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Pizza (GS) serves up a playful slice of heritage with a color recipe inspired by everyones favorite pie. Fire Red, Sesame, White, and Starfish tones layer across the iconic Air Jordan 4 framework, nodding to sauce, crust, and melted goodness while staying clean and wearable for every day. Classic design cues, grid mesh panels, sculpted heel tab, and midfoot wings, bring the legendary Tinker-era look to life, while the grade school fit keeps proportions sharp for younger sneaker fans. Style ID IH2094-200 anchors the pairs collectability, and the bold palette adds instant energy to jeans, joggers, and uniforms alike. Comfort and durability come standard. A visible Air unit cushions landings on the court or the playground, the padded collar hugs the ankle for secure support, and a sturdy midsole pairs with a grippy herringbone outsole for confident traction. Thoughtful materials and breathable details help feet stay comfortable from homeroom to weekend hangouts, and the structured upper keeps its shape wear after wear. Whether theyre discovering the Air Jordan 4 for the first time or adding a fresh colorway to their rotation, this GS Pizza edition balances sport DNA with kid-friendly flair. Our team loves this product because it blends fun, food-inspired color storytelling with dependable cushioning, lasting build quality, and the timeless style kids and parents both appreciate.

Display Name: Jordan 40 Bordeaux
Description: The Air Jordan 40 Bordeaux arrives with rich tonal depth, dressing the modern silhouette in layered shades of Bordeaux and Burgundy Crush. University Red accents provide subtle contrast, keeping the color story cohesive while still injecting classic Jordan energy. The streamlined build and sculpted sole reflect how far the signature line has progressed since its early beginnings. Bordeaux tones have long held a special place in Jordan history, most notably through iconic retros that helped define entire eras. Bringing that color family onto the Jordan 40 connects the newest generation to those memorable releases. It feels refined, slightly luxurious, and confident without being loud, making it a standout for fans who appreciate when heritage shades return in contemporary form. The Air Jordan 40 Bordeaux was released on December 1, 2025 with a retail price of $205.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Reverse Panda
Description: The Jordan 1 Mid Reverse Panda is a mid-top basketball sneaker featuring a colorway that resembles a panda bear. This version of the Jordan 1 Mid features an upper made of white leather. It is perforated at the toebox to allow extra air flow. White leather overlays can be seen around the toebox, heel, and up under the laces. There is also a white leather ankle strap. The Nike Swoosh appears in black on both midsoles, while the heel is rounded out in black, too. A black Air Jordan logo can also be found on the ankle strap on the lateral side. A black and white rubber outsole provides grip and traction both on and off the court. What we like best about this shoe is the clean black and white colorway, which gives it a sleek look. The Jordan 1 Mid Reverse Panda was released on December 12, 2023, for a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low UNC (Women's)
Description: The women's Jordan 1 Low UNC (W) features a white and blue leather upper with standard white acting as the base of the silhouette and wrapped up in the pale tones of the University Blue overlays. From there, blue on the "Jumpman" logo tongue, laces, and Nike "Swoosh" and a University Blue outsole complete the design. The women's Jordan 1 Low UNC (W) released in February of 2020 and retailed for $90.

Model: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi
Display Name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Single Heart Milk
Description: The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Single Heart Milk delivers one of the most recognizable collaborations in modern footwear, pairing the Chuck 70 silhouette with the signature PLAY heart logo. The milk colored upper keeps the look soft and clean, while the red heart adds a bold focal point that stands out immediately. What makes this pair so popular is its simplicity and consistency. The collaboration has remained relevant for years because it does not overcomplicate the design, letting the logo and silhouette do the work. It is a staple that continues to resonate with both casual wearers and collectors. The Converse Chuck Taylor All Star 70 Hi Comme des Garcons PLAY Single Heart Milk was released on July 11, 2024 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 WB Triple Black Nubuck
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 WB Triple Black Nubuck embraces a stealth driven aesthetic with an all black finish that amplifies the silhouettes strong lines. Wrapped entirely in black nubuck, the upper feels textured and durable while maintaining the clean structure of the original design. The low cut profile and solid sole unit remain unchanged, allowing the tonal approach to focus attention on form and material. Collectors often rely on triple black pairs for their effortless versatility and sharp presence. This edition adds depth through nubuck construction, giving the classic model a slightly rugged edge. It moves seamlessly between streetwear and everyday styling, offering understated impact without unnecessary detail. The result is a confident and dependable interpretation of a cultural staple. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 WB Triple Black Nubuck was released on October 19, 2025 with a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Olive Grey
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Olive Grey introduces an earthy palette to the timeless low top through a mix of Black and Olive Grey. Subtle Light Wild Mango accents bring unexpected brightness, adding depth to the otherwise muted foundation. The clean paneling and streamlined build maintain the unmistakable AJ1 identity that has defined sneaker culture for decades. This colorway stands out because it balances restraint with subtle energy. The olive and black pairing feels grounded and versatile, while the mango detailing adds a modern twist that keeps the look from feeling flat. Fans gravitate toward versions like this for their everyday adaptability and layered contrast. It is a thoughtful reinterpretation that refreshes the silhouette without straying from its iconic roots. The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Olive Grey was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Triple Black
Description: Released ahead of Halloween, the Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Triple Black paints the familiar silhouette in a spooky monochromatic colorway. Although the Halloween accents are subtle, they make the triple black version of the SB Dunk Low stand out from other models. For example, Nikes signature orange label, part of the insole, and the care instructions are the only colorful accents on the shoe. They pop against the all-black nubuck on the Swoosh, forefoot, and heel overlays, vamp, eyelets, and heel tab. Completing the dark aesthetic, the laces and rubber outsole also come in black. Perforations across the vamp allow the foot to breathe, while padding in the tongue and collar protects the ankle. Our experts like that this sneaker was released only in skate shops, giving the sneaker an exclusive feel. The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Triple Black was released on October 1, 2024, and sold for $115.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Off-White Black
Description: Its officially 2019 and Virgil is back applying pressure on the sneaker world with the release of the Air Max 90 Off-White Black. This AM 90 is sporting a black upper, white Nike "Swoosh", black midsole, and a black sole. These sneakers released in January 2019 and retailed for $160. The Virgil x Nike World Tour continues, so dont miss out and place a Bid on StockX today.

Display Name: Nike Metcon 8 Black White
Description: The Nike Metcon 8 Black White is an indoor cross-training shoe with a lightweight, supportive design and a monochromatic colorway of black, white, and Dark Smoke Grey. Due to the reworked upper, the Black White Nike Metcon 8 model is more durable, yet the mesh still allows the foot to breathe. Specifically, the textured overlays reinforce areas of high wear, extending the shoes longevity. Nike React foam in the midsole provides a responsive feel and lasting comfort, while the wide base offers flexible stability during lifting. Designed for climbing ropes, the rubber outsole wraps around the midfoot area and comes with grippy tread. Our experts at StockX like the Swoosh logo on the outer side panel. It features white zebra stripes and tonally matches branding details, including "METCON," the tongue tag, and the brands promise printed on the outer side. The Nike Metcon 8 Black White was released on August 25, 2022, and sold for $130.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Steel Grey Orca
Description: The New Balance 2002R Steel Grey Orca is an iteration of the New Balance 2002R running sneaker in a Steel Grey Orca colorway. This sneakers upper is made of a Grey mesh base cut out by Steel and Lead Grey leather overlays on the toe box. Lead Grey accents also appear on the upper eyelets, quarter panel, and the upper part of the tongue. The top overlay, which dominates the upper, features a premium Suede build in a Steel Grey tone highlighted by a Light Grey N logo with a White outline and 2002R branding on the lateral ankle. A White Absorb midsole and a Black N-ergy outsole round out the design. The New Balance 2002R Steel Grey Orca White was made available on October 21st, 2022, retailing at $140.

Display Name: New Balance 1906A White Green
Description: The New Balance 1906A White Green blends archival performance cues with fresh color contrast in a streamlined runner silhouette. White mesh anchors the upper with a clean and breathable base, while green accents inject energy across the layered overlays. The visible cushioning and structured midfoot support keep the design rooted in performance heritage while maintaining lifestyle appeal. Fans gravitate toward the 1906A because it captures the resurgence of retro running design with thoughtful updates. The white and green pairing feels classic yet lively, making it adaptable across seasons. Collectors appreciate how the silhouette balances comfort and visual detail without becoming overly complex. It stands as a versatile and heritage driven release that reinforces New Balances strength in blending archival inspiration with modern styling clarity. The New Balance 1906A White Green was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Mind 002 Flyknit White Dark Grey Volt
Description: The Nike Mind 002 Flyknit White/Dark Grey/Volt is a May 27, 2026 release from Nike's Mind collection, retailing at $145 with style code IR2176-100 in the White/Dark Grey/Pure Platinum/Wolf Grey/Barely Volt colorway, confirmed by StockX, Sole Retriever, Sneaker News, and the official Nike SNKRS listing. As confirmed by Sole Retriever, the Nike Mind 002 FK White Dark Grey was one of the original colorways created during the design process when the Mind technology was being developed by the Nike ISPA team, making this the first inline retail release of the ISPA-origin upper after Hiroshi Fujiwara's fragment collaboration introduced the Flyknit construction to the Mind 002. Sole Retriever confirmed the typical breathable mesh upper found on the standard Mind 002 is replaced with a white textured Flyknit giving the sneaker stretch, with Volt highlights on the vents along the upper and the Mind nodes on the outsole, green piping running from the tongue to the toebox, a toggling lace system carried over from the fragment collaboration, grey tones across the sculpted midsole and heel tab, and a reflective silver heel counter. Sneaker News confirmed the White/Dark Grey/Pure Platinum/Wolf Grey foundations are accented with Barely Volt through the individually articulating 22-node outsole pods and sheer upper layer details, with the ISPA ethos of improvise, scavenge, protect, and adapt visible throughout the sneaker's construction. Retail price $145. The Nike Mind 002 Flyknit White/Dark Grey/Volt is the May 27, 2026 IR2176-100 ISPA-origin white-textured-Flyknit toggle-lace Volt-vents-and-nodes green-tongue-to-toebox-piping reflective-silver-heel-counter 22-node-sensory-activation unisex Nike Mind 002 sneaker for the Nike Mind collector who wants the most understated and most design-historically resonant neutral white-and-grey ISPA-origin Flyknit execution from the Nike Mind 002 Flyknit program. The Nike Mind 002 Flyknit White/Dark Grey/Volt was released on May 27, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 3 All-star (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 3 All Star Womens captures Sabrina Ionescus competitive edge through vibrant color and sharp contrast. Soft yellow sets an energetic tone across the upper, while orange trace accents bring heat and movement that feel celebratory without overpowering the design. Black details ground the palette, keeping the silhouette focused and balanced. The overall look feels fast and expressive, reflecting an All Star moment built on confidence and visibility rather than excess. Fans connect with this release because it feels earned and authentic. The Sabrina line has quickly become known for precision and control, and this colorway adds flair without losing that identity. Collectors appreciate how the All Star theme is communicated through color and mood rather than heavy graphics. It feels bold yet disciplined, mirroring Sabrinas approach to the game and reinforcing her place among the sports most influential modern athletes. The Nike Sabrina 3 All Star Womens was released on July 18, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike Air Presto Off-White Black (2018)
Description: After an absolute frenzy over Virgil Abloh's first iteration, the Nike Air Presto Off White is back-- in black. In a Richard Lewis-approved colorway (word to LD), this shoe is dressed in a monochromatic black. In addition, it features a white Nike Swoosh sewn onto the lateral side. Finally, "AIR" is written in classic Virgil fashion on the side heel, completing this deconstructed, utilitarian #vibe. This pair released in July 2018 for $160.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 White Metallic Silver
Description: Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 White Metallic Silver delivers a crisp and confident take on the Supreme SB legacy by pairing clean white tones with metallic silver accents. The colorway feels sharp and deliberate, highlighting the SB Dunks classic proportions while giving it a polished edge. It reflects Supremes ability to elevate simple ideas through precision rather than excess. What makes this pair special is its versatility within the Supreme SB lineage. The restrained palette allows the shoe to move easily between skate heritage and lifestyle wear, making it appealing to collectors who value longevity. It feels like a release designed to stand the test of time, rewarding fans who appreciate subtlety and cultural continuity over trend driven design. The Nike SB Dunk Low Supreme 94 White Metallic Silver was released on 09/04/2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Dawn Forrest Gump
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble Total 90 in White, Racer Blue, Black, and Metallic Silver is the cleanest and most classic-feeling entry in the Total 90 Big Bubble lineup, the white base and racer blue accents referencing the football boot color combinations that made Total 90 equipment immediately recognizable on pitches across the world during the sub-brand's peak years. Racer blue on the Big Bubble Air unit creates a striking visual anchor at the heel while white across the upper keeps the layered 95 paneling open and legible, the metallic silver adding the premium hardware quality that distinguishes the SE specification from standard platform releases. The Total 90 narrative lands naturally in this colorway, the blue and white combination carrying genuine football kit associations without requiring any explicit branding to communicate the reference. White Air Max 95 releases with vivid accent colors have a long and distinguished history in the silhouette's archive, and the racer blue and metallic silver combination gives this Total 90 version a specific and visually sophisticated personality that works across both sport and lifestyle contexts with equal ease. The Big Bubble's oversized heel unit in white with racer blue detailing is the shoe's visual centerpiece, the technical feature and the color story converging at the most architecturally dramatic point of the entire silhouette. The Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble Total 90 in White and Racer Blue has a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Shox R4 White Bright Crimson Metallic Silver
Description: Futuristic, robotic, and bold, the Nike Shox R4 White Bright Crimson Metallic Silver sneakers make a striking statement with their distinctive silhouette. This shoe features Shox columns in the sole, adding to its unmistakable look. With a shiny synthetic leather and mesh upper, these Crimson, White, and Metallic Silver sneakers are instantly recognizable and unique. The midsole features visible Shox columns, while the outsole boasts a tough rubber for extra grip. A lifestyle shoe above all, the Shox has Metallic, glossy patterning on the sides in waves over a perforated upper. Crimson highlights appear on the tongue, lining, and heel logo, set against an otherwise clean shoe. Standing out in a sea of sneakers, we love how chunky and retro-futuristic these Shox are. Perfect for those looking for a bolder addition to their sneaker collection. The Nike Shox R4 White Bright Crimson Metallic Silver sneakers were released on December 20, 2024, priced at $150 retail.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro QS Argon (2022)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro QS Flash White Argon Blue Flash features a smooth leather upper that combines a marine blue foundation with powder blue overlays and a crisp white Swoosh. This Low Retro QS Nike Dunk has a woven Nike tag on the breathable nylon tongue, while the white leather back tab displays a Nike wordmark in slanted block lettering. The sneaker rests on a standard rubber cupsole, featuring white sidewalls and a pastel blue outsole. The Nike Dunk Low Retro QS Flash White Argon Blue Flash was released on the 23rd of September 2022 for a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Free RN 2018 White (Women's)
Description: The Nike Free RN 2018 White W reflects a minimalist approach to running design, focusing on lightweight construction and natural movement. The white upper keeps the look simple and clean, while black accents add just enough contrast to define the silhouette. The flexible sole reinforces its connection to a more natural running experience. This pair stands out because of its simplicity. It strips away unnecessary elements, allowing the runner to focus on movement and comfort. Fans of the Free line appreciate how it stays true to its purpose, offering a shoe that feels intuitive and easy to wear without distraction. The Nike Free RN 2018 White W was released on April 1, 2018 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 Flagstaff
Description: The Nike Book 1 Flagstaff is a performance shoe designed as part of a partnership with American basketball star Devin Booker. This iteration of the Nike Book 1 has a smooth, durable upper in a Fir green color that represents the mountain paths and forests of Flagstaff, where Devin Booker goes to escape the desert heat. Decorative stitching crosses the upper for visual interest. A white outline of the Swoosh appears on each side. The tongue contains a Book branding patch and pays homage to Humphreys Peak, the highest point in Flagstaff. The heels are adorned with gold lettering reading "Flagstaff" on one heel and "no service" on the other. An Air Zoom unit under the heel allows for responsiveness and quick movements. What we like best about this shoe is the woven tongue tag, paying homage to Humphreys Peak, which provides a nice contrast to the green color of the rest of the shoe. The Nike Book 1 Flagstaff was released on February 1, 2025, for $140.

Display Name: Nike LeBron 8 South Beach (2021)
Description: In 2021, Nike brought back the classic 2010 Nike LeBron 8 South Beach. The upper consists of a mix of Filament Green leather and carbon fiber. From there, hits of Pink Flash appear on the laces and inner lining. Lastly, a lion head is embossed on the tongue to symbolize LeBrons status as king of the court. The Nike LeBron 8 South Beach (2021) releases July of 2021 for $200.

Display Name: Nike V2K Run Doernbecher Khovny Vignery (Women's)
Description: The Nike V2K Run Doernbecher Khovny Vignery Womens transforms a modern runner into a deeply personal expression of creativity and resilience. A multi color execution spreads across the layered upper, creating a sense of movement and emotion that feels intentional rather than decorative. The futuristic V2K Run silhouette provides structure, allowing the artwork and color to tell a story while maintaining a strong and contemporary form. This release carries special meaning because it represents the heart of the Doernbecher program. Fans value these designs for the stories and voices behind them, not just their appearance. Collectors see this pair as a reminder that sneakers can be platforms for expression and impact. It feels fearless and sincere, blending modern Nike design with personal narrative in a way that resonates far beyond aesthetics alone. The Nike V2K Run Doernbecher Khovny Vignery Womens was released on January 17, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike P-6000 Metallic Silver Summit White-Wolf Grey
Description: Nike P 6000 Metallic Silver Summit White Wolf Grey elevates early two thousands running cues with a metallic silver finish that gives the shoe sleek presence and visual depth. The contrast between metallic silver, summit white, and wolf grey creates a layered look that feels dynamic and modern without feeling chaotic. It reflects Nikes ability to reinvent performance inspired classics for contemporary taste.Todays sneaker culture loves subtle complexity, and this palette delivers exactly that with confidence and clarity. Collectors appreciate this release because it balances heritage and style effortlessly. The P 6000 silhouette carries nostalgia when done right, and this execution adds dimension without losing sight of the forms roots. It feels like a piece that belongs in thoughtful rotations where texture and tone matter as much as silhouette history. The Nike P 6000 Metallic Silver Summit White Wolf Grey was released on 06/27/2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves White
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves White is a sneaker that was released as a collaboration between Nike and Patta as a commemorative the 1-of-1 "ROMAN FOREVER" iteration, remembering Patta co-founder Edson Sabjos late son. The White Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves has a mix of white leather and blue-tinted grey mesh that features a distinct wavy leather overlay above cream-colored Air bubble midsoles. Logos of "Patta Air Max" are found on the tongue tabs and the insoles are blank. Nike Air emblems round out the design on the heel and white waffle outsoles. The sneaker was released on the 26th of August, 2022, with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: New Balance 992 MiUSA Black
Description: The New Balance 992 MiUSA Black delivers quiet authority through one of the brands most respected silhouettes. An all black upper gives the shoe a sleek and understated presence, allowing the layered suede and mesh construction to define the look. The sculpted midsole and classic proportions stay true to the 992s heritage, reinforcing its reputation as a cornerstone of Made in USA craftsmanship. It feels refined and grounded rather than trend driven. Collectors gravitate toward the 992 because it represents New Balance at its most authentic. The monochrome black execution enhances versatility, making it easy to wear while still carrying cultural weight. Fans appreciate how the silhouette balances comfort and structure without relying on loud color blocking. It stands as a timeless and dependable option, rooted in quality and consistency rather than flash or experimentation. The New Balance 992 MiUSA Black was released on March 7, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Diamond Turf Cowboys
Description: The Nike Air Diamond Turf Cowboys channels team identity into a silhouette built on toughness and versatility. The white, college navy, and metallic silver palette immediately ties the shoe to Cowboys heritage, giving it a strong sports driven personality. The Diamond Turfs rugged structure and layered design make it feel ready for anything, reflecting the physicality and confidence associated with the franchise. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it blends nostalgia and team culture seamlessly. The Diamond Turf has always lived beyond a single sport, and the Cowboys colorway adds emotional connection without overpowering the silhouette. Fans love it as a wearable tribute, a sneaker that represents loyalty, tradition, and the kind of bold attitude that defined an era of Nike training footwear. The Nike Air Diamond Turf Cowboys was released on December 5, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Michigan (2021)
Description: The upper of the Nike Dunk Low Michigan is made of Varsity Maize leather with Midnight Navy overlays and Swoosh logos. A woven Nike label stitched to the tongue and "NIKE" text embroidered on the heel complete the design. The Nike Dunk Low Varsity Michigan released in June of 2021 and retailed for $100.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Phantom Pink Blast
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Phantom Pink Blast brings sharp precision and bold color to one of Nikes most responsive court silhouettes. Phantom sets a clean and balanced foundation across the upper, while Cobalt Tint and Metallic Platinum accents frame the design with cool contrast. Pink Blast cuts through with high energy detailing that highlights the streamlined shape. Built for quick changes in direction, the low profile stance and visible cushioning elements reinforce its identity as a guard driven performance shoe. Players and collectors appreciate how the GT Cut line blends speed focused engineering with expressive color. The mix of soft neutrals and vibrant pink gives this pair personality without sacrificing versatility. It feels fast, modern, and unapologetically built for the hardwood. This edition captures that balance between technical innovation and standout presence. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Phantom Pink Blast was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Halo
Description: Unveiled on August 23, 2023, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Halo signals the epic return of the iconic Kobe line. Drenched in a pristine all-white colorway, this sneaker stands as an embodiment of purity, legacy, and unparalleled style. A true nod to the rebirth of the legendary Nike Kobe series, this piece is all about legacy and finesse. From its seamless upper construction to the intricate detailing, every aspect echoes Kobe's timeless style and unwavering commitment to the game. An embodiment of both on-court prowess and off-court style, this sneaker is a must-have for any collection. Mamba mentality isn't just a mindset; it's a lifestyle. And for those looking to embody that spirit, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro Halo was made available at a retail price of $180. Truly, a timeless tribute to basketball royalty.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Beach Light Khaki (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Beach Light Khaki Womens brings warm neutral tones to a layered runner silhouette. Beach and Light Khaki shape the upper with soft earthiness, while Pale Ivory and Sail accents add subtle brightness. The intricate paneling highlights the technical inspiration behind the design, and the cushioned midsole reinforces its comfort driven identity. Its tonal palette feels calm and cohesive. Fans of neutral runners appreciate how sandy hues elevate everyday styling with minimal effort. The blend of khaki and ivory keeps the look refined and adaptable across seasons. It captures the Vomeros balance of performance heritage and lifestyle versatility. Grounded and polished, this pair offers understated sophistication with every step. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Beach Light Khaki Womens was released on December 20, 2024 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Total 90 3 White Gym Red
Description: Rediscover an icon with the Nike Total 90 3 White Gym Red, a modern nod to the celebrated Total 90 lineage that ruled pitches and street courts alike. This mens sneaker blends soccer-bred design with everyday comfort, showcasing the clean White/Gym Red/Black colorway and signature T90 details for instant impact. The streamlined silhouette hints at the originals off-center lacing look and striking panel lines, while the bold Swoosh placement amplifies the fast-forward aesthetic. A cushioned midsole supports all-day wear, and a padded collar secures the ankle without sacrificing that sleek, low-profile stance. Whether you remember the legend or youre discovering it for the first time, this pair brings heritage energy to modern style. Built for versatility, the Nike Total 90 3 remaster pairs a durable upper with a grippy outsole designed for confident traction on city sidewalks, indoor courts, and everything in between. Lightweight construction helps keep your stride quick, while a responsive footbed softens landings and keeps you locked in during quick cuts. From the crisp white base to the Gym Red accents and black trim, the color blocking delivers sharp contrast that pops with joggers, shorts, or tailored denim. With its soccer DNA and lifestyle-ready comfort, the Nike Total 90 3 White Gym Red (style HQ2851-100) makes a strong case for everyday rotation, and a standout addition to any Nike collection. Our team loves this product because it delivers heritage design with modern comfort, making it a versatile pick for daily wear, small-sided play, and collectors who value iconic color blocking and timeless Nike storytelling.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Valentine's Day (2026) (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Valentines Day 2026 Womens leans into layered romance with a rich mix of Silt Red, Burgundy Crush, and Peony across its classic paneling. Sail and Light Bone soften the palette, while subtle hits of Light Armory Blue add unexpected contrast that keeps the design from feeling predictable. The familiar Dunk Low structure provides a clean foundation for the expressive color story. Valentines releases on the Dunk have become a seasonal tradition, and this version feels especially nuanced thanks to its deeper red tones. The blend of warm hues with neutral balancing panels gives it depth beyond a simple holiday theme. For fans who appreciate statement color blocking that remains wearable year round, this pair strikes that balance confidently. The Nike Dunk Low Valentines Day 2026 Womens was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.
Colorway: Silt Red/Sail/Light Bone/Burgundy Crush/Peony/Light Armory Blue

Display Name: Nike Air Foamposite One Eggplant (2024)
Description: The Nike Air Foamposite One Eggplant 2024 is a bold retro of a classic silhouette, bringing back the iconic eggplant colorway. The striking combination of black and varsity purple across the sneaker's futuristic, molded upper provides a visual impact that's both nostalgic and forward-thinking. Nike's Foamposite technology has always been about pushing the boundaries of sneaker design, and the Eggplant 2024 edition is no exception. Its seamless, liquid-like upper and distinctive color transition showcase Nike's commitment to innovation and style. The sneaker's durability and comfort are unmatched, making it suitable for both performance and everyday wear. With its rich history and eye-catching design, the Nike Air Foamposite One Eggplant 2024 is a must-have for collectors and new fans alike. Released on February 29, 2024, and priced at $240, the Nike Air Foamposite One Eggplant 2024 pays homage to its roots. This sneaker has quickly become a sought-after item among enthusiasts, blending history, and style.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro College Navy
Description: Paying tribute to Kobe Bryants legacy, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro College Navy was released alongside the "Wolf Grey" and "University Red" editions as part of Nikes Fall 2024 collection. The College Navy Nike Kobe 8 Protro basketball shoe boasts a slim design and a collegiate color palette of College Navy and white. Designed to improve a player's on-court performance, the sneaker features several enhancements, including a responsive React foam midsole and a grippy herringbone traction pattern on the outsole. However, the standout feature is the lightweight engineered mesh on the upper. It comes in College Navy and allows the foot to breathe without sacrificing durability. Contrasting the dark College Navy base, white can be found on Bryants sword in a sheath logo on the tongue and heel, the rubber outsole, the embroidered Swoosh logos, and the athletes signature. Our experts like the reinforced eyelets because they provide a secure fit. The Nike Kobe 8 Protro College Navy was released on September 6, 2024, and sold for $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 White Black
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 White Black paints the Air Max 1 silhouette in a contrasting colorway of white, black, and Pure Platinum. Like the original Air Max 1 from 1987, the "White Black" version was designed with comfort in mind and includes design elements that pay tribute to the original. For example, the sneaker features wavy mudguards and overlapping overlays. The waffle design on the rubber outsole is another feature that pays homage to the sneakers running roots. It also provides traction without adding bulky lugs. While white is the bases dominant color, the leather overlays come in Pure Platinum and the mudguard is black. Notable branding elements include the Swooshes on the side panels and the retro-inspired logo tag on the tongue. Our StockX experts appreciate the transparent windows in the heel, which allow you to see the Air Max unit. The Nike Air Max 1 White Black was released on January 4th, 2024, and retailed at $140.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Stranger Things Phantom
Description: Nike Dunk Low Stranger Things Phantom taps into the darker, atmospheric side of the Dunk Low by drawing inspiration from the eerie tone that defines Stranger Things. The Phantom color story keeps things muted and moody, letting texture and contrast create tension rather than loud color. It feels cinematic, like a sneaker designed to mirror the slow burn suspense and nostalgia that made the series a cultural phenomenon. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it treats collaboration as storytelling rather than branding. The Dunk Low silhouette anchors the design in familiarity, while the Stranger Things influence adds emotional depth tied to late night episodes and eighties inspired dread. It feels intentional and immersive, appealing to fans who enjoy sneakers that capture a feeling rather than chase spectacle, making it a natural fit for displays rooted in pop culture crossover moments. The Nike Dunk Low Stranger Things Phantom was released on 11/06/2025 with a retail price of $155.
Colorway: Phantom/Midnight Navy/College Grey/Varsity Red/Lemon Drop/Dark Smoke Grey

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Psychic Purple
Description: Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Psychic Purple embraces bold creativity by turning the Dunk into an expressive art object rather than a traditional sneaker. The Swamp Sponge treatment exaggerates texture and form, while the Psychic Purple tones add a surreal and playful energy that feels unmistakably CPFM. It is intentionally strange, designed to stand out and spark conversation rather than blend in. Collectors love this pair because it represents freedom in design. The Dunk Low becomes a canvas for experimentation, rewarding fans who appreciate sneakers as creative statements. It feels fearless and joyful, celebrating individuality and imagination in a way that few releases attempt, let alone pull off successfully. The Nike Dunk Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Swamp Sponge Psychic Purple was released on 09/17/2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Jalen Brunson NY vs. NY PE
Description: The Nike Kobe 5 Protro NY vs NY is one of the most culturally charged Kobe releases of 2026, born directly from one of the most dramatic moments of the NBA postseason. Jalen Brunson debuted this colorway on his feet during Game 1 of the Eastern Conference Finals, leading the New York Knicks back from a 22-point deficit with under eight minutes remaining in one of the most memorable comebacks in Madison Square Garden history, giving the shoe an on-court story before it ever hit a retail shelf. The Menta upper draws an immediate comparison to the Statue of Liberty, that recognizable mint green reading as a full tribute to New York City, while Blue Glow lands on the Swoosh logos and branding to reinforce the city's basketball identity. Orange Horizon accents and splatter detailing across the forefoot and heel tie the whole colorway to the outdoor court culture that defines New York summers, referencing Nike's annual NY vs. NY high school basketball tournament. The Kobe 5 silhouette remains one of the most beloved basketball shoes ever made, celebrated for its low-cut profile, responsive cushioning, and the fearless aesthetic that Kobe Bryant and designer Eric Avar built into every detail of its original 2010 construction. The Protro update carries all of that forward while adding modernized performance tech under the hood, making this a shoe that hoopers can genuinely ball in at the same level fans will want to collect it. The crossover between a legitimate NBA Finals moment, a player wearing the Mamba's signature, and a colorway built to celebrate one of basketball's greatest cities makes the NY vs. NY one of those rare releases that earns meaning before it even arrives on shelves. The Nike Kobe 5 Protro NY vs NY was released on June 8, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Wolf Grey Hyper Pink
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Wolf Grey Hyper Pink is a striking addition to the iconic Air Max line. This men's sneaker features a cool grey and wolf grey upper, accented with eye-catching hyper pink details that add a vibrant pop of color. The classic silhouette is enhanced with black and anthracite elements, creating a balanced and stylish design that pays homage to the original 1990 release while offering a fresh, modern twist. Crafted with Nike's renowned attention to detail, these sneakers boast the signature visible Air unit in the heel, providing superior cushioning and comfort for all-day wear. The durable rubber outsole ensures excellent traction, while the padded collar and tongue offer additional support. With its versatile colorway and timeless design, the Nike Air Max 90 Wolf Grey Hyper Pink is perfect for both casual outings and athletic pursuits. We at StockX believe this product is great for sneaker enthusiasts looking for a versatile shoe that combines classic style with contemporary flair. The Air Max 90's enduring popularity and comfort make it an excellent choice for those who appreciate both fashion and function in their footwear.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro SE White Off Noir Sanded Purple
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE White Off Noir Sanded Purple blends neutral tones with a subtle pop of color, creating a version of the Dunk that feels both understated and distinctive. The white base provides a clean foundation, while off noir overlays add a darker contrast. Sanded purple accents introduce a soft touch of color that gives the design a unique identity without overpowering the look. Fans appreciate this release because it offers a slightly different approach to color blocking while maintaining the familiar Dunk structure. The balance between neutral and color makes it easy to wear, while still standing out upon closer look. It reflects Nikes continued ability to refresh a classic silhouette through thoughtful combinations. The Nike Dunk Low Retro SE White Off Noir Sanded Purple was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low QS Wheatgrass Camo
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low QS Wheatgrass Camo blends earthy tones with subtle pattern work on a familiar frame. Asparagus and Wheat Grass shades dominate the upper, layered with Aluminum and Phantom accents that add contrast without overpowering the design. The camo influence introduces depth and texture, giving the classic silhouette a rugged edge. The low cut shape and sturdy sole unit preserve the identity that has defined the Air Force 1 for decades. This release resonates with collectors who appreciate understated experimentation. The muted palette keeps it versatile, while the camo elements add personality and movement. It feels grounded in nature inspired color but rooted firmly in street heritage. The result is a balanced interpretation that refreshes the icon without straying too far from tradition. The Nike Air Force 1 Low QS Wheatgrass Camo was released on February 10, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Iron Grey Chrome
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Iron Grey Chrome is one of the most technically atmospheric and most visually precise colorways in the Vomero 5's sustained 2025-26 reissue program, a palette that Sneaker News described as offering a "late-night aesthetic" through its deliberate shift toward a cooler, moodier, and more industrial visual register than the warmer or more vibrant colorways that surrounded it in the seasonal lineup. The Iron Grey, Metallic Silver, Coconut Milk, and Chrome four-color construction applies deep iron grey to the upper's mesh and synthetic leather layers while Chrome-finished panels sit across the toe, eyestays, and midfoot, the polished metallic surface catching light with a precision that adds movement and depth to the shoe without requiring any color outside the grey and silver family. The Vomero 5's signature molded TPU cage, one of the silhouette's most recognizable structural features, arrives in a muted charcoal shade that provides the ribbed texture and visual architecture that defines the shoe's side profile while staying within the colorway's disciplined tonal range. Coconut Milk laces and a matching midsole introduce the only warmth in the palette, a deliberate softening of what would otherwise be an entirely cold, metallic execution and one that prevents the colorway from tipping into a register that would limit its styling versatility. The shoe's construction follows the Vomero 5 standard that has made it one of the defining lifestyle running reissues of the 2020s: mesh and real or synthetic leather layered with plastic caging on the side for support, mesh ventilation ports on the heel for breathability, Cushlon midsole foam paired with Zoom Air cushioning for a quick-off-the-ground ride, and a rubber outsole for durable traction. Style code IM3486-001. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Iron Grey Chrome is the Vomero 5 for the collector and daily wearer who wants the silhouette's full material complexity and structural character expressed through the most industrially precise and most tonally refined metallic-grey colorway in the 2025-26 program. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Iron Grey Chrome was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Realtree Black Camo
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Realtree Black Camo brings an outdoor inspired perspective to the silhouette, using a camo pattern that feels both rugged and street ready. The off noir base allows the multi color Realtree pattern to stand out, while the gum yellow outsole adds a subtle contrast that ties the look together. It feels durable and visually layered. This version stands out for how it merges two different worlds.
