The Air Force 1 has always been rooted in urban culture, but this pair introduces elements pulled from outdoor gear and hunting aesthetics. Fans appreciate that crossover, especially when it is executed in a way that still feels wearable and cohesive. It is a unique take that expands the reach of a classic model. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Realtree Black Camo was released on October 3, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SE Blue Void Midnight Navy
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SE in Blue Void and Midnight Navy is a special edition of the Vomero 5 that distinguishes itself from standard iterations through a closed mesh upper with tighter, chain-like TPU detailing in place of the model's usual more open mesh construction, layered with Midnight Navy synthetic leather overlays and Metallic Silver accents, while Light Orewood Brown covers the Zoom Air and Cushlon foam midsole providing a warm off-white contrast against the dark blue upper palette. The SE designation marks this as a more construction-forward variant of the standard Vomero 5, with the tighter closed mesh and reinforced synthetic leather overlay combination giving the shoe a more durable and more structurally dense character that aligns with the broader Y2K running revival's appetite for technical-looking footwear that reads as complex and layered from a material standpoint. The Vomero 5's core performance architecture includes Zoom Air cushioning for a snappy, responsive ride, plastic side caging for support, mesh panels and ventilation ports at the heel for breathability, and a rubber outsole for durable traction, all preserved in the SE version alongside the updated upper construction that makes this colorway one of the more visually distinctive releases in the Vomero 5's growing lifestyle catalog. Released February 1, 2026 at $170 retail via nike.com and select retailers with style code IQ6589-400. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SE Blue Void Midnight Navy was released on February 1, 2026 with a retail price of $170.
Colorway: Blue Void/Midnight Navy/Light Orewood Brown/Metallic Silver

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Sail Mink Brown Black (Women's)
Description: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Sail Mink Brown Black Womens leans into early two thousands performance aesthetics while delivering a color palette that feels calm and wearable. The sail base lightens the layered upper, while mink brown and black accents add depth and balance, giving the shoe a refined and lifestyle ready feel. It captures the moment when technical running shoes crossed fully into everyday culture. Collectors appreciate this pair because it blends complexity and comfort seamlessly. The Vomero 5s layered construction creates visual rhythm, while the soft tones keep it approachable for daily rotation. It feels intentional rather than nostalgic, appealing to fans who value comfort driven silhouettes that still carry strong design language. This release reinforces why the Vomero 5 has become a staple among collectors who appreciate subtle detail and long term wearability. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Sail Mink Brown Black Womens was released on 04/20/2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Blazer Low 77 Jumbo White Black Sail
Description: The Nike Blazer Low 77 Jumbo White Black Sail provides wearers with extra support and cushioning, making them a convenient choice for either going about your daily business or embarking on a long walk throughout the city. The Nike Blazer Low 77 Jumbo White Black Sail features a cream-colored sole, coupled with an extra-large version of the famous Nike swoosh symbol in black. On the toes and heels of the foot, you will find grey patches, as well as a splash of neon yellow beneath the laces. First released in February of 2022, the Nike Blazer Low 77 Jumbo White Black Sail had a starting retail price of $95.

Display Name: Nike KD 18 Clear Jade Liquid Lime
Description: The Nike KD 18 Clear Jade Liquid Lime takes a more contrast driven approach, pairing clear jade with liquid lime to create a bright and modern look. The black elements ground the design, allowing the vibrant tones to stand out without overwhelming the silhouette. The structure remains performance focused, built for movement and support on the court. This version resonates with players and collectors who appreciate bold but balanced colorways. The combination of greens gives it a fresh and energetic feel, while the darker accents maintain structure. Nike continues to refine the KD line through both design and technology, and this release reflects that balance clearly. It is a standout option that blends performance with visual identity. The Nike KD 18 Clear Jade Liquid Lime was released on April 18, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Harris Tweed Sesame (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Harris Tweed Sesame Womens brings texture and heritage to the Dunk Low through a material choice that feels thoughtful and elevated. The Harris Tweed upper immediately sets this pair apart, adding depth and warmth that contrasts beautifully with the familiar Dunk shape. Sesame tones anchor the design in earthy neutrality, while subtle color variation across panels makes the shoe feel crafted rather than manufactured, turning a classic basketball silhouette into a lifestyle statement. Fans love this release because it rewards attention. The tweed material gives the Dunk a tactile quality that feels premium and intentional, appealing to collectors who appreciate craftsmanship as much as color. It feels refined without losing the Dunks easygoing identity, making it a shoe that works just as well dressed up as it does worn casually. This pair resonates with people who enjoy seeing iconic silhouettes reimagined through fabric and feel rather than loud graphics or heavy branding. The Nike Dunk Low Harris Tweed Sesame Womens was released on September 3, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Timberland 6" Premium Boot Black Nubuck (GS)
Description: The Timberland 6" Premium Boot Black (GS) is a grade school-sized Timberland 6" Premium Boot in a monochromatic black colorway. This Timberland boot features a premium full-grain waterproof leather upper with a padded collar covered in soft leather. Primaloft lining keeps the feet warm and comfortable. Other details include a lace closure system with matching metallic eyelets and Taslan® fiber laces, the signature Timberland branding etched at the lateral heel, waterproof seam-sealed construction, and matching stitching. Finishing off the design is a black sole unit with a rubber lug outsole for traction. What our experts particularly love about this grade school-sized Timberland boot is its simple colorway and premium construction. The upper materials contribute to its comfort and durability, while the simple colorway gives it a timeless and versatile aesthetic appeal, making it a standout choice for outdoor and everyday wear. The Timberland 6" Premium Boot Black (GS) was made available on January 1st, 2018. Initially, it retailed at $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Hot Curry
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Hot Curry revives one of the most influential Air Max silhouettes through a colorway that emphasizes the layered anatomy inspired design language central to the original concept. The Air Max 95 changed sneaker culture forever because of Sergio Lozanos human body inspired construction and visible forefoot Air cushioning, and the Big Bubble treatment enhances the retro authenticity of the release by bringing back exaggerated Air unit proportions tied to early production eras. The Hot Curry accents introduce rich warmth against the Pencil Point and Anthracite tones, giving the sneaker a rugged and highly textured personality. Fans gravitate toward Air Max 95 releases because the silhouette remains one of Nikes boldest and most technically layered retro runners. The gradient upper and segmented paneling create natural depth and movement throughout the shoe, while the Hot Curry details add striking contrast without overwhelming the darker foundation. Collectors especially appreciate Big Bubble editions because they reconnect modern retros to the original visual identity and cushioning aesthetic that made early Air Max models so revolutionary. The overall presentation feels gritty, industrial, and deeply connected to the enduring legacy of 1990s Nike running culture. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Hot Curry was released with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 Tiempo 2005
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 Tiempo 2005 in Black, White, Golf Leaf, Pear, Black Tea, and Blue Jay is a multi-color tribute release that references the specific and beloved Tiempo football boot color palette from 2005, bringing a full spectrum of natural and earth-adjacent tones to the Air Max 90's iconic silhouette in a way that creates one of the most chromatically complex and palette-historically specific releases in the platform's current retro and tribute-themed seasonal production. The Tiempo 2005 connection is the kind of football culture archive reference that rewards genuine kit and boot heritage knowledge, the specific year designation situating this colorway in a precise and memorable chapter of Nike football boot history that dedicated collectors and football culture enthusiasts will immediately recognize and personally connect to through their own memories of the era. The combination of pear, golf leaf, black tea, and blue jay creates a multi-tone color story that feels simultaneously naturalistic and slightly surreal, the organic green and yellow tones sitting alongside the tea and jay blues in a palette that references the original boot's specific color composition with genuine archive fidelity. Nike football boot tribute Air Max 90 releases occupy a genuinely specific and underserved space in the Nike collector market by bridging two of the brand's most devoted collector communities, the Air Max platform enthusiasts and the football boot archive collectors whose respective passions for Nike's running and football heritage rarely intersect in a single shoe until a tribute colorway like the Tiempo 2005 creates exactly the kind of cross-category cultural moment that generates the most interesting and broadly discussed seasonal releases. The multi-color complexity of the pear, golf leaf, black tea, and blue jay combination across the Air Max 90's layered upper panels creates a shoe that rewards viewing from every angle with new color discoveries and tonal relationships. At one hundred and fifty dollars the Air Max 90 Tiempo 2005 is a fair investment in one of Nike's most football-historically specific and color-research-intensive seasonal tribute releases. The Nike Air Max 90 Tiempo 2005 was released on May 21, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Salomon XT-MM-6 MM6 Maison Margiela Asparagus Green
Description: The Salomon XT MM6 MM6 Maison Margiela Asparagus Green merges technical trail design with avant garde fashion through a collaboration that feels both experimental and wearable. The Asparagus Green and Gull palette gives the shoe a muted and slightly unconventional tone, while the XT silhouette provides the structure and performance foundation. MM6 Maison Margiela brings a deconstructed and conceptual approach, transforming the trail runner into something more fashion oriented without losing its core functionality. Fans gravitate toward MM6 collaborations because they reinterpret familiar silhouettes through a more artistic lens. The tonal green execution adds depth while maintaining versatility, allowing the shoe to work across different styles. Salomons presence within fashion continues growing as its technical designs gain recognition beyond outdoor use. For collectors, pieces like this highlight the intersection of performance and high fashion, where innovative design meets practical functionality in a way that feels fresh and forward thinking. The Salomon XT MM6 MM6 Maison Margiela Asparagus Green was released on April 29, 2026 with a retail price of $480.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves Hyper Crimson Pure Platinum (With Bracelet)
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves Hyper Crimson Pure Platinum continues the iconic Waves series with a bold and recognizable design language. The hyper crimson accents cut through the upper with a flowing pattern that breaks away from traditional mudguard shapes, while pure platinum and black tones provide balance. It feels dynamic, almost in motion even when still. Fans of the Patta collaboration value consistency in concept, and this release delivers that while introducing a fresh colorway. The wave design has become a signature, and each new iteration builds on that identity without feeling repetitive. It is a continuation of a story that has remained relevant through strong execution and cultural impact. The Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves Hyper Crimson Pure Platinum was released on March 6, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Victor Solomon Sunset Strip
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Victor Solomon Sunset Strip transforms the silhouette into a storytelling piece, using Victor Solomons artistic lens to reinterpret a classic. The white, black, and metallic gold palette provides contrast, but it is the concept behind the design that gives it depth. Inspired by the energy and culture of Sunset Strip, the shoe feels like a wearable narrative rather than just a colorway. This collaboration stands out because it treats the Air Force 1 as a canvas. Fans of Solomons work recognize the attention to storytelling and detail, while sneaker collectors appreciate how it adds another dimension to a familiar model. It is a piece that connects art, place, and footwear in a way that feels intentional and layered. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Victor Solomon Sunset Strip was released on February 14, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Shox Z Calistra Pale Ivory Oatmeal (Women's)
Description: The Nike Shox Z Calistra Pale Ivory Oatmeal Women's is the general-release debut colorway for one of 2026's most culturally specific and most design-genre-defying Nike silhouettes, a women's-exclusive shoe that occupies the specific intersection of balletcore, Y2K athletic heritage, and Shox technology that no other shoe in the Nike catalog has previously inhabited. The Calistra, which builds on the foundation of the Shox Z silhouette but applies an entirely different identity through a Mary Jane-style midfoot strap and a patent leather or molded synthetic leather upper in place of traditional sneaker materials, was first introduced through a February 2026 Naked Copenhagen collaboration before Nike expanded it into a general-release program, establishing the ballet-inspired sneaker as a genuine women's category entry with its own design language. The Pale Ivory and Oatmeal colorway is the first-mover general-release pair, applying the Shox Calistra's molded upper in the most neutral and most broadly wearable palette available, the cream-to-warm-beige tonal relationship that reads as simultaneously minimal and sophisticated without being stark. The adjustable midfoot strap provides the secure, customized fit that a laceless sneaker requires for proper lateral hold, the functional solution that also provides the Mary Jane visual signature that drives the shoe's entire aesthetic identity. Shox Z cushioning beneath the heel delivers the responsive mechanical compression that the Shox franchise has provided since its introduction, now applied to a silhouette that references ballet flats, formal women's footwear, and early-2000s performance running simultaneously. Style code IR5510-100, released May 20, 2026 at $135 in women's sizing. The Nike Shox Z Calistra Pale Ivory Oatmeal Women's is the defining balletcore sneaker in Nike's 2026 catalog, the first general-release execution of a silhouette that redefines what Shox technology looks like when placed inside a women's shoe designed to move between athletic and formal contexts with equal ease. The Nike Shox Z Calistra Pale Ivory Oatmeal Women's was released on May 20, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Born X Raised One Block At A Time
Description: Introducing the Born x Raised One Block At A Time Nike SB Dunk Low, showcased in a Deep Royal Blue and White colorway. This isn't just another Dunk  it's a collaboration with the legendary LA brand, Born x Raised. Representing the culture of LA with a hint of luxury, the upper mixes premium leather with nubuck and silver detailing on the iconic Nike Swoosh & heel tab. "One Block At a Time" is embroidered on the mudguard & featured on the tongue. The heel features "On The Turf" with an extra Nike Swoosh on the back of the midsole. Ensuring you're not only wearing a shoe but a statement. This shoe effortlessly mirrors LA's vibrant and dynamic style. Its design boasts of its heritage while nudging to the future. And of course, the iconic Dunk silhouette ensures a snug fit and ultimate comfort. In essence, the Born x Raised collab is where street meets sneaker. This masterpiece dropped on shelves at a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Drift White Black Metallic Silver
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Drift White Black Metallic Silver delivers an elegant, modern design with innovative detailing. Highlighting striking colors, this iteration of the classic Air Max combines advanced materials with a bold aesthetic that demands attention. The White Black Metallic Silver Air Max Plus Drift by Nike merges airy mesh with synthetic overlays for durability and breathability. It features a dynamic gradient finish on its signature wavy lines and a design that evokes natural elements like ocean waves and palm trees. Nikes "Tn" branding on the rubber sole complements its Air cushioning technology. The Swoosh is displayed on the sides on a smaller scale. As the experts, one thing we enjoy about the Nike Air Max Plus Drift White Black Metallic Silver is its lightweight Air cushioning for comfort in urban settings or fitness trails. Another outstanding feature is its gradient accents, which give the shoe more of a futuristic look. Retailing for $185 upon release on 1st April 2024, it remains a top pick.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme GOODENOUGH
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme GOODENOUGH fuses three pillars of street culture into a clean, daily-wear staple. Dressed in a White/Multi palette, the IM3483-100 pairs crisp leather with carefully placed color hits that nod to both Supreme and GOODENOUGHs graphic legacy. Expect sharp paneling, a perforated toe box for breathability, and the classic cupsole with visible stitching that made the AF1 an icon. Co-branded details shine across the tongue label, heel, and insole, while a polished Swoosh and subtle contrast accents deliver a balanced look that feels timeless yet unmistakably modern. The included Supreme/GOODENOUGH laces add a customizable twist straight out of the box, letting you swap in heritage-inspired flair or keep it understated. Underfoot, Nike Air cushioning provides all-day comfort, supported by the grippy pivot-point outsole that keeps you steady from city commutes to weekend hangs. Thoughtful finishing touches, clean edge paint, smooth leather grain, and refined proportions, underscore the premium feel without sacrificing the AF1s everyday versatility. Whether youre styling them with relaxed denim or technical layers, this collaboration lands right in the sweet spot between wearable and collectible. With its 2025-06-05 release date, the Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme GOODENOUGH captures the energy of cross-cultural design in a pair youll reach for again and again. Our team loves this product because it blends iconic AF1 comfort with sharp co-branding and elevated materials for a standout look thats easy to wear.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Susan Fang Artist Collection (Women's)
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Susan Fang Artist Collection Womens transforms the iconic basketball silhouette into a wearable art piece. Dressed in Summit White and Wolf Grey with Hydrogen Blue and Blue Tint accents, the upper feels delicate yet layered. The familiar Dunk shape acts as a canvas, allowing the artistic detailing and soft color transitions to take center stage. Collaborations within the Artist Collection always bring a different perspective, and this release reflects Susan Fangs imaginative and expressive approach. The cool blue tones feel airy and refined, contrasting beautifully with the crisp white base. It is a Dunk that celebrates creativity while staying grounded in the timeless structure that has made the model a cultural staple. The Nike Dunk Low Susan Fang Artist Collection Womens was released on September 12, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Book 1 Aurora
Description: The Nike Book 1 Aurora channels Devin Bookers smooth scoring style through layered color and controlled contrast. Wild Grape sets a bold tone across the upper, while Medium Ash and multi color accents create dimension throughout the silhouette. The low profile build emphasizes agility and court feel, giving the shoe a sleek and modern presence. Its design balances expressive tones with performance focus, reflecting Bookers ability to blend flair and fundamentals seamlessly. Book 1 releases continue to resonate with fans who appreciate subtle storytelling in basketball footwear. The purple driven palette feels confident and distinct without overwhelming the streamlined shape. It captures a sense of movement and creativity that mirrors Bookers game. Polished yet vibrant, this pair stands out with quiet intensity. The Nike Book 1 Aurora was released on November 7, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike KD 17 Easy Money All-Star
Description: The Nike KD 17 Easy Money All-Star is a striking addition to Kevin Durant's signature line, designed to make a statement on and off the court. This eye-catching colorway features a vibrant combination of Barely Volt, Hyper Pink, Total Orange, and Baltic Blue, creating a visually dynamic sneaker that's sure to turn heads. The shoe's upper is crafted with innovative materials that provide both durability and breathability, ensuring optimal performance during intense gameplay. Engineered for the modern basketball player, the KD 17 incorporates Nike's latest technology to enhance comfort, support, and responsiveness. The cushioning system offers excellent energy return, while the outsole pattern is optimized for multi-directional traction, allowing for quick cuts and explosive movements on the court. With its sleek silhouette and bold color scheme, this sneaker seamlessly blends style and functionality, making it a versatile choice for athletes and sneaker enthusiasts alike. Our team thinks this product is great for players seeking a high-performance basketball shoe that doesn't compromise on style, offering the perfect balance of form and function.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low SE Concord (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE Concord (GS) comes in a white and black color palette. The Jordan 1 Low SE Concord has a leather upper, and the Jumpman emblem is embroidered on the tongue. The sneaker features a lightweight midsole for padding and a sturdy rubber outsole for grip and stability. The shoe also features a padded collar and perforations in the toe box for ankle support and ventilation, respectively. The sneaker's design is completed with a Nike Swoosh on the lateral sides and an Air Jordan logo on the heel. The grade schoolers sizing of the Air Jordan 1 Low SE Concord (GS) was released at a retail price of $95 on January 17, 2023.

Display Name: adidas Handball Spezial Maroon Cream White (Women's)
Description: The adidas Handball Spezial Maroon Cream White Womens delivers a refined and timeless take on one of adidas most trusted silhouettes. Rich maroon suede sets a confident tone, complemented by cream white details that soften the overall look. Subtle gold metallic accents add a hint of elegance, while the gum sole reinforces the shoes roots in indoor athletics and European terrace culture. This colorway appeals to fans because it feels classic without being predictable. The balance of deep color and neutral contrast makes it easy to wear across seasons, and collectors appreciate how the Spezial continues to thrive through thoughtful color storytelling rather than drastic redesigns. It carries a sense of history and restraint that resonates with those who value longevity in their rotation, making it a quiet staple with lasting appeal. The adidas Handball Spezial Maroon Cream White Womens was released on April 22, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 White Blue (GS)
Description: The ASICS Gel 1130 White Blue GS delivers a clean and energetic take on early two thousands running style, scaled perfectly for a younger audience. White mesh sets a crisp foundation, while blue accents add movement and contrast across the layered upper. Silver details highlight the technical lines of the silhouette, reinforcing its performance heritage while keeping the overall look light and wearable. The design feels sporty without being loud. This pair resonates with fans because it captures the essence of ASICS running culture in a form that works effortlessly for everyday wear. The color balance feels classic and timeless, making it easy to style while still offering visual interest. Collectors appreciate how the Gel 1130 continues to bridge function and lifestyle, proving that authentic design does not need heavy modification to stay relevant across generations. The ASICS Gel 1130 White Blue GS was released on June 1, 2025 with a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Ceramic
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Ceramic made its return in 2020. Originally released in 2001, the Ceramic colorway was a part of the "Ugly Duckling" pack with fellow pack-mates the Veener and Plum, which have each seen a retro treatment in 2020. This weeks release brings back the nearly 10-year old colorway, giving fans of the OG pair a way to re-up or add it to their collection. Similar to the other colorways within the pack, the Nike Dunk Low Ceramic is composed of a premium suede upper. Orange appears throughout the upper with hits of black and green on the toe and Nike Swoosh. Lastly, a mesh tongue wraps the sneaker up, bringing it back in true original form. The Nike Dunk Low Ceramic released in November of 2020 for $100. The Nike Dunk Low Ceramic re-released in 2024.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Doernbecher Hugo
Description: Released as part of the Doernbecher Freestyle XIX Collection, the Jordan 3 Retro Doernbecher Hugo is the creation of Hugo Covarrubias Molina, drawing inspiration from his favorite NFL team  the Seattle Seahawks. The Doernbecher Hugo Jordan 3 Retros color scheme mirrors the iconic team colors and incorporates a navy leather upper adorned with gray elephant print overlays and a vibrant Slime Green drip pattern. Secured by glow-in-the-dark laces, the design includes a transparent heel tab showcasing Hugo's stylized logo, an embossed Jumpman, and his nickname, 'Juice.' The green-tinged translucent outsole reveals the uplifting message: 'Its OK to be different.' Adding a luxurious touch, a gold-plated hangtag serves as a pendant on a necklace. The Jordan 3 Retro Doernbecher Hugo stands out for its distinctive design, featuring Hugos unique style and nickname, 'Juice,' creatively integrated with a cool, dripping effect on the upper. This, along with the 24-carat gold-plated custom logo hangtag, contributes to the shoe's unparalleled and unique aesthetic. The sneaker debuted for $210 on December 2nd, 2023.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Reimagined (GS)
Description: The Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Reimagined (GS) delivers a bold twist on a classic, dressed in a striking dark powder blue and sail colorway made exclusively for grade school sizes. Built from a mix of smooth and tumbled leather, the UNC Reimagined (GS) Jordan 1 Retro High OG offers a blend of durability, support, and standout style. A crisp white leather and dark powdered blue base, perforated toe box, and padded collar enhance comfort and breathability for everyday wear. Signature touches include the stamped white Wings logo on the ankle collar and dark powder blue Swooshes across the side panels. Subtle Nike branding hits the tongue tag, insole, and outsole, tying the look together. A cushioned midsole provides lightweight responsiveness, while the rubber outsole with a pivot-point tread pattern ensures reliable grip on a variety of surfaces. The Jordan 1 Retro High OG UNC Reimagined (GS) stands out for its clean design, premium materials, and understated color blocking. It was released on May 10, 2025, with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Dark Marina Blue (GS)
Description: The kid-sized Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Dark Marina Blue (GS) for grade school sizes uses the colorway Dark Marina Blue/Black/White with heritage styling. The black leather upper features blue overlays and Swooshes. A black Wings logo appears on the blue collar overlay. The Nike Air logo and Swoosh is white on a blue tongue patch and blue on a white insole. Perforations on the black toebox, blue laces, a black tongue, a white midsole, and a blue outsole complete the look of this shoe. The kid-sized Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Dark Marina Blue GS was released on February 16, 2022, at a retail price of $130.

Display Name: New Balance 1906R White Black Metallic
Description: The New Balance 1906R White Black Metallic brings a classic and high contrast look to one of the brands most popular retro runners. The white base keeps the design clean, while black and metallic accents add sharp definition across the layered upper. The combination highlights the technical elements of the shoe, giving it a crisp and structured appearance. Fans appreciate this colorway because it leans into timeless contrast rather than bold experimentation. The balance of light and dark makes it versatile, while the metallic touches add just enough edge to keep it interesting. It is a reliable option within the 1906R lineup, appealing to those who value a clean and wearable take on a detailed silhouette. The New Balance 1906R White Black Metallic was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Pink Blast
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Pink Blast injects energy into the Vomero 5 through a bold contrast that feels modern and expressive. The black and anthracite base keeps the shoe sleek and grounded, while pink blast accents add sharp visual punch that brings the layered upper to life. Metallic touches enhance the technical feel, reinforcing the silhouettes roots in performance running design. Fans gravitate toward this colorway because it feels confident without being overwhelming. The Vomero 5 already stands out through structure and comfort, and the pink accents give it personality that feels intentional rather than flashy. Collectors love how Nike continues to push this silhouette into new territory, making it a go to option for those who want comfort, edge, and unmistakable Nike design in one package. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Pink Blast was released on April 20, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

Display Name: New Balance 1906L Rich Oak
Description: The New Balance 1906L Rich Oak is a stylish and versatile sneaker that combines modern design with classic comfort. Featuring a rich oak colorway with black accents, this shoe offers a sophisticated look that's perfect for both casual and semi-formal occasions. The upper is crafted with premium materials, ensuring durability and breathability for all-day wear. Engineered for optimal performance, the 1906L incorporates New Balance's innovative cushioning technology in the midsole, providing exceptional support and energy return with every step. The outsole is designed with a sturdy rubber compound, offering excellent traction on various surfaces. With its sleek silhouette and attention to detail, this sneaker seamlessly blends fashion and function. Our team thinks this product is great for those seeking a versatile sneaker that doesn't compromise on style or comfort. The New Balance 1906L Rich Oak is an excellent choice for individuals who appreciate quality craftsmanship and timeless design in their footwear.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Crenshaw Skate Club
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Crenshaw Skate Club features the classic low-top silhouette of the SB Dunk in a colorway inspired by the Crenshaw Skate Club, including a mix of earthy tones  Sail, light blue, and Cedar. The Crenshaw Skate Club Nike SB Dunk Low incorporates a Sail foundation adorned with cracked leather overlays, drawing inspiration from the iconic Crenshaw Square sign. Each tongue tag and back tab displays Nike and CSC branding in a mismatched manner, adding a unique touch to the design. Inside the tongue sits an illustration reminiscent of a daycare, and this graphic is repeated under the translucent rubber outsole, which features a subtle blue tint. The sneaker features light blue Swoosh logos on either side. Our experts love the Nike SB Dunk Low Crenshaw Skate Club and its unique colorway inspired by the Crenshaw Skate Club, a nod to the local skateboarding culture and community. This collaborative aspect and the earthy color palette set it apart from other SB Dunk releases. The sneaker debuted for $130 on August 5th, 2023.

Display Name: Jordan 8 Retro SP SoleFly Mi Casa Es Su Casa
Description: The Jordan 8 Retro SP SoleFly Mi Casa Es Su Casa represents a distinctive fusion of style and heritage, drawing inspiration from the Bandera de Cuba to celebrate Cuban culture. With a sail upper providing a neutral canvas, the SoleFly Mi Casa Es Su Casa Jordan 8 Retro SP design comes to life with vibrant colors, where golden accents introduce an element of elegance and red details infuse energy into the overall aesthetic. Exclusive branding elements like the SoleFly hangtag and lace tips contribute to the shoe's uniqueness. The chenille Jumpman tongue logo, a signature feature, stands prominently amid the rich blend of Sail and Fossil neutrals. Metallic Gold accents add a further layer of sophistication, concluding the design with an elegant touch. The standout characteristic of the Jordan 8 Retro SP SoleFly Mi Casa Es Su Casa lies in its captivating color scheme. Drawing inspiration from the Bandera de Cuba, these colors breathe vitality into the shoe, crafting a vibrant and meaningful tribute to Cuban heritage. The sneaker debuted for $225 on December 16th, 2023.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 90 USA (2025)
Description: The Nike Air Max 90 USA 2025 channels patriotic energy through a timeless running silhouette. Dressed in White with Cool Grey and University Red accents, the layered upper highlights the iconic paneling that defines the Air Max 90. The visible Air unit in the heel anchors the design in performance heritage while reinforcing its classic proportions. USA themed colorways always carry strong seasonal appeal, especially when tied to summer releases. The crisp white base keeps the look clean, while red and grey accents add subtle contrast without overpowering the silhouette. It feels sporty and versatile, a nod to national pride wrapped in one of Nikes most celebrated runners. The Nike Air Max 90 USA 2025 was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

Display Name: Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 Birch Green Red Yellow
Description: Meet the iconic Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66, now surfing the trend waves in the Birch Green/Red/Yellow colorway. This sneaker tells tales of legendary style, resurrected for the modern trailblazers. Presented in various shades, it brings together a perfect blend of birch green with hits of red and yellow, making it a timeless masterpiece. The upper, crafted with premium materials, reflects class and durability, setting it apart in the sneaker world.The design pays a harmonious tribute to the iconic Onitsuka Tiger stripe alongside the logo nestled on the tongue and the heel. Dive into the world where the past meets the present with this undeniable trendsetter. Released at a retail price of $120, the Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66 is an investment in timeless style.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Blueberry
Description: The ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Blueberry is an athletic running shoe fabricated with a Cream mesh upper. Blueberry and silver metallic overlay cages form the shoe's structure. The ASICS logo appears on the tongue, accented by Gel branding on the rear heel. A linear textured midsole in white with silver accents is finished with a gray outsole. Japanese sneaker brand ASICS is known for its running shoes, a sport that is evocative of their brand philosophy: sound mind with a sound body. The GEL-1130 style is derived from the Gel-1000 series, which debuted in 2008 and introduced ASICS' stability-geared fabrication and comfort. This innovation was so popular that it is still in use and informing future ASICS styles. Our experts feel that the best feature of the Gel-1130 Blueberry is its understated aesthetic, which has just the right amount of metallic pop. The ASICS Gel-1130 Cream Blueberry was released on January 1, 2025, and retailed for $95.

Display Name: Jordan 13 Retro Playoffs (2023)
Description: The Jordan 13 Retro Playoffs are making another return in 2023, its first appearance since its last retro in 2011. Michael Jordan debuted the Air Jordan 13 Playoffs in the 1998 NBA All-Star game, and continued to wear the sneakers throughout the season en route to his record breaking sixth NBA championship. ? ?Tinker Hatfield's original design for the Jordan 13 was inspired by Jordans aggressive play style, which was referred to as a Black Cat. The retro sneaker features black leather uppers, suede mudguards, and holographic eyes that sit below each collar. ? ?The Air Jordan 13 Retro Playoffs (2023) released February 18, 2023, with a retail price of $210.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Lower Merion Home
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Lower Merion Home continues the tribute through a reversed color scheme that mirrors the home uniform. The white base with team red accents creates a clean and classic look, emphasizing contrast while maintaining a strong link to Lower Merions identity. The silhouette remains unchanged, keeping the focus on the story behind the design. Fans appreciate how this version complements the away pair, offering a complete representation of Kobes high school era. The lighter palette gives it a more versatile feel, while still carrying the same cultural weight. Nike continues to use the Air Force 1 as a platform for storytelling, and this release reflects that approach with clarity. It is a respectful and well executed tribute to an important chapter in Kobes career. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Lower Merion Home was released on March 23, 2026 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Black Vintage Indigo
Description: The New Balance 9060 Black Vintage Indigo blends futuristic design language with retro running inspiration through a colorway that feels both bold and grounded. The black base anchors the silhouette, while vintage indigo accents add depth and contrast across the layered upper. The exaggerated sole unit gives the shoe its signature presence, creating a look that feels sculptural and forward thinking. Fans of the 9060 appreciate how it pushes beyond traditional runner aesthetics while still maintaining comfort and wearability. The combination of dark tones and subtle color shifts makes this version easy to style while still standing out. It is a sneaker that captures New Balances evolving design direction, balancing heritage influence with modern experimentation. The New Balance 9060 Black Vintage Indigo was released on July 14, 2023 with a retail price of $150.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Lemon Venom
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Lemon Venom radiates high energy through one of the boldest palettes in the lineup. Lemon Venom dominates the upper, creating an electric foundation that instantly commands attention. Hyper Crimson, Yellow, and Laser Orange accents intensify the look, while Blackened Blue and black details provide structure. The signature wavy cage design and visible Air cushioning remain central to its identity. Fans of expressive sneakers will find this release impossible to ignore. The bright color mix pushes the silhouette into statement territory, celebrating the daring spirit that defines the Plus series. Despite its vibrancy, the layered construction keeps everything cohesive and grounded. Loud, confident, and unmistakable, this pair captures the fearless essence of Air Max culture. The Nike Air Max Plus Lemon Venom was released on August 7, 2025 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: New Balance 1890 Joe Freshgoods Cut The Check
Description: The New Balance 1890 Joe Freshgoods Cut The Check represents another chapter in one of the most influential partnerships in modern sneaker culture. Known for blending storytelling with color and material, Joe Freshgoods brings a bold Red, Blue, and Pale Lime Green palette to the 1890 silhouette, creating a look that feels expressive and deeply rooted in community driven design. The model itself carries a performance inspired structure, but this collaboration shifts the focus toward lifestyle and narrative, giving the shoe a more personal identity. Fans gravitate toward Joe Freshgoods collaborations because they consistently deliver more than just colorways. Each release feels tied to a larger message about identity, heritage, and representation within sneaker culture. The vibrant color blocking on this pair gives it strong visual impact while still feeling thoughtfully balanced. New Balance continues to benefit from collaborations that push its silhouettes into new creative territory. For collectors, releases like this stand out because they combine storytelling, color, and cultural relevance into sneakers that feel meaningful beyond design alone. The New Balance 1890 Joe Freshgoods Cut The Check was released on April 24, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 12.1 Silver Ice Blue
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 121 Silver Ice Blue delivers cool tonal contrast through a Pure Silver base accented by Ice Blue and Cream. The layered construction emphasizes the silhouettes supportive framework, while the icy blue tones add freshness and subtle vibrancy. Underfoot, GEL cushioning keeps the focus on long lasting comfort and stability. This pair stands out because it leans into crisp, winter inspired hues while maintaining the Kayanos performance identity. The silver and ice blue pairing feels modern and refined, making it easy to style without losing technical presence. Fans of the model appreciate when color updates enhance rather than overshadow its structure. It is a clean and composed take on a stability icon built for both movement and everyday wear. The ASICS Gel Kayano 121 Silver Ice Blue was released on October 15, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Family Reunion Seongsu
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble 211 explores a more technical and layered palette, using a mix of greys and metallic tones to highlight the silhouettes structure. Photon dust, metallic silver, and dark smoke grey create a gradient that feels clean and futuristic, while off white and gym red accents introduce subtle contrast. The big bubble unit reinforces its connection to original Air Max innovation. This version appeals to fans who appreciate a more refined and slightly experimental take on the 95. The balance between metallic finishes and neutral tones gives it a distinct identity without straying too far from the models roots. It feels modern but still grounded in the DNA that made the Air Max 95 iconic. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble 211 was released on February 19, 2026 with a retail price of $190.
Colorway: Photon Dust/Metallic Silver/Dark Smoke Grey/Cool Grey/Off White/Gym Red

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Knicks
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Knicks sneaker can be found in a combination of university orange, old royal, white, as well as tech grey tone. This Retro Knicks version features a blue sock liner with some hits around its tongue and the eyelet. There is also a visible Air Jordan branding on this shoes heel. A classic Air Jordan 3 branding is displayed on the grey, white, and black outsole of this sneaker, and Nike´s AIR technology soles complete its design. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Knicks was first released to the market on September 21, 2019, and its recommended retail price was $190.

Display Name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 14 Thom Browne Black
Description: The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Thom Browne Black transforms a performance rooted silhouette into a refined collaboration that leans heavily into monochrome precision. The all black upper creates a sleek and uniform look, allowing the layered construction and paneling to stand out through texture rather than color. Thom Brownes influence brings a more tailored and intentional feel, elevating the Kayano 14 into a space that blends performance heritage with high fashion sensibility. Fans of both ASICS and Thom Browne appreciate how this collaboration avoids unnecessary flash, instead focusing on restraint and structure. The result feels deliberate, offering a version of the Kayano 14 that stands apart through subtlety rather than bold contrast. It is a pair that resonates with collectors who value craftsmanship and design language, bridging two worlds in a way that feels cohesive and elevated. The ASICS Gel Kayano 14 Thom Browne Black was released on March 2, 2026 with a retail price of $330.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Essential University Gold
Description: The Nike Air Max 1 Essential University Gold blends classic design with cushioned comfort, featuring a visible Max Air unit and a mixed material upper on the silhouette that debuted in 1987. The University Gold Nike Air Max 1 Essential has a white mesh base with light gray suede overlays on the midfoot and heel. The sneaker introduces University Gold accents on the leather mudguard and Swooshes, as well as branding embroidery on the heel. More University Gold hits the sock liner and branding patch on the tongue. The sneaker sits on a foam midsole housing a visible Max Air unit, with a speckled waffle rubber outsole and round toe cage capping off the design. What our experts love about the Nike Air Max 1 Essential University Gold is how the University Gold accents energize the sneaker. The bright yellow pops against the muted light gray and white, adding a vibrant contrast to the classic silhouette. The sneaker debuted on July 1, 2024, and sold for $140.

Display Name: New Balance 204L Pastel Pink
Description: The New Balance 204L Pastel Pink softens the bold 204L silhouette with a colorway that feels calm, playful, and surprisingly refined. The pastel pink finish transforms the shoe into something approachable and expressive, letting shape and texture shine without visual noise. It feels modern and fashion aware, designed for people who appreciate sneakers as part of personal style rather than just performance or heritage cues. Fans love this release because it shows how color can completely shift the mood of a design. The 204L keeps its strong proportions, but the gentle pink tone makes it feel lighter and more versatile. Collectors appreciate how New Balance continues to explore color and form in a way that feels natural rather than forced, creating sneakers that feel current and emotionally resonant. This pair stands out as a lifestyle piece that feels confident, creative, and easy to wear. The New Balance 204L Pastel Pink was released on November 18, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Family Reunion I-95
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Family Reunion Off Noir embraces a darker and more unified aesthetic while amplifying its cushioning heritage. Off Noir layers dominate the upper, flowing across the signature wave panels with black accents adding subtle depth. The enlarged visible Air units reinforce the Big Bubble theme, spotlighting the innovation that made the 95 legendary. The tonal approach gives the silhouette a sleek and commanding presence. Collectors who appreciate stealth driven colorways will find this release especially compelling. The monochromatic execution allows the sculpted design to stand out through shape and texture rather than contrast. It balances modern minimalism with historic performance energy. Refined yet powerful, this pair proves the Air Max 95 remains just as impactful in understated form. The Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Family Reunion Off Noir was released on February 19, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

Display Name: Nike Calm Slide Black
Description: Nike made a bold statement on July 14, 2023, dropping the Calm Slide in the slick Black colorway. A pure embodiment of understated cool, these slides speak volumes to the casual-yet-classy crowd. ? ?Designed with a soft, cushioned footbed, the slides promise unparalleled comfort. The sleek black upper gives off an aura of minimalist sophistication, with the Nike logo subtly debossed onto the outter side of the slide. Versatile and stylish, these slides are ready to accompany you wherever you go. ? ?Be it the beach, the city streets, or your own living room, these slides are all about that casual comfort. Making their bold mark on the world on July 14, 2023, the Nike Calm Slide in Black came with an affordable retail price of $50, proving that you don't need to break the bank for top-tier style.

Display Name: Nike ZoomX Vaporfly 3 Multi-Color
Description: The Nike ZoomX Vaporfly 3 Multi-Color is a vibrantly colored trainer featuring a comfortable chunky sole and an extremely lightweight, breathable mesh upper. It combines a modern angular design with vintage contours. These Multi-Color Nike ZoomX Vaporfly 3 trainers also have serious athletic credentials. The ZoomX unit provides elite levels of impact absorption and energy return. They're all-rounders, capable of getting you through anything from a marathon to a Saturday morning park run. A full-length carbon fiber fly plate both protects your foot and helps the shoe maintain its athletic rigidity. Extra padding has been added to the tongue to reduce lace pressure. The colorway features a blend of pink and luminous yellow, complemented by shades of cream, blue, and gray. Our StockX experts were very impressed by the performance of this trainer. It is a comfortable shoe to wear at home, boasting a modern design that belies its true capabilities. The unusual colorway and material blend make it a worthwhile collectible as well. The Nike ZoomX Vaporfly 3 Multi-Color was released on October 3, 2024, at a retail price of $260.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Tiffany & Co. 1837
Description: Nikes first-ever collaboration with Tiffany & Co. comes in the form of a luxurious Air Force 1. This updated take on the iconic basketball sneaker features elevated details that include a sterling silver piece on the heel, a suede upper, and a signature Tiffany Blue shade on a tumbled suede Swoosh. Additional elements such as a black soft leather lining and "tiffany" cursive branding on the tongue make these a rich and subtle pair of Air Force 1s. The Nike Air Force 1 Tiffany & Co. 1837 released in March of 2023 and retailed for $400.

Display Name: Nike Vomero Premium Pale Ivory Jade Horizon
Description: The Nike Vomero Premium Pale Ivory Jade Horizon takes a softer and more elevated approach, using a pale ivory sanddrift jade horizon black spruce palette that feels calm and layered. The premium construction enhances the overall look, giving the shoe a more refined presence while maintaining the cushioning and support that define the Vomero line. Collectors gravitate toward premium iterations like this because they offer a balance between performance and lifestyle appeal. The color palette feels natural and easy to style, while the materials add depth that becomes more noticeable up close. It works across different settings, delivering both comfort and a polished aesthetic. The Nike Vomero Premium Pale Ivory Jade Horizon was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gift of Mamba
Description: The Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gift of Mamba emerges in a striking Black/Black-University Gold colorway, showcasing a perfect blend of luxury and performance. The upper is crafted from light black suede, complemented by a faux snakeskin pattern on the mudguard, collar, and Swoosh, adding a touch of elegance and edge. The sneaker's design is a tribute to the late Kobe Bryant, featuring his iconic logo and signature in university gold for a regal effect. The heel counter proudly displays the number "24," debossed, symbolizing Kobe's legacy. The university gold accents stand out against the black suede, creating a visually impactful design. The Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gift of Mamba released on December 27, 2023, and retailed for $180, making it a must-have for both sneaker collectors and Kobe fans.

Display Name: Nike Sabrina 3 Gamer (Women's)
Description: The Nike Sabrina 3 Gamer Womens delivers electric contrast through a bold mix of Green Shock, Vapor Green, and Vivid Purple. Black accents ground the vibrant palette, while Neon Yellow highlights intensify the dynamic feel of the upper. The streamlined construction keeps the silhouette fast and agile, built for high tempo play. Every detail feels charged with movement and personality. This colorway speaks to players who bring flair and fearlessness to the court. The layered greens and purples create visual depth that stands out instantly. It blends competitive focus with expressive style, capturing the energy of a locked in gamer mindset. Loud and dynamic, this pair demands attention from tip off to final buzzer. The Nike Sabrina 3 Gamer Womens was released on October 16, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: New Balance 9060 Landslide Mushroom
Description: The New Balance 9060 Landslide Mushroom leans into earthy tones, combining landslide, mushroom, and incense hues to create a palette that feels natural and cohesive. The 9060 silhouette adds depth through its layered construction, allowing each color to stand out while still working together. The design balances bold structure with muted tones, giving the shoe a grounded but modern feel. Collectors gravitate toward colorways like this because they highlight how the 9060 can shift between loud and understated depending on execution. The earthy palette makes it versatile, while the silhouette keeps it visually engaging. It is a sneaker that reflects New Balances ability to experiment with color while maintaining a strong and recognizable form. The New Balance 9060 Landslide Mushroom was released on February 24, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

Model: Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP
Display Name: Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Action Green Altitude Green
Description: The Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Action Green Altitude Green is a performance shoe equipped with both Air Max and waffle technology. This iteration of the Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP has a lightweight textile upper in Action Green, allowing for breathability and flexibility. Suede overlays, also in green, form the toe cap, eyestays, and the sides of the heel. Black leather Nike Swooshes adorn both sides of the shoe. The heel counter and collar are made of black leather, with a Tuned Air logo and the Nike brand name appearing in Total Orange. The tongue also bears a Nike Air logo. An Air Max unit can be found under the heel, while the black outsole creeps up over the heel and forefoot with its waffle traction pattern. What stands out about this shoe is the fact that it combines the best elements of both types of technology, giving it even more function. The Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Action Green Altitude Green was released on November 14, 2024, for $140.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog LoveShackFancy Pink Milk (Kids)
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog LoveShackFancy Pink Milk Kids transforms the familiar clog silhouette through a soft and whimsical design approach tied to LoveShackFancys aesthetic. The pink milk colorway feels delicate and playful, bringing a lighter and more decorative energy to the typically casual Crocs form. It keeps the comfort and simplicity of the original while adding a more expressive identity. Fans of the collaboration appreciate how it introduces a different mood to the clog, making it more fashion oriented while still practical. The kids sizing makes it especially appealing for younger wearers, offering something that stands out without sacrificing comfort. It works as both a fun everyday shoe and a collectible tied to a recognizable partnership. The Crocs Classic Clog LoveShackFancy Pink Milk Kids was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $55.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Hyper Violet (GS)
Description: The Jordan 4 Retro Hyper Violet (GS) updates the Air Jordan 4 Retro silhouette with a white-on-white base and bold Hyper Violet accents. This sneaker boasts a white leather upper with layers of tonal panels on the sides. The rubber outside and TPU eyelets provide splashes of Hyper Violet, which complement the Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel. A patch of mesh peeks out from behind the leather panels and adds a contrasting texture to the otherwise smooth upper. The padded mid-cut collar and tongue contribute to the sneaker's bulky appearance; however, the thick midsole completes the chunky aesthetic. Finally, the white midsole houses visible air units that cushion against impact. Our StockX experts like the incorporation of semi-translucent rubber on the outsole because it gives the Hyper Violet depth of color. The grade school-sized Jordan 4 Retro Hyper Violet (GS) was released on April 26, 2024, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Christmas (2024)
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Christmas (2024) is a relaunch of the original Nike Kobe 9 Elite ÄúChristmasÄù from 2014 with modern upgrades. Like the original, the 2024 variation features a bold Christmas-inspired colorway that decks out the upper and sole unit in Bright Crimson accented by black and white. This time the basketball shoe is part of the Kobe Protro series, which updates classic Kobe models with modern tech. For instance, the upper is constructed from breathable Flyknit, while dynamic Flywire cables secure the midfoot area. Lightweight React foam replaces Lunarlon foam in the insole and carbon fiber paneling reinforces the responsive foam midsole. Our experts appreciate the contrast created by black on the Swoosh and KobeÄôs signature sheath logo. Black also appears on the midsole paneling. The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro Christmas (2024) was released on December 12, 2024, and retailed for $240.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Cherry (2022) (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro Cherry 2022 GS was introduced in the grade schoolers' (GS) catalog with a display of a two-tone colorway. The sneaker features Varsity Red glossy patent leather mudguards, a tonal leather overlay, and white ballistic mesh. For a tight fit, webbing eyelets on the rope laces are fed. The collar is embellished with a red Jumpman insignia, and the heel tab is decorated with a "23" inscription. An encased Air-sole unit is mounted on a white Phylon midsole, which is aided by a translucent rubber outsole for cushioning. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Cherry 2022 GS was released on December 10th, 2022. It originally retailed at $185.

Display Name: Jordan 14 Retro Black Toe (2024)
Description: The Jordan 14 Retro Black Toe (2024) is a triumphant return for the iconic AJ14 trainer. This updated design features premium materials, which gives it a stunning visual effect of sleek luxury. Its low-to-the-ground style was inspired by sports car ground effect aerodynamics. This Air Jordan 14 has been remodeled for the present day, with a mottled leather ice-white upper punctuated by wavy panels of midnight black. The sole has white claws reaching across the distinctive black toe to create a dramatic effect. The shoe also has the latest Nike Air Zoom cushioning unit. This shoe has always been special, being the model that Michael Jordan wore when he made his last basket in the NBA. Our reviewers not only appreciate the upgrade; they also find it irresistible collectible. It's a milestone trainer to have in one's collection. The Jordan 14 Retro Black Toe (2024) was released on 2 November 2024, priced at $210.

Display Name: Nike Flight Legacy White
Description: The Nike Flight Legacy White takes a retro silhouette and dresses it in an eye-catching colorway that pops. The White/University Red/Black version of the Nike Flight Legacy features an upper of Tumbled White leather with Tumbled White leather overlays. The mud guard is molded black synthetic material that gleams, while the black Swoosh on the collar is smooth black leather. Air Flight branding appears on the white tongue beneath white laces. The sock liner is red, and the insoles are black with red Nike branding. The Tumbled White leather heel sports red and black Nike Air branding. The white foam midsole features a visible Air unit, and the rubber outsole is red and black with Nike branding. The details our experts most appreciate concern the eyestays. The uppermost eyestays are made from molded red synthetics, and the remaining eyestays are textured black synthetic material. The Nike Flight Legacy White was released February 25th, 2021, for $90 retail.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Valentine's Day Treat Yourself (2025) (Women's)
Description: The Jordan 3 Retro Valentines Day Treat Yourself (2025) (Womens) is a love letter to sneaker enthusiasts who appreciate a perfect blend of style and nostalgia. Dressed in a luxurious washed coral leather upper, this special edition release stays true to the classic Jordan 3 silhouette while adding a romantic twist. The iconic elephant print appears on the mudguard and heel in a shimmering pink hue, creating a subtle contrast that elevates the overall design. Adding to its charm, gym red accents highlight the Jumpman logos and lower eyelets, giving the pair a striking pop of color. A standout feature is the set of two red jewel charmss, allowing wearers to personalize their look with a little extra sparkle. The midsole is finished in sail, complementing the pink upper, while a semi-translucent pink gum outsole provides the perfect finishing touch. Whether worn for a Valentine's date or simply as an everyday statement piece, this pair is a must-have for sneaker lovers. Released on February 1, 2025, the Jordan 3 Retro Valentines Day Treat Yourself (2025) (Womens) retailed at $200 and quickly captured the hearts of collectors and casual wearers alike. With its romantic washed coral, gym red, and sail colorway, this sneaker celebrates love and style in a way only Jordan Brand can.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Lisboa
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Lisboa pays tribute to Lisbon through a colorway that blends coastal brightness with urban edge. The white base feels clean and architectural, while game royal and varsity maize accents inject energy inspired by the citys vibrancy and football culture. The signature wavy cage and Tuned Air sole remain central, keeping the silhouette unmistakably Air Max Plus. Fans love this pair because it captures a sense of place without overexplaining it. The colors feel celebratory and confident, while the structure stays true to the models aggressive roots. Collectors appreciate city themed Air Max releases for their cultural storytelling, and this one stands out as a balanced homage that feels wearable, expressive, and deeply connected to global sneaker culture. The Nike Air Max Plus Lisboa was released on October 9, 2025 with a retail price of $185.

Model: Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP
Display Name: Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Black Anthracite
Description: The Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Black Anthracite might be a hybrid mix of the classic Air Max Plus and Waffle Racer silhouettes from Nike, but its making a name for itself as a special project within Nikes large catalog of styles. This Nike Air Max Waffle Racer boasts an upper inspired by the Waffle Racer while the sole is based on the Air Max Plus. Dressed in stealthy, anthracite black, this monochromatic sneaker only allows a blip of color via the red Nike Swoosh on the old-school tongue tag. As for materials, the black upper is made of nylon and sports tonal suede overlays and leather Swooshes on both sides. StockX experts would like to point out the unique design element of the rubber outsole waffle lugs and how they arent just limited to being underfoot but also adorn the toe cap area and climb the heel. Released on November 26, 2024, the Nike Air Max Waffle Racer SP Black Anthracite sold for a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Panda (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Panda (2023) (W) arrives in a white, black, and white color palette. The Low Panda Jordan 1 (2023) (W) has an upper that is constructed from durable materials, including a combination of supple leather and suede. The shoe's cushioned midsole and supportive collar ensure a comfortable fit. The outsole is made of a durable rubber material with a traditional tread pattern, providing traction and stability. The shoe's toe box is perforated for ventilation. The sneaker features black Swoosh branding on either lateral side, the Jumpman logo on the tongue, and the Air Jordan Wings logo on the heel. The womens rendition of the Air Jordan 1 Low Panda (2023) (W) was released on March 10, 2023, and sold for a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Miami Dolphins
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Miami Dolphins takes a classic sports shoe silhouette and dresses it in the iconic colors of the legendary NFL franchise. The Miami Dolphins colorway of the Nike Dunk Low-Top sports a base of white leather with the signature perforations in the toe box for breathability. Overlays adorn the upper in iconic Miami Dolphin turquoise that matches the sock liner that's padded at the collar. The orange leather Nike swoosh matches the orange heel tab with white Nike branding. White Nike branding appears on the turquoise insole, while turquoise Nike branding adorns the white tongue tag. What we enjoy most about this sneaker is the way the sole unit locks in the Miami Dolphins colors as well as the Nike Dunk dependability. A white foam midsole and turquoise rubber outsole provide impact absorption and traction for sports or everyday wear. The Nike Dunk Low Miami Dolphins was released on January 17, 2024, for a retail price of $115.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 1 Kasina Won-Ang Grey
Description: South Korean boutique Kasina honored its 25th Anniversary with the Nike Air Max 1 Kasina Wong-Ang Grey. Referencing Wong-Ang Ducks, a style of carved wooden ducks traditionally gifted to newlywed couples, the Nike Air Max 1 Kasina Wong-Ang Grey incorporates colors and materials that are said to bring good fortune in Korean culture. It features a premium teal tumbled leather upper with dark grey faux horsehair overlays and light grey suede mudguards. At the heel, small Wong-Ang Duck embroidery nods to the Korean wedding custom. From there, an icy, semi-translucent outsole revealing a geometric pattern on the bottom of the midsole completes the design. The Nike Air Max 1 Kasina Wong-Ang Grey released in June of 2022 and retailed for $160.

Display Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Sanddrift (Women's)
Description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Sanddrift Womens offers a warm and understated take on the Vomero 5, leaning into earthy tones that feel calm and wearable. Sanddrift and hemp hues soften the shoes technical build, while white and black accents maintain clarity and balance. The layered mesh and synthetic construction remains visually rich, giving the silhouette depth without relying on loud contrast. Fans love this release because it feels effortless. The Vomero 5s reputation for comfort makes it a daily favorite, and this colorway enhances that appeal with a palette that works across seasons and outfits. Collectors appreciate how Nike uses subtle color stories to elevate performance inspired silhouettes into lifestyle essentials, reinforcing why the Vomero 5 continues to resonate so strongly right now. The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Sanddrift Womens was released on June 20, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro World's Best Dad (GS)
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro Worlds Best Dad GS brings a heartfelt and lifestyle driven theme to one of the most celebrated silhouettes in Jordan Brand history. Built on the classic Air Jordan 3 foundation, the shoe combines Sail, Black, University Red, Pale Ivory, and Palomino tones to create a warm vintage inspired palette that feels personal and nostalgic rather than performance focused. The Air Jordan 3 remains iconic because of its visible Air cushioning, elephant print heritage, and direct connection to Michael Jordans rise in the late 1980s, and themed releases like this show how the silhouette continues evolving emotionally beyond basketball alone. Fans appreciate storytelling driven Jordan releases because they give familiar silhouettes a more personal identity while preserving the details that made them timeless in the first place. The Worlds Best Dad concept gives the pair a softer and more sentimental atmosphere compared to aggressive sport focused colorways, making it feel especially unique within the Jordan 3 lineup. Collectors also enjoy how the earthy neutral tones and vintage inspired colors make the shoe versatile for everyday wear while still standing out through subtle thematic details. The result feels thoughtful and expressive without sacrificing the heritage driven personality that defines the Jordan 3. The Air Jordan 3 Retro Worlds Best Dad GS was released on May 16, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

Display Name: Jordan 4 Retro Valentine's Day (2026) (TD)
Description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro Valentines Day 2026 TD translates the same festive palette into a toddler friendly format while preserving the models unmistakable shape. White anchors the upper, while Medium Soft Pink, Half Blue, and Vapor Green accents create layered contrast across the classic AJ4 paneling. Even in TD sizing, the structured build and signature details remain true to the original blueprint. This edition resonates because it introduces one of Jordan Brands most iconic silhouettes in a playful seasonal colorway for the youngest sneaker fans. The pastel tones feel cheerful and balanced, keeping the design bright without overpowering its heritage lines. Parents and collectors appreciate how faithfully the silhouette is adapted at a smaller scale. It is a compact celebration of a timeless classic. The Air Jordan 4 Retro Valentines Day 2026 TD was released on February 21, 2026 with a retail price of $85.

Display Name: Nike KD 4 Scoring Title (2025)
Description: Originally debuting in 2012, the Nike KD 4 Scoring Title (2025) commemorates Kevin Durants landmark accomplishment as the youngest NBA player to win three consecutive scoring titles, with this blue and yellow colorway celebrating his 2011-12 season award in particular. The Scoring Title (2025) Nike KD 4 features a mesh base and a synthetic upper in a dynamic blend of blue and yellow, a nod to KDs time with the Oklahoma City Thunder. Blue dominates most of the upper, with vibrant yellow accents appearing on key design elements, including the Swoosh, KDs logo, and an intricate pattern covering the collar, heel, and adjustable strap. Graphics on the tongue showcase the numbers 30.1, 27.7, and 28, KDs league-leading points per game average for the 2011-12 season. The sneaker sits atop a blue Phylon midsole housing Zoom Air cushioning, while a translucent rubber outsole completes the design. Our experts love how the Nike KD 4 Scoring Title (2025) pays homage to Kevin Durants historic achievement. The sneakers design elements, including colors, graphics, and tongue details, nod to his legendary scoring run with the Oklahoma City Thunder. The sneaker debuted for $130 on February 14th, 2025.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid Blue Void
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid Blue Void introduces bold contrast through a Blue Void upper accented by Summit White, Hot Lava, and Pure Platinum details. The mid cut silhouette offers slightly more coverage while maintaining the same iconic panel layout that made the AJ1 legendary. The deep blue foundation gives the shoe a commanding presence, while the brighter accents inject energy across the design. This colorway stands out because it balances depth and vibrancy. The mix of cool and warm tones creates layered dimension without overwhelming the structure. Fans of the Jordan 1 Mid appreciate when strong palettes refresh the silhouette while staying true to its basketball roots. It feels expressive and dynamic, delivering heritage influence with a modern twist. The Air Jordan 1 Mid Blue Void was released on November 1, 2025 with a retail price of $130.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Cactus Plant Flea Market White (2024)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Cactus Plant Flea Market White (2024) is one of Cactus Plant Flea Market (CPFM)s distinctive reinterpretations of the classic Air Force 1 Low. It features an all-white construction with quirky detailing that blends Nike and CPFMs house codes. Although the sneaker boasts a white-on-white color scheme, the colorway actually includes white and Light Bone, which is slightly warmer. The upper is crafted from smooth and texturized leather, creating a subtle contrast. The right shoe features "AIR" in bubble letters on the outer side panel, while "SUNSHINE" wraps around both sides of the left shoe. The signature Swoosh logo can be found behind the bubble lettering and over the leather overlays. Nike branding decorates the heel tab and the tongues logo tag. Our experts like light padding around the collar, which bulks up the shoes silhouette. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Cactus Plant Flea Market White (2024) was released on May 7, 2024, and retailed at $150.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Triple Stack Sail Coconut Milk (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple Stack Sail Coconut Milk Womens elevates the classic low top through exaggerated tooling and a soft Sail and Coconut Milk palette. The triple stacked sole adds height and presence, transforming the familiar AJ1 shape into something more fashion forward while keeping its heritage lines intact. Anthracite accents provide subtle contrast, grounding the creamy upper with a touch of depth. This version stands out because it blends elegance with attitude. The neutral tones make it easy to style, while the amplified sole gives the silhouette a bold and contemporary feel. Fans of the Jordan 1 appreciate when the model evolves through proportion rather than drastic redesign. It feels refined yet expressive, offering a womens exclusive take that balances timeless color with elevated structure. The Air Jordan 1 Low Triple Stack Sail Coconut Milk Womens was released on January 1, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

Display Name: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Black Bright Crimson
Description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Black Bright Crimson channels pure on court aggression through a colorway that feels fast, focused, and unapologetic. The GT Cut silhouette was built for sharp guards and constant movement, and the black base paired with bright crimson accents gives it a serious competitive edge. Every curve and panel feels intentional, reinforcing the shoes identity as a tool for players who rely on speed, control, and split second reactions rather than flash. Fans love this pair because it feels locked in. The color contrast highlights the shoes low profile shape and responsive design, making it feel aggressive without being chaotic. Collectors appreciate how the GT Cut represents a modern era of basketball footwear, where performance drives design first. This version stands out as a no nonsense option that still carries visual punch, appealing to hoopers who want their footwear to look as sharp as it performs. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Black Bright Crimson was released on December 3, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: New Balance 2002R Protection Pack White
Description: The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack White refines the deconstructed aesthetic that made the Protection Pack a modern cult favorite. Wrapped in layered White panels with subtle Silver Metallic accents, the upper carries that signature raw edge look through exposed foam and jagged overlays. The 2002R base keeps the silhouette grounded in early 2000s running heritage while pushing it into contemporary territory. The Protection Pack series changed how people viewed archival New Balance models, turning understated runners into statement pieces through texture alone. In an all White execution, the distressed detailing feels even more pronounced, giving depth without relying on bold color blocking. For fans who appreciate subtle experimentation, this pair delivers complexity in the cleanest possible palette. The New Balance 2002R Protection Pack White was released on November 3, 2025 with a retail price of $170.

Display Name: Puma Speedcat OG Pelé Yellow Black
Description: The Puma Speedcat OG Pele Yellow Black brings football heritage into the Speedcat line, using a pelé yellow black palette that directly references one of the sports most legendary figures. The low profile silhouette remains consistent, while the color choice adds cultural weight to the design. Fans of football and Puma history appreciate releases like this for their connection to iconic athletes. The bright yellow gives it strong visual identity, making it instantly recognizable. It stands as both a wearable sneaker and a tribute piece tied to the legacy of Pelé. The Puma Speedcat OG Pele Yellow Black was released on February 6, 2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low Alexis Sablone Chameleon
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Alexis Sablone Chameleon is a creative collaboration between Nike SB and pro skateboarder, Alexis Sablone. Known for her unique style both on and off the board, Sablone draws inspiration from chameleons for this standout design. The sneaker features an oil green, desert moss, and white colorway with chameleon-like color-shifting panels and scale-textured overlays that make it truly one-of-a-kind. The playful design is a nod to the ever-evolving world of skateboarding and style. The Nike SB Dunk has been a cultural icon since its debut in the early 2000s, blending performance features with a design that has transcended the skate world. This latest iteration continues that legacy, featuring Sablones logo on the heel and interior of the sneaker. The green scale overlays reveal a purple layer underneath, adding a dynamic touch that changes as the shoes wear in.
