This mix of artistry, functionality, and personal expression makes the Alexis Sablone Chameleon Dunk an instant classic that appeals to skaters and sneaker enthusiasts alike. Released on August 22, 2024, the Nike SB Dunk Low Alexis Sablone Chameleon retailed at $135. Its oil green, desert moss, and white colorway, combined with the unique wear-and-reveal feature, ensures this sneaker is more than just a stylish pieceit's a statement. Whether youre skating or simply making a fashion statement, this collaboration captures the essence of both skate culture and Sablones creative spirit.

Model: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro
Display Name: Nike Kobe 9 Low Protro Orange Frost Brilliant Orange Summit White Ice Peach
Description: The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro WNBA is a May 2026 release timed to the WNBA's 30th anniversary season opener, featuring an Orange Frost and Ice Peach gradient upper transitioning from the WNBA logo orange toward the back to a lighter peachy tone toward the front, with Brilliant Orange Swooshes and matching lace details sharpening the presentation against the Summit White midsole and outsole that keeps the warm palette balanced. The WNBA colorway continues the Nike Kobe line's deeply meaningful association with women's basketball  a connection built through Kobe Bryant's vocal advocacy for the WNBA throughout his career, his attendance at games, and his profound commitment to his daughters' athletic development, making the Kobe line's seasonal WNBA colorway one of the most emotionally resonant releases in the annual Kobe retro calendar. The Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro features an Engineered Mesh upper for breathability, a Nike React foam midsole replacing the original Lunarlon cushioning, a cable lacing system, and the original Kobe 9's legendary fingerprint outsole traction pattern with updated grip performance, with Bryant's signature, the Kobe Code, and the iconic heel stitches all present in tribute to the original design. Released May 8, 2026 at $190 retail through Nike and select retailers globally in adult and Grade School sizing with style code IM6119-800. The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro WNBA was released on May 8, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Command Summit White
Description: The Nike Air Max Command Summit White is a 2025 general release of Nike's mid-2000s basketball-influenced lifestyle silhouette, featuring a combination of leather and mesh across the upper in Summit White with black Swoosh, heel, and outsole accents and Pure Platinum tonal overlays, building on the Air Max Command's design language that draws from late-1990s and early-2000s Nike basketball aesthetics to produce a bulkier, Heritage-adjacent silhouette in the Air Max family. The Air Max Command features a visible Max Air heel unit for cushioning, padded collar for ankle support, a rubber waffle outsole pattern, and the layered panel construction across the upper that gives the model its distinctive technical appearance. The Summit White colorway is the most clean and broadly wearable expression of the Command, with the near-white base complemented by the black accents creating the crisp neutral palette that makes the shoe versatile across casual outfits regardless of season. The Air Max Command originally launched in 2011 and has been periodically restocked in general-release colorways, positioning it as an accessible retro Nike Basketball lifestyle shoe at a lower price point than the heritage running silhouettes in the Air Max catalog. Released October 24, 2025 at $110 retail with style code 629993-102 via nike.com and select retailers. The Nike Air Max Command Summit White was released on October 24, 2025 with a retail price of $110.

Display Name: Converse Chuck 70 Low Noah True Blue
Description: The Converse Chuck 70 Low Noah True Blue reimagines a classic silhouette through Noahs refined and thoughtful design approach, bringing a deeper tone to the iconic Chuck 70. The true blue white colorway feels rich and understated, allowing the premium canvas and vintage inspired construction to shine. It stays close to the original DNA while adding subtle adjustments that elevate the overall feel. Collectors appreciate Noah collaborations for their attention to detail and respect for heritage. This pair carries that philosophy, offering a version of the Chuck 70 that feels slightly more intentional and curated. It fits seamlessly into everyday wear while still standing out through its color and craftsmanship, making it a strong addition for those who value classic sneakers with a refined edge. The Converse Chuck 70 Low Noah True Blue was released on March 27, 2026 with a retail price of $112.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Hand Crafted
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Hand Crafted features a white leather upper with multicolor leather and Durabuck overlays for a unique look. From there, Wings logo collar patches and two-tone laces add a DIY feel. The Air Jordan 1 Hand Crafted released in December of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentine's Day University Red (2026) (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentines Day University Red 2026 embraces bold color with a confident, monochromatic approach. University Red covers the upper from toe to heel, creating a vibrant presence that instantly commands attention. Black detailing adds depth and structure, highlighting the signature lines of the Air Force 1 silhouette. The classic low cut build ensures the design remains grounded in decades of cultural relevance. Seasonal releases often play with theme, and this pair leans fully into expressive energy. The all red execution feels passionate and eye catching, making it a standout choice for those who appreciate statement sneakers. At the same time, the timeless construction keeps it wearable long after the holiday passes. It is a confident reinterpretation of an enduring classic. The Nike Air Force 1 Low Valentines Day University Red 2026 was released on January 14, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Mid SE Black Flax
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Black Flax blends bold contrast with autumn inspired tones. Built in Black with Varsity Red, Sail, and Flax accents, the mid cut silhouette highlights layered textures and strong color blocking. The classic Wings logo and padded collar reinforce its connection to the original Air Jordan lineage. Mid versions of the AJ1 have carved out their own following thanks to versatile height and fresh seasonal palettes. The flax detailing adds warmth against the darker base, while red hits provide sharp contrast. It feels balanced and expressive, offering a contemporary take on one of the most recognizable basketball silhouettes ever created. The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Black Flax was released on October 1, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

Display Name: Nike SB PS8 Wolf Grey White Black
Description: The Nike SB PS8 Wolf Grey White Black represents Nike SB pushing forward with a modern skate silhouette that feels streamlined and intentional. The PS8 design is cleaner and more minimal than classic SB Dunks, and the wolf grey palette reinforces that approach with a neutral and technical look. It feels contemporary and focused, built for skaters who want performance without visual noise. Fans love this release because it feels like evolution rather than replacement. The PS8 does not try to mimic older SB models, instead carving out its own identity through shape and simplicity. Collectors appreciate how Nike SB continues to innovate while staying true to skate needs, making this shoe appealing to people who care about function, durability, and understated style rather than nostalgia alone. The Nike SB PS8 Wolf Grey White Black was released on May 22, 2025 with a retail price of $120.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Low Ruby (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Low Ruby Womens blends heritage design with rich color through a Sail base accented by Varsity Red and Team Red tones. The layered red hues give the upper warmth and dimension, while the low cut construction keeps the silhouette sleek and wearable. Classic Jordan branding reinforces the connection to the models storied basketball roots. This release stands out because it balances elegance and boldness. The ruby inspired palette feels expressive without straying too far from traditional Jordan color blocking. Fans gravitate toward pairs like this for their ability to refresh the AJ1 Low through strong but refined contrast. It is a confident womens exclusive that keeps the legacy alive through thoughtful color execution. The Air Jordan 1 Low Ruby Womens was released on May 1, 2024 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Atmosphere (Women's)
Description: The women's Air Jordan 1 High Atmosphere follows the classic Black Toe color blocking format with a white and dark navy leather upper. Light pink patent leather on the ankle and vamp nods to the pink bubblegum that Michael Jordan chewed throughout his time on the hardwood. Woven Nike tongue labels and a signature Jordan Wings logo draw inspiration from the original 1985 Jordan 1 design. The women's Air Jordan 1 High Atmosphere released in December of 2021 and retailed for $170.

Display Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Team USA World Cup
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Team USA World Cup connects the iconic silhouette to a global sports moment through a colorway inspired by Team USA. The white base is accented with midnight navy, university red, and metallic gold, creating a palette that feels patriotic and celebratory. The design keeps the structure familiar while adding a sense of occasion. This pair stands out because it ties the Air Force 1 to a larger cultural event. World Cup themed releases often carry extra energy, and this version reflects that through its color choices. It is a collectible option that still works as an everyday sneaker. The Nike Air Force 1 Low 07 LV8 Team USA World Cup was released on March 23, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

Display Name: Nike Ja 3 Hustle & Flow (GS)
Description: Nike Ja 3 Hustle and Flow GS translates Ja Morants mindset into a youthful and expressive colorway that still carries serious energy. Hustle and Flow is about balance, mixing effort and instinct, and that idea comes through in the layered tones and dynamic feel of the design. Even in grade school sizing, the shoe feels fast and confident, built to stand out without losing purpose. What draws collectors to this pair is how closely it mirrors Jas personality. The Ja 3 silhouette thrives on movement, and this colorway amplifies that sense of rhythm and drive. It feels fun and motivational, appealing to fans who love sneakers that tell a story about attitude and ambition rather than just performance specs. The Nike Ja 3 Hustle and Flow GS was released on 09/10/2025 with a retail price of $100.

Display Name: UGG Tasman II Slipper Black (Women's)
Description: UGG Tasman II Slipper Black Womens represents everyday comfort elevated through thoughtful design that prioritizes warmth and ease. The black colorway gives this classic UGG slipper a versatile foundation that works naturally with loungewear and casual wear alike, while the upgraded materials and soft footbed make every step feel intentional. Its the sort of slipper that becomes part of the rhythm of everyday life rather than just another item in a closet. Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Georgetown
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Georgetown arrives with a smooth grey leather upper with Midnight Navy overlays and Swooshes. From there, matching woven Nike Air tongue tags, heel tabs, and Air soles complete the retro design. The Nike Dunk Low Georgetown releases in November of 2021 and retails for $100.

Model: Rick Owens DRKSHDW Lido Low Sneaks
Display Name: Rick Owens DRKSHDW Lido Low Sneaks Black Milk
Description: The Rick Owens DRKSHDW Lido Low Sneaks Black Milk is a low-top profile in black and milk-colored cotton barre with a shark-tooth rubber sole. The raw-edge collar and Gimp eyelets frame the foot, and the traction elements and organic cotton feel make them more comfortable. Here at StockX, one thing we love about these sneakers is the GOTS-certified cotton barre fabric, which offers a washed hand feel, and the shark-tooth rubber outsole that gives you multi-directional grip. The Rick Owens DRKSHDW Lido Low Sneaks Black Milk retailed at $570 when it was first released on March 26th, 2024.

Display Name: Crocs Classic Clog One Piece Tony Tony Chopper
Description: The Crocs Classic Clog One Piece Tony Tony Chopper centers around one of the series most beloved characters, bringing Choppers personality into a colorful and character driven design. The multi color palette reflects his recognizable look, creating a clog that feels playful and instantly identifiable. The collaboration highlights how Crocs continues to push into pop culture, creating footwear that doubles as a collectible. It is a piece that blends comfort with personality, appealing to fans who want something both functional and meaningful. The Crocs Classic Clog One Piece Tony Tony Chopper was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $70.

Display Name: Jordan 9 Retro Cool Grey (2025) (GS)
Description: The Jordan 9 Retro Cool Grey (2025) (GS) is a highly anticipated release that brings back a beloved colorway for the younger sneaker enthusiasts. This grade school edition features a sleek medium grey upper complemented by white and cool grey accents, creating a versatile and stylish look. The shoe's design incorporates the classic elements of the Air Jordan 9, including the distinctive sole pattern and the embroidered Jumpman logo on the heel. Built for both style and comfort, these sneakers boast a durable construction with a combination of leather and synthetic materials. The padded collar and tongue provide support for growing feet, while the Air-Sole unit in the heel offers responsive cushioning. With its timeless color scheme and iconic silhouette, the Jordan 9 Retro Cool Grey (2025) (GS) is set to become a must-have for young Jordan fans and collectors alike. Us at StockX believe this product is great for kids who want a classic Jordan look with modern comfort and durability.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Plus Black Sapphire White
Description: The Nike Air Max Plus Black Sapphire White is a spring-ready and chromatically sharp execution of Sean McDowell's 1998 silhouette, one of the Air Max Plus's most convincingly gradient-faithful releases in the Spring 2026 seasonal program, pairing a black-to-Sapphire mesh upper with the model's iconic wavy TPU overlays and Tuned Air cushioning in a color story that recalls the original Air Max Plus's coastal Florida sunset inspiration while translating it into a cooler, more urbane tone. The Air Max Plus introduced Nike's Tuned Air technology in 1998 and has been known as the TN among fans outside the United States ever since, a designation that reflects both the technology and the silhouette's enduring cultural presence in streetwear communities across Europe, Australia, and globally. McDowell's original design was inspired by Florida's palm trees and coastal sunsets, with the wavy TPU overlays referencing ocean waves and the whale tail arch shank adding another nautical element to the shoe's construction, a design vocabulary that the Black Sapphire colorway honors by applying the gradient technique the silhouette was built to carry to a Sapphire blue tone that sits in the ocean-adjacent cool spectrum. Across the upper, the mesh transitions from Pure Platinum into Sapphire blue in the kind of smooth, almost liquid gradient that recalls earlier TN colorways while feeling controlled and contemporary in its 2026 execution. The glossy black TPU ribs cut across the sides, restoring the aggressive lines that define the silhouette, while black carries through the mudguard, laces, and tongue. Beneath, visible Air units sit inside the sculpted midsole with faint blue tinting, and small Tuned Air hits in yellow and red quietly nod to the model's late 1990s lineage. Style code DM0032-031. The Nike Air Max Plus Black Sapphire White is the Spring 2026 TN for the collector who wants the silhouette's ocean-referencing gradient tradition executed in its coolest and most controlled blue-toned colorway of the season. The Nike Air Max Plus Black Sapphire White was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $180.

Display Name: Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue (2025) (TD)
Description: Air Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue 2025 TD introduces one of the most iconic Jordan color stories to the smallest size range while keeping its bold personality intact. The contrast between deep black and vivid gamma blue gives the shoe a futuristic edge that instantly highlights the sleek Air Jordan 11 silhouette. Even in toddler sizing, the design feels confident and unmistakable. For collectors, this release represents continuity across generations. The Gamma Blue story has long been associated with confidence and modern flair, and seeing it translated into TD form reinforces the timelessness of the design. It feels symbolic, connecting legacy colorways to new beginnings in a way that sneaker fans find especially meaningful. The Air Jordan 11 Retro Gamma Blue 2025 TD was released on 12/13/2025 with a retail price of $90.

Display Name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Khaki (Women's)
Description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Khaki Womens is the kind of women's exclusive drop that immediately gets men checking size run availability, and for good reason: this colorway is built on material choices and tonal layering that the Jordan 1 does not explore often enough in its mainline releases. Arriving during Jordan Brand's 40th anniversary year for the Air Jordan 1 silhouette, this pair lands as one of the most premium feeling general release colorways of the entire 2026 celebration calendar. The upper opens with soft tan nubuck on the toe box and heel paneling, building a rich and textured foundation that changes under different lighting and catches the eye in a way that smooth leather never quite manages. Textured white leather on the side panels and toebox creates quiet contrast between adjacent sections, and the combination of nubuck, leather, and canvas across the upper gives the shoe a genuinely elevated material story that rewards close inspection. Khaki suede overlays on the eyestay and collar pull the palette toward an earthy military inflection without ever leaving lifestyle territory, while the Sail midsole brings a vintage cream tone that keeps the base from reading too bright or too sharp against the warm upper. Cargo Khaki and Coconut Milk tones round out the full color build on the outsole and inner lining details, and the Pecan accent on select branding elements adds one final warm note that makes every element feel considered rather than assembled. The high cut collar with padded ankle support provides the structural fit that made the Jordan 1 a basketball shoe before it became a cultural artifact, and plush cushioning underfoot makes this a pair you can wear all day without the shoe reminding you it is there. Women's exclusive Jordan 1s at this material and design tier tend to move quickly on and after release, and the Khaki colorway specifically slots into the kind of neutral-leaning earth tone space that has driven the most consistent resale interest in the Jordan 1 market across the last several seasons. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Khaki Womens was released on May 23, 2026 with a retail price of $185.

Display Name: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Patent (Women's)
Description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Patent Womens brings a sleek and glossy update to the classic silhouette, using patent detailing to create a more elevated and eye catching look. The black base keeps the design cohesive, while reflective silver and metallic elements add contrast and depth. The big bubble Air unit reinforces the models original identity while giving it a slightly updated feel. Fans are drawn to this pair because it combines the familiar Air Max 95 structure with a more refined and fashion forward finish. The patent elements add a layer of shine that sets it apart from standard versions, making it feel more distinctive. It stands as a strong option for those who want a classic silhouette with a polished twist. The Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Patent Womens was released on July 28, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

Display Name: Jordan 3 Retro Fragment
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Fragment is the follow up to the very popular 2015 Air Jordan 1 collaboration. Fans waited patiently for Fragments founder Hiroshi Fujiwara to drop a new collaboration with Jordan Brand, after a slew of other collaborations with other entities such as Louis Vuitton, Anti-Social Social Club, and Pokemon. The Air Jordan 3 Fragment brings the lighting bolt brand back to a classic Jordan model. Following Hiroshi Fujiwaras love for simplistic motifs, the Air Jordan 3 Fragment comes dressed in white and black. The upper features a primarily white leather upper with a black full-grain leather mudguard. This collaboration replaces the Elephant print that typically appears on a Jordan 3 with plush black leather embossed with the Fragment lighting bolt logo. The sneakers white midsole has the colorways style code and release date printed in black text. To show true unison between the two brands, the Fragments lighting bolt logo appears behind a translucent Jumpman, in a similar fashion to Augusts Fire Red Denim 3s. The Air Jordan 3 Fragment dropped in September of 2020 for $200.

Display Name: Nike Air Max Goadome Black Pony Hair
Description: The Nike Air Max Goadome Black Pony Hair blends rugged outdoor heritage with unexpected texture. Known for its boot inspired construction, the Goadome arrives here in an all Black finish, elevated by pony hair detailing that adds depth and attitude to the upper. The thick outsole and sturdy build give it a commanding presence, far removed from lightweight runners but still connected to the broader Air lineage. Collectors appreciate the Goadome for its cult status within the Air Max universe. It has long been associated with harsh weather durability and East Coast street culture, and this pony hair execution adds a premium twist to that tough identity. It feels bold, unapologetic, and built to stand out in colder seasons when most sneakers retreat. The Nike Air Max Goadome Black Pony Hair was released on December 11, 2025 with a retail price of $230.

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk Low City of Cinema
Description: The Nike SB Dunk Low City of Cinema is a low-top athletic shoe featuring a Celestial Gold leather upper with a mottled finish, accented by the Nike Swoosh in black on the sides. The tongue and heel collar are done in Dark Team Red crushed velvet, accented by coordinating laces and Nike branding in Baroque Brown and Gold. An Armory Navy heel tab displays embroidered Nike branding, while the Baroque Brown outsole coordinates the aesthetic. The Nike Dunk has evolved from a university sports shoe into a staple within Nike SB, the American sneaker brands skateboarding collection. In honor of the Olympic Games 2024, held in Paris, France, Nike released the City of Cinema Dunk Low, which features an aesthetic that recalls the decor of classic Parisian theaters. In our opinion, the best feature of these shoes is their velvet accents, which are not a common fabrication in sneakers. The Nike SB Dunk Low City of Cinema was released on October 10, 2024, and retailed for $125.
Colorway: Celestial Gold/Black/Dark Team Red/Armory Navy/Baroque Brown/Gold

Display Name: Nike SB Dunk High Strawberry Cough (Regular Box)
Description: Designed by Nike SB legend Todd Bratrud, the Nike SB Dunk High Strawberry Cough is composed of red ostrich-textual leather with shaggy green suede overlays and a green velour collar. From there, a graphic of a strawberry coughing embroidered on the heel and a semi-translucent sole add a custom feel. The Nike SB Dunk High Strawberry Cough released in October of 2021 and retailed for $110.

Display Name: Nike Dunk Low Valerian Blue
Description: The Nike Dunk Low Valerian Blue arrives in a smooth white leather construction with deep Valerian Blue overlays and Swooshes. Hits of red on the woven tongue label and heel embroidery add a subtle contrast. At the base, a matching white and blue Air sole completes the design. The Nike Dunk Low Valerian Blue released in May of 2022 and retailed for $100.
